steps out of the laboratory.
fields.JP:
お父さんはあんな感じで研究バカだから、
普段はほとんど研究室から出ないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad's a research nut, so he rarely
steps out of the laboratory.

fields.EN:
He's a little better about it now,
apparently, but back then even some
people in Dawn didn't know who Dad was.
fields.JP:
今じゃ少しはマシになったらしいけど、昔は
黎明の人でもお父さんのこと、知らない人も
いたくらいなんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's a lot more straight-laced
now, but he was supposedly quite
the character back in the day.

fields.EN:
If that's the case, we shouldn't
bother him much.
fields.JP: じゃあ……あんまり邪魔しない方がいいよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's the case, we shouldn't
bother him much.

fields.EN:
Mmm... I think he's back to doing
work or something by now.
fields.JP:
んー。確かにもう、仕事に戻ってるんじゃ
ないかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I think he's back to doing
work or something by now.

fields.EN:
I see... Well, we did just speak
with him, so it's probably best to
leave him alone for now.
fields.JP:
そう……
それなら今、話をさせて頂いたばかりだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Well, we did just speak
with him, so it's probably best to
leave him alone for now.

fields.EN:
I'd be happy if you did that, at
least for now. Now then...
fields.JP:
そうしてくれると助かるかな！
それじゃあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd be happy if you did that, at
least for now. Now then...

fields.EN:
The Liberated District has all kinds of
facilities. I think you've been to Miko-san's
already; you can handle most things here.
fields.JP:
この解放地区にはいろいろな施設があってね、
視子さんのところはもう行ったと思うけど、
だいたいのことはここでできるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are a lot of facilities in
the Liberated District. You saw 
Miko's, but there are still more.

fields.EN: Now then, let me show you the way!
fields.JP: じゃあ、早速中を案内しよっか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, let me show you the way!

fields.EN:
Let's see... You can get all your
basic needs here! Even things to
help with battle...
fields.JP:
えーと、ここで生活必需品から変なものまで
たいていのものは揃うからね！
もちろん作戦行動に必要なものも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see... You can get all your
basic needs here! Even things to
help with battle...

fields.EN: ...or that's what I was going to say.
fields.JP: ……って言おうと思ったんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, it would help if
someone was here to confirm what I
said...

fields.EN:
She must be slacking off
somewhere...
fields.JP: ……ったく、またサボってどっか行ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
She must be slacking off
somewhere...

fields.EN:
She works at this store, but
she's also working as an
assistant to Haru-san.
fields.JP:
ああ、一応ここで店をやってる子なんだけどさ。
あの子、ハルさんの助手もやってるんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She works at this store, but
she's also working as an
assistant to Haru.

fields.EN:
Huh... It sounds like she's really
busy.
fields.JP: へぇ……結構忙しい人なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... It sounds like she's really
busy.

fields.EN:
So it's a case of 'those
who don't work don't eat,' then...
fields.JP:
『働かざるもの、食うべからず』というわけ
かしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She must have to work her
fingers to the bone...

fields.EN:
Heh... Well, not really. In any
case, she's a good kid, so I hope
the three of you can get along.
fields.JP:
あはは……そういう感じでも無いんだけどさ、
まぁ、悪い子じゃないから仲良くしてやってよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Well, not really. In any
case, she's a good kid, so I hope
the three of you can get along.

fields.EN:
When I find her, I'll let her know
to come back and man her post.
fields.JP:
あたしからも、ちゃんと仕事するように
言っとくからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I find her, I'll let her know
to come back and man her post.

fields.EN:
Okay. I guess we'll be coming
here again, then.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. I guess we'll be coming
here again, then.

fields.EN:
Well, of course she's not here.
She was with Haru-san just earlier.
fields.JP:
……ま、いるわけないか。
さっきハルさんのとこにいたもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, of course she's not here.
She was with Haru just earlier.

fields.EN:
(Oh, so it was that girl from
before...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, so it was that girl from
before...)

fields.EN: Um, so Clara-san manages the store?
fields.JP: その……くららさんが、お店をやっているの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, so Clara manages the store?

fields.EN:
Yup. She's a lot more reliable
than she looks. And she's somehow
able to procure supplies, as well.
fields.JP:
うん、そう。
あれで結構しっかりしててね。
どこからか品物を仕入れてくるんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. She's a lot more reliable
than she looks. And she's somehow
able to procure supplies, as well.

fields.EN:
Wow... That's really something,
coming from a kid like her.
fields.JP: へぇ……小さいのに偉いんだなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow... That's really something,
coming from a kid like her.

fields.EN:
Stop in to see her every so often,
would you?
fields.JP: ま、時々顔出してやってよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop in to see her every so often,
would you?

fields.EN:
Looks like she's not back yet... I
can't believe she left the place
wide open like this...
fields.JP:
……やっぱりまだ戻ってないみたいだね。
全く、店を放り出して呑気なもんなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like she's not back yet... I
can't believe she left the place
wide open like this...

fields.EN:
Ahaha... I guess we'll have to
stop by later.
fields.JP: あはは……また来てみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahaha... I guess we'll have to
stop by later.

fields.EN:
Well, as you can see, we fidget
with weapons and things here.
fields.JP:
見てわかるだろうが、ここでは武器だの
なんだのを日々考案改良してるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, as you can see, we fidget
with weapons and things here.

fields.EN:
If you wanna strengthen or
maintain your weapons, come see
me. It'll help in the long run.
fields.JP:
武器のメンテだの強化だのをしたかったら、
いつでも来るんだな。
まあ、こまめにやった方がいいぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you wanna strengthen or
maintain your weapons, come see
me. It'll help in the long run.

fields.EN:
(I guess it doesn't concern me
much...)
fields.JP: （僕にはあんまり関係ないかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess it doesn't concern me
much...)

fields.EN:
Hey, kiddo. Don't look so gloomy.
You never know what might happen!
fields.JP:
……おい坊主。
しけた顔してんじゃねぇぞ。
いつ何があるか、わかんねえからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, kiddo. What's with that look
on your face? Take things a bit
more seriously, will ya?!

fields.JP: キャスケットの女の子

fields.EN:
Don't "ugh" me. You need to man
the store. This isn't your den,
you know?
fields.JP:
『げっ』じゃないってば。
あんた暇さえあれば、店放り出して
こっちに入り浸って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't "ugh" me. You need to man
the store. This isn't your den,
you know?

fields.EN:
Her? Her name's "Clara," and she's
supposedly my assistant, or
something like that...
fields.JP:
ああ。こいつは『くらら』っていって、
自称俺の助手なんだと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her? Her name's "Clara," and she's
supposedly my assistant, or
something like that...

fields.EN:
What'cha mean, "supposedly?!"
I'm officially your assistant,
Boss!
fields.JP:
『自称』って何すか、師匠！
自分は師匠のれっきとした助手っすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What'cha mean, "supposedly?!"
I'm officially your assistant,
Boss!

fields.EN:
And she's also "supposed" to be
manning the store.
fields.JP: でもって、あっちで店番もやってる筈なんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
And she's also "supposed" to be
manning the store.

fields.EN:
C'mon, Sis! That's harsh! I'm
manning the store just fine!
fields.JP:
姉貴もひどいっすよー！
一応自分がやってる店っすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, Sis! That's harsh! I'm
manning the store just fine!

fields.EN:
Why don't you man the store by
actually being there, then?
fields.JP: じゃあ、しっかり店にいなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you man the store by
actually being there, then?

fields.EN:
Whatever... Having to work two
jobs is a major chore...
fields.JP: へいへい……二足のわらじは大変っすねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever... Having to work two
jobs is a major chore...

fields.EN:
By the way, Clara, we were at the
store just earlier.
fields.JP:
つーか、くらら。
あたしらさっき、あんたの店に行ったんだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, Clara, we were at the
store just earlier.

fields.JP: キャスケットの女の子

fields.EN:
Don't "ugh" me. You need to man
the store. This isn't your den,
you know?
fields.JP:
『げっ』じゃないってば。
あんた暇さえあれば、店放り出して
こっちに入り浸って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't "ugh" me. You need to man
the store. This isn't your den,
you know?

fields.EN:
Um... And this small girl here is
Clara-san, I assume?
fields.JP:
……ええと、
この小さな子がくららさん、ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... And this small girl here is
Clara, I assume?

fields.JP: ああ。なんでも自称俺の助手なんだと

fields.EN:
That's pretty harsh, boss! You
too, Jack-san! I'm not small, and I'm
sure as heck doing good work here!
fields.JP:
師匠もジャックさんもひどくないっすか！？
自分、小さくないし、ちゃんと師匠の役に
立ってるつもりっすけどー！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's pretty harsh, boss! You
too, Jack! I'm not small, and I'm
sure as heck doing good work here!

fields.EN:
What?! Boss, quit trying to act so
tough! In that case, why don't you
just do your laundry yourself?!
fields.JP:
むっかー！　師匠のツンデレ！
洗濯はしばらく自分でやるといいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Boss, quit trying to act so
tough! In that case, why don't you
just do your laundry yourself?!

fields.EN:
Why don't you just man the store?
It's a pain when we really need to
buy something, you know?
fields.JP:
いや……その前に、しっかり店にいなよ。
急いでるとき店空けられてると、
結構困るんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you just man the store?
It's a pain when we really need to
buy something, you know?

fields.JP: じゃ、あたしらはこれで！

fields.EN:
Please take care of my
boss, too, along with my store!
fields.JP: うちの店ともども、師匠をよろしくっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to my store or see my boss
here if you need anything, ya
hear?

fields.JP: うん。くららさんもよろしくね

fields.EN:
C'mon, cut the formality! You can
just call me "Clara."
fields.JP:
水臭いっすよ！
くららでいいっす、お二人とも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, cut the formality! You can
just call me "Clara."

fields.EN:
Thanks. We'll see you again,
Clara.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。
じゃあくらら、またね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks. We'll see you again,
Clara.

fields.EN:
Sup, what are you all doing here?
Check out the other locations, you
hear?
fields.JP:
よう。
今んとこ特に用もねぇだろ？
ちゃっちゃと回ってこい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sup, what are you all doing here?
Check out the other locations, you
hear?

fields.EN: Oh? What brings you all here?
fields.JP: あら。どうしたの、三人揃って？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? What brings you all here?

fields.EN:
Well, I was showing the two of
them around headquarters.
fields.JP: うん。二人に本部の中を案内しててね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I was showing the two of
them around headquarters.

fields.EN:
I see. How nice of you to do that.
Both of you were here yesterday,
right?
fields.JP:
そう。ご苦労様。
……といっても、二人は昨日、
ここには来ているわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. How nice of you to do that.
Both of you were here yesterday,
right?

fields.EN:
(Should I ask her about her test
results with my blood?)
fields.JP:
（そういえば、血液検査のこと、聞いて
　みた方がいいかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Should I ask her about her test
results with my blood?)

fields.EN:
Um, do you mind if I ask about
my...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, do you mind if I ask about
my...

fields.EN:
(I should be a bit more observant
and see how everyone works here
before looking too curious...)
fields.JP:
（ここの様子がもう少しわかるまでは、
　みんなの様子を見ていた方がいい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should be a bit more observant
and see how everyone works here
before looking too curious...)

fields.EN:
Um, well... Thank you for
yesterday. I feel a lot better
now.
fields.JP:
あ、いえ……昨日はありがとうございました。
おかげで体力も回復したみたいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... Thank you for
yesterday. I feel a lot better
now.

fields.EN: After all, that's your specialty, Miko-san!
fields.JP: なんたって、視子さんはそれが専門だしね！
fields.LOCALIZED: After all, it is Miko's expertise!

fields.EN:
I suppose so. If you don't feel
well, or you're concerned about
anything, feel free to stop by.
fields.JP:
まぁ、そうね。
体力や体調に不安がある時には、いつでも
いらっしゃいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose so. If you don't feel
well, or you're concerned about
anything, feel free to stop by.

fields.JP: はい。よろしくお願いします
よろしく……お願いします

fields.EN:
Oh? Is there anything else you
need?
fields.JP: あら。まだ何か用かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Is there anything else you
need?

fields.EN:
While I'm at it, let me explain a
bit. This city here is called the
"Liberated District."
fields.JP:
まぁ、ちょっとおまけって感じだけど……
あたしたちは、黎明が造り上げたこの街を、
『解放地区』って呼んでるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
While I'm at it, let me explain a
bit. This city here is called the
"Liberated District."

fields.EN:
Yup. We regained control of it
from the Marchens so that people
could live the way they should!
fields.JP:
うん。メルヒェンたちから取り戻した、
人間の世界……人が安心して、人間らしく
暮らせる場所さ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. We regained control of it
from the Marchens so that people
could live the way they should!

fields.EN:
So people won't be attacked by Marchens
anymore... and so those who safely escaped
the Prison Area can live here again...
fields.JP:
もうこれ以上、人がメルヒェンに襲われない
ように……独房エリアから無事に逃げて来れた
人たちが、ここでまた暮らせるように、って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is for those who escape
the prison cells, so they can live
a normal life again.

fields.EN:
We Blood Maidens and the Dawn
protect the district in hopes of
escaping the Jail one day!
fields.JP:
あたしたち血式少女や、黎明のみんなは、
ここを大事に守りながら、ジェイルからの脱出を
狙ってるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We Blood Maidens and the Dawn
protect the district in hopes of
escaping the Jail one day!

fields.EN:
A place where people could live
the way they should... That's nice
to hear.
fields.JP: 人が人間らしく暮らせる場所……素敵ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
A place where people could live
the way they should... That's nice
to hear.

fields.EN:
Right? You're both free to roam
this district however you like.
fields.JP:
……でしょ！
ふたりとも、ここの中は自由に見て回って
大丈夫だからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? You're both free to roam
this district however you like.

fields.EN:
(Even if this place is protected,
this is still the Jail...)
fields.JP:
（そうだよな。どんなに平和に見えても、
　ここはジェイルの中なんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if this place is protected,
this is still the Jail...)

fields.EN:
(I can see the tower pretty well
from here...)
fields.JP:
（……あの『塔』……
　ここから、よく見える……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can see the tower pretty well
from here...)

fields.EN:
(I'm going to climb that tower,
and...)
fields.JP:
（……僕は、必ずあれを昇るんだ。
　それから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm going to climb that tower,
and...)

fields.EN:
You were just gazing at the
tower...
fields.JP: あなた、ずっと黙って塔を見つめているから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were just gazing at the
tower...

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm sorry... I was just
thinking about how clear it can be
seen from here...
fields.JP:
あ……ごめん。
よく見えるなあと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm sorry... I was just
thinking about how clear it can be
seen from here...

fields.EN:
The tower... It really is eerie.
It's almost as if it's looking
down at us.
fields.JP:
……塔か。気持ち悪いよね。
どこにいたってあたしたちを見下ろしてる
みたいでさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The tower... It really is eerie.
It's almost as if it's looking
down at us.

fields.EN:
But one day, we're gonna use it to
get everybody out of here!
fields.JP:
……でも、あたしたちはきっと、あいつを使って
ここからみんなで脱出するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But one day, we're gonna use it to
get everybody out of here!

fields.EN:
(Why is it that I keep having this
urge to climb...?)
fields.JP:
（時々……無性に『昇り』たくなる気持ち……
　どうしてだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is it that I keep having this
urge to climb...?)

fields.EN:
Oh, and take a look over there.
That's the entrance to the
Liberated District.
fields.JP:
……というわけでさ。
あっちに見えるのが、解放地区の入り口だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and take a look over there.
That's the entrance to the
Liberated District.

fields.EN:
Of course, I couldn't explain that
when we first got here.
fields.JP:
来た時は落ち着いて案内するような暇、
なかったけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, I couldn't explain that
when we first got here.

fields.JP: （……あそこを通って、僕らはここに来たんだ）

fields.EN:
Darling, are you getting ready to
deploy?
fields.JP: やあ、お気に入り。出撃かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Darling, are you getting ready to
deploy?

fields.EN:
Nope. I'm just giving a quick tour
to these two.
fields.JP:
ううん。
今日は二人にここを案内してるとこ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nope. I'm just giving a quick tour
to these two.

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, and quit calling me
"Darling!" Stop giving weird
nicknames to everyone, Towa!
fields.JP:
……っていうかその『お気に入り』っていうの
やめろって言ってるじゃん、永遠はー！
誰でも彼でも、変なあだ名付けてさー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, and quit calling me
"Darling!" Stop giving weird
nicknames to everyone, Towa!

fields.EN:
Hahaha. Same goes for you—don't
call me by my name, all right?
fields.JP:
ははは。
お前こそ、人のこと名前で呼ばないでくれよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Same to you. I'd
appreciate it if you would call me by
my last name.

fields.EN:
Towa is Towa! Why do you have to
be ashamed of being called by your
first name?
fields.JP:
永遠は永遠じゃん！
何、恥ずかしがってんのさー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Towa is Towa! Why do you have to
be ashamed of being called by your
first name?

fields.EN:
You two sound like brother and
sister...
fields.JP: 何だか……仲のいいきょうだいみたいですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You two sound like brother and
sister...

fields.JP: きょうだいって言うな！
きょうだいって言うな！

fields.EN:
Hahaha! That was a bit
embarrassing! The name's
Kadowaki. I'm the gatekeeper here.
fields.JP:
ははは。恥ずかしいところを見せちゃったね！
僕は門脇。ここの門番をやってるのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! That was a bit
embarrassing! The name's
Kadowaki. I'm the gatekeeper here.

fields.EN:
C'mon, you have to say his whole
name. He's embarrassed for having
a cute-sounding first name.
fields.JP:
ほらほら。ちゃんと下の名前も言わなきゃ。
こいつ、自分の名前が可愛いからって、
恥ずかしがって言いたがらないんだよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, you have to say his whole
name. He's embarrassed for having
a cute-sounding first name.

fields.EN: Heh, heh! You're getting all red.
fields.JP: へへっ。恥ずかしがってるー
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh, heh! You're getting all red.

fields.EN:
(They really seem to get along
well together...)
fields.JP: （やっぱり仲が良さそうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They really seem to get along
well together...)

fields.EN: My name is Jack. Nice to meet you.
fields.JP:
僕は、ジャックといいます。
よろしくお願いします
fields.LOCALIZED: My name is Jack. Nice to meet you.

fields.EN:
Oh, so you're officially the new recruit
here. Since this guy carried you in, I
thought you were one of the escaped prisoners.
fields.JP:
ああ、正式にここの新入りになったのか。
なにしろこいつに運び込まれてきたからね、
逃げてきた囚人の一人かと思ってたんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so you're the one? And to
think I saw you unconscious and
carried in here that day.

fields.EN:
Kadowaki-san? Jack saved me, which
is why he was unconscious when he
was brought in.
fields.JP:
門脇さん。
ジャックは、わたしを助けて倒れたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mr. Kadowaki? Jack saved me, which
is why he was unconscious when he
was brought in.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Sorry if I sounded rude.
I know you did your best, kid. And
who is this bold young lady here?
fields.JP:
ははは、悪い悪い。坊主、頑張ったんだな！
で、勇ましい嬢ちゃん、あんたは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Sorry if I sounded rude.
I know you did your best, kid. And
who is this bold young lady here?

fields.EN:
My name is Alice, and I'm not the
bold one. Jack is.
fields.JP:
アリスです。
勇敢なのは、わたしではなくジャックです
fields.LOCALIZED:
My name is Alice, and I'm not the
bold one. Jack is.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Looks like you've got a
fiesty one joining the ranks,
Darling!
fields.JP:
ははは。
威勢のいい子が来たモンだな、お気に入り
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Looks like you've got a
fiesty one joining the ranks,
Darling!

fields.JP: まあね。頼もしい仲間だよ

fields.EN:
He may be a bit weird, but he's
definitely a nice guy, so I hope
you two can get along with him.
fields.JP:
ジャック、アリス。
コイツ、こういう奴だけどさ、
悪い奴じゃないから仲良くしてやってよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He may be a bit weird, but he's
definitely a nice guy, so I hope
you two can get along with him.

fields.EN:
He may not look it, but he puts his
own body on the line to guard this gate.
fields.JP:
これでも体を張って、ここの門を守ってるん
だからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's the gatekeeper and makes
sure the place is safe, sort of.

fields.EN:
Come now, you didn't need to add
"sort of" there. In any case, glad
to make your acquaintance.
fields.JP:
おいおい。『これでも』はひどいなあ。
ま、ふたりとも、よろしく
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, you didn't need to add
"sort of" there. In any case, glad
to make your acquaintance.

fields.JP: よろしくお願いします！

fields.EN:
Hm? Need something? I wouldn't
recommend going outside recklessly.
fields.JP:
ん？　何か用かい？
無闇に外に出るのはお勧めしないなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Did you want to go out?
I can't let you go without a
purpose, though.

fields.EN:
This is where our rooms are, so
I don't need to give you a tour
here, right?
fields.JP:
あ……ここは別にいっか。
あたし達の部屋がある場所だから、
別にわかんないこと無いよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is where our rooms are, so
I don't need to give you a tour
here, right?

fields.EN:
Like, that's Alice's room, and
this is Jack's room, and the one
over there is mine.
fields.JP:
そっちがアリス、こっちがジャック、
それであそこがあたしの部屋だもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, that's Alice's room, and
this is Jack's room, and the one
over there is mine.

fields.EN:
There are a lot of rooms. Are
there others living here?
fields.JP:
そういえば部屋、たくさんあるよね。
他にも住んでる人、いるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are a lot of rooms. Are
there others living here?

fields.EN:
Yup. Each girl has her own room.
They're all out on their missions,
save one.
fields.JP:
うん。他の子たちが一部屋ずつ。
……今はほとんど任務に出ちゃってて、
一人しかここにはいないけどねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Each girl has her own room.
They're all out on their missions,
save one.

fields.JP:
任務……。
危険なことはないのかしら……

fields.EN:
Mmm... They can handle themselves,
and Dad puts thought into the
assignments, so they'll be fine!
fields.JP:
んー。みんなそれなりにしっかりしてるから
大丈夫だと思うんだけどね。
お父さんもちゃんと考えてくれてるし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... They can handle themselves,
and Dad puts thought into the
assignments, so they'll be fine!

fields.EN:
(Dad? Is she referring to the
Professor? But why "Dad?")
fields.JP:
（『お父さん』って、博士のことだっけ。
　でも、何で『お父さん』なんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Dad? Is she referring to the
Professor? But why "Dad?")

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san, you call the Professor
"Dad," but... is he really your father?
That's kind of nice...
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんは、博士のことを『お父さん』って
呼んでるけど……もしかして実のお父さんなの？
いいなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You keep referring to the
Professor as "Dad." Is he really
your Dad? That's kind of neat...

fields.JP: あー。そーいうワケじゃないんだけどね……

fields.EN:
Dad found me when I was a baby
and raised me. I guess that's why...
fields.JP:
あたし、赤ちゃんの頃にお父さんに拾われて
育ててもらったんだ。
だから……かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad adopted me when I was a baby,
so that's why I call him "Dad."

fields.EN:
This is embarrassing! Now that I
think about it, I sound like a kid in
front him, don't I? Ahahaha!
fields.JP:
あー！　なんか恥ずかしいなー！
やっぱちょっと子供っぽいよね！
あはははっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is embarrassing! Now that I
think about it, I sound like a kid in
front him, don't I? Ahahaha!

fields.JP: （赤ずきんさん、博士のこと大好きなんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood really likes the
Professor...)

fields.JP: そんなこと、ないと思う……

fields.EN: Right. In fact, I'm a bit jealous.
fields.JP: ええ。むしろ羨ましいわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. In fact, I'm a bit jealous.

fields.EN:
R-Really? Well, the Professor's
like everyone's Dad, you know?
fields.JP:
そ……そっか！
まあ博士は実際、あたしたちみんなの
お父さんみたいなものだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Really? Well, the Professor's
like everyone's Dad, you know?

fields.EN:
That's why we can fight without worrying!
And I do my part as everyone's big sister!
fields.JP:
だからあたしたちも、安心して戦えるってわけ！
あたしもみんなのお姉さん役としてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we can fight without
any worries! Don't forget, I'm
your older sister here, too!

fields.EN:
Oh, wait... There is one person I
need to worry about...
fields.JP: ……ま、約一名、ちょっと心配なくらいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, wait... There is one person I
need to worry about...

fields.EN:
Now then, let's go and say hi to
the girl here!
fields.JP:
……それじゃ、いま居残りしてる子に
ちょっと挨拶しときますか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's go and say hi to
the girl here!

fields.EN:
(We've been here already, so we
should move on.)
fields.JP: （ここはもうさっき見たからいいかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We've been here already, so we
should move on.)

fields.EN:
She's a bit weird, but she's a nice
girl, okay?
fields.JP:
ちょっと変わってるけど、
悪い子じゃないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's a bit weird, but she's a nice
girl, okay?

fields.EN:
Kaguya? You mind if I bother you
for a sec?
fields.JP: かぐやー。ちょっといいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya? You mind if I bother you
for a sec?

fields.EN: I'm tired, so leave me alone...
fields.JP: ……だるいので放っておいてください～
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm tired, so leave me alone...

fields.EN:
Oh, c'mon! Just show your face!
We have some newcomers joining our
ranks!
fields.JP:
まあいいから、ちょっと顔出しなって！
新しい仲間を紹介するからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, c'mon! Just show your face!
We have some newcomers joining our
ranks!

fields.EN:
Can we save it for later? I need
some time to prepare when meeting
new faces.
fields.JP:
また今度でいいですか～？
知らない人と会うの、心の準備がいるんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can we save it for later? I need
some time to prepare when meeting
new faces.

fields.EN:
C'mon, there's nothing to worry
about. It's not like they're scary
or anything.
fields.JP:
まあまあ、そう言わずにさー
ふたりとも怖くないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, there's nothing to worry
about. It's not like they're scary
or anything.

fields.EN:
We have enough new people here...
I'm busy, too...
fields.JP:
新しい仲間なら間に合ってます～
わらわは忙しいので～
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have enough new people here...
I'm busy, too...

fields.EN:
(Or maybe she just doesn't want us
here...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Or maybe she just doesn't want us
here...)

fields.EN:
Just come out already! I know
you're slacking off in there!
fields.JP:
いいから出てきなっつーの！
ゴロゴロしてんのはわかってんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just come out already! I know
you're slacking off in there!

fields.JP: よっ！　おはよ、かぐや！

fields.EN: You're really quite a bother, Akazukin...
fields.JP: 赤ずきんはいつも騒がしいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're really quite a bother, Red
Riding Hood...

fields.EN:
So, Kaguya... Meet our two new
recruits. Jack and Alice.
fields.JP:
あ、かぐや。
この二人が新人くんたちだよ。
ジャックと、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Kaguya... Meet our two new
recruits. Jack and Alice.

fields.EN:
Her name's Kaguya. She's a good
kid and has the looks, but she's
wasting it all on being a hermit.
fields.JP:
で、この子がかぐや。
いい子なんだけど引きこもりなとこがねー。
せっかくの美人さんなのにもったいないよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her name's Kaguya. She's a good
kid and has the looks, but she's
wasting it all on being a hermit.

fields.EN:
Come now, I'm too tired to be
bothered...
fields.JP: そんなこと、気にするだけ疲れますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, I'm too tired to be
bothered...

fields.EN:
Anyway, you mentioned they joined
our ranks, but... is this Jack
here also a Blood Maiden?
fields.JP:
それより、仲間ということは……
そこのジャックも血式少女なんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, you mentioned they joined
our ranks, but... is this Jack
here also a Blood Maiden?

fields.EN:
Huh? Of course not! He's like an
add-on to Alice.
fields.JP:
え？　そんなわけないじゃん！
アリスとセットでついて来たの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Of course not! He's like an
add-on to Alice.

fields.EN:
First of all, Jack's a guy.
There's no way he can be a Blood
"Maiden!"
fields.JP:
だいたいジャックは男だよ？
血式少女はないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
First of all, Jack's a guy.
There's no way he can be a Blood
"Maiden!"

fields.EN:
Oh, you're right... I've never
heard of a Blood Youth before...
fields.JP:
ああ、そうですよね……
血式少年なんて、今まで聞いたことありませんし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're right... I've never
heard of a Blood Youth before...

fields.EN:
(I guess I really don't have much
use here...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり僕は、ここじゃ何の役にも
　立たない存在、なのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess I really don't have much
use here...)

fields.EN:
Oh, but Jack here may just be
the one!
fields.JP:
でもね、ジャックはね……ひょっとすると
ひょっとするかもしれないんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but Jack here may just be
the one!

fields.JP: ……ひょっとするって何ですか～？

fields.EN:
Mmm... That'll be something to
know later after we get more
information!
fields.JP:
うーん。それはいろいろはっきりするまでの
お楽しみかな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... That'll be something to
know later after we get more
information!

fields.EN:
Well then, I'm not interested
until it's clear. I mean, I'm not
interested in anything.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、はっきりするまで興味無いです～。
ていうか、かぐやは何も興味無いです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I'm not interested
until it's clear. I mean, I'm not
interested in anything.

fields.EN:
Hold on there! We've got new
members! Now's the time for you to
finally do some work!
fields.JP:
いやいやいや、仲間も増えたことだし！
あんたもそろそろまともに働く気になんない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold on there! We've got new
members! Now's the time for you to
finally do some work!

fields.EN:
Mmm... No. I'm tired. I don't want
to work...
fields.JP:
あ～、それは無理です～。
だるいので働きたくないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... No. I'm tired. I don't want
to work...

fields.EN:
Ugh! There she goes again with
that "I'm tired" bit! You know how
much easier it is when you help?
fields.JP:
うー、出たよ『だるいので』攻撃。
あんたが一緒に出てくれると、ほんと助かるん
だけどなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh! There she goes again with
that "I'm tired" bit! You know how
much easier it is when you help?

fields.EN:
You've got the longest-ranged
attack, and you really help our
defenses.
fields.JP:
あんたが一番遠距離攻撃できるんだしさ、
こっちの防御力だって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've got the longest-ranged
attack, and you really help our
defenses.

fields.EN: I'm going to tune out now...
fields.JP: もう戻っていいですか～
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm going to tune out now...

fields.JP: あ……あの！　かぐやさん！

fields.EN:
Why aren't you helping when you
have the power to help others?
fields.JP:
君は人を助けられる力があるのに、
どうして役に立てようとしないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why aren't you helping when you
have the power to help others?

fields.EN:
I don't want to work until the
five treasures come together.
fields.JP: 五つの宝物が揃わないと、わらわは働きたくないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to work until the
five treasures come together.

fields.EN:
That again... You really are a
greedy princess, you know that?
fields.JP:
まーた出たよそれ。
ワガママ姫なんだからー
fields.LOCALIZED:
That again... You really are a
greedy princess, you know that?

fields.EN:
Now then, I'm tired, so if you'll
excuse me...
fields.JP: それじゃあだるいので戻ります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I'm tired, so if you'll
excuse me...

fields.EN:
Also, my name is 'Kaguyahime'~. Please
don't get so familiar and call me 'Kaguya'~.
fields.JP:
あと、わらわの名前は『かぐや姫』です～。
馴れ馴れしく『かぐや』なんて呼ばないで下さい～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and my name is "Princess"
Kaguya. Don't call me "Kaguya"
so casually...

fields.JP: き……嫌われちゃったのかな……

fields.EN:
Oh, don't let her bother you.
She's always like that. She's just
shy, is all.
fields.JP:
あ。それは気にしないで平気だよ。
あの子、いつもあんな感じだし、
人見知りなだけだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, don't let her bother you.
She's always like that. She's just
shy, is all.

fields.EN:
I really wish she fought with us.
She'd be a lot of help in battle.
fields.JP:
でもまあ、あの子も戦ってくれると
ほんと助かるんだけどな～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really wish she fought with us.
She'd be a lot of help in battle.

fields.EN:
We'll be serving meals according
to this schedule...
fields.JP: では、炊き出しはこの日程で行いますので……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll be serving meals according
to this schedule...

fields.EN:
Understood. I'm counting on you,
Hitsuka-san.
fields.JP: ああ。よろしく頼みますよ、陽司さん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. I'm counting on you,
Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
How much supplies and manpower
will you be needing?
fields.JP:
こちらからの物資と増員はどの程度必要
でしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How much supplies and manpower
will you be needing?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about that. Now then,
we're expecting a turnout of
about...
fields.JP:
失礼。……そうですね。
今回の炊き出しの具体的な規模としましては……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about that. Now then,
we're expecting a turnout of
about...

fields.JP:
あの、赤ずきんさん……
あの人たちは……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, Red Riding Hood? Who are they?

fields.JP: お父さーん、視子さーん。打ち合わせ？

fields.EN:
Ah, Akazukin. Did you
finish showing them around
already?
fields.JP:
……ああ。赤ずきんか。
しっかり案内してきたかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Red Riding Hood. Did you
finish showing them around
already?

fields.EN:
I see. That's my girl. Now then,
Miko-kun? I'll leave the rest to you.
fields.JP:
そうか。いい子だ。
……では視子くん、後は任せたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. That's my girl. Now then,
Miko? I'll leave the rest to you.

fields.EN:
So, Miko-san, what's the meeting
about?
fields.JP:
……それで視子さん、
今日は何の打ち合わせなんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Miko, what's the meeting
about?

fields.EN:
Do you remember the people you
saved earlier? We're preparing
meals for them.
fields.JP:
……ああ。先日あなたたちが救出してきた
人たちがいるでしょう？
彼らのために炊き出しをするのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you remember the people you
saved earlier? We're preparing
meals for them.

fields.JP: タイヨウさんたちにはいつもお世話になります！

fields.EN:
We are all brothers and sisters
under the sun... All is in the
name of our Oohime-sama.
fields.JP:
私たちは全て太陽の兄弟姉妹……
全ては大陽女様の御心です
fields.LOCALIZED:
We are all brothers and sisters
under the sun... All is in the
name of our Lady Oohime.

fields.EN: Ahaha. Same as ever... Michiru and Chii, too.
fields.JP:
あはは。相変わらずだなあ……
ミチルもちーも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Same as always... Nice
to see you, Michiru! Chii!

fields.EN:
Like I always tell you, don't
address Oohime-sama so casually.
fields.JP:
いつも言っているように、大陽女様を
そのように軽々しく呼ぶものではない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I've said a number of times,
do not call our Lady Oohime by her
name in vain.

fields.EN:
Oh... New little bird-sans. One...
two... There are two of you. Hello~ Hehe...
fields.JP:
……あ。新しい小鳥さん。
ひとり……ふたり。ふたりもいるのね。
こんにちはー。くすくす……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? We have new little birdies
here. One... Two... Two of them.
Hello, there... Heh, heh...

fields.EN:
They're the representatives of the
Order of the Sun.
fields.JP: ああ。この人たちはタイヨウ教団の代表の方達よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're the representatives of the
Order of the Sun.

fields.EN:
Yes. The order is led by the Oohime,
Michiru-san, and Hitsuka-san is her assistant.
fields.JP:
ええ。
教団を率いる大陽女……ミチルさんと、
陽司さん……補佐の方よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The order is led by the
Oohime, Lady Michiru, and Hitsuka
acts as her advisor.

fields.EN:
These two here just joined the
Dawn. Jack and Alice.
fields.JP:
こちらは新たに黎明に加わった、
ジャックとアリスです
fields.LOCALIZED:
These two here just joined the
Dawn. Jack and Alice.

fields.JP: よ、よろしくお願いします

fields.EN:
If you seek salvation by the sun,
come and listen to the words of
Oohime-sama.
fields.JP:
……太陽の救済を求めるならば、大陽女様の
教えを聞きに来ると良い
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you seek salvation by the sun,
come and listen to the words of
Lady Oohime.

fields.EN:
Now then, if you'll excuse us...
Let us depart, Michiru-sama.
fields.JP:
では、我々はこれで……
ミチル様、参りましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, if you'll excuse us...
Let us depart, Lady Michiru.

fields.EN:
Hehe... You're a little bird-san,
Jack. Do you like high places?
fields.JP:
ふふ……ジャックは小鳥さんね。
あなた、高いところは好き？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Jack's a little
birdie. Do you like high places?

fields.EN:
(What does she mean by that? Does
she know I really want to climb the
tower?)
fields.JP:
（今の……どういう意味だったんだろう？
　僕がどうして塔に昇りたがってること、
　知ってるんだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What does she mean by that? Does
she know I really want to climb the
tower?)

fields.EN:
(No, she wouldn't know. We've only
just met.)
fields.JP:
（……そんなわけないか。
　初めて会ったんだし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No, she wouldn't know. We've only
just met.)

fields.EN:
Um, Miko-san? Are Oohime and Hitsuka
their names?
fields.JP:
あの、視子さん……
大陽女や陽司というのは……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Miko? Are Oohime and Hitsuka
their names?

fields.EN:
They're titles within their order.
They preach that salvation will be
delivered by the sun.
fields.JP:
……ああ。教団内での称号のようなものよ。
あの教団は、太陽による救済をうたっているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're titles within their order.
They preach that salvation will be
delivered by the sun.

fields.EN:
Ah, so the name "Hitsuka-san" isn't
his real name.
fields.JP:
あ、じゃあ『陽司さん』って、
あの男の人の名前じゃなかったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, so the name "Hitsuka" isn't
his real name.

fields.EN:
Silly you! Of course it's not!
Everyone calls him that because
no one knows his real name.
fields.JP:
あはは。そりゃそーだよ！
そんな変な名前なわけないじゃん。
単にあの人の名前を誰も知らないだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Silly you! Of course it's not!
Everyone calls him that because
no one knows his real name.

fields.EN:
But you called him "Chii" or
something...
fields.JP: でも確か、あなたはさっき『ちー』って……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you called him "Chii" or
something...

fields.EN:
Oh, I just call him that because I
hear Michiru calling him that,
too.
fields.JP: ああ。ミチルがそう呼んでるから、ついねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I just call him that because I
hear Michiru calling him that,
too.

fields.EN:
He wasn't like that before, you
know? As for Michiru, she's always
been like that.
fields.JP:
あの人も、昔はあそこまで取っ付きにくい人じゃ
なかったんだけどなあ……
ま、ミチルは前からあんな感じだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
He wasn't like that before, you
know? As for Michiru, she's always
been like that.

fields.EN:
But isn't she the leader? She
didn't look like she could lead
people...
fields.JP:
でも……宗教団体を率いている方なのでしょう？
何かを率いる人のようには見えなかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But isn't she the leader? She
didn't look like she could lead
people...

fields.EN:
She's probably his puppet. You're right,
Alice—she doesn't seem capable of thinking
for herself.
fields.JP:
傀儡なのよ、おそらくあの人の。
アリスの言う通り、何かを考えられるような
頭の持ち主ではないものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's probably acting as his
puppet. I mean, it's not like she
has the brains to think properly.

fields.EN:
(But there's something mysterious
about that Michiru-san person that
almost mesmerized me...)
fields.JP:
（でも……あのミチルさんって人、
　なんだか引き付けられるようなところがある
　不思議な人だったけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But there's something mysterious
about that Michiru person that
almost mesmerized me...)

fields.EN:
Even though Michiru's like that,
she's still pretty popular.
fields.JP: でも、あれで結構人気あるんだよ、ミチルって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even though Michiru's like that,
she's still pretty popular.

fields.EN:
Which is why she's perfect as a
puppet...
fields.JP: ……だから傀儡として便利なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why she's perfect as a
puppet...

fields.EN:
They believe that the Oohime is
the incarnation of the sun. Silly,
considering no one's seen it.
fields.JP:
あの人たちによれば、
『大陽女』は太陽の生まれ変わりなんだそうよ
……本物の太陽なんか、見たこともないくせに
fields.LOCALIZED:
They believe that the Oohime is
the incarnation of the sun. Silly,
considering no one's seen it.

fields.EN:
Miko-san? Do you have something
against them?
fields.JP: 視子さんは……あの人たちが嫌いなんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko? Do you have something
against them?

fields.EN:
They're shady, and honestly,
I don't like the mentality of
clinging to something for support.
fields.JP:
……彼らは胡散臭いし、
正直、何かに縋ろうという精神は好きではないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're shady, and in all honesty,
I don't like how they try to leech
off of others.

fields.EN:
That said, they do augment what we
in the Dawn lack.
fields.JP:
けれど、現在の黎明には不足している部分を
補ってくれる存在でもあるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, they do augment what we
in the Dawn lack.

fields.EN:
The order is here in the Liberated District,
so if you're interested, why not visit? Though
I'd rather you didn't become believers.
fields.JP:
教団はこの解放地区の中にあるから……
興味があったら訪ねてみたらどうかしら。
もっとも信者になられても困るけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Their order is located in the
middle of the Liberated District,
so you can always take a look.

fields.EN:
Well, we said hi to Dad, so we're
about done! You have a better
idea of the Dawn now, right?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、お父さんにも挨拶できたし……
案内の方は、ここで解散でいいかな！
ふたりとも、黎明の中はだいたいわかった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we said hi to Dad, so we're
about done! You have a better
idea of the Dawn now, right?

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、ありがとう

fields.EN:
Just a minute. Do you mind I ask
you something?
fields.JP: ああ。ところでひとつ、用があったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a minute. Do you mind I ask
you something?

fields.EN: What? You have a mission for me?
fields.LOCALIZED: What? You have a mission for me?

fields.EN:
Not a mission. Do you know where
I can find magnolia leaves?
fields.JP:
任務という程の規模ではないけど、
ホオノキの葉の在処を知らないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not a mission. Do you know where
I can find magnolia leaves?

fields.EN:
Yes. The leaves look like this
drawing.
fields.JP: ええ。こういう形状の葉を付けるのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The leaves look like this
drawing.

fields.EN:
Well, we just call them magnolia
leaves because they look similar
to the ones in the outside world.
fields.JP:
まあ……
葉の形状が外の世界にあるホオノキに似てるから
黎明でそう呼んでるだけなんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we just call them magnolia
leaves because they look similar
to the ones in the outside world.

fields.EN:
This looks like Dad's! Yikes, his
penmanship is sloppy as usual...
fields.JP:
これ……お父さんが書いたやつだね！
相変わらず字がへたくそだなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This looks like Dad's! Yikes, his
penmanship is sloppy as usual...

fields.EN:
We were having a meeting about
supplies, and the Professor was
the most artistic one there.
fields.JP:
ええ。必要な物資について会議をしていて……
意外にも博士が一番絵心があったというわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were having a meeting about
supplies, and the Professor was
the most artistic one there.

fields.EN:
Ahaha! That's a surprise for sure!
So then, what's with this leaf?
fields.JP:
あはは！　それ、あたしも意外だよ！
……それで、この葉っぱがどうかしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahaha! That's a surprise for sure!
So then, what's with this leaf?

fields.EN:
It has blood-clotting properties.
We're running out of medicine, and
we're going to need some soon.
fields.JP:
この葉には止血成分が含まれているの。
抽出した薬剤がいよいよ切れかけてきて、
できれば早急に補給がしたいのよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It has blood-clotting properties.
We're running out of medicine, and
we're going to need some soon.

fields.EN:
I remember now. I've picked up
those leaves on past missions.
fields.JP:
ああ。
今までは探索ついでに適当にむしってきてた中に
その葉っぱもあったってわけかー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember now. I've picked up
those leaves on past missions.

fields.EN:
Yes. I asked Haru-san, but he said he
doesn't remember where they came
from, so I thought you'd know.
fields.JP:
ええ。ハルさんに聞いても、いちいち覚えてない
って言うし……あなたなら覚えてるかと思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I asked Haru, but he said he
doesn't remember where they came
from, so I thought you'd know.

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'm sure I saw them
somewhere, but...
fields.JP: うーん。どっかにあったかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'm sure I saw them
somewhere, but...

fields.JP:
……ねえ、ジャック。
この葉って、もしかして……

fields.EN: Do you know where to get them?
fields.JP: あなたたち、知っているの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you know where to get them?

fields.EN:
Maybe... I recall we used large
leaves in place of bandages back
when we were imprisoned.
fields.JP:
ええ……多分。
捕えられていた頃、よく手近に群生していた
大きな葉を包帯代わりにしていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe... I recall we used large
leaves in place of bandages back
when we were imprisoned.

fields.EN: I think it was shaped like that...
fields.JP: たしか、こんな形をしていた気がするので
fields.LOCALIZED: I think it was shaped like that...

fields.EN:
Yeah, I'm pretty sure it was! That
would explain why it stopped the
bleeding so quickly.
fields.JP:
うん……多分間違いないと思います！
……どうりで早く血が止まったわけだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, I'm pretty sure it was! That
would explain why it stopped the
bleeding so quickly.

fields.EN:
I suppose we used the right tools
without even knowing.
fields.JP: ええ。知らず知らず、適切な処置をしていたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we used the right tools
without even knowing.

fields.EN: Well then, this should be simple!
fields.LOCALIZED: Well then, this should be simple!

fields.EN:
We're... going back there, aren't
we?
fields.JP: あの場所に……また行くのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're... going back there, aren't
we?

fields.JP: そういうこと！　ね、視子さん！

fields.EN: Well, it would help a lot, but...
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, it would help a lot, but...

fields.EN:
Miko-san. You were speaking with Dad
about it, so it's safe to assume he
knows, right?
fields.JP:
視子さん。お父さんと話し合ったってことは……
これ、お父さんも知ってる作戦ってことで
間違いないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were speaking with Dad about
it, so it's safe to assume he
knows, right?

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose so... Why do you
ask?
fields.JP:
ええ。おおよそ、そういうことになるけれど……
どうして？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose so... Why do you
ask?

fields.EN:
Well, because Dad didn't know
about Jack's blood samples. I
figured I'd ask just in case.
fields.JP:
いやー、ジャックの血液検査の件さ……
お父さん、知らなかったから。
……一応聞いてみようと思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, because Dad didn't know
about Jack's blood samples. I
figured I'd ask just in case.

fields.JP: （あのこと……赤ずきんさんも気になってたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was bothering Red Riding
Hood, too?)

fields.EN:
About that, we got it all cleared
up.
fields.JP: ……ああ。そのことなら解決しているわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
About that, we got it all cleared
up.

fields.JP: それで、どういうことだったの？

fields.EN:
The Professor knows that we wanted
his blood samples, right?
fields.JP:
彼の血液検査については、当然博士は了承して
いることでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor knows that we wanted
his blood samples, right?

fields.EN:
Health examinations, including blood tests,
are standard for everyone who comes here...
fields.JP:
ここに来た人の血液検査を含めた健康診断は
定められていることだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Drawing a person's blood sample is
common practice when people come
to see me for a check-up.

fields.EN:
His unusual blood concerns us all. It
seems the Professor forgot we'd said we'd
wait for the results and report back.
fields.JP:
彼の血液の特殊性については、共通の関心事項
だもの。結果を待って報告すると伝えたことを、
忘れてしまっていたらしいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We told the Professor that we'd
turn in a report with Jack's
results, and he forgot about that.

fields.EN:
Oh, is that it? Well, okay then.
Dad is a bit forgetful, so I can
see that happening.
fields.JP:
……ふーん。なーんだ。それなら安心だ。
お父さんああいう人だし、結構忘れっぽい
からねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, is that it? Well, okay then.
Dad is a bit forgetful, so I can
see that happening.

fields.EN:
Yes, and that's why we have these
misunderstandings every so often.
fields.JP:
ええ。おかげでたまにこうした齟齬が発生
するわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and that's why we have these
misunderstandings every so often.

fields.EN:
Anyway, that's a relief! Miko-san, I thought
you were investigating something behind
Dad's back.
fields.JP:
ほんとよかったよ！
あたしてっきり、視子さんがお父さんに内緒で
何か調べてんじゃないかと思ってさー
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, that's a relief! I
thought you were doing something
behind Dad's back.

fields.EN: Me? Why would I do that?
fields.LOCALIZED: Me? Why would I do that?

fields.EN:
You could make the discovery of
the century and use it to become
Dad's favorite or something.
fields.JP:
ほら、お父さんに内緒で世紀の大発見！　とか
しちゃってさ、一気にお父さんのお気に入りに
登り詰めようとしてんのかなー、なんてさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could make the discovery of
the century and use it to become
Dad's favorite or something.

fields.EN: Heh, heh! Sorry I questioned you!
fields.JP: あはは。疑っちゃってごめんね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh, heh! Sorry I questioned you!

fields.EN:
Heh... You know that's a dumb
thought. After all, you are his
favorite... in many ways.
fields.JP:
ふふ。馬鹿なことを考えないで。
あの人の一番のお気に入りは、いつだって
あなたよ。……色々な意味でね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... You know that's a dumb
thought. After all, you are his
favorite... in many ways.

fields.EN:
Good to hear! Okay, so Jack,
Alice...
fields.JP:
じゃあ安心だ！
……ってことで、アリス、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good to hear! Okay, so Jack,
Alice...

fields.JP: これからみんなで、ホオノキ採取に行くよ！

fields.EN:
Yup! Alice can get used to
fighting, and having you around
would help her keep her cool, too.
fields.JP:
うん。アリスの実戦慣れにもなるしさ、
あんたがいた方が、アリスも安心するでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Alice can get used to
fighting, and having you around
would help her keep her cool, too.

fields.EN:
W-Well, I guess. I don't mind
going, but...
fields.JP: う……うん。僕は構わないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I guess. I don't mind
going, but...

fields.EN:
As long as you can promise me that
Jack won't be put into harm's way,
then I'm okay with it.
fields.JP:
ジャックを危険に晒さないと約束するのなら……
わたしは構わないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you can promise me that
Jack won't be put into harm's way,
then I'm okay with it.

fields.EN:
(I'm only going to get in their
way...)
fields.JP: （僕はやっぱり足手まといだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm only going to get in their
way...)

fields.EN:
C'mon, Alice. Don't say that.
Jack's our comrade, you know?
fields.JP:
やだなあ。変なこと言わないでよ、アリス。
ジャックは大事な仲間だよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, Alice. Don't say that.
Jack's our comrade, you know?

fields.EN:
Once you're ready, let's meet up
here, okay?
fields.JP: じゃあ、準備ができたらここに集合しよっか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once you're ready, let's meet up
here, okay?

fields.EN:
Wait a minute! You can't do this
without proper...
fields.JP:
ちょっと待ちなさい！
そんな独断は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute! You can't do this
without proper...

fields.EN:
You said Dad knows about this
already, right?
fields.JP: お父さんも了承済みの作戦なんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said Dad knows about this
already, right?

fields.EN:
It'll be okay! We've been there
before, so it'll be a cinch! I'll
let Dad know just in case, too.
fields.JP:
一度行ってるとこなんだし、大丈夫だって！
ちょちょいと採ってくるよ。
あたしも一応、お父さんに声かけてくから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be okay! We've been there
before, so it'll be a cinch! I'll
let Dad know just in case, too.

fields.EN:
I see... Well, be careful, all
right?
fields.JP: そう……それじゃ、気をつけるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Well, be careful, all
right?

fields.EN: This is the Order of the Sun...
fields.LOCALIZED: This is the Order of the Sun...

fields.EN:
(I was really curious, but it
looks very quiet and calm here.)
fields.JP:
（気になって、見に来ちゃったけど……
　案外のどかそうなところだなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was really curious, but it
looks very quiet and calm here.)

fields.EN:
Your clothing... Are you from the
Dawn?
fields.JP: おや、その格好は黎明の人か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your clothing... Are you from the
Dawn?

fields.EN: Did you come to see Hitsuka-sama?
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you come to see Sir Hitsuka?

fields.EN:
Uh, no. I was just curious about
the Order of the Sun.
fields.JP:
あ、いえ。タイヨウ教団って、どういうところ
なのかな、と思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, no. I was just curious about
the Order of the Sun.

fields.JP: （こんな言い方、失礼だったかな……）

fields.EN:
Ah! The order is a fine place to
be. Feel free to come here if you 
desire help from the Sun God.
fields.JP:
ああ。ここはいいぞ。
坊主も太陽の神様に縋りたくなったら、
いつでもおいで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! The order is a fine place to
be. Feel free to come here if you 
desire help from the Sun God.

fields.EN:
Huh... Um, what are the teachings
of the Order of the Sun?
fields.JP:
はあ……あの。タイヨウ教団の教えって、
どういうものなんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... Um, what are the teachings
of the Order of the Sun?

fields.EN:
The Sun God will someday burn away the
canopy and let us out of this prison...
That's Oohime-sama's revelation.
fields.JP:
太陽の神様を信じていれば、いつか太陽の神様が
天幕を焼いて、この監獄の外に出してくれる……
大陽女様のお告げなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Keep faith, as the Sun God will
scorch the heavens to render
salvation from the Jail."

fields.EN:
Yes. Oohime-sama relays the words
of the Sun God to us.
fields.JP:
ああ。大陽女様は太陽の神様の御言葉を
俺たちに伝えて下さるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Lady Oohime relays the words
of the Sun God to us.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... But the sun speaks to
everyone, you know?
fields.JP:
ふふ……
お日様はみんなに話しかけてくれるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... But the sun speaks to
everyone, you know?

fields.JP: 大陽女様が……私たちの前に！！

fields.EN:
Oohime-sama spoke to us! We
are not worthy!
fields.JP:
大陽女様がお言葉を……！
何てありがたい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime spoke to us! We
are not worthy!

fields.EN:
But there's a large barrier
blocking the skies, making it
difficult to hear the sun's voice.
fields.JP:
でもね、いまはお空に大きな膜がかかっちゃって、
それでお日様の声が届きにくくなってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there's a large barrier
blocking the skies, making it
difficult to hear the sun's voice.

fields.EN:
The sun is always watching over
us, so hold on a bit longer, okay?
fields.JP:
だけど、お日様はみんなのことを見てるから、
もうちょっとがまん……ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sun is always watching over
us, so hold on a bit longer, okay?

fields.JP: 大陽女様は俺らの希望です……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Lady Oohime! You are our hope!

fields.EN:
(She has this many followers?! Or
is this normal for these kinds of
things?)
fields.JP:
（こ……こんなに慕われてるんだ！？
　それとも、こういうもの、なんだろうか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has this many followers?! Or
is this normal for these kinds of
things?)

fields.JP: ジャック。こっちこっち……

fields.EN: Oohime-sama called out to him directly...
fields.JP: お、大陽女様が直にお呼びになるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: Lady Oohime called him by name...?

fields.EN:
He looks like a member of the
Dawn, so maybe he's just here on
errands.
fields.JP:
黎明の人間みたいだし、やっぱり何か用があったん
じゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
He looks like a member of the
Dawn, so maybe he's just here on
errands.

fields.EN:
But isn't Hitsuka-sama the one who
handles those kind of things?
fields.JP:
でも、だったらどうして陽司様がお相手を
なさらないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But isn't Sir Hitsuka the one who
handles those kind of things?

fields.JP: （な……何だか、いたたまれないなあ……）

fields.EN:
Jack? Are you interested in high
places?
fields.JP: ジャック、高いところが気になった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Are you interested in high
places?

fields.JP: ね……ミチル様、このようなところに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru, what are you
doing...

fields.EN:
...So it was you. Forgive me for not noticing
sooner. To have Oohime-sama deal with this
personally... it was Hitsuka's failing...
fields.JP:
……君だったか。すぐに気付かずに済まない。
大陽女様には、直々にご対応あそばされ、
陽司の不徳でありました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's you again. I'm sorry I didn't
notice you sooner. Lady Oohime,
I apologize for the trouble.

fields.EN: So he is here to see Hitsuka-sama.
fields.JP: 何だ。やっぱり陽司様に用事だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: So he is here to see Sir Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
Well, there's no way Oohime-sama
would speak with some kid.
fields.JP:
大陽女様がいきなり普通の子に声なんかかける
わけ、ないものねえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, there's no way Lady Oohime
would speak with some kid.

fields.EN:
It looks like they really adore
you...
fields.JP: ず……ずいぶん慕われてるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like they really adore
you...

fields.EN:
Everyone awakens from dreams, but
dreams are a figment of reality
taking on a different form.
fields.JP:
誰もがいつか夢から醒める。
けれど、夢とは何者かに化けた現実の姿……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone awakens from dreams, but
dreams are a figment of reality
taking on a different form.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Jack is curious of
high places.
fields.JP:
くすくす……
ジャックは高いところが気になっただけなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Jack is curious of
high places.

fields.JP: ジャック。また来てね。ばいばい

fields.EN: Um... About what she just said...
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... About what she just said...

fields.EN:
I don't know who you are... but
could you avoid agitating her unnecessarily?
fields.JP:
君が何者なのかは知らない。
……余計な刺激を与えないでもらえないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know who you are, but may
I ask that you please avoid
excessive contact with her?

fields.EN:
She rarely speaks with others, and
rightfully so. Now, I'll need to
ask you to leave.
fields.JP:
あの方は滅多な者とはお話にはならない。
帰ってもらおうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
She rarely speaks with others, and
rightfully so. Now, I'll need to
ask you to leave.

fields.EN:
(What a weird place... I have a
feeling that Hitsuka person is
hiding something...)
fields.JP:
（……ここは変なところだ……
　ここっていうより、あの陽司って人は
　何かを隠してる気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a weird place... I have a
feeling that Hitsuka person is
hiding something...)

fields.EN:
Now then, let's go and find some
magnolia leaves!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、ホオノキの葉探し……
張り切って行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's go and find some
magnolia leaves!

fields.JP: ひょっとして……怖い、よね？

fields.EN:
No... Just worried about that
state from before...
fields.JP: いえ……ただ、またあの状態には……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... Just worried about that
state from before...

fields.EN:
No worries! That won't happen
again! I'll be protecting you and
Jack!
fields.JP:
大丈夫！　あんな風にはなんない！
あんたもジャックも、あたしが守るから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No worries! That won't happen
again! I'll be protecting you and
Jack!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry for sounding so
anxious... I'm fine now!
fields.JP:
……弱音を吐いたりして、ごめんなさい。
わたしは大丈夫よ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for sounding so
anxious... I'm fine now!

fields.EN:
If push comes to shove, my blood
should...
fields.JP: いざとなったら、僕の血を浴びせれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If push comes to shove, my blood
should...

fields.EN:
I keep telling you. We still don't
even know for sure what effect it has, do we?
fields.JP:
だーかーらー。
それまだ効果がはっきりしてるわけじゃない
でしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you do know that we haven't
gotten any test results back from
your blood yet, right?

fields.EN:
Besides, we can't have Jack getting seriously
injured every single time! Now, get moving!
fields.JP:
だいたい、ジャックにいちいち大怪我
させるわけにもいかないでしょ！
さ、歩いた歩いた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, there's no way we'd have
you injured every time something
happened! Now then, walk!

fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん、僕らのことを気にかけて
　くれてるんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood is really
thinking about us...)

fields.EN:
It's so creepy... I'd rather not
look at it.
fields.JP: ……いつ見ても、いい気分はしないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's so creepy... I'd rather not
look at it.

fields.EN:
That's right! About the moon... I
need to tell you something!
fields.JP:
……そうだ！
あの月のことだけど、
ちょっと教えておかなくちゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! About the moon... I
need to tell you something!

fields.EN:
Hmm... I can't seem to find them
around.
fields.JP: うーん、なかなか見つからないもんだねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... I can't seem to find them
around.

fields.EN:
I guess we can't expect it to grow
all over the place just because
we're here...
fields.JP:
ここの中なら、どこにでも生えてるわけじゃ
ないみたいだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we can't expect it to grow
all over the place just because
we're here...

fields.EN:
All right! Let's take a break here. It'd
defeat the purpose if we collapsed on the way!
fields.JP:
……よーし！
ここらで、いったん休憩しよっか。
行き倒れたら、元も子もないからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then! Why don't we rest for
a moment? No use tiring ourselves
out over nothing!

fields.EN:
Yeah, I'm fine. I hope you two
aren't overworking yourselves.
fields.JP:
うん。まだまだ平気だよ。
ふたりこそ無理しないで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, I'm fine. I hope you two
aren't overworking yourselves.

fields.EN:
Well, we're pretty deep in here. I
would've marked it somehow if I
knew it was so important.
fields.JP:
しっかし、だいぶ深いとこまで潜ちゃったね。
そんな大事な草なら、目印でも付けて
おくんだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we're pretty deep in here. I
would've marked it somehow if I
knew it was so important.

fields.EN:
I guess we'll have to go back to
where the cells are...
fields.JP:
結局、僕らがいた牢のあたりまで、
行ってみるしかなさそうだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we'll have to go back to
where the cells are...

fields.EN: I hope there are some left over...
fields.JP: まだ、残ってるといいのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope there are some left over...

fields.EN:
I'm sure we'll find some. I mean,
no one would harvest them, would
they?
fields.JP:
きっと、残ってるよ。
そんなの採る奴なんかいないでしょ。
それに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we'll find some. I mean,
no one would harvest them, would
they?

fields.EN:
And even if we don't find any, I'm
pretty satisfied already with what
we've done.
fields.JP:
まあ、あたしは結構満足したし？
ホオノキの葉が無くてもいいかなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
And even if we don't find any, I'm
pretty satisfied already with what
we've done.

fields.EN:
Oh, but that means no medicine,
huh? And Miko-san would be angry if we
didn't bring any back...
fields.JP:
あ、でも……それだと薬が不足しちゃうのか
視子さんも怖そうだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but that means no medicine,
huh? And Miko would be angry if we
didn't bring any back...

fields.EN:
Oh, about Alice getting used to
fighting.
fields.JP: ああ。アリスの実戦慣れのこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, about Alice getting used to
fighting.

fields.EN:
(That's right. She did say that
earlier.)
fields.JP: （そういえば、そんなこと言ってたっけ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right. She did say that
earlier.)

fields.EN:
Alice, you're getting used to
fighting, aren't you?
fields.JP: どう、アリス。少しは慣れた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, you're getting used to
fighting, aren't you?

fields.EN: Not that I particularly like it...
fields.JP: ……あまりいい気分はしないけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Not that I particularly like it...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! None of us likes
fighting, you know?
fields.JP: あはは……誰だっていい気分はしないって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! None of us likes
fighting, you know?

fields.JP: えっ、赤ずきんさんでも！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Even you, Red Riding
Hood?!

fields.EN: Whoa, I take offense to that!
fields.JP: どういう意味よ、失礼だなー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa, I take offense to that!

fields.EN:
Uh, well... I just thought you
liked fighting because you looked
like you were having fun.
fields.JP:
あ、ええと……
気持ちよさそうに戦ってるから、つい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... I just thought you
liked fighting because you looked
like you were having fun.

fields.EN:
Well, that's because I'm used to
it after coming here so often.
Speaking of...
fields.JP:
まあ、この辺なら何度か来てるし……
慣れだよ、慣れ！
とはいえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's because I'm used to
it after coming here so often.
Speaking of...

fields.EN:
Alice, you're amazing! You adapt
so quickly, and you've got talent!
Yeah, even better than I expected!
fields.JP:
アリス、あんたやっぱりすごいよ！
順応性も高いし、才能あるよ！
うん！　予想以上だね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're amazing, Alice! You're
already fighting like a pro! Way
better than expected!

fields.EN:
I think I can ask you to cover for
me without any worries now.
fields.JP: これなら背中を任せることができるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I can ask you to cover for
me without any worries now.

fields.EN: I see... That's good to hear.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... That's good to hear.

fields.EN:
I didn't give Jack much of a
choice in coming, but having him
here is making you fight better.
fields.JP:
正直、勢いで引っ張って来ちゃったんだけど、
ジャックがいて、かえって安定して戦えてる
みたいだしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't give Jack much of a
choice in coming, but having him
here is making you fight better.

fields.EN:
So you did force me to tag
along...
fields.JP: やっぱり勢いだったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you did force me to tag
along...

fields.EN: Haha... C'mon, don't be mad, okay?
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha... C'mon, don't be mad, okay?

fields.EN:
It's always scary to take on your
first mission, so having someone
to rely on helps.
fields.JP:
やっぱり最初の作戦行動はさ、誰だって
不安なもんだから……ひとつでも、
頼りにできるものがあったほうがいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's always scary to take on your
first mission, so having someone
to rely on helps.

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san, were you scared
on your first mission, too?
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさんも、やっぱり最初は不安だったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Were you scared on your first
mission, too?

fields.JP: さあ、どうだったかなー

fields.EN: Well, resting time is over, folks!
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, resting time is over, folks!

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san is a bit random,
but she does act like an older
sister and a leader...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん、無茶なとこはあるけど……
　みんなのお姉さんって言ってただけあって
　ちゃんとリーダーなんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood is a bit random,
but she does act like an older
sister and a leader...)

fields.EN:
What?! I thought they were around
here... There aren't any leaves
whatsoever. Alice, what about you?
fields.JP:
……ない！　この辺に群生してたのに……
ホオノキの葉が……なくなってる。
アリス、そっちの方はどう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! I thought they were around
here... There aren't any leaves
whatsoever. Alice, what about you?

fields.EN:
Same here. I can't find any... It
looks like the place has changed
since we left.
fields.JP:
同じよ……全然、見つからないわ。
わたしたちが居た頃とは、
だいぶ様子が変わってるみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. I can't find any... It
looks like the place has changed
since we left.

fields.EN:
(I'm sure there were some around
the torture chamber...)
fields.JP: （奥の拷問部屋にもあった気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm sure there were some around
the torture chamber...)

fields.JP: もっとよく調べてみよう

fields.EN:
When we're serious, someone like
that is no match for us! You two okay?
fields.JP:
……本気のあたしたちにかかったら、
あんな奴、目じゃないってね！
ふたりとも、大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one can stand in my way when
I'm serious! You two all right?

fields.EN:
(I'm hurt a bit, but it's the same
as those two...)
fields.JP:
（ちょっと怪我はしたけど、それはふたりだって
　同じだし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm hurt a bit, but it's the same
as those two...)

fields.EN:
All right... This time we're
taking out the core. Alice, ready?
fields.JP:
それじゃあ……今度こそ核をやるよ。
アリス、いい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then. I'll hand you the core
this time. You ready, Alice?

fields.EN:
(What's going to happen when it's
destroyed?)
fields.JP: （これを破壊したら、何が起きるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's going to happen when it's
destroyed?)

fields.JP: ジェイルが悲鳴をあげてる！？

fields.EN:
I never heard such a sound
before...
fields.JP: こんなの……聞いたことない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I never heard such a sound
before...

fields.EN:
So this was something important
to the the Jail... Like an
organ...
fields.JP:
やはりこれは、ジェイルにとって
大切な器官だったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this was something important
to the the Jail... Like an
organ...

fields.EN:
That means... we did it! We
destroyed the core! Dad's going to
be so happy to hear this!
fields.JP:
てことは……やったよ！
間違いなく、核を破壊したんだ！
お父さん、きっと喜んでくれる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means... we did it! We
destroyed the core! Dad's going to
be so happy to hear this!

fields.EN:
Okay. Let's hurry back, then. That
Nightmare could come around
any moment!
fields.JP:
じゃあ……早く戻ろう。
あのナイトメアが出てくるかもしれない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. Let's hurry back, then. That
Nightmare could come around
any moment!

fields.EN:
Ah! Wait a sec! I need to take a
fragment of the core with me!
fields.JP:
あ！　そうだ……ちょっと待って！
核の欠片を持ってかなきゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! Wait a sec! I need to take a
fragment of the core with me!

fields.EN:
Dad told me to bring back a sample
of the core if we were able to
destroy it!
fields.JP:
もし核を破壊することができたら、
必ずサンプルを採取するようにって、
お父さんに言われてたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad told me to bring back a sample
of the core if we were able to
destroy it!

fields.EN:
Um, okay... I gotta be careful...
There...!
fields.JP:
えーと、取り扱いに注意……っと。
……これでよし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, okay... I gotta be careful...
There...!

fields.EN:
I can't believe we destroyed a
core while working on Miko-san's
request. Must be our lucky day.
fields.JP:
視子さんに頼まれたお使いにきて、
核の破壊に成功するなんて……
こーゆーのを棚からぼた餅っていうのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe we destroyed a
core while working on Miko's
request. Must be our lucky day.

fields.EN:
That was an incredible victory.
We have to tell Dad right away!
fields.JP:
ものすごい戦果を上げちゃったよ。
早く、お父さんに報告しなきゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This was a pretty swell turn of
events, if you ask me. We need to
report back to Dad, pronto!

fields.EN:
Let's hurry, Akazukin-san. I
feel like something's going to
happen soon...
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん……急ごう。
嫌な予感がするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's hurry, Red Riding Hood. I
feel like something's going to
happen soon...

fields.EN:
Oh, yeah... I got caught up in the
excitement there. Sorry.
fields.JP:
あ……うん。
ちょっと浮かれすぎたね。ごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, yeah... I got caught up in the
excitement there. Sorry.

fields.JP: あたりが暗くなってきたわ……！

ナイトメアだ……！
やっぱり出会っちゃったか……
ヒォォォオオオォォオ！！

fields.EN:
Let's get out of here! It'll be
all right, Alice.
fields.JP:
どうにかやり過ごそう！
アリス……大丈夫だからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's get out of here! It'll be
all right, Alice.

fields.EN:
Yes... You said I could
leave my back to you. I'm fine...!
fields.JP:
ええ……！
背中は任せてもらえると言ってくれたもの。
わたしは大丈夫……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... If I'm able to cover for
you, I'm sure I'll be fine!

fields.EN:
I don't know how I can help, but
I'll be here, too!
fields.JP:
僕も……何もできないかもしれないけど……
ついてるから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know how I can help, but
I'll be here, too!

fields.JP:
わかってるって……！
じゃあ、行くよ！

fields.EN:
I don't believe it...! But if this
is true...
fields.JP:
こんなことって……！
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't believe it...! But if this
is true...

fields.EN:
We can do this! We can kill the
Nightmare! Are you two still able
to fight?!
fields.JP:
……いける！　ナイトメアを殺れる！
ふたりとも……まだいける！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can do this! We can kill the
Nightmare! Are you two still able
to fight?!

fields.EN:
We beat it... We really beat a
Nightmare...
fields.JP:
……倒せた……
あたしたち、ナイトメアを倒したんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We beat it... We really beat a
Nightmare...

fields.EN:
We beat it! We beat the Nightmare!
Dad! We did it!
fields.JP:
倒した！　ナイトメアを倒した！
お父さん……あたしたち、やったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We beat it! We beat the Nightmare!
Dad! We did it!

fields.JP:
……しまった！
まだ息があったの！？

fields.EN:
Thank goodness... I made it in
time...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness... I made it in
time...

fields.JP: ナイトメアが……消えていく……
今度こそ……間違いなく倒したんだ……

fields.EN:
I can't believe we were able to do
this... A win against a
Nightmare...
fields.JP:
…………
まさか、このメンバーで成し遂げるとはね。
ナイトメア戦、初勝利だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe we were able to do
this... A win against a
Nightmare...

fields.JP: こいつら……倒せたんだね……

fields.EN: I see... You beat a Nightmare...
fields.JP: ……そうか。ナイトメアを倒したとは……
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... You beat a Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Yup! I still can't believe we were
able to kill something that we
thought could never be killed.
fields.JP:
うん。不死のナイトメアを倒せたなんて、
まだ信じらんないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I still can't believe we were
able to kill something that we
thought could never be killed.

fields.EN:
If anything's different from
before, it's that Jack and Alice
are with us now.
fields.JP:
今までと違ったことといえば……
……アリスとジャック、なのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anything's different from
before, it's that Jack and Alice
are with us now.

fields.JP: わたしは……別に特別では……

fields.EN:
Yeah... It was the first time we
found a core and destroyed it, so
maybe...
fields.JP:
うん。核を見つけるのも、破壊するのも
初めてだって……だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It was the first time we
found a core and destroyed it, so
maybe...

fields.EN: I see! I forgot about that!
fields.JP:
そっか……！
それ、すっかり忘れてたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I see! I forgot about that!

fields.EN:
Oh? Looks like you've got the
brains.
fields.JP: ほう。坊主、頭が回るじゃねぇか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Looks like you've got the
brains.

fields.EN:
Hm... Destroying the area's core
rendered the Nightmare vulnerable
to death...
fields.JP:
うむ……エリアの核を破壊することにより、
ナイトメアの不死性を剥奪し、消滅させ得る
というならば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Destroying the area's core
rendered the Nightmare vulnerable
to death...

fields.EN:
This is just an assumption, but
the Nightmares may be acting as
guardians of their areas...
fields.JP:
ナイトメアという存在は、そのエリアの
守護者たる役割を果たしているのかも
しれないね……あくまで仮説だが
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is just an assumption, but
the Nightmares may be acting as
guardians of their areas...

fields.EN:
Guardians of their areas...
Guardians of the Jail...
fields.JP: エリアの……ジェイルの守護者……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guardians of their areas...
Guardians of the Jail...

fields.EN:
And the discovery of the cores'
existence was also an assumption
derived from our observations.
fields.JP:
実のところ、核の存在もこれまでジェイルの
組織から導き出した、仮説に過ぎなかった
のだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And the discovery of the cores'
existence was also an assumption
derived from our observations.

fields.JP: えっ！　そうだったんだ……！

fields.EN:
None of the Dawn's search units
could find one, primarily because
of the presence of the Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ああ。かつての黎明の探索でも、これまでも、
探し出すことはできなかったからね。
ナイトメアが立ち塞がっていたことでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
None of the Dawn's search units
could find one, primarily because
of the presence of the Nightmares.

fields.EN: (And we were able to beat one...)
fields.JP: （僕たち、それを倒すことができたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (And we were able to beat one...)

fields.EN:
In any case, the fact that a
Nightmare can be defeated is a
major step towards our goal.
fields.JP:
いずれにせよ、作戦の難関の一つだった
ナイトメアの討伐が行えたことは、
大変大きな進歩だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, the fact that a
Nightmare can be defeated is a
major step towards our goal.

fields.EN:
Really?! I'm so happy you think
so, Dad!
fields.JP:
ほんと！？
お父さん……よかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?! I'm so happy you think
so, Dad!

fields.JP: いいえ。ちっともよくないわ

fields.EN:
You didn't inform the Professor
like you said you would. And you
brought these two with you.
fields.JP:
聞けば、結局あなたは博士には何も言わずに
飛び出して行ったそうじゃない。
しかも、このふたりを連れてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't inform the Professor
like you said you would. And you
brought these two with you.

fields.EN:
Well, we did get the magnolia
leaves, and we have a sample of the
core, and everyone's safe...
fields.JP:
で……でもさ、ほら。
ホオノキは採ってきたし、核のサンプルも
あるし、みんな無事だし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we did get the magnolia
leaves, and we have a sample of the
core, and everyone's safe...

fields.EN:
You're only saying that because
you succeeded. Jack isn't battle-
ready, either. This was too risky.
fields.JP:
全て結果論よ。
ましてジャックは、戦闘においては全くの素人。
無茶にも程があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're only saying that because
you succeeded. Jack isn't battle-
ready, either. This was too risky.

fields.EN:
Uh, but... I could've used my
blood if we needed it, and I don't
think she did it without thought.
fields.JP:
あ、あの……でも、いざとなったら僕の血が
使えますし……
全然考えがなかったわけじゃ……多分……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but... I could've used my
blood if we needed it, and I don't
think she did it without thought.

fields.EN:
We haven't gotten the results from
your tests yet. Be more mindful of
yourself. None of you are tools.
fields.JP:
あなたの検査結果はまだ出ていなかったのよ？
少しは自分の身を大切になさい。
あなたたちは道具でも何でもないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
We haven't gotten the results from
your tests yet. Be more mindful of
yourself. None of you are tools.

fields.EN:
I should have stopped Jack from
coming...
fields.JP:
わたしも……せめてジャックのことは
止めるべきでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should have stopped Jack from
coming...

fields.EN:
I-I know it was a little forceful...
But everything worked out, right? We've
faced danger before too... Right, Dad?
fields.JP:
そ、そりゃ、ちょっと強引だったけど……　
でも、あたしたち、上手くいったじゃん！
今までだって危ないことは……ね、お父さん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, maybe I was rushing
things, but I've been through
worse. Isn't that right, Dad?

fields.EN:
Your actions were quite
inappropriate this time around.
fields.JP: 今回の行動は確かに軽率ではあった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your actions were quite
inappropriate this time around.

fields.EN:
An operation that achieved this
much will likely pose a major
threat to the Jail as well.
fields.JP:
これだけ大きな成果を上げた活動だ。
それは、ジェイルにとっても大きな脅威という
ことになるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, you allowed us to make
great leaps today. I'm sure it'll prove
useful in our efforts.

fields.EN:
In any case, I'm just glad you
didn't encounter Snark. That would
have spelled doom for everyone.
fields.JP:
……ともかく、スナークと遭遇しなくて本当に
幸運だったよ。
遭遇していたら確実に命は無かっただろうからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I'm just glad you
didn't encounter Snark. That would
have spelled doom for everyone.

fields.EN:
It was 15 years ago... We
adventured to the Tower when the
Dawn was initially mobilized.
fields.JP:
かつて……十五年前のことだ。
黎明がようやく組織として軌道に乗った頃、
我々調査隊はあの塔を目指したのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was 15 years ago... We
adventured to the Tower when the
Dawn was initially mobilized.

fields.JP: やっぱり無茶だったんだよ……あんなの……

fields.EN:
Indeed. Now that I look back, it
was a foolhardy thing to do. But
we were desperate to escape.
fields.JP:
ああ。今になって思えば無茶だったかもしれん。
しかし、私たちは焦っていたのだ。
どうにかここから脱出できないものかとね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. Now that I look back, it
was a foolhardy thing to do. But
we were desperate to escape.

fields.EN:
We had skilled fighters and
weapons from the surface. But we
knew we wouldn't last long.
fields.JP:
当時の黎明には、君たち程ではないが、優秀な
戦士たちがいた。外界の武器もまだ多少は残存
していた。しかし、限りは見えていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
We had skilled fighters and
weapons from the surface. But we
knew we wouldn't last long.

fields.EN:
Our fear and anxiety reached its
limit, and everyone thought the
time was ripe to take action.
fields.JP:
人々の恐怖や焦りも頂点に達していた。
我々の勝機は……この時しか無いと、誰もが
そう思ったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our fear and anxiety reached its
limit, and everyone thought the
time was ripe to take action.

fields.EN:
And then it happened... We
encountered Snark...
fields.JP:
そして、惨劇は起きた。
……スナークと遭遇したのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And then it happened... We
encountered Snark...

fields.EN:
Our survey team was wiped out there in no
time. Thanks to their desperate resistance,
I alone somehow made it back alive.
fields.JP:
そこで我々調査隊は、あっけなく全滅した。
彼らの決死の応戦によって、私だけがどうにか
生還した
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our unit was destroyed. Through
everyone's efforts, I was somehow
able to survive...

fields.EN:
They said they couldn't afford to lose the
Dawn's brains, and they let me escape...
I still see that scene in my dreams.
fields.JP:
……黎明の頭脳を失うわけにはいかないと、
彼らはそう言いながら、私を逃がしてくれた……
あの時の光景は、今でも夢にみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They said they couldn't allow the
Dawn's leader to die, and ensured
my escape. I still remember it...

fields.EN:
That sounds like a horrible
past...
fields.JP: ……そんな過去があったんですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds like a horrible
past...

fields.EN:
As for "Snark," It had appeared
suddenly and slaughtered everyone.
fields.JP:
……スナークの話に戻ろう。
奴は突然我々の前に現れ、一瞬にして仲間たちを
次々と殺戮していったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for "Snark," It had appeared
suddenly and slaughtered everyone.

fields.EN:
Dad, what is "Snark?" What kind
of weapons did it use?
fields.JP:
お父さん。スナークっていうのは、いったい
どんな奴なの？　武器は！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad, what is "Snark?" What kind
of weapons did it use?

fields.EN:
Its form... is hard to describe. It was
neither human, Marchen, nor Nightmare—just
something bizarre that inspired fear.
fields.JP:
奴の形状は……何とも表現がつかない。
人、メルヒェン、ナイトメア……そのいずれとも
異なる。ただ恐怖感を誘う異様な何かだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It wasn't like anything we'd seen
before. I can't explain it... Only
that it was a form of fear itself.

fields.EN:
B-But if that's the case, how will
we know who or what this Snark
is?!
fields.JP:
じゃ……じゃあ、どうやって見分けたらいいのか
わからないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But if that's the case, how will
we know who or what this Snark
is?!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry this is all the information
I could bring back... I owe an apology
to all of you—and to those who died...
fields.JP:
このような情報しか持ち帰れずに済まないと
思っている……
君たちにも、そして死んでいった彼らにも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I can't forgive myself
for not being able to help you or
those who died for me.

fields.EN:
I wasn't trying to blame you...
Please don't get too down on
yourself, Dad...
fields.JP:
そ、そういう意味じゃ……
お父さん、あんまり自分を責めないでよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't trying to blame you...
Please don't get too down on
yourself, Dad...

fields.EN:
Just know that Snark is beyond
the level of Nightmares. I believe
it is the king of Nightmares.
fields.JP:
……ただ、伝えたかったのだ。
スナークとはナイトメアを凌駕する、異質な怪物
……恐らく、ナイトメアたちの王なのだと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just know that Snark is beyond
the level of Nightmares. I believe
it is the king of Nightmares.

fields.EN: And... it seems to understand human language.
fields.JP: そして……人語を解するようだと
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... it can speak our
language...

fields.EN:
So that means it has a high level
of intelligence.
fields.JP: 高い知能を持つ……ということですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that means it has a high level
of intelligence.

fields.EN:
Exactly. All I ask of you is to
beware of Snark during your
exploration.
fields.JP:
その通りだ。
……どうか、探索行動の際には、スナークには
注意してほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. All I ask of you is to
beware of Snark during your
exploration.

fields.EN: Got it, Dad, and... I'm sorry.
fields.JP:
うん。わかったよ、お父さん
……ごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it, Dad, and... I'm sorry.

fields.EN:
As long as you're all aware and
cautious, that's fine. That's all
from me.
fields.JP:
いや。君たちが危険を理解してくれればいい。
……私からは以上だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you're all aware and
cautious, that's fine. That's all
from me.

fields.EN:
Thank you for gathering the
leaves. They're of great help.
fields.JP:
ホオノキの採取、ありがとう。
実際、助かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for gathering the
leaves. They're of great help.

fields.EN:
I'll give your weapons a good
tune-up, so come by later, Akazukin, Alice.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、アリス。
お前らの武器、手入れしてやるから、
後で寄ってけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll give your weapons a good
tune-up, so come by later, Red
Riding Hood, Alice.

fields.EN:
We have the results from your
blood samples.
fields.JP: 君の血液の検査結果が出たよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have the results from your
blood samples.

fields.EN:
How was it? Am I able to help
everyone?
fields.JP:
結果は……どうだったんですか？
僕は、みんなの役に立てるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How was it? Am I able to help
everyone?

fields.EN:
...In short, you're a 'Blood Youth.' It's
unprecedented and extremely interesting.
I'd like to keep examining you.
fields.JP:
……結論から言えば、君は『血式少年』だ。
今までに無い例で、非常に興味深い。
これからも引き続き、調べさせてもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It turns out you're a Blood Youth,
so to speak. If possible, we'd
like to conduct further research.

fields.JP:
血式少年、ですか……？
じゃあ……！

fields.EN:
But a Blood Youth has unusual properties.
You can't draw out your power through
the Blood weapons used by Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
だが、血式少年とは特殊な性質を持っていてね。
血式少女たちの使用する血式武器では、力を
発揮することは不可能なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you're different from the
Blood Maidens. Your power can't be
utilized through Blood weapons.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: それって……どういうことですか
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
In simplicity, you're not battle-
worthy.
fields.JP: 簡単に言えば、戦力外ということだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In simplicity, you're not battle-
worthy.

fields.EN:
I can't use their weapons?! What's
a Blood weapon?! Why can't I use
one?!
fields.JP:
血式武器が使えないって……！
血式武器って何ですか！？
僕じゃ、どうして使えないんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't use their weapons?! What's
a Blood weapon?! Why can't I use
one?!

fields.JP: ハルさん！　視子さん……！

fields.EN:
Well, ya see, a Blood weapon is
made from the body parts of
Marchens.
fields.JP:
あー。そのな、血式武器っていうのは、
メルヒェンの体組織をパーツに使ってんだよ。
そんで、お前の場合……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, ya see, a Blood weapon is
made from the body parts of
Marchens.

fields.EN:
When your blood goes on one, the
weapon starts to rust immediately.
fields.JP: お前の血をかけると、武器が錆びちまうんだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When your blood goes on one, the
weapon starts to rust immediately.

fields.EN:
We believe it has something to do
with how your blood holds purging
properties against Corruption.
fields.JP:
おそらく『穢れ』を浄化する機能が反作用として
働くのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We believe it has something to do
with how your blood holds purging
properties against Corruption.

fields.EN:
Isn't there anything I can do
about it?! Like, maybe use a
normal weapon?
fields.JP:
ど……どうにかならないんですか！？
たとえば……普通の武器、とか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't there anything I can do
about it?! Like, maybe use a
normal weapon?

fields.EN:
Like the Professor said, hardly any weapons
like that remain. Besides, they rely on brute
strength. An amateur couldn't use one...
fields.JP:
さっき博士も言ってたが、そんなモンは殆ど
残っちゃいねえし、第一ああいうのは体力勝負だ。
素人にゃ何もできねえよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There aren't many normal weapons
here, and you wouldn't stand a
chance against 'em, ya know?

fields.EN:
So... I can't fight alongside
Alice and everyone else...
fields.JP:
僕は……アリスと……みんなと……
戦えないってこと、ですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So... I can't fight alongside
Alice and everyone else...

fields.EN:
B-But, I was useful on the
expedition, right?!
fields.JP:
で、でも……今回だってちゃんと、
みんなの役に立てた、と思うし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, I was useful on the
expedition, right?!

fields.EN:
You're battered and bleeding, right?
What you're doing is no different from
suicide. ...You'll die eventually.
fields.JP:
ボロボロにケガして、血ィ流して……だろ。
そいつは自殺行為と変わんねえ。
……いずれ死ぬ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only after you're bloody... What
you're doing is no different from
committing suicide.

fields.EN:
That's right, Jack. Your constitution
and your blood are subjects of
great interest to us. So...
fields.JP:
そうよ、ジャック。
あなたの体質やその血液は、高い関心対象では
あるの。だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Jack. We are aware
of how important you are, down to
your very blood, so...

fields.EN:
But... that doesn't mean a thing
to anyone...
fields.JP: そんなの……意味ないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... that doesn't mean a thing
to anyone...

fields.EN:
Everyone has things they're suited
for and things they aren't. Know your limits.
fields.JP:
