怪談じゃないの。出口がわからなくなった子……
それに、出口があるって知らない子……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not a horror story. A child
has lost their way... Who
doesn't know there's a way out.

fields.JP: ……やっぱ、あたしにはわかんないや

fields.EN:
It's true. I understood what Blue
Bird-san... what Bird-san told me. The
things in the labyrinth are those children.
fields.JP:
本当なの。青い鳥さん……鳥さんが
教えてくれたこと、わたしにはわかったの。
迷宮にあるものってあの子たちなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true. Blue bird tells me all.
I know what it says. There are
children in the labyrinth.

fields.EN:
They're waiting to be found. Their
exit from... the labyrinth...
Labyrinth, labyrinth, labyrinth...
fields.JP:
あの子たちは、見つけてくれるのを待ってるの。
あの子たち、出口を……迷宮からの……
迷宮、迷宮迷宮迷宮迷宮迷宮……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're waiting to be found. Their
exit from... the labyrinth...
Labyrinth, labyrinth, labyrinth...

fields.EN:
Michiru-sama?! I haven't seen her
like this in awhile...
fields.JP:
ミチル様……！？
こんな風には滅多に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru?! I haven't seen her
like this in awhile...

fields.EN:
Maybe she's tired... May I suggest
you let Oohime-san rest for a
bit?
fields.JP:
……ご心労がたたったのではないですか？
大陽女さんを少し休ませて差し上げては？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she's tired... May I suggest
you let Lady Oohime rest for a
bit?

fields.EN:
Michiru-sama... Please, sit here.
Take a deep breath...
fields.JP:
……ミチル様。さあ、ここに座って……
……ゆっくり息を吸って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru... Please, sit here.
Take a deep breath...

fields.EN:
(I haven't seen her like this
before... What's this "Blue Bird-san"
she was talking about?)
fields.JP:
（あんなに取り乱すなんて……
　それに、『青い鳥さん』って……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't seen her like this
before... What's this "blue bird"
she was talking about?)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry to have interrupted our
discussion. Now, about the other
rumor...
fields.JP:
……話を中断して申し訳ありません。
一つ目の話は以上です。もう一つは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry to have interrupted our
discussion. Now, about the other
rumor...

fields.EN:
The second rumor is something one
of our members actually
encountered at the Waterside.
fields.JP:
『旧河川・沼エリア』での話です。
こちらは教団員が実際に目撃遭遇しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
The second rumor is something one
of our members actually
encountered at the Waterside.

fields.EN:
Encountered? Why would you call it
a rumor, then?
fields.JP:
……目撃？
なのに不可思議だなんて、不思議な話ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Encountered? Why would you call it
a rumor, then?

fields.EN:
As you may know, we do not possess
the power to free the captives.
The Dawn is our only hope.
fields.JP:
ご存知でしょうが……我々教団は、囚われた
人々を解放できるだけの力を持ちません。
あなたたち黎明の力が唯一の頼みです
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you may know, we do not possess
the power to free the captives.
The Dawn is our only hope.

fields.EN:
But at least we began going to each
area's entrance to bring them Lady
Oohime-sama's words—her promise of salvation.
fields.JP:
しかし、せめて大陽女様の御言葉……救済を
彼らに届けられればと、各エリアの入り口
付近まで足を運ぶ活動を開始したのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we sought to send word of
their salvation to come, and sent
missionaries throughout the Jail.

fields.EN:
(I see... So that's why the
prisoners from back then knew
about the Order of the Sun...)
fields.JP:
（そうか……それで、かぐや姫のいたところでも
　タイヨウの教えを……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... So that's why the
prisoners from back then knew
about the Order of the Sun...)

fields.EN:
That's insane! You need to at
least have someone accompany
you!
fields.JP:
でも、無茶だよそんなの……！
せめて、誰か護衛を連れてかないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's insane! You need to at
least have someone accompany
you!

fields.EN:
Does the Dawn have the resources
to do that? Do you approve of our
activities?
fields.JP:
そのような人員を割く余裕が、黎明にあるの
でしょうか？
教団の活動に賛同して頂けるとでも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does the Dawn have the resources
to do that? Do you approve of our
activities?

fields.EN:
After taking in the escapees from the
City Streets, we realized just how deep
their despair and emotional scars were...
fields.JP:
『元街道沿いエリア』からの脱出者たちを
受け入れて、痛感したのです。
彼らの絶望と心の傷は、とても深いのだと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We deeply felt the prisoners'
hardships after welcoming escapees
from the City Steets, so...

fields.EN:
Back to the subject: a golden
hairball-like creature has appeared
there and seems to be attacking Marchens.
fields.JP:
……話を戻しましょう。
そのエリアには金の毛玉の化け物が出現し、
メルヒェンを襲撃しているようです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Back to the subject, there's an
unusual golden hairball there that
is killing the Marchens.

fields.EN:
A golden hairball? You better not
be pulling our leg.
fields.JP:
金の毛玉の化け物！？
ちー。あんたまで変なこと言わないでよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A golden hairball? You better not
be pulling our leg.

fields.EN:
Golden hairball... That sounds
quite interesting...
fields.JP: 金の毛玉ですか～。面白そうですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Golden hairball... That sounds
quite interesting...

fields.EN:
The creature is very agile and apparently
stole the missionaries' food... At
least we know it's a living creature.
fields.JP:
その化け物は非常に敏捷で、教団員の食料を
奪い去って行ったとのこと……
少なくとも、生物であることは確かなようです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever it is, it's fast and
cunning, and steals provisions
from our missionaries.

fields.JP: お父さん、『旧河川・沼エリア』って……？

fields.EN:
Similar to the Dorm, it's located
quite a distance away. We haven't
really gotten around there yet.
fields.JP:
『旧学生街エリア』と同じく、かなり奥地にあたる
場所になる。黎明の探索も手が回っていないのが
現状だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Similar to the Dorm, it's located
quite a distance away. We haven't
really gotten around there yet.

fields.EN:
So, I guess Dad doesn't know
anything about this golden
hairball thing.
fields.JP:
じゃあお父さんでも、その毛玉のことは
わかんないのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I guess Dad doesn't know
anything about this golden
hairball thing.

fields.EN:
These rumors are not only scaring
the people, but from Michiru-sama's words,
I feel there are others seeking salvation.
fields.JP:
これらの噂話が人々に不安を与えていることも
さることながら、ミチル様のお言葉から、
救済を望んでいる者がいるのではと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
These rumors are not only scaring
the people, but I feel there are
more out there seeking salvation.

fields.EN:
If possible, I would like to ask
the Dawn to investigate these
rumors, and save those found.
fields.JP:
真相の解明と、独房エリアからの救助……
可能ならば、黎明にお願いしたい。
これが、本日の用件です
fields.LOCALIZED:
If possible, I would like to ask
the Dawn to investigate these
rumors, and save those found.

fields.EN:
Hm... I was actually thinking of
having those locations
investigated anyway.
fields.JP:
ふむ……その両エリアの探索は、いずれ
行わねばならないとは、考えておりました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I was actually thinking of
having those locations
investigated anyway.

fields.EN:
But isn't it risky to act on just
rumors?
fields.JP: でも、こんな怪しい話だけじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But isn't it risky to act on just
rumors?

fields.EN:
Compared to before, our force is
much stronger now. Akazukin. Can you deploy?
fields.JP:
しばらく前と比べ、我らの戦力も充実している。
赤ずきんや。行けるかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Compared to before, our force is
much stronger now. Red Riding
Hood. Can you deploy?

fields.JP: ……もちろんだよ！　ね、みんな！
（赤ずきんさん、乗せられやすいなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood is pretty easy to
convince...)

fields.EN:
Very well, then. We will accept
your request.
fields.JP: では、お受けしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well, then. We will accept
your request.

fields.EN:
I thank you very much. Now then,
if you'll excuse us...
fields.JP:
……感謝します。
では、私たちはこれで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thank you very much. Now then,
if you'll excuse us...

fields.EN:
Michiru-sama? Are you able to
stand?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru? Are you able to
stand?

fields.EN:
Let's review what we know so
far...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's review what we know so
far...

fields.EN:
One report came from the Dorm. It's
beyond the Temple, and exploration
there had once been abandoned.
fields.JP:
ひとつは『旧学生街エリア』での目撃談。
ここは『旧寺院エリア』の更に奥地にあり、
一度調査は放棄されている
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Dorm is past the Temple area,
and is where the rumor of a girl
and a Nightmare originated.

fields.EN:
The other concerns a mysterious creature in
the Waterside. It's beyond Downtown and is,
for all practical purposes, almost unexplored.
fields.JP:
ひとつは『旧河川・沼エリア』での謎の生物。
ここは『元繁華街エリア』の更に奥地にあり、
実質上、未調査に近い
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Waterside is past the Downtown
area, and is the rumored site of a
golden hairball.

fields.EN:
Which of the two would you like
to explore first?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which of the two would you like
to explore first?

fields.EN:
I'm quite interested in the golden
hairball... I'd like everyone to
go there and get it for me.
fields.JP:
わらわは金の毛玉に興味があります～。
みんなで行って、取ってきてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite interested in the golden
hairball... I'd like everyone to
go there and get it for me.

fields.EN:
What the heck are you saying,
Princess Lazy? You're coming
with us, too!
fields.JP:
何言ってんのよ、グータラ姫。
あんたも当然行くのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the heck are you saying,
Princess Lazy? You're coming
with us, too!

fields.EN:
I'm a bit nervous about the place
where people were getting lost...
fields.JP: 行方不明者が出た方は、少し不安ですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a bit nervous about the place
where people were getting lost...

fields.EN:
Well, I'm interested in going to
places we haven't been yet!
fields.JP:
人跡未踏のエリアといいますと、
興味がありますわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm interested in going to
places we haven't been yet!

fields.EN:
But we really haven't gone to
either of those places, so I don't
think that changes much.
fields.JP:
どちらも実質未調査に近いということは……
条件はあまり変わらないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we really haven't gone to
either of those places, so I don't
think that changes much.

fields.EN:
Well... personally, I think the Dorm area
is riskier. It wasn't merely unexplored—we
couldn't investigate it at all.
fields.JP:
そうだな……俺個人の考えで言えば、
『旧学生街エリア』の方がリスクが高い。
未調査というより調査不可能だったわけだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, in my opinion, the Dorm
area's more risky. We lost guys
over there, remember...

fields.EN:
Speaking of that, in the Waterside area
they've sighted a creature believed to
be neither a Marchen nor a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
それを言ったら、『旧河川・沼エリア』では
メルヒェンともナイトメアとも異なると
思われる生物が目撃されているわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Waterside has that strange
thing roaming around. There's no
telling what might happen.

fields.EN:
So, that means both would be a
pain. Why don't we just forget
about them?
fields.JP:
つまり、どちらも面倒臭いということですね～
両方行くのをやめたらどうですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that means both would be a
pain. Why don't we just forget
about them?

fields.EN:
B-But, we did say we were going
to investigate...
fields.JP: で……でも、もう引き受けちゃったからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, we did say we were going
to investigate...

You mean the Professor said he
would investigate...

fields.EN:
Come now, we're going to have to
venture there one day, anyway.
fields.JP: まあ、いずれ必要な調査ではあるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, we're going to have to
venture there one day, anyway.

fields.EN:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?
fields.JP:
……そうだ。君たち……
今回はチームを分けてみないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?

fields.EN: And why do you suggest that?
fields.JP: それは……どうしてですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: And why do you suggest that?

fields.EN:
With Kaguyahime and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.
fields.JP:
なに、せっかくかぐや姫とシンデレラという
強力な戦力が行動可能になったわけだしね。
今の君たちなら、何も全員で行くこともあるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Kaguya and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.

fields.EN:
We've had one major operation after
another. I thought one team could take a
modest break while the other investigates.
fields.JP:
大きな作戦も続いたところだ。
一方のチームが調査に赴いている間、もう一方は
ささやかだが休暇を取るのも良いかと思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our goal is still far off. I think
it would make sense to have a team
head in while the other rests.

fields.EN:
But, that won't give Jack any time
to rest...
fields.JP: ……それでは、ジャックは休めないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, that won't give Jack any time
to rest...

fields.EN:
You could say his load would be
lighter with fewer people to worry
about in the party.
fields.JP:
人数が少ない方が、彼の負担も減るとは
考えられるけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could say his load would be
lighter with fewer people to worry
about in the party.

fields.EN:
But giving everyone but Jack a
chance to rest lacks parity and
may contribute to lower morale.
fields.JP:
彼だけ休暇無しという不公平さは、チームの
士気を下げかねないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But giving everyone but Jack a
chance to rest lacks parity and
may contribute to lower morale.

fields.EN:
Sure we got more hands on deck,
but those areas are new to us.
Why shorthand the group now?
fields.JP:
確かに戦力は充実したとはいえ、今回のエリアは
いわば下調べ無しのぶっつけ本番だ。
ここで戦力の出し惜しみもあるまい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure we got more hands on deck,
but those areas are new to us.
Why shorthand the group now?

fields.EN:
And if it's about rest, just give
them a huge-ass vacation after
everything's done.
fields.JP:
……休暇をやりたいなら、ケチケチせずに
作戦終了後にたっぷりくれてやったらどうだ、
オッさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if it's about rest, just give
them a huge-ass vacation after
everything's done.

fields.EN:
I'm fine taking a vacation right
now... Forever...
fields.JP: わらわは今すぐずっと休暇でいいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine taking a vacation right
now... Forever...

fields.EN:
I'm happy that you're thinking
about us, Dad... Like, really,
really happy.
fields.JP:
お父さんがあたしたちのことを考えて
言ってくれたのはわかってるんだ……
すごく嬉しいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy that you're thinking
about us, Dad... Like, really,
really happy.

fields.EN:
But we're finally coming together
as a solid team. I'd rather have
everyone work together as one.
fields.JP:
でも、せっかくこのメンバーで、チームが
固まってきてるしね。
せっかくなら、あたしはみんなで行きたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we're finally coming together
as a solid team. I'd rather have
everyone work together as one.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! You're right. I was
getting a bit ahead of myself here
again.
fields.JP:
ははは。君たちの言う通りだよ。
私としたことが、少し浮かれてしまっていた
ようだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! You're right. I was
getting a bit ahead of myself here
again.

fields.EN:
Well, back on topic. Which
location do you want to
investigate first?
fields.JP:
では、話を戻そう。
君たちはどちらを先に調査すべきだと思うかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, back on topic. Which
location do you want to
investigate first?

fields.EN:
Mmm... To be honest, both are
pretty risky, but...
fields.JP:
うーん。ま、ぶっちゃけどっちが先でも
リスクはあるってことなんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... To be honest, both are
pretty risky, but...

fields.EN:
I'd like to check out the
Waterside. It sounds pretty
challenging!
fields.JP:
あたしは『旧河川・沼エリア』かな。
なんていうか、挑みがいがありそうだしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd like to check out the
Waterside. It sounds pretty
challenging!

fields.EN:
I don't care... Both sound
tiring... If I had a choice, I'd
rather not go to either...
fields.JP:
面倒臭いからどっちでもいいです～
むしろ行きたくないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't care... Both sound
tiring... If I had a choice, I'd
rather not go to either...

fields.EN:
As for me... I think I'd prefer the Dorm.
That "labyrinth of no return" has me curious!
fields.JP:
私はそうね……
『旧学生街エリア』がいいかしら。
帰らずの迷宮っていうのが気になるしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for me, I'd prefer the Dorm.
Those kids getting lost in the
labyrinth seems interesting!

fields.EN:
Shirayuki would like to see the
girl walking around with the
Nightmare at the Dorm, as well.
fields.JP:
白雪は、『旧学生街エリア』です。
ナイトメアと仲良しな女の子が気になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White would like to see the
girl walking around with the
Nightmare at the Dorm, as well.

fields.EN:
Ohohoho! I prefer the Waterside
myself! Leave that golden ball to
me!
fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ……
わたくしは『旧河川・沼エリア』ですわね！
化け物退治ならお任せあそばせ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohoho! I prefer the Waterside
myself! Leave that golden ball to
me!

fields.EN:
I'm interested in what's happening
at the Dorm.
fields.JP:
わたしは……『旧学生街エリア』ね。
何が起きているのか、気になるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm interested in what's happening
at the Dorm.

fields.EN:
So aside from one person who
doesn't want to go at all, we're
tied. How about you, Jack?
fields.JP:
……ってことは、約一名の棄権者を除けば
三対三か……
ジャックはどっちが先がいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So aside from one person who
doesn't want to go at all, we're
tied. How about you, Jack?

fields.EN:
...The Dorm. There could be more
people getting lost there as we
speak.
fields.JP:
『旧学生街エリア』かな……？
こうしている間にも、また行方不明者が出ると
大変だって思うし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...The Dorm. There could be more
people getting lost there as we
speak.

fields.EN: All right! The Dorm it is!
fields.JP: それじゃ、『旧学生街エリア』に決定だね！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! The Dorm it is!

fields.JP: えっ！？　そんな簡単に決めていいの！？

fields.EN:
We took a democratic vote here.
Fair, right?
fields.JP:
全員が意見を出した上で多数決なんだから、
いいんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
We took a democratic vote here.
Fair, right?

fields.EN:
Well then, I'd like to ask you all
to head to the Dorm area.
fields.JP:
では、君たちにはまず『旧学生街エリア』へ
向かってもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I'd like to ask you all
to head to the Dorm area.

fields.EN: Yup! Off to the Dorm we go!
fields.JP: うん……じゃあ、『旧学生街エリア』へ出発！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! Off to the Dorm we go!

fields.EN:
...The Waterside area. Who knows
what other problems this golden
hairball thing could cause.
fields.JP:
『旧河川・沼エリア』かな……？
毛玉の化け物だなんて、誰か被害者が出ると
危ないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...The Waterside area. Who knows
what other problems this golden
hairball thing could cause.

fields.EN: All right! Waterside area it is!
fields.JP: それじゃ、『旧河川・沼エリア』に決定だね！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! Waterside area it is!

fields.JP: えっ！？　そんな簡単に決めていいの！？

fields.EN:
We took a democratic vote here.
Fair, right?
fields.JP:
全員が意見を出した上で多数決なんだから、
いいんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
We took a democratic vote here.
Fair, right?

fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ……
その通りですわ！

fields.EN:
Well then, I'd like to ask you all
to head to the Waterside.
fields.JP:
では、君たちにはまず『旧河川・沼エリア』へ
向かってもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I'd like to ask you all
to head to the Waterside.

fields.EN: Yup! Off to the Waterside we go!
fields.JP: うん……じゃあ、『旧河川・沼エリア』へ出発！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! Off to the Waterside we go!

fields.EN:
Looks like everyone's here. Now
then, let's begin.
fields.JP:
……みんな揃ったようだね。
では、話を始めよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like everyone's here. Now
then, let's begin.

fields.EN:
Thank you all for investigating
the Dorm, and for destroying the
area's core.
fields.JP:
『旧学生街エリア』での調査および核の破壊……
本当によくやってくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you all for investigating
the Dorm, and for destroying the
area's core.

fields.EN: Yup! We all did our best!
fields.JP: うん。みんな本当にがんばったからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! We all did our best!

fields.EN:
We shared our findings with the Order of the
Sun and discussed them. Once she learned the
truth, Oohime-san seemed greatly relieved...
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団とも調査結果を伝え、協議したよ。
真相を知り、大陽女さんも非常に安心された
様子だった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We reported our results to the
Order of the Sun, and Oohime
seemed quite pleased.

fields.EN:
At the same time, let me tell you that she was
deeply pained by what happened to Hansel-kun.
fields.JP:
同時に、ヘンゼルくんのことは、大変心を
痛められていたと伝えておこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have to say I am very sad
about what happened to Hansel.

fields.EN:
That said, I would like to
officially welcome Gretel-kun as a
member of the Dawn.
fields.JP:
また、既に伝わっているかもしれないが、
ここにいるグレーテルくんが、
我々の正式なメンバーとなった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I would like to
officially welcome Gretel as a
member of the Dawn.

fields.EN:
We have the final results
confirming that she's a Blood
Maiden.
fields.JP:
彼女が間違いなく、血式少女であるという
検査結果も出たわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have the final results
confirming that she's a Blood
Maiden.

fields.EN:
Though, to be honest, I'm quite
surprised that there was a Blood
Maiden living out in that area.
fields.JP:
正直、驚きね。
あのエリアに血式少女が住んでいたなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Though, to be honest, I'm quite
surprised that there was a Blood
Maiden living out in that area.

fields.EN:
It's truly a joy to have another
join us. Thank you, and please
welcome her with open arms.
fields.JP:
ここでまた、新たに仲間を迎えられるのは、
大きな喜びだ。みんな、本当にありがとう
どうか、彼女を迎えてやってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's truly a joy to have another
join us. Thank you, and please
welcome her with open arms.

fields.EN:
I suppose I should say that I'm
looking forward to being here
with all of you.
fields.JP: 改めて、どうぞよろしくね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I should say that I'm
looking forward to being here
with all of you.

fields.EN: Yup! You're one of us now!
fields.JP: うん。あんたはもう、あたしたちの仲間だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! You're one of us now!

fields.EN:
Now then, on to the next subject.
I take it you remember your other
mission, yes?
fields.JP:
さて。前置きはここまでとなる
君たちは、もう一つの任務を覚えているかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, on to the next subject.
I take it you remember your other
mission, yes?

fields.EN:
I need you to check on the rumor
about the golden hairball running
around the Waterside area.
fields.JP:
『旧河川・沼エリア』での謎の生物の目撃……
その真相を確認してもらいたいのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need you to check on the rumor
about the golden hairball running
around the Waterside area.

fields.EN:
Heh... So, I suppose this marks
my first mission as a Blood
Maiden.
fields.JP:
ふふ……これが私の
……血式少女としての、初任務というわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... So, I suppose this marks
my first mission as a Blood
Maiden.

fields.EN:
Just as a reminder, we need you to
work with us, and not on your own.
fields.JP:
わかっているとは思うけれど、独断による行動は
謹んで頂戴
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just as a reminder, we need you to
work with us, and not on your own.

fields.EN:
Why, yes. This will be my first
time working as part of a group.
It should be quite interesting.
fields.JP:
ええ、わかってるわ。
初めての集団行動……何もかもが興味深いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. This will be my first
time working as part of a group.
It should be quite interesting.

fields.EN:
I must say, though, that I feel
bad for placing such a burden upon
you all without much rest...
fields.JP:
連続した任務となり、君たちには負担を強いる
ことになるが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, though, that I feel
bad for placing such a burden upon
you all without much rest...

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Dad. It's our duty as
members of the Blood Team to
handle these things.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、お父さん。
それが、あたしたち血式部隊の仕事なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Dad. It's our duty as
members of the Blood Team to
handle these things.

fields.EN:
There could be others in danger as
we speak, so just leave it to us.
fields.JP:
それに……こうしてる間にも、誰か被害者が
出たらいけないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There could be others in danger as
we speak, so just leave it to us.

fields.EN:
I'm really sorry to have you all
go through this...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm really sorry to have you all
go through this...

fields.EN:
Now, please make your way over to
the Waterside.
fields.JP:
では、君たちには早速『旧河川・沼エリア』へ
向かってもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, please make your way over to
the Waterside.

fields.EN:
Looks like everyone's here. Now
then, let's begin.
fields.JP:
……みんな揃ったようだね。
では、話を始めよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like everyone's here. Now
then, let's begin.

fields.EN:
Thank you all for investigating
the Waterside and for destroying
the area's core.
fields.JP:
『旧河川・沼エリア』での調査および核の破壊
……本当によくやってくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you all for investigating
the Waterside and for destroying
the area's core.

fields.EN:
Well, I think Jack was the major
player in this victory.
fields.JP: まあ……ジャックの手柄も大きいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I think Jack was the major
player in this victory.

fields.JP: じゃっく、すきーーーー！！

fields.EN:
We reported our results to the
Order of the Sun, and Oohime-san
seemed quite pleased.
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団とも調査結果を伝え、協議したよ。
真相を知り、大陽女さんも非常に安心された
様子だったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We reported our results to the
Order of the Sun, and Oohime
seemed quite pleased.

fields.EN:
They thanked us and said that
they could now relieve their
followers of their anxiety.
fields.JP:
信者の人たちの不安も、これで取り除けると
感謝しておられた
fields.LOCALIZED:
They thanked us and said that
they could now relieve their
followers of their anxiety.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルは気にしなくていいんだよ

fields.EN:
That said, I would like to
officially welcome Rapunzel-kun as a
member of the Dawn.
fields.JP:
また、ここにいるラプンツェルくんが、
我々の正式なメンバーとなった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I would like to
officially welcome Rapunzel as a
member of the Dawn.

fields.EN:
We have the final results
confirming that she's a Blood
Maiden.
fields.JP:
彼女が間違いなく、血式少女であるという
検査結果も出たわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have the final results
confirming that she's a Blood
Maiden.

fields.EN: I've got her equipment all ready.
fields.JP: 装備の方も、調整しといたぜ
fields.LOCALIZED: I've got her equipment all ready.

fields.JP: うう……ねむねむ……ふく、きらい……

fields.EN:
She can actually converse with
Nemu?!
fields.JP: この子、ネムと会話ができてるわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She can actually converse with
Sleepy?!

fields.EN:
Well, for some reason, she's been
quite attached to Nemurihime
from the start.
fields.JP:
うん。最初から眠り姫には心を許してた
みたいだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, for some reason, she's been
quite attached to Sleeping Beauty
from the start.

fields.JP: ねむねむ、すきーーーー！

fields.EN:
It's truly a joy to have another
join us. Thank you, and please
welcome her with open arms.
fields.JP:
ここでまた、新たに仲間を迎えられるのは、
大きな喜びだ。みんな、本当にありがとう
どうか、彼女を迎えてやってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's truly a joy to have another
join us. Thank you, and please
welcome her with open arms.

fields.EN: Rapunzel joined everyone as a companion!
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、なかまになったよ！

fields.EN: Yup! You're one of us now!
fields.JP: うん。あんたはもう、あたしたちの仲間だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! You're one of us now!

fields.EN:
Now then, on to the next subject.
I take it you remember your other
mission, yes?
fields.JP:
さて。前置きはここまでとなる
君たちは、もう一つの任務を覚えているかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, on to the next subject.
I take it you remember your other
mission, yes?

fields.EN:
I need you to investigate the
mysterious girl sighted in the Dorm...
and the continuing disappearances.
fields.JP:
『旧学生街エリア』での謎の少女の目撃……
行方不明者の続出……
その真相を確認してもらいたいのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need you to check on the rumor
about the disappearances of the
children at the Dorm area.

fields.EN: Jack? Good food to eat there?
fields.JP: じゃっく、そこ……おいしいものある？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? Good food to eat there?

fields.EN: Okay! I eat Jack when hungry!
fields.JP: じゃあ、おなかすいたらじゃっくたべるー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! I eat Jack when hungry!

fields.EN: Um... That's not a good idea...
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... That's not a good idea...

fields.EN:
Then... We'll bring rations with
us. Would that work for you,
Rapunzel-san?
fields.JP:
ええと……
何か傷まないものを持って行きましょう。
ね、ラプンツェルさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then... We'll bring rations with
us. Would that work for you,
Rapunzel?

fields.EN:
I must say, though, that I feel
bad for placing such a burden upon
you all without much rest...
fields.JP:
連続した任務となり、君たちには負担を強いる
ことになるが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, though, that I feel
bad for placing such a burden upon
you all without much rest...

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Dad. It's our duty as
members of the Blood Team to
handle these things.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、お父さん。
それが、あたしたち血式部隊の仕事なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Dad. It's our duty as
members of the Blood Team to
handle these things.

fields.EN:
It's an area we judged impossible
to investigate. Be careful that
you don't go missing as well.
fields.JP:
調査不可能と判断されたエリアだ。
お前らまで行方不明にならねえように
気をつけろよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That place is dangerous. A lot of
our guys went missing there, so be
careful.

fields.EN:
Thanks! We'll be careful, Haru-san.
And don't worry... We're used to
reckless missions and things!
fields.JP:
ありがと。気をつけるよ、ハルさん。
それに……無茶な任務は慣れてるしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks! We'll be careful, Haru.
And don't worry... We're used to
reckless missions and things!

fields.EN:
I'm really sorry to have you all
go through this...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm really sorry to have you all
go through this...

fields.EN:
Now, please make your way over to
the Dorm.
fields.JP:
では、君たちには早速『旧学生街エリア』へ
向かってもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, please make your way over to
the Dorm.

fields.EN:
Hm... So this is the Dorm...
Doesn't seem so different from the
other areas.
fields.JP:
ふーん。ここが『旧学生街エリア』なのね。
ぱっと見じゃ、他のエリアとあんまり違う
ようにも思えないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... So this is the Dorm...
Doesn't seem so different from the
other areas.

fields.EN:
True. But it's still known for
disappearances, so we'd better be
careful.
fields.JP:
そうね……でも、不可思議な事件が起きている
場所であることには変わりないわ。
警戒して進まなければ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. But it's still known for
disappearances, so we'd better be
careful.

fields.EN:
Yup. Be sure to keep an eye out
for anything weird.
fields.JP:
うん。何か変わったところがないか、
気を配って探索した方がいいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Be sure to keep an eye out
for anything weird.

fields.EN:
Maybe this is where everyone runs
away to when they want to play
hooky.
fields.JP:
実はだらだらしたくて逃げ込む場所が、
ここだってことはないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe this is where everyone runs
away to when they want to play
hooky.

fields.JP: さ……さすがにそれはないんじゃないかな……

fields.EN:
If anyone would do that, it'd be
you, Princess Lazy...
fields.JP:
ていうか、それ……グータラ姫くらいなもの
だと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anyone would do that, it'd be
you, Princess Lazy...

fields.JP: オオオオォォォォォォオオオオオオ……

fields.EN:
There it goes again. It sounds
creepier than usual. Like
something is about to appear...
fields.JP:
……今日は一段と気味が悪い声ですね。
何か出そうです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There it goes again. It sounds
creepier than usual. Like
something is about to appear...

fields.EN:
A-Appear?! I-It better not be a
ghost!
fields.JP: おお、お化けなんて出ないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-Appear?! I-It better not be a
ghost!

fields.JP: おばけ？　それおいしい？

fields.EN: Are ghosts supposed to be scary?
fields.LOCALIZED: Are ghosts supposed to be scary?

fields.EN:
N-Not at all! No way! They're
absolutely not scary!
fields.JP:
い、いや！　怖くないよ！
怖くないって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Not at all! No way! They're
absolutely not scary!

fields.JP: （ジェイルはお腹が空いてるみたいだ……）
オオオオォォォォォォオオオオオオ……

fields.EN:
(The sound coming from the Jail is
more disturbing than ever... I'd
better keep my headphones on...)
fields.JP:
（ジェイルの声、今日は一段と耳障りだ……
　ヘッドホン、はめておこう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The sound coming from the Jail is
more disturbing than ever... I'd
better keep my headphones on...)

fields.EN:
I'm surprised seeing Aka-nee
freak out like this...
fields.JP: 赤姉の意外な弱点を発見って感じね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised seeing Sister Red
freak out like this...

fields.EN:
S-Stop it... I... I just got
startled, that's all...
fields.JP: い、いや……びっくりしただけだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop it... I... I just got
startled, that's all...

fields.EN: It can talk! It's not a ghost!
fields.JP:
喋りましたよ！
幽霊じゃありません……！
fields.LOCALIZED: It can talk! It's not a ghost!

fields.EN:
L-Like I said, I'm not afraid of
ghosts...
fields.LOCALIZED:
L-Like I said, I'm not afraid of
ghosts...

fields.EN:
Um... My name is Jack. The girls
here are...
fields.JP:
あ……あの、僕はジャック。
一緒にいるみんなは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... My name is Jack. The girls
here are...

fields.EN:
Isn't it proper etiquette to first
introduce yourself before
inquiring about others?
fields.JP:
人に名前を聞くときには、まず自分から名乗る
ものよ。違うかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it proper etiquette to first
introduce yourself before
inquiring about others?

fields.JP:
……それもそうね。
私の名前はグレーテルよ

fields.EN: Hello, Gretel. My name is Alice.
fields.JP:
そう。グレーテルというのね。
わたしはアリスよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hello, Gretel. My name is Alice.

fields.EN:
Um... Isn't she the girl from the
rumors?
fields.JP:
あの……あの人が、噂になってる女の子じゃ
ないでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Isn't she the girl from the
rumors?

fields.EN:
I see! Then we can ask her about
what's happening here.
fields.JP:
……そうか！
だったら、事情を聞いてみれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see! Then we can ask her about
what's happening here.

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel? There's something we
want to ask you...
fields.JP:
あの、グレーテル……
実は、君に聞きたいことが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel? There's something we
want to ask you...

fields.JP: ワープしたんじゃないかと思います～

fields.EN:
Warped?! What do you mean by
that?!
fields.JP: ……ワープ？　どういうことよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Warped?! What do you mean by
that?!

fields.EN:
There's always a method to move
objects.
fields.JP:
物が移動する時には、必ず何か方法がある
ものです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's always a method to move
objects.

fields.EN:
Vanishing like that could only
mean she used some tool or
special power.
fields.JP:
あんな風に一瞬で消えるとしたら、何か道具か、
特殊な能力を使ったとしか考えられません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Vanishing like that could only
mean she used some tool or
special power.

fields.EN:
But I didn't notice any item use,
so I believe it was her special
power.
fields.JP:
でも、道具を使った素振りはありませんでした。
つまり、あの子は特殊な能力を持っているのだと
思います～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I didn't notice any item use,
so I believe it was her special
power.

fields.JP: かぐやさん、鋭いですね……！

fields.EN:
I may be lazy, but that doesn't
mean I'm delusional. There's no
such thing as ghosts.
fields.JP:
わらわはこう見えても現実主義者ですから～
幽霊なんているわけありませんし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may be lazy, but that doesn't
mean I'm delusional. There's no
such thing as ghosts.

fields.EN:
And of course you're a master
at using tools to avoid putting
effort into anything.
fields.JP:
さすが、サボるためなら道具でも何でも使って
努力を惜しまないだけあるわよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And of course you're a master
at using tools to avoid putting
effort into anything.

fields.EN:
Regardless of how she did that, I
guess it's safe to assume she
isn't a normal human...
fields.JP:
具体的な方法はともかく……
普通の人間ではなさそうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless of how she did that, I
guess it's safe to assume she
isn't a normal human...

fields.EN:
Well, if that is her special
power, wouldn't that make her a
Blood Maiden?
fields.JP:
でも……特殊な能力ということになりますと、
あの方は血式少女ということになりますの
ですかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if that is her special
power, wouldn't that make her a
Blood Maiden?

fields.EN:
If she is, why would there be
rumors of her hanging out with a
Nightmare?
fields.JP:
でも、もし血式少女なんだとしたら、
どうしてナイトメアと一緒にいるって噂が
出るんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she is, why would there be
rumors of her hanging out with a
Nightmare?

fields.EN:
True... There's no way anyone
could befriend a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
……それはそうよね。人と仲良くするナイトメア
なんて、ありえないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... There's no way anyone
could befriend a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
And if she is a Blood Maiden, I'm
sure that would have been known
to us by now already.
fields.JP:
血式少女だとしたら、今まで誰にも発見されず、
保護もされていないなんて、考えられません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if she is a Blood Maiden, I'm
sure that would have been known
to us by now already.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, the Dawn
discovered me and Jack in that
prison cell, too.
fields.JP:
わたしとジャックも、黎明に発見してもらって
牢獄を出ることができたのだものね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, the Dawn
discovered me and Jack in that
prison cell, too.

fields.EN:
Yup. And we only arrived so late
because we didn't have the power
to free you earlier...
fields.JP:
うん。むしろ二人の場合は遅かったくらい……。
投獄されてたっていうのが大きかったけど、
あたしらの力不足だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. And we only arrived so late
because we didn't have the power
to free you earlier...

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san, you don't need
to worry about that...
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさんが気にすることじゃないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to get down on
yourself over that.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens go through a lot in
their lives. I'm just one of the
lucky ones.
fields.JP:
みんな知ってることだけど、血式少女は決して
恵まれた境遇で生きてこれるわけじゃない。
あたしなんかは恵まれ過ぎてたくらいなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens go through a lot in
their lives. I'm just one of the
lucky ones.

fields.EN:
So it's kind of unfortunate that
not all of them meet nice people
like everyone in the Dawn...
fields.JP:
くやしいけど……みんながみんな、
黎明の人たちみたいにいい人ばかりじゃ
ない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it's kind of unfortunate that
not all of them meet nice people
like everyone in the Dawn...

fields.EN:
That's why I'm doing my best to
find Blood Maidens, not just for
help, but to protect them.
fields.JP:
だから……戦力の充実ってだけじゃなくて
早く保護するためにも……あたしたちは
血式少女の情報を集めて、探してるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I'm doing my best to
find Blood Maidens, not just for
help, but to protect them.

fields.JP: んーーーーーラプンツェルはーーー？

fields.EN:
Sorry! Uh, you kinda slipped
through the cracks!
fields.JP:
ごめん！
あんたは完全にノーチェックだったわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry! Uh, you kinda slipped
through the cracks!

fields.EN:
Well, but in her case, she was
attacking people, not being
attacked.
fields.JP: 虐められるどころか、むしろ人を襲ってたしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, but in her case, she was
attacking people, not being
attacked.

fields.EN:
In any case, does that mean she
isn't a Blood Maiden?
fields.JP:
……だとすれば、あの方は血式少女ではないと
いうことになりますのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, does that mean she
isn't a Blood Maiden?

fields.EN:
I don't think we can say that yet.
After all, this area hasn't been
fully explored yet, right?
fields.JP:
そうとも言えないわね。
何しろここは今まで、人の手が及ばなかった
場所なのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think we can say that yet.
After all, this area hasn't been
fully explored yet, right?

fields.EN:
Well, based on what we know, we
don't have much information on
hand to make that call.
fields.JP: まあ……今のところは何とも言えないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, based on what we know, we
don't have much information on
hand to make that call.

fields.EN: But, if she is a Blood Maiden...
fields.LOCALIZED: But, if she is a Blood Maiden...

fields.EN: "If she is a Blood Maiden," what?
fields.JP: 血式少女だとしたら……何よ？
fields.LOCALIZED: "If she is a Blood Maiden," what?

fields.EN:
Wouldn't it be a possibility that
she's being forced by the
Nightmare to follow its orders?
fields.JP:
ナイトメアに脅されて、言うことを聞かされてる
……ってことはないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't it be a possibility that
she's being forced by the
Nightmare to follow its orders?

fields.EN:
But we're still not sure whether
Nightmares even have the capacity
to do that, right?
fields.JP:
でも、ナイトメアにそこまでの知能があるの
か、甚だ疑問ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we're still not sure whether
Nightmares even have the capacity
to do that, right?

fields.JP:
ジャックさんが言いたいのは、『スナーク』の
こと……じゃないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe Jack was trying to say it
could be... Snark?

fields.EN:
Y-Yes, that's right, but... Maybe
I'm overthinking it...
fields.JP:
う、うん……実はそうなんだけど……
少し、考えすぎかもしれないよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes, that's right, but... Maybe
I'm overthinking it...

fields.EN:
Let's go and look for Gretel
first. No use speculating amongst
ourselves now..
fields.JP:
とりあえずはさ、グレーテルだっけ？
あの子を探してみようよ。
ここで話してたってしょうがないんだしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go and look for Gretel
first. No use speculating amongst
ourselves now..

fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャック……
もしかしたらなのだけど、この場所は……

fields.EN:
Yeah... It looks like we've been
wandering around the same places
over and over again...
fields.JP:
うん……
どうも、さっきから何度も同じ場所を
ぐるぐる回っているみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It looks like we've been
wandering around the same places
over and over again...

fields.EN:
I knew it... I thought there was
something strange here...
fields.JP:
やっぱ、そうか……
そんな気がしてたんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it... I thought there was
something strange here...

fields.JP: ぐるぐるだねーーーーーーーーー！
要するに……迷子ってわけね……

fields.EN:
Looks like we've bitten off more
than we can chew... I am very
quickly becoming bored...
fields.JP:
ミイラ取りがミイラになるってやつですね～
わらわはだんだん飽きてきました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we've bitten off more
than we can chew... I am very
quickly becoming bored...

fields.EN:
Kaguya-san, this is no time to take
it easy. Even we have limits to our stamina...
fields.JP:
かぐやさん。呑気にしてる場合じゃありません
ですわ。わたくしたちにも体力の限界という
ものがございますもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, this is no time to joke.
We need to hurry, as we can only
do this for so long.

fields.EN:
I suppose... I wouldn't want my
Bamboo One to run out of fuel
after all...
fields.JP:
そう言われればそうですね～
わらわのバンブー一号も、燃料切れになったら
困りますし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose... I wouldn't want my
Bamboo One to run out of fuel
after all...

fields.EN: Is that all you're worried about?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that all you're worried about?!

fields.JP: ラプンツェルはげんきだよーーーー！

fields.EN:
Shirayuki has been keeping an eye
out, but it looks like we keep
ending up in the same place.
fields.JP:
白雪も、少し前に気がついてから
だいぶ注意していたんですけど……
やっぱり、同じ場所に出てしまうんですよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White has been keeping an eye
out, but it looks like we keep
ending up in the same place.

fields.EN:
And it doesn't look like we took
any wrong turns, either...
fields.JP:
そうね。
道を間違えたというわけではなさそうだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And it doesn't look like we took
any wrong turns, either...

fields.EN:
I've been thinking... Maybe
there's some unusual power that's
affecting this area.
fields.JP:
さっきから考えていたんだけど……
このエリアには……何か……
特殊な力が働いてるんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been thinking... Maybe
there's some unusual power that's
affecting this area.

fields.EN:
I can't really place it, but...
Um... Like some power to mess with
our sense of direction?
fields.JP:
なんていうか……ええと……
方向感覚を麻痺させるような力、っていうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't really place it, but...
Um... Like some power to mess with
our sense of direction?

fields.EN:
If that's true, we'll never get
out of here! Whatever shall we
do?!
fields.JP:
そんなワケのわからない力が働いてたら、
ここから永遠に抜け出せないではありませんの！
どうしたらいいんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's true, we'll never get
out of here! Whatever shall we
do?!

fields.EN:
Hm... A magical labyrinth, so to
speak... We may as well keep
moving ahead.
fields.JP:
……神秘の迷宮というわけね。
でも、ここでこうしていても仕方ないわ。
とにかく先に進んでみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... A magical labyrinth, so to
speak... We may as well keep
moving ahead.

fields.EN:
Yup, not like we have a choice.
Let's just keep an eye on our
surroundings and move on.
fields.JP:
うん、それしかなさそうだね。
注意しながら進んでみようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, not like we have a choice.
Let's just keep an eye on our
surroundings and move on.

fields.JP:
おおーーーー！
ここ、さっききたところだーーーー！

fields.EN:
It's no good! We can't get out of
here! We're doomed to roam around
here forever, like zombies!
fields.JP:
ダメですわ！　迷宮を抜けられませんわ……
ここで全員ミイラになるまで、
わたくしたち、ずっと彷徨う運命なんですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no good! We can't get out of
here! We're doomed to roam around
here forever, like zombies!

fields.EN:
Shut up already! Crying won't do
us any good! I don't like this
either, you know?!
fields.JP:
やかましいです～！
泣いたって何の解決にもならないです～！
わらわだって、面倒くさいのは嫌いです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up already! Crying won't do
us any good! I don't like this
either, you know?!

fields.EN:
Augh! You're just as loud as she
is! Shut up!
fields.JP:
あー……もう！
あんたの声の方がうるさいっつーの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Augh! You're just as loud as she
is! Shut up!

fields.EN:
Hahahahaha! Round and round and
round!
fields.JP:
あはははははははは！
ぐるぐるぐるぐるーーーーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahahaha! Round and round and
round!

fields.EN: You! Rugrat! You shut up, too!
fields.JP: 野生児。あんたもうるさいっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You! Rugrat! You shut up, too!

fields.EN:
Please calm down,
Oyayubi-neesama. Everyone is confused
and worried.
fields.JP:
親指姉様、落ち着いてください。
みんな不安なんですよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please calm down, Sister
Thumbelina. Everyone is confused
and worried.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki's got that right.
There's no sense in bickering with
each other now.
fields.JP:
白雪の言う通りだね。
ここであたしらがケンカしたって、何も解決
しないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White's got that right.
There's no sense in bickering with
each other now.

fields.JP:
……ジャック？
どうかしたの？

fields.EN:
I was just thinking there must be
a clue on how to get out of
here...
fields.JP:
何か……きっと何か……
この迷宮を抜け出すためのヒントが
あるんじゃないかって思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just thinking there must be
a clue on how to get out of
here...

fields.JP: ヒントってどういうことですか～？

fields.EN:
Well, if whoever did this wanted
to harm us, they could've set
traps all over the place.
fields.JP:
うん。たとえばだけど……本当に僕らをどうにか
しようと思ってるなら、もっと危険な罠なんかが
仕掛けられててもいいと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if whoever did this wanted
to harm us, they could've set
traps all over the place.

fields.EN:
I feel like this is more of a
prank. Watching us struggle and
enjoying it.
fields.JP:
つまり、なんていうか……この迷宮は誰かの
悪戯みたいな感じがするっていうか、
僕らが困るのを喜んでるみたいだっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like this is more of a
prank. Watching us struggle and
enjoying it.

fields.EN:
If you ask me, it's a pretty weak
prank. But still a major pain,
regardless.
fields.JP:
そう言われてみれば……
単なる嫌がらせって言えなくもないわよね。
迷惑この上ないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you ask me, it's a pretty weak
prank. But still a major pain,
regardless.

fields.EN:
Right. I think the earlier survey teams never
returned because they couldn't escape this
labyrinth. They were probably wiped out...
fields.JP:
うん。過去のエリア調査隊が未帰還なのは、
この迷宮を抜け出せなかったからだと思う。
おそらく全滅してるんじゃないかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. The lost members who came
here probably couldn't find their
way out, and...

fields.EN:
Are you saying the lost members
of the Dawn were accidentally
killed by a prank?!
fields.JP:
それじゃ、エリア調査隊は……
悪戯で全滅させられたというの？
さしたる悪意もなく……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you saying the lost members
of the Dawn were accidentally
killed by a prank?!

fields.EN:
I can't confirm it, but it sure
feels that way...
fields.JP: はっきりとは言えないけど、そんな気がする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't confirm it, but it sure
feels that way...

fields.EN:
Then, even if it's only a prank,
it's still dangerous... It doesn't
stop even after the victim dies...
fields.JP:
それじゃ、いくら悪戯でもやっぱり
危険は危険ですね……
相手が死んでもやめないんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whether it is a prank or not, it's
still dangerous. After all, death
seems to be the only way out...

fields.EN:
Right. If this was done in
innocence, it seems worse than
intentional evil, in a way...
fields.JP:
ええ。自覚の無い悪意とも言えるわ。
それが一番たちが悪いものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. If this was done in
innocence, it seems worse than
intentional evil, in a way...

fields.JP: いたずらなら、ラプンツェルまけないよ！

fields.EN:
But if it is a prank, there should
be a trick behind all this.
fields.JP:
……そうですね～
悪戯なら、必ずタネも仕掛けもあるはずです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if it is a prank, there should
be a trick behind all this.

fields.EN:
Whoever the perpetrator is, they'd
need an easy way out themselves.
Such is the way of the lazy.
fields.JP:
仕掛けた本人が嵌って抜け出せなくなったら、
元も子もありませんから～
これ、サボりの秘訣です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoever the perpetrator is, they'd
need an easy way out themselves.
Such is the way of the lazy.

fields.JP: ……あんたが言うと、妙に説得力があるのよね

fields.EN:
Well, she's right. There has to be
a way out of this if we assume
this is some sort of prank.
fields.JP:
うん。そうなんだよ。これがもし本当に悪戯の
類なら……この迷宮を抜け出す仕組みも、
必ず用意してある筈だと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, she's right. There has to be
a way out of this if we assume
this is some sort of prank.

fields.EN:
Well, let's look for clues, then.
If you notice something, be sure
to speak up.
fields.JP:
それじゃ……とりあえず、そのヒントを探し
ながら進もう。
何か気になることがあったら、報告すること！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's look for clues, then.
If you notice something, be sure
to speak up.

fields.EN:
I suppose having an objective
helps instead of wandering around
aimlessly.
fields.JP:
そうですわね。どうせ歩き詰めなんですもの。
目的があった方がいいですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose having an objective
helps instead of wandering around
aimlessly.

fields.EN:
But not even knowing what we're
looking for will make it
challenging.
fields.JP:
気になるものっていっても、意外とわからない
ものよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But not even knowing what we're
looking for will make it
challenging.

fields.EN: But... there has to be something.
fields.JP: でも……何かきっとあるはずです
fields.LOCALIZED: But... there has to be something.

fields.EN:
Yes, so long as this labyrinth
isn't naturally created, or the
creator isn't completely insane...
fields.JP:
ええ……この迷宮自体が自然発生的なものか、
仕掛けた張本人の気が触れていない限りはね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, so long as this labyrinth
isn't naturally created, or the
creator isn't completely insane...

fields.JP: アリスもさらっとそういうこと言わない～！

fields.EN:
It looks like it was placed there
by someone. See? There's a
trail...
fields.JP:
あの石、誰かが置いたものなんじゃないかな？
ほら、あっちの方にまでずっと続いてる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it was placed there
by someone. See? There's a
trail...

fields.EN:
You're right. It looks
intentional. I can't believe we
didn't notice that until now.
fields.JP:
本当だわ……明らかに人為的な置き方ね……！
ずっと気づかなかったなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. It looks
intentional. I can't believe we
didn't notice that until now.

fields.EN:
I was expecting something
flashier. Geez... We should've
noticed it sooner.
fields.JP:
私たち、最初からもっと派手なのを探しちゃって
いたってわけね。くやしいけど、まんまと
やられたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was expecting something
flashier. Geez... We should've
noticed it sooner.

fields.EN:
Well, I don't think anyone
expected something as plain and
simple as that...
fields.JP:
……そうだね。まさかこんな地味なやつだとは、
なかなか気がつかないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I don't think anyone
expected something as plain and
simple as that...

fields.EN:
Jack-san... I guess plain
things can be useful sometimes!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……
地味なのも時には役に立つんですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, you're so helpful when it
comes to the plain and simple!

fields.EN:
Let's follow those stones and see
where they lead us.
fields.JP: ひとまず、あの置き石に沿って進んでみようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's follow those stones and see
where they lead us.

fields.JP: じゃあ、仕切り直しってことで……出発！
さっきの子……グレーテルだ……！

fields.EN:
All right! This time she's not
getting away!
fields.JP: よーし。今度こそ、とっ捕まえて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! This time she's not
getting away!

fields.EN:
I don't think it's a good idea to
surprise her.
fields.JP: 驚かさない方がいいと思います～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think it's a good idea to
surprise her.

fields.EN: Why don't we try talking to her?
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't we try talking to her?

fields.JP:
……ねえ、君。
グレーテル……だよね？

fields.EN:
I didn't expect you to get out of
there, let alone get to me.
fields.JP:
……ここまでよく辿り着いたものね
あそこから抜け出せるなんて思わなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect you to get out of
there, let alone get to me.

fields.EN:
You set that place up as a trap,
didn't you?
fields.JP: ……あなたが仕組んだ罠だったのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You set that place up as a trap,
didn't you?

fields.EN:
I'm not sure I agree. After all,
anyone would know their own
home well enough, no?
fields.JP:
さあ……どうかしら？
誰だって自分の家の中は熟知しているもの
でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure I agree. After all,
anyone would know their own
home well enough, no?

fields.EN:
Home? That's a very odd example
to use!
fields.JP: 家、ですの？　変な例えはおよしあそばせ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Home? That's a very odd example
to use!

fields.EN:
Odd? I don't understand what you
find odd about what I said.
fields.JP: どこが変な例えなのか、理解できないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Odd? I don't understand what you
find odd about what I said.

fields.EN:
Have you... been here all this
time?
fields.JP: 君……ずっとここにいるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Have you... been here all this
time?

fields.EN: Why, yes. This is my home.
fields.JP: ええ。そうよ。ここは私の家なのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED: Why, yes. This is my home.

fields.EN:
H-Home...? But, this place is
crawling with Marchens!
fields.JP:
い……家って……
メルヒェンがうようよしてるのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Home...? But, this place is
crawling with Marchens!

fields.EN:
Indeed. They can be noisy at
times, but as a whole, they're
quite cute.
fields.JP: ええ。時々騒がしいけれど、可愛いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. They can be noisy at
times, but as a whole, they're
quite cute.

fields.EN:
Uh, I don't think anyone eats
them.
fields.JP: いや、普通食べないから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I don't think anyone eats
them.

fields.EN:
Anyway... You said the Marchens
are cute? Who are you?
fields.JP:
と、ともかく……メルヒェンが可愛いって……
……あんた、何者なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway... You said the Marchens
are cute? Who are you?

fields.JP: 私？　私はナイトメアよ

fields.EN:
A Nightmare?! But you don't look
like one...
fields.JP:
ナイトメア……！？
だってあんた、どう見たって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Nightmare?! But you don't look
like one...

fields.EN:
We heard a rumor that there was
a girl here that walks with a
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
実は、こういう噂を聞いたんだ。
このジェイルの中で、ナイトメアと一緒にいる
女の子がいるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We heard a rumor that there was
a girl here that walks with a
Nightmare.

fields.EN: Could that be you, by any chance?
fields.LOCALIZED: Could that be you, by any chance?

fields.EN:
I don't understand what you're
saying, but I suppose that could
pertain to me.
fields.JP:
……………………
あなたの言っていることがよく解らないのだけど
……そういうことになるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't understand what you're
saying, but I suppose that could
pertain to me.

fields.EN:
I've lived with
Hansel-niisan since I was born.
fields.JP:
私、生まれた時からずっと、
ヘンゼル兄さんと暮らしてきたんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been living with my brother,
Hansel, since I was born.

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan? You mean there's another
person here besides you?
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんって……
もう一人、人間がいるってことになるんでしょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel? You mean there's another
person here besides you?

fields.EN:
...Human? Hansel-niisan
and I are Nightmares, you know?
fields.JP:
……人間？
私とヘンゼル兄さんは、ナイトメアよ？
ウン……ボクラハナイトメアダ……

fields.EN:
(She's able to converse with a
Nightmare?!)
fields.JP: （ナイトメアとこの子……会話をしてる！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's able to converse with a
Nightmare?!)

fields.EN:
Is there something unusual about
our being able to speak with each
other? You all speak, don't you?
fields.JP:
私たちが喋ることに、何か変なことでもあると
いうの？　あなたたちだって喋るじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there something unusual about
our being able to speak with each
other? You all speak, don't you?

fields.EN:
It's a Nightmare! Everyone, be
careful!
fields.JP:
……ナイトメアだ！
みんな、気をつけて！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a Nightmare! Everyone, be
careful!

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん……みんな、待って！

fields.EN:
Why are you stopping us?! It's a
Nightmare!
fields.JP: 何言ってんのよ！　ナイトメアよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you stopping us?! It's a
Nightmare!

fields.EN:
I see. So you all really are
intruders. Our enemies.
fields.JP:
……そう。
やはり、あなたたちは侵入者……私たちの敵なのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So you all really are
intruders. Our enemies.

fields.EN:
Please wait! Aren't you a Blood
Maiden?!
fields.JP:
……待ってよ！
君は、血式少女じゃないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please wait! Aren't you a Blood
Maiden?!

fields.EN:
Blood Maiden? I don't understand
what you're saying. In any case,
intruders bear no good will.
fields.JP:
血式少女？
……何を言っているのかわからないわ。
もっとも、侵入者にろくな者はいないものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maiden? I don't understand
what you're saying. In any case,
intruders bear no good will.

fields.EN: Let's be rid of them now.
fields.JP: 追い払ってしまいましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's be rid of them now.

fields.JP: ジャック。ここは引くよ！

fields.EN:
Jack! Now's not the time! Be
mindful of the situation!
fields.JP:
ジャック……今は無理だわ！
状況を見極めて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Now's not the time! Be
mindful of the situation!

fields.JP: どうにか……逃げ切りましたね……

fields.EN:
Wh-What was that?! What's with
that girl and the Nightmare?!
fields.JP:
な……何なの！？
あの子とあのナイトメア！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What was that?! What's with
that girl and the Nightmare?!

fields.EN:
It seemed as if the Nightmare was
protecting her...
fields.JP:
あのナイトメア……あの子を守ってるように
見えましたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seemed as if the Nightmare was
protecting her...

fields.JP:
じゅるるる……
あのないとめあ、おいしそうだった……
い……いや、食べちゃ駄目だから……

fields.EN:
She called it her brother...
Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP: ヘンゼル兄さんって……言ってましたね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She called it her brother...
Hansel.

fields.EN:
And, that Nightmare was answering
back to her. It seems it possesses
some level of intelligence.
fields.JP:
あのナイトメアも、きちんとあの子と受け答えを
していたわ……
あのナイトメアには、それだけの知性があるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, that Nightmare was answering
back to her. It seems it possesses
some level of intelligence.

fields.JP: ん……あの子、馬鹿じゃない…………

fields.EN:
Nemu! You shouldn't call a
Nightmare a "kid!"
fields.JP:
ネムはナイトメアのことまで『あの子』だなんて
言うんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy! You shouldn't call a
Nightmare a "kid!"

fields.EN:
One thing's for sure. The rumor
about the girl and the Nightmare
is definitely about them.
fields.JP:
でも……ひとつはっきりしたことがあるわ。
目撃された『ナイトメアと一緒に歩く女の子』
……それは、あの子たちのことで間違いないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
One thing's for sure. The rumor
about the girl and the Nightmare
is definitely about them.

fields.EN:
It seems as if they were acting of
their own free will.
fields.JP:
見たところ……誰にも強制されているようでは
なかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if they were acting of
their own free will.

fields.EN:
And also that they don't feel a
thing about those who died here.
fields.JP:
そして、ここで多くの人が死んだことについて、
何ら痛痒を感じてはいないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And also that they don't feel a
thing about those who died here.

fields.EN:
W-Wait a second, Alice. Isn't it a
bit early to come to that
conclusion?
fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっと待ってよ、アリス。
そこまで決めつけるのは早すぎると思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait a second, Alice. Isn't it a
bit early to come to that
conclusion?

fields.EN:
Jumping to conclusions...?
I'm sorry... Maybe I am...
fields.JP:
決めつける……？
ごめんなさい……そうなのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Conclusion? I'm sorry. That wasn't
my intention...

fields.EN:
Oh, um... I mean, we still don't
know what's going on with that
Gretel girl.
fields.JP:
あ、ううん。まだグレーテル……あの子の事情は
よくわかっていないからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... I mean, we still don't
know what's going on with that
Gretel girl.

fields.EN:
Not only that... I feel like that
girl is a Blood Maiden, too.
fields.JP:
それに……僕はやっぱり、あの子は血式少女じゃ
ないかと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only that... I feel like that
girl is a Blood Maiden, too.

fields.EN:
After all, it's hard to imagine a
normal person living here from
birth, with a Nightmare, no less.
fields.JP:
ただの人間が、生まれた時からずっと
こんなところでナイトメアと暮らせるのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, it's hard to imagine a
normal person living here from
birth, with a Nightmare, no less.

fields.EN:
If we're on the subject of "hard
to imagine," the same goes for
the Nightmare, as well!
fields.JP:
それを言うなら……あのナイトメアだって
とびきり変ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we're on the subject of "hard
to imagine," the same goes for
the Nightmare, as well!

fields.EN:
But if they're fine together,
shouldn't we just leave them be?
fields.JP:
本人たちがいいなら、わらわは別に
いいと思いますけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if they're fine together,
shouldn't we just leave them be?

fields.EN:
Not really... Our mission does
include finding the area's core
and destroying it.
fields.JP:
でも……そうも言ってらんないんだよねー。
ほら、あたしたちの任務には、エリアの核を
見つけて破壊することも含まれてるしさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not really... Our mission does
include finding the area's core
and destroying it.

fields.EN: We should just leave them alone...
fields.JP: 放っておいてやってもいいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: We should just leave them alone...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki feels the same way,
too.
fields.JP:
白雪も……あのふたりを見てたら、そんな気が
します……
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White feels the same way,
too.

fields.EN:
It looks like they think we're
their enemies now.
fields.JP:
白雪たちはすっかり、敵だと思われてしまった
ようですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like they think we're
their enemies now.

fields.EN:
What the hell are you saying?!
That Nightmare is our enemy! One
that'll do anything to kill us!
fields.JP:
白雪。あんた何言ってんの！？
ナイトメアは敵よ！？
私たちを容赦なく殺そうとする敵じゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the hell are you saying?!
That Nightmare is our enemy! One
that'll do anything to kill us!

fields.EN:
It didn't look like it was going
to chase us, but there's no
telling what'll happen next time.
fields.JP:
まあ、確かにしつこく追ってくる気配は無いよ。
でも、次に出会ったら、どうなるかはわからない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It didn't look like it was going
to chase us, but there's no
telling what'll happen next time.

fields.EN:
If only there was a way to speak
a bit more with that girl and the
Nightmare...
fields.JP:
せめて、あの子やナイトメアと、もう少し話が
できれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only there was a way to speak
a bit more with that girl and the
Nightmare...

fields.EN:
How about we look for the core
first? A mission is a mission,
after all.
fields.JP:
ともかく、核を見つけちゃわない？
任務は任務なんだしさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about we look for the core
first? A mission is a mission,
after all.

fields.EN:
True... We can stop the Nightmare
from reviving, but that alone
doesn't mean it'll die.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
核を破壊すればナイトメアの再生は止められる。
でも、殺すことにつながるわけじゃないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... We can stop the Nightmare
from reviving, but that alone
doesn't mean it'll die.

fields.EN:
There's no telling what's going to
happen, so we'd better have a
fallback plan ready.
fields.JP:
問題を先送りにするようだけど、どう話が転がるか
わかんないわけだしさ……
活路は用意しておかないとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling what's going to
happen, so we'd better have a
fallback plan ready.

fields.EN:
Yes... There's a good chance we
won't get through to them.
fields.JP: ええ……決裂の可能性は、十分にあるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... There's a good chance we
won't get through to them.

fields.EN:
(They're right... We can't risk
dying here...)
fields.JP:
（確かに……僕らまで全滅するわけには
　いかないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're right... We can't risk
dying here...)

fields.EN:
Okay... Let's go and find the
core.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... Let's go and find the
core.

fields.EN:
There it is! That must be the
core!
fields.JP:
……あったわ！
あっちに見えるの、きっと核よ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There it is! That must be the
core!

fields.JP: ええ！　やりましたわね！

fields.EN:
Despite being a labyrinth, the
structure itself isn't much
different from the other areas.
fields.JP:
……迷宮になっているとはいえ、
基本的には他の場所と造りは同じということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite being a labyrinth, the
structure itself isn't much
different from the other areas.

fields.EN:
But there's no eerie-looking eye
here...
fields.JP:
でも……ここにはあの気持ちの悪い
大きな『眼』がありませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there's no eerie-looking eye
here...

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, you're right!
Nice catch, Shirayuki!
fields.JP:
言われてみれば……！
白雪、いいとこに気がつくじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, you're right!
Nice catch, Snow White!

fields.EN:
Shirayuki only noticed because
she's been looking at the walls
this entire time.
fields.JP: 白雪、迷路の中でも壁ばかり見ていたので……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White only noticed because
she's been looking at the walls
this entire time.

fields.EN:
You're too modest. You've been
keeping an eye out for us all this
time. That's how you noticed it.
fields.JP:
いいえ。あなたはとても優しくて、いつも
わたしたちのことを見守ってくれているもの。
だから、よく気がつくのだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're too modest. You've been
keeping an eye out for us all this
time. That's how you noticed it.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki isn't kind... You're
all the ones who are truly kind...
fields.JP:
白雪、優しくなんかありません……
本当に優しいのは、皆さんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White isn't modest...
Everyone is much more modest
than I am...

fields.EN:
Could you accept the compliment
already?
fields.JP: あんたはすぐそうやって謙遜するんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could you accept the compliment
already?

fields.EN:
In any case, we do know that this
place is a few notches weirder
than any of the other areas.
fields.JP:
ともかく、ここがとびきり変な場所だってことは
確かってことよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, we do know that this
place is a few notches weirder
than any of the other areas.

fields.EN:
Why, yes. But it would be good to
know what those eyes are for.
fields.JP:
ええ。問題は、あの『眼』がいったい何かという
ことですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. But it would be good to
know what those eyes are for.

fields.EN:
I'm curious as to why it isn't in
this area...
fields.JP: このエリアに無い理由も気になりますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm curious as to why it isn't in
this area...

fields.EN:
Yeah... I've been bothered by
them for a while, too...
fields.JP:
うん。僕もあの『眼』のことは、ずっと
気になっていたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I've been bothered by
them for a while, too...

fields.EN:
Why don't we just smash the core
first? There must be something
protecting it, like the others.
fields.JP:
ま……まあ、とりあえず核をやっちゃおうよ。
仕組みが他とだいたい同じってことは、
ここを護ってる奴もそこらにいる筈だしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we just smash the core
first? There must be something
protecting it, like the others.

fields.EN:
Guess so. It's not a good idea to
just chit-chat the day away.
fields.JP:
そうね。こんなところで無駄話をしてるのは、
ちょっと不用心ってものよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess so. It's not a good idea to
just chit-chat the day away.

fields.EN:
I see some intruders planning
something interesting here.
fields.JP:
面白そうなことをしているこそ泥さんも
あったものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see some intruders planning
something interesting here.

fields.EN:
And why would they want to destroy
the core?
fields.JP: 核を壊して、どうしようというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And why would they want to destroy
the core?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but it's our duty to do
so.
fields.JP: 悪いけど、仕事なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but it's our duty to do
so.

fields.EN:
Answered like a true intruder.
Barging into one's house, calling
it a "duty."
fields.JP:
こそ泥さんはこそ泥さんね。
ひとの家を荒らして、仕事と言うのだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Answered like a true intruder.
Barging into one's house, calling
it a "duty."

fields.EN:
Gretel? Do you have a minute?
We just want to talk to you.
fields.JP:
グレーテル……
僕たち、君と少し話がしたいんだ。駄目かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel? Do you have a minute?
We just want to talk to you.

fields.JP: この子、少し借りていくわね

fields.EN:
(Wh-What the...?! My stomach feels
like it's turning inside out...)
fields.JP:
（な……何だ、この感じ……！？
　お腹の中がひっくり返る感じっていうか……
　心もとないっていうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What the...?! My stomach feels
like it's turning inside out...)

fields.EN: Wh-Where am I?! What was that?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Wh-Where am I?! What was that?!

fields.EN:
Well, it's a secret. No one would
answer or explain to an intruder,
would they?
fields.JP:
さあ……内緒。
こそ泥さんに手の内は見せられないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's a secret. No one would
answer or explain to an intruder,
would they?

fields.JP: 僕たちは泥棒なんかじゃ……！

fields.EN:
If you really think this is your
home, then I suppose me being
an intruder is right.
fields.JP:
でも……ここを家だと思ってるなら、
僕らが荒らしてるって言われても、
無理は無いんだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you really think this is your
home, then I suppose me being
an intruder is right.

fields.EN:
I've never seen an intruder act in
humility before. Do you think that
will get you off the hook?
fields.JP:
わざわざ荒らしに来て恐縮する泥棒さんなんて、
初めて見たわね。
でも……それが許されると思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen an intruder act in
humility before. Do you think that
will get you off the hook?

fields.EN:
So, our members who went missing
were...
fields.JP:
じゃあ……調査隊が行方不明になったのって、
やっぱり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, our members who went missing
were...

fields.EN:
Anyone would defend themselves
from intrusion, no?
fields.JP: 誰だって自衛はするものでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyone would defend themselves
from intrusion, no?

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel? What do you want with
me?
fields.JP:
あの、グレーテル？
それで僕を一体……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel? What do you want with
me?

fields.EN:
Hm... What to do? We have so much
time since your friends won't be
able to reach this place easily...
fields.JP:
さあ……どうしようかしら？
お仲間もそうそう追っては来れないでしょうし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... What to do? We have so much
time since your friends won't be
able to reach this place easily...

fields.EN:
Relax. That's a joke. I just want
to speak with you.
fields.JP:
嘘よ。少しお話がしたいだけ。
……安心していいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Relax. That's a joke. I just want
to speak with you.

fields.JP: あなたが一番、お話ししやすそうだから

fields.EN:
Oh, I see. Um, I did want to speak
with you, too.
fields.JP:
……そ、そうなんだ。
あ、でも、僕も話がしたかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see. Um, I did want to speak
with you, too.

fields.EN:
You're a strange one. Brave, yet
open. Inquisitive, yet gullible.
fields.JP:
……あなたはおかしな人ね。
勇敢なくせに、とても無防備。
知りたいくせに疑うことを知らない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a strange one. Brave, yet
open. Inquisitive, yet gullible.

fields.EN:
Foolhardy, then? If you see
Nightmares as enemies, you should
have your guard up against me.
fields.JP:
ならば蛮勇なのかしら？
ナイトメアと敵対しているのならば、
この私にももっと警戒しなければ駄目よ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Foolhardy, then? If you see
Nightmares as enemies, you should
have your guard up against me.

fields.EN:
So, what's this "eye" you were all
talking about?
fields.JP:
ねえ、さっきあなたたちが話してた
『眼』って何？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what's this "eye" you were all
talking about?

fields.EN:
We're not sure, but there's always
a wall in each area with an eye on
it. Almost like it's watching us.
fields.JP:
それは……僕らにもよくわからないんだけど、
他のエリアには必ず壁にあって……
なんだか僕らを見てるみたいにみえるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're not sure, but there's always
a wall in each area with an eye on
it. Almost like it's watching us.

fields.EN:
Next question. What's a "Blood
Maiden?" It seems as if your
friends are "Blood Maidens," too.
fields.JP:
それじゃ、本題だけど……『血式少女』って、何？
聞いている限り、あなたのお仲間が『血式少女』
なのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next question. What's a "Blood
Maiden?" It seems as if your
friends are "Blood Maidens," too.

fields.EN:
Yes, but all we know is that Blood
Maidens are powerful, and heal
faster than normal people.
fields.JP:
うん……でも、僕らにもよくわからないんだ。
ただ……普通の人よりも力が強いし、怪我の治りも
早いんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but all we know is that Blood
Maidens are powerful, and heal
faster than normal people.

fields.EN:
Also, Marchen blood makes them
stronger. It changes their form
and the color of their eyes.
fields.JP:
それから……メルヒェンの血で、強くなる……
っていうか、目の色がピンクになって、
姿が変わるっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, Marchen blood makes them
stronger. It changes their form
and the color of their eyes.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... What I'm saying must
sound confusing.
fields.JP: ごめん……こんな説明じゃ、よくわからないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... What I'm saying must
sound confusing.

fields.JP: （や、やっぱ困らせちゃったかな……）

fields.EN:
From what I've just heard, it's
quite possible I'm a Blood Maiden,
as well.
fields.JP:
……話を聞く限り、私が血式少女である可能性は
十分に考えられるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
From what I've just heard, it's
quite possible I'm a Blood Maiden,
as well.

fields.EN:
Well then, come with us! Come and
join us in our fight!
fields.JP:
それならやっぱり、僕たちと一緒に行こうよ！
それで、一緒に戦おうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, come with us! Come and
join us in our fight!

fields.JP:
戦う……？
一体、何と戦うというのかしら？

fields.EN:
We're with the Dawn, and we're
trying to find a way to escape
from the Jail!
fields.JP:
僕たち……黎明は、僕たちを閉じ込めている
このジェイルから、みんなで地上に抜け出そうと
してるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're with the Dawn, and we're
trying to find a way to escape
from the Jail!

fields.EN:
That's why we're destroying the
cores, to grow the Tower and
reach the surface.
fields.JP:
そのために核を破壊して、
あの高い塔を成長させて……
そうしたら、そこから地上に行けるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we're destroying the
cores, to grow the Tower and
reach the surface.

fields.EN:
You and your friends are very
kind.
fields.JP:
……お人好しなのね。
あなたも……お仲間たちも
fields.LOCALIZED:
You and your friends are very
kind.

fields.EN:
Oh? You didn't know? The Marchens
are also nurturing this realm and
the Tower you just mentioned.
fields.JP:
あら。まさか知らないのかしら？
メルヒェンたちもね、この場所とあのタワーを
育てているのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? You didn't know? The Marchens
are also nurturing this realm and
the Tower you just mentioned.

fields.EN:
Why, yes. It seems you're all
working toward the same goal.
fields.JP:
ええ。……だとしたら、あなたたちは
同じ目的のために努力していることになるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. It seems you're all
working toward the same goal.

fields.EN:
Doesn't that intrigue you? I'm
surprised that thought didn't dawn
on any of you at all.
fields.JP:
とても面白いことだと思わないかしら？
……いいえ。あなたたちが今まで
そこに思い至らなかったことが不思議なくらい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't that intrigue you? I'm
surprised that thought didn't dawn
on any of you at all.

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel? Do we need to fight
Hansel? He seems close to you,
so...
fields.JP:
あの、グレーテル……
ヘンゼルとはどうしても戦わなきゃいけないのかな？
君とはすごく仲が良さそうだし……ひょっとしたら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel? Do we need to fight
Hansel? He seems close to you,
so...

fields.EN:
Aren't Nightmares your enemies?
If so, Hansel-niisan is your enemy too.
fields.JP:
だってあなたたちにとって、ナイトメアは
敵なのでしょう？
ならばヘンゼル兄さんにとっても敵だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aren't Nightmares your enemies?
If so, my brother Hansel is your
enemy, too.

fields.EN:
B-But I don't think we have to
fight all of them. If we destroy
the core, we can leave this place.
fields.JP:
で……でも、必ずしも戦う必要はないと思うんだ。
核さえ壊せれば、僕らはそのままここから
立ち去るから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But I don't think we have to
fight all of them. If we destroy
the core, we can leave this place.

fields.JP: あなたは本当に、お人好しなのね

fields.EN:
The exit is there. Go straight,
and you'll be back to where you
were.
fields.JP:
お帰りはあちら。
まっすぐに行けば、さっきのところに戻れるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The exit is there. Go straight,
and you'll be back to where you
were.

fields.JP: ジャック……！　どこにいるの……！？
おーい！　ジャックー！

fields.EN:
(She actually did return me to
where everyone else was... I'd
better hurry on back!)
fields.JP:
（ほんとだ……みんなのいるところと近い場所に
　帰してくれたんだ……。
　とにかく、みんなのところへ行こう！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She actually did return me to
where everyone else was... I'd
better hurry on back!)

fields.EN:
Jack... I couldn't protect him...
Jack! What am I supposed to do?!
fields.JP:
ジャック……わたし……守れなかった……
ジャック、どうしたらいいの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I couldn't protect him...
Jack! What am I supposed to do?!

fields.EN: I wonder where he was taken.
fields.JP: どこへ連れてかれたんでしょうね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder where he was taken.

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Wait up! Where are you
going?!
fields.JP: ちょ……一人でどこ探そうってのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Wait up! Where are you
going?!

fields.EN:
But Jack...! I promised him we'd
escape from here together...
that we'd make it out alive...!
fields.JP:
でも、ジャックが……！
わたし……一緒にここを脱出するって……
生きて脱出するって約束したのだもの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...! I... I promised to him
that we'd escape together!

fields.EN:
Stop, Alice-san! Don't go wandering
out alone!
fields.JP:
駄目ですわ、アリスさん！
お一人では危険極まりないですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop, Alice! Don't go wandering
out alone!

fields.JP: でも、こうしている間にも……！

fields.EN:
Calm down for now, Alice. If anything
happened to you, Jack would be heartbroken!
fields.JP:
……とりあえず落ち着きなよ、アリス。
あんたに何かあったら、それこそジャックが
悲しむよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just calm down. Jack would never
forgive himself if something
happened to you!

fields.EN: We can all look for him, together.
fields.JP: だからさ、みんなで探そう
fields.LOCALIZED: We can all look for him, together.

fields.EN:
That's right. Um, y-you're not the
only one w-worried about him, you
know?
fields.JP:
そうよ。あんただけじゃなくて……
わ、私たちだって心配してるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Um, y-you're not the
only one w-worried about him, you
know?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. You're right... Let's
go look for Jack.
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい。
そうね……ジャックを探しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. You're right... Let's
go look for Jack.

fields.EN:
If that Gretel does something to
our lifeline, she's gonna get it!
fields.JP:
それにしてもあのグレーテルって子、
あたしらの命綱に何かしたら、承知しないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that Gretel does something to
our lifeline, she's gonna get it!

fields.EN:
It all happened in an instant...
What did she want with him?
fields.JP:
……一瞬のことだったわね。
あの子はジャックに一体、何をするつもりなの
かしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It all happened in an instant...
What did she want with him?

fields.EN:
You know, it's partially his
fault, too! He kept protecting
her, and now look what happened!
fields.JP:
だいたいジャックもジャックなのよ！
妙にあの子に肩入れしたりしてるから、
ああやって攫われたりするのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, it's partially his
fault, too! He kept protecting
her, and now look what happened!

fields.EN:
Jack-san won't be separated from us,
will he?
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……白雪たちから離れたり
しませんよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack won't be separated from us,
will he?

fields.EN:
Jack-san is too kind! That is why this
happened!
fields.JP:
ジャックさんは……優しすぎるんですわ！
だからこんなことに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is too kind! That is why this
happened!

fields.EN:
Things are a chore without him
around. His disappearance is a
major pain.
fields.JP:
ジャックがいないと、いろいろ不便です～
こういう抜け駆けは迷惑です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Things are a chore without him
around. His disappearance is a
major pain.

fields.EN:
She took Jack! Rapunzel get him
back!
fields.JP:
じゃっく、とられたーーーーーーーー！
ラプンツェル、とりかえす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She took Jack! Rapunzel get him
back!

fields.EN:
But looking around randomly is
only going to get us in trouble...
fields.JP:
……といっても、闇雲に探したって
相手の術中にはまるだけだろうしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But looking around randomly is
only going to get us in trouble...

fields.EN:
Indeed. We should search for him
quite carefully.
fields.JP: ええ。慎重に探す必要がありますわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. We should search for him
quite carefully.

fields.EN:
Yes. If we end up in that
labyrinth again, we could all end
up dead.
fields.JP:
はい。またあの迷宮に入り込んでしまって、
もし仕掛けが変わっていたら……
白雪たちも全滅してしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. If we end up in that
labyrinth again, we could all end
up dead.

fields.EN:
Let's just search around here
first.
fields.JP: まずは、この辺りから探していきましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's just search around here
first.

fields.EN:
Jack! If you can hear us, come on
out!
fields.JP:
ジャックー！
いたら出てきなさいよーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! If you can hear us, come on
out!

fields.JP: みんな、心配かけてごめん……！
じゃっくだーーーーー！

fields.EN:
Glad to see you back. I figured
you'd find us, one way or the
other!
fields.JP:
無事合流できてよかったよ。
あんたのことだから、ちゃんと戻ってくるとは
信じてたけどね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad to see you back. I figured
you'd find us, one way or the
other!

fields.JP: ほんとに……よかったです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is so relieved to see
you...

fields.EN:
Jack, are you all right? Are you
hurt?
fields.JP:
ジャック、大丈夫？
その……怪我はない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, are you all right? Are you
hurt?

fields.EN:
I'm fine. She didn't do anything
to me...
fields.JP: うん。別に何もされてないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. She didn't do anything
to me...

fields.EN:
It seems like Gretel's interested
in us. She asked me a lot of
questions.
fields.JP:
グレーテルは、僕らに興味があるみたいなんだ。
いくつか質問されたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems like Gretel's interested
in us. She asked me a lot of
questions.

fields.EN:
I see... So that means there's a
good chance she's a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
……ってことは、血式少女の可能性が高いって
わけだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So that means there's a
good chance she's a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
But what should we make of the
Marchens working toward the same
goal as we are?
fields.JP:
メルヒェンたちとわたしたちが、同じ目的のために
動いていたなんて……どう考えればいいのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what should we make of the
Marchens working toward the same
goal as we are?

fields.EN:
Um, before that, we still don't
know her motive, right? You need
to ask the right questions.
fields.JP:
……っていうか、結局相手の考えてることは
たいしてわかんなかったってわけよね？
もっとちゃんと聞き出しなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, before that, we still don't
know her motive, right? You need
to ask the right questions.

fields.EN:
Actually, there is something we
know now, Oyayubihime.
fields.JP: いいえ、親指姫。ひとつわかったことがあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Actually, there is something we
know now, Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
We know that regardless of her
intellect, she's the type to do
anything to attain her goal.
fields.JP:
彼女がそれなりの知性を持っているにも関わらず、
目的のためには手段を選ばない類の人間である
ということよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We know that regardless of her
intellect, she's the type to do
anything to attain her goal.

fields.EN:
But, she explained how anyone
would protect their home from
intruders.
fields.JP:
でも、自分の家を踏み荒らされたら、誰だって
抵抗するんじゃないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she explained how anyone
would protect their home from
intruders.

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean she should kill
everyone. Her relationship with
that Nightmare isn't our concern.
fields.JP:
いいえ。全滅までさせる必要はなかったはず……
つまり、たとえ彼女が血式少女であっても、
あのナイトメアとどういう関係であっても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean she should kill
everyone. Her relationship with
that Nightmare isn't our concern.

fields.EN:
In other words, there's nothing
stopping us from destroying that
core.
fields.JP:
こちらが核を破壊することにためらう理由は、
もう何もないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, there's nothing
stopping us from destroying that
core.

fields.EN:
I guess you're right. After all,
she did abduct one of our
members...
fields.JP:
ま、それもそうよね。こっちは仲間を攫われた
わけなんだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you're right. After all,
she did abduct one of our
members...

fields.EN:
Ohohoho! She needs to learn what
it means to make enemies of us!
fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ……！
わたくしたちを敵に回したらどうなるか……
存分に味わっていただかなくては！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohoho! She needs to learn what
it means to make enemies of us!

fields.EN:
Um, everyone? I appreciate the
enthusiasm, but getting riled up
is only going to hurt us.
fields.JP:
あー、みんな。気持ちはわかるけどさ、
熱くなったら、相手の思う壺だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, everyone? I appreciate the
enthusiasm, but getting riled up
is only going to hurt us.

fields.EN:
Remember, our mission is to find
out what's happening here, and
destroy the core.
fields.JP:
あたしらの任務は、ここで起きてることの真相を
突き止めること……そして、核を破壊することだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember, our mission is to find
out what's happening here, and
destroy the core.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's get to work! First
we get rid of the guardian, then
we destroy the core! Got it?!
fields.JP:
というわけで、作戦行動に移るよ！
まずは核の守護者を叩いて、核を破壊しよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's get to work! First
we get rid of the guardian, then
we destroy the core! Got it?!

fields.EN:
There...! The Marchen guarding the
core!
fields.JP: いた……核を護ってるメルヒェンだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There...! The Marchen guarding the
core!

fields.JP: それじゃ、とっとと核を壊すわよ！

fields.EN:
That's the first time I've heard
the Jail wail like that.
fields.JP: ジェイルがこんな風に鳴くの、初めて聞いたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the first time I've heard
the Jail wail like that.

fields.EN:
Looks like you've done your duty
here.
fields.JP: 仕事は果たした、というわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you've done your duty
here.

fields.EN: How long have you been there?!
fields.LOCALIZED: How long have you been there?!

fields.EN:
How in the world are you able to
appear and vanish like that?!
fields.JP:
あんた、一体どうやって、
現れたり消えたりしてるのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How in the world are you able to
appear and vanish like that?!

fields.EN:
I thought I told Jack this, but
it's a secret. No one answers to
intruders, yes?
fields.JP:
内緒……と、ジャックに言ったはずだけど？
こそ泥さんに手の内は見せられないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I told Jack this, but
it's a secret. No one answers to
intruders, yes?

fields.EN:
I suppose that was Hansel-niisan's life
support.
fields.JP:
……これが、ヘンゼル兄さんの生命維持装置
だったというわけね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that was Hansel's life
support.

fields.EN:
Jack, do you remember telling me
that the destruction of the core
makes the Tower grow?
fields.JP:
あなたが話してくれたのよ、ジャック。
核を破壊することが、あのタワーを成長させることに
繋がっているのだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, do you remember telling me
that the destruction of the core
makes the Tower grow?

fields.EN:
From what you said, it's easy to
assume that the core supplies
energy to the Jail and Nightmares.
fields.JP:
その言葉からすれば、核がジェイルやナイトメアへの
エネルギー供給を担っていることは容易に
推察できるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From what you said, it's easy to
assume that the core supplies
energy to the Jail and Nightmares.

fields.JP: 謝らないわよ。なぜなら……

fields.EN:
Why, yes. This was your duty,
wasn't it?
fields.JP: ええ……あなたたちの仕事なのだものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. This was your duty,
wasn't it?

fields.EN:
No. It's because you let people
die on a whim.
fields.JP:
いいえ。あなたが面白半分に、人を見殺しに
してきたからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. It's because you let people
die on a whim.

fields.EN:
Oh, I didn't leave them to die.
Hansel-niisan and I took care of the
intruders who barged in on their own.
fields.JP:
あら。見殺しにしたんじゃないわ。
勝手に侵入してきた侵入者たちを、
ヘンゼル兄さんと一緒に始末したの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. I didn't let them
die. Hansel simply killed the
intruders who found their way in.

fields.EN:
