You...! That's not how you treat
humans like yourself!
fields.JP:
あなた……！
同じ人間に対してすることではないでしょう！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You...! That's not how you treat
humans like yourself!

fields.EN:
If a Nightmare protects an area,
then I'm also a Nightmare guarding
my home. Race doesn't matter.
fields.JP:
エリアを護る存在がナイトメアならば、
私もここ……私たちの家を護るナイトメアよ。
種族ではなく、在り方としてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If a Nightmare protects an area,
then I'm also a Nightmare guarding
my home. Race doesn't matter.

fields.EN:
You're Alice, right? You should
know what I'm talking about.
fields.JP:
あなた……アリスなのでしょう？
ならば、それがわからないあなたではない筈よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're Alice, right? You should
know what I'm talking about.

fields.EN:
What do you mean... Of course
I don't.
fields.JP:
あなたの言っている意味……
残念ながら、全くわからないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean... Of course
I don't.

fields.EN:
Listen carefully. You intruded
into our home and killed many of
my cute, little Marchens.
fields.JP:
いいこと？
あなたたちは、私たちの家を荒らし、私の可愛い
メルヒェンたちをたくさん殺したわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen carefully. You intruded
into our home and killed many of
my cute, little Marchens.

fields.JP:
メ……メルヒェンが可愛いって……この方、
正気ですの！？

fields.EN:
Marchens are deplorable to you,
no? If so, there's nothing I can
say to change your mind.
fields.JP:
あなたたちにとって、メルヒェンは害をなす
存在なのでしょう？
ならば、仕方のないことだと言えるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marchens are deplorable to you,
no? If so, there's nothing I can
say to change your mind.

fields.EN:
We acted in the same manner.
No... We acted justly, since you
were the ones intruding here.
fields.JP:
私たちのしてきたことは、それと全く同じ……
いいえ。それよりもはるかに筋が通っているわ。
私たちは、私たちの家を護っただけだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We acted in the same manner.
No... We acted justly, since you
were the ones intruding here.

fields.EN: So... it's a difference in where we stand.
fields.JP: 立場の違い……というわけね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose there's nothing I can
say to get through to you...

fields.EN:
Why, yes. You're correct. I'm
happy that you finally understand.
fields.JP:
ええ。そういうことね。
ようやく理解してもらえて嬉しいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. You're correct. I'm
happy that you finally understand.

fields.EN:
Gretel... Can we somehow get to
know each other better?
fields.JP:
グレーテル……
僕たち、どうにかわかり合えないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel... Can we somehow get to
know each other better?

fields.JP: わかり合うって……一体、何を？

fields.EN:
You may be a Nightmare, but you're
also a Blood Maiden, just like us.
fields.JP:
君はナイトメアなのかもしれない。
でも……僕らと同じ、血式少女でもあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be a Nightmare, but you're
also a Blood Maiden, just like us.

fields.EN:
Well, in my case, I'm a Blood
Youth...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, in my case, I'm a Blood
Youth...

fields.EN:
You said we're interesting, and
you asked me about the Blood
Maidens out of interest, right?
fields.JP:
君はさっき、僕らのことを興味深いって
言ったよね？　血式少女のことだって、
気になるから聞いたんだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said we're interesting, and
you asked me about the Blood
Maidens out of interest, right?

fields.EN:
We won't fight Hansel, so why
don't you come with us and see
what we do?
fields.JP:
だから……ヘンゼルとは戦わないから……
君も僕たちと一緒に来て、せめて
僕たちについて調べるっていうのは、どうかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We won't fight Hansel, so why
don't you come with us and see
what we do?

fields.EN:
Jack? What in the world are you
saying?!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? What in the world are you
saying?!

fields.EN:
I can't believe you're trying to
seduce her!
fields.JP: あんた、なんでこの子口説いてんのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you're trying to
seduce her!

fields.JP: 無様な口説き方もあったものです～

fields.EN:
She's right. That's not how you
seduce others. You really are too
kind.
fields.JP:
……確かに無様な口説き方ね。
お人好しにも程があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. That's not how you
seduce others. You really are too
kind.

fields.EN:
Hm... Knowledge is alluring...
Knowledge of your own existence,
and of this absurd world...
fields.JP:
そうね……知ることはとても魅力的なこと……
自分自身の存在について……この不条理な世界に
ついて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Knowledge is alluring...
Knowledge of your own existence,
and of this absurd world...

fields.EN:
Knowledge may be better than
keeping my role here as a
Nightmare...
fields.JP: 時には、ナイトメアとしての役割よりも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Knowledge may be better than
keeping my role here as a
Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Still, I was raised by Hansel-niisan,
and we've lived together all this time.
fields.JP:
けれど、私はヘンゼル兄さんに育てられ、
そしてずっと一緒に生きてきたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, I was born and raised with
my brother, Hansel. We've been
together all this time.

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan is my precious brother, and
this is my precious home. I have
no intention of leaving.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんは大切な家族だし、ここは私の
大切な生家よ。だから、ここから離れるつもりは
ないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel is my precious brother, and
this is my precious home. I have
no intention of leaving.

fields.EN:
Leave. If you leave now, I'll let
you all go out of respect to his
unique kindness.
fields.JP:
……お行きなさい。このまま立ち去るのなら、
このお人好しに免じて、特別に見逃してあげるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave. If you leave now, I'll let
you all go out of respect to his
unique kindness.

fields.EN:
But if we meet again... You know
what will happen, yes?
fields.JP: でも……次に出会ってしまったら……わかるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we meet again... You know
what will happen, yes?

fields.JP:
待ってよ、グレーテル！
君は本当は……！

fields.EN: Should we... just head back like this?
fields.JP: わたしたちは……このまま帰るべきなのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED: Should we just leave her alone?

fields.EN:
Shirayuki doesn't want to fight
her...
fields.JP: 白雪も……なんだか戦いたくないです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White doesn't want to fight
her...

fields.EN:
But if we leave, whoever decides
to come here will become her next
victim...
fields.JP:
でも……わたくしたちは見逃されたとしても、
今後訪れる人はきっと、犠牲になりますわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we leave, whoever decides
to come here will become her next
victim...

fields.EN:
I was thinking the same thing.
There's no way humans can ever get
along with Nightmares.
fields.JP:
私も同じ意見ね。所詮、人間とナイトメアは
共存なんかできないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was thinking the same thing.
There's no way humans can ever get
along with Nightmares.

fields.JP: ……あたしも親指たちと同意見かな

fields.EN:
Sure this place is weird, and that
Hansel Nightmare may be different
from the others.
fields.JP:
確かにここは、何もかもがおかしな場所だし、
ヘンゼルってナイトメアも例外的な奴なのかも
しれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure this place is weird, and that
Hansel Nightmare may be different
from the others.

fields.EN:
But, like Cinderella said, this
place is dangerous nonetheless.
fields.JP:
でも、シンデレラの言った通り、ここが危険な
場所であることは変わらない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, like Cinderella said, this
place is dangerous nonetheless.

fields.EN:
And like Dad said, there's no
telling what might happen here. If
Snark had something planned...
fields.JP:
それに……お父さんが言った通り、いつ何が
起きるか見当もつかないんだ。
スナークがもし、何か企んだら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And like Dad said, there's no
telling what might happen here. If
Snark had something planned...

fields.EN:
...There's a chance that girl will
be in danger, too. Is that what
you wanted to say?
fields.JP:
……あの子にも危険が及ぶ可能性は高い……
というわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
...There's a chance that girl will
be in danger, too. Is that what
you wanted to say?

fields.EN:
It's just a guess. That she hasn't
entered Blood Skelter yet is
probably due to sheer luck.
fields.JP:
あくまで、あたしの考えだけどね。
あの子だって、今までブラッドスケルター化
しなかったのは、運が良かったに過ぎないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just a guess. That she hasn't
entered Blood Skelter yet is
probably due to sheer luck.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルもそのぶらなんとかしてないよ！

fields.EN:
Ahaha... I don't think we need to
worry much about you, but you were
just as lucky as she was.
fields.JP:
あはは……あんたはその心配は少なそうだね。
でも、あんただって運が良かっただけだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahaha... I don't think we need to
worry much about you, but you were
just as lucky as she was.

fields.JP: ううーーーーずるーい！

fields.EN:
Now, now, I didn't mean it like
that...
fields.JP: ずるくない、ずるくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, I didn't mean it like
that...

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, the Dawn won't be
able to care for Hansel. He may
just become a new test subject.
fields.JP:
それに残念ながら、黎明だってヘンゼルのことまで
保護はできないよ。できるとすれば、実験体として
だろうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, the Dawn won't be
able to care for Hansel. He may
just become a new test subject.

fields.EN:
So, I want to make sure we solve
any potential problems that could
hit us in the future.
fields.JP:
だから……
あたしは、後顧の憂いは潰しておきたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I want to make sure we solve
any potential problems that could
hit us in the future.

fields.EN:
Even if it means Gretel-san would 
hate us for our actions?
fields.JP: グレーテルさんに恨まれても……ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if it means Gretel would 
hate us for our actions?

fields.EN:
If anybody's going to be hated,
it'll be me.
fields.JP: ……その時は、あたしが恨まれるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anybody's going to be hated,
it'll be me.

fields.JP: グレーテル……ミンナガキタヨ……

fields.EN:
Look like we meet again. And to
think I gave you a free pass out
of here.
fields.JP:
結局、また出会ってしまったわね。
せっかく見逃してあげると言ったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look like we meet again. And to
think I gave you a free pass out
of here.

fields.EN:
We decided this would bring
about the best results.
fields.JP: これが、最善の形を話し合った結果なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We decided this would bring
about the best results.

fields.EN:
Yes, I expected you to come to
this conclusion.
fields.JP: ええ。アリスなら当然の答えよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I expected you to come to
this conclusion.

fields.EN:
Stop right there... I'm the one
who made the call.
fields.JP: 待ってよ。決めたのは……あたしだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop right there... I'm the one
who made the call.

fields.JP: あなたが？　ふうん……そうなの

fields.EN:
So if you're going to begrudge
anyone, it's me.
fields.JP: だから……恨むなら、あたしにしなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if you're going to begrudge
anyone, it's me.

fields.EN:
Begrudge? You expect me to harbor
human emotion? I'm surprised that
you're speaking as if you'll win.
fields.JP:
恨むだなんて、人間的な感情を押し付けるのね。
しかも、勝つ気でいるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Begrudge? You expect me to harbor
human emotion? I'm surprised that
you're speaking as if you'll win.

fields.EN:
I will... protect... Gretel... and
our home...
fields.JP: ボクハ、グレーテルト、コノイエヲ、マモルヨ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will... protect... Gretel... and
our home...

fields.JP: ココハ……ボクタチノ、ダイジナ、イエダ
ジャック！　ぼんやりしてるんじゃないわよ！
そうよ……行きましょう、赤ずきんさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right... Let's go, Red
Riding Hood.

fields.JP: グレーテルハ、サガッテテ
グレーテル……ドコ……グレ……テ……ル……
ヘンゼル兄さん……私はここにいるわ
グレ……テ……ル……ブジ……ヨカッタ……

fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White can't do this anymore!

fields.EN:
Get a hold of yourself! There's no
turning back now!
fields.JP:
今更後に引けないわよ！
しっかりしなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Get a hold of yourself! There's no
turning back now!

fields.EN:
She's right. It's rude to Hansel
to be sorry now. He fought for
what was precious to him.
fields.JP:
そうよ……哀れみなど、ヘンゼルに失礼だわ。
彼は、大切なもののために戦ったのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. It's rude to Hansel
to be sorry now. He fought for
what was precious to him.

fields.EN:
We're doing the same... for what's
precious...
fields.JP: わらわたちも……大切なもののために
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're doing the same... for what's
precious...

fields.JP: ヘンゼル兄さん……よく頑張ったわ……
大丈夫よ……ヘンゼル兄さん……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll be fine, dear brother Hansel.

fields.JP: ゴメン……グ……レーテ……ル……ゴメン……
やっぱり……そうでしたのね……

fields.EN:
Thank you for all you've done,
Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP: ……今までありがとう、ヘンゼル兄さん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for all you've done,
dear brother.

fields.EN:
Thank... you... for being...
with... me... I'm... sorry...
fields.JP:
イッショニイテクレテ、アリガトウ……
……ズット……ゴメンネ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank... you... for being...
with... me... I'm... sorry...

fields.EN:
(They really cared for each other,
just like any other family...)
fields.JP:
（このふたりは……ほんとにお互いを大事に思ってる
　家族、だったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They really cared for each other,
just like any other family...)

fields.JP: （……本当にこれしかなかったのかな……）

わーーー！　じゃっくのちだーーーー！
とってもおいしいのーーー！

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I thought you were
going to go on a rampage, so...
fields.JP:
いきなりごめん……その、暴走するかも
しれないと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I thought you were
going to go on a rampage, so...

fields.EN:
With how she is now, I wouldn't be
surprised if she entered Blood
Skelter. Nice call, Jack.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。今のこの子なら、
ブラッドスケルター化してもおかしくないよ。
ジャック、よく気が付いたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how she is now, I wouldn't be
surprised if she entered Blood
Skelter. Nice call, Jack.

fields.EN:
Everyone else noticed, too. If
anything, this is about all I can
do for her...
fields.JP:
みんなだって気付いてたみたいだし、
僕にはこのくらいしかできないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone else noticed, too. If
anything, this is about all I can
do for her...

fields.EN: I see. So this is your power.
fields.JP: ……そう。それがあなたの力なのね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. So this is your power.

fields.EN:
True. Despite my lack of emotions,
I felt something swelling inside
me that I had never felt before.
fields.JP:
確かに……感情など持たないと思っていた
この私が、その奔流に呑まれそうになったわ。
今までにない衝動だった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. Despite my lack of emotions,
I felt something swelling inside
me that I had never felt before.

fields.EN:
I suppose there were emotions
inside me, after all.
fields.JP: 私にも、そんなことはあるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose there were emotions
inside me, after all.

fields.EN:
It can't be helped... You lost
someone you loved...
fields.JP: 無理もないよ……肉親を亡くしたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped... You lost
someone you loved...

fields.EN:
No. I found it interesting—the Blood Maiden
instinct I hadn't even known I had... and
emotions I'd never experienced before.
fields.JP:
いいえ。興味深いと思ったのよ。
自分でも知らなかった、血式少女としての習性が
……そして、体験したことのない感情の動きが
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I'm referring to the emotion
of succumbing to my animalistic
behavior as a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
I know this isn't the time to say
this, but we'd prefer you not to
call your powers "animalistic"...
fields.JP:
こんな時に言いたかないけど、
『習性』とか、動物みたいに言わないでよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know this isn't the time to say
this, but we'd prefer you not to
call your powers "animalistic"...

fields.EN:
That's an odd comment. We are
creatures like any other, and
merely categorized within it.
fields.JP:
あら。私たち生物は、遍く動植物かその中間に
分類される筈でしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's an odd comment. We are
creatures like any other, and
merely categorized within it.

fields.EN:
*sigh* I know you're not evil, but
you're a bit on the weird side...
fields.JP:
はあ……あんたは悪人なんじゃなくて、
変わってるってことだけはわかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I know you're not evil, but
you're a bit on the weird side...

fields.EN:
I have a feeling trying to
understand you is gonna pose a
huge challenge...
fields.JP:
意思の疎通って意味では、そっちの方が
厄介かもしれないけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a feeling trying to
understand you is gonna pose a
huge challenge...

fields.EN:
That can simply be resolved by
sharing information on our
differences.
fields.JP:
生育環境の違いに由来する、情報の不足が
解消されれば、特に問題はないと思うけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
That can simply be resolved by
sharing information on our
differences.

fields.EN:
That sounds quite tasteless,
coming from the side who brought
this about.
fields.JP:
殺した側がそれを言うのは、野暮というもの
じゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds quite tasteless,
coming from the side who brought
this about.

fields.EN:
However, it is kind... I do
appreciate that you recognized me
and my brother as a "family."
fields.JP:
……本当にお人好しね。
でも、肉親と言ってくれて感謝するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, it is kind... I do
appreciate that you recognized me
and my brother as a "family."

fields.EN:
Yes... I suppose I felt "sad," but
Hansel-niisan seemed satisfied with the
results, so...
fields.JP:
そうね……思ったよりは悲しかったけれど……
でも、ヘンゼル兄さんは納得していたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I suppose I felt "sad," but
Hansel seemed satisfied with the
results, so...

fields.EN:
Why, yes. Satisfied that I will
leave our home to live a normal
life as I should.
fields.JP:
ええ。私がこの家から離れて、本来在るべき
生き方を選ぶことを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. Satisfied that I will
leave our home to live a normal
life as I should.

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan said that he was fine with
you all defeating him. He has
entrusted me to you.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんは、あなたたちが自分を倒せた
のなら、それでいいと言ってくれたの。
あなたたちに……託してくれたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel said that he was fine with
you all defeating him. He has
entrusted me to you.

fields.EN:
As such, I have decided I will
accompany you.
fields.JP: だから私は、あなたたちと行くわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As such, I have decided I will
accompany you.

fields.EN:
H-Hey, wait! I thought you said
you were going to live here and
protect this place?!
fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっと待ってよ！
あんたさっき、ここを守って生きてるって
言ってたじゃない！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, wait! I thought you said
you were going to live here and
protect this place?!

fields.EN:
Yes, but this is an empty house
now. The brother and sister that
were once here are now gone.
fields.JP:
ええ。でも、ここはもう空き家になったわ。
住んでいた兄と妹は、いなくなってしまったもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but this is an empty house
now. The brother and sister that
were once here are now gone.

fields.EN:
So you're saying that your role
here is done?
fields.JP: つまり、ここでの役割は終わったというのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're saying that your role
here is done?

fields.EN:
Yes. Siblings can bind each other
together at times. Hansel-niisan had
known that all along.
fields.JP:
ええ。兄妹というものは、時に互いを縛り合う
もの……ヘンゼル兄さんも、そのことは
理解していたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Siblings can bind each other
together at times. Hansel had
known that all along.

fields.EN:
I have an interest in my existence
as a Blood Maiden and in the
existence of this world.
fields.JP:
私は、私という存在……血式少女というもの……
そして、この不条理な世界の在り方に
とても興味があるの。だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have an interest in my existence
as a Blood Maiden and in the
existence of this world.

fields.EN:
If you all don't mind, I would be
interested in joining you as... a
Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
あなたたちさえ構わなければ、迎えてもらえない
かしら。……血式少女として
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you all don't mind, I would be
interested in joining you as... a
Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
It turns out there was no reason
against Gretel joining us, so
she's a member of the Dawn now.
fields.JP:
……結局、拒む理由もないってことで、
グレーテルを黎明に迎えることになったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It turns out there was no reason
against Gretel joining us, so
she's a member of the Dawn now.

fields.EN:
She's different, and while the
others had varying thoughts on
it... I hope everyone gets along.
fields.JP:
風変わりな子だし、微妙な反応の子もいたし
……みんなとうまくやっていけるかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's different, and while the
others had varying thoughts on
it... I hope everyone gets along.

fields.EN:
(After all that's happened, maybe it'd be
stranger if she could accept it so easily.
Honestly, I'm still confused too...)
fields.JP:
（あれだけの経緯があれば、すんなり割り切れる
　方が無理なのかもしれないし、僕も正直、
　まだ戸惑ってるんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm surprised she's so calm about
what she went through... It seems
like I'm more concerned than her.)

fields.EN:
(I'm interested to know what the
Professor and Michiru-san are talking
about with Gretel...)
fields.JP:
（……博士たちやミチルさんたちが、
　グレーテルとどういう話し合いをしてるのかも
　気になる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm interested to know what the
Professor and Michiru are talking
about with Gretel...)

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, how did she
know so much about us?)
fields.JP:
（それに……僕たちのことを、あの子はどうして
　あんなに知ってるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, how did she
know so much about us?)

fields.EN:
(Especially with Alice, she even
seemed to understand her on some level...)
fields.JP:
（特にアリスとは、どこか判り合っているように
　さえ見えた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In particular, it seemed as if
she already knew Alice pretty
well...)

fields.EN:
(It felt completely different from
the bond of trust Alice and I had built up...)
fields.JP:
（僕とアリスが作り上げてきた信頼関係とは、
　もっと全然違う何かなような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her approach to Alice is
completely different from the way
Alice and I interact...)

fields.EN:
That was tiring, but the
discussion was quite interesting.
fields.JP: ……疲れたけど、興味深い会話ではあったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was tiring, but the
discussion was quite interesting.

fields.EN:
Oh? What's with the surprised
expression?
fields.JP: あら。何をびっくりした顔をしているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? What's with the surprised
expression?

fields.EN:
It's because you came in here all
of a sudden!
fields.JP: き……君がいきなり部屋に入ってきたからだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because you came in here all
of a sudden!

fields.EN:
Is there a problem? I did open
and close the door according to
its function.
fields.JP:
……何か、不都合なことでもあるのかしら？
私はきちんと扉を開閉して入ってきたわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a problem? I did open
and close the door according to
its function.

fields.EN:
Um... Most people knock before
coming in...
fields.JP:
いや……普通、他人の部屋に入るときには、
ノックしてから入るんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Most people knock before
coming in...

fields.EN:
Hm... I must say, that's a
bothersome custom. However, I'll
remember that.
fields.JP:
ふうん……面倒臭い風習があるのね。
でも、忘れないよう心がけるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I must say, that's a
bothersome custom. However, I'll
remember that.

fields.EN: Th-Thanks... So, how did it go?
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとう。それで……
話し合いはどうだったの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Th-Thanks... So, how did it go?

fields.EN:
They confirmed my admission as a
Blood Maiden, and said they would
prepare a room for me later.
fields.JP:
ええ。正式に血式少女として加わることが
認められたわ。
私の部屋とやらも、追って用意されるそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They confirmed my admission as a
Blood Maiden, and said they would
prepare a room for me later.

fields.EN:
Until then, I'll be rooming with
Alice.
fields.JP:
ひとまず、アリスのところに間借りすることに
なったみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until then, I'll be rooming with
Alice.

fields.EN:
Yes. I don't know their reasoning,
but I'm glad I'll be with someone
I can get along with.
fields.JP:
ええ。選定の基準はよくわからないけれど、
気の合う相手でよかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I don't know their reasoning,
but I'm glad I'll be with someone
I can get along with.

fields.EN:
(Get along with... If Alice heard
that, she'd probably deny it
completely...)
fields.JP:
（『気の合う相手』って……アリスが聞いたら、
　全力で否定しそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Get along with... If Alice heard
that, she'd probably deny it
completely...)

fields.EN:
I-I see... Well, that's good. It's
best to be in a place where you
can rest easily.
fields.JP:
そ、そう……よかったね。
少しでもゆっくり休めた方がいいもんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see... Well, that's good. It's
best to be in a place where you
can rest easily.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you'll need some time
to settle in. Why don't you take a
rest? You've been through a lot.
fields.JP:
じゃあその……しばらく落ち着かないだろうけど、
ゆっくり休むといいよ。
その……いろいろあったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you'll need some time
to settle in. Why don't you take a
rest? You've been through a lot.

fields.EN:
That was my plan. But before
that...
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was my plan. But before
that...

fields.EN:
We're... outside of the Liberated
District?
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're... outside of the Liberated
District?

fields.EN:
I wanted to speak with you in
private. There are a number of
questions I'd like answered.
fields.JP:
……あなたとだけ話したかったの。
知りたいことが山ほどあるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to speak with you in
private. There are a number of
questions I'd like answered.

fields.JP: あなたがお人好しだから

fields.EN:
I'm still analyzing the others,
so I didn't want them to overhear
us.
fields.JP:
……他の人たちのことは、まだ分析中だから
立ち聞きなどされたくなかったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still analyzing the others,
so I didn't want them to overhear
us.

fields.EN: You don't trust them yet, do you?
fields.JP: ……みんなのこと、やっぱり疑ってるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't trust them yet, do you?

fields.EN:
No. I just don't know them well
enough.
fields.JP: いいえ。まだよく知らないだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I just don't know them well
enough.

fields.EN:
From what I've seen, the fact that
you didn't want to kill Hansel-niisan
brands you as someone... unique.
fields.JP:
でも、彼らの説明を聞いた限り、あの状況で
ヘンゼル兄さんを倒したくないと言うなんて、
あなたはとても異質なのじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
From what I've seen, the fact that
you didn't want to kill Hansel
brands you as someone... unique.

fields.EN:
I'm... sorry about what happened
to him.
fields.JP: ヘンゼルのこと……ごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... sorry about what happened
to him.

fields.EN:
There's no need to apologize.
Everything ended as it should
have.
fields.JP:
いいえ。気にしていないわ
在るべき形に収まっただけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no need to apologize.
Everything ended as it should
have.

fields.EN:
I really don't understand what
you're saying...
fields.JP:
君の言ってること、やっぱりよくわからないん
だけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really don't understand what
you're saying...

fields.EN:
I don't know myself well either,
but how many can truly say they
know themselves well?
fields.JP:
私も私のことなどよくわからないわ。
でも……自分のことをよく知っている人なんて、
どれだけいるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know myself well either,
but how many can truly say they
know themselves well?

fields.EN:
The people of the Dawn are hiding
something. I can tell because
their stories are too orderly.
fields.JP:
黎明の人たちは、みんな何かを隠しているのね。
一見、話が整然としすぎているから、
それがわかるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The people of the Dawn are hiding
something. I can tell because
their stories are too orderly.

fields.EN:
I believe the members of the Blood
Team are aware of that. Your
flustered attitude is proof of it.
fields.JP:
あら。あなたを含め、血式少女たちの全てが
それに気付いていないとは思わないわ。
現に今、あなたは動揺している……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe the members of the Blood
Team are aware of that. Your
flustered attitude is proof of it.

fields.EN:
They're all good people here, so I
don't want to doubt them...
fields.JP:
みんないい人たちだから……
できれば……疑いたくなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're all good people here, so I
don't want to doubt them...

fields.EN:
(Why am I saying this to someone
I don't know very well?)
fields.JP:
（僕はどうして、まだよく知らないこの子に
　こんなことを話してるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why am I saying this to someone
I don't know very well?)

fields.EN:
Strong emotions can cloud one's
eyes from the truth. Everyone
seems to be trapped by emotions.
fields.JP:
強い感情は、真実に対して目を曇らせるものよ。
そして、あなたのお仲間たちのほとんどが、
強い感情に囚われているわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Strong emotions can cloud one's
eyes from the truth. Everyone
seems to be trapped by emotions.

fields.EN:
All the Blood Maidens have a
particular attachment to
something. Am I wrong?
fields.JP:
血式少女はみんな、
何かにこだわりを持っている。
……違うかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the Blood Maidens have a
particular attachment to
something. Am I wrong?

fields.EN:
You see, I have this urge to
climb up the Tower...
fields.JP:
実は僕にも、変な衝動みたいなものがあるんだ。
……わけもなく、塔に昇りたいっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You see, I have this urge to
climb up the Tower...

fields.EN:
It's an urge that's different from
wanting to escape from here...
fields.JP:
それは……脱出したい気持ちとはまた別って
いうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's an urge that's different from
wanting to escape from here...

fields.EN:
That's why I could relate to you
wanting your earring back. I just
wanted to get it back for you.
fields.JP:
だから……君がイヤリングが無いと、どうしても
不安でたまらなくなる気持ち、わかる気が
するんだ……だから、放っておけなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I could relate to you
wanting your earring back. I just
wanted to get it back for you.

fields.EN:
I haven't asked everyone yet, but
I'm sure they all have something
they're really attached to.
fields.JP:
全員に聞いたわけじゃないけど、他のみんなにも
そういうこだわりみたいなものがあるんじゃ
ないかって、思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't asked everyone yet, but
I'm sure they all have something
they're really attached to.

fields.EN:
(That's right... I had thought
about that before, too...)
fields.JP: （そうだ……確かに僕はそう感じたことがある）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I had thought
about that before, too...)

fields.EN:
But... Alice is different. She's
hindered more by logic than by
emotions.
fields.JP:
でも……アリスはあの中では異質な存在ね。
感情よりもむしろ理に囚われ、それ故に時として
足を掬われる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... Alice is different. She's
hindered more by logic than by
emotions.

fields.EN:
Her attachment is rooted in logic.
In that sense, she bears greater
similarity to me.
fields.JP:
血式少女としてのこだわりが、感情よりも理に
根差しているのね。
……私と近しいとするならば、その点よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her attachment is rooted in logic.
In that sense, she bears greater
similarity to me.

fields.EN:
(Is that why Gretel thought they
could both get along? Is it
something they can both sense?)
fields.JP:
（それで……ふたりはどこかわかり合ってた
　感じがあったのかな……
　そういうのって、肌で感じるものなのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that why Gretel thought they
could both get along? Is it
something they can both sense?)

fields.EN:
But, Alice... She was captured so
that she could be with me...
fields.JP:
でも、アリスは……僕のために一緒に牢獄に
囚われて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, Alice... She was captured so
that she could be with me...

fields.EN:
Yes... Her reason of being with
you is the same as the reason I
was with Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
ええ。私がヘンゼル兄さんと留まって
いたのと、同じ理由ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Her reason of being with
you is the same as the reason I
was with my brother, Hansel.

fields.EN:
I theorize Alice seeks order in an irrational
world and tries to discern its essence.
I seek the best solution for my goal...
fields.JP:
私の仮説でいえば、アリスは条理無き世界でも
条理を求め、世界の本質を見極めようとする。
私は、目的のための最適解を探求する……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice will seek logic even in a
illogical world, to see the truth
behind the world, as do I.

fields.EN:
The directions we face may be
different, but we share the same
outlook on lacking emotions.
fields.JP:
方向性は違えど、人間感情に乏しいことは
認めるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The directions we face may be
different, but we share the same
outlook on lacking emotions.

fields.EN:
The surprise and joy at knowing
selfless love, feeling it swell
within us, is invaluable.
fields.JP:
だからこそ……無償の愛に対する驚きと喜び、
自らの感情が揺れ動く感覚は、何にも代え難い
宝石のように映るものなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The surprise and joy at knowing
selfless love, feeling it swell
within us, is invaluable.

fields.EN:
Yes... An invaluable treasure
that we don't deserve.
fields.JP: そう……自分には勿体無い程の煌めき……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... An invaluable treasure
that we don't deserve.

fields.EN:
I don't understand what you're
saying...
fields.JP: 僕にはよくわからないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't understand what you're
saying...

fields.EN:
Oh? I believe your urge is
something that is different from
nature or emotions, as well.
fields.JP:
そうかしら？　あなたの持つ衝動も、生理的、
感情的なものに根ざすものではないと
思うのだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I believe your urge is
something that is different from
nature or emotions, as well.

fields.EN:
Yours comes from a desire to know.
Unusual, given your kindness. Or,
maybe it's because you're kind.
fields.JP:
あなたの衝動の根本は『知りたい』ということ。
お人好しなのに、とても不思議ね？
それとも……お人好しだから、なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yours comes from a desire to know.
Unusual, given your kindness. Or,
maybe it's because you're kind.

fields.EN:
True... I do want to know a lot of
things, but...
fields.JP: 確かに僕は、いろんなことを知りたいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... I do want to know a lot of
things, but...

fields.EN:
(I see... I want to escape because
I want to know... I want to climb
the Tower to see what lies ahead.)
fields.JP:
（……そうか。知りたいから脱出したい……
　その先に何があるのか知りたいから、
　僕は上に昇りたいのかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... I want to escape because
I want to know... I want to climb
the Tower to see what lies ahead.)

fields.EN:
Let me ask, how do you know so
much about us?
fields.JP:
でも、どうして君は、僕らのことをそんなに
よく知ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me ask, how do you know so
much about us?

fields.EN:
That's easy. It's all based on
accumulated knowledge derived from
research and analysis.
fields.JP:
それは簡単なこと……たゆまぬ調査と分析による
知識の蓄積に基づいた仮説だからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's easy. It's all based on
accumulated knowledge derived from
research and analysis.

fields.EN:
I have plenty of books in my home,
and all the time in the world to
read them.
fields.JP:
私の家には、腐るほど『本』があったわ。
……ここにはさすがに負けるけれど。
そして、それを読む時間も無限にあったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have plenty of books in my home,
and all the time in the world to
read them.

fields.EN:
Within these books were story
characters with the same names as
ours, each with a unique goal.
fields.JP:
中には、私たちと『同じ名前』を持つ人物が
登場する『童話』があって、彼らはそれぞれ
固有の行動原理を持っていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Within these books were story
characters with the same names as
ours, each with a unique goal.

fields.EN:
Stories...?! With the same name as
ours...?!
fields.JP:
童……話……！？
僕たちと……同じ名前……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stories...?! With the same name as
ours...?!

fields.EN:
If this absurd world sought to
have the Blood Maidens exist...
fields.JP:
もし、この不条理な世界の要請で、私たち
血式少女という存在が生まれたのならば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If this absurd world sought to
have the Blood Maidens exist...

fields.EN:
...It's of interest that we share
the same attachments as our
stories' counterparts.
fields.JP:
童話の人物たちと同じ名を持った私たちが
それに連なる衝動を持っていることは、とても
興味深いことだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...It's of interest that we share
the same attachments as our
stories' counterparts.

fields.EN:
Until now, I could analyze only
myself, but now that I've met
everyone, I've obtained proof.
fields.JP:
今までは、私個人に対する分析に過ぎなかった
けれど、みんなと出会って、仮説がひとつ
裏付けられたというわけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until now, I could analyze only
myself, but now that I've met
everyone, I've obtained proof.

fields.EN:
Does that mean our names have a
greater meaning than we think?
fields.JP:
それは……僕らの名前が思ったより大きな
意味を持ってるってこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean our names have a
greater meaning than we think?

fields.EN:
I suppose you could say that. Now
then, back on the subject of the
Dawn...
fields.JP:
まあ、そういうことでもいいわ。
ところで、本題の黎明の人たちに話を戻すけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you could say that. Now
then, back on the subject of the
Dawn...

fields.EN:
Not one of them explained the
Marchens' motives. Nothing aside
from the dangers they pose to us.
fields.JP:
彼らはメルヒェンたちの行動の目的について……
誰一人として説明しなかったわ。
ただ、『人間に危害を加える』という以外はね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not one of them explained the
Marchens' motives. Nothing aside
from the dangers they pose to us.

fields.EN:
(She's right... I haven't heard an
explanation from anyone,
either...)
fields.JP: （確かに、誰もその話はしていない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right... I haven't heard an
explanation from anyone,
either...)

fields.EN:
The Jail harbors desires so it can
grow. The Marchens' sense that,
so they work to satisfy the Jail.
fields.JP:
ジェイルは成長するための欲求を持っているの。
メルヒェンは、それを感知しては、
満たそうとして活動しているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail harbors desires so it can
grow. The Marchens' sense that,
so they work to satisfy the Jail.

fields.EN:
This is quite easy to deduce with
a little observation.
fields.JP:
そんなこと、少し観察していればすぐに
わかろうというものなのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is quite easy to deduce with
a little observation.

fields.EN:
I see... So then the torturing we
experienced in prison was for
that...
fields.JP:
そうなんだ……
……じゃあ僕らが受けてたあの拷問も、
そのために……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So then the torturing we
experienced in prison was for
that...

fields.EN:
Blood is its nutrition. Screams
are its lullaby. Licking satifies
its libido.
fields.JP:
血は養分。叫び声は子守唄。
舌での愛撫は性的な満足……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood is its nutrition. Screams
are its lullaby. Licking satifies
its libido.

fields.EN:
They themselves satisfied the
Jail's desires back at home.
fields.JP:
私の『家』では、
彼らはそれを自律的に行っていたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They themselves satisfied the
Jail's desires back at home.

fields.EN:
They themselves? You mean, the
Marchens where you lived were
doing those things on their own?
fields.JP:
自律的にって……君の住んでいた場所では、
メルヒェンが自分たちで……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
They themselves? You mean, the
Marchens where you lived were
doing those things on their own?

fields.EN:
Why, yes. It kept them busy, at
least enough to not attack me.
fields.JP:
そうね……少なくとも、私は襲われることなく
暮らしていたもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. It kept them busy, at
least enough to not attack me.

fields.EN:
If what the Marchens are doing is
sufficient, why are they capturing
and torturing humans?
fields.JP:
メルヒェンだけで問題ないなら……
どうしてわざわざ人間を捕らえて拷問なんか
してたんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If what the Marchens are doing is
sufficient, why are they capturing
and torturing humans?

fields.EN:
I heard from others that the
Nightmares mercilessly attack
humans, but that's not so.
fields.JP:
たとえば、ナイトメアは人間を容赦なく襲う敵
だと聞いたけれど、そんなことはないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard from others that the
Nightmares mercilessly attack
humans, but that's not so.

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan had never attacked humans
until he determined they were
intruders to be eliminated.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんは、人間に敵意なんて
持っていなかったもの
敵対的な侵入者だと判断した場合を除いてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel had never attacked humans
until he determined they were
intruders to be eliminated.

fields.EN:
And I never believed Hansel-niisan to be
any different from the other
Nightmares.
fields.JP:
それに私は、ヘンゼル兄さんが特殊な存在
だったとは考えてはいないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I never believed Hansel to be
any different from the other
Nightmares.

fields.EN:
I believe the other Nightmares
were able to speak too, yes?
fields.JP:
他所のナイトメアも、言葉を喋ったことがある
のでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe the other Nightmares
were able to speak too, yes?

fields.EN:
But if they're no different, then
why were your Marchens and Hansel
different from the others?
fields.JP:
でも、他と変わらないならなんで、
君が住んでいた場所のメルヒェンや
ヘンゼルだけ他の奴らとは違うんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if they're no different, then
why were your Marchens and Hansel
different from the others?

fields.EN:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have the
"eye" you made mention of before?
fields.JP:
他のエリアには必ずあった『眼』が、
あの場所にはなかったことが関係あるとは
思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have the
"eye" you made mention of before?

fields.EN:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
some time.
fields.JP:
もう一つ言えば……あの場所には、
ずっと誰も入ってこれなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
some time.

fields.EN: What are you trying to say?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you trying to say?

fields.EN:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail to monitor
us.
fields.JP:
黎明の誰かがジェイルと通じていて、
ジェイルの中や私たちのことを監視している……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail to monitor
us.

fields.EN: Has that ever occurred to you?
fields.JP: ……そうは思ってみたことはない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Has that ever occurred to you?

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, that would
explain why something didn't feel
right here...)
fields.JP:
（でも確かに……そう考えれば、
　これまで感じた違和感に説明がつく……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, that would
explain why something didn't feel
right here...)

fields.EN:
I'm thoroughly interested in
knowing who this person is, and
what motivations lie beneath.
fields.JP:
その『誰か』が誰なのか……
目的はどこにあるのか……とても興味深いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm thoroughly interested in
knowing who this person is, and
what motivations lie beneath.

fields.EN:
Let's just say that it's safe to
assume there's more information
in the Dawn than you expect.
fields.JP:
いずれにせよ……あの施設の中は、あなたの思う
以上に情報が収集管理されていると思って
間違いないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's just say that it's safe to
assume there's more information
in the Dawn than you expect.

fields.EN:
Your discussions there should only
be what you don't mind sharing, or
indeed, what you wish to be known.
fields.JP:
だから……あの施設で会話をするのなら、
与えても差し支えない……または、与えたい
内容にするべきね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your discussions there should only
be what you don't mind sharing, or
indeed, what you wish to be known.

fields.EN:
So from your point of view, the
Dawn is pretty suspicious, then?
fields.JP:
……君の目から見て、黎明はそれだけ胡散臭い
ってことなんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So from your point of view, the
Dawn is pretty suspicious, then?

fields.EN:
Actually, I would do the same.
They wish to control information.
I wish to control theirs, too.
fields.JP:
いいえ。それが私の趣味と重なるからなのよ。
彼らが私たちの情報を把握したいなら、私も
同じことをして、さらには出し抜きたいだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Actually, I would do the same.
They wish to control information.
I wish to control theirs, too.

fields.EN:
I suppose... What was meant to be
research for a purpose eventually became
research for its own sake—a hobby.
fields.JP:
そうね……目的のための調査研究だった筈が、
いつしか調査研究自体が趣味になってしまった
……そんなところなのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could say their previous goals
have now dwindled to something
akin to a pastime.

fields.EN:
All you need to do is enjoy using
them and myself to seek the truth.
fields.JP:
あなたは彼らと私……その両方を利用して、
真実を追求すると、楽しいと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All you need to do is enjoy using
them and myself to seek the truth.

fields.JP: ……君の気持ちは、やっぱり理解しにくいね

fields.EN:
Oh? I've already told you I'm not
rooted in emotions. You'll get
used to me soon enough.
fields.JP:
あら。感情が私を動かす基盤ではないことは、
さっき話したつもりよ。
あなたもじきに慣れるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I've already told you I'm not
rooted in emotions. You'll get
used to me soon enough.

fields.EN:
Oh, by the way, you said you were
a Nightmare. What made you think
that?
fields.JP:
あ。そういえば……
君は自分のことをナイトメアだと言ってたけど、
どうしてそう思ってたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, by the way, you said you were
a Nightmare. What made you think
that?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? It's because
Hansel-niisan called himself a
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんが、自分のことをナイトメアだと
言っていたからにきまっているでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? It's because my
brother, Hansel, called himself a
Nightmare.

fields.EN:
But the people at the Dawn created
the name "Nightmare"...
fields.JP:
でも……『ナイトメア』っていうのは、
黎明の人たちがそう名付けたって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the people at the Dawn created
the name "Nightmare"...

fields.EN: Create? Maybe they just knew it.
fields.JP: 名付けたのではなく、知ったのかもしれないわ。
fields.LOCALIZED: Create? Maybe they just knew it.

fields.EN: What are we fighting for then...?
fields.JP: ……僕らは何のために戦ってるんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are we fighting for then...?

fields.EN: That's what I would like to know.
fields.JP: それは、私こそが知りたいことだわ。
fields.LOCALIZED: That's what I would like to know.

fields.EN:
And, if the Blood Maidens harbor
danger within themselves, what'll
happen to them after our escape?
fields.JP:
それに血式少女は、常に暴走の危険を孕んでいる
そうだけど、もし脱出できたとしたら……
そんな厄介な存在を、どうするつもりかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, if the Blood Maidens harbor
danger within themselves, what'll
happen to them after our escape?

fields.EN:
As long as I use my blood, I can
stop Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化は……
僕の血があれば、止めることができるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as I use my blood, I can
stop Blood Skelter...

fields.EN:
Do you have an eternal supply of
blood?
fields.JP: あなたの血は無限にあるとでもいうの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you have an eternal supply of
blood?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. It looks like I've
toyed with you too much.
fields.JP: からかい過ぎたみたいね。ごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. It looks like I've
toyed with you too much.

fields.EN:
But do remember that their plan's
execution wouldn't hold without
your existence.
fields.JP:
でも、あなたがいなければ、この作戦自体
成立しなかったのではなくて？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But do remember that their plan's
execution wouldn't hold without
your existence.

fields.EN:
You're right... Their plan took
motion only after they found out
the effects of my blood.
fields.JP:
確かに……僕の血の効果がわかってから、
作戦が本格的にできるようになったって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... Their plan took
motion only after they found out
the effects of my blood.

fields.EN:
It's also possible that they were
planning to use the Blood Maidens
as expendables.
fields.JP:
あるいは……使い捨てながら進むつもり
だったのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's also possible that they were
planning to use the Blood Maidens
as expendables.

fields.EN:
That... crossed my mind before,
but I tried not to think about
it...
fields.JP:
……時々、そんな気もしたけど、なるべくそうは
考えたくなかったことだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That... crossed my mind before,
but I tried not to think about
it...

fields.EN:
According to my research, Blood
Maidens are a rare existence, and
even rarer to find alive.
fields.JP:
……私の研究では、血式少女と呼ばれる存在が
出現するのはごく稀なことの筈……
無事に生き延び、成長するケースは更に稀なこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
According to my research, Blood
Maidens are a rare existence, and
even rarer to find alive.

fields.EN:
All the more so in a place where
Marchens regard humans as enemies.
fields.JP:
人間をメルヒェンが敵視している場所なら、
尚更そうなるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even more so in a place where
humans see Marchens as enemies.

fields.EN:
And yet, the Dawn is able to
gather all of these Blood Maidens
so efficiently.
fields.JP:
なのに、黎明は、どうしてこうも効率よく
血式少女たちを集められたのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, the Dawn is able to
gather all of these Blood Maidens
so efficiently.

fields.EN:
And they even made plans that
didn't hesitate to use such precious
Blood Maidens as expendable...
fields.JP:
しかも、そんなに貴重な血式少女を使い捨てに
することも辞さないような作戦立案……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could support the theory that
they had previously planned to use
Blood Maidens as expendables...

fields.JP: ふふ……ここは本当に興味深いわね

fields.EN: So, what is it you want to say?
fields.JP: 君がいいたいのは……どういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what is it you want to say?

fields.EN: I suspect multiple motives are intertwined.
fields.JP:
おそらく、複数の思惑が錯綜しているだろうと
いうことよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe there are a number of
expectations at work.

fields.EN:
Analyzing them and unraveling them
is stimulating my curiosity.
fields.JP:
それを分析し、解きほぐしていく作業も
とても知的好奇心を掻き立てられるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Analyzing them and unraveling them
is stimulating my curiosity.

fields.EN:
I've said it a number of times
now, but I really don't understand
you...
fields.JP: ……やっぱり君の気持ちはよくわからないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've said it a number of times
now, but I really don't understand
you...

fields.EN:
But no one really know how one
feels, and that's what makes
things interesting, no?
fields.JP:
あら。人の気持ちなんて誰もわからないし、
わからないから面白いのではないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But no one really know how one
feels, and that's what makes
things interesting, no?

fields.EN:
(Not knowing makes things
interesting... That's something I
can't comprehend.)
fields.JP:
（わからないから面白い……か。
　僕にはなかなかそう思えないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not knowing makes things
interesting... That's something I
can't comprehend.)

fields.EN:
Um... Do you know anything about
"Snark?"
fields.JP: あのさ、『スナーク』って、君は知ってる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Do you know anything about
"Snark?"

fields.JP:
……『スナーク』？
いいえ、知らなかったわ

fields.EN:
That is, not until you brought it
up to me just now.
fields.JP: ……さっき説明を受けるまではね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That is, not until you brought it
up to me just now.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's return. I don't
want the others to be suspicious
of us.
fields.JP:
さて、そろそろ戻って休みましょうか。
みんなに怪しまれるといけないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's return. I don't
want the others to be suspicious
of us.

fields.EN:
Yeah... Thanks for sharing what
you know.
fields.JP: うん。……いろいろ話してくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Thanks for sharing what
you know.

fields.EN:
One suggestion... I think it will
prove interesting if you keep what
we shared here secret.
fields.JP:
ここで話したこと……
しばらく秘密にしておいた方が、面白いと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One suggestion... I think it will
prove interesting if you keep what
we shared here secret.

fields.EN:
So this is the Waterside! I can't
wait to show you my prowess!
fields.JP:
ここが『旧河川・沼エリア』ですのね！
腕が鳴りますわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is the Waterside! I can't
wait to show you my prowess!

fields.EN:
Ahaha! Don't get too excited and
trip over yourself!
fields.JP:
あはは！　張り切りすぎて転んだりしない
ようにね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahaha! Don't get too excited and
trip over yourself!

fields.EN:
So, what do you think this
hairball thing is?
fields.JP:
それにしても……
毛玉って、いったい何なんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what do you think this
hairball thing is?

fields.EN:
Gonna guess it's a Marchen. I bet
it's hairy all over.
fields.JP:
まあ、メルヒェンなんじゃないの？
きっと、全身毛むくじゃらのヤツなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gonna guess it's a Marchen. I bet
it's hairy all over.

fields.EN:
But, wasn't this hairball
attacking Marchens, too?
fields.JP:
でも……目撃者からの情報では、
その毛玉はメルヒェンも襲ってるんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, wasn't this hairball
attacking Marchens, too?

fields.EN: Maybe a large carnivore wandered in~
fields.JP: 大型肉食獣でも紛れ込んだんじゃないですか～

fields.EN:
You're not taking this seriously
at all, are you?
fields.JP: ……あんた、真面目に考える気ないでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not taking this seriously
at all, are you?

fields.EN:
All I'm interested in is taking
things easy and having someone
bring me my treasures.
fields.JP:
誰かが取ってきてくれる宝物と楽をすることしか
興味ありません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I'm interested in is taking
things easy and having someone
bring me my treasures.

fields.EN:
Well, I don't care what it is. All
we need to do is to capture it and
figure things out from there!
fields.JP:
……ま、私も何だってかまわないけどね。
ふん捕まえて、正体を確かめればいいのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I don't care what it is. All
we need to do is to capture it and
figure things out from there!

fields.EN:
I haven't heard of Marchens
fighting each other before. I
wonder what it's like...
fields.JP:
確かに……メルヒェン同士が争うという話は
聞きませんわよね……
でもそうすると……どんな生物なのですかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't heard of Marchens
fighting each other before. I
wonder what it's like...

fields.EN:
I think there's another
possibility for what it is...
fields.JP:
可能性って意味では……
もうひとつ、あると思いますけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think there's another
possibility for what it is...

fields.EN:
It could have something to do with
the fact that no Blood Maidens
have been discovered here.
fields.JP:
あら、はっきり言えばいいのに。
このエリアで血式少女が未発見であることと、
無関係とは思えないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could have something to do with
the fact that no Blood Maidens
have been discovered here.

fields.EN:
Yes... We only heard "hairball,"
so it made us assume...
fields.JP:
ええ。毛玉という突拍子も無い情報から、
そうではないという先入観を持ちがちなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... We only heard "hairball,"
so it made us assume...

fields.EN:
That a Blood Maiden would never
be described by such a word...
fields.JP:
……血式少女がそんな風に奇怪な姿な
はずが無い、というね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That a Blood Maiden would never
be described by such a word...

fields.EN:
W-Well I guess no ordinary human
could survive out there... That
thought never crossed my mind.
fields.JP:
ま……まあ、普通の人間じゃ、生き抜くことすら
無理だろうしね。
確かに、そっちの方向は考えてもみなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well I guess no ordinary human
could survive out there... That
thought never crossed my mind.

fields.EN:
It's only a possibility, so
there's no telling what it could
be until we find it.
fields.JP:
可能性ってだけだし、見つけてみるまでは
わからないと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's only a possibility, so
there's no telling what it could
be until we find it.
Hm? What's the matter, Snow White?

fields.EN: Let's just go and search the area!
fields.JP: ともかく……探してみましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's just go and search the area!

fields.EN:
Wh-What's the matter, Princess
Lazy? You startled me.
fields.JP:
きゅ……急に何よ、グータラ姫。
びっくりするじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What's the matter, Princess
Lazy? You startled me.

fields.JP: あれは……黄金の輝きです～

fields.EN:
Wait... Are you talking about
that? That can't possibly be
any kind of treasure.
fields.JP:
ひょっとして……あれのことですの？
あんなものをお宝だと勘違いするようでは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Are you talking about
that? That can't possibly be
any kind of treasure.

fields.EN:
Wait! Isn't that the very hairball
we've been searching for?!
fields.JP:
みなさん、あれこそわたくしたちが探している
毛玉ではありませんこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait! Isn't that the very hairball
we've been searching for?!

fields.EN:
That's what I've been trying to
say.
fields.JP: だからわらわがそう言ったじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I've been trying to
say.

fields.EN:
It sure looks like it... Seems
like gold is about the only thing
you notice, Princess Lazy.
fields.JP:
確かに……そのようね。
グータラ姫、あんた黄金が絡むといい仕事
するじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sure looks like it... Seems
like gold is about the only thing
you notice, Princess Lazy.

fields.EN:
It seems my value has dropped
significantly...
fields.JP: わらわの評価も地に落ちたものです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems my value has dropped
significantly...

fields.EN:
In your case, the only special
value you had was being able to
float.
fields.JP: あんたの場合、元から浮いてんのは本体だけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In your case, the only special
value you had was being able to
float.

fields.EN:
And to think this is coming from
someone so tiny...
fields.JP: ちびっこいそなたに言われたくありません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
And to think this is coming from
someone so tiny...

fields.EN:
Now, now. Save the small talk for
later. We've got our target in
front of us.
fields.JP:
まあまあ、とりあえずじゃれ合いは後にしてよ。
ようやく目標を見つけたんだからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now. Save the small talk for
later. We've got our target in
front of us.

fields.EN:
It looks like it's eating
something...
fields.JP: 何か……食べてるようですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's eating
something...

fields.EN:
All that hair is making it hard to
see... Is that a Marchen?
fields.JP:
毛だらけで何が何だかですけど……
メルヒェンですのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All that hair is making it hard to
see... Is that a Marchen?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I wouldn't mind
dissecting that hairball to see
what's inside.
fields.JP:
ふふ……あの毛玉……解剖して
中身を確認してみたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I wouldn't mind
dissecting that hairball to see
what's inside.

fields.JP: 解剖しちゃ駄目だから！？

fields.EN:
Mmm... I can't seem to make it out
from here...
fields.JP: うーん。ここからだと、なかなか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I can't seem to make it out
from here...

fields.EN:
What is it eating? I don't recall
there being much food around...
fields.JP:
何を食べているのかしら……？
独房エリアの中で、まともな食料なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it eating? I don't recall
there being much food around...

fields.EN: Oh? There was always quite a bit.
fields.JP: あら。いろいろあるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? There was always quite a bit.

fields.EN:
Maybe it's eating something it
took from the people it attacked.
fields.JP: 人間から奪った食料ってとこかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's eating something it
took from the people it attacked.

fields.EN:
I have to say, it does look sort
of like a human...
fields.JP:
でも……よく見ると、
人間に見えなくもないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to say, it does look sort
of like a human...

fields.EN:
Yeah... I think so, too. Maybe we
should talk to it.
fields.JP:
うん……僕もそう見える……
話しかけてみようか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I think so, too. Maybe we
should talk to it.

fields.EN:
We need to be careful, or else it
could run away.
fields.JP:
ですね。
気をつけないと、逃げられちゃうかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to be careful, or else it
could run away.

fields.EN:
It stood up! It's shaped like a
human!
fields.JP:
立ち上がったわ！
やっぱり人間の姿をしているわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It stood up! It's shaped like a
human!

fields.JP: だから言わんこっちゃないんです～
あんた、何も言ってないでしょ！

fields.EN: Let's just hurry and go after it!
fields.JP: と……とりあえず、後を追おうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's just hurry and go after it!

fields.EN:
We need to make sure it doesn't
get away...
fields.JP: 今度は逃げられないようにしませんと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to make sure it doesn't
get away...

fields.EN:
Don't surprise it, okay? Approach
it slowly...
fields.JP:
いい？　驚かせちゃだめよ？
そーっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't surprise it, okay? Approach
it slowly...

fields.EN:
I can just drop on it from above
on my Bamboo One, and...
fields.JP: わらわがバンブー一号で上空から……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can just drop on it from above
on my Bamboo One, and...

fields.EN: That'll make it run away for sure!
fields.JP: それ、逃げられるやつだから！
fields.LOCALIZED: That'll make it run away for sure!

fields.EN:
Now look at what you've done! It
noticed us!
fields.JP: ほら、気付かれちゃったじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now look at what you've done! It
noticed us!

fields.EN: You're the only loud one here...
fields.JP: 大声を出したのはそなたです～
fields.LOCALIZED: You're the only loud one here...

fields.EN:
It seems as if that hairball
mellowed out a bit...
fields.JP: あの毛玉……何だか和んだようですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if that hairball
mellowed out a bit...

fields.JP: 眠の癒しパワー、恐るべしですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's amazing how Sleepy can put
others at ease...

fields.EN:
Um... We're sorry to have
surprised you like that...
fields.JP: あの……驚かせてごめんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... We're sorry to have
surprised you like that...

fields.EN:
It looks like it's raising its
guard...
fields.JP: 警戒されたみたいだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's raising its
guard...

fields.JP: これ、あげないんだからね！！
あっ！　また逃げられた！

fields.EN:
And it's all because you surprised
it, Jack!
fields.JP: ジャックがびっくりさせるからよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And it's all because you surprised
it, Jack!

fields.EN:
What's surprising about that? It
had a mouth, after all.
fields.JP: 口があれば、喋っても不思議じゃないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's surprising about that? It
had a mouth, after all.

fields.JP: 声からすると、女の子みたいですね～
金髪の女の子……いいですわね……

fields.EN:
But, what a shame that she's so
unkempt...
fields.JP:
なのに……小汚くしているなんて、
もったいないですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, what a shame that she's so
unkempt...

fields.EN: Hey, that's not the point here...
fields.JP: いや、今はそういう問題じゃないから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, that's not the point here...

fields.EN:
But it did speak, so I think it's
safe to say it's human.
fields.JP:
けれど、喋ったということは、人間に間違い
ないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it did speak, so I think it's
safe to say it's human.

fields.JP: あら。ナイトメアだって喋るわよ？
いや、どう見てもナイトメアじゃないから……

fields.EN:
All right. Change of plans. We're
going to capture... No, bring her
under our protection.
fields.JP:
ともかく、作戦変更だね。
化け物退治から、あの子の捕獲……
いや、保護に移行しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. Change of plans. We're
going to capture... No, bring her
under our protection.

fields.JP: それは、あの子が望んでることなのかしらね？

fields.EN:
We won't know until we capture
her and confirm what she intends.
fields.JP:
捕まえて、意思を確認するまではわからない
ことだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And how exactly would we know for
sure without asking her first?

fields.EN:
(Alice and Gretel's interactions
make my stomach ache...)
fields.JP:
（この二人のやり取り……何だか胃が痛く
　なるなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice and Gretel's interactions
make my stomach ache...)

fields.EN:
But, won't she run away again?
It was quite apparent that her
guard was up...
fields.JP:
でも、また逃げられちゃいませんか？
はっきり警戒されちゃったみたいですし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, won't she run away again?
It was quite apparent that her
guard was up...

fields.EN:
No need to apologize. Apart from
Nemurihime, I doubt anyone
else had a chance with it.
fields.JP:
いいえ。眠り姫は例外として、他に誰が話し
かけても、結果は同じだったと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to apologize. Apart from
Sleeping Beauty, I doubt anyone
else had a chance with it.

fields.EN:
That sounds amazingly convincing
coming from you, Alice-san.
fields.JP:
アリスさんがおっしゃると、説得力があります
わね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds amazingly convincing
coming from you, Alice.

fields.EN: And what do you mean by that?
fields.JP: それは、どういう意味かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: And what do you mean by that?

fields.JP:
あ……あのさ！
こういうのはどうかな……？
良い考えでもあるんですか～？

fields.EN:
...So, that's my plan. What do
you think?
fields.JP: ……っていう段取りを考えてみたんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So, that's my plan. What do
you think?

fields.EN:
The plan you came up with is a lot
nastier than you look...
fields.JP:
あんた……見かけによらず、えげつない手を
考えるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The plan you came up with is a lot
nastier than you look...

fields.EN:
But, this should work! Let's do
it!
fields.JP: ……いや、いけるよ！　その手でいこう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, this should work! Let's do
it!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh, heh! Listen up, Oyayubi.
The ends always justify the
means!
fields.JP:
くっくっく……親指、覚えときな。
作戦ってのはね、成功すれば正義なんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh, heh! Listen up, Thumby.
The ends always justify the
means!

fields.EN:
Well, now. I believe we can
finally agree on something.
fields.JP: あら。意外なところで意見が合うわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, now. I believe we can
finally agree on something.

fields.EN:
(They're not exactly complimenting
my plan, are they?)
fields.JP: （な……何だか微妙な評価だなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're not exactly complimenting
my plan, are they?)

fields.EN:
All right! It's time to put our
plan to capture that hairball into
action!
fields.JP:
よーし。それじゃあ今から、毛玉捕獲作戦を
開始しよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! It's time to put our
plan to capture that hairball into
action!

fields.EN:
(Okay... First, we'll have
Nemurihime pretend to be asleep...)
fields.JP:
（よし……まずは眠り姫に寝たふりをして
　もらって……）

fields.EN:
This is so tiring... Let's hurry
up and get it over with...
fields.JP: めんどくさいから、早く終わらせましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is so tiring... Let's hurry
up and get it over with...

fields.EN:
(Now to sprinkle the candies
around Nemurihime...)
fields.JP: （眠り姫の周囲に、お菓子をばら撒く……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now to sprinkle the candies
around Sleeping Beauty...)

fields.EN:
(Then trail some candies leading
away from her, and...)
fields.JP: （それをもう少し先までつなげて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Then trail some candies leading
away from her, and...)

fields.EN:
(It looks like she noticed the
candies...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like she noticed the
candies...!)

fields.JP: （よし、そのまま眠り姫の傍まで……）

fields.EN: We'll beat her to a pulp!
fields.JP: ケチョンケチョンにして差し上げますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll beat her to a pulp!

fields.JP: （よし！　眠り姫のところへ逃げ込んだ！）
うーー！！　ううーーーー！！

fields.EN:
Stay calm for awhile, okay? We
just want to talk.
fields.JP:
……少し大人しくして頂戴？
あなたとお話がしたいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stay calm for awhile, okay? We
just want to talk.

fields.JP: うううーーーーーーー！！
……さっきは確かに、言葉を話したのに……

fields.EN: Maybe we can give her something.
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe we can give her something.

fields.EN:
How sly of you to reel a child in
with candy... As expected from
you, Jack...
fields.JP:
食べ物で釣るとは考えましたね～
さすがジャックです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
How sly of you to reel a child in
with candy... As expected from
you, Jack...

fields.EN:
Can you please stop? You're making
me sound like I'm a terrible
person...
fields.JP:
自分がすごく汚い人間に思えてくるから、
もう許してほしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please stop? You're making
me sound like I'm a terrible
person...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Now do you see how
much effort I have to put in to
keep these girls in line, Jack?
fields.JP:
あはは。この子たちをまとめる苦労、
ジャックも少しはわかってくれた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Now do you see how
much effort I have to put in to
keep these girls in line, Jack?

fields.JP:
はあ……
あたしもリタイアしたくなってきたよ……

fields.EN:
So, what specifically are we going
to give her?
fields.JP: それで、何をあげるんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what specifically are we going
to give her?

fields.EN: Well... I think candy is good.
fields.JP:
そうだなあ……
……お菓子……とか、どうかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Well... I think candy is good.

fields.EN:
Candy?! You're going to give her
something that good?!
fields.JP: お菓子！？　そんないいものあげちゃうの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Candy?! You're going to give her
something that good?!

fields.EN:
Ah, candy! Splendid idea. No one
can resist the allure of candy.
fields.JP:
……お菓子……！
お菓子に転ばない人はいないわ……
なかなか考えたわね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, candy! Splendid idea. No one
can resist the allure of candy.

fields.EN:
Well, let's see if she takes it.
Um... Here... You want it?
fields.JP:
ともかく、あげてみるよ。
……えーと……これ、食べる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's see if she takes it.
Um... Here... You want it?

fields.JP: おいしい！　もっとほしい！！

fields.EN:
Um, this is all I have right now,
but... Can we talk after you eat?
fields.JP:
えーと……今はこれだけしかないんだけど……
これ食べたら話、聞かせてくれるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, this is all I have right now,
but... Can we talk after you eat?

fields.JP:
うんうん！
いいひと！　いいひと！

fields.EN:
(I feel terrible, hooking her with
food...)
fields.JP:
（物で釣ってるみたいで、気がひけるなあ……
　いや、物で釣ってるんだよなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel terrible, hooking her with
food...)

fields.JP:
わああーーーーーーーー！！
おいしいものだーーーー！！

fields.EN:
You have to say "thank you"
when you get something from
someone.
fields.JP:
人からものをもらったら、ありがとうって
言うのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have to say "thank you"
when you get something from
someone.

fields.EN:
You're welcome. My name is Jack.
Nice to meet you.
fields.JP:
うん。どういたしまして。
僕の名前はジャックっていうんだ。
よろしくね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're welcome. My name is Jack.
Nice to meet you.

fields.EN:
So, you caught a child with candy,
and now you're seducing her?!
fields.JP: 子供をお菓子で釣って口説いてるわ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you caught a child with candy,
and now you're seducing her?!

fields.EN: I don't think he's seducing her.
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't think he's seducing her.

fields.JP:
んー、ラプ……ラプンツェル！
じゃっく、いいひと！！

へえ……ラプンツェルかあ。
あ。あたしはねー

う！？　うう……！！
じゃっくーーーー！！

fields.EN: Don't be scared. They're with me.
fields.JP: あ、みんな僕の仲間だから、怖くないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be scared. They're with me.

fields.EN:
They're my friends, so I was
hoping you could be my friend,
too.
fields.JP:
みんな、僕の友達だから……
君も友達になってくれると嬉しいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're my friends, so I was
hoping you could be my friend,
too.

fields.EN:
Urrrh... If I be your friend...
you give me tasty thing again?
fields.JP:
うーーーううう……
ともだち、なったら……おいしいのまたくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrrh... If I be your friend...
you give me tasty thing again?

fields.EN:
I don't have any more on me now,
but I'll give you more when we get
back.
fields.JP: ……今はもう無いけど、帰ったらあげるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have any more on me now,
but I'll give you more when we get
back.

fields.EN:
Okay! I be your friend! Rapunzel
go home with you!
fields.JP:
じゃあともだち、なるーー！
ラプンツェルもいっしょにかえるーーー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! I be your friend! Rapunzel
go home with you!

fields.EN:
Oh, um... What were you eating
earlier?
fields.JP:
あ……あのさ。
さっきは何、食べてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... What were you eating
earlier?

fields.JP: あれ！　いつもたべてるやつ！

fields.EN:
That...? Excuse me, but the only
thing there is the wall.
fields.JP: あれ……って、壁しかありませんわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That...? Excuse me, but the only
thing there is the wall.

fields.JP: うん！　かべたべてた！！

fields.EN: You were... eating the Jail wall?!
fields.JP: ジェイルの……壁を、ですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED: You were... eating the Jail wall?!

fields.EN:
You didn't know? It's quite
delicious.
fields.JP: あら。なかなかいけるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't know? It's quite
delicious.

fields.EN:
S-So then that pink thing around
your mouth is...!
fields.JP:
じゃ、じゃあ……口の周りに
付いてる、ピンクのものって……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So then that pink thing around
your mouth is...!

fields.JP:
くちのまわり？
ごしごし……ぺろっ……

fields.EN: Look at the color of her eyes...!
fields.LOCALIZED: Look at the color of her eyes...!

fields.JP: ……けっしきしょうじょ？　めのいろ？

fields.EN:
I was actually thinking that maybe
there was Marchen blood on the
wall...
fields.JP:
ひょっとしたらって思ってたんだけど
……メルヒェンの血が壁についてたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was actually thinking that maybe
there was Marchen blood on the
wall...

fields.EN:
Marchen tasty! But thing you gave
me taste better!
fields.JP:
メルヒェン、おいしいの！
でも、さっきもらったもののほうが、おいしいの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marchen tasty! But thing you gave
me taste better!

fields.EN:
Marchen... I never thought of
that.
fields.JP: メルヒェン……その発想はなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marchen... I never thought of
that.

fields.JP: メルヒェン……美味しいんですか……

fields.EN: Hey, you! Don't get any ideas!
fields.JP: そこ！　変な興味持たない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you! Don't get any ideas!

fields.EN:
W-Well, I have to admit, Marchen
blood does taste a bit on the
sweet side...
fields.JP:
ま……まあ、メルヒェンの血は
確かに甘いかもだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I have to admit, Marchen
blood does taste a bit on the
sweet side...

fields.EN:
But the sweetness from it isn't
the good kind...
fields.JP: でも……決して良い甘さではないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the sweetness from it isn't
the good kind...

fields.EN:
Oh, um! Did you live here,
Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
あ！　あのさ……！
ラプンツェルはずっとここにいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um! Did you live here,
Rapunzel?

fields.EN: Yup! Rapunzel here all the time!
fields.JP: うん！　ラプンツェル、ずっとここにいたー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! Rapunzel here all the time!

fields.JP: 他に何か、覚えていることはある？
んーーーーわかんない

fields.EN: Ooh! A place Rapunzel was before!
fields.JP: あ！　まえにラプンツェルいたとこ、ある！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ooh! A place Rapunzel was before!

fields.JP: そこは……こことは別の場所なのかしら？

fields.EN:
Is she trying to say that she was
in a different location within
this area?
fields.JP:
この場所の……別のところということで
ございますかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is she trying to say that she was
in a different location within
this area?

fields.JP: そう！　ここ、べつのところ！

fields.EN:
So, you've been living here alone
all this time...
fields.JP: ずっとここで、一人で生きてきたんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you've been living here alone
all this time...

fields.EN:
Well, it's not like it's an
inconvenience. There's food and
sufficient things of interest.
fields.JP:
あら。特に困ったことは無いわよ？
食料もあるし、それなりに興味深いし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's not like it's an
inconvenience. There's food and
sufficient things of interest.

fields.JP: いや、君はそうかもしれないけどさ……

fields.EN:
That's right. You'll be pretty in
an instant! We should wipe your
face, too!
fields.JP:
そう。綺麗になりますわよ？
ちゃんと顔も拭いた方がいいですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. You'll be pretty in
an instant! We should wipe your
face, too!

fields.JP: まあまあ！　これはいけませんわ！
あああんたは、あっち向いてなさいよ！
この子……服を着ていないのよ……

fields.EN:
Shoot... I should've noticed
earlier, looking at her...
fields.JP:
あー。まあ、ちょっと考えりゃ
想像はついたことだったけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot... I should've noticed
earlier, looking at her...

fields.EN:
Clothes? What's that? Rapunzel
okay now.
fields.JP:
ふく？　それなに？
ラプンツェルへいきだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clothes? What's that? Rapunzel
okay now.

fields.EN:
Well, we can't let you go without
clothes...
fields.JP: そういうわけにもいかないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we can't let you go without
clothes...

fields.EN:
Indeed! It's only natural for a
girl to want to be pretty!
fields.JP:
そうでしてよ！
女の子は綺麗にするのがたしなみですわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! It's only natural for a
girl to want to be pretty!

fields.EN:
I know! Jack, go back to
headquarters and get some clothes
for her, now!
fields.JP:
そうだわ！
ジャック。あんた、一度本部に戻って
この子の服、取って来なさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! Jack, go back to
headquarters and get some clothes
for her, now!

fields.EN:
Huh?! Me?! B-But I don't know
anything about girls' clothes.
Shouldn't one of you go instead?
fields.JP:
え！？　僕！？
で、でも、女の子の服なんて、わからないよ……
君たちの誰かが行った方がいいんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Me?! B-But I don't know
anything about girls' clothes.
Shouldn't one of you go instead?

fields.EN:
Guys are basically predators, you
know?
fields.JP: 男子はケダモノですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guys are basically predators, you
know?

fields.JP: ジャックはケダモノではないわ……

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! You tell him, Kaguya! In
any case, it's better for us girls
to keep watch on her, so... Go!
fields.JP:
あははは！　かぐやも言うねえ！
ま、確かに女の子が見てた方がいいかもね！
……というわけで、よろしく頼むよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! You tell him, Kaguya! In
any case, it's better for us girls
to keep watch on her, so... Go!

fields.JP: ジャックはケダモノではないわ……

わ……わかったよ。
じゃあ、行ってくるね

fields.EN:
Then I'll go with you. Jack would
have trouble fighting back on his own.
fields.JP:
それなら、わたしも一緒に行ってくるわ。
ジャック一人では、応戦に困るもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
If he's going, I'll go with him,
too. There's no telling what Jack
might encounter on his way back.

fields.EN:
Okay then... Take care of him,
Alice!
fields.JP: それじゃ、アリスもよろしく！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay then... Take care of him,
Alice!

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I'm just fulfilling a
role that's needed.
fields.JP: いいえ。ただの役割分担だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I'm just fulfilling a
role that's needed.

fields.EN:
Be sure none of you go on a
rampage while we're away.
fields.JP:
あなたたちはその間、
暴走しないよう気をつけることね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure none of you go on a
rampage while we're away.

fields.EN: Be careful on your way back.
fields.JP: お二人とも、気をつけてくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED: Be careful on your way back.

fields.JP: じゃっく……どっかいっちゃうの！？
あ……すぐに戻ってくるよ

fields.EN:
Yup... Really, really. You just
wait here with everyone else,
okay?
fields.JP:
うん。ほんとにほんとだから、
みんなと一緒に待っててね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... Really, really. You just
wait here with everyone else,
okay?

fields.EN: Rapunzel... Bear with me a bit...
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、ちょっと我慢して？
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel... Bear with me a bit...

fields.EN:
I know it doesn't feel good, but I
need to do this so that you don't
get into trouble while I'm away.
fields.JP:
気持ち悪かったかもしれないけど……
僕がいない間に、君が苦しい目に遭うといけない
から……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it doesn't feel good, but I
need to do this so that you don't
get into trouble while I'm away.

fields.JP:
おいしいーーーーーー！
これなに！？

fields.EN:
That's Jack's blood. He splashed
his blood on you so that you won't
go on a rampage.
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックの血だよ。
あんたが暴走するといけないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's Jack's blood. He splashed
his blood on you so that you won't
go on a rampage.

fields.EN: Jack's blood tasty! I like Jack!
fields.JP:
じゃっくのち、おいしいーーーー！
じゃっくすきーーーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack's blood tasty! I like Jack!

fields.EN:
(I feel like she's saying that she
likes me as food...)
fields.JP:
（食べ物として『好き』って言われてるような
　気がするんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel like she's saying that she
likes me as food...)

fields.JP: じゃ、じゃあ……行ってくるよ
じゃっく、ぜったいもどってくる？

fields.EN:
Yup... I'll really come back, so
wait here and don't eat anything
weird, you hear?
fields.JP:
うん。絶対戻ってくるから、
変なもの食べないで待ってるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... I'll really come back, so
wait here and don't eat anything
weird, you hear?

fields.JP: うん。たべないでまってる！

fields.EN:
Huh... I'm surprised how close
she is to Jack already.
fields.JP:
へえ……この子、ずいぶん
ジャックに懐いちゃったじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... I'm surprised how close
she is to Jack already.

fields.JP: ジャックは優しいもの

fields.EN:
Alice? Is there something the
matter?
fields.JP: ……アリス、何だか機嫌、悪くない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice? Is there something the
matter?

fields.JP:
いいえ、別に……
早く行ってきましょう

fields.EN:
Huh? What's the matter, you two?
On a date perhaps? Hahahaha!
fields.JP:
あれ？　どうしたんだい、お二人さん！
さてはデートかな？　あはははは！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What's the matter, you two?
On a date perhaps? Hahahaha!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Towa-san! We really
need to run!
fields.JP:
永遠さん、ごめんなさい！
ちょっと急いでて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Mr. Kadowaki! We really
need to run!

fields.EN: Hm? They're sure in a hurry.
fields.JP: 何だろう？　せわしないなあ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? They're sure in a hurry.

fields.EN:
Oh? Jack and Alice. What happened
to the mission?
fields.JP:
あら……ジャックにアリス。
作戦はどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Jack and Alice. What happened
to the mission?

fields.EN:
Perfect timing! We were just
heading to the laboratory!
fields.JP:
ちょうどよかった……！
いま、研究室に行こうと思ってたんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perfect timing! We were just
heading to the laboratory!

fields.JP: ……どうしたんだよ、そんなに慌てて？

fields.EN:
We found another one! A new Blood
Maiden!
fields.JP: 見つかったんです！　新しい血式少女が！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found another one! A new Blood
Maiden!

fields.EN:
Yes. The rumored hairball was a
Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
ええ。毛玉と呼ばれていたものの正体が、
血式少女だったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The rumored hairball was a
Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
W-We came back... to get her some
clothes...
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We came back... to get her some
clothes...

fields.EN:
She's not wearing anything, and...
with Jack around...
fields.JP:
その子、何も着ていなくて……
その、ジャックの目の毒だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's not wearing anything, and...
with Jack around...

fields.JP: えーと、それで……どのくらいの子なんだ？

fields.EN:
Um, we can discuss the details
later...
fields.JP: あの、詳しいことは後で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, we can discuss the details
later...

fields.JP: どのくらいのサイズの子かって聞いてんだよ

え、ええと……
確か、背の高さはこれくらいで……
よし。ちょっと待ってろ

fields.EN:
Here are Oyayubi's spare
clothes. They should work for now.
fields.JP:
親指のやつ用のスペアなんだが、
ま、とりあえずはこれで事足りるだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here are Thumbelina's spare
clothes. They should work for now.

fields.EN:
You know, you could've just
brought her back with ya...
fields.JP:
全く、一度連れて戻ってくるって手も
あっただろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, you could've just
brought her back with ya...

fields.EN:
But if we did that, we couldn't
bring Jack along with us.
fields.JP:
でも、あの状態でジャックと同行させる
わけには……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we did that, we couldn't
bring Jack along with us.

fields.EN:
Hm? Ah... I guess you could say
that.
fields.JP: あー。まあそういう考え方もあるねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Ah... I guess you could say
that.

fields.JP: では、行きましょうか、ジャック

（……親指姫用なら、
　確かに大きさ的には合いそうだけど……）

fields.EN:
(It also looks like it was fitted
specifically for that girl...)
fields.JP: （何だかあの子のために作られたような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It also looks like it was fitted
specifically for that girl...)

fields.EN:
Speak up. If you've got something
else to say, spill it.
fields.JP: おい、まだ注文があるんなら、はっきり言えよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speak up. If you've got something
else to say, spill it.

fields.JP: 僕らの服……ハルさんが作ってたんですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you made our
clothes!

fields.EN:
W-Well, they're like pieces of
armor... So what?
fields.JP:
お、おう。一応防具を兼ねてるからな。
それがどうかしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, they're like pieces of
armor... So what?

fields.EN:
Oh, um... It's just that you had
them ready for us when we arrived,
too.
fields.JP:
あ、いえ、僕とアリスがここに来た時も
すぐに用意してもらえたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... It's just that you had
them ready for us when we arrived,
too.

fields.EN:
Yeah, it was quite a job. Honestly, I couldn't
get around to yours, so I ended up just
reinforcing Dawn's standard-issue clothes.
fields.JP:
ああ、結構大変だったんだぜ？
ま、正直お前さんの分までは手が回らなくてな。
黎明の汎用服を補強しただけになっちまったが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, a real pain. I didn't have
time to make yours from scratch,
so I used what we already had.

fields.EN:
(He used something that was there
for mine... But what about
Alice's?)
fields.JP: （僕のは汎用……じゃあ、アリスの服は？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He used something that was there
for mine... But what about
Alice's?)

fields.EN:
Oh, but I was surprised you had
them ready the next morning!
fields.JP:
あの、それでもすごいですよ！
ここに来た次の日の朝に、もう用意されてる
なんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I was surprised you had
them ready the next morning!

fields.EN:
Alice's clothes really looks good
on her, like they were made just
for her...
fields.JP:
アリスの服なんて、すごく似合ってて、
まるでアリスのために……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice's clothes really looks good
on her, like they were made just
for her...

fields.EN:
You ain't got the time to talk
like this, right? Hurry up and
take that back with ya!
fields.JP:
いいからさっさと行けよ！
そいつ、待ってんだろーが！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You ain't got the time to talk
like this, right? Hurry up and
take that back with ya!

fields.JP:
は、はい……！
行こう、アリス

fields.EN:
I'm sorry we're late! We brought
some clothes!
fields.JP:
遅くなってごめん……！
服、持ってきたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry we're late! We brought
some clothes!

fields.EN: Were you good while we were away?
fields.JP: あなた、おとなしくしていたかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Were you good while we were away?

fields.JP:
うんっ！
ラプンツェル、いいこでまってたよ！

fields.EN:
We'll ask that you wait over
there, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
では、ジャックさんはあちらでお待ちください
ましね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll ask that you wait over
there, Jack.

fields.JP: あ、そっか……うん。わかったよ

fields.EN:
Now then, Rapunzel-san, let's get
these clothes on you.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ラプンツェルさん。
服を着ちゃいましょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, Rapunzel, let's get
these clothes on you.

fields.EN:
Marvelous! I knew you had that
brilliance in you!
fields.JP:
す……素晴らしいですわ！
やはり宝の持ち腐れでしたのね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marvelous! I knew you had that
brilliance in you!

fields.EN:
You're so cute in it! It looks
really good on you!
fields.JP:
すっごく可愛い……！
すっごく似合ってるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so cute in it! It looks
really good on you!

fields.EN:
Yup. You're such a pretty girl,
Rapunzel!
fields.JP:
うん。ラプンツェルって、こんなに綺麗な
女の子だったんだね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. You're such a pretty girl,
Rapunzel!

fields.JP: びっくりしますよね、ジャックさん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't surprise her like that,
Jack!

fields.EN:
I'm more surprised at how he can
sweet talk a girl so shamelessly.
fields.JP:
私は、そこまで臆面もなく女の子を褒められる
ジャックの神経の方にびっくりするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm more surprised at how he can
sweet talk a girl so shamelessly.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised at how he reacted
when all she did was clean herself
up and put on clothes...
fields.JP:
私は、身なりを整えただけで、これだけ
反応が変わることの方が驚きだわ
確かに……身だしなみは礼儀として大切だけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised at how he reacted
when all she did was clean herself
up and put on clothes...

fields.EN:
My sentiments exactly. It's
interesting how important visual
cues are.
fields.JP:
それは同感ね。
視覚情報が情報として侮れないということは
勉強になったけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
My sentiments exactly. It's
interesting how important visual
cues are.

fields.JP: ふく、なんだかへんだよ？

fields.EN:
That's because you're not used to wearing
them. You're a girl too, Rapu-Rapu, so from
now on you should keep yourself looking nice!
fields.JP:
それは着慣れないからですわ。
ラプラプも女の子なのですから、これからは
綺麗にしているべきですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because you're not used to
wearing them yet. Rappy's such a
pretty girl with them on!

fields.EN:
You can have greater confidence,
as well!
fields.JP: そうすれば、自分に自信が持てますもの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can have greater confidence,
as well!

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、つよいじしんあるよ！

fields.EN:
That's not what I was trying to
say...
fields.JP: ……そういう意味ではないんですのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not what I was trying to
say...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel has a place I was. I
wanna go there!
fields.JP:
……ラプンツェル、まえにいたとこあるの。
そこいきたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel has a place I was. I
wanna go there!

fields.EN:
A place where you were? You mean
where you were born and raised?
fields.JP:
前にいたところ……それは、生まれ育った場所、
という意味かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A place where you were? You mean
where you were born and raised?

fields.EN:
Yup! Born! Place Rapunzel was! I
wanna show everyone!
fields.JP:
そう！　うまれたとこ！
ラプンツェルがまえにいたとこ！
みんなにみせたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Born! Place Rapunzel was! I
wanna show everyone!

fields.EN:
It seems like she wants to show us
where she lived.
fields.JP: 生まれ育った場所に案内してくれるんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems like she wants to show us
where she lived.

fields.JP: うん！　あんないしたい！

fields.EN:
But... I forgot where... I wanna
find...
fields.JP:
でも、ばしょわかんなくなった……
みつけたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I forgot where... I wanna
find...
What should we do, Sister Red?

fields.EN:
We've accomplished our first objective.
Now we need to find this area's core...
fields.JP:
まず、第一の目的は果たしたとして、
あとはここの核を探し出すわけだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We already completed part of the
mission. All that's left is to
destroy the core...

fields.EN:
Let's see... Um, Rapu? Why don't
we look for your place while we
look for what we came for?
fields.JP:
そうだなあ……じゃあさ、ラプ。
あたしたちの探し物もしながらでよければ、
一緒に探そうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see... Um, Rappy? Why don't
we look for your place while we
look for what we came for?

fields.JP: うん！　いっしょにさがす！

fields.EN:
Are you sure about this...? It
sounds like a chore...
fields.JP:
本当にいいんですか～？
面倒くさそうですよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure about this...? It
sounds like a chore...

fields.EN:
We could find out more about her,
so I think it's worth it.
fields.JP:
この子のことがもっとわかるかもしれないしさ、
まったく無意味じゃないと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We could find out more about her,
so I think it's worth it.

fields.EN:
I think so, too. It's nice to know
that she at least remembers where
she was born.
fields.JP:
僕もそう思うな。
生まれた場所を覚えてるなんて、いいことだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think so, too. It's nice to know
that she at least remembers where
she was born.

fields.EN:
That's true. Come to think of it,
we don't even remember where we
were born.
fields.JP:
