そうですね。考えたら白雪たち、
生まれた場所って覚えてないですし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's true. Come to think of it,
we don't even remember where we
were born.

fields.EN:
I remember quite clearly. After
all, I've always been with Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
私はよく覚えてるわよ？
ヘンゼル兄さんといつも一緒に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember quite clearly. After
all, I've always been with Hansel.

fields.JP: あんたは例外中の例外！

fields.EN:
Quit pouting, Princess Lazy. Let's
hurry this up! We have to do this,
one way or the other.
fields.JP:
グータラ姫もそう渋い顔してないでさ、
とっとと探しましょ！
どうせやんなきゃいけないことなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quit pouting, Princess Lazy. Let's
hurry this up! We have to do this,
one way or the other.

fields.EN: I suppose... I guess we do...
fields.JP:
……そうですね。
どうせしなければいけないことですね
fields.LOCALIZED: I suppose... I guess we do...

fields.EN:
It's unusual to see you so
compliant.
fields.JP: 珍しく物わかりがいいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's unusual to see you so
compliant.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Well then, we'd better
hurry up before Kaguya changes her
mind!
fields.JP:
あはは。じゃあ、かぐやの気が変わらないうちに
早速出発しよっか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Well then, we'd better
hurry up before Kaguya changes her
mind!

fields.JP: うん！　しゅっぱーつ！

fields.EN:
It's dangerous, so stay close to
us.
fields.JP: 一人で行ったら危ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's dangerous, so stay close to
us.

fields.EN:
Wait... She did live here... Maybe
it isn't so dangerous?
fields.JP:
……いえ、住んでいたのだもの。
危なくないのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... She did live here... Maybe
it isn't so dangerous?

fields.JP: とにかく、行ってみようよ

fields.EN:
Rapunzel? Is this where you were
born?
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、ここが君の生まれた場所なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel? Is this where you were
born?

fields.EN:
Felt like same place, but not...
This not Rapunzel's place...
fields.JP:
けはい、にてるとおもったけど、ちがった……
ラプンツェルいたとこ、ここじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Felt like same place, but not...
This not Rapunzel's place...

fields.EN:
See? We can't find it. Looking
around is tiring, so we should
just forget about it.
fields.JP:
見つからないんじゃないですか～
面倒臭いから諦めるといいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? We can't find it. Looking
around is tiring, so we should
just forget about it.

fields.JP: やだ！　もっとさがす！

fields.EN:
Kaguya-san, I understand the concept
of being lazy, but can't you word
it a little better?
fields.JP:
かぐやさん、面倒臭い精神はわかりませんけど、
もう少し言い方があるのではなくて？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, I understand the concept
of being lazy, but can't you word
it a little better?

fields.JP: ま……まあ、もっと探せばいいじゃない！

fields.EN: Grrrr...! The one gets in my way!
fields.JP:
ぐるるるる……！！
こいつ、じゃまするやつだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Grrrr...! The one gets in my way!

fields.EN:
This makes things easier for us!
Don't let your guard down,
everyone!
fields.JP:
……ちょうど手間が省けたよ！
みんな、油断しないで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This makes things easier for us!
Don't let your guard down,
everyone!

fields.EN: Now then, time to smash that core!
fields.JP: じゃあ、とっとと核をやるわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, time to smash that core!

fields.JP: よっし！　一丁上がりだね！

fields.EN:
Now we can defeat the Nightmare
with ease!
fields.JP: これで、いつナイトメアが来ても楽勝ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now we can defeat the Nightmare
with ease!

fields.EN:
Now then, let's go and look for
the place she wants to show us!
fields.JP:
それじゃ、この子の探してる場所とやらも、
とっとと探しに行きましょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's go and look for
the place she wants to show us!

fields.JP: ……ん？　あんた何してんのよ？

fields.EN: Yes. It's dead, so it's safe now.
fields.JP: ええ。もう死んでいるから、大丈夫よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. It's dead, so it's safe now.

fields.EN:
(Even if she lived here, seeing
death may still be shocking to
her.)
fields.JP:
（いくらここで生きてきたっていっても、
　やっぱりショックだったのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if she lived here, seeing
death may still be shocking to
her.)

fields.EN:
Um, well... There's a thing called
a Nightmare here, and to beat
it...
fields.JP:
あ……ええと、
ここの中にはナイトメアっていうのがいてね、
それを倒すためには……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... There's a thing called
a Nightmare here, and to beat
it...

fields.EN:
Ahahahaha! No blood comes out when
dead!
fields.JP:
あははははっ！
したいだと、ちがでないー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahahahaha! No blood comes out when
dead!

fields.EN:
Why did you do that? This
Marchen's dead already.
fields.JP:
君……どうしてそんなことするの？
もうこのメルヒェンは死んでるんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did you do that? This
Marchen's dead already.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel like playing! I check
inside!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルね、あそんでるのー！
なかしらべるーー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel like playing! I check
inside!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Investigate the
unknown. She seems to understand
that naturally.
fields.JP:
ふふ……知らないものがあれば調査する。
なかなか見所のある子ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Investigate the
unknown. She seems to understand
that naturally.

fields.EN: I don't think that applies to her.
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't think that applies to her.

fields.EN:
That's not a very good thing to
do.
fields.JP: そういうの、あんまり良くないことなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not a very good thing to
do.

fields.EN:
We fight them as enemies, and it
ends when they die. So, you
shouldn't play with their bodies.
fields.JP:
相手は敵だから倒すけど、
倒した後はもう襲って来ないだろ？
だから、死体で遊んじゃいけないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We fight them as enemies, and it
ends when they die. So, you
shouldn't play with their bodies.

fields.EN:
Mmm... If Jack says no, then I
stop.
fields.JP: んーーーじゃっくがだめならやらない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... If Jack says no, then I
stop.

fields.EN:
(She doesn't understand, does
she? Oh well...)
fields.JP:
（この子、絶対わかってないよな……
　まあ、しょうがないか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't understand, does
she? Oh well...)

fields.EN:
Mind you, I don't think it's a
good idea to nip a person's
curiosity in the bud.
fields.JP:
他人の知的好奇心の芽を摘むのは
良いことではないと思うのだけれど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind you, I don't think it's a
good idea to nip a person's
curiosity in the bud.

fields.EN:
I don't think she was doing that
out of curiosity...
fields.JP: あれ、知的好奇心じゃないわよ……多分
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think she was doing that
out of curiosity...

fields.EN:
Having the wrong kind of curiosity
doesn't necessarily make someone
a good adult.
fields.JP:
間違った知的好奇心を持ってても、
ろくな大人にならないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Having the wrong kind of curiosity
doesn't necessarily make someone
a good adult.

fields.EN:
Hm, "good adult." Will that make
a person's life interesting?
fields.JP:
ろくな大人ね……
そんなもの、生きていて本当に楽しいのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, "good adult." Will that make
a person's life interesting?

fields.EN:
You're going to end up getting
hunted by Snark.
fields.JP: スナークに狩られますよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to end up getting
hunted by Snark.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Snark... I wouldn't
mind hunting it down so that I
could research it thoroughly.
fields.JP:
スナークね……
むしろ私が狩って、
心ゆくまで研究材料にしたいものね……ふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Snark... I wouldn't
mind hunting it down so that I
could research it thoroughly.

fields.EN:
Well, no use staying here any
longer. There's no telling when
the Nightmare's gonna show up.
fields.JP:
ま、長居は禁物だよ。
いつナイトメアが出るかわかんないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, no use staying here any
longer. There's no telling when
the Nightmare's gonna show up.

fields.EN:
Yes... Since we're searching the
place, we may as well find the
Nightmare ourselves.
fields.JP:
ええ……ここの探索を続ける以上、
こちらから見つけて倒したいものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Since we're searching the
place, we may as well find the
Nightmare ourselves.

fields.EN:
Ohohoho! Indeed! We shall
strike it first!
fields.JP:
をーっほほほほほ！
そうですわ！　先手必勝しかありませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohoho! Indeed! We shall
strike it first!

fields.JP: それじゃ……先へ進もうか

fields.EN:
It doesn't seem like it's noticed
us yet.
fields.JP: まだこちらには気づいてないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't seem like it's noticed
us yet.

fields.EN:
We can do this! We can strike the
Nightmare from behind!
fields.JP:
……いけるわ！
今ならナイトメアの背後を衝ける！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can do this! We can strike the
Nightmare from behind!

fields.JP: ゴァァァアアアアアアオオオオオ！！
おおおーーーーーーーー！！

fields.EN:
It's angry that we destroyed the
core!
fields.JP: 核を破壊されて、怒り狂ってますわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's angry that we destroyed the
core!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel can no kill before,
so run and hide...
fields.JP:
こいつ、ころせないから、
ラプンツェル、にげたりかくれたりしてた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel can no kill before,
so run and hide...

fields.EN:
Now Rapunzel can kill, so I
kill!
fields.JP:
ころせるようになったから、ラプンツェル
こいつ、ころす！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now Rapunzel can kill, so I
kill!

fields.JP: ゴァァァアアアアアアオオオオオ！！

fields.EN:
Let's hit it while we have the
chance. Is everyone ready?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's hit it while we have the
chance. Is everyone ready?

fields.EN: All right! Let's get this started!
fields.JP:
よーし！
じゃあ、さっそく始めようか！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! Let's get this started!

fields.JP:
おおおーーーーーーーー！！
かたち、かわった！！

fields.EN: I see... So it is like Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP: そう……やはりヘンゼル兄さんと同じなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So it is like my brother,
Hansel.

fields.JP: がるる……こいつ、よわってきたよ！！

fields.EN: Ohohohoho! I will end it myself!
fields.JP:
ほーっほっほっほ！
いまとどめを刺して差し上げましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohohohoho! I will end it myself!

fields.EN:
Keep your eyes on it! Don't let
your guard down!
fields.JP: 油断は駄目よ……気を引き締めて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep your eyes on it! Don't let
your guard down!

fields.JP: グォォオオァァァアア……！！
……みんな！　ケリをつけるよ！
はあ……はあ……みんな、お疲れ！

fields.EN:
That thing didn't stand a chance
against us!
fields.JP: 私たちにかかりゃ、ざっとこんなもんよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That thing didn't stand a chance
against us!

fields.EN:
(It's broken to pieces, but it's
exactly what I thought... A
transceiver!)
fields.JP:
（バラバラに壊れてるけど、やっぱり
　トランシーバーだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's broken to pieces, but it's
exactly what I thought... A
transceiver!)

fields.EN:
Rapunzel-san, you did great for your
first battle against a Nightmare!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルさん、初めてなのに、
がんばりましたね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
For this being your first battle
against a Nightmare, you did
great!

fields.JP:
これ、なくなっちゃうよ！？
どーして！？

fields.EN:
A Nightmare disappears when it
dies.
fields.JP: ナイトメアは、死ぬと消えてしまいますのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Nightmare disappears when it
dies.

fields.EN:
In your case, I'll take it you
mean differently.
fields.JP: ……あんたの場合は、きっと別の意味よね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In your case, I'll take it you
mean differently.

fields.JP: うう……なくなっちゃった……

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. When we get
back, let's eat something good,
okay?
fields.JP:
仕方ないよ。
帰ったら、何かおいしいものを食べようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped. When we get
back, let's eat something good,
okay?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Jack's really become an
older brother now, huh?
fields.JP: あはは。ジャックはすっかりお兄ちゃんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Looks like Jack's her
surrogate brother already.

fields.JP: こ、今度はどうしたのかしら？
ねーねーじゃっく、じゃっく！
どうしたの、ラプンツェル？

fields.EN:
We may have finally found her
place! Let's go, everyone!
fields.JP:
探してた場所を見つけたのかもしれない！
みんな、行ってみよう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may have finally found her
place! Let's go, everyone!

fields.EN: You want to play with it?
fields.JP: ……ひょっとして、これで遊びたいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: You want to play with it?

fields.JP: ううん！　ちがう！　ちがう！

fields.EN:
It looks like it's been dead for
awhile.
fields.JP: あらあら、ずいぶん古い死体ですこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's been dead for
awhile.

fields.JP: ほとんど風化しているわね……

fields.EN:
Um... It looks like its stomach
was ripped open.
fields.JP: あ。この死体、お腹が裂けてませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... It looks like its stomach
was ripped open.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, I've come
across Marchen carcasses like this
before.
fields.JP:
そういえばこういうメルヒェンの死体、
たまに見かけるよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, I've come
across Marchen carcasses like this
before.

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、これがどうかしたの？

fields.EN:
Here! Here! Found place! Where
Rapunzel was!
fields.JP:
ここなの！　ここ！　みつけたの！
ラプンツェルのいたとこ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here! Here! Found place! Where
Rapunzel was!

fields.EN:
Maybe she's saying that this
carcass is acting as a kind of
landmark?
fields.JP:
……つまり、このメルヒェンの死体が
目印ってことなのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she's saying that this
carcass is acting as a kind of
landmark?

fields.JP: きがついたら、ラプンツェルここにいたんだよ！
いやああああああああああああ！！
あああああ……っ！　ああああああ！！

かぐや！　どうしたの！？
かぐや……！！

fields.EN:
Are you sure you're all right? You
shouldn't push yourself...
fields.JP:
本当に大丈夫ですか？
無理はしない方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you're all right? You
shouldn't push yourself...

fields.EN:
Yeah, I think we should return
and rest already.
fields.JP: うん、帰って休んだ方がいいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, I think we should return
and rest already.

fields.EN:
All right! We're done here, so
it's time we head home!
fields.JP:
よし、みんな帰るよ！
ここでの目的は果たしたからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! We're done here, so
it's time we head home!

fields.EN:
Why did Princess Lazy call me out
here? I want to rest, too.
fields.JP:
全くグータラ姫ったら、こんなとこに呼び出して
どういうつもりよ。疲れてるってのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did Princess Lazy call me out
here? I want to rest, too.

fields.EN: Huh? Jack?! What's going on here?!
fields.JP:
……って、ジャックまで！？
いったいどういうことよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Jack?! What's going on here?!

fields.EN:
Sleeping late isn't good for one's
beauty, you know?
fields.JP: 夜更かしは美容の大敵ですのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping late isn't good for one's
beauty, you know?

fields.EN:
*sigh* And just when I was about
to turn in, too...
fields.JP: まったく、寝ちゃうとこだったよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* And just when I was about
to turn in, too...

fields.JP: あの……何かあったんですか？

fields.EN: Jack, what's the meaning of this?
fields.JP: ジャック、これは一体どういうことなの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, what's the meaning of this?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry to bother you at this
hour, but I really needed to talk
to everyone...
fields.JP:
みなさん、こんな時間にすみません。
でも、どうしても話したいことがあるんです。
実は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry to bother you at this
hour, but I really needed to talk
to everyone...

fields.JP: かぐや姫、ちょっと待って

fields.EN:
W-Where...? Outside of the
Liberated District...?
fields.JP: こ、ここは……解放地区の外……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Where...? Outside of the
Liberated District...?

fields.EN:
Quite a pain, but I suppose this
is part of what being "friends" is
all about.
fields.JP:
全く、世話を焼かされるわね……と、言いたい
ところだけど……これが『仲間』の醍醐味
なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite a pain, but I suppose this
is part of what being "friends" is
all about.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, and... Thank you,
Gretel.
fields.JP: ごめん……ありがとう、グレーテル
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, and... Thank you,
Gretel.

fields.JP: グレーテル……あんた、何やったのよ！？

fields.EN: You're as hard to like as ever...!
fields.JP: あいっかわらず可愛くないわね……！

fields.EN:
Fine by me if I'm hard to
like. We can talk here without
unnecessary people overhearing us.
fields.JP:
可愛くなくて結構よ。
ここでなら余計な人たちに聞かれずに
話ができるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, you should have. Now then,
you're free to talk here without
anyone eavesdropping.

fields.EN:
Think of it as a pajama party for
the Blood Team. Be sure to keep
everything here a secret.
fields.JP:
血式部隊のパジャマパーティってところね？
だから……ここでの話は、誰にも内緒……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think of it as a pajama party for
the Blood Team. Be sure to keep
everything here a secret.

fields.EN: That's what you want too, right, Jack?
fields.JP: ジャックは、そうしたいんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe Jack would prefer that
as well.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I think it's better that
way. Isn't that right, Kaguyahime?
fields.JP:
うん。多分……その方がいいと思うんだ。
だよね、かぐや姫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I think it's better that
way. Isn't that right, Kaguya?

fields.EN:
Um... You mind filling us in on
the details?
fields.JP: えーと、一体何の話なわけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You mind filling us in on
the details?

fields.EN:
What I'm going to say is probably
going to bring a lot of suffering
to everyone here.
fields.JP:
これから話すことは、みなさんにとって
とてもつらい話だと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I'm going to say is probably
going to bring a lot of suffering
to everyone here.

fields.EN:
But... I wanted to talk about it
myself...
fields.JP:
でも……このことは、わらわの口から……
話したかったんです。
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I wanted to talk about it
myself...

fields.EN:
After all, you're all my
friends...
fields.JP: ……そなたたちは、わらわの仲間ですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, you're all my
friends...

fields.EN:
Did you all feel something when
Rapunzel showed us her "place?"
fields.JP:
そなたたちは『ラプンツェルのいた場所』に
ついて、何か感じませんでしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you all feel something when
Rapunzel showed us her "place?"

fields.JP: ラプンツェルのいたとこー！

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Did you feel anything when you saw
that dead Marchen with its open
stomach?
fields.JP:
……あの、お腹の裂けたメルヒェンの死体を見て、
何か感じませんでしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you feel anything when you saw
that dead Marchen with its open
stomach?

fields.EN:
You mean the kind we sometimes
saw even in the Cell Area... right?
fields.JP:
たまに独房エリアの中でも見かけていたもの……
ですよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean like the ones we find
around every so often?

fields.EN:
Do any of you remember your
younger days?
fields.JP: そなたたちは、幼い頃のことは覚えてませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do any of you remember your
younger days?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel was right when she said
that was her place. That she came
from that Marchen's belly.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは、きちんと正しいことを話した
んです。気付いた時には『ここ』……
……あのメルヒェンの裂けた胎の中にいたと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel was right when she said
that was her place. That she came
from that Marchen's belly.

fields.JP: うん！　そこにいたよ！

fields.EN:
We Blood Maidens—and you—were born
from Marchens, yet have human forms...
We're literally children of monsters.
fields.JP:
……わらわたち血式少女やそなたは、
メルヒェンから産まれながら、人の形を持つ存在
……まさに化物の子なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We Blood Maidens were born from
Marchens in the form of humans.
We're monsters just like them.

fields.EN:
You're joking, right? This is no time
to be joking.
fields.JP:
嘘、でしょ？
そんな冗談……笑えないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're joking, right? This is no time
to be joking.

fields.EN:
One day, the human who delivered me—the person
I thought was my parent—told me. I heard
it when I was taken in by the Professor.
fields.JP:
わらわはある日、わらわを取り上げた人間……
親と思っていた人から、それを教えられました。
それを聞かされたのは、博士に引き取られる時です
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was told this by a person who I
thought was my parent, when I was
placed under the Professor's care.

fields.EN:
They spoke to the Professor about
me as if I were a burden, and he
listened with interest.
fields.JP:
厄介払いするように、厄介な物の説明でも
するように、彼らは博士にそれを話しました。
博士はただ、興味深げに聞いていました
fields.LOCALIZED:
They spoke to the Professor about
me as if I were a burden, and he
listened with interest.

fields.EN:
The Professor explained more, like the
Jail's mimicry, but it didn't matter. It
didn't change the fact that I wasn't human.
fields.JP:
博士はもっといろいろと、ジェイルの擬態能力など
説明してくれましたが、どうでもいいんです。
人間じゃないことには変わりないからです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor explained the Jail
to me, but I didn't care. All I
knew was that I wasn't a human.

fields.EN:
I didn't want to believe it. But I
now can't turn a blind eye to what
I saw...
fields.JP:
……ずっと信じたくなかった……
でも、あの光景を見て、もう自分を
ごまかすことができなくなりました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to believe it. But I
now can't turn a blind eye to what
I saw...

fields.JP: 僕らは……人間じゃなかったんだ……

fields.EN:
S-So, Dad kept that secret from us
all this time?
fields.JP:
そ……それじゃ、お父さんはそのこと、
知ってて黙ってたってこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So, Dad kept that secret from us
all this time?

fields.JP: ねえさまたち……何も言ってなかった……

fields.EN:
Perhaps the Professor kept quiet because
he was afraid you'd get hurt. Michiru
and the others were probably the same.
fields.JP:
博士は、そなたが傷つくのを怖れて、黙っていた
のではないでしょうか。
ミチルたちもおそらくは同じです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe the Professor kept it a
secret out of kindness. I believe
that applies to Michiru as well.

fields.EN:
This may sound silly, but I was
jealous of how you were all
sheltered out of love.
fields.JP:
……慰めに過ぎませんが、そんな愛情を貰えた
そなたたちが、わらわは羨ましいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
This may sound silly, but I was
jealous of how you were all
sheltered out of love.

fields.EN: That's not how I see it.
fields.JP: 私には、そうは思えないけど
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not how I see it.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Even if you're new, don't say
bad things about Dad and everyone else!
fields.JP:
いくら新入りだからって、お父さんやみんなの
ことを悪く言ったりしないで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you're a newcomer, that's
no excuse for saying something bad
about Dad!

fields.EN:
Calm down, Akazukin-san... You
too, Oyayubihime.
fields.JP: 落ち着いて、赤ずきんさん……親指姫も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Red Riding Hood... You
too, Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
How can I stay calm after hearing
that?! Are you okay with what you
just heard, Alice?!
fields.JP:
落ち着いてなんか、いらんないよ！
アリスはこんなこと言われて、平気なわけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How can I stay calm after hearing
that?! Are you okay with what you
just heard, Alice?!

fields.EN:
I know you have doubts about
the Dawn, Gretel. Even so, don't
try to rile them up.
fields.JP:
グレーテル、あなたが黎明を疑っている
ことは知っているわ。
でも……彼女たちへの挑発はやめなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you have doubts about
the Dawn, Gretel. Even so, don't
try to rile them up.

fields.EN:
I'm not riling them up. I'm just
implying that it's worse not being
told the truth.
fields.JP:
挑発なんかじゃないわ。
知らされないことが時にはもっとも残酷なのだと
私は言っているだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not riling them up. I'm just
implying that it's worse not being
told the truth.

fields.EN:
Yes... I would have appreciated
being told this earlier...
fields.JP: ええ。わたくしは……知らせてほしかったですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I would have appreciated
being told this earlier...

fields.EN:
I was told the Professor saved
me when I was together with a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
わたくし、ナイトメアと一緒にいたところを
博士に助けられたと、そう聞きましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard that I was saved from a
Nightmare by the Professor.

fields.EN:
I was also told much more about
myself than that.
fields.JP: いいえ……他にもいろいろと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was also told much more about
myself than that.

fields.EN: To think all of it was a lie...
fields.JP: それが、全部嘘だったなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: To think all of it was a lie...

fields.EN:
M-Maybe the Professor was being
kind and didn't want anyone to get
hurt...
fields.JP:
そ……それはさ、やっぱり博士はみんなに
傷ついてほしくなかったんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-Maybe the Professor was being
kind and didn't want anyone to get
hurt...

fields.EN: You be quiet for a moment, Jack-san!
fields.JP: ジャックさんは黙っててくださいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED: You be quiet for a moment, Jack!

fields.EN:
First of all, Jack-san, how can you
and Alice-san be so calm about this?!
fields.JP:
だいたい、ジャックさんもアリスさんも……
どうしてそんなに冷静でいられるんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
First, how can you and Alice be so
calm about this?!

fields.EN:
I-I'm not calm... I'm in shock,
just like everyone else, but...
fields.JP:
れ……冷静なんかじゃないよ。
僕だってショックだったよ……でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not calm... I'm in shock,
just like everyone else, but...

fields.EN:
It just made sense to us, that's
all. It explains why we were
shunned by others.
fields.JP:
ええ。どちらかというと、腑に落ちたの。
わたしたちがどうして人間から疎まれたのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just made sense to us, that's
all. It explains why we were
shunned by others.

fields.EN:
We were shunned because we
weren't human... We were something
different from them.
fields.JP:
わたしたち……人間ではなかったから……
彼らにとって異物だったから、疎まれたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were shunned because we
weren't human... We were something
different from them.

fields.EN:
This can't be true! Dad and
everyone in the Dawn, none of them
are shunning us at all!
fields.JP:
そんな……！　お父さんも黎明のみんなも、
あたしたちのことを疎んでなんかいない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This can't be true! Dad and
everyone in the Dawn, none of them
are shunning us at all!

fields.EN:
She has to be right... If not, all
that we've been doing is...
fields.JP: じゃないと……あたしたち、何のために……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She has to be right... If not, all
that we've been doing is...

fields.EN:
Kaguya-san has been carrying feelings
like these all by herself this whole time...
fields.JP:
かぐやさんは、これまでずっとこんな気持ちを
ひとりで抱えていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya has held back a lot of her
thoughts and feelings all this
time.

fields.EN:
But she decided to tell us, even
if it meant it would hurt, because
we're friends...
fields.JP:
それでも、仲間だから……
だからこんな辛い役目を引き受けてくれたんじゃ
ないですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she decided to tell us, even
if it meant it would hurt, because
we're friends...

fields.EN:
In that case, we shouldn't be
arguing amongst ourselves like
this...
fields.JP:
それなのに……白雪たちがいがみあっては
いけないと思います……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that case, we shouldn't be
arguing amongst ourselves like
this...

fields.EN:
Jack showed me that I was able to
keep sane here because everyone
accepted me as a friend.
fields.JP:
わらわは……ジャックに教えられました。
みなさんがいたから、仲間として受け入れて
くれたから、わらわは正気でいられたのだと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack showed me that I was able to
keep sane here because everyone
accepted me as a friend.

fields.EN:
I'm just happy to have met all of
you... People similar to me...
People I can trust...
fields.JP:
わらわは、そなたたちと出会えて……
同じ境遇を分かち合えて……
誰よりも信頼できる仲間を得られて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just happy to have met all of
you... People similar to me...
People I can trust...

fields.EN:
That's why I don't care whether
we're humans or not.
fields.JP:
だから、人間だとか、そうではないとか……
そんなことはどうでもいいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I don't care whether
we're humans or not.

fields.EN:
Even if you hate me for telling
the truth, I wanted to share it,
along with my gratitude.
fields.JP:
たとえそなたたちに嫌われても、この事実を
わらわたちだけで分かち合いたかった……
そして、感謝の気持ちを伝えたかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you hate me for telling
the truth, I wanted to share it,
along with my gratitude.

fields.EN:
Maybe I'm forcing my feelings on you... but
this time, I want to be the one who accepts
all of you. We can support one another...
fields.JP:
わらわの気持ちの押し付けかもしれません……
でも、今度はわらわがみなさんを受け止めたい。
わらわたちは、互いに助け合えるのだと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may be pushing my feelings onto
you, but I'll take all you have
onto me. Let's help each other.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... I'm supposed to be
leading everyone, and look at
what's happened...
fields.JP:
……ごめん、みんな。
ほんとはあたしが一番しっかりしなきゃ
いけないのに、取り乱してさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... I'm supposed to be
leading everyone, and look at
what's happened...

fields.EN:
I may have been insensitive,
too...
fields.JP:
わたしも……その、無神経だったのかも
しれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may have been insensitive,
too...

fields.EN:
Like I said before, your logic
could hinder you.
fields.JP:
言ったでしょ、アリス。
あなたの正論は、時としてあなたの足を掬うって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said before, your logic
could hinder you.

fields.JP: 聞いていないわ、そんなことは
あら。そうだったかしら？

fields.EN:
But, you're right... What I should
have said was...
fields.JP:
でも……そうね。
わたしはこう言うべきだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you're right... What I should
have said was...

fields.EN:
I wanted to live because Jack and
all of you were with me.
fields.JP:
誰よりも、ジャックとあなたたちがいたから、
わたしは、生きていこうと思えたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to live because Jack and
all of you were with me.

fields.EN:
I want everyone to do what they
can for themselves to escape, and
to live life as they see fit.
fields.JP:
誰のためでもない、わたしたち自身のために、
このジェイルを脱出して、その先を生きようと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want everyone to do what they
can for themselves to escape, and
to live life as they see fit.

fields.JP: わたくしたちが……いたから……？
誰のためでもない、あたしたち自身のために……

fields.EN:
That has been my intention from
the very beginning.
fields.JP: 私は初めからそのつもりだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That has been my intention from
the very beginning.

fields.EN:
But if you weren't all such softhearted
people, I might not have helped
with a secret talk like this.
fields.JP:
でも、あなたたちがお人好しでなかったら、
こんなふうに内緒話に手を貸したりしなかった
かもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if you all weren't so kind, I
probably wouldn't have mentioned
it.

fields.JP:
……かぐや。誰もかぐやのことを嫌いになんか
ならないよ

fields.EN: Of course we wouldn't hate you...
fields.JP: その……当たり前じゃない、そんなの
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course we wouldn't hate you...

fields.EN:
You were right to tell us. For
being lazy, you sure put effort in
keeping everything secret.
fields.JP:
それに、虐めの件といいこの件といい、
グータラ姫のくせに、水臭いのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were right to tell us. For
being lazy, you sure put effort in
keeping everything secret.

fields.EN:
Dunno what, but Rapunzel likes
everyone!
fields.JP: よくわかんないけど、ラプンツェル、みんなすき！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dunno what, but Rapunzel likes
everyone!

fields.EN:
Yeah. We have each other!
How we were born doesn't matter!
fields.JP:
うん。あたしたちにはあたしたちがいる！
生まれなんか、関係ないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! We have each other for
support! Who we are isn't an
issue!

fields.EN:
...At first I was confused, but...
I'm glad we handled it this way after all...
fields.JP:
……最初は戸惑ったけど、でも……
やっぱりこの形でよかったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: But I'm glad this all turned out okay...

fields.EN:
(We're a short distance away from
the Liberated District. We really
have been through a lot...)
fields.JP:
（もうすぐ開放地区だ。
　今回もいろいろあったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're a short distance away from
the Liberated District. We really
have been through a lot...)

fields.EN:
I wonder what happened to
Princess Lazy?
fields.JP: ……グータラ姫のやつ、どうしちゃったのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what happened to
Princess Lazy?

fields.JP: あれから、一言も喋らないわね……

fields.EN:
For someone who's so quick
to ask others for things, she has
been very quiet...
fields.JP:
いつもはどうでもいい要求はするくせに……
水臭いですわよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
For someone who's so quick
to ask others for things, she has
been very quiet...

fields.JP: かぐや？　どーしたの？

fields.EN:
Isn't there anything we can do for
her?
fields.JP: 白雪たちに何かできること、無いでしょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't there anything we can do for
her?

fields.EN:
But she hasn't really told us
anything...
fields.JP: あの子、肝心なことは何も言ってくれないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she hasn't really told us
anything...

fields.EN:
I'll talk with her. Maybe it'll
help for her to speak with
someone.
fields.JP:
……僕が話を聞いてみるよ。
ひょっとしたら、少し話した方が
楽になるかもしれないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll talk with her. Maybe it'll
help for her to speak with
someone.

fields.EN:
True... It may be better if you speak to her
alone, Jack.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
みんなで聞こうとするより、
ジャックだけの方がいいかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... It's probably best to have
Jack speak to her in private.

fields.EN:
We're counting on you, Jack. We'll
head back first.
fields.JP:
ジャック、よろしくね。
あたしたちは先に帰ってるからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're counting on you, Jack. We'll
head back first.

fields.EN:
You don't have to talk if you
don't want to. I just wanted to
make sure you were okay.
fields.JP:
あ。無理に喋らないで。
様子、どうかなって思っただけだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to talk if you
don't want to. I just wanted to
make sure you were okay.

fields.EN:
Jack... Will you listen to me for
a minute?
fields.JP:
……………………
ジャック……
わらわの話を聞いてくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Will you listen to me for
a minute?

fields.EN:
Are you sure? What I'm about to
say may hurt you, Jack...
fields.JP:
ジャックには、辛い話になるかもしれません。
……それでも聞いてくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure? What I'm about to
say may hurt you, Jack...

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm sure it must be
important if it's something you
want to share.
fields.JP:
……うん。
かぐや姫がそんな風に言うからには、
きっと大事なことだと思うから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm sure it must be
important if it's something you
want to share.

fields.EN:
Did you sense anything when you
saw that Marchen earlier with its
stomach open?
fields.JP:
……あの、お腹の裂けたメルヒェンの死体を見て、
何か感じませんでしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you sense anything when you
saw that Marchen earlier with its
stomach open?

fields.EN:
Just that I've seen them every so
often. Come to think of it, you've
been like this ever since then.
fields.JP:
……たまに見かけたなあって……
そういえば君、あれを見てから、様子が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just that I've seen them every so
often. Come to think of it, you've
been like this ever since then.

fields.EN:
To be exact, it hit me when I
heard Rapunzel's words. Everything
I had denied came together...
fields.JP:
正確には……あの子の言葉を聞いてから、です
……全てが繋がってしまったんです。
わらわが知っていた……認めたくなかったことが
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be exact, it hit me when I
heard Rapunzel's words. Everything
I had denied came together...

fields.EN:
Jack, do you remember your
childhood? The time before you met
Alice?
fields.JP:
ジャックは覚えていませんか？
そなたの幼かった頃のことを。
……そなたがアリスと出会った、その前のことを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, do you remember your
childhood? The time before you met
Alice?

fields.EN:
A time before I arrived at the
village...
fields.JP: 僕が……村に辿り着いた、その前のこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A time before I arrived at the
village...

fields.EN:
(That dead Marchen killed my
parents... No... Wait...)
fields.JP:
（いや……でもあれは確か、両親を殺した
　メルヒェンの死体で……でも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That dead Marchen killed my
parents... No... Wait...)

fields.EN:
I don't remember anything about my
parents...
fields.JP: ……僕は、両親のことを何も覚えてない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't remember anything about my
parents...

fields.EN:
Jack... You're different from us.
But you are a Blood Youth.
fields.JP:
ジャック。そなたはわらわたちとは違う。
でも、そなたもまた、血式少年です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... You're different from us.
But you are a Blood Youth.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel was right when she said
that was her place. That she came
from that Marchen's belly.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは、きちんと正しいことを話した
んです。気付いた時には『ここ』……
……あのメルヒェンの裂けた胎の中にいたと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel was right when she said
that was her place. That she came
from that Marchen's belly.

fields.EN:
We Blood Maidens—and you—were born
from Marchens, yet have human forms...
We're literally children of monsters.
fields.JP:
……わらわたち血式少女やそなたは、
メルヒェンから産まれながら、人の形を持つ存在
……まさに化物の子なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We Blood Maidens were born from
Marchens in the form of humans.
We're monsters just like them.

fields.EN:
The Professor explained more, like the
Jail's mimicry, but it didn't matter. It
didn't change the fact that I wasn't human.
fields.JP:
博士はもっといろいろと、ジェイルの擬態能力など
説明してくれましたが、どうでもいいんです。
人間じゃないことには変わりないからです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor explained the Jail
to me, but I didn't care. All I
knew was that I wasn't a human.

fields.EN:
One day, the human who delivered me—the person
I thought was my parent—told me. I heard
it when I was taken in by the Professor.
fields.JP:
わらわはある日、わらわを取り上げた人間……
親と思っていた人から、それを教えられました。
それを聞かされたのは、博士に引き取られる時です
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was told this by a person who I
thought was my parent, when I was
placed under the Professor's care.

fields.EN:
They spoke to the Professor about
me as if I were a burden, and he
listened with interest.
fields.JP:
厄介払いするように、厄介な物の説明でも
するように、彼らは博士にそれを話しました。
博士はただ、興味深げに聞いていました
fields.LOCALIZED:
They spoke to the Professor about
me as if I were a burden, and he
listened with interest.

fields.EN:
I didn't want to believe it. But I
now can't turn a blind eye to what
I saw...
fields.JP:
……ずっと信じたくなかった……
でも、あの光景を見て、もう自分を
ごまかすことができなくなりました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to believe it. But I
now can't turn a blind eye to what
I saw...

fields.JP: 僕らは……人間じゃなかったんだ……

fields.EN:
(So my first memory being that
image... The reason why I know how
the Jail feels...)
fields.JP:
（僕の最初の記憶が、あの光景だったこと……
　何故かジェイルの気持ちがわかること……
　それは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So my first memory being that
image... The reason why I know how
the Jail feels...)

fields.EN:
I knew Alice and I were different,
but I thought it was just because
of the way this strange world was.
fields.JP:
僕にもアリスにも、普通と違うところがあって、
でも、ただ……めちゃくちゃな世界だから
そんなこともあるんだって思い込んでいたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew Alice and I were different,
but I thought it was just because
of the way this strange world was.

fields.JP: だから、やっと納得がいった気がするよ……
そなたは……ショックではないんですか？

fields.EN:
It's not that I'm not a little
surprised, but deep down, I think
I already knew...
fields.JP:
ショックじゃないわけじゃないけど……
でも今は、どこかでわかってた気もするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not that I'm not a little
surprised, but deep down, I think
I already knew...

fields.EN:
You're much stronger than I
expected...
fields.JP: ……そなたは意外に……強い、んですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're much stronger than I
expected...

fields.EN:
I'm not strong. It's just that it
bugged me, wondering why we were
the way we were...
fields.JP:
強いんじゃないよ。
ただ、僕らはどうしてこんな風なんだろうって
ずっとおさまりが悪かったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not strong. It's just that it
bugged me, wondering why we were
the way we were...

fields.JP: だから多分、それだけだよ

fields.EN:
That's all...? Is that it? You're
not concerned that we're not
human?
fields.JP:
……それだけ……
そんなに簡単なことで、いいんですか？
わらわたちは人間ではなくても、いいんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's all...? Is that it? You're
not concerned that we're not
human?

fields.EN:
Well, because of that, we're able
to fight to escape the Jail,
and...
fields.JP:
だって、そのおかげでこのジェイルを脱出できる
かもしれない力を持ってるんだし、それに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, because of that, we're able
to fight to escape the Jail,
and...

fields.JP: だから、君たちにも出会えたんじゃないか

fields.EN: You truly are a strong person...
fields.JP: ……そなたはやはり、強い人です……
fields.LOCALIZED: You truly are a strong person...

fields.EN:
That's not true. Everyone's been
really friendly with us. I'm sure
we don't need to worry.
fields.JP:
そんなこと……
ほら、博士たちだって、僕らに良くしてくれるし、
多分、そんなに気にすることはないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. Everyone's been
really friendly with us. I'm sure
we don't need to worry.

fields.EN:
They're friendly with us because
they see us as useful tools...
fields.JP:
彼らが良くしてくれるのは、
わらわたちが役に立つ道具だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're friendly with us because
they see us as useful tools...

fields.EN:
...I can't see humans any other way
anymore. This is the first time I've
ever opened my heart this much...
fields.JP:
……わらわには、もうそんな風にしか
人間のことを見られないんです。
これだけ心を打ち明けたのも、今が初めて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see most humans as suspicious...
In fact, this is the first time
I've opened up to anyone.

fields.EN:
Jack? Can you please keep this our
secret?
fields.JP:
……だからジャック。
この話は、みんなには黙っていてくれませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Can you please keep this our
secret?

fields.EN:
I know I'm asking for a lot after
saying all this to you, but I
don't want to hurt anyone...
fields.JP:
そなたに打ち明けてしまって、虫のいい話だと
思います。
でも……みんなを傷つけたくないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm asking for a lot after
saying all this to you, but I
don't want to hurt anyone...

fields.EN:
Even with the way I am, all of you
are my only friends...
fields.JP:
これでもわらわにとっては……
みんなは初めてできた、唯一の仲間なんです。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even with the way I am, all of you
are my only friends...

fields.EN:
I can see Akazukin being
hurt the most if she knew about
this...
fields.JP:
特に赤ずきんは、隠し事があったと知ったら
とても傷つくはず……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can see Red Riding Hood being
hurt the most if she knew about
this...

fields.EN:
You're a really kind person,
Kaguyahime.
fields.JP: かぐや姫は、ほんとはとても優しい子なんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a really kind person,
Kaguya.

fields.JP: きゅ……急に、何を言うんですか

fields.EN:
I understand how you feel, but I
think it's best to share this with
everyone.
fields.JP:
君が隠しておきたい気持ちは、すごくわかる。
でも……僕は話した方がいいと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand how you feel, but I
think it's best to share this with
everyone.

fields.EN:
Why? Are you sure you understood
what I told you?
fields.JP:
どうしてですか？
やっぱりわかってくれていないんじゃないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why? Are you sure you understood
what I told you?

fields.EN:
No. I think both you and I
were saved because we met everyone.
fields.JP:
違うよ。
僕も君も、みんなに出会えたから救われたんじゃ
ないかなって、僕は思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but we all were saved because
we met each other.

fields.EN:
So... if you tell them yourself instead of
leaving it to the others... then this time,
you can be the one to accept everyone...!
fields.JP:
だから……他の人たちじゃなくて、
君の口から話せば……
今度は、君がみんなを受け止めてあげれば……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this should come from you, and
no one else. You'll need to listen
to what they have to say, too.

fields.EN:
Jack...? Are you going to take
responsibility?
fields.JP:
……ジャック。
そなたは責任を取ってくれるんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...? Are you going to take
responsibility?

fields.EN:
You aren't thinking of making me
say all this and take on the
entire burden, are you?
fields.JP:
まさかわらわだけに話させ、
みんなを受け止めさせる気なんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You aren't thinking of making me
say all this and take on the
entire burden, are you?

fields.EN:
You're right... Let's talk to them
together.
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... Let's talk to them
together.

fields.EN:
I'm... one of your friends, right? Even
if I'm selfish... even if I hate humans...
fields.JP:
わらわは……そなたたちの仲間、なんですよね？
わがままを言っても、人間が嫌いでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... I'm friends with everyone
here, right? Even with how
obnoxious and reclusive I am...

fields.EN:
...Of course! From the very start,
I've thought of you as an important companion.
fields.JP:
……当たり前だよ！
僕は最初から、君を大事な仲間だって思ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course you're our friend! I've
thought of you as a friend ever
since we met.

fields.EN:
Not just you—everyone. I think having all
of you here, accepting me as one of your
friends, is what kept me from giving up.
fields.JP:
君だけじゃなくて、ほかのみんなも……
みんながいて、仲間として受け入れてくれたから
僕はくじけずに済んでるんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only me, but all of us...
We're all friends. I think that's
why we can do what we're doing.

fields.EN:
But won't they hate me for
disclosing such a horrible story?
fields.JP:
みんなは、わらわが何か、嫌な話をしても
嫌わないでくれるでしょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But won't they hate me for
disclosing such a horrible story?

fields.EN:
If this is something from your
heart that you truly want to share
with everyone, it'll be fine.
fields.JP:
それが、かぐや姫がどうしても聞いてほしい、
真面目な話だったら……きっとそんなことはないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If this is something from your
heart that you truly want to share
with everyone, it'll be fine.

fields.EN:
At the very least, you know I
don't hate you.
fields.JP: 少なくとも、僕は嫌わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least, you know I
don't hate you.

fields.JP:
わかりました。
ありがとう、ジャック

fields.EN:
D-Do you mind if you stay by my
side for a moment?
fields.JP:
それでは……
その間、傍にいてもらえませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Do you mind if you stay by my
side for a moment?

fields.EN:
It's just that... seeing your face
eases my nerves a bit...
fields.JP:
その……そなたの顔を見ると、
いい具合に気が抜けますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that... seeing your face
eases my nerves a bit...

fields.JP: （かぐや姫、何を言うつもりなんだろう……？）

fields.EN:
We still have another objective to
clear for the mission.
fields.JP: 今回の使命は、まだもうひとつ残ってます
fields.LOCALIZED:
We still have another objective to
clear for the mission.

fields.EN:
I don't want this to affect
everyone when we haven't even
finished yet.
fields.JP:
先に話してしまって、作戦行動に影響が出て
しまったら、困ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want this to affect
everyone when we haven't even
finished yet.

fields.EN:
So, I'm thinking of waiting until
we've completed our mission.
fields.JP:
ですから、作戦行動が完了するまで、
待とうと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I'm thinking of waiting until
we've completed our mission.

fields.EN:
I'll speak with everyone when we
return to the Dawn...
fields.JP: 黎明に戻ったら……話したいと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll speak with everyone when we
return to the Dawn...

fields.EN:
But, I think it's best to speak
amongst ourselves, since it's a
pretty serious topic and all.
fields.JP:
でもきっと、仲間たちだけで話したほうが
いいと思うんだ。
かぐや姫の真面目な話なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I think it's best to speak
amongst ourselves, since it's a
pretty serious topic and all.

fields.EN: Yup... If only a bit tired.
fields.JP: ……うん。みんな、ちょっと疲れてるけどね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup... If only a bit tired.

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised. You've had to
handle two missions in a row.
fields.JP:
大きな作戦行動がふたつも続いたんだもの。
無理もないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised. You've had to
handle two missions in a row.

fields.EN:
Indeed. But your efforts have led
the Tower to grow again. We're
near the final stage of our plan.
fields.JP:
そうだね。君たちの活躍のおかげで、
『監獄塔』も更なる成長を遂げたよ。
計画もいよいよ大詰めにかかっている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. But your efforts have led
the Tower to grow again. We're
near the final stage of our plan.

fields.EN:
What you've done is amazing.
You're the hope of everyone here
in the Jail. Thank you.
fields.JP:
本当に素晴らしいよ。
君たちはこのジェイルに閉じ込められた人々の
まさに希望だよ。本当にありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you've done is amazing.
You're the hope of everyone here
in the Jail. Thank you.

fields.EN:
Now then, the reason I had
everyone come here this morning
despite being tired is...
fields.JP:
さて。疲れているところを押して、
今朝集まってもらったのは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, the reason I had
everyone come here this morning
despite being tired is...

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、げんきだよーー！！

fields.EN:
Ah. Based on Rapunzel-kun and
Gretel-kun's testimony, we've now
obtained further confirmation...
fields.JP:
ああ。このラプンツェルくんと
グレーテルくんの証言から、新たに
確証が取れたことがあってね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, yes. We have obtained further
evidence from our meetings with
Rapunzel and Gretel.

fields.EN:
I'd had this hypothesis for some time, but
it was based on one case, and hearsay at
that. So I kept it to myself until now...
fields.JP:
仮定としては以前から持っていたのだが、
それはほんの一例に過ぎず、しかも伝聞だった。
そのため、今まで話すのを控えていた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been holding back on talking
about this because I didn't have
firm evidence to support it.

fields.EN:
This may hurt you all, but I don't
want to hide it any longer.
fields.JP:
君たちには辛い話かもしれないが、隠し事は
したくないのでね……聞いてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
This may hurt you all, but I don't
want to hide it any longer.

fields.EN:
...Marchens born from the mimicry
of pregnant humans carried children
in their wombs who remained human.
fields.JP:
……人間の妊婦が擬態させられた
ことで生まれたメルヒェンは、胎内に
人間のままの子を宿していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems that Marchens created
by the Jail's mimicry of pregnant
humans doesn't affect the infant.

fields.EN:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.
fields.JP:
つまり、いくらジェイルでも胎内の子まで
擬態させることは不可能だったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.

fields.EN:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.
fields.JP:
そのメルヒェンたちは、そのまま胎内で
子を育て……胎を破って生まれてきた
子たちは、人間には無い能力を備えていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.

fields.EN:
...So we're half Marchen and half
human... No, that's not it. We're
a species called Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
……つまり、私たちはメルヒェンと人間との
ハーフ……違うわね。
血式少女という生物というわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we're a cross-breed between
Marchens and humans. A species
called "Blood Maidens."

fields.JP: 君は明晰だね。グレーテルくん

fields.EN:
Thank you for the praise. I
believe that's my... Let's see...
What did you call it, Professor?
fields.JP:
お褒めいただき、ありがとう。
おそらくは、それが私の……ええと……
博士、あなたは何と言っていたかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for the praise. I
believe that's my... Let's see...
What did you call it, Professor?

fields.JP: ……血式リビドー。博士が名付けたものよ

fields.EN:
Yes. Each of you holds a unique
attachment to something.
fields.JP:
ええ。あなたたちにはそれぞれ、何か特有の
こだわりのようなものがあるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Each of you holds a unique
attachment to something.

fields.EN:
You mean how I'm attached to my
shoe-shaped glass earrings, or how
I like cleaning?
fields.JP:
わたくしの……ガラスの靴のイヤリングや
お掃除のようなことですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean how I'm attached to my
shoe-shaped glass earrings, or how
I like cleaning?

fields.EN:
So my being attached to my hood
is...?!
fields.JP: じゃあ……あたしのフードへのこだわりも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So my being attached to my hood
is...?!

fields.EN:
Yes. Until recently, I thought Blood
Maidens had a volatile mental
state within them.
fields.JP:
ああ。これまでは血式少女として、不安定な
精神状態を併せ持っているものだと考えて
いたのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Until recently, I thought Blood
Maidens had a volatile mental
state within them.

fields.EN:
But after speaking with Gretel-kun, I
thought of that being a special
trait of a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
グレーテルくんとの対話で、それが血式少女と
しての特質なのではないかと考えたのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But after speaking with Gretel, I
thought of that being a special
trait of a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
(How much information did Gretel
share with the Professor...?)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルは、博士にどこまで話したん
　だろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How much information did Gretel
share with the Professor...?)

fields.EN:
That trait isn't a weakness, nor
is it something that needs to be
fixed. Simply a characteristic.
fields.JP:
それはあなたたちの克服すべき欠点でもなければ、
弱点でもないわ。個性の一環と考えていいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That trait isn't a weakness, nor
is it something that needs to be
fixed. Simply a characteristic.

fields.EN:
Well, everyone has things they're
particular about to one degree or another.
fields.JP:
まあ何だ。誰しも多かれ少なかれ、こだわりは
持ってるもんだしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, like how everyone has
a unique aspect to their
personality.

fields.EN:
That's all I have to share now,
but... Are you all okay? Is this
silence one of disbelief?
fields.JP:
私の話は以上だが……君たちは大丈夫かね？
それとも驚きのあまり、沈黙しているのかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's all I have to share now,
but... Are you all okay? Is this
silence one of disbelief?

fields.EN:
We found out after hearing what
Rapunzel-san said.
fields.JP:
白雪たち、ラプンツェルさんのお話から、
全てがわかっていたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found out after hearing what
Rapunzel said.

fields.EN:
Even so, we talked it over and
agreed that we're still who we are...
fields.JP:
それでも、白雪たちは白雪たちだって、
みんなで話し合ったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We also talked amongst ourselves,
too...

fields.JP: うん。あたしたちは大丈夫だよ、お父さん

fields.EN:
...I see. I'm lucky to have
such dependable daughters—and a son.
fields.JP:
……そうか。それは頼もしい娘たちや息子を
持ったものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I suppose my children
were a lot stronger than I
thought.

fields.JP: ええ。むしろこちらが驚いたわ

fields.EN:
Well, they've been through a lot
already. I bet stuff like this
wouldn't make 'em flinch at all.
fields.JP:
お前らもなんだかんだもう、歴戦の勇士だしな。
これくらいのことじゃ、びくともしねえだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, they've been through a lot
already. I bet stuff like this
wouldn't make 'em flinch at all.

fields.EN:
You are all precious members of
the Dawn, and even more so like
family to us all.
fields.JP:
君たちが我々黎明の大切な一員であり、
私たちが家族のような存在であることには
変わり無いからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are all precious members of
the Dawn, and even more so like
family to us all.

fields.EN:
We're about to head into our final
stage. I'll be asking for your
help, even more than before.
fields.JP:
……これからが、大詰めだ。
君たちには更に活躍してもらわなければ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're about to head into our final
stage. I'll be asking for your
help, even more than before.

fields.EN:
Now then, rest well and take it
easy for today as you please.
fields.JP:
今日のところはゆっくりと休息を取って、
英気を養ってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, rest well and take it
easy for today as you please.

fields.JP: うん！　あたしたち……がんばるよ！

fields.EN:
(What the Professor shared with
us is worded differently, but it's
the same as what Kaguyahime said.)
fields.JP:
（博士が話してくれたことは、言葉は違うけど
　かぐや姫の話と同じ内容だった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What the Professor shared with
us is worded differently, but it's
the same as what Kaguya said.)

fields.EN:
(But why now? He said we're in the
final stage...)
fields.JP:
（でも……どうして今こんな話をしたんだろう？
　これからが大詰めだって言ってたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But why now? He said we're in the
final stage...)

fields.EN:
(If we were shocked beyond belief,
it would've negatively affected
whatever plan was in the works...)
fields.JP:
（僕たちが立ち直れないくらい
　ショックを受けたら……その後の作戦行動に
　影響が出るかもしれないのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If we were shocked beyond belief,
it would've negatively affected
whatever plan was in the works...)

fields.EN:
Thank you for your time. You are
now dismissed.
fields.JP:
すっかり時間を取らせてしまったね。
さあ、みんな戻って休むといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for your time. You are
now dismissed.

fields.EN:
I was... surprised you were
getting along so well with the
Professor.
fields.JP:
あ、うん。
博士とあんなに意気投合してるなんて、
びっくりしたなって思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was... surprised you were
getting along so well with the
Professor.

fields.JP: ……あなたは何でも面白がるのね

fields.EN:
Why, yes. I believe it's because
my curiosity and inquisitiveness
is my Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
ええ。知的好奇心こそが、私の血式リビドー
なんだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. I believe it's because
my curiosity and inquisitiveness
is my Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
I wonder what your Blood Libido
could be, Alice...
fields.JP:
……アリス。あなたの血式リビドーは
何なのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what your Blood Libido
could be, Alice...

fields.EN: I don't know, and I don't care.
fields.JP: さあ……知らないし、興味も無いわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't know, and I don't care.

fields.EN:
You must still be wandering within
your deceptive dream.
fields.JP: あなたはまだ、欺瞞の夢の中を彷徨っているのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You must still be wandering within
your deceptive dream.

fields.EN:
From my perspective, it's you
who's toying with deception.
fields.JP:
……わたしには、あなたこそ欺瞞を弄んでいる
ように見えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From my perspective, it's you
who's toying with deception.

fields.JP: （……また、この二人の言い合いが始まった……）

fields.EN:
I'm just honest. But, I won't deny
that my method has become my
motive.
fields.JP:
私はいつだって正直よ？
でも……そうね。手段が目的になっていることは
否定はしないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just honest. But, I won't deny
that my method has become my
motive.

fields.EN:
And, your very nature is similar
to mine, and quite possibly
Jack's.
fields.JP:
けれど、あなたの本質は、私ととても似ているわ。
おそらく……ジャックもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, your very nature is similar
to mine, and quite possibly
Jack's.

fields.EN:
I'll accept being somewhat similar
to you, but don't drag Jack into
this.
fields.JP:
確かに、わたしとあなたはどこか似ているのかも
しれないわ。でも……ジャックを巻き込まないで
頂戴
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll accept being somewhat similar
to you, but don't drag Jack into
this.

fields.EN:
Oh? I was merely offering you both
the highest praise.
fields.JP: あら。私にとっては最大の賛辞なのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I was merely offering you both
the highest praise.

fields.EN:
I'm not a narcissist in the
slightest.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not a narcissist in the
slightest.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry I didn't notice you. Is
there something you need?
fields.JP:
……気付かなくてごめんなさい。
どうしたのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry I didn't notice you. Is
there something you need?

fields.JP: （……あ、もうみんな帰っちゃったんだ……）

……すみません！
何でもありません……！

fields.EN:
She seemed very serious... I
wonder what's wrong.
fields.JP:
何か思いつめていたようだけれど……
何かあったのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She seemed very serious... I
wonder what's wrong.

fields.EN:
I'm sure she'll let us know if
it's really important.
fields.JP:
……本当に困ったことがあったら、
きっと話してくれるんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure she'll let us know if
it's really important.

fields.EN:
Considering your relationship,
that may be possible.
fields.JP: あなたたちの関係なら……そうかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Considering your relationship,
that may be possible.

fields.EN: Now then, let's leave, shall we?
fields.JP: 私たちも、戻りましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, let's leave, shall we?

fields.EN:
(Even if I'm suddenly told to rest... I
actually don't know what to do with myself...)
fields.JP:
（いきなり休めって言われても……
　かえって手持ち無沙汰だなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if we could rest, it's not
like I really want to...)

fields.EN:
(That's right... I forgot about
how the Nightmare has a
transceiver, too...)
fields.JP:
（……そういえば、今回のナイトメアも
　トランシーバーを持っていた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I forgot about
how the Nightmare has a
transceiver, too...)

fields.JP:
（やっぱり、スナークと連絡を取り合って
　いたんだろうか……）

fields.EN:
(But, why? There are so many
things I don't know yet...)
fields.JP:
（でも、何のために……？
　……わからないことばかりだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, why? There are so many
things I don't know yet...)

fields.EN: Huh...? Who is it...? Come in.
fields.JP:
え……？　誰だろう……
はーい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh...? Who is it...? Come in.

fields.EN:
Um... I really need to talk to
someone...
fields.JP:
その……やっぱり誰かに話したくて。
話さなくちゃいけないって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I really need to talk to
someone...

fields.EN:
But I can't bring this up to
Aka-neesama or Oyayubi-neesama or
Nemu-chan...!
fields.JP:
でも、赤姉様には絶対に言えなくて……
親指姉様やネムちゃんにも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I can't bring this up to
Sister Red or Thumbelina or
Sleepy...!

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what you want to talk
about, but let's calm down first.
We can talk after.
fields.JP:
よくわからないんだけど……とりあえず、
落ち着いてよ。話だったら聞くからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what you want to talk
about, but let's calm down first.
We can talk after.

fields.JP: うう……ありがとうございます

fields.EN:
Why did the Professor bring that
up now?
fields.JP:
博士は、なんでこのタイミングであんなことを
言ったんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did the Professor bring that
up now?

(Snow White was having the same
thoughts...)

fields.EN:
He said he obtained evidence from
Rapunzel-san and Gretel-san...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルさんやグレーテルさんの話から
確証が取れたからって言ってましたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said he obtained evidence from
Rapunzel and Gretel...

fields.EN:
But if we didn't hear it first
from Kaguya-san, we would have all
been in shock and disbelief.
fields.JP:
もし白雪たちが、かぐやさんから話を聞いて
いなければ、すごくショックを受けたと
思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we didn't hear it first
from Kaguya, we would have all
been in shock and disbelief.

fields.EN:
But what we spoke about then
shouldn't be known by anyone in
the Dawn besides us.
fields.JP:
でも、あの場所で話したことは黎明のひとは
知らないはずで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what we spoke about then
shouldn't be known by anyone in
the Dawn besides us.

fields.EN:
(She's right... The Professor said
he didn't want to hide it anymore,
but... something isn't right...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……隠し事はしたくないって言ってた
　けど、何かが引っかかる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right... The Professor said
he didn't want to hide it anymore,
but... something isn't right...)

fields.EN:
To add, it seemed as if both Haru-san
and Miko-san were aware of it.
fields.JP:
それに、話の内容はハルさんや視子さんも
知ってるみたいでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, it seemed as if both Haru
and Miko were aware of it.

fields.EN:
The weird feeling I've been having
all this time is starting to feel
all too real...
fields.JP:
なんだか、これまで薄々感じていた違和感が、
心の中で大きくなるみたいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The weird feeling I've been having
all this time is starting to feel
all too real...

fields.EN:
To be honest, there's a number of
things that bother me...
fields.JP:
……実は、僕もいろいろ不審に思ってたことは
あったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, there's a number of
things that bother me...

fields.EN:
I'm not sure either, but the Dawn
is hiding something from us.
Gretel said the same thing, too.
fields.JP:
僕にもまだはっきりとはわからないんだけど、
確かに黎明の人たちはみんな、何かを隠してる。
グレーテルもそう言ってたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure either, but the Dawn
is hiding something from us.
Gretel said the same thing, too.

fields.EN:
That's why I'm keeping an eye out
for what's happening around us.
fields.JP:
僕も、ここで何が起きてるのかを、もっと
注意してみるようにするつもりなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I'm keeping an eye out
for what's happening around us.

fields.EN:
That said, just like Alice
mentioned, let's do our best for
ourselves, and escape from here.
fields.JP:
だけど……アリスも言ってたけど……
僕たちは僕たちのために、ここからの脱出を
成功させようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, just like Alice
mentioned, let's do our best for
ourselves, and escape from here.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki will become stronger
so that, when the time comes, she
can support everyone...
fields.JP:
……白雪、もっと強くなります。
その時が来たら、みんなを支えられるように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White will become stronger
so that, when the time comes, she
can support everyone...

fields.EN:
(I need to wake up... They're
calling to get everyone
together...)
fields.JP:
（……あ。集合の合図だ。
　起きなきゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to wake up... They're
calling to get everyone
together...)

fields.EN:
Hahaha! If you woke up, you don't
need to answer me.
fields.JP:
ははは。一度で起きてくれたのなら、
特に返事をしてくれなくても構わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! If you woke up, you don't
need to answer me.

fields.EN:
(It's still early... I wonder
what's up...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても……まだずいぶん早い時間だけど、
　何かあったのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's still early... I wonder
what's up...)

fields.EN:
The nest is filled with little
birdies.
fields.JP: 巣の中は、小鳥たちでいっぱいになったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The nest is filled with little
birdies.

fields.JP: そう。もうみんな寂しくないのね

fields.EN:
I'm sure the birdies will grow
strong and leave the nest.
fields.JP:
小鳥たちはみんな強く育って、やがて巣を
旅立つことだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure the birdies will grow
strong and leave the nest.

fields.EN: It's fate. All we can do is watch.
fields.JP:
それが運命だからね。僕らには見守ることしか
できないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's fate. All we can do is watch.

fields.JP: 空を覆う天幕が降りてきたね

fields.EN:
The sun is beyond the heavens,
right?
fields.JP: 天幕の向こうに、おひさまはいるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sun is beyond the heavens,
right?

fields.EN:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew and
a fruit from the Tree of Life.
fields.JP:
そうさ。さあ、今日のごはんだよ
森の朝露に、生命の木の実
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew and
a fruit from the Tree of Life.

fields.EN:
Blue Bird-san. I want to see the sun
with you, Blue Bird-san.
fields.JP:
青い鳥さん。わたし、
青い鳥さんといっしょに
おひさまが見たいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blue bird? I want to see the sun
with you, blue bird.

fields.EN:
Yes. I'm sure that will bring the
finale to the story's first
chapter.
fields.JP:
そうだね。それが物語の第一幕の
フィナーレとなることだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I'm sure that will bring the
finale to the story's first
chapter.

fields.EN:
Go ahead. Eat and drink as you
normally do...
fields.JP: さあ、飲んでお食べ……いつものように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go ahead. Eat and drink as you
normally do...

fields.EN:
Looks like everyone's here. How
does everyone feel?
fields.JP:
さて……みんな揃ったようだね。
疲れは取れたかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like everyone's here. How
does everyone feel?

fields.JP: うん……あたしはね。ラプは……
ごはんおいしかったー！
ワレも大変美味であった……

fields.EN:
Seems like all is well. How about
you, Gretel?
fields.JP: 問題無いとして、グレーテルは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like all is well. How about
you, Gretel?

fields.EN:
I'm fine. In fact, I've been
reading the Professor's research
with interest.
fields.JP:
ええ。博士の研究を興味深く拝見させて
もらってるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. In fact, I've been
reading the Professor's research
with interest.

fields.EN:
You've done more than just read.
Your insight has advanced our
knowledge of the Jail's mimicry.
fields.JP:
それどころではないよ。君の頭脳は
非常に優秀で、示唆に富んでいるよ。
ジェイルの擬態能力についても、一層……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've done more than just read.
Your insight has advanced our
knowledge of the Jail's mimicry.

fields.EN:
Oh? Guess she was a pretty awesome
find for you then, huh, old man?
fields.JP:
ほう……それじゃ、思わぬめっけものじゃ
ねえの、オッさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Guess she was a pretty awesome
find for you then, huh, old man?

fields.EN: Yes. I was an awesome find.
fields.JP: ええ。めっけものだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I was an awesome find.

fields.EN:
She doesn't possess respectful
traits such as humility.
fields.JP: 彼女に謙遜の美点などないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't possess respectful
traits such as humility.

fields.EN:
Humility is useless. Hm, perhaps I
can be the Professor's assistant
when we reach the surface.
fields.JP:
謙遜など、無意味だもの。
そうね……地上へ出たら、博士の助手にして
もらおうかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Humility is useless. Hm, perhaps I
can be the Professor's assistant
when we reach the surface.

fields.EN:
Ah... I guess all is well with
her, too...
fields.JP: あー。まあ、こっちも問題無いとして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... I guess all is well with
her, too...

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san is acting cheerful.
I guess she's trying hard because
she's everyone's older sister...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん、元気そうに振舞ってる。
　やっぱり、みんなのお姉さんだから……
　頑張ってるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood is trying to
keep a strong front... Maybe it's
because she's the senior here...)

fields.JP: ジャック。あんたはどう？

fields.EN:
If anyone here tends to
collapse, it's you, right?
fields.JP:
この中で一番倒れがちっていったら、あんた
でしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: We can't afford seeing you fall.

fields.EN:
Uh, well... I'm fine. I was able
to get some rest.
fields.JP:
あ……うん。僕も大丈夫だよ。
ゆっくり休めたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... I'm fine. I was able
to get some rest.

fields.JP: じゃあ全員問題なしだね！

fields.EN: That's a broad assumption to make!
fields.JP:
それ……
ものすごくアバウトじゃありませんこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED: That's a broad assumption to make!

fields.EN:
Hahaha! So you're all rested. I'm
happy to know how strong you all
are despite the news I shared.
fields.JP:
ははは。全員元気なことはわかったよ。
ショックもあっただろうに、強い子たちで
嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! So you're all rested. I'm
happy to know how strong you all
are despite the news I shared.

fields.EN:
Speaking of which, do you mind if
I ask a question?
fields.JP:
ところで……
ひとつ伺っても構いませんですかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of which, do you mind if
I ask a question?

fields.JP: お。どうした、シンデレラ？

fields.EN:
I understand that Hansel-san was
Gretel-san's older brother. But...
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルさんがグレーテルさんのお兄様だった
のはわかりましたわ。
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand Hansel being Gretel's
brother, but...

fields.EN:
Is there a reason why the other
Nightmares were able to speak?
fields.JP:
他のエリアでもナイトメアが喋ったのは何故なの
でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a reason why the other
Nightmares were able to speak?

fields.EN:
It was surprising to me because
I've been told all this time that
Nightmares couldn't speak.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは人間の言葉なんて話せないって
聞いていたので、それはびっくりしました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was surprising to me because
I've been told all this time that
Nightmares couldn't speak.

fields.EN:
Ah, well, we didn't have many
options but to run when we
encountered a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
あー、あれだ。ナイトメアっていったら、
出会ったら何が何でも逃げるしかない相手だった
からな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, well, we didn't have many
options but to run when we
encountered a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
So we never had the chance to
observe them speaking.
fields.JP:
これまではあいつらに喋らせるようなとこまで
持ってけなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we never had the chance to
observe them speaking.

fields.JP: （ハルさん……何か誤魔化してる？）

fields.EN:
Until we learned destroying the cores was the
key to defeating Nightmares, we understood
almost nothing about their ecology.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。核の破壊がナイトメア討伐の糸口
だと知るまでは、ナイトメアの生態はほぼ全く
解明されなかったといっていいからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We hardly knew anything about the
Nightmares until we found out
about the cores in the areas.

fields.EN:
We're only now finding out various
things from your missions and
information from Gretel-kun.
fields.JP:
それが君たちの活躍、そしてグレーテルくんから
の情報のおかげで、多くのことがわかってきたと
いうわけなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're only now finding out various
things from your missions and
information from Gretel.

fields.EN:
Unlike Marchens, we didn't know
Nightmares vanished upon death.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンとは違って、死ぬと消滅することすら
わかっていなかったものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unlike Marchens, we didn't know
Nightmares vanished upon death.

fields.EN:
And now we know that Nightmares
possess a level of intelligence,
though nothing complex.
fields.JP:
……ナイトメアには、決して高くはないものの、
一定の知能が備わっているようだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And now we know that Nightmares
possess a level of intelligence,
though nothing complex.

fields.EN:
Gretel-kun's example proves that, 
depending on the Nightmare, some
form of relationship is possible.
fields.JP:
グレーテルくんの事例のように、特定の状況……
いや、ナイトメアの性質次第では、固有の関係を
築く場合もあるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel's example proves that, 
depending on the Nightmare, some
form of relationship is possible.

fields.EN:
I didn't see anything unusual
about Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
……ヘンゼル兄さんは、特に変わっていたとは
思えないのだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't see anything unusual
about my brother, Hansel.

fields.EN:
On the contrary. From what I
heard, wasn't he quite calm and
gentle?
fields.JP:
いや、私の知る限り、非常に温和な性格の個体
だったのではないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary. From what I
heard, wasn't he quite calm and
gentle?

fields.EN:
I suppose. Hansel-niisan
was a very kind older brother.
fields.JP:
そうね……ヘンゼル兄さんは、とても優しい兄
だったものね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I suppose. Hansel was very kind.

fields.EN: So, Dad? What's up for today?
fields.JP: それでお父さん、今日の本題は？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, Dad? What's up for today?

fields.EN:
I need you to search the Station
Grounds. It used to be the center
of transit for the city.
fields.JP:
今度の探索地は『元駅構内エリア』になる。
かつてここにあった街の交通の中心となって
いた場所なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need you to search the Station
Grounds. It used to be the center
of transit for the city.

fields.EN:
It's located past the Waterside
and the Dorm.
fields.JP:
『旧河川・沼エリア』や『旧学生街エリア』の
更に奥に位置する、非常に奥まった位置に
なるのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's located past the Waterside
and the Dorm.

fields.EN: That's where you found me, right?
fields.JP: ……それ、あたしが拾われたって場所だよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: That's where you found me, right?

fields.EN:
Yup. Dad and his leader found me
there. I've been raised by the
Dawn ever since.
fields.JP:
うん。昔いた『隊長』って人とお父さんが、
あたしを見つけたんだって。それからあたしは、
黎明で育てられたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Dad and his leader found me
there. I've been raised by the
Dawn ever since.

fields.EN: ...He died in the tragedy fifteen years ago.
fields.JP: ……亡くなったわ。十五年前の惨劇でね
fields.LOCALIZED:
He died after the tragedy that
occurred 15 years ago.

fields.EN:
(The tragedy fifteen years ago...
when they headed for the Tower
and were wiped out by Snark...)
fields.JP:
（十五年前の惨劇って……タワーを目指して
　スナークに全滅させられたっていう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Tragedy 15 years ago? Isn't that
when they went to the Tower and
were attacked by Snark?)

fields.EN:
So we've searched the area before,
but being that it's the farthest
location, it's very dangerous.
fields.JP:
……そのようなわけで、『元駅構内エリア』は
過去に探索をしているのだが、最奥部に位置する
だけあって、危険度は非常に高い
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we've searched the area before,
but being that it's the farthest
location, it's very dangerous.

fields.EN:
Whatever's there may just eat you
up in one gulp.
fields.JP: お前なんか、ぺろっと食っちまうんじゃねえか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever's there may just eat you
up in one gulp.

fields.JP: じゃあラプンツェルがそれたべるよ！

fields.EN:
There shall be nothing to fear, so
long as I am there!
fields.JP: ワレがいれば、何の問題もなかろうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There shall be nothing to fear, so
long as I am there!

fields.EN:
Guess we'll need to be extra
cautious, then...
fields.JP: ……十分に警戒が必要だということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess we'll need to be extra
cautious, then...

fields.EN:
Yes. Exploration was extremely
difficult back then. The captain saved
my life more times than I can count.
fields.JP:
ああ。当時も探索には困難を極めたものだった
からね。私も何度隊長に命を救われたことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Search efforts back then were
impossible. My unit leader saved
me on more than one occasion.

fields.EN:
Please proceed with the utmost caution.
We want every one of you to come
back safely, with no one missing.
fields.JP:
くれぐれも念には念を入れて進んでもらいたい。
私たちは君たちに、誰一人として欠けることなく
戻って来てほしいと願っているからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be very careful. I want each and
every one of you back alive.

fields.EN:
By my calculations, if we can
destroy that area's core...
fields.JP:
……先ほど、このエリアが最奥部だと言ったと
思うが、それはつまり――
fields.LOCALIZED:
By my calculations, if we can
destroy that area's core...

fields.EN:
...The Tower will grow high enough
for us to escape.
fields.JP:
理論上、このエリアの核を破壊すれば、タワーが
脱出可能な高度に達することになるのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...The Tower will grow high enough
for us to escape.

fields.JP: じゃあ……今回の作戦が成功すれば……！

fields.EN:
Yes... We can finally begin our
ascension of the Tower. The time
for humanity to strike will begin.
fields.JP:
……ああ。いよいよ脱出計画の開始となり、
タワーを目指すこととなる。
……人類の反撃の始まりだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... We can finally begin our
ascension of the Tower. The time
for humanity to strike will begin.

fields.EN:
Then that's even more reason not
to waste time here! We'll go, take
care of it, and come right back!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ尚更、そんなとこでグズグズしてる
ヒマなんてないじゃない！
余裕で行って帰ってこなくちゃね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we shouldn't be wasting time
here like this! We need to get
this over and done with, pronto!

fields.EN:
It's nice to see you in high
spirits, but please do be careful.
fields.JP:
張り切ってくれるのは頼もしいが、
くれぐれも気をつけて行ってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nice to see you in high
spirits, but please do be careful.

fields.EN:
Yup! We'll do our best. Everyone,
once you're ready, head to the
lobby!
fields.JP:
うん。みんな……がんばろうね。
各自、準備ができたらロビーに集合だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! We'll do our best. Everyone,
once you're ready, head to the
lobby!

fields.EN:
(There's a ton of things to
consider, but I'd better focus on
this mission!)
fields.JP:
（考えなきゃいけないことは山程あるけど、
　今はこの作戦に集中しよう……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's a ton of things to
consider, but I'd better focus on
this mission!)

fields.EN:
Stop by my place later. I wanna
check out your Mary Gun.
fields.JP:
行く前に俺んとこに寄ってくれ。
メアリガンの調子を見てやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop by my place later. I wanna
check out your Mary Gun.

fields.JP: 師匠！　これ片付けとくっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Boss! I'll put it this way, kay?

fields.EN:
This should do it... Now ya don't
have to worry about it falling
apart during the mission.
fields.JP:
……ま、こんなとこだろ。
これで探索中に壊れる心配はねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This should do it... Now ya don't
have to worry about it falling
apart during the mission.

fields.JP: ありがとうございます、ハルさん

fields.EN:
Everyone—especially Akazukin and Oyayubi—seems
oddly determined to push themselves... but
that's exactly when people are liable to snap.
fields.JP:
みんな……特に赤ずきんや親指の奴は、
妙に張り切ろうとしてるようだが……
そういうのはポッキリ行きやすい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like everyone's excited.
But that also means it'll be that
much easier to lose balance.

fields.EN:
That geezer probably didn't want
rumors flying around, but bringing
it up affected everyone, no doubt.
fields.JP:
オッさんも、変な推測が広がるよりはと考えたん
だろうが、何もこんな時にバラさんでもな……
当人なら動揺して当然だろうに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That geezer probably didn't want
rumors flying around, but bringing
it up affected everyone, no doubt.

fields.EN:
Going into battle carrying that is almost
asking to die... but deceiving yourself
and forcing yourself onward is even worse.
fields.JP:
そんなもんを抱えて戦地に行くのは、死にに行く
ようなもんだが……自分を騙して鼓舞する方が、
より始末に悪い
fields.LOCALIZED:
Going to battle thinking you'll
die is one thing, but trying to
hide it with excitement is worse.

fields.EN:
The Professor's like a dry stick,
so I'm not surprised he didn't
think about it.
fields.JP: ハカセ、朴念仁っすからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor's like a dry stick,
so I'm not surprised he didn't
think about it.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you've got stuff on your
mind too, but can ya keep an eye
out for them?
fields.JP:
お前もお前で大変だろうが、気をつけて見て
やってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you've got stuff on your
mind too, but can ya keep an eye
out for them?

fields.EN:
You really are observant of
everyone, Haru-san...
fields.JP: ハルさん……みんなのこと、よく見てるんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are observant of
everyone, Haru...

fields.EN:
Boss is always worried about you
folks!
fields.JP:
師匠はみんなのこと、いつもすっごく心配してる
っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss is always worried about you
folks!

fields.EN:
Hey, Clara! If you're done, go and
mind the store. Can't believe
you're still scuttling around...
fields.JP:
おい、くらら。片付け終わったら店戻れ。
何かにつけてちょろちょろ来やがって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Clara! If you're done, go and
mind the store. Can't believe
you're still scuttling around...

fields.EN:
C'mon, Boss. What's with the cold
treatment? I'm your assistant,
y'know?
fields.JP:
もー。師匠、つれないっすよー。
自分、師匠の助手っすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, Boss. What's with the cold
treatment? I'm your assistant,
y'know?

fields.EN: You're a very kind person, Haru-san.
fields.JP: ハルさんは優しい人なんですね
fields.LOCALIZED: You're a very kind person, Haru.

fields.EN:
You're all we've got. You're our
lifeline. I can't have any one of
you die on us, that's all...
fields.JP:
……お前らは俺たちの大事な命綱だからな。
誰一人として死なれちゃ困る……それだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're all we've got. You're our
lifeline. I can't have any one of
you die on us, that's all...

fields.EN:
For some reason, Haru-san, I feel like I can
believe what you say, but...
fields.JP:
……ハルさんの言葉は、どうしてか
信じられるような気がするのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
For some reason, I can believe in
what you say to me, but...

fields.EN:
Haru-san, you and Miko-san knew too,
didn't you? That we weren't human...
fields.JP:
……ハルさんや視子さんも、やっぱり知ってたん
ですよね？　僕たちが人間じゃないってこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You and Miko knew, didn't you?
That we weren't human...

fields.EN:
...Yeah. But like the Professor said, nobody
has ever remembered that before, and none
of us actually witnessed you being born.
fields.JP:
……まあな。けど、博士も言ってたように、
今までそのことを覚えてる奴もいなけりゃ、
生まれる現場を見たわけじゃねえしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... But like that geezer said,
we didn't know for sure, and we're
not certain how you were all born.

fields.EN:
We only knew that mimicry's effect
leaves the inside untouched. Not
being human is a bit of a stretch.
fields.JP:
けど第一、擬態は母体止まりで、中の胎児はその
まんまだ。人間じゃないってのは、極論だろうが
fields.LOCALIZED:
We only knew that mimicry's effect
leaves the inside untouched. Not
being human is a bit of a stretch.

fields.EN:
But, everyone probably wanted to
believe they were the same as
everyone else in the Dawn...
fields.JP:
でも……みんな多分、自分が黎明のみんなと同じ
人間だって、信じたかったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, everyone probably wanted to
believe they were the same as
everyone else in the Dawn...

fields.JP: 『みんな多分』って、お前は違うのか？

fields.EN:
I'm like Alice... I've always felt
something was different about me,
so knowing this just felt normal.
fields.JP:
僕は……アリスもそうだけど、いつもどこか
人とは違うって違和感を持ってたから……
かえって腑に落ちた感じなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm like Alice... I've always felt
something was different about me,
so knowing this just felt normal.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel and Gretel are exactly as
you see them...
fields.JP: ラプンツェルやグレーテルはあの調子だし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel and Gretel are exactly as
you see them...

fields.EN:
I don't think ya need to worry
about anything you said, Jack-san!
fields.JP:
自分、ジャックさんたちが気にするようなこと、
なんもないと思うっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think ya need to worry
about anything you said, Jack!

fields.EN:
Same here. You're all no different
than before to me. Doesn't matter
if you're human or not.
fields.JP:
だな……ま、俺にとっちゃ、お前らはお前らだ。
人間だろうとハーフだろうと、変わりゃしねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. You're all no different
than before to me. Doesn't matter
if you're human or not.

fields.EN:
Is that because we're useful to
you as weapons?
fields.JP: ……僕らが兵器として役に立つからですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that because we're useful to
you as weapons?

fields.EN:
Who knows? And, don't go cornering
me into saying otherwise. You're
embarrassing me.
fields.JP:
さあな……ま、弱ってんのを利用して、あんまり
恥ずかしいこと大人に言わせんなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows? And, don't go cornering
me into saying otherwise. You're
embarrassing me.

fields.EN:
But I keep thinking about what's
going to happen to us once we
escape. Since we're not human.
fields.JP:
……でも、時々考えちゃうんです。
僕らが人間じゃないとしたら……ここから抜け
出した後、どうなるんだろうって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I keep thinking about what's
going to happen to us once we
escape. Since we're not human.

fields.EN:
You'll all probably live a normal
life, no different from before.
fields.JP: これまで通り、普通に生きてくんだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'll all probably live a normal
life, no different from before.

fields.EN:
C'mon, Jack-san! You keep worryin'
over nothing! All we gotta do is
work together and try our best!
fields.JP:
もー！　ジャックさんはすぐ悩んじゃうっすね！
みんなで力を合わせてがんばるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, Jack! You keep worryin'
over nothing! All we gotta do is
work together and try our best!

fields.EN:
Uh, Clara? I know you wanna help,
but get back to the store already.
Don't keep the customers waiting.
fields.JP:
あー。くらら。いいこと言ってるつもりだろうが
いい加減店に戻れって。
いっつも客待たせてるだろうが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, Clara? I know you wanna help,
but get back to the store already.
Don't keep the customers waiting.

fields.EN:
Even if we make it out into a world of
humans... will Alice and the others be
able to live without humans bullying them?
fields.JP:
人間だけの世界に出られたとして……
アリスたちは人間に虐められずに済むのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if we escaped, will Alice and
the others be able to live without
worry among the humans?

fields.EN:
No use thinking about it now. Save
it for later after you escape from
here alive.
fields.JP:
……ま、そん時ゃそん時考えろ。
全部、生きて出てからの話だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No use thinking about it now. Save
it for later after you escape from
here alive.

fields.EN: Whoa! Ya caught me off guard!
fields.JP: うわあ！　びっくりした！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa! Ya caught me off guard!

fields.JP: ……！！　お前、いつの間に入ってきた！？

fields.EN:
It's a secret. It's more
interesting that way. Of course,
I'm guessing you already knew.
fields.JP:
内緒よ。その方が面白いでしょう？
……もっとも、あなたたちはわかってるのかも
しれないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a secret. It's more
interesting that way. Of course,
I'm guessing you already knew.

fields.EN:
I dunno what you're talking
about...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I dunno what you're talking
about...

fields.EN:
Being inquisitive is fine, but
keep it civil. There's no telling
what you'll get yourself into.
fields.JP:
ま、知的好奇心はいいが、悪趣味も程々に
しとけよ。火傷じゃ済まねえかもしれんからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Being inquisitive is fine, but
keep it civil. There's no telling
what you'll get yourself into.

fields.EN:
Oh, you're worrying about me? But
I wonder who's going to be shoved
into the oven at the end?
fields.JP:
あら。心配してくれるのね。
でも、最後にかまどにくべられるのは誰かしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're worrying about me? But
I wonder who's going to be shoved
into the oven at the end?

fields.EN: Keep in mind I just warned ya...
fields.LOCALIZED: Keep in mind I just warned ya...

fields.EN:
Well then, who really are you?
Aren't you interested in knowing
that too, Jack?
fields.JP:
……それで、あなたは何者なの？
ジャックも興味があるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, who really are you?
Aren't you interested in knowing
that too, Jack?

fields.EN:
I'm just here to keep y'all in top
order. That's why I need and want
you all to come back alive.
fields.JP:
俺はお前らのメンテ要員だよ。
だから、どんな時でも生きて戻ってもらいたいと
思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just here to keep y'all in top
order. That's why I need and want
you all to come back alive.

fields.EN:
Boss is a bit hard to get used to,
but he's a really talented middle-
aged guy!
fields.JP:
師匠は、ちょっとこじらせてるけど凄腕の
おっさんっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss is a bit hard to get used to,
but he's a really talented middle-
aged guy!

fields.EN:
I see. I suppose that information
should do for now.
fields.JP: そう。今はそれでもいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. I suppose that information
should do for now.

fields.EN: Let me say one more thing.
fields.JP: ついでにもう一つ、忠告してやるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Let me say one more thing.

fields.EN:
Always try to outwit us, even me.
Don't trust anyone or anything.
fields.JP:
精々、裏をかくことだ。俺の裏もな。
……何も信用するな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Always try to outwit us, even me.
Don't trust anyone or anything.

fields.EN:
Don't think there's anything else
to talk about. Hurry up and get
going.
fields.JP: もういいだろ。ほら、行ってこい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't think there's anything else
to talk about. Hurry up and get
going.

fields.EN:
Hm... So this is where I was
found...
fields.JP: ふーん。ここがあたしが拾われた場所かあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... So this is where I was
found...

fields.EN:
I see... Quite an interesting
place, indeed!
fields.JP:
成る程……ここが貴様の……
興味深き場所もあるものぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
