I see... Quite an interesting
place, indeed!

fields.EN:
You're quite lucky to have been
found this deep within the Jail.
fields.JP:
こんな奥深くで発見されるなんて、
本当に運が良かったですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're quite lucky to have been
found this deep within the Jail.

fields.EN:
Mmm... I wonder if my mom's
rolling around inside? You know,
like Rapu's...
fields.JP:
んー。ひょっとしたらこの中に、あたしの
母さんも転がってんのかな？
……ラプみたいにさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I wonder if my mom's
rolling around inside? You know,
like Rappy's...

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san... Just like Haru-san
said, she really does seem to be
forcing herself to act cheerful...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん……ハルさんが言ってた通り、
　無理に元気そうに振舞ってるみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood is trying to act
excited, just like Haru said...)

fields.JP: ラプンツェルのかあさん？

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san... You really
shouldn't say something tasteless
like that.
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん。そういう趣味の悪い話は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood... You really
shouldn't say something tasteless
like that.

fields.JP: ホォォォォォオオオオオオオ！
い、一段と大きな声だったわね！

fields.EN:
That caught me off guard! I don't
think I've heard anything so loud
before.
fields.JP:
びっくりしましたわ……！
こんな大きな声、初めてではありませんこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That caught me off guard! I don't
think I've heard anything so loud
before.

fields.EN:
It seems like the Jail is happy
for some reason...
fields.JP:
……ジェイルは何だか、喜んでるみたいに
感じるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems like the Jail is happy
for some reason...

fields.EN:
I wonder if something good happens
to the Jail when the Tower grows?
fields.JP:
タワーが成長すると、ジェイルにとっても
良いことがあるんでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if something good happens
to the Jail when the Tower grows?

fields.EN:
That's an interesting thought,
linking the Jail's joy to
potential benefits it can gain.
fields.JP:
面白い仮説ね……
ジェイルが歓喜するということは、ジェイルに
とって、利益となっているということ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's an interesting thought,
linking the Jail's joy to
potential benefits it can gain.

fields.EN:
What a strange coincidence that the
Jail's interests align with Dawn's goal.
Just thinking about why thrills me...
fields.JP:
ジェイルの利益と黎明の目的が一致するなんて、
奇妙な偶然の一致もあったものね。
その理由を考察しただけでぞくぞくするわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I find it ironic that benefits to
the Jail match up with the Dawn's.
Interesting, indeed.

fields.EN:
Interesting or not, it does sound
too convenient that they match.
fields.JP:
ぞくぞくはしないけれど、確かに偶然というには
出来すぎている気がするわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting or not, it does sound
too convenient that they match.

fields.EN:
It's almost like there's something
about the Jail that we don't know
about mixed into our escape plan.
fields.JP:
わたしたちが知らされていないジェイルの生態が
あらかじめこの計画に組み込まれているような
気もしてくるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's almost like there's something
about the Jail that we don't know
about mixed into our escape plan.

fields.EN:
But why would anyone hide
information from us?!
fields.JP: 知らされてないって、何のためによ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But why would anyone hide
information from us?!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... I think I'm just
getting too excited for my own
good.
fields.JP:
……ごめん。あたし、張り切りすぎてて
ちょっとテンパってるみたいだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... I think I'm just
getting too excited for my own
good.

fields.JP: さーてと。リラックス、リラックス……

fields.EN:
Losing control of yourself means
death on the battlefield, that is,
if I'm not there.
fields.JP:
戦場では気負いが死を招こうというもの。
まあ、ワレがいれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Losing control of yourself means
death on the battlefield, that is,
if I'm not there.

fields.EN:
It's okay, Akazukin-san. We're
all here, so everything will work
out fine.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、赤ずきんさん。
みんな一緒なんだから……いつものように
絶対うまくいくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay, Red Riding Hood. We're
all here, so everything will work
out fine.

fields.EN:
Yup. You're right... We're all
together.
fields.JP: うん。そうだね……みんな一緒なんだもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. You're right... We're all
together.

fields.EN:
That's right. Be happy that I made
the effort to be here, too.
fields.JP:
そうですよ～。
このわらわだって、わざわざ足を運んでるん
ですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Be happy that I made
the effort to be here, too.

fields.EN:
Not much of an effort with how
you're not even walking...
fields.JP: あんたは歩いてないじゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not much of an effort with how
you're not even walking...

fields.EN:
(Good... It looks like she's a bit
more relaxed now.)
fields.JP: （よかった……少し肩の力が抜けたみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Good... It looks like she's a bit
more relaxed now.)

fields.EN:
If there is something the
Professor didn't tell us, I'm sure
it's for good reason.
fields.JP:
博士たちが言ってないことがあったとしても、
きっと事情があると思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there is something the
Professor didn't tell us, I'm sure
it's for good reason.

fields.EN:
Like, maybe he doesn't want to
present his findings without solid
evidence.
fields.JP:
まだはっきりしてないことは、軽々しく
伝えられないとかさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, maybe he doesn't want to
present his findings without solid
evidence.

fields.JP: ええ。それはありうるわ

fields.EN:
That said, I wonder what's really
going to happen when the Tower
grows to its fullest...
fields.JP:
その上で思うんだけど……タワーが成長すると、
どんなことが起きるんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I wonder what's really
going to happen when the Tower
grows to its fullest...

fields.EN:
Are you saying there's a chance something
the Dawn didn't anticipate could happen?
fields.JP:
それは、黎明にとって想定外の事態が起きる
可能性を言ってるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you saying that based on the
idea that the Dawn wasn't able to
anticipate certain recent events?

fields.EN:
Yeah. If the growth of the Tower
is making the Jail happy...
fields.JP:
うん。本当にタワーが成長することでジェイルが
喜んでるんだとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. If the growth of the Tower
is making the Jail happy...

fields.EN:
Maybe we're doing something that
we really shouldn't be doing...
fields.JP:
ひょっとしたら、僕らはとんでもないことを
引き起こそうとしてるんじゃないかって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we're doing something that
we really shouldn't be doing...

fields.EN:
Plants grow towards the sun...
Same with the Jail...
fields.JP:
……植物は、太陽に向かって伸びるの……
ジェイルも同じ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Plants grow towards the sun...
Same with the Jail...

fields.JP: うんっ！　みんなおっきくなりたいもん！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Looks like Michiru's
habits are rubbing off on you,
huh, Nemu?
fields.JP:
あはは。
ネム、あんたミチルの影響受けすぎてない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Looks like Michiru's
habits are rubbing off on you,
huh, Sleepy?

fields.EN:
It's no use thinking about it now!
I mean, no one really knows what
this weird place is.
fields.JP:
でも……そうよね！
今から考えたって始まらないわよ！
こんなワケのわかんない生き物のことなんかさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use thinking about it now!
I mean, no one really knows what
this weird place is.

fields.EN:
You got that right! Let's just
trust Dad and the Dawn!
fields.JP:
そういうこと！
今はお父さんと黎明のみんなを信じようよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got that right! Let's just
trust Dad and the Dawn!

fields.EN:
Indeed. We need more information,
and this is a prime opportunity to
learn about how the Jail operates.
fields.JP:
そうね。結果が出るまで結論は出ないのだし、
ジェイルの生態を知る、またとないチャンス
なんだもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. We need more information,
and this is a prime opportunity to
learn about how the Jail operates.

fields.EN:
I think maybe you're on a
different track...
fields.JP: それはそれでズレてると思うんですけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think maybe you're on a
different track...

fields.JP: ホォォォォォオオオオオオオ！

fields.EN:
Yikes! Stupid Jail and its stupid
noise...
fields.JP:
ひゃっ！！
全く、本当にでっかい声です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yikes! Stupid Jail and its stupid
noise...

fields.EN:
(Whatever the situation, we need
to stay focused. I better put on
my headphones...)
fields.JP:
（何にしても……気を散らしちゃ駄目だ。
　ヘッドホンをはめておこう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whatever the situation, we need
to stay focused. I better put on
my headphones...)

fields.EN:
All right! Let's keep our guard up
and get moving!
fields.JP: ともかく……気を引き締めて進もう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Let's keep our guard up
and get moving!

fields.EN: A Marchen was holding onto it.
fields.JP: メルヒェンが抱え込んでたのね
fields.LOCALIZED: A Marchen must have dropped it.

fields.JP:
なになに？
今度はどんなことが書いてあったの？

fields.EN: This must be about you, Akazukin-san...
fields.JP: これ……赤ずきんさんのことだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This must be about you, Red Riding
Hood...

fields.EN:
"The first child was found here. The captain
said that, though just a baby, she killed a
Marchen barehanded and smiled at everyone."
fields.JP:
『最初の子はここで発見したという。隊長の話
　によれば、赤子の身でありながら、素手で
　メルヒェンを倒し、皆を見て微笑んだそうだ』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"The first infant was found here.
Our leader said that she killed a
Marchen with her bare hands."

fields.EN:
"There is still much to study
about her biology, but to me she
looks like one adorable baby."
fields.JP:
『彼女の生態について研究の余地は多いが、
　私には一人の可愛い赤ん坊に見える』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Further research needs to be
conducted, but to me she's only
a cute little baby in need."

fields.EN:
From the way it's written, it
sounds like the Professor wrote
this...
fields.JP: 文章からすると……これ書いたの、博士よね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
From the way it's written, it
sounds like the Professor wrote
this...

fields.EN:
It looks like you've been loved
for a long time, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん……昔から愛されていたんですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like you've been loved
for a long time, Red Riding Hood.

fields.JP: 赤姉ったら、照れてるの？

fields.EN:
You said the Professor found you.
Is that what's bothering you?
fields.JP:
あなたを発見したのは博士だと、あなたはさっき
言ってたけど……そのことかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said the Professor found you.
Is that what's bothering you?

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, you mentioned
it before...
fields.JP: ……そういえば、そんな風に言ってましたね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, you mentioned
it before...

fields.EN:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...
fields.JP:
う……うん。あたし、確かにお父さんから
そう聞いたんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...

fields.EN:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.
fields.JP:
『発見した時、メルヒェンを前にしても笑ってた、
　勇敢な赤ん坊だったよ』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.

fields.JP: だ……だから……きっと……あはは……

fields.EN:
It was a long time ago, so I bet
Dad remembered things a bit
differently!
fields.JP:
そうだよ。昔のことだから、お父さんきっと、
勘違いして覚えてたんだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was a long time ago, so I bet
Dad remembered things a bit
differently!

fields.EN:
You're probably right. I bet the
Professor will say he forgot about
it or something.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。後で博士に聞いてみれば、
きっと『うっかりしてた』ってことになるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're probably right. I bet the
Professor will say he forgot about
it or something.

fields.EN:
(Am I really saying that because I
believe it, or...?)
fields.JP: （僕は、本当にそんな風に思ってるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Am I really saying that because I
believe it, or...?)

fields.EN:
Yup. I guess... I mean, Dad is
pretty forgetful...
fields.JP:
うん。そうだよね……お父さん、意外とうっかり
してるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I guess... I mean, Dad is
pretty forgetful...

fields.EN:
Oh? But, aren't memos left behind
by those who've been through the
areas before?
fields.JP:
あら。でもメモは過去に探索した誰かが残した
ものだろうって話じゃなかったかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? But, aren't memos left behind
by those who've been through the
areas before?

fields.EN:
You're right. If that's the case,
why didn't the Professor mention
that he wrote memos?
fields.JP:
言われてみれば、そうよね。
博士ったら、自分が書いたって、どうして
言わなかったのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. If that's the case,
why didn't the Professor mention
that he wrote memos?

fields.EN:
And even if he is scatterbrained, you'd
think he'd at least remember whether
or not he was the one who found you~
fields.JP:
それに、いくらボケボケだからといっても、
自分が見つけたのかどうかくらい、
覚えてるような気がしますよね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if he's scatterbrained, I'm
quite sure he would remember that
he's written memos before.

fields.EN:
Coming from you, it's not very
convincing...
fields.JP: あんたが言っても説得力ないけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Coming from you, it's not very
convincing...

fields.EN:
I refuse to be told that by a dolt
like you, Oyayubi.
fields.JP: 単純バカな親指には言われたくないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I refuse to be told that by a dolt
like you, Thumby.

fields.EN:
P-Please! This isn't the time or
the place to argue!
fields.JP:
も……もうっ！
こんなところでじゃれ合いはやめてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please! This isn't the time or
the place to argue!

fields.EN:
Dad wouldn't... *huff* *huff* lie
to me... *huff* Why...?
fields.JP:
嘘なんか……はあ……はあ……
……お父さん……はあ……何で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad wouldn't... *huff* *huff* lie
to me... *huff* Why...?

fields.EN:
She's hyperventilating. We need to
find a bag for her... If not...
Nemurihime, hold her head.
fields.JP:
過呼吸の発作よ。誰か、袋のようなものを持って
たら、口に当てて。無ければ……
眠り姫、彼女の頭を抱きかかえてあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's hyperventilating. We need to
find a bag for her... If not...
Sleeping Beauty, hold her head.

fields.EN:
Akazukin. Take it slow. Breathe deeply,
as if you're breathing in the air you exhaled.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん。ゆっくりでいいわ。
自分の吐いた息を吸うように、深く呼吸するの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood. Take a deep
breath and breathe out slowly.

fields.EN: It looks like she's calmed down.
fields.LOCALIZED: It looks like she's calmed down.

fields.EN:
But... you look like you're in so
much pain... What's wrong, Aka-neesama?
fields.JP:
でも……すごく辛そうです……
赤姉様、どうしちゃったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she looks like she's in pain.
What happened to Sister Red?

fields.EN:
Hyperventilation can occur from
panic or stress. You can control
it with your breathing pattern.
fields.JP:
過呼吸の発作……強い精神的な負荷がかかって
処理しきれなくなった時に起きるものよ。
こうして呼吸を整えることで治まるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hyperventilation can occur from
panic or stress. You can control
it with your breathing pattern.

fields.EN:
I guess you do come in handy
sometimes.
fields.JP: あなた……時には役にたつのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you do come in handy
sometimes.

fields.EN:
I read it before in a medical
journal, but it's the first time
I've actually seen it occur.
fields.JP:
家にいた頃、暇つぶしに読んでた医学書が
たまたま役に立っただけよ。
実例は初めて目にしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I read it before in a medical
journal, but it's the first time
I've actually seen it occur.

fields.JP: あの～。いったん戻りませんか～？

fields.EN:
Not that I want to slack off...
It's just a reasonable suggestion
based on what's happening.
fields.JP:
サボりたいわけじゃないです～。
合理的な提案をしただけです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that I want to slack off...
It's just a reasonable suggestion
based on what's happening.

fields.EN:
True... It may be best to
have Akazukin-san rest for awhile...
fields.JP:
……確かに、赤ずきんさんは少し休ませたほうが
いいと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... It may be best to have Red
Riding Hood rest for awhile...

fields.EN:
Yes. And we can't have her rest
here. It's too dangerous.
fields.JP:
そうね。休ませるにしても、このままここに
留まるのは危険が大きいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. And we can't have her rest
here. It's too dangerous.

fields.JP:
……みんな……はあ……
あたし……大丈夫……だから……

fields.EN:
Stop it, Aka-nee. You need to
rely on us too, you know?
fields.JP:
何言ってんのよ、赤姉。
少しは私たちにも頼んなさいっつーの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it, Sister Red. You need to
rely on us too, you know?

fields.EN:
If she can stand, then she should
be able to walk slowly with a bit
of support.
fields.JP:
立てるようなら、支えられてゆっくり歩けば
移動できるはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she can stand, then she should
be able to walk slowly with a bit
of support.

fields.EN: All right then... Let's head back.
fields.LOCALIZED: All right then... Let's head back.

fields.JP: あなたたち……どうしたの！？

fields.EN:
Akazukin?! ...First,
have her lie down... gently...
fields.JP:
赤ずきん！？
……とにかく横になって……そっと……

fields.EN:
I see. Well, it's a good thing
Gretel knew now to handle the
situation.
fields.JP:
……そう。グレーテルが応急措置の方法を知って
いてよかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Well, it's a good thing
Gretel knew now to handle the
situation.

fields.EN:
If we'd handled it wrong, there's a chance
it could have become serious, or the
symptoms could have become persistent.
fields.JP:
措置を間違えれば、大変なことになった可能性も
ゼロではないし、症状として定着してしまう
場合だってあるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
One wrong move and it could
have left severe side effects, or
worse.

fields.EN:
I guess we still experience the
same symptoms as humans,
even if we are monsters...
fields.JP: ……化け物でも、人間と同じ病にはかかるんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we still experience the
same symptoms as humans,
even if we are monsters...

fields.EN:
Don't be stupid. You're not
monsters. You're humans, just
like we are.
fields.JP:
馬鹿なこと言わないで。
あなたたちは化け物じゃないわ。私たちと同じ
……人間よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be stupid. You're not
monsters. You're humans, just
like we are.

fields.EN:
Even though you've thoroughly
examined and researched our bodies...
fields.JP:
わらわたちの体を、そなたは散々調べて研究
しているのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Coming from someone who's
diagnosed us on a daily basis...

fields.EN:
Why, yes. I diagnose and conduct
research on you. It's my duty as a
doctor and for everyone here.
fields.JP:
ええ。検査もするし、研究もするわ。
優先順位はあれど、解放地区全ての人たちのね。
医師として当然の務めだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. I diagnose and conduct
research on you. It's my duty as a
doctor and for everyone here.

fields.EN:
I don't know what you've misunderstood, but
every person has a different constitution
and different strengths and weaknesses.
fields.JP:
それに、何を勘違いしているのか知らないけど、
人にはそれぞれ体質も得手不得手もある
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you may be misunderstood.
Each person is different and
possesses various traits.

fields.EN:
Just like Kadowaki-kun's honesty and
strength, or Oohime-san's ability to
become a source of solace.
fields.JP:
体力と正直さを持つ門脇くんが門番に適任な
ように、大陽女さんの人柄がある種の人の心の
癒しになっているように、そして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just like Kadowaki's honesty and
strength, or Oohime's ability to
become a source of solace.

fields.EN:
(So, that's what Miko-san thinks about
Michiru-san's role...)
fields.JP:
（視子さん……ミチルさんのことも、そんな風に
　認めてたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So, that's what Miko thinks about
Michiru's role...)

fields.EN:
Someone like me only got into medicine
because I admired Sensei, and now
I'm merely imitating a doctor.
fields.JP:
たまたま先生に憧れ、医療現場に触れてきた
私などが、医療の真似事をしているようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for me, I'm acting as a doctor
out of admiration for my mentor in
the medical field.

fields.EN:
To be honest, I can't quite fathom
why it's important to be a human.
fields.JP:
正直、人間であることが何故それ程重要なのか、
私には理解できないのだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, I can't quite fathom
why it's important to be a human.

fields.EN:
Miko means that, in terms of what we are, she
recognizes us as the same kind as herself...
just as I defined myself as a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
視子が言いたいのは、私たちを在り方として同種
と認めているということなのね。
……私が自らをナイトメアと規定していたように
fields.LOCALIZED:
What Miko means is that we each
identify ourselves based on our
perceived existences with others.

fields.EN:
In any case, I think you made the
right call coming back here, even
if it meant the extra effort.
fields.JP:
……ともかく、ここまで運んで来るのも大変
だったと思うけど、引き上げたのは良い判断
だったと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I think you made the
right call coming back here, even
if it meant the extra effort.

fields.EN:
There probably isn't anywhere in
the Cell Area where you can rest safely.
fields.JP:
独房エリアでは、どこも安心して休むことは
できないだろうしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, there are no real places
in the Jail that we can call safe.

fields.EN:
Maybe we should call the Professor
here, Miko.
fields.JP: 視子、博士を呼んできたほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we should call the Professor
here, Miko.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Akazukin. The
Professor is out right now.
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい、赤ずきん。
博士はいま、留守にしてるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Red Riding Hood. The
Professor is out right now.

fields.EN:
(We're on an important mission,
and the Professor is away...?)
fields.JP:
（……こんな大事な作戦中だっていうのに……
　博士はどうしてここにいないんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're on an important mission,
and the Professor is away...?)

fields.EN: I guess it can't be helped...
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess it can't be helped...

fields.EN:
...Rest for now. Don't go back to the
Cell Area until you've recovered enough.
It should have drained your strength too.
fields.JP:
……ともかく今は安静にして、独房エリアに
出るのは、十分に回復してからにするのよ。
体力も奪われてる筈だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, let her rest. You can
go back to that area after you've
fully recovered.

fields.EN:
Looks like I've just burdened
everyone...
fields.JP: ……みんな、迷惑かけちゃったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like I've just burdened
everyone...

fields.EN:
Don't let it bother you. You're
just trying to do too much, Sister
Aka-nee.
fields.JP:
そんなの気にすることないのよ。
赤姉はしっかりしようとしすぎよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't let it bother you. You're
just trying to do too much, Sister
Red.

fields.EN: Are you fine getting up already?
fields.JP: もう起き上がって大丈夫なんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you fine getting up already?

fields.EN:
Yup... I feel a lot better now
that I was able to get some sleep
in.
fields.JP:
うん。
ちょっと眠ったら、だいぶすっきりしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... I feel a lot better now
that I was able to get some sleep
in.

fields.EN: You look a lot better now, too!
fields.JP: 顔色も戻ったようだしな！
fields.LOCALIZED: You look a lot better now, too!

fields.EN:
But... what happened to me? Something
like that made it so hard to breathe...
fields.JP:
でも、あたし……どうしちゃったんだろ。
あんなことぐらいで、すっごく息が苦しく
なってさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What really happened to me? I
never thought I'd be sick over
something like that...

fields.EN:
Your hyperventilating was probably
triggered by stress beyond your
mental threshold.
fields.JP:
精神的な負荷が閾値を超えると、時として起きる
発作のようなものだそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your hyperventilating was probably
triggered by stress beyond your
mental threshold.

fields.EN:
She's just saying that you were
holding onto too much pain
inside.
fields.JP:
あなたが、辛い気持ちを溜め込みすぎていた……
ということよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's just saying that you were
holding onto too much pain
inside.

fields.JP: あたしが？　そんなのあるかなあ？

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised. We've been through a lot.
Akazukin-san, maybe you were pushing
yourself without realizing it...
fields.JP:
いろいろあったしさ、無理はないよ。
赤ずきんさんも、気付かないうちに無理してたん
じゃないかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised. We've been
through a lot. I'm sure you became
overwhelmed without knowing it.

fields.EN:
Why, yes. We also did learn about
where we Blood Maidens came from.
fields.JP:
そうですわ。
血式少女の生まれのこともありましたし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. We also did learn about
where we Blood Maidens came from.

fields.EN:
And when you think about it, the
memo, the history of the Dawn, all
of it came from the Professor.
fields.JP:
はい。今回のメモのことだって、考えてみたら
これまで聞いてきた黎明の歴史は、全部博士から
伝わったものなんですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And when you think about it, the
memo, the history of the Dawn, all
of it came from the Professor.

fields.EN:
What?! Are you saying that Dad
purposely lied to everyone?!
fields.JP:
じゃあ何！？　それじゃ、お父さんがわざと
みんなに嘘を教えてるってわけ？！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Are you saying that Dad
purposely lied to everyone?!

fields.EN:
That's not what I wanted to imply!
I just thought the Professor may
have remembered things wrong.
fields.JP:
そ、そうじゃなくて……！
博士にだって、記憶違いくらいあるんじゃ
ないかって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not what I wanted to imply!
I just thought the Professor may
have remembered things wrong.

fields.EN:
H-He's really busy, so I wouldn't
be surprised if he forgot bits of
information, too...
fields.JP:
い……忙しくて言い忘れることだって
あるかもしれませんし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-He's really busy, so I wouldn't
be surprised if he forgot bits of
information, too...

fields.EN:
Ah... I see. You're right. I guess
that's it...
fields.JP:
あ……そっか。そうだよね。
……そういうことなのかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... I see. You're right. I guess
that's it...

fields.EN: I'm sorry for yelling at you, Shirayuki...
fields.JP: 大声出しちゃってごめん、白雪
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for yelling at you, Snow
White...

fields.EN:
No. You just love the Professor,
Aka-neesama. Shirayuki understands...
fields.JP:
いいえ。赤姉様は博士が大好きなだけ
ですし、白雪、わかってますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. Snow White knows very
well how much you like the
Professor...

fields.EN:
Um, Akazukin-san? What do you
mean by "that's it?"
fields.JP: その、赤ずきんさん……『そういうこと』って？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Red Riding Hood? What do you
mean by "that's it?"

fields.EN:
Well, I think I got all flustered
knowing that Dad didn't really
tell me everything.
fields.JP:
あーいや。あたしさ、実はお父さんがちゃんと
話してくれてなかったの、思ったよりこたえてた
みたいなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I think I got all flustered
knowing that Dad didn't really
tell me everything.

fields.EN:
I guess I was holding in all of my
feelings like you said, Alice.
fields.JP: アリスの言う通り、溜め込んじゃってたのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I was holding in all of my
feelings like you said, Alice.

fields.EN:
I'm quite envious that you have
someone you can be so attached
to.
fields.JP:
羨ましいわね、そんな風に強くこだわれるような
対象があるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite envious that you have
someone you can be so attached
to.

fields.EN:
Why not find someone like that
now?
fields.JP: これから作ればいいんですよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not find someone like that
now?

fields.EN:
I was able to overcome my problems
because I found friends to whom I
could entrust my life.
fields.JP:
わらわはあの時、みなさんの……命を預けられる
仲間の存在があったから、乗り越えられたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was able to overcome my problems
because I found friends to whom I
could entrust my life.

fields.EN:
Of course, I had never experienced
having friends before, so I wasn't
sure how to handle myself then.
fields.JP:
……そんなの、わらわには初めての存在なので、
正直扱いに困ります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, I had never experienced
having friends before, so I wasn't
sure how to handle myself then.

fields.EN:
I can't believe you're actually
saying that.
fields.JP: あんたがそんな風に言うなんてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you're actually
saying that.

fields.EN:
Friends you can entrust your life
to...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends you can entrust your life
to...

fields.JP: ……ラプンツェル、みんなとなかまだよ！

fields.EN:
Let's continue our mission. Time
to get back out to the Station
Grounds!
fields.JP:
……みんな、作戦を続行しよう。
『元駅構内エリア』に向かうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's continue our mission. Time
to get back out to the Station
Grounds!

fields.EN:
Our objective... Destroy the last
core!
fields.JP: 目的は……最後の核の破壊だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our objective... Destroy the last
core!

fields.EN:
So that's what a core looks
like...
fields.JP: これが……核というモノか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that's what a core looks
like...

fields.EN:
We can finally make our escape
after we destroy it. Is everyone
ready?
fields.JP:
これを破壊すれば、あたしたちはやっと念願の
脱出作戦に移れるんだ。
みんな……準備はいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can finally make our escape
after we destroy it. Is everyone
ready?

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san... she's back to being
the usual Akazukin-san...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん……いつもの赤ずきんさんに
　戻った……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like Red Riding Hood is
back to her normal self...)

fields.JP: 僕は、いつでも大丈夫だよ！

fields.EN:
I don't want to waste my whole
day, so let's get this over with.
fields.JP: 面倒臭いので、とっとと終わらせましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to waste my whole
day, so let's get this over with.

fields.JP: いつでもいいわよ、赤姉！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ready when you are, Sister Red!

fields.EN:
I'm surprised at how elated I feel
right now...
fields.JP: 不思議な高揚感もあったものね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised at how elated I feel
right now...

fields.EN:
Right on time... We're gonna crush
that core and the Nightmare, and
buy our ticket out of here.
fields.JP:
……おいでなすったね。
こいつも核もナイトメアも、全部ぶっ潰して
あたしらはここを脱出するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right on time... We're gonna crush
that core and the Nightmare, and
buy our ticket out of here.

fields.EN:
Everyone! Let's hit them before
they make their move!
fields.JP: みんな……先手必勝で行くよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! Let's hit them before
they make their move!

fields.JP: ワレに任せておくが良い！
……みなさん、核を破壊しましょう！

fields.EN:
This should make the tower grow to
where we want it to...
fields.JP: ……これで、塔は目標の高さまで伸びたのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
This should make the tower grow to
where we want it to...

fields.EN:
I can't believe we finally did
it...
fields.JP: こんな日が、本当に来るなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe we finally did
it...

fields.EN:
(Back when I came with Alice to
the Dawn, the plan they shared
with us sounded impossible...)
fields.JP:
（確かに、アリスと黎明に来たばかりの時は、
　途方もないような計画だって思ってたっけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Back when I came with Alice to
the Dawn, the plan they shared
with us sounded impossible...)

fields.EN:
(And... I never imagined
I'd make companions like this...)
fields.JP:
（それに……こんな風に仲間ができるなんて、
　思ってもいなかったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We didn't even expect to have
so many others here with us now,
either...)

fields.EN: Jack? What are you smiling about?
fields.JP: ジャック。あんた何にやにやしてんのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? What are you smiling about?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... It's just proof that
everyone likes you.
fields.JP: あはは……みんなに好かれてる証拠だって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... It's just proof that
everyone likes you.

fields.EN:
All we need to do is clean this
place up, then head back to
headquarters.
fields.JP:
この最後の独房エリアも、後始末をして帰還する
だけになったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we need to do is clean this
place up, then head back to
headquarters.

fields.EN:
We made it this far because everyone joined
forces. I'm truly glad all of you are here.
fields.JP:
ここまで来れたのも、みんなが力を合わせた
からだね。……みんながいてくれてよかったって
心から思ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were only able to do this
because everyone worked together
as a team. I'm really glad.

fields.EN:
That said, I still want to believe
in Dad...
fields.JP:
でも……あたしはお父さんのことも信じたいって
……そう思ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I still want to believe
in Dad...

fields.JP: ……あなたはそれでいいと、私は思うわ

fields.EN:
There are some answers that
only come from believing.
fields.JP:
信じることからしか生まれない解答もあるんだと
……そう、思うもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are some answers that
only come from believing.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's finish the
cleanup!
fields.JP: それじゃ……後始末とやらに行きましょうか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's finish the
cleanup!

fields.EN:
Yup! Our opponent is probably the
last Nightmare there is. Let's get
going!
fields.JP:
ああ！　相手はおそらく最後のナイトメアだ。
みんな……気を引き締めていくよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Our opponent is probably the
last Nightmare there is. Let's get
going!

fields.JP: ぐるるる……えもののけはい……！

fields.EN:
So, that's the last Nightmare!
Hmph! Nothing to it!
fields.JP:
……これが最後のナイトメアってわけね！
ふん。どうってことないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that's the last Nightmare!
Hmph! Nothing to it!

fields.EN:
How unfortunate that this is the
last battle we'll engage in...
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unfortunate that this is the
last battle we'll engage in...

fields.EN:
I hope it doesn't talk like the
others!
fields.JP: どうか喋らないでくださいましね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope it doesn't talk like the
others!

fields.EN:
We'll just have to kill it before
it can speak.
fields.JP: 喋る前にやっつければいいんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll just have to kill it before
it can speak.

fields.JP: ガルルルルゥウウウウウ！！
白雪たち、負けませんから……！

fields.EN:
Now then, time for me to enjoy
this moment!
fields.JP: せめて……楽しませてもらおうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, time for me to enjoy
this moment!

fields.EN: That was easier than I thought...
fields.LOCALIZED: That was easier than I thought...

fields.EN:
So, transformations differ
depending on the Nightmare...
fields.JP: ……ナイトメアによって、形態変化は異なるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, transformations differ
depending on the Nightmare...

fields.EN:
I wonder which of its forms is its
true form...
fields.JP:
通常の姿と今の姿……どちらが本来の姿
なのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder which of its forms is its
true form...

fields.EN:
Hey, save the observations for
later.
fields.JP: ちょっと……研究は後にしなさいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, save the observations for
later.

fields.JP: ギャオオオオォォォォオオオ！！

fields.EN:
Let's keep layering our attacks
on it!
fields.JP: このまま一気に畳みかけますわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's keep layering our attacks
on it!

fields.JP: そうだね……みんな、いくよ！
ギャオオォォォォオオン……！！
みんな……とどめといこう！

fields.EN:
What happens when the Jail Tower
grows? You know, don't you?
fields.JP:
ジェイルが成長したら、どうなるのかしら？
あなたは知ってるのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What happens when the Jail Tower
grows? You know, don't you?

fields.EN:
If you don't want to say it, fine.
I guess we'll have to kill all the
Marchens here, then.
fields.JP:
言わないつもりなら、それでもいいわ。
そしたら、ここのメルヒェンたちを皆殺しに
するけれどね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't want to say it, fine.
I guess we'll have to kill all the
Marchens here, then.

fields.EN:
I know you have intelligence and
can speak our language.
fields.JP:
あなたが知能を持ち、言葉を話せることは
知っているのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you have intelligence and
can speak our language.

fields.JP: ギャォォオオァァァアア……！！

fields.EN:
(We're going to die...? After all
we've been through?!)
fields.JP:
（僕たち、ここで全滅するのか！？
　ここまで……来たのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're going to die...? After all
we've been through?!)

fields.EN:
(But... Why... Why am I not scared
of it...?)
fields.JP:
（でも……なんだろう……不思議と怖さは
　感じない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But... Why... Why am I not scared
of it...?)

fields.JP: このままじゃ、囲まれるわ！

fields.EN:
Even in numbers, grunts are no
match to me!
fields.JP: かような雑魚ども、蹴散らしてくれるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even in numbers, grunts are no
match to me!

fields.EN: Let's just get rid of them, now!
fields.JP: とにかく、こいつらをやるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's just get rid of them, now!

fields.EN:
Looks like that was the last of
them...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like that was the last of
them...

fields.JP: こんなの、らくしょうだよ！
さっきの……スナーク、だよね？

fields.EN:
Yes... If we believe in what that
Nightmare said.
fields.JP: ええ。ナイトメアの言葉からすれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... If we believe in what that
Nightmare said.

fields.EN:
It's probably true. After all,
I've never seen a creature like
that before.
fields.JP:
間違いないでしょうね。
あんな生物は初めて見たもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's probably true. After all,
I've never seen a creature like
that before.

fields.EN:
How can I word it...? It was
eerie, and... it gave me
goosebumps.
fields.JP:
どう言ったらいいんですかしら。
すごく不気味で……鳥肌が立ちましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How can I word it...? It was
eerie, and... it gave me
goosebumps.

fields.EN:
(But for some reason, I
didn't feel afraid of it...)
fields.JP: （でも僕は、なぜか怖さを感じなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Strange... I didn't sense
anything like that from it...)

fields.JP: あれ……おいしくなさそう……

fields.EN: You're not supposed to eat it!
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not supposed to eat it!

fields.EN: I wonder why it let us go...
fields.JP: でも、何であたしらを見逃したんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder why it let us go...

fields.JP: ワレに恐れをなしちゃ……

fields.EN:
I'm curious as to why it killed
the Nightmare...
fields.JP:
配下のはずのナイトメアを
殺したことも気になります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm curious as to why it killed
the Nightmare...

fields.EN: Maybe to stop it from speaking.
fields.JP: 口止め……じゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe to stop it from speaking.

fields.EN:
It did happen when Gretel started
asking the Nightmare questions.
fields.JP:
確かに、グレーテルがナイトメアを尋問し始めた
とたんの出来事だったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It did happen when Gretel started
asking the Nightmare questions.

fields.EN:
So, the Nightmare was about to
say something that Snark didn't
want it to.
fields.JP:
つまり……あのナイトメアはスナークにとって
都合の悪いことを言いかけたということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, the Nightmare was about to
say something that Snark didn't
want it to.

fields.EN:
If it doesn't want us to
know, couldn't it just kill
Rapunzel and the others?
fields.JP:
しられたくないなら、ラプンツェルたちころせば
すむよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If not want us to know, it kill
us, too.

fields.EN:
You're a lot smarter than you
look...
fields.JP: あんた……意外と賢いじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a lot smarter than you
look...

fields.JP:
だってあいつ、ぜんぜんこわくないもん。
きっと、よわいよ

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)
fields.JP: （ラプンツェルも怖くなかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)

fields.EN:
No way! That's the one that massacred
everyone from Dawn fifteen years ago!
fields.JP:
そんなはずないじゃん！
十五年前、黎明の人たちが皆殺しに遭った
相手だよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No way! That thing killed the
members of the Dawn 15 years ago!

fields.EN:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.
fields.JP: でも、卑怯な相手なのは間違いないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.

fields.EN:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.
fields.JP:
そうですわ。
死にそうなナイトメアをいきなり後ろから
刺すなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.

fields.EN:
In any case, I lost my opportunity
to question it on the growth of
the Jail.
fields.JP:
いずれにせよ、尋問は中断され
ジェイルの成長に関する情報は得られなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I lost my opportunity
to question it on the growth of
the Jail.

fields.EN:
So that means that the growth of
the Jail is something it didn't
want us to know about?
fields.JP:
……ってことは……ジェイルが成長すると
何が起きるかって、そんなにあたしらに
知られたくないってこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that means that the growth of
the Jail is something it didn't
want us to know about?

fields.EN:
I sure hope what Jack said before
isn't going to happen. You know,
that something bad may happen.
fields.JP:
あんまり考えたくないけど、ジャックの言ってた
とんでもないことが起きる可能性があるって
ことかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sure hope what Jack said before
isn't going to happen. You know,
that something bad may happen.

fields.EN:
But, what is going to happen,
exactly?
fields.JP: 何が……起きるっていうんでしょう～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, what is going to happen,
exactly?

fields.EN:
And like Gretel said, if what the
Jail wants matches with what the
Dawn wants...
fields.JP:
そしてグレーテルが言ってた通り、
それが黎明の目的と一致してるとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And like Gretel said, if what the
Jail wants matches with what the
Dawn wants...

fields.EN:
(With how we are now, there's no
way I can bring up what Gretel
said before...)
fields.JP:
（以前グレーテルが言ったこと……
　そんなことを今言ったら、せっかくみんな
　元気になったのに、また……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With how we are now, there's no
way I can bring up what Gretel
said before...)

fields.EN:
That means... we have a traitor
among us...
fields.JP: それは……裏切り者がいるということです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means... we have a traitor
among us...

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you noticed that,
Shirayukihime.
fields.JP: まさか、あなたが気づいてたなんてね、白雪姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you noticed that,
Snow White.

fields.EN:
Something had felt off for a while.
But maybe part of me
didn't want to believe it.
fields.JP:
以前から違和感は感じてました。
でも、どこかで信じたくなかったのかも
しれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something didn't feel right
before. But deep down, Snow White
didn't want to believe it.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki didn't want anyone to
get hurt because she'd noticed it...
fields.JP:
きっと、白雪が気が付いてしまったことで、
誰かに傷ついてほしくなかったんです。
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White didn't want to hurt
anyone with her thoughts...

fields.EN:
But, if something terrible does
happen... If everyone died because
Shirayuki didn't say anything...
fields.JP:
もし、本当に大変なことが起きてしまうなら……
白雪が言えなかったせいで、みんなが死んじゃう
ようなことが起きるなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, if something terrible does
happen... If everyone died because
Snow White didn't say anything...

fields.EN: Shirayuki would hate that even more.
fields.JP: その方が、白雪は嫌です

fields.EN:
It's easy to assume that someone
has been working in tandem with
the Jail. It would all make sense.
fields.JP:
人間の社会の誰かがジェイルと通じていると
考えれば、全てはつじつまが合うこと……
とても簡単に推測できることよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's easy to assume that someone
has been working in tandem with
the Jail. It would all make sense.

fields.EN:
We didn't arrive at that thought because we
were unconsciously avoiding it... because
we wanted to remain connected to humans.
fields.JP:
そこに思い至らなかったのは、やはり……
無意識に避けていたから……人間たちと
繋がっていたいからなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I think we all wanted to avoid
that thought so we could stay on
the humans' side.

fields.EN:
O-Of course... the Dawn is... like
family to us...
fields.JP: あ……当たり前だよ。黎明は……家族だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course... the Dawn is... like
family to us...

fields.EN:
Oh? Neither Shirayukihime nor I...
nor Jack ever said the traitor
was someone from Dawn, did we?
fields.JP:
あら。私も白雪姫も……そしてジャックも、
その裏切り者が黎明の誰かだとは一言も言って
ないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Are you confirming that the
traitor could be from the Dawn?

fields.EN:
W-Well then, who do you think it
could be?
fields.JP:
じゃ、じゃあ……誰だと思うの？
その裏切り者って奴は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well then, who do you think it
could be?

fields.EN: Is that all you have to report?
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that all you have to report?

fields.EN:
Thank you for taking care
of Akazukin. You made the right
call.
fields.JP:
……赤ずきんの処置を適切に行ってくれて、
本当にありがとう。君たちの判断も適切だったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for taking care of Red
Riding Hood. You made the right
call.

fields.EN:
Where were you when I was here,
Dad?
fields.JP: お父さんは、どこへ行ってたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where were you when I was here,
Dad?

fields.EN:
Ah, I was monitoring the Tower's
growth. I'm so sorry I couldn't be
beside you when you needed me...
fields.JP:
ああ。塔の伸長について、計測していたのだよ。
突発的な事態だったとはいえ……
辛い時に傍にいてやれなくて済まなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I was monitoring the Tower's
growth. I'm so sorry I couldn't be
beside you when you needed me...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I know you were doing
something important.
fields.JP: ううん。お父さんは大事な仕事をしてたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I know you were doing
something important.

fields.EN:
Everyone else was with me, so all
was well!
fields.JP: それに……みんながついててくれたしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone else was with me, so all
was well!

fields.EN: I see... I'm glad to hear that.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... I'm glad to hear that.

fields.EN:
(I couldn't tell them who I
suspected... To be honest,
everyone could be a suspect...)
fields.JP:
（……結局、誰を疑ってるかは言えなかった。
　正直なところ、みんな怪しく思えるし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I couldn't tell them who I
suspected... To be honest,
everyone could be a suspect...)

fields.EN:
(And, if that place was being
monitored, it would've been best
to not have discussed it there...)
fields.JP:
（それに……あの場所も『監視』されているなら
　……まだ、誰にも言わない方がいい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And, if that place was being
monitored, it would've been best
to not have discussed it there...)

fields.EN:
Now then, about the Tower's
growth...
fields.JP: さて、塔の伸長を計測していたと言ったが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, about the Tower's
growth...

fields.EN:
With the destruction of the last
core, the Tower has reached our
goal height. Very well done.
fields.JP:
君たちが最後の核を破壊してくれたおかげで、
塔は見事に目標の高さまで成長したよ。
……本当によくやってくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
With the destruction of the last
core, the Tower has reached our
goal height. Very well done.

fields.EN:
You also mentioned that you met
Snark, and I'm glad you all made
it back alive...
fields.JP:
また、スナークと遭遇したと聞いたが、
それにも関わらず、無事に生還できたことも
本当によかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also mentioned that you met
Snark, and I'm glad you all made
it back alive...

fields.EN: It was easy! It was weak!
fields.JP:
らくしょうだったよ！
たぶん、あいつよわいし
fields.LOCALIZED: It was easy! It was weak!

fields.EN:
Hey, rugrat! Don't try to eat
everything, or else one day you're
gonna get eaten!
fields.JP:
おい、野生児。
何でも食おうとして食われんなよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, rugrat! Don't try to eat
everything, or else one day you're
gonna get eaten!

fields.JP:
『あたぼう』だなんて言葉……
一体どこで覚えてきたのかしら……

fields.EN:
That word doesn't fit her
character very well...
fields.JP: 確かにお嬢には似合わぬな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That word doesn't fit her
character very well...

fields.EN:
Speaking of learning, do you mind
answering something for us?
fields.JP: ところで博士。ひとつ教えてもらえないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of learning, do you mind
answering something for us?

fields.EN:
We found a memo in the area.
Why did you hide the fact that
you wrote memos, too?
fields.JP:
独房エリアで見つけたメモなのだけど……
何故あなたが書いたことを隠していたのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found a memo in the area.
Why did you hide the fact that
you wrote memos, too?

fields.EN:
(That's right... The memo we
found previously was, without a
doubt, written by the Professor.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……この間見つけたメモの内容は、
　明らかに博士が書いたものだった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... The memo we
found previously was, without a
doubt, written by the Professor.)

fields.EN:
"The first child was found here. Our leader
said that, though just an infant, she killed
a Marchen barehanded and smiled at everyone."
fields.JP:
『最初の子はここで発見したという。隊長の話
によれば、赤子の身でありながら、素手で
メルヒェンを倒し、皆を見て微笑んだそうだ』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"The first infant was found here.
Our leader said that she killed a
Marchen with her bare hands."

fields.EN:
"Further research needs to be
conducted, but to me she's only
a cute little baby in need."
fields.JP:
『彼女の生態について研究の余地は多いが、
私には一人の可愛い赤ん坊に見える』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Further research needs to be
conducted, but to me she's only
a cute little baby in need."

fields.EN:
It's quite obvious you wrote this,
didn't you, Professor?
fields.JP: 文章からすると……これ書いたの、博士よね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's quite obvious you wrote this,
didn't you, Professor?

fields.EN:
W-Well, it's not that I was hiding
it, but...
fields.JP: い……いや、隠していたわけではないのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, it's not that I was hiding
it, but...

fields.EN:
Is that so? Were you aware of how
saddened Akazukin was upon
finding out you hid it from her?
fields.JP:
あら、そうだったの？
赤ずきんったら、あなたに隠し事をされたって
それは落ち込んでいたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that so? Were you aware of how
saddened Red Riding Hood was upon
finding out you hid it from her?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Akazukin. To tell the truth...
I'd almost forgotten about that memo...
fields.JP:
それは済まなかったね、赤ずきん。
実のところ……あのメモのことはほとんど
忘れかけていてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry, Red Riding Hood. To
be honest, I completely forgot
about the memos I wrote.

fields.EN:
It was something I scribbled down ages
ago, and the interior structure is always
changing. It was only a personal note.
fields.JP:
なにぶん大昔に書き捨てたようなものでは
あったし、内部の構造も常に変化するしね。
ほんの覚え書きのようなものだったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wrote and discarded them as I
learned new things. They really
were memos, no more, no less.

fields.EN:
I have this habit of writing down
what comes to mind, and it led to
me often being scolded by Mother.
fields.JP:
私は思いついたことをメモして放っておく癖が
あってね、昔からお母さんによく叱られていた
ものだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have this habit of writing down
what comes to mind, and it led to
me often being scolded by Mother.

fields.EN:
She was a member of the Dawn who
died in the incident 15 years ago.
fields.JP: ……十五年前に命を落とした、黎明のメンバーよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was a member of the Dawn who
died in the incident 15 years ago.

fields.EN:
The women who were in charge of
supplies and keeping rules were
called "Mothers."
fields.JP:
食料の確保や分配をおこなったり、身近な
ルールを整えていた女性がそう呼ばれていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The women who were in charge of
supplies and keeping rules were
called "Mothers."

fields.EN:
I was surprised those notes had helped
you in an unexpected way, but by
then it was hard to bring it up...
fields.JP:
それが思わぬ形で君たちの役に立っていたことも
驚きだったが、今更言い出せなくてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was surprised to know those
memos helped your missions, but
I figured it wasn't relevant...

fields.EN:
Dad... You really have to tell us
stuff like that sooner, you know?
fields.JP:
お父さーん。そういうことはちゃんと言っといて
よねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad... You really have to tell us
stuff like that sooner, you know?

fields.EN:
Can you explain why the memo's
contents didn't match what Akazukin was told?
fields.JP:
……じゃあ、メモの内容が赤ずきんの記憶と
違ったことは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you explain why the memo's
contents didn't match what Red
Riding Hood was told?

fields.JP: いや、よくないよ。赤ずきん
fields.LOCALIZED: No, it's okay, Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
I first met you in the infirmary... "Sensei"
and "Mother" were doing their utmost to care
for you after the captain brought you back.
fields.JP:
君と出会ったのは、医務室だったのだがね……
隊長が連れ帰った君を『先生』と『お母さん』が
一生懸命面倒を見ていてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I met you in the infirmary where
you were being cared for after
being brought back by our leader.

fields.EN:
When I went in, you looked at me
and smiled. Your smile was so
bright, and it warmed my heart.
fields.JP:
様子を見に行った私と目が合った時、君は
にっこりと笑ったのだよ。
しみじみと心温まる笑顔でね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I went in, you looked at me
and smiled. Your smile was so
bright, and it warmed my heart.

fields.EN:
I was filled with such emotion...
I felt like I had physically found
you myself. How embarrassing...
fields.JP:
感動のあまり、思わず自分が発見したかのような
錯覚を覚えてしまったんだろうね……
いやはや、何とも恥ずかしい話だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was filled with such emotion...
I felt like I had physically found
you myself. How embarrassing...

fields.EN:
S-Stop it already... You're making
me feel embarrassed, too...
fields.JP: や、やっぱもういいよ……照れくさくなってきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop it already... You're making
me feel embarrassed, too...

fields.EN:
W-Well then, let's get back on
topic.
fields.JP: さ……さて、それでは話を戻そうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well then, let's get back on
topic.

fields.EN:
With your efforts, we can now
begin our escape. Many lives are
at stake, so we must be careful.
fields.JP:
君たちの活躍で、いよいよ脱出計画を開始できる。
だが、なにぶん大勢の人間の命がかかっている。
慎重に進めなくてはならない
fields.LOCALIZED:
With your efforts, we can now
begin our escape. Many lives are
at stake, so we must be careful.

fields.EN:
I would like to ask all of you to
rest and prepare for the mission
to come.
fields.JP: 一同、十分に疲れを取り、作戦に備えてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would like to ask all of you to
rest and prepare for the mission
to come.

fields.EN:
(As expected, no one brought up
the subject of a possibility of a
traitor...)
fields.JP:
（結局……
　『裏切り者』の話は、誰も口にしなかったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(As expected, no one brought up
the subject of a possibility of a
traitor...)

fields.JP: 太陽が近づいてきたね

fields.EN: Yes. But no one can see it yet.
fields.JP: そうね。みんなの目にはまだ見えないけど
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. But no one can see it yet.

fields.EN:
Two lost birdies made it back to
the nest.
fields.JP: 迷い鳥が二羽、巣に辿り着いたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Two lost birdies made it back to
the nest.

fields.EN:
Golden light... Golden
Little Bird-san told me about it.
fields.JP: 金の光、金の小鳥さんが教えてくれたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The golden light and the golden
birdie told me that.

fields.EN:
I wonder how high those birdies
can fly.
fields.JP: あの小鳥たちはどこまで高く飛べるだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder how high those birdies
can fly.

fields.EN:
The birdies don't have fake wings,
and won't burn. The birdie will
fly straight forward.
fields.JP:
作り物の羽根でもなく、燃え尽きることもない、
まっすぐに飛ぶ小鳥たちよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The birdies don't have fake wings,
and won't burn. The birdie will
fly straight forward.

fields.JP: そうあることを願うね

fields.EN:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew and
a fruit from the Tree of Life.
fields.JP:
さあ。今日の食べ物を運んできたよ。
森の朝露に、生命の木の実
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew and
a fruit from the Tree of Life.

fields.EN:
Go ahead. Drink and eat as you
normally do...
fields.JP: さあ、飲んでお食べ……いつものように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go ahead. Drink and eat as you
normally do...

fields.EN:
Yes, I will. The ambrosia you've
brought to me.
fields.JP:
ええ。頂くわ。これは、あなたがわたしのために
運んでくれるアムブロシア……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I will. The ambrosia you've
brought to me.

fields.EN:
Special, select flesh from the
Jail.
fields.JP: ……特別に上等な、ジェイルの肉体だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Special, select flesh from the
Jail.

fields.EN:
Good child... I knew you would be
a wonderful maiden of the sun.
fields.JP: いい子だね。さすが僕の見込んだ、太陽の巫女だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good child... I knew you would be
a wonderful maiden of the sun.

fields.EN:
Go ahead. Drink and eat as you
will... Though, perhaps you don't
need it any longer.
fields.JP:
……さあ、飲んでお食べ。
もっとも、もう君には必要ないかもしれないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go ahead. Drink and eat as you
will... Though, perhaps you don't
need it any longer.

fields.JP:
（ん……朝か。
　何だか外が騒がしいけど……）

fields.EN:
Um... What seems to be the
problem?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... What seems to be the
problem?

fields.EN:
Hi, Jack. There's a bit of a
ruckus going on inside the
Liberated District.
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックか。
解放地区内でちょっとした騒ぎが起きててね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hi, Jack. There's a bit of a
ruckus going on inside the
Liberated District.

fields.EN:
Everyone's heading over to the
laboratory now.
fields.JP: みんな、研究室に詰めかけてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone's heading over to the
laboratory now.

fields.JP: あの……何かあったんですか！？

fields.EN:
Are we under siege?! What is
going on?!
fields.JP:
討ち入りか！？
何が起きておる！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are we under siege?! What is
going on?!

fields.EN:
It seems as though the Order of
the Sun made a move inside the
Liberated District...
fields.JP:
この解放地区内……正しくはタイヨウ教団で
おかしな動きが起きているようなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as though the Order of
the Sun made a move inside the
Liberated District...

fields.EN:
Towa came rushing over to report
it... Apparently a huge number of
followers went out through the gate.
fields.JP:
さっき永遠の奴が大慌てで報せに来たんだが……
信者たちが大挙して門を出てったらしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Towa rushed here to let us know
that a group of followers have
left the Liberated District.

fields.EN:
But don't they usually preach
their teachings in those areas,
anyway?
fields.JP:
でも……彼らはよく、独房エリアに布教に
出かけているのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But don't they usually preach
their teachings in those areas,
anyway?

fields.EN:
The thing is, the number of people
who left is way more than we
expect are missionaries.
fields.JP:
それが、いつも布教に出かける人数じゃなかった
って話なんだよな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The thing is, the number of people
who left is way more than we
expect are missionaries.

fields.EN:
So we came here to notify the
Professor, but we couldn't find
him anywhere...
fields.JP:
それで、念のためここに来たら……博士の姿が
見当たらなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we came here to notify the
Professor, but we couldn't find
him anywhere...

fields.EN:
I saw the Professor earlier, and
he said he was gonna go and check
things out.
fields.JP:
博士なら、出てくとこにちょうど鉢合わせて、
状況を確認するって言ってたんすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I saw the Professor earlier, and
he said he was gonna go and check
things out.

fields.EN:
If nothing were happening it would be one
thing, but at a time like this, it's a
problem when he goes off on his own...
fields.JP:
何もない時ならともかく、こんな時に自分で
動かれると、困るのよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the matter wasn't urgent, it'd
be fine, but it's a problem when
it's something like this...

fields.EN:
I wonder what he might have gone
to check on.
fields.JP: 何を確認しに行ったのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what he might have gone
to check on.

fields.JP: グレーテル！　不謹慎よ！

fields.EN:
Miko-san, we'll go and see what's
happening at the Order of the Sun!
fields.JP:
視子さん、僕らもタイヨウ教団の様子を見に
行ってきます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko, we'll go and see what's
happening at the Order of the Sun!

fields.JP: ほんとに……人がほとんどいない……

fields.EN:
Oohime-sama and the others should
be at that Tower outside.
fields.JP: 大陽女様たちならあの塔にいるはずだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime and the others should
be at that Tower outside.

fields.EN:
Huh?! The Jail Tower?! The others
went there, too?!
fields.JP:
えっ！？　『監獄塔』に！？
じゃあ、他の人たちも！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! The Jail Tower?! The others
went there, too?!

fields.EN:
Yes. Our Oohime-sama gave word
to everyone to head to the Tower.
fields.JP:
ああ。さっき、大陽女様からお導きが
あったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Our Lady Oohime gave word
to everyone to head to the Tower.

fields.EN:
Everyone listened and left, but I
wasn't as convinced, so I stayed
behind.
fields.JP:
みんな塔を目指して出て行ったけど、
あたしはどうもねえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone listened and left, but I
wasn't as convinced, so I stayed
behind.

fields.EN: The followers went to the Tower...
fields.JP: 信者の人たち……塔に向かったなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: The followers went to the Tower...

fields.EN:
It's hard to believe Michiru-san would
send her followers off like
that...
fields.JP:
でも……ミチルさんたちがそんな指示を出す
なんて、あまり思えないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's hard to believe Michiru would
send her followers off like
that...

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised to hear you say
that, given how you seem to
support them.
fields.JP:
ジャックはあの人たちに肩入れしているよう
だものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised to hear you say
that, given how you seem to
support them.

fields.EN:
I don't necessarily support them,
this is really weird, regardless.
I mean, it's dangerous outside.
fields.JP:
肩入れってわけじゃないけど……何か変だよ。
どんな危険があるかもわからないのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't necessarily support them,
this is really weird, regardless.
I mean, it's dangerous outside.

fields.EN:
Are you sure that was what Lady
Oohime told everyone to do?
fields.JP: それ、ホントにミチルの指示なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure that was what Lady
Oohime told everyone to do?

fields.EN:
They both left early this morning, telling us
to "wait here until the sun shines," but only
Oohime-sama returned a little while ago...
fields.JP:
早朝に『太陽が照らすまでここで待つように』と
言い残してお二人で出て行かれたんじゃが、
先ほど大陽女様だけ引き返してこられての……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime and another left in
the morning, telling us to "wait
until the sun shines."

fields.EN:
I couldn't see her face under her
hood, but Oohime-sama did return
to us earlier.
fields.JP:
ああ。フードを閉じていらしたのでお顔は
見えなかったが、間違いなく大陽女様だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't see her face under her
hood, but Lady Oohime did return
to us earlier.

fields.EN:
It was then she pointed to the
Tower and shared with us her word.
fields.JP: そして、塔を指差して導かれたんじゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was then she pointed to the
Tower and shared with us her word.

fields.EN:
With how nutty she can get, I'm
not surprised she did such a
thing.
fields.JP:
あの頭のぶっ飛んだ人なら、
別に不思議じゃないって思うけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how nutty she can get, I'm
not surprised she did such a
thing.

fields.EN:
But, normal people climbing the
Tower? It's not the same as going
out on their normal missions.
fields.JP:
でも……普通の人が塔になんか昇ったら……
独房エリアに布教に行くのとは、訳が違うと
思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, normal people climbing the
Tower? It's not the same as going
out on their normal missions.

fields.EN:
I wanna go and see what's at the
Tower!
fields.JP:
とう、なにがあるのか
わくわくするよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanna go and see what's at the
Tower!

fields.EN:
So to be blunt, no one knows
what's really going on, then.
fields.JP:
つまり、何があるか見当もつかないってことです
よね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So to be blunt, no one knows
what's really going on, then.

fields.EN:
Right. Not to mention that place
is where the tragedy occurred 15
years ago...
fields.JP:
ええ。しかも……十五年前に大惨劇が起きたと
いう場所ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Not to mention that place
is where the tragedy occurred 15
years ago...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki doesn't think onee-sama-tachi
would order everyone to go somewhere
so dangerous.
fields.JP:
……そんな危ない場所に行けとみんなに命じる
なんて、お姉様たちがするとは白雪は思えません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White doesn't think dear
sister would send her followers
to such a dangerous place.

fields.EN:
Well, you three grew up here, so I can't blame
you for siding with Michiru and the others...
fields.JP:
まあ、ここで育った白雪たちなら、ミチルたちの
肩を持っても当たり前だけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, being that you three were
raised here, I don't blame you for
covering for Michiru.

fields.EN:
But at least we know something
strange is happening.
fields.JP: 何か変なことが起きてるのは、間違いないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But at least we know something
strange is happening.

fields.EN:
You know, the Professor may have
gone to the Tower, too.
fields.JP: それに……博士も塔に向かってるかもしれないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, the Professor may have
gone to the Tower, too.

fields.EN:
That's right... All Clara said was
that he'd go and "check things
out."
fields.JP: そういえば……状況を確認しに行くって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right... All Clara said was
that he'd go and "check things
out."

fields.EN: Let's go to the Tower, everyone!
fields.JP: みんな、塔に行ってみようよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's go to the Tower, everyone!

fields.EN:
B-But, we don't know exactly what's going
on, and we haven't received any directives
yet. What do you think, Akazukin-san?
fields.JP:
で……でも、いまどうなっているかの調査もまだ
ですし……指示も出てませんわ。
赤ずきんさんはどう思いまして？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, we don't know exactly
what's going on, and we haven't
received any directives yet.

fields.EN:
Yes. Who has to go and figure out
what's going on?
fields.JP: あら。今更誰が調査をするというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Who has to go and figure out
what's going on?

fields.EN:
That's right! We're the only ones
who can actually find out what's
happening!
fields.JP:
そうだよ。今調査ができる力があるとしたら、
僕たちしかいないんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! We're the only ones
who can actually find out what's
happening!

fields.EN:
If I might add, I think it's about
time we start making decisions for
ourselves.
fields.JP:
それに……わたしたちは自分たちで判断すべき
時期に来ているのだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I might add, I think it's about
time we start making decisions for
ourselves.

fields.JP: 自分たちで……判断すべき時期……？

fields.EN:
Yes. We don't know who could be
a traitor and what their motives
may be, right?
fields.JP:
ええ。誰が『裏切り者』で何が目的なのか、
わからないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. We don't know who could be
a traitor and what their motives
may be, right?

fields.EN:
But there are no traitors in the
Dawn!
fields.JP: 黎明には……裏切り者なんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there are no traitors in the
Dawn!

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san... Let's forget
about traitors for a moment.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん。
裏切り者のことは、ひとまず置いておこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood... Let's forget
about traitors for a moment.

fields.EN:
This is urgent. If we ignored this
now, it could very well lead to
worst possible scenario.
fields.JP:
これは異常な事態よ。放っておいたら
何が起きるかわからない……
最悪の惨事すら考えられるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is urgent. If we ignored this
now, it could very well lead to
worst possible scenario.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルも、やなよかんするー！

fields.EN:
So the only ones who can save
anyone would be us...
fields.JP:
馬鹿を助けられるとしたら、あたしたちだけって
ことか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So the only ones who can save
anyone would be us...

fields.EN:
That's right. There may be
casualties, even as we speak. The
Professor could be one, too.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。こうしてる間にも、被害者は出てるかも
しれない……その中には博士もいるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. There may be
casualties, even as we speak. The
Professor could be one, too.

fields.EN:
So we need to go now, and make our
way to the Tower!
fields.JP: だから、一刻も早く……塔へ向かおう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we need to go now, and make our
way to the Tower!

fields.JP: ぐるる……ここ、いっぱいえものいるね！

fields.EN:
Michiru and her followers were
insane to even think of coming
to a place full of Marchens...
fields.JP:
こんなにメルヒェンに溢れてるってのに、
ミチルたち、やっぱどうかしちゃったんじゃない
かしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru and her followers were
insane to even think of coming
to a place full of Marchens...

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm worried about the
followers, too...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm worried about the
followers, too...

fields.EN:
I'm sure they're fine. At least
for now.
fields.JP: 大丈夫だと思うわ。……今はまだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure they're fine. At least
for now.

fields.EN: Huh? What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Assuming those two are our
"traitors," the Marchens won't
harm them, right?
fields.JP:
もし『裏切り者』があの二人だったなら……
メルヒェンたちは敵じゃないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Assuming those two are our
"traitors," the Marchens won't
harm them, right?

fields.EN:
Are you calling Michiru a
traitor?!
fields.JP: ミチルたちが裏切り者だっていうの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you calling Michiru a
traitor?!

fields.EN:
I'm merely offering the
possibility. It has nothing to do
with how I feel about them.
fields.JP:
可能性は、一つ一つ挙げて検証するものよ。
私個人の感情とは関係ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm merely offering the
possibility. It has nothing to do
with how I feel about them.

fields.EN: So if they aren't, then what?
fields.JP: それじゃ、そうじゃない場合は……何故ですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: So if they aren't, then what?

fields.EN:
Then they were lured here by the
"traitor," to be used for their
purposes.
fields.JP:
『裏切り者』にとって利用できるから……
利用するためにここに誘導したから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then they were lured here by the
"traitor," to be used for their
purposes.

fields.EN:
That's what you're going to say,
right?
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what you're going to say,
right?

fields.EN:
As expected from you, Alice.
You're absolutely right.
fields.JP: さすがアリスね。その通りよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As expected from you, Alice.
You're absolutely right.

fields.EN:
The problem is whether it really was
onee-sama-tachi who brought everyone here...
fields.JP:
問題は、みんなを連れてきたのが本当に
お姉様たちなのかってことです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The problem is whether dear sister
actually was the one to ask her
people to follow her.

fields.EN:
Well said, rookie detective. But that's an
emotional argument. It has no direct bearing
on whether the followers live or die.
fields.JP:
あら。頼もしいじゃない、新米探偵さん。
でもそれも感情論よ。信者の生死には直接関係
ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said, though motivated by
your kindness. They have no direct
relationship with the traitor.

fields.EN:
Yes. That's a separate issue. But I think
it's an important distinction when it comes
to the traitor's identity and objective.
fields.JP:
そうですね。別のお話でした。
でも、『裏切り者』の正体と目的には重要な違い
だと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
True, but the followers' goals do
align with the traitor's, even
without a relationship with them.

fields.JP: ええ。その通りだと思うわ

fields.EN:
(Shirayukihime is mentally stronger
now than before...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snow White is mentally stronger
now than before...)

fields.EN:
Regardless, if everyone is still
safe, then we need to find them as
soon as we can!
fields.JP:
でも、みんながまだ無事だとしたら……
一刻も早く、見つけなきゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, if everyone is still
safe, then we need to find them as
soon as we can!

fields.JP: それでは早速、進もうぞ！

fields.EN:
Hm? It's no time to be playing
with Marchen carcasses.
fields.JP: ん？　メルヒェンの死体なら遊んじゃ駄目だよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? It's no time to be playing
with Marchen carcasses.

fields.EN:
I think she wants you to check
something on the ground over
there.
fields.JP:
そうです～。
あそこに何か落ちてます～。
調べてみたほうがいいと思います～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think she wants you to check
something on the ground over
there.

fields.JP: ご、ごめん。ラプンツェル……
……これは……ずいぶん古びてるけど……

fields.EN:
There are a lot of weapons here...
This brownish stain... Is it
blood?
fields.JP:
武器がたくさん……それに、この茶色い染みは、
血、かしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are a lot of weapons here...
This brownish stain... Is it
blood?

fields.EN:
Not smell like Marchen blood or
Jack's!
fields.JP:
これ、メルヒェンともじゃっくともちがう
ちのにおいだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not smell like Marchen blood or
Jack's!

fields.EN:
Yeah. I think this is where the
members of the Dawn were killed
15 years ago...
fields.JP:
うん。多分……多分だけど……
十五年前、ここで黎明の人たちが皆殺しに遭った
んだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I think this is where the
members of the Dawn were killed
15 years ago...

fields.EN:
It would explain all these old
weapons on the ground here...
fields.JP:
じゃなきゃ、ここにだけこんなに古い武器が
落ちてるわけない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It would explain all these old
weapons on the ground here...

fields.EN:
We're able to be here now because
of them, right...?
fields.JP: みなさんのおかげで、白雪たちは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're able to be here now because
of them, right...?

fields.EN:
Uh... We can feel sad about them
later. I believe we have other
matters to attend to.
fields.JP:
あ。あー。
哀しむのは後でもできます～。
わらわたちには、すべきことがあるはずです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... We can feel sad about them
later. I believe we have other
matters to attend to.

fields.EN:
(Everyone's a lot stronger than
before now...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone's a lot stronger than
before now...)

fields.EN:
(But, what about me? I feel like
my urge to climb is the only thing
getting stronger...)
fields.JP:
（僕は、どうなんだろう。
　上に昇らなければ……そんな欲求ばかりが
　強くなってく気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, what about me? I feel like
my urge to climb is the only thing
getting stronger...)

fields.EN:
(No... It's not a urge anymore.
It's more like... a mission.)
fields.JP:
（……欲求なんてものじゃない。
　使命、みたいな感じだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... It's not a urge anymore.
It's more like... a mission.)

fields.JP: これ、トランシーバーだよね？

fields.EN:
Yup. Well, not a working one,
anyway.
fields.JP:
うん。……まあ、もう使い物にならない
だろうけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Well, not a working one,
anyway.

fields.EN:
(Transceiver... A device that
connects Snark to the
Nightmares...)
fields.JP:
（トランシーバー……スナークとナイトメアを
　結ぶ鍵の一つ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Transceiver... A device that
connects Snark to the
Nightmares...)

fields.EN:
(This isn't from a Nightmare, but
it may be worth checking out...)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアが持ってたものじゃないけど、
　調べてみたら何かわかるかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't from a Nightmare, but
it may be worth checking out...)

fields.EN: Do you mind if I borrow this?
fields.JP: これ、借りていっても……いいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind if I borrow this?

fields.EN:
...If you're the one carrying it, Jack,
I think everyone who died would be happy too.
fields.JP:
……ジャックが持ってるなら、死んだみんなも
喜ぶんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure its previous owner would
be happy to have you make use of
it.

fields.JP: ありがとう、赤ずきんさん

fields.EN:
Oohime-sama... So, we're finally
able to see the sun...
fields.JP: 大陽女様……いよいよ太陽に会えるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime... So, we're finally
able to see the sun...

fields.EN:
The day when the sunlight burns
through the heavens is finally
drawing near.
fields.JP: 太陽の光が天幕を焼く日がついに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The day when the sunlight burns
through the heavens is finally
drawing near.

fields.EN:
So, you all wanted to see the sun
too, Marchens?
fields.JP:
メルヒェン……あんたたちも、
太陽が見たかったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you all wanted to see the sun
too, Marchens?

fields.EN:
Michiru-san is leading humans
and... Marchens?!
fields.JP: ミチルさんがメルヒェンと人間を引き連れて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oohime is being followed by humans
and... Marchens?!

fields.JP: ええ。陽司さんがいないわね

fields.EN:
Not only that, the Marchens aren't
attacking anyone... They actually
look... happy?
fields.JP:
それに、メルヒェンが……人間に危害を加える
どころか、楽しそうにしているわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only that, the Marchens aren't
attacking anyone... They actually
look... happy?

fields.EN: What in the world is going on...?
fields.LOCALIZED: What in the world is going on...?

fields.EN:
It seems to be a tree called a "cherry tree."
A tree that existed in the previous world.
fields.JP:
『桜』という木のようね。
以前の世界には存在した木ということよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like a "cherry blossom"
tree, a plant that supposedly
existed a long time ago.

fields.EN:
(I feel a sense of nostalgia and
sorrow coming from deep within
me...)
fields.JP:
（体の奥底が揺さぶられるような、
　この、懐かしくて哀しい感覚……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel a sense of nostalgia and
sorrow coming from deep within
me...)

fields.EN:
(It's almost as if we're being
told who we are...)
fields.JP:
（まるで、僕らが何者なのかを伝えて
　くれるような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's almost as if we're being
told who we are...)

fields.EN:
Why do I know this tree...? So
nostalgic... I loved the flowers
on it, and... I feared the moon.
fields.JP:
わらわは……何故かこの木を知ってます。
とても……懐かしい……
……この花を愛で……月を怖れた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why do I know this tree...? So
nostalgic... I loved the flowers
on it, and... I feared the moon.

fields.EN:
Mmm...? When my hair was cut,
everything was taken from me...
fields.JP:
うーーーー？
かみのけ、きられると、ぜんぶとられた……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mmm...? All my hair was cut off...

fields.JP: ほう……奇妙な感覚を覚えるな……

fields.EN:
I don't know why, but... I think I
know the reason behind my habit...
fields.JP:
何故かしら……わたし、自分の衝動の理由が
理解できる気がするわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know why, but... I think I
know the reason behind my habit...

fields.EN:
I was always trying to hide and
escape from things...
fields.JP:
わたし、いつも何かから隠れたかったんだ……
でも、脱け出したかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was always trying to hide and
escape from things...

fields.EN:
Mmm... I didn't want to wake up...
But, I wanted to wake up...
fields.JP:
……ん……ボク、目覚めたくなかった……
……目覚めたかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I didn't want to wake up...
But, I wanted to wake up...

fields.EN:
The reason I thought I needed to
dress in luxury to show my value
was...
fields.JP:
わたくし……身を飾らないと価値が無いと思って
いた理由は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The reason I thought I needed to
dress in luxury to show my value
was...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... No wonder I'm so
rational...
fields.JP: ふふ。私、それは合理的な筈よね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... No wonder I'm so
rational...

fields.EN:
(Everyone is feeling the same
thing... This weird feeling...)
fields.JP: （みんなも感じてるんだ……この感覚……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone is feeling the same
thing... This weird feeling...)

fields.EN:
Shirayuki was refused by
someone... Their feelings were
symbolized by... a mirror.
fields.JP:
白雪は……誰かから手酷く拒絶されたん
ですね……その象徴が、鏡……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White was refused by
someone... Their feelings were
symbolized by... a mirror.

fields.EN:
I kept thinking I was everyone's
older sister, and that I needed to
be reliable...
fields.JP:
あたしは……みんなのお姉さんだから、しっかり
しなきゃって思ってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept thinking I was everyone's
older sister, and that I needed to
be reliable...

fields.EN:
But... actually, I was always stopped
from taking interest in things because
something frightening would happen...
fields.JP:
でも……ほんとは、何かに興味を持ったら、
怖いことが起きるって……止められてて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, something scary happened
once, when I was interested in
something...

fields.EN:
So this is what you were talking
about, Gretel.
fields.JP:
グレーテル。あなたが言ったのは、
このことだったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is what you were talking
about, Gretel.

fields.EN:
Did you finally wake up from your
dream, Alice?
fields.JP: ようやく夢から醒めたの、アリス？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you finally wake up from your
dream, Alice?

fields.EN:
Who knows? But at least I know
now why I sought consistency in my
dreams.
fields.JP:
さあ。どうかしら。でも……何故かわかるわ。
わたしは夢にまで整合性を求める存在なのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows? But at least I know
now why I sought consistency in my
dreams.

fields.EN:
Jack, do you understand too? What I meant when
I said your impulse isn't rooted in emotion?
fields.JP:
ジャック。あなたもわかった？
あなたの衝動が、感情に根ざしているわけでは
ないといった意味が
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, how about you? Do you know
why you feel your desires far more
strongly than logic can explain?

fields.EN:
It's because... it's something I have
to do as the very reason for my existence...
fields.JP:
それは……僕が、僕自身の存在理由として
しなければいけないことだからだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because... I need to do it
for my existence...

fields.JP: みんな、思い出したのね

fields.EN: Michiru! I'm so glad you're safe!
fields.JP: ミチル……あんた……無事だったのね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Michiru! I'm so glad you're safe!

fields.EN: Michiru-san... Why did you come here?
fields.JP: ミチルさん……どうしてここへ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Michiru... Why did you come here?

fields.EN:
I came to pray here because this
place is the end of everything and
the beginning of everything.
fields.JP:
お祈りをするため。
ここは全てが終わり、全てが始まった場所だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I came to pray here because this
place is the end of everything and
the beginning of everything.

fields.JP: （ミチルさんの雰囲気が、今までと違う……）

fields.EN:
The end of everything and the
beginning of everything...
fields.JP: 『全てが終わり、全てが始まった場所』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The end of everything and the
beginning of everything...

fields.EN:
I tried to stop her, but she said
she needed to come here, that "the
time has come."
fields.JP:
僕は止めたんだが、どうしてもと……
『刻が来たから』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I tried to stop her, but she said
she needed to come here, that "the
time has come."

fields.EN:
I didn't want to bring Chiaki here
with me because I only came to put
the bird into its cage.
fields.JP:
本当は、千昭は連れて来たくなかったの。
だってわたしは、鳥を籠に入れに
来たんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to bring Chiaki here
with me because I only came to put
the bird into its cage.

fields.EN:
(The bird into its cage...? What
does she mean by that?)
fields.JP: （鳥を籠に入れる……どういう意味なんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The bird into its cage...? What
does she mean by that?)

fields.EN:
This place is the end and the
beginning of everything. So if 
something is to revive...
fields.JP:
ここは全てが終わり、全てが始まった場所。
だから、もし何かが蘇るとしたら……ここ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is the end and the
beginning of everything. So if 
something is to revive...

fields.EN:
Something...? Are you referring
to yourself, by any chance?
fields.JP: 『何か』って……自分のこと、ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something...? Are you referring
to yourself, by any chance?

fields.EN:
That's right, my sweet child,
Shirayuki. Just as I remembered
myself, so did all of you.
fields.JP:
そうよ、しらゆき。優しい子。
わたしがわたしのことを思い出したように、
あなたたちも何かを思い出したはずね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, my sweet child, Snow
White. Just as I remembered
myself, so did all of you.

fields.EN: As in, we remembered who we are...
fields.JP: それは……自分が何者か、ということね
fields.LOCALIZED: As in, we remembered who we are...

fields.EN:
Yes. My existence is rooted in
this location, but all of you are
slightly different.
fields.JP:
ええ。わたしはこの場所に根ざした存在だけど、
あなたたちは、ちょっとだけ違うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. My existence is rooted in
this location, but all of you are
slightly different.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I still don't
understand what you're saying.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、あんたの言ってることはやっぱり
わけわかんない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I still don't
understand what you're saying.

fields.EN:
Don't tell me your followers are
climbing the Tower because of
what you prophesized?
fields.JP:
信者たちがこの塔を昇ってるのも、
そのわけのわからない預言のせいなわけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me your followers are
climbing the Tower because of
what you prophesized?

fields.JP: わたし……みんなには『待ってて』って……
でも、そう……そういうことなのね……

fields.EN:
Michiru, you said your existence
is rooted here, right?
fields.JP:
ミチル……あなたはさっき、自分が
この場所に根ざした存在だと言ったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru, you said your existence
is rooted here, right?

fields.JP: そして私たちは、それとは少し違う存在だとも

fields.EN:
Thanks to that, everything that had only been
conjecture until now has fallen into place.
fields.JP:
おかげで、これまで推論でしかなかったものが
全て繋がったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to what you've said, my
theories seem to have connected.

fields.EN:
You're right. You're an existence
rooted to who was here in this
location.
fields.JP:
そうね……あなたは、
ここに『いたもの』に根ざした存在
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. You're an existence
rooted to who was here in this
location.

fields.EN:
And we're probably an existence
rooted to what was here as well.
fields.JP:
……そして私たちは恐らく、
ここに『あったもの』に根ざした存在
fields.LOCALIZED:
And we're probably an existence
rooted to what was here as well.

fields.JP: （ここに『いたもの』と『あったもの』……？）

fields.EN:
Gretel, what are you talking
about?
fields.JP: グレーテル、君は一体何を……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, what are you talking
about?

fields.EN:
Oh, you don't know? She's saying
that she's an existence created by
the Jail's mimicry.
fields.JP:
わからない？
この人は、自分はジェイルに擬態させられた
存在だと言ってるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you don't know? She's saying
that she's an existence created by
the Jail's mimicry.

fields.EN:
I didn't want you to find out,
Chii-chan...
fields.JP: ちーちゃんには、知られたくなかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want you to find out,
Chii...

fields.EN:
Chiaki... I'm sorry to have
burdened you. You're my one and
only brother. Please, believe me.
fields.JP:
千昭。今まで苦しめて、ごめんね。
でも、あなたはわたしの大切な、たったひとりの
弟なの。だから、わたしのこと、信じて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chiaki... I'm sorry to have
burdened you. You're my one and
only brother. Please, believe me.

fields.EN:
I know the warm and gentle
sunlight I felt, and the wishes of
the young lives that existed here.
fields.JP:
わたしはここに存在した幼き命たちの想いを、
その身に浴びた柔らかな陽の光の暖かさを
知っている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know the warm and gentle
sunlight I felt, and the wishes of
the young lives that existed here.

fields.EN:
I also personally know the desire
behind the growth of the Tower,
and the breath of life.
fields.JP:
そして、この塔の空へ伸びようとする想いと
生命の息吹をも我が身のように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also personally know the desire
behind the growth of the Tower,
and the breath of life.

fields.EN:
Those who believe my words climb
the Tower higher, ever so higher.
And at the very top...
fields.JP:
私の言葉を信じた人たちは、この塔を高く高く
昇っていくわ。そして、塔の上には……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those who believe my words climb
the Tower higher, ever so higher.
And at the very top...

fields.EN:
At the very top of this tree...
are treasures and an evil giant.
fields.JP: この樹の上には……宝物と、悪い巨人……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very top of this tree...
are treasures and an evil giant.

fields.EN:
(I feel something welling up
inside of me again...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel something welling up
inside of me again...)

fields.EN:
Yes. What awaits them is an ill
fate... and my role is to stop that fate.
fields.JP:
そう。彼らを待っているのは、悪い運命……
そして、それを止めるのが、わたしの役割
fields.LOCALIZED:
What awaits those who continue is
an ill fate... My role is to stop
them.

fields.EN:
That's why I need to go on. Let's
go together, Chii-chan.
fields.JP:
だから……先に行くね。
ちーちゃん、一緒に行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I need to go on. Let's
go together, Chii.

fields.EN:
I don't really understand what
happened here, but she went to
save her believers, right?
fields.JP:
意味が……よくわかりませんでしたけど、
彼女は信者を救いに行きましたのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't really understand what
happened here, but she went to
save her believers, right?

fields.EN:
It seems so. It also sounds like
there's some kind of disaster
waiting at the very top.
fields.JP:
ええ、恐らく。
塔の上に何か災厄が待っているんだわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems so. It also sounds like
there's some kind of disaster
waiting at the very top.

fields.EN:
If something bad's gonna happen,
we need to go up there, too!
That's why we came here!
fields.JP:
悪いことが起きようっていうなら、
あたしたちも行かなきゃ！
あたしたち、そのために来たんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If something bad's gonna happen,
we need to go up there, too!
That's why we came here!

fields.EN:
Interesting... Very interesting!
I cannot allow this trickster to
get away with it!
fields.JP:
面白い……面白くなってきたな！
ワレをたばかるモノは捨て置けぬわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting... Very interesting!
I cannot allow this trickster to
get away with it!

fields.JP: 赤ずきん……本当にいいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood, are you sure?

fields.EN:
Ah, but if you feel like you need
to go, that must be your truth.
fields.JP:
いえ。あなたが行く必要があるとそう感じたなら
それが真実ね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but if you feel like you need
to go, that must be your truth.

fields.EN:
Let's get going! Now it's my turn
to save everyone!
fields.JP:
じゃあ行くよ！
今度はあたしが……あたしたちが助け出す番だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's get going! Now it's my turn
to save everyone!

fields.EN: I'm surprised it didn't notice us.
fields.JP: でも、よく僕らの気配に気づかなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm surprised it didn't notice us.

fields.EN:
Maybe it has already finished its
work.
fields.JP: 仕事が終わった、といったとこじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it has already finished its
work.

fields.EN: Is that... someone collapsed over there...?
fields.JP: あれは……誰かが倒れてるんですの……？
まだ、息があるかもしれないわ……！

fields.EN:
Horrible... Look at all these
people...
fields.JP:
……ひどい状態だ……
しかも、何人も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Horrible... Look at all these
people...

fields.EN:
It's quite apparent that their
lives have ended.
fields.JP: どう見ても、生命活動を終えているわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's quite apparent that their
lives have ended.

fields.EN:
Calm down. Your emotions are
