going to get the better of you. I
simply stated facts.
fields.JP:
落ち着いて。感情論は身を滅ぼすわ。
私は状況を正確に述べただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down. Your emotions are
going to get the better of you. I
simply stated facts.

fields.JP:
赤姉様……！
落ち着いてください……

fields.EN:
It just means that we're in a very
dangerous place.
fields.JP:
いま白雪たちは、それだけ危険なところに
いるんだと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just means that we're in a very
dangerous place.

fields.EN:
What we need to do now is stay
calm and protect ourselves from
harm.
fields.JP:
……今わたしたちに必要なのは、
わたしたち自身が冷静になって、危機から
身を守ることだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What we need to do now is stay
calm and protect ourselves from
harm.

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san... It's not like
no one is distraught by this.
fields.JP:
……赤ずきんさん。
誰も……この人たちの姿に動揺していないわけ
ではないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood... It's not like
no one is distraught by this.

fields.EN:
Like m'lady said, none are
disregarding the brave who
perished here.
fields.JP: お嬢の言う通り……勇者を侮蔑して良い筈がない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like m'lady said, none are
disregarding the brave who
perished here.

fields.EN:
But who are they? They don't look
like members of the Dawn.
fields.JP:
……この人たち、何者なんだろ？
黎明の人じゃないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But who are they? They don't look
like members of the Dawn.

fields.EN:
They all look about the same age
as us, too...
fields.JP: 歳も、あたしたちと同じくらい……みたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
They all look about the same age
as us, too...

fields.EN:
So that means there are more who
were trying to climb the Tower...
fields.JP:
わらわたちと同じように……塔を目指した人が
いたということですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that means there are more who
were trying to climb the Tower...

fields.EN:
Can we... at least bury them? They
don't deserve to be left like
this...
fields.JP:
その……せめて、埋めて差し上げませんこと？
このままでは、可哀想ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can we... at least bury them? They
don't deserve to be left like
this...

fields.EN:
Yeah... We can at least do that
much, right?
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
せめてそのくらいは、してあげてもいいよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We can at least do that
much, right?

fields.EN: Yeah. I think that's a good idea.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. I think that's a good idea.

fields.EN:
At least they can rest in peace
under this beautiful tree...
fields.JP:
……ここなら……この綺麗な木の下でなら……
せめて安らかに眠れるんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least they can rest in peace
under this beautiful tree...

fields.EN:
I don't know who you all are,
but... please do rest in peace.
fields.JP:
……ええ。
どこの誰かは知らないけど……せめてゆっくり
休んでほしいもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know who you all are,
but... please do rest in peace.

fields.EN: Wait! Bury this with them, too!
fields.JP: ちょっと待って！　これも一緒に……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait! Bury this with them, too!

fields.EN:
The belongings we found... of the
dead Dawn members...
fields.JP: ……それは……昔の黎明の人たちの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The belongings we found... of the
dead Dawn members...

fields.EN:
Well, I know I'm getting
emotional, but I just want to at
least bury them while we're at it.
fields.JP:
あー。感情的って言われるかもしれないけどさ、
せっかくだから埋葬してあげたいなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I know I'm getting
emotional, but I just want to at
least bury them while we're at it.
That's so like you, Sister Red.

fields.EN: I hope the believers are all okay.
fields.JP: 信者さんたち……大丈夫でしょうか
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope the believers are all okay.

fields.EN:
I'm sure they're fine. I doubt
they would be harmed if they
were gathered here with a motive.
fields.JP:
多分……大丈夫だと思うよ。
目的があって集めた信者たちを、ただ傷つける
ことはしないだろうし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure they're fine. I doubt
they would be harmed if they
were gathered here with a motive.

fields.EN:
That's right, Shirayuki. It's no
use thinking about it now.
fields.JP: そうよ、白雪。今考えたって仕方ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Snow White. It's no
use thinking about it now.

fields.EN:
I'm not going to be swayed
anymore. I'm going to get this
done, no matter what.
fields.JP:
あたしはもう、迷わない。
必ず決着をつけるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not going to be swayed
anymore. I'm going to get this
done, no matter what.

fields.EN:
Let's go! We'd better find the
core before we meet that
Nightmare!
fields.JP:
じゃ、行くよ！
ナイトメアと出くわす前に……核を見つけよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go! We'd better find the
core before we meet that
Nightmare!

fields.EN: Um... I think I found it...
fields.JP: あの～、見つけたみたいです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... I think I found it...

fields.EN: What did you say, Princess Lazy?
fields.JP: どうしたのよ、グータラ姫？
fields.LOCALIZED: What did you say, Princess Lazy?

fields.JP: あれ、核じゃないでしょうか～

fields.EN:
The cherry blossom tree...? Oh,
over there?! Good work!
fields.JP:
その桜ってやつの……あそこね！
……なかなかやるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The cherry blossom tree...? Oh,
over there?! Good work!

fields.JP: おお。でかしたぞ、かぐや！

fields.EN:
I just found it while I was
wandering around.
fields.JP: サボってブラブラしてただけです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just found it while I was
wandering around.

fields.EN:
There's no telling what's going to
happen to the Jail if we destroy
this. But, the Nightmare...
fields.JP:
……これを壊したら、ジェイルに何が起きるか
わからない。でも、ナイトメアがいる以上……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling what's going to
happen to the Jail if we destroy
this. But, the Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Why, yes, we don't have much of a
choice. We can't be defeated now!
fields.JP:
ええ。
ここでやられたら元も子もありませんもの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes, we don't have much of a
choice. We can't be defeated now!

fields.EN:
Yup... We'll think about that
later...
fields.JP: ん……あとはその時考える……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... We'll think about that
later...

fields.EN:
I'm quite curious to see how the
Jail will react.
fields.JP: ジェイルの変化も興味深いしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite curious to see how the
Jail will react.

fields.EN:
You can't seem to hold yourself
back, can you?
fields.JP: あんたはいちいち、一言余計だっつーの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't seem to hold yourself
back, can you?

fields.JP: ご丁寧に守護者までいるってわけか……！
来たよ……みんな、用意はいいね！
いっちょあがりーーー！！

fields.EN: Now then, let's break the core!
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, let's break the core!

fields.EN: Yup! We've got no time to waste!
fields.JP:
そうだね！
ぐずぐずしてる暇はないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! We've got no time to waste!

fields.JP: アアアアァァアァアア……！！
あら。ずいぶん大きな悲鳴だこと

fields.EN:
Yeah... Maybe it's because we're
inside the Tower, or maybe...
fields.JP: うん……塔の中だからなのか、それとも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Maybe it's because we're
inside the Tower, or maybe...

fields.EN:
(What's going on? I can't sense
what the Jail is feeling...)
fields.JP:
（何だろう……？
　ジェイルが何を考えてるのか、わからない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's going on? I can't sense
what the Jail is feeling...)

fields.EN:
This sound... I can't get used to
it at all...
fields.JP: この声……何度聞いても慣れませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This sound... I can't get used to
it at all...

fields.EN:
I don't give a damn about the Jail
wailing! Let's just keep going!
fields.JP:
ジェイルの悲鳴なんか、知ったこっちゃないわ！
この調子でガンガンいきましょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't give a damn about the Jail
wailing! Let's just keep going!

fields.EN:
Yes. That is, if we can continue
without encountering the
Nightmare...
fields.JP:
ええ。ナイトメアと遭遇せずに、先へ進めれば
いいのだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. That is, if we can continue
without encountering the
Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Heh... Fear not! I shall protect
m'lady from the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
ふ……ナイトメアなど恐るるに足らず！
お嬢はワレが護ろうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Fear not! I shall protect
m'lady from the Nightmare!

fields.JP: ないとめあ、ぼっこぼこにしてやるよ！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I guess you're right.
I don't expect things to go easy
for us.
fields.JP:
あはは……確かにそうそう都合よくはいかない
だろうしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I guess you're right.
I don't expect things to go easy
for us.

fields.EN:
But, we did destroy the core, so
let's keep this up!
fields.JP: 核は壊したんだ。攻めの姿勢で行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we did destroy the core, so
let's keep this up!

fields.EN:
The next time we see the
Nightmare, it'll be the end of it!
fields.JP: 出会った時が向こうの最期……いいね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The next time we see the
Nightmare, it'll be the end of it!

fields.JP: キェェェェアアアァアア……！

fields.EN: I will pry it of its live...!
fields.JP: ワレが狩り取ってくれようじょ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I will pry it of its live...!

fields.JP: キェェェェアアアァアア……！

fields.EN:
I don't want to bother with it
anymore, so let's end this
quickly.
fields.JP: めんどくさいから、早く終わらせましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to bother with it
anymore, so let's end this
quickly.

fields.JP: ふん……大したことないわね！

fields.EN:
I wouldn't mind observing it a
little longer.
fields.JP: もう少し観察したかったのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't mind observing it a
little longer.

fields.EN:
I shall lead you to eternal
slumber!
fields.JP: ワレ、汝に永劫の安息を与えん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shall lead you to eternal
slumber!

fields.JP: とどめ……刺させて頂きましてよ！
キァァァアアアァアア……！

fields.EN:
It may curse itself in hell for
getting in our way.
fields.JP:
ワレの行手を阻んだこと……
地獄で後悔するがよい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It may curse itself in hell for
getting in our way.

fields.JP: ないとめあ、やっつけたー！

fields.EN:
Whew... Guess we can keep moving
now.
fields.JP: ふう。これで安心して先へ進めるってもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... Guess we can keep moving
now.

fields.JP: ふう、さすがにバテますわね……

fields.EN:
Aka-neesama, should we rest for a
while?
fields.JP: 赤姉様、一休みしますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red, should we rest for a
while?

fields.EN:
Mmm... I guess we're all a bit
beat, but...
fields.JP:
うーん……
確かにちょっとキツいんだけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I guess we're all a bit
beat, but...

fields.EN:
Nah, let's just get this over
with! I dunno why, but I feel like
we need to keep moving!
fields.JP:
やっぱり、一気に進もう！
なんかね……なんか……
そうしなきゃいけない気がするんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nah, let's just get this over
with! I dunno why, but I feel like
we need to keep moving!

fields.EN:
I feel the same way, too. We can't
let the rabbit escape.
fields.JP:
わたしもそう思うわ。
いま手を緩めたら、ウサギ穴から逃げて
しまうもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel the same way, too. We can't
let the rabbit escape.

fields.EN:
Yeah... What we're really after is
at the very top!
fields.JP:
うん……僕らが追ってるものは、はるか上に
あるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... What we're really after is
at the very top!

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、げんきだよー！

fields.EN: Fate tells me to continue onward.
fields.JP:
運命がワレに語りかけている……
前に進めと
fields.LOCALIZED: Fate tells me to continue onward.

fields.JP: わたしもまあ、どうってことないわ

fields.EN:
Well then, I suppose we need to
keep moving, then.
fields.JP: それなら……行くしかありませんわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I suppose we need to
keep moving, then.

fields.EN:
If you say so, Aka-neesama,
Shirayuki will do her best!
fields.JP:
……赤姉様がそう言うなら
白雪もがんばります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Sister Red says so, Snow White
will do her best!

fields.JP: うん！　行こう……みんなで！

fields.EN:
It looks like we can't go any
further...
fields.JP: ……このままじゃ、上に昇れないみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like we can't go any
further...

fields.EN:
I can't do anything, even with my
tools at our disposal...
fields.JP:
わらわの七つ道具を駆使しても、どうにも
しようがないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't do anything, even with my
tools at our disposal...

fields.EN:
Uh, your tools were meant to help
you slack off, so I doubt they'd
be of much help...
fields.JP:
あんたのはもともとサボるためのくだらない道具
でしょうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, your tools were meant to help
you slack off, so I doubt they'd
be of much help...

fields.EN:
Even with my indomitable power,
I cannot penetrate this barrier.
How vexing, indeed.
fields.JP:
ワレの威力をもってしても、この障壁が破れぬ
とは、世界は広いというべきか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even with my indomitable power,
I cannot penetrate this barrier.
How vexing, indeed.

fields.EN:
Guess we can't go up like this...
Now what?
fields.JP:
ともかく……このままじゃ上には行けないね。
どうしたもんかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess we can't go up like this...
Now what?

fields.EN:
Jack, you have such a troubled
look on your face. What's wrong?
fields.JP:
じゃっく、むずかしいかおしてるけど、
どうしたの？

fields.EN:
You know, I just feel something
strange...
fields.JP: 実はさ、変な予感がするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, I just feel something
strange...

fields.EN: A baby's gonna come out of you?
fields.JP: じゃっく、こどもうみそう？
fields.LOCALIZED: A baby's gonna come out of you?

fields.EN:
If we climb from here, I'm sure danger
unlike anything before is waiting
for us. But... we have to climb.
fields.JP:
ここを昇れば、きっとこれまでにないくらいの
危険が待ってる。
でも、昇らなきゃいけない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel something dangerous beyond
our imagination is waiting...

fields.EN:
But, we still need to keep
climbing, or else we can't finish
what we came here for...
fields.JP: じゃないと、終わらせられないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we still need to keep
climbing, or else we can't finish
what we came here for...

fields.EN:
Oh, is that it? We already know
we're in for it.
fields.JP: 何言ってんのよ。危険ならとっくに承知の上よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, is that it? We already know
we're in for it.

fields.EN:
Yes. We decided that we'd face
anything that comes for us!
fields.JP:
はい。それでも立ち向かおうって、
みんなで決めたじゃないですか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. We decided that we'd face
anything that comes for us!

fields.EN:
I kind of know what you mean
about the "finish" part...
fields.JP:
でも……わかる気がする
『終わらせなきゃ』ってこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kind of know what you mean
about the "finish" part...

fields.EN:
I want to finish whatever we're
here for, of my own will.
fields.JP:
わらわも……終えるんじゃなくて、わらわの
意志で終わらせたいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to finish whatever we're
here for, of my own will.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I'm ready for
anything.
fields.JP: ……ふふ。私はいつでも用意はできてるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I'm ready for
anything.

fields.EN:
I can feel it too! The time has come
to make them pay the price for their lies!
fields.JP:
ワレも感じるぞ。
嘘の対価を払わせる時が到来しているとにゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sense the time has come for
us to pay back what is due for
all the lines!

fields.EN:
Yes... Dreams always end when you
wake up. No... We have to wake from this one.
fields.JP:
……ええ。最後は必ず夢から醒めるものだもの。
いいえ。そうしなければいけないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Dreams are meant to be
awakened from. That much is
certain.

fields.EN:
We'll know everything if we keep
moving.
fields.JP: ……先へ進めばきっと、全てがわかるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll know everything if we keep
moving.

fields.JP: みんなも……同じなんだね……

fields.EN:
(It's coming from the transceiver
I found here earlier...)
fields.JP:
（何かわかるかと思って持ってきた
　トランシーバーだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's coming from the transceiver
I found here earlier...)

fields.EN:
The transceiver is picking up
something! I can't believe it
still works...
fields.JP:
トランシーバーが何か受信したんだ！
こんな古いのに、まだ生きてたなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The transceiver is picking up
something! I can't believe it
still works...

fields.EN:
I wonder what it's picking up...
Try and see if you can answer it,
Jack.
fields.JP:
でも……誰からだろ？
ジャック、答えてみてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what it's picking up...
Try and see if you can answer it,
Jack.

fields.JP:
こ……こう？
ええと……もしもし？

fields.EN: Hello?! Hey, can you hear me?!
fields.JP:
おい、聞こえるか？
……聞こえてんだな！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hello?! Hey, can you hear me?!

fields.JP: （この声……何だか聞き覚えがあるような……）

fields.EN: Is that you, Jack? I'm, uh...
fields.JP:
その声、ジャックか？
俺は……あー
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that you, Jack? I'm, uh...

fields.EN:
...Someone who died and came back
to life.
fields.JP: 『死んで蘇った者』ってやつかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Someone who died and came back
to life.

fields.EN: Died and came back to life?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Died and came back to life?!

fields.EN:
I see... A brave one who has seen
the depths of the abyss...
fields.JP:
成る程……黄泉の国を垣間見た存在か……
かような勇者がいるとはな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... A brave one who has seen
the depths of the abyss...

fields.EN:
What a subtle way to introduce
oneself.
fields.JP: ……何とも微妙な自己紹介ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a subtle way to introduce
oneself.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Sounds pretty lively over
there!
fields.JP: ははは。そっちは賑やかだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Sounds pretty lively over
there!

fields.EN:
No need to apologize. I actually
wanted to thank you.
fields.JP:
謝る必要はないさ。
むしろ、お礼を言いたいくらいなんだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to apologize. I actually
wanted to thank you.

fields.EN:
You're the ones who buried us,
right? We were able to revive
because of that.
fields.JP:
俺たちの死体をあの場所に埋葬してくれたのは
お前たちだろ？
おかげで蘇れたんだぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the ones who buried us,
right? We were able to revive
because of that.

fields.JP:
あ……あたしらが埋葬って……
ひょっとして、さっきの……！？

fields.EN:
Let me guess. You can't get to the
upper floor either, right?
fields.JP:
お前らも今、上階への入り口で足止めを
くらってる……違うか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me guess. You can't get to the
upper floor either, right?

fields.EN:
"Either?" So that means you
couldn't get through?
fields.JP: お前らもってことは、君たちも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Either?" So that means you
couldn't get through?

fields.EN:
Yeah. Our objective should be the
same, so how about we lend each
other a hand?
fields.JP:
ああ。俺たちの目的は同じはずだ。
どうだ、協力し合わないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Our objective should be the
same, so how about we lend each
other a hand?

fields.JP:
確かにそうかもしれないけど……
でも……

fields.EN:
Jack seems reluctant to
say it, so I'll say it for him.
fields.JP:
ジャックが言いにくそうだから、私が代わりに
言ってあげるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since Jack isn't the type to say
it, I'll say it for him.

fields.EN:
We don't know who you are, so we
can't just trust you outright.
fields.JP:
あんたが何者かわかんない以上、無条件には信用
しきれないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know who you are, so we
can't just trust you outright.

fields.EN:
Jack... Get a grip, too. We don't
have anywhere left to fall back to, you know?
fields.JP:
……ジャック。あんたもしっかりしなさいよ。
あたしたち、もう後がないのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, be a man! It's not like we
have the luxury of putting
our lives at risk, you know?

fields.EN:
(I have to hand it to Oyayubihime
for being able to say that, and
she's right...)
fields.JP:
（親指姫らしく、さらっと言ってのけたけど……
　でも、ほんとにその通りなんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to hand it to Thumbelina
for being able to say that, and
she's right...)

fields.EN:
(This is a battle to end
everything once and for all, so we
can't take any chances...)
fields.JP:
（僕らにとって、これは『終わらせる』ための戦い
　なんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is a battle to end
everything once and for all, so we
can't take any chances...)

fields.EN:
By the way, what do you mean when
you said that you revived because
you were buried?
fields.JP:
君……僕らが埋葬したから蘇ったって、
どういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, what do you mean when
you said that you revived because
you were buried?

fields.EN:
You know about the Jail's mimicry,
right?
fields.JP: ……ジェイルの擬態能力は知ってるな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know about the Jail's mimicry,
right?

fields.EN:
We're reincarnated forms of the
members of the Dawn who died here
long ago.
fields.JP:
今の俺たちは、かつてここで死んだ
黎明の人間たちの『転生体』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're reincarnated forms of the
members of the Dawn who died here
long ago.

fields.EN:
Reincarnated forms?! Wh-What do
you mean by that?!
fields.JP:
『転生体』……！？
ぜ……全然わかんないんだけど……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Reincarnated forms?! Wh-What do
you mean by that?!

fields.EN:
It's true that we died, but the
Jail's core mimicked us, bringing
us back to life.
fields.JP:
俺たちは確かに一度死んだ。
だが、あの場所にあったジェイルの核に
『擬態』させられて蘇ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true that we died, but the
Jail's core mimicked us, bringing
us back to life.

fields.EN:
They took on the thoughts and
memories of the original owners of
the weapons you buried with them.
fields.JP:
お前らが一緒に埋葬した武器の
元の持ち主たちの想いと記憶を宿す形でな
fields.LOCALIZED:
The memories of those who owned
those weapons were transferred to
our forms.

fields.EN:
A 'reincarnated form' is an existence
imbued with thoughts through mimicry.
fields.JP:
『転生体』ってのは、『擬態』によって
想いを宿した存在のことさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So our reincarnated forms are an
existence created by mimicry with
the same memories as the fallen.

fields.EN:
So... you carry the souls of the
people from Dawn who died in this tower.
fields.JP:
つまり……あなたたちはこの塔で死んだ、
黎明の人たちの魂を宿しているというわけね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. You died in this tower, and
revived with the soul of a fallen
member of the Dawn.

fields.EN:
(A reincarnated form with
memories... Like our memories of
characters from various stories.)
fields.JP:
（想いを宿す、転生体……そうか。
　やっぱり、僕らは童話の主人公の……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A reincarnated form with
memories... Like our memories of
characters from various stories.)

fields.EN:
Um, I still don't get it. I mean,
I've never heard of such a thing
before.
fields.JP:
いやその……やっぱよくわかんないんだけど？
ていうか、そんな例って知らないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I still don't get it. I mean,
I've never heard of such a thing
before.

fields.EN:
About 15 years ago, I found a baby
at the Station Grounds.
fields.JP:
昔……十五年前のことだが、俺は『元駅構内
エリア』で、ひとりの赤ん坊を拾ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
About 15 years ago, I found a baby
at the Station Grounds.

fields.EN:
That baby killed a Marchen with
her bare hands. Her name was
"Akazukin."
fields.JP:
メルヒェンを素手で倒した、
その赤ん坊の名前は……『赤ずきん』
fields.LOCALIZED:
That baby killed a Marchen with
her bare hands. Her name was
"Red Riding Hood."

fields.JP: そして俺は、『隊長』と呼ばれていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Back then, I was a leader of my
unit.

fields.EN:
What he's saying is known only
by a select few in the Dawn. I
think he's telling the truth.
fields.JP:
黎明でも一部の者しか知らない情報……
どうやら間違いなさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What he's saying is known only
by a select few in the Dawn. I
think he's telling the truth.

fields.EN:
But, that doesn't mean we can
trust him...
fields.JP: でもだからって、それが信じる理由には……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, that doesn't mean we can
trust him...

fields.EN:
You wanted to know who I was,
right? How about you, Jack?
fields.JP:
俺が何者か……だったな。
……なあ、お前はジャックなんだよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You wanted to know who I was,
right? How about you, Jack?
How do you know my name...?

fields.EN:
I see. You're together. Good. Doesn't
my voice sound familiar to either of you?
fields.JP:
そうか、ちゃんと一緒にいるんだな。よかった。
二人とも、俺の声に聞き覚えないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can hear her with you. That's
good. Are you sure neither of you
remember my voice?

fields.EN:
As long as we're alive, we still
have a chance of escaping
from here...
fields.JP:
……でも、殺されずにいれば……
生き延びるチャンスはあるわ。
いつか、脱出できるかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as we're alive, we still
have a chance of escaping
from here...

fields.EN:
Yeah... We'll get out of here one
day, right?
fields.JP:
そうだな。
いつかきっと脱出してみせる。
……だろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We'll get out of here one
day, right?

fields.EN: Yup! We're not going to give up!
fields.JP:
うん！
私たち、こんなのに負けちゃいけないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! We're not going to give up!

fields.EN:
Yes... No matter how painful
things are now.
fields.JP:
……ええ。
どんなに今が辛くても
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... No matter how painful
things are now.

fields.EN:
You're the person who was in the
prison cell next to us?
fields.JP: 僕らが囚われてた牢獄で、隣の牢にいた子？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the person who was in the
prison cell next to us?

fields.EN:
Finally remembered, eh? Glad to
hear you're both safe.
fields.JP:
思い出してくれたか？
お前たちも元気でいてくれてうれしいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally remembered, eh? Glad to
hear you're both safe.

fields.EN:
Of course, we did die once
already.
fields.JP: まあ、俺たちは一度死んじまったけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, we did die once
already.

fields.JP: （だから、どこかで聞いた声だって……！）

fields.EN:
Now listen up. It's hard to notice
from the outside, but this tower
is structured with dual spirals.
fields.JP:
いいか。この塔は、外から見ても分からないが、
実は二重の螺旋構造になってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now listen up. It's hard to notice
from the outside, but this tower
is structured with dual spirals.

fields.EN:
Yeah. The two towers intertwine like a
beanstalk and connect inside at certain
points, like the floor with the cherry tree.
fields.JP:
ああ。二つの塔が豆の木みたいに絡み合ってるんだ。
それがところどころ内部で繋がってる。
桜のあるフロアとかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Think of it as a beanstalk.
They link various floors, like the
floor where the tree is.

fields.EN:
(I see... So that means we climbed
up one side of the tower.)
fields.JP:
（そうだったんだ……つまり僕たちは、
　その片方の塔を昇ってたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... So that means we climbed
up one side of the tower.)

fields.EN:
We're on the other side, and I
think we need to synchronize what
we do to climb to the top.
fields.JP:
ここからは、俺たちのいる塔とお前たちのいる塔、
二手から同時に攻めないと昇れないのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're on the other side, and I
think we need to synchronize what
we do to climb to the top.

fields.EN:
C'mon, just give us a chance and
help us so that we can help you.
fields.JP: 頼む……騙されたと思って、一度協力してみてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, just give us a chance and
help us so that we can help you.

fields.EN: Got it. What do you need us to do?
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. What do you need us to do?

fields.EN:
All right. First, this door has
three buttons, marked 2, 3, and 4.
We don't know which one to press.
fields.JP:
よし。まず、こっちの扉には３つのボタンがある。
それぞれ、２、３、４と書かれてるんだが、
どれを押せばいいのか分からねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, there are buttons on our
portal numbered 2, 3, and 4, and
we don't know which to press.

fields.EN: Do you have any clues on your side?
fields.JP: そっちに何か、手がかりはないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does your portal have anything
like that in particular?

fields.EN: We don't have any buttons on our door...
fields.JP: こっちには、ボタンなんてないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have any buttons on our
portal...

fields.EN:
I see... I'm sure there has to be
something over there. Do you mind
searching for a bit?
fields.JP:
そうか……
すまん、もう少し探してみてくれないか？
きっとそっちにも何かあると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I'm sure there has to be
something over there. Do you mind
searching for a bit?

fields.EN:
Sure. I'll contact you as soon as
we find something.
fields.JP: 分かった。何か見つけたら連絡するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. I'll contact you as soon as
we find something.

fields.EN:
Great. Hope to hear back from you
soon.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great. Hope to hear back from you
soon.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry for making the decision
without checking with everyone...
fields.JP: ……ごめん、みんな。勝手に決めちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for making the decision
without checking with everyone...

fields.EN:
That's fine. Let's just search the
place like they asked. I want to
at least give them a chance.
fields.JP:
いいわ。
とりあえず言われた通りにしてみましょう。
私は……信じてみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine. Let's just search the
place like they asked. I want to
at least give them a chance.

fields.EN:
Alice... Okay, let's look for
clues, then!
fields.JP:
アリス……
うん、分かった。手がかりを探そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... Okay, let's look for
clues, then!

fields.EN:
(Hm, clues... Could there be any
on this floor?)
fields.JP:
（でも……手がかりなんてどこにあるんだろう？
　このフロアのどこかにあるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm, clues... Could there be any
on this floor?)

fields.JP: 何かあそこに書いてますね～

fields.EN:
You're right! Let's see... 'How many legs does
a human have in the morning, afternoon, and
evening?' What does that mean? Isn't it two?
fields.JP:
あ、本当だ！　えっと……
『人間の足は、朝、昼、夜でそれぞれ何本？』
……どういうことだろう？　２本じゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right! Let's see... "How
many legs does man have in the
morning, evening, and night?"

fields.EN:
I have no clue what that means.
Why don't we get our partners to
figure it out?
fields.JP:
難しいことは分かんないよー。
とりあえず、あっちに考えてもらおうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no clue what that means.
Why don't we get our partners to
figure it out?

fields.EN: I guess. Let me give them a call.
fields.JP: そうだね。とりあえず連絡してみよう
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess. Let me give them a call.

fields.EN:
Yeah. We found a strange inscription: 'How
many legs does a human have in the morning,
at noon, and at night?' Know what it means?
fields.JP:
うん。変な文章を見つけたよ。
『人間の足は、朝、昼、夜でそれぞれ何本か』
……どういうことか、分かる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found an etching that says,
"How many legs does man have in
the morning, evening, and night?"

fields.EN:
Hm... Just a second. I got someone
here that's good with those kinds
of things.
fields.JP:
さぁ……ちょっと待ってろ。
こっちにはそういうのが得意なヤツがいるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Just a second. I got someone
here that's good with those kinds
of things.

fields.EN:
Okay, got it. We'll head
back to that door in the meantime.
fields.JP:
うん、わかった。
その間にこっちはさっきの扉に戻っておくよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks. In the meanwhile, we'll
head on back to the portal.

fields.EN: The one on our side opened, too!
fields.LOCALIZED: The one on our side opened, too!
How did you open the portals?

fields.EN:
The time of day represents man's
life. A baby walks on 4, then 2 as
he grows, then 3 with a cane.
fields.JP:
朝は赤ん坊、昼は大人、夜は老人。
四つん這いで４本足、２本足、杖をついて３本足。
だから、４、２、３の順番が正解だとよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The time of day represents man's
life. A baby walks on 4, then 2 as
he grows, then 3 with a cane.

fields.EN:
We're going to head to the top
from here. Do you mind helping us
out?
fields.JP:
俺たちはこのまま最上階を目指す。
……手を貸してくれるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to head to the top
from here. Do you mind helping us
out?

fields.EN: Yes, I see no problem at all.
fields.JP: ええ。迷う必要はないわ。
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I see no problem at all.

fields.EN:
I'm good with that, too! Let's
work together for now.
fields.JP: あたしも賛成だね！　ひとまず共闘しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm good with that, too! Let's
work together for now.

fields.EN:
Guess we'll believe in you. We'll
get through this place together.
fields.JP: ……君を信じるよ。一緒に進もう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess we'll believe in you. We'll
get through this place together.

fields.JP: よし！　じゃあ行くぜ！

fields.EN:
Hey. We've found another door
that won't open. How is it on your side?
fields.JP:
よぅ。また開かない扉があった。
そっちはどうだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, looks like we came to
another closed portal. How
about on your side?

fields.EN:
Same here. So, I should look for
clues again, right?
fields.JP:
こっちもだよ。
また手がかりを探せばいいんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. So, I should look for
clues again, right?

fields.EN:
All right. Let's search the place
for clues!
fields.JP: よし。手がかりを探そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. Let's search the place
for clues!

fields.JP:
あったわね…。今度は……
『旅人のマントを脱がせよ』？
ぬ！？　マントを脱がせる……！？

fields.EN:
It doesn't make much sense to us,
but maybe it means something to
them? Let me get in contact...
fields.JP:
やっぱりこっちじゃ意味が分からないけど……
向こうならわかるかな？
とりあえず、連絡しよう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't make much sense to us,
but maybe it means something to
them? Let me get in contact...

fields.EN:
Yeah. We found another etching
that says, "Remove the traveler's
cloak." Does that ring a bell?
fields.JP:
うん。読むよ。
『旅人のマントを脱がせよ』
……分かる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. We found another etching
that says, "Remove the traveler's
cloak." Does that ring a bell?

fields.EN:
Wait a second. Let me ask my
team...
fields.JP: ちょっと待て。相談する……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a second. Let me ask my
team...

fields.EN:
Okay. We'll head back
to that door in the meantime.
fields.JP:
うん、わかった。
その間にこっちはさっきの扉に戻っておくよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. In the meanwhile, we'll head
on back to the portal.

Got it! The portal on our side
opened!

fields.EN: It opened on our side, too!
fields.LOCALIZED: It opened on our side, too!

fields.EN:
Good... We just have a little ways
to go!
fields.JP: いいぞ……あと一息で昇り切れる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good... We just have a little ways
to go!

fields.EN:
By the way, what did that etching
mean?
fields.JP: ところで、今度の答えは何だったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, what did that etching
mean?

fields.EN:
Our buttons were the sun, clouds,
rain, and wind. So, how do you get
a traveler to remove their cloak?
fields.JP:
こっちには、太陽、雲、雨、風のボタンがあった。
旅人のマントを脱がせるにはどうすればいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our buttons were the sun, clouds,
rain, and wind. So, how do you get
a traveler to remove their cloak?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Use the wind to blow it
off?
fields.JP: うーん……風で吹き飛ばす？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Use the wind to blow it
off?

fields.EN:
That'll just make the traveler
hold onto their cloak more
tightly.
fields.JP: それだと旅人はマントを強く押さえるだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That'll just make the traveler
hold onto their cloak more
tightly.

fields.EN:
The answer was the sun. The
sun's heat would make the traveler
remove their cloak themselves.
fields.JP:
正解は、太陽で照らす。
そうすると気温が上がって、暑くなった旅人が
自分からマントを脱ぐのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The answer was the sun. The
sun's heat would make the traveler
remove their cloak themselves.

fields.EN:
From what I've heard, yes. Well,
at least that's what the adults
said.
fields.JP: らしいぜ。大人たちが言うにはな
fields.LOCALIZED:
From what I've heard, yes. Well,
at least that's what the adults
said.

fields.EN:
Sun... I wonder if we'll get to
see the sun soon.
fields.JP:
太陽か……
もうすぐ僕たちも見られるのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sun... I wonder if we'll get to
see the sun soon.

fields.EN:
I forgot to ask, but did you guys
there kill the Nightmare that
killed us?
fields.JP:
……そういえば、俺たちを殺したナイトメア、
お前たちが倒してくれたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I forgot to ask, but did you guys
there kill the Nightmare that
killed us?

fields.EN:
Yes, though all I did was provide
support.
fields.JP:
うん、そうだね。
……といっても、僕はサポートしただけだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, though all I did was provide
support.

fields.EN:
How did you do that? We gave it
all we had and it didn't budge.
fields.JP:
一体どうやって？
どんなに攻撃しても死ななかったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did you do that? We gave it
all we had and it didn't budge.

fields.EN:
Um, the cores send nutrients to the Jail
and the Nightmares. Destroying one makes
it possible to defeat its Nightmare.
fields.JP:
ええと、核ってのはジェイルやナイトメアに
栄養を送ってて、壊すとナイトメアを
倒せるようになるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are cores in the Jail that
support the Nightmares. Destroying
them makes them vulnerable.

fields.EN: I see... So that's the trick!
fields.JP: そうか、やっぱりそうだったのか……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... So that's the trick!

fields.EN:
If only we'd known that 15 years
ago, then maybe we would've
survived.
fields.JP:
十五年前にも、それを知ってれば
全滅しなくてすんだのかもしれないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we'd known that 15 years
ago, then maybe we would've
survived.

fields.EN:
(That must be coming from the
leader's memory...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That must be coming from the
leader's memory...)

fields.EN:
Wait... Weren't you killed by
Snark? It sounds like you were
killed by a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
あれ……？
でも、確か十五年前は、ナイトメアじゃなくて
スナークに襲われて全滅したんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Weren't you killed by
Snark? It sounds like you were
killed by a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Isn't Snark the leader of the
Nightmares? A being that's white
and a bit frail-looking.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアの親玉でしょ？
なんかこう、白っぽくてひょろっとした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't Snark the leader of the
Nightmares? A being that's white
and a bit frail-looking.

fields.EN:
No... There's no doubt it was that same
Nightmare fifteen years ago. There's no way
I'd mistake the one that killed me, right?
fields.JP:
いや……間違いなく、
十五年前もあのナイトメアだった。
自分が殺された相手を間違えるはずないぜ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, we were definitely killed by a
Nightmare. There's no way we'd
forget who killed us.

fields.JP: ど、どういうことでしょう……？

fields.EN:
What a strange story... The tale that
became the basis for Snark being spoken of
as a symbol of fear was wrong all along.
fields.JP:
……不思議な話もあったものね。
恐怖の象徴として語られるスナークの
恐怖の根拠となる話が間違いだったなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unusual... Our fear of this
"Snark" is coming from something
which didn't even exist to them.

fields.JP:
スナーク、こわくないよ！
よわっちいもん

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, you said that
before, too.
fields.JP: 前にもそんなことを言っていましたね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, you said that
before, too.

fields.EN:
That Snark thing killed the
Nightmare, but only from behind as
it was already about to die...
fields.JP:
確か……そう、死にそうなナイトメアを
スナークが後ろから刺し殺した後でしたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Snark thing killed the
Nightmare, but only from behind as
it was already about to die...

fields.EN:
(Even if the survey team being wiped
out fifteen years ago wasn't Snark's
doing... what would that mean...?)
fields.JP:
（十五年前に調査隊が全滅したのが
　スナークのせいじゃなかったとして……
　それにどんな意味があるんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So they didn't die because of
Snark? What is going on here?)

fields.EN:
Don't let it bother you, Jack. We
just need to do what we came
here for, isn't that right?
fields.JP:
気にする必要ないわ、ジャック。
私たちは『終わらせる』ために進むだけ。
……そうでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't let it bother you, Jack. We
just need to do what we came
here for, isn't that right?

fields.EN:
Exactly! No use thinking about
something we don't have an answer
to!
fields.JP:
そうそう。
こんなとこでくよくよ考えてたって
答えなんか出ないしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly! No use thinking about
something we don't have an answer
to!

fields.EN:
I believe she's right. If
anything, the truth we seek lies
in wait ahead of us.
fields.JP:
それが正しいと思うわ。
真実はすぐそこ……この先にあるのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe she's right. If
anything, the truth we seek lies
in wait ahead of us.

fields.EN:
Well then, let's all go and see
what this "truth" is!
fields.JP: ……よし、お互い、真実を見つけようぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, let's all go and see
what this "truth" is!

fields.EN: We'll see you at the top!
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll see you at the top!

fields.EN:
So, this is the top of the
Tower...?
fields.JP: ここが……この塔の最上階ですのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this is the top of the
Tower...?

fields.EN:
I doubt we'll get through
this without something happening!
fields.JP: ただで済むとは思えないわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever! We're going to get this
done, one way or another!

fields.JP:
おおーーーー！
さいじょうかいーーーー！！

fields.EN:
So, how does it feel, "climbing to
the top?"
fields.JP:
ジャック、『高いところ』に昇って
どんな気分かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how does it feel, "climbing to
the top?"

fields.EN:
(Again...! I feel something
swelling deep inside me...!)
fields.JP:
（まただ…………！
　また、体の奥底から何かが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Again...! I feel something
swelling deep inside me...!)

fields.EN:
There should be a giant here we
need to beat.
fields.JP: ……ここには倒さなきゃいけない巨人がいる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
There should be a giant here we
need to beat.

fields.EN:
I think this is my Blood Libido...
It must mean there's a core
and a Nightmare here too...
fields.JP:
……多分これは、僕の血式リビドーで……
きっとここにも核やナイトメアが存在するって
ことなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think this is my Blood Libido...
To find the core and Nightmare
here...

fields.JP:
（そう、僕は…………いや、
　僕らは『転生体』だったんだ……！）

fields.EN:
(We were born carrying the strong
thoughts contained in the things
that were in that place...)
fields.JP:
（あの場所にあったものに込められた……
　強い想いを宿して生まれた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We were all born from a strong
desire...)

fields.EN:
I finally know after coming
here... We exist to end this
story...
fields.JP:
塔の最上階まできて……ようやくわかった。
僕は……僕たちは、物語を終わらせるための存在
なんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I finally know after coming
here... We exist to end this
story...

fields.EN:
I merely hypothesized from 
examining my desire. I also wasn't
preoccupied with being human.
fields.JP:
答えを知っていたわけではないわ。私はただ、
自分の欲求を検証し、仮説を立てていただけ……
もとから『人間』である執着なんてないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I merely hypothesized from 
examining my desire. I also wasn't
preoccupied with being human.

fields.EN:
I'm still awake in this dream...
Which is why I want to escape from
here...
fields.JP:
わたしは……夢の迷宮の中でも、目醒めたままの
存在だから……望むのね。この迷宮から抜け出す
ことを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still awake in this dream...
Which is why I want to escape from
here...

fields.EN:
So I was the same... These glass earrings
were what bound me. I had been wishing
for the day I could cast them off.
fields.JP:
わたくしもまた……そうでしたのね。
このガラスのイヤリングこそわたくしの囚われ……
脱ぎ捨てる日を希ってたんですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was attached to my earrings
because I was seeking a day to
remove them from me...

fields.EN: Mmm... A day for me to wake up...
fields.JP: ん……ボクも、目覚める日を……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mmm... A day for me to wake up...

fields.EN:
I don't want to return to the
moon, and I won't.
fields.JP:
わらわは月に帰るのは嫌です～
だから、嫌だって言ってやります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to return to the
moon, and I won't.

fields.EN: Not so lazy anymore, are you?
fields.JP: 『面倒くさいから』……じゃないのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Not so lazy anymore, are you?

fields.EN:
My days of hiding and finding a
reason to escape ends here.
fields.JP: わたしも、隠れて逃げ回る日を、終えるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My days of hiding and finding a
reason to escape ends here.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki didn't need to wake
up if that would prevent anyone
from being hurt...
fields.JP:
白雪は……目を覚まさなくてもよかったんです。
それでみんなが傷つかないなら……でも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White didn't need to wake
up if that would prevent anyone
from being hurt...

fields.EN: But I suppose it wasn't enough.
fields.JP: きっとそれじゃ、駄目なんです
fields.LOCALIZED: But I suppose it wasn't enough.

fields.EN:
I need to find a way to escape
too, without waiting for help...
fields.JP:
……そうだね。あたしも待ってないで、抜け出さ
なきゃいけないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to find a way to escape
too, without waiting for help...

fields.EN:
So, everyone... Let's end this
crazy story together!
fields.JP:
だからさ……みんなで終わらせようよ！
このふざけた物語をさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, everyone... Let's end this
crazy story together!

fields.EN:
Yeah. We are who we are. We'll end
this so that we can have a new
beginning!
fields.JP:
うん。
僕らがどんな存在でも、僕らは僕らだから……
行こう。終わらせて……始めるために！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. We are who we are. We'll end
this so that we can have a new
beginning!

fields.EN:
We found it! There really is a
core here...
fields.JP:
見つけた……核だ！
ほんとにあったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found it! There really is a
core here...

fields.EN:
Oh? What folly, sitting there
while we prepare for its demise.
fields.JP:
ほう……まさにワレらに破壊されんとしている
というのに、呑気に脈打っておるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? What folly, sitting there
while we prepare for its demise.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh, heh! Grrrr...! We're
gonna eat you!
fields.JP:
ふっふっふー。がるるる……
これからみんなで、たべちゃうよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh, heh! Grrrr...! We're
gonna eat you!

fields.EN:
I don't think you should try and
provoke it like that, or else
you're going to bring trouble.
fields.JP:
そうやって刺激して、いろいろ呼び寄せても
知りませんよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think you should try and
provoke it like that, or else
you're going to bring trouble.

fields.EN:
Ohohoho! If that happens,
we'll simply be wiped out!
fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ！
その時は全滅するまででしてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohoho! Well then, we'll just
destroy everything here!

fields.EN: We can't let ourselves get wiped out...
fields.JP: 全滅しちゃ駄目でしょ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, destroy everything except us,
okay?

fields.EN:
But she's right! We're going to
beat anything that stands in our
way!
fields.JP:
そうよ！　何が来たってみんなあたしたちが
やっつけてやるんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she's right! We're going to
beat anything that stands in our
way!

fields.EN:
This is the last core, right?
There's no way we're going to let
it sit there like that!
fields.JP:
だって……きっとこれが、最後の核なんでしょ？
引けるわけないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is the last core, right?
There's no way we're going to let
it sit there like that!

fields.EN: Yes... This is the last core...
fields.JP:
はい……これが……
最後の核、なんですよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... This is the last core...

fields.JP:
ええ……おそらくは。
もっとも……

fields.EN:
No... If the core we destroyed
in the Solitary Confinement Area
was meant to expand the Jail...
fields.JP:
いえ……独房エリアで破壊してきた核が、
ジェイルを拡げるためのものだとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... If the core we destroyed in
the area expanded the Jail...

fields.EN:
If all our operations up to now
were meant to concentrate the
Jail's nutrients in this tower...
fields.JP:
今までの作戦が、ジェイルの養分をこの塔に
集中させるためのものだとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...That means all our missions
simply focused the power from
the cores to this tower.

fields.EN:
If so, what are the cores in the
lower level and the one here for?
fields.JP:
下層にあった核とこの核は、いったい何のために
あるのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, what are the cores in the
lower level and the one here for?

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, wasn't the
Tower high enough for us to
escape?
fields.JP:
そういえば、脱出できる高さには成長したはず
なんですよね～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, wasn't the
Tower high enough for us to
escape?

fields.EN:
Well, it isn't surprising to find
integral parts of the Jail here,
too.
fields.JP:
まあ……各主要箇所に生体としての主要パーツが
存在するのは、不思議ではないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it isn't surprising to find
integral parts of the Jail here,
too.

fields.EN:
W-Wait a minute! You're making
it sound like this place is going
to grow again!
fields.JP:
そ……それじゃ、まだ成長する気じゃない
でしょうね！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait a minute! You're making
it sound like this place is going
to grow again!

fields.EN:
Well, not that we'd know since
we can't communicate with the
Jail.
fields.JP:
そればかりはジェイル本体にでも聞いてみないと
わからないんじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, not that we'd know since
we can't communicate with the
Jail.

fields.EN:
Oh? Come to think of it, we have
someone here who understands the
Jail. Isn't that right, Jack?
fields.JP:
あら？　でもジェイルの気持ちがわかる人なら
いるわよ。ねえ、ジャック？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Come to think of it, we have
someone here who understands the
Jail. Isn't that right, Jack?

fields.EN:
It's not like I can communicate
with it... All I can do is sort of
tell what it's feeling...
fields.JP:
僕は……何となく気持ちがわかるだけで、別に
会話なんかができるわけじゃないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like I can communicate
with it... All I can do is sort of
tell what it's feeling...

fields.EN:
(What the...? I can't feel the
Jail's fear or hear its wailing...
This emotion I'm picking up is...)
fields.JP:
（どうしてなんだろう……
　いつもみたいにジェイルが怯えてない。
　ジェイルから伝わってくるこの感情は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What the...? I can't feel the
Jail's fear or hear its wailing...
This emotion I'm picking up is...)

fields.EN:
I sense... joy from the Jail.
Extreme joy...
fields.JP:
ジェイルから……喜びみたいなものを
感じるんだ……それも、すごく嬉しそうな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sense... joy from the Jail.
Extreme joy...

fields.EN:
Does the Jail want its cores to
be destroyed?
fields.JP: ジェイルは核を破壊されたい、のかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does the Jail want its cores to
be destroyed?

fields.JP: オオオォォォォォオオオオオオ！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Looks like it's
answering you, Jack.
fields.JP: ふふ……ジャックの言葉に答えてるみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Looks like it's
answering you, Jack.

fields.EN: S-Stop it! You're creeping me out.
fields.JP: や……やめなさいよ！　気持ち悪いわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: S-Stop it! You're creeping me out.

fields.JP: うん……なんだか不気味だ……

fields.EN:
(I don't want the sound bothering
me, so I'd better put the
headphones on.)
fields.JP:
（気が散るといけないし……ヘッドホンを
　付けておこう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't want the sound bothering
me, so I'd better put the
headphones on.)

fields.EN:
But if the core is here, then
there should be a guardian and
Nightmare here, too.
fields.JP:
でも……ここに核があるってことは、守護者の
メルヒェンもナイトメアもいるってことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if the core is here, then
there should be a guardian and
Nightmare here, too.

fields.EN:
And if we don't beat them, we
can't continue our search for the
others here.
fields.JP:
そいつらを倒さなきゃ、僕らは先へ進めないし、
ここに来てるはずの人たちも探せない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if we don't beat them, we
can't continue our search for the
others here.

fields.EN:
Yup. Not like thinking will get us
anywhere now. Let's just smash
that core!
fields.JP:
……だね。
どうせいま考えたって何もわかんないんだし、
今は核をやることを考えよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Not like thinking will get us
anywhere now. Let's just smash
that core!

fields.EN:
I feel like Akazukin isn't
really thinking this through, but
I guess there's no other choice.
fields.JP:
いろいろすっ飛ばしてる気がするのが赤ずきん
らしいですが、たしかにこの際、仕方ないです～
やるしかないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like Red Riding Hood isn't
really thinking this through, but
I guess there's no other choice.

fields.EN:
Hmph! We'll just get rid of
whatever guardian is here, and
smash that core to pieces!
fields.JP:
フン。とっととここの番人とやらを倒して、
コイツをぶっ壊すわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! We'll just get rid of
whatever guardian is here, and
smash that core to pieces!

fields.EN:
Okay, is everyone ready? Let's do
this!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、みんな準備はいい？
……行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, is everyone ready? Let's do
this!

fields.EN: Hah! Nothing to it! Now, then...
fields.JP:
ハッ！　大したことなかったわね。
さあて、お次は……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hah! Nothing to it! Now, then...

fields.EN:
Heh... I shall end its misery in a
single stroke.
fields.JP: フッ……我が一撃のもとに屠ってみせよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I shall end its misery in a
single stroke.

fields.JP:
ラプラプ……
一体どうしたんですの？
あれ！　こあからなんかでてる！！

fields.EN:
Huh?! Wh-What the...?! Vines...
Or are they tentacles...?
fields.JP:
……え！？
な、何ですの……これ……！！
ツタみたいなものがニョロニョロと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Wh-What the...?! Vines...
Or are they tentacles...?

fields.EN:
The core... is eating the
Marchen?!
fields.JP: 核が……メルヒェンを……食べてる！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The core... is eating the
Marchen?!

fields.EN:
This may be a function unique to this
tower, something the other cores never had.
fields.JP:
これは……今までの核にはなかった、
この塔特有の機能なのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's a special
function specific to that core.

fields.EN:
What is it trying to do by
absorbing the Marchen that was guarding it?
fields.JP:
自分を守護していたメルヒェンを吸収して、
何をしようというのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's absoring the Marchen
that was guarding it... for
nourishment.

fields.EN:
In any case, we should stand back
until the core's done moving..
fields.JP:
ともかく……核の動きが収まるまで、
離れていた方がよさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, we should stand back
until the core's done moving..

fields.JP: おおー。たべおわったー！

fields.EN: Hey, Aka-Aka? Can we break it now?
fields.JP:
ねーあかあか。
もうこいつこわしていいー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Reddy? Can we break it now?

fields.JP: （……完全に動きがおさまったみたいだ……）

fields.EN:
I'm actually interested in seeing
what will happen after it's
destroyed.
fields.JP:
これを壊したら、何が起こるのか……
とても興味深いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm actually interested in seeing
what will happen after it's
destroyed.

fields.EN:
Okay then! Let's smash that core,
but be careful!
fields.JP:
……よし！　核をやろう！
みんな、慎重にね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay then! Let's smash that core,
but be careful!

fields.EN:
There is no means for it to stand
against my divine movements!
fields.JP: ワレの神速の攻撃に……抗う術なし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is no means for it to stand
against my divine movements!

fields.JP: アアァァァァァアアア……！
アアアァァァァァアアアアア……！！

fields.EN:
Wh-Wh-What's going on?! Why
does it shake so?!
fields.JP: なな何事ぞ！？　地面が揺れておるぞ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Wh-What's going on?! Why
does it shake so?!

fields.EN:
It looks like the Tower is growing
again...
fields.JP: ええ、塔がまた成長しているのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like the Tower is growing
again...

fields.EN:
What's going to happen if it keeps
growing?!
fields.JP: これ以上伸びたら、何が起きるんだろう……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's going to happen if it keeps
growing?!

fields.JP: 何が起きたって……いいじゃない！

fields.EN:
That's right! We already know what
we have to do!
fields.JP:
そうですよ！
白雪たちのやることは決まってます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! We already know what
we have to do!

fields.JP: ……ジャック！　ナイトメアよ！
ヴォオアァァアァアア……！

fields.EN: Yes, we've been waiting for you!
fields.JP: ええ。お待ちしてましてよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, we've been waiting for you!

fields.EN:
What a chore... Let's hurry up and
get rid of it already.
fields.JP: 面倒くさい奴……とっとと片付けましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a chore... Let's hurry up and
get rid of it already.

fields.EN:
Hmph! You don't need to tell us,
Princess Lazy!
fields.JP: フン！　グータラ姫に言われるまでもないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! You don't need to tell us,
Princess Lazy!

fields.JP: ヴォオアァァアァアア……！

fields.EN:
Okay! Let's do this! We're not
gonna lose to you!
fields.JP:
よし！　迎え討つよ！
あたしたちが、お前なんかに負けるかっての！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Let's do this! We're not
gonna lose to you!

fields.EN: We did it! Just a little more...!
fields.LOCALIZED: We did it! Just a little more...!

fields.EN:
A little more... Just a little
more!
fields.JP: もう少しよ……もう少しで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A little more... Just a little
more!

fields.EN:
So, trembling in fear of my
absolute power, are yule...
fields.JP: 我が武力の前に怖気じゅいた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, trembling in fear of my
absolute power, are yule...

fields.JP: とっとと死にやがれです～

fields.EN:
Yes, it's time to put an end to
it!
fields.JP: ええ！　行けましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it's time to put an end to
it!

fields.JP: ヴォォォォアァァアァアア……！

fields.EN:
That's right! We need to find the
followers!
fields.JP: そうですわ！　信者の皆さんを……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! We need to find the
followers!

fields.EN:
But, isn't this the top floor? I
don't see any of them around.
fields.JP:
でも、ここが最上階なんでしょ？
信者なんて見あたらないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, isn't this the top floor? I
don't see any of them around.

fields.JP: さっきまで、あんなのなかったです～

fields.EN:
It looks like the Tower grew
another floor.
fields.JP:
どうやら、塔が成長したことでさらに上の階が
できたようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like the Tower grew
another floor.

fields.EN: Yes, and... I bet Snark is there.
fields.JP:
ええ。
そして……多分、スナークもそこにいるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, and... I bet Snark is there.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルが、ばりばりたべちゃうよ！

fields.EN: End this, once and for all...
fields.LOCALIZED: End this, once and for all...

fields.EN:
I'm going to scold it with all I
have, then...!
fields.JP:
わたくし、そいつを思いっきり罵倒して
やりますのよ。そして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to scold it with all I
have, then...!

fields.JP: シンデレラは少し肩の力を抜くといいです～

fields.EN: Heh, heh. Are you ready, Akazukin?
fields.JP:
……ふふ。
赤ずきん、あなたはいいのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh. Are you ready, Red
Riding Hood?

fields.EN:
Yup. There's nothing holding me
back now.
fields.JP: うん。怖がることなんて、何もないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. There's nothing holding me
back now.

fields.JP: このあたりにはいないようね……

ミチル……！
それにちーも……

fields.EN:
Thank goodness. Looks like
everyone's safe.
fields.JP:
みんな無事みたいね。
よかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness. Looks like
everyone's safe.

fields.EN:
You all disappeared suddenly, so
we came by the Tower to check.
fields.JP:
あなたたちが急にいなくなったから
塔の近くまで様子を見に来たのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You all disappeared suddenly, so
we came by the Tower to check.

fields.EN:
Then we saw the followers climbing
the Tower with some Marchens, and
went into full alert.
fields.JP:
タイヨウの信者がメルヒェンどもと一緒に
塔を昇ってくのを見てな。只事じゃねえって
話になったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we saw the followers climbing
the Tower with some Marchens, and
went into full alert.

fields.EN:
We decided to follow them, and
that's when we met Michiru-san and
the others.
fields.JP:
それで後を追っていたら、ミチルさんたちと
会ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We decided to follow them, and
that's when we met these two.

fields.EN:
(Michiru and Chiaki went in by
themselves?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Michiru and Chiaki went in by
themselves?)

fields.EN:
Haru-kun and the others found me while
I was following the followers
entering the Tower.
fields.JP:
私は、信者を追って塔に来ていたところを
ハルくんたちに拾われてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru and the others found me while
I was following the followers
entering the Tower.

fields.EN:
Wait... The Marchens were with the
followers?
fields.JP: ……メルヒェンが、信者の人たちと一緒に？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... The Marchens were with the
followers?

fields.EN:
They told me they saw my sister leading
the Marchens and the cultists up this tower...
fields.JP:
それが、姉さんがメルヒェンと教団員を率いて
この塔を昇っているのを見たと言われてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, my sister said that she saw
the followers and Marchens going
up the Tower together.

fields.JP: どうも話が噛み合わないんだ

fields.EN:
I couldn't see their faces very
well, but I'm pretty sure that was
Michiru-san.
fields.JP:
顔は見えなかったけれど、あれは間違いなく
ミチルさんだったと思うのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't see their faces very
well, but I'm pretty sure that was
Michiru.

fields.EN:
That's impossible. She was with me
all along.
fields.JP:
姉さんはずっと僕といたんです。
そんなことはありえませんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's impossible. She was with me
all along.

fields.EN:
In any case, it's fortunate that
we were all able to meet here.
fields.JP: まあしかし、こうして全員が会えてよかった。
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, it's fortunate that
we were all able to meet here.

fields.EN:
I-I suppose. With all the Marchens
around, it's good that everyone's
safe.
fields.JP:
そ、そうですよね。塔の中にはメルヒェンが
たくさんいるのに、みんな無事だった
だけでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I suppose. With all the Marchens
around, it's good that everyone's
safe.

fields.EN:
Like Shirayukihime said, the Tower
is filled with Marchens...
fields.JP:
白雪姫の言うとおり、この塔はメルヒェンで
いっぱいだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like Snow White said, the Tower
is filled with Marchens...

fields.EN:
If so, how did everyone make it
here without being attacked?
fields.JP:
それなのに、なぜみんなはメルヒェンに
襲われずにここまで来れたんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, how did everyone make it
here without being attacked?

fields.EN:
I would assume evaluating what
Snark's goals are would answer
that query.
fields.JP:
それは……スナークの目的がどこにあるのかを
考えれば、おのずと答えが出るのでは
ないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would assume evaluating what
Snark's goals are would answer
that query.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Why did we, Michiru, and the
members of the Dawn come to this
tower?
fields.JP:
私たちやミチルたち、そして黎明のひとたちが
この塔に来たのはなぜだったかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did we, Michiru, and the
members of the Dawn come to this
tower?

fields.EN:
(That's because everyone came
after the followers who went up
this tower...)
fields.JP:
（それは、信者のひとたちがこの塔を昇った
　からだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's because everyone came
after the followers who went up
this tower...)

fields.EN:
(We destroyed the cores along the
way, and the Jail emitted a sound
of joy...)
fields.JP:
（そして、それを追ってきた僕らが
　核を全部壊したことで、ジェイルが喜びの
　声を上げた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We destroyed the cores along the
way, and the Jail emitted a sound
of joy...)

fields.EN:
(I see... If both of them were
needed to attain Snark's goals,
then...)
fields.JP:
（そうか……この二つがスナークの目的に
　必要な要素だったとしたら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... If both of them were
needed to attain Snark's goals,
then...)

fields.EN:
(No... What if nothing besides
those two was ever needed...?)
fields.JP:
（いや……むしろこの二つ以外には
　必要なかったんだとしたら……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... What if those two were the
goals that Snark wanted?)

fields.EN:
Now that Snark's achieved its
goal, it doesn't care about
anything else...?
fields.JP:
目的を叶えるための条件がそろった今……
その他はどうでも……よかった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that Snark's achieved its
goal, it doesn't care about
anything else...?

fields.EN:
Splendid, Jack. In that case,
there's only one thing to do.
fields.JP:
すばらしいわ、ジャック。
……ならば、なすべきことは一つね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Splendid, Jack. In that case,
there's only one thing to do.

fields.EN:
...Right. The time has finally come to uncover
the truth. For us, and for everyone here.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
とうとう真実を突き止める時が来たんだ。
僕らにとっても、ここにいるみんなにとっても
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It's time for us to
discover the truth that we've been
looking for.

fields.JP: 真実とは……どういうことかね？

fields.EN:
Too many things have been strange up to
now... So we started thinking: this escape
plan isn't what we were told it was.
fields.JP:
いままで、おかしなことが多すぎた……
だから、僕たち、考えたんです。
この脱出計画は、聞いていた通りのものじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
There have been too many odd
events until now. We figured that
the escape plan was just a ruse.

fields.EN:
There's probably a traitor among
us. And that traitor is using the
escape plan for their own goals.
fields.JP:
きっとこの中に裏切り者がいる。
そして脱出計画の裏で、そいつの目的が同時に
進行してるんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's probably a traitor among
us. And that traitor is using the
escape plan for their own goals.

fields.EN:
What's on the surface isn't always
the truth, just like our
existences.
fields.JP:
表面に見えてるものが、必ずしも真実な
わけじゃない。
……私たちの存在がそうであったようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's on the surface isn't always
the truth, just like our
existences.

fields.EN:
Your existences? What are you
talking about?
fields.JP:
あなたたちの存在が……？
一体どういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your existences? What are you
talking about?

fields.EN:
Hehe. You're all such strong
little bird-sans, after all.
fields.JP: ふふ。みんなはやっぱり、強い小鳥さんたちね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh. You're all strong little
birdies.

fields.EN: We really didn't want to notice...
fields.JP:
できることなら……気づかずにいたかった
です……
fields.LOCALIZED: We really didn't want to notice...

fields.EN:
But, we also needed to know the
truth...
fields.JP: でも……見据えなきゃいけないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we also needed to know the
truth...

fields.EN:
I may be a newcomer, but I
won't tolerate lies or broken promises!
fields.JP: ワレは新参者だが、嘘と違えた約束は許せんぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am still new here, but I will
not accept lies!

fields.EN:
I'm ready to go back to taking
things easy, which is why I want
to finish this up soon.
fields.JP:
わらわは楽をしたいです。
だから、面倒なことはさっさと終わらせたい
です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm ready to go back to taking
things easy, which is why I want
to finish this up soon.

fields.EN:
I'm simply tired of fooling others
and being fooled.
fields.JP: わたくし、騙すのも騙されるのももう沢山ですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm simply tired of fooling others
and being fooled.

fields.EN:
Yes... I don't mind using others,
but I won't stand being used by
them.
fields.JP:
……そうね。利用はしても、利用されるのは
まっぴらよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I don't mind using others,
but I won't stand being used by
them.

fields.EN:
We have a traitor here, and that's
probably who this Snark is!
fields.JP:
……裏切り者は僕らの中にいる。
そして……多分、そいつこそがスナークなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have a traitor here, and that's
probably who this Snark is!

fields.EN: Oh? So, Snark is amongst us?
fields.JP: ほう……つまり、スナークがここにいると……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? So, Snark is amongst us?

fields.EN:
Yes. Snark was watching us and the
Jail while communicating with the
Nightmares.
fields.JP:
はい。スナークは、常に僕らとジェイルを監視
しながらナイトメアとも連絡を取り合っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Snark was watching us and the
Jail while communicating with the
Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Despite our reservations, we
believed in the escape plan and
continued with our missions.
fields.JP:
そして僕らはどこか違和感を感じながらも、
この計画はジェイルから脱出するためのものだと
信じて行動し続けたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite our reservations, we
believed in the escape plan and
continued with our missions.

fields.EN:
And all the while, there was a
different plan in the works...
fields.JP: この計画に別の意味があるとは気づかずに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And all the while, there was a
different plan in the works...

fields.EN:
Until now, yes. But at last, we
have enough information to catch Snark.
fields.JP:
これまではそうね。でもようやく、スナークを
捕らえるための情報が揃ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Things wouldn't have changed if
it weren't for the information we
gathered to detain Snark.

fields.EN:
That's why we want to find the
truth, and have every one of us
escape here alive.
fields.JP:
だから……真実を突き止めて、みんなでここを
出よう。ここにいる人たちも、僕たちも……
できれば全員そろって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we want to find the
truth, and have every one of us
escape here alive.

fields.JP: 『ここ』ってのは、ジェイルのことか？

fields.EN:
From this absurd story. Everyone
here knows we must have wandered
into some strange story.
fields.JP:
この、でたらめな物語の中からです。
みんなもわかってる筈です。何かおかしな
物語の中に迷い込んでしまったって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
From this absurd story. Everyone
here knows we must have wandered
into some strange story.

fields.EN:
A story is complete when the book
is closed. That's why we need to
end this one.
fields.JP:
物語とは閉じて初めて完成するものだもの。
だからわたしたちは、この物語を終わらせ
なければ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A story is complete when the book
is closed. That's why we need to
end this one.

fields.EN:
...All the players are here. Let's
hunt Snark and bring this story to an end.
fields.JP:
……役者は全て揃ったわ。
スナークを狩りましょう。物語を終えるために
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the characters are here now.
All that's left is for us to
discover Snark and end it.

fields.EN: But then, who is this traitor?
fields.JP: でもそれじゃあ……誰が裏切り者だというの？
fields.LOCALIZED: But then, who is this traitor?

fields.EN:
You say it. You're the existence
that possesses the strongest will
to end this story.
fields.JP:
あなたが話すといいわ。
何故なら、あなたが物語を終える意志を
最も強く持つ存在だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You say it. You're the existence
that possesses the strongest will
to end this story.

fields.EN: Yes. All of us feel the same way you do.
fields.JP: ええ。私たちの気持ちは、あなたと一つよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. My feelings are the same as
yours, Jack.

fields.EN: We won't get in your way.
fields.JP: わらわたちは、話の邪魔をしませんから～
fields.LOCALIZED: We won't get in your way.

fields.JP: さっさとカタをつけちゃいなさい！

じゃあ、僕の考えだけど……
『裏切り者』は……
タイヨウ教団の中にいる
タイヨウ教団の中にいる

fields.EN:
I... didn't want to believe it,
but I think it's someone in the
Dawn.
fields.JP:
考えたくなかったけど……ここにいる
黎明の中の誰かだと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... didn't want to believe it,
but I think it's someone in the
Dawn.

fields.EN: You mean one of them here?
fields.JP: 黎明の……この人たちの中の誰かだって？
fields.LOCALIZED: You mean one of them here?

fields.EN:
Yes... The people of Dawn are the
ones who know the escape plan and
the Jail's ecology inside and out.
fields.JP:
はい……脱出計画の内容とジェイルの生態を
熟知しているのは、黎明の人たちですから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Only those in the Dawn knew
about the escape plan and what the
Jail is.

fields.EN:
It makes sense that someone in the
Dawn would pull the strings to 
manipulate the plan.
fields.JP:
計画を操作するなら、黎明の中にいるのが
一番効率的だと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
It makes sense that someone in the
Dawn would pull the strings to 
manipulate the plan.

fields.EN: So then, who is this traitor?
fields.JP: それなら、裏切り者……スナークは、誰？
fields.LOCALIZED: So then, who is this traitor?

fields.EN: Me?! Where'd you get that from?
fields.LOCALIZED: Me?! Where'd you get that from?

fields.EN:
I didn't want to believe it,
but...
fields.JP:
僕も……
こんな結論は出したくありませんでした。
……でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to believe it,
but...

fields.EN:
Haru-san, you had our clothes ready
when we first came, right? Even
without knowing us...
fields.JP:
ハルさんは、僕ら新入りが加わった時、
この服を用意してくれましたよね？
それも……すぐに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You had our clothes ready when we
first came, right? Even without
knowing us...

fields.EN: Uh, Jack? The hell are you saying?
fields.JP: ジャック。何が言いたいんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, Jack? The hell are you saying?

fields.EN:
It bothered me... It happened with
Alice, and then with Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
どうしても引っかかったんです。
アリスの時……それにラプンツェルの時も
fields.LOCALIZED:
It bothered me... It happened with
Alice, and then with Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
By the morning after Alice and I arrived
at Dawn, our clothes were prepared—special
ones with defensive functions...
fields.JP:
僕らが黎明に来た次の日の朝に、もう
僕とアリスの服が用意されていました。
しかも、防御機能を持つ特別な服が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The clothes were also treated with
special defensive functions for
us.

fields.EN:
The clothes for Rapunzel matched
her perfectly, despite your claim
that they were Oyayubihime's.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルに至っては、間に合わせとして
用意してくれた服が何もかもぴったりだった。
親指姫の服のスペアだって言ってたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The clothes for Rapunzel matched
her perfectly, despite your claim
that they were Thumbelina's.

fields.EN:
It was as if you already knew
ahead of time that Rapunzel was
going to join us...
fields.JP:
はじめから……ラプンツェルが来るのが
わかってたみたいに
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was as if you already knew
ahead of time that Rapunzel was
going to join us...

fields.EN: Yup! It was perfect for Rapunzel!
fields.JP: うん。ラプンツェルにぴったりだったー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! It was perfect for Rapunzel!

fields.EN:
That was when I became certain
you were suspicious, Haru-san...
fields.JP:
ハルさんが決定的に怪しいと思ったのは、
その時でした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was when you became my
primary suspect...

fields.EN:
And those huge eyes out there have
something to do with the Dawn's
control room, right?
fields.JP:
独房エリアにある巨大な『眼』……
黎明にあるモニター室と関係があるんじゃ
ないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And those huge eyes out there have
something to do with the Dawn's
control room, right?

fields.JP: お前ら……あれを知ってたのか……

fields.EN:
You can tell what's going on out
there, right? If so, preparing
our clothes would be easy.
fields.JP:
あれを使えば、独房エリアのことが手に取る
ようにわかりますよね？
それなら、あらかじめ服の用意くらい簡単だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can tell what's going on out
there, right? If so, preparing
our clothes would be easy.

fields.EN:
Well... Adults have their
own circumstances, you know...
fields.JP: いや……まあ、大人にゃいろいろあるんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's just that there are a
lot of things we needed to
prepare...

fields.EN:
There! Again! You keep trying to
avoid telling us the truth, Haru-san!
fields.JP:
ハルさんは、いつもそうやってはぐらかして
ばかりだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There! Again! You keep trying to
avoid telling us the truth, Haru!

fields.EN:
Haru-san, I also heard that, for some reason,
you aren't often targeted by Marchens.
fields.JP:
それに……ハルさんは何故かメルヒェンに
襲われにくいって聞きました
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also heard that, for some
reason, you're not often targeted
by Marchens.

fields.EN:
You avoided the conversation then,
too...
fields.JP: どうしてかは、はぐらかされましたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You avoided the conversation then,
too...

fields.EN:
Haru-san, is that because you're working
with the Jail?
fields.JP:
それは……ハルさんが、ジェイルと通じているから
なんじゃないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because you're working with
the Jail. Isn't that right?

fields.EN:
During our meetings, Haru-san, I felt like
you were covering for the Professor...
fields.JP:
作戦会議の時……何度かハルさんが
博士を庇ってるような気がして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
During our meetings, it felt as if
you were covering for the
Professor.

fields.EN:
Haru-san, if you were the traitor, why would
you cover for the Professor...?
fields.JP:
……ハルさんが裏切者だったとして……
なんで博士を庇うんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you were the traitor, why would
you cover for the Professor?

fields.EN:
Fine... Maybe I am this traitor
you're looking for.
fields.JP: ……確かに俺は『裏切者』なのかもしれねえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... Maybe I am this traitor
you're looking for.

fields.EN:
Well, a traitor to the old man
over there.
fields.JP: ……そこのオッさんにとってはな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, a traitor to the old man
over there.

fields.EN:
The reason I knew all about you
was because I've known him for a
long time.
fields.JP:
俺がお前らの情報をあらかじめ知ってたのも
何もかも、そいつとある意味昔のよしみ
だったからだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The reason I knew all about you
was because I've known him for a
long time.

fields.EN: I also knew the Jail, too.
fields.LOCALIZED: I also knew the Jail, too.

fields.EN:
The Jail?! Who exactly are you,
Haru-san? Professor?
fields.JP:
……ジェイルとも！？
博士やハルさんって、いったい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail?! Who exactly are you,
Haru? Professor?

fields.EN:
We're foreign bodies that came
from somewhere other than this planet.
fields.JP: 俺らはこの星とは別の場所から来た、異物なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're beings that came from a
different plant.

fields.EN:
I've been trying to change the
Professor's mind all this time.
fields.JP:
俺は……最後の最後まで、
博士の考えを変えようと思ってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been trying to change the
Professor's mind all this time.

fields.EN:
In my own way, I kept asking him
whether we couldn't live together
on this planet as it is...
fields.JP:
共に、ありのままのこの星で生きないかと、
俺なりに呼びかけてたんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I tried to tell him that we should
live here like everyone else.

fields.EN:
Professor... You were Blue Bird-san
all along.
fields.JP: 博士……あなたが青い鳥さんだったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're the blue bird then,
Professor.

fields.EN:
Yes... Snark. Boojum. The one who
was controlling me.
fields.JP:
そう……スナーク。ブージャム。
わたしを、操ってたひと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Snark. Boojum. The one who
was controlling me.

fields.EN:
Haru-san... Did you know all along?
That the food Blue Bird-san brings
was safe?
fields.JP:
ハルさん……あなたも知ってたの？
青い鳥さんの運んでくる食べ物が、大丈夫だって
ことを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru... Did you know all along?
That the food the blue bird brings
was safe?

fields.EN:
The food the Professor fed Oohime-san...
so he could control her as he wished.
fields.JP:
博士が大陽女さんに食べさせてた物さ。
……自分の思い通りに操るためにな
fields.LOCALIZED:
The food that the Professor fed to
her, so that he could control her
to do his bidding...

fields.EN:
Don't tell me... He served her
food mimicked by the Jail?
fields.JP: まさか……ジェイルが擬態した食べ物を……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me... He served her
food mimicked by the Jail?

fields.EN:
To clarify, the components of the
Jail don't have any adverse
effects to the human brain.
fields.JP:
だが実のところ、ジェイルの成分にこの星の
人間の脳を破壊する効用なんてないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To clarify, the components of the
Jail don't have any adverse
effects to the human brain.

fields.EN:
You only saw the transformations
humans went through when the Jail
landed on this planet.
fields.JP:
ジェイルがこの星に着床した時点での
人間の変化しか、あんたは見てない筈だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You only saw the transformations
humans went through when the Jail
landed on this planet.

fields.EN:
It had changed before I knew it...
I realized it when I saw the crops
in the Order of the Sun's fields.
fields.JP:
いつのまにか変わっていたのさ……俺は、
タイヨウ教団の畑の作物を見て気づいた
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, things change... I noticed it
when I saw the Order of the Sun's
crops.

fields.EN:
The Jail was adapting to this
planet's environment.
fields.JP: ……ジェイルは適応を進めてたんだ、この星に
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail was adapting to this
planet's environment.

fields.EN:
...It reduced its toxicity to life on this
planet. Now its worst side effects are like a
tranquilizer with little risk of dependence.
fields.JP:
……この星の生物への毒性を弱めたんだよ。
今じゃせいぜい、依存性の少ない精神安定剤
程度の副作用しかもたらさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
It alleviated its negative effect
on the planet's beings. All it can
offer now are calming properties.

fields.EN:
Weird, considering how batty your
Oohime-san became.
fields.JP:
……大陽女さんがおかしくなってたのが
不思議なくらいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Weird, considering how batty your
Lady Oohime became.

fields.EN:
Now then, maybe it's time we end
all this. End this, ever since you
replaced Professor Toojima.
fields.JP:
そろそろ、けじめをつける時なんじゃねえのか？
……十島博士に成り代わった頃からの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, maybe it's time we end
all this. End this, ever since you
replaced Professor Tohjima.

fields.EN: What do you mean...? Dad is...
fields.JP:
それ……どういう意味？
もしかして……お父さんは……
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean...? Dad is...

fields.EN:
The Professor who gave you your
red hood died 15 years ago.
fields.JP:
……お前に、赤いフードを最初に
被せてくれた博士は、十五年前に死んだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor who gave you your
red hood died 15 years ago.

fields.EN:
The Professor died in the tragedy
fifteen years ago...?! Then the
one who killed Sensei was...?!
fields.JP:
博士が……十五年前の惨劇で……！
では『先生』を殺したのも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor died then?! So, the
person who killed my mentor
was...?!

fields.EN:
You knew this all along?! Why
didn't you tell us earlier?!
fields.JP: あなたはそれを知ってて、どうして……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You knew this all along?! Why
didn't you tell us earlier?!

fields.EN:
I'm a traitor. I had changed my
outlook on this since that
tragedy.
fields.JP:
……俺は『裏切者』だって言ったろ。
気が変わったきっかけがそれだったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a traitor. I had changed my
outlook on this since that
tragedy.

fields.EN:
I doubted his efforts to
reconstruct our planet here, even
at the expense of others' lives.
fields.JP:
言い訳にもなりゃしねえが、そこまでして
滅んだ星を再生させてどうする……って思ってな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubted his efforts to
reconstruct our planet here, even
at the expense of others' lives.

fields.EN:
So then... those seeds on your desk,
Haru-san...
fields.JP: じゃあ……ハルさんの机にあった、あの種は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So then the seeds on Haru's
desk...

fields.EN:
Those are seeds from my planet.
Well, they were just in my pocket,
and I couldn't discard them.
fields.JP:
俺の元いた星の植物の種だ。
たまたまポケットに入ってたんでな……
どうしても捨てられなかったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those are seeds from my planet.
Well, they were just in my pocket,
and I couldn't discard them.

fields.EN:
I know his pain, not being able to
protect our planet... That's why I
wanted him to have redemption.
fields.JP:
……こいつの気持ちは痛いほどわかった。
自分の星を守れなかった無念……
だから……贖罪の機会をやりたかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know his pain, not being able to
protect our planet... That's why I
wanted him to have redemption.

fields.EN:
(So that's what Haru-san meant when
he said it's painful not being
able to protect what you wanted.)
fields.JP:
（ハルさんの言ってた、『護りたいものを
　護れないのは、辛いことだからな』って……
　そういう意味だったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So that's what Haru meant when
he said it's painful not being
able to protect what you wanted.)

fields.EN:
(That would also explain why he
went out of his way to make the
Mary Gun for me...)
fields.JP:
（だから……あんなに親身になって、
　メアリガンを造ってくれたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That would also explain why he
went out of his way to make the
Mary Gun for me...)

fields.JP: ……スナーク、今からでも考え直さないか？
視子さん……あなたしか考えられません

fields.EN:
I didn't want to believe it,
but...
fields.JP:
僕も……
こんな結論は出したくありませんでした。
……でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to believe it,
but...

fields.EN:
Miko-san, you understand the
constitutions of us Blood Boys and
the Blood Maidens better than anyone...
fields.JP:
視子さんは僕ら血式少年や血式少女たちの
体質を誰よりもよく知ってるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You knew about me and the Blood
Maidens more than anyone here.

fields.EN:
You also assisted with research
on the Marchens and probably even
on the Jail with the Professor.
fields.JP:
博士のメルヒェン研究を手伝ってる。
それだけじゃなく、きっとジェイル全般の
研究にも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also assisted with research
on the Marchens and probably even
on the Jail with the Professor.

fields.EN:
Because it's research that would inevitably
be useful in the field for me as a doctor.
fields.JP:
それは……医師として、必ず現場に役立つ
研究内容だからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because I needed to attend
to the research as a doctor.

fields.EN:
But Miko-san, it wouldn't be a stretch
to imagine you'd know how to
communicate with the Jail.
fields.JP:
だから……ジェイルと通じる術も、視子さんなら
持っていても不思議じゃない筈です
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it wouldn't be a stretch to
imagine you'd know how to
communicate with the Jail.

fields.EN:
And in your position, Miko-san, it
wouldn't be unusual to be the one
overseeing that control room...
fields.JP:
それに、視子さんの立場なら、
あのモニター室の主でもおかしくないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And with your position, it
wouldn't be unusual to be the one
overseeing that control room...

fields.EN:
Control room? What are you talking
about?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Control room? What are you talking
about?

fields.EN:
Stop acting! You should know,
especially with how often you're
there at the laboratory!
fields.JP:
ご、ごまかさないでください！
普段から研究室に出入りしてる人なら、
注意深く見てれば気が付くはずだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop acting! You should know,
especially with how often you're
there at the laboratory!

fields.EN:
If it's because of that, there are
others who'd know, too. What makes
you think it has to be me?
fields.JP:
でも……複数人が気付くようなものだとしたら、
どうして私がそこの主だと断定できるの？
その論拠は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's because of that, there are
others who'd know, too. What makes
you think it has to be me?

fields.EN:
A control room in the
laboratory... I didn't know there
was one there...
fields.JP:
……注意深く見れば気付く筈のモニター室、ね。
そんなものがあったなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
A control room in the
laboratory... I didn't know there
was one there...

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I only know now
because you told me.
fields.JP: でも残念ながら、私は知らないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I only know now
because you told me.

fields.EN:
I became so caught up in what was right
in front of me that I lost the broader
view... I failed as a researcher, too.
fields.JP:
つい目先の物事に囚われて、広い視野を
持てなかった……研究者としても失格ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I suppose it's my fault as a
researcher for not being keen
enough to observe my environment.

fields.EN:
Now then, if what you said is
true, isn't the Professor also a
suspect to you?
fields.JP:
でもそれを言うなら、あなたが今言ったことは
どれも博士にも当てはまるんじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, if what you said is
true, isn't the Professor also a
suspect to you?

fields.EN:
And if I really were the 'traitor'...
what do you think I would be trying to
accomplish by gathering everyone here?
fields.JP:
そもそも私が『裏切者』だとして……
こんなところにみんなを集めて一体何を
しようとしてるというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if I was this "traitor" like
you said, why would you disclose
that in front of everyone?

fields.EN:
B-But, Miko-san... you didn't report
my blood test results, and you were
always skeptical of the Professor...
fields.JP:
で、でも視子さんは……以前に僕の血を
採血したときも博士に報告してなかったし、
博士の言動に対して、いつも懐疑的で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, you didn't report my blood
test results, and you were always
skeptical of the Professor...

fields.EN:
You also seemed skeptical of our
escape from the Jail...
fields.JP:
ジェイルからの脱出についても、どこか疑いを
持っていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also seemed skeptical of our
escape from the Jail...

fields.EN:
You looked at Michiru-san with doubt,
too...
fields.JP:
ミチルさんのことも、すごく冷ややかに見て
いて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You looked at Michiru with doubt,
too...

fields.EN:
I won't deny any of that. I'm not
the trusting type of person.
fields.JP:
……それは、否定はしないわ。
人を無条件に信じることなんて、私にはできない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't deny any of that. I'm not
the trusting type of person.

fields.EN:
But, that's a normal trait sought
for in researchers.
fields.JP: ……でもそれは、研究者なら当然のことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, that's a normal trait sought
for in researchers.

fields.EN:
I understand that you doubt
everyone here, and that in itself
doesn't bother me.
fields.JP:
……あなたたちが全ての人を疑ってみる
姿勢は当然のことよ。
その点で腹を立てたりはしないわ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand that you doubt
everyone here, and that in itself
doesn't bother me.

fields.EN:
What bothers me is that you didn't
think it out well enough. It could
prove life-threatening, you know?
fields.JP: ただ、詰めが甘ければ命取りになるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What bothers me is that you didn't
think it out well enough. It could
prove life-threatening, you know?

fields.EN: I can agree with that, as well.
fields.LOCALIZED: I can agree with that, as well.

fields.EN:
Then you should've thrown
him a lifeline or something...
fields.JP: だったら、助け舟出すなりなんなりしなさいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, you should've said
something earlier.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Miko-san. I must have
judged you with what I felt,
without any solid facts.
fields.JP:
……すみません、視子さん。
僕は、あなたから受ける感じで、むりやり決め
つけていたのかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Miko. I must have
judged you with what I felt,
without any solid facts.

fields.EN:
And what exactly did you feel
about me?
fields.LOCALIZED:
And what exactly did you feel
about me?

fields.EN:
Maybe he interpreted your
indifferent attitude as a form of
silent aggression toward us.
fields.JP:
視子の冷淡さを、私たちに対する潜在的な敵意だと
感じていた、ということじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe he interpreted your
indifferent attitude as a form of
silent aggression toward us.

fields.EN:
I'm not used to talking about
myself, but...
fields.JP:
……個人的なことを話すのは、あまり慣れて
いないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not used to talking about
myself, but...

fields.EN:
I... adored my teacher, Ueshima-sensei, who
died fifteen years ago, like a mother. Her
spirit of universal love moved me deeply too.
fields.JP:
私は……十五年前に亡くなった『先生』……
上島先生のことを、それこそ母のように慕っていた。
その博愛精神に強く心を打たれてもいたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fifteen years ago, I lost my
mentor, Dr. Ueshima. I saw her as
a mother, and was inspired by her.

fields.EN:
I wanted to become like
her... but I made a mistake.
fields.JP:
彼女のようになりたいと願っていたけど……
間違えてしまったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sought to be like her, but I
must have mistaken her ways...

fields.EN:
I thought that to face everyone
equally, as she did... I had to keep
the same distance from everyone.
fields.JP:
彼女のように全ての人と等しく向き合うには、
……他人と等しく距離を置かねばならないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assumed I needed to see everyone
objectively so that I could treat
them with fairness.

fields.EN:
Ueshima-sensei was warm
