toward everyone, after all...
fields.JP:
上島先生は、
誰に対しても温かな人だったのにね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose Dr. Ueshima was
just equally kind to everyone...

fields.EN:
To be honest, I've been observing
you with interest, Miko.
fields.JP:
視子。正直なところ、あなたのことは興味深く
観察させてもらっていたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, I've been observing
you with interest, Miko.

fields.EN:
You try to behave logically, but you're
actually emotional. That's why your
actions contain so many contradictions...
fields.JP:
論理的に振舞おうとしていながら、実は感情的。
だから、行動に矛盾も多い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You try to act in logic, when you
are really an emotional person. It
explains many of your actions.

fields.EN:
I'm guessing that made Jack
suspect you.
fields.JP:
なによりその点が、ジャックに疑念を抱かせたん
じゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm guessing that made Jack
suspect you.

fields.EN:
I suppose. I have to admit that I
despised any and all things that
went against reason.
fields.JP:
……そうね。それは否めないわね。
理性に逆らうものを無条件で嫌悪してきたと、
そう認めるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose. I have to admit that I
despised any and all things that
went against reason.

fields.EN:
As I worked with the Professor, I
noticed a certain insensitivity in
him toward humanitarian concerns.
fields.JP:
私は……博士と関わる中で、彼の人道性への
ある種の鈍感さに気づいたわ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I noticed something odd with the
Professor's approach toward
humanity while I worked with him.

fields.EN:
I assumed it was simply his nature
as a researcher. No... I tried to
assume that was it.
fields.JP:
……でもそれは、私にもある研究者特有のものだと
思っていた……ううん、思い込もうとしていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assumed it was simply his nature
as a researcher. No... I tried to
assume that was it.

fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団への疑念も同じ……
ミチルという個人を見ようとはせずに、
その背後に何らかの黒幕がいるのだと疑っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
The same way I doubted the Order.
I was suspicious of Michiru for
reasons I couldn't place.

fields.EN:
Like Gretel said, I probably
didn't want to acknowledge the
illogical aspects of my thinking.
fields.JP:
きっと……グレーテルが看破した通り、
自分の理性的ではない部分を直視したくなかった
のね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like Gretel said, I probably
didn't want to acknowledge the
illogical aspects of my thinking.

fields.EN:
Um... Miko-san, why didn't you disclose
your doubts with everyone earlier?
fields.JP:
あの……視子さんはどうして、
自分の持つ疑いを誰にも言わなかったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Why didn't you disclose your
doubts with everyone earlier?

fields.EN:
...As a researcher, I was curious
to see the results of the Jail's
growth.
fields.JP:
ジェイルが成長した結果をこの目で確認したい
という、研究者としての興味があったのは事実よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...As a researcher, I was curious
to see the results of the Jail's
growth.

fields.EN:
...But really, until we learned what
they were after and reached a firm
answer, there was nothing we could do...
fields.JP:
……でも本当は、
疑念の対象の目的を探り、決定的な回答を
出すまで何も打つ手が無い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I allowed myself to have these
doubts without looking for an
answer to them.

fields.EN:
Or rather, I found reasons to not
take action.
fields.JP: 手を打つべきではないと考えていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or rather, I found reasons to not
take action.

fields.EN:
As the person carrying on Ueshima-sensei's
work... I wanted to fulfill the cherished
wish of the people who died back then.
fields.JP:
私は……上島先生を継ぐ人間として、あの時
亡くなった人たちの悲願を叶えたかった。
fields.LOCALIZED:
As someone picking up where
Dr. Ueshima left off, I wanted to
fulfill her wishes.

fields.EN:
But being too careful prevented me
from acting on my doubts...
fields.JP:
でも慎重を期するあまり、疑念に対する行動に
踏み切れなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But being too careful prevented me
from acting on my doubts...

fields.EN:
...Deep down, I hated death itself for taking
Ueshima-sensei and the others... and I was
afraid I'd be consumed by those feelings...
fields.JP:
……きっと私の中では、上島先生たちを奪った
死をとても憎んでいて……そんな自分の感情に
呑まれるのを怖れていたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Deep down, I wanted to hate the
Doctor's murderer. But I feared
being consumed by such emotions.

fields.EN:
That's probably why I kept turning
a blind eye, even though I wanted
to see what was going on.
fields.JP:
だから、全てをこの目で見ようとしていながら、
目を背けていたんだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's probably why I kept turning
a blind eye, even though I wanted
to see what was going on.

fields.EN:
I suppose now is the time for me
to take action...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose now is the time for me
to take action...

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: それは……どういう意味かね？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
You may not know, but I have a
picture...
fields.JP:
あなたは知らないでしょうけど、
私は……一枚の写真を持っているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may not know, but I have a
picture...

fields.EN:
When I was a child, I wanted a photo
of Ueshima-sensei so badly that I
begged until they gave me one.
fields.JP:
子供の頃、上島先生の写真がどうしても
欲しくて、無理に頼み込んでもらったものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I was a child, I begged to
get a picture of Dr. Ueshima.

fields.EN:
The picture is a picture of the
Dawn's primary members 15 years
ago.
fields.JP:
それは、古ぼけた記念写真。
十五年前、黎明幹部で撮った……ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The picture is a picture of the
Dawn's primary members 15 years
ago.

fields.EN:
I didn't know you had something
like that...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you had something
like that...

fields.EN:
The people in it are "Sensei,"
"Mother," "Master," "Captain"...
and one man I don't know.
fields.JP:
写っているのは、
『先生』『お母さん』『棟梁』『隊長』
……そして、私の知らない男性が一人。
fields.LOCALIZED:
In there is a picture of the
Doctor, Mother, chief, leader, and...
one other I didn't know...

fields.EN:
I've never met that person before,
but I believe that was Professor
Toojima.
fields.JP:
私は会ったことがなかったけれど……
恐らくそれが……十島博士
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never met that person before,
but I believe that was Professor
Tohjima.

fields.EN:
If so, you don't look like the
person in the picture.
fields.JP: でもその姿は、あなたではなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, you don't look like the
person in the picture.

fields.EN:
I've kept that thought to myself,
and never said a word...
fields.JP:
ずっと……心に抱えていたけど……
口には出せなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've kept that thought to myself,
and never said a word...

fields.EN:
I'm glad you had the intelligence
to stay silent, Miko-kun.
fields.JP:
君が沈黙するだけの知性の持ち主で良かったよ。
視子くん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you had the intelligence
to stay silent, Miko.

fields.EN:
If you took the Professor's place in the
tragedy fifteen years ago... then you
were the one who killed Ueshima-sensei.
fields.JP:
十五年前の惨劇であなたが博士と成り代わった
のだとしたら……上島先生を殺したのは、
あなたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you replaced the Professor 15
years ago, then you must have been
the one who killed Dr. Ueshima.

fields.EN:
If only I had the courage to kill
you...
fields.JP:
私に……
あなたを殺すだけの勇気があったなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I had the courage to kill
you...

fields.EN:
The emotion called
'reason' is a troublesome thing.
fields.JP: 理性という名の感情とは、厄介なものだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
How troublesome to have logic
exercise control over your
emotions.

fields.EN:
Still, your intelligence is
beneficial to us. But I couldn't
care less what your plans are.
fields.JP:
それでも……あなたの頭脳は有益なものよ。
何を目論んでいるのかはどうでもいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, your intelligence is
beneficial to us. But I couldn't
care less what your plans are.

fields.EN:
If you're willing to change your
ways and head down the right
path, then...
fields.JP: ……今からでもそれを、正しい方向に活かすなら
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're willing to change your
ways and head down the right
path, then...

fields.EN:
I wonder what the right path truly
is...
fields.JP: ……正しい方向とは、何だろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what the right path truly
is...

fields.EN:
...The Order of the Sun. I believe
it's either Michiru-san or Chiaki-san.
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団……ミチルさんか千昭さん
なんじゃないかと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
...The Order of the Sun. I believe
it's either Michiru or Chiaki.

fields.EN:
You're accusing us for being
traitors? What brings you to that
thought?
fields.JP:
僕らが……裏切者だというのかい？
いったい、何故……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're accusing us for being
traitors? What brings you to that
thought?

fields.EN:
I didn't want to believe it,
but...
fields.JP:
僕も……
こんな結論は出したくありませんでした。
……でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to believe it,
but...

fields.EN:
Why did you create the Order of
the Sun, Michiru-san?
fields.JP:
ミチルさんは、なぜタイヨウ教団を
作ったんでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did you create the Order of
the Sun, Michiru?

fields.EN:
Why did you go so far as to proselytize
in the Solitary Confinement Area
just to increase your followers...?
fields.JP:
なぜ独房エリアに行って布教してまで、
信者を増やそうとしていたんでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did you try to expand your
missions out to the different
areas?

fields.EN:
That's to bring salvation by the
sun to...
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's to bring salvation by the
sun to...

fields.EN:
Didn't you have a separate motive
for wanting to expand the Order of
the Sun?
fields.JP:
本当は何か別の目的があって、そのために
教団を大きくしたんじゃないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't you have a separate motive
for wanting to expand the Order of
the Sun?

fields.EN:
The very believers of which are
currently in this tower.
fields.JP: そして信者の人たちは今、この塔にいる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The very believers of which are
currently in this tower.

fields.EN:
Chiaki-san, I also believe you would
do anything to help Michiru-san.
fields.JP:
それに、千昭さんは……ミチルさんを助ける
ためなら、きっと何でもする人だと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chiaki, I also believe you would
do anything to help Michiru.

fields.EN:
Even if it meant standing up
against every other person in the
world...
fields.JP:
たとえ……それが人類全てを敵に回すことで
あっても
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if it meant standing up
against every other person in the
world...

fields.EN:
I won't deny that. But, there's no
way to save my sister.
fields.JP:
……それは否定しないよ。
でも、姉を救う術などないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't deny that. But, there's no
way to save my sister.

fields.EN:
Chiaki. I'm fine. You don't need
to save me.
fields.JP:
千昭。もう大丈夫。
救う必要なんてなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chiaki. I'm fine. You don't need
to save me.

fields.EN:
I'm still the same sister you knew
before. Of course, I didn't notice
it myself, either.
fields.JP:
わたし、ずっとあなたが知ってるわたしの
ままだったの。
自分でも気づかなかったけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still the same sister you knew
before. Of course, I didn't notice
it myself, either.

fields.EN:
I caught Blue Bird-san. I don't
need mimicry any more.
fields.JP:
青い鳥さんは捕まえたもの。
もう、擬態はいらないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I caught the blue bird. I don't
need mimicry any more.

fields.JP:
擬態……ですって？
どういうこと……？

fields.EN:
What were once a boy and a girl. The
Jail's seed swallowed them both and
gave shape to the girl's feelings...
fields.JP:
かつて少年と少女であったもの。
ジェイルの種は二人を呑み込み、
少女の想いを形造った……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's seed consumed what was
once a boy and a girl, and granted
the girl her desires.

fields.EN:
A yearning for the sun. An affirmation
of the world. And the strong desire to
remain older sister and younger brother...
fields.JP:
陽を乞い願う想い。世界への肯定。
そして姉と弟であり続けようとする
強い想い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She sought the sun. The world.
For the boy and the girl to be
siblings forever.

fields.JP: わたしたち……あの時に死んでいたのね

fields.EN:
The Jail's seed revived me, and
you as well, along with my desire.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの種がわたしを蘇らせたの。
そして、わたしの想いに引っ張られて、
あなたも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's seed revived me, and
you as well, along with my desire.

fields.EN:
Michiru-san... Are you saying the Jail
mimicked you and the others, and you
were revived as reincarnated forms...?
fields.JP:
ミチルさんたちは……ジェイルに擬態
させられて転生体として蘇ったって……
……そういうことなんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're telling us that both of
you were mimicked and revived by
the Jail in reincarnated forms?

fields.EN: This is a story of the beginning.
fields.LOCALIZED: This is a story of the beginning.

fields.EN:
The seed fell onto the storybook
I was reading, and rooted itself,
creating from it the new world.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの種は、
わたしが読んでた絵本の上に落ちて、
……そしてこの世界に根付いたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The seed fell onto the storybook
I was reading, and rooted itself,
creating from it the new world.

fields.EN:
The place where all ends and all
begins. Everyone in the preschool
died with us.
fields.JP:
全てが終わり、全てが始まった場所……
幼稚園にいた人たちは、わたしたちも含めて
その時に死んでしまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place where all ends and all
begins. Everyone in the preschool
died with us.

fields.EN:
I am who I was back then, and also
the dreams of all of the children.
fields.JP:
今のわたしは、かつてわたしだったものと、
そこにいた子供たちの夢みたいなもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am who I was back then, and also
the dreams of all of the children.

fields.EN:
And, I was probably the first to
revive. Which is why I was special
to you...
fields.JP:
そして多分、最初に蘇った存在……
だからあなたにとって、特別だったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I was probably the first to
revive. Which is why I was special
to you...

fields.EN:
Isn't that right, Blue Bird-san? No...
Professor?
fields.JP: そうでしょ、青い鳥さん……いいえ、博士
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't that right, blue bird? No...
Professor?

fields.EN:
What are you talking about, Lady
Oohime-san?
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking about, Lady
Oohime?

fields.EN:
It seems I had been
pretending to have gone mad.
fields.JP: わたし、おかしくなってたふりをしてたみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seemed easier to act as if I
lost my sanity.

fields.JP: おかしくなってた、ふり……？

fields.EN:
I received the kind of thoughts Blue
Bird-san wanted from me... and mimicked
them without even realizing it.
fields.JP:
青い鳥さんの期待する想いを受けて……
自分でも気づかないうちに擬態してたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
To mimic the expectations the blue
bird had for me.

fields.EN:
As for the food you gave me... It
had no effect.
fields.JP:
あなたのくれた食べ物には……
なんの効果もなかったのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for the food you gave me... It
had no effect.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Chiaki. I keep bringing
you pain.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、千昭。
わたし、あなたを苦しめてばかりだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Chiaki. I keep bringing
you pain.

fields.EN:
That's not true, Nee-san...
Because you were there, I...
fields.JP:
姉さん……そんなことないよ。
姉さんがいたから、僕は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true, Sister... I was
able to do all I've done because
of you.

fields.EN:
Professor? The place Chii-chan made
wasn't made for you.
fields.JP:
博士……ちーちゃんが作ってくれたあの場所は、
あなたのための場所じゃないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor? The place Chii made
wasn't made for you.

fields.EN:
It was made for the people who
want to see the sun.
fields.JP: お日様に会いたい人たちのための場所……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was made for the people who
want to see the sun.

fields.EN:
So, can you return them? Return
to me my precious people who
were there?
fields.JP:
だから……返して。
あの場所にいた、わたしの大事な人たちを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, can you return them? Return
to me my precious people who
were there?

fields.EN:
You said earlier that you caught
the blue bird.
fields.JP: ……君は先ほど、青い鳥を捕まえたといったが
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said earlier that you caught
the blue bird.

fields.EN:
But you have to remember that
you can't say so without first
putting it in its cage.
fields.JP: 鳥は籠に入れるまで、捕まえたとは言わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you have to remember that
you can't say so without first
putting it in its cage.

fields.EN:
...Like I wasted precious time
over all of your prattle.
fields.JP:
無駄話をしている間に、貴重な時間も失われた
ようだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Like I wasted precious time
over all of your prattle.

fields.EN:
Your assumptions weren't correct,
but you still arrived at the
truth.
fields.JP:
君たちの推測は正しくなかったが……
結果的に真実には辿り着いた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your assumptions weren't correct,
but you still arrived at the
truth.

fields.EN:
Regardless, our old story ends
here.
fields.JP: しかし、古い物語はここまでなのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, our old story ends
here.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Old stories must be discarded to
bring about the new.
fields.JP: 新たな物語のためには、古い物語は不要なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Old stories must be discarded to
bring about the new.

fields.EN:
These are... the followers
who were brought here...?!
fields.JP: これは……連れてこられた信者たちの……！？

fields.EN: They're somewhere on this floor! Nee-san...!
fields.JP: このフロアのどこかだ！　姉さん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister! They must be somewhere on
this floor!

fields.EN:
I'll go after them! You keep your
eyes on the Professor!
fields.JP: 俺が追う！　お前らは博士の方を頼む！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll go after them! You keep your
eyes on the Professor!

fields.EN:
Such a commotion... Nothing can
stop me now.
fields.JP:
やれやれ、せわしないことだ。
もう手遅れだというのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Such a commotion... Nothing can
stop me now.

fields.JP: 博士……あなた、何をする気なの！？

fields.EN:
"Planning?" No. My work here is
done.
fields.JP: するのではない、したのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Planning?" No. My work here is
done.

fields.EN:
All I need to do now is greet the
beginning of the new story.
fields.JP:
後は、迎えるだけだ。
新しい物語の始まりをね
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I need to do now is greet the
beginning of the new story.

fields.EN:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.
fields.JP: さて。用済みの玩具には退場願おうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.

fields.EN:
Oh? A gun that actually works...
Everyone, be careful...
fields.JP:
あら、使える銃なんてあったのね。
……みんな、気をつけて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? A gun that actually works...
Everyone, be careful...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.
fields.JP:
なに、このままじっとしていてくれれば何も
しないよ。面倒だからね。
何なら塔を降りてくれても構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.

fields.EN:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark!
fields.JP:
……みんな。
博士を……スナークを追おう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark!

fields.EN:
The Professor... Snark
is probably beyond this door.
fields.JP: たぶん、この扉の先に博士……スナークがいる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like the Professor... Snark
is past this portal.

fields.EN: So, this is the last battle...
fields.JP: これが、最後の戦いなのね
fields.LOCALIZED: So, this is the last battle...

fields.EN:
Once we go through, there's no
turning back. Are you ready, Jack?
fields.JP:
この扉を開けたら、もう後戻りはできないわ。
ジャック、準備はいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we go through, there's no
turning back. Are you ready, Jack?

fields.EN:
Well, I suggest you prepare
yourself, then.
fields.JP: それなら、準備をすませてくるといいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suggest you prepare
yourself, then.

fields.JP: ジャック、どこへ行くの？

fields.EN:
We should head after the Professor
and leave the followers to Haru
and Miko.
fields.JP:
信者のことはハルと視子に任せて、
私たちは博士を追うべきだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should head after the Professor
and leave the followers to Haru
and Miko.

fields.EN:
Yeah, you're right... Okay! Let's
go after the Professor!
fields.JP:
そうか、そうだね。
……よし、博士を追おう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you're right... Okay! Let's
go after the Professor!

fields.JP: それは……博士だと思います

fields.EN: Do you think so too, Akazukin?
fields.JP: 赤ずきん。君もそう思うのかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think so too, Red Riding
Hood?

fields.EN:
Now then, tell me what led you to
suspect me of being a traitor?
fields.JP:
……さて、君たちが私を疑う理由を聞かせて
もらえるかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, tell me what led you to
suspect me of being a traitor?

fields.EN:
It's because your plans went so
smoothly. As if all of it had been
orchestrated from the beginning.
fields.JP:
それは、作戦があまりに博士の計画通りに
進みすぎたからです。
あたかも、何が起こるかを知っていたように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because your plans went so
smoothly. As if all of it had been
orchestrated from the beginning.

fields.EN:
Oh? I was actually quite pleased
to see that our hard work and
research were paying off.
fields.JP:
……ほう？
周到な調査が実を結んだのであれば、
それはむしろ喜ばしいことだと思うが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I was actually quite pleased
to see that our hard work and
research were paying off.

fields.EN:
That's not all. The Jail is very
pleased now... Pleased to see us
destroy the cores.
fields.JP:
それに、ジェイルはいま……とても悦んでます。
僕らに核を破壊されたのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not all. The Jail is very
pleased now... Pleased to see us
destroy the cores.

fields.EN:
Pleased in a way that it seemed
like it wanted to grow as well.
Is that merely a coincidence?
fields.JP:
まるで、計画通りに成長することが、
嬉しいみたいに。
……そんな偶然って、あるんでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pleased in a way that it seemed
like it wanted to grow as well.
Is that merely a coincidence?

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、一つアドバイスをしよう。
考察が盲目的にならないためには、
一度その考察を逆説的に考えてみるといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.

fields.EN:
A hypothesis also needs to be tested.
So let's examine our current suspicion
from the opposite direction.
fields.JP:
考察を検証することも必要ということだ。
では、今の疑念を逆説的に考えてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking is more important than
actual evaulation. Now then, let's
think this out a moment, shall we?

fields.EN:
The escape plan is based on the
ecology of the Jail. Aligning our
plans with its behavior is vital.
fields.JP:
脱出計画はジェイルの生態を利用したものだ。
ジェイルの本能に沿っていた方が計画が
円滑に進む…………どうかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The escape plan is based on the
ecology of the Jail. Aligning our
plans with its behavior is vital.

fields.EN:
Wouldn't it only be natural to
come up with a plan utilizing that
knowledge?
fields.JP:
ジェイルの生態が先にあり、それを最大限
活用する形で計画が立案されたと考えれば、
特に違和感はないと思うが？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't it only be natural to
come up with a plan utilizing that
knowledge?

fields.EN:
That means you knew that the Jail
wanted the cores destroyed. How
would you know that?
fields.JP:
じ、じゃあ博士は、核を壊すとジェイルが
悦ぶって知ってたってことですよね。
……どうして知ってるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means you knew that the Jail
wanted the cores destroyed. How
would you know that?

fields.EN:
It's the result of accumulated research. Of
course, we also keep adding everything we've
learned thanks to you to the escape plan.
fields.JP:
これまでの研究の蓄積によるものだよ。
無論、君たちのおかげでわかったことも
随時脱出計画に反映している
fields.LOCALIZED:
After long hours of research, not
to mention the additional
discoveries that were reported.

fields.EN:
But what the members of the Dawn
knew and didn't know is too
unusual... Arbitrary, even.
fields.JP:
でも、黎明が『知っている』ことと
『知らない』こと、その境目が不自然過ぎるわ。
……恣意的ですらあった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what the members of the Dawn
knew and didn't know is too
unusual... Arbitrary, even.

fields.EN:
For example, the 'core'... Especially with a
creature we'd never seen before, I don't think
that could be known from hypotheses alone.
fields.JP:
たとえば『核』のこと……初めて見る生物なら
なおさら、仮説だけで知ることができるとは
思えないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, determining an
accurate theory about the cores'
function shortly after hearing it.

fields.EN:
True... We can only theorize off
of known biota based on knowledge
in line with our own observations.
fields.JP:
そうね。これまで人類が蓄積してきた生物相の
知識に沿ったものであるならともかく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... We can only theorize off
of known biota based on knowledge
in line with our own observations.

fields.EN:
But what you're saying is more in
relation to the Dawn itself rather
than me individually, correct?
fields.JP:
……それは、黎明全体に対する疑念であって、
私個人に対するものではないだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what you're saying is more in
relation to the Dawn itself rather
than me individually, correct?

fields.EN:
Yes. Miko and the others deserve blame for
that negligence. They ignored information
that should have raised your own suspicions.
fields.JP:
ええ。その点は視子たちの怠慢を責めるべきね。
あなた個人の疑念となるべき内容を黙認して
いたのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. In that sense, Miko and the
others are at fault for keeping
silent about their doubts.

fields.EN:
Or, maybe Miko and Haru are
your cohorts?
fields.JP: それとも……視子やハルも共犯なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or, maybe Miko and Haru are
your cohorts?

fields.EN:
(Cohorts... It's true that Miko-san
and Haru-san seemed to be hiding
something from us...)
fields.JP:
（共犯……確かに、視子さんやハルさんには、
　何かを隠しているような感じを受けてた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cohorts... It's true that Miko
and Haru seemed to be hiding
something from us...)

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose it can't be helped
if we were suspected as cohorts.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
共犯と疑われても仕方ないのかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose it can't be helped
if we were suspected as cohorts.

fields.EN:
As the only one who survived the
tragedy 15 years ago, his vast
knowledge seemed trustworthy.
fields.JP:
十島博士は、十五年前の惨劇を唯一生き延びた
ジェイルの権威……その見識を信じたい気持ちも
あったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the only one who survived the
tragedy 15 years ago, his vast
knowledge seemed trustworthy.

fields.EN:
As a researcher, I also wanted to
know what would happen to the Jail
once the plan succeeded.
fields.JP:
何より、計画が成功したらジェイルに何が
起きるのかを知りたかった……
研究者としての好奇心ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As a researcher, I also wanted to
know what would happen to the Jail
once the plan succeeded.

fields.EN:
So you're telling us that you
turned a blind eye because of
that? Pretty lazy, if you ask me.
fields.JP:
それだけのために、ずっと見て見ぬ振りをしてた
んですか～？
わらわ以上の怠慢ぶりですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're telling us that you
turned a blind eye because of
that? Pretty lazy, if you ask me.

fields.EN:
...Yes. Wanting to trust the Professor,
and wanting to look away from our doubts...
Neither was anything close to reason.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
博士を信じたい気持ちと疑念を黙認する気持ち。
どちらも理性とは程遠い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose. It would be difficult
to use logic in my defense when I
had acted based on trust...

fields.EN:
I guess you can say I'm not fit to
be a researcher.
fields.JP: 研究者として失格だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you can say I'm not fit to
be a researcher.

fields.EN:
Miko-kun. Whatever motives you may have had
for taking part in the research, I don't mind.
fields.JP:
視子くん。君がどういう思惑で研究に携わって
いたとしても、私は構わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko, it doesn't concern me that
you had your doubts while working
with me here.

fields.EN:
In fact, I see you as a comrade
who helped to uncover the truths
behind the Jail.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの実態を追求するために
力を貸してくれていた同志であることに、
変わりはないのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I see you as a comrade
who helped to uncover the truths
behind the Jail.

fields.EN:
And that applies to you as well,
Haru-kun. You were waiting to see the
Jail's growth. Isn't that right?
fields.JP:
そしてハルくん。それは君もだ。
君は私と同様に、ジェイルの成長を待望して
くれていた……そうだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that applies to you as well,
Haru. You were waiting to see the
Jail's growth. Isn't that right?

fields.EN:
No. I've been trying to stop you
from the start.
fields.JP:
……違う。
俺は……あんたを止めようと、ずっと
あがいてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I've been trying to stop you
from the start.

fields.EN:
Oh, is that so? All this time, I
thought we shared the same goals.
fields.JP:
おや……そうだったのかね？
てっきり、私と想いを同じくしてくれている
同志だと思っていたのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, is that so? All this time, I
thought we shared the same goals.

fields.JP: それはいささか残念な話だね。

fields.EN:
Haru-kun, would calling you a "traitor" to me
be too much of an exaggeration...? Of course,
I'm joking.
fields.JP:
ハルくんが、私にとっての
『裏切り者』だと言ったら……少し大げさかな？
……無論、冗談ではあるがね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would calling you a traitor be too
much of an exaggeration...? I'm
joking, of course...

fields.EN:
(This isn't good... I can't get
the Professor to confess...)
fields.JP:
（どうしよう……
　このままじゃ、博士を追い詰められない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't good... I can't get
the Professor to confess...)

fields.EN:
It looks like we've derailed for a
moment. Now then... Is there
anything else?
fields.JP:
話が逸れてしまったが……私に対する疑いは、
以上かね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like we've derailed for a
moment. Now then... Is there
anything else?

fields.EN:
(That's right! There was something
strange about the memo we
found...!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……！
　以前、独房エリアで拾ったメモに違和感を
　感じたことがあったはず）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right! There was something
strange about the memo we
found...!)

fields.EN:
The unusual memo we found before
was written by you, wasn't it?
fields.JP:
僕らが見つけたあの不思議なメモ……
それを書いたのは博士でした
fields.LOCALIZED:
The unusual memo we found before
was written by you, wasn't it?

fields.EN: But, you kept that a secret.
fields.JP: でも、あなたはそれを僕らに隠していた
fields.LOCALIZED: But, you kept that a secret.

fields.EN:
I believe I mentioned it then, but
I wasn't hiding anything. I simply
forgot about it.
fields.JP:
あの時も言ったが、隠していたわけではないよ。
私が忘れていたということで決着がついたと
記憶しているが……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe I mentioned it then, but
I wasn't hiding anything. I simply
forgot about it.

fields.EN:
(Urgh...! There has to be
something else... That's
right...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Urgh...! There has to be
something else... That's
right...!)

fields.EN:
That memo was referring
to Akazukin-san, wasn't it?
fields.JP: これ……赤ずきんさんのことだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That memo was referring to Red
Riding Hood, wasn't it?

fields.EN:
"The first child was found here. The captain
said that, though just a baby, she killed a
Marchen barehanded and smiled at everyone."
fields.JP:
『最初の子はここで発見したという。隊長の話
　によれば、赤子の身でありながら、素手で
　メルヒェンを倒し、皆を見て微笑んだそうだ』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"The first infant was found here.
Our leader said that she killed a
Marchen with her bare hands."

fields.EN:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...
fields.JP:
う……うん。あたし、確かにお父さんから
そう聞いたんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...

fields.EN:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.
fields.JP:
『発見した時、メルヒェンを前にしても笑ってた、
　勇敢な赤ん坊だったよ』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.

fields.EN:
The memo we found at the Station
Grounds differed from what you
told Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
『元駅構内エリア』で見つけたメモの内容は、
赤ずきんさんが博士から聞いていた内容と
食い違ってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The memo we found at the Station
Grounds differed from what you
told Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
The memo said that the leader found
Akazukin-san, whereas what you said
made it seem like you found her.
fields.JP:
『隊長』が見つけた赤ずきんさんのことを、
さも自分が見つけたかのように伝えていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The memo said that the leader
found her, whereas what you said
made it seem like you found her.

fields.EN:
(If he wasn't there when
Akazukin-san was found, why would
he say that he was...?)
fields.JP:
（……でも、赤ずきんさんを見つけた時に
　その場にいなかったのなら、なんで自分が
　見つけたなんて言ったんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If he wasn't there when Red
Riding Hood was found, why would
he say that he was...?)

fields.EN:
(It's true that the Professor said
he just forgot...)
fields.JP:
（確か博士は、記憶違いだったって言い訳してた
　けど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's true that the Professor said
he just forgot...)

fields.EN:
(His memory was wrong, so he thought he'd
found her himself... and he'd forgotten
there was a memo recording the truth.)
fields.JP:
（記憶違いで自分が見つけたと思ってて、
　その真実が書かれたメモの存在を忘れてた）

fields.EN:
(Is that even possible? It can't
be a coincidence that both of
these issues would be mistaken...)
fields.JP:
（本当にそんなことがあるのかな……？
　二つのアクシデントが重なるなんて、
　偶然にしてはできすぎてる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that even possible? It can't
be a coincidence that both of
these issues would be mistaken...)

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Jack-kun? You've
been pretty quiet.
fields.JP:
どうしたね、ジャックくん。
急に黙ってしまったが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Jack? You've
been pretty quiet.

fields.EN:
I know I'm repeating myself, but
I'm sorry for my forgetfulness and
for fostering doubt among you all.
fields.JP:
これも繰り返しになるが、
その件は私の記憶違いだったのだよ。
疑念を抱かせてしまったのは申し訳ないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm repeating myself, but
I'm sorry for my forgetfulness and
for fostering doubt among you all.

fields.EN:
(What can I do to prove my
doubts...?)
fields.JP:
（どうすれば……一体どうすれば、
　この違和感を立証できるんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What can I do to prove my
doubts...?)

fields.EN:
Isn't this enough, Jack-kun? I don't
think we have any more time to
spare here.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん……もう充分ではないかね？
こんなところで無駄な時間を使っている暇は、
私にはないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't this enough, Jack? I don't
think we have any more time to
spare here.

fields.EN:
Later, take your time and think it through
by yourself, following my advice. That
should clear up most of your doubts.
fields.JP:
後でゆっくり、私のアドバイスに沿って
一人で考えてみるといい。
それで大体の疑念が解消されるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think about my earlier advice. I'm
sure that will clear any doubts
you may have toward me.

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、一つアドバイスをしよう。
考察が盲目的にならないためには、
一度その考察を逆説的に考えてみるといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.

fields.EN:
(There is something that'll
explain what happened not being
a coincidence!)
fields.JP:
（そうか……！
　たった一つだけ、このアクシデントが
　偶然じゃなくなるケースがある……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There is something that'll
explain what happened not being
a coincidence!)

fields.JP: 博士、あなたは……本当は誰ですか？

fields.EN:
I thought it over based on your
advice. What if every doubt I had
about the memo was actually 'true'?
fields.JP:
あなたのアドバイスを元に考えてみたんです。
メモに対する疑念が、逆にどれも『真実』だと
したらって
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if my doubts about the memo
were true?

fields.EN:
You did find Akazukin-san with
the leader.
fields.JP:
……あなたは『隊長』と一緒に、
赤ずきんさんを見つけていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You did find Red Riding Hood with
the leader.

fields.EN:
And you didn't remember leaving a
memo behind.
fields.JP:
そして、博士がメモを残していたことを
知らなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you didn't remember leaving a
memo behind.

fields.EN:
The only way that both could be
possible is... you're not the
Professor.
fields.JP:
答えは一つです。
あなたは、博士ではない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only way that both could be
possible is... you're not the
Professor.

fields.EN:
You were someone else in the party
when Akazukin-san was found.
fields.JP:
そして、赤ずきんさんが発見された時の
調査に同行していた誰かだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were someone else in the party
when Red Riding Hood was found.

fields.EN:
Let me ask you a question, then.
How can you prove that I'm not
Professor Toojima?
fields.JP:
それでは聞こう。
どうやって、私が十島でないことを立証する？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me ask you a question, then.
How can you prove that I'm not
Professor Tohjima?

fields.EN:
(Do I have something that could
prove the Professor here is fake?)
fields.JP:
（博士が偽者であることを立証できる何か。
　僕は、それを提示できるのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Do I have something that could
prove the Professor here is fake?)

fields.EN:
(I do...! I have something with me
that I can use as proof!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……ある！
　今の博士と、本物の博士を比較できるものが
　僕の持ち物の中に……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I do...! I have something with me
that I can use as proof!)

fields.EN:
I didn't expect something like
this to be found in this area...
fields.JP:
それにしても……こんなもの独房エリアに
落ちてるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect something like
this to be found in this area...

fields.EN: I wonder who wrote this memo...
fields.JP: このメモ、いったい誰が書いたのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder who wrote this memo...

fields.EN:
Well, it is written nicely. I'm a
bit jealous... My penmanship is
pretty horrible.
fields.JP:
かなり綺麗な字だよね……！
あたし、そんなに字がうまくないから
……ちょっとうらやましいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is written nicely. I'm a
bit jealous... My penmanship is
pretty horrible.

fields.EN:
Yes. Judging from the handwriting,
it looks like it was written
by someone very meticulous.
fields.JP:
ええ。筆跡を見る限り、ずいぶんと几帳面な
人が書いたように思えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From the looks of it, it seems
like the person who wrote it was
very studious.

fields.EN: This is proof that you're a fake!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あなたが偽者である証拠はこれです！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is proof that you're a fake!

fields.EN:
What exactly do you intend
to do by thrusting that at me?
fields.JP:
そんなものを私に突きつけて、
一体どうしようと言うんだね？

え？　あ、あれ？
えーと……

fields.EN:
I haven't been this dissappointed
in you, Jack.
fields.JP: ジャック……あなたにはガッカリしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't been this dissappointed
in you, Jack.

fields.EN: This is proof that you're a fake!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あなたが偽者である証拠はこれです！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is proof that you're a fake!

fields.EN:
That's the memo Professor wrote
about the magnolia leaves!
fields.JP:
それは、博士が書いてくれた
ホオノキの葉のメモ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the memo Professor wrote
about the magnolia leaves!

fields.EN:
I didn't know you had such a thing
with you.
fields.JP: そんなものがあったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you had such a thing
with you.

fields.EN:
(This is the only item that was
written by the Professor
himself...!)
fields.JP:
（そう。これは唯一、今の博士が書いた
　ものなんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is the only item that was
written by the Professor
himself...!)

fields.EN:
Yes. The leaves look like this
drawing.
fields.JP: ええ。こういう形状の葉を付けるのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The leaves look like this
drawing.

fields.EN:
Well, we just call them magnolia
leaves because they look similar
to the ones in the outside world.
fields.JP:
まあ……
葉の形状が外の世界にあるホオノキに似てるから
黎明でそう呼んでるだけなんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we just call them magnolia
leaves because they look similar
to the ones in the outside world.

fields.EN:
This looks like Dad's! Yikes, his
penmanship is sloppy as usual...
fields.JP:
これ……お父さんが書いたやつだね！
相変わらず字がへたくそだなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This looks like Dad's! Yikes, his
penmanship is sloppy as usual...

fields.EN:
Compare this with the memo about
Akazukin-san. You can clearly tell
that the handwriting is different.
fields.JP:
これと、赤ずきんさんのことが書かれたメモ……
比べれば、明らかに筆跡が違うことがわかります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can clearly tell that your
memo and what we found are
different.

fields.EN:
This is proof that you're not
Professor Toojima!
fields.JP:
これが、あなたが十島博士ではないことの
証拠です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is proof that you're not
Professor Tohjima!

fields.EN:
Quite interesting... But isn't
that evidence too insufficient to
be considered proof?
fields.JP:
なかなかの名推理だが……
証拠としては弱いのではないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite interesting... But isn't
that evidence too insufficient to
be considered proof?

fields.EN:
I was badly injured in the tragedy fifteen
years ago. Miko-kun treated me, so she
knows; the scar on my face is from then too.
fields.JP:
私は、十五年前の惨劇で大怪我を負ってね。
治療してくれた視子くんは知っているが、
顔にあるのもその時の傷だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hurt badly in the tragedy 15
years ago. Miko cared for me, so
she would remember my wounds.

fields.EN:
Y-Yes... He did get badly injured
back then...
fields.JP: え、ええ……それは確かにそうだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes... He did get badly injured
back then...

fields.EN:
I didn't bring it up before, but
since that time, my right hand
doesn't move as much as before.
fields.JP:
これまで皆には黙っていたのだが……
その時の後遺症で、私の右手は若干不自由でね。
以前のようには動かないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't bring it up before, but
since that time, my right hand
doesn't move as much as before.

fields.EN:
That's probably why my handwriting looks
different. It may be shameful to admit a past
failure just to protect myself, though...
fields.JP:
筆跡が違うように見えるのはそのせいだろう。
保身のために過去の失態を自ら語るなど、
恥ずべきことかもしれんがね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the reason my handwriting
looks different. I only didn't
want to bring up my past injuries.

fields.EN:
Does that answer your doubts,
Jack-kun?
fields.JP: ジャックくん……わかってくれたかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that answer your doubts,
Jack?

fields.EN:
(He's finding excuses for
everything I'm pitting against
him...)
fields.JP:
（どんなに追求しても、
　あの手この手でかわされる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's finding excuses for
everything I'm pitting against
him...)

fields.EN:
(Isn't there anything else I can
say...?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Isn't there anything else I can
say...?)

fields.EN:
Not yet, Jack. You still have one
more thing with you.
fields.JP:
まだよ、ジャック。
あなたはもう一つ武器を持っているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not yet, Jack. You still have one
more thing with you.

fields.EN:
Remember what we talked about...
Remember why I thought there
was a traitor in the Dawn.
fields.JP:
思い出して。なぜ黎明に裏切り者がいると
思ったのか……私との会話を……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember what we talked about...
Remember why I thought there
was a traitor in the Dawn.

fields.EN:
(The conversation with Gretel... I
remember now!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The conversation with Gretel... I
remember now!)

fields.EN:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have that
"eye" you made mention of before?
fields.JP:
他のエリアには必ずあった『眼』が、
あの場所にはなかったことが関係あるとは
思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have that
"eye" you made mention of before?

fields.EN:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
a while.
fields.JP:
もう一つ言えば……あの場所には、
ずっと誰も入ってこれなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
a while.

fields.EN: What are you trying to say?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you trying to say?

fields.EN:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail and is
monitoring us.
fields.JP:
黎明の誰かがジェイルと通じていて、
ジェイルの中や私たちのことを監視している……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail and is
monitoring us.

fields.EN: Has that ever occurred to you?
fields.JP: ……そうは思ってみたことはない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Has that ever occurred to you?

fields.EN:
(It didn't dawn on me back then,
but...)
fields.JP: （あの時は意識してなかったけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It didn't dawn on me back then,
but...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe Gretel already connected
the eye with being monitored... If
so...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルは、あの『眼』を監視と結びつけて
　考えていた……そう考えれば……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Gretel already connected
the eye with being monitored... If
so...)

fields.EN:
Professor... Do you know what the giant
'eye' in the Solitary Confinement Area is?
fields.JP:
博士……独房エリアにある巨大な『眼』……
あれがなんだか知っていますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor? Do you know what those
"eyes" in the different areas are
for?

fields.EN:
(The eye is strongly connected to
its location...)
fields.JP:
（多分あの『眼』は、ある場所に大きく
　関係してるはず……その場所は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The eye is strongly connected to
its location...)

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to my room at the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『僕の部屋』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to my room at the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
I really don't think that's
correct. Jack-kun, I'm very
disappointed in you.
fields.JP:
私にはそうは思えないが？
……ジャックくん、これ以上失望させないで
くれたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really don't think that's
correct. Jack, I'm very
disappointed in you.

fields.JP:
え？　あ、あれ？
えーと……
ジャック……あなたを信じてたのに……

fields.EN:
Alice and I found an unusual room
in the laboratory.
fields.JP:
……博士。
僕とアリスは以前、研究室の奥で不思議な
部屋を見つけました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice and I found an unusual room
in the laboratory.

fields.EN:
The room displayed different parts of the
Solitary Confinement Area. I think those
images came from the 'eyes' in its walls...
fields.JP:
独房エリアのあちこちが映ってる部屋です。
それは恐らく、独房エリアの壁にある
『眼』から見えるものを映していた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The room showed screens of various
areas. I believe those images were
captured through the eyes.

fields.EN:
You were monitoring everything
from that room!
fields.JP: あなたは、あの部屋で全てを見ていたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were monitoring everything
from that room!

fields.JP:
あの、この間…ナイトメアが、
喋ったことについてなんですが……

fields.EN:
Ah... Well, that caught me by
surprise.
fields.JP:
ああ……その件なのだがね……
それは驚いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Well, that caught me by
surprise.

fields.EN:
Oh, good... So Clara was
able to relay the information to
you.
fields.JP:
よかった……
ちゃんとくららが伝えてくれたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, good... So Clara was
able to relay the information to
you.

fields.EN:
What about Clara? Do you know
something, Miko?
fields.JP:
何だ、くららがどうかしたのか？
……視子、知ってるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What about Clara? Do you know
something, Miko?

fields.EN:
(Huh? He didn't hear it from
Clara? Maybe Akazukin-san
told them...)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　くららじゃなかったのか。
　じゃあ、赤ずきんさんあたりかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? He didn't hear it from
Clara? Maybe Red Riding Hood
told them...)

fields.EN:
You knew the Nightmare had spoken
even though we never reported that to you.
fields.JP:
あなたは、ナイトメアが喋ったことを
僕らが報告していないのに知っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You knew about the Nightmare
before we even reported it to you.

fields.EN:
...Marchens born from the mimicry
of pregnant humans carried children
in their wombs who remained human.
fields.JP:
……人間の妊婦が擬態させられた
ことで生まれたメルヒェンは、胎内に
人間のままの子を宿していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems that Marchens created
by the Jail's mimicry of pregnant
humans doesn't affect the infant.

fields.EN:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.
fields.JP:
つまり、いくらジェイルでも胎内の子まで
擬態させることは不可能だったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.

fields.EN:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.
fields.JP:
そのメルヒェンたちは、そのまま胎内で
子を育て……胎を破って生まれてきた
子たちは、人間には無い能力を備えていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.

fields.EN:
Oddly enough, you also spoke about
the origin of the Blood Maidens
just after we found out.
fields.JP:
そして逆に、僕らが血式少女の出生の秘密を
知った時には、タイミングよく博士から
話があった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oddly enough, you also spoke about
the origin of the Blood Maidens
just after we found out.

fields.EN:
You brought it up, not knowing
that Kaguyahime spoke to us about it
outside of the Dawn!
fields.JP:
それは……黎明の外で、僕らがかぐや姫から
秘密を聞いたことを知らなかったからだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You brought it up, not knowing
that Kaguya spoke to us about it
outside of the Dawn!

fields.EN:
(I didn't know why the Professor
brought it up back then, but now I
do...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……あの時はなぜあのタイミングで
　博士が喋ったのかわからなかったけど、
　今ならわかる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know why the Professor
brought it up back then, but now I
do...)

fields.EN:
After we learned about Rapunzel's
origin, we would have suspected
you for keeping it secret.
fields.JP:
独房エリアでラプンツェルの話から
僕らが秘密に気づけば、それをあえて
黙っていた博士に疑念が向く
fields.LOCALIZED:
After we learned about Rapunzel's
origin, we would have suspected
you for keeping it secret.

fields.EN:
You didn't want us to doubt you.
Isn't that right, Professor?
fields.JP:
あなたはそれを恐れた。
違いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't want us to doubt you.
Isn't that right, Professor?

fields.EN:
I see... Your assumptions are
quite valid.
fields.JP:
なるほど……
見事な考察だ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Your assumptions are
quite valid.

fields.EN:
Those eyes are there to monitor
the safety of our units
investigating the Jail.
fields.JP:
あの『眼』は、ジェイルの調査をする者の
安全を期すために設置したものだとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those eyes are there to monitor
the safety of our units
investigating the Jail.

fields.EN:
We placed those eyes in the areas
during our expeditions long ago.
fields.JP:
かつての調査隊が、各独房エリアの調査を
進めると共に、あの『眼』を設置したのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We placed those eyes in the areas
during our expeditions long ago.

fields.EN:
That statement seems reasonable. I
don't recall seeing any eyes
around my home.
fields.JP:
一見、筋が通っているように聞こえるわね。
私の家には、確かにあの『眼』はなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That statement seems reasonable. I
don't recall seeing any eyes
around my home.

fields.EN:
Corroborated by the Dawn ceasing
its deployment of units there.
fields.JP: 黎明が調査を断念した……私の家には、ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Corroborated by the Dawn ceasing
its deployment of units there.

fields.EN: Does that make sense to you?
fields.LOCALIZED: Does that make sense to you?

fields.EN:
(Everything I'm pitting against
him isn't working... What should I
do?)
fields.JP:
（どんなに証拠を突きつけても
　通用しない……どうすればいいんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everything I'm pitting against
him isn't working... What should I
do?)

fields.EN:
Jack... That doesn't make sense.
Is it even possible to set up that
many eyes so easily?
fields.JP:
ジャック、今の話……何かおかしいわ。
あれだけ大量の『眼』を、そんなにすんなり
設置できるものかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... That doesn't make sense.
Is it even possible to set up that
many eyes so easily?

fields.EN:
(That's right... I can't give up.
I can't end it like this...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……ここであきらめちゃだめだ。
　これは、絶対に負けられない戦いなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I can't give up.
I can't end it like this...)

fields.EN:
It seems we spent quite some time
discussing this, but I'm glad to
know we're all in agreement now.
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと時間をとられてしまったが、
理解してもらえたようで私も嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems we spent quite some time
discussing this, but I'm glad to
know we're all in agreement now.

fields.EN:
No, not yet... If those eyes were
installed there by us, why did the
Jail allow it?
fields.JP:
……いいえ、まだです。
仮に調査隊があの『眼』を取り付けたとして、
なぜジェイルはされるがままだったんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, not yet... If those eyes were
installed there by us, why did the
Jail allow it?

fields.EN:
Why didn't the Marchens or the
Nightmares try to destroy those
eyes?
fields.JP:
なぜメルヒェンやナイトメアは、
あの『眼』を壊そうとしなかったんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why didn't the Marchens or the
Nightmares try to destroy those
eyes?

fields.EN:
That's further proof that you were
working with the Jail!
fields.JP:
それこそが、あなたがジェイルと通じている
大きな証拠だ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's further proof that you were
working with the Jail!

fields.EN:
Snark was communicating with the
Nightmares using a transceiver.
fields.JP:
スナークは、ナイトメアとトランシーバーで
連絡をとっていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snark was communicating with the
Nightmares using a transceiver.

fields.EN:
I believe that was done so that
you could command the Marchens
to capture humans...
fields.JP:
恐らく……メルヒェンに人間を捕らえさせ、
拷問にかけるために
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe that was done so that
you could command the Marchens
to capture humans...

fields.EN:
...And torture them to spur the
Jail's growth!
fields.JP: 拷問の目的は、ジェイルを成長させるためだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...And torture them to spur the
Jail's growth!

fields.EN:
That would match the escape plan's
objective as well.
fields.JP: 脱出計画との目的とも一致しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would match the escape plan's
objective as well.

fields.JP: 何のことかね、ハルくん

fields.EN:
They... Jack did the best he
could.
fields.JP: こいつらは……ジャックはよくやった
fields.LOCALIZED:
They... Jack did the best he
could.

fields.JP: ここまでお前を追い詰めたじゃねえか

fields.EN:
I was hoping you would change your
mind, but I suppose that isn't
going to happen.
fields.JP:
俺は、今の今までお前が考えを翻すのを
期待していたんだが……どうやら
無駄だったみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hoping you would change your
mind, but I suppose that isn't
going to happen.

fields.EN:
We can't replace what was lost.
Just give it up, Snark.
fields.JP:
……失ったものは二度と戻って来ない。
あきらめるんだ、スナーク
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't replace what was lost.
Just give it up, Snark.

fields.EN:
When you found Akazukin, you saw the potential
of a disposable field unit, and came up
with your scheme fifteen years ago...
fields.JP:
お前は、赤ずきんを発見したことで、
使い捨てになる実働部隊の可能性に気づき、
十五年前の策略を思いついた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This whole scheme of creating a
team to abuse after finding Red
Riding Hood has gone too far.

fields.EN:
You replaced Professor Toojima,
you came up with this escape
plan...
fields.JP:
それを実行して十島博士に成り代わり、
脱出計画を立案したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You replaced Professor Tohjima,
you came up with this escape
plan...

fields.EN:
I see... You efficiently gathered
the Blood Maidens and guided them along...
fields.JP:
なるほど、お前は血式少女たちを効率的に
集め導いていった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And things went well in finding
new Blood Maidens to do your
bidding.

fields.EN:
I'm guessing you wanted to
separate them because you thought
you were done with their services.
fields.JP:
以前、血式部隊を二手に分けようとしたのは、
そろそろ仕上げにかかり、用済みだと考えた
からだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm guessing you wanted to
separate them because you thought
you were done with their services.

fields.EN:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?
fields.JP:
……そうだ。君たち……
今回はチームを分けてみないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?

fields.EN: And why do you suggest that?
fields.JP: それは……どうしてですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: And why do you suggest that?

fields.EN:
With Kaguyahime and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.
fields.JP:
なに、せっかくかぐや姫とシンデレラという
強力な戦力が行動可能になったわけだしね。
今の君たちなら、何も全員で行くこともあるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Kaguya and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.

fields.EN:
We've had several large operations in a row.
I thought that while one team investigated,
the other could take a modest vacation.
fields.JP:
大きな作戦も続いたところだ。
一方のチームが調査に赴いている間、もう一方は
ささやかだが休暇を取るのも良いかと思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our goal is still far off. I think
it would make sense to have a team
head in while the other rests.

fields.EN:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...
fields.JP:
やれやれ……獅子身中の虫とは、
まさにこのことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...

fields.JP: お父さん……否定、してくれないんだ……

fields.EN: ...Let me say this one last time.
fields.JP: ……最後にもう一度だけ言わせてもらう

fields.EN:
Just stop. Everything changes.
You're not in control. Think about
coexisting with this planet.
fields.JP:
考え直せ。全ては変化していくんだ。
何もかもがお前の掌中にあるわけじゃない。
この星と共に生きることを考えろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just stop. Everything changes.
You're not in control. Think about
coexisting with this planet.

fields.EN:
What are you talking about, Haru-san?
What do you mean by "planet"...?
fields.JP:
……何の話ですか、ハルさん。
『この星』って、まるで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking about, Haru?
What do you mean by "planet"...?

fields.EN:
We came here from a different
planet that was destroyed long
ago...
fields.JP:
ああ。俺たちは、とある滅んだ星から
ここに流れ着いたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We came here from a different
planet that was destroyed long
ago...

fields.EN:
He was controlling a creature from the same
planet, one he already knew well, making it
grow toward the finished form he wanted.
fields.JP:
こいつは、勝手知ったる同じ星の生物を
操ってたんだ。こいつの願う完成形に向けて
育つようにな
fields.LOCALIZED:
He was controlling the creature
found on our planet, so that it
would mature to do his bidding.

fields.JP: にわかには……信じられない話だわ……

fields.EN:
But the Jail decided to coexist
with this planet. Our story ended
there.
fields.JP:
だが、ジェイルはこの星との共生を選んだ。
もう物語は終わったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Jail decided to coexist
with this planet. Our story ended
there.

fields.EN:
What if I said our story hasn't
ended yet?
fields.JP: ……まだ終わっていないと言ったら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if I said our story hasn't
ended yet?

fields.EN:
You disappoint me, Haru. You
truly are a traitor.
fields.JP:
……君には失望したよ。
やはり、私にとっての裏切者は君だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You disappoint me, Haru. You
truly are a traitor.

fields.EN:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.
fields.JP: さて。用済みの玩具には退場願おうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.

fields.EN:
He has a working gun?! Everyone,
be careful...!
fields.JP:
使える銃がまだ残っていたなんて……！
みんな、気をつけて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He has a working gun?! Everyone,
be careful...!

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.
fields.JP:
なに、このままじっとしていてくれれば何も
しないよ。面倒だからね。
何なら塔を降りてくれても構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.

fields.EN:
I will continue down this path to
attain my goal.
fields.JP: 私は私で、目的を叶えることにしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will continue down this path to
attain my goal.

fields.EN:
Even if you aren't the same Dad
I knew before, you're still my
Dad...
fields.JP:
お父さんが昔のお父さんじゃなくても、
あたしにとっては……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you aren't the same Dad
I knew before, you're still my
Dad...

fields.EN:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Akazukin. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.
fields.JP:
君には大いに感謝しているよ、赤ずきん。
私の計画は、君のおかげで大きく前進
することになったのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Red Riding Hood. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.

fields.EN:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...

fields.EN:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark...
fields.JP: ……みんな。博士を……スナークを追おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark...

fields.EN:
Wait. There's one other thing you
all need to know.
fields.JP:
待て。お前たちに一つ伝えておかなきゃ
ならんことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. There's one other thing you
all need to know.

fields.EN:
His objective is to change the
world using this tower... Using
the Jail for insemination.
fields.JP:
奴の目的は、この塔……ジェイルの『受精』に
よる、世界の塗り替えだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
His objective is to change the
world using this tower... Using
the Jail for insemination.

fields.EN:
He's trying to revive
our destroyed home planet...
fields.JP:
滅んじまった俺たちの星を蘇らせようと
してるのさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's trying to revive what was
lost on our planet.

fields.EN:
What does that have to do with
the Jail's insemination?
fields.JP:
それがジェイルの『受精』とどういう関係が
あるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What does that have to do with
the Jail's insemination?

fields.EN:
What is born through 'insemination'
is new life... a brand-new
core of the greatest scale.
fields.JP:
『受精』によって誕生するのは、新たな生命……
真新しい、最大級の『核』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A new life is born through
insemination. A brand new core...

fields.EN:
The Jail's core uses mimicry to
bring shape to things, even
desires.
fields.JP:
そしてジェイルの核は『擬態』する。
『想い』という無形のものさえも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's core uses mimicry to
bring shape to things, even
desires.

fields.EN:
Yes. Just as this Jail was born by
mimicking the thoughts contained
in those fairy-tale picture books.
fields.JP:
そうね。このジェイルが童話の絵本たちの想いを
擬態することで生まれたように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, just like how the Jail
brought to life characters from
storybooks...

fields.EN:
And like how I was born from the
desires of the children who read
those storybooks...
fields.JP:
そして、わたしがそれを読んだ子供たちの想いを
擬態させられて生まれた存在なように
fields.LOCALIZED:
And like how I was born from the
desires of the children who read
those storybooks...

fields.EN:
So, you're a reincarnated form,
then...
fields.JP: お前……『転生体』だったのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're a reincarnated form,
then...

fields.EN:
I found out where I came from...
I came from where a preschool once
stood long ago...
fields.JP:
あの始まりの場所で、はっきりとわかったの。
今のわたしの生は、あの場所……幼稚園があった
場所から始まったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found out where I came from...
I came from where a preschool once
stood long ago...

fields.EN:
But without realizing it, I had kept
mimicking even further... as a puppet
of the Blue Bird... of Snark...
fields.JP:
でも、自分でも気づかないうちにさらに
擬態していたのね……
青い鳥……スナークの操り人形として……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I was mimicked to life
without my knowledge by the blue
bird... by Snark...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Chiaki, for all the
suffering I've caused you. I'm
such a bad sister...
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい、千昭……わたし、あなたのことを
苦しめてばかりのお姉さんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Chiaki, for all the
suffering I've caused you. I'm
such a bad sister...

fields.EN:
So, Snark is planning to use the
Jail's mimicry on the new core.
To bring about a new world...
fields.JP:
……スナークは、新たに生まれる核に擬態させる
つもりなのね。
あの人の望む世界を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Snark is planning to use the
Jail's mimicry on the new core.
To bring about a new world...

fields.EN:
Yeah... I tried to convince him to
change his ways and coexist with
this world, but...
fields.JP:
ああ。
俺はこの星との共生を考え、最後の最後まで
あいつの考えを変えさせようとしたんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I tried to convince him to
change his ways and coexist with
this world, but...

fields.EN:
Guess I made more trouble than I
fixed... Sorry, everyone.
fields.JP:
そのせいでお前たちにも迷惑をかけたな
……本当にすまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess I made more trouble than I
fixed... Sorry, everyone.

fields.EN:
Let's hurry! He's gonna finish
this up by using the followers'
lives!
fields.JP:
さあ、急ごう！
あいつが最後の仕上げに使おうとしてるのは
……信者たちの命だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's hurry! He's gonna finish
this up by using the followers'
lives!

fields.EN:
I'm sure they're being held
somewhere on this floor!
fields.JP:
おそらく、このフロアのどこかに監禁されてる
筈だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure they're being held
somewhere on this floor!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Laboratory in the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『研究室』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Laboratory in the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Blood Factory in
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『血式兵器製造所』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Blood Factory in
the Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Order's HQ in the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『タイヨウ本部』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Order's HQ in the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Purging Center in
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『浄化場』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Purging Center in
the Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Wh-What's going on?! There are two
Michiru-sama?!
fields.JP:
こ……これはどういうこと？
ミチル様が二人……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What's going on?! Another Lady
Oohime?!

fields.EN:
I didn't expect them to mimic
Michiru.
fields.JP: まさか、ミチルに擬態してるなんてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect them to mimic
Michiru.

fields.JP: あら、歯ごたえないですね～
ほかにもたくさんいる！！

fields.EN:
Let's first get rid of the
Marchens!
fields.JP: まずはメルヒェンをかたづけましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's first get rid of the
Marchens!

fields.EN:
All who face me will be
obliterated!
fields.JP: 瞬く間に殲滅しようぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All who face me will be
obliterated!

fields.JP: みんな……これで自由だよ！
い、いきなり入ってきて、なんなんだ……！

fields.EN:
Who was that Michiru-sama just now...?
Why were there two of them, and why
was one cut down?!
fields.JP:
さっきまでのミチル様はなんだったの……？
なんで二人になったの……？
なんで斬られたの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wasn't that Lady Oohime?! Why were
there two of them, and why was one
killed?!

fields.EN:
I-I can't believe you killed those
harmless Marchens!
fields.JP:
そ、それに、害のないメルヒェンを
殺しおって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I can't believe you killed those
harmless Marchens!

fields.EN:
Wake up, everyone! You've all been
fooled!
fields.JP:
あんたたち、まだ気づかないの？
自分たちが騙されてたって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wake up, everyone! You've all been
fooled!

fields.EN:
She didn't show her face or even
speak to you. It was a fake, for
crying out loud!
fields.JP:
顔を見せないし、喋らない。
あんなの、どう見たって偽者じゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She didn't show her face or even
speak to you. It was a fake, for
crying out loud!

fields.JP: もう少し、自分たちで考えようとしなさいよ！

fields.EN: H-How do you know Oohime-sama was a fake?!
fields.JP:
な、なんであの大陽女様が偽者だったなんて
わかるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-How do you know that she was a
fake?!

fields.EN:
Th-That's right! She led us to
safety here! The Marchens didn't
lay a finger on us!
fields.JP:
そ、そうよ！
ここまで安全に導いてくださったのよ？
メルヒェンだって私たちに手出ししなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's right! She led us to
safety here! The Marchens didn't
lay a finger on us!

fields.EN:
You're telling us to believe you
when you all barged in here like
monsters, killing the Marchens?!
fields.JP:
むしろ……いきなりやってきてメルヒェンを
惨殺した、化け物のような奴らを信じろと
いう方が無理じゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're telling us to believe you
when you all barged in here like
monsters, killing the Marchens?!

fields.EN:
Listen! We don't have time! I need
you all to follow us!
fields.JP:
みな聞いてくれ。時間がないのだ。
今は私たちに従ってほしい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen! We don't have time! I need
you all to follow us!

fields.EN:
And who's to say that you're not a
monster, too?! You must be one of
them!
fields.JP:
こんな奴らとつるんでるなんて、
お前らも化け物の一味なんじゃないか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And who's to say that you're not a
monster, too?! You must be one of
them!

fields.EN:
Lady Oohime must have been a
fraud in the first place! Where is
this "sun," anyway?!
fields.JP:
そもそも、大陽女なんて女の話が最初から
怪しかったのよ！
太陽なんてどこにあるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime must have been a
fraud in the first place! Where is
this "sun," anyway?!

fields.EN:
If you're really a messenger of
the sun, prove it! Show us the
sun!
fields.JP:
太陽の使者だとか言うなら、いますぐ太陽を
呼んでみなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're really a messenger of
the sun, prove it! Show us the
sun!

fields.EN:
That's right! If you're supposed
to save us, save us right now!
fields.JP:
そうじゃ！
わしらを救うというなら、今ここで救ってくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! If you're supposed
to save us, save us right now!

fields.EN:
Heh... Sad, sad humans... See
how their expectations turn to
hatred in a heartbeat?
fields.JP:
ふうん……盲目な人間て愚かしいわね。
期待が転じると憎しみに変わるなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Sad, sad humans... See
how their expectations turn to
hatred in a heartbeat?

fields.EN:
Hey, did you hear that?! That woman
just said 'humans are foolish'! She
really is a monster, isn't she?!
fields.JP:
おい聞いたか！
今そこの女が『人間が愚か』なんて言ったぞ！
やっぱり化け物なんじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard that?! She called us
"sad humans!" They have to be
monsters!

fields.EN:
Eeeek! A-Are they going to kill
us?!
fields.JP:
ひ、ひいい！
私たちも斬り殺されるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eeeek! A-Are they going to kill
us?!

fields.JP: あー。どうしたもんかな……
愚かな輩が、何を寝ぼけたことを

fields.EN:
Blindly following, blindly
fearing. And always acting like
victims. Foolish blind reliance...
fields.JP:
なすがままに従い、なすがままに怯え、いざ
救われれば、今度は被害者として振る舞う。
他力本願もいいところ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blindly following, blindly
fearing. And always acting like
victims. Foolish blind reliance...

fields.EN:
You should all live your own lives
after you escape from here. Do
what you want with us later.
fields.JP:
そなたたちはここを脱出した後、思い描く
暮らしをすればよい。
わらわたちを排除したければすればいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should all live your own lives
after you escape from here. Do
what you want with us later.

fields.EN:
...But useless people who have no judgment
of their own and cannot even follow through
on what they believe can simply die here.
fields.JP:
……しかし、自らの判断を持たず、信じること
すら全うできぬ役立たずは、このまま死ねばいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if all you can do is believe
without taking action, stay here
and perish.

fields.EN:
Everyone... It's okay if you don't
believe in me.
fields.JP:
みんな……わたしを信じられないなら、
信じなくても構いません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone... It's okay if you don't
believe in me.

fields.EN:
Even so, I ask that you let me
save your lives.
fields.JP:
……たとえそうだとしても、
あなたたちの命を守らせてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, I ask that you let me
save your lives.

fields.JP: そして、もう少しだけ時間をください

fields.EN:
I promise I will bring the
sunlight to you all. That is my
wish, and my role in this life.
fields.JP:
わたしは必ず、太陽の光をみんなに
届けます。それがわたしの一番の希い……
わたしの役割だから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promise I will bring the
sunlight to you all. That is my
wish, and my role in this life.

fields.JP:
ミチル様が……わしらを裏切るはずが
なかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime would never betray
us...

fields.EN:
Everyone, please follow the instructions
from us and the people of Dawn.
First, let's get out of here.
fields.JP:
皆さん。私たちと黎明の方たちの指示に従って
ください。まずはここから出ましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to ask you all to follow
their instructions. First, we must
escape from here.

fields.EN:
*sigh* That was a sad sight to
see...
fields.JP: はあ……こういうものなのかしらね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* That was a sad sight to
see...

fields.EN:
I find it interesting to see them
succumb to mob mentality from
their lack of identity.
fields.JP:
この盲目的な主体性のなさ……群集心理の
テストケースとして、とても興味深いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I find it interesting to see them
succumb to mob mentality from
their lack of identity.

fields.EN:
In any case, it's better than
being stuck talking to them.
fields.JP: ま、事態が膠着してるよりゃ、いいんじゃねえの
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, it's better than
being stuck talking to them.

fields.EN:
All right! We'll protect you on
our way out! Stay together!
fields.JP:
よし、みんな！　脇は俺たちが守る！
はぐれないように固まって進んでくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! We'll protect you on
our way out! Stay together!

fields.EN:
We'll make sure they get out safe.
So, you mind stopping him for me?
fields.JP:
こいつらは俺たちが逃す。
だから、あとを頼んでもいいか？
……あいつを止めてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll make sure they get out safe.
So, you mind stopping him for me?

fields.EN: Don't you die on me, you hear?
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't you die on me, you hear?

fields.JP: 誰に向かって言ってんのよ！

fields.EN:
You should be careful on the way
back, old man!
fields.JP: 中年こそ道中を気をつけるがよいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should be careful on the way
back, old man!

fields.EN:
We may depart elsewhere, but none
of us die in our stories.
fields.JP:
わたしたちの物語は、誰も死なないわ。
どこかに旅立つ場合はあってもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may depart elsewhere, but none
of us die in our stories.

fields.EN:
There will always be a place for
you to return so long as we're
here, so please...
fields.JP:
わたしたちがいる限り、あなたたちの帰る場所は
あるわ。だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There will always be a place for
you to return so long as we're
here, so please...

fields.JP: 戻ってきます。……みんなで

fields.EN:
I don't have the right to say
this, but... Good luck.
fields.JP:
こんなこと言えた義理ではないけど……
頑張って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have the right to say
this, but... Good luck.

fields.EN: We'll see all of ya later!
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll see all of ya later!

fields.JP: ヒヤヒヤしちゃいました……

fields.EN: You did well back there, Kaguya-san!
fields.JP: かぐやさん、かっこよかったですわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You did well back there, Kaguya!

fields.EN:
Well, it's just because I wanted
to get it off my chest.
fields.JP: まあでも、すっきりしました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's just because I wanted
to get it off my chest.

fields.JP: ……ええ。あなたは立派だったわ

fields.EN:
I could only say it with all of
you here with me. But I won't take
responsibility if we're chased...
fields.JP:
み、みんながいたから……
つい言ってしまっただけです～
本当に追い立てられても責任取れません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could only say it with all of
you here with me. But I won't take
responsibility if we're chased...

fields.EN:
Oh? But it seems as if they will
prepare a place for us to return.
fields.JP:
あら。帰る場所はちゃんと用意してくれる
みたいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? But it seems as if they will
prepare a place for us to return.

fields.EN:
Let's get going! We need to finish
this, once and for all!
fields.JP:
さあ、行くよ！
あたしたちは、決着を付けなきゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's get going! We need to finish
this, once and for all!

fields.EN:
The Professor... Snark
is probably beyond this door.
fields.JP: たぶん、この扉の先に博士……スナークがいる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like the Professor... Snark
is past this portal.

fields.EN: So, this is the last battle...
fields.JP: これが、最後の戦いになるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: So, this is the last battle...

fields.EN:
Once we go through, there's no
turning back. Are you ready, Jack?
fields.JP:
この扉を開けたら、きっと後戻りはできない。
ジャック、準備はいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we go through, there's no
turning back. Are you ready, Jack?

fields.EN:
Okay. Let me know once you're
ready.
fields.JP:
わかったわ。
準備がすんだらまた声をかけて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. Let me know once you're
ready.

fields.EN:
If we beat Snark, this story will
probably end...
fields.JP:
……みんな。もしスナークを倒せたら、
多分、この物語は終わるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we beat Snark, this story will
probably end...

fields.EN:
We were reincarnated from stories.
Heroes and heroines of tales. Our
purpose is to end our stories.
fields.JP:
僕たちは、絵本に込められた想いの転生体。
童話の主人公の転生体だ。
主人公の役目は、物語を終わらせること……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were reincarnated from stories.
Heroes and heroines of tales. Our
purpose is to end our stories.

fields.EN:
If that's what we were born for,
then...
fields.JP:
もしそのために僕らが生まれたんだと
したら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's what we were born for,
then...

fields.EN:
...Once the story is over, we'll
probably disappear.
fields.JP:
物語が終わったら……僕らは
役目を終えて、消えて無くなっちゃうの
かもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Once the story is over, we'll
probably disappear.

fields.EN:
At least that's what I feel like
will happen...
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least that's what I feel like
will happen...

fields.EN:
We won't disappear. We're just
going to wake up from a dream.
fields.JP:
消えて無くなったりはしないわ。
ただ、一つの夢から醒めるだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We won't disappear. We're just
going to wake up from a dream.

fields.EN:
I'm sure we'll wake up as normal
boys and girls...
fields.JP: きっと……ただの男の子と女の子としてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we'll wake up as normal
boys and girls...

fields.EN: Ohohoho! There is nothing to fear!
fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ！
怖れることなどありまして？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohohoho! There is nothing to fear!

fields.EN:
Someday, I'll be able to discard
my glass shoes!
fields.JP:
わたくしだっていつかは、
ガラスの靴など捨てますのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Someday, I'll be able to discard
my glass shoes!

fields.EN:
I don't need treasures anymore...
I won't return to the moon, and
I'll find what I want myself.
fields.JP:
わらわも、もう宝物は要らないです～
月の国には帰らずに、欲しいものは自分で
探します～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't need treasures anymore...
I won't return to the moon, and
I'll find what I want myself.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... You sure you can do
that, Princess Lazy?
fields.JP:
ふふ。
グータラ姫。あんた、そんなことできんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... You sure you can do
that, Princess Lazy?

fields.EN:
I'm not going to be held captive
anymore! I'm going to escape this
cramped place!
fields.JP:
わたしだって、
いっつも囚われ役なんてまっぴらよ！
狭い場所からはもう脱け出してみせるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not going to be held captive
anymore! I'm going to escape this
cramped place!

fields.EN:
I wouldn't mind being any ordinary
girl. I won't be afraid of mirrors
anymore.
fields.JP:
どこにでもいる普通の女の子もいいかも
しれません。だから、鏡なんてもう怖れません
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't mind being any ordinary
girl. I won't be afraid of mirrors
anymore.

fields.EN:
When Rapunzel goes outside,
she's gonna be an adult!
fields.JP:
おそとにでたら。……いつかね。
ラプンツェルはおとなになるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
When Rapunzel goes outside,
she's gonna be an adult!

fields.EN:
Oh, and I'm gonna catch someone
I like and make babies!
fields.JP:
それでね、すきなひとをつかまえて、
ふたりのこどもをうむよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I'm gonna catch someone
I like and make babies!

fields.EN:
I shall lead the Marchens and
disappear... No! I won't
disappear...
fields.JP:
ワレはメルヒェンたちでも連れて消えてくさ……
……うぐっ。いや、どこにも行かないでやろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shall lead the Marchens and
disappear... No! I won't
disappear...

fields.EN:
Yup. I don't need my hood anymore.
I'm gonna beat that bad wolf
myself.
fields.JP:
……うん。あたしももうフードは要らない。
悪いオオカミは、こっちからとっちめてやるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I don't need my hood anymore.
I'm gonna beat that bad wolf
myself.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh. Well then, I suggest we
hurry and toss our bad father into
the oven so we can all return.
fields.JP:
ふふ。だから悪いお父さんはかまどに放り込んで、
……帰らなくてはね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh. Well then, I suggest we
hurry and toss our bad father into
the oven so we can all return.

fields.EN:
Yes. And, once we awaken, we'll
need to make sure we avoid other
rabbit holes...
fields.JP:
ええ。そして……夢から覚めても
別のウサギ穴がないか、気をつけなければね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. And, once we awaken, we'll
need to make sure we avoid other
rabbit holes...

fields.EN:
I'm going to cut down this
tower... And end this old
story...
fields.JP:
……僕もこの高い塔を切り倒すんだ。
そして、古い物語を終わらせて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to cut down this
tower... And end this old
story...

fields.EN:
We can all live together, happily
ever after!
fields.JP: みんなでかえって、またいっしょにくらす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can all live together, happily
ever after!

fields.EN: This is the top of the tower...?
fields.LOCALIZED: This is the top of the tower...?

fields.EN: There's no moon in the sky...?!
fields.LOCALIZED: There's no moon in the sky...?!

fields.EN:
Well, it seems you've all come.
How futile...
fields.JP:
やあ、みんな。やはり来てしまったのかね。
無為なことを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems you've all come.
How futile...

fields.EN:
Oh? You're still going to call me
"Dad?"
fields.JP: おや。まだその名で呼んでくれるのかね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? You're still going to call me
"Dad?"

fields.EN:
Thanks to you, the Jail has
matured very well.
fields.JP:
君たちのおかげで、このジェイルは非常に
効率良く成長してくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to you, the Jail has
matured very well.

fields.EN:
Michiru also brought results
beyond my expectations, regardless
of what happened.
fields.JP:
そしてミチルも、経緯はどうあれ
私の望む以上の結果をもたらしてくれたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru also brought results
beyond my expectations, regardless
of what happened.

fields.EN:
You were meant to be the final nutrients
for 'insemination'... Luckily, some
followers could substitute for you.
fields.JP:
本来君たちは、『受精』に必要な最後の養分と
なる予定だったのだが……一部の信者で代用
できたのはうれしい誤算だったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I intended for you all to become
the final source of nutrients, but
the followers were good specimens.

fields.JP:
見たまえ。
これがその成果だ

fields.EN:
Wh-What...? What's that huge egg
thing?
fields.JP:
な……何？
そのでかい卵みたいなの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What...? What's that huge egg
thing?

fields.EN:
The insemination was a success,
and a new core... A new source of
life has been born.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの『受精』は果たされ、
こうして新たな核……生命の源が誕生したと
いうわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The insemination was a success,
and a new core... A new source of
life has been born.

fields.JP: 『受精』って……まさか、あの白い月が……

fields.EN:
Indeed. The Jail is what you would
call a "male," and the moon, a
"female."
fields.JP:
その通りだ。
君たちがジェイルと呼んでいたものは雄型でね、
あの月こそが雌型なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. The Jail is what you would
call a "male," and the moon, a
"female."

fields.EN:
What you see here are their
results. Many thanks to you all.
fields.JP:
そして……ここにその果実を得ることができた。
君たちには礼を言おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you see here are their
results. Many thanks to you all.

fields.EN:
So that egg was what you wanted?
What are you going to do with it?
fields.JP:
その卵が、あなたの目的だったというのね？
それで何をするつもりなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that egg was what you wanted?
What are you going to do with it?

fields.EN:
It hurts... I can't breathe...
Why... Is this... happening to
me...?
fields.JP:
痛い……苦しい……
どうして……こんなことに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It hurts... I can't breathe...
Why... Is this... happening to
me...?

fields.EN:
They tricked me...? Aaah... My
blood... My bones...
fields.JP:
私は騙されたの……？
ああ……血が……骨が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They tricked me...? Aaah... My
blood... My bones...

I won't... forgive you for...
what... happened... to me...

fields.JP: 信者の人たちを……殺したのね……！

fields.EN:
Ah, "murder" is such a barbaric
term. Consider them sacrifices to
bring life to the core.
fields.JP:
やれやれ。『殺す』とは野暮なことを……
彼らはこの核に宿すべき魂……尊い犠牲と
なったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, "murder" is such a barbaric
term. Consider them sacrifices to
bring life to the core.

fields.EN:
Blind faith itself is a powerful 'thought'...
And powerful 'thoughts' are the source of
souls fit to give birth to a new god...
fields.JP:
盲信こそは強き『想い』……強き『想い』こそが
新たな神を生むに相応しき魂の源……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blind faith bears desire, and
desires become the source of life
to bring about a new god.

fields.JP: 神とはまた、使い古された概念ね

fields.EN:
Yet, it is an existence that will
become the foundation to a new
order.
fields.JP: しかし、新しき秩序の礎となるべき存在だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yet, it is an existence that will
become the foundation to a new
order.

fields.EN:
I won't let you do that! We're
going to defeat you and put an
end to your plans!
fields.JP:
そんなことさせない……！
お前を倒して、野望も食い止めてみせる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't let you do that! We're
going to defeat you and put an
end to your plans!

fields.JP: それは、御免こうむりたいね

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I have no battle
prowess to speak of. I prefer to
work behind the curtain...
fields.JP:
残念なことに、私は戦闘能力を有していない。
……だからこそ、裏で糸を引いていたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I have no battle
prowess to speak of. I prefer to
work behind the curtain...

fields.EN:
Patiently pulling strings to bring
about the ending I've wanted for
the longest time.
fields.JP:
長い時間をかけてゆっくりと、全てが私の
思い通りに進むように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Patiently pulling strings to bring
about the ending I've wanted for
the longest time.

fields.JP: （そうか、そういうことだったんだ……）

だってあいつ、ぜんぜんこわくないもん。
きっと、よわいよ

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)
fields.JP: （ラプンツェルも怖くなかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)

fields.EN:
No way! That's the one that massacred
everyone from Dawn fifteen years ago!
fields.JP:
そんなはずないじゃん！
十五年前、黎明の人たちが皆殺しに遭った
相手だよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No way! That thing killed members
from the Dawn 15 years ago!

fields.EN:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.
fields.JP: でも、卑怯な相手なのは間違いないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.

fields.EN:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.
fields.JP:
そうですわ。
死にそうなナイトメアをいきなり後ろから
刺すなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.

fields.EN:
(I didn't feel fear, either.
Rapunzel's instincts were
right...)
fields.JP:
（僕が怖さを感じなかったことも、
　ラプンツェルだけが気づいていたことも
　……正しかったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't feel fear, either.
Rapunzel's instincts were
right...)

fields.JP:
（スナークに戦闘能力はない。
　もしスナークとしての行動中に見つかって、
　戦いになったら困るから……）

fields.EN:
(That explains why he created
an image of fear around "Snark,"
so that no one would face him...)
fields.JP:
（だから、スナークは恐ろしく強い、
　絶対に手を出すなって嘘をついてたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That explains why he created
an image of fear around "Snark,"
so that no one would face him...)

fields.EN:
One other thing... You're too
late.
fields.JP: それに、もう手遅れなのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing... You're too
late.

fields.JP:
ウラギラレタ……フミニジラレタ……
ミステラレタ……
イタイ……アツイ……ナニモミエナイ……
ツライ……クルシイ……タスケテ……

fields.EN:
That's right. What you hear are
the voice of hatred, of fear, of
despair. All found within you.
fields.JP:
そうだ。君たちの中にもある声……
恐怖と絶望……憎しみの声だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. What you hear are
the voice of hatred, of fear, of
despair. All found within you.

fields.EN:
The sacrificed souls have been
compressed, and with the dark
voices, a new god is born!
fields.JP:
生贄の魂が凝縮され……
この暗き声を糧に、新たな神が生まれる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sacrificed souls have been
compressed, and with the dark
voices, a new god is born!

fields.EN:
...A new god the humans and I have
created.
fields.JP: 私と人間たちが生み出した、新たな神だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...A new god the humans and I have
created.

fields.EN:
Now, then... I will need your
stories to end so I can usher in a
new world!
fields.JP:
さあ。新しい世界のために、古い物語は退場して
くれたまえ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, then... I will need your
stories to end so I can usher in a
new world!

fields.EN:
Right... You have no right to end
us, Snark.
fields.JP:
……ええ。
スナーク、退場を決めるのはあなたではないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right... You have no right to end
us, Snark.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki won't forgive you...
For deceiving everyone... For
treating everyone like tools...!
fields.JP:
ずっとみんなを騙してたこと……
みんなを使い捨ての道具のように扱ったこと……
白雪は、許しません……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White won't forgive you...
For deceiving everyone... For
treating everyone like tools...!

fields.EN:
I shall bring judgment by death to
the traitor!
