fields.JP: 裏切り者には、死の制裁を与えん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shall bring judgment by death to
the traitor!

fields.EN:
What I hate is that soul... No, your
very existence that drove that soul so far...
fields.JP:
わらわが憎むのは、その魂……いいえ、
魂をそこまで追い詰めたそなたの存在……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hate your soul... No... Your
very existence that made your
soul into what it is now!

fields.EN:
Yes... Humans are inherently
weak, but they can become
stronger!
fields.JP:
ええ……ひとの心は弱いもの……
でも、強くもなれるんですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Humans are inherently
weak, but they can become
stronger!

fields.EN:
If you weren't here,
Hansel-niisan might still be alive.
fields.JP:
あなたがいなければ、ヘンゼル兄さんも
生きられたかもしれないのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you weren't here, my brother
Hansel might still be alive.

fields.EN:
I'm going to crush you, along with
that creature of yours!
fields.JP:
あんたなんか……そいつとまとめて
ブッ潰してやる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to crush you, along with
that creature of yours!

fields.JP: ぐるる……ぜんぶ、しとめる……！！

fields.EN:
I'm ready... I need to slice open
the big bad wolf!
fields.JP:
……もう心は決まってる。
悪い狼は、切り刻んでやらなきゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm ready... I need to slice open
the big bad wolf!

fields.EN:
How disappointing... It would have
been easier if all of you were
consumed.
fields.JP:
やれやれ。手間をかけさせずに、
おとなしく食われていれば良いものを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How disappointing... It would have
been easier if all of you were
consumed.

fields.JP: ウオオォォォォオオオッ……！！

fields.EN: Did he die with it? Or maybe...
fields.JP:
一緒に死んだのかしら？
それとも……
fields.LOCALIZED: Did he die with it? Or maybe...

fields.EN:
The Tower...! We have to get out
of here, now!
fields.JP:
塔が……！
みんな、早くここを出よう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Tower...! We have to get out
of here, now!

fields.EN:
It's probably wilting from the
insemination...
fields.JP: ……受精を済ませて、枯れていくんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's probably wilting from the
insemination...

fields.JP:
もう一度伸長することは……望めないの
かしら……？

fields.EN:
No one knows what will happen to a
Jail adapted to this world after insemination.
fields.JP:
この世界に適応したジェイルの受精後が
どうなるかなんて、誰にもわからねえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one knows what's gonna
happen to this world after the
Jail completes its insemination.

fields.JP: だが、普通に考えりゃ無理だろうな……

fields.EN:
So how are we supposed to get
out of here?!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、わたしたちはどうやってここから
抜け出せばいいのよ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So how are we supposed to get
out of here?!

fields.EN:
What we just did... Has merely
brought about death to
everyone...?
fields.JP:
僕たちのしてきたことは……人々を死なせる
だけの結果に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What we just did... Has merely
brought about death to
everyone...?

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. By the time
you got to the prison, it was all too
late.
fields.JP:
仕方ねえよ……牢に駆けつけた時は、
もう全てが終わってたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped. By the time
you got to the prison, it was all too
late.

fields.EN:
Then, was what we did all for
nothing...?
fields.JP: わたくしたちの今までは……何だったんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then, was what we did all for
nothing...?

fields.EN:
I want to believe that none of it
was a waste!
fields.JP: 無駄じゃないって……信じたいのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to believe that none of it
was a waste!

fields.EN:
Michiru-san? Please continue to preach
about the sun.
fields.JP:
……ミチルさんは、太陽のことを……
これからもずっと話し続けてください……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru? Please continue to preach
about the sun.

fields.EN:
No matter how small, it still is a
source of hope to everyone...
fields.JP:
どんなに小さくても……
みんなの……希望、なんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter how small, it still is a
source of hope to everyone...

fields.EN: I won't let it end here...
fields.JP: こんなことで……負けるもんか……
fields.LOCALIZED: I won't let it end here...

fields.EN:
That's right. Defeat comes only to
those who accept defeat!
fields.JP: そうだ。敗北を認めた時こそ、真の敗北だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Defeat comes only to
those who accept defeat!

fields.EN:
I'm sure there's something we can
do...
fields.JP: きっと、まだ何かできることがあるはずだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure there's something we can
do...

fields.EN:
Well, Pandora's box did have Hope
left inside it.
fields.JP:
……そうね。災厄の箱に最後に残ったものは
希望だというわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Pandora's box did have Hope
left inside it.

fields.EN:
Yes. No matter how deep the
labyrinth, there's always a way
out.
fields.JP:
ええ。どんなに入り組んだ迷宮でも、
出口は必ずあるものだもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. No matter how deep the
labyrinth, there's always a way
out.

fields.EN:
That's right, Aka-nee...
We crushed his scheme!
fields.JP:
そうよ。赤姉……
わたしたち、あいつの企みは潰したんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Sister Red... We
came here to stop his plans!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... You're right. I was
just about to give up there... We
did at least complete one thing...
fields.JP:
へへ……そうだった。忘れるとこだったよ……
あたしたち、ひとつくらいはできたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... You're right. I was
just about to give up there... We
did at least complete one thing...

fields.EN:
No matter how many times we're
beat or how many times we're put
to despair...
fields.JP:
どんなに打ちのめされても……
どんなに絶望に叩き落とされたって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter how many times we're
beat or how many times we're put
to despair...

fields.EN:
We're all going to escape from
here... from this prison-world together...!
fields.JP:
必ずみんなで……ここから、
この監獄の世界から抜け出してみせる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to escape from the
Jail, once and for all!

fields.EN: Are we at the very top...?
fields.LOCALIZED: Are we at the very top...?

fields.JP: ここがほんとのてっぺんだね！

fields.EN: Look at how close the moon is!
fields.JP: 白い月が……こんなに近くに……！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Look at how close the moon is!

fields.EN:
The top of the tower... is in
contact with the moon...?
fields.JP:
あれは……塔の先端が白い月に触れて
輝いてる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The top of the tower... is in
contact with the moon...?

fields.EN:
Ah, I see you're all here. I must
say, you all brought about
something quite unexpected.
fields.JP:
やあ、みんな。
ずいぶんと予定外なことをしてくれたようだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I see you're all here. I must
say, you all brought about
something quite unexpected.

fields.EN:
I should have fired the gun
earlier. That last bit of mercy I
felt didn't do me any good.
fields.JP:
やはり、先ほど撃っておけばよかったか。
最後の最後……ほんの一滴の慈悲が仇になった
ようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should have fired the gun
earlier. That last bit of mercy I
felt didn't do me any good.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised to hear you say
that, considering you never had a
drop of mercy in you...
fields.JP:
勝手なこと言って……
慈悲なんてこれっぽっちもなかったくせに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised to hear you say
that, considering you never had a
drop of mercy in you...

fields.EN:
We have all the means to put you
down. Give up now, while you
still have the chance.
fields.JP:
あなたを狩る道具は全て揃ってる。
だから……諦めるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have all the means to put you
down. Give up now, while you
still have the chance.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, everything is ready
on my side as well. I told you that
you were no longer needed, didn't I?
fields.JP:
残念ながら、私の方も全てが整ったのだよ。
君たちは用済みだと言ったろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I have the means
to put you all down, too. Didn't
I say I had no more use for you?

fields.EN:
You were meant to be the final nutrients
for 'insemination'... Luckily, the Marchens
guarding the core could substitute for you.
fields.JP:
本来君たちは、『受精』に必要な最後の養分と
なる予定だったのだが……核を守護する
メルヒェンで代用できたのはうれしい誤算だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were all to be nutrients for
the insemination, but I'm happy
that the Marchens sufficed.

fields.EN:
The Marchens guarding
the core... were substitutes?
fields.JP: 核を守護するメルヒェンで……代用？

fields.EN:
The core... is eating the
Marchen?!
fields.JP: 核が……メルヒェンを……食べてる！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The core... is eating the
Marchen?!

fields.EN:
This may be a function unique to this
tower, something the other cores never had.
fields.JP:
これは……今までの核にはなかった、
この塔特有の機能なのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's a special
function specific to that core.

fields.EN:
What is it trying to do by
absorbing the Marchen that was guarding it?
fields.JP:
自分を守護していたメルヒェンを吸収して、
何をしようというのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's absoring the Marchen
that was guarding it... for
nourishment.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you were able to use
a single Marchen to replace all of
us.
fields.JP:
私たちの代用が、
たかだか一体のメルヒェンだなんて
ずいぶんと大ざっぱな計算をしていたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you were able to use
a single Marchen to replace all of
us.

fields.EN:
But that was only possible because
of all of you. Your work nurtured
the Jail far more than I expected.
fields.JP:
そうではないよ。
これは、君たちの活躍によって、
ジェイルが想定以上に育ったからなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that was only possible because
of all of you. Your work nurtured
the Jail far more than I expected.

fields.EN:
How ironic. The life-risking efforts
you made under my guidance will
end up saving your own lives.
fields.JP:
皮肉なものだね。
私に導かれた君たちの命がけの頑張りが、
君たち自身の命を救うことになるとは
fields.LOCALIZED:
How ironic, seeing your efforts
bring about the very existence
which will reap you of your lives.

fields.EN:
Anger isn't needed here. On the
contrary, you should all be
rejoicing.
fields.JP:
怒るのは野暮だよ。
むしろ、喜びたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anger isn't needed here. On the
contrary, you should all be
rejoicing.

fields.EN:
Behold! The insemination is about
to begin!
fields.JP:
今、まさにこの刻、『受精』が始まろうと
しているのだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Behold! The insemination is about
to begin!

fields.EN:
(The top of the tower and the moon
are shining...!)
fields.JP: （くっ！　塔の先端と白い月が光って……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The top of the tower and the moon
are shining...!)

fields.EN:
Wh-What's with that huge egg
thing?!
fields.JP:
な……何！？
そのでかい卵みたいなの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What's with that huge egg
thing?!

fields.EN:
This is the new "core"...
the one and only source of life.
fields.JP:
これこそ、新たな『核』……
唯一無二の生命の源だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, this is the new core... The
source of life for all.

fields.EN: It... was created from the moon?
fields.JP: まさか、あの白い月から……？
fields.LOCALIZED: It... was created from the moon?

fields.EN:
Indeed. The Jail is what you would
call a "male," and the moon, a
"female."
fields.JP:
その通りだ。
君たちがジェイルと呼んでいたものは雄型でね、
あの月こそが雌型なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. The Jail is what you would
call a "male," and the moon, a
"female."

fields.EN:
What you see here are their
results. Many thanks to you all.
fields.JP:
そして……ここにその果実を得ることができた。
君たちには礼を言おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you see here are their
results. Many thanks to you all.

fields.EN:
What if I propose that you leave
that core to nature?
fields.JP: たとえばその『核』を、自然に任せたとしたら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if I propose that you leave
that core to nature?

fields.EN:
Ah, but all it would do is mimic
whatever is around it when it
hatches, just like the Jail did.
fields.JP:
どうもこうもない。これが孵る際、
適当にその辺のものを擬態させながら成長する
だけだ……ジェイルのようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but all it would do is mimic
whatever is around it when it
hatches, just like the Jail did.

fields.EN:
I see. So this world and our
existence were created out of your
control.
fields.JP:
そう……この世界や私たちの存在は、
あなたの企図したものではないわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So this world and our
existence were created out of your
control.

fields.EN:
Yes, but it gave me an excellent hint:
the Jail had become able to mimic even
abstract things such as fairy tales...
fields.JP:
ああ、しかし良い示唆は与えたくれた。
童話などという、観念的なものまでを
ジェイルが擬態できるようになったのだとね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but through it, I discovered
that the Jail can mimic even
imaginary beings from stories.

fields.EN:
So, that made you think of using
it to change the world?
fields.JP:
それで、それを利用して世界を塗り替えようと
考えたんですか。
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that made you think of using
it to change the world?

fields.EN:
You spoke with him...? What an
unimaginative thing to say, though
it sounds like him to say that.
fields.JP:
……あの男に聞いたのか。
あの男らしい堅実な発想だが、実につまらない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You spoke with him...? What an
unimaginative thing to say, though
it sounds like him to say that.

fields.EN:
This world has already changed in
a way. If so, your desire must be
something purer.
fields.JP:
そうね。世界は既に塗り替えられてしまって
いるといってもいいものね。だとしたら、
あなたの望みはもっと純粋なもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This world has already changed in
a way. If so, your desire must be
something purer.

fields.EN:
That would mean what you seek is a
purer form of order, with all
contaminants removed.
fields.JP:
不純な要素を排除し、より純粋な秩序を求めよう
というのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would mean what you seek is a
purer form of order, with all
contaminants removed.

fields.EN:
Very insightful, Gretel. Though I
must say I despise you for that...
fields.JP:
君はいつも察しがいいね、グレーテル。
……だが私は、君のそんなところがたまらなく
嫌いだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very insightful, Gretel. Though I
must say I despise you for that...

fields.EN:
Now then, it's time we end the
prattle. I have work to do.
fields.JP:
さて、お話はそろそろおしまいにしよう。
私にはまだやるべきことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, it's time we end the
prattle. I have work to do.

fields.EN:
We came here to stop you! To
defeat you and end this story!
fields.JP:
やらせないわ……！
あなたを倒して、このばかげた物語を
終わらせてみせる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We came here to stop you! To
defeat you and end this story!

fields.EN:
Alice... I'm honored to hear your
enthusiasm, but I'm afraid I must
decline your offer.
fields.JP:
アリス……お誘いはとても光栄だが……
今回は遠慮しておくとしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... I'm honored to hear your
enthusiasm, but I'm afraid I must
decline your offer.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I have no battle
prowess to speak of. I prefer to
work behind the curtain...
fields.JP:
私は戦闘能力を有していないのでね。
……だからこそ、裏で糸を引いていたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I have no battle
prowess to speak of. I prefer to
work behind the curtain...

fields.EN:
Patiently pulling strings to bring
about the ending I've wanted for
the longest time.
fields.JP:
長い時間をかけてゆっくりと、全てが私の
思い通りに進むように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Patiently pulling strings to bring
about the ending I've wanted for
the longest time.

fields.JP: （そうか、そういうことだったんだ……）

だってあいつ、ぜんぜんこわくないもん。
きっと、よわいよ

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)
fields.JP: （ラプンツェルも怖くなかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)

fields.EN:
No way! That's the one that massacred
everyone from Dawn fifteen years ago!
fields.JP:
そんなはずないじゃん！
十五年前、黎明の人たちが皆殺しに遭った
相手だよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No way! That thing killed members
from the Dawn 15 years ago!

fields.EN:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.
fields.JP: でも、卑怯な相手なのは間違いないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.

fields.EN:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.
fields.JP:
そうですわ。
死にそうなナイトメアをいきなり後ろから
刺すなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.

fields.EN:
(I didn't feel fear, either.
Rapunzel's instincts were
right...)
fields.JP:
（僕が怖さを感じなかったことも、
　ラプンツェルだけが気づいていたことも
　……正しかったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't feel fear, either.
Rapunzel's instincts were
right...)

fields.JP:
（スナークに戦闘能力はない。
　もしスナークとしての行動中に見つかって、
　戦いになったら困るから……）

fields.EN:
(That explains why he created
an image of fear around "Snark,"
so that no one would face him...)
fields.JP:
（だから、スナークは恐ろしく強い、
　絶対に手を出すなって嘘をついてたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That explains why he created
an image of fear around "Snark,"
so that no one would face him...)

fields.EN:
The blind souls that were to dwell
within the core... The source of its
'thoughts' was lost because of you.
fields.JP:
『核』に宿らせるべき盲目な魂……
『想い』の源は、君たちによって失われた
fields.LOCALIZED:
The blind souls meant to feed the
core... Its intended source of
desire was lost, thanks to you.

fields.EN:
Considering how strenuous it was
to lead Michiru here, that was a
terrible loss, indeed.
fields.JP:
ここまでミチルを導くのは大変な労力を
要したというのに、大変な損失だったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Considering how strenuous it was
to lead Michiru here, that was a
terrible loss, indeed.

fields.EN:
But that means nothing to me
now. The reason...?
fields.JP:
だが、もはやそれも問題ではない。
……なぜならば
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that means nothing to me
now. The reason...?

fields.EN:
I will become the soul to live
within the core!
fields.JP: この私自身が宿れば良いのだから……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will become the soul to live
within the core!

fields.EN:
There are tentacles coming out of
the core!
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are tentacles coming out of
the core!

fields.EN:
Now then, my dear core... Guide
me! A new story will now unfold!
fields.JP:
さあ、『核』よ。私を導くが良い！
新たな世界の幕開けだ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, my dear core... Guide
me! A new story will now unfold!

fields.JP: ヴオオオオォォォォオオオァ！！
マサカ、ココデ邪魔ガ入ルトハ……！！
おおー！　ゆれてるー！！
一体、何がどうなってるの！？

fields.EN:
We're... standing on the broken
pieces from the tower...
fields.JP: 崩れた瓦礫が浮いて……足場になってる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're... standing on the broken
pieces from the tower...

fields.JP: あれは……ジェイルなのか！？

fields.EN: I-It's like some kind of monster!
fields.JP: ま、まるで化け物みたいです……！！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-It's like some kind of monster!

fields.EN:
What you see there is what you
once called "Snark."
fields.JP:
……あれは、あなた方がスナークと
呼んでいたものです
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you see there is what you
once called "Snark."

fields.EN:
Snark merged himself with the
Jail, and brought about a new
awakening.
fields.JP:
スナークはあの塔……雄型のジェイルと
一体化し、新たな目覚めを迎えました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snark merged himself with the
Jail, and brought about a new
awakening.

fields.EN:
The Jail's new core conceived two
desires and divided upon its
hatching.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの新たな『核』は、
二つの想いを同時に受け入れて
分裂孵化したのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's new core conceived two
desires and divided upon its
hatching.

fields.EN:
Snark's desire was absorbed by
the Tower, transforming it into a
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
スナークの想いは、あの塔を取り込んで
……ナイトメアに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snark's desire was absorbed by
the Tower, transforming it into a
Nightmare.

fields.EN:
And the wish to save this world
transformed one girl... and became me.
fields.JP:
そして、この世界を救いたいという
想いは……一人の少女を変容させ、
私となったのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The other desire of saving the
world was transformed into a girl,
which is who you see here.

fields.JP: あんたは一体、何者なわけ？

fields.EN: Jack? Do you remember my voice?
fields.JP:
それは……ジャック、私の声に聞き覚えは
ありませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? Do you remember my voice?

fields.EN:
"We'll see you at the top!"
I believe I made that promise with
you.
fields.JP:
絶対、頂上で会おうね！
……そう、約束したでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
"We'll see you at the top!"
I believe I made that promise with
you.

fields.EN:
I am a reincarnated form of that
girl. To be exact, I am the hope
that was imparted upon her.
fields.JP:
私は、あの少女の転生体。
正確に言うと、あの少女に託された希望たちの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am a reincarnated form of that
girl. To be exact, I am the hope
that was imparted upon her.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジェイル

fields.EN:
I WONDERED WHERE YOU'D
RUN OFF TO. THERE YOU ARE...!!
fields.JP:
ドコヘ逃ゲタカト思エバ、
ソンナトコロニイタカ……！！

fields.EN:
...That being's deepest wish is 'destruction.'
Left alone, this world will be swallowed
by it and become a dead planet.
fields.JP:
……あの者の根源的な願いは『破壊』。
このままにしておけば、この世界はいずれ
その願いに呑み込まれ、死の星と化すでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you see was created from
the desire to destroy. Left alone,
it'll bring death to this planet.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジェイル
浅ハカナ考エデ私ヲ語ルナ……！
ナイトメア・ジェイル

fields.EN:
DESTRUCTION LEADS TO REBIRTH. I WILL
BECOME GOD AND THE FOUNDATION OF CREATION...!
fields.JP:
『破壊』ハ『再生』ヘト繋ガッテイル。
私ハ神トナリ、創世ノ礎トナルノダ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
DESTRUCTION LEADS TO REVIVAL. I AM
GOD, AND I WILL CREATE A NEW
WORLD!

fields.EN:
Blind ambition to become a god...
How shallow.
fields.JP: 神への野望……実に浅はかな考えね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blind ambition to become a god...
How shallow.

fields.EN: We're going to finish you here!
fields.JP: 僕らは……お前の息の根を止める！！
fields.LOCALIZED: We're going to finish you here!

fields.EN:
B-But, what are we supposed to
do...?!
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, what are we supposed to
do...?!

fields.EN: I will create a path to him...
fields.JP:
……私が道を造ります。
それを使ってあれの元へ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I will create a path to him...

fields.JP: わかった。いろいろありがとう！
ナイトメア・ジェイル

fields.EN:
I AM GOD. I AM THE ONE TO BRING
ORDER TO THE NEW WORLD!
fields.JP: 我ハ神……新世界ニ秩序ヲモタラス者ナリ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I AM GOD. I AM THE ONE TO BRING
ORDER TO THE NEW WORLD!

fields.EN:
Yes... A fitting end to this crazy
story.
fields.JP: ええ……狂った物語に、ふさわしい結末を
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... A fitting end to this crazy
story.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジェイル
ヴオオオオォォォォオオオァ！！
ナイトメア・ジェイル
オオオォオオォォォォオオオ……！

fields.EN:
I see that the curtains have
closed.
fields.JP: 幕は下りた、というべきか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see that the curtains have
closed.

fields.EN: Our footing is falling apart, too!
fields.JP: 足元の瓦礫が崩れてきます……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Our footing is falling apart, too!

fields.EN:
It seems I used too much of my
power...
fields.JP:
……少し、疲れました。
どうやら……力を使い過ぎてしまった
ようです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I used too much of my
power...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... Being newly born, my
power is highly unstable...
fields.JP:
……申し訳ありません。
生まれたばかりで……まだ……
力が不安定なのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... Being newly born, my
power is highly unstable...

fields.EN:
Hurry! Over here! I may be able to
maintain at least some footing...
fields.JP:
早く……この瓦礫の上に……！
一つだけならば……あるいは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hurry! Over here! I may be able to
maintain at least some footing...

fields.JP: みんな、その瓦礫に急いで！！
（まずい！　赤ずきんさんが！！）
（まずい！　ラプンツェルが！！）
（このままじゃ、地面に激突する……！！）

fields.EN:
(There... There has to be a
way...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There... There has to be a
way...!)

fields.JP: （いくつか使えそうなものが……！）

（だ……駄目だ！
　どうにもならない……！）

fields.EN: (If I can at least save Akazukin-san...!)
fields.JP: （せめて、赤ずきんさんだけでも……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save Red Riding
Hood...!)

fields.JP: ジャック！　ジャック！！
どうして、あたしのことなんか庇って……
こんなのって、こんなのってないよーっ！

fields.EN: (If I can at least save Alice...!)
fields.LOCALIZED: (If I can at least save Alice...!)

fields.JP: ジャック……あなた、どうして……

fields.EN:
You promised... You promised we'd
make it out of here alive!
fields.JP:
一緒に……生きようって……
約束したじゃない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You promised... You promised we'd
make it out of here alive!

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Oyayubihime...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Thumbelina...!)

fields.JP:
死んじゃったら……もう
どうにもならないじゃない……

fields.EN: (If I can at least save Shirayukihime...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save Snow
White...!)

fields.JP:
え……そんな……
ジャックさん……どうして……？

fields.LOCALIZED: Why did you save Snow White...?

fields.EN:
What is Shirayuki supposed to
do...? Jack-san...
fields.JP:
白雪は……これからどうすれば
いいんですか……ジャックさん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is Snow White supposed to
do...? Jack...

fields.EN: (If I can at least save Nemurihime...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save Sleeping
Beauty...!)

fields.JP:
ジャック……ボク……
…………どうして…………！

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Cinderella...!)
fields.JP: （せめて、シンデレラだけでも……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Cinderella...!)

fields.JP:
ジャックさん……！
どうして……

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Kaguyahime...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Kaguya...!)

fields.EN:
I... I will bring you in as my
retainer...
fields.JP:
…………そなたを……
わらわの従者にしてあげます……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... I will bring you in as my
retainer...

fields.EN:
Let's go together... to the
moon...
fields.JP: 一緒に……月まで連れて行きますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go together... to the
moon...

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Gretel...!)
fields.JP: （せめて、グレーテルだけでも……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Gretel...!)

fields.EN:
You fool... I didn't care
what happened to my own life.
fields.JP:
馬鹿ね……私は、自分の命なんてどうでも
よかったのに
fields.LOCALIZED: How stupid of you to save me.

fields.EN:
But, do know that I felt solace in
being with you...
fields.JP:
……ただ、あなたと一緒にいることが
心地よいと感じていたのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, do know that I felt solace in
being with you...

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Rapunzel...!)
fields.JP: （せめて、ラプンツェルだけでも……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Rapunzel...!)

fields.EN:
Guess we can't make babies
now...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess we can't make babies
now...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel had a lot of fun with
you. It was always fun being with
you...
fields.JP:
でもラプンツェル、たのしかったよ。
いちばん……たのしかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel had a lot of fun with
you. It was always fun being with
you...

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Hameln...!)
fields.JP: （せめて、ハーメルンだけでも……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Hameln...!)

fields.EN: Fool... Why did you save me?
fields.LOCALIZED: Fool... Why did you save me?

fields.EN:
What meaning is there to this
victory?
fields.JP: ……こんな勝利に、意味などあるか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What meaning is there to this
victory?

fields.EN: A victory with no one to share the joy with...
fields.JP:
喜びを分かち合う者の……
おらぬ勝利など……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A victory without the one whom I
dreamt of sharing...

fields.EN:
(All right! The thrust slowed the
fall!)
fields.JP: （よし！　逆噴射で勢いを殺した！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All right! The thrust slowed the
fall!)

fields.JP: おーい。街の連中も集めてきたよー！

fields.EN:
Everyone under the Order of the
Sun is ready.
fields.JP: タイヨウのみんなも、そろってるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone under the Order of the
Sun is ready.

fields.EN:
Hey, you sure there's nothing left
to bring with us?
fields.JP:
おい。
本部から持ち出すものは、他にもう無いか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, you sure there's nothing left
to bring with us?

fields.EN:
Yes. Unlike you, I only have to
bring my medicines, materials,
and medical tools.
fields.JP:
ええ。薬品と医療器具と資料と……
あなたと違って身軽なものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Unlike you, I only have to
bring my medicines, materials,
and medical tools.

fields.EN:
That doesn't sound different from
how much I'm gonna bring with
me...
fields.JP: 全然身軽じゃねえだろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't sound different from
how much I'm gonna bring with
me...

fields.JP: 姉さん、持つの手伝うっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna help carry her stuff,
too!

fields.EN:
Gotta say though, I'm impressed
you're gonna bring the materials
even after everything's done.
fields.JP:
しっかし、全部終わったってのに、
資料まで残さず持ち出すとは、真面目だねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gotta say though, I'm impressed
you're gonna bring the materials
even after everything's done.

fields.EN:
You're the unserious one. You're
nothing like that person from your homeland.
fields.JP:
あなたが不真面目なのよ。
同郷だったっていうあの人とは大違いね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like to be prepared. I have to
say that you're not like that
comrade of yours.

fields.EN:
Yeah... Well, he was a bit too
hard-headed, for better or worse.
fields.JP:
まあ……あいつは良くも悪くもクソ真面目だった
からな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Well, he was a bit too
hard-headed, for better or worse.

fields.EN: So much so that he lost his way...
fields.JP: 真面目すぎて、歪んじまったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: So much so that he lost his way...

fields.EN:
Um, Haru-san, where exactly did you
and the Professor come from?
fields.JP:
あの、ハルさんと博士って……どこから
来たんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, so where exactly did you and
the Professor come from?

fields.EN:
I'll talk about it once we get
settled. It's so out of this world
that it doesn't fit this story.
fields.JP:
……落ち着いたらおいおい話してやるよ。
ま、突拍子も無い話だ。
どのみちこの物語にはふさわしくねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll talk about it once we get
settled. It's so out of this world
that it doesn't fit this story.

fields.EN: Way to put on airs, Boss!
fields.JP: 師匠のもったいぶりー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Way to put on airs, Boss!

fields.EN:
That what adults do. Unlike brats,
we have a lot more baggage.
fields.JP:
大人はもったいぶるんだよ。
ガキどもと違って、持ってるもんが少ねえからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That what adults do. Unlike brats,
we have a lot more baggage.

fields.EN:
I guess my story's about a prince
from a faraway planet losing his
place, and bringing along a rose.
fields.JP:
……ま、お前ら風に言うなら、
遠い星の王子様が、住んでた小さな星を失って、
大事な花だけ持ってやって来た……そんな話さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess my story's about a prince
from a faraway planet losing his
place, and bringing along a rose.

fields.EN:
Eew! He called himself a prince!
Way to overstate yourself!
fields.JP:
うわ！　自分のこと王子様とか言ってるし……
ちょっと引いたっすよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eew! He called himself a prince!
Way to overstate yourself!

fields.EN:
That's just an analogy, you little
brat...
fields.JP: 例えって言ったろ。シメるぞガキ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's just an analogy, you little
brat...

fields.EN:
Whoa! Uh, I just remembered I
needed to go and check on
something!
fields.JP:
ひゃー！
自分、あっち見てくるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Uh, I just remembered I
needed to go and check on
something!

fields.EN:
That did come out of nowhere.
But you've piqued my interest.
I'd like to hear more later.
fields.JP:
確かに突拍子も無い話ね。
……落ち着いたら詳細を聞きたいところだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That did come out of nowhere.
But you've piqued my interest.
I'd like to hear more later.

fields.JP: そうね。興味深い事例だわ……

fields.EN:
Whoa! Where'd you come from?! Damn
those ears of yours...
fields.JP:
うお、いきなり出てきやがって。
お前、地獄耳だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Where'd you come from?! Damn
those ears of yours...

fields.EN:
Yes. I'm the one who will inherit
his intellect. Naturally. Miko, I
propose that we cooperate once again.
fields.JP:
ええ。彼の頭脳を継ぐのは私だもの。当然よ
視子、改めて連携を提案するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you expect anything less? I
did share his intellect. Now,
may I suggest we cooperate, Miko?

fields.EN:
Why, yes, that sounds like an
excellent idea.
fields.JP: そうね。有意義な提案だと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes, that sounds like an
excellent idea.

fields.EN:
Jack... You felt sorry for me
there, didn't ya? You need a
beating?
fields.JP:
ジャック。お前いま、同情しただろ？
お前もシメるぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... You felt sorry for me
there, didn't ya? You need a
beating?

fields.EN:
Wha-?! I didn't feel sorry! H-Hey!
P-Please, stop!
fields.JP:
ええっ！？　してませんってば！
わあっ！　ほ、ほんとにシメないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! I didn't feel sorry! H-Hey!
P-Please, stop!

fields.EN:
Jack... I really appreciate what
you've done.
fields.JP: ……ジャック。お前には感謝してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I really appreciate what
you've done.

fields.JP: おーい、永遠。こっちは準備できたぞー！

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Finally! Guess now we
can begin our exodus!
fields.JP:
ははは。待ってましたよ。
まあ、ちょっとした民族大移動ですからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Finally! Guess now we
can begin our exodus!

fields.JP: ……みんな！　みんなは準備はいい？

fields.EN:
I will now lead everyone to the
surface. This will mark my final
mission.
fields.JP:
これから私は、みなさんを地上へと導きます。
それが私の最後の仕事……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will now lead everyone to the
surface. This will mark my final
mission.

fields.EN:
Um... What about your companion who
climbed the other tower with you? I
don't see anyone like that here...
fields.JP:
あ、あの！
君と一緒にもう一つの塔を昇った、あの人は？
見当たらないみたいだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, what happened to the others
who climbed the Tower with you?
I don't see them around.

fields.EN:
They have already moved to a
safe place... I plan on going
there after this, too.
fields.JP:
……彼らはすでに、安全な場所へ移動しています。
このあと、私も彼らの所へ帰ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
They have already moved to a
safe place... I plan on going
there after this, too.

fields.EN:
(That's good to hear. I guess I'll
get a chance to meet them next
time.)
fields.JP:
（良かった……
　また、いつか会えるかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's good to hear. I guess I'll
get a chance to meet them next
time.)

fields.JP: かみさま、いなくなっちゃうの？

fields.EN:
I'm not a god, but I will be
watching over you all with hope of
the world's revival.
fields.JP:
私は神様ではないわ。
世界の再生を願いながら、どこかでずっと
あなたたちを見守っています
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not a god, but I will be
watching over you all with hope of
the world's revival.

fields.EN:
You are the ones to create this
new story. Isn't that right?
fields.JP:
新しい物語を始めるのはあなたたち……
そうでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are the ones to create this
new story. Isn't that right?

fields.EN:
The old story is coming to an end,
and the time for a new beginning
has come.
fields.JP:
旧い物語は幕を下ろし、
始まりの刻が巡ってきたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The old story is coming to an end,
and the time for a new beginning
has come.

fields.EN:
Regardless of the new chapter
unfurling a new world, the sun
will set and rise as usual.
fields.JP:
新たに開いた頁の先に広がる世界が
どのような姿であろうと、陽は沈み、また昇る……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless of the new chapter
unfurling a new world, the sun
will set and rise as usual.

fields.EN:
If so, there will always be a
fragment of hope hidden within
that world.
fields.JP:
そんな世界に、希望の欠片が潜まぬ筈がない
……そうでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, there will always be a
fragment of hope hidden within
that world.

fields.EN:
I want to bring sunlight to everyone...
so I'll stay with Chii-chan and keep
watching over everyone. Okay?
fields.JP:
わたしは、みんなにお日様を届けたいから……
ちーちゃんとずっと一緒に、みんなのことを
見守るの。ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I deliver everyone to the
sun, Chii and I will watch over
everyone.

fields.EN: Yeah. Me too... with you, Nee-san...

fields.JP: ねー、ちじょうってどんなとこ？
今となっては、ここの誰もがわからないわね

fields.EN:
That's why we're heading there,
right?
fields.JP: だから行くのよ。そうでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we're heading there,
right?

fields.EN:
We're going to be together, so
it'll be fine. We'll survive.
fields.JP:
みんなと一緒なんだから……どんなところだって
生きていけるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to be together, so
it'll be fine. We'll survive.

fields.EN:
Yup. After all, I trained
everyone! Not like we'd lose to
anything now!
fields.JP:
そうだね。あたしの鍛えたみんなだもん。
そんじょそこらじゃ負けないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. After all, I trained
everyone! Not like we'd lose to
anything now!

fields.EN:
I wonder what it's like, climbing
up to the sky to reach the
surface.
fields.JP:
地上に行くのに空へと昇るなんて……
どんな感じなんでしょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what it's like, climbing
up to the sky to reach the
surface.

fields.EN:
The new world will have its own
mysteries. Of course it's going
to be interesting there.
fields.JP:
新しい世界には、新しい謎がたくさん
あるはず……楽しくないわけがないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The new world will have its own
mysteries. Of course it's going
to be interesting there.

fields.EN:
I experienced this once before...
I didn't expect to experience it
again...
fields.JP:
ワレは一度、身をもって体験したこと……
二度も体験できりゅとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I experienced this once before...
I didn't expect to experience it
again...

fields.JP: うんっ！　ラプンツェル、たのしみー！

fields.EN:
Leave this lost world and go to
where the sun shines...
fields.JP:
お行きなさい。
予め失われたこの世界から、陽の差す場所へ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave this lost world and go to
where the sun shines...

fields.EN: A new beginning to a new story...
fields.JP: 新しい物語の、始まりね……
fields.LOCALIZED: A new beginning to a new story...

fields.EN:
We're going to create a new story
with everyone...
fields.JP:
これからみんなで、新しい物語を
始めていくんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to create a new story
with everyone...

fields.EN:
But the end of one dream marks the
beginning of another.
fields.JP: けれど、夢の終わりは、別の夢の始まり
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the end of one dream marks the
beginning of another.

fields.EN:
You've heard that before, haven't
you?
fields.JP: ……誰かにそう聞いたことはないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've heard that before, haven't
you?

fields.EN:
That was a close call... Are you
okay, Alice?
fields.JP:
一時はどうなることかと思ったよ……
アリスは大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was a close call... Are you
okay, Alice?

fields.EN:
Stupid! Stupid! Stupid! I can't
believe how stupid you are!
fields.JP:
馬鹿馬鹿馬鹿！
なんて馬鹿なことしたのよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stupid! Stupid! Stupid! I can't
believe how stupid you are!

fields.JP:
アリス！？　落ち着いて！
もう大丈夫だよ、助かったんだ……！
そんなのわかってるわ！

fields.EN:
What were you going to do if you
lost all your blood using the
Mary Gun like that?!
fields.JP:
あんな風にメアリガンをめいっぱい使って、
血を使い果たしてしまったら、
どうするつもりだったの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What were you going to do if you
lost all your blood using the
Mary Gun like that?!

fields.EN:
We finally made it this far...
We're so close to finding our way
out of this story's labyrinth!
fields.JP:
せっかくここまで来たのに……
物語の迷路から抜け出すことができたのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We finally made it this far...
We're so close to finding our way
out of this story's labyrinth!

fields.EN:
If you died on me... It wouldn't
make any sense for me to live!
fields.JP:
ここでもしあなたが死んだりしたら
わたしは……何のために生きてきたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you died on me... It wouldn't
make any sense for me to live!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry for worrying you like
that, Alice. But... I wanted to
save you...
fields.JP:
アリス、心配かけてごめん。
でも……どうしても助けたかったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for worrying you like
that, Alice. But... I wanted to
save you...

fields.EN:
It's the same with me. I can't
imagine you dying on me.
fields.JP:
僕だって、こんなことでアリスが死ぬなんて
我慢ならなかったからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's the same with me. I can't
imagine you dying on me.

fields.EN:
Remember that we promised we'd
have a tea party once we made it
out alive?
fields.JP:
一緒に生き延びて、お茶会をするって……
そう約束、しただろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember that we promised we'd
have a tea party once we made it
out alive?

fields.EN:
Alice, I was able to fight all
this time because you were with
me.
fields.JP:
アリス、君がいつも一緒にいてくれたから、
僕は最後まで戦えたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, I was able to fight all
this time because you were with
me.

fields.EN:
Me, too... I was able to search
for a way out of the labyrinth in
my mind because of you.
fields.JP:
わたしだって……あなたがいてくれたから、
迷路の出口を探し続けることができた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me, too... I was able to search
for a way out of the labyrinth in
my mind because of you.

fields.EN:
That's not all. My world is filled
with joy because you're with me.
It made me want to live.
fields.JP:
それだけじゃないわ。あなたがいてくれたから
……世界がとても豊かになったわ。生き延びる
だけじゃない。生きようって思えたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not all. My world is filled
with joy because you're with me.
It made me want to live.

fields.EN: It's the same with me, too.
fields.JP: 僕も……そうかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED: It's the same with me, too.

fields.EN:
That's why we were able to have
such precious friends like we do
now.
fields.JP:
だから……仲間というかけがえのない存在も
得ることができたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we were able to have
such precious friends like we do
now.

fields.EN:
It's so beautiful to know that
there are people we can trust...
fields.JP: 誰かを信じられるって……素敵なことね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's so beautiful to know that
there are people we can trust...

fields.JP: じゃっくー！　ありすー！
全員、無事だったようね……
（みんな無事で本当によかった……）

fields.EN:
Can we continue to support each
other? Just like this?
fields.JP:
わたしたち……これからも、支え合って
いけるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can we continue to support each
other? Just like this?

fields.EN:
Now we can have a huge tea party
with everyone!
fields.JP:
今度こそ、
みんなで盛大にお茶会をやろうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now we can have a huge tea party
with everyone!

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
Yes... A new story, with everyone
together...
fields.JP: ……ええ。新しい物語は、みんなで一緒に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... A new story, with everyone
together...

fields.EN:
Ugggh... I thought I was gonna die
just now!
fields.JP: はああ……死ぬかと思った……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugggh... I thought I was gonna die
just now!

fields.EN:
(I can still feel
Akazukin-san's weight in my arms...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんの重み……離れてもまだ
　腕に残ってる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can still feel Red Riding
Hood's weight in my arms...)

fields.EN:
Looks like you saved me again,
Jack...
fields.JP: ……ジャックには、また助けられちゃったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you saved me again,
Jack...

fields.EN:
But, of all the things you
could've done...
fields.JP: でも、あんな無茶なやり方して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, of all the things you
could've done...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but that was the best
I could come up with. I'm glad it
worked.
fields.JP:
ごめん。
でも、あれしか思いつかなかったんだ。
ちゃんと助けられてよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but that was the best
I could come up with. I'm glad it
worked.

fields.EN:
Looks like you're the one saving
me all the time...
fields.JP: あたし、ジャックに助けられてばっかりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're the one saving
me all the time...

fields.EN:
Now that I think about it, I think
I was able to bear Dad's betrayal
because of you, Jack.
fields.JP:
……お父さんに裏切られたことだって、
ジャックがいたから受け止められたんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I think about it, I think
I was able to bear Dad's betrayal
because of you, Jack.

fields.EN:
If I'd been alone, I probably
wouldn't have made it out with
everything that's happened...
fields.JP:
あたしだけだったら、一人でいっぱいになって
破裂しちゃってたかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I'd been alone, I probably
wouldn't have made it out with
everything that's happened...

fields.EN:
Thinking about Dad still feels
weird to me...
fields.JP:
……まだ、お父さんのことを考えると
いろんな気持ちでわけわかんなくなる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking about Dad still feels
weird to me...

fields.EN:
He was the one who killed my real
father, the man who cherished me...
and yet I loved him for so long...
fields.JP:
あの人は、あたしを大事にしてくれた
本物のお父さんのことを殺した奴で、
でも、長い間、ずっと大好きで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He killed everyone who found me,
then he cared for me... I loved
him with all I had...

fields.EN:
I can't forgive him, but I can't
not love him. It's all a jumble. I
can't just hate him.
fields.JP:
許せない気持ちと、好きだった気持ちが
混ざり合ってて、ただ憎むって感じに
ならないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't forgive him, but I can't
not love him. It's all a jumble. I
can't just hate him.

fields.EN: That's very much like you, Akazukin-san...
fields.JP: ……僕は、それも赤ずきんさんらしいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's very much like you, Red
Riding Hood...

fields.EN:
It's because you're like that,
Akazukin-san, that I learned how wonderful
it is to care about your friends...
fields.JP:
そういう赤ずきんさんだから僕も、
仲間を大切にするのが素敵なことだって……
知ることができたと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I learned how wonderful it is to
care about your friends, how to
care for others, from you.

fields.EN:
Jack... I wasn't doing anything
special.
fields.JP:
ジャック……
あたしはそんな大したことしてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I wasn't doing anything
special.

fields.EN:
I think Akazukin-san taught me
what I need to do to protect what's important.
Strength, kindness, and... pain.
fields.JP:
僕は、大切なものを守るために何をするべきか、
赤ずきんさんから教わった気がするんだ。
強さも、優しさも、それに……辛さも
fields.LOCALIZED:
I learned what I needed to protect
those special to me. I learned
strength, kindness, and pain...

fields.EN:
So if remembering it gets painful,
Akazukin-san... don't pretend to be strong.
At least tell me.
fields.JP:
……だから、赤ずきんさんが思い出して辛く
なったら……強がったりしないで、せめて
僕にだけは言ってほしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I want you to at least
share that burden, and not try to
hide it behind a strong front.

fields.EN:
...Because I want you
to stay true to yourself,
Akazukin-san...
fields.JP:
……赤ずきんさんには、
赤ずきんさんらしくいてほしいから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to be who you really
are, Red Riding Hood...

fields.EN:
Jack, I want you to take better
care of yourself.
fields.JP:
でも……ジャックには、
自分のことをもっと大事にしてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, I want you to take better
care of yourself.

fields.EN:
You do the darndest things when
the pressure's on, and that hurts
my heart.
fields.JP:
ここぞって時にいきなり無茶するからさ、
心配で胸が苦しくなる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do the darndest things when
the pressure's on, and that hurts
my heart.

fields.EN: I'm sorry if I worried you...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry if I worried you...

fields.EN:
Well, next time let me know.
Discuss with me what you want to
do first!
fields.JP:
だからさ、一言でいいから……
何かする前にあたしに相談して！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, next time let me know.
Discuss with me what you want to
do first!

fields.EN:
I want you to talk to me more than
before. I am older than you, after
all.
fields.JP:
ジャックの考えてること、
もっとあたしに相談してほしいんだ。
これでも年上なんだから、さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to talk to me more than
before. I am older than you, after
all.

fields.EN:
Uh, but you seem to know what I'm
thinking before I even say
anything...
fields.JP:
いつも何も言わなくても、
見抜かれちゃってるんだけどな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but you seem to know what I'm
thinking before I even say
anything...

fields.EN:
F-Fine! I'll be sure to rely on
you more, Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
じゃ、じゃあこれからは、赤ずきんさんのこと
もっと頼りにするようにするよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine! I'll be sure to rely on
you more, Red Riding Hood!

fields.EN:
Very good. Well then, let's do a
lot more together, okay?
fields.JP:
……よろしい。
また一緒にいろいろやろうね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very good. Well then, let's do a
lot more together, okay?

fields.EN:
(Why do I feel like she's going to
make me do something
unreasonable...?)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだか無茶なことをさせられそうな
　気が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why do I feel like she's going to
make me do something
unreasonable...?)

fields.JP:
よかった！
みんな、無事だったんだ……！

fields.EN:
We've got a lot to do now... Guess
I need to get back in shape and do
more sisterly stuff!
fields.JP:
これからいろいろ立て直して……
まだまだお姉さんとして頑張んなきゃね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've got a lot to do now... Guess
I need to get back in shape and do
more sisterly stuff!

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
You said it! We're going to help
each other out, just like before.
After all, we're a family now.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
これからもみんなで……助け合っていこう。
あたしたちは……家族なんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said it! We're going to help
each other out, just like before.
After all, we're a family now.

fields.JP:
はあ……はあ……！
助か……った？

親指姫……！
よかった、君も無事で……！
……これでやっと、全部終わったのね

fields.EN:
That was way too risky! I can't
believe you used your Mary Gun
like that!
fields.JP:
あんた、いくらなんでも無理しすぎ！
あんなにメアリガンを使って……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was way too risky! I can't
believe you used your Mary Gun
like that!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry! But, that was about
all I could do...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん！
でも、あの時はああするしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry! But, that was about
all I could do...

fields.EN:
Well, maybe, but... I-In any case,
you had me worried there! Stupid!
fields.JP:
確かに、そうだけど……
も、もう……めちゃくちゃ心配したんだから！！
この馬鹿！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, maybe, but... I-In any case,
you had me worried there! Stupid!

fields.EN:
But, um... Th-Thanks... I really
appreciate what you did... I'm
just glad you're safe...
fields.JP:
でも、その……あ、ありがとう……
本当に……感謝してるわ。
あんたが無事で、よかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, um... Th-Thanks... I really
appreciate what you did... I'm
just glad you're safe...

fields.EN: I'm glad that you're safe, too...
fields.JP: 僕も……君が無事で本当によかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad that you're safe, too...

fields.EN:
...This isn't like me, is it? Something
about being around you throws me off! It's
like my true feelings just come out...
fields.JP:
……って、こんなの、わたしらしくないわよね。
な、なんかあんたの前だと調子狂っちゃうわ！
ほ、本音が出ちゃうっていうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It isn't like me to be like this.
I can't seem to keep it together
when you're around, you know?!

fields.EN:
...I don't think so. I think you're
more like yourself this way, Oyayubihime.
fields.JP:
……そんなことないよ。
その方が、親指姫らしいと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That isn't true... I think you're
no different now than usual,
Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
You've supported me all this time,
and I know you cared about me,
too...
fields.JP:
君には、今までたくさん支えられて、
心配もしてもらってたと思うんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've supported me all this time,
and I know you cared about me,
too...

fields.EN:
Heh... Now I remember... Back
when we first met, you mistook me
for the youngest sister.
fields.JP:
……そういえば最初は、
末の妹だと勘違いされたり、色々あったわよね。
まったく……ふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Now I remember... Back
when we first met, you mistook me
for the youngest sister.

fields.EN:
Heh... I'm sorry about that. But
later I realized what a dependable,
kind older sister you are...
fields.JP:
あはは……あの時はごめんね。
……でも後で、思ったんだ。
しっかりした優しいお姉さんなんだなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I'm sorry about that. But
it dawned on me afterward how
dependable you really are.

fields.EN:
Well, um... I think you helped me
a lot, too...
fields.JP:
わたしも……あんたには、色々助けてもらった
気がしてるわよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, um... I think you helped me
a lot, too...

fields.EN:
You know, just like what happened
here...
fields.JP: さっきだって、そうなのよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, just like what happened
here...

fields.EN:
S-So... how do I put this... This
story may be over, but... I want
to be with you... always...
fields.JP:
だ、だから……なんていうか……
この物語は終わったけど……その……
わたしは、あんたと一緒に……ずっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So, um... I know this story
ended, but... I want you to be
with me for...

fields.JP:
おーい！！
ジャック、親指～！
みんなも……無事に逃げられたみたいね

fields.EN:
Uh, sorry! What was it you were
saying, Oyayubihime?
fields.JP:
あ、そうだ！
親指姫……さっき、何を言いかけたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, sorry! What was it you were
saying, Thumbelina?

fields.EN: Huh? Um... Well... I want to be...
fields.JP:
えっ？
そ、それは……その…
あんたと一緒に……ごにょごにょ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Um... Well... I want to be...

fields.EN:
Aaaugh! I just said that I want us
to stay friends, got that?! What a
dolt!
fields.JP:
……あーーもう！！
これからもよろしくねって言ったのよ！
この鈍感バカ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaaugh! I just said that I want us
to stay friends, got that?! What a
dolt!

fields.EN:
Oh, um... Okay, sure. We'll always
be together.
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……こちらこそ、よろしくね。
これからも、ずっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Okay, sure. We'll always
be together.

fields.EN:
Wha-?! Hmph...! W-Well I guess if
that's what you want, then...
Um... Th-Thanks, Jack.
fields.JP:
なっ！？　ふ、ふん……
あんたがどうしてもって言うなら……
よ、よろしく、ジャック……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Hmph...! W-Well I guess if
that's what you want, then...
Um... Th-Thanks, Jack.

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! You're right! It's time
for us to get writing!
fields.JP:
ふふ。そうね……
わたしたちみんなの、新しい物語の始まりよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! You're right! It's time
for us to get writing!

fields.EN:
Th-That was close...! Are you
okay, Shirayukihime?
fields.JP:
あ、危なかった……！
……白雪姫、大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That was close...! Are you
okay, Snow White?

fields.JP:
はい……！
い、生きてます……！

fields.EN:
But more importantly, Jack-san...
You're bleeding!!
fields.JP:
それより、ジャックさんこそ……
血が……！！
fields.LOCALIZED: But, look at you! You're bleeding!

fields.EN:
Heh... I-I'm okay...
I'm just a little anemic...
fields.JP:
あはは、だ、大丈夫……
ちょっと貧血気味なだけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Heh... It's okay... I
just feel a bit dizzy, that's
all...

fields.EN:
Anemia can be the root of all kinds
of illness! Please don't push yourself...
fields.JP:
貧血は万病の元です！
無理はしないでください……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bleeding can lead to other
problems! Please, take better care
of yourself...

fields.JP:
白雪姫……
心配してくれてありがとう……

fields.EN:
Shirayuki is the one who should
be thanking you...
fields.JP:
……お礼を言わなくちゃいけないのは、
白雪の方です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is the one who should
be thanking you...

fields.EN:
You risked yourself like this,
just to save Shirayuki...
fields.JP:
こんな危険な目に遭ってまで……
白雪を助けてくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You risked yourself like this,
just to save Snow White...

fields.EN: And, it's all thanks to you...
fields.JP: 君のおかげだよ、白雪姫……
fields.LOCALIZED: And, it's all thanks to you...

fields.EN:
You always supported everyone,
which made us want to do better. I
think that's why we all made it.
fields.JP:
君が支えていてくれたから、
僕は頑張れた……そしてみんなも、
辛いことを乗り越えられたと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You always supported everyone,
which made us want to do better. I
think that's why we all made it.

fields.EN:
But, I did learn that... this was
Shirayuki's role...
fields.JP:
ただ、気付いたんです。
これが……白雪の役目なんだなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I did learn that... this was
Snow White's role...

fields.EN:
I always thought to myself that
Shirayuki was a plain and
ordinary girl...
fields.JP:
白雪は自分のこと、ずっとただの地味な、
冴えない子だと思ってたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I always thought to myself that
Snow White was a plain and
ordinary girl...

fields.EN:
Because you believed in me, Jack-san, I found
the courage to tell everyone about the traitor
and finally gained confidence in myself.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんが、信じてくれたから……
裏切り者のことをみんなに話す勇気を持てて、
やっと自分に自信が持てたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
You believed in me, and that gave
me the courage and the strength to
talk about the traitor before.

fields.EN:
Even if Shirayuki doesn't stand
out, she wants to do what only she
can do to make everyone happy.
fields.JP:
たとえ目立つ何かが無くても……
白雪にも、白雪にしかできないことがあって、
それでみんなが幸せになってくれれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if Snow White doesn't stand
out, she wants to do what only she
can do to make everyone happy.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki is happy just doing
that...
fields.JP: それで、白雪は満足なんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is happy just doing
that...

fields.EN:
You're not plain at all,
Shirayukihime. In fact, you're...
fields.JP:
白雪姫は、全然地味なんかじゃないよ。
だって、こんなに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not plain at all, Snow
White. In fact, you're...

fields.JP: ジャックー！　白雪姫ー！
よかった、みんな無事で……！

fields.EN: Yeah, guess we all made it.
fields.JP: うん、これで一安心だね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, guess we all made it.

fields.EN:
Um, Jack-san...? If I feel afraid or
feel uneasy, will you be by my
side?
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……また不安になったら、
傍にいてくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Jack...? If I feel afraid or
feel uneasy, will you be by my
side?

fields.EN:
I have to ask the same to you,
too... Though in my case, I might
just worry you more...
fields.JP:
僕こそ……これからもいっぱい、心配させちゃう
かもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to ask the same to you,
too... Though in my case, I might
just worry you more...

fields.JP: なんですか、ジャックさん？

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
That's right... It's time to begin
a new story with everyone in it!
fields.JP:
そうですね……これからは白雪たちみんなの、
新しい物語なんですね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right... It's time to begin
a new story with everyone in it!

fields.JP:
ふう……！！
な、なんとか助かった……！
眠り姫……よかった、無事で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty...? Thank goodness
you're safe...

fields.EN: I'm fine... But not you, Jack...
fields.JP:
……ボクはだいじょうぶ……
でも……ジャックが駄目……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm fine... But not you, Jack...

fields.JP:
いっぱい……ムリした……
だから……

fields.EN:
Thanks for worrying about me, but
I'm okay.
fields.JP:
心配してくれてありがとう。
でも、僕も大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for worrying about me, but
I'm okay.

fields.EN:
But, I'm really okay. Sure, it was
risky, but what better time than
that to do my very best?
fields.JP:
でも、本当に大丈夫なんだ。
確かに少し無理したかもしれないけど、
頑張りどころだったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I'm really okay. Sure, it was
risky, but what better time than
that to do my very best?

fields.EN:
Heh... With you at stake, there's
no way I could've let you go.
fields.JP:
特にさっきは、君を助けなくちゃって
無我夢中で……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... With you at stake, there's
no way I could've let you go.

fields.EN:
You took us by surprise! That was
the most insane thing I've ever
seen you do!
fields.JP:
びっくりです～
ウルトラＣにも程があります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You took us by surprise! That was
the most insane thing I've ever
seen you do!

fields.EN:
Oh, uh... Are you sure you're
okay? Are you feeling sleepy?
fields.JP:
あ……それより、大丈夫？
そろそろ、眠くなってきたんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh... Are you sure you're
okay? Are you feeling sleepy?

fields.EN:
Mmm... It's okay... I'm not sleepy
anymore... The curse... Wore
off...
fields.JP:
……ん……大丈夫……もう、眠くない……
……魔法、解けたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... It's okay... I'm not sleepy
anymore... The curse... Wore
off...

fields.EN:
I see... So that means your story
ended...
fields.JP: そっか……物語は、終わったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So that means your story
ended...

fields.EN:
Yup... Now I can see... My
prince...
fields.JP:
ん……
王子様の顔……ずっと、見てられる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... Now I can see... My
prince...

fields.EN:
Prince...? No... Jack...
You're my... precious friend...
fields.JP:
王子様、じゃない……ジャック……
ボクの……大事な仲間……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Prince...? No... Jack is my...
precious friend...

fields.EN:
Oh, I see. You're my precious
friend, too.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
僕にとっても、君はかけがえのない仲間だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see. You're my precious
friend, too.

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN: I guess we got out of this alive.
fields.JP: どうやら生きてるみたいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess we got out of this alive.

fields.EN:
In any case, I need to ask you to
not do such a risky thing like
that again.
fields.JP:
それにしても……
あんな無茶はもう金輪際やめてほしいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I need to ask you to
not do such a risky thing like
that again.

fields.EN:
Even if I were saved, if you died,
it would have all been for
nothing.
fields.JP:
わらわを助けたところで、ジャックが死んで
しまっては元も子もないではありませんか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if I were saved, if you died,
it would have all been for
nothing.

fields.EN:
What would I have done if you
died...?
fields.JP: そなたが死んだら、わらわは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What would I have done if you
died...?

fields.EN: But, I really wanted to save you.
fields.JP: でも、どうしても君を助けたかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: But, I really wanted to save you.

fields.EN:
The moment that crossed my mind,
I had already jumped and you were
in my arms.
fields.JP:
そう思った瞬間、もう飛び出してて……
気づいたら君を抱きしめてた
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moment that crossed my mind,
I had already jumped and you were
in my arms.

fields.JP: 君が無事で、本当によかった……

fields.EN:
I'm tired of getting angry
already, so I'll just let you
go this time...
fields.JP:
怒るのも面倒臭いので、
今回だけは許してあげます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm tired of getting angry
already, so I'll just let you
go this time...

fields.EN:
*sigh* I can't believe how
emotional I am now... How times
have changed...
fields.JP:
ふう……わらわがここまで感情的になるとは……
時代も変わったものです
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I can't believe how
emotional I am now... How times
have changed...

fields.EN:
But maybe changing is the way
things are meant to be. I think
I've changed quite a lot myself...
fields.JP:
でも、変わっていくのが在るべき姿なのかも
しれませんね。わらわ自身……ずいぶん
変わったと思いますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose change is what I really
wanted. In fact, I have changed
quite a bit from before.

fields.EN:
You already know how afraid of
humans I was. No... More like how
I hated humans...
fields.JP:
知ってるでしょうが、わらわはずっと人間が
怖かったのです……いえ、嫌いでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
You already know how afraid of
humans I was. No... More like how
I hated humans...

fields.EN:
I still can't say for certain that
I like them...
fields.JP: 多分、今でも好きにはなれないでしょう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still can't say for certain that
I like them...

fields.EN:
But this last battle, and telling
the followers what was on my mind,
lessened my fear...
fields.JP:
けれど、最後の戦いの前に、タイヨウ信者に
気持ちをぶちまけたことで、恐怖心は薄らいだ
気がしますし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But this last battle, and telling
the followers what was on my mind,
lessened my fear...

fields.EN:
And I feel like I can look forward
now with friends like you. I owe
it all to you, Jack.
fields.JP:
何より、そなたたちという仲間の存在のおかげで
わらわは前に進む気になれたんです。
ジャック、そなたのおかげです
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I feel like I can look forward
now with friends like you. I owe
it all to you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Me too... You carried so much and still
gave your all to lazing around... Thanks to
that, none of us lost sight of ourselves...
fields.JP:
僕だって……かぐや姫がいろんなことを背負って
全力でダラダラしていてくれたから……
だから、僕もみんなも、自分を見失わずに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. You kept everything
inside and stayed lazy, so I was
able to try my hardest, and...

fields.EN:
Wait a sec... That doesn't sound
like I appreciated what you did...
fields.JP:
……あれ？　感謝してるのに、なんだかそう
聞こえないよね。これじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a sec... That doesn't sound
like I appreciated what you did...

fields.EN:
That's fine. I don't plan on
changing my lazy ways, which, of
course, means I'll need a servant.
fields.JP:
ふふっ。それでいいんですよ～
わらわはこれからもダラダラするつもりですし、
それには下僕が欠かせませんし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine. I don't plan on
changing my lazy ways, which, of
course, means I'll need a servant.

fields.EN: Huh...? What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh...? What do you mean by that?

fields.JP: ジャック……！　かぐや姫……！

fields.EN: Hey, you two! Are you okay?!
fields.JP: おーい、二人とも！　無事だったんだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you two! Are you okay?!

fields.EN: It looks like everyone made it...
fields.JP: みんなも無事で、ほっとしました～
fields.LOCALIZED: It looks like everyone made it...

fields.EN: Yeah, I'm glad we all made it...
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, I'm glad we all made it...

fields.EN:
Jack... I suppose my story ends
without me leaving where I am now.
fields.JP:
ジャック……わらわはこの地上に
留まったまま、物語を終えられたのですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I suppose my story ends
without me leaving where I am now.

fields.EN:
That must mean we can all be
together again.
fields.JP: これからも、みんな一緒にいられるんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must mean we can all be
together again.

fields.JP: うん……もちろんだよ。それに……

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
The old story met a different
ending, leading to a new story for
us to tell...
fields.JP:
古い物語とは別の結末から始まる……
わらわたちみんなで始める物語です
fields.LOCALIZED:
The old story met a different
ending, leading to a new story for
us to tell...

fields.EN:
Jack... Thank you for letting me
stay a part of this world...
fields.JP:
ジャック……
この世界に引き止めてくれてありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Thank you for letting me
stay a part of this world...

fields.JP:
ふう……
な、なんとか……助かったみたいだね……

fields.EN:
That was close... I knew it was a
risk, but... Wh...at...?
fields.JP:
かなり危なかったし、イチかバチかだったけどね
……あ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was close... I knew it was a
risk, but... Wh...at...?

fields.EN:
Jack-san! Are you all right?! You look
sick!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……！　大丈夫ですの！？
顔色が悪いですわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Are you all right?! You look
sick!

fields.EN:
Sorry... Thank you, Cinderella.
I almost fell over... Heh.
fields.JP:
ごめん……ありがとう、シンデレラ。
ちょっと転んじゃうとこだった……あはは
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... I'm okay now,
Cinderella. I was just tripping
over myself. Heh...

fields.EN:
Don't "heh" me! You... You really
are stupid!
fields.JP:
あははじゃありませんわ！
貴方……馬鹿ですわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't "heh" me! You... You really
are stupid!

fields.EN:
I wasn't worth enough to have you
risking your life like that...
fields.JP:
……わたくしなんかに……
そこまでする価値はありませんのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't worth enough to have you
risking your life like that...

fields.EN:
You're much more important than
you think! I wanted to save you!
fields.JP:
君に助ける価値がないなんて……そんなわけない
じゃないか。僕は、君を助けたかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're much more important than
you think! I wanted to save you!

fields.EN:
I wanted to save you for who you
are, Cinderella. I want you to
live...
fields.JP:
それは……君が君だから、シンデレラだから……
だから助けたいって……生きててほしいって……
だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to save you for who you
are, Cinderella. I want you to
live...

fields.EN:
So please, don't say anything like
that again!
fields.JP:
だから……これからは、
自分に価値がないなんて思わないでよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, don't say anything like
that again!

fields.EN:
You're a very precious person to
me, and everyone else!
fields.JP:
シンデレラは、僕にとってもみんなにとっても
かけがえのない存在なんだから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a very precious person to
me, and everyone else!

fields.EN:
You keep teaching me things, Jack-san.
You keep telling me that I'm fine,
and with a smile...
fields.JP:
……ジャックさんには、いつも教えられて
ばかりですわね。わたくしはわたくしでいいと、
いつも笑って言ってくださるんですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You keep teaching me things, Jack.
You keep telling me that I'm fine,
and with a smile...

fields.EN:
Caring for myself means the same
thing as treating everyone around
me with care...
fields.JP:
自分を大切にすることが、みんなを大切に思うと
いうことなんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Caring for myself means the same
thing as treating everyone around
me with care...

fields.EN:
You teach me a lot, too. What it
means to be truly strong and
kind...
fields.JP:
僕だって……シンデレラには教えられてるんだ。
本当に強くて優しいって、どういうことか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You teach me a lot, too. What it
means to be truly strong and
kind...

fields.EN:
I'm still grateful for the time
you tore your dress to treat my
wounds...
fields.JP:
大事なドレスを破ってまで、手当てしてくれた
こと……いまでも感動してるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still grateful for the time
you tore your dress to treat my
wounds...

fields.EN:
*giggle*... Oh, um... That isn't
so big of a deal.
fields.JP:
ふふ。あんなこと……大したことじゃ
ありませんわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... Oh, um... That isn't
so big of a deal.

fields.EN:
Well... One day, I want to wear a
beautiful dress again for you to
lay your eyes on...
fields.JP:
でも……そうですわね。
いつかまた、綺麗な服を着たわたくしを見て
ほしいんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... One day, I want to wear a
beautiful dress again for you to
lay your eyes on...

fields.JP: ジャック！　シンデレラ！

fields.EN: Hey, you two! Are you all right?!
fields.JP:
二人ともーー！
無事だったみたいだねー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you two! Are you all right?!

fields.EN:
It looks like everyone escaped
safely...
fields.JP: みなさん……無事に脱出できたんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like everyone escaped
safely...

fields.EN:
The story here has ended, but it
seems we're not alone...
fields.JP:
物語が終わっても……僕たちは、一人じゃ
ないんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The story here has ended, but it
seems we're not alone...

fields.EN: Indeed... I will always be here...
fields.JP:
そうですわ……
わたくしも……いつもここにいますわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Indeed... I will always be here...

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
...Yes. I'm sure... all of us will
cry and laugh more naturally...
It'll be a wonderful story...
fields.JP:
……そうですわね。きっと……
わたくしたちみんな、もっと自然に泣いたり
笑ったりしていく……素敵な物語ですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure the new story will be
filled with beautiful, happy
tears.

fields.EN: And... You will be with us, too...
fields.JP: そして……そこには貴方がいますのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: And... You will be with us, too...

fields.EN: It should be fine now, Gretel.
fields.JP: もう大丈夫だよ、グレーテル
fields.LOCALIZED: It should be fine now, Gretel.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Looks like we're
finally grounded.
fields.JP: あはは、やっと地に足がついた感じがするね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Looks like we're
finally grounded.

fields.EN:
Heh, indeed. In more ways than
one..
fields.JP:
ふふ……そうね。
実際、足が地面に着いたものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, indeed. In more ways than
one..

fields.EN: I'm just glad you're safe, Gretel.
fields.JP: でも、グレーテルが無事で本当によかった……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm just glad you're safe, Gretel.

fields.EN:
One wrong move and we'd both have
died, yet you still tried to save
me. You're quite the odd one...
fields.JP:
一歩間違えれば、もろともに死ぬほかないと
いうのに、私を助けようだなんて物好きも、
大概なものね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite surprised you would risk
your life to save me. You must
have developed an acquired taste.

fields.EN:
Why, yes. When I fell, you leaped
at just the right angle to catch
me in midair.
fields.JP:
ええ。私が落下を開始したとき、
あなたは的確に跳躍し、適切な角度で降下し、
そして最適のタイミングで私をキャッチした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. When I fell, you leaped
at just the right angle to catch
me in midair.

fields.EN:
I'm impressed you thought to use
the Mary Gun like that. If only I
could have recorded it all...
fields.JP:
メアリガンを使うなんて思い付きも、
あなたにしては上出来だったわね。
一部始終を記録しておきたかったくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm impressed you thought to use
the Mary Gun like that. If only I
could have recorded it all...

fields.EN:
Wow... You're so calm that it's
scaring me...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow... You're so calm that it's
scaring me...

fields.EN:
I'm just kidding. In all honesty,
I wasn't in the right mindset to
think of any of that.
fields.JP:
……冗談よ。
そんなこと考えてる余裕もなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just kidding. In all honesty,
I wasn't in the right mindset to
think of any of that.

fields.EN:
(Huh? This may be the first time
I've seen Gretel like this...)
fields.JP:
（あれっ？　しおらしいグレーテルなんて、
　初めて見るかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? This may be the first time
I've seen Gretel like this...)

fields.EN:
How unusual... I'm here now with
a sense of relief that I'm alive.
fields.JP:
でも、不思議なものね。
生きてて良かったと思ってる自分がいるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unusual... I'm here now with
a sense of relief that I'm alive.

fields.EN:
After Hansel-niisan's departure, my only
goal in life was to observe
everyone.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんと別れてこのかた、
私はただ、あなたや他の人たちを観察する
ことだけが生き甲斐のようだったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
After Hansel's departure, my only
goal in life was to observe
everyone.

fields.EN:
And I didn't care much about my
own well-being.
fields.JP:
そもそも……
自分の生死に興味なんか無かったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I didn't care much about my
own well-being.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I wonder whose fault
this is.
fields.JP: ふふふ。誰のせいかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I wonder whose fault
this is.

fields.EN: Huh... Why are you looking at me?
fields.JP: えっ……どうしてこっち見るの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh... Why are you looking at me?

fields.EN:
Hm... If you don't know, that's
fine, too.
fields.JP:
ふうん。
気付かないのならそれでもいいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... If you don't know, that's
fine, too.

fields.EN:
I think I was able to fight
because of you, Gretel...
fields.JP:
……僕も、グレーテルのおかげで
ここまで戦って来れたんだと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I was able to fight
because of you, Gretel...

fields.EN:
You taught me the importance of
keeping my emotions in check. To
calmly make the right decisions.
fields.JP:
一時の感情に流されずに、冷静に物事を考えて
判断するよう、君に教わったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You taught me the importance of
keeping my emotions in check. To
calmly make the right decisions.

fields.EN:
Well, it doesn't seem like that,
considering how quickly you moved
to action when I fell.
fields.JP:
その割には、私が足を踏み外したときの
素早さといったらなかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it doesn't seem like that,
considering how quickly you moved
to action when I fell.

fields.EN:
Uh, well... I just acted on
impulse, and...
fields.JP: あ、あれは……その、無我夢中で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... I just acted on
impulse, and...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I'm actually
appreciative of what you've done.
fields.JP: ふふ。これでも感謝してるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I'm actually
appreciative of what you've done.

fields.EN:
Thank you, Jack. Thanks to you,
I'm still here, alive.
fields.JP:
……ありがとう、ジャック。
あなたのおかげで、私はここにいるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Jack. Thanks to you,
I'm still here, alive.

fields.EN:
(What...? She sounds amazingly
gentle right now...)
fields.JP: （えっ、なんだろう。この素直さは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What...? She sounds amazingly
gentle right now...)

fields.EN:
If we'd mistimed the Mary Gun by
even 0.1 seconds, we'd have hit the
ground at terminal velocity by now...
fields.JP:
あのときメアリガンを使うタイミングを
コンマ1秒でも間違えてたら、今頃私たちは
終末速度で地面と接触することで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you were off by even a fraction
of a second, we would have
accelerated straight downward...

fields.EN:
(Nope... This is the Gretel I
know, all right...)
fields.JP:
（いや、やっぱりグレーテルはグレーテル
　だった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Nope... This is the Gretel I
know, all right...)

fields.JP: じゃっくーーーぐれーーー！
無事でよかったですー！

fields.EN: Looks like everyone made it, too.
fields.JP: どうやら、みんなも無事のようね
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like everyone made it, too.

fields.EN:
I have no intention of dying ahead
of you.
fields.JP: 私、あなたより先に死ぬ気はないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention of dying ahead
of you.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.JP: だって私、あなたを研究し尽くしてないもの

fields.EN:
Uh, I'm still your research
subject...?
fields.JP: ああ、僕はまだ研究対象なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I'm still your research
subject...?

fields.JP:
『まだ』ではなく、
『これからも』、『ずっと』よ

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about
to begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about
to begin.

fields.EN:
I suppose it's not like me to say
this, but... Yes, you're right.
fields.JP: 言うだけ野暮だけれど……でも、そうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose it's not like me to say
this, but... Yes, you're right.

fields.EN:
We've finally escaped from the
dark forest, and everyone has made
it back home.
fields.JP:
私たちはようやく暗い森から抜け出して、
みんなのいる家に辿り着いたんだもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've finally escaped from the
dark forest, and everyone has made
it back home.

fields.EN:
And, that also marks the beginning
of a new story...
fields.JP: それも、新しい物語の始まりね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, that also marks the beginning
of a new story...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, did it hurt? Maybe I
squeezed you too hard...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、痛いところはない？
……強く抱っこしちゃったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, did it hurt? Maybe I
squeezed you too hard...

fields.JP: じゃっく、ラプンツェルをたすけてくれた

（ラプンツェルが
　僕を心配してくれるなんて……）
じゃっく、たすけてくれてありがとう

ううん。
僕がラプンツェルを助けたかったんだ

fields.EN:
I would be sad if you died,
Rapunzel.
fields.JP: ラプンツェルがいなくなったら悲しいから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would be sad if you died,
Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's sad if you died too,
Jack!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも、じゃっくいなくなったら
かなしいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's sad if you died too,
Jack!

fields.EN:
I like Jack, so I want you with
me!
fields.JP: じゃっくだいすきだから、いっしょにいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like Jack, so I want you with
me!

fields.JP: ……ラプンツェル、おとなになるよ！

fields.EN:
(What a relief... Looks like
everyone's safe...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a relief... Looks like
everyone's safe...)

fields.EN:
Whoa! That's dangerous, jumping
on me like that!
fields.JP:
わわっ！
急に飛びつくと、危ないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! That's dangerous, jumping
on me like that!

fields.JP: へへへ……じゃっくのにおい……

fields.EN:
What's gonna happen when the
story's done, Jack?
fields.JP: じゃっく、おはなしおわったらどうなるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's gonna happen when the
story's done, Jack?

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.JP: あたらしい、ものがたり？
うん。僕らみんなの物語だよ

fields.EN:
Okay! Rapunzel's gonna be with
Jack forever!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ラプンツェル、じゃっくとずーっと
いっしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Rapunzel's gonna be with
Jack forever!

fields.EN:
Right. Let's take our
time growing up together.
fields.JP: そうだね。一緒にゆっくり、大人になっていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. We'll be together,
and you can grow up to become an
adult, just like everyone else.

fields.EN: Whew... Th-That was a close one...
fields.JP:
ふう……！！
あ、危なかったね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Whew... Th-That was a close one...

fields.EN:
What are you saying? That was
exhilarating!
fields.JP: 何を言うか。ワレは爽快であったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying? That was
exhilarating!

fields.JP: そ、そっか……それはよかったよ

fields.EN:
But, I have to admit that I didn't
expect myself, the Demon King, to
be saved by you...
fields.JP:
しかし、その……この魔王ともあろう者が
よもや助けられるとはな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have to admit that I didn't
expect myself, the Demon King, to
be saved by you...

fields.EN:
I don't really remember what I
did, but all that came to mind
was that I couldn't let you go.
fields.JP:
とっさの事だったから、よく覚えてないけど……
君だけは、離しちゃいけないって、
そう思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't really remember what I
did, but all that came to mind
was that I couldn't let you go.

fields.EN:
I did bring you to where we were,
and I do want you to see more than
what you saw down there.
fields.JP:
君を地下から連れ出しちゃったし……
君にはもっと、いろんなものを見て欲しいからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I did bring you to where we were,
and I do want you to see more than
what you saw down there.

fields.EN:
Jack... Without you, I would not
have been here...
fields.JP:
ジャック。貴様がいなければ……
ワレはきっと、ここにいなかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Without you, I would not
have been here...

fields.EN:
W-Well, not in a physical sense.
I mean that I wouldn't have been
alive like this.
fields.JP:
そ、その……地下にいたという意味ではないぞ？
いまここに、生きて立っていなかったという……
そういう意味だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, not in a physical sense.
I mean that I wouldn't have been
alive like this.

fields.JP: ……大袈裟ではにゃい……こほん、ない

fields.EN:
Thanks to you, I have friends
now. Precious friends...
fields.JP:
貴様のおかげで……ワレには仲間ができた。
大切な仲間が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to you, I have friends
now. Precious friends...

fields.EN:
I spent my whole life alone, and I
now know what it's like to have
friends I care about...
fields.JP:
ずっと一人で過ごしてきたこのワレが……
仲間というものの意味を知り、それがワレにとり
存外に大切であることを知ったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I spent my whole life alone, and I
now know what it's like to have
friends I care about...

fields.EN:
I'm sure I was quite peculiar to
you when we first met.
fields.JP:
ジャック。初めて出会った頃のワレは、
さぞかし奇妙なことであったろうな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure I was quite peculiar to
you when we first met.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... You're a great and
wonderful Demon King, Hameln!
fields.JP:
あはは。ハーメルンは、立派な……
素敵な魔王だと思うよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... You're a great and
wonderful Demon King, Hameln!

fields.JP:
ま、まあ……当然のことでありゅな！
ううっ……

fields.EN: Heeeey! Are you two all right?!
fields.JP: おーい！　二人ともーー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Heeeey! Are you two all right?!

fields.JP: ジャック！　ハーメルン！

fields.EN: It seems as if everyone is safe.
fields.JP: どうやら皆、無事だったようだな
fields.LOCALIZED: It seems as if everyone is safe.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I'm so glad they're
safe...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I'm so glad they're
safe...

fields.EN:
Hmph... I extend my thanks to you
once more, Jack.
fields.JP: ……フッ。ジャック、改めて礼を言おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... I extend my thanks to you
once more, Jack.

fields.EN:
Thank you for grabbing my hand
during my fall. I didn't know the
joy of having one's hand grabbed.
fields.JP:
落ちるワレの手を取ってくれたこと……
手を繋いでもらうというのは、あれ程までに
幸せなものであったのだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for grabbing my hand
during my fall. I didn't know the
joy of having one's hand grabbed.

fields.EN:
You've got it slightly wrong
there. Hands aren't meant to be
grabbed. They're meant to be held.
fields.JP:
違うよ、ハーメルン。
手は……どっちかからじゃなくて、一緒に繋ぐ
ものなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've got it slightly wrong
there. Hands aren't meant to be
grabbed. They're meant to be held.

fields.EN:
Ah, I see... Another lesson
learned. I'm grateful to have met
everyone... especially you...
fields.JP:
そうだな……また一つ教わったな……
ワレは会えてよかった……お嬢にも、みんなにも
……そして、なにより貴様にな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I see... Another lesson
learned. I'm grateful to have met
everyone... especially you...

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
Our story... A story that will see
everyone together, forever.
fields.JP: ワレらみんなの……誰もどこにも去らぬ物語だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our story... A story that will see
everyone together, forever.

fields.EN: Yup. We can finally go home...
fields.JP: うん。やっと帰れたんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. We can finally go home...

fields.EN:
Well then, the new story will
begin with a party where you and
I will be together...
fields.JP:
では、物語はこのように始めよう。
まずはワレと貴様で、宴を開く……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, the new story will
begin with a party where you and
I will be together...

fields.JP: それは……博士だと思います

fields.EN: Do you think so too, Akazukin?
fields.JP: 赤ずきん。君もそう思うのかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think so too, Red Riding
Hood?

fields.EN:
Now then, tell me what led you to
suspect me of being a traitor?
fields.JP:
……さて、君たちが私を疑う理由を聞かせて
もらえるかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, tell me what led you to
suspect me of being a traitor?

fields.EN:
It's because your plans went so
smoothly. As if all of it had been
orchestrated from the beginning.
fields.JP:
それは、作戦があまりに博士の計画通りに
進みすぎたからです。
あたかも、何が起こるかを知っていたように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because your plans went so
smoothly. As if all of it had been
orchestrated from the beginning.

fields.EN:
Oh? I was actually quite pleased
to see that our hard work and
research were paying off.
fields.JP:
……ほう？
周到な調査が実を結んだのであれば、
それはむしろ喜ばしいことだと思うが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I was actually quite pleased
to see that our hard work and
research were paying off.

fields.EN:
That's not all. The Jail is very
pleased now... Pleased to see us
destroy the cores.
fields.JP:
それに、ジェイルはいま……とても悦んでます。
僕らに核を破壊されたのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not all. The Jail is very
pleased now... Pleased to see us
destroy the cores.

fields.EN:
Pleased in a way that it seemed
like it wanted to grow as well.
Is that merely a coincidence?
fields.JP:
まるで、計画通りに成長することが、
嬉しいみたいに。
……そんな偶然って、あるんでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pleased in a way that it seemed
like it wanted to grow as well.
Is that merely a coincidence?

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、一つアドバイスをしよう。
考察が盲目的にならないためには、
一度その考察を逆説的に考えてみるといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.

fields.EN:
A hypothesis also needs to be tested.
So let's examine our current suspicion
from the opposite direction.
fields.JP:
考察を検証することも必要ということだ。
では、今の疑念を逆説的に考えてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking is more important than
actual evaulation. Now then, let's
think this out a moment, shall we?

fields.EN:
The escape plan is based on the
ecology of the Jail. Aligning our
plans with its behavior is vital.
fields.JP:
脱出計画はジェイルの生態を利用したものだ。
ジェイルの本能に沿っていた方が計画が
円滑に進む…………どうかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The escape plan is based on the
ecology of the Jail. Aligning our
plans with its behavior is vital.

fields.EN:
Wouldn't it only be natural to
come up with a plan utilizing that
knowledge?
fields.JP:
ジェイルの生態が先にあり、それを最大限
活用する形で計画が立案されたと考えれば、
特に違和感はないと思うが？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't it only be natural to
come up with a plan utilizing that
knowledge?

fields.EN:
That means you knew that the Jail
wanted the cores destroyed. How
would you know that?
fields.JP:
じ、じゃあ博士は、核を壊すとジェイルが
悦ぶって知ってたってことですよね。
……どうして知ってるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means you knew that the Jail
wanted the cores destroyed. How
would you know that?

fields.EN:
It's the result of accumulated research. Of
course, we also keep adding everything we've
learned thanks to you to the escape plan.
fields.JP:
これまでの研究の蓄積によるものだよ。
無論、君たちのおかげでわかったことも
随時脱出計画に反映している
fields.LOCALIZED:
After long hours of research, not
to mention the additional
discoveries that were reported.

fields.EN:
