But what the members of the Dawn
knew and didn't know is too
unusual... Arbitrary, even.
fields.JP:
でも、黎明が『知っている』ことと
『知らない』こと、その境目が不自然過ぎるわ。
……恣意的ですらあった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what the members of the Dawn
knew and didn't know is too
unusual... Arbitrary, even.

fields.EN:
For example, the 'core'... Especially with a
creature we'd never seen before, I don't think
that could be known from hypotheses alone.
fields.JP:
たとえば『核』のこと……初めて見る生物なら
なおさら、仮説だけで知ることができるとは
思えないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, determining an
accurate theory about the cores'
function shortly after hearing it.

fields.EN:
True... We can only theorize off
of known biota based on knowledge
in line with our own observations.
fields.JP:
そうね。これまで人類が蓄積してきた生物相の
知識に沿ったものであるならともかく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... We can only theorize off
of known biota based on knowledge
in line with our own observations.

fields.EN:
But what you're saying is more in
relation to the Dawn itself rather
than me individually, correct?
fields.JP:
……それは、黎明全体に対する疑念であって、
私個人に対するものではないだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what you're saying is more in
relation to the Dawn itself rather
than me individually, correct?

fields.EN:
Yes. Miko and the others deserve blame for
that negligence. They ignored information
that should have raised your own suspicions.
fields.JP:
ええ。その点は視子たちの怠慢を責めるべきね。
あなた個人の疑念となるべき内容を黙認して
いたのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. In that sense, Miko and the
others are at fault for keeping
silent about their doubts.

fields.EN:
Or, maybe Miko and Haru are
your cohorts?
fields.JP: それとも……視子やハルも共犯なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or, maybe Miko and Haru are
your cohorts?

fields.EN:
(Cohorts... It's true that Miko-san
and Haru-san seemed to be hiding
something from us...)
fields.JP:
（共犯……確かに、視子さんやハルさんには、
　何かを隠しているような感じを受けてた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cohorts... It's true that Miko
and Haru seemed to be hiding
something from us...)

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose it can't be helped
if we were suspected as cohorts.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
共犯と疑われても仕方ないのかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose it can't be helped
if we were suspected as cohorts.

fields.EN:
As the only one who survived the
tragedy 15 years ago, his vast
knowledge seemed trustworthy.
fields.JP:
十島博士は、十五年前の惨劇を唯一生き延びた
ジェイルの権威……その見識を信じたい気持ちも
あったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the only one who survived the
tragedy 15 years ago, his vast
knowledge seemed trustworthy.

fields.EN:
As a researcher, I also wanted to
know what would happen to the Jail
once the plan succeeded.
fields.JP:
何より、計画が成功したらジェイルに何が
起きるのかを知りたかった……
研究者としての好奇心ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As a researcher, I also wanted to
know what would happen to the Jail
once the plan succeeded.

fields.EN:
So you're telling us that you
turned a blind eye because of
that? Pretty lazy, if you ask me.
fields.JP:
それだけのために、ずっと見て見ぬ振りをしてた
んですか～？
わらわ以上の怠慢ぶりですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're telling us that you
turned a blind eye because of
that? Pretty lazy, if you ask me.

fields.EN:
...Yes. Wanting to trust the Professor,
and wanting to look away from our doubts...
Neither was anything close to reason.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
博士を信じたい気持ちと疑念を黙認する気持ち。
どちらも理性とは程遠い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose. It would be difficult
to use logic in my defense when I
had acted based on trust...

fields.EN:
I guess you can say I'm not fit to
be a researcher.
fields.JP: 研究者として失格だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you can say I'm not fit to
be a researcher.

fields.EN:
Miko-kun. Whatever motives you may have had
for taking part in the research, I don't mind.
fields.JP:
視子くん。君がどういう思惑で研究に携わって
いたとしても、私は構わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko, it doesn't concern me that
you had your doubts while working
with me here.

fields.EN:
In fact, I see you as a comrade
who helped to uncover the truths
behind the Jail.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの実態を追求するために
力を貸してくれていた同志であることに、
変わりはないのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I see you as a comrade
who helped to uncover the truths
behind the Jail.

fields.EN:
And that applies to you as well,
Haru-kun. You were waiting to see the
Jail's growth. Isn't that right?
fields.JP:
そしてハルくん。それは君もだ。
君は私と同様に、ジェイルの成長を待望して
くれていた……そうだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that applies to you as well,
Haru. You were waiting to see the
Jail's growth. Isn't that right?

fields.EN:
No. I've been trying to stop you
from the start.
fields.JP:
……違う。
俺は……あんたを止めようと、ずっと
あがいてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I've been trying to stop you
from the start.

fields.EN:
Oh, is that so? All this time, I
thought we shared the same goals.
fields.JP:
おや……そうだったのかね？
てっきり、私と想いを同じくしてくれている
同志だと思っていたのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, is that so? All this time, I
thought we shared the same goals.

fields.JP: それはいささか残念な話だね。

fields.EN:
Haru-kun, would calling you a "traitor" to me
be too much of an exaggeration...? Of course,
I'm joking.
fields.JP:
ハルくんが、私にとっての
『裏切り者』だと言ったら……少し大げさかな？
……無論、冗談ではあるがね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would calling you a traitor be too
much of an exaggeration...? I'm
joking, of course...

fields.EN:
(This isn't good... I can't get
the Professor to confess...)
fields.JP:
（どうしよう……
　このままじゃ、博士を追い詰められない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't good... I can't get
the Professor to confess...)

fields.EN:
It looks like we've derailed for a
moment. Now then... Is there
anything else?
fields.JP:
話が逸れてしまったが……私に対する疑いは、
以上かね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like we've derailed for a
moment. Now then... Is there
anything else?

fields.EN:
(That's right! There was something
strange about the memo we
found...!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……！
　以前、独房エリアで拾ったメモに違和感を
　感じたことがあったはず）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right! There was something
strange about the memo we
found...!)

fields.EN:
The unusual memo we found before
was written by you, wasn't it?
fields.JP:
僕らが見つけたあの不思議なメモ……
それを書いたのは博士でした
fields.LOCALIZED:
The unusual memo we found before
was written by you, wasn't it?

fields.EN: But, you kept that a secret.
fields.JP: でも、あなたはそれを僕らに隠していた
fields.LOCALIZED: But, you kept that a secret.

fields.EN:
I believe I mentioned it then, but
I wasn't hiding anything. I simply
forgot about it.
fields.JP:
あの時も言ったが、隠していたわけではないよ。
私が忘れていたということで決着がついたと
記憶しているが……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe I mentioned it then, but
I wasn't hiding anything. I simply
forgot about it.

fields.EN:
(Urgh...! There has to be
something else... That's
right...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Urgh...! There has to be
something else... That's
right...!)

fields.EN:
That memo was referring
to Akazukin-san, wasn't it?
fields.JP: これ……赤ずきんさんのことだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That memo was referring to Red
Riding Hood, wasn't it?

fields.EN:
"The first child was found here. The captain
said that, though just a baby, she killed a
Marchen barehanded and smiled at everyone."
fields.JP:
『最初の子はここで発見したという。隊長の話
　によれば、赤子の身でありながら、素手で
　メルヒェンを倒し、皆を見て微笑んだそうだ』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"The first infant was found here.
Our leader said that she killed a
Marchen with her bare hands."

fields.EN:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...
fields.JP:
う……うん。あたし、確かにお父さんから
そう聞いたんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...

fields.EN:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.
fields.JP:
『発見した時、メルヒェンを前にしても笑ってた、
　勇敢な赤ん坊だったよ』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.

fields.EN:
The memo we found at the Station
Grounds differed from what you
told Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
『元駅構内エリア』で見つけたメモの内容は、
赤ずきんさんが博士から聞いていた内容と
食い違ってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The memo we found at the Station
Grounds differed from what you
told Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
The memo said that the leader found
Akazukin-san, whereas what you said
made it seem like you found her.
fields.JP:
『隊長』が見つけた赤ずきんさんのことを、
さも自分が見つけたかのように伝えていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The memo said that the leader
found her, whereas what you said
made it seem like you found her.

fields.EN:
(If he wasn't there when
Akazukin-san was found, why would
he say that he was...?)
fields.JP:
（……でも、赤ずきんさんを見つけた時に
　その場にいなかったのなら、なんで自分が
　見つけたなんて言ったんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If he wasn't there when Red
Riding Hood was found, why would
he say that he was...?)

fields.EN:
(It's true that the Professor said
he just forgot...)
fields.JP:
（確か博士は、記憶違いだったって言い訳してた
　けど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's true that the Professor said
he just forgot...)

fields.EN:
(His memory was wrong, so he thought he'd
found her himself... and he'd forgotten
there was a memo recording the truth.)
fields.JP:
（記憶違いで自分が見つけたと思ってて、
　その真実が書かれたメモの存在を忘れてた）

fields.EN:
(Is that even possible? It can't
be a coincidence that both of
these issues would be mistaken...)
fields.JP:
（本当にそんなことがあるのかな……？
　二つのアクシデントが重なるなんて、
　偶然にしてはできすぎてる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that even possible? It can't
be a coincidence that both of
these issues would be mistaken...)

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Jack-kun? You've
been pretty quiet.
fields.JP:
どうしたね、ジャックくん。
急に黙ってしまったが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Jack? You've
been pretty quiet.

fields.EN:
I know I'm repeating myself, but
I'm sorry for my forgetfulness and
for fostering doubt among you all.
fields.JP:
これも繰り返しになるが、
その件は私の記憶違いだったのだよ。
疑念を抱かせてしまったのは申し訳ないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm repeating myself, but
I'm sorry for my forgetfulness and
for fostering doubt among you all.

fields.EN:
(What can I do to prove my
doubts...?)
fields.JP:
（どうすれば……一体どうすれば、
　この違和感を立証できるんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What can I do to prove my
doubts...?)

fields.EN:
Isn't this enough, Jack-kun? I don't
think we have any more time to
spare here.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん……もう充分ではないかね？
こんなところで無駄な時間を使っている暇は、
私にはないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't this enough, Jack? I don't
think we have any more time to
spare here.

fields.EN:
Later, take your time and think it through
by yourself, following my advice. That
should clear up most of your doubts.
fields.JP:
後でゆっくり、私のアドバイスに沿って
一人で考えてみるといい。
それで大体の疑念が解消されるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think about my earlier advice. I'm
sure that will clear any doubts
you may have toward me.

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、一つアドバイスをしよう。
考察が盲目的にならないためには、
一度その考察を逆説的に考えてみるといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.

fields.EN:
(There is something that'll
explain what happened not being
a coincidence!)
fields.JP:
（そうか……！
　たった一つだけ、このアクシデントが
　偶然じゃなくなるケースがある……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There is something that'll
explain what happened not being
a coincidence!)

fields.JP: 博士、あなたは……本当は誰ですか？

fields.EN:
I thought it over based on your
advice. What if every doubt I had
about the memo was actually 'true'?
fields.JP:
あなたのアドバイスを元に考えてみたんです。
メモに対する疑念が、逆にどれも『真実』だと
したらって
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if my doubts about the memo
were true?

fields.EN:
You did find Akazukin-san with
the leader.
fields.JP:
……あなたは『隊長』と一緒に、
赤ずきんさんを見つけていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You did find Red Riding Hood with
the leader.

fields.EN:
And you didn't remember leaving a
memo behind.
fields.JP:
そして、博士がメモを残していたことを
知らなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you didn't remember leaving a
memo behind.

fields.EN:
The only way that both could be
possible is... you're not the
Professor.
fields.JP:
答えは一つです。
あなたは、博士ではない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only way that both could be
possible is... you're not the
Professor.

fields.EN:
You were someone else in the party
when Akazukin-san was found.
fields.JP:
そして、赤ずきんさんが発見された時の
調査に同行していた誰かだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were someone else in the party
when Red Riding Hood was found.

fields.EN:
Let me ask you a question, then.
How can you prove that I'm not
Professor Toojima?
fields.JP:
それでは聞こう。
どうやって、私が十島でないことを立証する？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me ask you a question, then.
How can you prove that I'm not
Professor Tohjima?

fields.EN:
(Do I have something that could
prove the Professor here is fake?)
fields.JP:
（博士が偽者であることを立証できる何か。
　僕は、それを提示できるのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Do I have something that could
prove the Professor here is fake?)

fields.EN:
(I do...! I have something with me
that I can use as proof!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……ある！
　今の博士と、本物の博士を比較できるものが
　僕の持ち物の中に……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I do...! I have something with me
that I can use as proof!)

fields.EN:
I didn't expect something like
this to be found in this area...
fields.JP:
それにしても……こんなもの独房エリアに
落ちてるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect something like
this to be found in this area...

fields.EN: I wonder who wrote this memo...
fields.JP: このメモ、いったい誰が書いたのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder who wrote this memo...

fields.EN:
Well, it is written nicely. I'm a
bit jealous... My penmanship is
pretty horrible.
fields.JP:
かなり綺麗な字だよね……！
あたし、そんなに字がうまくないから
……ちょっとうらやましいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is written nicely. I'm a
bit jealous... My penmanship is
pretty horrible.

fields.EN:
Yes. Judging from the handwriting,
it looks like it was written
by someone very meticulous.
fields.JP:
ええ。筆跡を見る限り、ずいぶんと几帳面な
人が書いたように思えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From the looks of it, it seems
like the person who wrote it was
very studious.

fields.EN: This is proof that you're a fake!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あなたが偽者である証拠はこれです！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is proof that you're a fake!

fields.EN:
What exactly do you intend
to do by thrusting that at me?
fields.JP:
そんなものを私に突きつけて、
一体どうしようと言うんだね？

え？　あ、あれ？
えーと……

fields.EN:
I haven't been this dissappointed
in you, Jack.
fields.JP: ジャック……あなたにはガッカリしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't been this dissappointed
in you, Jack.

fields.EN: This is proof that you're a fake!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あなたが偽者である証拠はこれです！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is proof that you're a fake!

fields.EN:
That's the memo Professor wrote
about the magnolia leaves!
fields.JP:
それは、博士が書いてくれた
ホオノキの葉のメモ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the memo Professor wrote
about the magnolia leaves!

fields.EN:
I didn't know you had such a thing
with you.
fields.JP: そんなものがあったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you had such a thing
with you.

fields.EN:
(This is the only item that was
written by the Professor
himself...!)
fields.JP:
（そう。これは唯一、今の博士が書いた
　ものなんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is the only item that was
written by the Professor
himself...!)

fields.EN:
Yes. The leaves look like this
drawing.
fields.JP: ええ。こういう形状の葉を付けるのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The leaves look like this
drawing.

fields.EN:
Well, we just call them magnolia
leaves because they look similar
to the ones in the outside world.
fields.JP:
まあ……
葉の形状が外の世界にあるホオノキに似てるから
黎明でそう呼んでるだけなんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we just call them magnolia
leaves because they look similar
to the ones in the outside world.

fields.EN:
This looks like Dad's! Yikes, his
penmanship is sloppy as usual...
fields.JP:
これ……お父さんが書いたやつだね！
相変わらず字がへたくそだなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This looks like Dad's! Yikes, his
penmanship is sloppy as usual...

fields.EN:
Compare this with the memo about
Akazukin-san. You can clearly tell
that the handwriting is different.
fields.JP:
これと、赤ずきんさんのことが書かれたメモ……
比べれば、明らかに筆跡が違うことがわかります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can clearly tell that your
memo and what we found are
different.

fields.EN:
This is proof that you're not
Professor Toojima!
fields.JP:
これが、あなたが十島博士ではないことの
証拠です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is proof that you're not
Professor Tohjima!

fields.EN:
Quite interesting... But isn't
that evidence too insufficient to
be considered proof?
fields.JP:
なかなかの名推理だが……
証拠としては弱いのではないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite interesting... But isn't
that evidence too insufficient to
be considered proof?

fields.EN:
I was badly injured in the tragedy fifteen
years ago. Miko-kun treated me, so she
knows; the scar on my face is from then too.
fields.JP:
私は、十五年前の惨劇で大怪我を負ってね。
治療してくれた視子くんは知っているが、
顔にあるのもその時の傷だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hurt badly in the tragedy 15
years ago. Miko cared for me, so
she would remember my wounds.

fields.EN:
Y-Yes... He did get badly injured
back then...
fields.JP: え、ええ……それは確かにそうだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes... He did get badly injured
back then...

fields.EN:
I didn't bring it up before, but
since that time, my right hand
doesn't move as much as before.
fields.JP:
これまで皆には黙っていたのだが……
その時の後遺症で、私の右手は若干不自由でね。
以前のようには動かないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't bring it up before, but
since that time, my right hand
doesn't move as much as before.

fields.EN:
That's probably why my handwriting looks
different. It may be shameful to admit a past
failure just to protect myself, though...
fields.JP:
筆跡が違うように見えるのはそのせいだろう。
保身のために過去の失態を自ら語るなど、
恥ずべきことかもしれんがね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the reason my handwriting
looks different. I only didn't
want to bring up my past injuries.

fields.EN:
Does that answer your doubts,
Jack-kun?
fields.JP: ジャックくん……わかってくれたかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that answer your doubts,
Jack?

fields.EN:
(He's finding excuses for
everything I'm pitting against
him...)
fields.JP:
（どんなに追求しても、
　あの手この手でかわされる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's finding excuses for
everything I'm pitting against
him...)

fields.EN:
(Isn't there anything else I can
say...?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Isn't there anything else I can
say...?)

fields.EN:
Not yet, Jack. You still have one
more thing with you.
fields.JP:
まだよ、ジャック。
あなたはもう一つ武器を持っているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not yet, Jack. You still have one
more thing with you.

fields.EN:
Remember what we talked about...
Remember why I thought there
was a traitor in the Dawn.
fields.JP:
思い出して。なぜ黎明に裏切り者がいると
思ったのか……私との会話を……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember what we talked about...
Remember why I thought there
was a traitor in the Dawn.

fields.EN:
(The conversation with Gretel... I
remember now!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The conversation with Gretel... I
remember now!)

fields.EN:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have that
"eye" you made mention of before?
fields.JP:
他のエリアには必ずあった『眼』が、
あの場所にはなかったことが関係あるとは
思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have that
"eye" you made mention of before?

fields.EN:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
a while.
fields.JP:
もう一つ言えば……あの場所には、
ずっと誰も入ってこれなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
a while.

fields.EN: What are you trying to say?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you trying to say?

fields.EN:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail and is
monitoring us.
fields.JP:
黎明の誰かがジェイルと通じていて、
ジェイルの中や私たちのことを監視している……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail and is
monitoring us.

fields.EN: Has that ever occurred to you?
fields.JP: ……そうは思ってみたことはない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Has that ever occurred to you?

fields.EN:
(It didn't dawn on me back then,
but...)
fields.JP: （あの時は意識してなかったけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It didn't dawn on me back then,
but...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe Gretel already connected
the eye with being monitored... If
so...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルは、あの『眼』を監視と結びつけて
　考えていた……そう考えれば……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Gretel already connected
the eye with being monitored... If
so...)

fields.EN:
Professor... Do you know what the giant
'eye' in the Solitary Confinement Area is?
fields.JP:
博士……独房エリアにある巨大な『眼』……
あれがなんだか知っていますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor? Do you know what those
"eyes" in the different areas are
for?

fields.EN:
(The eye is strongly connected to
its location...)
fields.JP:
（多分あの『眼』は、ある場所に大きく
　関係してるはず……その場所は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The eye is strongly connected to
its location...)

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to my room at the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『僕の部屋』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to my room at the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
I really don't think that's
correct. Jack-kun, I'm very
disappointed in you.
fields.JP:
私にはそうは思えないが？
……ジャックくん、これ以上失望させないで
くれたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really don't think that's
correct. Jack, I'm very
disappointed in you.

fields.JP:
え？　あ、あれ？
えーと……
ジャック……あなたを信じてたのに……

fields.EN:
Alice and I found an unusual room
in the laboratory.
fields.JP:
……博士。
僕とアリスは以前、研究室の奥で不思議な
部屋を見つけました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice and I found an unusual room
in the laboratory.

fields.EN:
The room displayed different parts of the
Solitary Confinement Area. I think those
images came from the 'eyes' in its walls...
fields.JP:
独房エリアのあちこちが映ってる部屋です。
それは恐らく、独房エリアの壁にある
『眼』から見えるものを映していた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The room showed screens of various
areas. I believe those images were
captured through the eyes.

fields.EN:
You were monitoring everything
from that room!
fields.JP: あなたは、あの部屋で全てを見ていたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were monitoring everything
from that room!

fields.JP:
あの、この間…ナイトメアが、
喋ったことについてなんですが……

fields.EN:
Ah... Well, that caught me by
surprise.
fields.JP:
ああ……その件なのだがね……
それは驚いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Well, that caught me by
surprise.

fields.EN:
Oh, good... So Clara was
able to relay the information to
you.
fields.JP:
よかった……
ちゃんとくららが伝えてくれたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, good... So Clara was
able to relay the information to
you.

fields.EN:
What about Clara? Do you know
something, Miko?
fields.JP:
何だ、くららがどうかしたのか？
……視子、知ってるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What about Clara? Do you know
something, Miko?

fields.EN:
(Huh? He didn't hear it from
Clara? Maybe Akazukin-san
told them...)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　くららじゃなかったのか。
　じゃあ、赤ずきんさんあたりかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? He didn't hear it from
Clara? Maybe Red Riding Hood
told them...)

fields.EN:
You knew the Nightmare had spoken
even though we never reported that to you.
fields.JP:
あなたは、ナイトメアが喋ったことを
僕らが報告していないのに知っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You knew about the Nightmare
before we even reported it to you.

fields.EN:
...Marchens born from the mimicry
of pregnant humans carried children
in their wombs who remained human.
fields.JP:
……人間の妊婦が擬態させられた
ことで生まれたメルヒェンは、胎内に
人間のままの子を宿していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems that Marchens created
by the Jail's mimicry of pregnant
humans doesn't affect the infant.

fields.EN:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.
fields.JP:
つまり、いくらジェイルでも胎内の子まで
擬態させることは不可能だったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.

fields.EN:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.
fields.JP:
そのメルヒェンたちは、そのまま胎内で
子を育て……胎を破って生まれてきた
子たちは、人間には無い能力を備えていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.

fields.EN:
Oddly enough, you also spoke about
the origin of the Blood Maidens
just after we found out.
fields.JP:
そして逆に、僕らが血式少女の出生の秘密を
知った時には、タイミングよく博士から
話があった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oddly enough, you also spoke about
the origin of the Blood Maidens
just after we found out.

fields.EN:
You brought it up, not knowing
that Kaguyahime spoke to us about it
outside of the Dawn!
fields.JP:
それは……黎明の外で、僕らがかぐや姫から
秘密を聞いたことを知らなかったからだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You brought it up, not knowing
that Kaguya spoke to us about it
outside of the Dawn!

fields.EN:
(I didn't know why the Professor
brought it up back then, but now I
do...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……あの時はなぜあのタイミングで
　博士が喋ったのかわからなかったけど、
　今ならわかる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know why the Professor
brought it up back then, but now I
do...)

fields.EN:
After we learned about Rapunzel's
origin, we would have suspected
you for keeping it secret.
fields.JP:
独房エリアでラプンツェルの話から
僕らが秘密に気づけば、それをあえて
黙っていた博士に疑念が向く
fields.LOCALIZED:
After we learned about Rapunzel's
origin, we would have suspected
you for keeping it secret.

fields.EN:
You didn't want us to doubt you.
Isn't that right, Professor?
fields.JP:
あなたはそれを恐れた。
違いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't want us to doubt you.
Isn't that right, Professor?

fields.EN:
I see... Your assumptions are
quite valid.
fields.JP:
なるほど……
見事な考察だ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Your assumptions are
quite valid.

fields.EN:
Those eyes are there to monitor
the safety of our units
investigating the Jail.
fields.JP:
あの『眼』は、ジェイルの調査をする者の
安全を期すために設置したものだとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those eyes are there to monitor
the safety of our units
investigating the Jail.

fields.EN:
We placed those eyes in the areas
during our expeditions long ago.
fields.JP:
かつての調査隊が、各独房エリアの調査を
進めると共に、あの『眼』を設置したのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We placed those eyes in the areas
during our expeditions long ago.

fields.EN:
That statement seems reasonable. I
don't recall seeing any eyes
around my home.
fields.JP:
一見、筋が通っているように聞こえるわね。
私の家には、確かにあの『眼』はなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That statement seems reasonable. I
don't recall seeing any eyes
around my home.

fields.EN:
Corroborated by the Dawn ceasing
its deployment of units there.
fields.JP: 黎明が調査を断念した……私の家には、ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Corroborated by the Dawn ceasing
its deployment of units there.

fields.EN: Does that make sense to you?
fields.LOCALIZED: Does that make sense to you?

fields.EN:
(Everything I'm pitting against
him isn't working... What should I
do?)
fields.JP:
（どんなに証拠を突きつけても
　通用しない……どうすればいいんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everything I'm pitting against
him isn't working... What should I
do?)

fields.EN:
Jack... That doesn't make sense.
Is it even possible to set up that
many eyes so easily?
fields.JP:
ジャック、今の話……何かおかしいわ。
あれだけ大量の『眼』を、そんなにすんなり
設置できるものかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... That doesn't make sense.
Is it even possible to set up that
many eyes so easily?

fields.EN:
(That's right... I can't give up.
I can't end it like this...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……ここであきらめちゃだめだ。
　これは、絶対に負けられない戦いなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I can't give up.
I can't end it like this...)

fields.EN:
It seems we spent quite some time
discussing this, but I'm glad to
know we're all in agreement now.
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと時間をとられてしまったが、
理解してもらえたようで私も嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems we spent quite some time
discussing this, but I'm glad to
know we're all in agreement now.

fields.EN:
No, not yet... If those eyes were
installed there by us, why did the
Jail allow it?
fields.JP:
……いいえ、まだです。
仮に調査隊があの『眼』を取り付けたとして、
なぜジェイルはされるがままだったんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, not yet... If those eyes were
installed there by us, why did the
Jail allow it?

fields.EN:
Why didn't the Marchens or the
Nightmares try to destroy those
eyes?
fields.JP:
なぜメルヒェンやナイトメアは、
あの『眼』を壊そうとしなかったんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why didn't the Marchens or the
Nightmares try to destroy those
eyes?

fields.EN:
That's further proof that you were
working with the Jail!
fields.JP:
それこそが、あなたがジェイルと通じている
大きな証拠だ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's further proof that you were
working with the Jail!

fields.EN:
Snark was communicating with the
Nightmares using a transceiver.
fields.JP:
スナークは、ナイトメアとトランシーバーで
連絡をとっていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snark was communicating with the
Nightmares using a transceiver.

fields.EN:
I believe that was done so that
you could command the Marchens
to capture humans...
fields.JP:
恐らく……メルヒェンに人間を捕らえさせ、
拷問にかけるために
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe that was done so that
you could command the Marchens
to capture humans...

fields.EN:
...And torture them to spur the
Jail's growth!
fields.JP: 拷問の目的は、ジェイルを成長させるためだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...And torture them to spur the
Jail's growth!

fields.EN:
That would match the escape plan's
objective as well.
fields.JP: 脱出計画との目的とも一致しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would match the escape plan's
objective as well.

fields.JP: 何のことかね、ハルくん

fields.EN:
They... Jack did the best he
could.
fields.JP: こいつらは……ジャックはよくやった
fields.LOCALIZED:
They... Jack did the best he
could.

fields.JP: ここまでお前を追い詰めたじゃねえか

fields.EN:
I was hoping you would change your
mind, but I suppose that isn't
going to happen.
fields.JP:
俺は、今の今までお前が考えを翻すのを
期待していたんだが……どうやら
無駄だったみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hoping you would change your
mind, but I suppose that isn't
going to happen.

fields.EN:
We can't replace what was lost.
Just give it up, Snark.
fields.JP:
……失ったものは二度と戻って来ない。
あきらめるんだ、スナーク
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't replace what was lost.
Just give it up, Snark.

fields.EN:
When you found Akazukin, you saw the potential
of a disposable field unit, and came up
with your scheme fifteen years ago...
fields.JP:
お前は、赤ずきんを発見したことで、
使い捨てになる実働部隊の可能性に気づき、
十五年前の策略を思いついた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This whole scheme of creating a
team to abuse after finding Red
Riding Hood has gone too far.

fields.EN:
You replaced Professor Toojima,
you came up with this escape
plan...
fields.JP:
それを実行して十島博士に成り代わり、
脱出計画を立案したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You replaced Professor Tohjima,
you came up with this escape
plan...

fields.EN:
I see... You efficiently gathered
the Blood Maidens and guided them along...
fields.JP:
なるほど、お前は血式少女たちを効率的に
集め導いていった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And things went well in finding
new Blood Maidens to do your
bidding.

fields.EN:
I'm guessing you wanted to
separate them because you thought
you were done with their services.
fields.JP:
以前、血式部隊を二手に分けようとしたのは、
そろそろ仕上げにかかり、用済みだと考えた
からだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm guessing you wanted to
separate them because you thought
you were done with their services.

fields.EN:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?
fields.JP:
……そうだ。君たち……
今回はチームを分けてみないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?

fields.EN: And why do you suggest that?
fields.JP: それは……どうしてですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: And why do you suggest that?

fields.EN:
With Kaguyahime and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.
fields.JP:
なに、せっかくかぐや姫とシンデレラという
強力な戦力が行動可能になったわけだしね。
今の君たちなら、何も全員で行くこともあるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Kaguya and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.

fields.EN:
We've had several large operations in a row.
I thought that while one team investigated,
the other could take a modest vacation.
fields.JP:
大きな作戦も続いたところだ。
一方のチームが調査に赴いている間、もう一方は
ささやかだが休暇を取るのも良いかと思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our goal is still far off. I think
it would make sense to have a team
head in while the other rests.

fields.EN:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...
fields.JP:
やれやれ……獅子身中の虫とは、
まさにこのことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...

fields.JP: お父さん……否定、してくれないんだ……

fields.EN: ...Let me say this one last time.
fields.JP: ……最後にもう一度だけ言わせてもらう

fields.EN:
Just stop. Everything changes.
You're not in control. Think about
coexisting with this planet.
fields.JP:
考え直せ。全ては変化していくんだ。
何もかもがお前の掌中にあるわけじゃない。
この星と共に生きることを考えろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just stop. Everything changes.
You're not in control. Think about
coexisting with this planet.

fields.EN:
What are you talking about, Haru-san?
What do you mean by "planet"...?
fields.JP:
……何の話ですか、ハルさん。
『この星』って、まるで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking about, Haru?
What do you mean by "planet"...?

fields.EN:
We came here from a different
planet that was destroyed long
ago...
fields.JP:
ああ。俺たちは、とある滅んだ星から
ここに流れ着いたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We came here from a different
planet that was destroyed long
ago...

fields.EN:
He was controlling a creature from the same
planet, one he already knew well, making it
grow toward the finished form he wanted.
fields.JP:
こいつは、勝手知ったる同じ星の生物を
操ってたんだ。こいつの願う完成形に向けて
育つようにな
fields.LOCALIZED:
He was controlling the creature
found on our planet, so that it
would mature to do his bidding.

fields.JP: にわかには……信じられない話だわ……

fields.EN:
But the Jail decided to coexist
with this planet. Our story ended
there.
fields.JP:
だが、ジェイルはこの星との共生を選んだ。
もう物語は終わったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Jail decided to coexist
with this planet. Our story ended
there.

fields.EN:
What if I said our story hasn't
ended yet?
fields.JP: ……まだ終わっていないと言ったら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if I said our story hasn't
ended yet?

fields.EN:
You disappoint me, Haru. You
truly are a traitor.
fields.JP:
……君には失望したよ。
やはり、私にとっての裏切者は君だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You disappoint me, Haru. You
truly are a traitor.

fields.EN:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.
fields.JP: さて。用済みの玩具には退場願おうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.

fields.EN:
He has a working gun?! Everyone,
be careful...!
fields.JP:
使える銃がまだ残っていたなんて……！
みんな、気をつけて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He has a working gun?! Everyone,
be careful...!

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.
fields.JP:
なに、このままじっとしていてくれれば何も
しないよ。面倒だからね。
何なら塔を降りてくれても構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.

fields.EN:
I will continue down this path to
attain my goal.
fields.JP: 私は私で、目的を叶えることにしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will continue down this path to
attain my goal.

fields.EN:
Even if you aren't the same Dad
I knew before, you're still my
Dad...
fields.JP:
お父さんが昔のお父さんじゃなくても、
あたしにとっては……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you aren't the same Dad
I knew before, you're still my
Dad...

fields.EN:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Akazukin. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.
fields.JP:
君には大いに感謝しているよ、赤ずきん。
私の計画は、君のおかげで大きく前進
することになったのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Red Riding Hood. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.

fields.EN:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...

fields.EN:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark...
fields.JP: ……みんな。博士を……スナークを追おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark...

fields.EN:
Wait. There's one other thing you
all need to know.
fields.JP:
待て。お前たちに一つ伝えておかなきゃ
ならんことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. There's one other thing you
all need to know.

fields.EN:
His objective is to change the
world using this tower... Using
the Jail for insemination.
fields.JP:
奴の目的は、この塔……ジェイルの『受精』に
よる、世界の塗り替えだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
His objective is to change the
world using this tower... Using
the Jail for insemination.

fields.EN:
He's trying to revive
our destroyed home planet...
fields.JP:
滅んじまった俺たちの星を蘇らせようと
してるのさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's trying to revive what was
lost on our planet.

fields.EN:
What does that have to do with
the Jail's insemination?
fields.JP:
それがジェイルの『受精』とどういう関係が
あるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What does that have to do with
the Jail's insemination?

fields.EN:
What is born through 'insemination'
is new life... a brand-new
core of the greatest scale.
fields.JP:
『受精』によって誕生するのは、新たな生命……
真新しい、最大級の『核』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A new life is born through
insemination. A brand new core...

fields.EN:
The Jail's core uses mimicry to
bring shape to things, even
desires.
fields.JP:
そしてジェイルの核は『擬態』する。
『想い』という無形のものさえも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's core uses mimicry to
bring shape to things, even
desires.

fields.EN:
Yes. Just as this Jail was born by
mimicking the thoughts contained
in those fairy-tale picture books.
fields.JP:
そうね。このジェイルが童話の絵本たちの想いを
擬態することで生まれたように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, just like how the Jail
brought to life characters from
storybooks...

fields.EN:
And like how I was born from the
desires of the children who read
those storybooks...
fields.JP:
そして、わたしがそれを読んだ子供たちの想いを
擬態させられて生まれた存在なように
fields.LOCALIZED:
And like how I was born from the
desires of the children who read
those storybooks...

fields.EN:
So, you're a reincarnated form,
then...
fields.JP: お前……『転生体』だったのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're a reincarnated form,
then...

fields.EN:
I found out where I came from...
I came from where a preschool once
stood long ago...
fields.JP:
あの始まりの場所で、はっきりとわかったの。
今のわたしの生は、あの場所……幼稚園があった
場所から始まったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found out where I came from...
I came from where a preschool once
stood long ago...

fields.EN:
But without realizing it, I had kept
mimicking even further... as a puppet
of the Blue Bird... of Snark...
fields.JP:
でも、自分でも気づかないうちにさらに
擬態していたのね……
青い鳥……スナークの操り人形として……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I was mimicked to life
without my knowledge by the blue
bird... by Snark...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Chiaki, for all the
suffering I've caused you. I'm
such a bad sister...
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい、千昭……わたし、あなたのことを
苦しめてばかりのお姉さんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Chiaki, for all the
suffering I've caused you. I'm
such a bad sister...

fields.EN:
So, Snark is planning to use the
Jail's mimicry on the new core.
To bring about a new world...
fields.JP:
……スナークは、新たに生まれる核に擬態させる
つもりなのね。
あの人の望む世界を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Snark is planning to use the
Jail's mimicry on the new core.
To bring about a new world...

fields.EN:
Yeah... I tried to convince him to
change his ways and coexist with
this world, but...
fields.JP:
ああ。
俺はこの星との共生を考え、最後の最後まで
あいつの考えを変えさせようとしたんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I tried to convince him to
change his ways and coexist with
this world, but...

fields.EN:
Guess I made more trouble than I
fixed... Sorry, everyone.
fields.JP:
そのせいでお前たちにも迷惑をかけたな
……本当にすまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess I made more trouble than I
fixed... Sorry, everyone.

fields.EN:
Let's hurry! He's gonna finish
this up by using the followers'
lives!
fields.JP:
さあ、急ごう！
あいつが最後の仕上げに使おうとしてるのは
……信者たちの命だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's hurry! He's gonna finish
this up by using the followers'
lives!

fields.EN:
I'm sure they're being held
somewhere on this floor!
fields.JP:
おそらく、このフロアのどこかに監禁されてる
筈だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure they're being held
somewhere on this floor!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Laboratory in the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『研究室』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Laboratory in the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Blood Factory in
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『血式兵器製造所』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Blood Factory in
the Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Order's HQ in the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『タイヨウ本部』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Order's HQ in the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Purging Center in
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『浄化場』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Purging Center in
the Liberated District!

fields.EN:
This is a story before the closing
of a story... A fragment of a
story that may have existed.
fields.JP:
これは物語が閉じられる前の物語……
あったかもしれない、もう一つの物語の欠片。
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a story before the closing
of a story... A fragment of a
story that may have existed.

fields.JP: どうやら、みんな揃ったみたいね

fields.EN:
Uh, I don't think you needed to
squeeze everyone in here.
fields.JP:
なにも、この部屋に全員集める必要は
なかったんじゃねえのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I don't think you needed to
squeeze everyone in here.

fields.JP: 息苦しくてかなわねえよ……

fields.EN:
It's just more efficient to speak
with everyone at once.
fields.JP:
メンバー全員に話しておいた方が、
説明が一度で済むでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just more efficient to speak
with everyone at once.

fields.EN:
Um, and what is it that you wanted
to talk about?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, and what is it that you wanted
to talk about?

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm sorry. I gathered everyone
here to ask a favor.
fields.JP:
ああ、ごめんなさい。
あなたたちにお願いしたいことが
あって来てもらったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm sorry. I gathered everyone
here to ask a favor.

fields.EN:
What I'm going to talk about is
what I heard from the refugees, so
I'm not sure how accurate it is...
fields.JP:
避難民たちからの情報でね、
どの程度信頼できるのかは正直
わからないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I'm going to talk about is
what I heard from the refugees, so
I'm not sure how accurate it is...

fields.EN:
It's about an underground cavern
in the Solitary Confinement Area.
fields.JP: 独房エリアに地下洞窟があるっていう話なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
...It seems as if there's an
underground cavern somewhere
in the Jail.

fields.EN:
And if that's true, that means
there's an uncharted area the Dawn
is unaware of.
fields.JP:
もし、本当の話なら……
黎明では把握していないエリアになる
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if that's true, that means
there's an uncharted area the Dawn
is unaware of.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised there would be an
area that the Dawn wouldn't know
about.
fields.JP:
黎明でも把握してない場所があるなんて、
驚きですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised there would be an
area that the Dawn wouldn't know
about.

fields.EN:
The only areas the Dawn knows are
those we sent our units to. There
may be others still unknown.
fields.JP:
まあぶっちゃけ、黎明が把握しているのは、
過去の調査隊が発見したものだけだからな。
知らない場所があっても不思議じゃねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only areas the Dawn knows are
those we sent our units to. There
may be others still unknown.

fields.EN:
That almost sounds like we're only
relying on what was done in the
past.
fields.JP:
なによそれ。
つまり、ほとんど昔の人頼みだって話じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That almost sounds like we're only
relying on what was done in the
past.

fields.EN:
It just means that the casualties
from 15 years ago were that
profound...
fields.JP:
それは……十五年前の事件が黎明に及ぼした
人的被害が、それだけ甚大だったという
ことなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just means that the casualties
from 15 years ago were that
profound...

fields.EN:
After that, most work was follow-up
investigation. Our only achievements were
Blood Maiden studies and forming their unit...
fields.JP:
その後の活動はほとんど追跡調査のみで、
唯一の成果といったら、血式少女の研究と
その部隊の編成くらいだったものね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We chose to conduct research in
well-traversed areas, building our
knowledge of the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Well, gotta hand it to you. With
all of you around, we were finally
able to get out of that rut.
fields.JP:
まあ、お前らのおかげで、ようやくまた
ぼちぼち歩みを進めることができてるってな。
……感謝してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, gotta hand it to you. With
all of you around, we were finally
able to get out of that rut.

fields.EN:
It sounds fake, coming from you...
In fact, your gratitude sounds
cold and unnerving...
fields.JP:
そなたが言うと嘘くさいです～
むしろ寒いです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounds fake, coming from you...
In fact, your gratitude sounds
cold and unnerving...

fields.EN:
Oh, yeah... So, what we wanted to
ask was for y'all to go and
investigate the area.
fields.JP:
あ、ああ……
んで、手間をとらせて悪いんだけどな……
お前らに調査を頼みたいわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, yeah... So, what we wanted to
ask was for y'all to go and
investigate the area.

fields.EN:
I believe you are referring to my
castle - the underground
labyrinth!
fields.JP:
それはおそらく、ワレの城たる地下迷宮の
ことではなかろうか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe you are referring to my
castle - the underground
labyrinth!

fields.EN:
That's possible, since the
information we received was a bit
unreliable in terms of positions.
fields.JP:
確かに……その可能性もあるわね。
避難民の情報ではエリアの位置があいまい
だったから、断定はできないけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's possible, since the
information we received was a bit
unreliable in terms of positions.

fields.EN:
But from what they said, they
heard an eerie voice coming from
underneath.
fields.JP:
話によれば、地下の奥底から、
うめき声みたいなものが聞こえてくると
いうのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But from what they said, they
heard an eerie voice coming from
underneath.

fields.EN:
That sounds more like a horror
story...
fields.JP: なんだか……怖いお話ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds more like a horror
story...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... There may be something
in wait for us to discover.
fields.JP:
ふふ。何か意外なものが、
見つかるかもしれないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... There may be something
in wait for us to discover.

fields.EN:
What the...?! Stop saying it as if
it's going to get us!
fields.JP:
何言ってるんですか～！
不吉なこと言わないでください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?! Stop saying it as if
it's going to get us!

fields.EN:
Oh, come on, it's probably
nothing.
fields.JP: どうせ、大したことないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on, it's probably
nothing.

fields.EN:
Adventure to labyrinth! We need
lunches!
fields.JP:
めーきゅーたんけんだね！
おべんとうがいるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Adventure to labyrinth! We need
lunches!

fields.EN:
Well, I guess we can check the
place out!
fields.JP: ま、そういうことなら仕方ないね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess we can check the
place out!

fields.EN:
Don't get too excited. Who knows
what danger lies ahead...
fields.JP:
面白半分は良くないわ。
思わぬ危険が待ち受けているのかも
しれないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't get too excited. Who knows
what danger lies ahead...

fields.EN:
Why, yes, that is quite possible.
You all need to be very careful,
you hear?
fields.JP:
ええ、その可能性も否定できないわ。
十分に注意してちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes, that is quite possible.
You all need to be very careful,
you hear?

fields.EN:
(Eerie voice... I wonder what
that's about...)
fields.JP: （うめき声……一体何がいるんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Eerie voice... I wonder what
that's about...)

fields.EN:
Oh? I'm surprised to find a place
like this in my abode!
fields.JP:
ほう……我が迷宮にこのような場所が
あったとは！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I'm surprised to find a place
like this in my abode!

fields.JP: ヒォォォォオオオオォオ……！

fields.EN:
Yikes! I hear some sort of moaning
coming from far away...
fields.JP:
ひっ！
遠くからうめき声が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yikes! I hear some sort of moaning
coming from far away...

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'm not getting good vibes
from this... What a chore...
fields.JP:
あー、すごく嫌な予感がします～。
面倒臭いです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'm not getting good vibes
from this... What a chore...

fields.JP: ええ。ナイトメアの気配を感じるわ……
ラプンツェルもかんじるー！！

fields.EN:
Huh? The heck are you saying? It's
not like we know it's really a
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
はあ？　あんたたち、何言ってんのよ。
まだなんなのか、わからないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? The heck are you saying? It's
not like we know it's really a
Nightmare.

fields.EN:
No... There's a Nightmare here...
I can sense it, too...
fields.JP:
いいえ…‥いるわ、ナイトメアが。
わたしも感じるもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... There's a Nightmare here...
I can sense it, too...

fields.EN:
How dare it live without my
knowledge! It must be punished!
fields.JP: ワレの許可なしに住み着くとは……許せんな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare it live without my
knowledge! It must be punished!

fields.EN:
Well, if it's a Nightmare, there's
nothing to worry about.
fields.JP:
あら。でもナイトメアなら、怖れることは
ないじゃありませんの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if it's a Nightmare, there's
nothing to worry about.

fields.EN:
Right! All we have to do is beat
it to a pulp!
fields.JP:
まあ、そうね。
邪魔なヤツはぶっ潰すのみよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! All we have to do is beat
it to a pulp!

fields.EN:
But if there's a Nightmare, that
means there's a core too, right?
What should we do, Aka-neesama?
fields.JP:
……ナイトメアがいるってことは……
当然、核も存在するってことですよね？
赤姉様、どうしましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if there's a Nightmare, that
means there's a core too, right?
What should we do, Sister Red?

fields.EN:
Well, our gals here are saying
they sense something, so it must
be true. Let's look for that core.
fields.JP:
勘の鋭い連中が口を揃えて言ってるんだから、
まず間違いないね……
とりあえず、核を探そう。奥へ進むよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, our gals here are saying
they sense something, so it must
be true. Let's look for that core.

fields.EN:
I thought the area felt different
than usual, but I guess a core
being here doesn't change...
fields.JP:
他のエリアとはどこか雰囲気が違うと思って
ましたけど、やっぱり核はあるんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought the area felt different
than usual, but I guess a core
being here doesn't change...

fields.EN:
I can't believe something like
that existed within my abode!
fields.JP:
このようなモノが、我が迷宮にも存在していた
とは……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe something like
that existed within my abode!

fields.EN:
Now that we've found it, I guess
we need to take care of it. What a
chore...
fields.JP:
見つけてしまったものは仕方ないです～。
面倒臭いです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that we've found it, I guess
we need to take care of it. What a
chore...

fields.EN:
It doesn't matter where we found
it. If we find one, we destroy it.
Simple as that!
fields.JP:
どこにあろうと関係ないじゃない？
核は見つけ次第、破壊……それだけよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't matter where we found
it. If we find one, we destroy it.
Simple as that!

fields.JP: ぐるるる……！　ばんにん、きたよ！！

fields.EN: My, my, how quick it is.
fields.LOCALIZED: My, my, how quick it is.

fields.EN: I guess this is the same, too...
fields.JP: そうなりますよね、やっぱり……
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess this is the same, too...

fields.JP: みんな、気を引き締めて！

fields.EN: All right then. Let's do this!
fields.JP: そうだね……みんな、こっちから行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right then. Let's do this!

fields.JP: ジョォォオオオオオオ……！
今のは……ジェイルの鳴き声？

fields.EN:
But, it sounded different than
usual...
fields.JP: なんだか、いつもと声が違う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it sounded different than
usual...

fields.EN:
W-Well, no use thinking at this
point! At least we can beat the
Nightmare now!
fields.JP:
ま、まあいいじゃない！
これでナイトメアを倒せることには
変わりないんだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, no use thinking at this
point! At least we can beat the
Nightmare now!

fields.EN:
We should be careful, just in
case.
fields.JP: とりあえず、油断はしない方がよさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should be careful, just in
case.

fields.EN:
Right! Let's keep an eye out for
anything!
fields.JP: そうだね、慎重に行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! Let's keep an eye out for
anything!

fields.JP:
すんすん……ないとめあ、いない……
……ちかくにいるはずなのに

fields.EN:
Hmph... Let me beckon it here.
Nightmaaaaaare!
fields.JP:
ふ……ワレがひとつ呼んでみよう。
ナイトメ…‥あああああああッ～～～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... Let me beckon it here.
Nightmaaaaaare!

fields.EN:
The place turned dark all of a
sudden!
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place turned dark all of a
sudden!

fields.JP: ヒォォォォオオオオォオ……！

fields.EN: So, are you able to talk?
fields.JP: ねえ。あなた……話はできる？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, are you able to talk?

fields.JP: ヒォォォオオオオオオォオ……！

fields.EN:
Gretel! This is no time to be
talking!
fields.JP:
グレーテル！
そんなことしてる場合じゃないってば！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel! This is no time to be
talking!

fields.EN:
Oh, but inquisitiveness shouldn't
be constrained by time.
fields.JP: あら。どんな時にでも探究心は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but inquisitiveness shouldn't
be constrained by time.

fields.EN:
Oyayubi! Hold the Nightmare back! Alice!
Gretel! Attack from both flanks! Jack,
support the three in the front line!
fields.JP:
親指！　ナイトメアを抑えて！
アリス！　グレーテル！　両翼から攻撃！
ジャックは前衛三人のフォローを！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby! Get ready! Alice and
Gretel! Attack from the sides!
Everyone else, support us!

fields.EN: Let's do this! Bring it on!
fields.JP:
上等だわ！
やってやろうじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's do this! Bring it on!

fields.EN:
Hameln, you're free to do what
you want as long as you don't go
overboard!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンは……無茶しない範囲内で
好きにしてよし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, you're free to do what
you want as long as you don't go
overboard!

fields.EN:
It looks like it's going to go
down soon!
fields.JP: よし。相手は弱ってきたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's going to go
down soon!

fields.JP: ヒォォォォオオォォオ……！

fields.EN: H-Hey wait! Wait up, you coward!
fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと……コラ！
ま、待ちなさいよ！　卑怯者！
fields.LOCALIZED: H-Hey wait! Wait up, you coward!

fields.EN:
Hmph... It must have succumbed to
fear in my presence!
fields.JP: フッ……ワレの武威を怖れたのであろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... It must have succumbed to
fear in my presence!

fields.JP: それにしても、変なナイトメアですね～

fields.EN:
It responded differently from the
others we've faced before.
fields.JP: これまでのナイトメアとは、反応が違うわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It responded differently from the
others we've faced before.

fields.EN: S-So what should we do now?
fields.JP: そ……それで、どうするんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: S-So what should we do now?

fields.EN:
We're gonna chase it down! Let's
go, everyone!
fields.JP:
当然、追いかけるさ！
みんな！　追撃するよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're gonna chase it down! Let's
go, everyone!

fields.JP: ヒォォォォオオオオォオ……
ないとめあ、みつけたぞーーーー！

fields.EN:
You're one troublesome fellow,
aren't you?
fields.JP: ずいぶん手間をかけさせてくれたじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're one troublesome fellow,
aren't you?

fields.JP: わはははは！　観念するがよいぞ！

fields.EN:
It's hurt, but be careful... Let's
finish it off!
fields.JP:
相手は手負いだ……みんな、注意して。
一気にケリをつけるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's hurt, but be careful... Let's
finish it off!

fields.JP: オォォォォオオオオォオ……！！
オォォォォォォオォォ……

fields.EN:
(We beat the Nightmare, but this
all feels too weird...)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアは倒せたけど……
　なんだろう、この釈然としない感覚……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We beat the Nightmare, but this
all feels too weird...)

fields.JP: これで、一件落着ですね

fields.EN:
Well, it seems we went in pretty
far chasing after it...
fields.JP:
それより……ずいぶん奥まで来てしまい
ましたわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems we went in pretty
far chasing after it...

fields.EN:
It's going to be a pain, heading
back...
fields.JP: 戻るのが大変そうです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's going to be a pain, heading
back...

fields.EN:
Yeah... We did go up and down and
all over.
fields.JP:
……あー。降りたり昇ったり、ずいぶん
走らされたからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We did go up and down and
all over.

fields.EN:
It doesn't look like we're
underground now, but... Where are
we, exactly?
fields.JP:
さすがに地下じゃなさそうだし、
どの辺りなんだろ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't look like we're
underground now, but... Where are
we, exactly?

fields.EN:
Maybe we can get to a different
area if we just punch a hole
someplace.
fields.JP:
その辺りをブチ抜いたら、
どこかのエリアに出られるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can get to a different
area if we just punch a hole
someplace.

fields.EN:
Well, if that's what you want,
then...
fields.JP: そういうことなら、ワレが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if that's what you want,
then...

fields.EN:
H-Hold on there! If you do that,
there's no telling whether this
place is going to cave in.
fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっと待ってよ！
そんなことしたら、あちこち崩れたりする
かもしれないし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hold on there! If you do that,
there's no telling whether this
place is going to cave in.

fields.JP: グレーテル、どうしたの？

fields.EN:
There were a few things different
here from other areas.
fields.JP:
このエリアには……他と違う点がいくつか
あったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There were a few things different
here from other areas.

fields.JP: まず、ここだけ地下にありますね～

fields.EN:
The wailing from the Jail was
different when we destroyed the
core earlier, too.
fields.JP:
それに、核を壊した時のジェイルの鳴き声が、
いつもと違いましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The wailing from the Jail was
different when we destroyed the
core earlier, too.

fields.EN:
Not to mention, the Nightmare ran
from us during battle.
fields.JP: ナイトメアは、戦ってる途中に逃げ出したしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention, the Nightmare ran
from us during battle.

fields.EN: Yes, it looks like a window.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, it looks like a window.

fields.EN:
There's rubble all over the place,
but I guess this is inside some
sort of structure.
fields.JP:
瓦礫で埋まってますけど。
ここって建物の中だったんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's rubble all over the place,
but I guess this is inside some
sort of structure.

fields.JP: そうすると……ますますどの辺りなんだろ？

fields.EN:
Maybe we can see outside if we
move this steel plate...
fields.JP:
この鉄の板をどかせば……
こっちから外が見えるかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can see outside if we
move this steel plate...

fields.EN:
Yup. Everyone, come and lend a
hand.
fields.JP: うん。みんなでどかそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Everyone, come and lend a
hand.

fields.EN:
The sky... I haven't seen that
kind of color coming from the sky
before...
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sky... I haven't seen that
kind of color coming from the sky
before...

fields.EN:
That's... the Jail Tower, isn't
it?
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's... the Jail Tower, isn't
it?

fields.EN:
Yes. And... it looks like
the two towers are connected.
fields.JP:
ええ。
しかも……二本繋がっているように見えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It looks like the place is
connected to it.

fields.JP: これって……なんなんですか……

fields.EN:
This place is starting to creep
me out...
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is starting to creep
me out...

fields.JP: うう……なんだかここ、こわいよ

fields.EN:
Connected to the Tower...? So
is this what happens when it
grows?
fields.JP:
塔が繋がってるなんて……ジェイルが育つと
ああなるんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Connected to the Tower...? So
is this what happens when it
grows?

fields.EN:
Jack! There's something written on
the steel plate we just moved!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　さっきどかした鉄板……
何か文字が書いてあるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! There's something written on
the steel plate we just moved!

fields.EN:
It's all rusty and falling apart,
but it's a train station sign.
fields.JP:
これって、駅の標識なんだよ！
錆び付いてボロボロになってるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's all rusty and falling apart,
but it's a train station sign.

fields.EN:
At least the larger words are
still legible... Let me see...
fields.JP:
大きな文字なら……
どうにか読めそうだわ……ええと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least the larger words are
still legible... Let me see...

fields.EN:
Could it be that we're... Actually
outside of the Jail?
fields.JP:
もしかして、ここは……
私たちのジェイルの……外……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could it be that we're... Actually
outside of the Jail?

fields.JP: まさか……いやでも、そんなことって！

fields.EN:
So even if we escape from the
Jail, the surface is covered in
Jails, too?!
fields.JP:
何よこれ！　ジェイルから出られても、
外の世界もジェイルだらけだってこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So even if we escape from the
Jail, the surface is covered in
Jails, too?!

fields.EN:
(I didn't expect the surface to be
like some paradise, but...)
fields.JP:
（外の世界が素晴らしい場所だなんて、
　そこまでは思ってなかったけど、でも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't expect the surface to be
like some paradise, but...)

fields.JP: どうかしたの、ジャック？

fields.EN:
It looks like some sort of
entrance... Where does this lead
to?
fields.JP:
何かの……入り口みたいなんだ。
どこに繋がってるんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like some sort of
entrance... Where does this lead
to?

fields.EN: Yes... And, it looks quite deep...
fields.JP: 本当ね……結構、深そうだわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... And, it looks quite deep...

fields.JP: おいしいものあるかな！
あんた、ほんとに食い意地張ってるわよね……

fields.EN:
Hm, but I wonder where it goes.
This wasn't in any of the Dawn's
reports...
fields.JP:
でも……何なのかしら。
黎明からの情報にもなかったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, but I wonder where it goes.
This wasn't in any of the Dawn's
reports...

fields.EN:
Instead of assuming, I suggest
we simply see where it leads.
fields.JP: あれこれ詮索するより、調べた方が早いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Instead of assuming, I suggest
we simply see where it leads.

fields.JP: たんけん！　たんけん！

fields.EN: Ohohoho! I am up to the challenge!
fields.JP:
をーっほほほほほ！
望むところですわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohohoho! I am up to the challenge!

fields.EN:
So, we're going inside...? It's a
bit scary...
fields.JP:
……この中に入っていくんですか？
怖そうですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we're going inside...? It's a
bit scary...

fields.EN: I don't want to do extra work...
fields.JP: 余計な仕事はしたくないです～
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't want to do extra work...

fields.EN:
We may find out something useful
if we search an area we've never
seen before.
fields.JP:
でも……未知の領域を調査すれば、
更に何かがわかるかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may find out something useful
if we search an area we've never
seen before.

fields.EN: Okay then! Let's check it out!
fields.JP:
うん、そうだね！
それじゃ、行ってみようか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay then! Let's check it out!

fields.EN:
Huh... I didn't know there was an
area like this underground...
fields.JP:
へえ……地下にこんな空間が広がってたなんて
全然知らなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... I didn't know there was an
area like this underground...

fields.EN: Yes. The place is so spacious...
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. The place is so spacious...

fields.JP: あははははっ！　ひろーい！！
こら、ラプは走らないの！

やだー！
ラプンツェルあそびたーいー！

fields.EN:
Rapu-Rapu! There's no telling what's
lurking here!
fields.JP:
ラプラプ！
何が出るかわからないですわよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy! There's no telling what's
lurking here!

fields.JP: うん！　ねむねむとて、つなぐ！

fields.EN: I'm so glad Nemu is here...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm so glad Sleepy is here...

fields.EN:
I wonder if the Jail's growth
created this underground area...
fields.JP:
でも……こんなところがあったなんて、
ジェイルは地下にも成長してるのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if the Jail's growth
created this underground area...

fields.EN:
Who knows? I at least know
there's a lot more we need to find
out about this place.
fields.JP:
どうかしら……
ともかく、まだまだ謎が多いことは確かね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows? I at least know
there's a lot more we need to find
out about this place.

fields.EN: Yeah... Let's keep our guard up.
fields.JP: うん。油断しないように進もう
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah... Let's keep our guard up.

fields.EN:
Do you think you can really stop
us?
fields.JP: そんなもの、この私に通用すると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think you can really stop
us?

fields.EN:
Please wait! Her eyes are glowing
pink!
fields.JP:
待ってください！
この人の目、ピンクに光ってます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please wait! Her eyes are glowing
pink!

fields.EN:
You're right! So she's another
Blood Maiden?! If you're a Blood
Maiden, we're not your enemies!
fields.JP:
ほんとだ……！
じゃああんたも血式少女じゃない！？
だったらあたしたち、敵じゃないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right! So she's another
Blood Maiden?! If you're a Blood
Maiden, we're not your enemies!

fields.EN:
Um, we're really not your enemies.
Uh... How can I get through to
you?
fields.JP:
あの……僕たち、本当に敵なんかじゃないんだ。
ええと……どうすれば伝わるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, we're really not your enemies.
Uh... How can I get through to
you?

fields.EN:
Oh? There's only one thing to do
if you can't be heard.
fields.JP:
あら。道理が通じない相手なら、やることは
一つよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? There's only one thing to do
if you can't be heard.

fields.EN:
How about we punish her a bit? We
just have to make her listen to
us.
fields.JP:
お仕置きというのはいかがなものかしら……
でも、話を聞いてくれない人には、聞く耳を
持たせるまでね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about we punish her a bit? We
just have to make her listen to
us.

fields.EN: W-Wait a sec! Um, you too!
fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっとみんな待ってよ！
その……きみも！
fields.LOCALIZED: W-Wait a sec! Um, you too!

fields.EN:
Jack! Just don't stand there!
She's ready to fight!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　ボヤボヤしてんじゃないわよ！
相手はやる気よ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Just don't stand there!
She's ready to fight!

fields.JP:
そうだね！
みんな……油断するんじゃないよ！

fields.EN:
Tch...! I can't believe I've
tasted defeat...
fields.JP: くっ……このワレが敗北を喫するとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch...! I can't believe I've
tasted defeat...

fields.EN:
W-We're sorry to have ganged up
on a girl like you...
fields.JP: お……女の子に大勢で……すみません
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We're sorry to have ganged up
on a girl like you...

fields.EN:
Um, I don't think we had a
choice...
fields.JP: い……いや、仕方なかったと思うけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I don't think we had a
choice...

fields.EN:
D-Don't call me a gyrl! I am
Hameln! The Demon Kyngh!
fields.JP:
お……おんにゃのこと言うでない！
ワレはハーメルン。魔王でありゅぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't call me a gyrl! I am
Hameln! The Demon Kyngh!

fields.JP: こ……小娘ども！　頭が高いわ！

fields.EN:
I don't think that attitude of
yours is fitting, when you took
the first swing and lost to us.
fields.JP:
だいたいあなたが戦闘を仕掛けてきて、
わたしたちに負けたのでしょう？
なのに、その態度は無いのではないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think that attitude of
yours is fitting, when you took
the first swing and lost to us.

fields.EN:
I-Indeed... I did lose... Well
then, take my head if you
please...
fields.JP:
い……いかにも……ワレは敗北した……
故に、この首でも何でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-Indeed... I did lose... Well
then, take my head if you
please...

fields.JP: いいから普通に話しなさい

fields.EN:
...I see. So there are no cores
here, or Nightmares, for that
matter...
fields.JP:
……そう。このエリアには核も無ければ、
ナイトメアもいないのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I see. So there are no cores
here, or Nightmares, for that
matter...

fields.EN:
What you mention is something I
have never seen before here,
m'lady.
fields.JP:
お嬢の言うそれらのものは、残念ながら
ワレは見たことも聞いたこともなくてな
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you mention is something I
have never seen before here,
m'lady.

fields.EN:
What a strange and unusual
place...
fields.JP: ……不思議な場所もあったものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a strange and unusual
place...

fields.EN:
Oh? Let me rephrase that to "a
boring place."
fields.JP: あら。つまらない場所の間違いじゃないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Let me rephrase that to "a
boring place."

fields.EN:
What?! You, the aloof one called
Gretel! Is where you came from
interesting?!
fields.JP:
何！？
グレーテルとやら。上階は面白いのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! You, the aloof one called
Gretel! Is where you came from
interesting?!

fields.EN:
I'd prefer you to call me "m'lady"
as well. Or you can me "princess,"
if you'd like.
fields.JP:
ねえ。私のこともお嬢とか姫とか呼んで
くれない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd prefer you to call me "m'lady"
as well. Or you can me "princess,"
if you'd like.

fields.JP: あなた……また人をからかって……

fields.EN:
The only one I shall address as
m'lady is the one called Alice!
Behold her elegant form!
fields.JP:
わ……ワレがお嬢と呼ぶのは、このアリスのみ！
この気高く凛とした様を見よ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only one I shall address as
m'lady is the one called Alice!
Behold her elegant form!

fields.EN:
I thought I told you to speak
normally...
fields.JP: その……あなたも普通に話しなさいと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I told you to speak
normally...

fields.EN:
You heard that?! She's calling
Alice "m'lady!"
fields.JP: あいつ……アリスのことお嬢ですって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard that?! She's calling
Alice "m'lady!"

fields.EN:
Despite her holier-than-thou attitude,
maybe she's born to be a subordinate.
Alice-san accepts it pretty naturally, too.
fields.JP:
偉そうなのに、下僕体質なんでしょうか～
アリスさんも普通に受け入れてますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite her holier-than-thou
attitude, maybe she's born to be
a subordinate.

fields.EN:
S-Stop it, you two... She can hear
us.
fields.JP:
や……やめなよ、ふたりとも。
きっと聞こえてるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop it, you two... She can hear
us.

fields.EN:
Are you all what you call a
"friend?"
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you all what you call a
"friend?"

fields.JP: え？　うん、僕たちは仲間だけど……？

fields.EN:
I will become this "friend" of
yours to protect m'lady! Rejuice!
fields.JP:
喜ぶが良いぞ！
このワレはお嬢を守護すべく、貴様らの仲間と
なってやりょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will become this "friend" of
yours to protect m'lady! Rejuice!

fields.EN:
With my powers at your disposal,
ruling the world shall be within
your grasp!
fields.JP:
このワレの強力な力をもってすれば、
しぇかい……世界征服も夢では無い！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
With my powers at your disposal,
ruling the world shall be within
your grasp!

fields.EN:
Thanks for becoming our friend.
Um, hahaha...
fields.JP: 仲間になってくれてありがとう……ははは
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for becoming our friend.
Um, hahaha...

fields.EN:
In that case, ruling the world is
out of the question. Just be a
normal friend like anybody else.
fields.JP:
だから、世界征服なんかしなくていいの。
仲間になるなら普通に仲間になりなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that case, ruling the world is
out of the question. Just be a
normal friend like anybody else.

fields.EN:
I-If that's what you say, m'lady!
It shall be d-d-d-done!
fields.JP:
お、お嬢がそうおっしゃりゃりぇ……
御意！！　……と
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-If that's what you say, m'lady!
It shall be d-d-d-done!

fields.EN:
That's what happens when you wear
such a long cloak...
fields.JP:
もう……そんなに長いものを着て
いきなり立ち上がるからよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what happens when you wear
such a long cloak...

fields.EN:
Um... Maybe it's just me, but she
could be an incredible klutz...
fields.JP:
この方……ひょっとして、とってもドジっ子
じゃありませんこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Maybe it's just me, but she
could be an incredible klutz...

fields.EN:
Despite her looks, she seems to be
a nice person.
fields.JP: 見た目と違って、案外いい人そうですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite her looks, she seems to be
a nice person.

fields.JP: オォォォォォォオォォ……

fields.EN:
(We beat the Nightmare, but this
all feels too weird...)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアは倒せたけど……
　なんだろう、この釈然としない感覚……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We beat the Nightmare, but this
all feels too weird...)

fields.JP: これで、一件落着ですね

fields.EN:
Well, it seems we went in pretty
far chasing after it...
fields.JP:
それより……ずいぶん奥まで来てしまい
ましたわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems we went in pretty
far chasing after it...

fields.EN:
It's going to be a pain, heading
back...
fields.JP: 戻るのが大変そうです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's going to be a pain, heading
back...

fields.EN:
Yeah... We did go up and down and
all over.
fields.JP:
……あー。降りたり昇ったり、ずいぶん
走らされたからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We did go up and down and
all over.

fields.EN:
It doesn't look like we're
underground now, but... Where are
we, exactly?
fields.JP:
さすがに地下じゃなさそうだし、
どの辺なんだろ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't look like we're
underground now, but... Where are
we, exactly?

fields.EN:
Maybe we can get to a different
area if we just punch a hole
someplace.
fields.JP:
その辺をブチ抜いたら、
どこかのエリアに出られるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can get to a different
area if we just punch a hole
someplace.

fields.EN:
Well, if that's what you want,
then...
fields.JP: そういうことなら、ワレが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if that's what you want,
then...

fields.EN:
H-Hold on there! If you do that,
there's no telling whether this
place is going to cave in.
fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっと待ってよ！
そんなことしたら、あちこち崩れたりする
かもしれないし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hold on there! If you do that,
there's no telling whether this
place is going to cave in.

fields.JP: グレーテル、どうしたの？

fields.EN:
There were a few things different
here from other areas.
fields.JP:
このエリアには……他と違う点がいくつか
あったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There were a few things different
here from other areas.

fields.JP: まず、ここだけ地下にありますね～

fields.EN:
The wailing from the Jail was
different when we destroyed the
core earlier, too.
fields.JP:
それに、核を壊した時のジェイルの鳴き声が、
いつもと違いましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The wailing from the Jail was
different when we destroyed the
core earlier, too.

fields.EN:
Not to mention, the Nightmare ran
from us during battle.
fields.JP: ナイトメアは、戦ってる途中に逃げ出したしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention, the Nightmare ran
from us during battle.

fields.EN: Yes, it looks like a window.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, it looks like a window.

fields.EN:
There's rubble all over the place,
but I guess this is inside some
sort of structure.
fields.JP:
瓦礫で埋まってますけど。
ここって建物の中だったんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's rubble all over the place,
but I guess this is inside some
sort of structure.

fields.JP: そうすると……ますますどの辺なんだろ？

fields.EN:
Maybe we can see outside if we
move this steel plate...
fields.JP:
この鉄の板をどかせば……
こっちから外が見えるかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can see outside if we
move this steel plate...

fields.EN:
Yup. Everyone, come and lend a
hand.
fields.JP: うん。みんなでどかそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Everyone, come and lend a
hand.

fields.EN: That sky... Is that a white moon...?
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sky... I haven't seen that
kind of color coming from the sky
before...

fields.EN:
That's... the Jail Tower, isn't
it?
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's... the Jail Tower, isn't
it?

fields.EN:
Yes. And... it looks like
the two towers are connected.
fields.JP:
ええ。
しかも……二本繋がっているように見えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It looks like the place is
connected to it.

fields.JP: これって……なんなんですか……

fields.EN:
This place is starting to creep
me out...
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is starting to creep
me out...

fields.JP: うう……なんだかここ、こわいよ

fields.EN:
Connected to the Tower...? So
is this what happens when it
grows?
fields.JP:
塔が繋がってるなんて……ジェイルが育つと
ああなるんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Connected to the Tower...? So
is this what happens when it
grows?

fields.EN:
Jack! There's something written on
the steel plate we just moved!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　さっきどかした鉄板……
何か文字が書いてあるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! There's something written on
the steel plate we just moved!

fields.EN:
It's all rusty and falling apart,
but it's a train station sign.
fields.JP:
これって、駅の標識なんだよ！
錆び付いてボロボロになってるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's all rusty and falling apart,
but it's a train station sign.

fields.EN:
At least the larger words are
still legible... Let me see...
fields.JP:
大きな文字なら……
どうにか読めそうだわ……ええと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least the larger words are
still legible... Let me see...

fields.EN:
Could it be that we're... Actually
outside of the Jail?
fields.JP:
もしかして、ここは……
私たちのジェイルの……外……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could it be that we're... Actually
outside of the Jail?

fields.EN:
Yeah... This atmosphere feels more
like we're inside the Jail than outside it...
fields.JP:
そうよ……この雰囲気、
ジェイルの外というよりは
中の方が近い気がするんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't feel like we're outside
at all... It almost feels like we
moved into another Jail...

fields.EN:
This is supposed to be what
the outside of the Jail is like?
fields.JP:
これがジェイルの外だって言うなら、
こんなのってないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is supposed to be what
the outside of the Jail is like?

fields.EN:
All I see here is a world without
any hope...
fields.JP:
この不気味な光景はどう見ても
希望に満ちてなんかいない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I see here is a world without
any hope...

fields.EN:
It's too early to give up hope.
We still don't know what that
place is yet.
fields.JP:
希望を手放すにはまだ早いよ。
あれが何なのか、僕たちはまだ何も知らない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's too early to give up hope.
We still don't know what that
place is yet.

fields.EN:
True. We would need to examine
the place to determine that
tower's true identity.
fields.JP:
そうね。調べてみないことには、
あの塔が監獄塔なのかどうかも……
分かりはしないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. We would need to examine
the place to determine that
tower's true identity.

fields.JP: 確かに、それはそうですけれど……

fields.EN:
I can only hope searching that
place won't make us worse
that how we are now...
fields.JP:
調べた結果、余計につらい現実を
突きつけられそうな気もするけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope searching that
place won't make us worse
that how we are now...

fields.EN:
I wish we could block the road that leads
here and pretend we never saw any of this...
fields.JP:
ここに通じている道を塞いで、
見なかったことにしたいですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A certain part of me wants to
turn the blind eye to what we
saw...

fields.EN:
I understand that feeling, but
then again, we need to know
what that really is...
fields.JP:
でも……気持ちは分かりますが、
それでは何の解決にもなりませんよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand that feeling, but
then again, we need to know
what that really is...

fields.EN:
Jack's right. We have to first
search the place before we come
to any conclusions.
fields.JP:
ジャックの言うとおり、
調べてみないことには何も始まらないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's right. We have to first
search the place before we come
to any conclusions.

fields.EN:
...Yeah, you're right. We've come
this far; turning back isn't an option.
fields.JP:
……うん、そうだね。ここまで来たんだし、
引き返すって選択肢はないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, and we made it this far.
No way am I going back empty
handed.

fields.EN:
We shall find out soon enough
what that place holds.
fields.JP: 行ってみればすぐに分かる話だぞ、貴様ら
fields.LOCALIZED:
We shall find out soon enough
what that place holds.

fields.EN:
I can only hope we do find out
something good...
fields.JP: 少しでもいい結果が出るといいですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope we do find out
something good...

fields.EN: That's what we call having hope.
fields.JP: きっと希望に繋がるって、そう思おうよ
fields.LOCALIZED: That's what we call having hope.

fields.EN:
(Why is that place so familiar...?
What is going on?)
fields.JP:
（なんだろうこの既視感……？
　不思議な感覚がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is that place so familiar...?
What is going on?)

fields.JP: じゃあみんな、行こうか
この場所はいったい何……？

fields.EN:
The tower is really different than
the tower we know...
fields.JP:
わたしたちの知っている監獄塔とは
随分と雰囲気が違うわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The tower is really different than
the tower we know...

fields.EN: No telling what we'll find here...
fields.JP:
いったい何が出るか
分かったもんじゃないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: No telling what we'll find here...

fields.EN:
We may even encounter Marchens
we've never met before.
fields.JP:
そうだね。見たこともない
メルヒェンがいるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may even encounter Marchens
we've never met before.

fields.EN:
Just make sure you all have
your guard up, you hear?
fields.JP:
みんな、何が出るか
分からないから油断しないでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just make sure you all have
your guard up, you hear?

fields.EN:
Why yes, we should approach this
place very carefully.
fields.JP: ええ。慎重に慎重を重ねて進まないとですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, we should approach this
place very carefully.

fields.JP: みんなはなれちゃだめだよ！

fields.EN:
I shall crush anything that stands
in our way.
fields.JP: 何が出ようとワレが殲滅してやるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shall crush anything that stands
in our way.

fields.EN:
I can only hope we won't need to
resort to violence here...
fields.JP:
戦わないで済むなら
それに越したことはないんだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope we won't need to
resort to violence here...

fields.JP: とにかくみんな、注意して進みましょう

fields.EN:
The future...
may change the past...
fields.JP:
未来が……過去を……
変えるときがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The future...
may change the past...

fields.JP: （今聞いたことがあるような声が……）

fields.EN:
I was not made... to lie...
I was not made... to lie...
fields.JP:
私は……ウソをつけれるように……
作られてません、私は……
ウソをつけれるように……作られてません
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was not made... to lie...
I was not made... to lie...

fields.EN:
I wonder if there are more
towers like these elsewhere.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、こんな風に
様々な場所に監獄塔があるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if there are more
towers like these elsewhere.

fields.EN:
If there's more than one,
then there's likely to be more
somewhere out there.
fields.JP:
２つめが見つかった以上、
可能性としては大いにあり得るわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there's more than one,
then there's likely to be more
somewhere out there.

fields.EN:
So, what the heck is
happening around the world?
fields.JP:
だとしたら……
世界はどうなってるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what the heck is
happening around the world?

fields.EN:
Maybe there is no "world"
on the surface any more...
fields.JP:
もしかしたら地上なんて……
もう存在しないんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe there is no "world"
on the surface any more...

fields.EN:
H-Hey, stop it!
We can't just give up!
fields.JP:
だ、駄目っ！
希望をしっかり持たないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, stop it!
We can't just give up!

fields.EN:
It's still worth considering
as a possibility.
fields.JP: でも考察はするべきよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's still worth considering
as a possibility.

fields.JP: ねえ……ジャックはどう思う？

fields.EN:
After it!
Jack, back us up!
fields.JP:
追うわよみんな！
ジャックは援護お願いっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
After it!
Jack, back us up!

fields.EN:
It's trying to run!
Surround it!
fields.JP:
そっち行ったよ！
囲むんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's trying to run!
Surround it!

fields.EN: Very well, I shall intercept it!
fields.JP: それならわたしが先回りいたしますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well, I shall intercept it!

fields.JP:
……ぐご……づがまる……
がご……わげには……

なっ！？
予想外に小回りが効きますわね！

fields.EN:
Cinderella! Just block its path!
Don't get ahead of yourself!
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、進路を塞ぐだけでいい！
あまり１人で先行しないで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella! Just block its path!
Don't get ahead of yourself!

fields.EN:
Tch! Dang it, it's fast!
It's already that far ahead of us!
fields.JP:
くっ！
もうあんな先に…！
逃げ足の速いやつ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch! Dang it, it's fast!
It's already that far ahead of us!

fields.JP: お前はさっきのナイトメア……っ！

fields.EN:
Everyone! Over here!
I found the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
みんな、こっちだよっ！　
ナイトメアを見つけたっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! Over here!
I found the Nightmare!

fields.JP: あっ！　このっ！　逃げるなっ！！

fields.EN:
(That Nightmare...
doesn't want to fight us...?)
fields.JP:
（このナイトメア……もしかしたら、
　僕らと争う気はないんじゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That Nightmare...
doesn't want to fight us...?)

fields.JP:
白雪、ネム！
回り込んで退路を塞ぐのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White! Sleepy!
Block it's path!

fields.EN:
Did you think you could get away
from me?
fields.JP: ワレから逃げられるとでも思ったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you think you could get away
from me?

fields.EN:
Begging for its life...?
What is that Nightmare plotting?
fields.JP:
命乞い……？
ナイトメアが何を企んでるんだか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, acting all weak to frame
us, eh? What a farce.

fields.EN:
(No... That Nightmare is
sincerely asking for mercy...)
fields.JP:
（いや、このナイトメア……
　本気で命乞いをしているんじゃ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... That Nightmare is
sincerely asking for mercy...)

fields.JP: 問答無用！　覚悟するのだっ！
待ちなさいハーメルン

fields.EN:
What is it?
I was getting to the good part.
fields.JP:
なんなのだグレーテル。
今がいいところなのではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it?
I was getting to the good part.

fields.EN:
That's what I wanted to stop.
Something is not quite right
with this Nightmare.
fields.JP:
だからそれを止めなさいと言っているの。
このナイトメア、明らかに様子がおかしいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I wanted to stop.
Something is not quite right
with this Nightmare.

fields.EN: I feel the same way, too.
fields.LOCALIZED: I feel the same way, too.

fields.EN:
Well, sure it runs a lot and
is acting like it wants us to
spare it, but...
fields.JP:
逃げ出したり命乞いしたり、
確かに他のナイトメアとは違うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, sure it runs a lot and
is acting like it wants us to
spare it, but...

fields.EN:
No telling if that's a trap,
right?
fields.JP:
でもそれが罠じゃないとは
言い切れないでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No telling if that's a trap,
right?

fields.EN:
If it can communicate, then it
could be possible it lured us
all the way here.
fields.JP:
話すだけの知能があるなら、
地下洞窟からここまで誘い出した、
なんてこともあるかもですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it can communicate, then it
could be possible it lured us
all the way here.

fields.EN:
But it looks scared...
Why don't we give it a chance?
fields.JP:
でも……すごく怯えてるように見えるよ。
ちょっとだけでも話を聞いてみない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it looks scared...
Why don't we give it a chance?

fields.JP: 私もこのナイトメアに興味があるわ

fields.EN:
If we're going to kill it, we can
wait until after we've heard it out, can't we?
fields.JP:
だから殺すなら、話を聞いてからでも
遅くはないと思うのだけれど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can finish it after we try to
communicate with it.

fields.EN: Hmph... This is a waste of time.
fields.JP: うぬぅ……まどろっこしいな
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph... This is a waste of time.

fields.EN:
Oh, but the moment I see it do
something funny, it's gonna
get it.
fields.JP: けど怪しいそぶりを見せたらすぐに殺すよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but the moment I see it do
something funny, it's gonna
get it.

fields.EN:
I'll keep my guard up just in
case, too.
fields.JP: いつでも対処できるように身構えておくわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll keep my guard up just in
case, too.
Thanks for giving it a chance.

fields.EN: Say, why are you so scared...?
fields.JP: ……ねえ、君は何にそんなに怯えているの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Say, why are you so scared...?

fields.JP:
わだ……じぎちち…………
だだがうの……ぎらい…………

そっぢ……おぞってぐるがら……
わだじ……んぎぃ……にげだ……

fields.EN:
So you're saying you wouldn't
do anything if we don't fight you?
fields.JP:
わたしたちが襲わなければ
何もしなかったっていうんですの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're saying you wouldn't
do anything if we don't fight you?

fields.EN:
I've never seen such a cowardly
Nightmare before.
fields.JP:
こんなに臆病な
ナイトメアなんて初めて見たわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen such a cowardly
Nightmare before.

fields.EN:
Mmhe... Lhn...g... aagho...
hhe...re... Ggh...
Wha...ndur... thhe...re...
fields.JP:
……わだじ……ずっどまえ……
ごごがら…………そっぢに……
ぎ……ぎぎ……まよいごんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmhe... Lhn...g... aagho...
hhe...re... Ggh...
Wha...ndur... thhe...re...

fields.EN:
So it isn't a Nightmare from that
underground cavern then.
fields.JP:
あの地下洞窟のナイトメアって
わけじゃなかったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it isn't a Nightmare from that
underground cavern then.

fields.EN:
Well, I wouldn't be surprised that
it got lost there with how
expansive that place is...
fields.JP:
