確かにあの地下洞窟はあまりにも
広大でしたからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I wouldn't be surprised that
it got lost there with how
expansive that place is...

fields.EN:
Bhe...frre... lhho...stt... mhe...
ahtk...ed... bai... Marrsh...en...
sayv... Lhitt..le... Meer...mad...
fields.JP:
ぎちち……どうぐづでまようまえ……
わだじ……メルヒェンに……おぞわれだ……
……にんぎょびめ……だずげでぐでだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bhe...frre... lhho...stt... mhe...
ahtk...ed... bai... Marrsh...en...
sayv... Lhitt..le... Meer...mad...

fields.JP: ああいや、何でもないよ……

fields.EN:
Shh...e... saahv...d... mhe...
Bht... sooo... sch...rd...
fields.JP:
だずげで……ぐでだのに……
わだじ……ごわぐで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shh...e... saahv...d... mhe...
Bht... sooo... sch...rd...

fields.JP:
でも……んぎぎ……にんぎょびめ……
やざじく……じでぐれで………

ぞれがら……ずごじずつ……ぎぎ……
……ながよぐ……なっで…………

fields.EN:
This Ningyohime must have
been a very kind person.
fields.JP:
にんぎょひめって子は
とっても優しい人だったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This Little Mermaid must have
been a very kind person.

fields.EN:
Yh...ss... Bht... I... ddhnt...
sahe... th...nkks... Ggh...
Shhee... naw... gh...ne....
fields.JP:
うん……で……でも……
いっがいも……おれい……いえないまま……
ぎぎぎ……いなぐなっぢゃっだ……がら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yh...ss... Bht... I... ddhnt...
sahe... th...nkks... Ggh...
Shhee... naw... gh...ne....

fields.EN:
Ggh... Ssoh... I... whant...
seee... hher... agh...nn...
ssahee... tha....kksss...
fields.JP:
みちち……だがら……
も……いぢど……あっで……
おれい……いいだい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ggh... Ssoh... I... whant...
seee... hher... agh...nn...
ssahee... tha....kksss...

fields.JP:
ねえ……んぎぃぃ……
にんぎょびめ……どご……？

fields.EN:
Mmm... Not that I know who that
person is, so I don't know where
that person may have gone.
fields.JP:
うーん……どこって言われてもなぁ……
僕たちの知らない人だし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Not that I know who that
person is, so I don't know where
that person may have gone.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure how long you meant
by "long ago," too.
fields.JP:
ずっと前というのが
いつなのかも分からないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure how long you meant
by "long ago," too.

fields.JP:
…………人魚姫は……
あたしが……殺しちゃった……

fields.EN:
I met her in the Solitary Confinement area
back when I'd only just
become a Blood Maiden...
fields.JP:
あたしがまだ血式少女になりたての頃、
独房エリアで出会ったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid is a girl I met
long ago back when I just
became a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
I found her in one of the areas.
I wanted to protect her, but she
entered Blood Skelter, and...
fields.JP:
保護するはずだったけど、あの子
ブラッドスケルター化しちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found her in one of the areas.
I wanted to protect her, but she
entered Blood Skelter, and...

fields.EN:
If she had entered Blood Skelter, you couldn't
have held back. Don't blame yourself too much.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化して
しまったのなら、手加減なんてできないわ。
あまり自分を責めちゃ駄目よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she was in Blood Skelter, then
the bigger worry is protecting
yourself.

fields.EN:
But now someone has appeared who is
searching for her. I need to explain
what happened properly and apologize...
fields.JP:
でもこうして、あの子を求める者が現れた。
ならちゃんと説明と謝罪、しないとね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to come out clean now that
someone looking for her
is in front of me...

fields.EN:
I couldn't protect her. I killed
Ningyohime. I'm...
I'm sorry...
fields.JP:
身を守るためとはいえ、
人魚姫はあたしが殺してしまった。
それについては……謝罪するよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't protect her. I killed
Little Mermaid. I'm...
I'm sorry...

fields.JP:
ごろじ……だ……？
ぎちちち……ごろじ……？
人魚姫はもうこの世にいないのよ

んぎぃぃ……ぎぎぎ……
にんぎょびめ…………どご……！

あわぜで……にんぎょびめ……
わだじ……あいだい……！！

fields.EN:
I understand how you feel...
But... there's nothing we can do.
fields.JP:
悲しい気持ちは分かるよ……
でも僕たちにも、どうにもできないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand how you feel...
But... there's nothing we can do.

fields.JP:
んぎぃぃぃぃぃ…………！
ぎぎぎ……ぎぎ……！！

fields.EN:
I can only assume it wasn't able
to accept Ningyohime's death.
fields.JP:
おそらく人魚姫が死んだということを
受け止めきれなかったんでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only assume it wasn't able
to accept Little Mermaid's death.

fields.JP:
（ん……あのナイトメア、
　何か落としてった……？）

（ん？
　スイッチがいくつか付いてる……）
どうするの？　おいかけるの？

fields.EN:
It doesn't seem hostile,
so I think we can leave it alone.
fields.JP:
害はなさそうだし、
無理に追いかける必要はないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't seem hostile,
so I think we can leave it alone.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I'd rather not chase it
already...
fields.JP:
うん……これ以上追い詰めるのは
あたしは正直、したくないかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I'd rather not chase it
already...

fields.EN:
(Why was that Nightmare holding
onto this?)
fields.JP:
（あのナイトメアはどうして
　こんなものを大事そうに
　持っていたんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why was that Nightmare holding
onto this?)

fields.EN:
(This switch... No...
How about this one...?)
fields.JP:
（このスイッチは……駄目か。
　じゃあこっちならどうかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This switch... No...
How about this one...?)

fields.JP: とってもすてきだったわ

fields.EN:
I can't find the right words for
it, but your song had a touch of
sadness to it...
fields.JP:
上手く言えないけど、
なんだかすごく切ない歌……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't find the right words for
it, but your song had a touch of
sadness to it...

fields.JP:
ぎぎ……いまの……
……うだ……もっど……ぎぎだい……

fields.EN:
Heh, looks like Jack liked
your singing, too.
fields.JP:
はは、ジャックも
とても気に入ったみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, looks like Jack liked
your singing, too.

fields.EN:
(I know this voice...
I know what this is about...?)
fields.JP:
（僕はこの声を――
　場面を知っている――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know this voice...
I know what this is about...?)

fields.EN:
(My memory...!
Someone's memory is flooding
into me...!)
fields.JP:
（なんだこの記憶は……！
　知らない記憶が僕の頭に大量に
　流れ込んでくる……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My memory...!
Someone's memory is flooding
into me...!)

fields.EN: Get a hold of yourself, Jack!
fields.JP: しっかりして、ジャック！
fields.LOCALIZED: Get a hold of yourself, Jack!

fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
大……丈夫だよ……
（やっと痛みが落ちついてきた……）

fields.EN:
(I get it now...
This memory isn't from someone...
It's my memory...)
fields.JP:
（そして全部理解した……
　この知らないと思った記憶は……
　僕自身のものだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I get it now...
This memory isn't from someone...
It's my memory...)

fields.EN:
(How could I have forgotten? No,
it can't be helped... This is my
memory from the previous world...)
fields.JP:
（どうして僕は忘れていた……？
　いや、仕方ない。だってこれは
　『前の』世界の記憶だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How could I have forgotten? No,
it can't be helped... This is my
memory from the previous world...)

fields.EN:
(Wait...! Which means what I'm
experiencing here is...!)
fields.JP:
（はっ……！　ということは、
　今直面してるこの場面はつうの――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait...! Which means what I'm
experiencing here is...!)

fields.EN:
Jack? Do you know the people
who were recorded in the
microphone?
fields.JP:
ジャックはマイクから聞こえた
女の子たちを知っているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Do you know the people
who were recorded in the
microphone?

fields.EN:
Yes, every one of them...
I was there, too...
fields.JP:
うん……知ってる。
なんせ僕はその場にいたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, every one of them...
I was there, too...

fields.EN:
Let's go after Tsuu...
No, that Nightmare!
fields.JP:
ねえみんな、
つう……あのナイトメアを追おう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go after Otsuu...
No, that Nightmare!

fields.EN:
What are you...?
Hey! Wait up!
fields.JP:
ジャック、何をいきなり……
ってちょっと待ちなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you...?
Hey! Wait up!

fields.EN:
We can't let him go alone!
Let's go after him!
fields.JP:
ジャック１人じゃ危険だわ。
わたしたちも行きましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't let him go alone!
Let's go after him!

fields.JP: 待って！　話を聞いてほしいんだ！

ぎち……にんぎょびめ……
じんだ……なら……
いぎがえらぜる……ぎちち……

fields.EN:
I know...! I know what you're
planning on doing!
fields.JP:
分かるよ……！
君が今、何をしようとしているのか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know...! I know what you're
planning on doing!

fields.EN:
(That's right...
This place is "that" Jail Tower.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……この都庁は
　間違いなくこのジェイルの監獄塔だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right...
This place is "that" Jail Tower.)

fields.EN:
(Nightmare... Tsuu knows that
the white core can make her wish
a reality...)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメア……つうは『白い核』が
　願いを叶えてくれると知っている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Nightmare... Otsuu knows that
the white core can make her wish
a reality...)

fields.EN:
(That white core... No...
I should call it what Tsuu
called it as... "Witchcraft.")
fields.JP:
（いや……つうの
　呼び方なら『白い核』じゃなくて
　『ウィッチクラフト』か……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That white core... No...
I should call it what Otsuu
called it as... "Witchcraft.")

fields.EN:
(Yes... Tsuu used the Metropolitan Office
Jail's 'Witchcraft' to reincarnate as a Blood
Maiden in the Aquarium of ten years ago...)
fields.JP:
（そう、つうはこの都庁ジェイルの
　『ウィッチクラフト』で、血式少女として
　１０年前の水族館に転生し……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Otsuu used it to reincarnate
and send her back 10 years in
time to the Aquarium Ruins...)

fields.EN:
(All so that she could save
Ningyohime-san...)
fields.JP: （人魚姫さんを助けようとするんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All so that she could save
Little Mermaid...)

fields.JP: ジャック！　近づきすぎだってば……！

fields.EN:
It's me... Jack...
Do you remember me?
fields.JP:
ほら、思い出してよ……
僕だよ、ジャックだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's me... Jack...
Do you remember me?

fields.EN:
I'm human now, but I'm Jack,
the Nightmare who spent
all that time with Tsuu!
fields.JP:
今は人間だけど、
僕はつうとずっと一緒に過ごした
ナイトメアのジャックだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a human now, but I was that
Nightmare you spent all that
time with before!

fields.JP:
ジャックさん……？
いったい何の会話を……？

一緒に過ごしてた……？
ナイトメア……？
意味不明ですよ、ジャックさん……

fields.EN:
What can I do to make her
remember me...?
fields.JP:
どうしよう……どうしたら
思い出してくれるのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What can I do to make her
remember me...?

fields.JP:
じゃっぐ……？
ちぎぃ……じらない……ぎぎぎ……

ぎぎ…………どにがぐ……
じゃま……じないで…………

fields.EN:
No matter what, we can't
let the 'Witchcraft' be born!
fields.JP:
ともかく『ウィッチクラフト』を
誕生させては駄目だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just please! Don't bring the
Witchcraft here!

fields.EN:
There may be another way to
bring Ningyohime-san back!
Listen to me!
fields.JP:
人魚姫さんは別の方法で蘇るかもしれない、
だから僕の話を聞いてくれ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There may be another way to
bring Little Mermaid back!
Listen to me!

fields.JP:
ぎぎぎ……ど……どうじで……
ぞのごどを……じっでるの……？

fields.EN: I told you... I was with you...
fields.JP:
言っただろ？　僕は君と一緒に
過ごしていたって……
fields.LOCALIZED: I told you... I was with you...

fields.EN:
I saw the same dream you
saw back then!
fields.JP:
あの時の君の夢は、
僕にも見えていたんだよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I saw the same dream you
saw back then!

fields.EN:
Bha...k... thee...n...?
Ggh... Ah...ee... dh...nt...
knh...oww...
fields.JP:
あのどぎ……？
ぎぎぎ……じらない…………
わだじ……ぞんなのじらない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bha...k... thee...n...?
Ggh... Ah...ee... dh...nt...
knh...oww...

fields.JP:
わ……わだじを……だまぞうど……
……じでるな…………ぎぃぎぎ……

fields.EN:
No! I'm not trying to trick you!
I'm trying to help you and
Ningyohime-san, so please...!
fields.JP:
違うよ！　騙そうとなんてしていない！
君と人魚姫さんのためなんだ！
だから話を――
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! I'm not trying to trick you!
I'm trying to help you and Little
Mermaid, so please...!

fields.JP: ぎぃぃぃぃっ！　じゃまっ！　ずるなっ！！
危ないから下がって、ジャック！！
ジャック、冷静になりなさい

fields.EN:
Jack, I don't really understand what you
know. But right now, this isn't a situation
where you can make her listen to it.
fields.JP:
あなたが何を知っているのか、
私にはよく分からない。でも今は
それを聞かせる状況ではないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what you're talking
about, but what I do know is
that it won't listen to you.

fields.EN:
Yeah, and it looks like it's
getting ready to come at us now...
fields.JP:
そうね。あのナイトメア……
どうやらこっちを敵とみなしたようだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and it looks like it's
getting ready to come at us now...

fields.JP: ぎぃぃぃぃぃっ！！　どっがいげ！！

fields.EN:
If we had to fight it, we
should've finished it off earlier!
fields.JP:
結局戦う羽目になるなら、
初めに倒しておけばよかったのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we had to fight it, we
should've finished it off earlier!

fields.JP: みんな、ハーメルンの援護をするよ！
もう話を聞くどころじゃないでしょ！

fields.EN:
Jack, I don't know what's going
on, but if it is attacking,
we need to defend ourselves.
fields.JP:
ジャック、わたしは事情をよく知らない。
でも襲ってくるのなら、対処するしかないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, I don't know what's going
on, but if it is attacking,
we need to defend ourselves.

fields.JP:
みんな！　とにかくこのナイトメアを
おとなしくさせるよ！！

fields.EN:
All right! We've got the
upper hand!
fields.JP: よし、だいぶ押してるわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! We've got the
upper hand!

fields.EN: We should be able to win this!
fields.JP: このままいければ勝てそうですわね……！
fields.LOCALIZED: We should be able to win this!

fields.EN:
Wait up!
It isn't evil or anything!
fields.JP:
待ってよみんな！
あのナイトメアは悪い奴じゃないんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait up!
It isn't evil or anything!

fields.EN:
Please! We need to find a way
besides fighting!
fields.JP:
だからどうにかして
戦わない方法を見つけようよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please! We need to find a way
besides fighting!

fields.JP:
ぎぃぃ……わだじ……
……じゃま……ずるな……
ぎちち……ぎちぃぃぃぃぃぃぃぃっ！！

fields.EN:
Not like we have an option, Jack!
We need to fight!
fields.JP:
向こうはまだやる気だよジャック！
ならこっちもやるしかない！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not like we have an option, Jack!
We need to fight!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Jack.
This was the only way.
fields.JP:
すまぬな、ジャック。
だがこれ以外に道はなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Jack.
This was the only way.

fields.JP: ちょっと待って。何かおかしいわ

fields.EN:
It is falling apart, but it
doesn't look like it will
disappear like the others...
fields.JP:
確かに、壊れていってますけど、
消滅する様子がないですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is falling apart, but it
doesn't look like it will
disappear like the others...

fields.EN:
Did we only destroy a part of it,
and not it's actual body?
fields.JP:
まさか本体だと思った部分も
違っていたんですの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did we only destroy a part of it,
and not it's actual body?

fields.EN:
I see... So the body is actually
inside the part we just destroyed.
fields.JP:
なるほど、本体は
今破壊した部分の中ということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So the body is actually
inside the part we just destroyed.

fields.EN: Something's coming out from inside it...!
fields.LOCALIZED: It's going to come at us...!

fields.EN:
It's...
talking like the rest of us...
fields.JP: 言葉が……はっきりと人間と同じに……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's...
talking like the rest of us...

fields.JP:
それに見た目も随分と人間に
近くなりましたね……！

fields.EN: Humans... Don't get in my way!
fields.JP: にんげん……じゃまを……するな……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Humans... Don't get in my way!

fields.EN: Is it still going to fight?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Is it still going to fight?!

fields.EN:
Sure seems that way...
Quite a formidable one, indeed.
fields.JP:
そのようだな。
敵ながらその心意気は褒めてやろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure seems that way...
Quite a formidable one, indeed.

fields.EN:
Everyone! That's got to be the
Nightmare's true form!
Let's do this!
fields.JP:
みんな！　きっと
今度こそ本体だから、一気に叩くよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! That's got to be the
Nightmare's true form!
Let's do this!

fields.JP: もう止めようよ、みんな……！

fields.EN:
(It's no use...!
My words aren't reaching them!)
fields.JP:
（駄目だ……言葉だけじゃ
　止められない……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's no use...!
My words aren't reaching them!)

fields.EN:
(Tch...! If only Tsuu regains her
memory...)
fields.JP:
（くっ……つうが記憶を取り戻せば、
　戦う必要なんてないんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Tch...! If only Otsuu regains her
memory...)

fields.EN:
(There has to be something that
will trigger her memory...
But what?!)
fields.JP:
（何か……つうの記憶を
　呼び覚ます取っ掛かりになるような……
　どうすればいいんだ……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There has to be something that
will trigger her memory...
But what?!)

fields.JP: うっ、ああああああああっ……！
（やった、効果があったみたいだ……！）
つう、僕だよ！　ジャックだよ！！

fields.EN:
Wait... So Jack really knows it...
no... her?!
fields.JP: まさか本当に知り合いだったの……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... So Jack really knows it...
no... her?!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... Even if I didn't
remember, I still attacked everyone...
fields.JP:
ごめん……覚えてないとはいえ、
みんなに襲いかかったりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... I don't have any
excuse for attacking everyone...

fields.EN:
It can't be helped.
You were a Nightmare in this world
all this time.
fields.JP:
仕方ないよ、つう。
だってこの世界ではつうはまだ、
ナイトメアだったんだからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped.
You were a Nightmare in this world
all this time.

fields.EN:
Jack... Thank you for bringing my
memories back...
fields.JP:
ジャック……僕の記憶を
呼び覚ましてくれてありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Thank you for bringing my
memories back...

fields.JP:
ハッ……！？
僕……ナイトメア……！？

fields.EN:
Ningyohime-san...
She doesn't exist in this world anymore...
fields.JP:
人魚姫さんは
この世界ではもう……いないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She...
She doesn't exist in this world...

fields.EN:
I see... So this is the world after Princess
and I spent time together with everyone...
fields.JP:
そうか……ここは僕と姫が
みんなと一緒に過ごした後の世界……か
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... This world is the future
of the other world where I spent
my time with Princess...

fields.EN: Yes... Which is why I'm human.
fields.JP: うん……だから僕は人間の姿だしね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... Which is why I'm human.

fields.EN:
Um, Jack? We would appreciate it
if you would explain to us what
is happening here...
fields.JP:
ね、ねえジャック……
そろそろわたしたちにも何なのか
説明してほしいのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Jack? We would appreciate it
if you would explain to us what
is happening here...

fields.EN:
Yeah...
You're making my head spin...
fields.JP:
そうだよ……何が何だかさっぱり
分からないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah...
You're making my head spin...

fields.EN:
Indeed. With what happened,
I believe you're responsible
of telling us what is happening.
fields.JP: ええ。説明責任を果たしてほしいところね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. With what happened,
I believe you're responsible
of telling us what is happening.

fields.EN:
I'll explain later, but for now,
I need you all to let me handle
this for a bit.
fields.JP:
後でちゃんと説明するから、
だからもう少しだけ僕に任せてほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll explain later, but for now,
I need you all to let me handle
this for a bit.

fields.EN:
Tsuu, you jumped into the white
core... the Witchcraft yourself
and reincarnated once, right?
fields.JP:
ねえ、つう。
つうは『白い核』……『ウィッチクラフト』に
自ら飛び込んで、１度転生したんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? You reincarnated once
by sacrificing yourself to the
Witchcraft, right?

fields.EN:
What happened at the very end?
I wasn't with you then, so please
tell me what happened.
fields.JP:
なら……その結末は覚えてる？
最後の最後、僕は一緒にいなかったから
分からないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What happened at the very end?
I wasn't with you then, so please
tell me what happened.

fields.EN:
But if you can remember the previous
world now... I wondered if that meant
you came back to this world once again...
fields.JP:
でもこうして前の世界の記憶を今
持てるということは……もう１度
この世界に戻したってことなのかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remembering the previous
world must mean that you returned
this world to its true form...

fields.EN:
So it's hard to say this, but... I don't think
the world you reached had a happy ending...
fields.JP:
だから言いにくいけど、決して幸せな
世界ではなかったんじゃないかって、
そう思うんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, the world you experienced
may not have been the best, but
I'm sure it was worthwhile...

fields.EN:
I suppose... It was far from
a happy ending, though...
fields.JP: そうだね……幸せな終わりではなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose... It was far from
a happy ending, though...

fields.JP: やっぱりそうなんだね……

fields.EN:
But now that you're here,
don't sacrifice yourself to the
Witchcraft any more.
fields.JP:
じゃあつう、
もう『ウィッチクラフト』に飛びこんじゃ駄目だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now that you're here,
don't sacrifice yourself to the
Witchcraft any more.

fields.EN:
But without that, I can't get to
the world where Princess is
still alive...
fields.JP:
でも、それだと姫が
生きている世界に辿り着けないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But without that, I can't get to
the world where Princess is
still alive...

fields.EN:
About that... There may be a way
to bring Ningyohime-san back to
life.
fields.JP:
それなんだけど……もしかしたら
人魚姫さんを生き返らせることが
できるかもしれないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
About that... There may be a way
to bring Little Mermaid back to
life.

fields.JP:
そ、それは本当なのか！？
ジャック！！

fields.EN:
Yeah, we saw Mamoru come back to
life in this world.
fields.JP:
うん。僕たちはこの世界でマモルたちが
蘇ったのを見たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we saw Mamoru come back to
life in this world.

fields.EN:
Wait... Mamoru and the others
were dead in this world?
fields.JP:
こっちではマモルたちは
死んでいたの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Mamoru and the others
were dead in this world?

fields.EN:
That's right. But they came back
to life with the Jail's core.
fields.JP:
そうなんだ。でもジェイルの核のおかげで
生き返らせられたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. But they came back
to life with the Jail's core.

fields.EN: There's a core here too, right?
fields.JP: この都庁のジェイルにも核はあるんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: There's a core here too, right?

fields.EN:
Then maybe, with Ningyohime-san's body
and this mic that still holds Ningyohime-san's
strong feelings...
fields.JP:
ならさ、人魚姫さんの遺体と、
人魚姫さんの想いが強く残った
『このマイク』があればもしかしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, we may be able to bring her
back with Little Mermaid's body
and her precious mic...

fields.EN:
You may be right...
I think this could work!
fields.JP:
それなら確かに姫を……
……生き返らせられるかも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be right...
I think this could work!

fields.EN:
But, where is her body?
Didn't she pass away awhile ago?
fields.JP:
ただ……姫の亡骸なんてあるの……？
もうずっと前に死んじゃったんだよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, where is her body?
Didn't she pass away awhile ago?

fields.EN:
I'm not sure, but Ningyohime-san is a
Blood Maiden, so maybe her body was
kept preserved someplace.
fields.JP:
そうだね、そこの確証はない。
でも人魚姫さんは数少ない血式少女だ。
もしかしたら残してくれてるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure, but she is a Blood
Maiden, so maybe her body is
kept preserved someplace.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry that I don't have any
tangible fact over my assumption,
but it's worth the try, right?
fields.JP:
こんな細い糸をたぐるような話でごめんね。
だけど、方法が他にないなら賭けてみても
いいんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry that I don't have any
tangible fact over my assumption,
but it's worth the try, right?

fields.EN:
Yes...
I'll do what I can so long as
there's still hope.
fields.JP:
そう……だね……
少しでも希望があるなら……
僕はそれに賭けたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes...
I'll do what I can so long as
there's still hope.

fields.EN:
Why don't we head back to Dawn
and look for her body?
fields.JP:
じゃあ１度黎明に戻ってさ、
確認しに行こうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we head back to Dawn
and look for her body?

fields.EN:
Oh, and stay with me. That way
I can take care of you in case
something happens.
fields.JP:
その間に暴走しないように、
つうも僕と一緒に来てね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and stay with me. That way
I can take care of you in case
something happens.

fields.EN:
Well now, it looks like our
position has changed.
fields.JP: な……何だか昔と逆になっちゃったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, it looks like our
position has changed.

fields.EN:
Um... My brain is crying for help.
You mind filling us with details?
fields.JP:
あのー……そろそろ本気でワケが
分からないから説明してほしいんだけどー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... My brain is crying for help.
You mind filling us with details?

fields.EN:
I don't blame you for getting
confused with all that's
happening now.
fields.JP:
突然すぎて……
分からないことだらけだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't blame you for getting
confused with all that's
happening now.

fields.JP: そのナイトメアはなかまになったの？
そうだよ、ラプンツェル

fields.EN:
Well, at least I can tell she
doesn't mean any harm...
fields.JP:
まあ……害がないことは
理解しましたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, at least I can tell she
doesn't mean any harm...

fields.EN:
I can't help you two without
proper information, so do you mind
telling me what is going on?
fields.JP:
さすがに私も推測の材料が足りなすぎるわ。
だからしっかりと説明してもらいましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't help you two without
proper information, so do you mind
telling me what is going on?

fields.EN:
Sure, I'll explain what I can
as we head back to Dawn.
fields.JP:
うん、黎明に戻るまでの間に
ちゃんと説明するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, I'll explain what I can
as we head back to Dawn.

fields.EN: You all mind we leave for Dawn?
fields.JP: だからみんな、１度戻らせてほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: You all mind we leave for Dawn?

fields.EN:
This sounds pretty serious, so
I guess we should head back for now.
fields.JP:
結構深刻な話のようだし、
仕方ない、一旦戻ろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems like you've got a
pretty wild agenda in mind, so
we may as well head back.

fields.JP: ジャックがそう言うなら……

fields.EN: Now then, lead the way, Jack.
fields.JP: じゃあジャック……よろしく頼むよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, lead the way, Jack.

fields.EN:
Will do.
We still have hope on our side.
fields.JP: うん。希望は捨てずに行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will do.
We still have hope on our side.

That's all that I can share
right now...

fields.EN:
I was in that other world
separate from ours.
fields.JP:
これが僕の知ってる
もう１つの時間軸の世界だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was in that other world
separate from ours.

fields.EN:
It's a world that was created
by me.
fields.JP: 僕のせいで生み出された……世界だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a world that was created
by me.

fields.EN:
Well now, that was way more than
what I expected. I still don't
understand what I just heard...
fields.JP:
さすがにスケールが大きすぎて……
ちょっとお姉さん理解できないや……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, that was way more than
what I expected. I still don't
understand what I just heard...

fields.EN:
I do think the two of you
probably aren't lying, but...
fields.JP:
２人が嘘を言ってないだろうとは、
まあ……思うのですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you wouldn't lie to us,
but...

fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、
ぜんぜんわからなかった！

fields.EN:
What an interesting story...
I suppose I was the only one who
understood here.
fields.JP:
ワレは理解したが……
あえて多くは語るまい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What an interesting story...
I suppose I was the only one who
understood here.

fields.EN:
You didn't understand a single
bit, did you?
fields.JP: いや、絶対理解してないでしょ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't understand a single
bit, did you?

fields.EN:
I don't understand everything either... but
I can at least understand that a world on
a different timeline definitely existed.
fields.JP:
わたしもすべては理解できないけど……
でも違う時間軸の世界が確かに存在したって
ことだけは理解できるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only thing I know is that
there's some kind of parallel
world out there.

fields.EN:
Yes, and that both of them
retained their memories from
that world.
fields.JP:
そうね。そしてそこの世界の記憶を
再び２人は保持してる……ということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and that both of them
retained their memories from
that world.

fields.EN:
Glad someone sort of understands
what I said.
fields.JP: それだけ分かってくれればありがたいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad someone sort of understands
what I said.

fields.JP: わらわはさっぱりです～

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan? You and Ningyo-chan
know Shirayuki and the others
here, right?
fields.JP:
でもおつうちゃんも、話に出てくる
人魚ちゃんも、白雪たちのことを
知っていますよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? You and Little Mermaid
know Snow White and the others
here, right?

fields.JP: 分かってくれてありがとう、白雪……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and I'm happy you could
deduce that from what little
we shared.

fields.EN:
Well, you said things that would
never be known if you didn't
know us from before.
fields.JP:
だって初対面の人では絶対に
分からないことまで知ってるんですもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you said things that would
never be known if you didn't
know us from before.

fields.EN:
True. Tsuu holds information
that proves her statements.
fields.JP:
確かに信じざるを得ない情報を
つうは持っているわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. Otsuu holds information
that proves her statements.

fields.EN:
But we still don't have enough information
to understand it all. So you'll have to
explain everything again later, all right...?
fields.JP:
でもまだ完全に理解できるだけの
情報をもらってないわ。だからまた
改めて説明してもらうわよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I haven't received all the
details needed to fully understand
the situation.

fields.EN:
Yes. I want to know the details, so
you'll explain everything properly, right?
fields.JP:
ええ、詳細が気になるから
ちゃんと説明してくれるわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, every detail helps, so do you
mind going into the smaller
details now?

fields.EN:
Before I go on...
Jack? Why were you able to
recall your memory?
fields.JP:
それにしてもジャック……
君は何故、思い出せたんだい……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before I go on...
Jack? Why were you able to
recall your memory?

fields.EN: Oh, it's because of this mic.
fields.JP:
ああ、それはつうの
持っていたマイクのおかげなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it's because of this mic.

fields.EN:
That's Princess's mic!
My special treasure!
fields.JP: それは姫のマイク……僕の宝物……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's Princess's mic!
My special treasure!

fields.EN:
You dropped it back where we
met when you ran away.
fields.JP:
つうが都庁のジェイルで
逃げる時に落としていったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You dropped it back where we
met when you ran away.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but when I examined it,
I heard Ningyohime-san's songs and
conversations between the two of you...
fields.JP:
その時に悪いけど調べさせてもらったら、
人魚姫さんの歌や、つうたちの会話が
聞こえてきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but my curiosity got
the best of me. I listened to you
and Little Mermaid's recording.

fields.JP: それで、すべて思い出したんだ

fields.EN:
So I thought that, just like me, if I
showed you something tied to your memories
of that time, it might bring them back...
fields.JP:
だから僕と同じように、つうにも
あの時に関わる思い出の品を見せれば、
きっと思い出すんじゃないかって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I thought I could
bring your memory back, too.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised it was found
in this world...
fields.JP:
そんなものが
こっちの世界にもあるなんてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised it was found
in this world...

fields.EN:
I guess deep down, I didn't want
to get rid of my memories, even
after resetting the world...
fields.JP:
きっと世界をリセットできても、
思い出だけは消したくないって……
心のどこかで願ってたんだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess deep down, I didn't want
to get rid of my memories, even
after resetting the world...

fields.EN:
And because of that, we could
connect like this again.
fields.JP:
そのおかげで僕もつうも、
もう１度こうして繋がることができたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And because of that, we could
connect like this again.

fields.EN:
Yes, but if you killed me back
there, you wouldn't have to go
through all this hassle...
fields.JP:
そうだけど……でも僕のことなんて
思い出さず、あの時に殺してしまえば
こんな面倒にはならなかったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but if you killed me back
there, you wouldn't have to go
through all this hassle...

fields.JP: そんなこと言わないでよ、つう！

fields.EN: You're my partner and my friend.
fields.JP:
つうは大事な仲間……
ううん、相棒なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: You're my partner and my friend.

fields.JP:
君という奴は、いったいどこまで
お人好しなんだい……

fields.EN:
Oh, and I still need to repay you
for what I "owe."
fields.JP:
それに僕、まだつうに
『借り』を返してないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I still need to repay you
for what I "owe."

fields.EN:
Heh...
I haven't heard that
word in awhile.
fields.JP: ははっ……懐かしいフレーズだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh...
I haven't heard that
word in awhile.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's go and search for
Ningyohime-san's body.
fields.JP:
じゃあつう、一緒に
人魚姫さんの遺体を探しに行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's go and search for
Little Mermaid's body.

fields.JP: ジャック……そのことなんだけど

fields.EN:
I know where her body is...
I was there when she was
buried...
fields.JP:
実はあたし……知ってるんだ。
埋葬した時にその場にいたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know where her body is...
I was there when she was
buried...

fields.JP: ど、どこなんだ赤ずきん！

fields.EN:
I still don't get what you two are
planning, but I can at least tell
you're both serious.
fields.JP:
正直、あたしには何が何だか
よく分からない部分も多いけど、
２人が真剣なのは分かってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still don't get what you two are
planning, but I can at least tell
you're both serious.

fields.EN: So I'll guide you there now...
fields.JP: だから今から案内する……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I'll help you with what
I can...

fields.JP: それはこの黎明にあるのかい……？

fields.EN:
Yup... To be precise, a bit away
from headquarters. We made a
grave for her outside.
fields.JP:
うん。黎明の外れ……
誰も行かない場所にね、お墓を作ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... To be precise, a bit away
from headquarters. We made a
grave for her outside.

fields.EN:
I have a question. If she was cremated,
what happens to that plan of yours, Jack?
fields.JP:
疑問なのだけど、火葬していたら
ジャックの考える計画はどうなるのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a thought, but what happens
if she was cremated?

fields.EN:
Um... I'm not sure...
We'd have to try to find out.
fields.JP:
それは……ごめん、
やってみないと分からないや……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I'm not sure...
We'd have to try to find out.

fields.JP: その点に関しては大丈夫だよ

fields.EN:
She retained her Blood Skelter
form at death, so Dawn opted to
study her body whole and intact.
fields.JP:
人魚はブラッドスケルター状態で死んだ。
それは当時としては貴重なものだったから、
検査のために火葬はしてないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She retained her Blood Skelter
form at death, so Dawn opted to
study her body whole and intact.

fields.EN:
I see...
She was Dawn's valuable specimen.
fields.JP: なるほど。大事な検体ってわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
She was Dawn's valuable specimen.

fields.EN:
Uh, you should be a bit more
selective with your words...
fields.JP:
ちょっとあんた、さすがに
言い方ってものが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you should be a bit more
selective with your words...

fields.EN:
No, she's right. Dawn was so
desperate that they resorted to
less desirable means...
fields.JP:
いいんだ、事実だから。
それくらい当時の黎明は
追い詰められていたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, she's right. Dawn was so
desperate that they resorted to
less desirable means...

fields.EN:
In any case, we placed her in a
coffin and buried her.
fields.JP:
とにかく、人魚の遺体は棺に入れて、
その墓に丁重に埋葬してあるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, we placed her in a
coffin and buried her.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry to have you recall
such memories...
fields.JP:
ごめん……つらいことを
思い出させてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry to have you recall
such memories...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. If there's a way to
bring her back to life, I want
that to happen.
fields.JP:
ううん、違うんだ。
あたしだって人魚が生き返るなら、
もちろん生き返らせたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. If there's a way to
bring her back to life, I want
that to happen.

fields.EN:
But it's been ten years...
Her body may be only bones by now.
fields.JP:
でもね、もう１０年……正直、骨だけに
なっている可能性だってある……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's been ten years...
Her body may be only bones by now.

fields.EN:
That's what's scaring me...
Opening the coffin may end
whatever hope I may have in me...
fields.JP:
それが……正直怖いんだ。
棺を開けたら、希望が失われそうで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what's scaring me...
Opening the coffin may end
whatever hope I may have in me...

fields.EN: That's a scary thought to me, too.
fields.JP: 確かにそれは……僕だって怖い……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's a scary thought to me, too.

fields.EN: Oh? So are we calling this quits?
fields.JP: あら、やっぱり行かないの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? So are we calling this quits?

fields.EN:
Easy for you to say!
It's not like you know Ningyo!
fields.JP:
あ、あんたは人魚を知らないから
簡単にそう口にできるのかも
しれないけど……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Easy for you to say!
It's not like you know Mermie!

fields.EN:
The outcome isn't fixed until observed. In
other words, without observation, Ningyohime
has zero chance of coming back to life.
fields.JP:
観測するまで結果は確定しないわ。
逆に言えば、観測しなければ人魚姫とやらが
蘇生する可能性はゼロということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing is determined until we
see her body. That also means we
need to see her body to have hope.

fields.EN:
Gretel's right. Let's go to
Ningyohime-san's grave.
fields.JP:
……グレーテルの言うとおりだ。
行こう、人魚姫さんの墓へ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel's right. Let's go to
Little Mermaid's grave.

fields.EN:
Akazukin...
I want to see where this leads us,
so long as there's hope.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん……ゼロじゃないのなら
僕はその可能性に賭けたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood...
I want to see where this leads us,
so long as there's hope.

fields.EN:
Egad, this isn't like me to be
freaking out like this...
fields.JP:
……あたしとしたことが、
ビビってる場合じゃないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Egad, this isn't like me to be
freaking out like this...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. I think I'm ready now.
Let's get going.
fields.JP:
ごめん、みんな。
腹は括ったよ。じゃあ行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I think I'm ready now.
Let's get going.

fields.JP: ここが……人魚姫さんのお墓……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this is Little Mermaid's
grave...

fields.EN:
I didn't know such a place existed
within Dawn's premises.
fields.JP: こんな場所が黎明にあったんですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know such a place existed
within Dawn's premises.

fields.EN:
I didn't know about this place
too, even after being with Dawn
for such a long time.
fields.JP:
長くいながら、
まったく知りませんでした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know about this place
too, even after being with Dawn
for such a long time.

fields.JP: いい風が吹くのね、ここ……

fields.EN:
Yup... Which is why we decided
to bury her here, so that she
could rest in peace...
fields.JP:
うん……せめて安らかにって、
この場所にしたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... Which is why we decided
to bury her here, so that she
could rest in peace...

fields.EN:
Now then, time to dig her
coffin up.
fields.JP:
それじゃあみんな、
今から人魚の棺を掘り起こすよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, time to dig her
coffin up.

fields.JP: これが……人魚姫さんの棺……
この中に……姫がいるんだね……
そうだね……じゃあみんな…………

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry! I-I can't open it...!
Jack! Please!
fields.JP:
ごめんっ……あたし開けられない……！
ジャック、お願い……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry! I-I can't open it...!
Jack! Please!

fields.EN:
(I was the one who brought this
up, so I should be the one to
open the coffin...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、これは僕が言い出したこと……
　なら僕がやらなきゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was the one who brought this
up, so I should be the one to
open the coffin...)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry you had to go through
all this, Akazukin-san.
Let me open it...
fields.JP:
ごめんね赤ずきんさん、無理させて。
……うん、僕が開けるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry you had to go through
all this, Red Riding Hood.
Let me open it...

fields.EN:
Interesting...
She hasn't rotted a single bit.
fields.JP: 白骨化はおろか、腐ってすらいないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting...
She hasn't rotted a single bit.

fields.EN:
Princess...! Just as she was
back then... young and adorable...!
fields.JP:
あの時のままの……
幼くて、かわいらしい姫だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's the same Princess that
I knew from before!

fields.JP: こんなことってあるんですね……

fields.EN:
This was ten years ago, right?
So, why is her body in such a
preserved state?
fields.JP:
１０年も前なのよね？
どうしてこんなに綺麗なままの遺体で
いられるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This was ten years ago, right?
So, why is her body in such a
preserved state?

fields.EN:
There has to be something that
kept her this clean!
fields.JP: いったいどういうカラクリなのだ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There has to be something that
kept her this clean!

fields.JP:
じゅーねんねむってるの？
すごいね……！

fields.EN:
Her hair... I see... Ningyohime-san
died while she was in her
Blood Skelter form, right?
fields.JP:
この髪の色……そうか、
人魚姫さんはブラッドスケルター状態で
死んだんだっけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her hair... I see...
She died while she was in her
Blood Skelter form, right?

fields.JP:
……っ！　そうだよ、
ブラッドスケルター状態だよ！

fields.EN:
Tsuu, remember how Cinderella-san
was able to retain her young
form?!
fields.JP:
つう、ほらあの時！
シンデレラさんは幼いままだったでしょ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, remember how Cinderella
was able to retain her young
form?!

fields.EN:
That's right! Cinderella was able
to keep her youth because she was
in Blood Skelter!
fields.JP:
ハッ……！　そうか、シンデレラはずっと
ブラッドスケルター状態だった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! Cinderella was able
to keep her youth because she was
in Blood Skelter!

fields.EN:
M-Me? Youth?
What are you two talking about?
fields.JP:
わ、わたくしが幼いまま……？
いったい何を言ってるんですの、
あなたたちは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-Me? Youth?
What are you two talking about?

fields.EN:
I suppose they're referring to the
Cinderella of the other world.
fields.JP: どうやら違う時間軸の時の話のようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose they're referring to the
Cinderella of the other world.

fields.EN:
Blood Skelter doesn't exactly stop
aging. It keeps the body in the
state it was in when it transformed!
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化は明確には
歳を取らないんじゃなくて、肉体が
その状態であり続けるって仕組みだったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Skelter doesn't prevent
aging... It simply maintains the
body's initial form!

fields.EN:
So, the body's time stops, and
maintains its state? That would
explain her preserved state.
fields.JP:
つまり肉体の時間が止まり、
その時点での状態を維持するわけね。
それなら確かに肉体は腐らないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, the body's time stops, and
maintains its state? That would
explain her preserved state.

fields.EN: I never knew that was possible...
fields.JP: 白雪、初めて知りました……
fields.LOCALIZED: I never knew that was possible...

fields.EN:
Uh, so what are we talking about
here?
fields.JP:
ちょっと、いったい
どういうことだっていうの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, so what are we talking about
here?

fields.EN:
We may be able to bring
Ningyohime-san back to life,
Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
人魚姫さんは生き返るかも
ってことだよ、赤ずきんさん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may be able to bring Little
Mermaid back to life!

fields.EN:
All right, let's take Ningyohime-san's
body and the mic to the Metropolitan
Office!
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあすぐにでも
人魚姫さんの遺体とあのマイクを持って、
都庁に向かおう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's take her body and
the mic to the Metropolitan
Office!

fields.EN:
Yes, let's! And quick!
I'll carry her body!
fields.JP:
うん……すぐに行こう……！
姫の身体は僕が運ぶ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, let's! And quick!
I'll carry her body!

fields.EN:
(Good!
We still have hope on our side!)
fields.JP:
（よかった……！
　希望はまだ繋がっている……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Good!
We still have hope on our side!)

fields.EN:
We may be able to bring
Ningyohime-san back to life now!
fields.JP: これで人魚姫さんを復活できるかも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may be able to bring
Little Mermaid back to life now!

fields.JP: ふぎゃああああああああああ

fields.EN:
And, a guardian is here,
as expected...
fields.JP: 核あるところに番人あり……ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, a guardian is here,
as expected...

fields.EN:
We shouldn't be surprised it's
here...
fields.JP: やっぱり番人もいるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We shouldn't be surprised it's
here...

fields.EN:
Looks like what we do won't
change here, too.
fields.JP:
こっちのジェイルも
やることに変わりはないのね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like what we do won't
change here, too.

fields.EN: Makes it that much easier for us.
fields.JP: その方が面倒がなくていいけどね
fields.LOCALIZED: Makes it that much easier for us.

fields.EN:
Well, we better get rid of it
first.
fields.JP:
なんにしてもこっちを
先に片付けないと話が進まないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we better get rid of it
first.

fields.EN:
The Marchens here were a lot
stronger than the others before.
We should be careful.
fields.JP:
道中のメルヒェンも他より強かったわ。
みんな、油断しないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchens here were a lot
stronger than the others before.
We should be careful.

fields.JP: そうだね。頑張って切り抜けよう！

fields.EN:
Looks like we can hold our
ground here, too.
fields.JP:
こっちのジェイルでも
あたしたちはしっかり戦えるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we can hold our
ground here, too.

fields.EN:
All right, then hurry up and use the
core to bring this Ningyohime back to life!
fields.JP:
よし、ではさっさと核を
使って人魚姫とやらを
復活させるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, let's get rid of the
core and bring this Little Mermaid
person back to life!

fields.JP:
ひゅぎぎぎぎ♪
ぎぎぎーー！
こんな時にナイトメアが現れるなんて……！

ひゅううううひひひひひ♪
ひゅぎぎぎぎ！
アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

なっ……え！？
ナイトメア自身が核を破壊した！？

ゆゆゆひひひぎぎ♪
ひゅぎぎぎぎ！

ひっ！
なんなんですか、
このナイトメア！

fields.EN:
It's definitely unlike any other
I've seen before.
fields.JP:
私達が知っているナイトメアとは
完全に異質な存在ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's definitely unlike any other
I've seen before.

fields.EN:
It looks more like it's on a
rampage than running away...
fields.JP:
逃げた、というより
暴走しているように見えるわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks more like it's on a
rampage than running away...

fields.EN:
W-Wait!
Tsuu, are you all right?!
fields.JP:
そ、そうだ……！
つう大丈夫かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait!
Otsuu, are you all right?!

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm fine, but...
Why do you ask?
fields.JP:
ああ、僕は大丈夫だけど、
どうしてだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm fine, but...
Why do you ask?

fields.EN:
It's because I thought you were
the Nightmare here...
fields.JP:
いや……つうは確か
都庁のナイトメアだったなって思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because I thought you were
the Nightmare here...

fields.EN:
Ah, if the core here is yours,
then you'll lose your regenerative
powers...
fields.JP:
あ……この核が対応するものなら、
再生能力が失われちゃうのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, if the core here is yours,
then you'll lose your regenerative
powers...

fields.EN:
Um, but I believe we did destroy
a part from you when we fought
her the last time.
fields.JP:
でも以前戦った時には、
しっかりと部位を破壊できてましたよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, but I believe we did destroy
a part from you when we fought
her the last time.

fields.EN:
Does that mean your core was
already destroyed from before?
fields.JP:
じゃあすでに、対応する核は
破壊されているのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean your core was
already destroyed from before?

fields.EN:
I'm not sure. My memories only
go as far back as when I was
wandering this area...
fields.JP:
どうだろうね……僕は気づいた時から
この辺りを彷徨っていたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure. My memories only
go as far back as when I was
wandering this area...

fields.EN:
I don't know which core actually
belongs to me.
fields.JP:
もう僕自身、どこの核の所属かなんて……
分からないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know which core actually
belongs to me.

fields.EN:
But that's besides the point...
We needed the core for Princess...
fields.JP: それよりも姫のための核が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that's besides the point...
We needed the core for Princess...

fields.EN:
For all I know, there are no other
cores here. We need to look for
one someplace else.
fields.JP:
僕の知る限り、もう都庁に核はない、
別の場所の核を探すしかないのか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
For all I know, there are no other
cores here. We need to look for
one someplace else.

fields.EN: Oh? We still have a core.
fields.JP: あら、核ならまだあるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? We still have a core.

fields.EN:
What? But she's saying there
are none around.
fields.JP:
何いってんのよ。
元々都庁にいたナイトメアがないって
言ってるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? But she's saying there
are none around.

fields.EN:
I'm sure there's one at the
very top of this place.
fields.JP: あら、この最上階なら確実にあると思うけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure there's one at the
very top of this place.

fields.JP:
そ、そうか……！
ウィッチクラフトなら！

fields.EN:
Tsuu, we still have a chance!
Let's beat that Nightmare and
get to the very top!
fields.JP:
つうまだ希望は途絶えてないよ！
あのナイトメアを倒して、
最上階へ進もう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, we still have a chance!
Let's beat that Nightmare and
get to the very top!

fields.EN:
The place is getting dark...
Here it comes!
fields.JP: 来たわ……辺りが暗くなった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place is getting dark...
Here it comes!

fields.EN:
Looks like it's ready to attack!
Let's get this over with!
fields.JP:
今度は相手もやる気まんまんみたいね！
あとは倒すだけだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like it's ready to attack!
Let's get this over with!

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm sure we'll be able
to defeat it.
fields.JP:
ええ。ここまで戦ってきた
私たちなら、きっとやれるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm sure we'll be able
to defeat it.

fields.JP: みんな……無茶はしないで……

fields.EN: Heh, no need to worry, Otsuu.
fields.JP: あはは……心配性だね、おつうは
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh, no need to worry, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
I can believe how you were with
another me and others in another
world now.
fields.JP:
あたしの知らないどこかで
おつうとあたしたちが仲間だったって、
今なら信じられるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can believe how you were with
another me and others in another
world now.

fields.EN:
So all you need to do is to
believe in us, too.
fields.JP:
だからおつうもさ、
あたしたちを信じて見守っていてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So all you need to do is to
believe in us, too.

fields.EN:
All right!
Let's win this for Otsuu!
fields.JP:
よし！　じゃあみんな！
おつうのためにも絶対に勝つよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right!
Let's win this for Otsuu!

fields.EN:
We destroyed the Nightmare's
body part!
fields.JP: よし、部位を破壊できましたわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We destroyed the Nightmare's
body part!

fields.EN:
That should make things a bit
easier!
fields.JP: これでもっと戦いやすくなるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That should make things a bit
easier!

fields.EN:
It looks madder than before!
Be careful, everyone!
fields.JP:
でも敵もさらに怒ってるよ！
みんな気をつけて！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks madder than before!
Be careful, everyone!

fields.EN:
There's no way we will lose.
I'm getting quite intrigued in
seeing what lies ahead for us.
fields.JP:
この先で何が起きるのか、
私はとても興味があるわ。
だから負けてはいられないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we will lose.
I'm getting quite intrigued in
seeing what lies ahead for us.

fields.EN:
She's right! There's no way we
can lose now! Time to finish it!
fields.JP:
そうだよ、負けてなんていられない！
一気に本体を叩くよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right! There's no way we
can lose now! Time to finish it!

fields.JP: ナイトメアが消えていく……
よかった……みんな無事で……

fields.EN:
You really are kind and caring,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
本当におつうちゃんは
仲間想いですね……
fields.LOCALIZED: You really are kind and caring.

fields.EN:
You're making it hard for us
to refute that you were with
us in that other world.
fields.JP:
いつかどこかでわらわたちと
仲間だったって、本当に思えてきますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're making it hard for us
to refute that you were with
us in that other world.

fields.EN:
I'm sure we were all friends,
and we still are.
Ain't that right Otsuu?
fields.JP:
本当に仲間だったんだよ。
昔も今もね……ね、おつう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we were all friends,
and we still are.
Ain't that right Otsuu?

fields.EN:
(What a relief... It looks like
everyone is accepting Tsuu,
just like in the other world.)
fields.JP:
（よかった……みんな、
　つうのことをあの世界みたいに
　認め始めている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a relief... It looks like
everyone is accepting Otsuu,
just like in the other world.)

fields.JP:
アァァァァァ……
アァァァァァァァァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
The Jail's wailing like never
before!
fields.JP: ジェイルが一際大きく鳴いて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's wailing like never
before!

fields.EN:
The Jail's desire has been
fulfilled!
fields.JP: ジェイルの欲望が……満たされたんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's desire has been
fulfilled!

fields.EN:
Its fulfilment must have
extended the tower to its limit!
fields.JP:
きっと欲望が満たされたことで、
監獄塔が……最大まで伸びたんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Its fulfilment must have
extended the tower to its limit!

fields.EN:
If that's so, then that white
core... The Witchcraft may
have been born!
fields.JP:
監獄塔が最大まで伸びたのなら……
『白い核』……『ウィッチクラフト』が
産まれたかもしれない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's so, then that white
core... The Witchcraft may
have been born!

fields.EN:
We can...
bring Princess back to life!
fields.JP: 姫を……姫を生き返らせるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can...
bring Princess back to life!

fields.EN:
All right, let's hurry and
get going!
fields.JP: よし、みんな屋上に急ごう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's hurry and
get going!

fields.EN: We finally made it to the top...
fields.LOCALIZED: We finally made it to the top...

fields.EN:
A white core...
It's exactly how Jack explained it
to be.
fields.JP:
『白い核』……
ジャックやつうの話していたとおりね
fields.LOCALIZED:
A white core...
It's exactly how Jack explained it
to be.

fields.EN:
I'm glad it's the same as
I thought it to be...
fields.JP: うん……予想通りでよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad it's the same as
I thought it to be...

fields.EN:
So, we may be able to bring
Ningyo back to life
with it?
fields.JP:
これで人魚は
生き返るかもしれないんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we may be able to bring
Little Mermaid back to life
with it?

fields.EN:
Tsuu... Can you let me handle
Ningyohime-san's body and her
microphone?
fields.JP:
つう、人魚姫さんの遺体とマイク、
僕に預けてくれないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Can you let me handle
Little Mermaid's body and her
microphone?

fields.EN:
(Mamoru's group came back to life.
I'm sure it will work this time,
too.)
fields.JP:
（マモルたちだって生き返ったんだ
　きっと今回だって上手くいくさ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mamoru's group came back to life.
I'm sure it will work this time,
too.)

fields.EN:
That may not be enough to bring
her back to life.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら……それだけじゃ
想いが足りないかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That may not be enough to bring
her back to life.

fields.EN:
I know what you mean, but we don't
have anything else that can link us
to Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
絶対の確証はないから、
気持ちは分かるけど……でもこれ以上
人魚姫さんに繋がるものはないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know what you mean, but we don't
have any other items that can
link to her existence.

fields.EN: I will offer myself to the core.
fields.JP: 僕が……僕自身が核に身を捧げるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I will offer myself to the core.

fields.JP: な、何を言ってるんだよ、つう！！

fields.EN:
He's right! It defeats all purpose
if you sacrifice yourself now
after all we've been through!
fields.JP:
そうだよ、せっかくここまで来たのに、
あんたがいなくなったら意味ないじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right! It defeats all purpose
if you sacrifice yourself now
after all we've been through!

fields.EN:
But, we only have one chance,
and I can't have it fail.
fields.JP:
でも……チャンスは１度きり……
失敗はできない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we only have one chance,
and I can't have it fail.

fields.JP: 僕は絶対に姫を助けたいんだ……

fields.EN:
If the strength of the feelings offered
affects success, then Tsuu, who never stopped
thinking of Ningyohime, is certainly ideal.
fields.JP:
捧げる想いの強さが成功率に関わるのなら、
人魚姫のことを考え続けたつうは
確かに最適と言えるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If an item that can prove her
existence is needed, Otsuu
would be the perfect item to use.

fields.JP: そうかもしれないよ！　けど……！

fields.EN:
Thank you, Akazukin.
Thank you, everyone...
fields.JP: ありがとう……赤ずきん……みんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Red Riding Hood.
Thank you, everyone...

fields.EN:
But, this is something I wanted
all along... Please...
Let me sacrifice myself...
fields.JP:
でもこれは……僕がずっと
叶えたかった願いなんだ……
だからどうか……やらせてほしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, this is something I wanted
all along... Please...
Let me sacrifice myself...

fields.EN:
But...!
After finally being able to meet
you...!
fields.JP:
そんな……せっかく再会できたのに、
そんなのって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...!
After finally being able to meet
you...!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
But, you understand me, right?
fields.JP:
ごめんね……でもジャックなら……
分かってくれるだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
But, you understand me, right?

fields.EN:
So... I want you to pray for
it... for the miracle that my
feelings will reach Princess...
fields.JP:
だから……どうか願っててほしいんだ……
僕の想いが……姫に届く奇跡を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, let me fulfill my wish.
I want to be the one to
bring Princess back.

fields.EN:
If that's what she wants, then
we need to honor her wish, Jack.
fields.JP:
分かってあげよう、ジャック。
これがこの子のしたいことなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's what she wants, then
we need to honor her wish, Jack.

fields.EN:
You better make this miracle
happen! Got it?
fields.JP:
その代わり、絶対に奇跡を起こすこと！
いい、分かった！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You better make this miracle
happen! Got it?

fields.EN:
Princess is so young...
She's so light, and...
so cute...
fields.JP:
幼い姫の身体……
こんなにも軽くて……愛おしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess is so young...
She's so light, and...
so cute...

fields.JP: つう……いってらっしゃい……

fields.EN:
Don't you worry my princess.
I'll protect you no matter what.
fields.JP:
はっはっは、何があろうと
僕が必ずや守ってみせましょう、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry my princess.
I'll protect you no matter what.

fields.EN:
I can't believe you said it with
such a straight face...
fields.JP: そんな臆面もなく言われると恥ずかしいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you said it with
such a straight face...

fields.EN:
I've already decided. You're
someone precious to me, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
もう決めたの。おつうちゃんは
わたしにとって大事なひと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to make me stay.
You're someone special to me,
Otsuu.

fields.EN:
All the more reason why I need
to go with you.
fields.JP: だからわたしは、一緒に行くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the more reason why I need
to go with you.

fields.EN:
Princess, I love you too. ...Let's meet
again someday, at the far end of the future.
fields.JP:
姫、僕もあなたを愛しています。
……いつか未来の果てで、お会いしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you more than anything.
I pray that we will meet again
one day in the future...

fields.EN:
Yes... And when we meet,
we'll be joined in matrimony again.
fields.JP:
はい……ふつつか者ですが、
末永くよろしくお願い致します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... And when we meet,
we'll be joined in matrimony again.

fields.JP: ジャック……それにみんな……！

fields.EN:
Huh...? What?!
You're right... I'm... human?
fields.JP:
へ……？　うわぁっ！？
本当だ、人間になれてる！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...? What?!
You're right... I'm... human?

fields.EN:
She's back...
She's really, really back!
fields.JP: 本当に……人魚を生き返らせた……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's back...
She's really, really back!

fields.EN:
It also looks like she's
grown to our ages.
fields.JP:
しかも……わたしたちと
同い年くらいに成長した姿で……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also looks like she's
grown to our ages.

fields.JP: ここまでとは……正直思わなかったわ

fields.EN:
Tsuu's wish brought about
a miracle...!
fields.JP: つうの願いが奇跡を起こしたんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu's wish brought about
a miracle...!

fields.EN: Truly, the power of Otsuu-chan's love!
fields.JP: まさにおつうちゃんの愛の力ですね！
ん……あれ……おつうちゃんだ……

fields.EN:
I... wasn't I supposed to have jumped
into the core? No... wasn't I supposed
to have died in the correct world?
fields.JP:
わたし……核に飛び込んだはずじゃ……？
ううん、正しい世界で死んだはずじゃ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I went into the...?
No wait. Didn't I die and...?

fields.EN:
Huh? Otsuu-chan's here...
Everyone's here, too...?!
fields.JP:
あれ、おつうちゃんがいて……
みんなもいる……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Otsuu's here...
Everyone's here, too...?!

fields.EN:
You're in another world, and
everyone's safe, Ningyohime-san!
fields.JP:
ここはもう次の世界で、
みんなも無事なんだよ、人魚姫さん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're in another world, and
everyone's safe, Little Mermaid!

fields.JP: そうなの……おつうちゃん……？

fields.EN:
Yes... This is the proper timeline
Princess wished for... and both Princess
and I were able to meet again here...!
fields.JP:
うん……そうだよ……
姫が願った、正しい時間軸の世界で……
僕も姫もまた出会えたんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... and we're able to meet
like this in the proper world
we should be in!

fields.EN:
I see... So Otsuu-chan, everyone,
and I were able to return to the
proper world together...
fields.JP:
そっか……わたしもおつうちゃんも、
そしてみんなも一緒の正しい世界に
来られたんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So everyone was able
to return to the proper world
with us, too.

fields.EN:
That's right!
And, it's all because of Jack
and our friends!
fields.JP:
そうだよ姫……！
ジャックやみんなのおかげなんだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right!
And, it's all because of Jack
and our friends!

fields.EN:
(They finally met... I couldn't
have wished for any better.)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They finally met... I couldn't
have wished for any better.)

fields.JP:
ニンギョ……
本当に、ニンギョなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid...
Is that really you?

fields.JP:
もしかして……
おねーちゃん……？

fields.EN:
Ningyo...!
Y-You're so much older now!
fields.JP:
ああ、ニンギョ……！
こんなに、こんなに大きくなって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid...!
Y-You're so much older now!

fields.EN:
Sorry, Ningyo. Even though
I'm your onee-chan, back then, I...
fields.JP:
ごめんねニンギョ、あたし、おねーちゃんなのに、
あの時、あんたを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry! I was your sister,
but I wasn't able to save you
back then...!

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Onee-chan. That wasn't your
fault. We're back together again,
so we're all good now.
fields.JP:
……大丈夫だよ、おねーちゃん。
あれはおねーちゃんが悪いんじゃないし、
それに、こうやってまた会えたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Sis. That wasn't your
fault. We're back together again,
so we're all good now.

fields.EN:
Really?
You're going to forgive me?
fields.JP:
本当に？
あたしを、許してくれるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?
You're going to forgive me?

fields.EN:
Of course! So please, I want
to see you smile, Onee-chan.
fields.JP:
うん！
だから、笑ってよ、おねーちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! So please, I want
to see you smile, Sis.

fields.EN:
Gotcha...
I am your onee-chan after all!
fields.JP:
……わかった。
あたしは、あんたのおねーちゃんだもんね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gotcha...
I am your sister after all!

fields.EN:
Jack, what did you mean by
"everyone's safe" earlier?
fields.JP:
しかし、ジャックの言う『みんなも無事』……？
いったいどういうことでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, what did you mean by
"everyone's safe" earlier?

fields.EN:
I still don't quite understand
what you're getting at...
fields.JP: いまいち要領を得ませんけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was a bit peculiar, if not
disturbing...

fields.EN:
What happened to us in this
other world anyway?
fields.JP:
違う時間軸とやらでは
何があったっていうのよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What happened to us in this
other world anyway?

fields.JP: ワレにもちゃんと説明せぬか！

fields.EN:
But, there's no reason to
dwell on that awful past.
fields.JP: でも……それを思い出す必要なんてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, there's no reason to
dwell on that awful past.

fields.EN:
Yes...
That was just a bad dream...
fields.JP:
そうだね……あれはきっと
『悪い夢』だったんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes...
That was just a bad dream...

fields.EN:
We're living in the present.
That's all that's important now.
fields.JP:
僕たちは『今』を生きている。
それでいいんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're living in the present.
That's all that's important now.

fields.EN:
Now then,
let's head back home...
fields.JP:
じゃあ戻ろうみんな。
僕たちの帰るべき場所へ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then,
let's head back home...

fields.EN: We can return to the surface now.
fields.JP: これでやっと僕たちは地上に戻れるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: We can return to the surface now.

fields.EN:
I was worried how we were
going to get to the surface,
but...
fields.JP:
でも、一時はどうやって
地上に戻るのかって思ったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was worried how we were
going to get to the surface,
but...

fields.EN:
I didn't expect Hikari-san to have
the power to make that happen.
fields.JP:
ヒカリさんの力で
それが可能だなんて驚いたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect Hikari to have
the power to make that happen.

fields.EN:
She's also willing to do
everything to get everyone back
to the surface.
fields.JP:
どうやらみんなを地上に戻すって
張り切ってくれてるみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's also willing to do
everything to get everyone back
to the surface.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, she said for
me to let her know when I'm
ready, but...
fields.JP:
準備ができたら声かけてほしい、
って伝えられたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, she said for
me to let her know when I'm
ready, but...

fields.EN:
Once we get to the surface, it's
going to be difficult coming back
here...
fields.JP:
……地上に脱出すれば、もちろんここには
簡単には戻ってこられない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we get to the surface, it's
going to be difficult coming back
here...

fields.EN:
I better make sure I got
everything checked and ready
to go...
fields.JP: 何かやり残したことはないかなぁ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better make sure I got
everything checked and ready
to go...

fields.JP: おーい。街の連中も集めてきたよー！

fields.EN:
Everyone under the Order of the
Sun is ready.
fields.JP: タイヨウのみんなも、そろってるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone under the Order of the
Sun is ready.

fields.EN:
Hey, you sure there's nothing left
to bring with us?
fields.JP:
おい。
本部から持ち出すものは、他にもう無いか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, you sure there's nothing left
to bring with us?

fields.EN:
Yes. Unlike you, I only have to
bring my medicines, materials,
and medical tools.
fields.JP:
ええ。薬品と医療器具と資料と……
あなたと違って身軽なものよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Unlike you, I only have to
bring my medicines, materials,
and medical tools.

fields.EN:
That doesn't sound different from
how much I'm gonna bring with
me...
fields.JP: 全然身軽じゃねえだろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't sound different from
how much I'm gonna bring with
me...

fields.JP: 姉さん、持つの手伝うっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna help carry her stuff,
too!

fields.EN:
Gotta say though, I'm impressed
you're gonna bring the materials
even after everything's done.
fields.JP:
しっかし、全部終わったってのに、
資料まで残さず持ち出すとは、真面目だねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gotta say though, I'm impressed
you're gonna bring the materials
even after everything's done.

fields.EN:
You're the unserious one. You're
nothing like that person from your homeland.
fields.JP:
あなたが不真面目なのよ。
同郷だったっていうあの人とは大違いね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like to be prepared. I have to
say that you're not like that
comrade of yours.

fields.EN:
Yeah... Well, he was a bit too
hard-headed, for better or worse.
fields.JP:
まあ……あいつは良くも悪くも
クソ真面目だったからな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Well, he was a bit too
hard-headed, for better or worse.

fields.EN: So much so that he lost his way...
fields.JP: 真面目すぎて、歪んじまったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: So much so that he lost his way...

fields.EN:
Um, Haru-san, so where exactly did
you and the Professor come from?
fields.JP:
あの、ハルさんと博士って……どこから
来たんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, so where exactly did you and
the Professor come from?

fields.EN:
I'll talk about it once we get
settled. It's so out of this world
that it doesn't fit this story.
fields.JP:
……落ち着いたらおいおい話してやるよ。
ま、突拍子も無い話だ。
どのみちこの物語にはふさわしくねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll talk about it once we get
settled. It's so out of this world
that it doesn't fit this story.

fields.EN: Way to put on airs, Boss!
fields.JP: 師匠のもったいぶりー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Way to put on airs, Boss!

fields.EN:
That what adults do. Unlike brats,
we have a lot more baggage.
fields.JP:
大人はもったいぶるんだよ。ガキどもと
違って、持ってるもんが少ねえからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That what adults do. Unlike brats,
we have a lot more baggage.

fields.EN:
I guess my story's about a prince
from a faraway planet losing his
place, and bringing along a rose.
fields.JP:
……ま、お前ら風に言うなら、遠い星の
王子様が、住んでた小さな星を失って、大事
な花だけ持ってやって来た……そんな話さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess my story's about a prince
from a faraway planet losing his
place, and bringing along a rose.

fields.EN:
Eew! He called himself a prince!
Way to overstate yourself!
fields.JP:
うわ！　自分のこと王子様とか
言ってるし……ちょっと引いたっすよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eew! He called himself a prince!
Way to overstate yourself!

fields.EN:
That's just an analogy, you little
brat...
fields.JP: 例えって言ったろ。シメるぞガキ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's just an analogy, you little
brat...

fields.EN:
Whoa! Uh, I just remembered I
needed to go and check on
something!
fields.JP:
ひゃー！
自分、あっち見てくるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Uh, I just remembered I
needed to go and check on
something!

fields.EN:
That did come out of nowhere.
But you've piqued my interest.
I'd like to hear more later.
fields.JP:
確かに突拍子も無い話ね。
……落ち着いたら詳細を聞きたいところだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That did come out of nowhere.
But you've piqued my interest.
I'd like to hear more later.

fields.EN:
Now then, I better get back
to work.
fields.JP: さてと、俺も作業に戻るか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I better get back
to work.

fields.EN:
Jack... I really appreciate what
you've done.
fields.JP: ……ジャック。お前には感謝してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I really appreciate what
you've done.

fields.JP:
いや、何でもねえよ。
じゃあまた後でな

fields.EN:
Instead of telling others to help,
Akazukin should take
care of her own stuff...
fields.JP:
まったく赤ずきんの奴、
暇なら手伝えとか……自分の荷物くらい
自分でまとめればいいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Instead of telling others to help,
Red Riding Hood should take
care of her own stuff...

fields.EN:
Tsuu, Ningyohime-san...
Are you two ready?
fields.JP:
つう……それに人魚姫さんも。
２人は準備は大丈夫なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, Little Mermaid...
Are you two ready?

fields.EN:
We're done. It's not like we
had many things to take with us.
fields.JP:
わたしたちはそんなに準備もないから、
すぐに終わったんだー
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're done. It's not like we
had many things to take with us.

fields.EN:
Guess what Akazukin
asked us to do?
fields.JP: そしたら赤ずきんの奴がさぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess what Red Riding Hood
asked us to do?

fields.EN:
Oh, but that's just Onee-chan treating
us like how she used to.
fields.JP:
おねーちゃん、すぐに前と変わらず
わたしたちに接してくれるように
なったんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but that's just Sis treating
us like how she used to.

fields.EN:
Which means you're back to bickering with her
like always, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
それってつまり、おつうちゃんといつも
言い合ってる関係ってことで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That also means that Otsuu is
arguing with her again...

fields.EN:
Looks like you're having fun,
Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP: 楽しそうだね、人魚姫さん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're having fun,
Little Mermaid.

fields.EN: Yup! It's the same as before!
fields.JP:
うん！　だってそれがわたしたちの
日常だったんだもん
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! It's the same as before!

fields.EN:
Princess...
Well, it's not that I don't like
the old Akazukin, but...
fields.JP:
姫…………まあ僕も
いつもの赤ずきんがいいけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess...
Well, it's not that I don't like
the old Red Riding Hood, but...

fields.JP:
はいみなさん、
どいてどいてっすー！

fields.EN:
Look at all this luggage...
Everyone else is bickering
over how much to take with them.
fields.JP:
ほんとみんな、すごい荷物だな……
あっちじゃ積むの積まないので揉めてるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at all this luggage...
Everyone else is bickering
over how much to take with them.

fields.EN:
At least no one
is in despair now.
fields.JP:
でもこれまでみたいに悲壮感とか、
そういう雰囲気じゃないもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least no one
is in despair now.

fields.EN:
Yeah, everyone is full of life.
I never thought I'd see a day
with everyone smiling like this.
fields.JP:
うん、生き生きとしてる。
まさか黎明の人たちのこんな笑顔が
見られるなんて、夢みたいだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, everyone is full of life.
I never thought I'd see a day
with everyone smiling like this.

fields.EN:
Yup, it was hard to imagine
that, especially back then...
fields.JP:
うん、あの頃からしたら、
想像もできなかったことだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, it was hard to imagine
that, especially back then...

fields.EN: This time, everyone at Dawn is alive too.
fields.JP:
今度はちゃんと、
黎明のみんなも生きててくれてるしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even the members of Dawn
look happy and excited.

fields.EN:
Hey, there you are.
I've got something to ask
you guys.
fields.JP:
お、いたいた。なあお前ら、
ちょっと聞きたいことがあるんだけどよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, there you are.
I've got something to ask
you guys.

fields.JP:
マモル……それにみなさん。
……何かあったの？

fields.EN:
No, there was something we
wanted to confirm.
fields.JP:
いや、どうしても
確認しておきたいことがあってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, there was something we
wanted to confirm.

fields.EN:
I've heard that there are Jails on the surface
too, but... are there really that many?
fields.JP:
いや、地上にもジェイルはある、
みたいな話は聞いてるんだけどよ……
本当にわんさかあるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone heard that there's
plenty of Jails out on the
surface, but is that true?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Not sure about "plenty,"
but the odds are likely there
may be more up there.
fields.JP:
うーん……わんさかかどうかは
分からないけど、別のジェイルがある
確率は高いと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Not sure about "plenty,"
but the odds are likely there
may be more up there.

fields.EN:
Beyond the underground cavern was
the Metropolitan Office Jail, so
there could be more out there.
fields.JP:
実際、地下洞窟の先には
『都庁』のジェイルがあるわけだし、
他のジェイルもあると考えていいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beyond the underground cavern was
the Metropolitan Office Jail, so
there could be more out there.

fields.EN:
Yes... So, it's possible there are
other Jails on the surface.
fields.JP:
うん……他にもあるなら、
地上に出てもジェイルはあるよね、きっと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... So, it's possible there are
other Jails on the surface.

fields.EN:
You don't look well...
Is something wrong?
fields.JP: 少し浮かない顔に見えるけど、どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't look well...
Is something wrong?

fields.EN:
Our unique situation means our lives
are similar to Marchens. So now
we need to be near a core to live.
fields.JP:
僕たちは訳あってメルヒェンみたいな
存在になってしまったんだ。だから、
核の近くじゃないと生きていけない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our unique situation means our lives
are similar to Marchens. So now
we need to be near a core to live.

fields.EN:
That's right...
You're all mimicked creatures...
fields.JP:
そうか、みんなは
擬態化した存在……だったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right...
You're all mimicked creatures...

fields.EN:
Indeed. So, if there really are
more Jails up there, we'll be
able to live on the surface, too.
fields.JP:
そうだ。だからその情報が正しければ、
僕たちは地上に出ても生き残れる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. So, if there really are
more Jails up there, we'll be
able to live on the surface, too.

fields.EN:
Yeah, but we're not sure if that's
a good thing or a bad thing yet.
fields.JP: ただそれを喜んでいいか分かんなくてよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but we're not sure if that's
a good thing or a bad thing yet.

fields.EN:
Like, doesn't that mean we'd
still have to kill Marchens
just like before?
fields.JP:
だってそれだとよ、地上に出ても
またメルヒェンぶっ殺す日々の
始まりってわけだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, doesn't that mean we'd
still have to kill Marchens
just like before?

fields.EN:
I just feel like it'd be wrong to
the others for us to be happy about that.
fields.JP:
それを喜ぶのはさ、
他のみんなに悪いかなって思うわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one's exactly eager to do
that anymore, you know?

fields.EN:
Like, I'm all happy and stuff,
because it's not like I wanna
die or anything.
fields.JP:
そりゃ俺っち、内心嬉しいぜ？
心の中じゃいっつも死にたくねえって
思ってたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, I'm all happy and stuff,
because it's not like I wanna
die or anything.

fields.EN:
But I'm enough of an adult not to
go, 'Hell yeah, lucky me! Woo!' over it.
fields.JP:
ただそれを『やったぜラッキー、フゥー！』
ってやらないくらいは俺っちも大人なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But ya know, I'm an adult so
I'm not gonna break down and
and cry in happiness, ya dig?

fields.EN:
...I think it's okay to be happy
about it. Everyone wants to live, after all.
fields.JP:
……僕はいいと思うけどな。
だってみんな生きていたいんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see the big deal.
You're all alive, right?

fields.EN:
Same here. You don't need to
proclaim to everyone how
happy you are, you know?
fields.JP:
わたしも、あえてみんなの前で
言わなければ、喜んだっていいと思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. You don't need to
proclaim to everyone how
happy you are, you know?

fields.EN:
They're right. Plus, there's
always the chance we'll need
to return in the future.
fields.JP:
そうだよみんな。それにこれから先、
戻るチャンスだってきっとあると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're right. Plus, there's
always the chance we'll need
to return in the future.

fields.EN:
Yes, Jack's right. Opportunity
comes only to those who stay
alive.
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックの言うとおりだ。
生きていればチャンスは絶対にある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, Jack's right. Opportunity
comes only to those who stay
alive.

fields.EN:
We didn't give up, which is why
we're here today.
fields.JP:
だって僕たちも諦めなかったから、
今こうしてここにいるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't give up, which is why
we're here today.

fields.EN:
Of course, we stumbled plenty
of times and took a lot of detours...
fields.JP:
そりゃあ何度も挫けたし、
遠回りもしたけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, we went through
a lot ourselves, sometimes
regretting our choices...

fields.EN: ...Yeah. That was one very long detour.
fields.JP:
……そうだね、あれはとても長い
遠回りだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, what you two went through
was quite something...

fields.EN:
But, everything you went
through was necessary to
bring you to this moment here.
fields.JP:
でも、全然無駄なことじゃなかったよ。
むしろ必要なことだったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, everything you went
through was necessary to
bring you to this moment here.

fields.EN:
We've all been through the
ringer, but it led us here.
fields.JP:
みんな、僕たちは最悪を経験して、
それでこうして今ここにいるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've all been through the
ringer, but it led us here.

fields.EN:
Now that you've survived the
worst, I'm sure good things
are headed your way.
fields.JP:
だから、こう思おうよ。
悪いことの後には幸せが待ってる、って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that you've survived the
worst, I'm sure good things
are headed your way.

fields.EN:
Heh, you're right. We saw rock
bottom, so we can only go
up from here!
fields.JP:
……へっ、そうだな。
俺たちはもう最悪を経験した。
なら後は上がるっきゃねーな！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, you're right. We saw rock
bottom, so we can only go
up from here!

fields.EN:
We all went through a lot to
get here. We can't give up now.
fields.JP:
何度もつまずいて、
ようやくここまで来たんだもん。
めげてなんかいられないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We all went through a lot to
get here. We can't give up now.

fields.EN:
Yup! We're not gonna let
hope go so easily!
fields.JP:
うん。もう簡単に
希望を捨てたりなんてできないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! We're not gonna let
hope go so easily!

fields.EN:
The sun rises after the storm, eh?
Nice way to wrap things up.
fields.JP:
悪いことの後には幸せが待ってる……か。
いいこと言ってくれるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sun rises after the storm, eh?
Nice way to wrap things up.

fields.EN:
Indeed. It lacks scientific proof,
but oddly enough, it sounds
coherently true...
fields.JP:
ああ。非論理的だが、
どこかそう思わせてくれるから不思議だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. It lacks scientific proof,
but oddly enough, it sounds
coherently true...

fields.EN:
That's our Jack-kun!
I knew you had it in you!!
fields.JP:
さすがジャッくん、
あたしゃやる子だって信じてたよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice words, Jack! You were
always a winner in my book!

fields.EN:
You know, your words seem to
move people, just like they used
to when we were imprisoned.
fields.JP:
監獄にいた時からそうだったけどよ、
なんかお前の言葉には力があるな、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, your words seem to
move people, just like they used
to when we were imprisoned.

fields.EN:
And you too, Otsuu and Ningyohime. We
haven't even known each other long,
but you're a strange pair, seriously.
fields.JP:
それにおつうと人魚姫も。
会って間もないってのに、
不思議な奴らだぜ、まったく
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Otsuu, Little Mermaid.
I can't believe your words would
be so moving, too.

fields.EN:
Heh... You took what we
said to heart?
fields.JP:
はは、そんなに簡単に
僕たちを信じてくれるのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... You took what we
said to heart?

fields.EN:
At first, we were thinking of
looking for another core down
here.
fields.JP:
……最初はよ、俺たちはこのまま地下から
別の核を見つけようって決めてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first, we were thinking of
looking for another core down
here.

fields.EN:
You know how Hikari brought
you and Ningyohime to
convince us to follow you, right?
fields.JP:
けど、ヒカリがおまえと人魚姫を
連れてきてくれて、一緒に行こうって
言ってくれただろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how Hikari brought
you and Little Mermaid to
convince us to follow you, right?

fields.EN:
It was a bit forceful, but we
decided to follow you girls.
fields.JP:
あの時は強引だなと思いつつも、
説得されてついてきたわけだけどよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was a bit forceful, but we
decided to follow you girls.

fields.EN:
It felt like old friends were
trying to convince me,
so I decided to believe in you.
fields.JP:
その、なんつーかまるで
昔の仲間に説得された気持ちになってよ。
だからつい信じちまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It felt like old friends were
trying to convince me,
so I decided to believe in you.

fields.EN:
Yup, we're old friends all right!
Right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
うん、昔っから仲間なんだよ！
ね、おつうちゃん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, we're old friends all right!
Right, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
Yeah! I'm sure we were old
friends that helped each other
from before!
fields.JP:
ああ！　僕たちはきっと昔、
どこかで助け合って生きてきた
仲間なんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! I'm sure we were old
friends that helped each other
from before!

fields.EN:
Uh-huh, so what's with you
two holding hands all
happy and everything?
fields.JP:
ありゃりゃ、手ぇ取り合って
喜んじゃってまあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh-huh, so what's with you
two holding hands all
happy and everything?

fields.EN:
Speaking of... Hikari, how come
you brought Otsuu and Ningyohime to us?
fields.JP:
ところでヒカリは、どうしておつうと
人魚姫を連れてきてくれたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of... Hikari, how come
you brought Otsuu and Little
Mermaid to us?

fields.EN:
Those two came to me and said,
"We're definitely all going together."
fields.JP:
２人がね、私に声をかけてくれたの。
絶対みんなで行こう、って
fields.LOCALIZED:
They spoke with me, and we
decided to go see you together.

fields.EN:
I told them how I turned into an
angel, and they learned what
happened to everyone.
fields.JP:
私が天使になった経緯を知って、
マモルたちの状態も全部知って……
その上で言ってくれたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told them how I turned into an
angel, and they learned what
happened to everyone.

fields.EN:
Then they said that we should
all work together...
fields.JP:
『それなら尚更、
　みんなで手を取りあおうよ』って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then they said that we should
all work together...

fields.EN:
They were complete strangers,
but somehow they felt incredibly
familiar to me. That gave me hope.
fields.JP:
全然知らない人たちだったのに、
何かとても懐かしく感じちゃってね？
それで希望が湧いてきたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know who they were, but
their words were caring and
opened my eyes to hope.

fields.JP:
へっ、ヒカリもだったのか。
何か不思議だな

fields.EN:
I think everyone can tell now
that those two are very unique.
fields.JP:
あの２人が不思議な存在というのは、
みんな感じていることみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think everyone can tell now
that those two are very unique.

fields.EN:
Stop making it sound like you
were in the know from before...
fields.JP: 何をしたり顔で言ってんのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop making it sound like you
were in the know from before...

fields.EN:
I was simply giving an
observation...
fields.JP: 僕は客観的に意見を述べただけであって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was simply giving an
observation...

fields.EN:
I had my eyes on them before
they got big, ya know!
fields.JP:
自分、あいつらが売れる前から
ずっと目ぇつけてたんで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had my eyes on them before
they got big, ya know!

fields.EN:
Heh heh. Just like you to act
like you were the first
on the spot.
fields.JP:
あーいるいる。
前から知ってましたってアピールする奴
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh. Just like you to act
like you were the first
on the spot.

fields.EN:
Yeah, but it's not like we knew
them from before or anything.
fields.JP: ってか前からは知らねえだろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but it's not like we knew
them from before or anything.

fields.EN:
Hey, there you are!
We're all ready on our side!
fields.JP:
あ、いたいた！
みんな！　こっちは準備できたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, there you are!
We're all ready on our side!

fields.JP: じゃあみんな、僕たちも行こう！

fields.EN: I'll send everyone to the surface.
fields.JP:
それじゃあこれから、
みんなを地上に送るね
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll send everyone to the surface.

fields.JP: かみさまもいっしょにいく？

fields.EN:
Yup! I sure am!
Oh, but I'm not a "god," okay?
fields.JP:
うん！　一緒に行くよ！
それと、私は神様なんかじゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I sure am!
Oh, but I'm not a "god," okay?

fields.EN:
But the power you hold is akin
to that of a god...
fields.JP: ……でも、そう思えるくらいの素敵なチカラ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the power you hold is akin
to that of a god...

fields.EN:
Heh heh, so the curtains will
close on the old story to hail
the new story to come...
fields.JP:
ふふ、ついに旧い物語は幕を下ろし、
始まりの刻が巡ってきたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, so the curtains will
close on the old story to hail
the new story to come...

fields.EN:
Regardless of the new chapter
unfurling a new world, the sun
will set and rise as usual.
fields.JP:
新たに開いた頁の先に広がる世界が
どのような姿であろうと、
陽は沈み、また昇る……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless of the new chapter
unfurling a new world, the sun
will set and rise as usual.

fields.EN:
If so, there will always be a
fragment of hope hidden within
that world.
fields.JP:
そんな世界に、希望の欠片が潜まぬ筈がない
……そうでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, there will always be a
fragment of hope hidden within
that world.

fields.EN:
Yes! I'm sure it'll be a world
filled with hope! Everyone
already showed that to me!
fields.JP:
うん！　希望しかないよ、きっと！
私はそうみんなに教わったもん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! I'm sure it'll be a world
filled with hope! Everyone
already showed that to me!

fields.EN:
I want to bring sunlight to everyone
too... so I'll stay with Chii-chan and
keep watching over everyone. Okay?
fields.JP:
わたしも、みんなにお日様を
届けたいから……ちーちゃんとずっと
一緒に、みんなのことを見守るの。ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I deliver everyone to the
sun, Chii and I will watch over
everyone.

fields.EN: Yeah. Me too... with you, Nee-san...

fields.JP: ねー、ちじょうってどんなとこ？
今となっては、ここの誰もがわからないわね

fields.EN:
Otsuu, Ningyohime... Do you
know anything about the surface?
fields.JP:
おつうたちは地上について、
何か知ってたりしねえのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you don't really know
much about the surface, do you?

fields.EN:
I don't know that much
about the surface, though.
fields.JP: さすがに地上のことまで詳しくは知らないよ

fields.EN:
I can explain a lot about what's
down here, though.
fields.JP: むしろ地下の方ならとっても詳しいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can explain a lot about what's
down here, though.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan? Remembering what you went
through down here isn't going
to bring a smile to your face...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、そこで思い出して
へこまないでってば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? Remembering what you went
through down here isn't going
to bring a smile to your face...

fields.EN:
Well, I for one am interested in
what you went through, Tsuu.
fields.JP:
つう、後で地下の生活について詳しく
話を聞かせてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I for one am interested in
what you went through, Otsuu.

fields.EN: Quick to the subject as usual...
fields.JP: 相変わらず食いつきの早いことで……
fields.LOCALIZED: Quick to the subject as usual...

fields.EN:
Most humans hold fear of the
unknown, but in this case...
fields.JP:
まあ人間は『分からない』ものに
恐怖を覚えるものだが、今回は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most humans hold fear of the
unknown, but in this case...

fields.EN:
Right, we want to hurry and
see what's in store for us.
fields.JP: そうね、早くこの目で見てみたいって思うね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, we want to hurry and
see what's in store for us.

fields.EN:
Count us in, too.
That's why we're all going up
to the surface, right?
fields.JP:
同じく。
だから行くのよ。そうでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
