Count us in, too.
That's why we're all going up
to the surface, right?

fields.EN:
We're all together... so no matter what kind
of place it is, we'll be able to live there.
fields.JP:
みんなと一緒なんだから……
どんなところだって生きていけるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as we're together,
we can go anywhere.

fields.EN:
That's right, and don't forget who
trained all of you! We'll be able
to take on anything!
fields.JP:
そうだね。あたしの鍛えたみんなだもん。
そんじょそこらじゃ負けないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, and don't forget who
trained all of you! We'll be able
to take on anything!

fields.EN:
Ya know, as a newbie here, I'm
counting on ya Blood Maidens!
fields.JP:
新参者のあっしとしては、めっちゃ
頼りにしてまっせ、血式少女のみなはん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ya know, as a newbie here, I'm
counting on ya Blood Maidens!

fields.EN:
Yup, yup! Big Sis and all her Blood Maiden
friends will protect every last one of you!
fields.JP:
うんうん、みーんなまとめて
お姉さんと血式少女の仲間たちで
守ってあげるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, don't you worry!
"Sis and the Blood Maidens"
are here for everyone!

fields.EN:
Don't make up a group name
like that...!
fields.JP: 何だかそのグループ名は釈然としない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't make up a group name
like that...!

fields.JP: まあまあ、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
Oh my, I can't wait to see what
lies on the surface!
fields.JP:
それにしても本当に、
地上には何が待ってるのかしら。
ふふ、楽しみですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, I can't wait to see what
lies on the surface!

fields.EN:
I wonder what it's like, climbing
up to the sky to reach the
surface.
fields.JP:
地上に行くのに空へと昇るなんて……
どんな感じなんでしょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what it's like, climbing
up to the sky to reach the
surface.

fields.EN:
The new world will have its own
mysteries. Of course it's going
to be interesting there.
fields.JP:
新しい世界には、新しい謎がたくさん
あるはず……楽しくないわけがないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The new world will have its own
mysteries. Of course it's going
to be interesting there.

fields.JP: うんっ！　ラプンツェル、たのしみー！

fields.EN:
I experienced this once before...
I didn't expect to experynce it
again...
fields.JP:
ワレは一度、身をもって体験したこと……
二度も体験できりゅとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I experienced this once before...
I didn't expect to experynce yit
agayne...

fields.EN:
I-I didn't slyrr!
Unbelievable! You still say that
don't you?!
fields.JP:
か、噛んでなどおりゃにゅわ！！
久しぶりに会ったと思えば失礼な奴らめ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I didn't slyrr!
Unbelievable! You still say that
don't you?!

fields.EN:
I didn't believe we'd see the
day we'd be able to talk like this
again!
fields.JP:
またこうしてこのやり取りができるとは……
あたい感激だわ～～～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't believe we'd see the
day we'd be able to talk like this
again!

fields.EN: So you all met Hameln in this world too.
fields.JP:
みんなはこっちの世界でも
ハーメルンに会ってるんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good to know Hameln still
slurs in this world too.

fields.JP: ふふふ、じゃあみんないくよ

fields.EN:
Surface, eh...?
Well, here's to hoping we get
along up there, too!
fields.JP:
いよいよ地上か……
おまえら、向こうでもよろしくな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surface, eh...?
Well, here's to hoping we get
along up there, too!

fields.EN:
Of course!
We'll always be together!
fields.JP: もちろん！　みんな一緒だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course!
We'll always be together!

fields.EN:
Yes, and we're going to make
our way to a new future!
fields.JP: ああ！　みんなで未来を切り拓こう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and we're going to make
our way to a new future!

fields.EN: A new beginning to a new story...
fields.JP: 新しい物語の、始まりね……
fields.LOCALIZED: A new beginning to a new story...

fields.EN:
We're going to create a new story
with everyone...
fields.JP:
これからみんなで、新しい物語を
始めていくんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to create a new story
with everyone...

fields.EN:
But the end of one dream marks the
beginning of another.
fields.JP: けれど、夢の終わりは、別の夢の始まり
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the end of one dream marks the
beginning of another.

fields.EN:
You've heard that before, haven't
you?
fields.JP: ……誰かにそう聞いたことはないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've heard that before, haven't
you?

fields.EN: Can I bother you for a moment?
fields.LOCALIZED: Can I bother you for a moment?

fields.JP: ええ、入ってちょうだい

fields.EN:
(It feels a bit weird visiting her
like this...)
fields.JP:
（訪ねてみたはいいものの、改まって話すと
　なると、なんかくすぐったいな…）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It feels a bit weird visiting her
like this...)

fields.JP: その……新しい部屋はどう？

fields.EN:
Compared to the prison cell, much
better. Nothing could have been
worse than where we were.
fields.JP:
いいに決まってるわ。
なにしろ前は牢獄だったじゃない。
あれより悪いとこなんかないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Compared to the prison cell, much
better. Nothing could have been
worse than where we were.

fields.EN:
Y-You're right. Sorry for the
weird question.
fields.JP: そ、そうだね。変なこと聞いちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're right. Sorry for the
weird question.

fields.EN:
But, how can I word this...
Doesn't the place look drab?
fields.JP:
でも、なんだろう。
……まだ殺風景な感じがしない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, how can I word this...
Doesn't the place look drab?

fields.EN:
Yeah... It's your room now, so why
not decorate the place?
fields.JP:
うん。
折角の自分の部屋だし、
飾り付けしてみるのもいいんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It's your room now, so why
not decorate the place?

fields.EN: I'm not the type to decorate...
fields.JP:
……部屋を飾るだなんて、
そんなのわたしの柄じゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not the type to decorate...

fields.EN:
(Alice has always been indifferent
to things like that... I guess you
could say she's not very girly.)
fields.JP:
（アリスは昔からそういうとこ無頓着だよなあ。
　……女の子っぽくないっていうか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice never was into those kind
of things... I guess you could say
she's not into showcasing...)

fields.EN:
(Well, with what she's been
through, I don't blame her...)
fields.JP:
（環境が環境だったから、
　しょうがないのかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, with what she's been
through, I don't blame her...)

fields.EN: That aside, are you okay, Jack?
fields.JP:
……それより、ジャック。
傷はもういいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: That aside, are you okay, Jack?

fields.JP: うん。もうなんともないよ

fields.EN:
You know how quickly my bleeding
stops, right?
fields.JP:
アリスも以前から知ってるように、
僕は出血してもわりとすぐに止まるだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how quickly my bleeding
stops, right?

fields.EN:
Back then, not knowing why, whenever I
felt that heat deep inside, I'd blindly
bite your fingertip and lick your blood.
fields.JP:
昔は何もわからず、身体の奥がかあっとなると、
やみくもにあなたの指先に噛み付いて血を舐めて
いたりしたものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember those times I used to
feel angry, and I'd bite onto your
finger for your blood.

fields.EN:
Yeah, and then I just started to
cut my finger for you.
fields.JP:
僕もそのうち自分から指を切って
血を出したりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and then I just started to
cut my finger for you.

fields.EN:
I sucked on it almost like it was
a pacifier...
fields.JP: おしゃぶりするみたいに舐めさせてもらったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sucked on it almost like it was
a pacifier...

fields.EN:
Um... I-I mean, I had no weird
intentions when I did that, you
know?!
fields.JP:
……って、ち、違うわ！
そういう意味じゃなくて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I-I mean, I had no weird
intentions when I did that, you
know?!

fields.EN:
(Seeing Alice blush is making me
blush, too...)
fields.JP:
（アリスが赤くなるもんだから、
　僕もつられてしまった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seeing Alice blush is making me
blush, too...)

fields.EN:
Whatever the reason, licking your
blood seemed to calm me down. I
felt as if my anger melted away.
fields.JP:
あの頃から、あなたの血を舐めると
ほっとしたものだったわ。
猛る心が癒されていく感じがした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever the reason, licking your
blood seemed to calm me down. I
felt as if my anger melted away.

fields.EN:
I... always thought it was you who
was giving me that sense of reassurance...
fields.JP:
わたし……あなたが安心をくれているのだと
ばかり、思っていたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I've been reliant on you ever
since then...

fields.EN:
(I wonder if Alice is still
regretting going into Blood
Skelter...)
fields.JP:
（アリス……ブラッドスケルター化のこと、
　まだ悔やんでるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if Alice is still
regretting going into Blood
Skelter...)

fields.EN:
I told you we'd stop talking
about that, remember, Alice?
fields.JP:
もう、その話はやめようって言っただろ。
アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice? Why don't we stop the
conversation here?

fields.EN:
I'm actually proud that I've been
able to help you in some way.
fields.JP:
僕は、自分が君の役に立ててたってわかって、
すごく……誇らしいんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm actually proud that I've been
able to help you in some way.

fields.JP: ……誇らしいだなんて、変なジャック

fields.EN:
I really hated myself for not
being of any use...
fields.JP:
僕は、役立たずな自分のことが、
ほんとに嫌だったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really hated myself for not
being of any use...

fields.EN:
That's not true, not even a
little.
fields.JP:
あなたが役立たずだったことなんて、
一度もないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true, not even a
little.

fields.EN:
Let's just find our way out of
here together, okay?
fields.JP:
……だから、これからも一緒に……
ここを脱出しましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's just find our way out of
here together, okay?

fields.EN:
Alice... You're right. Let's
escape from here, together.
fields.JP:
アリス……。
そうだね……一緒に脱出しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... You're right. Let's
escape from here, together.

fields.EN:
Alice-san, that's one fine specimen
yer looking at!
fields.JP:
アリスさん。
それ、かなりの掘り出し物っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, that's one fine specimen
yer looking at!

fields.EN:
(What is she looking at? I've
never seen her so happy before...)
fields.JP:
（何を夢中になって見ているんだろう。
　あんな嬉しそうな顔、見たことないかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What is she looking at? I've
never seen her so happy before...)

fields.EN:
(I have to admit, this place is
always filled with weird stuff...)
fields.JP:
（それにしてもこの道具屋、いつ来ても
　わけのわからない物で溢れ返ってるなあ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to admit, this place is
always filled with weird stuff...)

fields.EN:
(I wonder where she gets the
supplies to stock up.)
fields.JP: （これだけの物、どこで仕入れて来るんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder where she gets the
supplies to stock up.)

fields.JP: あ、ジャックさん！　まいどっす！

fields.EN: Alice? What are you looking at?
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice? What are you looking at?

fields.JP:
（『ひゃっ』！？
　こ、こっちがびっくりした……）

fields.EN:
Heh... Looks like you finally
noticed. So, what were you looking
at?
fields.JP:
あはは……やっと気が付いた
何をそんなに真剣に見てたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Looks like you finally
noticed. So, what were you looking
at?

fields.EN:
Yeah. It's pretty old and it
doesn't look like it can be used
properly anymore.
fields.JP:
ええ。
まあ、だいぶボロボロだし、
使い物になるかどうかも怪しいってところね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. It's pretty old and it
doesn't look like it can be used
properly anymore.

fields.EN:
Rare wouldn't describe it. It's a
miracle that every piece is still
here in the set.
fields.JP:
珍しいなんてものじゃないわ。
１客も欠けていないだけでも奇跡なのに、
各種ポットもぜんぶ揃っているなんてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rare wouldn't describe it. It's a
miracle that every piece is still
here in the set.

fields.EN:
And, look at this line. It's not
often you see such a well-balanced
line like this.
fields.JP:
それに見て、このカップの子持ち線。
これだけの均等なラインを引いているのは
滅多にないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, look at this line. It's not
often you see such a well-balanced
line like this.

fields.EN:
(Even though she said it was
pretty old, she's talking about it
with such passion...)
fields.JP:
（さっきボロボロだって言ってたのに、
　随分と熱心に話すんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even though she said it was
pretty old, she's talking about it
with such passion...)

fields.EN:
(I didn't know Alice knew so much
about dishware...)
fields.JP:
（でも、アリスって……
　そんなに食器に詳しかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know Alice knew so much
about dishware...)

fields.EN:
I'm curious... Do you want it,
Alice?
fields.JP: もしかして……アリスはこれが欲しいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm curious... Do you want it,
Alice?

fields.EN:
Wh-What are you saying?
There's no meaning in buying a set
meant for five people. To start...
fields.JP:
な、なにを言ってるの。
こんなの５客もあったって意味ないでしょう。
だいたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What are you saying?
There's no meaning in buying a set
meant for five people. To start...

fields.EN:
N-Nevermind... Um, I'll see you
later...
fields.JP: も、もういいわ……それじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Nevermind... Um, I'll see you
later...

fields.EN:
(It sure looked like she wanted
it...)
fields.JP:
（どう見ても、欲しいようにしか
　見えないんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It sure looked like she wanted
it...)

fields.JP: えーと……これはいいものなの？

fields.EN:
Hey! Everything I've got here's
good stuff!
fields.JP:
むー。ウチに悪いものなんか、
いっこも置いてないっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Everything I've got here's
good stuff!

fields.EN:
Didn't ya hear Alice-san? That's one
rare find you ain't gonna see just
anywhere!
fields.JP:
それに、アリスさんの説明、
ちゃんと聞いてたっスか？
そうそうお目にかかれない掘り出し物っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't ya hear Alice? That's one
rare find you ain't gonna see just
anywhere!

fields.EN:
Then how about buying it
as a present for Alice-san?
fields.JP:
ここは一丁、
アリスさんへのプレゼントにどうっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how about you be a man and buy
it as a gift for Alice?

fields.JP: あ、ジャック。どうしたの？

fields.EN:
Well... I wanted to give this to
you.
fields.JP:
あのさ……これなんだけど。
受け取ってもらえるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... I wanted to give this to
you.

fields.JP:
ど、どうしたの、いきなり……
それに……これ……！

fields.EN:
It's what you were looking at back
at the store. I wanted to get it
for you, so...
fields.JP:
この間、君が道具屋で見てたやつだよ。
プレゼント、しようと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's what you were looking at back
at the store. I wanted to get it
for you, so...

fields.EN:
No, that's not it... Why did you
get it for me?
fields.JP: そうじゃなくて、どうしてわたしに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's not it... Why did you
get it for me?

fields.EN:
You know how I'm weak and can't
fight? Without you, I wouldn't
have made it this far.
fields.JP:
僕は弱っちくて、戦闘もからきしダメだし、
君がいなければとっくに死んでたかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how I'm weak and can't
fight? Without you, I wouldn't
have made it this far.

fields.EN:
Why I'm still alive, and why I
wanted to fight alongside everyone
was because of you, Alice.
fields.JP:
そんな僕が今まで生きてこられたのも、
一緒に戦おうって思えるようになったのも、
みんなアリスのおかげなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why I'm still alive, and why I
wanted to fight alongside everyone
was because of you, Alice.

fields.EN:
So this is, um... A thank you
gift, sort of?
fields.JP: だから、その……、お礼、みたいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is, um... A thank you
gift, sort of?

fields.EN:
When I saw the tea set, I felt an
urge to have a tea party. And I
suddenly knew things about it...
fields.JP:
販売所でこのティーセットを見かけたとき、
なぜかお茶会を開きたいって気持ちが湧いて……
知りもしないはずの、茶器の知識まで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I saw the tea set, I felt an
urge to have a tea party. And I
suddenly knew things about it...

fields.EN:
I was trying to figure out how I
knew so much, and ended up just
staring at it.
fields.JP:
何故なのだろう、と思って、
ついこれをじっと見てしまったの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was trying to figure out how I
knew so much, and ended up just
staring at it.

fields.EN:
(That sounds almost like the
strange urge I have...)
fields.JP:
（それ……僕のわけのわからない衝動と
　同じようなものなのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That sounds almost like the
strange urge I have...)

fields.EN:
And, I was also thinking of being
able to drink tea with you one
day...
fields.JP:
でも……
いつか、これであなたとお茶を飲めたら
いいなって思っていたの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I was also thinking of being
able to drink tea with you one
day...

fields.EN: Do you remember this hair pin?
fields.JP: 覚えてるかしら？　この髪留め……
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you remember this hair pin?

fields.EN:
Yeah. The one I gave to you a long
time ago, right?
fields.JP: ……うん。昔、僕があげたもの、だよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. The one I gave to you a long
time ago, right?

fields.EN:
Yes. It's the very first thing you
gave me, Jack. You can't imagine
how happy I was.
fields.JP:
ええ。ジャックがいちばん最初にくれたものよ。
……とても嬉しかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It's the very first thing you
gave me, Jack. You can't imagine
how happy I was.

fields.EN:
In fact, I'm always happy that you
keep looking after me.
fields.JP:
あなたがわたしを気にかけてくれていること、
いつも嬉しかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I'm always happy that you
keep looking after me.

fields.EN:
Jack... You are the one who
supports me.
fields.JP:
ジャック、
あなたこそわたしを支えてくれてるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... You are the one who
supports me.

fields.EN: Stop it... You're making me blush.
fields.JP: なんか、そう言われると照れちゃうな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop it... You're making me blush.

fields.EN:
I might not look good with this
hair pin, but I wear it so I don't
forget what you've done for me.
fields.JP:
わたしなんかには似合わないかもしれないけど、
この髪留めをつけてるのは、あなたへの
感謝の気持ちを忘れないためでもあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I might not look good with this
hair pin, but I wear it so I don't
forget what you've done for me.

fields.EN:
Oh, come on! You look good with
it on!
fields.JP:
似合わないだなんて！
そんなことないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on! You look good with
it on!

fields.EN:
Really! I think it looks perfect
on you. I'm happy that you have it
with you all the time.
fields.JP:
ほんとに！　君にぴったりだと思うよ。
君がいつもつけててくれて、僕だって嬉しいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really! I think it looks perfect
on you. I'm happy that you have it
with you all the time.

fields.JP:
そうなの……？
その……ありがとう

fields.EN:
Once we escape from the Jail, we
should have a tea party. No, we
can even have one right now!
fields.JP:
それから、ジェイルを脱出したら、
このティーセットでお茶会を開こうよ。
いや、いますぐだって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we escape from the Jail, we
should have a tea party. No, we
can even have one right now!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Now, that's a bit too
soon.
fields.JP: ふふ。それはまだ早すぎるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Now, that's a bit too
soon.

fields.EN:
Jack, thank you... I really
couldn't be happier.
fields.JP:
ジャック。
ありがとう、嬉しいわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, thank you... I really
couldn't be happier.

fields.EN: I'm happy to see you happy.
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm happy to see you happy.

fields.EN:
(Seeing her this happy was worth
it.)
fields.JP:
（こんなに喜んでもらえるなんて、
　……やっぱりあげてよかったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seeing her this happy was worth
it.)

fields.EN:
That's what I wanted to ask you.
You locked yourself up in your
room right after you returned.
fields.JP:
どうしたの、じゃないわ。
戻るなり、すぐ部屋に閉じ篭って
しまうし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I wanted to ask you.
You locked yourself up in your
room right after you returned.

fields.EN:
You look pale... Are you all
right?
fields.LOCALIZED:
You look pale... Are you all
right?

fields.EN:
Really? I don't think there's
anything wrong with me.
fields.JP:
そうかな？
いつも通りだと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? I don't think there's
anything wrong with me.

fields.EN:
(I'm a little anemic, but I
can't let her worry about me...)
fields.JP:
（少し貧血気味だけど、
　心配させるわけにはいかないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sure I feel a bit dizzy, but it's
nothing for Alice to be worried
about...)

fields.EN:
It sure doesn't look like you're
okay...
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sure doesn't look like you're
okay...

fields.EN:
(I can't let Alice see through me
now... I need to be the one to
protect her...)
fields.JP:
（弱気なところを悟られてはダメだ。
　今度は僕がアリスを守らなきゃ
　いけないんだから…）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't let Alice see through me
now... I need to be the one to
protect her...)

fields.EN:
Maybe you've been overexerting
yourself too frequently.
fields.JP: 最近、少し無理しすぎではないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe you've been overexerting
yourself too frequently.

fields.EN:
It's just that I can't be resting
all the time while you're out there
fighting, Alice.
fields.JP:
それに、アリスたちが必死に戦っているのに、
僕だけ休んでもいられないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I can't be resting
all the time while you're out there
fighting, Alice.

fields.EN:
So there's nothing to worry about.
You're such a worrywart, Alice.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、心配要らないよ。
アリスは心配性だなあ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So there's nothing to worry about.
You're such a worrywart, Alice.

fields.EN:
As long as you're okay, I'm fine.
I'll see you later, then...
fields.JP:
……そう、大丈夫ならいいわ。
それじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you're okay, I'm fine.
I'll see you later, then...

fields.EN:
(I was only trying to ease her
worries, but did I do it
wrong...?)
fields.JP:
（安心させようと思っただけなんだけど、
　何か、間違えちゃったかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was only trying to ease her
worries, but did I do it
wrong...?)

fields.EN:
(She looks like she's in a bad
mood...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks like she's in a bad
mood...)

fields.EN:
Um... I'm sorry about the other day.
You were so worried about me that
I just wanted to reassure you...
fields.JP:
その……この間はごめん。
君があんまり心配するから、
安心させようと思ったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, about last time... I'm sorry
if it sounded rude. I just wanted
to keep you from worrying.

fields.JP: 安心なんかできないわ！！

fields.EN:
I'm fighting out there for
everyone, for myself, and... for
you.
fields.JP:
わたしは……わたしは戦ってる。
みんなのため、わたしのため、
あなたのため……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fighting out there for
everyone, for myself, and... for
you.

fields.EN:
Jack... If you get hurt, or
worse... then all that fighting
would mean nothing!
fields.JP:
ジャック。
あなたがもし倒れたら、
わたしが戦う意味なんてなくなるの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... If you get hurt, or
worse... then all that fighting
would mean nothing!

fields.EN:
Please! Please don't overdo it...
I want to support you just as much
as you want to support me.
fields.JP:
お願い、もう無理はしないで。
あなたがわたしの支えであるように、
わたしもあなたの支えになっていたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please! Please don't overdo it...
I want to support you just as much
as you want to support me.

fields.EN:
If you're tired or hurt, let me
know. At least rely on me when
we're together!
fields.JP:
キツいときは言って。
せめて二人のときくらいはわたしを頼って……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're tired or hurt, let me
know. At least rely on me when
we're together!

fields.EN:
(I've never seen Alice like this
before...)
fields.JP: （アリスがこんな顔をするのは初めてだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen Alice like this
before...)

fields.EN:
I'd completely convinced myself I was
a burden. Even if you tell me now I'm
not, it's hard for me to believe it...
fields.JP:
僕はすっかり自分がお荷物だと思ってた
いまさら違うって言われても、なかなか
そう思えなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept thinking I was a burden,
and I still do.

fields.EN:
Ever since I was little, I've been
relying on you, and I kept making
matters worse in battle...
fields.JP:
小さいときから君に頼り切っていて、
戦いでも足手まといで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since I was little, I've been
relying on you, and I kept making
matters worse in battle...

fields.EN:
Now that I can finally help, I
just want to hold a stronger
front and tell you it's my turn.
fields.JP:
……ようやく君の役に立てると思って、
今度は僕が君を助ける番だって思って、
強がってみせてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I can finally help, I
just want to hold a stronger
front and tell you it's my turn.

fields.EN:
But, you're right... If things get
tough, I'll rely on you. If things
are fun, I'll share them with you.
fields.JP:
……そうだよ。
つらいことがあれば、君に頼る。
楽しいことがあれば、君と分かち合う
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you're right... If things get
tough, I'll rely on you. If things
are fun, I'll share them with you.

fields.EN:
Now that I think about it, I can't
believe I haven't been doing
that already...
fields.JP:
それだけのこと、
どうして僕はできなかったんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I think about it, I can't
believe I haven't been doing
that already...

fields.EN:
Even after being with you for so
long...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even after being with you for so
long...

fields.EN:
(I should have opened up to her
to begin with...)
fields.JP:
（……最初から、ちゃんと話せば
　よかったんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should have opened up to her
to begin with...)

fields.EN:
Wh-What are you saying? There's
no need to thank me.
fields.JP:
な、なに言ってるの。
お礼なんか言う必要ないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What are you saying? There's
no need to thank me.

fields.EN:
Promise me that you're not going
to bear so much of a burden on
yourself.
fields.JP:
でも、約束よ。
我慢するのは、もうやめて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Promise me that you're not going
to bear so much of a burden on
yourself.

fields.EN:
(I didn't know Alice's hands were
so small and warm, and... so
reliable...)
fields.JP:
（アリスの手、こんなに温かかったんだ。
　それに……小さいのに、頼もしい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know Alice's hands were
so small and warm, and... so
reliable...)

fields.EN:
(I've never noticed this about
her. I guess I haven't changed
much since I was a kid...)
fields.JP:
（そんなことにも気がつかなかったなんて、
　僕は、ほんとうに子供だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never noticed this about
her. I guess I haven't changed
much since I was a kid...)

fields.EN:
Okay, but that applies to you,
too.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, but that applies to you,
too.

fields.JP: ……中央の塔もだいぶ高くなってきたね

fields.EN:
Yes. It makes the moon look eerier
than ever. As if it's beckoning
the Tower toward it...
fields.JP:
ええ。
そのぶん月の輝きが、殊更不気味に感じるわね。
まるで塔を手招きしているような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It makes the moon look eerier
than ever. As if it's beckoning
the Tower toward it...

fields.EN:
It also seems like it knows the
Jail's desires...
fields.JP:
ジェイルの欲求をわかってるみたいなのも、
なんだか気味が悪いし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also seems like it knows the
Jail's desires...

fields.EN:
But the Professor said that we're
just about ready to escape from
here.
fields.JP:
……でもさ、博士が言ってたよね。
脱獄できる目処はついてきたって。
……もう、間もなくだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Professor said that we're
just about ready to escape from
here.

fields.EN:
We're a lot stronger now, and we
can face the Marchens and the
Nightmare on level ground!
fields.JP:
僕らもさ、
メルヒェンたちにも手こずらなくなってきたし、
ナイトメアにだって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're a lot stronger now, and we
can face the Marchens and the
Nightmare on level ground!

fields.EN:
True. I think we're a lot more
adept in battle now. You're a lot
more reliable than before, too.
fields.JP:
そうね。戦いにも慣れてきたと思うわ。
……あなたもだいぶ逞しくなってきたと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. I think we're a lot more
adept in battle now. You're a lot
more reliable than before, too.

fields.EN:
You stay calm, even when we enter
Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
わたしたちがブラッドスケルター化しても、
冷静に対応できるようになったじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You stay calm, even when we enter
Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
I guess I'm not as panicky as
before. So, I'm really acting
calmer, then?
fields.JP:
……確かに以前はすぐパニクってたかもしれないな。
今は結構、冷静にできてる……よね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I'm not as panicky as
before. So, I'm really acting
calmer, then?

fields.EN:
*giggle*... Don't let it go to
your head.
fields.JP: ふふ。過信は禁物だけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... Don't let it go to
your head.

fields.EN:
(But Alice is right. I should stay
focused. There's no telling what
might happen.)
fields.JP:
（でも、アリスの言う通り、過信は禁物だ。
　まだ何が起きるかわからないんだから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But Alice is right. I should stay
focused. There's no telling what
might happen.)

fields.EN:
Is the Jail's wailing still
bugging you?
fields.JP: ……ジェイルの鳴き声は、相変わらず煩いの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is the Jail's wailing still
bugging you?

fields.EN:
As usual. But the headphones help
muffle the sound, so it's not as
bad as before.
fields.JP:
相変わらず、かな。
ヘッドホンのお陰でほとんど気にならないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
As usual. But the headphones help
muffle the sound, so it's not as
bad as before.

fields.EN:
You wear them here too sometimes,
but can you hear us? I see you put
them on when there are arguments.
fields.JP:
……あなた時々、ここでもそれを着けてるけれど
人の声も遮ることができるの？
思えば、誰かしら揉めてる時が多いような……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You wear them here too sometimes,
but can you hear us? I see you put
them on when there are arguments.

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh, it's not like I'm wearing
them to avoid getting into
arguments and things...
fields.JP:
え？　ぼ、僕は別に、
みんなの口喧嘩に巻き込まれたくないとか、
そんな風に思ってるわけじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh, it's not like I'm wearing
them to avoid getting into
arguments and things...

fields.EN: Hm? Who said anything about that?
fields.JP:
あら。
誰もそんなことを言ってはいないのだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Who said anything about that?

fields.EN:
You can be mean sometimes,
Alice...
fields.JP: もう。アリスは意地悪だなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can be mean sometimes,
Alice...

fields.EN:
I keep an ear out for anything
important, and I'm always
listening to you, Alice.
fields.JP:
でも、大事な話はちゃんと聞いてるし、
アリスの言葉はいつだって、
聞き逃さないようにしてるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I keep an ear out for anything
important, and I'm always
listening to you, Alice.

fields.EN:
You know, I'm able to fight like
this because of you, Jack.
fields.JP:
……ジャック。
あなたがいたからここまで戦って来れたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, I'm able to fight like
this because of you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Where did that come from? I think
you're doing great because
everyone's working as a team.
fields.JP:
どうしたの、いきなり？
そんなの、みんなが力を合わせてるからだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where did that come from? I think
you're doing great because
everyone's working as a team.

fields.EN:
Heh... That sounds so like you.
But really, it's because of you.
Thank you.
fields.JP:
ふふ。そういうところは相変わらずね。
……ほんとうに、あなたのお陰なのよ。
ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... That sounds so like you.
But really, it's because of you.
Thank you.

fields.JP:
……僕だって、同じだよ。
ありがとう、アリス

fields.EN:
Say, what are you going to do when
you get to the surface?
fields.JP:
ねえ。
地上に出られたら、ジャックはどうするの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, what are you going to do when
you get to the surface?

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'll probably stroll around
the area or something.
fields.JP:
うーん。
まずはそこらじゅう、見て回りたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'll probably stroll around
the area or something.

fields.EN:
After all, we don't know what the
world is like on the surface.
fields.JP:
塔の上にどんな世界があるのか、
僕たちは何も知らないんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, we don't know what the
world is like on the surface.

fields.EN:
I'm sure there's a lot to see and
do once we get up there.
fields.JP:
きっと、わくわくするような世界が広がって
るんじゃないかって、思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure there's a lot to see and
do once we get up there.

fields.EN:
What's the matter? You're going to
be with me, too!
fields.JP:
……どうしたの？
その時は、アリスも一緒に行こうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter? You're going to
be with me, too!

fields.JP:
わたしも……？
一緒に行っても……いいの？

fields.EN:
Well, unless there's something
else you wanted to do.
fields.JP:
あ……君が別のことをしたいんじゃなければ、
の話だけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, unless there's something
else you wanted to do.

fields.EN:
No... I want to see the world up
there with you!
fields.JP:
そんな……
わたし、あなたと一緒に世界を見たいわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... I want to see the world up
there with you!

fields.EN:
We're going to climb that tower
and get to the surface. Then we're
going to see the world together.
fields.JP:
僕たちは生き延びて、あの塔を昇って、
地上に出るんだ。
そして一緒に世界中を見て回る……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to climb that tower
and get to the surface. Then we're
going to see the world together.

fields.JP:
……ね？
今からわくわくすると思わない？

fields.EN:
Yes... It sounds like a dream come
true.
fields.JP:
……ええ、そうね。
まるで、夢のようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... It sounds like a dream come
true.

fields.EN:
It isn't a dream. I'm sure it'll
happen soon.
fields.JP:
夢じゃないんだ。
きっと、もうすぐ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It isn't a dream. I'm sure it'll
happen soon.

fields.JP:
そうね。
きっと、もうすぐ……

fields.EN:
(That's right... We're going to
escape from here, together.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ。
　もうすぐ僕たちは、ここを脱出するんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... We're going to
escape from here, together.)

fields.JP: （あれ、あそこにいるのはもしかして？）

（やっぱり、アリスだ。
　でも、一緒にいるのは……）

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel...? That's unusual. I
never see those two together...)
fields.JP:
（……ラプンツェル、だよね？
　ふたりでいるなんて、珍しい気が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel...? That's unusual. I
never see those two together...)

fields.JP:
あのね、ラプンツェル。
それは食べ物ではないの

うー？
たべものだよー？

fields.EN:
You found it on the ground. It's 
not good to eat.
fields.JP:
道ばたで拾ったものでしょう？
食べるものではありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
You found it on the ground. It's 
not good to eat.

fields.JP: じゃあ、ありすがたべる！

そー。ありすがたべる！
もったいないの！

fields.EN:
Waste... Well, I guess it would be
wasteful, but...
fields.JP:
もったいない……
もったいないのかもしれないけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Waste... Well, I guess it would be
wasteful, but...

fields.EN:
Listen, Rapunzel. You're not
supposed to eat things that fell
on the ground.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、いいこと？
落ちているものは食べてはいけないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen, Rapunzel. You're not
supposed to eat things that fell
on the ground.

fields.EN:
Aww... If Alice no eat, Rapunzel
gonna eat! Food is food!
fields.JP:
えー。ありすがたべないなら
ラプンツェルがたべるー！
たべものはたべものなのーーーー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aww... If Alice no eat, Rapunzel
gonna eat! Food is food!

fields.JP: ありすわかんないーーー

fields.EN:
Um... You look like you need some
help.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You look like you need some
help.

fields.JP:
じゃーっくーーーー！！
あのねありすがねーー！

fields.EN: She's a handful, that's for sure.
fields.LOCALIZED: She's a handful, that's for sure.

fields.EN:
I saw that you were having
trouble, but why are you two
together in the first place?
fields.JP:
困ってるのは見えたけど……
君たちだけで一緒だなんて、どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I saw that you were having
trouble, but why are you two
together in the first place?

fields.EN:
I thought it would help for her to
get out of her room and take a
walk outside.
fields.JP:
気晴らしになるかと思って散歩させてたのよ。
部屋に閉じ篭りっぱなしも良くないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought it would help for her to
get out of her room and take a
walk outside.

fields.EN:
But I didn't want her to walk
around by herself. There's no
telling what she would do.
fields.JP:
かといってひとりだけじゃ、
何をしでかすかわかったものじゃないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I didn't want her to walk
around by herself. There's no
telling what she would do.

fields.JP:
これ！
じゃっくたべる！

fields.EN:
(Whoa... What is this...? Forget
it being food or not, I'm not even
sure what it's made of...)
fields.JP:
（うわあ……なんだこれ……
　食べ物どころか成分もわからないもの
　渡されちゃったよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa... What is this...? Forget
it being food or not, I'm not even
sure what it's made of...)

fields.EN: Um, and the wall! So tasty!
fields.JP:
あのね。それでね。
かべ！
おいしかった！
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, and the wall! So tasty!

fields.EN: Stop talking about the Jail walls.
fields.JP: ジェイルの壁の話はやめなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop talking about the Jail walls.

fields.EN:
How about Nightmare? That was
good, too!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ないとめあ？
あれもおいしかった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about Nightmare? That was
good, too!

fields.JP: （さすがに食べてないと思うよ……）
じゃっくもおいしかった！

fields.EN:
Wait a minute! When did you eat
Jack?!
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って！
いつジャックを食べたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute! When did you eat
Jack?!

fields.JP:
やめて！
僕は食べ物じゃないよ！

fields.EN:
He's right, Rapunzel. He's not
food. Let him go.
fields.JP:
そうよ、ラプンツェル。
それは食べるものじゃないの。
離れなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right, Rapunzel. He's not
food. Let him go.

fields.EN: How come I can't eat him?
fields.JP: どうしてたべちゃだめなの？
fields.LOCALIZED: How come I can't eat him?

fields.JP: アリスのものだからだよ

fields.EN:
Mmm... Alice should eat Alice's
stuff.
fields.JP:
そっかー。
ありすのものはありすがたべる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Alice should eat Alice's
stuff.

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san... Can you please
stop saying meaningless things
like that?
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん、意味のわからない冗談は
ほどほどにしていただけるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood... Can you please
stop saying meaningless things
like that?

fields.EN:
Oooh! Scary... Don't go into Blood
Skelter on me now...
fields.JP:
おーこわ。
こんなところで『覚醒』されちゃかなわないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oooh! Scary... Don't go into Blood
Skelter on me now...

fields.EN:
Rapu, come over here. Let Big
Sister get you some super sweet
treats for you.
fields.JP:
ラプ、こっちおいで。
お姉さんがとびっきり甘いお菓子をあげよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, come over here. Let Big
Sister get you some super sweet
treats for you.

fields.EN:
Well, see you two around. Thanks
for keeping watch over her.
fields.JP:
じゃあね、おふたりさん。
子守り、ご苦労様～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, see you two around. Thanks
for keeping watch over her.

fields.EN:
Whew... She was more obnoxious
than I expected.
fields.JP:
ふう。
ほんとに騒々しいったらありゃしないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... She was more obnoxious
than I expected.

fields.EN:
I just thought that you looked
like you were having fun, despite
what you just said.
fields.JP:
いや、迷惑っぽく言うわりには、
けっこう楽しそうに見えたなあと思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just thought that you looked
like you were having fun, despite
what you just said.

fields.EN:
W-Well, I suppose it wouldn't hurt
to have experiences like that
sometimes.
fields.JP:
ま、まあ……
たまには、こういうのも悪くはないかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I suppose it wouldn't hurt
to have experiences like that
sometimes.

fields.EN:
But, only sometimes. If I had to
go through that all the time, I'm
not sure I could make it.
fields.JP:
……たまには、よ。
いつもこれじゃ先が思いやられるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, only sometimes. If I had to
go through that all the time, I'm
not sure I could make it.

fields.EN:
Ahaha. You don't have to insist—I
know. Like how Alice actually
likes taking care of people...
fields.JP:
あはは。
念を押さなくてもわかってるって。
アリスが実は世話好きなこととか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Of course I know you'd
never be the type to look after
others, so no need to tell me.

fields.JP: か……からかうのはやめて頂戴

fields.EN:
(I suppose something like this is
good sometimes.)
fields.JP: （ほんとに、こういうのも悪くないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose something like this is
good sometimes.)

fields.EN:
(Now that I've had a good look
around, her room seems a lot
cleaner than before.)
fields.JP:
（ふふっ。
　それにしてもここに来た頃に比べると
　随分部屋も綺麗になったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that I've had a good look
around, her room seems a lot
cleaner than before.)

fields.EN:
(Back then the room looked pretty
drab, and she had her clothes all
over the place.)
fields.JP:
（あの頃はほんと殺風景な部屋で、
　服もそこらに放りっぱなしだったし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Back then the room looked pretty
drab, and she had her clothes all
over the place.)

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, what is this
soapy smell...?)
fields.JP:
（そう言えば、
　さっきからしてるこの香りは石けん！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, what is this
soapy smell...?)

fields.EN:
Jack! Are you all right?! You're
bleeding!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　大丈夫！？
血が出てるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Are you all right?! You're
bleeding!

fields.JP: だ、大丈夫だよ、これくらいなら……

ア……アリス！！
な、なにをして……

fields.EN:
What do you mean what? I'm licking
your wound.
fields.JP: なにって、傷口を舐めてあげ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean what? I'm licking
your wound.

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... It's just an old
habit...
fields.JP: ご、ごめんなさい。つい昔の癖で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... It's just an old
habit...

fields.EN:
No! I'm the one who should apologize! You
didn't answer and I came in anyway. I'm sorry!
fields.JP:
いや！
謝らなきゃならないのはこっちだよ！
返事もないのに勝手に入ってごめん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! I'm the one who should
apologize! I'm sorry for coming in
without letting you know first!

fields.EN:
I mean, sure we used to share the
same cell for a long time, but now
we're in separate rooms!
fields.JP:
そりゃ、小さい時から同じ監獄に放り込まれて
たけど、部屋も今は別々なんだし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, sure we used to share the
same cell for a long time, but now
we're in separate rooms!

fields.EN:
It was insensitive of me to
forget, and saying I lack common
sense is an understatement...!
fields.JP:
だいたい僕は鈍感っていうか、
デリカシーに欠けると言うか、
気遣いができなくて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was insensitive of me to
forget, and saying I lack common
sense is an understatement...!

fields.EN:
Like, I need to be respectful of
everyone! Wow, if only I could've
told myself earlier! Um, sorry!
fields.JP:
親しき仲にも礼儀ありって言うよね！
まったく、さっきの僕に言ってやりたいよ！！
ほんとごめん……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, I need to be respectful of
everyone! Wow, if only I could've
told myself earlier! Um, sorry!

fields.EN:
W-Wait... If you apologize that
much, it makes things awkward for me too.
fields.JP: ……そんなに謝られるとわたしも困るわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You don't need to make so many
excuses...

fields.EN:
It's my fault, too. I shouldn't be
walking around with just a towel
over me, even it is my room.
fields.JP:
い……いくら自分の部屋だからって、
お風呂からあがってタオル一枚で
ふらつくものじゃないもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's my fault, too. I shouldn't be
walking around with just a towel
over me, even it is my room.

fields.EN:
Um... I'm sorry if I made this all
feel awkward...
fields.JP: その……気まずい思いをさせてごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I'm sorry if I made this all
feel awkward...

fields.EN:
(Huh?! I'm pretty sure it's all my
fault for coming in like this...)
fields.JP:
（ええ！？
　悪いのは全面的に僕のほうだと
　思うんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh?! I'm pretty sure it's all my
fault for coming in like this...)

fields.JP: いや、アリスが謝るようなことはないよ！

fields.EN: But, I did make you feel bad...
fields.JP:
でも……
あなたに不快な思いをさせてしまったのだし……
fields.LOCALIZED: But, I did make you feel bad...

fields.EN:
(Well, not really... Wait... What
am I thinking?!)
fields.JP:
（不快ってことは全然ないんだけどな……
　って、何考えてるんだ僕は！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, not really... Wait... What
am I thinking?!)

fields.EN:
I don't want you to stop coming
because of this...
fields.JP:
こんなことであなたが、その、
あまり来てくれなくなるのは嫌だなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want you to stop coming
because of this...

fields.JP: 大丈夫、そんなことはないから！

fields.EN:
Yes! I'll be sure to knock until
you actually answer, though.
Okay?
fields.JP:
うん。今度からはちゃんとノックの返事を
確認してから入るよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! I'll be sure to knock until
you actually answer, though.
Okay?

fields.EN:
So, um... could you put some
clothes on? I'll turn around...
fields.JP:
だからその……服、着てくれないかな？
あっち向いてるからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, so... Do you mind putting your
clothes on? My neck is starting to
hurt...

fields.EN:
I'm telling you that you lack
common sense and a sense of ethics.
fields.JP:
だから、あなたには常識や倫理観と言うものが
欠けていると言っているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So, I'm telling you that you
lack common sense and logic.

fields.EN:
There's no value in needlessly
criticizing others.
fields.JP:
無闇に他人を批判したって、得るものなんか
無いでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no value in needlessly
criticizing others.

fields.JP: （アリスと…グレーテルが言い争ってる？）

fields.EN:
I can obtain valuable data through
the reactions from the criticism.
Very fundamental to my analyses.
fields.JP:
批判し、その反応を見ることで、
判断するのに必要なデータが得られるわ。
観察と分析は初歩の初歩よ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can obtain valuable data through
the reactions from the criticism.
Very fundamental to my analyses.

fields.EN:
Even so, you need to read the air
around you, too.
fields.JP:
それにしても、
その場の雰囲気とか流れとかあるでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, you need to read the air
around you, too.

fields.EN:
Oh? It's a fundamental rule to
eliminate extraneous factors. Forget
that, and you'll make a fatal mistake.
fields.JP:
あら？　夾雑物は排除するのが鉄則よ。
それを忘れると、致命的な間違いを犯すわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Allowing unsubstantial variables
to interfere often leads to
negative consequences.

fields.EN:
So tell me, what kind of
consequences occur when you
read the air around you?
fields.JP:
少しくらい空気を読んだところで、
どんな致命的なことが起きるって言うのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So tell me, what kind of
consequences occur when you
read the air around you?

fields.EN:
Oh, my... I know of humans who
entered my home and died from
"reading the air."
fields.JP:
ふふ。起きるわよ？
かつて私の家に侵入してきた人間たちは、
あなたの言う空気を読んで死んでいったもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, my... I know of humans who
entered my home and died from
"reading the air."

fields.EN:
I have no intention of dying like
them.
fields.JP: 私はまだ死ぬつもりはないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention of dying like
them.

fields.EN:
That leads to me taking action as
needed. I see no problem in taking
steps to ensure my survival.
fields.JP:
だから私は観察し、判断し、行動する。
生きるために最善を選ぶのに何の躊躇があって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That leads to me taking action as
needed. I see no problem in taking
steps to ensure my survival.

fields.EN:
So are you saying that, if you
don't have the funds, you'll take
things for your own survival?
fields.JP:
じゃああなたは、もしお金がなければ、
生きるためなら欲しいモノを勝手に奪い取って
いいと思っているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So are you saying that, if you
don't have the funds, you'll take
things for your own survival?

fields.EN:
But, it's a common rule to
purchase things with money!
fields.JP:
欲しいモノがあったらお金で買うのがルール
じゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it's a common rule to
purchase things with money!

fields.EN:
Girls, it's okay now. She didn't
really dine and dash or anything...
fields.JP:
お姉ちゃんたち、もういいよ～。
ホントに食い逃げされたワケじゃないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, it's okay... She really didn't
try to leave without paying the
bill or anything...

fields.EN:
(All that talk over not paying a
bill?! Well, I guess it is a
problem, but...)
fields.JP:
（深刻な話だと思ったら、食い逃げ未遂！？
　いやまあ……深刻っちゃ深刻だけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All that talk over not paying a
bill?! Well, I guess it is a
problem, but...)

fields.EN:
Um, you're both scaring my
customers away, standing there
like that...
fields.JP:
そこで立ってられると、
お客さんが怖がって寄ってくれないからさ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you're both scaring my
customers away, standing there
like that...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh, heh, you're pretty hard-
headed, aren't you?
fields.JP: ふふふ、大した堅物なのね、あなた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh, heh, you're pretty hard-
headed, aren't you?

fields.EN:
Wouldn't you say we're breaking
the Jail's rules? Should we abide
by its expectations?
fields.JP:
ジェイル全体からすれば、私たちが脱獄しようと
していることもルール違反ではないのかしら？
あなたはそのルールにも従うべきだと思うの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't you say we're breaking
the Jail's rules? Should we abide
by its expectations?

fields.EN:
You're mixing up two separate
topics here.
fields.JP: それとこれと一緒にするほうがどうかしてるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're mixing up two separate
topics here.

fields.EN: On what are you basing that claim?
fields.JP:
一緒にしてはいけないとすれば、
その根拠はどこにあるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: On what are you basing that claim?

fields.JP: あきれてものが言えない……

fields.EN:
(Despite the way Alice is looking
right now, it almost seems as if
she's enjoying this...)
fields.JP:
（アリスってば頭抱えてるけど、
　そんなに嫌っているわけでもなさそうだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite the way Alice is looking
right now, it almost seems as if
she's enjoying this...)

fields.EN:
(Gretel looks like she's enjoying
this interaction, too...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルのほうはじゃれてるようにも
　見えるし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel looks like she's enjoying
this interaction, too...)

fields.EN:
Oh, Jack. What are you doing
there? Come and join our
conversation.
fields.JP:
あら、ジャック。
そんなとこにいないで、こっちに来なさいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Jack. What are you doing
there? Come and join our
conversation.

fields.EN:
Jack?! How long have you been
here?!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack?! How long have you been
here?!

fields.EN:
You heard what we were talking
about, right? You know who's right
here, don't you?
fields.JP:
話、聞こえてたでしょう？
ジャックなら、どちらが正しいことを
言ってるか、わかるわよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard what we were talking
about, right? You know who's right
here, don't you?

fields.EN:
Gretel keeps coming up with excuse
after excuse...
fields.JP:
グレーテルったら、次から次へと
屁理屈ばかりで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel keeps coming up with excuse
after excuse...

fields.EN:
Um, well... It just looked like
you two were getting along, so...
fields.JP:
え、いや、その…
ぼ、僕から見ると、二人は割と
仲いいのかなあって…
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... It just looked like
you two were getting along, so...

fields.EN: You've got to be kidding me!
fields.LOCALIZED: You've got to be kidding me!

fields.EN:
Jack's analysis of the situation
is apt. I do get along well with
everyone, you know?
fields.JP:
ジャックは正しく物事を観察しているようね。
私は誰とも仲がいいわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's analysis of the situation
is apt. I do get along well with
everyone, you know?

fields.EN:
And where exactly do you get the
confidence to say that?!
fields.JP: あなたもどこからその自信が出てくるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And where exactly do you get the
confidence to say that?!

fields.EN: Girls, give me a break already...
fields.JP: 姉ちゃんたち、勘弁してくれよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, girls... Can you stop it
already...?

fields.EN:
Um... Maybe you should both go
someplace else.
fields.JP:
あ、あの……
どこかに移ったほうがいいんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Maybe you should both go
someplace else.

fields.EN:
Oh, and... I have something to do,
so...
fields.JP: あと……ぼ、僕、帰っていいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and... I have something to do,
so...

fields.EN:
(I guess they do go well
together...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり、なんだかんだで気が合うんだよ、
　この二人って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess they do go well
together...)

fields.EN:
Um, okay, but let's move someplace
else.
fields.JP: と、とにかくどこかに移ろうよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, okay, but let's move someplace
else.

fields.EN: Um, uh... I'm coming in, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
あ……ええと……
赤ずきんさん、お邪魔します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, uh... I'm coming in, Red
Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
Hey, you sound pretty tense. Come
right in!
fields.JP:
おー、何かしこまってんのさ。
入って入って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, you sound pretty tense. Come
right in!

fields.JP:
（す、すごい…。
　色々なトレーニンググッズが……。）
で。ジャック。体の調子はどうなの？

fields.EN:
I think so... I'm sorry if I
caused you any trouble...
fields.JP:
もう大丈夫、かな……
何だかかえって心配かけちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think so... I'm sorry if I
caused you any trouble...

fields.EN:
Seriously... That's quite a thing
Haru-san made for you.
fields.JP:
全く……無茶苦茶なもん作るよね、
ハルさんは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously... That's quite a thing
Haru made for you.

fields.EN:
Oh, um... Well, I asked him to
make a weapon for me, and he ended
up making me the Mary Gun.
fields.JP:
あ、ううん。メアリガンは……武器は、
僕からお願いして、作ってもらったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Well, I asked him to
make a weapon for me, and he ended
up making me the Mary Gun.

fields.EN:
Why don't you have a seat? You
need to take things a bit easier.
fields.JP:
……まあ、座りなよ。
病み上がりなんだからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you have a seat? You
need to take things a bit easier.

fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんのベッド、
　赤ずきんさんの匂いがする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood's bed smells just
like her...)

fields.EN:
I gotta hand it to you for using
that thing without a second
thought.
fields.JP:
あんなものをためらいもせず身につけるなんて、
あんた、本当にすごいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I gotta hand it to you for using
that thing without a second
thought.

fields.EN:
Once a Blood Maiden enters Blood
Skelter, they can never return.
There's no way to stop it...
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化した血式少女は、
二度と人には戻らなかった……
……自分じゃ止められないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once a Blood Maiden enters Blood
Skelter, they can never return.
There's no way to stop it...

fields.EN:
That's why we fought with the fear
of Blood Skelter looming over
us...
fields.JP:
だからあたしたちは、ブラッドスケルター化を
何よりも恐れながら戦ってきたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we fought with the fear
of Blood Skelter looming over
us...

fields.EN:
We kept retreating, thinking there
was no way to beat a Nightmare,
which is why we're all still here.
fields.JP:
引き返したことだって何度もあるし、
あのナイトメアだって倒せないもんだと思ってた。
だから、まだジェイルの中にいる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We kept retreating, thinking there
was no way to beat a Nightmare,
which is why we're all still here.

fields.EN:
Now that you're with us, I really
think we've got a shot at getting
out of here!
fields.JP:
ジャックが一緒に戦ってくれるから、
本当に脱獄できる気がしてきたよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that you're with us, I really
think we've got a shot at getting
out of here!

fields.JP:
あ、あの……！
僕は、そんな……

fields.EN:
The resolve you showed makes me
wanna respond in kind! We're all
gonna get out of here!
fields.JP:
あたしは、あんたの覚悟に報いたい……！
だから……必ずみんなでジェイルを出ようね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The resolve you showed makes me
wanna respond in kind! We're all
gonna get out of here!

fields.EN:
I've constantly been protected by
Alice, and I hated myself,
watching her get hurt each time...
fields.JP:
……僕はずっと、アリスに守られてばかりで、
一人で傷付いたアリスを見るたびに、
悔しくてたまらなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've constantly been protected by
Alice, and I hated myself,
watching her get hurt each time...

fields.EN:
And even after I came here, Akazukin-san,
all I've done is let you and the others
protect me...
fields.JP:
それなのに、
ここに来てからは赤ずきんさんたちにも
守ってもらうだけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And even after I came here,
you protected me while I did
nothing...

fields.EN:
I didn't know you felt that way,
Jack...
fields.JP: ジャック……あんた、そんな風に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you felt that way,
Jack...

fields.EN:
That's why I'm happy I'm finally
able to do something for everyone!
fields.JP:
……だから、僕がみんなの力になることができて、
本当に、嬉しくて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I'm happy I'm finally
able to do something for everyone!

fields.EN: Well... I did collapse from anemia, though...
fields.JP: その、貧血で倒れちゃいましたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, I did get dizzy and
knock myself out...

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Gotcha! Don't worry,
you're one of us now.
fields.JP:
あははは！
あんたの気持ち、しっかり伝わったよ。
あたしたちはもう仲間さ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Gotcha! Don't worry,
you're one of us now.

fields.EN: So, again... Welcome to the Dawn!
fields.JP: ジャック。改めて、黎明にようこそ
fields.LOCALIZED: So, again... Welcome to the Dawn!

fields.JP:
あ……はい……！
改めてよろしく、赤ずきんさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, yes! Thank you, Red Riding
Hood.

fields.EN:
(For someone who uses a weapon
like that, her hand is so soft...)
fields.JP:
（あんなふうに武器を使う手なのに、
　手のひらはやわらかい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(For someone who uses a weapon
like that, her hand is so soft...)

fields.JP: よーし！　それじゃあ！

fields.EN:
Let's start with some running! If
you want to make more blood, you
need to build up your stamina!
fields.JP:
まずは走り込みにいこうか！
血を増やしたいなら、体力付けないとね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's get some runs in! You'll
need to train yourself up if
you're gonna be our blood bank!

fields.JP:
ほらー！　早く！
立った立った！！

fields.EN:
W-Wait... I don't think I can
follow through today...
fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと……
さすがに今日は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait... I don't think I can
follow through today...

fields.EN:
All right! Let's get this
expedition over with!
fields.JP:
よっし！
ちゃっちゃと探索を終わらすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Let's get this
expedition over with!

fields.EN:
Yes. The mission today isn't very
hard, is it?
fields.JP:
そうね。
今日の任務はそこまで難しくないんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The mission today isn't very
hard, is it?

fields.EN:
Supposedly... But, we better not
let our guard down!
fields.JP: その筈だけど……油断は大敵だしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Supposedly... But, we better not
let our guard down!

fields.EN:
I'll keep my guard up while I
rest... Do your best, everyone.
fields.JP:
わらわは油断せずに待機してます～
みなさんで頑張ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll keep my guard up while I
rest... Do your best, everyone.

fields.EN:
Ohohohoho! As long as I'm here,
all will be well!
fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ！
わたくしがいれば、問題ありませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohohoho! As long as I'm here,
all will be well!

fields.EN: Well, not like I'd miss anything.
fields.JP: まあ、そうそうヘマはしないわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, not like I'd miss anything.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! That's what it means
to lower your guard!
fields.JP: あはは！　それが油断のもとなんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! That's what it means
to lower your guard!

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san is really
reliable. I need to make sure I
don't hold anyone back!)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんは頼りになるなあ。
　僕も足を引っ張らないようにしなきゃ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood is really
reliable. I need to make sure I
don't hold anyone back!)

fields.EN:
The place is a bit rugged, so be
careful not to trip!
fields.JP:
このへん、ちょっと荒れてるね。
みんな、転ばないように気をつけて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place is a bit rugged, so be
careful not to trip!

fields.EN:
Urrh... She must think I'm the
clumsiest in the group...
fields.JP:
……うう……
僕だけがどんくさいと思われてる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... She must think I'm the
clumsiest in the group...

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san's hood is caught
on the wall...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんのフードが
　壁の突起に引っかかってる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood's hood is caught
on the wall...)

fields.EN:
Shoot... I can't get my hood
off...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot... I can't get my hood
off...

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、ちょっと待って……

（あれ？
　赤ずきんさんの様子が……）

fields.EN:
Is it frayed...? I hope it didn't
get torn...
fields.JP:
どこも破れてないかな……？
すり切れたりしてない……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it frayed...? I hope it didn't
get torn...

fields.EN: It looks fine. Here, try it on.
fields.JP:
うん、大丈夫そうだよ。
……ほら、かぶってみて
fields.LOCALIZED: It looks fine. Here, try it on.

fields.EN:
Thank goodness you weren't hurt,
Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんが怪我したんじゃなくて、
本当によかった……

fields.EN:
Um... You sure it isn't frayed in
the back? It's not dirty, is it?
fields.JP:
で、でもさ……
後ろの方も、ほつれてない？
汚れてるとこない……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You sure it isn't frayed in
the back? It's not dirty, is it?

fields.EN:
It's fine. Even if it's torn or
frayed, you can get it fixed once
we return.
fields.JP:
……大丈夫よ。もし破れていたとしても、
帰ったら直してもらえばいいのだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine. Even if it's torn or
frayed, you can get it fixed once
we return.

fields.EN:
(With how Akazukin-san is, I'm
surprised she's grumbling over her
hood like that...)
fields.JP:
（サバサバした赤ずきんさんが、
　こんなにフードにこだわるなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With how Red Riding Hood is, I'm
surprised she's grumbling over her
hood like that...)

fields.EN:
That hood must be something special
to you, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
……そのフードは、
赤ずきんさんにとって、特別な物なんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That hood of yours must be
something special.

fields.EN:
It's just that I don't feel very
good without it on me...
fields.JP:
……あたし、フードがないと
どうも落ち着かないんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I don't feel very
good without it on me...

fields.EN:
You really can't get in the right mood
without something over your head, Aka-nee.
fields.JP: 赤姉は、何かかぶってないと調子が出ないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red can't seem to get in
the right mood without something
over her head.

fields.EN:
I understand. I'm kind of the
same...
fields.JP: そういうの、わたくしにもありますわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand. I'm kind of the
same...

fields.EN:
I see... I suppose everyone has a
a thing or two like that. I'm
sorry.
fields.JP:
そうね……
そういうのって、誰にもあると思うわ。
……ごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I suppose everyone has a
a thing or two like that. I'm
sorry.

fields.EN:
D-Don't worry! That was my fault,
anyway! I'm just getting myself
worked up, that's all!
fields.JP:
い、いや！
あたしが不注意だったんだよ！
それに、自分でも気にしすぎだと思うしさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't worry! That was my fault,
anyway! I'm just getting myself
worked up, that's all!

fields.EN:
Sorry to keep you all waiting like
this! Now then, let's go!
fields.JP:
みんな、心配かけちゃってごめんね！
さ、行こ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry to keep you all waiting like
this! Now then, let's go!

fields.EN:
Too bad... If her hood was torn,
we could've gone back...
fields.JP:
わらわは残念です～
フードが破れたら、帰れたのに～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too bad... If her hood was torn,
we could've gone back...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Well, too bad for you.
I'm gonna work you hard today,
Kaguya.
fields.JP:
へへっ。
残念だけど、働いてもらうよ。かぐや
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Well, too bad for you.
I'm gonna work you hard today,
Kaguya.

fields.JP: じゃ、そろそろ行くわよ

fields.EN:
(Looks like Akazukin-san is
back to her normal self.)
fields.JP: （赤ずきんさん、もう大丈夫みたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like Red Riding Hood is
back to her normal self.)

fields.EN: What's the matter? Are you hurt?
fields.JP:
どうしたの？
……もしかして、どこか痛いの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What's the matter? Are you hurt?

fields.EN:
No... I'm sorry about earlier. You
were just worried about me, and...
fields.JP:
ううん……、さっきはごめんね。
ジャックはあたしのことを
心配してくれてたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... I'm sorry about earlier. You
were just worried about me, and...

fields.EN: Oh, that? Don't worry about it!
fields.JP: う、ううん。気にしなくていいよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, that? Don't worry about it!

fields.EN:
Without something on my head, I get so anxious
that I lose sight of everything around me...
fields.JP:
あたし、なんかかぶってないと、
すごく不安になって、
周りが見えなくなっちゃうんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I get anxious
without something on my head, and
I start to feel lightheaded...

fields.EN:
Being the big sister here, I have
to say sorry for being so
unreliable...
fields.JP:
お姉さんなのに、
頼りないとこみせてごめんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Being the big sister here, I have
to say sorry for being so
unreliable...

fields.EN:
Well, everyone's allowed to feel
anxious, so if wearing the hood
helps, I think that's fine.
fields.JP:
えっと、僕は……
不安なことっていっぱいあるから
フードで楽になるなら、いいことだと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, everyone's allowed to feel
anxious, so if wearing the hood
helps, I think that's fine.

fields.EN:
Okay, let's get going! Look!
They're way ahead of us already.
fields.JP:
……じゃ、行こうか！
もうみんな、あんなところにいるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let's get going! Look!
They're way ahead of us already.

fields.JP: ああっ！？　いつの間に……！
ジャック、置いて行かれないでよね！

fields.EN:
Wait... Isn't everyone going to
wait for me...?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Isn't everyone going to
wait for me...?

fields.EN:
I'm gonna catch up to them! See
you!
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna catch up to them! See
you!

fields.EN:
She's running...?!
W-Wait for me, Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
いきなり走っ……！？
まってよ、赤ずきんさーん！

fields.EN:
(Huh? Akazukin-san? What's she
doing, sitting over there?)
fields.JP:
（あれ……？　赤ずきんさんだ……
　あんなところで座り込んで、
　どうしたんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Red Riding Hood? What's she
doing, sitting over there?)

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san? Did you come to
see Haru-san?
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、ハルさんに何か用事？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood? Did you come to
see Haru?

fields.JP:
ジャック！？
び、びっくりした……！

fields.EN:
Oh, uh, I'm sorry... I was just
passing by and saw you here,
Akazukin-san, so...
fields.JP:
あ、ご、ごめん……。
その、たまたま通りかかったら、
赤ずきんさんを見つけたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh, I'm sorry... I was just
passing by and I saw you here,
so...

fields.JP: そういえば、フードはどうしたの？

fields.EN:
Well, it tore... Haru-san's patching
it up for me now.
fields.JP:
……それが……破れちゃってさ……
今、ハルさんに直してもらってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it tore... Haru's patching
it up for me now.

fields.EN:
He did say he'd get it fixed in a
jiffy, so once he's done, let's go
and train!
fields.JP:
ま、すぐ直せるっていってたから、
……終わったら特訓しよっか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He did say he'd get it fixed in a
jiffy, so once he's done, let's go
and train!

fields.EN:
Huh? But... I'm a bit tired,
and...
fields.JP: ええっ。僕、ちょっと疲れて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But... I'm a bit tired,
and...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Well, you better rest
while you still can, then.
fields.JP:
あはは。あたしのフードが直るまでに
しっかり休憩しておきなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Well, you better rest
while you still can, then.

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san is smiling, but
she seems less energetic than usual...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん、笑ってるけど、
　いつもと違って元気がない気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's smiling, but I can't feel
her enthusiasm or energy at
all...)

fields.EN:
Maybe we can train with
projectiles. I don't think I'd
lose to you in that.
fields.JP:
……今日は射撃の特訓をするかな。
射撃でも、ジャックに負ける気はしないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can train with
projectiles. I don't think I'd
lose to you in that.

fields.EN:
(Yeah, she doesn't look well at
all. Come to think of it, she does
get uneasy without her hood.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり元気がないみたいだ……。
　そういえばこの間も、フードが無いと
　不安だって……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yeah, she doesn't look well at
all. Come to think of it, she does
get uneasy without her hood.)

fields.EN:
(Oyayubihime said a hat should work...
I'll go to Akazukin-san's room
and get one...!)
fields.JP:
（……帽子でも大丈夫だって、親指姫たちが
　言ってたっけ。
　赤ずきんさんの部屋にいって、帽子を……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thumbelina said that she's fine
as long as she's wearing something
on her head, right?)

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san. I'll go to your room
and get something to cover your head...!
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん。
僕、ちょっと、赤ずきんさんの部屋に行って
何かかぶる物を取ってくるから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, let me go to your room and get
you something to wear on your
head.

fields.JP: （……赤ずきんさんの手、震えてる……）

fields.EN:
I don't feel good now. Don't leave
me... Stay with me here...
fields.JP:
不安なの。あたしから離れないで……
……一緒に、ここで待ってて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't feel good now. Don't leave
me... Stay with me here...

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry! Um, just forget what
I said!
fields.JP:
……ご、ごめんっ！
変なこと言ったけど……忘れてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry! Um, just forget what
I said!

fields.JP: あたしは大丈夫だからさ……

fields.EN:
(I can't leave Akazukin-san
alone when she looks so anxious...)
fields.JP:
（こんな心細そうな赤ずきんさん、
　一人にできない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't leave her alone like
that...)

fields.EN:
If you don't mind, I'll stay here
until Haru-san's done.
fields.JP: 僕でよければ、一緒にハルさんを待つよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't mind, I'll stay here
until Haru's done.

fields.EN:
Yeah, it's not like I had anything
to do...
fields.JP:
う、うん……
他に用事もないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it's not like I had anything
to do...

fields.EN:
(S-She's holding onto my arm...!
Akazukin-san is so soft...)
fields.JP:
（わわっ、隣に座ったら、腕を……！
　……赤ずきんさん、柔らかい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(S-She's holding onto my arms! Her
hands are so soft...)

fields.EN:
I-I know! How about my
handkerchief? Maybe it'll work!
fields.JP:
そ、そうだ、ハンカチでよければ、
頭にかぶってみて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I know! How about my
handkerchief? Maybe it'll work!

fields.EN:
See? Like... this! Well, it's
small, so it won't cover your head
entirely, but...
fields.JP:
……ほら、こんなふうに……！
ぜんぜん、かぶるには小さすぎるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? Like... this! Well, it's
small, so it won't cover your head
entirely, but...

fields.EN:
Your handkerchief... I think I
feel a little better now...
fields.JP:
ジャックのハンカチ……
ちょっと落ち着いたかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your handkerchief... I think I
feel a little better now...

fields.EN:
B-But, I still want you to wait
here...
fields.JP: で、でも、離れちゃだめだからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, I still want you to wait
here...

fields.EN: Sure thing. Let's wait for Haru-san.
fields.JP: うん、一緒にハルさんを待とう
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure thing. Let's wait for Haru.

fields.JP:
えへへ……
……ジャック、ありがと

fields.EN:
(I would've never expected to see
Akazukin-san like this...)
fields.JP:
（僕よりずっと強くて
　しっかりしてる赤ずきんさんに、
　こんな一面があるなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I would've never expected to see
Red Riding Hood like this...)

fields.EN:
Don't tell this to anyone. This
isn't in my character, you know...
fields.JP:
……このこと、誰にも言わないでよ？
その……あたしのキャラじゃないしさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell this to anyone. This
isn't in my character, you know...

fields.EN:
(Is Akazukin-san blushing...?
She's like an older sister, but she's
kind of cute...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん、照れてる……？
　お姉さんなのに、なんか可愛いな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she blushing...? For being an
older sister-type, she's kind of
cute...)

fields.EN:
You're not disappointed in me, are
you? After all, I'm in a pretty
pathetic state right now...
fields.JP:
もしかして、あたしにガッカリした？
……こんな情けないとこ見せちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not disappointed in me, are
you? After all, I'm in a pretty
pathetic state right now...

fields.EN: N-Not at all! In fact, you're...
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことないよ！
むしろ、逆っていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED: N-Not at all! In fact, you're...

fields.JP:
ええと……っ
そ、そうだ……！

fields.EN:
Let's talk while we wait for Haru-san!
I want to hear more about you,
Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
ハルさんを待つ間、話そうよ！
赤ずきんさんの話、聞きたいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's talk about something else
while we wait! I want to hear more
about you!

fields.EN:
I feel like I can tell you
anything...
fields.JP:
……ジャックになら、
なんでも話せる気がする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like I can tell you
anything...

fields.JP: （やっと笑ってくれた……よかった）

fields.EN:
Huh? You're going to the store? I
was just gonna go there, too!
Let's go together!
fields.JP:
え、販売所に行くの？
ちょうどあたしも用事あったんだ！
一緒に行こうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You're going to the store? I
was just gonna go there, too!
Let's go together!

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、一緒にいってくれるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you're okay coming
with me?

fields.EN:
Of course! I was just thinking
about getting something new to
wear, like a hood or a hat.
fields.JP:
もちろん！
あたしもそろそろ、
新しいフードか帽子がほしくてさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! I was just thinking
about getting something new to
wear, like a hood or a hat.

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、おしゃれなんだなあ……

fields.EN:
Fashionable...? Headwear is
pretty much my only hobby... Haha...
fields.JP:
おしゃれっていうか……
被りものはあたしの唯一の趣味みたいなもん
だからね……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fashionable? More like a headwear
enthusiast... Haha...

fields.EN:
...And then Kaguya was being so
lazy, as usual, but at the worst
time possible!
fields.JP:
……でさー、
よりによって、そのときにかぐやが、
いつものグータラを発揮したわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...And then Kaguya was being so
lazy, as usual, but at the worst
time possible!

fields.JP:
かぐや姫が？
そ、それはタイミングが悪いね……

fields.EN:
(It feels good to have a casual
conversation with her like this.)
fields.JP:
（こういう何気ない話をしてくれるの、
　なんか嬉しいなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It feels good to have a casual
conversation with her like this.)

fields.EN:
Right? And then Oyayubi got so mad,
she refused to talk to her!
fields.JP:
そうなんだよ！　そしたら、
親指が口もきかないくらい怒っちゃって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? And then Thumby got so mad,
she refused to talk to her!

fields.EN:
It was a major pain, having to
diffuse that tension.
fields.JP: なだめるの、本当に大変だったんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was a major pain, having to
diffuse that tension.

fields.EN:
I guess you always end up taking charge,
Akazukin-san.
fields.JP: 結局、まとめるのは赤ずきんさんなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you always end up having
to take care of things like that.

fields.EN:
Seriously, I always have to be the
moderater.
fields.JP: ほんと、いっつもそうだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously, I always have to be the
moderater.

fields.EN:
Well, it doesn't bother me, since
everyone's like my younger sister.
fields.JP: ま、みんなあたしの妹みたいなもんだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it doesn't bother me, since
everyone's like my younger sister.

fields.EN:
I'd probably be in a lot of trouble
without you, Akazukin-san...
fields.JP:
僕も、赤ずきんさんがいなかったら
大変だろうなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't imagine what I would've
gone through if you weren't here.

fields.EN:
Oh, but you're my most bothersome
little brother. You're kinda
klutzy, too.
fields.JP:
あんたが一番、手のかかる弟だね。
どんくさいし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but you're my most bothersome
little brother. You're kinda
klutzy, too.

fields.EN:
I'm just kidding! You learn
quickly, so you've got a lot going
for you.
fields.JP:
うそうそ！
飲み込みはいいし、将来は有望だと思うよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just kidding! You learn
quickly, so you've got a lot going
for you.

fields.EN:
Absolutely! I know talent when I
see it! Don't worry, I'll train
you up real good!
fields.JP:
あたしの見立てに間違いはないよ。
これからもしっかり特訓してあげるからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Absolutely! I know talent when I
see it! Don't worry, I'll train
you up real good!

fields.EN:
Um, I'd appreciate it if you'd
tone it down on the training...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'd appreciate it if you'd
tone it down on the training...

fields.JP: あはは……お、販売所についたよ！
おー、お二人さん。まいどっす！

fields.EN:
You mind showing me your hats,
Clara?
fields.JP: くらら、帽子みせてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mind showing me your hats,
Clara?

fields.EN: I've got just the one for you!
fields.JP: いいの入ってるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I've got just the one for you!

fields.EN:
(I wonder which hat would look
good on Akazukin-san...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんに似合う
　帽子はどれかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder which hat would look
good on Red Riding Hood...)

fields.EN:
A white hat with a flower on it...
It's so pretty...
fields.JP: わぁ、この、お花のついた白い帽子……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A white hat with a flower on it...
It's so pretty...

fields.EN:
How about this simple hat? I think it'd
look good on you, Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
あ、このシンプルな帽子、
赤ずきんさんに似合いそう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about this? The design's
simple, but I think it would look
good on you!

fields.EN:
I'm about the only Blood Maiden
who can pull off a chic look like
this!
fields.JP:
こんな大人っぽいのが似合うのは、
血式少女じゃあたしだけだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm about the only Blood Maiden
who can pull off a chic look like
this!

fields.EN:
For sure! You look just like a
sophisticated older sister! If
not...
fields.JP:
うんうん！　すごくお姉さんっぽい！
あと、他には……
fields.LOCALIZED:
For sure! You look just like a
sophisticated older sister! If
not...

fields.EN:
A pink hood with a lacy rim... The
stitching's cute, too.
fields.JP:
このピンク色のフード、ふちがレースだし、
刺繍も可愛いなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A pink hood with a lacy rim... The
stitching's cute, too.

fields.EN:
Look! This black hood has a cool silver
ornament. It'd look great on you,
Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
……見て！
この黒いフード、銀の飾りもかっこよくて、
赤ずきんさんに似合うよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look! The silver accessory on this
black hood would look great on
you!

fields.EN:
Let me see that... Hey, not bad at
all. ...How's it look?
fields.JP:
どれどれ。
おおっ、これは、いいのを見つけたねぇ。
……どう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me see that... Hey, not bad at
all. ...How's it look?

fields.EN:
It's just as I thought! You look
even stronger with it on!
fields.JP:
思った通り似合ってる！
いつも以上に強く見えるし、
すごくかっこいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just as I thought! You look
even stronger with it on!

fields.EN:
What do you mean "stronger?"
What you see here is pure
awesomeness!
fields.JP:
いつも以上ってなによ。
これがあたしの真の実力だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean "stronger?"
What you see here is pure
awesomeness!

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、かっこいいなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED: It really does look cool on you...

fields.EN:
Say, Jack? What color should I
choose for this ribbon? I'm
debating between red and yellow.
fields.JP:
ねえジャック、このリボン、
色はどっちがいいと思う？
……赤にするか黄色にするかで迷ってて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack? What color should I
choose for this ribbon? I'm
debating between red and yellow.

fields.EN:
I think this feather would suit you
better than a ribbon, Akazukin-san...
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんには、リボンよりも、
この羽根の方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think a feather would look
better on you than a ribbon.

fields.EN:
I sure do! You're a lot cooler than
I am, Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
だって、赤ずきんさん、
僕よりずっとかっこいいもん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sure do! You're a lot cooler
than I am!

fields.EN: Sorry Jack, but I gotta go...
fields.JP: ……ジャック、悪い、あたし帰るわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry Jack, but I gotta go...

fields.EN:
Why don't you take your time and
look around?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you take your time and
look around?

fields.JP: （赤ずきんさん、行っちゃった……）

fields.EN:
Huh? You havin' problems with Big
Sis?
fields.JP: あれ？　姉貴とケンカっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You havin' problems with Big
Sis?

fields.EN: Did I do something to Akazukin-san...?
fields.JP:
……僕、赤ずきんさんに
なにかしちゃったのかなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Did I do something to her...?

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, Akazukin-san
was looking at different hats...
Cute ones with flowers and ribbons...)
fields.JP:
（……そういえば、赤ずきんさんは、
　僕が見てたのとは別の帽子を見てた気がする……
　お花やリボンの可愛いやつを……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, she was looking at the
cuter-looking hats, like the ones
with flowers and ribbons...)

fields.EN:
(Was I being too pushy with the
image I had of her?)
fields.JP:
（それなのに、僕は勝手なイメージを
　一方的に押しつけてた？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Was I being too pushy with the
image I had of her?)

fields.EN:
(I haven't been able to talk to
Akazukin-san since then... I'd
better break the ice today...)
fields.JP:
（あれから赤ずきんさんと
　二人だけでちゃんと話せてない……
　でも、今日はちゃんと話さないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't been able to talk to
Red Riding Hood since then... I'd
better break the ice today...)

fields.EN:
R-Akazukin-san... Do you have
a moment?
fields.JP:
あ、赤ずきんさん……！
いま、いいかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Red Riding Hood... Do you have
a moment?

fields.EN:
Hey, Jack! It's been a while! Come
on in!
fields.JP:
おー、ジャック、久々じゃない！
さ、入って入って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Jack! It's been a while! Come
on in!

fields.EN:
Has it really been a while? I
mean, we see each other when
we're with everyone else.
fields.JP:
ひ、久しぶり、だっけ……？
みんなでは会ってるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Has it really been a while? I
mean, we see each other when
we're with everyone else.

fields.JP:
（やっぱり、赤ずきんさん、
　落ち込んでる……）

fields.EN:
Well, I am an older sister, so I
guess you only need me when you
need to rely on me...
fields.JP:
まあ、お姉さんなんて、そんなもんだよね。
頼りたいときだけ必要にされてさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I am an older sister, so I
guess you only need me when you
need to rely on me...

fields.EN:
That's not true...! I always have
so much I want to talk to you about,
Akazukin-san...!
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ……！
僕はいつも、赤ずきんさんだから、
話したいことがいっぱいあるのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true! There are a lot
of things I want to talk to you
about!

fields.EN:
Jack...? What are you trying to
tell me?
fields.JP:
ジャック……？
あんた、何言ってるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...? What are you trying to
tell me?

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san, you're certainly
a dependable older sister, but that's
just your role on the Blood Team.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんは確かに頼れるお姉さんだけど、
それは血式少女隊での役割であって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure you're reliable, but that's
strictly because of your role on
the Blood Team.

fields.EN:
You're a cute girl too, Akazukin-san...!
And yet last time I said something
so rude... I'm sorry...!
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんは可愛い女の子なのに……！
それなのに、この前は……
失礼なこと言って、ごめん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're just as cute as any other
girl, and I was so rude about it
last time! I'm so sorry!

fields.EN: H-Hold on there! Wait a sec, Jack!
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って……！
待ってよ、ジャック……！
fields.LOCALIZED: H-Hold on there! Wait a sec, Jack!

fields.EN:
I only thought of you as a dependable
older sister, Akazukin-san, and
assumed you liked cool things...
fields.JP:
僕は、お姉さんとしての
赤ずきんさんのイメージだけで、
かっこいいものが好きだって決めつけて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept seeing you as a cool and
reliable person just because you
act as our older sister, and...

fields.EN:
Stop right there! I know you
really think I'm not fit to be
called cute, right?!
fields.JP:
それ以上言わなくていいよ！
可愛いなんて、本当はイメージじゃないって
言いたいんでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop right there! I know you
really think I'm not fit to be
called cute, right?!

fields.EN:
That's not it! Akazukin-san,
you're certainly dependable, but you
have a feminine side too!
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ！
赤ずきんさんは確かに頼れるお姉さんだけど、
女の子らしいところだってあるんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not it! I know you're
dependable, but you're just like
any other girl!

fields.EN:
Me? The tomboy of the group?! You
can't be serious...
fields.JP:
女の子らしいって……あたしが？
ガサツで男勝りのあたしが！？
そんなわけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me? The tomboy of the group?! You
can't be serious...

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san, you always
celebrate everyone's anniversaries
at the Dawn, right?
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん……黎明のみんなの記念日には、
いつもお祝いしてあげてるよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You always remember to
congratulate members of the Dawn
on their anniversaries, right?

fields.EN:
Well, that's because I'm the older
sister...
fields.JP: それは、お姉さんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's because I'm the older
sister...

fields.EN:
You're fashionable, and your hair is
so silky... Akazukin-san, you
always make me think girls are amazing!
fields.JP:
おしゃれだし、髪の毛だってサラサラしてるし、
女の子はすごいなあって、赤ずきんさんを見て
いつも思ってるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing you reminds me how
fashionable girls can be, and how
pretty... with nice, clean hair!

fields.EN:
I know how you take good care of
your hands, even with handling
heavy weapons like yours!
fields.JP:
武器を持つとあんなに強いのに、
手が荒れないように、すごく気をつけてるのも
ちゃんと知ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know how you take good care of
your hands, even with handling
heavy weapons like yours!

fields.JP: いっ、いつの間に、そんなところを……！

fields.EN:
You also have cute things in your
room.
fields.JP: それに、部屋にも可愛い物がいっぱいあるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also have cute things in your
room.

fields.EN:
That red hood is feminine, fashionable,
and cute. It suits you, Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
その赤いフードだって、女の子らしくて、
おしゃれで、可愛い赤ずきんさんに似合ってる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your red hood is also feminine,
and fashionable, and looks great
on you!

fields.JP:
わー！　もういい！
もうやめてってば！！

fields.EN:
Why? Akazukin-san, does it
bother you when I say you're feminine
and cute?
fields.JP:
なんで？
赤ずきんさんが女の子らしくて可愛いって、
僕が言ったら迷惑だった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why? Is it a bother for me to call
you cute, or pretty?

fields.EN:
That's not the point! I got it
that you see me as a girl!
fields.JP:
違うっての！
ジャックがあたしを女の子だと思ってくれてる
ってことは、わかったから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not the point! I got it
that you see me as a girl!

fields.EN:
Urrh! Do I have to tell you?! I'm
just embarrassed!
fields.JP:
うー。察してよ！
照れくさいんだってば！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh! Do I have to tell you?! I'm
just embarrassed!

fields.EN:
(Now that she said that, I guess
what I was saying is embarrassing,
but I wasn't lying...)
fields.JP:
（言われてみれば、自分が言ってたことも
　結構恥ずかしかった気が……
　で、でも、間違ったことは言ってないよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that she said that, I guess
what I was saying is embarrassing,
but I wasn't lying...)

fields.EN:
Dad's the only one who ever says
things like that to me, so I'm
happy to hear you say it, too...
fields.JP:
……あたしをそんなふうに言ってくれるの、
お父さんだけだから、嬉しいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad's the only one who ever says
things like that to me, so I'm
happy to hear you say it, too...

fields.EN:
Jack, take seat. I'll get you
something to drink.
fields.JP:
ジャック。
飲み物を用意するから、座ってて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, take seat. I'll get you
something to drink.

fields.EN:
This flower-shaped cup is cute,
too...
fields.JP:
そのカップも、
いつも、お花みたいで可愛いなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This flower-shaped cup is cute,
too...

fields.EN: Like I said, stop it already...
fields.JP: もういいってば、そういうのは……
fields.LOCALIZED: Like I said, stop it already...

fields.EN:
I should've been honest with you
back then.
fields.JP:
ほんとはあのときも、
あたしから素直に言えば良かったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should've been honest with you
back then.

fields.EN:
I wanted to say that I wanted a
cute hat, and that I like flowers
and ribbons.
fields.JP:
可愛い帽子が欲しいって……
花やリボンが好きだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to say that I wanted a
cute hat, and that I like flowers
and ribbons.

fields.EN:
No, I should have noticed. I'm so
sorry...
fields.JP:
あのときは、僕だって気が付いてても
良かった筈なのに……ごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I should have noticed. I'm so
sorry...

fields.EN:
But, I was happy you were looking
for something that looks good on
me.
fields.JP:
……でも、
ジャックがあたしのために
見立ててくれるのは嬉しかったよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I was happy you were looking
for something that looks good on
me.

fields.EN:
I think you should go
with what you really like,
Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
……僕は、赤ずきんさんが
本当に好きな物の方がいいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I think what you like is
what would look best for you.

fields.EN:
If you like cute things, tell me. You're still
you, Akazukin-san, so I want you to say what
you like.
fields.JP:
可愛い物が好きだって、
赤ずきんさんは赤ずきんさんなんだから
好きな物は好きって教えてほしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you like cute things, let me
know. After all, you are who you
are.

fields.EN:
You don't mind? Even if someone
who's supposed to be the older
sister likes things like that...?
fields.JP:
ジャックは嫌じゃないの？
お姉さんのあたしが、そんなでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sure? You don't expect me to
like older-sister things?

fields.EN:
No! I was really happy to learn
something about you I didn't know,
Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
ううん！
赤ずきんさんの知らないところを知って、
すごく嬉しかったから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure! I'm actually happy to
learn things about you that I
didn't know before!

fields.EN:
I was also happy that you leaned
on me when you were feeling down
on yourself before...
fields.JP:
落ち込んでいたときも、
僕を頼ってくれたのが嬉しかったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was also happy that you leaned
on me when you were feeling down
on yourself before...

fields.EN:
Oh, that...! Um... Thanks... You
can't believe how much you helped,
Jack...
fields.JP:
あ、あのときは……！
その……ありがとう……
ジャックのおかげで助かったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that...! Um... Thanks... You
can't believe how much you helped,
Jack...

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, you were really girly and
cute back then too, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
あのときの赤ずきんさんも、
女の子らしくて可愛い赤ずきんさんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, you were
really cute back then.

fields.EN:
And to think, afterwards I was
saying that you were cooler than
me and stuff...
fields.JP:
それなのに、この前は、
『僕よりかっこいい』なんて言っちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And to think, afterwards I was
saying that you were cooler than
me and stuff...

fields.EN:
Well, you at least got that
right...
