fields.JP: ……まあ、それは否定しないかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you at least got that
right...

fields.EN:
Well, anyway... Let's keep
getting along from now on, Jack!
fields.JP:
ま、そんなわけで……
これからもよろしくね、ジャック！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, everything's back
to normal again, right?

fields.EN:
Hey, what's with that grin of
yours?
fields.JP: ……って、なにニヤニヤしてるわけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, what's with that grin of
yours?

fields.JP:
わあっ！
ぬいぐるみが顔に……！
ジャック、ほんとにごめん！

fields.EN:
It's okay. Just the water from the
vase splashed on me, that's all.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ。
花瓶の水がかかっただけだし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay. Just the water from the
vase splashed on me, that's all.

fields.EN:
Well, don't just sit there! Take
your shirt off! You're gonna catch
a cold like that.
fields.JP:
ぼやっと座ってないで、上着を脱いで！
風邪ひいちゃうでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, don't just sit there! Take
your shirt off! You're gonna catch
a cold like that.

fields.EN:
Jack... What's that scar on your
arm?!
fields.JP: ジャック、その腕の傷はどうしたの……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... What's that scar on your
arm?!

fields.JP:
（しまった……！
　跡を見られちゃった！）

fields.EN:
Look at all those scars... Did you
get them from the Marchens? Don't
tell me it's from other people...
fields.JP:
こんなにたくさん……
メルヒェンにやられたわけ？
それとも人間に……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at all those scars... Did you
get them from the Marchens? Don't
tell me it's from other people...

fields.EN:
Alice needed my blood, so I used
to cut myself...
fields.JP:
こ、これは、自分でつけたんだ。
アリスのために、血が必要だったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice needed my blood, so I used
to cut myself...

fields.EN:
Oh, really...? But, didn't it
hurt?
fields.JP:
そ、そうか……
でも、痛かったんじゃない……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, really...? But, didn't it
hurt?

fields.EN:
It's not like I cut myself deep. I
mean, the torturing was way worse.
fields.JP:
そんなに深く切ってないから大丈夫。
拷問なんて、もっとひどかったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like I cut myself deep. I
mean, the torturing was way worse.

fields.EN:
Dad found me right after I was
born, and I grew up at Dawn...
I really was lucky, wasn't I?
fields.JP:
生まれてすぐにお父さんに拾われて、
黎明で育ったあたしは、幸せだったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I should be happier being
found by my dad and raised by the
Dawn...

fields.EN:
I'm glad I came to the Dawn and got
to meet Akazukin-san and
everyone else too.
fields.JP:
……僕も、黎明に来て、
赤ずきんさんたちに会えて良かったよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm actually happy that I got to
meet everyone here at the Dawn.

fields.EN: I'm happy to hear that from you...
fields.JP: ……そう思ってもらえてるなら嬉しいな
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm happy to hear that from you...

fields.EN:
Things are a bit wonky now, but
ever since I was little, everyone
in the Dawn's been like family.
fields.JP:
今、ちょっとぎくしゃくしちゃってるけど、
小さい頃からあたしにとって
黎明のメンバーは大切な家族なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Things are a bit wonky now, but
ever since I was little, everyone
in the Dawn's been like family.

fields.EN:
Speaking of which, Akazukin-san,
what were you like when you were little?
fields.JP:
そういえば、赤ずきんさんの小さい頃って、
どんなだったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of which, what were you
like when you were little?

fields.EN:
I came here when I was two years
old, and from what I heard, I was
pretty much a rascal.
fields.JP:
あたし、二歳でここにきたけど、
そのときから暴れん坊だったらしくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I came here when I was two years
old, and from what I heard, I was
pretty much a rascal.

fields.EN:
They said they always had to chase
me around.
fields.JP:
あたしを、みんなで
追いかけ回してたらしいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They said they always had to chase
me around.

fields.JP: あはは、想像できるなあ……

fields.EN:
Everyone finished their work early
to celebrate my birthday with a
birthday cake.
fields.JP:
あたしの誕生日には、
みんな仕事を早く終わらせて
ケーキでお祝いしてくれたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone finished their work early
to celebrate my birthday with a
birthday cake.

fields.EN:
I have every single one of my
gifts that Dad gave me. He'd
always say how big I was getting.
fields.JP:
お父さんがくれたプレゼントは
全部大事にしまってある。
毎年、大きくなったねってほめてくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have every single one of my
gifts that Dad gave me. He'd
always say how big I was getting.

fields.EN:
(The Professor must really care
for Akazukin-san...)
fields.JP:
（博士は赤ずきんさんのことを
　大事にしてるんだなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Professor must really care
for Red Riding Hood...)

fields.EN:
Haru-san's about the only one who
still calls me a kid.
fields.JP:
ハルさんだけは、
いつまでも小さいとか子どもとか言ってたけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru's about the only one who
still calls me a kid.

fields.EN:
I think this is the first time I've
heard about your childhood,
Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
……赤ずきんさんの小さい頃の話って、
初めて聞いたかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think this is the first time
I've heard you talk about your
past like this.

fields.EN:
It's embarrassing, but I feel okay
talking about it with you.
fields.JP:
恥ずかしいけど、ジャックには、
なんでも話せる気がしちゃうんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's embarrassing, but I feel okay
talking about it with you.

fields.JP: それって、なんか嬉しいかも……

fields.EN:
Everyone in the Dawn is my family,
so you and Alice are part of my
family too, now.
fields.JP:
黎明はみんな家族だから、
今はジャックとアリスもあたしの大切な
家族だなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone in the Dawn is my family,
so you and Alice are part of my
family too, now.

fields.EN:
Are you telling me all this,
Akazukin-san, because we're
family at the Dawn...?
fields.JP:
……もしかして、赤ずきんさんが
僕にいろんな話をしてくれるのは、
黎明の家族だから……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're talking about yourself
like this to me because I'm in your
Dawn family?

fields.EN:
Mmm... You could say that, but
that's not exactly right.
fields.JP:
うーん、そうともいえるけど、
違うのかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... You could say that, but
that's not exactly right.

fields.EN:
I mean, besides the Dawn, I didn't
really have any friends...
fields.JP:
だってあたしには、黎明以外で
友達や仲間っていなかったからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, besides the Dawn, I didn't
really have any friends...

fields.EN:
Uh...! I'm so sorry for saying
that!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん！
ひどいこと聞いちゃった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh...! I'm so sorry for saying
that!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Don't worry. Regardless
of what anyone says, I'm happy now
because of the Dawn!
fields.JP:
あはは。気にしてないって！
あたし、黎明のおかげでずっと幸せだもん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Don't worry. Regardless
of what anyone says, I'm happy now
because of the Dawn!

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san cares about
the Dawn more than anyone...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんは、
　誰よりも黎明を大事にしてる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She cares about the Dawn more
than anyone around...)

fields.EN:
Sure we're family now, but each
person is a special someone to me.
fields.JP:
でもね、家族は一つの家族だけど、
今は、みんなの存在がそれぞれ大切だって
思ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure we're family now, but each
person is a special someone to me.

fields.EN:
Whether you're family or not, you
are who you are, and my dad is
my dad, right?
fields.JP:
お父さんはお父さん。
ジャックはジャック。
家族でも代わりはいないでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whether you're family or not, you
are who you are, and my dad is
my dad, right?

fields.EN:
I guess... But I can't fight or
make things or do doctor stuff...
fields.JP:
確かに……
僕は戦うことも、製造も救護もできないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess... But I can't fight or
make things or do doctor stuff...

fields.EN: I wasn't saying that as sarcasm.
fields.JP: 悪い意味じゃないっての！
fields.LOCALIZED: I wasn't saying that as sarcasm.

fields.EN:
...I think the reason I was able
to feel that way was because of you, Jack.
fields.JP:
……あたしがそう思えたのは、
ジャックのおかげなんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED: I just said that because of you.

fields.EN:
You're the one who told me that I
am who I am.
fields.JP:
どんなあたしでも、
あたしはあたしだって、
ジャックがそう言ってくれたからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the one who told me that I
am who I am.

fields.EN:
Of course...! No one could ever replace
you, Akazukin-san, whether you're
cute or cool.
fields.JP:
当たり前だよ……！
可愛いところもかっこいいところも、
赤ずきんさんの代わりは誰にもできないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, of course! No one can
replace how cool or cute you are.

fields.EN:
Well, if the missions we undertake
get dangerous, I'm sure there'll
be a lot of conflicting opinions.
fields.JP:
作戦が難しくなれば、
みんなの意見がぶつかることも
あるかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if the missions we undertake
get dangerous, I'm sure there'll
be a lot of conflicting opinions.

fields.EN:
But, we are still family, so as
the big sister, I want to take
whatever comes my way to heart.
fields.JP:
でも、家族だからさ……！
あたしはお姉さんとして、
全部受け止めてやりたいんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we are still family, so as
the big sister, I want to take
whatever comes my way to heart.

fields.EN:
But don't overdo it... Well, not
that I'm not going to rely on
you...
fields.JP:
……あんまり、無理はしないでね。
……僕も、頼っちゃうと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But don't overdo it... Well, not
that I'm not going to rely on
you...

fields.EN:
Well, if you think things are
getting rough for me, just be by
my side.
fields.JP:
……そういうときは、
ジャックがそばにいてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you think things are
getting rough for me, just be by
my side.

fields.EN:
Gotcha! If you're okay with me
doing that, I will!
fields.JP:
うん……！
僕でいいなら、ずっとそばにいるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gotcha! If you're okay with me
doing that, I will!

fields.EN:
Um, maybe it's just me, but I feel
like the food now tastes better
than before...
fields.JP: ……ねえ、最近、ご飯が美味しくない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, maybe it's just me, but I feel
like the food now tastes better
than before...

fields.EN:
It's always been this good. I
don't taste anything different.
fields.JP:
別に、普通じゃない？
……前から美味しいってことだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's always been this good. I
don't taste anything different.

fields.EN:
I've learned how good food is
since coming here. I think eating
is something I'm going to enjoy.
fields.JP:
ご飯が美味しいってこと、ここに来て知ったわ。
黎明に来てから、食べることが好きになりそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've learned how good food is
since coming here. I think eating
is something I'm going to enjoy.

fields.EN:
I didn't know there were so many
recipes until now...
fields.JP:
こんなにいろいろ料理があるなんて
前まで知らなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know there were so many
recipes until now...

fields.EN:
Pass me your plate, Jack. We've
got enough for seconds too, if
you'd like.
fields.JP:
ほら、ジャック、お皿貸して。
おかわりあるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pass me your plate, Jack. We've
got enough for seconds too, if
you'd like.

fields.EN:
I'm full already. You're a guy, so
you should be eating more than us.
fields.JP:
あたしはもう充分。
男の子は必要な量があたしたちより多いからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm full already. You're a guy, so
you should be eating more than us.

fields.EN:
The meals are made with that in
mind, so you better eat what
you've got.
fields.JP:
それぞれの分を考えて作ってくれてるんだから、
きちんと食べないと迷惑だしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The meals are made with that in
mind, so you better eat what
you've got.

fields.JP: とりあえず、これくらいかな？

fields.EN:
(The perfect amount! And even
without me saying anything.)
fields.JP:
（ほんとにぴったりの量だ……！
　僕、何もいってないのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The perfect amount! And even
without me saying anything.)

fields.EN:
Eat up, Jack. You're gonna need
it to build up your blood.
fields.JP:
いっぱい食べなよ、ジャック。
血が増えないからね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eat up, Jack. You're gonna need
it to build up your blood.

fields.EN:
Miko-san also said that males should
eat more, too.
fields.JP:
ふふ。男の子はもっと食べた方がいいって、
視子さんも言ってたものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko also said that males should
eat more, too.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki thinks the food has
been tasting better as of
recently.
fields.JP:
白雪も最近、
お食事がすごく美味しいと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White thinks the food has
been tasting better as of
recently.

fields.EN:
Ah, I get it! The food tastes
better because we have more people
at the table!
fields.JP:
なるほどね～。
二人が増えたから、美味しく感じるんだね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I get it! The food tastes
better because we have more people
at the table!

fields.EN:
It's fun to have everyone together
here, isn't it?
fields.JP: みんなでテーブルを囲むの、楽しいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fun to have everyone together
here, isn't it?

fields.EN:
Here you go, Nemu. You want this
sauce, right?
fields.JP:
……はい、ネム。
このソースでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here you go, Sleepy. You want this
sauce, right?

fields.EN:
I think the chef would be happy to
hear that from you.
fields.JP:
それは、
料理人さんに直接伝えると喜ぶよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think the chef would be happy to
hear that from you.

fields.EN:
(She's hardly talking, but they
can converse like normal?!)
fields.JP:
（……眠り姫はほとんど無言なのに、
　ちゃんと会話になってる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's hardly talking, but they
can converse like normal?!)

fields.EN:
Um, Nemu-chan...? Can you eat mine,
too...?
fields.JP:
……ネムちゃん。
これ、わたしの分も食べてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Sleepy...? Can you eat mine,
too...?

fields.EN:
Hey, Shirayuki! Don't make Nemu
eat what you can't eat!
fields.JP:
こら、白雪！
苦手だからって、ネムに食べさせるんじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Snow White! Don't make Sleepy
eat what you can't eat!

fields.EN: You're pretty sharp, Aka-nee, you know?
fields.JP: ふふ。赤姉はなんでもお見通しよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red is pretty sharp, you
know?

fields.EN:
Even if I have a hard time
understanding Nemu, she can read
her like a book.
fields.JP:
私でもたまに難しいのに、
ネムの言いたいこともちゃーんとわかるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if I have a hard time
understanding Sleepy, she can read
her like a book.

fields.EN:
She really watches over us,
doesn't she?
fields.JP:
それだけ白雪たちのことを
見ててくれてるんですね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She really watches over us,
doesn't she?

fields.EN:
(I see... Akazukin-san knows
how everyone feels because she
watches over everyone...)
fields.JP:
（そっか。赤ずきんさんは
　みんなのことをよく見ているから、
　みんなの気持ちがわかるんだなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... Red Riding Hood knows
how everyone feels because she
watches over everyone...)

fields.EN:
Are you okay, Akazukin-san? I
think I can reach it, so if you'd
like, I can get that for you.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん、大丈夫？
僕がとろうか。ちょっとは身長あるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you okay, Red Riding Hood? I
think I can reach it, so if you'd
like, I can get that for you.

fields.EN:
No problem. I just need to use a
chair to get it. I was the one who
put it up there, you know?
fields.JP:
これくらいなら、椅子使えば一緒だって。
第一、あたしがここにしまったんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem. I just need to use a
chair to get it. I was the one who
put it up there, you know?

fields.EN: Got it! It's my favorite hat.
fields.JP:
とれた！
これ、お気に入りの帽子なんだぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it! It's my favorite hat.

fields.EN:
But, it looked too cute for me, so
I haven't worn it at all...
fields.JP:
……可愛いすぎるかなって思って、
一度もかぶってないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it looked too cute for me, so
I haven't worn it at all...

fields.JP:
あっ！
赤ずきんさん、椅子が……！

fields.EN:
(S-She's going to fall! I need to
catch her!)
fields.JP:
（わわっ、倒れちゃう……！
　助けなきゃ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(S-She's going to fall! I need to
catch her!)

fields.EN:
Owww... Huh? It didn't hurt that
much...
fields.JP:
いったー！
……って、あれ、
そんなに痛くない……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Owww... Huh? It didn't hurt that
much...

fields.EN:
(Ouch... Thank goodness she didn't
fall headfirst...)
fields.JP:
（いたたた……。
　なんとか頭から転ばなくて
　すんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ouch... Thank goodness she didn't
fall headfirst...)

fields.JP: 『あかずきんさん、大丈夫だった？』
fields.LOCALIZED: Ref Rifin Hoof, are youf ofay?

fields.EN:
(I can't speak clearly...
Something's covering my face...)
fields.JP: （顔に何かが乗ってて、喋れないぞ！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't speak clearly...
Something's covering my face...)

fields.EN:
Wh-What the...?! Something's
moving! Eek! Wait... Jack?!
fields.JP:
なにこれ……動いてるっ！
やあっ……、えっ！？
ジャック！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What the...?! Something's
moving! Eek! Wait... Jack?!

fields.EN:
(What now?! Something soft is
sandwiching my face! Wait...!)
fields.JP:
（なんだ！？　今度は、耳とこめかみに両側から
　柔らかいものがむにゅっと……？
　……いや、そんなことより！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What now?! Something soft is
sandwiching my face! Wait...!)

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san, what's wrong?
It's pitch dark. Where are you?
fields.JP:
『赤ずきんさん、どうしたのっ？
　真っ暗だけど、どこにいるの？』
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whaf the maffer, Ref Rifin Hoof?
Ifs so darf. Are youf there?

fields.JP:
ひゃんっ！
そこで喋らないでよぉ！

fields.EN:
(Augh! My head's being squeezed
from both sides! I-I can't
breathe...!)
fields.JP:
（うわっ！
　頭を両側から挟まれる……！
　くっ、苦しい……っ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Augh! My head's being squeezed
from both sides! I-I can't
breathe...!)

fields.EN:
Aack! Huh... It's not dark
anymore...
fields.JP:
いったあ！
……あれ、明るくなった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aack! Huh... It's not dark
anymore...

fields.EN:
Uh, Akazukin-san? What are you
doing huddling in the corner like
that?
fields.JP:
あ、赤ずきんさん、どうしたの？
隅っこで小さくなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, Red Riding Hood? What are you
doing huddling in the corner like
that?

fields.JP: もしかして怪我したの！？

fields.EN:
Are you sure? I mean, you did fall
off the chair, and...
fields.JP:
ほんとに？
だって、椅子は倒れてるのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure? I mean, you did fall
off the chair, and...

fields.EN:
I'm not hurt! Y-You caught me, so
I'm fine...
fields.JP:
してないってば！
あ、あんたが、受け止めてくれたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not hurt! Y-You caught me, so
I'm fine...

fields.EN: Don't tell me... My face was...?!
fields.JP:
……もしかして、
僕の上に乗ってたのって……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't tell me... My face was...?!

fields.EN:
Shut up! Do you want to get kicked
again?!
fields.JP:
黙って！
また蹴られたくないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up! Do you want to get kicked
again?!

fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんの
　……お尻……だよね……？）
変なとこ見るんじゃない！

fields.EN:
(Well, covering up with her hat
isn't helping at all...!)
fields.JP:
（帽子で隠したら、
　ますます思い出しちゃうよ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, covering up with her hat
isn't helping at all...!)

fields.EN:
I-I'm so sorry! I didn't mean for
that to happen...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……！
そんなつもりはなかったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm so sorry! I didn't mean for
that to happen...

fields.EN:
If you did, I would have punched
you until you got amnesia!
fields.JP: ……あったら記憶飛ぶまで殴るから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you did, I would have punched
you until you got amnesia!

fields.EN:
I, um... Y-You were trying to help
me, right...?
fields.JP: ……助けてくれようとしたんでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I, um... Y-You were trying to help
me, right...?

fields.EN:
Thanks, Jack. I'm sorry for
kicking you like that... I was
just... embarrassed.
fields.JP:
……ありがとう、ジャック。
それなのに、恥ずかしくて、
思いっきり蹴っちゃってごめんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, Jack. I'm sorry for
kicking you like that... I was
just... embarrassed.

fields.JP: き、気にしなくていいよ……！

fields.EN:
I-I know! Let's, um, forget about
what happened!
fields.JP:
……そ、そうだ！
このことはもう忘れよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I know! Let's, um, forget about
what happened!

fields.EN:
Th-That sounds like a plan! We
didn't get hurt, so it works!
fields.JP:
そ、そうだねっ。
お互い怪我もないしさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That sounds like a plan! We
didn't get hurt, so it works!

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san's thighs were
really soft... Though being squeezed
between them hurt...)
fields.JP:
（……赤ずきんさん、
　太腿も柔らかかったなあ……。
　挟まれたのは、痛かったけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her thighs were really soft, but
boy, was that painful...)

fields.EN:
All right, then! Let's get
friendly with our newcomer!
fields.JP:
……さーてと！
ジャック、新入りと親交を深めようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, then! Let's get
friendly with our newcomer!

fields.EN:
(Sounds good, but what's with that
ball? Why do I have a bad feeling
about this...?)
fields.JP:
（それには賛成だけど、嫌な予感しか
　しないぞ……。ボール抱えてるし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sounds good, but what's with that
ball? Why do I have a bad feeling
about this...?)

fields.JP: グレーテル、開けるよー！

fields.EN:
Akazukin? Jack? What's
with the rude entry?
fields.JP:
赤ずきん……？
ジャックまで……不躾に何の用なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood? Jack? What's
with the rude entry?

fields.EN:
We just wanted to have a comfy
welcome party with you!
fields.JP:
個人的に、
グレーテルの歓迎会をしようと思ってね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We just wanted to have a comfy
welcome party with you!

fields.EN:
*sigh* I don't particularly
feel any need to study you, Akazukin.
fields.JP:
はあ……私は特に、あなたの研究をする必要を
感じてないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I have no intention of
getting to know you better at this
time.

fields.EN:
(I knew it... She refused us in an
instant...)
fields.JP: （やっぱり全力で拒否された……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I knew it... She refused us in an
instant...)

fields.JP:
よし！
……とりあえず、外に出るよ！
（……って、赤ずきんさん聞いてないし！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And, Red Riding Hood isn't
listening to her...)

fields.EN:
You need to explain to me the
purpose of going outside.
fields.JP:
……説明してもらわないと、それをする
意図がわからないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need to explain to me the
purpose of going outside.

fields.EN:
What's there to explain? We're
gonna play catch! It'll help with
training, too!
fields.JP:
そんなの……
ボール投げ合って遊ぶに決まってるじゃない！
訓練にもなるしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's there to explain? We're
gonna play catch! It'll help with
training, too!

fields.EN:
No, thanks. I'm spending my time
thinking now.
fields.JP:
……お断りするわ。
今は私にとって大切な、思考の時間なのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, thanks. I'm spending my time
thinking now.

fields.EN:
(I can almost hear Gretel adding
"unlike you" to her sentence...)
fields.JP:
（今、『赤ずきんと違って』って
　言葉が聞こえた気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can almost hear Gretel adding
"unlike you" to her sentence...)

fields.EN:
Okay! I guess a real challenge is
what you need instead of a simple
game of catch!
fields.JP:
……そうか！
ただボール投げて受け取るよりも、
ちゃんと勝負したほうが本気になれるよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! I guess a real challenge is
what you need instead of a simple
game of catch!

fields.EN:
Hmm... We could see who throws
the farthest, or play kickball, or
see who can hit Jack the most...
fields.JP:
うーん。どこまで飛ばせるか……
それとも蹴るか……
ジャックにどれだけ当てられるかでもいいし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... We could see who throws
the farthest, or play kickball, or
see who can hit Jack the most...

fields.EN:
(Uh, did she just say "who can hit
Jack the most?")
fields.JP: （えっ、僕に当てるって、今言ったよね！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh, did she just say "who can hit
Jack the most?")

fields.EN:
I see... Fighting Marchens isn't enough for
bloodthirsty Akazukin-san, so now
you want pointless contests too...
fields.JP:
……血の気の多い赤ずきんさんは、
メルヒェンと戦うだけでは足りなくて、
無意味な勝負事をしようっていうのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... You need futile
challenges to satiate your
appetite for battling Marchens.

fields.EN:
What do you mean "futile?!" We can
get to know each other better
through even a single challenge!
fields.JP:
無意味なんかじゃないよ！
一度本気で勝負すれば、お互いにもっと
わかり合えるようになるんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean "futile?!" We can
get to know each other better
through even a single challenge!

fields.EN:
(They're completely different. At
this rate, they're going to start
fighting...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんか、
　根本的な価値観の違いを感じるぞ……
　このままだとケンカに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're completely different. At
this rate, they're going to start
fighting...)

fields.EN:
Huh? What do you mean by that?
I just want to become friends with
you!
fields.JP:
……は？　どういうこと？
あたしは、黎明に来てくれたあんたと、
仲間として仲良くなりたくて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What do you mean by that?
I just want to become friends with
you!

fields.EN:
So how does that relate to your
suggested activities? Talking
should suffice.
fields.JP:
それで、どうして運動なのかしら……？
ゆっくり、色々な話をすればいいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
So how does that relate to your
suggested activities? Talking
should suffice.

fields.EN:
I can see sense in conversing to
deepen our knowledge of each
other.
fields.JP:
会話を通じてお互いについての知識を深める
ことは、確かに有意義なことだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can see sense in conversing to
deepen our knowledge of each
other.

fields.EN:
But if we challenge each other, we
wouldn't even need to talk to know
each other better!
fields.JP:
……それなら、
本気で体動かして勝負した後なら、
何も言わなくても通じ合えてるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we challenge each other, we
wouldn't even need to talk to know
each other better!

fields.EN:
I can see we're on different
planes.
fields.JP: ……どうやら全く話が噛み合わないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can see we're on different
planes.

fields.EN:
You keep holing yourself up
inside, so I wanted to...
fields.JP:
……いつもあんたがそうやって引きこもってる
から、あたしは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You keep holing yourself up
inside, so I wanted to...

fields.EN:
I doubt your brain of muscles is
suited for understanding me.
fields.JP:
……あなたの筋肉でできた脳では、
私のことを理解できるとは思えないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt your brain of muscles is
suited for understanding me.

fields.EN:
H-Hold on there! Calm down, you
two!
fields.JP:
ま、待って……！
落ち着いて、二人とも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hold on there! Calm down, you
two!

fields.EN:
You have something to say to me
too, Jack?!
fields.JP: ジャックまで、あたしに文句があるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have something to say to me
too, Jack?!

fields.JP:
私はいつも落ち着いているわよ。
……赤ずきんさんと違ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unlike Red Riding Hood, I'm always
calm.

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san just wants you to get along
with everyone at the Dawn, Gretel!
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんは、グレーテルにも、黎明の
みんなと仲良く過ごしてほしいだけなんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She just wants you to enjoy being
friends with everyone at the Dawn!

fields.EN:
W-Well, that's what I want to
happen, but...
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, that's what I want to
happen, but...

fields.EN:
But you'll be friendlier if we
talk instead of moving around and
doing things, right?!
fields.JP:
でもグレーテルは、運動より話をした方が
仲良くなれるんだよね！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you'll be friendlier if we
talk instead of moving around and
doing things, right?!

fields.EN:
Then neither Akazukin-san nor Gretel
is at fault! Neither of you is wrong!
fields.JP:
だったら、赤ずきんさんもグレーテルも
悪くないよ！
……どっちも間違ってない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, then! How come you two can't
get along?!

fields.JP: ……ジャック、ずいぶんと必死ね？

fields.EN: Yup! Look at how red your face is!
fields.JP:
……ほんとだ！
ジャックの顔、真っ赤になってる
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! Look at how red your face is!

fields.EN:
I just didn't want to see you two
arguing with each other, and...!
fields.JP:
あ、あの、僕は、
二人に喧嘩してほしくなくて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just didn't want to see you two
arguing with each other, and...!

fields.EN: Jack? Whose side are you on?
fields.JP:
ジャックー？
あんたどっちの味方なのー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? Whose side are you on?

fields.EN:
I believe siding with someone with
the proper mindset, like myself,
would do you the most good.
fields.JP:
まともな思考力のある私についた方が、
あなたのためになるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe siding with someone with
the proper mindset, like myself,
would do you the most good.

fields.EN:
Don't tell me you forgot all the
things we've been through
together, Jack!
fields.JP:
ジャックは、今までの付き合いを
全てなかったことにするつもり……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me you forgot all the
things we've been through
together, Jack!

fields.EN: W-Wait! You're both friends to me!
fields.JP:
そ、そんな……！
二人とも、黎明の仲間だし……！
fields.LOCALIZED: W-Wait! You're both friends to me!

fields.EN:
Men who can't decide are the
enemies of women.
fields.JP: 優柔不断な男は女の敵よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Men who can't decide are the
enemies of women.

fields.JP: そうだよね、グレーテル……！

fields.EN:
Why, it's only natural to think
so.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, it's only natural to think
so.

fields.EN: Do you have anything to say, Jack?
fields.JP: ジャック……弁明をしたい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you have anything to say, Jack?

fields.EN:
And to think I trusted you all
this time...
fields.JP:
あたしは、
あんたのことを信頼していたんだけどねえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And to think I trusted you all
this time...

fields.EN: Wha--?! What are you both saying?!
fields.JP:
うっ……
そんなこといわれても……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha--?! What are you both saying?!

fields.EN:
So, Jack? What are you going to
do?
fields.JP: それでジャック、どうするの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Jack? What are you going to
do?

fields.EN:
(So, this is Oyayubihime-san's
room... I'd better knock before I go in...)
fields.JP:
（ここが親指姫、さんの部屋か……
　やっぱりノックした方がいいのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So, this is Thumbelina's room...
I'd better knock before I go
in...)

fields.EN: You're... Hmph! Why are you here?!
fields.JP:
あんたは……
ふん、一体何の用よ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You're... Hmph! Why are you here?!

fields.JP: あ、ごめん……もしかして、忙しかった？

fields.EN:
I-I didn't say that! Um, you're
letting the cold air in, so just
come inside!
fields.JP:
べ、別に、そんなこと言ってないでしょ！
……突っ立ってないで、早く入りなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I didn't say that! Um, you're
letting the cold air in, so just
come inside!

fields.JP: そ、それじゃあ……失礼します
（わ、なんか良い匂いがする部屋だなあ……）

fields.EN:
By the way, are you okay?
Shouldn't you be resting or
something?
fields.JP:
……っていうかあんた、身体は大丈夫なの？
まだ大人しく寝てた方がいいんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, are you okay?
Shouldn't you be resting or
something?

fields.EN:
Thanks, but I think I'm okay now.
Sorry to have worried you.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、もう大丈夫……だと思う。
心配かけてごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, but I think I'm okay now.
Sorry to have worried you.

fields.EN:
I-I wasn't worried at all! Uh, so
what brings you here?
fields.JP:
べっ……別に心配なんかしてないわよ！
……で、一体わたしに何の用なわけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I wasn't worried at all! Uh, so
what brings you here?

fields.EN:
Oh, um... I was worried about you,
too. I mean, you were captured,
Oyayubihime-san.
fields.JP:
あ、うん……その、僕も少し心配になって。
親指姫さんも、ずっと囚われてたわけだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... I was worried about you,
too. I mean, you were captured,
Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
Hmph! That's none of your
business! Don't lump me in with you!
fields.JP:
……ふん、大きなお世話よ！
あんたなんかと一緒にしないでよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! That's none of your
business! I'm not some wimp, you
know?

fields.EN: Oh, I see... That's good, then.
fields.JP: そ、そっか……ならよかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I see... That's good, then.

fields.EN:
Well, I do appreciate that you
thinking about me... Um...
Th-Thanks!
fields.JP:
ま、心配してくれたのには……
その……感謝してあげるわ。
あ、ありがと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I do appreciate that you
thinking about me... Um...
Th-Thanks!

fields.EN: Heh... You don't need to thank me.
fields.JP: あはは……そんなお礼なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh... You don't need to thank me.

fields.EN:
(She's a bit rough with her words,
but she's really a nice person...)
fields.JP:
（言い方はけっこうキツイけど……
　なんだかんだで、優しい子なんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's a bit rough with her words,
but she's really a nice person...)

fields.EN:
Well, to be honest, they didn't do
anything to me.
fields.JP: それに……実際、特に何もされてないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, to be honest, they didn't do
anything to me.

fields.EN:
They handled me roughly, sure... but there
was no torture or corporal punishment at
all. I guess I was lucky in that sense...
fields.JP:
確かに扱いは手荒だったけど……
拷問とか体罰とかは、全くなかったのよね。
ラッキーといえばラッキーだったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They did rough me up a bit, but
they didn't exactly torture me.
Guess you could call it lucky.

fields.EN:
(Alice and I were tortured when we
were captured... What's different
about her situation?)
fields.JP:
（僕やアリスの時とは違う……何でだろう？
　無事だったなら、
　もちろんその方がいいんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice and I were tortured when we
were captured... What's different
about her situation?)

fields.EN:
...And apologize properly for
treating me like the youngest little sister!
fields.JP:
あんた、わたしを一番下の妹扱いしたこと……
ちゃんと謝りなさいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you want to apologize, you
should apologize for treating me
like a younger sister!

fields.EN:
Oh, um... Sorry! I'll be careful
next time!
fields.JP:
ごっ……ごめん！
これからは気を付けるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Sorry! I'll be careful
next time!

fields.EN:
Fine... I guess I can let you go
this time. Oh, and... I'm sorry I hit you...
fields.JP:
……まあいいわ。許してあげる！
わたしもぶったりして……
その……悪かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I guess I can let you go
this time. Oh, and... I'm sorry I hit you...

fields.EN:
I'm officially a member now, so,
um... Oyayubihime-san. I-I hope
we can get along from now on...!
fields.JP:
一応、正式に仲間になったわけだし……
その……親指姫、さん。
こ、これからよろしく……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm officially a member now, so,
um... I hope we can get to know
each other better, Thumbelina!

fields.EN:
Quit it with the formalities... I
can tell you're not used to that
kind of thing. It creeps me out!
fields.JP:
べ……別に「さん」付けしなくていいわ。
明らかに呼び慣れそうにないし……
なんだかムズムズするのよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quit it with the formalities... I
can tell you're not used to that
kind of thing. It creeps me out!

fields.EN:
Well then, looking forward to
working with you, Oyayubihime.
fields.JP:
じゃあ……親指姫。
これからもよろしくね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, looking forward to
working with you, Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
Hmph... Just so you know, we're
about the same age, so I'm just
going to call you "Jack," got it?
fields.JP:
ふん、その代わり……
わたしもジャックって呼ばせてもらうからね！
見たところ、どうせ同い年くらいだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... Just so you know, we're
about the same age, so I'm just
going to call you "Jack," got it?

fields.EN:
Oh, of course... Wait... What?!
We're about the same age?!
Really?!
fields.JP:
も、もちろん……って、えっ！？　
同い年くらい？　そ、そうだったの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, of course... Wait... What?!
We're about the same age?!
Really?!

fields.JP: ……なんでそこでそんなに驚くわけ？

fields.EN:
Uh... W-Well, not in any way that
would mean something negative...
fields.JP:
えっ？
い、いや決して、そういう意味じゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... W-Well, not in any way that
would mean something negative...

fields.EN:
The next time you say something
strange, you're seriously gonna
get it!
fields.JP: ……次また変な事言ったら、マジで殺すからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The next time you say something
strange, you're seriously gonna
get it!

fields.EN:
(Whew... I better watch out next
time. But she's a lot friendlier
than I thought.)
fields.JP:
（ほっ……これからは気を付けよう。
　でも……
　思ったより話しやすい子で、よかったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whew... I better watch out next
time. But she's a lot friendlier
than I thought.)

fields.EN:
(Hm? What's that sound...? Am I
hearing things?)
fields.JP:
（ん？なんだろう……
　今何か物音がした気が……気のせい？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? What's that sound...? Am I
hearing things?)

fields.EN:
(A real cat! I need to find it!
And cuddle it, if possible!)
fields.JP:
（……こんなところに猫がいるなんて！！
　これは……ぜひとも見つけたい！！
　そして、できればもふもふしたい……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A real cat! I need to find it!
And cuddle it, if possible!)

fields.JP: お～いネコちゃ～ん、どこにいるの～？

fields.EN:
Whoops... Maybe it's scared...
Don't worry, I won't hurt you... I
just want to pet you...
fields.JP:
あはは……怯えてるのかな？
大丈夫……怖くないよ。
ちょっと触らせてくれるだけでいいから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoops... Maybe it's scared...
Don't worry, I won't hurt you... I
just want to pet you...

fields.EN:
(The cat's angry? Maybe it's not
used to people. But I can't give
up now...)
fields.JP:
（……あれ、なんか怒ってる？
　あまり人間慣れしてないのかな？
　でも、ここで諦めるわけには……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The cat's angry? Maybe it's not
used to people. But I can't give
up now...)

fields.EN:
Where are you? Don't be afraid.
Come on out...
fields.JP:
……どこにいるのかな……？
怖くないから出ておいで～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where are you? Don't be afraid.
Come on out...

fields.JP:
フーーッ！　フーーーッ！！
ぐるるる……！！

fields.EN:
(The cat's trying to intimidate
me? But, I know where it is now...
Probably that box over there...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだか威嚇されてるような……？
　でも、大体の場所が分かってきたぞ……
　この箱のあたり、かな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The cat's trying to intimidate
me? But, I know where it is now...
Probably that box over there...)

fields.EN:
Aaaaagh! What is it with you?!
Hurry and get out!
fields.JP:
……あーーーーー、もう！！
何なのよ一体！？
早くどっか行きなさいよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaaaagh! What is it with you?!
Hurry and get out!

fields.EN:
And just when I was relaxing out
here... You're so annoying! Just
give it up already!
fields.JP:
せっかく人がまったりしてたのに……
何なのよあんたは！
さっさと諦めなさいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And just when I was relaxing out
here... You're so annoying! Just
give it up already!

fields.EN:
I-I'm so sorry! Hey, wait...
Oyayubihime?!
fields.JP:
ご、ごご、ごめんなさいっ！！？
って……お、親指姫！！？？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm so sorry! Hey, wait...
Thumbelina?!

fields.EN:
You better not tell anyone that I
like being in cramped places, you
hear?!
fields.JP:
……わたしが狭い所が好きなこと、
絶対誰にも言うんじゃないわよ、このバカ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You better not tell anyone that I
like being in cramped places, you
hear?!

fields.EN:
(I see... So she meowed, hoping I
would just leave the area...)
fields.JP:
（なるほど……それで見つかりたくなくて、
　猫のフリしてたのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... So she meowed, hoping I
would just leave the area...)

fields.EN:
(But what's with her wanting to be
in such a cramped space like
that?)
fields.JP:
（でも、何もあんな小さい所に入らなくても……
　ど、どういう趣味なんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But what's with her wanting to be
in such a cramped space like
that?)

fields.EN:
Jack... That wound of yours... Are
you sure you're okay?
fields.JP:
……ジャック。
ちょっとあんた……その傷。
……大丈夫なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... That wound of yours... Are
you sure you're okay?

fields.EN:
Are you deaf?! Are you sure you're
okay?! Like, you sure you're not
bleeding or anything?!
fields.JP:
……だーかーら！！
無理しすぎてないかって聞いてんのよ！
血、流しすぎてないかってこと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you deaf?! Are you sure you're
okay?! Like, you sure you're not
bleeding or anything?!

fields.EN:
Oh, thanks. I think I'm still
okay...
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとう。
多分、まだ大丈夫だと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, thanks. I think I'm still
okay...

fields.EN: Augh! You! Come here for a moment!
fields.JP:
……あー、もう！！
あんた、ちょっとこっちへ来なさい！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Augh! You! Come here for a moment!

fields.EN:
Hmph! I guess this place should
do.
fields.JP:
……ふん！
ま、ここならいいかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! I guess this place should
do.

fields.EN: Um, why are you so upset...?
fields.JP: ど、どうしたの？　急に怒って……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, why are you so upset...?

fields.EN:
Augh! I'm telling you I'm going to
treat that wound of yours! Just
sit!
fields.JP:
……あーもう！！
て、手当てしてやるって言ってんの！
つべこべ言わずにそこに座んなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Augh! I'm telling you I'm going to
treat that wound of yours! Just
sit!

fields.EN:
You really are too nice for your
own good... You really seem more
keen about others than yourself.
fields.JP:
大体……あんたって、お人好し過ぎるのよ。
他人にはやたら優しいくせに、
自分の事だけは妙に鈍感っていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are too nice for your
own good... You really seem more
keen about others than yourself.

fields.JP:
あはは……そ……そうかな？
……痛っ……！！

fields.EN:
*sigh* You're a guy, so just bear
it!
fields.JP:
男なんだから、このくらいガマンしなさいよね！
まったく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* You're a guy, so just bear
it!

fields.EN:
Th-Thanks... You really are kind,
Oyayubihime.
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとう……
親指姫は……優しいんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thanks... You really are kind,
Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
D-Don't get the wrong idea! I just don't want
you bleeding more than necessary! We'd be in
trouble if you couldn't help when it matters!
fields.JP:
かっ……勘違いしないでよね！
あんたに余計な出血して欲しくないだけよ！
肝心な時に役に立たなかったら、困るし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't you take this the wrong
way! Your blood is important to
us, so you can't be bleeding!

fields.EN:
Heh... You're right. But, thanks
anyway for keeping an eye out for
me.
fields.JP:
あはは……それは、確かにそうだね。
でも、ありがとう……
心配してくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... You're right. But, thanks
anyway for keeping an eye out for
me.

fields.EN:
(She may be abrasive, but she
really is kind...)
fields.JP:
（言い方は乱暴だけど……
　この子、本当に優しい子なんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She may be abrasive, but she
really is kind...)

fields.EN:
Hmph! Flattery isn't going to get
you anywhere!
fields.JP:
ふっ……ふん！
そんな風に褒めたって、
別に何も出ないんだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! Flattery isn't going to get
you anywhere!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Sorry. By the way, do
you mind I ask you a question?
fields.JP:
あはは……ごめん。
ところで、素朴な疑問なんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Sorry. By the way, do
you mind I ask you a question?

fields.EN:
Um... Why are we in such a narrow
place...?
fields.JP:
その……なんでまた……
わざわざこんな狭い場所に？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Why are we in such a narrow
place...?

fields.EN:
Oh, that's right... I forgot that
you told me you like cramped
places...
fields.JP:
あっ……そっか！
ごめん、忘れてた。
親指姫は、確か狭い場所が好きなんだっ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's right... I forgot that
you told me you like cramped
places...

fields.EN:
I told you to not tell anyone, you
idiot! We're done here, so let's
get going!
fields.JP:
だ……誰にも言うなって言ったでしょ！！
……このバカ！！
手当ては済んだんだし、さっさと行くわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you to not tell anyone, you
idiot! We're done here, so let's
get going!

fields.JP: （だ、誰にも言ってないんだけど……！？）

fields.EN: Oh, it's just you... What is it?
fields.JP:
なんだ、ジャックか……
……何の用よ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it's just you... What is it?

fields.EN:
Oh, um... I was just passing by,
and I heard you sighing, so...
fields.JP:
あ、いや……
たまたま部屋の前を通りかかったら、
溜め息が聞こえてきたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... I was just passing by,
and I heard you sighing, so...

fields.EN:
That's it? Wow, you really are too
nice for your own good...
fields.JP:
それだけで？　……呆れた。
あんたって、ほんとにお人好しね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's it? Wow, you really are too
nice for your own good...

fields.EN:
Those two told me...
"Nee-sama, you worry too much"...
fields.JP:
……あの二人に、言われたんだ。
姉さまは、心配しすぎだってね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My two younger sisters told me
that I worry too much...

fields.EN:
Two...? Oh, you mean Shirayukihime
and Nemurihime?
fields.JP: あの二人って……白雪姫と眠り姫のこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Two...? Oh, you mean Snow White
and Sleeping Beauty?

fields.EN:
I've supported them since we were little,
so I thought I had to keep supporting
them from now on too... That's all...!
fields.JP:
小さい頃からわたしが支えてきたから、
これからも支えなきゃいけないって……
そう思ってただけなのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I only wanted to support them like
I used to when we were all
little...

fields.EN:
Apparently even that was unwanted
meddling. I was just being
self-righteous... Pretty stupid, huh?
fields.JP:
どうやら、それも大きなお世話だったみたい。
わたしの独りよがりだったってことね……
……バカみたいでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that's just too much for
them now. Seems like I was doing
it for nothing. Lame...

fields.JP: そ、そんなことはないと思うけど……

fields.EN: What do you think I should do?
fields.JP: ねえ……わたし、どうしたらいいのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you think I should do?

fields.EN:
I'm just kidding... No use talking
to you about it...
fields.JP:
……なーんてね。
あんたに話しても仕方ないわよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just kidding... No use talking
to you about it...

fields.EN:
(She must have been keeping up a
front to do her best as the
eldest...)
fields.JP:
（きっと……ずっと気を張ってたんだろうな。
　お姉さんとして、自分を奮い立たせて。
　ずっと頑張ってきたんだ、この子は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must have been keeping up a
front to do her best as the
eldest...)

fields.EN:
(But I bet those two just wanted
to tell her not to overdo it...)
fields.JP:
（でも、親指姫だけが無理しなくたって……
　あの二人だってそれを知ってるから、
　そう言ったんだよな、きっと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I bet those two just wanted
to tell her not to overdo it...)

fields.EN:
Um... I don't think you really
need to do anything.
fields.JP:
その……
何もしなくて、いいんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I don't think you really
need to do anything.

fields.EN:
Um... I don't think they dislike
you or anything. Just that they
didn't want you to push yourself.
fields.JP:
あ、いや……なんていうか、
二人とも君のことを嫌ってないと思うんだ。
だから、無理にがんばらなくても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I don't think they dislike
you or anything. Just that they
didn't want you to push yourself.

fields.JP: ……あんたに何が分かるっていうの？

fields.EN:
Huh? Um, well, I don't know,
but...
fields.JP:
え？　いや……
それはそうなんだけど……
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Um, well, I don't know,
but...

fields.EN:
...You've got it easy. Everyone
relies on you and needs you... Of
course you're different from me!!
fields.JP:
……あんたはいいわよね。
みんなから頼りにされて、必要とされて……
そりゃあ、わたしとは違うわよね！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're lucky everyone relies on
you, unlike me!

fields.EN:
Wh-Where did that come from?! I
just think they were thinking of
you, and...
fields.JP:
そ、そういう意味じゃないよ！
あの二人だって、きっと君のことを思って……
だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Where did that come from?! I
just think they were thinking of
you, and...

fields.EN:
Fine! I'm not reliable! But... But
I still...
fields.JP:
どうせわたしは頼りになんかならないわよ！！
でも、それでもわたしだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine! I'm not reliable! But... But
I still...

fields.JP:
そ、そんな事ないよ……！
君は……

fields.EN:
Fine! I'll leave! You stupid
idiot! I don't care anymore!
fields.JP:
……じゃあわたしが出てくわよ！！
このバカ！！　グズ！！
もう知らないんだから！！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine! I'll leave! You stupid
idiot! I don't care anymore!

fields.EN:
(I was just trying to console
her... I guess I just hurt her
more...)
fields.JP:
（……結局、余計に傷付けちゃったのかな……
　励ましたかっただけなのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was just trying to console
her... I guess I just hurt her
more...)

fields.EN:
(Why am I always like this? I need
to apologize to her later.)
fields.JP:
（どうしていつも僕はこうなんだ……
　……後で、ちゃんと謝らなくっちゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why am I always like this? I need
to apologize to her later.)

fields.EN:
*sigh* Dang it! Why did I say
that?!
fields.JP:
はあ……あー、もう……！！
なんであんな事言っちゃったんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Dang it! Why did I say
that?!

fields.EN:
He was just worried about me... I
know that, but... I'm so stupid...
fields.JP:
あいつだって、心配してくれただけなのに……
それは分かってるはずなのに……
……わたしって、ほんとバカ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He was just worried about me... I
know that, but... I'm so stupid...

fields.JP:
な、ななな、何やってんのよ？
こんなところで……

fields.EN:
Uh, well... I was just passing
by...
fields.JP:
い、いや別に……
たまたま通りかかっただけだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... I was just passing
by...

fields.EN:
(I wonder if she's still feeling
down about what happened before.
I have to apologize to her...)
fields.JP:
（この間のこと、まだ気にしてるのかな……
　だったら、僕も謝らなくっちゃ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if she's still feeling
down about what happened before.
I have to apologize to her...)

fields.EN:
Um... About last time... That was
my bad...
fields.JP:
こっ……この間はその……
悪かったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... About last time... That was
my bad...

fields.EN:
I just lost it, and... Um... I'm
sorry...
fields.JP:
わたしとしたことが、
ついカーッとなっちゃって……
その……ごめんなさい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just lost it, and... Um... I'm
sorry...

fields.EN:
(It's so awkward seeing her
apologize like that... Well, at
least she's not angry anymore...)
fields.JP:
（こ、こんなに素直に謝られると、
　なんか調子狂うな……
　でも、怒ってなくてよかった……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's so awkward seeing her
apologize like that... Well, at
least she's not angry anymore...)

fields.EN:
No, I'm sorry for not thinking
more about your feelings before...
fields.JP:
……こっちこそ、ごめん。
僕も、君の気持ちを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm sorry for not thinking
more about your feelings before...

fields.EN: I think... I was envious of you...
fields.JP:
……わたしね。
きっと、あんたが羨ましかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I think... I was envious of you...

fields.EN:
You always worry about everyone,
even to the point of becoming
anemic... And everyone needs you.
fields.JP:
ほら、あんたはいつも貧血になってまで……
皆の事を気にかけてたから。
……皆から、必要とされてるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You keep worrying about everyone,
even as you're losing your
blood... Everyone... needs you.

fields.JP:
あんたは、皆にとって……
いなくちゃならない存在だから

fields.EN:
That's why I felt lonely when you
told me that I didn't need to do
anything...
fields.JP:
だから、そんなあんたに
『何もしなくていい』って言われて……
きっと、寂しかったんだと思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I felt lonely when you
told me that I didn't need to do
anything...

fields.EN:
Don't worry... I understand. I
know you weren't trying to hurt
anyone...
fields.JP:
大丈夫……分かってるわよ。
あんたに悪気がない事くらい、ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry... I understand. I
know you weren't trying to hurt
anyone...

fields.EN:
I really was trying to make those
two rely on me. I guess that's why
I was pushing myself too hard...
fields.JP:
わたし……確かにあの二人に、
頼られようとしてたみたい。
それで無理してたのね、きっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted my younger sisters to
depend on me, so I must have
been too pushy with them...

fields.EN:
(I can relate... Sometimes I feel
like that's what I'm doing,
too...)
fields.JP:
（なんかその気持ち、わかるなあ……
　僕も同じようなものなのかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can relate... Sometimes I feel
like that's what I'm doing,
too...)

fields.EN:
I felt like that when I first came
here... I was trying to find a
way to make myself useful...
fields.JP:
僕も、ここに来たばかりの頃、
そんな気持ちだったんだ……
何の役にも立たないって、焦って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt like that when I first came
here... I was trying to find a
way to make myself useful...

fields.EN:
I know! Why don't you give your
sisters a gift?
fields.JP:
……そうだ！
あの二人が喜ぶように……
何かプレゼントでもしてみたら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! Why don't you give your
sisters a gift?

fields.EN:
Yeah! I'm sure that would make
them happy!
fields.JP:
うん！　無理に頼られようとしなくても、
きっと喜んでもらえると思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! I'm sure that would make
them happy!

fields.EN:
I see...! Okay, then I'm going to
need you help me out, too!
fields.JP:
そっか……！
……じゃあ、ジャック。
ちょっとあんたの知恵を借りるわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...! Okay, then I'm going to
need you help me out, too!

fields.EN:
H-Help...? What do you mean by
that?
fields.JP:
ち、知恵……？　
どういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Help...? What do you mean by
that?

fields.EN: I, uh... I'll tell you later!
fields.JP: そっ……それはまた今度話すわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I, uh... I'll tell you later!

fields.JP:
その……ありがとう。
……じゃあね！

fields.EN:
(That's the first time I've seen
her smile like that... At least
she looks happy now.)
fields.JP:
（あんな屈託のない笑顔、初めて見たな……
　とにかく、仲直りできてよかった。
　……でも僕、何か特別なこと言ったかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's the first time I've seen
her smile like that... At least
she looks happy now.)

fields.EN:
(Oyayubihime? What's she doing?
It looks like... she's making
something?)
fields.JP:
（あ、親指姫……何やってんだろ？
　何か作ろうとしてるみたいだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thumbelina? What's she doing?
It looks like... she's making
something?)

fields.EN:
Augh! What's with all these
steps?! I don't have enough
ingredients, either!
fields.JP:
……あーーもう！！
なんで工程がこんなにめんどくさいのよ！
そもそも材料がないっつーの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Augh! What's with all these
steps?! I don't have enough
ingredients, either!

fields.EN:
J-Jack?! It's nothing! I'm not
baking cookies or anything!
fields.JP:
ジャ、ジャック……！！
な、何でもないわよ！
別にクッキーなんて作ってないし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Jack?! It's nothing! I'm not
baking cookies or anything!

fields.EN:
C-Cookies? Why are you baking
cookies?
fields.JP:
く、クッキー……？
何でまたそんなものを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
C-Cookies? Why are you baking
cookies?

fields.EN:
Ah... I-It's none of your
business!
fields.JP: あっ……な、なんでもないわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... I-It's none of your
business!

fields.EN:
Wait... Are you making them for
the gift we talked about before?
fields.JP:
もしかして……！
この間言ってた、プレゼントのこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Are you making them for
the gift we talked about before?

fields.EN:
Um... Y-Yes. You've got a problem
with that?! I figured Shirayuki
and Nemu would like them...
fields.JP:
あ……！
そ、そうよ。……悪い！？
白雪とネムにあげたら、喜ぶかなと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Y-Yes. You've got a problem
with that?! I figured Snow White
and Sleepy would like them...

fields.EN:
(So that's why she was so
focused...)
fields.JP: （そうだったのか、それでこんなに必死に……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So that's why she was so
focused...)

fields.EN:
I got the recipe and appliances
from Gretel, but I didn't expect
it to be this hard!
fields.JP:
グレーテルに、
レシピ本も、機材も借りたんだけど……
こんなに苦戦するとは思わなかったわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got the recipe and appliances
from Gretel, but I didn't expect
it to be this hard!

fields.EN:
Gathering all the ingredients is
difficult, so I'm sure they'll be
happy regardless!
fields.JP:
食材集めるのも一苦労だもんね……
でも、きっと大丈夫だよ！
きっとあの二人も喜ぶと思う……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gathering all the ingredients is
difficult, so I'm sure they'll be
happy regardless!

fields.EN:
D-Do you think so? I just wanted
to have a small get-together to
celebrate all we've been through.
fields.JP:
そ、そうかしら……？
……ちゃんと祝おうと思ったのよ。
三人の……わたし達姉妹の、今までを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Do you think so? I just wanted
to have a small get-together to
celebrate all we've been through.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
We've never celebrated birthdays
or anything, but I figured we
could do something similar.
fields.JP:
わたし達って……生まれてから今まで、
誕生日なんて意識したことなかったから。
だからせめて……ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've never celebrated birthdays
or anything, but I figured we
could do something similar.

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it... none
of us knows our own birthday...)
fields.JP:
（確かに……僕たちみんな、
　自分の誕生日なんて分からないもんな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, I don't
think I know when my birthday is,
either...)

fields.EN:
Huh...? Hmph! I'm fine! I don't
need your help! You don't trust
me or what?!
fields.JP:
え……。ふん！　別に大丈夫よ！
あんたの助けなんて！
それとも何？　わたしの腕じゃ心配なわけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...? Hmph! I'm fine! I don't
need your help! You don't trust
me or what?!

fields.EN:
Uh, that's not it, but... I'm
sorry!
fields.JP:
いや、そういうわけじゃないけど……
ご、ごめん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, that's not it, but... I'm
sorry!

fields.EN:
(I have to admit, I am a little
worried...)
fields.JP: （まあ、確かにちょっと心配ではあるけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to admit, I am a little
worried...)

fields.EN:
I appreciate the thought, but I
need to do this myself!
fields.JP:
……気持ちは受け取っておいてあげるわ。
でも今回はわたしが……
一人でやらなきゃダメなの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate the thought, but I
need to do this myself!

fields.EN:
(Guess she really is serious about
it...)
fields.JP: （……彼女なりに、きっと真剣なんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess she really is serious about
it...)

fields.EN:
I see... Well, you don't mind if I
stay here, do you? I just want to
see the results.
fields.JP:
そっか……じゃあ僕は、ここで見てるよ。
ちゃんと完成するまで……
それならいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Well, you don't mind if I
stay here, do you? I just want to
see the results.

fields.EN:
Hmph! Fine! Suit yourself! But
you're gonna get it if you get in
my way!
fields.JP:
ふ……ふん、勝手にしなさいよ！
ただし……邪魔したら殺すわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! Fine! Suit yourself! But
you're gonna get it if you get in
my way!

fields.EN:
I-I did it! It's finally
finished, Jack! It came out perfectly!
fields.JP:
で……できたー！！
ついに完成したわ、ジャック！！
会心の出来よ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm done! I did it, Jack! It's
the best batch I've made yet!

fields.JP: やった！　おめでとう！！

fields.EN:
Hah! Of course I'm great! Nothing
to it! Now then, time to go and
give them my cookies!
fields.JP:
ふ……ふん、まあね！
わたしの手にかかれば、こんなの簡単よ！
じゃあ、さっそく渡しに行ってくるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hah! Of course I'm great! Nothing
to it! Now then, time to go and
give them my cookies!

fields.JP:
あはは……
うん、頑張ってね！

fields.EN:
Oh, um... D-Do you... want to
come, too?
fields.JP:
あ……そうだ。
その……あ、あんたもよかったら……
一緒に来る……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... D-Do you... want to
come, too?

fields.EN:
You did come up with the idea of
giving them a gift, so... I'll let
you come with me this time!
fields.JP:
プレゼントの案を出してくれたのは
あんただし……
と……特別に、許してあげるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You did come up with the idea of
giving them a gift, so... I'll let
you come with me this time!

fields.EN:
Th-Thanks... But this time, the three of
you should enjoy yourselves. It's a rare
chance for the sisters to be alone together.
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとう……
でも……今回は、三人で楽しんできなよ。
せっかくの姉妹水入らずなんだし……さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thanks... But, this is a
special occasion for you three, so
you should go by yourself.

fields.EN:
Um... Thanks! Well, just be happy
knowing I appreciate all you did!
fields.JP:
あ……ありがとっ！
今回は素直に感謝してあげるから、
感謝しなさいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Thanks! Well, just be happy
knowing I appreciate all you did!

fields.EN:
(I hope they're enjoying their
time together.)
fields.JP: （今頃、三人で楽しんでるかなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope they're enjoying their
time together.)

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime...? So, how was it? Did
they enjoy it?
fields.JP:
あ、親指姫……！
どうだったの？　喜んでもらえた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina...? So, how was it? Did
they enjoy it?

fields.EN:
Well, of course... They were
ecstatic!
fields.JP:
まあね……当たり前じゃない……
二人とも、大喜びだったわよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, of course... They were
ecstatic!

fields.EN:
That's good to hear! So how come
you look so pale...?
fields.JP:
そっか、よかった……！
でも……どうしたの？
なんだか顔色が悪いけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear! So how come
you look so pale...?

fields.JP:
な、なんでもないわ……
ちょ、ちょっと疲れただけ……

fields.EN:
I feel a little dizzy now... You
don't mind me borrowing you, do
you?
fields.JP:
……なんだか身体がフラフラして……
寄りかかったりして、迷惑だったかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel a little dizzy now... You
don't mind me borrowing you, do
you?

fields.EN:
(Her nerves must have been off the
charts...)
fields.JP: （よっぽど気を張ってたんだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her nerves must have been off the
charts...)

fields.JP: ……な、なに人の頭触ってんのよ！？

fields.EN:
Hmph! Well, I guess I can let you
off easy this time...
fields.JP:
ふ、ふん……まあ、いいわ。
今回だけは、特別に許してあげる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! Well, I guess I can let you
off easy this time...

fields.EN:
You don't need to thank me.
It's not like it costs me anything...
fields.JP:
……お礼なんて、別にいいわよ。
……別に減るもんじゃないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to thank me. It's
not like you're getting
anything...

fields.EN:
(Hm? What are those three doing
there?)
fields.JP:
（……あれは……親指姫たちだ……
　姉妹三人揃って、何やってるんだろ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? What are those three doing
there?)

fields.EN:
Huh? What the...? You want me to
teach you how to bake cookies?
fields.JP:
……え？
クッキーの作り方を教えて欲しいって？
どうしたのよ、二人とも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What the...? You want me to
teach you how to bake cookies?

fields.EN:
Yes! We wanted to return our
thanks to you, Oyayubi-neesama.
fields.JP:
はい！
親指姉様に何かお返しをしたくって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! We wanted to return our
thanks to you, dear sister.

fields.EN:
Yup... Yup... I wanna... give you
a gift...
fields.JP:
……ん……ん……
ボクも……プレゼント……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... Yup... I wanna... give you
a gift...

fields.EN:
Mmm... Well, it's not like I'm a
master at it or anything...
fields.JP:
う～ん……
そう言われても、ねえ。
わたしもそんなに自信があるわけじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Well, it's not like I'm a
master at it or anything...

fields.EN:
That's not true! The cookies were
very delicious!
fields.JP:
えっ、そうなんですか？
でも、とっても美味しかったです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true! The cookies were
very delicious!

fields.EN:
R-Really? Well, I guess I can show
you how to bake them next time.
fields.JP:
そ、そう……？
じゃあ、今度一緒に作りましょ。
わたしが教えてあげるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Really? Well, I guess I can show
you how to bake them next time.

fields.JP:
本当ですか！？
わぁ……！
よかったね、ネムちゃん！

fields.EN:
I know! Why don't we make cookies
for everyone? It'll be good
training for us!
fields.JP:
そうだ！
それなら、みんなの分も作っちゃおっか。
たくさん作れば三人とも、練習できるしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! Why don't we make cookies
for everyone? It'll be good
training for us!

fields.JP:
わあ……！
それは名案ですね～！

fields.EN:
All right then! Let's go and get
the ingredients!
fields.JP:
よ～し、そうと決まったら……
さっそく材料集めよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right then! Let's go and get
the ingredients!

fields.EN:
(She may be rough at times, but
she's really kind to her
sisters...)
fields.JP:
（ふふ……いつもは厳しいけど、
　二人の前では優しいお姉さんなんだな。
　……そりゃそうだよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She may be rough at times, but
she's really kind to her
sisters...)

fields.EN:
Oh, but what should we do if they
don't turn out well? We can't give
them to someone else...
fields.JP:
あ、でも……もし失敗しちゃったら、
その分はどうしましょう？
皆にあげるわけにもいかないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but what should we do if they
don't turn out well? We can't give
them to someone else...

fields.EN:
No problem! We'll just give them
to Jack! He's a guy, so I'm sure
he'll eat anything!
fields.JP:
それなら大丈夫よ！
ジャックのやつに食べさせればいいじゃない。
一応男なんだし、きっとよく食べるでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem! We'll just give them
to Jack! He's a guy, so I'm sure
he'll eat anything!

fields.EN: That also sounds like a plan!
fields.LOCALIZED: That also sounds like a plan!

fields.EN:
(I'll just assume I didn't hear
anything. She'll get mad if she
finds out I overheard...)
fields.JP:
（い、今のは聞かなかったことにしとこう……
　聞かれてたって知ったら、絶対怒る……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'll just assume I didn't hear
anything. She'll get mad if she
finds out I overheard...)

fields.EN:
Shirayuki, I'm fine! I can do it
myself.
fields.JP:
もう……白雪！　
ほんとに大丈夫だって！
わたし一人でも、出来るから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, I'm fine! I can do it
myself.

fields.EN:
No, Oyayubi-neesama! This is your
first time wearing one,
so Shirayuki will help!
fields.JP:
ダメですよ、親指姉様！
何せ、初めてなんですから……
ちゃんと白雪がお手伝いします！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, dear sister! This is your
first time wearing one, so Snow
White will help!

fields.EN:
What's the big deal...? It's just
a bra... And you know, I'm the
older one here...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな、大げさな……
たかがブラジャーなのに……
っていうか、わたしの方が姉なんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the big deal...? It's just
a bra... And you know, I'm the
older one here...

fields.EN:
Big deal?! It is a big deal! Let's
measure you first!
fields.JP:
たかがじゃありません！
女の子にとっては、大切なことです！
というわけで、まずはサイズを測りましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Big deal?! It is a big deal! Let's
measure you first!

fields.EN:
Huh? What the...?! Just let me
share whatever you're wearing!
fields.JP:
え？　な、なんでそうなるのよ！？
ブラなんて、白雪のと同じのでいいじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What the...?! Just let me
share whatever you're wearing!

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama... I hate to say this, but
I don't think mine will fit you. Mainly
because there'd be too much room...
fields.JP:
親指姉様……とっても言いにくいんですけど、
白雪のでは、サイズがきっと合いません。
主に余ってしまう的な意味で、です
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hate to say this, but... I think
my bras are... a bit too big for
you.

fields.EN:
D-Don't say it so
bluntly! And that's not true!
Here, let me borrow your bra!
fields.JP:
なっ……はっきり言うんじゃないわよ！
それに、そんなことないわよ！
ちょっとあんたのブラ、貸してみなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Hey! That's not true! Hand
it over!

fields.JP: ええっ！？　親指姉様、それは……

……ひゃんっ！？
そんな強引に……ダメですっ……！

ああっ……姉様、そんなっ……
だめですぅっ……！

はあ、はあ……
よし！　取れた！

fields.EN:
Nee-sama... Forcing my
bra off like that is awful...
fields.JP:
姉様……
人のブラを無理矢理脱がすなんて、
ひどいです……
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't believe you took it off...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! I'm sorry. But just you
watch! It's going to fit me...
perfectly...
fields.JP:
あはは、ごめんごめん！
まあ見てなさいって！
きっとピッタリだか……ら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! I'm sorry. But just you
watch! It's going to fit me...
perfectly...

fields.EN:
Oh, my... See? It's way too big
for you.
fields.JP:
あらあら……
ほらぁ。ブッカブカじゃないですか。
だから言ったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, my... See? It's way too big
for you.

fields.EN:
It... It can't be... I'm supposed
be the older one... This can't be
happening...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな……
わたしの方が姉なのに……
こんな理不尽なことって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It... It can't be... I'm supposed
be the older one... This can't be
happening...

fields.EN:
It's fine, Oyayubi-neesama! You just
need to find one that fits you! I
mean, your shape is just right!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫ですよ、親指姉様！
ちゃんとサイズがピッタリなのを着ければ！
白雪なんかより、形いいんですから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine, dear sister! You just
need to find one that fits you! I
mean, your shape is just right!

fields.JP:
う、ううう……
ほ、本当に……？

fields.EN:
Yes! But, the right size is
important. Let me take your
measurements, okay?
fields.JP:
も、もちろんです！
ね？　サイズって大事でしょう？
だから……まずは測りましょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! But, the right size is
important. Let me take your
measurements, okay?

fields.EN:
I-I guess you're right! I'm
counting on you, Shirayuki!
fields.JP:
そ、そうね……！
白雪、頼んだわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I guess you're right! I'm
counting on you, Snow White!

fields.EN:
Yes! Now then, stay still... Let
me get this around you...
fields.JP:
はい！じゃあじっとしててくださいね……
今測りますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! Now then, stay still... Let
me get this around you...

fields.JP:
う、うん……ひゃんっ！？
ちょ、ちょっと白雪、くすぐったいって！

fields.EN:
Just a little more... I'll be done
soon, so please bear with me.
fields.JP:
はいはい……すぐ終わりますから、
ちょっとガマンしててくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a little more... I'll be done
soon, so please bear with me.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry for being late,
Oyayubihime! I bought what you...
asked... for...?
fields.JP:
ごめん、親指姫。遅くなっちゃって！
言われたもの、買ってきた……よ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for being late,
Thumbelina! I bought what you...
asked... for...?

fields.EN:
Aaaaaaaaaaah! I-I'm so sorry! I-I
didn't know you were...!
fields.JP:
…………うわーーーーっ！！！
ごごご……ごめん！！？？
そそ、そんなつもりじゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaaaaaaaaaah! I-I'm so sorry! I-I
didn't know you were...!

fields.EN:
D-Oyayubi-neesama! P-Please! Your
clothes! Jack-san! Look away, now!
fields.JP:
お、親指姉様。
とりあえず服を……！！
ジャックさんは向こうを向いてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Dear sister! P-Please! Your
clothes! Jack! Look away, now!

fields.EN:
And... How much longer are you
going to be standing there like
that?
fields.JP:
……で？
いつまでそこで突っ立ってんのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... How much longer are you
going to be standing there like
that?

fields.EN:
Huh? Um, well... Oh, I know! Let
me leave what you asked for over
here...
fields.JP:
え？　いやその、えっと……
あ、そうだ……！
た、頼まれたもの、ここに置いておくね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Um, well... Oh, I know! Let
me leave what you asked for over
here...

fields.JP: いいから早く出てけーーーーっ！！！！！

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Oyayubi-neesama?
Are you okay?
fields.JP:
親指姉様、どうしたんですか？
大丈夫ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, dear sister?
Are you okay?

fields.EN:
Huh? N-No, it's nothing. I'm still
not quite used to the... shoulder straps...
fields.JP:
え？　う、ううん、何でもないわ。
肩の、その……紐が、
まだちょっと慣れなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh, it's nothing. I just
can't seem to get used to that
tight feeling around my chest ...

fields.EN:
Ah... that. You'll get used to
it after a while. It does hurt
a little at first, though...
fields.JP:
あ……例のアレ、ですね。
しばらくすればきっと慣れますよ。
最初はちょっと痛いですけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're talking about that...
It just takes a while to get used
to.

fields.JP: そ、そういうもんなのかしら……

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Oyayubihime?
Are you hurt?
fields.JP:
……親指姫、どうしたの？
もしかして、ケガでもしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Thumbelina?
Are you hurt?

fields.JP:
あ、アリス……ううん！　
な、なんでもないわ！

fields.EN:
Really? But you said
your shoulder area hurt...
fields.JP:
そう……？
でも、肩の辺りが痛いって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? I overheard something
about your chest feeling tight...

fields.EN:
It's really nothing! S-See?
Everything's fine!
fields.JP:
ぜ、全然！
ほらこの通り、なんともないわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's really nothing! S-See?
Everything's fine!

fields.JP: アリスさん、アリスさん……

fields.EN:
Um, well... Oyayubi-neesama just started
wearing a bra recently...
fields.JP:
その、実はですね……
親指姉様は最近、
ブラジャーを着けるようになったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... My sister just started
wearing a bra recently...

fields.JP:
ブラジャー、ですって……？
親指姫が……！？

fields.EN:
Yes. And it seems she still
isn't used to the shoulder straps...
fields.JP:
はい。それでまだ、
肩紐が慣れないらしくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and... it seems like she's
not used to the band yet...

fields.EN:
I-I don't believe it... I'm not
wearing one, and she's already...
fields.JP:
そ、そんなこと……
わたしだって、まだ着けてないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I don't believe it... I'm not
wearing one, and she's already...

fields.EN:
Can I ask you something,
Oyayubihime?
fields.JP: ……親指姫、ちょっといいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can I ask you something,
Thumbelina?

fields.EN:
Huh? Wh-What is it? You look so
serious...
fields.JP:
え？　ど、どうしたのよ？
急に真剣な顔して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Wh-What is it? You look so
serious...

fields.EN:
I heard you... started wearing
bras...
fields.JP:
あなた……
ブラジャーを着け始めたんですって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard you... started wearing
bras...

fields.EN:
Um... Alice-san? That's a bit too
straightforward, isn't it?
fields.JP:
あのーアリスさん……
いきなりそれはちょっと直すぎるんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Alice? That's a bit too
straightforward, isn't it?

fields.EN:
Wha-?! What's it to you?! I can
wear whatever I want, you know?!
fields.JP:
なっ……そ、それがどうしたってのよ！？
わたしの勝手でしょ、そんなの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! What's it to you?! I can
wear whatever I want, you know?!

fields.EN:
Why yes, but... Do you mind
if I... confirm?
fields.JP:
ええ、もちろんそうだけれど……
少し……確認させてもらえるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, but... Do you mind
if I... confirm?

fields.EN:
Don't worry. It'll be quick. I
just need to feel it a bit...
fields.JP:
大丈夫、すぐ終わるわ。
ちょっと触らせてくれるだけでいいから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. It'll be quick. I
just need to feel it a bit...

fields.EN:
Wh-What in the world are you
saying?! W-What's with those
hands of yours?! Stop it!
fields.JP:
な、なんでそうなるのよ！？
……って、その手つきは何！？
思いっきり触る気満々なんですけど！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What in the world are you
saying?! W-What's with those
hands of yours?! Stop it!

fields.EN:
How did hers get so big? Maybe
it's my nutritional intake...
fields.JP:
どうして大きくなるのかしら……
やっぱり、これまでの栄養状態とか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did hers get so big? Maybe
it's my nutritional intake...

fields.EN:
I'm growing too, but... That's
right... I don't need to worry...
I just need to confirm...
fields.JP:
わたしだって、成長してるはずなのに……
……そうよ、焦ることはないわ。
まず、状況の確認を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm growing too, but... That's
right... I don't need to worry...
I just need to confirm...

fields.EN:
Eek! Now you're freaking me out!
H-Hey wait! T-Touching me isn't
going to do any good!
fields.JP:
ひっ……なんか怖い！？
ちょ、ちょっと待って……！？
さ、触ったって、何もわかんないわよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eek! Now you're freaking me out!
H-Hey wait! T-Touching me isn't
going to do any good!

fields.JP: いいえ……きっと無駄ではないわ……

ア、アリスさん、落ち着いてください！
アリスさんってば！！

fields.EN:
(Well, there goes me going into
the cafeteria. If I heard right, I
wouldn't dare step inside now...)
fields.JP:
（食堂が騒がしいと思って来たはいいけど……
　結局会話の内容がきわどすぎて、
　一歩も入れなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, there goes me going into
the cafeteria. If I heard right, I
wouldn't dare step inside now...)

fields.EN:
(That was a close call... Who
knows what would've happened if
I got here earlier...)
fields.JP:
（もう少し早くここに来てたら……
　確実に巻き込まれてたな。
　あぶないあぶない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was a close call... Who
knows what would've happened if
I got here earlier...)

fields.EN:
Whew... Finally... Got away...
What was that about?
fields.JP:
ふう……やっと逃げ切れたわ。
まったく、何なのよ一体……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... Finally... Got away...
What was that about?

fields.EN:
Um... Jack? What are you doing
here?
fields.JP: ……ってジャックあんた、何やってんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Jack? What are you doing
here?

fields.EN:
Whoa! Th-Oyayubihime?! Oh, um...
I wasn't doing anything, really.
fields.JP:
わっ！？
お、親指姫……！！
い、いや別に、何も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Th-Thumbelina?! Oh, um...
I wasn't doing anything, really.

fields.EN:
...You didn't hear what we
were talking about just now, did you?
fields.JP: ……さっきの話……聞いてなかったでしょうね？

fields.EN:
Um, uh... I don't know what you're
talking about. I was... just
passing by!
fields.JP:
な、何の事、かな……
僕、たまたま今通りかかっただけだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, uh... I don't know what you're
talking about. I was... just
passing by!

fields.EN:
...I see. If you heard anything, forget
every last bit of it. Otherwise... you'll die.
fields.JP:
……そう。……もし聞いてたのなら、
全てキレイさっぱり忘れる事ね。
でないと……死ぬ事になるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... If you heard anything,
forget it. All of it... Or else,
you may lose your life...

fields.EN: Lighten up. It's just... a joke.
fields.LOCALIZED: Lighten up. It's just... a joke.

fields.EN:
(S-She sure doesn't look like
she was joking!)
fields.JP: （……め、目が笑ってないんですけど！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(S-She sure doesn't look like
she was joking!)

fields.EN:
(So tired... Being anemic is such
a pain...)
fields.JP:
（まだ、身体がだるいや……
　貧血って、けっこうきついんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So tired... Being anemic is such
a pain...)

fields.EN: Um... Jack-san, are you in here?
fields.JP:
あの……
ジャックさん、いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... Jack, are you in here?

fields.JP:
あ、君は……
白雪姫……一体どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Snow White? What's the
matter?

fields.EN:
You used a lot of blood, so I came
to visit to make sure you were
okay.
fields.JP:
ちょっと心配になって……
お見舞いに来たんです。
たくさん血を使ってたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You used a lot of blood, so I came
to visit to make sure you were
okay.

fields.EN:
You came to see me because of
that?
fields.LOCALIZED:
You came to see me because of
that?

fields.EN: Yes. I hope I'm not bothering you.
fields.JP:
はい。
もしかして今、お邪魔でしたか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I hope I'm not bothering you.

fields.JP:
い、いや、そんな事はないよ！
ありがとう……！

fields.EN:
(It's nice to know someone's
worried about me...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's nice to know someone's
worried about me...)

fields.EN:
Oh, where are my manners... Let me
get you some tea.
fields.JP:
あ……ごめんね、気が利かなくて。
今お茶を出すから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, where are my manners... Let me
get you some tea.

fields.EN:
P-Please stay still, Jack-san!
Shirayuki will get the tea ready!
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさんはじっとしててください！
白雪がやります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please stay still, Jack! Snow
White will get the tea ready!

fields.EN:
Are you sure? Thanks... You're so
kind.
fields.JP:
そ、そう……？
ありがとう。優しいんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure? Thanks... You're so
kind.

fields.EN:
It's nothing. It's all part of
coming to visit and making sure
you're okay!
fields.JP:
いえ！
そのためのお見舞いですから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nothing. It's all part of
coming to visit and making sure
you're okay!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... Are you really
okay? Maybe I can get more ice for
you...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんなさい……
だ、大丈夫ですか……？
もう少し、冷やしたほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... Are you really
okay? Maybe I can get more ice for
you...

fields.EN:
I-I'm fine. It's just a burn.
Compared to what we go through in
battle, this is nothing.
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫……軽いヤケドだから。
いま薬も塗ってもらったし、
この前の戦いに比べたら、全然平気だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm fine. It's just a burn.
Compared to what we go through in
battle, this is nothing.

fields.EN:
*sob* I did it again... Shirayuki
is so useless...
fields.JP:
うう……またやってしまいました……
白雪は本当に役立たずです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sob* I did it again... Snow White
is so useless...

fields.JP:
（また、って……
　もしかしてこの子って
　けっこうドジなんじゃ……）

fields.EN:
D-Don't worry about it! Let's just
enjoy some tea together. I'll go
and make some more for us.
fields.JP:
き、気にしないで！
ほ、ほら……お茶飲もう？
いま淹れ直すからさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't worry about it! Let's just
enjoy some tea together. I'll go
and make some more for us.

fields.EN:
Th-Thank you very much! You really
are kind, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとうございます……！
ジャックさんは優しい方なんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thank you very much! You really
are kind, Jack.

fields.EN:
Do you think so? But you're really
kind, too.
fields.JP:
そ、そうかな……？
白雪姫だって優しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think so? But you're really
kind, too.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki is a plain girl...
Oyayubi-neesama, Nemu-chan,
Aka-neesama are all unique, unlike me...
fields.JP:
白雪は……地味なだけです。
親指姉様も、ネムちゃんも、赤姉様も
みんな個性的ですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is a plain girl...
Sister Thumbelina, Sleepy, Sister
Red are all unique, unlike me...

fields.EN:
(I suppose... But... she's making
it sound like they're just
oddballs...)
fields.JP:
（た、確かにそれはそうかも……
　っていうか、キャラが濃いってだけじゃ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose... But... she's making
it sound like they're just
oddballs...)

fields.EN:
Um, but I'm not very unique
compared to them, either.
fields.JP:
でも……僕だってあの中にいたら、
そんなに個性的な方じゃないと思うよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, but I'm not very unique
compared to them, either.

fields.EN:
Well, their personalities are very
distinct, in a good way. Compared
to them, I'm just...
fields.JP:
うん、みんな良い意味で、
すごく強烈だからね。
それに比べたら、僕なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, their personalities are very
distinct, in a good way. Compared
to them, I'm just...

fields.EN: Let us "plain" people do our best!
fields.JP:
私達……
お互い『地味』同士がんばりましょうね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let us "plain" people do our best!

fields.EN:
I'm so happy I have someone like
me now. I hope we can get along
even better!
fields.JP:
うふふ……
なんだか仲間ができたみたいで嬉しいです。
これからもよろしくお願いしますね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so happy I have someone like
me now. I hope we can get along
even better!

fields.JP:
う、うん……
これからもよろしく……！

fields.EN:
(What kind of group am I a part of
now...?)
fields.JP: （なんだか変な仲間に入れられたような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What kind of group am I a part of
now...?)

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Shirayuki?
Oh, that... It's okay. Just kick
it like... so.
fields.JP:
どうしたの、白雪？
ああ……アレが落ちてたのね。
大丈夫よ。ほら、こうして蹴飛ばしちゃえば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Snow White?
Oh, that... It's okay. Just kick
it like... so.

fields.JP: ね、もう無くなっちゃったでしょ？

fields.EN:
Oh, Jack-san... I'm sorry! You don't
have to worry about me!
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……
ごめんなさい、気になさらないでください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Jack... I'm sorry! You don't
have to worry about me!

fields.JP:
そう……？
今の、確か……鏡だったような……？

fields.EN:
W-Well, Shirayuki has been scared
of mirrors for a long time...
fields.JP:
じ、実は……
白雪は、昔から……鏡が怖いんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, Snow White has been scared
of mirrors for a long time...

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm not sure why, but
looking at mirrors makes me
feel anxious...
fields.JP:
はい……理由はわからないんですけど、
なんだか鏡を見ると不安になってきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm not sure why, but
looking at mirrors makes me
feel anxious...

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's like that strange urge
I have...)
fields.JP:
（……僕の、あのわけのわからない気持ちと
　なんだか似てる、のかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe it's like that strange urge
I have...)

fields.EN:
But... I'm really okay! Nee-sama-tachi
are here too... Let's hurry on!
fields.JP:
あ、でも……本当に大丈夫ですから！
姉様たちもいますし……
今は先を急ぎましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but it's fine! My sisters are
with me. Now then, let's go!

fields.EN:
I'll be sure to remember that
you're not good with mirrors. I
can help, too.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、僕も覚えておくよ。
君が鏡が苦手だってこと……
僕も気をつけてれば、もっと心配ないと思うしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll be sure to remember that
you're not good with mirrors. I
can help, too.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much, Jack-san. I'm
happy to hear you say that.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……ありがとうございます。
そう言ってもらえるだけで嬉しいです……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much, Jack. I'm
happy to hear you say that.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... It's not a big deal.
Um, but doesn't that make it hard
to get ready in the morning?
fields.JP:
あはは、大げさだよ……
でも、鏡が見れないと、大変じゃない？
その、身だしなみとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... It's not a big deal.
Um, but doesn't that make it hard
to get ready in the morning?

fields.EN:
Yes... but it's okay. Nee-sama-tachi
are always nearby to check on me.
fields.JP:
はい……でも、それは大丈夫なんです。
姉様たちが、いつもそばにいて
チェックしてくれますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but that's all right. My
sisters stay close to me and make
sure I look fine.

fields.EN:
I'm always grateful to
nee-sama-tachi...! Now, let's go!
fields.JP:
姉様たちにはいつも感謝しっぱなしです……！
さ、行きましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate everything my sisters
do for me... Now then, let's go!

fields.EN:
(They really do get along well
together...)
fields.JP: （この姉妹、ほんとに仲が良いんだなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They really do get along well
together...)

fields.EN:
(Shirayukihime? What's she doing?
She doesn't look very good right
now...)
fields.JP:
（あ、白雪姫……どうしたんだろ？
　なんだか元気がなさそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snow White? What's she doing?
She doesn't look very good right
now...)

fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……
いえ、何でもないんです。
ただちょっと……

fields.EN: You have something on your mind?
fields.LOCALIZED: You have something on your mind?

fields.EN:
Sometimes I suddenly feel sad...
Oyayubi-neesama and Nemu-chan are so
cute, yet Shirayuki is so drab and plain...
fields.JP:
……時々、ふと悲しくなるんです。
親指姉様もネムちゃんもとっても可愛いのに、
白雪だけ地味だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just sadness... every so often. My
sisters are so cute, yet Snow
White is so drab and plain...

fields.EN:
Th-That's not true! Sure, they're
cute, but you're just as cute!
fields.JP:
そ、そんなこと……！
確かに二人も可愛いけど、白雪姫だって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's not true! Sure, they're
cute, but you're just as cute!

fields.EN:
It's all right, it's all right.
You don't need to console me.
Shirayuki really is plain. She knows.
fields.JP:
いいんですいいんです。
無理にフォローして下さらなくても。
実際白雪は、地味ですし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's all right, it's all right.
You don't need to console me. Snow
White really is plain. She knows.

fields.EN:
(But I really was telling the
truth... How I can I get through
to her? I know!)
fields.JP:
（フォローじゃないんだけどなあ……
　どう言えばいいんだろ……そうだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I really was telling the
truth... How I can I get through
to her? I know!)

fields.EN:
You have such a cute and soft aura
to you! You really don't need to
be down on yourself.
fields.JP:
白雪姫だって、なんていうか……
ふんわりしててかわいいよ！
だからそんなに落ち込まなくても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have such a cute and soft aura
to you! You really don't need to
be down on yourself.

fields.EN:
Huh...? Soft? Do you mean that I'm
fat? Oh, of course... Yes, I
suppose so...
fields.JP:
えっ、それって……
太ってるってこと、ですか……？
やっぱり……そう、ですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...? Soft? Do you mean that I'm
fat? Oh, of course... Yes, I
suppose so...

fields.EN:
Actually... it bothered me a little.
Shirayuki is fatter than nee-sama-tachi...
and I'm plain enough already...
fields.JP:
実は……ちょっと気にしてたんです。
白雪は姉様たちと比べて太ってるなって……
ただでさえ地味なのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was bothering me... I'm not
only plain, but I'm also fatter
than my sisters...

fields.JP: （し、しまった……なんか誤解されてる？）

fields.EN: N-No! I meant soft as in, um...
fields.JP:
ち、違うよ！
ふんわりってそういう意味じゃなくて、
なんていうか……えーと……
fields.LOCALIZED: N-No! I meant soft as in, um...

fields.EN:
Um... You know? Aura... The air
around you! You have a soft and
gentle aura, and...
fields.JP:
そ、その……そう、雰囲気！
雰囲気が優しいっていうか、
柔らかいっていうか、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You know? Aura... The air
around you! You have a soft and
gentle aura, and...

fields.EN:
Right! It's nice and calm being
next to you, and you're cute,
and... So, yeah!
fields.JP:
そう！　一緒にいて落ち着くというか、
可愛らしいというか……
と、とにかく、そういうことだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! It's nice and calm being
next to you, and you're cute,
and... So, yeah!

fields.EN:
*giggle*... Regardless of the
reason, I'm just happy to hear
someone say that to me...
fields.JP:
ふふふ……なんだかんだで、
そんな風に言ってもらえると、
嬉しいなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... Regardless of the
reason, I'm just happy to hear
someone say that to me...

fields.EN:
Thank you very much. I feel a bit
better now. You really are kind,
Jack-san.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます……
少し自信が出てきました。
……やっぱりジャックさんは優しい方ですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much. I feel a bit
better now. You really are kind,
Jack.

fields.EN:
I see... So being plain means
that I'm calm...
fields.JP:
そうなんですね……
地味って、落ち着くってことなんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So being plain means
that I'm calm...

fields.EN:
(I... don't think that's what I
was getting at. Is she what you'd
call a "natural?")
fields.JP:
（っていうか、そういう話じゃなかったような？
　やっぱりちょっと天然……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I... don't think that's what I
was getting at. Is she what you'd
call a "natural?")

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime...? What are you doing
here?
fields.JP:
あ、白雪姫……
ここにいたんだ。何やってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White...? What are you doing
here?

fields.EN:
Hello there, Jack-san... I wasn't...
doing anything.
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……こんにちは。
いえ、なんでもないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello there, Jack... I wasn't...
doing anything.

fields.EN:
(Is she down on herself again? It
seems more severe this time...)
fields.JP:
（元気がない……また落ち込んでるのかな？
　でも、この前よりもなんだか深刻そうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she down on herself again? It
seems more severe this time...)

fields.EN:
What's the matter? You don't look
well.
fields.JP:
……どうしたの？
なんだか、元気がなさそうだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter? You don't look
well.

fields.EN:
You really are kind, Jack-san... I'm
fine. It's all Shirayuki's fault.
fields.JP:
……ジャックさんは、本当に優しいですね。
大丈夫です。白雪が悪いので……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are kind, Jack... I'm
fine. It's all Snow White's fault.

fields.EN:
Aka-neesama told me, given how
clumsy I am, I should worry about
myself before others.
fields.JP:
この間……赤姉様に言われたんです。
人の心配する前に自分の心配をしなって。
白雪が、いつもドジだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red told me, given how
clumsy I am, I should worry about
myself before others.

fields.EN:
I see... I'm sure she said it
because she cares about you,
and...
