fields.JP:
そ、そっか……
でもそれは、きっと君の事を心配して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I'm sure she said it
because she cares about you,
and...

fields.EN:
See? There. Everyone's worried
about me. Oyayubi-neesama,
Nemu-chan, everyone...
fields.JP:
そうなんです。そこなんです。
親指姉様や、ネムちゃんにも、
いつも心配ばかりかけてるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? There. Everyone's worried
about me. Dear Sister Thumbelina,
Sleepy, everyone...

fields.EN:
I never had much confidence to begin
with, but... Shirayuki must be even
more hopeless than she thought...
fields.JP:
もともと自信はなかったけど、
きっと自分が思ってる以上に、
白雪はダメな子なんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White wasn't confident
before, but now she knows she must
be the worst girl around...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki's not good at
anything... Maybe it's better here
without her around...
fields.JP:
取り柄もないし……
白雪なんて、いない方がよかったのかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White's not good at
anything... Maybe it's better here
without her around...

fields.EN:
That's not true! Don't say things
like that.
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことないよ！
取り柄がないとか、
いない方がいいだなんて、そんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true! Don't say things
like that.

fields.EN:
Well then, what is Shirayuki good
at?
fields.JP: ……じゃあ、白雪の取り柄って、何ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, what is Snow White good
at?

fields.EN:
(She has a lot of good traits, but
it's a bit embarrassing to praise
her aloud...)
fields.JP:
（そんなの、もちろんたくさんあるけど……
　改めて言えって言われると、なんだか
　妙に照れるというか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has a lot of good traits, but
it's a bit embarrassing to praise
her aloud...)

fields.EN:
You don't have to force
yourself... I knew it. There's
nothing good about Shirayuki...
fields.JP:
……無理しなくても、いいですよ。
やっぱりそうなんですね……
白雪には何も良いところは無いんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to force
yourself... I knew it. There's
nothing good about Snow White...

fields.JP:
ち、違うよ！
そうじゃなくて、その……

fields.EN:
No, nothing... Could you please
leave me alone for a moment?
fields.JP:
……いいんです。
しばらく一人にしてください……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, nothing... Could you please
leave me alone for a moment?

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime... Okay, I understand.
I'll see you later.
fields.JP:
白雪姫……
ごめん、わかったよ……
じゃあ、行くね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White... Okay, I understand.
I'll see you later.

fields.EN:
(I wasn't able to say a single
thing to her... I wasn't able to
cheer her up. I'm such an idiot.)
fields.JP:
（結局、何も言えずじまいだった……
　何でもっと気の利いた事が
　言えなかったんだろ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wasn't able to say a single
thing to her... I wasn't able to
cheer her up. I'm such an idiot.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder if Shirayukihime is feeling
better now. Maybe I should leave
her alone, but...)
fields.JP:
（白雪姫、まだ落ち込んでるのかな……？
　そっとしといた方がいいのかもしれないけど、
　でも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if Snow White is feeling
better now. Maybe I should leave
her alone, but...)

fields.EN:
(No use thinking now. I'd better
go and apologize to her.)
fields.JP:
（……考えてもしょうがないか。
　まずはちゃんと謝らなくっちゃ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No use thinking now. I'd better
go and apologize to her.)

fields.EN:
Jack-san...? What brings you here? I
was just about to get ready to
step out.
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん。
……どうしたんですか？
今、ちょっと外出の準備中でして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...? What brings you here? I
was just about to get ready to
step out.

fields.EN:
Uh, I'm sorry! Um... You're going
someplace?
fields.JP:
あ、ごめん……！
……どこかに出かけるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I'm sorry! Um... You're going
someplace?

fields.EN:
Yes... I was going to go to the
city on an errand for Oyayubi-neesama.
fields.JP:
ええ……親指姉様のお使いで、
街に行くところだったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I was going to go to the
city on an errand for Sister
Thumbelina.

fields.JP:
その……
何か、ご用ですか？

fields.EN:
(She feels so distant... I need to
fix this now!)
fields.JP:
（……なんだか、よそよそしい？
　なら、なおさらちゃんと話さなくちゃ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She feels so distant... I need to
fix this now!)

fields.EN:
Um... Do you mind if I come with
you?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、その……
僕も一緒に行っていいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Do you mind if I come with
you?

fields.EN:
Huh? But... You don't need to
force yourself. I'm not worth
it...
fields.JP:
え？　でも……
無理に付き合わなくていいですよ。
こんな自分に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But... You don't need to
force yourself. I'm not worth
it...

fields.EN:
(I knew it... She's still holding
onto that...)
fields.JP: （やっぱり、この間の事、気にしてるんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I knew it... She's still holding
onto that...)

fields.EN:
Um, well... I, uh... I have to go
to the city, too! Is it okay if I
tag along?
fields.JP:
なんていうか、その……
そう！　僕も街に用事があるんだ。
ダメ……かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... I, uh... I have to go
to the city, too! Is it okay if I
tag along?

fields.EN:
W-Well, if that's the case, I
suppose it's fine...
fields.JP:
そ、そういう事なら、
別に構いませんけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, if that's the case, I
suppose it's fine...

fields.JP: ……お使い、思ったより、早く終わったね

fields.EN:
Speaking of... What did you need
to do here, Jack-san?
fields.JP:
……そういえば、
ジャックさんの用事は、何だったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of... What did you need
to do here, Jack?

fields.JP:
えっ？
あ、いや、それはその……
あ、白雪おねえちゃんだー！

fields.EN:
Why, hello there. Have you been a
good boy?
fields.JP:
……あら、こんにちは。
元気でしたか？
ちゃんと良い子にしてますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, hello there. Have you been a
good boy?

fields.EN:
Yup! I'm fine! But onee-chan,
you don't look too good...
fields.JP:
うん！　ボクはげんき！
でも、おねえちゃんは、
なんだかげんきなさそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I'm a good boy! But... you
don't look too good.

fields.EN:
*giggle*... That's not so.
Shirayuki is always doing well. See?
fields.JP:
うふふ、そんな事はないですよ。
白雪はいつでも元気です。
ほら、この通り！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... That's not so. Snow
White is always doing well. See?

fields.EN: Okay! Heh, heh! That's good, then!
fields.JP:
そっかー！　えへへ！
よかったー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! Heh, heh! That's good, then!

fields.EN:
Oh, I know! A good boy deserves a
good treat!
fields.JP:
あ、そうだ……！
元気な子には、これをあげますね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I know! A good boy deserves a
good treat!

fields.EN:
Oooh! An apple! Yaaay! I love
apples! Thank you, onee-chan!
fields.JP:
あー！　リンゴーー！
やったー！　ボク、リンゴだいすき！
ありがとう、おねえちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oooh! An apple! Yaaay! I love
apples! Thank you!

fields.EN:
Heh... My pleasure. I'll bring
more the next time I come around,
okay?
fields.JP:
うふふ……ならよかったです。
また街に来た時には、
リンゴを持ってきますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... My pleasure. I'll bring
more the next time I come around,
okay?

fields.EN:
(I can't believe she's so down on
herself with how kind and well-
liked she is...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりこの子、
　すごく優しい子じゃないか……
　取り柄がないなんて、そんな事ないのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe she's so down on
herself with how kind and well-
liked she is...)

fields.JP: じゃあまたね、おねえちゃん！

fields.EN:
Yes, see you... Be a good boy,
okay?
fields.JP:
ええ、また……
良い子にしてるんですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, see you... Be a good boy,
okay?

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm so sorry! I see that boy
quite often in the city, so I
just...
fields.JP:
あ、ごめんなさい……！
よく街で会う子だったから、つい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm so sorry! I see that boy
quite often in the city, so I
just...

fields.JP: この間は、その……本当にごめん！

fields.EN:
I was just... embarrassed last
time, and couldn't tell you about
your good qualities...
fields.JP:
白雪姫には良いところがたくさんあるのに、
うまく言えなくて……
その……照れちゃってたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just... embarrassed last
time, and couldn't tell you about
your good qualities...

fields.EN:
W-Well... But there's nothing good
about Shirayuki...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな……
白雪に良いところなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... But there's nothing good
about Snow White...

fields.EN:
You're a really kind person. I
knew that, and... I took it for
granted...
fields.JP:
君は……こんなに優しい子なのに。
それは知ってたはずなのに……
僕は……それに甘えてしまってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a really kind person. I
knew that, and... I took it for
granted...

fields.EN:
But... being kind isn't
anything special. Shirayuki is...!
fields.JP:
そんなこと……
優しいなんて、何もすごくないですよ。
白雪なんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I'm not kind or anything...
Snow White is...

fields.EN:
That's not true! I think your
kindness is something to be proud
of!
fields.JP:
そんな事ないよ！
それは立派な取り柄だと思う……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true! I think your
kindness is something to be proud
of!

fields.EN:
But... Oyayubi-neesama and
Nemu-chan have better qualities than
I do...
fields.JP:
でも……
親指姉様やネムちゃんの方が、
良いところはたくさんありますし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... Sister Thumbelina and
Sleepy have better qualities than
I do...

fields.EN:
They're not clumsy like me, and
they actually help others! Shirayuki is...
fields.JP:
そそっかしくないし、
みんなの役に立ってますし…！
それに比べたら、白雪なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're not clumsy like me, and
they actually help others! Snow
White is...

fields.EN:
I see... You're comparing yourself
with Oyayubihime and Nemurihime...
fields.JP:
そっか、君は……親指姫や眠り姫と、
自分を比べていたんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... You're comparing yourself
with Thumbelina and Sleeping
Beauty...

fields.JP:
えっ？
な、なんでそんな事……

fields.EN:
You said you were jealous last
time, right?
fields.JP:
だって、この間……
『うらやましい』って言ってたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said you were jealous last
time, right?

fields.EN:
Yeah... But, you've got it all
wrong. You don't need to compare
yourself to your sisters.
fields.JP:
……うん。でも、それは違うよ。
いくら姉妹だからって、
誰かと比べる必要なんてない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... But, you've got it all
wrong. You don't need to compare
yourself to your sisters.

fields.EN:
Those two are certainly unique, but
I don't think your thoughtfulness
toward others is any less than theirs.
fields.JP:
あの二人は、確かに個性的だけど……
君の誰かを思いやる気持ちは、
二人に決して劣ってないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, they're unique, but I don't
think your thoughtfulness is any
less unique.

fields.EN:
Your kindness is something special
that comes from you. Or, at least
that's what I think.
fields.JP:
白雪姫の優しさは、形には見えないけど、
誰にも真似できないよ。
少なくとも僕は……そう思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your kindness is something special
that comes from you. Or, at least
that's what I think.

fields.EN:
W-Well... Thank you very much. I
feel so much better now after
hearing that from you.
fields.JP:
そ、そんな事……ありがとうございます。
嬉しい……
なんだか、とても楽になりました
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... Thank you very much. I
feel so much better now after
hearing that from you.

fields.JP: そっか……それならよかった……

fields.EN:
Um... Shirayuki is sorry, too.
Sorry for how she treated you back
then...
fields.JP:
その……白雪こそ、ごめんなさい。
この間は、突っぱねてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Snow White is sorry, too.
Sorry for how she treated you back
then...

fields.EN:
And still, you thought about me
and said those things... You
really are kind, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
なのに、そんな風に言ってくれるなんて……
ジャックさんも、本当に優しいんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And still, you thought about me
and said those things... You
really are kind, Jack.

fields.EN:
*giggle*... And you respond just
like Shirayuki...
fields.JP:
うふふ、そのリアクション……
なんだか白雪そっくりです
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... And you respond just
like Snow White...

fields.EN:
I suppose I was thinking a bit too
much. Shirayuki is Shirayuki and
no other.
fields.JP:
そうですね……ちょっと考えすぎてました。
白雪は白雪ですもんね。
他の人と比べても仕方ないです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I was thinking a bit too
much. Snow White is Snow White and
no other.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much, Jack-san...
Shirayuki may be clumsy, but she hopes
you'll stay friends with her.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……本当にありがとう。
そそっかしい白雪ですが……
これからも、よろしくお願いします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much, Jack... Snow
White may be clumsy, but she hopes
you'll stay friends with her.

fields.EN:
Hello there, Jack-san! What brings you
here today?
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……こんにちは！
今日はどうしたんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello there, Jack! What brings you
here today?

fields.EN:
Nothing special, but... I just
wanted to see you, that's all.
fields.JP:
いや、用事があったわけじゃないんだけど……
ちょっと、顔が見たくなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing special, but... I just
wanted to see you, that's all.

fields.EN: I-I see... Th-Thank you very much!
fields.JP:
そ、そうだったんですか……
あ、ありがとうございます……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I see... Th-Thank you very much!

fields.EN:
Well, it's good to see you, um...
doing better now.
fields.JP:
でも……よかった！
なんていうか、その、最近、元気そうで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's good to see you, um...
doing better now.

fields.EN:
I've... gained a bit of confidence
since then. Well, not that
anything has really changed...
fields.JP:
あれから……ちょっと自信が持てたんです。
前と、何が変わった訳でもないんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've... gained a bit of confidence
since then. Well, not that
anything has really changed...

fields.EN:
And, I think it's all because of
you, Jack-san!
fields.JP:
きっと、その……
それも、ジャックさんのおかげだと思います！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I think it's all because of
you, Jack!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... That's not true. Oh, I
know!
fields.JP:
あはは……そんなことないよ。
……そうだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... That's not true. Oh, I
know!

fields.EN:
Oh... Well, in that case... since we have the
chance, why don't you try looking in a mirror?
fields.JP:
あ……いや。
それなら、その……
せっかくだから、鏡を見てみない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... Why you're confident,
why don't you take a look in the
mirror?

fields.EN:
I'm not sure how to word it, but
now is your chance to see
yourself. Are you still scared?
fields.JP:
その……うまく言えないけれど。
今だから、君にちゃんと自分を見て欲しいんだ。
……ダメかな？　やっぱり、怖い……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure how to word it, but
now is your chance to see
yourself. Are you still scared?

fields.EN:
I understand... I am scared a bit,
but... I'll give it a try!
fields.JP:
……わかりました。
正直言って、ちょっと怖いですけど……
やってみます……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand... I am scared a bit,
but... I'll give it a try!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... It's strange for you to be
thanking me, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
ふふ……ジャックさんがお礼を言うのは
おかしいですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... It's strange to hear
you thank me for this.

fields.JP: そ、それもそうだね……あはは……

fields.EN:
But, um... Please be next to me,
okay?
fields.JP:
……でも、その……
ちゃんとそばにいてくださいね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, um... Please be next to me,
okay?

fields.EN:
Okay... I-I can do this...!
There...!
fields.JP:
よ～し……！
が、がんばります……！
えいっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... I-I can do this...!
There...!

fields.EN:
(She really must be scared of
mirrors if she has to pump herself
up like that...)
fields.JP:
（か、鏡と向き合うだけで
　ここまで気合いを入れるなんて……
　本当に、よっぽど怖いんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She really must be scared of
mirrors if she has to pump herself
up like that...)

fields.EN:
S-Shirayukihime?! Are you okay?
Does it still scare you?
fields.JP:
し、白雪姫！
大丈夫？
やっぱり怖かった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Snow White?! Are you okay?
Does it still scare you?

fields.EN:
I knew it... I am plain-looking...
It looks like I have a bit of fat
on me, too...
fields.JP:
やっぱり、地味です……
そして、やっぱり……
ちょっと太ってるような気がします……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it... I am plain-looking...
It looks like I have a bit of fat
on me, too...

fields.JP: そ、そんなことないと思うけど……

fields.EN:
(What a relief... It seems like it
didn't scare her.)
fields.JP: （怖かったんじゃなくて、よかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a relief... It seems like it
didn't scare her.)

fields.EN:
(Wait... That's not the point
right now!)
fields.JP: （いやでも、気になるのはそこなの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... That's not the point
right now!)

fields.EN:
Um, I am a bit surprised. I think
this is the first time I've been
able to see myself in a mirror!
fields.JP:
……でも、ちょっと驚いてます。
こんなにちゃんと鏡を見られたのは、
生まれて初めてかも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I am a bit surprised. I think
this is the first time I've been
able to see myself in a mirror!

fields.EN:
I'm sure it's because you were by my side,
Jack-san... Thank you!
fields.JP:
きっと、ジャックさんが
そばにいてくれたからです……
ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's because you were here
with me. Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... By the way, you're not
plain at all, Shirayukihime.
fields.JP:
あはは……
でも、白雪姫は全然地味じゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... By the way, you're not
plain at all, Snow White.

fields.EN:
Um... That smile of yours is...
really charming.
fields.JP:
その……
笑顔の白雪姫は、すごく、素敵だと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... That smile of yours is...
really charming.

fields.JP: あ、ありがとうございます……

fields.EN:
(I can't belive what I said!
That's so embarrassing!)
fields.JP:
（って、何を恥ずかしい事を
　言ってるんだ……僕は！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't belive what I said!
That's so embarrassing!)

fields.EN:
So... I guess that means you're the only plain
one left, Jack-san. Hee hee...
fields.JP:
……じゃあこれで、地味なのは
ジャックさんだけになりましたね。
うふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So... I guess that means you're
the only plain one here then.
*giggle*...

fields.EN:
I can't believe you're saying that
to me...
fields.JP: いや、僕だけになるのは、ちょっとそれは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you're saying that
to me...

fields.EN:
(I'm a little surprised myself...
I can joke this naturally. Maybe
it's because it's this girl...)
fields.JP:
（でも、自分でもちょっと驚いた……
　こんなに自然に冗談が言えるなんて、
　相手がこの子だからなのかもな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm surprised myself over how
casually I'm speaking now... Maybe
it's because it's Snow White...)

fields.EN:
Jack-san? Um, please keep your eyes on
Shirayuki.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……
これからも、白雪を見ててくださいね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Um, please keep your eyes on
Snow White.

fields.EN:
(That caught me off guard... Did
she mean what I think she did?)
fields.JP:
（び、びっくりした……今のは、
　ど、どういう意味だろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That caught me off guard... Did
she mean what I think she did?)

fields.EN:
(What was that?! That came from
the hallway...)
fields.JP:
（なな、なんだ今の声は！？
　廊下から聞こえてきたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What was that?! That came from
the hallway...)

fields.EN: You! What did you mean by that?!
fields.JP:
ちょっと貴方！！
それはどういう意味ですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED: You! What did you mean by that?!

fields.EN:
Y-You don't have to be so
surprised...
fields.JP: そ、そんなに驚かなくても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You don't have to be so
surprised...

fields.EN:
Surprised? I'm offended! Why are you and
I supposed to be the same kind of person?!
And 'plain friends,' of all things!
fields.JP:
驚くというか、心外ですわ！！
どうして貴方とわたくしが同類なんですの！？
しかも、『地味仲間』だなんて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surprised?! I'm furious! I can't
believe you called me "plain!"

fields.JP:
え、だって……！
シンデレラさんって、
意外と庶民的なところがあるというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But... You seem to have
qualities similar to what you see
from commoners...

fields.EN:
You always say, 'What a waste,'
and... you're actually quite
earnest and serious, aren't you?
fields.JP:
すぐに『もったいない』って言いますし、
それに……けっこう生真面目なところも
あるじゃないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You keep saying the word "waste,"
and you're quite straightforward.

fields.EN:
So, I just thought you were
inherently plain... And, that you
were like me...
fields.JP:
だからきっと、
根は地味な方なんじゃないかって……
……白雪とは仲間だって思ったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I just thought you were
inherently plain... And, that you
were like me...

fields.EN:
Are you picking a fight with me?!
I can't believe how rude you are!
fields.JP:
わたくしに喧嘩を売ってらっしゃいますの！？
何をサラッと失礼なこと、
おっしゃってますのかしら！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you picking a fight with me?!
I can't believe how rude you are!

fields.EN:
I definitely don't want to fight,
but... was it that really rude?
fields.JP:
喧嘩だなんてそんな……
し……失礼、でしたか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I definitely don't want to fight,
but... was it that really rude?

fields.EN:
(I see... She wanted to be friends
with Cinderella, but something
went terribly wrong...)
fields.JP:
（な、なるほど、そういうことか……
　きっと単純に、仲良くなりたいんだな。
　……完全に何かが間違ってるけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... She wanted to be friends
with Cinderella, but something
went terribly wrong...)

fields.EN:
In any case! You have no reason or
right to call me out for being
plain!
fields.JP:
と、とにかく！
貴方に地味だなんて言われる筋合いは
ありませんですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case! You have no reason or
right to call me out for being
plain!

fields.JP: そうですか……すみません……

fields.EN:
Wh-What's with that look on your
face?! Stop acting like you're
sad!
fields.JP:
な、何ですの、その表情は……？
今さら急にしおらしくなったって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What's with that look on your
face?! Stop acting like you're
sad!

fields.EN:
Shirayuki just wanted to become friends with
Cinderella-san... But if you didn't want that,
I'm sorry...
fields.JP:
白雪は……ただシンデレラさんと
仲良くなりたかっただけなんです。
でも……嫌だったら、すみません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White just wanted to be
friends with you... I'm sorry if
that's not what you wanted...

fields.EN:
I-I didn't say I didn't want to be
friends... I'm... fine with that.
fields.JP:
べ、別に……
い、嫌だなんて言ってませんわよ……
仲良くなるのは、別にかまいませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I didn't say I didn't want to be
friends... I'm... fine with that.

fields.EN:
W-We are on the same team, so it's
not like I hate you. But, if you
insist on becoming friends...
fields.JP:
も、元々わたくし達は仲間ですし……
貴方のこと、別に嫌いじゃありませんですし？
どうしてもって仰るなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We are on the same team, so it's
not like I hate you. But, if you
insist on becoming friends...

fields.EN:
R-Really? Thank goodness! I'm so
happy!
fields.JP:
ほ、本当ですか！？
……よかった……！
嬉しいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Really? Thank goodness! I'm so
happy!

fields.EN:
I have to say, though, what you
said isn't what someone would say
to make friends.
fields.JP:
でも、それで仲良くなろうだなんて、
普通伝わりませんですことよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to say, though, what you
said isn't what someone would say
to make friends.

fields.EN:
Calling people plain, or saying
they're like commoners, or
scrooges, or arrogant, or...
fields.JP:
人のことを地味だとか庶民的だとか
もったいない精神のカタマリだとか
貧乏くさいとか、見栄っ張りだとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calling people plain, or saying
they're like commoners, or
scrooges, or arrogant, or...

fields.EN:
(I don't think she said that
much...)
fields.JP: （……そこまで言ってなかったと思うけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't think she said that
much...)

fields.EN:
If someone was told that, they
would want to keep themselves far
away!
fields.JP:
そんな風に言われて、
普通、仲良くしたがってるだなんて
伝わると思いまして！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If someone was told that, they
would want to keep themselves far
away!

fields.JP:
はっ……！
言われてみれば……

fields.EN:
Maybe Shirayuki ended up praising something
you're self-conscious about, Cinderella-san...
fields.JP:
白雪、もしかして
シンデレラさんの気にしていること……
ほめてしまったんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess Snow White was praising
the qualities that bother you.

fields.EN:
B-Bother?! Me?! Wait... You were
trying to praise me?
fields.JP:
わ……わたくし、気にしてなんか……！
……ていうか、ほめてましたの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-Bother?! Me?! Wait... You were
trying to praise me?

fields.EN:
Oh, and your that "Plain Alliance"
you proposed is such a backwards-
sounding thing!
fields.JP:
と、ともかくですわ！
『地味同盟』ってなんなんですの！？
最初から後ろ向きな響きじゃありませんこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and your that "Plain Alliance"
you proposed is such a backwards-
sounding thing!

fields.EN:
Plain Alliance doesn't sound
good...? Backward... I see...
fields.JP:
地味同盟……ダメですか？
……後ろ向き……そうですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Plain Alliance doesn't sound
good...? Backward... I see...

fields.EN:
F-Fine! I get it! I just have to
join this "Plain Alliance" of
yours, right?!
fields.JP:
……も、もう！　わ、分かりましたわ……
入ればいいんでしょう？
その『地味同盟』とやらに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine! I get it! I just have to
join this "Plain Alliance" of
yours, right?!

fields.EN:
(She's going to join after all
that?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's going to join after all
that?)

fields.EN:
Really?! I-I'm so happy! Thank you
so very much!
fields.JP:
本当ですか！？
うう……嬉しいです！
ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?! I-I'm so happy! Thank you
so very much!

fields.EN:
You don't have to be that happy...
Um, can't you at least reconsider
the name?
fields.JP:
そ、そこまで喜ばなくても……
あと、その名前……どうにかなりませんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to be that happy...
Um, can't you at least reconsider
the name?

fields.EN:
Huh? I think it's a good name... Oh! Then
Cinderella-san, you come up with a name!
fields.JP:
え？　良い名前だと思うんですけど……
あ、そうだ！
じゃあ、シンデレラさんが名前考えてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? I thought it was good, but...
I know! Why don't you come up with
a name that you'd like?

fields.EN:
Huh? M-Me? Well... How about the
"Gracious Ladies All-For-One
Club?"
fields.JP:
え？　わ、わたくしが？
そうですわね……じゃあ、
『清楚なお嬢様運命共同体』とか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? M-Me? Well... How about the
"Gracious Ladies All-For-One
Club?"

fields.EN:
That's so cute! But, it is a bit
long, and... Jack-san is in it, too.
fields.JP:
わあ、可愛いですね！
でも、ちょっと長いかもしれませんし、
ジャックさんも居ますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's so cute! But, it is a bit
long, and... Jack is in it, too.

fields.JP: （やっぱり僕も入ってるんだ……）

fields.EN:
Oh, Jack? I suppose "Ladies"
wouldn't work then. Hm...
fields.JP:
まあまあ、ジャックもですの……？
それでは『お嬢様』はダメですわね……
う～ん……それでは何がいいかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Jack? I suppose "Ladies"
wouldn't work then. Hm...

fields.EN:
(I was worried there for a moment,
but it looks like it all ended
well...)
fields.JP:
（一時はどうなるかと思ったけど……
　なんだかんだで仲良くやれそうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was worried there for a moment,
but it looks like it all ended
well...)

fields.EN:
(I feel so tired all of a
sudden... I'd better go back to my
room and rest...)
fields.JP:
（ほっとしたら疲れた……
　……部屋に戻ろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel so tired all of a
sudden... I'd better go back to my
room and rest...)

fields.EN:
(What's the matter with
Shirayukihime? It's unusual to hear her
wanting to see me in her room...)
fields.JP:
（白雪姫、どうしたんだろう？
　自分から、部屋に来てくれだなんて……
　珍しいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's the matter with Snow
White? It's unusual to hear her
wanting to see me in her room...)

fields.EN:
Jack-san! I'm so sorry to have you
come here!
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん！
急に呼び出したりして、すみません……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! I'm so sorry to have you
come here!

fields.EN: No, that's fine. Um... What is it?
fields.JP:
ううん、大丈夫だよ。
それより……どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: No, that's fine. Um... What is it?

fields.EN: W-Well... I had a favor to ask...
fields.JP:
そ、その……
実は、お願いがあるんです……
fields.LOCALIZED: W-Well... I had a favor to ask...

fields.EN:
I got a pretty dress, and... I was
hoping you could see it...
fields.JP:
この間、お洋服をもらったんですけど……
それを見てほしくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got a pretty dress, and... I was
hoping you could see it...

fields.JP:
へえ……！
でも、なんでまた僕に……？

fields.EN:
W-Well, I wanted a boy's opinion
on whether it looks good or not...
Is that okay?
fields.JP:
そ、その……似合うかどうか、
男性の意見も欲しくて……
ダメ、ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I wanted a boy's opinion
on whether it looks good or not...
Is that okay?

fields.EN:
I see... Sure! If you're fine with
me.
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……！
僕なんかでよければ、もちろんいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Sure! If you're fine with
me.

fields.JP:
本当ですか？
ありがとうございます！

（とは言ったものの、
　なんかちょっと緊張するなあ……）

fields.EN:
Okay! Let me go and change, then.
But, be sure you look away! No
peeking!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、さっそく着替えますね！
……ちょっと向こう向いててください！
の……覗いちゃダメですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Let me go and change, then.
But, be sure you look away! No
peeking!

fields.EN:
(I wonder how much longer it's
going to take...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder how much longer it's
going to take...)

fields.EN: I'm done! You can turn around now!
fields.JP:
き、着ました……！
もうこっちを向いて大丈夫です！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm done! You can turn around now!

fields.EN:
(I need to give her my honest
opinion, but this is going to be
so embarrassing...)
fields.JP:
（ちゃんと感想言わなくちゃ……
　なんだか恥ずかしいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to give her my honest
opinion, but this is going to be
so embarrassing...)

fields.EN:
H-How is it? It feels a bit tight
at the top, though...
fields.JP:
ど、どうですか……？
ちょっときついような気がします……
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-How is it? It feels a bit tight
at the top, though...

fields.EN:
(S-Sure, she looks good, but...
Her breasts are...!)
fields.JP:
（ど、どうって……もちろん似合ってるけど、
　その前に、ボタンが……
　け、けっこう胸がちらっと……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(S-Sure, she looks good, but...
Her breasts are...!)

fields.EN:
Um, uh! Y-You look real good! But,
um... I think it's best to pull up
the top part...
fields.JP:
あ、あはは！　す、すごく似合ってるよ！
でも、その……
ぼ、ボタンはちゃんと上まで閉めた方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, uh! Y-You look real good! But,
um... I think it's best to pull up
the top part...

fields.JP:
えっ？
……きゃっ！！？
す、すみません……！！

fields.EN:
N-No! I'm sorry for saying such a
thing!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……！
変な事言って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No! I'm sorry for saying such a
thing!

fields.EN: Aaaah! I need to cover up! Yikes!
fields.JP:
あわわわ……早く閉めないと……！
……ひゃああっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Aaaah! I need to cover up! Yikes!

fields.JP: （み、見るなジャック！　見ちゃダメだ！）

fields.EN:
Urrh... I guess it was too small
for Shirayuki... It must be
because I'm fat...
fields.JP:
うう……白雪には小さかったみたいです……
やっぱり……太ってるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... I guess it was too small
for Snow White... It must be
because I'm fat...

fields.EN:
No, that's fine... I've known it
all along... Heh... Heh, heh,
heh...
fields.JP:
いえ、いいんです。
知ってましたから……
うふ、うふふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's fine... I've known it
all along... Heh... Heh, heh,
heh...

fields.EN:
(This isn't good... She must
have snapped!)
fields.JP:
（や、やばい……自虐を通り越して
　変なテンションになってる……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't good... She must
have snapped!)

fields.EN:
Heh... Um... By the way,
who gave you those clothes?
fields.JP:
あはは……そ、そういえば……
その服……誰からもらったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Uh, um... By the way... Who
bought you that?

fields.EN: Huh?! I-I see! Is that so?
fields.JP:
え！？　そ、そうなの！？
それは……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh?! I-I see! Is that so?

fields.EN:
(Well, duh! It's no wonder it's
too small! I can't believe what
Oyayubihime did here!)
fields.JP:
（いや、そりゃ小さいだろ！
　っていうか、親指姫も何でそんなことを！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, duh! It's no wonder it's
too small! I can't believe what
Thumbelina did here!)

fields.EN:
C'mon! You can do better than
that!
fields.JP: ほらほら！　もっと気合入れて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon! You can do better than
that!

fields.EN:
(Hm? Akazukin-san and
Shirayukihime are running... Wait...
They're coming right at me!)
fields.JP:
（ん？　あれは……赤ずきんさんと、白雪姫？
　なんで走って……
　ってか、なんかこっちに来るし！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Red Riding Hood and Snow
White are running... Wait...
They're coming right at me!)

fields.EN:
Hey! Jack! Perfect timing! Join
us!
fields.JP:
あ、ジャック！
ちょうどいいところにいた！
あんたも一緒にやるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Jack! Perfect timing! Join
us!

fields.EN:
*huff* *huff* Jack-san...! You're
going to join us? Thank you!
fields.JP:
はあはあ……ジャックさん……！
ありがとうございます！
付き合ってくれるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*huff* *huff* Jack...! You're
going to join us? Thank you!

fields.EN:
All right! Ten more laps, and
you're coming too, Jack!
fields.JP:
よーし……それじゃあ、
ジャックも一緒に、あと１０周だね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Ten more laps, and
you're coming too, Jack!

fields.EN:
Y-Yes...! Shirayuki can do more
as long as Jack-san is with us!
fields.JP:
は……はい！
ジャックさんも一緒なら、白雪、がんばります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes...! Snow White can do more
as long as Jack is with us!

fields.EN: Nice! That's what I wanna hear!
fields.JP: よーし！　いい心がけだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Nice! That's what I wanna hear!

fields.EN:
(I have no idea what's going on,
but now I can't get away from
them...!)
fields.JP:
（な、なんかよく分からないけど、
　いつの間にか巻き込まれてる！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have no idea what's going on,
but now I can't get away from
them...!)

fields.EN:
Okay! Not bad for the first day!
Let's have a break!
fields.JP:
よーし！
ま、初日だし、今日はこんなもんかな
ちょっと休もっか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Not bad for the first day!
Let's have a break!

fields.EN:
(I ended up running, but what is
this all about? Some sort of
special training exercise?)
fields.JP:
（ついつい一緒に走っちゃったけど、
　な、なんなんだ一体……？
　何かのトレーニングなのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I ended up running, but what is
this all about? Some sort of
special training exercise?)

fields.EN:
(But I have to hand it to
Akazukin-san. She didn't even break
a sweat...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、さすが赤ずきんさん。
　息も切らしてないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I have to hand it to Red
Riding Hood. She didn't even break
a sweat...)

fields.EN:
S-Shirayukihime? What's going on?
Were you forced to join
Akazukin-san's training?
fields.JP:
し、白雪姫……これは一体？
赤ずきんさんのトレーニングに
君も巻き込まれたとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Snow White? What's going on?
Were you forced to join Red Riding
Hood's training?

fields.EN:
Shirayuki wanted to build up her
stamina! It's definitely not for
losing weight!
fields.JP:
なんていうか……
白雪も、体力を付けようと思って！
決してダイエットの為じゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White wanted to build up her
stamina! It's definitely not for
losing weight!

fields.EN:
(She's isn't trying hard to hide
her motive, is she? I'd better
keep quiet for now...)
fields.JP:
（いや、思いっきりバレバレだけど、
　ここはツッコまないでおこう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's isn't trying hard to hide
her motive, is she? I'd better
keep quiet for now...)

fields.EN:
Huh? You wanted to build up your
stamina?
fields.JP:
え……？
なんだ白雪、あんた力を付けたかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You wanted to build up your
stamina?

fields.JP: え？　いえ、えっと、それはその……

fields.EN:
Then you need to eat more! To the
cafeteria we go!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、沢山食べなくっちゃね！
そうと決まれば、食堂に行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then you need to eat more! To the
cafeteria we go!

fields.JP:
えええっ！？
いえ、白雪はいいです！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha--?! No! Snow White is fine!

fields.EN:
Nope! You need to eat at least
five extra servings! C'mon, stand
up!
fields.JP:
もう。ダメだよ、ちゃんと食べなくちゃ！
５杯はおかわり絶対だからね！
ほら、立って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nope! You need to eat at least
five extra servings! C'mon, stand
up!

fields.JP:
ひいいいいいっ！？
違うんです！　違うんです～！！
ジャックさん、助けて～！！

fields.EN: La-la-la! It's off to eat we go!
fields.JP:
ふんふ～ん♪
ご飯ご飯、っと♪
fields.LOCALIZED: La-la-la! It's off to eat we go!

fields.EN:
(She should have just fessed up
that she was doing all this to
lose weight...)
fields.JP:
（素直にダイエットしたいって
　言えばよかったのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She should have just fessed up
that she was doing all this to
lose weight...)

fields.EN:
(Wait, now that I think about it,
Akazukin-san must know that.
She's just having fun with her...)
fields.JP:
（っていうか……
　赤ずきんさんも絶対気付いてて
　悪ノリしてるよな、あれ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait, now that I think about it,
Red Riding Hood must know that.
She's just having fun with her...)

fields.JP:
（あ。眠り姫だ……
　こんなところで、何してるのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sleeping Beauty? What is she
doing here?)

fields.EN:
(Seems like she isn't doing
anything in particular. Is she
just loafing around?)
fields.JP:
（見たところ、何もしてなさそうだけど……
　日向ぼっこかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems like she isn't doing
anything in particular. Is she
just loafing around?)

fields.EN:
H-Hi there, Nemurihime. What
are you doing here?
fields.JP:
や……やあ、眠り姫。
こんなところで、何してるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hi there, Sleeping Beauty. What
are you doing here?

fields.EN:
Heh... The weather's pretty nice,
isn't it? Are you getting some
sun?
fields.JP:
あはは……今日は珍しく、良い天気だね……
日向ぼっこかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... The weather's pretty nice,
isn't it? Are you getting some
sun?

fields.EN:
(What am I saying? This place
doesn't have much weather to begin
with...)
fields.JP:
（て……天気なんかここじゃ変わらないのに、
　何を言ってるんだ、僕は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What am I saying? This place
doesn't have much weather to begin
with...)

fields.EN:
(Is she ignoring me? Wait...
Ignoring me?!)
fields.JP:
（もしかして……スルー？
　む、無視されてる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she ignoring me? Wait...
Ignoring me?!)

fields.EN:
(Why is she ignoring me? Did I do
something to her?)
fields.JP:
（な、なんで無視されるんだろう……
　僕、嫌われてるのかな？
　何かまずい事したっけ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is she ignoring me? Did I do
something to her?)

fields.JP:
（……え？
　っていうか、もしかして……寝てる！？）

fields.EN:
(What a relief... I thought I did
something wrong... Huh, she sure
does sleep a lot...)
fields.JP:
（ほっとしたような、拍子抜けのような……
　……でも、よく寝てるなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a relief... I thought I did
something wrong... Huh, she sure
does sleep a lot...)

fields.EN:
(I'd better leave before I wake
her up...)
fields.JP:
（起こしちゃ悪いし、
　ここはひとまず退散しよう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'd better leave before I wake
her up...)

fields.JP:
（ま、まずい！
　起こしちゃった……？）

fields.EN:
S-Sorry! You were sleeping,
weren't you?
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……！
やっぱり……寝てたんだよ、ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry! You were sleeping,
weren't you?

fields.EN: I-I see... Do you come here often?
fields.JP:
そ……そっか。
屋上にはよく来るの？
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I see... Do you come here often?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... So I guess I just came
at the right time. Did you sleep
well?
fields.JP:
あはは……
じゃあ、たまたまなんだね。
よく眠れた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... So I guess I just came
at the right time. Did you sleep
well?

fields.JP: そっか、それはよかった……

fields.EN:
(I'd better not bother her for too
long if she was having a good
rest just now...)
fields.JP:
（せっかくよく寝てたんなら、
　あまり話しかけるのも悪いよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'd better not bother her for too
long if she was having a good
rest just now...)

fields.EN:
W-Well, I'll be going. Oh, but
make sure you go back inside
before you catch a cold!
fields.JP:
じゃ……じゃあ、僕はそろそろ行くね。
あ……風邪ひくといけないし、
キリの良いところで帰るんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I'll be going. Oh, but
make sure you go back inside
before you catch a cold!

fields.EN:
(She's a unique one, all right...
She was sleeping so soundly...
She was really cute, too...)
fields.JP:
（なんだか、変わった子だなあ……
　でも、気持ち良さそうに眠ってたな。
　可愛らしい寝顔で……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's a unique one, all right...
She was sleeping so soundly...
She was really cute, too...)

fields.EN:
I woke up... and you were
there... Jack... a prince...?
fields.JP:
目が覚めたら……いた……
ジャック……
……王子……さま？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I woke up... and there... Jack...
My prince...?

fields.JP:
（こんなとこで座り込んでるけど……
　ひょっとして、寝てるのかな？）

fields.EN:
(It's good she's sleeping, but I
can't leave her here like this...)
fields.JP:
（よく眠るのはいいとして、
　さすがにこんな所じゃ……
　ほっとくわけにもいかないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's good she's sleeping, but I
can't leave her here like this...)

fields.EN:
Okay... I'd better carry her back
to her room...
fields.JP:
よし……
と、とりあえず、眠り姫の部屋まで運ぼう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... I'd better carry her back
to her room...

fields.EN:
Sorry... Just need to get under
here...
fields.JP: ごめん。ちょっとだけ動かすよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry... Just need to get under
here...

fields.EN:
(Whoa! She's a lot lighter than I
thought!)
fields.JP:
（わ……！
　やっぱり女の子って軽いんだな……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa! She's a lot lighter than I
thought!)

fields.EN:
(Nemurihime smells so good...
My heart's pounding... I'd better
get her to her room, quick!)
fields.JP:
（眠り姫……甘くていい匂いがする……
　な、なんだかドキドキしてきた……
　早く運ばないと……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sleeping Beauty smells so good...
My heart's pounding... I'd better
get her to her room, quick!)

fields.JP:
ふう……
これでよし、と……

fields.EN:
(Now that I have time to look
around, her room seems to be
filled with plants and vines...)
fields.JP:
（この部屋…改めて見ると
　植物やツタだらけだな…）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that I have time to look
around, her room seems to be
filled with plants and vines...)

fields.EN:
(It's interesting, but I shouldn't
wake her up just to ask her
about it. I'll save it for later.)
fields.JP:
（気になるけど……
　さすがに起こしてまで聞くのも
　悪いし……また今度にしよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's interesting, but I shouldn't
wake her up just to ask her
about it. I'll save it for later.)

fields.EN: Okay, guess I'll be going now...
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, guess I'll be going now...

fields.EN:
(My feet got caught in the
vines... I need to get them off of
me...)
fields.JP:
（つ、ツタが足に絡まった！？
　ど、どうにか外して……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My feet got caught in the
vines... I need to get them off of
me...)

fields.EN:
(D-Did I wake her...? I should get
out of here... What? It's dark
all of a sudden! What gives?!)
fields.JP:
（お……起こしちゃったかな？　
　早くどかないと……って……
　目の前が真っ暗！？　な、なんで！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(D-Did I wake her...? I should get
out of here... What? It's dark
all of a sudden! What gives?!)

fields.EN:
(What're these huge, soft things
sandwiching my face? Wait...! Are
these her b-breasts...?!)
fields.JP:
（柔らかくて、大きい何かが顔に……
　……はっ！？　ま、まさかこれって……
　眠り姫の、む、胸……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What're these huge, soft things
sandwiching my face? Wait...! Are
these her b-breasts...?!)

fields.EN:
Nemurihime? Are you there?
You need to keep your door closed.
fields.JP:
……眠り姫？　いるのかしら？
駄目じゃない。
部屋のドアを開けっ放しにしては……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty? Are you there?
You need to keep your door closed.

fields.EN:
I bet she's just sleeping... But
it isn't safe to do this, even if
we're at the headquarters!
fields.JP:
もう……どうせ寝てるんだろうけど。
いくら本部内とはいえ……
さすがに無用心すぎるわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet she's just sleeping... But
it isn't safe to do this, even if
we're at the headquarters!

fields.JP:
……ぶはっ！
や、やっと顔が出せた……！

ジャック……！！
あ、あんた……

fields.EN:
Alice?! Oyayubihime?! No! This
isn't what you think!
fields.JP:
……あ、アリスと親指姫！？
違うんだ！　これはその……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice?! Thumbelina?! No! This
isn't what you think!

fields.EN:
Of all the people... Lewd scum!
Prepare yourself!
fields.JP:
まさか……あんたがこんな……
スケベ野郎だったなんてね……！
びっくりだわ……覚悟なさい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of all the people... Lewd scum!
Prepare yourself!

fields.EN:
It's really not what you think!
You have to hear me out!
fields.JP:
ち、違うんだって！！
まずは僕の話を……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's really not what you think!
You have to hear me out!

fields.EN:
J-Jack... You did that...? No...
This... This has to be a dream...
fields.JP:
ジャ……ジャックがそんなこと……
嘘よ……これはきっと……夢だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Jack... Jack was... No...
This... This has to be a dream...

fields.EN: (Dang it! This isn't good at all!)
fields.LOCALIZED: (Dang it! This isn't good at all!)

fields.EN: Hm...? Why am I... on the bed...?
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm...? Why am I... on the bed...?

fields.EN:
You were sleeping in the hallway,
so I brought you here without
waking you up...
fields.JP:
君が廊下で寝てたから、
そっと運んだつもりだったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were sleeping in the hallway,
so I brought you here without
waking you up...

fields.EN:
But, then I tripped on that vine
there, and... I'm sorry to wake
you up like this...
fields.JP:
その、そこのツタに引っかかって転んじゃって
……起こしてごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, then I tripped on that vine
there, and... I'm sorry to wake
you up like this...

fields.EN:
Don't you be trying to get out of
this with that kind of lie! Isn't
that right, Nemu?
fields.JP:
そんな苦しい嘘をついたって駄目よ！
ねえ、ネム
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you be trying to get out of
this with that kind of lie! Isn't
that right, Sleepy?

fields.EN:
In my dream... Jack carried me...
I think... he fell...
fields.JP:
……夢の中で……
ジャックが……運んでくれた……
……転んでた……かも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In my dream... Jack carried me...
I think... he fell...

fields.EN:
S-So that's what happened? Hmph!
What a troublemaker! You should've
said so earlier!
fields.JP:
そ、そういうことだったの……
ふん！　紛らわしいのよまったく！
そうならそうと早く言いなさいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So that's what happened? Hmph!
What a troublemaker! You should've
said so earlier!

fields.EN:
Yes... I knew Jack wasn't that
kind of person, but... I wish you
had told us about it...
fields.JP:
そうね……ジャックはそんな事はしないと
わたしはわかっていたのだけど……
ちゃんと言ってほしかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I knew Jack wasn't that
kind of person, but... I wish you
had told us about it...

fields.EN:
(It looks like they understand
what happened, but why does it
feel like I'm being scolded...?)
fields.JP:
（ご、誤解は解けたはずなのに、
　なんで僕は怒られてるんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like they understand
what happened, but why does it
feel like I'm being scolded...?)

fields.EN: And... there. That should do it...
fields.JP:
よいしょっ……
これで、よしと……
fields.LOCALIZED: And... there. That should do it...

fields.EN:
(Since that day, whenever I find Nemurihime
asleep in the hall, I carry her back like
this... I'm completely used to it now.)
fields.JP:
（あの日以来、廊下で寝てる眠り姫を
　見かけるたびにこうして運んでるけど……
　すっかり慣れちゃったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It seems like I'm always carrying
Sleeping Beauty from the hallway
back to her room. Same old story.)

fields.EN:
It's really mesmerizing how well
she can sleep through all this...
fields.JP:
それはそれとして、いつ見ても
惚れ惚れする眠りっぷりだなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's really mesmerizing how well
she can sleep through all this...

fields.EN:
(Did she just respond to me? Can
she hear me, even if she's
asleep?)
fields.JP:
（反応があった！？
　もしかして……眠ってても
　一応聞こえてはいるのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did she just respond to me? Can
she hear me, even if she's
asleep?)

fields.EN:
(Maybe she'll answer me if I ask
her something...)
fields.JP:
（今、何か聞いてみれば、
　返事が返ってくるかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she'll answer me if I ask
her something...)

fields.EN: Can I... ask you a question?
fields.JP: 眠り姫……ちょっと聞いてもいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Can I... ask you a question?

fields.EN:
Um... is it because you're really
into interior decorating or something?
fields.JP:
君の、この部屋なんだけど……
その……どうしてこんな感じなの？
インテリアに凝ってる……とか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
About your room... Why is it like
this? Was the interior too harsh
before?

fields.EN:
Oh, no? So, it's just that you
like plants?
fields.JP:
あ、違うんだ……
じゃあ、単純に植物が好きなのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, no? So, it's just that you
like plants?

fields.EN:
I see... I guess the plants would
help you sleep better.
fields.JP:
そっか……
植物があった方が、きっとよく眠れるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I guess the plants would
help you sleep better.

fields.EN:
(I'm actually having a
conversation with her! I wonder if
she'll forget when she wakes up.)
fields.JP:
（会話が成り立ってる……！
　でも、これって起きた時には
　やっぱり忘れてるのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm actually having a
conversation with her! I wonder if
she'll forget when she wakes up.)

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh, that? I said that I was
mesmerized with how you can sleep
so soundly.
fields.JP:
え？　……ああ、さっきの……！
『惚れ惚れする眠りっぷりだ』って
言ったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:

お主のリアクションは素直でよいな！
他の者どもは、ワレがせっかく話しておるのに、
全然まともに聞こうとしないのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very good, indeed! The others
don't appreciate my blessed words
as you have...

fields.EN:
How unfortunate, as my tales are
quite interesting, and... Ah...
Aaah...?!
fields.JP:
ワレの冒険談はたいそう面白いというのに……
っと……おっとと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unfortunate, as my tales are
quite interesting, and... Ah...
Aaah...?!

fields.JP: お、おわわ……バランスが崩れ……

fields.EN:
Ah... Ah, thank you... You saved
me! What a brave princess you are!
fields.JP:
お……おお、すまん……
貴様のおかげで救われたぞ！
なんと勇敢な姫であろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Ah, thank you... You saved
me! What a brave princess you are!

fields.EN:
(I'm surprised how well they get
along... It's almost as if they're
long-time friends...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだか意外と相性が良いというか……
　仲良さそうに見えてきたぞ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm surprised how well they get
along... It's almost as if they're
long-time friends...)

fields.EN:
Ahem! Now then, allow me to
continue. Hm?
fields.JP:
ごほん！　
……では、話を続けるか。
……む？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahem! Now then, allow me to
continue. Hm?

fields.EN:
(Shoot! She's starting to doze
off! Hameln isn't going to like
this...!)
fields.JP:
（げっ！　う、うとうとしてる！？
　まずい、ハーメルンが怒ったら……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot! She's starting to doze
off! Hameln isn't going to like
this...!)

fields.EN:
Worry not. Come and lean upon me.
How calm and happy you look when
you are asleep...
fields.JP:
そう遠慮せずに、ワレにもたれよ。
気持ち良さそうに眠りおってからに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Worry not. Come and lean upon me.
How calm and happy you look when
you are asleep...

fields.EN:
(She's not mad about it? Actually,
it looks like Hameln is happy to
be leaned on...)
fields.JP:
（怒らない……！？
　それどころか、わりと嬉しそうにもたれ
　かからせてる！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's not mad about it? Actually,
it looks like Hameln is happy to
be leaned on...)

fields.EN:
(Huh... I didn't expect the two of
them to be like that...)
fields.JP:
（へえ……なんだか、
　二人の意外な一面を見たなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh... I didn't expect the two of
them to be like that...)

fields.EN:
I'm a bit surprised seeing you
treating her so nicely like that!
fields.JP:
君っていいとこあるんだね……
ちょっとびっくりしちゃったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a bit surprised seeing you
treating her so nicely like that!

fields.EN:
Shhh! Quiet, you fool! Are you
trying to wake the princess from
her slumber?!
fields.JP:
しーーーっ！！
大きな声を出すな！　姫を起こす気か！？
この愚か者めが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shhh! Quiet, you fool! Are you
trying to wake the princess from
her slumber?!

fields.EN:
Unbelievable! Why, I should have
expected someone like you to
lack such tact!
fields.JP:
まったく……！！
これだから無神経な輩は……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable! Why, I should have
expected someone like you to
lack such tact!

fields.EN:
(Um, but her voice is louder than
mine...)
fields.JP:
（で、でも……今の大声の方が
　起きちゃうんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Um, but her voice is louder than
mine...)

fields.EN:
(That's right... Gretel told me to
come to her room when I have the
time.)
fields.JP:
（そういえばグレーテルに、時間があったら
　部屋に来てって言われてたっけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... Gretel told me to
come to her room when I have the
time.)

fields.EN: (I wonder what she wants with me.)
fields.LOCALIZED: (I wonder what she wants with me.)

fields.JP: 僕だよ、ジャックだけど……

fields.EN: What did you want with me?
fields.LOCALIZED: What did you want with me?

fields.JP: （えっ？　突然何の話なんだろう？）
ええと……興味深いって、どのへん？

fields.EN:
There are a number of facilities
here with no substantial value
other than enriching one's life.
fields.JP:
何をする訳でもない、ただ生きるだけのために、
いくつもの施設がある……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are a number of facilities
here with no substantial value
other than enriching one's life.

fields.EN:
Each seems logically designed,
but their lack of cohesiveness
appears to go unnoticed.
fields.JP:
それぞれが一見合理的な設計をされているように
見えて、実はバラバラに存在しているだけ。
そして誰もそのことに頓着していないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each seems logically designed,
but their lack of cohesiveness
appears to go unnoticed.

fields.EN:
They built something this complex inside the
Jail, yet everyone moves between its parts and
lives here without even thinking about it...
fields.JP:
ここまで複雑に入り組んだものをジェイルの中に
作っておきながら、みな無意識にそれぞれを行き
来して暮らしている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite having such complicated
facilities in the Jail, no one has
even the slightest concern.

fields.EN:
(I guess how the people live
here seems peculiar to Gretel.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりグレーテルには、人間の暮らしって
　変なものに見えるのかなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess how the people live
here seems peculiar to Gretel.)

fields.EN:
To add, the humans here follow
abstract rules without question,
and coexist under an order.
fields.JP:
それに、ここには多くの人間が存在するのに、
意味のわからない細かな規則に無批判に従って
統制され、共存しているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, the humans here follow
abstract rules without question,
and coexist under an order.

fields.EN:
Everything here is quite
interesting. I'm glad I came here.
fields.JP:
どれもこれも興味深いことよ。
ここに来て良かったと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everything here is quite
interesting. I'm glad I came here.

fields.JP:
そ、そうかな？
ええと……ありがとう……？

fields.EN:
(Why am I thanking her? Wait...
Was she actually praising?)
fields.JP:
（……って、僕がお礼を言うようなことだっけ？
　ていうか、今のって褒めてたの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why am I thanking her? Wait...
Was she actually praising?)

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... You're quite
interesting as well.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
あなたもとても興味深いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... You're quite
interesting as well.

fields.EN:
Yes. Your blood... is quite
interesting.
fields.JP:
そう。あなたのその血。
とても気になるわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Your blood... is quite
interesting.

fields.EN:
Ah, but don't worry. I'm not
planning anything that would
be dangerous.
fields.JP:
ああ、心配要らないわ。
危ないことなんかしないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but don't worry. I'm not
planning anything that would
be dangerous.

fields.EN:
(But that would mean she's
planning something...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But that would mean she's
planning something...)

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I hope this will all
go well, Jack.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
よろしくね、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I hope this will all
go well, Jack.

fields.EN:
(She's interested in my blood?
I can already feel the danger...)
fields.JP:
（血が気になるって……やっぱり身の危険しか
　感じないんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's interested in my blood?
I can already feel the danger...)

fields.EN:
I can't get used to these
utensils... Spoons, chopsticks,
whatnots...
fields.JP:
どうにも慣れないのよ。
この『スプーン』だとか『ハシ』だとかいう
道具にはね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't get used to these
utensils... Spoons, chopsticks,
whatnots...

fields.EN:
Then how were you eating your food
before?
fields.JP:
慣れないって、
今までどうやって食事していたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then how were you eating your food
before?

fields.EN: Why, with my hands of course.
fields.JP: あら。私には手があるもの
fields.LOCALIZED: Why, with my hands of course.

fields.EN:
Huh... It sounds pretty crude,
eating with your bare hands.
fields.JP: へえ。手づかみだなんて粗野ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... It sounds pretty crude,
eating with your bare hands.

fields.EN:
Crude? What do you mean by
"crude?"
fields.JP:
粗野？
粗野って、どういう意味かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Crude? What do you mean by
"crude?"

fields.JP: えっ、それ本気で言ってるわけ？

どうしたの、赤ずきんさん？
楽しそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with the cheer, Red Riding
Hood?

fields.EN: I got me some dessert today!
fields.JP: 今日はデザート貰ったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I got me some dessert today!

fields.JP:
……デザート？
デザートとはどういうものなの？

fields.EN: Desserts are food stuff like this!
fields.JP: デザートってのはね、こーゆうやつ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Desserts are food stuff like this!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! I got them as a gift
after I finished a mission out in
the city!
fields.JP:
へっへっへ！
街でさ、一仕事したらお礼にくれたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! I got them as a gift
after I finished a mission out in
the city!

fields.EN:
I don't like working, but sweets
are always welcome in my book.
fields.JP: 働くのは嫌ですけど、甘いものはほしいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't like working, but sweets
are always welcome in my book.

fields.EN:
Um, please work... Uh, but I only
got one. Sorry, folks.
fields.JP:
いや、あんたはちょっとは働きなよ……。
ていうか、一個しかないんだ。
ごめんねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, please work... Uh, but I only
got one. Sorry, folks.

fields.EN:
Fine... I'm going to scab off of
someone else.
fields.JP: 誰かにねだってくるからいいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I'm going to scab off of
someone else.

fields.EN:
So, you only have one... If so,
I'll just gaze at it.
fields.JP:
そう……ひとつしかないのね。
それなら私は眺めているだけでいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you only have one... If so,
I'll just gaze at it.

fields.EN:
(I wonder if that's how she
researches things...)
fields.JP: （これも「研究」の一環なのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if that's how she
researches things...)

fields.EN:
That looks delicious...
I might be a little jealous.
fields.JP:
おいしそうです……
ちょっとうらやましいかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
That looks good... Snow White is a
little envious...

fields.EN:
(That's not an expression I see
every day. She looks a bit more
childish than usual...)
fields.JP:
（なんか、あんまり見たことない表情だな。
　いつもと違って、子供みたいな顔っていうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's not an expression I see
every day. She looks a bit more
childish than usual...)

fields.EN:
Honeycomb toffee... I've heard
about it before. I believe it uses
a rare ingredient called "sugar."
fields.JP:
カルメ焼き……聞いたことがあるわ。
そう、原料の砂糖はとても貴重な素材のはず……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honeycomb toffee... I've heard
about it before. I believe it uses
a rare ingredient called "sugar."

fields.EN:
You know about sweets, Gretel-san?
Do you like sweets?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、お菓子に詳しいんですね！
お好きなんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know about sweets, Gretel?
Do you like sweets?

fields.EN:
Yes. If I had no self-control,
I'd have snatched it away and
eaten every last bit already.
fields.JP:
ええ。私に理性がなかったら、
とっくに奪い取って残らず食べているところよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. If I didn't have self-
restraint, I would have taken that
from her for my own satisfaction.

fields.EN:
I guess that's just how much you
like sweets...
fields.JP: そ、そんなに好きなんですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that's just how much you
like sweets...

fields.EN:
Urgh... H-How about I give you
half, then?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh... H-How about I give you
half, then?

fields.EN:
I'm a bit irritated to be offered
crumbs, but I'm not sure how much
longer I can contain my urge...
fields.JP:
あなたにお情けを頂戴するのは癪に触るけど、
いつまでこの衝動を抑えていられるか
わからないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a bit irritated to be offered
crumbs, but I'm not sure how much
longer I can contain my urge...

fields.EN:
That doesn't sound much like
someone giving thanks...
fields.JP:
それ、人に感謝する時の言葉ではないと
思うのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't sound much like
someone giving thanks...

fields.JP: では、一口いただくわね

fields.EN:
(I haven't seen a smile like that
before!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't seen a smile like that
before!)

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you can smile like
that...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you can smile like
that...

fields.EN:
What is this sensation I feel
percolating inside me? It's
melting away all my desires...
fields.JP:
何かしらこの感覚……
身体の奥底からわき上がってくるの……
あらゆる衝動が溶けてゆくわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is this sensation I feel
percolating inside me? It's
melting away all my desires...

fields.EN:
Ah, I see... So this is my Blood 
Libido...
fields.JP:
……ああ、これが……
これが私の血式リビドーなのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I see... So this is my Blood 
Libido...

fields.EN:
I'm happy to know you're enjoying
it... Hahaha...
fields.JP:
そ、そんなに喜んでもらえてよかったよ……
あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy to know you're enjoying
it... Hahaha...

fields.EN: Huh. So sweets are enough to lure you in, huh?
fields.JP: へー、お菓子で釣れるのね、あんた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? So sweets are what we need
to keep you down, then.

fields.EN:
If Gretel-san can enjoy sweets like
that, then she must be a nice
person.
fields.JP:
でも……お菓子で素直に喜べるんですから、
グレーテルさんって、いい人なんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Gretel can enjoy sweets like
that, then she must be a nice
person.

fields.JP:
（みんなと馴染みにくいかなと思ってたけど、
　案外すんなりとけ込めそうかも……）
ふふ……なんていう恍惚感かしら……

fields.EN:
(Whoops... Looks like I disturbed
her reading...)
fields.JP: （って、本を読むのに夢中になってるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoops... Looks like I disturbed
her reading...)

fields.EN:
Ah, welcome. You can sit anywhere
over there.
fields.JP:
ああ、いらっしゃい。
そのへんにどうぞお座りなさいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, welcome. You can sit anywhere
over there.

fields.JP: あの……何を読んでいるの？

fields.EN:
Jack, let me ask you this... What
is the biggest problem in making
sweets?
fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャック。
ここでお菓子を作るのに最大の問題は
なんだと思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, let me ask you this... What
is the biggest problem in making
sweets?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Not having the right
cooking tools and utensils?
fields.JP: うーん、調理器具が足りないことかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Not having the right
cooking tools and utensils?

fields.EN:
It's that the ingredients are hard
to come by.
fields.JP: 原料が手に入りにくいってことなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's that the ingredients are hard
to come by.

fields.EN:
I thought it would be easier to
make the ingredients myself, so
I began researching it, but...
fields.JP:
それなら原料そのものから作ればいいと思って、
研究しているのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought it would be easier to
make the ingredients myself, so
I began researching it, but...

fields.EN:
(It's pretty extreme, wanting to
make the ingredients, but I guess
she really does like sweets.)
fields.JP:
（原料から作ればいいって、
　強引だけど、それだけ好きなんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's pretty extreme, wanting to
make the ingredients, but I guess
she really does like sweets.)

fields.EN:
Huh? You're not going to read
that anymore?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You're not going to read
that anymore?

fields.EN:
Correct. It's time now for me to
read research reports.
fields.JP: ええ。レポートを読んで研究する時間よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Correct. It's time now for me to
read research reports.

fields.EN:
(That's... a report that the
Professor wrote.)
fields.JP: （これは……博士の書いたレポートだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's... a report that the
Professor wrote.)

fields.EN:
(And that's... What is that? It
looks like a difficult read...)
fields.JP:
（こっちは……？
　なんだろ？　この小難しい内容の本……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And that's... What is that? It
looks like a difficult read...)

fields.EN:
You're able to change gears pretty
quickly. Don't sweets come to mind
every so often?
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと切り換えが早いんだね。
お菓子のこと、つい考えちゃったりしないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're able to change gears pretty
quickly. Don't sweets come to mind
every so often?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... It's only obvious that
I can control my Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
血式リビドーくらい、制御できて当然でしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... It's only obvious that
I can control my Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
Giving in to Blood Libido
is like masturbating nonstop.
fields.JP:
血式リビドーに負けるということは、
のべつまくなしに自慰をしているようなものだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Losing oneself to Blood Libido is
no different from someone
indulging in orgasm.

fields.EN:
Um, uh... What...? Are you sure
about that...?
fields.JP: えっ、えっと、そ……そういうものなのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, uh... What...? Are you sure
about that...?

fields.EN:
Why the blushing? Ah, that's
right. Show me your arm. Your
blood should be flowing well now.
fields.JP:
何を赤くなっているの？
あ、ちょうどいいわ。腕を出して頂戴。
そんなに血の巡りがいいんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why the blushing? Ah, that's
right. Show me your arm. Your
blood should be flowing well now.

fields.EN: What are you planning on doing?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you planning on doing?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Why, I'm going to
draw your blood, of course.
fields.JP: ふふ。血を抜くにきまってるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Why, I'm going to
draw your blood, of course.

fields.EN:
Heh heh. Don't worry, I have the tools.
Though this will be my first time doing it.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
道具はあるから心配要らないわよ。
やるのは初めてだけどね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Don't worry. I have
the proper tools with me. This
will be my first time using them.

fields.EN: There's a lot to worry about!
fields.LOCALIZED: There's a lot to worry about!

fields.EN:
I'm surprised Miko-san actually let
you borrow all those tools.
fields.JP: 大体そんな道具、視子さんがよく貸してくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised Miko actually let
you borrow all those tools.

fields.EN:
Easy...? Wait... You took them
without her approval?!
fields.JP: 楽勝って……勝手に持ち出してきたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Easy...? Wait... You took them
without her approval?!

fields.EN:
Well now, if we can't get your
blood, how about I examine your
pupils? I have tools for that.
fields.JP:
そうねえ、採血がだめなら、
瞳孔の検査をしましょう。
そっちの道具もあるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, if we can't get your
blood, how about I examine your
pupils? I have tools for that.

fields.EN:
Um, no! I-I have something to do,
so I'll see you!
fields.JP: い、いや、僕は用事があるからこの辺で……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, no! I-I have something to do,
so I'll see you!

fields.EN:
Oh, really? Too bad for me. You
are quite an interesting specimen,
after all.
fields.JP:
そう……残念ね……
これほど興味深い研究対象もないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, really? Too bad for me. You
are quite an interesting specimen,
after all.

fields.EN:
(I suppose her research is all for
a reason...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、何でも研究したがるのも、
　ちゃんと理由があってのことなんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose her research is all for
a reason...)

fields.EN:
(I'm starting to wonder that maybe
her inquisitiveness and curiosity
is her real Blood Libido.)
fields.JP:
（……む、むしろ、その知的好奇心のほうが
　グレーテルの『血式リビドー』なんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm starting to wonder that maybe
her inquisitiveness and curiosity
is her real Blood Libido.)

fields.EN:
(In any case, I'll have to be
careful...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In any case, I'll have to be
careful...)

fields.JP: （あれ？　あそこにいるの、グレーテル？）

fields.EN:
Gretel? Are you looking for
something?
fields.JP:
グレーテル！
何か探しているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel? Are you looking for
something?

fields.JP: 別に、そんなのではないわ

fields.EN:
But it looked like you were
looking around a bit...
fields.JP: あちこち見回していた様子だったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it looked like you were
looking around a bit...

fields.EN:
Why, yes. I was simply observing
the people here.
fields.JP: ええ、人間を観察していたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. I was simply observing
the people here.

fields.EN:
Did you find someone worth
observing?
fields.JP: 観察するような興味深い人間がいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you find someone worth
observing?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Not in particular, but
each one of these people here is
refreshing to watch.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。誰か個人のことではないわ。
ここの人間はとても新鮮ね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Not in particular, but
each one of these people here is
refreshing to watch.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it... Back when I lived
in that house, the things the humans who
barged in there said and did were awful.
fields.JP:
そういえば……
あの家にいたころ、そこに勝手に入ってきた
人間たちの言動ときたらなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Much better than the ones who
barged into my home...

fields.EN:
(That house... She means
the Old Student District...)
fields.JP:
（あの家って……
　『旧学生街エリア』のことか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Home... Is she referring to the
Dorm?)

fields.EN:
Cowards with a smidgen of hope,
who succumbed to fear and in the
end, were engulfed in despair.
fields.JP:
微かな希望と臆病さが入り交じり、それはやがて
恐怖に変わると、すぐに諦めとなって……
最後には絶望に終わるの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cowards with a smidgen of hope,
who succumbed to fear and in the
end, were engulfed in despair.

fields.EN:
There were also those who tried
to kill me the moment they saw
my frail figure.
fields.JP:
……私が弱々しそうに見えたのね、
真っ先に私を殺そうと向かってきた人間もいたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There were also those who tried
to kill me the moment they saw
my frail figure.

fields.EN:
Did you really go through
something like that?!
fields.JP: そんな目にも遭ってたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you really go through
something like that?!

fields.EN:
Why, yes. But Hansel-niisan
would always help me in those
instances.
fields.JP:
ええ。
いつもヘンゼル兄さんが助けてくれたけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. But my brother, Hansel,
would always help me in those
instances.

fields.JP:
助けるって、それはつまり、その……
その人たちは……

fields.EN:
They all died. Every last one of
them.
fields.JP: 死んだわよ。一人残らず
fields.LOCALIZED:
They all died. Every last one of
them.

fields.EN:
Why do humans fight fate, despite
knowing their chance of victory is
close to nil?
fields.JP:
客観的に勝率ゼロに等しい状況下であっても、
人間はなぜ戦い、その運命に抗おうとするの
かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why do humans fight fate, despite
knowing their chance of victory is
close to nil?

fields.JP: うん。なにか言い争ってるね

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Their actions are
identical to the ones who invaded
my home.
fields.JP:
……ふふふ。
あの人たちの言動、私の家に入ってきた人間たち
と同じだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Their actions are
identical to the ones who invaded
my home.

fields.EN:
Humans find value in the primitive
act of staying alive itself, even if
their lives have no special meaning...
fields.JP:
人間は、自身の人生に特別な意義を持たなくても
原始的生命存続そのものに、価値を見いだして
いるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Humans look for reasons to
maintain their lives, even if
their lives serve no purpose.

fields.EN:
That's why... with such obsession
and passion, they struggle to survive
simply in order to keep surviving...
fields.JP:
だからだわ。
あれほどの執念と情念とでもって、
生き延びるために生き延びようとするのは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They cling with such tenacity...
I suppose that's how they're able
to live as long as they do.

fields.EN:
Why are you saying that with so
much joy?
fields.JP: どうして君は、そんなことを楽しそうに話すの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you saying that with so
much joy?

fields.EN:
Is it wrong to try and live? Do
you hate humans?
fields.JP:
生き延びることは悪いことなの？
君は、人間が嫌いなの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it wrong to try and live? Do
you hate humans?

fields.EN:
Let me ask you this... Why are you
interpreting my words in that way?
fields.JP:
……どうしてあなたはそのような捉え方を
するの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me ask you this... Why are you
interpreting my words in that way?

fields.EN:
I was simply praising how humans
vigorously fight for life.
fields.JP:
私は人間の旺盛な生命力を買っているのよ。
私は人間を褒めているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was simply praising how humans
vigorously fight for life.

fields.EN:
But the way you worded it is just
horrible...
fields.JP: でも、そんな言い方、あんまりだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the way you worded it is just
horrible...

fields.EN:
Jack... It seems as if you're
easily swayed by your emotions.
fields.JP:
ジャック。
あなたって、表面的な感情に囚われすぎている
のではなくて？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... It seems as if you're
easily swayed by your emotions.

fields.EN:
If killing someone is necessary to survive,
I won't hesitate. Whether the other party
is human or not, that truth doesn't change.
fields.JP:
生き延びるために必要であれば、相手を殺すこと
も厭わない。それは人間であろうとなかろうと、
変わりのない真実なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Survival means doing anything to
live, even killing someone. That's
true of all living beings.

fields.EN:
(Is she holding a grudge against
us for killing Hansel...?)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり、グレーテルはヘンゼルを殺された
　ことを恨んでいるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she holding a grudge against
us for killing Hansel...?)

fields.EN:
(She still calls that area her
home, too... I guess the Dawn
isn't her home...)
fields.JP:
（あの場所をいまだに『家』と呼んでるし……
　黎明はいまだに、グレーテルの『家』じゃ
　ないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She still calls that area her
home, too... I guess the Dawn
isn't her home...)

fields.EN: Oh? And where are you going?
fields.JP:
あら？
どこへ行くの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? And where are you going?

fields.EN:
It seems I'm missing something
critical, after all...
fields.JP:
私にはやはり、
何か欠けているものがあるのかしらね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I'm missing something
critical, after all...

fields.EN:
If so, what is this odd feeling I
have deep inside me?
fields.JP:
だとすれば……
この胸の底に小さくわだかまっているものは何？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, what is this odd feeling I
have deep inside me?

fields.EN:
Do you know what this feeling is,
Jack?
fields.JP:
ジャック。
あなたはそれを知っているの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you know what this feeling is,
Jack?

fields.EN:
(It's been hard to look at Gretel
after I ran off from our
conversation like that...)
fields.JP:
（あんなこと聞いて逃げてきちゃったし、
　いまさら会いに行くのも気が重いなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's been hard to look at Gretel
after I ran off from our
conversation like that...)

fields.EN:
(But I need to clear the air with
her somehow...)
fields.JP: （でも、誤解があるなら解いておかないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I need to clear the air with
her somehow...)

fields.EN:
What are you doing over there,
Jack?
fields.JP:
そこで何をしているの？
ジャック……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing over there,
Jack?

fields.EN:
Did you come to see me? If so,
you should have gone in..
fields.JP:
私の部屋に入るつもりだったの？
それなら入ればいいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you come to see me? If so,
you should have gone in..

fields.EN:
I can't just go inside without
your permission.
fields.JP:
そんな！
勝手に入る訳にはいかないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't just go inside without
your permission.

fields.EN: Oh? I go wherever I want, anytime.
fields.JP:
そう？
私なら、入りたい時には勝手に入るわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? I go wherever I want, anytime.

fields.EN:
(That's disturbing to hear... I'd
better lock my door when I step
out...)
fields.JP:
（あっさり言ってるし……
　部屋を出る時は鍵かけておかなきゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's disturbing to hear... I'd
better lock my door when I step
out...)

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel...? I'm sorry I left in
the middle of our conversation
before...
fields.JP:
グレーテル。その……
この間は話の途中で勝手に帰ってごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel...? I'm sorry I left in
the middle of our conversation
before...

fields.EN:
Conversation? Ah, that. I thought
you maybe had a stomachache.
fields.JP:
話の途中で？
……ああ、あの時のこと。
急にお腹でも壊したのかと思ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Conversation? Ah, that. I thought
you maybe had a stomachache.

fields.EN:
See?! You keep saying things to
provoke others! That's why
everyone misunderstands you!
fields.JP:
君はそうやってすぐ皮肉っぽく茶化すから
誤解されるんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See?! You keep saying things to
provoke others! That's why
everyone misunderstands you!

fields.EN:
And you also seem to get emotional
all the time.
fields.JP: あなたもそうやってすぐに感情的になるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you also seem to get emotional
all the time.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. I suppose my comment
just now came from emotion, too.
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい。
私の今の言い方も、感情的だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I suppose my comment
just now came from emotion, too.

fields.EN:
(Huh? It's pretty unusual for her
to apologize...)
fields.JP:
（え？
　グレーテルが謝るなんて、珍しいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? It's pretty unusual for her
to apologize...)

fields.EN:
I was thinking afterward... How I
lack understanding of human
emotions.
fields.JP:
あのあと、考えたのよ。
私にはやっぱり何かが欠けていて、人間の感情に
対する理解や共感が足りないみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was thinking afterward... How I
lack understanding of human
emotions.

fields.JP: それは……そうかもしれないけど、でも……

fields.EN:
But you're trying to understand us,
and you really do act with us in mind...
fields.JP:
でも君は理解しようとしてくれてるし、
実際僕たちのことを考えて行動してくれてる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you tried to understand us,
which is why you're with us now...

fields.EN: Or, at least that's what I hope.
fields.LOCALIZED: Or, at least that's what I hope.

fields.EN:
Maybe that's because your pure curiosity
drives you to pursue the principles behind
human behavior and the roots of emotion...!
fields.JP:
それは多分、君の純粋な好奇心が、人間の
行動原理とか感情の根っことかを追求してて
……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think the emotions you're
looking for come from a primal,
human curiosity.

fields.EN:
That curiosity makes you want to
know and understand others.
fields.JP:
それはきっと……
君が対象をきちんと理解したいからなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That curiosity makes you want to
know and understand others.

fields.EN:
But the way you analyze things
comes across as cold, which is
why others see you as uncaring...
fields.JP:
でも、冷静に分析しようとするあまり、
周りには冷たく見えてしまうだけなんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the way you analyze things
comes across as cold, which is
why others see you as uncaring...

fields.EN: Wait... Um, what was my point?
fields.JP:
って、あれ？
……僕は何を言いたいんだっけ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait... Um, what was my point?

fields.EN:
Anyway... I'm sure you just want
to get to know and understand
others!
fields.JP:
だからつまり……君はちゃんと相手のことを
理解したがってるんだよ……きっと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway... I'm sure you just want
to get to know and understand
others!

fields.EN:
Quite interesting... You truly are
a fascinating specimen.
fields.JP:
面白いことを考えるのね。
やっぱりあなたは大変興味深い研究対象だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite interesting... You truly are
a fascinating specimen.

fields.EN:
(Finally, it looks like I got
through to her.)
fields.JP: （……どうにか、ちゃんと話せてよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Finally, it looks like I got
through to her.)

fields.EN:
Wait... Hold on there! What's that
in your hand?!
fields.JP:
……って！　ちょっと待ってよ！
その手に持っているのは……何！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Hold on there! What's that
in your hand?!

fields.EN: Why, it's a syringe, of course.
fields.LOCALIZED: Why, it's a syringe, of course.

fields.EN:
I know that! I'm asking you why
you pulled it out!
fields.JP:
それはわかってるよ！
なんでそんなものを持ち出してきたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know that! I'm asking you why
you pulled it out!

fields.EN:
You seem very excited. Wouldn't
your increased bloodflow make this
the best time to draw a sample?
fields.JP:
あら、だっていい具合に興奮してきて
血行も良くなってることだし、
今日はうまく採れると思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You seem very excited. Wouldn't
your increased bloodflow make this
the best time to draw a sample?

fields.EN:
I see. Well. After all I did to
procure those things from Miko-san...
fields.JP:
そう……
視子さんのとこからいろいろ調達してきたのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Well. After all I did to
procure those things from Miko...

fields.EN:
Don't tell me you took more stuff
from her again!
fields.JP: また勝手に持ち出してきたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me you took more stuff
from her again!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I have an interest in
tools, too.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
人間だけでなく、道具にだって興味はあるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I have an interest in
tools, too.

fields.EN:
And the only way to observe the
value of a tool is to use it.
Isn't that right?
fields.JP:
そして道具なら、使ってみて初めてその真価が
わかるというものでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And the only way to observe the
value of a tool is to use it.
Isn't that right?

fields.EN:
W-Well, sure, but...! No, you're
absolutely right! So, then... See
you!
fields.JP:
う、うん、そうだね！
ほんとその通りだよね！
じゃ……またね！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, sure, but...! No, you're
absolutely right! So, then... See
you!

fields.EN:
Oh? He's in such a hurry... I
wouldn't have minded conversing
with him further.
fields.JP:
あら……もう少し話していたかったのに、
せっかちなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? He's in such a hurry... I
wouldn't have minded conversing
with him further.

fields.EN:
Well... I suppose what he said is
right.
fields.JP:
……まあ、そうね。
ジャックの言う通りなのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... I suppose what he said is
right.

fields.EN:
But what could I do to appear less
cold to others?
fields.JP:
もう少し冷淡に見えないようにするには、
どうすればいいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what could I do to appear less
cold to others?

fields.EN: Maybe I could send a gift?
fields.JP: 贈り物でもしてみようかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe I could send a gift?

fields.EN:
I know. I'll make some sweets.
Hm... Pudding... That sounds good.
I've read a recipe already, so...
fields.JP:
そう、何か甘いお菓子でも作ってみましょう。
プリン？　いいわね。
作り方の本はこの間読んだことだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. I'll make some sweets.
Hm... Pudding... That sounds good.
I've read a recipe already, so...

fields.EN:
(*yawn*... What time is it...?
Maybe I'll get something to drink
before heading back to bed...)
fields.JP:
（ふああ……変な時間に起きちゃったな……
　何か飲んでまた寝よう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(*yawn*... What time is it...?
Maybe I'll get something to drink
before heading back to bed...)

fields.EN:
I see. Your theory is quite
interesting. We should dissect the
sample to verify it.
fields.JP:
なるほど。その仮説は興味深いね。
ぜひサンプルを解体して検査してみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Your theory is quite
interesting. We should dissect the
sample to verify it.

fields.EN:
Oh, but dissection is meaningless.
Isn't there a way to observe
bloodflow without killing it?
fields.JP:
あら。解体してしまっては無意味だと思うわ。
生きた状態での血液循環から、どうにか
観察できないものかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but dissection is meaningless.
Isn't there a way to observe
bloodflow without killing it?

fields.JP: （あれ？　博士とグレーテルだ）

fields.EN:
So unless the blood is circulating while
the subject remains alive, you can't obtain
precise data—is that what you're saying?
fields.JP:
……つまり、個体の生命活動が保たれた状態での
血液循環でなければ、厳密なデータは揃わないと
いうことだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, are you saying you need the
sample to be alive in order to
acquire the proper data?

fields.EN:
Why, yes. It's structured
differently from humans, but mere
blood clots wouldn't do us good.
fields.JP:
ええ。人間とは構造が異なるのだもの。
ただの血糊では駄目
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. It's structured
differently from humans, but mere
blood clots wouldn't do us good.

fields.EN:
(I feel a bit uneasy hearing the
words "dissect" and "blood clot"
coming from them...)
fields.JP:
（『解体』だの『血糊』だの、物騒な言葉が
　聞こえてくるなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel a bit uneasy hearing the
words "dissect" and "blood clot"
coming from them...)

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right. I'll get
started right away.
fields.JP: 一理あるね。早速試してみようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right. I'll get
started right away.

fields.EN:
(The Professor's leaving... I
guess he's going back to do more
research.)
fields.JP:
（あ、博士が帰ってく。
　これからまた研究なのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Professor's leaving... I
guess he's going back to do more
research.)

fields.EN:
You were talking about research
until this late?
fields.JP: こんなに夜遅くまで研究の話？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were talking about research
until this late?

fields.EN:
Why yes. Research in relation
to our... sample.
fields.JP: そうよ、研究。……サンプルのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. Research in relation
to our... sample.

fields.JP: サンプルって、もしかして……

fields.EN:
Yes. The blood of a captured
Marchen. We were discussing its
composition.
fields.JP:
ええ。捕えてきたメルヒェンの血液よ。
その成分について話をしていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The blood of a captured
Marchen. We were discussing its
composition.

fields.EN:
I shared my theory, but it stands
quite inferior to the Professor's
analysis and insight.
fields.JP:
私も仮説を立ててみたのだけれど、
さすがに博士の分析と洞察力には
一籌を輸する他ないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shared my theory, but it stands
quite inferior to the Professor's
analysis and insight.

fields.JP: ふふ。とても興味深いわ……

fields.EN:
(Interesting...? She's talking
about the Marchen blood, isn't
she?)
fields.JP: （興味深いって……メルヒェンの血液が？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Interesting...? She's talking
about the Marchen blood, isn't
she?)

fields.JP: （グレーテル……さすがに疲れてるのかな？）
そ……そうだ。ちょっと待ってて

fields.EN:
(Um... If no one touched it, it
should still be in the fridge...)
fields.JP:
（えーと……誰かに食べられてなければ、
　冷蔵庫のこの辺に……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Um... If no one touched it, it
should still be in the fridge...)

fields.EN:
You want it? I... happened to have
one.
fields.JP:
……これ、食べる？
あ。あの、偶然手に入ったものなんだけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You want it? I... happened to have
one.

fields.EN:
The shape, the color, the aroma...
That's it, all right. And just as
I wanted to make some, too.
fields.JP:
この形、色つや、香り……
私が作ろうと思ったものと寸分違わない、
どこからどう見てもプリンのようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The shape, the color, the aroma...
That's it, all right. And just as
I wanted to make some, too.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I don't think it's
anything else but a pudding...
fields.JP:
うん……
プリン以外の何物でもないと思うよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I don't think it's
anything else but a pudding...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... It was soft of you to
bother bringing me anything.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
わざわざ私にこんなものを持ってくるなんて、
あなたも随分とお人好しなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... It was soft of you to
bother bringing me anything.

fields.EN:
(Huh? Did she say that she wanted
to make one?)
fields.JP:
（あれ？
　今さっきグレーテルも作ろうと思ったと
　言ってなかったっけ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Did she say that she wanted
to make one?)

fields.EN:
(How much longer is she going to
just stare at it?)
fields.JP: （……いつまで観察してるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How much longer is she going to
just stare at it?)

fields.EN: I'm glad to see you enjoying it.
fields.JP: ……喜んでもらえたみたいで、よかった
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad to see you enjoying it.

fields.EN:
Jack, why are you doing so much
for me?
fields.JP:
ジャック。
あなたは私のためにどうして
ここまでしてくれるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, why are you doing so much
for me?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Because I wanted to see
the expression on your face.
fields.JP:
うーん。
……そんな顔を見たかったから、かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Because I wanted to see
the expression on your face.

fields.EN: My face? You see that all the time...
fields.JP:
私の顔？
それくらいいつでも見ているはず……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My face? You seem to pay great
attention to my face...

fields.EN:
You don't smile like that very
often, do you?
fields.JP: 君って、そんな風にはめったに笑わないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't smile like that very
often, do you?

fields.EN:
Yeah... It looks so natural on
you...
fields.JP: うん。なんか素直な感じっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It looks so natural on
you...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... How surprising... I
didn't know I could express myself
this way. How did this come about?
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
不思議なものね、私にこんな顔ができるなんて。
どうやったらこうなるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... How surprising... I
didn't know I could express myself
this way. How did this come about?

fields.EN: It would be nice to always see it.
fields.JP: いつもそういう顔、してればいいのに
fields.LOCALIZED: It would be nice to always see it.

fields.EN:
Because of you, my research has
shown great advancement. I'd like
to ask you to help me further.
fields.JP:
……ジャック、あなたのお陰で私の研究は
とても進展しているの。
これからも協力をお願いするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because of you, my research has
shown great advancement. I'd like
to ask you to help me further.

fields.JP: ……もちろん、研究対象としてね

fields.EN:
Urgh... Stop calling me a
specimen...
fields.JP: うう。研究対象って言うのはやめてよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh... Stop calling me a
specimen...

fields.EN:
Let's see... I want to ask one
other question.
fields.JP: そうね。もう一つ聞きたいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see... I want to ask one
