other question.

fields.EN:
I actually want to ask about that
brain of yours...
fields.JP:
私はむしろ、あんたの頭の中について
聞きたいわよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I actually want to ask about that
brain of yours...

fields.EN:
Oh? So you find it interesting? I
would be more than happy to
speak about it.
fields.JP:
あら。興味を持ってくれるのね。
幾らでも話してあげるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? So you find it interesting? I
would be more than happy to
speak about it.

fields.EN:
(It's unusual to see Gretel with
those three...)
fields.JP:
（……珍しいな。
　グレーテルがあの三人と一緒にいるなんて）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's unusual to see Gretel with
those three...)

fields.EN:
Hey guys, what are you talking
about?
fields.JP: やあみんな。何を話してるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey guys, what are you talking
about?

fields.EN:
Ah, Jack. I was conducting some
research on these three.
fields.JP:
あら、ジャック。
この子たちのことについて研究していたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Jack. I was conducting some
research on these three.

fields.EN:
Huh? This was research? Shirayuki
thought we were just having a
friendly conversation...
fields.JP:
えっ。研究だったんですか！？
白雪はてっきり、普通にお喋りしてるのかと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? This was research? Snow White
thought we were just having a
friendly conversation...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. What you said is
right, too.
fields.JP: 大丈夫よ。白雪の言ってることが正しいから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. What you said is
right, too.

fields.EN:
Oh? But all matters of data
acquisition are part of research.
fields.JP: あら。知識を得る行為の全ては研究よ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? But all matters of data
acquisition are part of research.

fields.EN:
Heh... So, causing trouble with
your research again?
fields.JP:
あはは。
また得意の『研究』で困らせているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... So, causing trouble with
your research again?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... How rude. I'm not
troubling any of them. Isn't that
right?
fields.JP:
ふふふ、失礼なこと言うわね。
困らせてなんかいないわよ。ねえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... How rude. I'm not
troubling any of them. Isn't that
right?

fields.EN:
*sigh* I can't believe how
confident you are in saying
that...
fields.JP:
はあ。
どこから出てくるのよ、その自信……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I can't believe how
confident you are in saying
that...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki enjoys speaking with
you, Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
白雪は……
グレーテルさんとのお喋り、楽しいですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White enjoys speaking with
you, Gretel.

fields.EN:
Say, Jack... Don't they possess
starkly different personalities
despite being sisters?
fields.JP:
ねえジャック。
この子たち、姉妹だと言うわりには、
性格が違いすぎていると思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack... Don't they possess
starkly different personalities
despite being sisters?

fields.EN:
True. But, I think that's what
makes them great as sisters.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
でもそれがいいんだと僕は思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. But, I think that's what
makes them great as sisters.

fields.EN:
Exactly. That's why researching
them is worthwhile. They are
wonderful specimens.
fields.JP:
その通りよ。
だからこそ研究のしがいがあるの。
大変興味深い検体だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. That's why researching
them is worthwhile. They are
wonderful specimens.

fields.EN:
Like I said a thousand times, stop
calling us "specimens."
fields.JP:
だーかーら。
検体って言うの、やめなさいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said a thousand times, stop
calling us "specimens."

fields.EN:
You're surprisingly perceptive, Oyayubihime.
You don't show it off, but you seem
good at quietly supporting others.
fields.JP:
親指姫は意外と細かいことに気付くし、
それを誇示することはないけれど、
陰でフォローするのは得意に見えるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina is surprisingly keen,
and adept at offering support
without calling attention to it.

fields.EN:
But sometimes your words and actions
don't match what you intend. I suppose
you could call it unintended hostility.
fields.JP:
ただし言動が意図するところと一致しないことが
あるように思えるわ。
そうね……企図せぬ敵対行為というのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But her actions don't always
match her intentions. She appears
to be putting up a strong front.

fields.EN:
Um... Are you trying to pick a
fight with me?
fields.JP:
……ねえ。
あんた、もしかして喧嘩売ってる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Are you trying to pick a
fight with me?

fields.EN:
She could be antinomic by nature.
Or perhaps have difficulty in
expressing her affection.
fields.JP:
……思春期特有の二律背反かしら？
あるいは愛情表現が下手なのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She could be antinomic by nature.
Or perhaps have difficulty in
expressing her affection.

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama can be a
bit awkward sometimes. But she is
very kind.
fields.JP:
親指姉様は、ちょっと不器用ですからね。
でも、本当はとっても優しいんですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dear Sister Thumbelina can be a
bit awkward sometimes. But she is
very kind.

fields.EN:
Awkward... I see. A very accurate
description.
fields.JP: 不器用……そうね。適切な表現だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Awkward... I see. A very accurate
description.

fields.EN:
Th-Oyayubihime! They aren't saying
that to hurt you! They're, um...
praising you!
fields.JP:
お、親指姫！
二人とも悪気は無いんだよ！
褒めてる！　そうだよ！　むしろ褒めてる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thumbelina! They aren't saying
that to hurt you! They're, um...
praising you!

fields.EN:
Yes. Shirayukihime is a thoughtful, kind girl.
She simply treasures Oyayubihime, who gives
her sisters affection in her own awkward way.
fields.JP:
ええ。白雪姫は思いやりのあるいい子だもの。
不器用な愛情を姉妹に注ぐ親指姫を、
とても大切に思っているだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. Snow White is a kind
person, after all. Your awkward
affection is precious to them.

fields.EN: Oh, my... You're making Shirayuki blush...
fields.JP: そ、そう言われると……白雪、照れます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, my... You're making Snow
White blush...

fields.EN:
You know that kindness can sometimes become
violence. That's why you become timid
and keep everything bottled up inside.
fields.JP:
……優しさが時に暴力になるということを
知っているし、だからこそ臆病になり、
全てを裡に抱え込んでしまうのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also know that kindness can
become violent, and that's why you
hold back so much.

fields.EN:
But what you should fear most
aren't mirrors or your childish
body stature.
fields.JP:
だけどあなたが恐れるべきは、鏡でも子供っぽい
身体のバランスでもないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what you should fear most
aren't mirrors or your childish
body stature.

fields.JP: や、やっぱり太ってます！？

fields.EN:
The kindness that makes you care
for others is the very thing that
eats away at you from the inside.
fields.JP:
まして、誰かを傷つけることでもない……
あなた自身の優しさが、あなたを裡から蝕む
ことじゃないのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The kindness that makes you care
for others is the very thing that
eats away at you from the inside.

fields.EN:
Uh, just so you know, you're not
going to leave here pretty if you
hurt Shirayuki, you hear?
fields.JP:
ちょっとあんたねえ。
白雪を傷つけたら承知しないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, just so you know, you're not
going to leave here pretty if you
hurt Snow White, you hear?

fields.EN:
Hurt? All I'm doing is stating my
observations of the situation.
fields.JP:
傷つける？
私は気付いた問題点を提示しているだけよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hurt? All I'm doing is stating my
observations of the situation.

fields.EN:
(Uh, more like tossing grenades
left and right...)
fields.JP:
（むしろ、見境なく爆弾投げつけてるように
　見えるんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh, more like tossing grenades
left and right...)

fields.EN:
As for Nemurihime, one would
assume she's being protected, but
in reality, she's protecting you.
fields.JP:
そうそう、眠り姫は見たところ寝てばかりね。
あなたたちに護られているようでいて護っている
面白い存在……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for Sleeping Beauty, one would
assume she's being protected, but
in reality, she's protecting you.

fields.EN:
Well, it's true that Nemu's like
that...
fields.JP:
まあ……確かにネムはそういうとこ、
あるのかもしれないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's true that Sleepy's like
that...

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, you really notice all kinds of
things... both the good and bad sides of us...
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんって、実はいろいろ見てるん
ですね……
白雪たちの良いところも悪いところも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised by how observant
you are... It's like you know
everything about us, good and bad.

fields.EN:
Oh? But good and bad are one and
the same.
fields.JP:
あら。
美点と欠点なんて表裏のものじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? But good and bad are one and
the same.

fields.EN:
For example, I believe
Nemurihime has already gone through
puberty.
fields.JP:
美点と欠点といえば……
眠り姫ときたら、もう育つ時期は過ぎたと
思うのだけれど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, I believe Sleeping
Beauty has already gone through
puberty.

fields.EN:
(Puberty...? Wh-What specifically
is she referring to...?)
fields.JP:
（それ以上育つって、な、なんのことを言ってる
　のかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Puberty...? Wh-What specifically
is she referring to...?)

fields.JP:
そ、育つ時期って……！
グレーテル！　あんたまさか……

fields.EN:
Wha-?! So, that is what I think it
means?!
fields.JP: ええっ！　やっぱりそういう意味なんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! So, that is what I think it
means?!

fields.EN:
What's to be flustered about? I'm
just sharing a biological analysis
of Nemurihime's...
fields.JP:
何を動揺しているのかしら？
私はただ、生物学的に眠り姫の……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's to be flustered about? I'm
just sharing a biological analysis
of Sleeping Beauty's...

fields.EN:
I can't believe how
Nemurihime is able to sleep through
this like it's no biggie...
fields.JP:
こ、こんな状況でも寝ていられるなんて、
眠り姫って、結構大物なんだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe how Sleeping
Beauty is able to sleep through
this like it's no biggie...

fields.EN:
Biggie?! I can't believe you
said that looking at...! You
pervert!
fields.JP:
『大物』って……
何を見て言ってるのよ！　この変態！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Biggie?! I can't believe you
said that looking at...! You
pervert!

fields.EN:
Oh? So you're interested in
such topics... are you, Jack?
fields.JP:
ふうん、そう。
ジャックはそちらに興味津々なのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? So you're interested in
such topics... are you, Jack?

fields.EN:
Of course not! Hey! You're the
one who said something about
biology and stuff!
fields.JP:
そ、そんな訳ないだろ！？
グレーテルだってさっき『生物学的に』とか
言ってたじゃないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not! Hey! You're the
one who said something about
biology and stuff!

fields.JP: いやっ！　ジャックのくせに不潔よ！

fields.EN: I don't find you filthy at all.
fields.JP: あら、私は不潔だとは思わないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't find you filthy at all.

fields.EN:
It's even written that youths find
interest in well-developed chests
and hips, proof of maturity.
fields.JP:
年頃の男子が女子のよく発達した胸部や臀部に
興味を抱くのは、極めて自然で正常な発達段階に
ある証拠だと、書物にあったもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's even written that youths find
interest in well-developed chests
and hips, proof of maturity.

fields.EN: What book did you get that from?
fields.JP: あんた、どこで何の本を読んで来たのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: What book did you get that from?

fields.EN:
Jack, you're free to continue your
observation of the Blood Maidens'
breasts.
fields.JP:
だからジャックは、これからも正々堂々と
私たち血式少女の胸……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, you're free to continue your
observation of the Blood Maidens'
breasts.

fields.JP:
わー！！
もういい！　もういいから！！

fields.EN:
Jack-san, is that how you were looking at us
all this time...?
fields.JP:
ジャックさんってそういう目で白雪たちを
見ていたんですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were looking at us with that
in mind all this time...?

fields.EN:
Wake up and say something,
Nemurihime!
fields.JP: 眠り姫、寝てないでなんか言ってよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wake up and say something,
Sleeping Beauty!

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime and Oyayubihime, we may
encounter interesting results by
placing emphasis on your breasts.
fields.JP:
白雪姫、親指姫。
私たちももっと胸元を強調してみると、
更に面白い研究結果が出るかもしれないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White and Thumbelina, we may
encounter interesting results by
placing emphasis on your breasts.

fields.EN:
I read that underdeveloped parts
stimulate one's imagination,
another sign of a youth maturing.
fields.JP:
未発達の部位がむしろ想像力を刺激する場合も
あるということだし、そうした嗜好も広範的には
男子の発達段階に含まれるそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I read that underdeveloped parts
stimulate one's imagination,
another sign of a youth maturing.

fields.JP: うわっ！　それますます変態じゃない！

fields.EN:
I suppose Shirayuki can give it a
try...
fields.JP: 白雪……試してみようかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose Snow White can give it a
try...

fields.JP: （お願い！　僕で遊ぶのやめて！）

fields.EN:
(Gretel said she needed to see me,
but... I wonder what it's about.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルが、用があるから来てって
　言ってたけど……何だろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel said she needed to see me,
but... I wonder what it's about.)

fields.EN:
I've been waiting for you. Now,
hurry.
fields.JP: 待っていたわ、早く入って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been waiting for you. Now,
hurry.

fields.EN:
I brought the Mary Gun like you
asked, but why do you need it?
fields.JP:
メアリガンも持ってきたけど、
こんなのどうするの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I brought the Mary Gun like you
asked, but why do you need it?

fields.JP:
……うるさいわね。
何なの、その大声？

fields.EN:
Clothes! Clothes! Why aren't you
wearing your clothes?!
fields.JP:
服！　服！
なんで服着てないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clothes! Clothes! Why aren't you
wearing your clothes?!

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? Because I took
them off, of course.
fields.JP:
……脱いだからにきまってるでしょう？
わかりきったことを聞かないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? Because I took
them off, of course.

fields.EN:
Oh? Why are you leaving? I'm
not done with you yet.
fields.JP:
あら？
ちょっと、なんで出て行こうとするの？
まだ用事は終わってないのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Why are you leaving? I'm
not done with you yet.

fields.EN:
Well then, at least put something
on! Anything!
fields.JP: そしたらせめて服を着て！　服を！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, at least put something
on! Anything!

fields.EN:
That I cannot do. It would make no
sense if my intention is to have
you splatter your blood on me.
fields.JP:
それは駄目ね。
あなたの血を私の身体にかけてもらおうと思って
呼んだのだから、服を着たら意味ないじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That I cannot do. It would make no
sense if my intention is to have
you splatter your blood on me.

fields.EN:
...Why did you come up
with something like that?
fields.JP: ……なんでそんなこと思いついたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What is this really all about?

fields.EN:
Your blood can neutralize a Blood
Maiden's Blood Skelter state.
fields.JP:
あなたの血にはブラッドスケルター化した
血式少女を鎮静化させる効果があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your blood can neutralize a Blood
Maiden's Blood Skelter state.

fields.EN:
I have a hypothesis on what takes
place when your blood covers one,
so I wish to evaluate the results.
fields.JP:
それなら、その血を全身いっぱいに浴びたら
どうなるのか、仮説を立ててみたの。
だから……検証したいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a hypothesis on what takes
place when your blood covers one,
so I wish to evaluate the results.

fields.EN: I don't think you need to do that!
fields.JP: その必要はないと思うよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't think you need to do that!

fields.EN:
But unproven hypotheses
essentially equate to mere
imagination.
fields.JP:
あら。
実験によって検証されない理論は、ただの妄想に
過ぎないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But unproven hypotheses
essentially equate to mere
imagination.

fields.JP:
だめだよ！
離して！　グレーテル！！

fields.EN:
Heeeey! Quiet in there! What's
all this commo...tion...
fields.JP:
おーい、うるさいよ！
何騒いでんの、あんたらは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heeeey! Quiet in there! What's
all this commo...tion...

fields.EN:
(Dear lord, this is only going to
get worse...)
fields.JP: （ああっ、なんだかめんどくさいことに…）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Dear lord, this is only going to
get worse...)

fields.EN:
Sorry... Um... I didn't realize
you two were so close...
fields.JP:
……悪い。
そういう仲だとは気付かなかったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry... Um... I didn't realize
you two were so close...

fields.EN:
No, don't worry. I won't say a
word, so you go back to... You
know.
fields.JP:
いや、いいって。気にしなくて大丈夫だからさ。
誰にも言わないから安心してよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, don't worry. I won't say a
word, so you go back to... You
know.

fields.EN: No! It's not what you think!
fields.JP: 違うから！　ぜんっぜん違うから！！
fields.LOCALIZED: No! It's not what you think!

fields.EN:
Let's have Akazukin join too. It's a perfect
chance to see what happens if we're all
covered in blood and lick each other.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんにも混ざってもらいましょう。
みんなで血まみれになって、舐めあいっこしたら
どうなるか、実験するのにいい機会だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she joins us, we can observe
what happens when we both lick
the blood off of each other.

fields.EN:
An excellent idea, don't you
think?
fields.LOCALIZED:
An excellent idea, don't you
think?

fields.JP: そ、そうは思えないけど……

fields.EN: Um... Can I ask what you're doing?
fields.JP: ……あのさ。それであんたは何してるわけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... Can I ask what you're doing?

fields.EN:
I'm taking your clothes off. I
must say, it's surprising how
intricate your clothing is...
fields.JP:
服を脱がしてあげてるの。
意外とめんどうな構造してるのね、この服……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm taking your clothes off. I
must say, it's surprising how
intricate your clothing is...

fields.EN:
It's surprising how strong you
are!
fields.JP: あたしはあんたの力が結構あるのが意外だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's surprising how strong you
are!

fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんを助けるべき？　だよね？
　でも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should help Red Riding Hood,
right? But...)

fields.EN:
Jack! Don't just stand there! Do
something!
fields.JP: ジャック！　見てないで助けてよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Don't just stand there! Do
something!

fields.EN:
Don't move... Your underwear is
going to tear.
fields.JP: 動かないで、下着も破れてしまうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't move... Your underwear is
going to tear.

fields.EN:
H-Hey! If you tear my hood, I'm
seriously going to kill you!
fields.JP: ちょ……フード破ったらぶっ殺すからね！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! If you tear my hood, I'm
seriously going to kill you!

fields.EN:
(Uh... I don't think your hood is
the major issue here...)
fields.JP: （……ていうか、気にするのフードなの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh... I don't think your hood is
the major issue here...)

fields.JP: （……赤ずきんさん、やっぱりごめん！）

fields.EN: Hey! Jaaack! Don't run! Don't run awaaaaay!
fields.JP:
こらーっ！　ジャーック！
逃げるな！　逃げないでーーーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Jack! Don't run! Please, save
me!

fields.JP:
（あれ、ラプンツェルだ。
　あんなとこに座り込んで、何食べてるの
　かな？）

fields.EN:
Ah, Rapunzel. What's that you have
there?
fields.JP: あら、ラプンツェル。……それは何？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Rapunzel. What's that you have
there?

fields.EN:
Sweets! I got at the city! They
said I'm small and doing my best!
fields.JP:
おかし！
まちでねー、ちっちゃいのによくがんばってる
ねーって、もらった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sweets! I got at the city! They
said I'm small and doing my best!

fields.JP: ふうん。それは良かったわね
これ、ラプンツェルのだよ？
うう……もういっこあげる

fields.EN:
...Guree, this is the last one.
You can have it...
fields.JP:
……ぐれー、これ、さいごのいっこ。
あげる……
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretty? Last one I have. Here...

fields.JP: おかし、もうなくなっちゃった……

fields.EN:
(She's gone... That must have made
Gretel feel bad...)
fields.JP:
（行っちゃった……
　これじゃ、さすがにグレーテルも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's gone... That must have made
Gretel feel bad...)

fields.EN:
(I can't believe how happy she
looks eating them!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe how happy she
looks eating them!)

fields.EN:
(She's horrible... I can't believe
she actually pressured Rapunzel
into giving her food...)
fields.JP:
（よ、容赦無い……
　いや、あのラプンツェルに眼力で勝つなんて
　……しかも食べ物のことで……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's horrible... I can't believe
she actually pressured Rapunzel
into giving her food...)

fields.EN:
(That was no different from seeing
the power balance in an animal
hierarchy...)
fields.JP: （や、野生の世界を垣間見た気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was no different from seeing
the power balance in an animal
hierarchy...)

fields.EN:
I wonder how Rapunzel's doing...
I need to teach her about the
Dawn...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、どうしてるかな？
黎明のこと、色々教えてあげないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder how Rapunzel's doing...
I need to teach her about the
Dawn...

fields.EN:
Wait... Is this Rapunzel's room?
The door is splintered... Does it
even open?
fields.JP:
あれ、ラプンツェルの部屋ってここだっけ……？
ドアがなんかぼろぼろだけど……開くかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Is this Rapunzel's room?
The door is splintered... Does it
even open?

fields.EN:
It's so dark... Rapunzel? Are you
here?
fields.JP:
真っ暗だ……
ラプンツェル、いないのかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's so dark... Rapunzel? Are you
here?

fields.JP:
ぐるる……！
ハグッハグッ！

fields.EN: Whoa! A pink light in the dark?!
fields.JP:
うわっ！
暗闇にピンク色の光が……！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa! A pink light in the dark?!

fields.EN:
W-Wait! Rapunzel! Where are you?!
Are you all right?!
fields.JP:
……そ、そうだ！
ラプンツェル、どこにいるの！？
大丈夫！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait! Rapunzel! Where are you?!
Are you all right?!

fields.EN:
The stuff around your mouth... Is
that... Marchen blood? Were you...
eating a Marchen?
fields.JP:
……もしかして、その口についてるの、
メルヒェンの血……？
……メルヒェンを食べたの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The stuff around your mouth... Is
that... Marchen blood? Were you...
eating a Marchen?

fields.EN:
No more for Jack. Rapunzel ate
all...
fields.JP:
じゃっくのぶん、ないよ……？
ラプンツェル、ぜんぶたべちゃった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No more for Jack. Rapunzel ate
all...

fields.EN:
I don't want any! And you
shouldn't be eating Marchens!
fields.JP:
いらないよ！
メルヒェンは食べちゃだめだってば！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want any! And you
shouldn't be eating Marchens!

fields.EN:
We have a lot of other foods here,
so no eating Marchens or the Jail,
you hear?!
fields.JP:
ここはちゃんとした食べ物があるんだから、
メルヒェンもジェイルも食べちゃだめなの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have a lot of other foods here,
so no eating Marchens or the Jail,
you hear?!

fields.JP: ……ラプンツェル、おなかすいた……

fields.EN:
(Wh-What now? Why is she staring
at me?)
fields.JP:
（……な、なんだ？
　じっと見られてるぞ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What now? Why is she staring
at me?)

fields.JP: じゃっくーーーたべるーーー！

待って！
ラプンツェル、止まって……！

ううううう…………
じゃっくたべるの、まってる……

fields.EN:
H-Hold on there! H-Here! Have some
sweets!
fields.JP:
そ、そうじゃなくて……！
……ほら、お菓子を食べて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hold on there! H-Here! Have some
sweets!

fields.JP:
おかしだ！
すごくおいしいやつ……！

fields.EN:
(I need to do something about her
Corruption...)
fields.JP: （穢れの方もなんとかしないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to do something about her
Corruption...)

fields.EN:
Here, Rapunzel... Come and lick my
blood...
fields.JP:
ほら、ラプンツェル。
僕の血も舐めて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, Rapunzel... Come and lick my
blood...

fields.JP:
うん！
なめるーーーーー！
……じゃっく、すごくおいしいよ

fields.EN:
O-Only lick! You can't eat me, you
hear?!
fields.JP:
ち、血を舐めるだけだからね！
僕のことは食べちゃだめだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Only lick! You can't eat me, you
hear?!

fields.EN:
If Jack say no, then not eat
Jack...
fields.JP:
……じゃっくがだめなら、
じゃっくたべない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Jack say no, then not eat
Jack...

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness... It looks like
Rapunzel's calmed down...)
fields.JP:
（よかった……
　ラプンツェル、落ち着いたみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness... It looks like
Rapunzel's calmed down...)

fields.EN: Do you want some more sweets?
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you want some more sweets?

fields.EN:
(Look at how cute she is, with the
crumbs around her mouth...)
fields.JP:
（口をお菓子だらけにして、
　可愛いなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at how cute she is, with the
crumbs around her mouth...)

fields.EN:
(Though I have to admit, it's
pretty sad that I have to rely on
the sweets to make her listen...)
fields.JP:
（お菓子で言うこと聞かせてるのが、
　我ながら情けないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Though I have to admit, it's
pretty sad that I have to rely on
the sweets to make her listen...)

fields.JP: おいしーーーーーーー！

fields.EN: Nope, I don't have any more.
fields.LOCALIZED: Nope, I don't have any more.

fields.JP: じゃっくたべるの、だめなんだよね！

fields.EN:
That's right. Glad you remembered
that... Haha...
fields.JP:
……そうだよ。
よく覚えたね……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Glad you remembered
that... Haha...

fields.JP: じゃっく、これ、いらない

fields.EN:
Come to think of it... Rapunzel,
what happened to the door? It's
splintered all over...
fields.JP:
そういえば……
ラプンツェル、ドアはどうしたの？
結構傷んでたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it... Rapunzel,
what happened to the door? It's
splintered all over...

fields.JP: んーーーーーーーーー？

fields.EN:
Don't tell me... Did you try to
eat the door?
fields.JP:
……もしかして、
ドアを食べようとした……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me... Did you try to
eat the door?

fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、
どあなんてたべないよ！

fields.EN:
(Well, that's a relief... Guess I
jumped the gun there...)
fields.JP:
（ほっ……。
　なんだ、僕の早とちりか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, that's a relief... Guess I
jumped the gun there...)

fields.JP: どあ、おいしくなかったから！

fields.EN:
I knew it! Even if the door tasted
good, you're not supposed to eat
it!
fields.JP:
やっぱり！
ドアは美味しくても食べちゃだめ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it! Even if the door tasted
good, you're not supposed to eat
it!

fields.EN:
The door isn't food, so I'm going
to have Haru-san fix it, okay?
fields.JP:
ドアは食べ物じゃないから、
ハルさんに直してもらおうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The door isn't food, so I'm going
to have Haru fix it, okay?

fields.JP: はるはる、どあなおせるの？

fields.EN:
That's right. Haru-san, Alice, the
Professor, and everyone has an
important role, so don't eat them.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。ハルさんもアリスも博士も、
みんな大事な役目があるから、
食べちゃだめだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Haru, Alice, the
Professor, and everyone has an
important role, so don't eat them.

fields.EN: But... I can't eat you yet...
fields.LOCALIZED: But... I can't eat you yet...

fields.EN:
I-I guess that would work for
now...
fields.JP:
ま、まあいっか……
今はそれでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I guess that would work for
now...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel? You're just like
everyone else. You're a member of
the Dawn now.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも、みんなとおなじ、
黎明の仲間になったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel? You're just like
everyone else. You're a member of
the Dawn now.

fields.EN:
Of course! And, you're not
supposed to eat your fellow
members and friends, okay?
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ！
仲間は食べちゃだめなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! And, you're not
supposed to eat your fellow
members and friends, okay?

fields.EN: (I sure hope she does get it...)
fields.LOCALIZED: (I sure hope she does get it...)

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、おはよう……

fields.EN:
A yellow hairball...? Oh, yeah...
It's Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
……黄色い毛玉……？
あ、ラプンツェルか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A yellow hairball...? Oh, yeah...
It's Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Wake up, Rapunzel. I came for you.
We need to go and meet with
everyone.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、起きて。
もうみんな集まってるから、呼びに来たよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wake up, Rapunzel. I came for you.
We need to go and meet with
everyone.

fields.EN:
Wha-?! You're naked?! Where are
your clothes, Rapunzel?!
fields.JP:
……って、裸……！？
ラプンツェル、服はどうしたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! You're naked?! Where are
your clothes, Rapunzel?!

fields.EN: Hair is warm so no need clothes.
fields.JP:
かみのけ、あったかいから、
ふくいらないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hair is warm so no need clothes.

fields.EN:
But you live with other people
now, so you'll need to put your
clothes on, Rapunzel!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはみんなで住んでるから、
着ないとだめだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you live with other people
now, so you'll need to put your
clothes on, Rapunzel!

fields.JP: えーーーーーーーーー？

まったくもう……。
……えっと、ラプンツェルの服は……

fields.EN:
Here they are! Go ahead and put on
your clothes, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
……あった！
ほら、ラプンツェル、服を着て
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here they are! Go ahead and put on
your clothes, Rapunzel.

fields.EN: Wha-?! No! I-I'm a guy, you know?
fields.JP:
ええっ！？
僕はだめだよ！
こ、これでも、男だし……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha-?! No! I-I'm a guy, you know?

fields.EN:
(All I have to do is look away...
Don't look... Don't look...)
fields.JP:
（目を逸らして……。
　見ないように……見ないように……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All I have to do is look away...
Don't look... Don't look...)

fields.JP:
きゃはははっ！
じゃっくの手、あったかいね……！

fields.EN:
S-Sorry! D-Did I touch--?! B-But,
I'm not looking, okay?!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……！
へんなとこさわったかも！？
……で、でも、見てないからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry! D-Did I touch--?! B-But,
I'm not looking, okay?!

fields.EN:
(I have to hurry before someone
sees me...!)
fields.JP:
（はやくしないと、
　誰かにこんなところ見られたら……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to hurry before someone
sees me...!)

fields.EN:
Good! You look much better like
that! Now then, let's comb your
hair.
fields.JP:
うん！
その方がずっといいよ……！
じゃあ髪の毛もとかしちゃおうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good! You look much better like
that! Now then, let's comb your
hair.

fields.EN:
(What a relief! It's a good thing
no one saw that...)
fields.JP:
（よかった……！
　誰にも見られなくて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a relief! It's a good thing
no one saw that...)

fields.EN:
Wh-What?! Why are you grabbing
me...?
fields.JP:
……な、なに、どうしたの？
急にしがみついてきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What?! Why are you grabbing
me...?

fields.JP: ううーーーじゃっくーーー

んんっ……？
じゃっくもこどもがほしいんだね！

fields.EN:
Huh?! Um, sure babies are cute,
but...
fields.JP: えっ！？　確かに子供は可愛いけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Um, sure babies are cute,
but...

fields.EN:
W-Well, I'm not old enough to
think about that yet, but once I
grow up and escape from here...
fields.JP:
そ、そうだなあ……
まだそこまでは考えてないけど、
脱獄して、大きくなったら、いつか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I'm not old enough to
think about that yet, but once I
grow up and escape from here...

fields.EN:
Jack's heartbeat fast. Rapunzel,
too! I want babies!
fields.JP:
じゃっく、どきどきしてるよ。
ラプンツェルもこどもほしいと、
どきどきするんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's heartbeat fast. Rapunzel,
too! I want babies!

fields.EN:
(Huh?! Wait... She's talking about
in the future, right?!)
fields.JP:
（えっ！？
　将来の夢、とかじゃなくて！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh?! Wait... She's talking about
in the future, right?!)

fields.EN:
W-Wait up! My heart's beating fast
because I didn't want anyone to
see me put your clothes on!
fields.JP:
ち、違うよ……！
ドキドキしてるのは、服着せてるとこを誰かに
見られたらどうしようってだけで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait up! My heart's beating fast
because I didn't want anyone to
see me put your clothes on!

fields.EN:
Jack wants to make babies when
heart beats, right?
fields.JP:
でも、じゃっくも、
どきどきするとこどもつくりたくなるよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack wants to make babies when
heart beats, right?

fields.JP: ……ほら、どきどきがおおきくなったよ！

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel is still so young and there
are so many things she doesn't know...
So why does she want a child?! )
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェル、まだ小さいっていうか、
　知らないことばっかりなのに、
　何で子供が欲しいなんて……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is Rapunzel wanting babies
when she's like a huge baby
herself?!)

fields.JP:
あっ！
アリス、赤ずきんさん、親指姫も……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Alice, Red Riding Hood, and
Thumbelina...?!

fields.EN:
You two were taking forever, so we
came to get you two.
fields.JP:
いつまでたっても来ないから、
見に来ちゃったわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You two were taking forever, so we
came to get you two.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Seems like Rapu's
really attached to you now!
fields.JP:
はははっ！
随分とラプに懐かれたなあ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Seems like Rappy's
really attached to you now!

fields.EN: Rapunzel put clothes on with Jack.
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、じゃっくとふくきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel put clothes on with Jack.

fields.EN:
And then Jack's heart beat was
fast!
fields.JP:
……そしたら、
じゃっくのしんぞうがどきどきした！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And then Jack's heart beat was
fast!

fields.EN:
Um... You're making it sound
like...
fields.JP:
な、なんか、
誤解を生む言い方してない……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You're making it sound
like...

fields.EN:
Jack... She's a child... Don't
tell me you...?
fields.JP:
……ジャック。
あなた、子供にまさか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... She's a child... Don't
tell me you...?

fields.EN:
I don't support that kind of
thing, you know...
fields.JP:
あたしはあんまり感心しないなー、
そーいうの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't support that kind of
thing, you know...

fields.EN:
Y-You have it all wrong! I was
trying not to look, and...!
fields.JP:
ち、違うよ！
僕は、見ないようにって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You have it all wrong! I was
trying not to look, and...!

fields.EN:
Jack! Let's make babies together
next time!
fields.JP:
じゃっく、
こんどはいっしょに、こどもつくろうね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Let's make babies together
next time!

fields.EN:
Ah, wait! Wh-What do you mean by
babies...?!
fields.JP:
あ、まって……！
子供ってどういうこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, wait! Wh-What do you mean by
babies...?!

fields.JP: 僕は何もしてないってばーー！
みこしってるーーーーー？
何かしら？　ラプンツェル

fields.EN:
(It's Rapunzel and Miko-san... I
wonder what they're talking
about...)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルと視子さんだ。
　何を話してるんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's Rapunzel and Miko... I
wonder what they're talking
about...)

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、こどもうみたいんだ
……こども、どうやってつくるの？

fields.EN:
(What in the world is Rapunzel
saying?!)
fields.JP: （ラプンツェル、なんてことを……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What in the world is Rapunzel
saying?!)

fields.EN:
Why, if it isn't Jack. What are
you squatting there for?
fields.JP:
あら、ジャック。
そんなところに座り込んだりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, if it isn't Jack. What are
you squatting there for?

fields.EN: Miko! How do you make babies?
fields.JP:
みこ！
こども、どうやってつくるのーー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Miko! How do you make babies?

fields.EN:
When you're grown up, someone who
can teach you will appear. That
person will be your fated one...
fields.JP:
……大人になったら、ラプンツェルに
教えてくれる人が現れるわ。
それは運命の人なのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
One day when you're older, you
might meet a person who'll end up
being your special someone...

fields.JP: ううーーーーーーーー

fields.EN:
Hey, hey! Jack! Jack knows how to
make babies, right?
fields.JP:
ねえねえ！　じゃっく！
じゃっくは、こどものうみかたしってるよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, hey! Jack! Jack knows how to
make babies, right?

fields.EN:
Jack wants babies, too! We can
make babies together!
fields.JP:
じゃっくもこどもほしいんだもんね！
いっしょにつくろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack wants babies, too! We can
make babies together!

fields.EN:
If you don't know, it just means
it's still too early for you,
Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
……ま、まだ知らないってことは、
ラプンツェルにはまだ早いってことだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't know, it just means
it's still too early for you,
Rapunzel.

fields.JP: じゃっく、ほんとはしってる！

fields.EN: Rapunzel! Don't kick me like that!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル……！
いきなり蹴らないで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel! Don't kick me like that!

fields.EN:
Oh, my... If you want to find the
right person, you're going to need
to grow up first, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
あらあら……。
ラプンツェルはまず、大人にならないとね。
運命の人と会いたかったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, my... If you want to find the
right person, you're going to need
to grow up first, Rapunzel.

fields.EN: I can make babies if I grow up?
fields.JP: おとなになったら、こどもできるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: I can make babies if I grow up?

fields.JP: おとなになるの、どうするの！？

fields.EN:
First, stop kicking or hitting your
friends. Then learn to eat neatly
and wear your clothes properly...
fields.JP:
まず、友達を蹴ったりぶったりしないことね。
それから、綺麗にごはんを食べて
きちんと服を着て……
fields.LOCALIZED:
First, don't kick your friends.
Next, eat all your food and wear
your clothes.

fields.EN:
Your hair would look better tidied up
too. Trim it to your back and keep it
neat... You'd be even prettier than now.
fields.JP:
髪の毛もスッキリした方がいいわね。
背中まで切って、綺麗にまとめて……。
今よりもっと美人になるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should do something about your
hair, too. Maybe cut it shoulder-
length. It'll look pretty.

fields.JP: ど、どうしたの？　ラプンツェル

かみのけ、きらない！
かみのけやだ！
ラプンツェル、落ち着いて……！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel go bye-bye! No one wants
Rapunzel no hair!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルいなくなっちゃうよおっ！
かみのけないと、
みんなラプンツェルいらないの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel go bye-bye! No one wants
Rapunzel no hair!

fields.JP: これが、この子の血式リビドーなのね……
こんな小さい子なのに……

fields.EN:
Rapunzel? No one is going to cut
your hair, so calm down.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、
髪の毛は切らないから、落ち着いて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel? No one is going to cut
your hair, so calm down.

fields.JP:
うえええん
かみのけやだあああ！

fields.EN:
(What do I do... She won't stop
crying...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What do I do... She won't stop
crying...)

fields.EN:
Jack tease me! Not telling how to
make babies!
fields.JP:
じゃっく、いじわるするもん……！
こどものうみかた、おしえてくれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack tease me! Not telling how to
make babies!

fields.EN:
O-Okay! I'll tell you! I won't cut
your hair, and I'll tell you how
to make babies!
fields.JP:
お、教えてあげるから……！
髪の毛も切らないし、子供の作り方も教える！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Okay! I'll tell you! I won't cut
your hair, and I'll tell you how
to make babies!

fields.JP:
う、うん……！
嘘はつかないよ！

fields.EN:
*sniff* *sniff* You teach me how
to make babies?
fields.JP:
ひっく……ひっく……
こどものうみかた、おしえてくれる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sniff* *sniff* You teach me how
to make babies?

fields.EN: When we get out of the Jail...
fields.JP: ……ジェイルから出られたらだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED: When we get out of the Jail...

fields.JP: （な、泣き止んでくれたみたいだ……！）

fields.EN: Promise, Jack! We go and escape!
fields.JP:
やくそくだよ、じゃっく！
だつごくしようね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Promise, Jack! We go and escape!

fields.EN: Then we can make babies together!
fields.JP: そしたら、いっしょにこどもつくろうね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then we can make babies together!

fields.EN: Wha-?! Th-That's not what I meant!
fields.JP:
ええっ！？
ぼ、僕は、そんなつもりじゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha-?! Th-That's not what I meant!

fields.EN:
That means Jack is
Rapunzel's fated person, right?!
fields.JP:
じゃっくがラプンツェルの
うんめいのひとってことだよね！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel gonna make babies with
Jack!
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、じゃっくとこどもつくるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel gonna make babies with
Jack!

fields.EN:
(W-Well, Rapunzel looks happy, so maybe
I should just leave it alone... It'll
probably only last for now anyway...)
fields.JP:
（……ま、まあ、ラプンツェルが嬉しそうだから
　何も言わないでおこうかな……。
　……今だけだろうし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's happy, so I guess I can
leave it at that... I'm sure
she'll forget about it later...)

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, are you around? I
brought you some sweets, so
let's...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、いるー？
お菓子を持ってきたから、一緒に食べ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, are you around? I
brought you some sweets, so
let's...

fields.JP: じゃっくがきたーーーーーー！

fields.EN: I got us some sweets...! Urgh!
fields.LOCALIZED: I got us some sweets...! Urgh!

fields.JP: いくよーーーーーーー！

fields.EN:
(L-Let go...! Can't... breathe!
I'm going... to die...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(L-Let go...! Can't... breathe!
I'm going... to die...!)

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness... Looks like I'm
still alive...)
fields.JP: （よかった……まだ生きてるみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness... Looks like I'm
still alive...)

fields.EN:
*cough* S-So why are we on the
roof?
fields.LOCALIZED:
*cough* S-So why are we on the
roof?

fields.EN:
Of course it is! *cough* I thought
I was going to die there!
fields.JP:
してるよ！　……げほっ
死ぬかと思ったよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course it is! *cough* I thought
I was going to die there!

fields.JP:
すきってことだね！
……じゃっく、すき？

fields.EN:
Jack likes Rapunzel? Wanna make
babies?
fields.JP:
じゃっく、ラプンツェルのことすき？
こどもつくりたい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack likes Rapunzel? Wanna make
babies?

fields.JP:
ま、まって……げほっ
……それ、どういうこと？

fields.EN:
Aka-Aka said that heart beating fast
means you like a person.
fields.JP:
あかあかが、
『ドキドキするのは、
　相手のことを好きってことだよ』だって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Reddy said that heart beating fast
means you like a person.

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san is just amused
because it's someone else's problem!!)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんは、
　他人事だと思って面白がって！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Unbelievable, Red Riding Hood!
I can't believe she said that!)

fields.EN:
Kaguya said that you make babies
with person you like.
fields.JP:
あとね、かぐやーが
『子は好きなおのこと作るのです～』
っていってたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya said that you make babies
with person you like.

fields.EN:
(In Kaguyahime's case, I bet she just
got tired and said that to shoo
her away...)
fields.JP:
（かぐや姫は、何度も聞かれて
　面倒臭くなったんだんだろうなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In Kaguya's case, I bet she just
got tired and said that to shoo
her away...)

fields.EN:
Let's make babies, Jack! We like
and both hearts beating faster!
fields.JP:
じゃっく、こどもつくろ！
すきってどきどきいってる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's make babies, Jack! We like
and both hearts beating faster!

fields.EN:
Um... My heart's beating quickly
because you dragged me around the
place, Rapunzel...
fields.JP:
……あのね、このドキドキは、
ラプンツェルが僕を引きずって
思いっきり走ったからだからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... My heart's beating quickly
because you dragged me around the
place, Rapunzel...

fields.EN:
Jack's heart beats fast last time
when Jack put clothes on
Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
じゃっく、このまえもどきどきしてたよ。
ラプンツェルにふくきせたとき……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's heart beats fast last time
when Jack put clothes on
Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
W-Well, that was because I was
anxious about whether someone was
going to see us...
fields.JP:
あ、あの時は、
誰か来たらどうしようって、緊張してたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, that was because I was
anxious about whether someone was
going to see us...

fields.JP:
じゃっくがラプンツェルすきなの、
だめなの……？

fields.EN: N-No! That's not what I meant!
fields.JP: ち、違うよ……そういう意味じゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: N-No! That's not what I meant!

fields.EN: Other side of like is not like...
fields.JP: ……すきのはんたいは、きらいなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Other side of like is not like...

fields.EN:
You've got this all wrong,
Rapunzel!
fields.JP: 違うんだってば、ラプンツェル……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've got this all wrong,
Rapunzel!

fields.JP:
（どうしよう……
　ラプンツェルに誤解されちゃった……）

fields.EN:
(I can't eat all these sweets I
brought for her alone...)
fields.JP:
（お菓子もいっぱい持ってきたのに、
　一人じゃ食べきれないよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't eat all these sweets I
brought for her alone...)

fields.JP:
（今日こそ、
　ラプンツェルに謝らなきゃなあ……）

fields.EN: I'm sorry about the last time...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry about the last time...

fields.EN:
(Maybe she'll feel better if I pat
her on the head...)
fields.JP:
（頭を撫でてみたら、
　機嫌直してくれるかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she'll feel better if I pat
her on the head...)

fields.EN:
I worded myself badly then. Come,
show me your face...
fields.JP:
僕だって、言い方が悪かったんだよ
ほら、顔を上げて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I worded myself badly then. Come,
show me your face...

fields.JP:
やだっ！
かみのけきらないで！

fields.EN:
Jack can not like Rapunzel, but
not cut my hair!
fields.JP:
じゃっくがラプンツェルきらいでも、
かみのけきらないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack can not like Rapunzel, but
not cut my hair!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry! I just wanted to pat
you on the head because your hair
is so pretty!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……！
……綺麗な髪の毛だから、
撫でたくなっただけなんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry! I just wanted to pat
you on the head because your hair
is so pretty!

fields.JP: （か、かえって驚かせちゃった……）

fields.EN:
Waaaah! I'm sorry, Jack! So not
cut my hair!
fields.JP:
わあああん！
じゃっく、ごめんなさい！
だからかみのけきらないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Waaaah! I'm sorry, Jack! So not
cut my hair!

fields.EN:
(She's so small in my arms... I
made such a small child cry...!)
fields.JP:
（……僕は、
　抱きしめるとこんなに小さな女の子を
　泣かせてしまったんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so small in my arms... I
made such a small child cry...!)

fields.EN:
Jack's heart beats fast, but not
like Rapunzel...
fields.JP:
じゃっく、どきどきしてるけど、
ラプンツェルのこときらい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's heart beats fast, but not
like Rapunzel...

fields.EN:
I want to apologize to Rapunzel, whom
I like, but I'm nervous because I don't
know if I can get it across properly.
fields.JP:
それは、好きなラプンツェルに謝りたいけど、
ちゃんと伝わるかわからなくて、
緊張してるからだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because I'm not sure I got
through to the Rapunzel I like.

fields.JP: じゃっく、ラプンツェルのこと、すきなの……？

fields.EN:
Of course. I like Alice,
Akazukin, Oyayubihime, Haru-san,
Miko-san... I like everyone!
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ。
アリスも赤ずきんも親指姫もハルさんも
視子さんも、僕はみんなが好きだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. Alice, Red Riding Hood,
Thumbelina, Haru, Miko... Everyone
likes you!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel likes Jack, too... Likes
Clara, Alice, Aka-Aka, everyone...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもじゃっくすき……
くららもありすもあかあかも、みんなすき……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel likes Jack, too... Likes
Clara, Alice, Reddy, everyone...

fields.EN:
Yes, there are plenty of likes out
there. I like my friends, and
you're one of them, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
うん。いろんな好きがあって、僕は仲間が好きで、
ラプンツェルも、その好きの中に入ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, there are plenty of likes out
there. I like my friends, and
you're one of them, Rapunzel.

fields.JP: じゃっく、ラプンツェルのこときらいじゃない！

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness... Looks like I
got through to her.)
fields.JP: （よかった。誤解が解けたみたいだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness... Looks like I
got through to her.)

fields.EN: Jack? Your heart still beats fast.
fields.JP: じゃっく、またどきどきしてるよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? Your heart still beats fast.

fields.EN:
That's because I feel relieved
after apologizing to you,
Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
これは、緊張が解けたドキドキ。
ラプンツェルに謝れたからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because I feel relieved
after apologizing to you,
Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Heart beats fast even if not for
like?
fields.JP: すき、じゃないのにどきどきするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heart beats fast even if not for
like?

fields.EN:
Yup. There are lots of reasons for
that. Of course, liking someone is
one of them.
fields.JP:
うん。
ドキドキには、いろんな理由があるんだよ。
もちろん、『好き』のドキドキもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. There are lots of reasons for
that. Of course, liking someone is
one of them.

fields.EN:
Say, Rapunzel. From now on, let's
look for all kinds of heartbeats together.
fields.JP:
ねえ、ラプンツェル。
これから色んなドキドキを二人で探していこうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Rapunzel? Why don't we look
for all sorts of likes together?

fields.EN:
Yup! I wanna have lots of
heartbeats with Jack!
fields.JP:
うん……！
じゃっくといっぱいどきどきしたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I wanna have lots of
heartbeats with Jack!

fields.EN: You made me a friend again...
fields.JP: なかなおりしてくれたから……
fields.LOCALIZED: You made me a friend again...

fields.EN:
It was my fault, so don't worry.
You just be yourself, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
僕も悪かったんだから、もう気にしないで。
ラプンツェルはラプンツェルらしくいてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was my fault, so don't worry.
You just be yourself, Rapunzel.

fields.JP:
うん……！
じゃっくがいうなら、そうする！

fields.EN:
Friends again, so Rapunzel gonna
make Jack wear clothes!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、なかなおりしたから、
ラプンツェルがじゃっくにふくきせるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends again, so Rapunzel gonna
make Jack wear clothes!

fields.EN: Whoa! D-Don't take my clothes off!
fields.JP:
うわあああ！
服を脱がさないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa! D-Don't take my clothes off!

fields.EN:
Why no? Jack put clothes on
Rapunzel, too.
fields.JP:
なんでー？
じゃっくも、
ラプンツェルにふくきせてくれたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why no? Jack put clothes on
Rapunzel, too.

fields.JP: そ、それは、ラプンツェルが……

fields.EN:
(...Because she wouldn't put her
clothes on. But, I better think on
it before I hurt her again...)
fields.JP:
（……そうしないと服を着ないって
　言ったからだけど、伝え方を
　気をつけないと、また傷つけるかも……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...Because she wouldn't put her
clothes on. But, I better think on
it before I hurt her again...)

fields.EN:
R-Rapunzel? Um... Can you put
clothes on me?
fields.JP:
ラ、ラプンツェル。
……僕に、服を着せてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Rapunzel? Um... Can you put
clothes on me?

fields.JP:
……うんっ！
じゃっくのふく、きせる！

fields.EN: Uh, but just this once, okay?
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, but just this once, okay?

fields.EN:
Hey... Your heart is beating
fast... How come?
fields.JP:
あれ、どきどきしてるよ？
なんでーーーーー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey... Your heart is beating
fast... How come?

fields.EN:
Embarrassed so your heart beats
fast? Why?
fields.JP:
はずかしいのどきどき、
なんでーーーーー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Embarrassed so your heart beats
fast? Why?

fields.EN:
You're a girl and I'm a guy,
that's why!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは女の子で、
僕は男だからっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a girl and I'm a guy,
that's why!

fields.JP:
わかんないや！
えーーーーーーーーい！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, please! Be a bit more
gentle! You're going to tear my
clothes!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、丁寧にお願い！
破れちゃうから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, please! Be a bit more
gentle! You're going to tear my
clothes!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh, heh! Jack and Rapunzel
get along!
fields.JP:
あははははっ！
じゃっくとラプンツェルは、
なかよしだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh, heh! Jack and Rapunzel
get along!

fields.EN: Rapunzel, do you want more sweets?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、
お菓子はもういらない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel, do you want more sweets?

fields.JP: じゃっくとおはなしする！

fields.EN:
Okay... What do you want to talk
about?
fields.JP: じゃあ……どんなお話する？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... What do you want to talk
about?

fields.EN:
Urrh... I'm sorry... Rapunzel
can't talk good...
fields.JP:
うー。ラプンツェル、
おはなしうまくなくてごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... I'm sorry... Rapunzel
can't talk good...

fields.JP:
えっ？
そんなことは……

fields.EN:
Rapunzel all alone, so never
talk...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、ずっとひとりだったから……
おはなし、しなかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel all alone, so never
talk...

fields.EN:
Just take your time and speak calmly. I'm not
good at talking either... That's why I often
end up making people misunderstand me...
fields.JP:
ゆっくり落ち着いて話せばいいよ。
僕も話は下手だし……。
……だからよく誤解させちゃうんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just say what you want to slowly.
I'm not great at it, either. Which
is why I get into trouble...

fields.EN:
I like listening to you talk,
Rapunzel. So I hope you can talk
a bit more with me.
fields.JP:
僕、ラプンツェルの話を聞くの好きだよ。
だからもっと聞きたいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like listening to you talk,
Rapunzel. So I hope you can talk
a bit more with me.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel likes Jack's talks! Likes
talking with Jack!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも、じゃっくのはなし、すき！
じゃっくとはなすの、すき……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel likes Jack's talks! Likes
talking with Jack!

fields.EN:
Um, what did you do for fun when
you were alone, Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
……あのさ。ラプンツェルは、
一人の時はどんなふうに遊んでいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, what did you do for fun when
you were alone, Rapunzel?

fields.EN: Fun? You mean like Jack and Clara?
fields.JP: あそぶって、じゃっくやくららみたいに？
fields.LOCALIZED: Fun? You mean like Jack and Clara?

fields.EN: I used to play with dead Marchens.
fields.JP: メルヒェンのしたいとあそんでたよ

fields.EN:
Sorry. I think I asked the wrong
question... You were alone, after
all...
fields.JP:
ごめんね、変なこと聞いたかも……
ラプンツェルはずっと一人だったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. I think I asked the wrong
question... You were alone, after
all...

fields.EN:
No, okay! Fun to play with dead
Marchens!
fields.JP:
ううん！
メルヒェンしぬと、おもしろかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, okay! Fun to play with dead
Marchens!

fields.EN:
But more fun playing with everyone
in Dawn!
fields.JP:
でも、あそぶのは、
れいめいのみんなのほうがたのしい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But more fun playing with everyone
in Dawn!

fields.EN:
Are you happy you came here,
Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
……ラプンツェルは、
ここにきてよかったと思ってる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you happy you came here,
Rapunzel?

fields.JP:
うんっ！
ごはんもおかしもおいしいから。
……それにね……

fields.EN:
Very excited to talk and play with
everyone! But not the same as
heart beat fast!
fields.JP:
みんなとおはなしして、あそぶの、
わくわくするんだ……！
どきどきじゃなくて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very excited to talk and play with
everyone! But not the same as
heart beat fast!

fields.EN:
I see... Well, it's exciting
listening to your stories too,
Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
そっかあ……。
僕も今、ラプンツェルの話をきいて
わくわくしてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Well, it's exciting
listening to your stories too,
Rapunzel.

fields.EN: Rapunzel and Jack are the same!
fields.JP: ラプンツェルとじゃっく、おんなじだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel and Jack are the same!

fields.JP:
……だつごくしたら、
みんなどうなるのかなあ……
……ラプンツェル、またひとりになるのかな

fields.EN:
But, you'll be escaping with
everyone else, too...
fields.JP: みんなで脱獄するのに、なんで……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you'll be escaping with
everyone else, too...

fields.EN:
But, no one wants to be with
Rapunzel...
fields.JP:
だって、みんな、ラプンツェルと
いっしょにいるのいやだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, no one wants to be with
Rapunzel...

fields.JP:
えっ？
そんなこと誰も思ってないよ……！

fields.EN:
But Rapunzel keeps doing
trouble... Jack always worry...
fields.JP:
……ラプンツェル、
いつもみんなにめいわくかけてるのに？
じゃっくも、いつもこまってるもん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Rapunzel keeps doing
trouble... Jack always worry...

fields.EN:
(It looks like Rapunzel's paying
attention a lot more than before.
I guess she's maturing every day.)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェル、
　そんなこと考えるようになってたんだ……。
　少しずつ大人になってるんだなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like Rapunzel's paying
attention a lot more than before.
I guess she's maturing every day.)

fields.EN:
Listen, Rapunzel. I cause trouble for
you too, don't I? And sometimes you get
confused by things everyone says, right?
fields.JP:
……あのね、ラプンツェル
僕もラプンツェルを困らせることあるよね。
みんなが言うことに、戸惑うこともあるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Rapunzel? I worry you too,
right? And sometimes what everyone
says confuses me, too.

fields.JP:
うーーーーーー……
……たまに……
なんでかわかんないことある……

fields.EN:
Right? Causing trouble and helping
go hand-in-hand. That's what it
means to be together.
fields.JP:
だよね？　お互いに迷惑をかけるのが、
助け合うってことなんだよ。
それが、一緒にいるってことなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? Causing trouble and helping
go hand-in-hand. That's what it
means to be together.

fields.EN:
Being together means causing
trouble all the time?
fields.JP:
いっしょにいると
ずっとめいわくかけるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Being together means causing
trouble all the time?

fields.EN:
It doesn't bother anyone, and
everyone likes you, which is why
everyone wants to be with you.
fields.JP:
それが嫌じゃないから、
ラプンツェルのことが好きだから、
みんなラプンツェルと一緒にいるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't bother anyone, and
everyone likes you, which is why
everyone wants to be with you.

fields.EN: Jack is okay being with Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
じゃっくはラプンツェルといっしょにいるの、
いやじゃないの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack is okay being with Rapunzel?

fields.EN:
Yeah. I don't mind being with
you. Everyone else feels the same way...
fields.JP:
うん。嫌じゃないよ。
みんなだって、そう思ってるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... I like you, and so does
everyone else...

fields.EN:
I wish Rapunzel can be with
everyone...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、
ずっとみんなといっしょがいいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wish Rapunzel can be with
everyone...

fields.EN:
I want to be with you too when we
escape, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
僕も、脱獄しても、
ずっとラプンツェルと一緒にいたいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to be with you too when we
escape, Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel... is gonna be with you
forever, Jack!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも……。
ずっといっしょにいようね、じゃっく！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel... is gonna be with you
forever, Jack!

fields.EN:
Thanks, and... I'm sure we'll all
get along!
fields.JP:
ありがとう！
これからもよろしくね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, and... I'm sure we'll all
get along!

fields.EN:
I dunno why, but... Heart beats
fast with Jack... But not the same
fast as fun playing...
fields.JP:
なんでだろう……
じゃっくにわくわくじゃなくてどきどきする……
しらないどきどきだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I dunno why, but... Heart beats
fast with Jack... But not the same
fast as fun playing...

fields.JP:
なんでもないよ！
……じゃっく、あそぼー！

fields.EN:
Okay! I promised yesterday that
we'd play on the roof, so let's
go!
fields.JP:
いいよ！
屋上で遊ぼうって、昨日約束してたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! I promised yesterday that
we'd play on the roof, so let's
go!

fields.EN:
How come? Not the same fast,
but... I don't wanna ask Jack...
fields.JP:
……なんでかなあ……
しらないどきどきなのに、じゃっくに、
なんのどきどきなのか、ききたくない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How come? Not the same fast,
but... I don't wanna ask Jack...

fields.JP: ねむねむ、いいにおいする……

fields.EN:
Smells like marshmallows!
Rapunzel likes marshmallows!
fields.JP:
ましゅまろのにおいだ！
ラプンツェル、ましゅまろすき！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Smells like marshmallows!
Rapunzel likes marshmallows!

fields.EN:
You're saying that because of how
she feels, aren't you?
fields.JP:
……それはどっちかっていうと、
感触じゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're saying that because of how
she feels, aren't you?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Well, she is attached
to Nemurihime... To her
breasts in particular...
fields.JP:
あはは。
しっかり抱きついてるもんなあ……
……眠り姫の胸に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Well, she is attached
to Sleeping Beauty... To her
breasts in particular...

fields.JP: あーーーーーーーーん

もぐもぐ……
もぐもぐ……

fields.EN:
What kind of sweets does Nemu-Nemu
like? Dawn's sweets all so tasty!
fields.JP:
ねむねむはどんなおかしがすき？
れいめいのおかし、ぜんぶおいしいね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What kind of sweets does Sleepy
like? Dawn's sweets all so tasty!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel found a flower just like
Nemu-Nemu!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、このまえ、
ねむねむみたいなおはなをみつけたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel found a flower just like
Sleepy!

fields.EN:
It had two big, round petals!
White and jiggly!
fields.JP:
おおきなまるいはなびらがふたつあったの！
しろくて、ふるふるってふるえてた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It had two big, round petals!
White and jiggly!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's about the only one who
can get away with saying that...
fields.JP: ……ラプンツェルだから許される会話ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's about the only one who
can get away with saying that...

fields.EN:
Yup... Don't think anyone else
would be able to...
fields.JP: 他の奴じゃ、ちょっとこれはできないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... Don't think anyone else
would be able to...

fields.JP: ねむねむねむねむねむ！
これ、会話って言えるの……？

fields.EN:
As long as they understand each
other...
fields.JP: 通じ合ってるからいいんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as they understand each
other...

fields.EN:
I suppose so... I haven't heard
Nemu talk this much before.
fields.JP:
確かに通じ合ってるわよね。
ネムもいつもより喋ってるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose so... I haven't heard
Sleepy talk this much before.

fields.EN:
Well, guess Nemu tamed the
wild...
fields.JP: 野生児が、ネムにはよく懐いてるなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, guess Sleepy tamed the
wild...

fields.EN:
Tamed... That's a pretty accurate
term...
fields.JP: まあ、懐いてるって表現がぴったりよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tamed... That's a pretty accurate
term...

fields.EN:
Speaking of, I heard that Jack
isn't her master or anything. He's
Rapunzel's food...
fields.JP:
そういえば、ジャックは飼い主じゃなくて、
ラプンツェルの食料らしいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of, I heard that Jack
isn't her master or anything. He's
Rapunzel's food...

fields.JP: ああ、そんな感じするわよね……
あ、みんなここにいたんだ

fields.EN: What are you talking with Nemurihime about?
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、眠り姫とお話してるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking with Sleeping
Beauty about?

fields.JP: だめーーーーーーーー！

fields.EN:
Jack was pushed back by
Rapunzel?!
fields.JP: ジャックがラプンツェルに押しのけられた！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack was pushed back by
Rapunzel?!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's playing with Nemu-Nemu!
You go away, Jack!
fields.JP:
いまはラプンツェルがねむねむとあそぶの！
じゃっく、あっちいって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's playing with Sleepy!
You go away, Jack!

fields.EN: Guess Jack got in her way there...
fields.JP: ジャックが邪魔にされるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: Guess Jack got in her way there...

fields.JP: 可哀相に……ジャックのやつ……

fields.EN:
Um, you two are having fun seeing
what's happening, aren't you?
fields.JP: ……あのさ、二人とも面白がってるよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you two are having fun seeing
what's happening, aren't you?

fields.JP: あら？　そんなことないわよ？

fields.EN:
*sigh* Whatever... Guess I'll see
you all later...
fields.JP:
はあ……もういいよ……
それじゃあ、またね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Whatever... Guess I'll see
you all later...

fields.JP: ねむねむだーーいすきーーー

fields.EN:
(Look at the time... I'd better
get to sleep...)
fields.JP:
（……あ。もういい時間だ。
　早く寝ないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at the time... I'd better
get to sleep...)

fields.EN:
(I couldn't read books until I came
here, so I ended up staying up late...)
fields.JP:
（本なんて、ここに来るまで読めなかったから、
　つい夜更かししちゃったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't read books since I got
here, so I think I may have been
reading a bit too much...)

fields.EN:
(Well, at least I should be...
able to sleep... easily now...)
fields.JP: （でも……すぐに寝られそう……かな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, at least I should be...
able to sleep... easily now...)

fields.EN:
Why are you here this late? You
have go and sleep in your room.
fields.JP:
……こんな時間にどうしたの？
駄目だよ、自分の部屋で寝なきゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you here this late? You
have go and sleep in your room.

fields.JP: んーーじゃっくとねる……

fields.EN:
I dunno... But, don't want to be
alone...
fields.JP:
わかんない……
……でも、ひとりやだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I dunno... But, don't want to be
alone...

fields.EN: I see... Only for tonight, okay?
fields.JP:
……そっか。
じゃあ、今日だけだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... Only for tonight, okay?

fields.EN:
(I guess she had a bad dream...
Well, she is still a kid...)
fields.JP:
（……やっぱり、怖い夢でも見たのかな？
　ま……まあ、まだ子供だし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess she had a bad dream...
Well, she is still a kid...)

fields.JP: ええと……これで眠れそう……？

fields.EN:
Mmm... Weird... Rapunzel was
always alone...
fields.JP:
……んー。
ラプンツェル、ずっとひとりだったのに
なんでかなあ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Weird... Rapunzel was
always alone...

fields.EN:
Maybe it's because you're slowly
growing into an adult.
fields.JP:
……それは、ラプンツェルが少しずつ、
大人に近付いてるんじゃないのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's because you're slowly
growing into an adult.

fields.EN:
I'm not an adult yet, but I think
they like to be with someone.
fields.JP:
僕もまだ大人じゃないけど、だから、
誰かと一緒にいるようになるんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not an adult yet, but I think
they like to be with someone.

fields.EN:
Mmm... It's good being with
Jack...
fields.JP:
んー……
じゃっくといっしょなのはいいね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... It's good being with
Jack...

fields.JP:
よかった……
……ラプンツェル、お休み

fields.EN:
(Heh... Look at her sleeping...
She looks like any other kid...)
fields.JP:
（ふふ、穏やかな寝顔に……
　こうしてると、普通の子供だなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Heh... Look at her sleeping...
She looks like any other kid...)

fields.JP: （ラプンツェル、まだ寂しいのかな……？）

fields.EN:
(I-I'll pretend to be
asleep... Pretend to be asleep...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to sleep... Time to
sleep...)

fields.JP: （痛っ……！　か、噛むのはやめて……！）

（……なんだろう？
　今度は抱きついてきた……）
……じゃっくといっしょ、うれしいな

（そうだ……！
　ラプンツェルは寂しいだけなんだ……！）

fields.EN:
Jack smells like what Rapunzel
likes...
fields.JP:
……じゃっくは、
ラプンツェルがすきなにおいがする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack smells like what Rapunzel
likes...

fields.EN:
Huh? Or, do I like Jack's smell?
Hm...
fields.JP:
……あれえ？
じゃっくのにおいだから、すきなのかなあ……
どっちだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Or, do I like Jack's smell?
Hm...

fields.JP:
……どっちでもいいや……
じゃっくの、おいしいにおい……
うう……ほとんど寝られなかった……

（……そういえば、
　ラプンツェル、いつ帰ったんだろう？）

fields.EN:
Wha--?! I got bite marks all over
me!
fields.JP: ああっ！　体中、歯形だらけだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha--?! I got bite marks all over
me!

fields.EN:
(What am I going to doing about
this...?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What am I going to doing about
this...?)

fields.JP: おおーーーーーーーーー！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel! Stop fooling around with
Kaguyahime's device! It's dangerous!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル！
かぐや姫の乗り物に触ったら危ないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel! Stop fooling around with
Kaguya's device! It's dangerous!

fields.EN:
Oh, but it isn't very dangerous.
All it does is float.
fields.JP:
あら、大したことないんじゃありませんこと？
浮いているだけですもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but it isn't very dangerous.
All it does is float.

fields.JP: おおーーーーーーーーー？

fields.EN: Kaguya, how does the thing you're riding move?
fields.JP:
かぐやののってるの、
どうやってうごくの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How does Kaguya's sitting thing
move?

fields.EN:
It's no use telling you. I'm the
only one who can move it.
fields.JP:
知っても無意味です～
わらわしか動かせませんし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use telling you. I'm the
only one who can move it.

fields.JP: どうやってうごかすのーーー？

fields.EN:
Ohohohoho! I suppose even you
can't resist Rapu-Rapu, Kaguya-san!
fields.JP:
をーっほほほほ！
さすがのかぐやさんも、
ラプラプには逆らえませんわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohohoho! I suppose not even
Kaguya can handle Rappy!

fields.JP:
困ります～
放っておいてほしいです～
ラプンツェル、もうそれくらいに……

fields.EN:
If she's that interested, why
don't you let her ride it?
fields.JP:
……いっそのこと、
乗せて差し上げたらいかがですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she's that interested, why
don't you let her ride it?

fields.EN:
Please don't ride it...! Please
get off...!
fields.JP:
乗らないでください～！
降りてください～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't ride it...! Please
get off...!

fields.JP:
おおっ！
なんかいっぱいある！
あちこち触らないでください～

わわっ！
たかくなった！
じゃーこんどは……えいっ！
ラプラプ、およしあそばせ！

きゃはははは！
えいっ！

危ない！
シンデレラ、伏せて！

fields.EN:
Th-This isn't good! We need to
stop Rapunzel...!
fields.JP:
た、大変だ！
ラプンツェルを止めなきゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-This isn't good! We need to
stop Rapunzel...!

fields.JP: これ、たのしーーーーー！

fields.EN:
Here she comes... If I can just
get on it...
fields.JP:
こっちに来るぞ……
なんとか飛び乗れば……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here she comes... If I can just
get on it...

fields.JP: じゃっくだーーーーー！
えーーーーーーーーーい！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel! Don't jump on my stomach
like that!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル……
いきなりお腹に乗らないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel! Don't jump on my stomach
like that!

fields.JP:
おおっ！
じゃっく、どきどきしてるよ

fields.EN:
It's because I was scared and
because I'm hurt!
fields.JP: 怖かったし、痛いからだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because I was scared and
because I'm hurt!

fields.EN:
Aaah... Look at all this mess... I
need to clean the place up!
fields.JP:
ああっ……あちこちこんなに……！
お片づけしなければいけませんわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaah... Look at all this mess... I
need to clean the place up!

fields.EN:
Urrh... My Bamboo One... I'm never
going to leave my room now...
fields.JP:
うう……わらわのバンブー一号……
もう部屋から出ません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... My Bamboo One... I'm never
going to leave my room now...

fields.JP:
……ん？　なんだこれ？
ほうきだ……
（ひょっとして、シンデレラのかな？）
あ、ごめん……ジャックだけど……

fields.EN: Oh, Jack-san... Please, come right in.
fields.JP:
まあ……ジャックさんでしたの。
どうぞ、お入りになって？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Jack... Please, come right in.

fields.JP: それで、一体何のご用ですの……

fields.EN:
Oh, so this is your broom, then. I
found it in the hallway.
fields.JP:
あ、やっぱりこのほうき、
シンデレラのなんだね。
廊下に置いてあったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so this is your broom, then. I
found it in the hallway.

fields.EN:
I-I-I can't believe what I've
done...! How embarrassing! I am so
sorry!
fields.JP:
わわわっ……わたくしとしたことが……
お恥ずかしいですわ！
申し訳ございませんですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I-I can't believe what I've
done...! How embarrassing! I am so
sorry!

fields.EN:
I... wanted to thank you for
protecting me from the Nightmare.
Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
この間は、その……
ナイトメアから守っていただきまして、
本当にありがとうございましたわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... wanted to thank you for
protecting me from the Nightmare.
Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
The pleasure's mine. Um, I hope we
can become better friends, too!
fields.JP:
ど、どういたしまして……
こちらこそ、改めてこれからもよろしく……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The pleasure's mine. Um, I hope we
can become better friends, too!

fields.EN:
By the way, those glass shoe
earrings look really good on you!
fields.JP:
そういえば、そのガラスの靴のイヤリング……
確かに、よく似合ってるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, those glass shoe
earrings look really good on you!

fields.JP: あ……ありがとうございますですわ……

fields.EN:
Oh! Speaking of which...
Is your anemia all right now?
fields.JP:
あっ！　そういえば……！
貧血はもう大丈夫ですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of...! Are you all right?
You used a great deal of your
blood, didn't you?

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh, yeah... I'm still a bit
dizzy, but I'm fine. Thanks.
fields.JP:
え？　ああ、うん……
まだちょっとフラフラするけど……
大丈夫だよ、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh, yeah... I'm still a bit
dizzy, but I'm fine. Thanks.

fields.EN:
I know what would help you now!
Eating liver and seaweed would be
good!
fields.JP:
わたくしが貧血の対処法を教えて差し上げますわ！
貧血にはレバーがいいんですのよ！
あと、ひじきもオススメですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know what would help you now!
Eating liver and seaweed would be
good!

fields.EN:
Also, be sure you loosen your
buttons and belt when you sleep
to improve your blood flow!
fields.JP:
あと、寝る時はシャツのボタンやベルトを
緩めるのを忘れてはなりませんわね。
血流を良くしないといけませんもの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, be sure you loosen your
buttons and belt when you sleep
to improve your blood flow!

fields.JP:
へ、へえ……そうなんだ。
ありがとう……

fields.EN:
(She seems to be familiar with
folk remedies. In a way, she looks
almost too graceful to know...)
fields.JP:
（や、やたら民間療法に詳しい……
　なんだか見た目のイメージと違うな……
　ぱっと見、かっこいい人なのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She seems to be familiar with
folk remedies. In a way, she looks
almost too graceful to know...)

fields.EN:
If you feel ill or tired, by all
means, please consult me! I know
quite a bit that would help!
fields.JP:
他にも体調面で困った事がありましたら、
何でもお聞きになってくださいまし！
わたくし、そういうのは詳しいんですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you feel ill or tired, by all
means, please consult me! I know
quite a bit that would help!

fields.EN:
(Given how earnest she is, she has
to be kind, too... right?)
fields.JP:
（でもこんなに一生懸命言ってくれてるんだ、
　きっと優しい人……なんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Given how earnest she is, she has
to be kind, too... right?)

fields.EN:
Hm? What's that on the ground? A...
hair ornament?
fields.JP:
ん？　また何か落ちてる。
これは……髪飾り……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What's that on the ground? A...
hair ornament?

fields.EN:
(I recall Cinderella having one on
like this...)
fields.JP:
（確か、シンデレラがこんなのを
　付けてたような……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I recall Cinderella having one on
like this...)

fields.EN:
(Guess she drops things pretty
often... It seems to conflict with
how put together she looks...)
fields.JP:
（案外よく物を落とすんだな……
　しっかりしてそうに見えるのに……)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess she drops things pretty
often... It seems to conflict with
how put together she looks...)

fields.EN:
Uh, yeah... Can I come in? In the
hallway I found a...
fields.JP:
あ、うん……入ってもいいかな？
実は廊下で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, yeah... Can I come in? In the
hallway I found a...

fields.EN:
Please don't open the door! I
don't want to see anyone right
now!
fields.JP:
……開けないでくださいまし！
誰とも会いたくないんですの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't open the door! I
don't want to see anyone right
now!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... It's just that I
found a hair ornament, and thought
that maybe it belonged to you.
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……
ただ、さっき廊下で髪飾りを拾ったから、
君のじゃないかと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... It's just that I
found a hair ornament, and thought
that maybe it belonged to you.

fields.EN:
How clumsy of me! I-I'm truly
sorry...!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんなさいまし……
わたくしったら……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How clumsy of me! I-I'm truly
sorry...!

fields.EN: Uh, okay... Um, so this is yours?
fields.JP: う、ううん……これ、君のだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, okay... Um, so this is yours?

fields.EN:
Ah... Yes... Thank goodness! I'm
so glad you found it!
fields.JP:
あ……ああ……よかった……！！
本当に……よかったですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Yes... Thank goodness! I'm
so glad you found it!

fields.JP: み、見つかってよかったね……？

fields.EN:
Thank you so very much, Jack-san. I
thought I had lost it
irrevocably...
fields.JP:
……ジャックさん、本当にありがとうございます。
わたくし……無くしてしまったのかと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you so very much, Jack. I
thought I had lost it
irrevocably...

fields.EN:
So, it must be pretty important to
you...
fields.JP: そんなに大事なものだったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it must be pretty important to
you...

fields.EN:
Th-That's not it... Well, it is
important, but...
fields.JP:
ち、違うんですの……
大事といえば、大事なのですけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's not it... Well, it is
important, but...

fields.EN:
I can't seem to explain it very
well, but... I've always been like
this...
fields.JP:
何故かは分からないのですけれど……
昔からわたくし……こうなんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't seem to explain it very
well, but... I've always been like
this...

fields.EN:
I get anxious the moment something
I wear goes missing... I begin
feeling unsightly and useless...
fields.JP:
自分が身に着けているものが一つでも欠けると、
どうしようもなく不安になって……
自分が醜い役立たずに思えてきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get anxious the moment something
I wear goes missing... I begin
feeling unsightly and useless...

fields.EN:
I know it's strange, too. After
all that trouble I've caused,
and now this... I'm very sorry...
fields.JP:
自分でも変だとは分かっているんですの。
この間も、それでご迷惑をおかけしたのに……
本当にすみませんですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's strange, too. After
all that trouble I've caused,
and now this... I'm very sorry...

fields.EN:
You don't need to apologize... You
remember how I told you that I
have a strange urge, too?
fields.JP:
そんな……謝ることなんてないよ。
僕にもあるって言ったよね。
そういう、自分でもよく分からない衝動が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to apologize... You
remember how I told you that I
have a strange urge, too?

fields.EN:
Everyone said they have something
like that, too.
fields.JP: みんなだって、そう言ってたしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone said they have something
like that, too.

fields.EN:
That's why I know how you feel.
But, I've never thought of you as
useless or unsightly.
fields.JP:
……だから、気持ちは分かるんだ。
でも……僕はいつだって、
シンデレラは役立たずでも、醜くもないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I know how you feel.
But, I've never thought of you as
useless or unsightly.

fields.EN:
So, I'm not sure how to word it,
but... I'm sure you're okay as-is!
fields.JP:
だからその……うまく言えないけれど。
大丈夫だよ、きっと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I'm not sure how to word it,
but... I'm sure you're okay as-is!

fields.JP: あ、ありがとうございます……

fields.EN:
Oh my, if it isn't Jack-san... What a
coincidence!
fields.JP:
あら。ジャックさん……
奇遇ですわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, if it isn't Jack... What a
coincidence!

fields.EN: Huh? What's that in your hand?
fields.JP:
あれ？
手に持ってるそれは……何？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What's that in your hand?

fields.EN:
Ah, this? These are some sweets I
picked up the last time. Something
called "cookies."
fields.JP:
ああ……これですの？
これはこの間手に入れたお菓子ですわ。
クッキー、というものらしいのですけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, this? These are some sweets I
picked up the last time. Something
called "cookies."

fields.EN:
Oh, cookies! I'm surprised you got
your hands on those!
fields.JP:
へー、クッキーかあ！
お菓子なんてよく手に入ったね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, cookies! I'm surprised you got
your hands on those!

fields.EN:
*giggle*... I'm surprised myself.
I wonder what they taste like.
fields.JP:
ふふ……わたくしもびっくりしましたのよ。
一体、どんな味がするのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... I'm surprised myself.
I wonder what they taste like.

fields.EN:
Heeeey! I know them! Cookies! So
good!
fields.JP:
あーーー！！
それしってるー！　くっきー！！
いいなーーー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heeeey! I know them! Cookies! So
good!

fields.EN:
Uh, Rapunzel? No. Those are
Cinderella's...
fields.JP:
あ、ラプンツェル。
ダメだよ、それはシンデレラの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, Rapunzel? No. Those are
Cinderella's...

fields.JP:
ラプラプ……
……これ、欲しいんですの？

うん！
ラプンツェル、おかしだいすきーー！

そうですの……
でしたら、差し上げましてよ！

やったーー！！
ありがとーー！！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Make sure to savor
them. They aren't easy to come by,
after all...
fields.JP:
うふふ……
ゆっくり味わって食べるんですのよ。
なかなか手に入らないんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Make sure to savor
them. They aren't easy to come by,
after all...

fields.EN:
Yup! See you, Cinderella! Jack!
Thanks!
fields.JP:
うんーー！
じゃあね、シンデレラ、じゃっく！
ありがとーー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! See you, Cinderella! Jack!
Thanks!

fields.EN:
*giggle*... Look at her so
happy... What innocence...
fields.JP:
ふふ……あんなにはしゃいで……
本当に、無邪気な方ですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... Look at her so
happy... What innocence...

fields.EN:
You're really okay with giving them
away?
fields.JP: シンデレラ、よかったの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're really okay with giving them
away?

fields.EN:
It's fine... Did you see how happy
she was? This was for the best.
fields.JP:
別にかまいませんわ……
あんなに喜んでいらっしゃるんですもの！
……これでよかったんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine... Did you see how happy
she was? This was for the best.

fields.EN:
You're so kind, always thinking
about others...
fields.JP:
シンデレラは、いつも皆の事考えていて……
優しいんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so kind, always thinking
about others...

fields.JP:
いいえ……
そんなんじゃありませんの……

fields.EN:
As you can see, I'm vain and
arrogant... So I have to at least
be this kind to other people...
fields.JP:
わたくしはご覧のとおり見栄っ張りですし、
高慢ちきですもの……
他の方には、このくらい優しくしないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may have noticed that I'm
quite self-involved, so it's only
proper that I treat others kindly.

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm so sorry... P-Please
forget what I just said!
fields.JP:
あ、すみませんですわ……
な、なんでもありませんの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm so sorry... P-Please
forget what I just said!

fields.JP: ……僕は、そんな事ないと思うけど……

fields.EN:
If you were thinking of making
someone happy, and you made them
happy, it's because you were kind!
fields.JP:
シンデレラはみんなが喜ぶ事を考えて、
本当にそれをやってるんだから……
ほんとに優しいんだと思うよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you were thinking of making
someone happy, and you made them
happy, it's because you were kind!

fields.EN:
Ah... S-Sorry if that sounded too
forceful...
fields.JP:
あ……ご、ごめん！
偉そうな事言っちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... S-Sorry if that sounded too
forceful...

fields.EN:
No... Thank you very much! You
are... quite unique, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
いえ……ありがとうございます……！
ジャックさんって、その……
不思議な方なんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... Thank you very much! You
are... quite unique, Jack.

fields.EN:
You listened to my thoughts, and
made me feel better ever so
quickly...
fields.JP:
わたくしの思い込みをきちんと聞いて下さって、
なのに、こんなに簡単に、そこから楽にして
下さるんですもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You listened to my thoughts, and
made me feel better ever so
quickly...

fields.EN:
You're the first I've met who has
been able to do that...
fields.JP: こんな方には、初めてお会いしましてよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the first I've met who has
been able to do that...

fields.EN:
Oh, I know! I'm sure I had it in
my pocket...
fields.JP:
あ、そうだ！
確か、ポケットの中に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I know! I'm sure I had it in
my pocket...

fields.EN:
Here it is! I actually got this
recently...
fields.JP:
……あった！
実は僕も、この間ちょうど手に入れたんだ。
これ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here it is! I actually got this
recently...

fields.EN:
Is that... a chocolate? Why, and
it's shaped like a flower, too...
How cute!
fields.JP:
これは……確か、チョコレートでしたかしら？
まあ……それも、お花みたいな形。
なんだか可愛らしいですわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that... a chocolate? Why, and
it's shaped like a flower, too...
How cute!

fields.EN: Yeah! Well... Will you accept it?
fields.JP:
うん……！
……これ、もらってくれないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! Well... Will you accept it?

fields.EN:
What...? B-But... are you sure?
It isn't very easy to come by...
fields.JP:
えっ……？
で、でも……い、いいんですの？
せっかく手に入ったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...? B-But... are you sure?
It isn't very easy to come by...

fields.EN:
I don't know... I just thought it
would suit you better than it would
me. That's why I want you to have it.
fields.JP:
なんていうか……僕よりも、
シンデレラの方が似合いそうだなと思って……
だから、もらってほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just thought it would be better
for you to have it... So, I want
you to have it, Cinderella.

fields.EN:
Th-Thank you very much! Jack-san...
I couldn't be happier!
fields.JP:
あ……ありがとうございます！
ジャックさん……！
嬉しいですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thank you very much! Jack...
I couldn't be happier!

fields.EN:
(Heh... I haven't seen Cinderella
this happy before...)
fields.JP:
（ふふ……
　こんなに素直に喜んでるシンデレラ、
　初めてみたな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Heh... I haven't seen Cinderella
this happy before...)

fields.EN:
Cinderella? It's me, Jack. Can I
come in?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、ジャックだけど……
入ってもいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella? It's me, Jack. Can I
come in?

fields.EN:
Ah, Jack-san! You've come! P-Please
wait a moment!
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……！
来てくださったんですのね！
……しょ、少々お待ちになって下さいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Jack! You've come! P-Please
wait a moment!

fields.EN:
Thank you for waiting. Please,
come in!
fields.JP:
お待たせいたしましたわ……
どうぞ、お入りになって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for waiting. Please,
come in!

fields.EN: Jack-san! Please take a look at this!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん！
これをご覧になってくださいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack! Please take a look at this!

fields.EN:
Wow...! That's such a beautiful
dress! Where'd you get that?
fields.JP:
わあ……！
綺麗なドレスだね！
一体どうしたの、それ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow...! That's such a beautiful
dress! Where'd you get that?

fields.EN:
I found it in town the other day. Jack-san,
I really wanted you to see it...
fields.JP:
この間、街に行った時に見つけたんですわ。
それでぜひ……
ジャックさんにも見て頂きたかったんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found it at the city. And... I
wanted you to see it.

fields.EN:
I see... I'm sure it'll look good
on you, Cinderella!
fields.JP:
そうなんだ……。
確かにシンデレラなら、すごく似合いそうだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I'm sure it'll look good
on you, Cinderella!

fields.EN:
*giggle*... I heard that everyone
used to wear clothing like this
back in the day, before the Jail!
fields.JP:
ふふ……ジェイルが無かった昔の時代は、
みんな、こんなお洋服を
着てらしたんですって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... I heard that everyone
used to wear clothing like this
back in the day, before the Jail!

fields.EN:
If I could wear such a beautiful
dress like this, I'm sure I'll...!
fields.JP:
わたくしも、こんな素敵な服さえ着ていれば、
もっと、もっと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I could wear such a beautiful
dress like this, I'm sure I'll...!

fields.EN:
(Is this another one of Cinderella's
compulsions...? She's already more than
beautiful enough just as she is...)
fields.JP:
（これも、シンデレラの強迫観念なのか……？
　別に今のままだって、十分綺麗なのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is this another one of
Cinderella's traits? She's already
beautiful as she is...)

fields.EN:
Next time... I'll try wearing this! And when I
do, Jack-san, I'd like you to...!
fields.JP:
今度……これを着てみますわね！
またその時は、ジャックさんに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next time, I'll try it on, so I'd
like you to...!

fields.JP:
……シンデレラ。
少し聞いてほしいんだけど……

fields.EN:
Oh? What is it? You look very
serious...
fields.JP:
あら……どうしましたの？
急に神妙な顔をして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? What is it? You look very
serious...

fields.EN:
That dress is beautiful, and I
think it would look great on you,
but...
fields.JP:
確かにそのドレスは綺麗だし、
シンデレラにもきっと似合うと思う。
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That dress is beautiful, and I
think it would look great on you,
but...

fields.EN:
You're already beautiful as you
are. No one could deny that.
fields.JP:
別に……着飾ったりなんかしなくても、
シンデレラは綺麗だよ。
それに、誰も認めてくれないなんて事もない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're already beautiful as you
are. No one could deny that.

fields.EN:
So, I don't think you need to do
this much... You're good just the
way you are.
fields.JP:
だから……その、そんなに無理したり、
しなくてもいいと思うんだ。
そのままの君で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I don't think you need to do
this much... You're good just the
way you are.

fields.EN:
What... What do you know? You
wouldn't know how I feel...
fields.JP:
貴方に……貴方に何がわかりますの？
わたくしの気持ちの、何が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What... What do you know? You
wouldn't know how I feel...

fields.EN:
Huh...? Sorry! I-I wasn't trying
to...
fields.JP:
え……ごめん……！
僕は、そんなつもりじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...? Sorry! I-I wasn't trying
to...

fields.EN:
And here I thought that you...
That you would understand me!
fields.JP:
貴方なら、貴方だけは……
理解してくださると思ってましたのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And here I thought that you...
That you would understand me!

fields.EN:
I think I've had enough... Please
leave!
fields.JP:
もういいですわ……
……少し、一人にしてくださいまし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I've had enough... Please
leave!

fields.EN:
(I thought I said it for her own
good, but it looks like I only
hurt her...)
fields.JP:
（良かれと思って言ったはずなのに……
　結局、傷つけてしまった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought I said it for her own
good, but it looks like I only
hurt her...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I worded it too strongly to
Cinderella... She looked so
sad...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり、この間……
　シンデレラに強く言いすぎたのかな……？
　シンデレラ、すごく悲しそうな顔してた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I worded it too strongly to
Cinderella... She looked so
sad...)

fields.EN:
(She must have been suffering all
this time. And then I come along
and push my feelings onto hers...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラだって、きっとずっと悩んでたんだ。
　それなのに僕は、自分の気持ちを押し付けて
　しまったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must have been suffering all
this time. And then I come along
and push my feelings onto hers...)

fields.JP:
きゃあっ！　メルヒェンよ！
メルヒェンが……！

め、メルヒェン！？
なんで、こんなところに！？
おい！　みんな逃げろ！

fields.EN:
Where the hell is the Dawn when
you need them?!
fields.JP: 黎明の連中は何やってんだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where the hell is the Dawn when
you need them?!

fields.EN:
(What should I do?! Can I take
care of this myself?!)
fields.JP:
（どうする……！？
　僕一人でなんとかなるのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What should I do?! Can I take
care of this myself?!)

fields.EN:
(No... I should get everyone to
safety first!)
fields.JP:
（いや、それよりも街の人達を早く
　避難させないと！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... I should get everyone to
safety first!)

fields.EN:
(For now, I have to get
out to the main street...!)
fields.JP: （とりあえず、表通りに出ないと……！）

fields.EN:
(Tch! I let my guard down! My
arm...! Wh-What should I do?! At
this rate...!)
fields.JP:
（くっ、油断した……！
　腕が……ど、どうする……！？
　このままじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Tch! I let my guard down! My
arm...! Wh-What should I do?! At
this rate...!)

fields.JP:
（くそっ……
　こ、こんなところで……！！）
メルヒェンが倒れたぞ！
あの女の子が倒してくれたの！

fields.EN:
A member of the Dawn?! Just in the
nick of time!
fields.JP: 黎明の人か！　ありがたい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A member of the Dawn?! Just in the
nick of time!

fields.EN:
That was close...! Jack-san, are you
all right?!
fields.JP:
危ないところでしたわ……！
ジャックさん、ご無事でして！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was close...! Jack, are you
all right?!

fields.JP:
う、うん……！
ありがとう、助かったよ……

fields.EN:
Jack-san...! Look at that gash on your
arm!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、貴方……！
腕を怪我しているじゃありませんの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...! Look at that gash on your
arm!

fields.EN:
It's okay... The cut isn't deep,
so...
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫だよ……
傷はそこまで深くないし、このくらい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay... The cut isn't deep,
so...

fields.JP: ……少しお待ちになってくださいまし……！

し、シンデレラ！？
そのドレスは！

……いいんですわ。
それより少しじっとしててくださいましね……！

fields.EN:
...There. As long as the bleeding stops,
it shouldn't become anything too serious...
fields.JP:
……これでよし、ですわ。
出血さえ止まれば、そこまで大事には
至りませんもの……
