fields.LOCALIZED:
That should do it... The bleeding
will subside, so it won't get any
worse.

fields.EN:
It's only temporary, but you
should be fine now.
fields.JP:
……応急処置ですけれど、
これで、ひとまずは安心ですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's only temporary, but you
should be fine now.

fields.EN:
Thank you... But... Wasn't that
dress important to you?
fields.JP:
ありがとう……
でもその服……大切なものだったんじゃ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you... But... Wasn't that
dress important to you?

fields.EN:
What are you saying?! Caring for
your wounds is more important!
fields.JP:
何を言ってますの！？
今は、貴方の手当ての方が大切でしてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying?! Caring for
your wounds is more important!

fields.EN:
It's not only your looks... Your
heart is beautiful, too...
fields.JP:
君は……見た目だけじゃなくて、
何よりも、心が綺麗なんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not only your looks... Your
heart is beautiful, too...

fields.EN:
What? Th-That came out of
nowhere...!
fields.JP:
えっ？
な、何を突然……仰いますの……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Th-That came out of
nowhere...!

fields.EN:
(Wh-What did I just say?! That was
embarrassing!)
fields.JP:
（な、何を言ってるんだ僕は……
　めちゃくちゃ恥ずかしいぞ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What did I just say?! That was
embarrassing!)

fields.EN:
Come to think of it... Why did you
have that dress with you?
fields.JP:
でも、そういえば……
何でシンデレラはあの服を持ってたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it... Why did you
have that dress with you?

fields.JP:
そ、それは、その……
試そうとしたんですの

fields.EN:
Jack-san, I've been thinking about what you
said to me the other day... and I realized
something.
fields.JP:
この間、ジャックさんがおっしゃった事……
わたくしなりに考えましたの。
それで……気付いたんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought about what you said to
me before, and then I realized...

fields.EN:
I realized that you really said that because
you were thinking of me, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
ジャックさんは、本当にわたくしのためを思って
ああ言ってくださったんだ、って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That you were saying it, thinking
about me...

fields.EN:
That's why I was testing myself to
see if I could let go of my dress.
If I could overcome myself...
fields.JP:
だから、自分を乗り越えようと……
服を本当に手放せるのか、
試そうとしていたんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I was testing myself to
see if I could let go of my dress.
If I could overcome myself...

fields.EN:
Cinderella... I'm sorry for
cornering you like that...
fields.JP:
シンデレラ……
そこまで思い詰めさせてしまって、ごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella... I'm sorry for
cornering you like that...

fields.EN:
No... this was fine. In the end,
something unexpected happened, so
we never found out the result...
fields.JP:
いえ……これでよかったんですのよ。
結局、思わぬ事になってしまったので、
結果は分からずじまいでしたけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... It's completely fine. There
was no telling what might have
happened...

fields.EN:
Everyone has a particular
attachment, so... you don't have
to force yourself away from it...
fields.JP:
こだわりは、僕たち誰もが持ってるものだし……
……だから、無理しなくてもいいと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone has a particular
attachment, so... you don't have
to force yourself away from it...

fields.JP:
ジャックさん……
確かに、そうかもしれませんわね……

fields.EN:
Whatever the case, I appreciate
what you said to me.
fields.JP:
それでもわたくし、やっぱり感謝してますのよ？
ですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever the case, I appreciate
what you said to me.

fields.EN:
Let's do our best together, one
step at a time... So, I hope we
can get along better.
fields.JP:
……お互い、ゆっくり、頑張っていこう？
改めて、これからも、よろしくね。
シンデレラ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's do our best together, one
step at a time... So, I hope we
can get along better.

fields.JP: ええ……わたくしこそ、ですわ……

fields.EN:
(Cinderella? What's she doing over
there? She looks really stressed
out...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラだ……どうしたんだろう？
　何だか思いつめてるみたいだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella? What's she doing over
there? She looks really stressed
out...)

fields.EN:
Well... I can't seem to hold back
the urge to become more
beautiful...
fields.JP:
実は、その……
また、綺麗になりたい衝動が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... I can't seem to hold back
the urge to become more
beautiful...

fields.EN:
(Looks like she's still suffering
over it... If only there was
something I could do for her...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり、まだ苦しめられてるんだな……
　僕に何か出来る事があればいいけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like she's still suffering
over it... If only there was
something I could do for her...)

fields.EN:
It just comes in spurts... But
I finally found out recently...
fields.JP:
……時々、発作のようにやってくるんですの。
でも……最近、気付いたことがありますのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just comes in spurts... But
I finally found out recently...

fields.EN:
That my desire to be more
beautiful was because I wanted to
show myself to someone...
fields.JP:
最近わたくしが思う、綺麗になりたいという
気持ちは……
誰かに、それを見せたいということなんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That my desire to be more
beautiful was because I wanted to
show myself to someone...

fields.EN:
S-So, I was just thinking about
that...
fields.JP:
だ、だからその……
その事についてずっと考えてましたの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So, I was just thinking about
that...

fields.EN:
Is there a specific "someone"
you're referring to?
fields.JP:
でも、じゃあその見せたい相手って……
一体誰なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a specific "someone"
you're referring to?

fields.EN:
(Huh? Did I ask her something
strange?)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　も、もしかして……
　変な事聞いちゃったかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Did I ask her something
strange?)

fields.EN:
Well... How can I word this...?
It's someone always close to me...
More like, in front of me...
fields.JP:
えっと……その……
……いつも近くにいるというか……
というか、目の前に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... How can I word this...?
It's someone always close to me...
More like, in front of me...

fields.EN:
(Why is she mumbling...? I can't
hear her voice with how softly
she's speaking...)
fields.JP:
（急に声が小さくなって……どうしたんだろ？
　よく聞こえないけど……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is she mumbling...? I can't
hear her voice with how softly
she's speaking...)

fields.JP:
ジャ……
ジャックさん、貴方ですわ……

fields.EN:
*cough* I-In any case! I will
strive to be ever more beautiful
both on the outside and inside!
fields.JP:
ごほん！　と、とにかく……！
わたくしはこれまで以上に！
心も見た目も誰よりも綺麗になりましてよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*cough* I-In any case! I will
strive to be ever more beautiful
both on the outside and inside!

fields.EN:
I-I see...! Okay! I'm rooting for
you!
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……！
うん、僕も応援してるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see...! Okay! I'm rooting for
you!

fields.EN:
*sigh* I can't believe how dim he
is...
fields.JP:
はあ……
いくらなんでも鈍感すぎますわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I can't believe how dim he
is...

fields.JP:
えっ？
今、何か言った？

fields.EN:
N-Nothing at all! You're hearing
things!
fields.JP:
な、なんでもありませんわ！
気のせいではありませんこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Nothing at all! You're hearing
things!

fields.EN:
(I-I don't really get what happened,
but... Cinderella looks so lively...!
I'm glad she seems more positive now...!)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだかよくわからないけど……
　シンデレラ、生き生きしてるな……！
　前向きになれたみたいでよかった……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not sure what happened, but
at least she's back to her old
self.)

fields.EN:
Wha-?! Wh-What's that sound?!
Where did it come from?!
fields.JP:
わっ！？　な、なんだ今の音は！？
ど、どこから！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Wh-What's that sound?!
Where did it come from?!

fields.JP:
これは……ラプンツェルの部屋からだ……！
一体、何があったんだ！？

ラプンツェル！？
一体、何を……

あはははーーー！！
かみのけくるくるーーー！！

fields.EN:
(C-Cinderella? What's she doing?
Are they roughhousing...?)
fields.JP:
（し、シンデレラ？
　な、何をやってるんだ！？
　まさか、何か乱暴なことを……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(C-Cinderella? What's she doing?
Are they roughhousing...?)

fields.JP: くるくるくるくるーーー！！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... My, my, Rapu-Rapu! Time
for payback! Pinchy, pinch!
fields.JP:
ふふふ……
もう、ラプラプったら……！
仕返しですわよ。ぷにぷにぷに！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... My, my, Rappy! Time
for payback! Pinchy, pinch!

fields.JP:
あははははは！！
ぷにぷにぷにぷにーー！！

fields.EN:
(Wh-What are they doing? It looks
like... they're both having fun.)
fields.JP:
（な、何やってるんだ……？
　どっちも、ものすごく楽しそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What are they doing? It looks
like... they're both having fun.)

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I must say, your skin is
so smooth, Rapu-Rapu... I'm quite jealous...
fields.JP:
ふふふ……それにしても、ラプラプのお肌は
本当につるっつるですのね……
うらやましいですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I must say, your skin
is so smooth... I'm quite jealous...

fields.EN:
You're smooth too, Cinderella!
See? Pinch, pinch, pinch!
fields.JP:
シンデレラだって、つるつるだよーー！！
ほらー。ぷにぷにぷにぷにーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella's smooth, too! See?
Pinch, pinch, pinch!

fields.EN:
Eep! That tickles...! Heh, heh...
Now you've done it! Pinch, pinch,
pinch!
fields.JP:
きゃっ！？　くすぐったい……
うふふ……やってくれましたわね！
ぷにぷにぷにぷに！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eep! That tickles...! Heh, heh...
Now you've done it! Pinch, pinch,
pinch!

fields.JP:
きゃははは！！
ぷにぷにぷにぷにーー！！

ふふふ……
ぷにぷにぷにぷにーー！！

fields.EN:
(They're really cute, but... I'll
just assume I didn't see this.
Better move before they see me...)
fields.JP:
（こ、これは……なんか微笑ましいけど、
　見なかった事にした方が良さそうだな……
　そっと退散しよう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're really cute, but... I'll
just assume I didn't see this.
Better move before they see me...)

fields.JP:
あ、じゃっくだ！！
じゃっくー！！

fields.EN:
Ah... Oh my... Jack-san! What are you
doing here?
fields.JP:
あ、あら、ジャックさん……！
一体何故こんなところに……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Oh my... Jack! What are you
doing here?

fields.JP: じゃっくもいっしょにぷにぷにやろー！！

fields.EN:
Huh?! N-No, I'm fine! I-I'll see
you both later!
fields.JP:
えっ！？
い、いや僕はいいよ！！
じゃ、じゃあまたね！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! N-No, I'm fine! I-I'll see
you both later!

fields.JP:
じゃっく、いっちゃった……
へんなのーー！！

fields.EN:
(They were having fun, but there's
no way I could've joined them...)
fields.JP:
（楽しそうだったけど、
　あれに混ざるのは……いくらなんでも、
　ハードルが高すぎるよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They were having fun, but there's
no way I could've joined them...)

fields.JP: ジャックさん、いらっしゃいまして？

あ、シンデレラ……！
どうしたの？

fields.EN:
Well... I wanted to show you
something!
fields.JP:
その……
実は、見て頂きたいものがあるんですの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... I wanted to show you
something!

fields.JP:
じゃーん！！
これですわ！

fields.EN: What is this...? It's shaped like a tube...
fields.JP:
これは……何？
筒みたいな形だけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's...! What is it...? It looks
like a bullet...

fields.JP:
ふふふ……
これは、『口紅』ですわ！

口紅……？
何に使うものなの？

fields.EN:
I'm... not sure. I heard it was
something called "cosmetics," used
by girls long ago.
fields.JP:
それが……わたくしにもわかりませんの。
昔の女性がしていたという、『お化粧』に
関係のあるものらしいんですけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... not sure. I heard it was
something called "cosmetics," used
by girls long ago.

fields.EN:
"Cosmetics?" Used by girls long
ago...? You sure know a lot...
fields.JP:
『おけしょう』？
へえ、昔の女の人が……
っていうか、よくそんなこと知ってるね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Cosmetics?" Used by girls long
ago...? You sure know a lot...

fields.EN:
(Now that I think about it, there
are a lot of things from long ago
I don't know about...)
fields.JP:
（昔は、僕たちの知らないものが
　たくさんあったんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that I think about it, there
are a lot of things from long ago
I don't know about...)

fields.EN:
It was in this old magazine.
Unfortunately, I couldn't read
much with how it's torn all over.
fields.JP:
この古雑誌に載ってましたの。
ところどころ破れていて、
詳しいことがわからないのが残念ですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was in this old magazine.
Unfortunately, I couldn't read
much with how it's torn all over.

fields.EN:
I see... So, why did you want to
show me that?
fields.JP:
そっか……
でも、何でまた、僕にこれを？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So, why did you want to
show me that?

fields.EN:
Actually... it seems "lipstick" is
something you have someone apply
to your lips with their finger!
fields.JP:
実は……『口紅』は、誰かに
『指で唇に塗ってもらう』ものらしいんですの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems as if this lipstick
needs to be applied to your lips
using your fingers.

fields.EN:
Fingers...? Lips...? Wait... Y-You
don't mean...?!
fields.JP:
指で……唇に……？
って、ええっ！？
ま、まさか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fingers...? Lips...? Wait... Y-You
don't mean...?!

fields.EN:
That's exactly it! I... I want you to put the
lipstick on me, Jack-san!
fields.JP:
そのまさか、ですわ！
わたくし……是非ジャックさんに、
口紅を塗って欲しいんですの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! I wanted you to... apply
the lipstick onto my lips!

fields.EN:
S-S-Something like that...!
You can't just spring that on me...!
fields.JP:
そそそ、そんな……！
急に言われても……！
いや、そ……そんな事はないけど……

fields.EN:
Well then, if you could!
Please...!
fields.JP:
……それでは、さっそく……
お願いいたしますわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, if you could!
Please...!

fields.EN:
(W-Why did she close her eyes?!
Well, not that having them open
would have been any better...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんで目を閉じるんだ……！？
　いや、開けられてても、
　それはそれで困るけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(W-Why did she close her eyes?!
Well, not that having them open
would have been any better...)

fields.EN:
O-Okay... I'm going to put it
on...
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Okay... I'm going to put it
on...

fields.EN:
It... It's fine! It's just that it
tickled... I'm fine!
fields.JP:
な、何でもありませんわ！
ただ、少しくすぐったくて……
でも、大丈夫ですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It... It's fine! It's just that it
tickled... I'm fine!

fields.JP:
そ、そっか……
じゃあ、続きを……
（な、なんかドキドキするんですけど……）

fields.EN:
(Cinderella's lips are so soft...
What am I thinking?! I need to
focus here...!)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラの唇……や、柔らかい……
　って、何考えてんだ僕は！
　ちゃんとやらないと……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella's lips are so soft...
What am I thinking?! I need to
focus here...!)

fields.EN: Really?! Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
本当でして！？
ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED: Really?! Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
Heh, well... I didn't do
anything...
fields.JP:
いや、そんな大げさな……
あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, well... I didn't do
anything...

fields.EN: S-So how is it? Does it look good?
fields.JP:
ど、どうですかしら……？
似合っていまして……？
fields.LOCALIZED: S-So how is it? Does it look good?

fields.EN:
(She looks beautiful... And a bit
more mature... So this is what
cosmetics do...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんか……
　いつもより大人っぽいというか……
　綺麗だなあ……これが、化粧か……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks beautiful... And a bit
more mature... So this is what
cosmetics do...)

fields.EN:
Uh... N-No! Nothing! You look
really great!
fields.JP:
え……い、いや、なんでもないよ！
よく、似合ってるよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... N-No! Nothing! You look
really great!

fields.EN:
Th-Thank you very much! I'm so
happy to hear that!
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとうございます……！
嬉しいですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thank you very much! I'm so
happy to hear that!

fields.EN:
These cosmetic things are really
something!
fields.JP: 化粧って、すごいんだね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
These cosmetic things are really
something!

fields.EN:
It seems that girls from back then
used to use these often. See? It
says so right here...
fields.JP:
昔の女性はみんな、していたらしいんですの。
ほら、この古雑誌にも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems that girls from back then
used to use these often. See? It
says so right here...

fields.EN: Hm? Let me see... Huh? It says...
fields.JP:
へえ、どれどれ……ん？
これって……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Let me see... Huh? It says...

fields.EN:
I guess you can put the lipstick
on yourself... The picture here
shows her using it herself...
fields.JP:
……く、口紅って……
別に人に塗ってもらわなくてもいいんだね……
この雑誌の中の人、自分で塗ってるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you can put the lipstick
on yourself... The picture here
shows her using it herself...

fields.EN:
Why, yes... And, it seems you
don't need to smear it on your
finger first...
fields.JP:
え、ええ……
しかも、別に指で塗らなくてもいい……
みたいですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes... And, it seems you
don't need to smear it on your
finger first...

fields.EN:
Um... Heh, heh! Guess we had that
all wrong...
fields.JP:
あ、あはは……！
早とちりしちゃったね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Heh, heh! Guess we had that
all wrong...

fields.JP:
そ、そうですわね……
ご、ごめんなさいまし……！

fields.EN:
(Now that I think about it, that
should've been obvious... But,
what an experience that was...)
fields.JP:
（そ、そりゃそうだよね、よく考えたら……
　それにしても、ドキドキしたなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that I think about it, that
should've been obvious... But,
what an experience that was...)

fields.EN:
(That's Cinderella, Shirayukihime,
and... Gretel? They all look so
serious...)
fields.JP:
（あれは……
　シンデレラに、白雪姫に……グレーテル？
　真剣な顔して、何話してるんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's Cinderella, Snow White,
and... Gretel? They all look so
serious...)

fields.EN:
Food contains something called
"calories," and it relates
strongly to fashion!
fields.JP:
……よろしくて？
食べ物には、カロリーというものがあって……
これがおしゃれとは密接な関係がありますのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Food contains something called
"calories," and it relates
strongly to fashion!

fields.JP: ふむふむ……なるほどです……！

fields.EN:
That's a bit vague. How do they
relate?
fields.JP:
……いまいちよく分からないわ。
どう関係しているのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a bit vague. How do they
relate?

fields.EN:
Well, if you consume too many
calories, you'll grow fat! The
horror!
fields.JP:
だって……カロリーを摂りすぎると、
太ってしまいますのよ……！
ああ、なんて恐ろしい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you consume too many
calories, you'll grow fat! The
horror!

fields.EN:
That really is scary! I'd better be
careful of what I eat!
fields.JP:
そ、それは恐ろしいですね……！
摂りすぎないようにしないと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That really is scary! I'd better be
careful of what I eat!

fields.EN:
That still doesn't make sense. How
does being fat relate to fashion?
fields.JP:
……やはり理解できないわね。
太るのと『おしゃれ』には、
何の関係があるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That still doesn't make sense. How
does being fat relate to fashion?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? You need to keep
your figure in order to enjoy
fashion!
fields.JP:
そんなの、決まってますわ。
おしゃれをしたいなら、
まずは体型が何よりも大事だからですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? You need to keep
your figure in order to enjoy
fashion!

fields.EN:
What?! I knew it... You're
right... Urrh... I need to lose
more weight...
fields.JP:
がーん……！
やっぱり、そうですよね……
うう……もっと痩せないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! I knew it... You're
right... Urrh... I need to lose
more weight...

fields.EN:
So... is there some benefit to being
"fashionable"? Otherwise, I can't see
why you'd have to try this hard...
fields.JP:
で……『おしゃれ』になると何か得をするの？
でないと、そこまで必死にならなければならない
理由が見出せないのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what are the benefits of this
"fashion?" It all sounds
needlessly vain.

fields.EN:
(I see... She's teaching Gretel
about fashion... That's going to
be tough...)
fields.JP:
（な、なるほど……
　グレーテルに『おしゃれ』について
　教えてるのか……大変そうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... She's teaching Gretel
about fashion... That's going to
be tough...)

fields.EN:
It isn't a matter of benefits!
It's only natural to want to be as
attractive as possible.
fields.JP:
得とか損とかの問題ではありませんわ！
魅力的になりたいというのは、
女性なら皆持っている願望ではありませんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It isn't a matter of benefits!
It's only natural to want to be as
attractive as possible.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, that doesn't apply
to me. It's not needed for my
survival.
fields.JP:
残念ながら、
そういった願望は私にはないわね。
だって、生存に必要なものとは思えないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, that doesn't apply
to me. It's not needed for my
survival.

fields.EN:
W-Well, that's sort of an end-all
conclusion...
fields.JP: そ、それを言ったら身も蓋もないですよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, that's sort of an end-all
conclusion...

fields.EN:
*sigh* What don't you understand
about what I explained to you?
fields.JP:
はあ……
何でわかって頂けないのかしら……
わたくしの説明がいけませんのかしら……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* What don't you understand
about what I explained to you?

fields.EN:
Well now, what are you three
talking about?
fields.JP: あら、三人揃って……何の話をしているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, what are you three
talking about?

fields.EN:
Oh, Alice-san! You came at just the
right time! We were talking about
fashion with Gretel-san, and...
fields.JP:
あ、アリスさん……
ちょうどいいところに来ましたわ！
今、グレーテルさんに『おしゃれ』について……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Alice! You came at just the
right time! We were talking about
fashion with Gretel, and...

fields.JP:
おしゃれ？
おしゃれ……って、何かしら？

fields.EN:
You like cute things don't you,
Alice-san? Fashion is... to be cute!
fields.JP:
アリスさんは、可愛いものが好きですわよね？
おしゃれとは……そう、ずばり……！
『可愛い』ことですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You like cute things don't you,
Alice? Fashion is... to be cute!

fields.EN:
You're losing me with each
explanation...
fields.JP: ますます理解できなくなったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're losing me with each
explanation...

fields.EN:
I like cute things, but... what
does that have to do with this
"fashion" thing?
fields.JP:
可愛いものは好きだけど……
それが『おしゃれ』と何の関係があるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like cute things, but... what
does that have to do with this
"fashion" thing?

fields.EN:
Those who pay attention to fashion
become cute and beautiful!
fields.JP:
女の子がおしゃれをすると、
可愛く、そして綺麗になるんですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those who pay attention to fashion
become cute and beautiful!

fields.EN:
Become cute? As in, like a plush
doll? Is that what this is about?
fields.JP:
……可愛く？
ぬいぐるみみたいに、ということかしら？
……そうなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Become cute? As in, like a plush
doll? Is that what this is about?

fields.EN:
N-No, that's not the point... It
means wearing beautiful dresses
and to adorning oneself!
fields.JP:
い、いえ、そういう事ではなくて……
もっと、綺麗なドレスで着飾ったりとか、
そういう事ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No, that's not the point... It
means wearing beautiful dresses
and to adorning oneself!

fields.EN:
The "cute" Alice mentioned applies
to others, but this "fashion"
applies to yourself, right?
fields.JP:
アリスの言った『可愛い』は、
自分以外の対象物に対してでしょう？
でも、おしゃれはあくまで自分の話なのよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The "cute" Alice mentioned applies
to others, but this "fashion"
applies to yourself, right?

fields.EN:
So, you're telling me that I
should be cute like a plush doll?
I never thought of that before...
fields.JP:
自分がぬいぐるみみたいに、
可愛くなるということ？
あまり考えたことはないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're telling me that I
should be cute like a plush doll?
I never thought of that before...

fields.EN:
In the first place, the subjective
quality of "cute" doesn't stand
without an observer. If so...
fields.JP:
そもそも、『可愛い』という感情自体が、
他者の存在なくして成立しないわ。
という事は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the first place, the subjective
quality of "cute" doesn't stand
without an observer. If so...

fields.EN:
Then the "cute" here applies
toward the concept that you wish
to be looked upon as being cute?
fields.JP:
つまり、自分以外の誰かから、
自分の事を『可愛い』と思われたい、
という事かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then the "cute" here applies
toward the concept that you wish
to be looked upon as being cute?

fields.EN:
I deduce that's the case here...
It still bewilders me as to why
one would want that validation.
fields.JP:
……理屈で言えば、そういう事になるわね。
なぜ他人からの無意味な評価を得たいのか、
私には理解できないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I deduce that's the case here...
It still bewilders me as to why
one would want that validation.

fields.EN:
I don't mind the idea of being
cute, but I'm not sure how "cute"
and "fashion" correlate.
fields.JP:
ええ。普通に『可愛い』でいいようにも思うわ。
それに、『可愛くなる』ことと『おしゃれ』の
関係が、どうしてもよくわからないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't mind the idea of being
cute, but I'm not sure how "cute"
and "fashion" correlate.

fields.EN:
True. If the objective is simply
to be seen as cute, fashion itself
isn't a mandatory element.
fields.JP:
そうね。『可愛い』と思われたいという目的だけ
ならば、なにも『おしゃれ』という手段が必須
だとは考えられないのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. If the objective is simply
to be seen as cute, fashion itself
isn't a mandatory element.

fields.EN:
I have no idea what you two are
talking about. Isn't that right,
Cinderella-san?
fields.JP:
ふ、二人とも……何を言ってるのか
白雪には分からないです……
シンデレラさん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no idea what you two are
talking about. Isn't that right,
Cinderella?

fields.EN:
Yes... My head is starting to
throb... Wait... What is "fashion"
again?
fields.JP:
ええ……なんだかわたくしまで、
頭が痛くなってきましたわ……
おしゃれって、一体……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... My head is starting to
throb... Wait... What is "fashion"
again?

fields.JP: ラプンツェルにはわかるよーー！！

fields.EN:
Rapu-Rapu?! Since when...?! Why are
you...?!
fields.JP:
ラプラプ！！？
いつの間に……
って、その格好はなんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy?! Since when...?! Why are
you...?!

fields.JP:
やっぱり、はだかがいちばんだよーーー！！
あははははーー！！

fields.EN:
W-Wait, Rapu-Rapu! Running
around dressed like that is indecent!
fields.JP:
ま……待ちなさい、ラプラプ！！
そんな格好で、はしたない！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait up! Rappy! Don't be running
around like that!

fields.EN:
I suppose we can discuss more
about this later. First, we need
to stop her!
fields.JP:
……仕方ないわ……
この話はまた今度にしましょう。
皆で取り押さえなければ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we can discuss more
about this later. First, we need
to stop her!

fields.JP: まったく……面倒なことね

だ、ダメですよー！
ラプンツェルさーん！！

fields.EN:
(Well... Hm... I'll just pretend
nothing happened here...)
fields.JP:
（え……ええと……
　何も見なかったし聞かなかったってことで
　いいかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well... Hm... I'll just pretend
nothing happened here...)

fields.EN:
(It looks like she's calling for
help! Did something happen?!)
fields.JP:
（誰かを呼んでるみたいだ……！
　ひょっとして、何かあったのかな！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like she's calling for
help! Did something happen?!)

fields.JP: かぐや姫！　どうしたの！？

fields.EN:
That voice... Jack? Perfect
timing. Please come in...
fields.JP:
あ、その声は……ジャックですね～。
ちょうど良かったです～。入ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That voice... Jack? Perfect
timing. Please come in...

fields.EN:
(She sounded a lot calmer than I
thought...)
fields.JP: （あ、案外落ち着いてたみたいだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She sounded a lot calmer than I
thought...)

fields.JP: あのう、一体どうしたの？

fields.EN:
(Urgh! Look at how messy her room
is! I'm not even sure how she got
this place so messy!)
fields.JP:
（っていうか……この部屋散らかりすぎ！
　どうしたらここまで散らかせるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Urgh! Look at how messy her room
is! I'm not even sure how she got
this place so messy!)

fields.EN:
Can you please get that book over
there...?
fields.JP: ああ。そこにある本を取ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please get that book over
there...?

fields.EN:
I didn't want to move and get it
myself. It was very troubling...
fields.JP:
どうしてもこの場所から動きたくなくて……
とても困っていたのです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to move and get it
myself. It was very troubling...

fields.EN:
I usually can reach things on my
own, but I couldn't today, even
with this magical hand of mine...
fields.JP:
いつもなら自分で取るんですよ～？
この『魔法の手』で……でも、届かなくて～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I usually can reach things on my
own, but I couldn't today, even
with this magical hand of mine...

fields.EN:
"Magical hand?" You mean that toy
thing you have there?
fields.JP:
ま……『魔法の手』？
そのおもちゃの手みたいなものが？
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Magical hand?" You mean that toy
thing you have there?

fields.EN:
It's one of my special tools that
help me be lazy... I use it to
grab things...
fields.JP:
わらわのさぼり七つ道具の一つです～
こうやって……
物を取る時に使うんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's one of my special tools that
help me be lazy... I use it to
grab things...

fields.EN:
(She has more of these? She really
is lazy...)
fields.JP:
（こ、こんなものがあと六つも……？
　筋金入りのめんどくさがりだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has more of these? She really
is lazy...)

fields.JP:
なかなか役に立つじゃないですか～
ちょっと見直しました～

fields.EN:
Um, but you could've done this
yourself...
fields.JP:
……っていうか、
さすがにこのくらいは、自分で取ろうよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, but you could've done this
yourself...

fields.JP: 嫌です、めんどくさいです～

fields.EN:
I know! Why don't you clean my
room while you're at it?
fields.JP:
……あ、そうだ！
ついでに、この部屋を片付けてくれませんか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! Why don't you clean my
room while you're at it?

fields.EN:
You seem like the clean type...
You should put your cleaning
skills to the test here...
fields.JP:
そなたが几帳面そうだからです～
掃除は、得意な人がやるべきです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You seem like the clean type...
You should put your cleaning
skills to the test here...

fields.JP: はあ……もう、仕方ないなあ……

fields.EN:
(I sometimes hate myself for being
so compliant...)
fields.JP:
（と、言いつつ……
　ついついやってしまう僕も僕だけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I sometimes hate myself for being
so compliant...)

fields.EN:
Whew... That should do it. I'm
done cleaning.
fields.JP:
ふう……よし、こんなもんかな。
片付け、終わったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... That should do it. I'm
done cleaning.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much. You really
are quite something... I knew you
had it in you...
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます～。
そなたはなかなか見所がありますね～
わらわの目に狂いはなかったです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much. You really
are quite something... I knew you
had it in you...

fields.EN:
Never mind that... Thanks, and I'm
counting on you...
fields.JP:
まあいいじゃないですか～。
これからも、よろしくです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never mind that... Thanks, and I'm
counting on you...

fields.EN:
Huh? Um, right... Well, I'll be
leaving, then.
fields.JP:
え？　う、うん……よろしく……！
それじゃあ、僕はこれで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Um, right... Well, I'll be
leaving, then.

fields.EN:
(Again? She wants me to clean her
room again, doesn't she?)
fields.JP:
（また今度って……
　まさか、次も掃除させられるんじゃ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Again? She wants me to clean her
room again, doesn't she?)

fields.EN: Uh, so what's this about again?
fields.JP: えーと……それで、今日は一体何の用？
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, so what's this about again?

fields.EN:
A massage... My shoulders have
been a bit stiff recently...
fields.JP:
今日はマッサージです～
最近ちょっと肩が凝ってるんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
A massage... My shoulders have
been a bit stiff recently...

fields.EN:
Huh... Why me, though? And I doubt
you even move enough to get your
shoulders stiff...
fields.JP:
はあ……なんで僕がそんな事を……
だいたい君は肩が凝るほど、動いてないと
思うんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... Why me, though? And I doubt
you even move enough to get your
shoulders stiff...

fields.EN:
*sob* You're so mean...! You don't
believe me, do you?
fields.JP:
うっうっうっ……ひどいです～！
わらわを疑うのですね～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sob* You're so mean...! You don't
believe me, do you?

fields.EN:
Those are eye drops in your hand,
right? And your delivery is completely
flat... Stop the fake crying...
fields.JP:
……その手に持ってるの、目薬だよね？
セリフもやたら棒読みだし……
嘘泣きはよそうよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's an eye dropper in your
hand, right? You also sounded too
dramatic. It won't work on me...

fields.EN:
It's not an eye dropper... It's
one of my lazy tools, "Angel
Tears."
fields.JP:
目薬じゃありません～。
さぼり七つ道具の一つ、通称『天使の涙』です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not an eye dropper... It's
one of my lazy tools, "Angel
Tears."

fields.JP:
はあ……わかったよ。
マッサージ、やるよ……

fields.EN: It helps that you're so understanding, Jack~
fields.JP: ジャックは物分りが良くて助かります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like how you're a fast learner,
Jack.

fields.EN:
(It feels like I've been doing her
bidding since the day I cleaned
her room...)
fields.JP:
（なんだかあれ以来、
　いいようにこき使われてる気が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It feels like I've been doing her
bidding since the day I cleaned
her room...)

fields.EN:
(Well, I guess it's worth it,
considering how much friendlier
we are now...)
fields.JP:
（まあ、少しは打ち解けられた気がするのは
　よかったけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, I guess it's worth it,
considering how much friendlier
we are now...)

fields.EN:
Ah, there... You're good at
massaging, Jack... Ah, it feels so
good...
fields.JP:
あ～、そこそこ……
ジャックはマッサージがうまいですね～
あ～、気持ちいいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, there... You're good at
massaging, Jack... Ah, it feels so
good...

fields.JP: そ、そっか……それならよかった……

fields.EN:
(N-Now I'm getting nervous... I
can feel my heart pounding...)
fields.JP:
（さ、さすがにこれは、
　ちょっとドキドキするなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(N-Now I'm getting nervous... I
can feel my heart pounding...)

fields.EN:
Um, Kaguyahime, do you mind if I ask you
something? Why do you use people
like this?
fields.JP:
ところで、かぐや姫はどうして、その……
そんなに人をこき使うの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Kaguya, do you mind if I ask you
something? Why do you use people
like this?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? I don't want to
do anything myself. I just want to
be lazy, that's all.
fields.JP:
……そんなの決まってるじゃないですか～。
自分で何もしたくないからです～。
つまりサボりたいからです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? I don't want to
do anything myself. I just want to
be lazy, that's all.

fields.EN:
I'm not even sure why you would
ask me a question with such an
obvious answer...
fields.JP:
それにしても、その質問……
何を今さらって感じですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not even sure why you would
ask me a question with such an
obvious answer...

fields.EN:
Well, I thought it was the
opposite. You know, you slack off
so that you're able to use others.
fields.JP:
いや、てっきり……僕は逆だと思って。
人をこき使いたいから、サボってるのかなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I thought it was the
opposite. You know, you slack off
so that you're able to use others.

fields.EN:
That's completely against the
spirit behind laziness. You have
a lot to learn, young one.
fields.JP:
……そんな不純な動機で、
わらわがサボるわけないです～。
そなたがサボりを語るのは、百年早いですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's completely against the
spirit behind laziness. You have
a lot to learn, young one.

fields.EN:
S-Sorry... So, why do you want to
slack off so often, then?
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……
じゃあ、なんでそんなにサボりたいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry... So, why do you want to
slack off so often, then?

fields.EN:
Why? That's a weird question to
ask.
fields.JP:
……なんで？
また妙なことを聞きますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why? That's a weird question to
ask.

fields.EN:
Well... I thought maybe you still
didn't want to take part in our
operation to help people...
fields.JP:
いや、その……やっぱりかぐや姫は僕たちの、
人間を助ける為の作戦には、
加わりたくないのかと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it almost felt as if you
didn't want to get involved in
trying to save the captives.

fields.EN:
You don't have to have a reason to
slack off!
fields.JP: ……サボりたい気持ちに理由なんてありません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to have a reason to
slack off!

fields.EN:
(That caught me off guard... I
didn't expect her to be so
straightforward with her answer.)
fields.JP:
（びっくりした……
　ここまできっぱり答えるとは思わなかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That caught me off guard... I
didn't expect her to be so
straightforward with her answer.)

fields.EN:
Me being lazy is similar to
Akazukin and her hood. Everyone
has their traits and quirks.
fields.JP:
……わらわの面倒くさがりは、赤ずきんのフード
みたいなものです。
誰だって持ってるこだわりです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me being lazy is similar to Red
Riding Hood and her hood. Everyone
has their traits and quirks.

fields.EN:
Jack... You have something too,
don't you? You know, a strange
trait or an urge and things...
fields.JP:
ジャック……そなたにだってあるでしょう？
そういうこだわりは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... You have something too,
don't you? You know, a strange
trait or an urge and things...

fields.EN:
Mmm... Well, I guess I have the
urge to climb as high as I can...
fields.JP:
う～ん……そうだなあ……
高いところに昇りたい……気持ち？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Well, I guess I have the
urge to climb as high as I can...

fields.EN:
Pfft... Ahahaha... You know what
they say: fools and smoke like high places~
fields.JP:
……ぷっ。あははは……
『バカと煙は何とやら』というやつですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pfft...! Hahahaha! Guess you're no
different than a monkey...

fields.EN:
Hey! And after I answered your
question, too! Fine... I'm
leaving!
fields.JP:
むっ……せっかく答えたのに……
じゃあもういいよ。今日は僕はもう帰るから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! And after I answered your
question, too! Fine... I'm
leaving!

fields.JP:
えっ？
あ……ちょっと待ってください～！

fields.EN:
I just felt like teasing you...
I'm sorry for laughing about it...
fields.JP:
……ちょっとからかいたくなっただけです。
笑って……その、悪かったです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just felt like teasing you...
I'm sorry for laughing about it...

fields.EN:
Huh? Uh, well... I'm not that
angry or anything...
fields.JP:
えっ？
い、いや……別に、そんなに怒ってないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Uh, well... I'm not that
angry or anything...

fields.EN:
(I know she's not a bad person,
but... She really has a unique
personality...)
fields.JP:
（うーん……悪い子じゃないんだ、悪い子じゃ！
　ちょっと独特な性格だけで……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know she's not a bad person,
but... She really has a unique
personality...)

fields.EN:
You're so much of a subordinate
that I just poked a little fun at
you...
fields.JP:
ジャックがあまりにも下僕向きだから……
ちょっとバカにしてしまいました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so much of a subordinate
that I just poked a little fun at
you...

fields.EN:
(*sigh* Well, there goes the
idea that she's not a bad
person...)
fields.JP:
（はあ……
　心の中とはいえ、フォローして損した……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(*sigh* Well, there goes the
idea that she's not a bad
person...)

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime, are you around? I brought
you what you asked for...
fields.JP:
……かぐや姫、いる？
頼まれてたもの、持ってきたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, are you around? I brought
you what you asked for...

fields.EN:
(Huh? Her room feels a bit
different...)
fields.JP:
（……あれ？
　なんだかいつもと部屋の様子が違うような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Her room feels a bit
different...)

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime isn't in her room?! This
is way too weird! I need to go and
find her!)
fields.JP:
（あのかぐや姫が、部屋にいないなんて！
　これはただ事じゃないぞ！
　とにかく探さないと……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya isn't in her room?! This
is way too weird! I need to go and
find her!)

fields.EN:
(The roof... Nah, she wouldn't be
here, would she?)
fields.JP:
（屋上か……
　まさかこんなところにいるわけないよなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The roof... Nah, she wouldn't be
here, would she?)

fields.EN:
(And there she is... Huh? What is
she doing?)
fields.JP:
（って、いたし！？
　……あれ？　何やってるんだろ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And there she is... Huh? What is
she doing?)

fields.EN:
(She's sighing...? Does she have
a problem? I bet it can't be that
bad...)
fields.JP:
（溜め息ついてる……？　何か悩んでるのかな？
　……ろくな悩みじゃなさそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's sighing...? Does she have
a problem? I bet it can't be that
bad...)

fields.JP: あの、かぐや姫……どうしたの？

fields.EN: Oh, Jack... What brings you here?
fields.JP:
あ、ジャック……
こんなところで何やってるんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Jack... What brings you here?

fields.EN:
I was just about to ask the same
thing. I was looking for you since
I couldn't find you in your room.
fields.JP:
いや、それはこっちのセリフだよ……
部屋にいないから、どうしたのかと思って……
それでずっと探してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just about to ask the same
thing. I was looking for you since
I couldn't find you in your room.

fields.EN:
You're a strange one... I can't
believe someone actually came to
look for me...
fields.JP:
……そなたは変な人ですね～。
わざわざ、わらわなんかを探しに来るなんて～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a strange one... I can't
believe someone actually came to
look for me...

fields.EN:
Sometimes... I start
to feel suffocated in here.
fields.JP: ……たまに、ここの中が息苦しくなるんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Every so often, I just get sick
and tired of being here...

fields.EN:
I-I see... Well, I don't blame you
with how we're here in the Jail.
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……
確かにジェイルの中じゃ、そうなっちゃうよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see... Well, I don't blame you
with how we're here in the Jail.

fields.EN:
I just feel like there's no place
I can call home. That applies to
being with the Dawn, too...
fields.JP:
なんていうか……どこにいても、
自分の居場所ではないような気がするんです。
それは黎明の中にいても、同じで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just feel like there's no place
I can call home. That applies to
being with the Dawn, too...

fields.EN:
I don't know why, but it just
feels that way...
fields.JP:
……自分でも、何故かはよくわからないんです
けどね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know why, but it just
feels that way...

fields.EN:
Is it because you feel like you're
being forced to work?
fields.JP:
それはやっぱり……
無理やり働かされてるって思ってるから……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it because you feel like you're
being forced to work?

fields.EN:
(Maybe she doesn't see us as
friends, or even allies...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり僕たちはまだ、仲間だと思って
　もらえてないのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she doesn't see us as
friends, or even allies...)

fields.EN:
It seems as if being a Blood
Maiden is painful to you.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫にとって、血式少女っていう境遇は
辛いものだったみたいだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if being a Blood
Maiden is painful to you.

fields.EN:
No, that's not it. That's not it,
but...
fields.JP:
いえ、それは全然違います……
そういうわけではないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's not it. That's not it,
but...

fields.EN:
It's just that I feel like I need
to go someplace...
fields.JP:
時々、わらわには……どこか行かなければ
ならない場所が、あるような気がして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I feel like I need
to go someplace...

fields.EN:
And yet, I don't want to... I
would rather stay here with
everyone...
fields.JP:
でも、決してそこに行きたいわけじゃなくて……
みんなとは、むしろ……一緒にいたいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, I don't want to... I
would rather stay here with
everyone...

fields.JP: ううん、そんなことないよ……

fields.EN:
(Wha-?! S-She's leaning on me?!
The scent of incense on her is so
nice...)
fields.JP:
（わわっ……い、いきなり寄りかかって……！
　お香みたいないい匂いが……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wha-?! S-She's leaning on me?!
The scent of incense on her is so
nice...)

fields.EN:
Can I... stay like this for a
little while...?
fields.JP: 少しだけ……ここにいてほしいです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can I... stay like this for a
little while...?

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime, what's the matter? You
don't look well...
fields.JP:
かぐや姫、どうしたの？
なんだか元気ないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, what's the matter? You
don't look well...

fields.EN:
Jack... Don't you think
everyone is acting strange after all?
fields.JP:
ジャック……みんなの様子、
やっぱりおかしくはないでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Have you noticed how
everyone didn't seem quite here,
so to speak?

fields.EN:
(She must be talking about our
origins...)
fields.JP: （あ……！　僕たちの出生のこと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must be talking about our
origins...)

fields.EN:
Everyone is pretending to be fine, but...
something still feels unnatural about it...
fields.JP:
みんな、元気なふりをして振舞っていますが、
やっぱりどこか不自然なような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone is acting like
everything's fine, but they aren't
the same as before...

fields.EN:
(Finding out you were born from a
Marchen's womb... I guess it would
be stranger not to be shocked.)
fields.JP:
（自分がメルヒェンの胎から産まれたなんて、
　確かにショックじゃない方がおかしいかも
　しれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not surprised, especially
after finding out that we were
born from Marchens...)

fields.EN:
(I wonder why I'm not shocked
about it... Maybe there's
something wrong with me...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルはともかく……僕はどうして
　そんなにショックじゃないんだろう？
　僕の方が……変なんだよな、きっと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why I'm not shocked
about it... Maybe there's
something wrong with me...)

fields.EN:
Maybe I shouldn't have said
anything... I should have left it
to the Professor to disclose...
fields.JP:
……わらわは言うべきではなかったんでしょうか。
あんなことは、博士に任せておけばよかったんで
しょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe I shouldn't have said
anything... I should have left it
to the Professor to disclose...

fields.EN:
Don't think like that, Kaguyahime.
It's not your fault that everyone
feels a bit different now...
fields.JP:
……そんなことないと思うよ、かぐや姫。
みんなが落ち込んでたとしても、それは君の
せいじゃなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't think like that, Kaguya.
It's not your fault that everyone
feels a bit different now...

fields.EN: Please don't try to console me!
fields.JP: 慰めはよしてください！
fields.LOCALIZED: Please don't try to console me!

fields.EN:
Ever since I spoke about it, no
one's fought me on anything, no
matter what I ask for...
fields.JP:
あの日から、みんな……わらわがどんなワガママ
を言っても、何も言わないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since I spoke about it, no
one's fought me on anything, no
matter what I ask for...

fields.EN:
They're probably compliant to what
I say because they're worried
about me...
fields.JP:
それは……わらわに気を遣っているからなんじゃ
ないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're probably compliant to what
I say because they're worried
about me...

fields.EN:
All because I spoke before the
Professor could...
fields.JP:
わらわが……博士より先に、みんなに話して
しまったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All because I spoke before the
Professor could...

fields.EN:
Is that a bad thing? Everyone is
just thinking about you.
fields.JP:
それは……嫌なこと、なの……？
みんなはきっと、君のことを思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that a bad thing? Everyone is
just thinking about you.

fields.EN:
Of course it's a bad thing! They
aren't their usual selves! I don't
want them to worry about me!
fields.JP:
当たり前です！　そんなのみんなじゃないです！
わらわになんか、気を遣わないでほしいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course it's a bad thing! They
aren't their usual selves! I don't
want them to worry about me!

fields.EN:
At this rate... No...! Why...? Why
did this...
fields.JP:
このままだと……いつか……ああもう……！！　
何で……何でこんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this rate... No...! Why...? Why
did this...

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what you're going
through now, but why not accept
everyone's thoughts?
fields.JP:
よくわからないんだけど……
みんなの気持ちを少しは考えてあげたら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what you're going
through now, but why not accept
everyone's thoughts?

fields.EN:
That's not the point! I just...!
How can I word this...
fields.JP:
そうじゃなくて！
わらわはただ……ああ、どう言えば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not the point! I just...!
How can I word this...

fields.EN:
So... are you saying everyone
should keep going along with your
selfish demands like always?
fields.JP:
じゃあ……みんなが君のワガママに、いつも
付き合えって言うの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you just want them to keep
worrying about you and doing
everything you say?

fields.EN:
I'm sure they'd all want to think
about it. Why don't you give them
some space for a while?
fields.JP:
みんなだってきっと、考えたいんだよ。
今は、そっとしといてあげなよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure they'd all want to think
about it. Why don't you give them
some space for a while?

fields.EN:
Why...? How can you say that,
of all people?
fields.JP:
どうして……？
どうしてそなたがそんなことを言うんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why...? How can you say that,
of all people?

fields.EN:
After all the discussions I've had
with you! I thought you'd
understand!
fields.JP:
そなたには、あれだけ……
色んなことを話したのに……！
きっと、わかってもらえると思ったのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all the discussions I've had
with you! I thought you'd
understand!

fields.EN:
Let me think about it... You don't
need to come here anymore.
fields.JP:
一人で考えます……
もうしばらくここには来なくていいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me think about it... You don't
need to come here anymore.

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... I wasn't trying
to...
fields.JP: ご、ごめん……そんなつもりじゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... I wasn't trying
to...

fields.EN:
(I should have just listened to
her...)
fields.JP:
（もっと……ちゃんと聞かなきゃいけなかった
　んだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should have just listened to
her...)

fields.EN:
(And I knew she was the type to
keep her feelings to herself,
too...)
fields.JP:
（……かぐや姫は、自分で抱え込んじゃう子
　だって、知ってたはずなのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And I knew she was the type to
keep her feelings to herself,
too...)

fields.EN:
(I need to let Kaguyahime know how I
feel...)
fields.JP:
（……かぐや姫にちゃんと、自分の気持ちを
　伝えなくちゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to let Kaguya know how I
feel...)

fields.EN:
What is it? I thought I told you
not to come by anymore.
fields.JP:
……何の用ですか？
来ないくていいって、言ったはずです
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it? I thought I told you
not to come by anymore.

fields.EN:
Um, I'll do anything you want, so
can you tell me what you want
me to do?
fields.JP:
あのさ……何でもいいから僕に、ワガママを
言ってくれないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'll do anything you want, so
can you tell me what you want
me to do?

fields.EN:
Seriously, anything. I want to you
to make me do stuff so that you
can slack off however you want!
fields.JP:
何でもいいからさ……
僕にワガママを言って、ダラダラしてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously, anything. I want to you
to make me do stuff so that you
can slack off however you want!

fields.EN:
I have no idea what you're trying
to get at. Please leave...
fields.JP:
……何を言っているのか、さっぱりわかりません。
出てってください……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no idea what you're trying
to get at. Please leave...

fields.EN:
To be honest, you've been acting
strange!
fields.JP: だって、最近の君は、どう考えてもおかしいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, you've been acting
strange!

fields.JP:
……おかしい？　わらわが？
どこがですか？

fields.EN:
You come to the cafeteria for your
meals yourself, you return things you've
borrowed yourself... Everyone's shocked!
fields.JP:
自分で食堂に食事に来るし、
借りたものも自分で返しに行くし……
みんなびっくりしてるじゃないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You come to the cafeteria to get
your own food, and you do things
yourself now. You're scaring us!

fields.EN:
To add, this room is so clean now.
This isn't like you, Kaguyahime!
fields.JP:
しかも部屋も綺麗に片付いてるし、
そんなの、かぐや姫らしくないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, this room is so clean now.
This isn't like you, Kaguya!

fields.EN:
Well now, you're making it sound
like I'm a lazy person...
fields.JP:
……それじゃ、まるで……わらわが、
普段はダメな人みたいじゃないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, you're making it sound
like I'm a lazy person...

fields.EN:
That's right! Being lazy was who
you were! Isn't that right?
fields.JP:
……そうだよ！
そのダメな人を自分でやってるのが、
かぐや姫なんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! Being lazy was who
you were! Isn't that right?

fields.EN:
You were worried about everyone,
but now you're worrying everyone
with what you're doing!
fields.JP:
みんなのことが心配だって言ってた本人が、
みんなに心配かけてどうするんだよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were worried about everyone,
but now you're worrying everyone
with what you're doing!

fields.EN:
So you came to tell me I'm causing
problems? You must have a lot of
time on your hands...
fields.JP:
……つまり、わらわが迷惑だと、わざわざ
言いに来たんですか。暇ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you came to tell me I'm causing
problems? You must have a lot of
time on your hands...

fields.EN:
No... I came here because I was
worried about you...
fields.JP:
違うよ……
僕が、君のことが心配なんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... I came here because I was
worried about you...

fields.EN:
If our feelings keep missing each other
like this, it's too dangerous—we won't even
be able to operate together on missions!
fields.JP:
こんなんじゃ、気持ちがすれ違ってばかりで、
危なっかしくて、一緒に作戦行動だって
できないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We keep hurting each other with
words... I can't even imagine
being with you on missions now!

fields.EN:
Please let me apologize for not
listening back then... I just want
you back to your normal lazy self.
fields.JP:
この間……ちゃんと話を聞かなかったのは謝る。
ただ僕は……君にもっと、普通にダラダラ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please let me apologize for not
listening back then... I just want
you back to your normal lazy self.

fields.JP: ぼ、僕……何か変なこと……言った？

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Well, I assume what
you said makes sense. I suppose I
was acting strange.
fields.JP:
ふふ……確かに。
そなたの言うとおりかもしれませんね。
わらわも、どうかしてました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Well, I assume what
you said makes sense. I suppose I
was acting strange.

fields.EN:
Very well. I will be lazy again.
As you said, it's better to have
everyone else do things for me.
fields.JP:
それでは、わらわはダラダラします～。
そなたの言うとおり、みんなに任せて楽を
するのもアリですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well. I will be lazy again.
As you said, it's better to have
everyone else do things for me.

fields.EN:
S-So you just want to slack
off...?
fields.JP: や、やっぱりサボりたいんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So you just want to slack
off...?

fields.EN:
It's a chore having someone know
who you are. That's why I gave up
and slacked off when I could.
fields.JP:
……人に自分のことをわかってもらうのは、
面倒くさいです。だから、いつも諦めてて
サボってたんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a chore having someone know
who you are. That's why I gave up
and slacked off when I could.

fields.EN:
But I thought you would understand
me, Jack...
fields.JP:
でも、ジャック。そなたにだけはわかって
ほしいって……わかってくれると思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I thought you would understand
me, Jack...

fields.EN:
I suppose my laziness got the
better of me. I should have said
what I wanted to say.
fields.JP:
こんなところにも、サボり癖が出たんですね。
本当に伝えたいことは、ちゃんと言わなければ
伝わらないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose my laziness got the
better of me. I should have said
what I wanted to say.

fields.EN:
I'm happy that you came here
despite what happened. Thank
you...
fields.JP:
でも、それでもこうして来てくれて……
わらわは嬉しかったです。
ありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy that you came here
despite what happened. Thank
you...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry that I didn't try to
hear you out back then...
fields.JP:
僕こそ……君はちゃんと言おうとしてたのに、
聞こうとしなくてごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry that I didn't try to
hear you out back then...

fields.EN:
I was the one who knew the truth before
everyone else in the first place, and I
decided on my own that I'd support them...
fields.JP:
もともと……先に真実を知っていたわらわが、
みんなの支えになろうと自分で決めたこと
だったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I realized the truth, I
resolved to support everyone as
much as I could...

fields.EN:
I should have just told everyone myself that
they were being too distant with me, but
instead I only made them tiptoe around me...
fields.JP:
みんなに水臭いって自分で言えばよかったのに、
かえって気を遣わせる結果になって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But instead, it seems as if I made
everyone worried. I should have
just said to not worry about me.

fields.EN:
I suppose things don't go so well
when you're not used to doing
something...
fields.JP:
……やっぱり、慣れないことはするものでは
ありませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose things don't go so well
when you're not used to doing
something...

fields.EN:
That's not true. I'm sure everyone
cares about you, too.
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ。
みんな、君のことを大事に思ってるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. I'm sure everyone
cares about you, too.

fields.JP: ……それにしても、そなたはお人よしですね～

fields.EN:
I'm the one who took my frustration
out on you, so you could have used
this chance to put me in your debt...
fields.JP:
八つ当たりをしたのはわらわなんですから、
ここでわらわに恩を売っておかない手は
ありませんのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how I acted toward you, you
could have used that to get the
better of me.

fields.EN:
I have no intention of doing that.
I was just worried about you.
fields.JP:
そんなつもりはないよ……
僕はただ、君が心配で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention of doing that.
I was just worried about you.

fields.JP: そうですか？　それじゃあさっそく……

fields.EN:
After moving around so much, I'm
very tired now... I need you to
massage me...
fields.JP:
最近動きすぎていたので、疲れました～
マッサージをお願いします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
After moving around so much, I'm
very tired now... I need you to
massage me...

fields.EN: Jack? Please get me that book...
fields.JP: ジャック、その本を取ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? Please get me that book...

fields.JP: ありがとうございます～

fields.EN:
All right. Guess the rest is to
clean up your room.
fields.JP:
うん。
あと、部屋の片付けもやっとくね
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. Guess the rest is to
clean up your room.

fields.EN:
Why aren't you complaining about
my neediness and my requests?
fields.JP:
そなたは、どうして最近……わらわのワガママに
対して、何も文句を言わないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why aren't you complaining about
my neediness and my requests?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Maybe I'm just getting used
to this?
fields.JP:
う～ん……
きっと、慣れてきたんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Maybe I'm just getting used
to this?

fields.EN:
Getting used to this? What a
splendid answer! You're such a
good subordinate!
fields.JP:
慣れ……
なんて素晴らしい答えでしょう……！
わらわは良い下僕を持ちました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Getting used to this? What a
splendid answer! You're such a
good subordinate!

fields.EN:
I think that's praise, but I'm not
too happy about it...
fields.JP:
そ、その褒め方、
全然嬉しくないんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think that's praise, but I'm not
too happy about it...

fields.EN:
Oh, and can I ask you one more
thing?
fields.JP:
……それと、
もう一つ、聞いてもいいですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and can I ask you one more
thing?

fields.EN:
If I need to go somewhere, will
you try and stop me?
fields.JP:
もし……わらわが、
どこかに行かなければならなくなったら……
わらわを引き止めてくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I need to go somewhere, will
you try and stop me?

fields.EN:
(I wonder if this has to do with
what we spoke about on the
roof...)
fields.JP:
（これ……この前の屋上での話と、
　何か関係があるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if this has to do with
what we spoke about on the
roof...)

fields.EN:
You don't need to go anywhere,
Kaguyahime.
fields.JP: ……かぐや姫はどこにも行く必要はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to go anywhere,
Kaguya.

fields.EN:
If you went away... life around
here wouldn't have the same spark to it...
fields.JP:
その……もしどこかに行っちゃったら……
生活に、張り合いがないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you go away, things won't be
the same around here...

fields.EN:
(I think this is the first time
I've seen her smile like that...)
fields.JP: （こんな素直な笑顔、初めて見たかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think this is the first time
I've seen her smile like that...)

fields.EN:
...I have no interest in depriving my
servant of his reason for living, after all~
fields.JP:
……わらわも、下僕の生きがいを奪う趣味は
ないですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention of leaving my
faithful subordinate behind.

fields.EN:
But if something does happen,
I'll leave it to you...
fields.JP: だから……いざという時は、任せました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if something does happen,
I'll leave it to you...

fields.EN:
Sure... I'll do what I can and
stop you from going anywhere.
fields.JP:
うん……
どこにも行かないように、引き止めるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure... I'll do what I can and
stop you from going anywhere.

fields.JP: よっ！　おはよ、かぐや！
こんにちはー、かぐやさん……！

fields.EN:
Your room is very clean. Are you
using Jack to do things for you
again?
fields.JP:
意外と片付いてるわね……
もしかして、またジャックをこき使っている
のかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your room is very clean. Are you
using Jack to do things for you
again?

fields.EN:
Hahaha... I just got used to it. I
have to say, it's unusual to see
everyone gathered like this.
fields.JP:
ははは……
なんか、もう慣れちゃったというか……
でも珍しいね。こうして、親睦会だなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha... I just got used to it. I
have to say, it's unusual to see
everyone gathered like this.

fields.EN: And of all places, my room...
fields.JP: しかも、何でわらわの部屋で……
fields.LOCALIZED: And of all places, my room...

fields.EN:
It's because you have the largest
room! C'mon, don't hog the place
to yourself!
fields.JP:
だってここが一番広いんだもん。
ま、いいじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because you have the largest
room! C'mon, don't hog the place
to yourself!

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose it's all right...
And I won't need to move around as
much like this, too...
fields.JP:
……まあ、別にいいですけど～。
わらわも動く手間が省けましたし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose it's all right...
And I won't need to move around as
much like this, too...

fields.JP: （かぐや姫、満更でもなさそうだ……）

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, there's
something I've been wanting to
ask...
fields.JP: そういえば、前から気になってたんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, there's
something I've been wanting to
ask...

fields.EN:
Kaguya-san, with such a lazy
lifestyle, how do you not get fat?
fields.JP:
そんなにダラダラしているのに、
何故かぐやさんは、太らないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
With your lazy lifestyle, how do
you not get fat?

fields.EN:
(That's a heck of a question to
ask...)
fields.JP: （い、いきなりぶっ込んだ質問だなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's a heck of a question to
ask...)

fields.EN:
Do you have a secret? Or maybe
you're exercising behind our
backs.
fields.JP:
何か太らない秘訣があるんですの？
実はみんなの知らないところで、運動して
らっしゃるとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you have a secret? Or maybe
you're exercising behind our
backs.

fields.EN: Princess Lazy would never do that!
fields.JP: グータラ姫に限って、ありえないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Princess Lazy would never do that!

fields.EN: Yes, I doubt that's the case.
fields.JP: ええ、それはありえないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I doubt that's the case.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised to hear you all say
that, but... I'm not thin at all.
I'm quite fat.
fields.JP:
なんだか勝手な事言われてますけど……
わらわは普通に太ってますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised to hear you all say
that, but... I'm not thin at all.
I'm quite fat.

fields.JP:
はあ？
全然そうは見えないんだけど！

fields.EN:
She's right! You're not fat at
all!
fields.JP:
そうですよ！
全然太ってませんよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right! You're not fat at
all!

fields.JP: 別にどうでもいいじゃないですか～
確かめましょう、真相を！
ふっふっふ。観念なさい！

まさか……こんな事って！？
嘘でしょ……？

（わわわ……！
　み、見ちゃダメだ……！）

fields.EN:
Impossible... I can't believe hers
are larger than mine...
fields.JP: 嘘よ……まさかわたしより大きいなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Impossible... I can't believe hers
are larger than mine...

fields.EN:
I-I won't believe it! It can't
be...!
fields.JP:
わたしは、わたしは信じないわよ……！
こんなのって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I won't believe it! It can't
be...!

fields.EN:
I-I suppose her attire kept her
endowments secret... Still, hiding
it from us is quite rude!
fields.JP:
か、隠れ巨乳というやつですわね……
それにしても……過度な謙遜は嫌味でしてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I suppose her attire kept her
endowments secret... Still, hiding
it from us is quite rude!

fields.EN:
You're not fat at all... If
anything, you're skinny...
fields.JP:
っていうか、
やっぱり全然太ってないじゃないですか……
むしろ痩せてるじゃないですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not fat at all... If
anything, you're skinny...

fields.EN: I-I want to be left alone!
fields.JP: や……やっぱり一人が一番いいです～！！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I want to be left alone!

fields.EN:
Wh-Why, you...! I can't believe
you didn't leave earlier! Get out!
fields.JP:
あ、あ、あんたね……！
こういう時は、空気読んで出て行きなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Why, you...! I can't believe
you didn't leave earlier! Get out!

fields.JP: 問答無用！！　出てけーーー！！

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Jack? Did you
come to receive orders from me?
If so, good for you.
fields.JP:
どうしたんですか、ジャック？
わらわのワガママを聞きに来たんですか～？
良い心がけですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Jack? Did you
come to receive orders from me?
If so, good for you.

fields.JP: いや、そういうわけじゃないんだけど……

fields.EN:
Here. Akazukin-san told me to
give these to you.
fields.JP:
はい、これ。
赤ずきんさんがかぐや姫にって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here. Red Riding Hood told me to
give these to you.

fields.EN:
Yeah, Akazukin-san said they
didn't look good on her, so...
fields.JP:
うん、赤ずきんさんが、
自分には似合わないからあげるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, Red Riding Hood said they
didn't look good on her, so...

fields.JP: って、あれ？　どうしたの？

fields.EN:
I get bad vibes about the things
she "gives away"... Like she's
trying to make me exercise...
fields.JP:
赤ずきんが持ってくるものって……
悪い予感しかしないんですよね～
運動させるためとか、思惑がありそうで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get bad vibes about the things
she "gives away"... Like she's
trying to make me exercise...

fields.JP: はは……それはさすがに、考えすぎだよ

fields.EN:
Mmm... Well, it does look good, so
I suppose I can keep it...
fields.JP:
う～ん……
まあ、見た目は良さそうですし、
もらってあげてもいいですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Well, it does look good, so
I suppose I can keep it...

fields.EN:
(Despite what she says, she looks
pretty happy...)
fields.JP:
（とは言いつつ、
　なんだかんだで嬉しそうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite what she says, she looks
pretty happy...)

fields.EN:
Well then, please put it on me,
Jack.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ジャック……
そなたがこれを着せてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, please put it on me,
Jack.

fields.EN:
It's a chore for me to put on
clothes that I'm not used to...
fields.JP:
だって、慣れない洋服を一人で着るの、
面倒くさいじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a chore for me to put on
clothes that I'm not used to...

fields.EN:
This is part of your job as a
subordinate. Now, hurry.
fields.JP:
これも下僕の役目ですよ～
ほら、早く～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is part of your job as a
subordinate. Now, hurry.

fields.EN: (What in the world am I doing?!)
fields.LOCALIZED: (What in the world am I doing?!)

fields.EN:
Ah, this feels like it's nice and
snug...
fields.JP: あ、これ……サイズはぴったりですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, this feels like it's nice and
snug...

fields.EN:
(It's too exposing! I need to look
away! Look away, Jack!)
fields.JP:
（っていうか、色々見えそうなんですけど……！
　って、ダメだ、見るな！
　目を逸らすんだ、ジャック！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's too exposing! I need to look
away! Look away, Jack!)

fields.JP:
……お、終わった！
こ、これでどうかな……？

fields.EN:
Thank you very much. It's a lot
better than I expected.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます～。
思ったより、けっこう良い感じですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much. It's a lot
better than I expected.

fields.EN:
(That was way too much for
me...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was way too much for
me...!)

fields.EN:
But, um... Isn't it a bit
short...?
fields.JP:
でもこれ、その……
ちょっと、短すぎるような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, um... Isn't it a bit
short...?

fields.JP: い、いやその……なんというか……

fields.EN:
I know it's not like me to say
this, but I wish to step out of my
room now... You, come with me.
fields.JP:
……わらわにしては珍しく、
部屋から出てみたくなりました～
そなたも、付いてきてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's not like me to say
this, but I wish to step out of my
room now... You, come with me.

fields.EN:
(Well, it isn't often that she
wants to step out of her room, so
I guess I can cover for her!)
fields.JP:
（でも、せっかくかぐや姫が珍しく部屋から
　出たいって言ってるんだし……
　ここは僕がなんとかするしか……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, it isn't often that she
wants to step out of her room, so
I guess I can cover for her!)

fields.EN:
How refreshing... I suppose it's
good to change clothes every so
often...
fields.JP:
……なんだか、新鮮です～。
たまにはいつもと違う服を着るのもいいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
How refreshing... I suppose it's
good to change clothes every so
often...

fields.EN: I-I see... Good for you... Haha...
fields.JP: そ、そう……よかったよ……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I see... Good for you... Haha...

fields.JP: う、ううん……なんでもないよ！

fields.EN:
(H-Her underwear is about to peek
out from under her skirt... But I
can't just tell her that...)
fields.JP:
（さ、さっきから……
　ぱ、パンツが見えそうなんですけど……
　でもそんな事言えないし……どうしよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(H-Her underwear is about to peek
out from under her skirt... But I
can't just tell her that...)

fields.EN:
(It can't be helped... I'll act as
a shield and cover her front!)
fields.JP:
（し、仕方ない……こうなったら、
　僕が盾になって前方を守るしか……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It can't be helped... I'll act as
a shield and cover her front!)

fields.EN:
What's wrong~? Why are you looking around
so much with that scary look on your face...?
fields.JP:
……どうしたんですか～？
そんなに怖い顔できょろきょろして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with that glare? Pretty
scary, if you ask me...

fields.EN:
Huh? Uh, well... I was just
thinking that things looked
different with you around, Kaguyahime.
fields.JP:
え？　い、いやその……かぐや姫と一緒だと、
黎明の中もいつもと違う感じに見えて、
新鮮だなーって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Uh, well... I was just
thinking that things looked
different with you around, Kaguya.

fields.EN:
Th-That's a strange thing to
say... If that's true, then you
don't need to make such a face.
fields.JP:
へ、へんな人ですね～
それなら別に、怖い顔をする必要はないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's a strange thing to
say... If that's true, then you
don't need to make such a face.

fields.JP:
あ、白雪じゃないですか～。
こんにちは～

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Kaguya-san? You're
not in your usual kimono...
fields.JP:
かぐやさん、どうしたんですか？
いつもは着物なのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Kaguya? You're
not in your usual kimono...

fields.EN:
Do I look strange in this? Maybe I
shouldn't have tried it on.
fields.JP:
……やっぱり変ですか～？
着替えなければよかったです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do I look strange in this? Maybe I
shouldn't have tried it on.

fields.EN:
Not at all! I was just surprised
at how beautiful you are!
fields.JP:
違います！
あんまり素敵なので驚いたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all! I was just surprised
at how beautiful you are!

fields.EN:
Well now, that's just as
embarrassing...
fields.JP: それはそれで、恥ずかしいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, that's just as
embarrassing...

fields.EN:
(That's right! She's beautiful,
but...! Her underwear is about to
show...)
fields.JP:
（そう、素敵なんだ……！
　しかもパンツが見えそうなんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right! She's beautiful,
but...! Her underwear is about to
show...)

fields.EN:
Um, Jack-san? What are you trying to
look at?
fields.JP:
あの、ジャックさん、
なんでそんなにきょろきょろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Jack? What are you trying to
look at?

fields.JP:
（え？　……あ！
　かぐや姫のパンツが見えてる……！）

fields.EN:
N-No, Shirayukihime! I-I was... Um...
Uh, you're misunderstanding me!
fields.JP:
ち、違うんだ白雪姫！
こ、これはその……
と、とにかく、多分……誤解なんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No, Snow White! I-I was... Um...
Uh, you're misunderstanding me!

fields.JP: は……は……破廉恥ですーーーー！！！

ちょ、ちょっと待って！！
し、白雪姫……

fields.EN:
What's with her? It looked like
she was crying...
fields.JP:
……白雪、どうしたんでしょう～？
なんか泣いてましたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with her? It looked like
she was crying...

fields.JP: さ、さあ……なんでだろうね……
（うう……あれは絶対、何か誤解された……）

fields.EN:
Heh, heh, heh... The filth here
has no chance against me!
fields.JP:
ふふふ……こんな汚れ、
わたくしの手にかかれば瞬殺ですわよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh, heh... The filth here
has no chance against me!

fields.EN:
(Cinderella and Kaguyahime? Now that's
a pair you don't see every day...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラとかぐや姫……？
　なんだか、珍しい取り合わせだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella and Kaguya? Now that's
a pair you don't see every day...)

fields.JP: それにしても……理解不能です～

fields.EN:
Why are you always cleaning,
Cinderella?
fields.JP:
シンデレラは、いつも掃除をしてますけど、
何故なんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you always cleaning,
Cinderella?

fields.EN:
Why? Ohohohoho! Value cannot be
found in spaces or people without
cleanliness!
fields.JP:
何故って……をーっほほほほ！
住空間も人も、綺麗でなければ価値なんてない
からでございましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why? Ohohohoho! Value cannot be
found in spaces or people without
cleanliness!

fields.EN:
But living a normal life brings
about filth. So, you keep cleaning
each time the place gets dirty?
fields.JP:
普通に暮らしてれば、どうせ汚れるのに、
汚しては綺麗にする繰り返しですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But living a normal life brings
about filth. So, you keep cleaning
each time the place gets dirty?

fields.EN:
Also, saying there's no value is
masochistic...
fields.JP:
……綺麗にしてないと価値がないなんて、
なんだか自虐の極みですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, saying there's no value is
masochistic...

fields.EN: Wha--?! What did you just say...?!
fields.JP:
ムッ……
これは面白いことをおっしゃいますわね……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha--?! What did you just say...?!

fields.JP:
（こ、これは……もしかして、
　一触即発というやつなんじゃ……！？）

fields.EN:
Did I say something strange? Oh...
You missed a spot in the
kitchen...
fields.JP:
わらわが、何かおかしい事言いましたっけ～？
あ……キッチンのそこ、まだ汚れてますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did I say something strange? Oh...
You missed a spot in the
kitchen...

fields.EN:
What?! Wh-Where is it?! The
scrub brush—where's the scrub brush?!
fields.JP:
えっ！？　ど、どこですの！？
たわし、たわしは……！？

fields.EN:
It's right there. Let me get it
like... so.
fields.JP:
たわしなら、ここにあります～。
よいしょ……っと～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's right there. Let me get it
like... so.

fields.JP: そ……その道具は一体何ですの！？

fields.EN:
It's one of my special lazy tools,
the "Cat's Paw." I can use this to
rake what I want toward me...
fields.JP:
わらわのさぼり七つ道具、『猫の手』です～。
これがあれば、取りたい物をこっちに
寄せることが出来るんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's one of my special lazy tools,
the "Cat's Paw." I can use this to
rake what I want toward me...

fields.JP:
な、なんて便利な……！
……なかなかやりますわね……！

fields.EN:
See? That's why I don't see why
you would want to toil in cleaning
the place...
fields.JP:
だから、理解不能なんです～。
どうしてわざわざ面倒くさい掃除なんかして、
綺麗にしようとするのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? That's why I don't see why
you would want to toil in cleaning
the place...

fields.EN:
It's the satisfaction of
knowing I cleaned it myself!!
fields.JP: 綺麗にしたという……実感ですわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's so that I know that the place
is clean!

fields.EN:
The easier the better. If it's
just the results you're after,
just have Jack clean instead.
fields.JP:
結果が出るなら楽な方がいいです～。
ジャックに掃除してもらうとか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
The easier the better. If it's
just the results you're after,
just have Jack clean instead.

fields.EN: Jack-san... I feel sorry for you...
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……
それはジャックさんがお気の毒な気が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Poor soul... I feel sorry for
Jack.

fields.EN:
(Whew... Thank goodness Cinderella
has common sense...)
fields.JP: （……ほっ……シンデレラが常識人でよかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whew... Thank goodness Cinderella
has common sense...)

fields.EN:
That's what you call an unreasonable demand!
Wouldn't cleaning be more harmless than
testing someone's feelings like that?
fields.JP:
そういうのを無茶振りっていうんですのよ！
そうして人の気持ちを試すよりは、お掃除の方が
無害ではなくて？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All you're doing is forcing him to
work! Instead of playing with his
feelings, why not clean yourself?

fields.EN:
I'm not forcing him. He actually
finds fulfillment in working for
me.
fields.JP:
無茶振りではないです～。
ジャックはわらわのために働くことに、
やりがいを見出してますから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not forcing him. He actually
finds fulfillment in working for
me.

fields.EN:
I'm starting to feel even
sorrier for you, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
ジャックさんがますますお気の毒になって
きましたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now I really feel sorry for
Jack...

fields.JP: （僕も自分が気の毒に思えてきた……）

fields.EN:
You also said that I'm playing
with his feelings, didn't you?
fields.JP:
しかも……わらわが人の気持ちを試していると、
そう言うんですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also said that I'm playing
with his feelings, didn't you?

fields.EN:
Why, thank you... Back on the
subject... Am I wrong?
fields.JP:
あら、ありがとうございます……
それで、違うんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, thank you... Back on the
subject... Am I wrong?

fields.EN:
No. You're pretty sharp... Oh,
here's the detergent...
fields.JP:
いえ。そなた、なかなか鋭いですね～
ああ、洗剤です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. You're pretty sharp... Oh,
here's the detergent...

fields.EN:
Thank you... You're very
thoughtful, aren't you...
fields.JP:
……助かりますわ。
貴方、意外と気が付きますのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you... You're very
thoughtful, aren't you...

fields.EN:
I'm extremely observant because
I don't like to move.
fields.JP:
わらわは普段から動かないぶん、
物事の観察は得意ですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm extremely observant because
I don't like to move.

fields.EN:
I see...! I suppose that's one way
of looking at things. How
enlightening.
fields.JP:
なるほど……！
そういう考え方もあるんですのね。
目から鱗ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...! I suppose that's one way
of looking at things. How
enlightening.

fields.EN:
Same here... You have a keen eye
yourself...
fields.JP:
それはこちらこそです～。
そなたこそ、なかなかの眼力じゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here... You have a keen eye
yourself...

fields.EN:
Ohohohoho! I do take pride in my
keenness!
fields.JP:
をーっほほほほ！
わたくし、見る目は自信ありましてよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohohoho! I do take pride in my
keenness!

fields.EN:
Oh, there's another spot over
there...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, there's another spot over
there...

fields.EN:
Oh! I didn't notice that!
We're making great progress!
fields.JP:
あら。気付きませんでしたわ！
はかどりましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, how could I not have
noticed?! Much obliged!

fields.EN:
It's fun watching someone work...
Oh, there are more dry rags over
there...
fields.JP:
人が働くのを見るのは良いものです～
空拭き用の雑巾ならそちらに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fun watching someone work...
Oh, there are more dry rags over
there...

fields.JP: （……案外ウマが合ってるような……？）

fields.EN:
It feels strange having friends,
but I suppose it's not half bad...
fields.JP:
仲間がいるって、なんだか変な感じですね～
でも、悪い気はしないものです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels strange having friends,
but I suppose it's not half bad...

fields.JP: ええ……わたくしも同感でしてよ！

fields.EN:
(Guess there's nothing to worry
about here...)
fields.JP: （心配する必要、なさそうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess there's nothing to worry
about here...)

fields.EN:
(That girl... Hameln, was it? She
was a pretty random recruit. I
wonder what kind of girl she is.)
fields.JP:
（あの子……ハーメルンだっけ。
　なんだかよくわからないまま仲間になったけど
　……どんな子なんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That girl... Hameln, was it? She
was a pretty random recruit. I
wonder what kind of girl she is.)

fields.EN: Who goes there? State your name!
fields.LOCALIZED: Who goes there? State your name!

fields.JP:
あ、ご、ごめん……
ジャックだけど……

fields.EN:
Aah... That weak-looking... Hmph!
Come in!
fields.JP:
ああ……あの時の、軟弱そうな……。
ふん、入るがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah... That weak-looking... Hmph!
Come in!

fields.JP: は、はあ……それじゃ、お邪魔します

fields.EN:
(Wh-Why is she standing there so imposingly?!
And "late"—was she waiting for me?! )
fields.JP:
（ど、どうして仁王立ちしてるの！？
　しかも『遅い』って、待ってたの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is she standing up on
there?! And "late"? Was she
waiting for someone?!)

fields.EN:
How rude of you to not come
earlier to greet me!
fields.JP:
今の今までこのワレに挨拶がないとは……
何事か！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How rude of you to not come
earlier to greet me!

fields.JP:
（や、やっぱり誰か来るまで待ってたの！？
　ひょっとしてずっとその体勢で！？）

fields.EN:
Hmph! I suppose I can at least
praise you for coming heyare.
fields.JP:
ふん……！
だが、こうして来た事自体は褒めてやりゅ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! I suppose I can at least
praise you for coming heyare.

fields.EN:
(Whoops... She slurred at the very
end...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoops... She slurred at the very
end...)

fields.EN:
Um... You joined us, so... I just
came by to say hi.
fields.JP:
ええと、なんていうか……仲間になったんだし、
これからよろしく……それを言いに来たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You joined us, so... I just
came by to say hi.

fields.EN:
I-I see. Good work... Make
ample use of my true powyer... power...
fields.JP:
そ、そうか。ご苦労であった……
わが真の力、大いに役立てるが良いじょ……ぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see. Very well. You shall
witness the greatness of my true
powyer... Power...

fields.EN:
Uh, before that, what happened to
the clothes that were supplied to
you?
fields.JP:
っていうか……あの、服は……？
さっき、支給されたはずだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, before that, what happened to
the clothes that were supplied to
you?

fields.EN:
Hmph! I have no need for them!
This is my proper attire...
Whoops... My true form!
fields.JP:
ふん！　あんなものは必要ないわ！
これがワレに相応しい制服……じゃなかった、
然るべき、真の姿だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! I have no need for them!
This is my proper attire...
Whoops... My true form!

fields.EN:
O-Oh... So, you prefer what you're
wearing now...
fields.JP: そ、そう……気に入ってるんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Oh... So, you prefer what you're
wearing now...

fields.EN:
(It looks like parts she got from
Marchens that she stitched
together...)
fields.JP:
（どう見ても、メルヒェンのパーツを繋げてるだけ
　なんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like parts she got from
Marchens that she stitched
together...)

fields.EN:
Um, do you mind if I ask you a
question?
fields.JP: ところでさ……ひとつ聞きたかったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, do you mind if I ask you a
question?

fields.EN:
What is it?! State yourself! I
shall allow one query!
fields.JP:
……何だ、申してみよ！
特別に許可してやろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it?! State yourself! I
shall allow one query!

fields.EN:
Uh, well... Why do you speak to
everyone like a superior?
fields.JP:
……なんで、その……
そんな偉そうな喋り方なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... Why do you speak to
everyone like a superior?

fields.EN:
Hmph... Isn't it obvious?! It is
because I am your superyey!
fields.JP:
ふ……そんなの、決まっておろう！
ワレが偉いからでありゅ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... Isn't it obvious?! It is
because I am your superyey!

fields.EN:
(She speaks in a haughty way, but
it doesn't seem like she's stuck-
up... She seems nice.)
fields.JP:
（この子って、偉そうにはしてるけど、
　別に本当に威張ってるわけじゃなさそうだな。
　悪い子じゃなさそうだし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She speaks in a haughty way, but
it doesn't seem like she's stuck-
up... She seems nice.)

fields.EN:
Hm... Your presence here bespeaks
great potential. I look forward to
seeing more from you, Jack!
fields.JP:
ふむ……しっかり挨拶に来るあたり、
貴様はなかなか見所があるな。
これからもよろしく頼むぞ、ジャックよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Your presence here bespeaks
great potential. I look forward to
seeing more from you, Jack!

fields.EN:
Yes, same here! If you need
anything all, feel free to let us
know!
fields.JP:
うん。こちらこそ……！
もし困った事とかあったら、何でも僕やみんなに
言ってね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, same here! If you need
anything all, feel free to let us
know!

fields.EN:
Hahahaha! That is not necessary!
Leave it all to me, and...! Uh,
oh...!
fields.JP:
……ふはははは！！
そんなものは必要ない。
ワレに全て任せておけば……あ、あれっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha! That is not necessary!
Leave it all to me, and...! Uh,
oh...!

fields.EN:
Whew... This room is quite
dangerous...
fields.JP:
……ふう……
この部屋の仕組み……侮れぬな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... This room is quite
dangerous...

fields.EN:
Especially when you're standing
on the chair like that... Be
careful, okay?
fields.JP:
そんなところに立ったら、転んじゃうから……
気を付けてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Especially when you're standing
on the chair like that... Be
careful, okay?

fields.EN:
Hmph... That you saved me has
raised my expectations of you. You
have my thanks, Jack!
fields.JP:
ふん……ワレを危機から救うとは……
やはり見所があるな。
褒めてつかわすぞ、ジャック！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... That you saved me has
raised my expectations of you. You
have my thanks, Jack!

fields.EN: Feel free to come by anytime!
fields.JP: ちょくちょく遊びに来るが良いぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Feel free to come by anytime!

fields.EN:
(Guess she's not that hard to
speak with once you get the hang
of it...)
fields.JP: （コツさえ掴めば、話しやすい子なのかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess she's not that hard to
speak with once you get the hang
of it...)

fields.JP:
（ハーメルン……？
　なんだか、妙にそわそわしてるな……）

fields.EN:
I don't know! I don't know at all!
Why is everyone walking out of
order?!
fields.JP:
……分からぬ……どうしても分からぬ！！
なぜ皆、バラバラに歩いておるのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know! I don't know at all!
Why is everyone walking out of
order?!

fields.EN:
It wasn't like this in my
underground abode! I can't get
used to it at all!
fields.JP:
ワレが地下の迷宮にいた頃は、こうではなかった！
こんなのは、初めてで……慣れん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It wasn't like this in my
underground abode! I can't get
used to it at all!

fields.EN: How did you walk down there?
fields.JP: じゃあ、今まではどうやって歩いてたのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: How did you walk down there?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious?! I marched in
formation together with the Marchens!
fields.JP:
そんなの、決まっておろう！
メルヒェンたちと整列して行進していたのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious?! I was marching
with the Marchens!

fields.EN: I'm not so sure about that...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not so sure about that...

fields.EN:
(So that's the reason why she
looked nervous?)
fields.JP: （それでそわそわしてたのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So that's the reason why she
looked nervous?)

fields.EN:
(So the Marchens underground
weren't enemies to Hameln...)
fields.JP:
（地下のメルヒェンは、ハーメルンの敵じゃ
　なかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So the Marchens underground
weren't enemies to Hameln...)

fields.EN:
Look at everyone here! Everyone is
walking randomly! How can I be at
ease with everyone like thiysh!
fields.JP:
……それが何だ、貴様らは！
揃いも揃ってテキトーに歩きおって！
これじゃさっぱり落ち着かんではにゃいか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at everyone here! Everyone is
walking randomly! How can I be at
ease with everyone like thiysh!

fields.EN:
Hmm... But if something happened
while we're walking in order, our
reaction time would be delayed.
fields.JP:
う～ん。でも何かあった時、変にまとまってると
動きが鈍くなると思うんだけどなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... But if something happened
while we're walking in order, our
reaction time would be delayed.

fields.EN:
Hm... I suppose that makes
sense...
fields.JP: ふむ……それも一理あるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I suppose that makes
sense...

fields.EN:
Is there anything else we can do
to help?
fields.JP: 他にはどうすると落ち着く、とかある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there anything else we can do
to help?

fields.EN:
If possible... holding hands,
um... seems to help... Augh! This
is so embarrasshing!
fields.JP:
で、できれば手を繋ぐと……その……
落ち着くはずだ……って、ええい！
みなまで言わすでにゃい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If possible... holding hands,
um... seems to help... Augh! This
is so embarrasshing!

fields.EN:
Huh... You act like a king all the
time, but at times like this you want
to hold hands... That's unexpected.
fields.JP:
ふーん、普段は王様気取りなのに、
こういう時は手を繋ぎたいだなんて……
なんだか意外ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... The attitude of a king, but
the fear response of a child...
That's surprising.

fields.EN:
It is pretty unexpected... Or
cute, rather...
fields.JP:
確かに、ちょっと意外ですね……
ちょっと可愛らしいというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is pretty unexpected... Or
cute, rather...

fields.EN:
Tch...! S-Say any more and I shall
burn you all with hellfire!
fields.JP:
くっ……！
そ、それ以上言うと、地獄の業火で焼くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch...! S-Say any more and I shall
burn you all with hellfire!

fields.EN:
Hmm... Holding hands with Marchens
while walking in order...
fields.JP:
うーん。それにしても……
メルヒェンと手をつないで整列かあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... Holding hands with Marchens
while walking in order...

fields.EN:
Hm? Does that bother you? They are
cute, you know?
fields.JP:
あら。そうかしら？
なかなかあれで可愛いのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Does that bother you? They are
cute, you know?

fields.JP: メルヒェンおいしいよ！

fields.EN:
(Hameln wasn't eating the
Marchens? That's pretty surprising
to me...)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンはメルヒェンを食べて
　いなかったんだ……むしろ意外だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hameln wasn't eating the
Marchens? That's pretty surprising
to me...)

fields.EN:
Of course we wouldn't know! I, at
least, have not met a Marchen that
didn't attack before!
fields.JP:
襲ってこないメルヒェンなんて、出会ったこと
ありませんし、わかりませんわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course we wouldn't know! I, at
least, have not met a Marchen that
didn't attack before!

fields.EN:
A friendly Marchen...? It would be
nice if there were some like
that...
fields.JP:
友好的なメルヒェンですか～
いたらいいかもしれませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
A friendly Marchen...? It would be
nice if there were some like
that...

fields.EN:
You're only saying that so that
you wouldn't have to fight...
fields.JP: あんたの場合はどうせサボるためでしょ
