fields.LOCALIZED:
You're only saying that so that
you wouldn't have to fight...

fields.EN:
But perhaps they would be useful
if they worked for us...
fields.JP: 働いてもらうと便利そうじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But perhaps they would be useful
if they worked for us...

fields.EN:
Hearing you girls talk is starting
to make my head spin...
fields.JP:
な、何だかあんた達と話してたら、頭が
こんがらがってきたよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hearing you girls talk is starting
to make my head spin...

fields.EN:
If there are friendly Marchens,
all that remains is whether we can
find common ground with them.
fields.JP:
確かにそうなると、生物としての利害の一致が
見出せるかどうかになってくるわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there are friendly Marchens,
all that remains is whether we can
find common ground with them.

fields.JP: よ、余計こんがらがるから……！

fields.EN:
Well, when they die, they become
part of my clothing, so they
aren't all that bad.
fields.JP:
いや、死ねばこうして衣類にもなってくれるし、
悪い奴らではないぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, when they die, they become
part of my clothing, so they
aren't all that bad.

fields.EN:
(Does that mean there are
Marchens that aren't harmful, too...?)
fields.JP:
（メルヒェンにも、有害なのと違うのがいるって
　ことだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Does that mean that there are
useful Marchens, too...?)

fields.EN:
(Maybe like Gretel and Hansel? If
so, it would mean that someone's
ordering them to attack humans.)
fields.JP:
（それは……グレーテルとヘンゼルみたいな
　ものなのかな？　そうすると、やっぱり誰かが
　人間を襲えと命令してることになる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe like Gretel and Hansel? If
so, it would mean that someone's
ordering them to attack humans.)

fields.JP: ん？　どうかしたか、ジャック？

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry... I was just thinking a
bit about the Marchens...
fields.JP:
あ、ごめん……ちょっとメルヒェンについて
考えちゃってて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry... I was just thinking a
bit about the Marchens...

fields.JP: 貴様は変わった奴だな……

fields.EN:
(Uh, of all the people who would
say that to me...)
fields.JP: （いや……君には言われたくないんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh, of all the people who would
say that to me...)

fields.EN:
Okay, Hameln-san. Why don't we hold
hands?
fields.JP:
……じゃあ、ハーメルンさん……
一緒に、手を繋ぎましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, Hameln. Why don't we hold
hands?

fields.JP: そうですわね！　楽しそうですもの！
む、むう……そこまで申すのなら……

fields.EN:
Okay, then Shirayuki will hold
your right hand!
fields.JP: じゃあ、白雪は右手ですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then Snow White will hold
your right hand!

fields.EN: I will hold your left hand!
fields.JP: ではわたくしは左手を……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I will hold your left hand!

fields.JP:
ふ、ふん……
く、苦しゅうない……！

fields.EN:
Ahhh... I can already feel the
tension easing inside me...
fields.JP: はー。何とも心が安らぐな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahhh... I can already feel the
tension easing inside me...

fields.JP:
（ふふ……ハーメルン、あんなに嬉しそうな
　顔して……）

fields.EN:
(I suppose that's her Blood Maiden
trait then...)
fields.JP:
（でも……これも血式少女特有のこだわり
　なのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose that's her Blood Maiden
trait then...)

fields.EN:
Hameln... I thought I heard you
calling for me. Is something
wrong?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン……何か困ったことでもあった？
確か呼ばれてたと思ったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln... I thought I heard you
calling for me. Is something
wrong?

fields.EN:
Ah, it's you... Well then, come
in...
fields.JP:
ああ……貴様か……
まあ、とりあえず入るがよい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, it's you... Well then, come
in...

fields.EN:
(What's the matter with her? She's
not her usual self today...)
fields.JP:
（どうしたんだろう？　いつもと何だか様子が
　違う気がするけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's the matter with her? She's
not her usual self today...)

fields.EN:
(I haven't seen her like this
before... Is she feeling down?)
fields.JP:
（こんなハーメルン、初めて見た……
　ひょっとして落ち込んでる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't seen her like this
before... Is she feeling down?)

fields.EN:
Um, what's the matter? You don't
seem well. Is there a problem?
fields.JP:
あの……どうしたの？
元気がないけど、何か悩み事とか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, what's the matter? You don't
seem well. Is there a problem?

fields.EN:
W-Well... Um... It's hard for me
to say this, but...
fields.JP:
じ、実はな……その……
少々、言いにくいのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... Um... It's hard for me
to say this, but...

fields.EN:
(Is she having that big of a
problem?)
fields.JP: （そ、そんな深刻な悩みなのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she having that big of a
problem?)

fields.EN:
I've been waiting forever now,
but... Clara hasn't brought me my
pipe yet...
fields.JP:
くららの奴が……いつまで経っても
笛を持ってきてくれないのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been waiting forever now,
but... Clara hasn't brought me my
pipe yet...

fields.EN:
She promised me she would give
me one, and... I was eagerly
awaiting her arrival...
fields.JP:
くれると約束していたのに……
ワレは楽しみにしていたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She promised me she would give
me one, and... I was eagerly
awaiting her arrival...

fields.EN:
Maybe she just forgot. Clara has
a knack for forgetting things.
fields.JP:
……うっかり忘れてるだけじゃないかな？
くらら、結構忘れっぽいし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she just forgot. Clara has
a knack for forgetting things.

fields.EN:
Ah, but... Something doesn't feel
right... I'm getting bad vibes
from this...
fields.JP:
ああ。しかし……どうも腑に落ちぬ……
何故だか胸がざわざわするのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but... Something doesn't feel
right... I'm getting bad vibes
from this...

fields.EN:
I know it isn't anything major,
and that she has no ill
intentions, however...
fields.JP:
このような些細な約束で、しかも……
相手には悪意がないのもわかっているのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it isn't anything major,
and that she has no ill
intentions, however...

fields.EN:
If this was a promise of an
important nature, what would have
happened to me by now?
fields.JP:
もしこれが、もっと重大な約束だったら……
ワレは一体、どうなってしまうのだろうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If this was a promise of an
important nature, what would have
happened to me by now?

fields.EN:
(If it were me making that promise
with her, I wouldn't want to worry
her like this...)
fields.JP:
（だったら……せめて僕は、そんな不安な思いは
　させたくないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If it were me making that promise
with her, I wouldn't want to worry
her like this...)

fields.EN:
Um... I'll promise you that I
won't break any promises with you.
fields.JP:
あのさ……僕は約束を破ったりしないって、
約束するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I'll promise you that I
won't break any promises with you.

fields.EN:
Heh... Well, it does sound strange
that I'm promising a promise.
fields.JP:
……『約束を破らない』っていう約束も、
なんか変かもしれないけど……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Well, it does sound strange
that I'm promising a promise.

fields.EN:
Hm... The promise has been sealed!
Be wary of what will happen if you
break it, Jack!
fields.JP:
ふ……それでは約束成立だな！
破ったら承知せぬから、よく覚えておけ！
ジャックよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... The promise has been sealed!
Be wary of what will happen if you
break it, Jack!

fields.EN:
Heh... A promise... A promise with
Jack!
fields.JP:
えへへ……約束……
ジャックと約束したぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... A promise... A promise with
Jack!

fields.EN:
(Hameln looks really happy... I
better make sure I keep that
promise.)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルン……嬉しそうでよかった……
　約束、絶対に守らなきゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hameln looks really happy... I
better make sure I keep that
promise.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder if this is her Blood
Libido that Gretel was talking
about...)
fields.JP:
（でも……これも、グレーテルの言ってた
　『血式リビドー』ってやつなのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if this is her Blood
Libido that Gretel was talking
about...)

fields.EN:
Speaking of, why do you want the
pipe?
fields.JP:
そういえば……
ところで、なんでそんなに笛が欲しいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of, why do you want the
pipe?

fields.EN:
W-Well... It's because... I want
to sing and dance with everyone...
Is that a problem?!
fields.JP:
そ、それはだな……
み、みんなと一緒に歌ったり踊ったり……
したいのだ……悪いか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... It's because... I want
to sing and dance with everyone...
Is that a problem?!

fields.EN:
No. Not at all. I'm sure
you'll be able to do it someday...!
fields.JP:
ううん。そんなことないよ。
いつか、きっとできるよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. I'm sure you'll be
able to do that soon!

fields.EN:
W-Well then... I suppose you will
suffice for now!
fields.JP:
……だ、だから……今日のところは……
貴様で我慢してやることにした！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well then... I suppose you will
suffice for now!

fields.EN:
What's the matter? Now, your hands
to my hip...
fields.JP: ……どうしたのだ？　さあ、ワレの腰に手を
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter? Now, your hands
to my hip...

fields.EN:
I will show you how to waltz. See,
you move your foot like... so.
fields.JP:
ワルツ、という踊りの作法なのだ。
……いいか？　こう、足を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will show you how to waltz. See,
you move your foot like... so.

fields.EN: Heh... Not bad at all, Jack.
fields.JP: ふふ……なかなか筋がいいぞ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh... Not bad at all, Jack.

fields.EN:
(I have no idea whether I'm really
dancing well or not, but...)
fields.JP: （うまく踊れてるのか、わからないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have no idea whether I'm really
dancing well or not, but...)

fields.JP: （ハーメルンの歌声、綺麗だな……）
みんな、あんまり離れちゃ駄目だからねー！
うーーー。おなかすいたー

fields.EN:
And, no catching Marchens or
eating the Jail.
fields.JP:
メルヒェン獲りに行ったりジェイル食べたり
するのも駄目だからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, no catching Marchens or
eating the Jail.

fields.JP: うー。あかあかきびしーー
fields.LOCALIZED: Urrh... Red Riding Hood so mean...

fields.EN: Rapu-Rapu, I brought us some sweets!
fields.JP: ラプラプ、お菓子持ってきましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Rappy, I brought us some sweets!

fields.EN:
(Heh... Everyone looks a bit more
relaxed now...)
fields.JP: （はは……みんなもほっとしてるみたいだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Heh... Everyone looks a bit more
relaxed now...)

fields.EN:
(I feel a bit tired, though... I
guess it was great timing that we
got to rest for now...)
fields.JP:
（でも……ちょっと疲れたな……
　休憩取れて助かったかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel a bit tired, though... I
guess it was great timing that we
got to rest for now...)

fields.JP: （すごく悲しそうな顔してる……）

fields.EN:
What's the matter? You should stay
close to everyone...
fields.JP: どうしたの？　あんまり離れないほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter? You should stay
close to everyone...

fields.EN:
Everyone says... that my way of
battling is not good. But I don't
know what they mean by that...
fields.JP:
みんなが……口を揃えて言うのだ。
ワレの戦い方が、なっていないと……
だが……ワレには何が不味いのか、わからぬ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone says... that my way of
battling is not good. But I don't
know what they mean by that...

fields.EN:
They said that... I'm causing
disorder with my lack of
teamwork...
fields.JP:
その……ワレだけ、チームワークが悪いと……
皆の輪を乱していると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They said that... I'm causing
disorder with my lack of
teamwork...

fields.EN:
(It's true that she tends to go in
solo, but it's not like everyone's
fighting in unison all the time.)
fields.JP:
（確かにハーメルンはスタンドプレーが多いけど
　……でもみんな別に、めちゃくちゃ息を合わせて
　るってわけでもないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's true that she tends to go in
solo, but it's not like everyone's
fighting in unison all the time.)

fields.EN: What... What am I supposed to do?!
fields.JP:
ワレは……ワレは一体どうすれば良いのだ……？
さっぱり分からぬ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: What... What am I supposed to do?!

fields.EN:
(Wait... Maybe it looks
like Hameln isn't trying
to join everyone?)
fields.JP:
（……あ。ひょっとしたら、ハーメルンがみんなの
　輪に入ろうとしてないように見えてるんじゃ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... Is she trying to fit
in...?)

fields.JP: 何だ？　何でも申すが良い

fields.EN:
Maybe they're saying that you
should fight with us as an ally
and not as an enemy.
fields.JP:
周りにいるのは敵じゃなくて、味方だってことを
意識して戦えってこと……じゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe they're saying that you
should fight with us as an ally
and not as an enemy.

fields.JP: ……貴様は一体、何を言っているのだ？

fields.EN:
I joined you all. Of course I know
you are my allies!
fields.JP:
……このワレが、仲間になると言ったのだ。
貴様らが味方だという事くらい、分かっておるに
決まっておろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I joined you all. Of course I know
you are my allies!

fields.EN:
Um, that's not what I was trying
to say... I just think that they
still don't know you well, and...
fields.JP:
えっと、そういう事じゃなくて……
多分まだみんな、ハーメルンのことが、ちゃんと
わかってないというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, that's not what I was trying
to say... I just think that they
still don't know you well, and...

fields.EN:
Don't know me?! I am one with
you all! And yet, what is it that
you don't know about me?!
fields.JP:
わかっていないだと！？
……ワレは、間違いなく貴様らの仲間だ！
なのに……一体何がわからんというのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't know me?! I am one with
you all! And yet, what is it that
you don't know about me?!

fields.EN:
O-Of course we know that! But,
you only joined us recently, so...
fields.JP:
そ、それはもちろんわかってるよ！
でも、まだ仲間になって日が浅いから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course we know that! But,
you only joined us recently, so...

fields.EN:
You feel a bit distant from us
both in battle and in your daily
life... But we can get to...
fields.JP:
普段の生活や作戦でも、まだ微妙に距離を感じてる
んじゃって……でも、それはこれから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You feel a bit distant from us
both in battle and in your daily
life... But we can get to...

fields.EN:
Enough! Distance?! Daily life?! I
have no idea what you are trying
to say!
fields.JP:
……もうよい！！
距離だの生活だの……ワレにはさっぱりわからぬ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enough! Distance?! Daily life?! I
have no idea what you are trying
to say!

fields.EN:
(How else was I supposed to
approach her...?)
fields.JP: （……どう言えばよかったんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How else was I supposed to
approach her...?)

fields.JP:
（ハーメルン、あの時以来ずっと元気がない
　気がする……）

fields.EN:
(I wonder how I can get through to
her...)
fields.JP: （……どう言ったらうまく伝わるかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder how I can get through to
her...)

fields.EN:
Urrh... I can't figure it out! Not
one bit!
fields.JP:
むううう……ぬう……
やはりワレにはさっぱり分からん！
分からんぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... I can't figure it out! Not
one bit!

fields.EN:
(What's with those stacks of
manga? The titles look like
they're about friendship...)
fields.JP:
（ま、漫画の山……？
　しかもなんだかやたら熱血友情っぽい？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's with those stacks of
manga? The titles look like
they're about friendship...)

fields.EN:
Hm, it's you, Jack. What are you
doing standing over theyur? Come
in.
fields.JP:
む……ジャックか。
何をそんなところで突っ立っていりゅ？
……入ってよいぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, it's you, Jack. What are you
doing standing over theyur? Come
in.

fields.EN:
These? I borrowed them from
Gretel.
fields.JP:
これか？
これはな……グレーテルに借りたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
These? I borrowed them from
Gretel.

fields.EN:
(I knew Gretel had a lot of books
with her, but I didn't expect her
to have manga, too...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテル、確かに本はいっぱい持ってる
　けど……漫画もあったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I knew Gretel had a lot of books
with her, but I didn't expect her
to have manga, too...)

fields.EN:
W-Well... I wanted to know what
this "teamwork" was about...
fields.JP:
そ、それはだな……
チームワークというのが一体何なのか……
その、ワレも知りたくてだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... I wanted to know what
this "teamwork" was about...

fields.EN:
But...! I can't figure out what
it is, no matter how many times I
read about it!
fields.JP:
……だが！！
何度読んでも……どういう事なのか、
やはりさっっっっぱり分からぬ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...! I can't figure out what
it is, no matter how many times I
read about it!

fields.EN:
I've been alone from birth, so I
have no idea what else to refer
to.
fields.JP:
ワレは……生まれてからずっと、一人だった故、
何を参考にすれば良いのか分からぬのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been alone from birth, so I
have no idea what else to refer
to.

fields.EN:
I, too, know that I need to
change, but... I don't know how...
fields.JP:
もちろん、このままではいけないとも思う……
だが、何をどうすれば良いのか、分からぬのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I, too, know that I need to
change, but... I don't know how...

fields.EN:
(She's trying her best to figure
things out...)
fields.JP: （この子なりに、必死で考えてたんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's trying her best to figure
things out...)

fields.EN:
Hameln, um... I'm sorry about last
time...
fields.JP: ハーメルン。……この間は……ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, um... I'm sorry about last
time...

fields.EN:
I couldn't explain myself very
well, and... I think I confused
you with what I said.
fields.JP:
この前はなんだか、うまく説明できなくて……
君を混乱させちゃったみたいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't explain myself very
well, and... I think I confused
you with what I said.

fields.EN:
I was already confused to start
with. That was no fault of
yours...
fields.JP:
ワレが勝手に混乱した故、別に気にしてなど
おらぬが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was already confused to start
with. That was no fault of
yours...

fields.EN:
(I guess she's really honest at
heart...)
fields.JP: （基本的には素直な子、なんだよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess she's really honest at
heart...)

fields.EN:
Everyone thinks of you as their
friend, Hameln... I feel the same
way, too...
fields.JP:
みんな、ハーメルンの事は……
ハーメルンが思ってる以上にちゃんと仲間だって
思ってるよ。もちろん僕だって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone thinks of you as their
friend, Hameln... I feel the same
way, too...

fields.EN:
Yes, but... I think everyone wants
you to rely on them a bit more.
And they want to rely on you, too.
fields.JP:
うん。ただ……
きっと皆、君にもっと頼ってほしいんだよ。
そして、君を頼りたいとも思ってる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but... I think everyone wants
you to rely on them a bit more.
And they want to rely on you, too.

fields.EN:
Really...? But, I don't understand
that concept very well...
fields.JP:
頼り……頼られる……？
だが……ワレは……それがどういうことなのか、
よくわからなくてな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really...? But, I don't understand
that concept very well...

fields.EN:
As the greatest among you all, my
leading the charge would protect
everyone else.
fields.JP:
たとえば……最強のワレが前面に立って戦えば、
結果的にはみんなを守れるのではないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the greatest among you all, my
leading the charge would protect
everyone else.

fields.EN:
You are strong, but that doesn't
mean you're immortal, right?
fields.JP:
確かに君は強いけど、それでも不死ってわけ
じゃないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are strong, but that doesn't
mean you're immortal, right?

fields.JP: む……それは確かに、そうだが……

fields.EN:
That's why everyone's worried
about you. No one wants to see
you hurt, or even worse, die...
fields.JP:
だから、みんなはそんな君を心配してるんだよ。
ハーメルンだけがひどい怪我をしたり、死んだり
なんか、誰もしてほしくないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why everyone's worried
about you. No one wants to see
you hurt, or even worse, die...

fields.EN: Of course, I feel the same way...
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course, I feel the same way...

fields.EN:
We don't know what kind of enemies
we're going to have to face.
That's we should help each other.
fields.JP:
これからだって、どんな強敵が現れるか、
わからないし……
だからこそ、みんなで協力し合いたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know what kind of enemies
we're going to have to face.
That's we should help each other.

fields.EN:
Is that what it means to be this
"friend" you mentioned?
fields.JP: ……それが、仲間、ということなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that what it means to be this
"friend" you mentioned?

fields.EN:
(Did I finally get through to
her...?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did I finally get through to
her...?)

fields.EN:
Jack... I want you to follow me to
a certain place. Will you come
with me?
fields.JP:
……ジャックよ。
貴様に、一緒に来てほしい場所がある。
……ついてきてくれるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I want you to follow me to
a certain place. Will you come
with me?

fields.EN:
I found this place while I was
strolling the area. It is my
favorite special place.
fields.JP:
この間、散歩していて見つけたのだ。
……ワレのお気に入りの場所なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found this place while I was
strolling the area. It is my
favorite special place.

fields.EN:
I see... But, why are you showing
me a place that's special to you?
fields.JP:
そうなんだ……！
でも、どうしてそんな大切な場所に、僕を……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... But, why are you showing
me a place that's special to you?

fields.EN:
I learned through the manga I read
that a special place is needed to
come to a resolution with friends.
fields.JP:
な、仲間と和解し誓い合う時には、
『とっておきの場所』でするのだと……
そう、漫画で学んだのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I learned through the manga I read
that a special place is needed to
come to a resolution with friends.

fields.EN:
That's why I brought you here...
So that I can pledge myself as a
"friend."
fields.JP: だから、その……改めて仲間の誓いをしたいのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I brought you here...
So that I can pledge myself as a
"friend."

fields.EN:
Thanks, and... I hope we all can
be the best of friends!
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ……！
これからも、よろしく……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, and... I hope we all can
be the best of friends!

fields.EN:
I appreciate it, Jack... Now then,
let's join hands!
fields.JP:
感謝するぞ、ジャック……
よし！　では、手を握ろうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate it, Jack... Now then,
let's join hands!

fields.EN:
Why are you blushing? Are you
prepared to deny my wish?
fields.JP:
何を照れておるのだ？
ワレがこうしたいのだ……よいだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you blushing? Are you
prepared to deny my wish?

fields.EN:
(Her hands are soft and small... I
can tell she's no different from
any other girl...)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンの手、小さくて、柔らかい……
　こういうところは、普通の女の子と変わらない
　んだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her hands are soft and small... I
can tell she's no different from
any other girl...)

fields.EN:
In all honesty, I still don't know
what it means to be friends, given
my solitary life.
fields.JP:
ずっと一人で生きてきたワレにはきっとまだ、
仲間というものが、正直、よく分かっておらぬ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In all honesty, I still don't know
what it means to be friends, given
my solitary life.

fields.EN:
I once met some humans underground. They
were a group of five who said they were
companions trying to escape together.
fields.JP:
以前、地下で人間に会ったことがある。
五人組で、共に脱獄を目指す仲間だと言っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Previously, I met humans in my
abode who said they were friends
seeking to escape...

fields.EN:
I couldn't understand what they were
saying at all. Then they told me I couldn't
understand because I had no companions...
fields.JP:
その時は、そいつらの言うことが全く分からなかった。
するとそいつらは、仲間がいないから分からないんだ、
と言った……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't understand what they were
talking about, as I had not had
anyone around to call friends.

fields.EN:
But... I understand how you and
everyone else care about me. Someday,
I must apologize to everyone too...
fields.JP:
だが……ワレを大切に思ってくれているという、
貴様やみんなの気持ちは承知した。
いずれ、みんなにも謝らねばな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand everyone is concerned
about me, and I appreciate that.
One day, I will let everyone know.

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm sure everyone would love
to hear that from you!
fields.JP: うん……きっとみんな、喜ぶよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm sure everyone would love
to hear that from you!

fields.EN:
And you, Jack... I give you this
sight as proof of my friendship to
you. We shall escape together!
fields.JP:
そして、ジャック……
この景色を、我々の友情の証としよう。
共に、必ずや脱獄を果たそうぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you, Jack... I give you this
sight as proof of my friendship to
you. We shall escape together!

fields.EN:
Say, Jack... Might I ask you a
question?
fields.JP: なあ……ジャック。一つ聞いてもよいか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack... Might I ask you a
question?

fields.JP: （ハーメルン、何だか不安そうだ……）

fields.EN:
After we escape, what will happen
to us?
fields.JP:
もし、脱獄に成功したら……
その後、我々はどうなるのだろうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
After we escape, what will happen
to us?

fields.EN:
I promised you that we will escape
here, and I set that as my goal...
fields.JP:
ワレは、貴様にこの間誓った……
この監獄からの、脱獄を。
だから、それを目標にこれまでやってきた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promised you that we will escape
here, and I set that as my goal...

fields.EN:
But, what happens when we succeed?
What should I live for? The
thought is bearing down on me...
fields.JP:
だが……それが終わったら、ワレはどうなる？
何を目標に生きれば良い？
それを考えていると、ふと不安になってな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, what happens when we succeed?
What should I live for? The
thought is bearing down on me...

fields.EN:
I understand how you feel... I get
anxious thinking about it
sometimes, too...
fields.JP:
僕も……君の気持ちはわかるよ。
時々、不安になることもあるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand how you feel... I get
anxious thinking about it
sometimes, too...

fields.EN:
I see... So what lies in wait
beyond that?
fields.JP:
貴様もやはり、そうか……
我々は、この先一体……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So what lies in wait
beyond that?

fields.EN:
I don't know what to expect after
we escape, but I feel like
something is going to change...
fields.JP:
……ここを出た後のことなんかわからないし、
よくわからないけど、何かが大きく変わって
しまいそうな、そんな気もするんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what to expect after
we escape, but I feel like
something is going to change...

fields.EN:
What I do know is that we will
always be friends. That won't
change a bit.
fields.JP:
でも、一つだけはっきりしてる事がある。
それは……僕たちが仲間だって事だよ。
ここを出た後でも、それは変わらないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I do know is that we will
always be friends. That won't
change a bit.

fields.EN:
So maybe you can hold that thought
until after we escape. It isn't
careful planning, that's for sure.
fields.JP:
だから……その先の事は、その時に考えれば
いいんじゃないかな？
行き当たりばったりかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So maybe you can hold that thought
until after we escape. It isn't
careful planning, that's for sure.

fields.EN:
Hahahahaha! You're right! I can't
believe I was concerned over such
a simple matter.
fields.JP:
ふ……ふははははは……！
確かに、貴様の言うとおりだ。
ワレは何を簡単な事で悩んでいたのだろうな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahahaha! You're right! I can't
believe I was concerned over such
a simple matter.

fields.EN:
And to think that I never worried
about the future at all before.
fields.JP:
よくよく考えてみれば、ワレはこれまで、
未来について心配した事など、
生まれてこの方、今まで一度もなかったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And to think that I never worried
about the future at all before.

fields.EN:
But now, I have everyone with
me... I have you... There is
nothing to concern myself with!
fields.JP:
しかも、今は貴様や、仲間達がいる……
何故不安になる必要があろうか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now, I have everyone with
me... I have you... There is
nothing to concern myself with!

fields.EN:
I think you were concerned because
you have friends you care about
now. It's the same for me, too...
fields.JP:
……馬鹿馬鹿しくなんかないよ。
不安になるのは、大切な仲間ができたからだと
思う。僕もそうだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you were concerned because
you have friends you care about
now. It's the same for me, too...

fields.EN:
Jack... You are very kind, aren't
you?
fields.JP:
ジャック……
貴様は、どこまでも優しいのだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... You are very kind, aren't
you?

fields.JP:
……そ、そうだ！
ワレは良い事を思いついたぞ！！

fields.EN:
Once we escape, we shall hold a
grand banquet!
fields.JP:
いつか、ここを脱出した暁には……
ワレと共に盛大な宴を挙げよう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we escape, we shall hold a
grand banquet!

fields.JP: それは良いアイデアだね……！

fields.EN:
O-Of course, it will be for the
two of us...
fields.JP:
も、もちろん……
わ、ワレと貴様の二人だけでな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course, it will be for the
two of us...

fields.JP:
う、ううん、そんなことない！
そうだね……！

fields.EN:
Hm, now I have something to look
forward to after the escape!
Hahahaha!
fields.JP:
ふ……そう考えると、
脱出した後も楽しみになってきおったわ！
はははは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, now I have something to look
forward to after the escape!
Hahahaha!

fields.EN:
Um... Hameln-san? Do you mind I bother
you for a bit?
fields.JP:
あ、あのう……ハーメルンさん。
ちょっとよろしいですこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Hameln? Do you mind I bother
you for a bit?

fields.EN:
Hm...? What is it, out of nowhere...?
I'm eating right now, y'know... *munch*...!
fields.JP:
む……何だ、藪から棒に……？
ワレは今食事中だじょ……もぎゅ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? You mean now? As you can
see, I am currently enjoying my
mail...

fields.EN:
(Cinderella? Is she wanting to eat
with Hameln?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、シンデレラだ。
　ハーメルンとご飯を食べたいのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella? Is she wanting to eat
with Hameln?)

fields.EN: Um... I'm sorry if I'm being presumptuous.
fields.JP: その……差し出がましければすみませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'll leave if you're busy
now...

fields.JP: ん……？　いいからしゃっしゃと申せ

fields.EN:
If you would like, would you mind
if I washed your clothes for you?
fields.JP:
わたくしでよければ、貴女のその服を、
洗って差し上げましてよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you would like, would you mind
if I washed your clothes for you?

fields.EN:
Wh-What?! Are you saying that my
clothes are filthy?!
fields.JP:
な……なん……だと！？
それは貴様……まさか、
ワレの衣装が汚いとでも言うつもりか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What?! Are you saying that my
clothes are filthy?!

fields.EN:
Th-That's not what I meant... I
just...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな事は……
わたくしはただ、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's not what I meant... I
just...

fields.EN:
Then what are you trying to tell
me?!
fields.JP:
でなければ、何故そんなことを申すのだ！？
おかしいではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then what are you trying to tell
me?!

fields.EN:
Yes! You're right! Everyone is
bothered by your dirtiness!
fields.JP:
……ええ！　その通りでしてよ！！
みなさん、迷惑してますわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! You're right! Everyone is
bothered by your dirtiness!

fields.EN:
This is a cafeteria! Have the tact
to at least think about the people
here!
fields.JP:
だいたいここは食堂ですのよ！
少しはそういうことをお気遣いなさっても
よろしいのではありませんこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a cafeteria! Have the tact
to at least think about the people
here!

fields.JP: （こ、これは、間に入ったほうが……！？）
そんなにワレは汚い……のか……？

fields.EN:
I don't believe it... I didn't
notice it at all... How
shameful...
fields.JP:
なんということだ……全く気付かなかった……
このワレが……そのような醜態を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't believe it... I didn't
notice it at all... How
shameful...

fields.EN:
Um, did I make it sound that
bad...? It's just that...
fields.JP:
あ……そ、そこまでは言ってませんわよ……
わ、わたくしはただ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, did I make it sound that
bad...? It's just that...

fields.JP:
……貴女のその服が、だいぶ傷んでいるよう
でしたから……

fields.EN:
I wanted to wash them and patch
them up for you...
fields.JP: ただ、洗って、繕って差し上げたくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to wash them and patch
them up for you...

fields.EN:
I'm so sorry for raising my
voice...
fields.JP:
わたくし、ついカっとなってしまいまして……
すみませんですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry for raising my
voice...

fields.EN:
No, I am the one to apologize. It
seems I doubted you, despite your
profound kindness...
fields.JP:
いや、ワレの方こそ悪かった……
貴様は……とても優しいのだな。
なのに、すまぬ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I am the one to apologize. It
seems I doubted you, despite your
profound kindness...

fields.JP: そ、そんなことはないですわ……！

fields.EN:
(I guess it turned out for the
best... I feel like they each got
through to each other.)
fields.JP:
（な、なんとかなった……！？
　むしろ仲良くなれそうな感じだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess it turned out for the
best... I feel like they each got
through to each other.)

fields.EN:
Very well, then. I would like you
to handle my clothes for me. Just
a moment...
fields.JP:
……では、宜しく頼もう。
……少し待っておれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well, then. I would like you
to handle my clothes for me. Just
a moment...

fields.EN:
Y-You shouldn't be taking off your
clothes in such a public place!
fields.JP:
お、女の子がこんなところで
服を脱いではいけませんですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You shouldn't be taking off your
clothes in such a public place!

fields.EN:
Odd... You were the one who wanted
to wash my clothes. So, here...
fields.JP:
妙な事を……
洗いたいと言ったのは貴様ではないか。
だから今、こうしてだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Odd... You were the one who wanted
to wash my clothes. So, here...

fields.EN:
(Sh-Should I stop her?! B-But that
means I would see her... Uh, but I
did see her already...)
fields.JP:
（ぼ、僕も止めた方がいいのか……！？
　でも、それもずっと見てたようで……
　いや……見てたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sh-Should I stop her?! B-But that
means I would see her... Uh, but I
did see her already...)

fields.EN:
(I know! I'll just slowly back
away, and...)
fields.JP: （よし！　ここは、ひっそりと立ち去って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know! I'll just slowly back
away, and...)

fields.EN:
What do you think you're doing?!
If you saw what happened, go in
and stop it!
fields.JP:
あんた、何コソコソ逃げようとしてんのよ！？
見てたんなら、さっさと止めなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you think you're doing?!
If you saw what happened, go in
and stop it!

fields.EN:
You too, Hameln! This isn't the
place to take your clothes off in!
fields.JP:
アンタもよ、ハーメルン！
ここで服を脱ぐなっつーの！
そういう場所じゃないんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Hameln! This isn't the
place to take your clothes off in!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... I don't know why
you need to yell like that,
though...
fields.JP:
す、すまぬ……
しかし、そんなに大きな声を出さなくても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... I don't know why
you need to yell like that,
though...

fields.EN:
Your voice is louder than this
most of the time!
fields.JP: アンタの普段の声のほうがよっぽど大きいわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your voice is louder than this
most of the time!

fields.EN:
Unbelievable! It's like I'm
surrounded by a bunch of idiots!
fields.JP:
まったく、どいつもこいつも……！
バカばっかりなんだから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable! It's like I'm
surrounded by a bunch of idiots!

fields.JP:
をーほほほほほ！
さすが親指姫さんの一喝ですわね！

fields.EN:
You too, Cinderella! You're not as
tough as you look!
fields.JP:
アンタもよ、シンデレラ。
こう見えて弱腰なんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Cinderella! You're not as
tough as you look!

fields.JP: うう……すみませんですわ……
ほら、マント引きずってるわよ

fields.EN:
Now stop bothering me from eating
my food, you hear?
fields.JP:
まったく、
食事くらい落ち着いてさせなさいよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now stop bothering me from eating
my food, you hear?

fields.EN:
(Got to hand it to Oyayubihime for
putting things in order...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Got to hand it to Thumbelina for
putting things in order...)

fields.JP: ひゃぁぁあああああああっ！！？

（今の声は……ハーメルン！？
　何があったんだ！？）

ハーメルン！？
どうしたの……！？

fields.EN:
(What in the world is she doing,
using her power?! What's going on
here?!)
fields.JP:
（めちゃくちゃ興奮してる……？
　ていうか、普通に能力使ってるし！？
　な……何があったんだ！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What in the world is she doing,
using her power?! What's going on
here?!)

fields.EN:
I will end your life, you
worthless bug! You will
pay for surprising me!
fields.JP:
絶対……殺す……！！
身の程知らずの虫ケラめ……！！
ワレを驚かせた事を、後悔するがよい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will end your life, you
worthless bug! You will
pay for surprising me!

fields.EN:
B-Bug...? Wait... Is this all
about a bug?
fields.JP:
む……虫？
もしかして……部屋に虫が出たの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-Bug...? Wait... Is this all
about a bug?

fields.EN:
Damn you, bug! How dare you come
at me from behind! I shall kill
you! Die!
fields.JP:
くそう、虫ケラめ！
いきなり背後からとは卑怯な……！！
絶対殺す！　とにかく殺す！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn you, bug! How dare you come
at me from behind! I shall kill
you! Die!

fields.EN:
C-Calm down, Hameln! P-Parts of
your room are on fire!
fields.JP:
お、落ち着いてハーメルン！！
部屋ちょっと燃えてるし！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
C-Calm down, Hameln! P-Parts of
your room are on fire!

fields.EN:
(How can someone who lived among
Marchens be so scared of bugs?)
fields.JP:
（……っていうか、メルヒェンを子分にしてた
　ような子が、何で虫に怯えてるわけ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How can someone who lived among
Marchens be so scared of bugs?)

fields.EN:
It's probably gone already! J-Just
hold off on the flames, and...
fields.JP:
た、多分虫はもう、どこかに行っちゃったよ！
とりあえず、その炎を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's probably gone already! J-Just
hold off on the flames, and...

fields.EN:
No! I have not confirmed its
carcass yet! Where are you?! Bug!
fields.JP:
ダメだ！！
奴の死骸をまだ確認できておらん！！
どこだ！　虫ケラめ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! I have not confirmed its
carcass yet! Where are you?! Bug!

fields.EN:
(She's not listening! I need to at
least put out the fire in here!)
fields.JP:
（ダメだ、聞く耳持ってくれない……！
　とりあえず、火の方をなんとかしなくちゃ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's not listening! I need to at
least put out the fire in here!)

fields.EN:
I know! I'll get water from the
bathroom...!
fields.JP:
……そうだ！　
風呂場に行けば、水が……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! I'll get water from the
bathroom...!

fields.EN:
All right! This should do! And...
there!
fields.JP:
よし、これで……！！
それっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! This should do! And...
there!

fields.JP:
ひゃあっ！！？
つ、冷たいいぃい！？

……あ……あれ……？
ジャックではないか……

fields.EN:
Finally got the fire doused... Are
you okay now?
fields.JP:
よかった……火も消えたし、
なんとか落ち着いた……みたいだね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally got the fire doused... Are
you okay now?

fields.JP: ジャック……わ、ワレは、一体……

fields.EN:
(H-Her clothes are hardly covering
anything! I-I need to look away!)
fields.JP:
（って、この格好……ほとんど裸だし……！？
　とにかく……み、見ちゃダメだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(H-Her clothes are hardly covering
anything! I-I need to look away!)

fields.JP:
もしかして、ジャックが……
ワレを助けてくれたのか？

fields.EN:
Uh, well... "Rescue" isn't really
the right word to use...
fields.JP:
い、いや……助けたっていうか……
なんというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... "Rescue" isn't really
the right word to use...

fields.EN: Well done, Jack! I praise thee!
fields.JP:
……よくやったジャック！！
褒めて遣わすぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Well done, Jack! I praise thee!

fields.EN:
Uh, but I didn't... Um, before
that...
fields.JP:
い、いや、そんな事は……
っていうか、あの、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but I didn't... Um, before
that...

fields.EN:
What's the matter? You seem quite
flustered.
fields.JP:
どうした？
何を慌てておるのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter? You seem quite
flustered.

fields.JP: い、いや……なんでもないです……！

fields.EN:
(Well, it's because I can't look
at you like that now...)
fields.JP: （……め、目のやり場に困るんですけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, it's because I can't look
at you like that now...)

fields.JP: （あれ？　アリスと……ハーメルンだ）

……む！？
これは……お嬢ではないか……！

fields.EN:
Oh, Hameln? It's unusual to see
you here.
fields.JP:
あら、ハーメルン。
こんなところで会うなんて、奇遇ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Hameln? It's unusual to see
you here.

fields.EN:
S-So true! But... What, may I ask,
are you doing here?
fields.JP:
そ、そうであるな……！
しかし……こんな所で、一体何を？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So true! But... What, may I ask,
are you doing here?

fields.EN: I was just taking a walk...
fields.JP: 何って……ただの散歩だけれど……？
fields.LOCALIZED: I was just taking a walk...

fields.EN:
Wha--?! This is no place for a
lady such as yourself to walk
through alone!
fields.JP:
なっ！？
こんな危ない通りで女性が一人で散歩だなどと
……危険すぎるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha--?! This is no place for a
lady such as yourself to walk
through alone!

fields.EN:
Hm? You're making it sound like
this place is dangerous. I don't
see it that way...
fields.JP:
え？　ここって、そんなに危ないの？
そんなイメージはなかったけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? You're making it sound like
this place is dangerous. I don't
see it that way...

fields.EN:
Very well! Let me escort you for
safety!
fields.JP:
よし！　ワレが……お供して差し上げよう！
安心するがよいぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well! Let me escort you for
safety!

fields.JP:
え……？
そ、それはどうも……ありがとう……

fields.EN: It just dawned on me, but...
fields.JP:
……その。
ふと思ったのだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED: It just dawned on me, but...

fields.EN:
You said it wasn't a place for a
lady to walk through, but...
you're a girl, too.
fields.JP:
さっき、女性の一人歩きは危ないって
言ってたけれど……よく考えたら、
あなたも、女の子よね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said it wasn't a place for a
lady to walk through, but...
you're a girl, too.

fields.EN:
Hmph! But I am the Demon King!
Guarding m'lady is my messhon!
fields.JP:
ふ……ワレは、魔王だ！
よって、お嬢を守るのは我が義務じょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! But I am the Demon King!
Guarding m'lady is my messhon!

fields.EN:
The shoes in the storefront would
surely suit you, m'lady! Might I
suggest you try them on?
fields.JP:
あの店に置いてあるあの靴……
きっとお嬢に似合おうぞ！
試してみてはいかがか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The shoes in the storefront would
surely suit you, m'lady! Might I
suggest you try them on?

fields.EN:
Huh? Do you think so? Well, they
do look cute, but I'm not sure
they would fit my feet...
fields.JP:
え？　そ……そうかしら？
確かに、可愛い靴だけれど……
足のサイズ、合うかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Do you think so? Well, they
do look cute, but I'm not sure
they would fit my feet...

fields.EN:
Ah, feet! M'lady! With all this
walking, you must be tired now!
fields.JP:
はっ……足といえば！
お嬢！　そろそろ疲れたのではないか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, feet! M'lady! With all this
walking, you must be tired now!

fields.JP:
え……？
い、いえ、別にそんなには……

fields.EN:
A-Are you sure?! You need not
force yourself...
fields.JP:
ほ、本当でありゅか！？
無理をしているのでは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-Are you sure?! You need not
force yourself...

fields.EN:
A-Are you all right? Your mantle's
caught on the wall!
fields.JP:
あ、あなたこそ……大丈夫！？
マントが壁に引っかかっているわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-Are you all right? Your mantle's
caught on the wall!

fields.EN:
I-I am fine! A-Are you all right,
m'lady?!
fields.JP:
わ、ワレは……大丈夫だ！
それより、お嬢はご無事か！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I am fine! A-Are you all right,
m'lady?!

fields.JP:
え？
わ、わたしは大丈夫だけど……

fields.EN:
Look at you... You scraped
yourself... Heh... You're such a
handful, Demon King.
fields.JP:
……ちょっと擦りむいてるじゃない。
ふふ……手のかかる魔王様ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at you... You scraped
yourself... Heh... You're such a
handful, Demon King.

fields.EN:
Here, let me look at your feet.
I'll patch you up.
fields.JP:
ちょっと、足を見せてみなさい。
手当てしてあげるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, let me look at your feet.
I'll patch you up.

fields.EN:
I guess I can't keep my eyes off
of you for a second...
fields.JP:
まったく、なんだかんだ目が離せないのよね。
この子は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I can't keep my eyes off
of you for a second...

fields.EN:
(I'd better not interrupt their
private time together...)
fields.JP:
（せっかく仲良さそうだし……
　邪魔するのはよくないかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'd better not interrupt their
private time together...)

fields.EN:
Tsuu and Ningyohime-san must feel uneasy
in a different environment... There aren't
enough rooms, so they have to share one...
fields.JP:
つうと人魚姫さん、きっと前と
環境が違ってて落ち着かないだろうな……
部屋も足りなくて、２人一緒だし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and Little Mermaid must
feel uneasy right now...
Not like they have privacy, too...

fields.EN:
They won't outright complain about
being in the same room, so maybe
I should bring it up from my side.
fields.JP:
でも不便でも気をつかって
何も言わなそうだし、ここは僕の方から
率先して聞いてあげないとな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They won't outright complain about
being in the same room, so maybe
I should bring it up from my side.

fields.EN:
This is getting awkward...
I mean, it's not like we've had
a lot of time talking as humans...
fields.JP:
でもなんだか緊張するな……
お互い人間の姿でしゃべるのが
久しぶりだからかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is getting awkward...
I mean, it's not like we've had
a lot of time talking as humans...

fields.JP: そこに誰かいるんですか？
あっ！　ジャックさん！

fields.EN:
Whoa! Ningyohime-san!
S-Sorry to have bothered you!
fields.JP:
わわっ、人魚姫さん！
と、突然お邪魔してごめん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Little Mermaid!
S-Sorry to have bothered you!

fields.EN:
I was just wondering if everything
was okay, especially with how
so much has changed...
fields.JP:
その、新しい環境で
何か困ってないかな、なんて思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just wondering if everything
was okay, especially with how
so much has changed...

fields.EN: Yes, I've had no trouble at all.
fields.JP: ううん、全然こまってないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I've had no trouble at all.

fields.EN:
Oh, perfect timing! I wanted to have a proper
talk with you, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
でもちょうどよかった！
わたしもジャックさんと改めて
お話したかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but perfect timing!
I wanted to talk to you about
something.

fields.JP:
だからタイミングバッチリ！
さ、入って

fields.EN:
Um, what's this you want to
talk about?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, what's this you want to
talk about?

fields.EN:
I'm so happy to spend my time
with Otsuu-chan and everyone.
fields.JP:
ここ数日ね、おつうちゃんや
血式少女のみんなと一緒に過ごして、
わたしとっても幸せなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so happy to spend my time
with Otsuu and everyone.

fields.EN:
And it helps that you're still in human form,
Jack-san.
fields.JP:
それにジャックさんも
人間の姿のままでいてくれてるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also helps seeing you in
human form.

fields.EN: At least I haven't fallen off a cliff here.
fields.JP:
ここでは崖から
落ちたりはしてないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I didn't fall down into
some underground area in
this world.

fields.EN: Right? So, I wanted to thank you.
fields.JP: だからね、改めてお礼を言いたかったの。
fields.LOCALIZED: Right? So, I wanted to thank you.

fields.EN:
Thank you for bringing me back
to life.
fields.JP:
わたしを蘇らせてくれて、
本当にありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for bringing me back
to life.

fields.EN:
Oh no!
I didn't do anything!
fields.JP:
そ、そんな！
僕なんて全然たいしたことしてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no!
I didn't do anything!

fields.EN:
It only happened because the
others were willing to listen to
me...
fields.JP:
血式少女のみんなが
僕のお願いを聞き入れてくれたからで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It only happened because the
others were willing to listen to
me...

fields.EN:
The only one who knows me in
this world is Onee-chan.
fields.JP:
この世界でわたしのことを知っている人は、
血式少女ではおねーちゃんだけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only one who knows me in
this world is Sis.

fields.EN:
No one knew about Otsuu-chan,
and yet everyone pitched in
to help...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんに至っては誰も
知らなかったはず……なのに、
みんな動いてくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one knew about Otsuu,
and yet everyone pitched in
to help...

fields.EN:
That all came about because
of you, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
それはひとえに、
ジャックさんのおかげ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That all came about because
of you, Jack.

fields.EN:
If you hadn't acted, Jack-san, neither
Otsuu-chan nor I would be here now.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんが動いてくれなかったら、
わたしもおつうちゃんも、今ここにいないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you didn't take action, neither
me or Otsuu would be here.

fields.EN: So, thank you so very much.
fields.JP: だから、本当にありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED: So, thank you so very much.

fields.EN:
Y-Yeah... I'm really happy I got to
reunite with both of you like this, too.
fields.JP:
う、うん……
僕も２人とまたこうして再会できて、
本当に嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem at all. I'm happy
that both of you are here now.

fields.EN:
I guess all that adventuring with
Nightmare Jack-san wasn't all for
naught.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアのジャックさんと探索した
日々は、無駄じゃなかったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess all that adventuring with
Nightmare Jack wasn't all for
naught.

fields.EN:
Yeah, we're here now because
of what we went through back
in the other world.
fields.JP:
うん、あの時があったから、
今の僕たちがあるんだもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we're here now because
of what we went through back
in the other world.

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness... Ningyohime-san hasn't
changed at all.)
fields.JP:
（よかった、人魚姫さん、
　全然変わってないや）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness...
She's no different than before.)

fields.EN:
(I thought the new environment
she's in would make her anxious,
but I guess she's fine.)
fields.JP:
（環境が違うから不安かなって思ったけど、
　どうやら大丈夫みたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought the new environment
she's in would make her anxious,
but I guess she's fine.)

fields.JP: あの、今回は本当にさ、その……

fields.EN:
Well, um... I'm sorry I didn't
have the chance to say it,
but...
fields.JP:
いやぁ、僕もバタバタしてて、
その、ちゃんと言えなくて……
悪かったんだけど、さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, um... I'm sorry I didn't
have the chance to say it,
but...

fields.EN:
Y-Yeah... I'm happy I can be
together with you like this again, Tsuu.
fields.JP:
う、うん。またこうして
僕もつうと一緒にいられて、
その……嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm just happy we can talk
like this together.

fields.EN:
Uh, so...
Hope we get along here, too.
fields.JP: その、これからもまた……よろしく
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, so...
Hope we get along here, too.

fields.JP: う、うん……僕の方こそ、よろしく……
何で今さら照れてるの、２人とも

fields.EN:
I-I just remembered what it
was like when I was a Nightmare...
fields.JP:
い、いやちょっと僕がナイトメアだった
時のこと思い出しちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um, it's just that I regained
my memories back when I was a
Nightmare, and...

fields.EN:
I wasn't necessarily bright back
then, and I was living with her,
so...
fields.JP:
あの時は知性なんてなかったけど、
その、一緒の部屋で暮らしてたし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't necessarily bright back
then, and I was living with her,
so...

fields.JP: そ、その言い方はやめてくれ！

うああ、ごめん
つう！

fields.EN:
It's just... It feels like I know what you
were like as a child, so it's embarrassing...
I have mixed feelings about it.
fields.JP:
その……どこか幼い頃を
知ってるみたいで、恥ずかしいというか……
なんだか複雑な気持ちなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, uh, it feels like remembering
childhood days... You know? It's
just embarrassing to remember.

fields.EN:
Ah, I see. Since you were a Nightmare then,
Jack-san, you would've seen Otsuu-chan as she
really is.
fields.JP:
ああ、なるほど。
確かにナイトメアのジャックさんだったら、
素のおつうちゃんを見てるよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see. You were able to see
Otsuu as how she is when you
were a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
How about it, Otsuu-chan? Is Otsuu-chan acting
awkward because you're embarrassed too?
fields.JP:
どうなの、おつうちゃん？
やっぱりおつうちゃんも照れくさいから
ぎこちなくなってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, is that why you're embarrassed
too, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
W-Well, I guess?
But beyond that...
fields.JP: そ、それも確かにあるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I guess?
But beyond that...

fields.EN:
But when I think that everything in the
previous world was caused by me... I feel
especially sorry toward you, Jack...
fields.JP:
けど、前の世界はすべて、
僕が原因だったんだ……って思うと、
特にジャックには申し訳なくて、さ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel awkward because I was the
cause of everything back then...

fields.EN:
Tsuu... I don't resent you at all. If
anything, it's because that world existed
that we can all be together like this now.
fields.JP:
つう……僕は何も恨んでないよ。
むしろあの世界があったから、今こうして
僕たちは一緒にいられるんだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. If it wasn't for the
other world, I wouldn't be here
with you two.

fields.EN:
He's right, Otsuu-chan. You did all
that for me too, right? No need to
put yourself down like that.
fields.JP:
そうだよおつうちゃん……
わたしのためにしてくれたことでしょ？
それならそんなに抱え込まないで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right, Otsuu. You did all
that for me too, right? No need to
put yourself down like that.

fields.EN:
Thanks... Hearing you two just
lifted the heavy burden on me...
fields.JP:
……２人がそう言ってくれると、
救われた気持ちになるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks... Hearing you two just
lifted the heavy burden on me...

fields.EN:
So, about being embarrassed...
What kind of embarrassing thing
happened, Otsuu?
fields.JP:
それで、照れくさいってのは
どんなことがあったのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, about being embarrassed...
What kind of embarrassing thing
happened, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
You have to bring it up again,
don't you?!
fields.JP: 流れたと思ったのに掘り返すの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have to bring it up again,
don't you?!

fields.EN:
I was just embarrassed how Jack
knew what I was thinking with how
our dreams were linked...
fields.JP:
……い、いやジャックには夢を通じて僕の
考えていたことがバレていたって思うと、
恥ずかしいっていうか、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just embarrassed how Jack
knew what I was thinking with how
our dreams were linked...

fields.EN:
No, I mean... my thoughts were completely
out in the open too...
fields.JP:
いや、僕の考えも完全に
ダダ漏れだったっていうか、その……

fields.EN:
(She knows how I kept thinking
about wanting to protect Alice...)
fields.JP:
（僕もずっとアリスを守りたいって
　ことばかり考えていたのが
　伝わってるんだよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She knows how I kept thinking
about wanting to protect Alice...)

fields.EN:
(Yikes! The more I think about
it, the more embarrassing it is!)
fields.JP:
（うわ！　今さらだけど、
　すごく恥ずかしいなこれ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yikes! The more I think about
it, the more embarrassing it is!)

fields.EN:
You two are worrying about the same thing.
You're kind of like siblings.
fields.JP:
同じことで悩んでて、
何か２人とも兄弟みたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You two are like brothers with how
you both are thinking alike.

fields.EN: That... makes a lot of sense.
fields.JP: ……そう言われると何だか納得するかも
fields.LOCALIZED: That... makes a lot of sense.

fields.EN:
I guess we are thinking about
the same kind of things.
fields.JP: 確かに同じことで悩んでるね、僕たち
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we are thinking about
the same kind of things.

fields.EN:
It feels like we have a strange
relationship, but... I look forward
to being with you from now on, Jack.
fields.JP:
何だか変な関係な気もするけど、
これからもよろしくな、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't exactly represent us
two, but... Hope we get along
even better, Jack.

fields.JP: 僕の方こそよろしく、つう

fields.EN:
That's a nice handshake!
Like a sibling pact?
fields.JP:
いい握手だね！
兄弟の契り、みたいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh, a handshake!
So, it's like being soul brothers!

fields.EN:
Jack... I need to talk with you
later on things not to disclose...
fields.JP:
……後で姫やみんなに
話してはいけない話をしに行くから、
時間空けといてくれ……ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I need to talk with you
later on things not to disclose...

fields.EN:
You mean how you were secretly practicing
prince-like lines in your room to make
Ningyohime-san happy...?
fields.JP:
それってつうが部屋でこっそり、
人魚姫さんが喜びそうな王子さまセリフの
練習をしていたこととか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean about how you were
secretly practicing your lines to
make you sound like a prince?

fields.JP: （本当にそういう内容だったの……）

fields.EN:
(I was wondering where everyone
went... What are they doing at
the cafeteria?)
fields.JP:
（みんなどこ行ったかって思ったら、
　食堂に集まってたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was wondering where everyone
went... What are they doing at
the cafeteria?)

fields.EN:
You and Otsuu are really comfy
with each other, but how comfy
are you two? Spill it.
fields.JP:
それで？　おつうと人魚ってすっごく
仲いいけどさ、どういう関係なのよー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You and Otsuu are really comfy
with each other, but how comfy
are you two? Spill it.

fields.EN:
Uh, um... Before we continue,
do you mind I call you how
I used to?
fields.JP:
あ、あのっ……その前に、
また昔と同じ呼び方しても、いい……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, um... Before we continue,
do you mind I call you how
I used to?

fields.EN:
Of course! Call me onee-sama,
aneue, whatever you like!
fields.JP:
もちろん！　おねーさまでも
姉上でも何でも呼んで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! You can call me
"dear sister" or "Sis" or
anything!

fields.JP: あはは！　かわいい奴めー

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, what did Otsuu call me
by?
fields.JP: で？　おつうはあたしを何て呼んでたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, what did Otsuu call me
by?

fields.JP: 赤ずきんは赤ずきんだ
ほんとだーじゃっく、こっちこっち

fields.EN:
Looks like everyone is having
fun.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like everyone is having
fun.

fields.EN:
We were just talking with Otsuu-chan
and Ningyo-chan! Isn't that right,
Oyayubi-neesama?
fields.JP:
今おつうちゃんと人魚ちゃんの
話を聞かせてもらってるんです！
ね、親指姉様？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were just talking with Otsuu
and Mermie! Isn't that right,
sister Thumbelina?

fields.EN:
Yeah, it just feels weird that
they know us, you know?
fields.JP:
ええ、なんか２人はわたしたちを
知ってるというのが不思議な感じよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it just feels weird that
they know us, you know?

fields.JP: とても興味深いわよね

fields.EN:
So, how come you two are so
friendly with each other?
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how come you two are so
friendly with each other?

fields.EN:
Because she was the first person I met,
the person who saved my life, and the
person who showed me the most kindness.
fields.JP:
僕が最初に出会って、命を助けられて、
そして最も優しさをもらった人だからだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because she saved my life
and showed me what kindness
really is.

fields.EN:
That's not true. I survived when I was little
because Otsuu-chan treated me with kindness.
fields.JP:
それはわたしの方だよ。
おつうちゃんが優しくしてくれたから、
幼いわたしは生き延びられたんだもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. She saved me
by treating me with kindness.

fields.EN:
That was back when you were
a Nightmare, right?
fields.JP: それはナイトメアの時の……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was back when you were
a Nightmare, right?

fields.EN:
Yes, and if I didn't meet Princess
back then, I'm sure I would've
perished as a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。あの時姫に出会わなかったら、
僕はきっとナイトメアのままどこかで
のたれ死んでただろうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and if I didn't meet Princess
back then, I'm sure I would've
perished as a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
So that's how you two met?
What an unusual meeting of
fate.
fields.JP:
それが出会いだったんですか～
奇妙なご縁もあるんですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that's how you two met?
What an unusual meeting of
fate.

fields.EN:
Princess saved me from the
Marchens who were attacking me.
fields.JP:
最初は、僕がメルヒェンに
襲われてるところを姫が
助けてくれたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess saved me from the
Marchens who were attacking me.

fields.EN:
I was cowardly back then, and
stayed away from Princess in fear,
even though she saved me...
fields.JP:
でも、その時の僕は臆病で、
助けてもらったのに姫を
怖がってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was cowardly back then, and
stayed away from Princess in fear,
even though she saved me...

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. I did enter my
Genocide state, you know? Oh, and
you're the one who saved me.
fields.JP:
しょうがないよ、あの時のわたしは
ジェノサイド化してたんだから。
それに、助かったのはわたしの方だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped. I did enter my
Massacre state, you know? Oh, and
you're the one who saved me.

fields.EN:
You saved me from my solitude
by staying with me, even if it was
from afar.
fields.JP:
あの時孤独だったわたしと、
遠巻きにでも交流を続けてくれたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You saved me from my solitude
by staying with me, even if it was
from afar.

fields.EN:
To repay Princess for what she's
done, I left food for her to which
she responded with her singing.
fields.JP:
その後、僕は姫に何かお礼がしたくて、
出会った場所に食料を置いてみたんだ。
そうしたら、歌声でお返しをしてくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
To repay Princess for what she's
done, I left food for her to which
she responded with her singing.

fields.EN:
That was about all I could do.
I'm sorry I was too scared to
show myself to you...
fields.JP:
できることがあれしかなかったから……
あの時は、怯えて顔も出せずにごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was about all I could do.
I'm sorry I was too scared to
show myself to you...

fields.EN:
That can't be helped.
I was a Nightmare after all.
fields.JP:
それも仕方ない。あの時の僕は、
ナイトメアだったんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
That can't be helped.
I was a Nightmare after all.

fields.EN:
Singing! That's so wonderful!
Such a great way to show your
gratitude!
fields.JP:
歌ですか！　いいですね、そのお返し。
何だかとても素敵です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Singing! That's so wonderful!
Such a great way to show your
gratitude!

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, I recall
hearing Ningyohime's singing
from that microphone.
fields.JP:
おお、そういえばマイクとやらに
人魚姫の歌声らしきものが入っておったな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, I recall
hearing Little Mermaid's singing
from that microphone.

fields.EN:
I was a bit farther back and
couldn't hear properly, but is
Ningyo-chan really a good singer?
fields.JP:
白雪、あの時は後ろの方にいたので
ちゃんと聞けなかったのですが、やっぱり
人魚ちゃんは歌、上手いんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was a bit farther away, so I
couldn't hear, but was her singing
beautiful as I think it is?

fields.EN:
Why, of course!
I would pay anything to get
to hear her sing!
fields.JP:
それはもちろん！
姫の歌は何を犠牲にしても聴く価値のある
最っ高のものさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, of course!
I would pay anything to get
to hear her sing!

fields.EN: Really? Well then, let's hear it.
fields.JP: へぇ～、それはぜひ聴かせてもらいたいね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? Well then, let's hear it.

fields.EN:
O-Otsuu-chan!
Please, you're making it difficult
for me!
fields.JP:
お、おつうちゃん！
ハードル上げないでよ～！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Otsuu!
Please, you're making it difficult
for me!

fields.JP:
おねーちゃん、
それはまた今度ってことで……

fields.EN: Ooh! Otsuu, why you a prince?
fields.JP:
そういえば、おつうーはどうして
おうじさまなの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ooh! Otsuu, why you a prince?

fields.EN:
That's something I wanted to
ask, too.
fields.JP: それは私も興味があるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's something I wanted to
ask, too.

fields.JP: ほらほら、教えなさいよー

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san can be a bit
pushy at times...)
fields.JP: （赤ずきんさん、ぐいぐい行くなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood can be a bit
pushy at times...)

fields.EN:
Oh, uh, it just means that we're
so close to each other that it's
like we're married...
fields.JP:
そのっ、おしどり夫婦って言葉くらいに
仲良くいたいねって意味で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh, it just means that we're
so close to each other that it's
like we're married...

fields.EN:
No... Um, we took our vows in
marriage...
fields.JP: ……ううん、夫婦の契り……交わした仲です
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... Um, we took our vows in
marriage...

fields.EN: Uh, I don't know what to say...
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, I don't know what to say...

fields.EN:
Love can take different forms.
I don't see anything wrong with
what you just told me.
fields.JP:
そうね。でも愛のカタチは人それぞれ、
素敵なことじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Love can take different forms.
I don't see anything wrong with
what you just told me.

fields.EN:
This was back in the other world
I presume.
fields.JP: それは『前の』世界で、かしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
This was back in the other world
I presume.

fields.EN:
Yeah... My wish to see Princess
again came true, so I offered my
hand in marriage when we met.
fields.JP:
うん……そうだよ。念願叶って
姫に再会できたんだ、だから出会った時に
プロポーズを……したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... My wish to see Princess
again came true, so I offered my
hand in marriage when we met.

fields.EN:
But Otsuu-chan asked me to take
her as my wife.
fields.JP:
でもね、おつうちゃんってば
『お嫁さんにして下さい』って言うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Otsuu asked me to take
her as my wife.

fields.EN:
I'm not exactly the husband type, and
having two brides would be... so I
blurted out, 'Then become my prince.'
fields.JP:
わたしはお婿さんって感じじゃないし、
お嫁さん２人じゃ……って思って、とっさに
『だったら王子さまになって』って言ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not the husband-type,
so I just asked her to become
my prince.

fields.EN:
Oh, so is that why Otsuu is trying
to act like a prince?
fields.JP:
それでおつうは王子さまな感じに
振る舞ってるんですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so is that why Otsuu is trying
to act like a prince?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-san is more the princely type
don't you think, Jack?
fields.JP:
確かにおつうさんの方が
王子さまっぽいわよね、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu is more the princely type
don't you think, Jack?

fields.EN:
Yeah, but despite her looks, she's
very much like any normal girl...
fields.JP:
そうだね。でも、こう見えても
つうは意外と女の子っぽいとこ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but despite her looks, she's
very much like any normal girl...

fields.EN:
Excuse me, Jack?!
I-I would never exhibit such...
fields.JP:
ジャック！？　何を言ってるんだ！？
ぼ、僕にそんなとこあるわけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Excuse me, Jack?!
I-I would never exhibit such...

fields.EN:
Jack... How much of Otsuu-san
do you really know?
fields.JP:
ちょっとジャック、あなたおつうさんの
そんな深いところまで知ってるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... How much of Otsuu
do you really know?

fields.EN:
S-Sorry! B-But, didn't I explain
to you about the other world?!
fields.JP:
ごご、ごめん！　ってかアリスには
説明しといたよね！？　前の世界のこと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry! B-But, didn't I explain
to you about the other world?!

fields.EN:
That's right. You were a Nightmare
and Otsuu-san needed to be with you
to prevent you from going wild.
fields.JP:
そ、そうね。ジャックは前の世界では
ナイトメアで、おつうさんのそばじゃないと
暴走の可能性があったのよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. You were a Nightmare
and Otsuu needed to be with you
to prevent you from going wild.

fields.EN:
Um, when it comes to going wild
you were a bit of that, Alice...
fields.JP:
ま、まあどっちかというと
暴走したのはアリスだった感あるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, when it comes to going wild
you were a bit of that, Alice...

fields.EN:
Um, I'm not sure what happened,
but... I'm sorry.
fields.JP:
なんだかわからないけれど……
それはごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'm not sure what happened,
but... I'm sorry.

fields.EN:
Heh heh, it's nothing for you
to apologize about. I'm just happy
I can talk to you like this now.
fields.JP:
はははっ、今のアリスが謝ることじゃないよ。
君とこんな風に話せるなんて嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, it's nothing for you
to apologize about. I'm just happy
I can talk to you like this now.

fields.JP: そうだね、おつうちゃん

ねえ、他のみんなは
どんな感じだったの？

fields.EN:
You always seemed dependable,
onee-chan, but Otsuu-chan was
always saying you were reckless.
fields.JP:
おねーちゃんは頼りがいのある感じ
だったけど、いつもおつうちゃんに
危なっかしいって言われてたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were reliable as ever, but
Otsuu kept trying to calm you down
to avoid getting into trouble.

fields.EN:
I see...
In other words, she was the same.
fields.JP: なるほど、変わらないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
In other words, she was the same.

fields.EN: H-Hey, I don't get into trouble!
fields.JP: あ、危なっかしくなんてないっての！
fields.LOCALIZED: H-Hey, I don't get into trouble!

fields.EN:
Gretel was always calm, and gave
us a lot of sound decisions, even
in the harshest of times.
fields.JP:
グレーテルは冷静でいつも
戦況を見極めてくれたり、たくさんの
助言をくれたりしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel was always calm, and gave
us a lot of sound decisions, even
in the harshest of times.

fields.EN:
You were also very inquisitive,
and kept bugging Otsuu-chan for
answers.
fields.JP:
好奇心が強くて、おつうちゃん
いつも質問攻めにあってたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were also very inquisitive,
and kept bugging Otsuu for
answers.

fields.EN:
I wouldn't have expected
any less of myself.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't have expected
any less of myself.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel... referred to Princess
as looking delicious...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは姫のこと
美味しそうって言ってたな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel... referred to Princess
as looking delicious...

fields.EN:
How'd you know Rapunzel
think that!
fields.JP:
じつはラプンツェルも
ずっとそうおもってたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How'd you know Rapunzel
think that!

fields.EN:
Same here too, huh?
...
Please don't eat me...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here too, huh?
...
Please don't eat me...

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime was a hard worker,
and would always help whenever
possible.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫はすごい働き者で、
いつも助けられてたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya was a hard worker,
and would always help whenever
possible.

fields.EN: I see... So I'm the same, too.
fields.JP:
なるほど、今とまったく
変わらないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... So I'm the same, too.

fields.EN: Uh, not by a long shot...
fields.JP: いや、全っっっ然違うじゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, not by a long shot...

fields.EN:
Oyayubi would often argue,
but she would always help at the
most crucial of times.
fields.JP:
親指とは反発しあったりもしたけど、
いざという時はすごく助けてもらったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby would often argue,
but she would always help at the
most crucial of times.

fields.EN:
It feels weird hearing myself
being praised when it wasn't me...
fields.JP:
知らない自分を褒められるのって、
何だかこそばゆいわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels weird hearing myself
being praised when it wasn't me...

fields.EN:
Everyone relies on you wherever you
go, Oyayubi-neesama! Shirayuki is happy too!
fields.JP:
親指姉様はどこでも頼りにされますね！
白雪も嬉しいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're relied on anywhere!
Snow White is so proud!

fields.EN:
Of course, Shirayuki-chan and Nemu-chan
were kind to us all the time!
fields.JP:
もちろん、白雪ちゃんやねむちゃんも、
わたしたちにとっても優しくしてくれたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, Snow White and Sleepy
were kind to us all the time!

fields.EN:
I'm just happy to see you three
so friendly with each other...
fields.JP:
でも、３人ともとっても
仲よさそうでよかったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just happy to see you three
so friendly with each other...

fields.EN:
Why wouldn't we?
We would never get into a
fight with each other!
fields.JP:
あったりまえじゃないの。
わたしたちがケンカなんてするわけ
ないじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why wouldn't we?
We would never get into a
fight with each other!

fields.JP: ワレはっ！　ワレはどうだったのだ！？

fields.EN:
Hameln...
Are you the Demon King?
fields.JP:
ハーメルンは……
今、もしかして魔王かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln...
Are you the Demon King?

fields.EN:
How did you know?!
Yes, I am the Demon King Hameln!
fields.JP:
うむ、よく分かったな！
ワレは魔王ハーメルンであるぞー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did you know?!
Yes, I am the Demon King Hameln!

fields.EN:
I see...
Which means you're no different
from the Hameln we knew.
fields.JP: なるほど……君はほんとに変わらないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Which means you're no different
from the Hameln we knew.

fields.EN: What?! What do you mean by that?!
fields.JP: なにっ！？　ど、どういうことなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! What do you mean by that?!

fields.EN:
The Hameln we knew was a
hero that we placed our trust on.
fields.JP:
あっちではハーメルンは勇者だったよ。
とっても頼りになった
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Hameln we knew was a
hero that we placed our trust on.

fields.JP: なんと！　勇者であるか！！

fields.EN:
Well now, that puts her on the
opposite spectrum of things.
fields.JP:
それまた随分と違うじゃない
今と真逆だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, that puts her on the
opposite spectrum of things.

fields.EN:
No, she's the same. Amazingly
the same... In fact, the only
thing different is her attire.
fields.JP:
いや、同じだよ。
ほんと、びっくりするくらいそのままだ。
変わったのは衣装ぐらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, she's the same. Amazingly
the same... In fact, the only
thing different is her attire.

fields.EN:
I don't know why, Otsuu, but the way you're
looking at me feels extremely rude...
fields.JP:
なぜか、おつうのワレを見る目が
ひじょーに失礼に感じるのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know why, but the look on
Otsuu's face is strangely rude...

fields.EN:
Heh heh... She's just trying to say she's
happy you're still the same Haa-chan as
ever.
fields.JP:
ふふっ……
ハーちゃんはハーちゃんのままで嬉しい
って言いたいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
She's just trying to say that
she's happy Hammy is Hammy.

fields.EN:
Hm... I see...
Well, fyne then.
fields.JP: む、むぅ……そうか。にゃらいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I see...
Well, fyne thyen.

fields.EN:
Oh, and the Hameln back in the
other world kept slurring, too.
fields.JP:
ああ、そういえば、
向こうでもハーメルンは
噛み噛みだったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and the Hameln back in the
other world kept slurring, too.

fields.EN:
I see why you said she's the
same now.
fields.JP: なるほど、まったく変わらないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see why you said she's the
same now.

fields.EN:
Same as usual, even in another
world...
fields.JP: 変わらないのね……どこに行っても
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same as usual, even in another
world...

fields.EN:
You're all making fun of me,
aren't you?!
fields.JP: やっぱりバカにされてる気がするぞ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're all making fun of me,
aren't you?!

fields.JP: あとは誰か聞いてない人いるー？

fields.EN:
Wh-What about me?
It's quite unnerving to be the
very last one...
fields.JP:
わ、わたくしですわ。
最後だと何だか緊張しますわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What about me?
It's quite unnerving to be the
very last one...

fields.EN:
Cinderella...
You're the most surprising out
of everyone.
fields.JP:
シンデレラは……
実は一番ビックリしてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella...
You're the most surprising out
of everyone.

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm surprised how grown
you are with all the curves in
the right areas...
fields.JP:
うん……すごい大人になってて
スタイルも良くて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm surprised how grown
you are with all the curves in
the right areas...

fields.EN:
The Cinderella in the other world
went missing during her youth
while in Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
あっちのシンデレラは、
幼い頃にブラッドスケルター化して
そのまま失踪してしまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Cinderella in the other world
went missing during her youth
while in Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
A long while passed, and when we
found her, she was still in her
youthful form.
fields.JP:
そして長い時間が経った後、
幼い姿のまま発見されたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A long while passed, and when we
found her, she was still in her
youthful form.

fields.EN:
So, this is the first time we've seen you
grown up, Cinderella-san...
fields.JP:
だから、シンデレラさんの
成長した姿を見るのは、初めてなんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this is the first time we've
seen you grown...

fields.EN:
But, hearing your tone of speech
shows how you cared about the
others.
fields.JP:
でもそうやって思って下さるだけで、２人が
どれだけ仲間想いか、よく分かりましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, hearing your tone of speech
shows how you cared about the
others.

fields.EN:
But this all happened because
of me... I was the cause of
everything...
fields.JP:
……違うんだ。これは僕のせいなんだ……
僕が身勝手に願ったせいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But this all happened because
of me... I was the cause of
everything...

fields.EN:
I think I said it before, but
your train of thought is wrong.
fields.JP:
つう、この前も言ったけど
それは違うと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I said it before, but
your train of thought is wrong.

fields.EN:
Both you and Ningyohime-san
wouldn't be here with us without
that other world.
fields.JP:
あの世界を願わなければ、
つうも人魚姫さんも今ここにいないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Both you and Little Mermaid
wouldn't be here with us without
that other world.

fields.EN:
The result we see is because of
the courage and love you've shown.
What you did was with reason.
fields.JP:
それはつうの勇気と愛が
生み出した結果だと思う……だから、
まったく無駄なんてなかったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The result we see is because of
the courage and love you've shown.
What you did was with reason.

fields.EN:
That's right, Otsuu-chan. If it weren't for
that other world, we wouldn't exist in this
proper world.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、おつうちゃん。
あっちの世界がなければ、わたしたちは
この正しい世界に存在していないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right. We wouldn't be in
this world if it wasn't for the
other world.

fields.EN:
So please, don't try to bring
yourself down over it.
fields.JP: だから、もう自分を責めなくていいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, don't try to bring
yourself down over it.

fields.EN:
Um... Not sure what this is all
about, but we're all here now,
so don't worry already!
fields.JP:
えーっと……よく分からないけど、
今あたしたちはみんな無事だしさ、
気にすんなって感じかな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Not sure what this is all
about, but we're all here now,
so don't worry already!

fields.EN:
My, she's right. I don't care who
I was or what happened to me
back in the other world.
fields.JP:
そうですわ、あっちの世界の
わたくしがどんなことになっていても、
今のわたくしは気にしませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My, she's right. I don't care who
I was or what happened to me
back in the other world.

fields.EN:
Did you hear that, Tsuu?
You can smile already, you know?
fields.JP:
……そういうことだよ、つう。
だからほら、笑ってよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you hear that, Otsuu?
You can smile already, you know?

fields.JP: アリスどこ行ったんだろう……

fields.EN:
So, what is it that you wanted
to talk about, Gretel, Alice?
fields.JP:
それでグレーテル、アリス、
改まって話って何……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what is it that you wanted
to talk about, Gretel, Alice?

fields.EN:
We wanted to ask you some
things in case you knew.
fields.JP:
もし知ってることがあったら
教えてもらおうと思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
We wanted to ask you some
things in case you knew.

fields.EN:
You mean about the other world?
If so, we'll try to answer the
best as we can.
fields.JP:
わたしたちに分かることなら、
もちろんお話しするけれど……
前の世界のお話？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean about the other world?
If so, we'll try to answer the
best as we can.

fields.EN: No, it's about the white core.
fields.JP: いいえ、白い核についてよ
fields.LOCALIZED: No, it's about the white core.

fields.EN:
Why, please do. It seems like
you know about it, too.
fields.JP:
ぜひお願いするわ。
あなたも色々と知っていそうだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, please do. It seems like
you know about it, too.

fields.EN:
I'll answer what I can.
So, what about the white core?
fields.JP:
僕に答えられることなら、もちろん。
それで……白い核について、だっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll answer what I can.
So, what about the white core?

fields.EN:
I believe it's also referred to as
the "Witchcraft" based on you
and Tsuu's conversation.
fields.JP:
ええ。あの時のジャックとつうの
会話から推察するに『ウィッチクラフト』
とも言うようだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe it's also referred to as
the "Witchcraft" based on you
and Otsuu's conversation.

fields.EN:
That name came to me from the
core back when I was wandering the
underground cavern.
fields.JP:
『ウィッチクラフト』という言葉は、
僕が地下洞窟をさまよっていた時に核から
流れてきた情報なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That name came to me from the
core back when I was wandering the
underground cavern.

fields.EN:
Now that I think about it,
that could've come from Snark's
information.
fields.JP:
今思えば……あれは
スナークの情報だったのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I think about it,
that could've come from Snark's
information.

fields.EN:
That could be possible. Well, for
the sake of simplicity, I'll just
refer to it as the "white core."
fields.JP:
なるほど。それはあり得そうな話ね。
まあ今は『白い核』で通させてもらうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That could be possible. Well, for
the sake of simplicity, I'll just
refer to it as the "white core."

fields.EN:
Ultimately, it brought about the
revival of Ningyohime, and
turned Tsuu into a human.
fields.JP:
今回、結果として人魚姫は蘇り、
そしてつうはナイトメアの姿から
血式少女の姿になったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ultimately, it brought about the
revival of Little Mermaid, and
turned Otsuu into a human.

fields.EN:
So, does this white core really
hold the power to do such things?
fields.JP:
『白い核』というのはそれほどまでに
凄まじい力を持っているというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, does this white core really
hold the power to do such things?

fields.EN:
It basically granted your wish,
right? If so, the power it holds
is astounding.
fields.JP:
願いを叶える力……というわけよね。
これが本当ならすごいことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It basically granted your wish,
right? If so, the power it holds
is astounding.

fields.EN:
Even if it asked for the body
of the deceased, it could bring
that one back to life.
fields.JP: 遺体が必要とはいえ、死者を蘇らせる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if it asked for the body
of the deceased, it could bring
that one back to life.

fields.EN:
It also holds the power to
transform or reincarnate
Nightmares into humans.
fields.JP:
そしてナイトメアから人間へと
変身、あるいは生まれ変わらせる力。
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also holds the power to
transform or reincarnate
Nightmares into humans.

fields.EN:
In either case, the power it
exhibited is beyond any mortals.
fields.JP:
どれをとっても人間には
決して不可能な異常な力よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In either case, the power it
exhibited is beyond any mortals.

fields.EN:
Mmm... It's true that I turned
into a human, and that Princess
came back to life.
fields.JP:
うーん……確かにグレーテルの言うとおり、
僕は人間の姿になれたし、姫は蘇ったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... It's true that I turned
into a human, and that Princess
came back to life.

fields.EN:
But, that was just luck. The core
isn't as convenient as you two
may be thinking.
fields.JP:
でもそれは、正直運がよかっただけなんだ。
本来は２人が思ってるほど万能じゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, that was just luck. The core
isn't as convenient as you two
may be thinking.

fields.EN: But your wish really did come true, Otsuu-san.
fields.JP: でも実際におつうさんの願いは叶ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: But it did grant your wish, right?

fields.EN:
Do you both know what the Jail
is from a biological standpoint?
fields.JP:
……２人はジェイルが生物学上、
何に分類されるか分かるかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you both know what the Jail
is from a biological standpoint?

fields.EN:
I believe you and Rapunzel
ate the Jail's walls.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルやあなたは確か、
ジェイルの壁食べてたわよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe you and Rapunzel
ate the Jail's walls.

fields.EN:
Indeed. To add, the walls don't
seem to be any type of animal
protein.
fields.JP:
そうね、食料にしていたわね。
そして動物性タンパク質という
感じでもなかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. To add, the walls don't
seem to be any type of animal
protein.

fields.EN:
I suppose the Jail is some type
of flora?
fields.JP:
ということは、
ジェイルは植物なのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose the Jail is some type
of flora?

fields.EN:
Yes, it's a flora all right. It is
something called a "Theophil"
that grows to become a Jail.
fields.JP:
そう、ジェイルは植物なんだ。
元は「テオフィル」と呼ばれる種で、
それが成長することでジェイルになる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it's a flora all right. It is
something called a "Theophil"
that grows to become a Jail.

fields.EN:
It feels weird thinking that
some plant is keeping us
down here...
fields.JP:
僕たちを閉じ込めているものが
植物だなんて不思議だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels weird thinking that
some plant is keeping us
down here...

fields.EN:
It's hard to believe, but it makes
sense when you consider the tower
is a stamen and the moon a pistil.
fields.JP:
にわかに信じ難い話だけど、監獄塔を雄しべ
白い月を雌しべとするとしっくりくると思うんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's hard to believe, but it makes
sense when you consider the tower
is a stamen and the moon a pistil.

fields.EN:
Flora can differ in growth
depending on the environment.
fields.JP:
そして植物は生育環境によって
様々な個体差が生まれる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Flora can differ in growth
depending on the environment.

fields.EN:
It's like how there are varying
types and sizes of apples.
fields.JP:
例えば同じリンゴでも良いもの悪いもの、
大きいもの小さいものがあるようにさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's like how there are varying
types and sizes of apples.

fields.EN:
So let's say what you said is
true... Are you suggesting that we
happened to be in a good Jail?
fields.JP:
じゃあそれぞれのジェイルに
個体差があって、今回はたまたま
良いジェイルだったということ……かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So let's say what you said is
true... Are you suggesting that we
happened to be in a good Jail?

fields.EN:
I think Snark's strong desire
made him fuse with the Jail,
but...
fields.JP:
……スナークはきっと『強い力』を願って、
結果ジェイルと融合したけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think Snark's strong desire
made him fuse with the Jail,
but...

fields.EN:
I don't think his form was
something that he wished for...
fields.JP:
あれは確かに望んであの姿になったわけじゃ
ないんだと思うな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think his form was
something that he wished for...

fields.EN:
So, the Jail's environmental state
wasn't the most desirable?
fields.JP: ここのジェイルは生育状況が悪かったと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, the Jail's environmental state
wasn't the most desirable?

fields.EN:
Yeah... Whatever the case,
I doubt that was the desired
result...
fields.JP:
うん……ちゃんとした
願いの結果ではなかったのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Whatever the case,
I doubt that was the desired
result...

fields.EN:
Interesting. I suppose it's true
that Snark didn't want to
fuse with the Jail.
fields.JP:
まあ確かに、スナークが望んだのは
別にジェイルとの融合ではなかった
かもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting. I suppose it's true
that Snark didn't want to
fuse with the Jail.

fields.EN:
I haven't seen the Snark in this
world, so I can't confirm, but...
fields.JP:
こっちのスナークのことは
直接見ていないから断言はできないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't seen the Snark in this
world, so I can't confirm, but...

fields.EN:
Like Jack said, I'm sure the
environment wasn't well, so his
desire wasn't properly reflected.
fields.JP:
ジャックの言うとおり、
きっとジェイルの生育環境が悪くて、
願いが正しく反映されなかったんだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like Jack said, I'm sure the
environment wasn't well, so his
desire wasn't properly reflected.

fields.EN:
Does that mean the Metropolitan
Office Jail was special?
fields.JP: じゃあ都庁のジェイルが特別よかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean the Metropolitan
Office Jail was special?

fields.JP: うん……おそらくそうだと思う

fields.EN:
That Jail was formed from the many
desires stemming from the
Festival of the Weaver.
fields.JP:
何故なら都庁のジェイルは
色々な人々の願いがこもった『七夕』が
擬態化してできたジェイルだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Jail was formed from the many
desires stemming from the
Festival of the Weaver.

fields.EN:
Festival of the Weaver... I read
about it before. People would tie
their wishes to a tree, was it?
fields.JP:
七夕……何かの本で読んだことあるわ。
願い事を書いたものを木にくくりつける、
だったかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Festival of the Weaver... I read
about it before. People would tie
their wishes to a tree, was it?

fields.EN:
Yes... It's an age-old tradition
where people wrote their wishes
to be tied onto some tree.
fields.JP:
うん……そうだね。
それは古来の風習で、多くの人が
願い事を一斉に吊すんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... It's an age-old tradition
where people wrote their wishes
to be tied onto some tree.

fields.EN:
In other words, I believe that
Jail held greater powers because
of all the wishes it formed from.
fields.JP:
つまり『願い』に関して、
他のどのジェイルよりも強い力を
持っていたんだと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, I believe that
Jail held greater powers because
of all the wishes it formed from.

fields.EN:
As a result, it exhibited stronger
powers as it was a manifestation
of wishes...
fields.JP:
その結果、本来よりも『願い』の力を
発揮できた……というわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As a result, it exhibited stronger
powers as it was a manifestation
of wishes...

fields.EN:
I don't have any proof, but that's
the best assumption I can come
up with.
fields.JP:
確証はないけど……
それが最も説明をつけられるはずだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have any proof, but that's
the best assumption I can come
up with.

fields.EN:
To add, cores hold special
properties reminiscent of each
Jail they are in.
fields.JP:
それに核だって
ジェイルごとに特色があるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, cores hold special
properties reminiscent of each
Jail they are in.

fields.EN:
Some cores will grant wishes
right, whereas others may twist
wishes, and more...
fields.JP:
願いを正しく叶えようとする核、
願いを曲解して叶えようとする核、
願いの上辺だけを叶える核……様々さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some cores will grant wishes
right, whereas others may twist
wishes, and more...

fields.EN:
Which is why there was a chance
we could've turned into some
kind of monster...
fields.JP:
だから僕や姫が化け物になって
生まれ変わってもおかしくなかったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why there was a chance
we could've turned into some
kind of monster...

fields.EN:
We did wish for the world to be
back to how it was, and that
didn't come out perfectly, too.
fields.JP:
前の世界の時だって、僕と姫で
『元の世界に戻ってほしい』と願ったけど、
それも完璧ではなかったしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did wish for the world to be
back to how it was, and that
didn't come out perfectly, too.

fields.EN:
Maybe Otsuu-chan and I both still had
something we couldn't let go of...
fields.JP:
それは……わたしもおつうちゃんも、
どこかに未練があったのかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think that was because we may
have had regrets deep inside
of us...

fields.EN:
I see... So it isn't as convenient
as we thought.
fields.JP:
なるほど……決して
万能なんかじゃないわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So it isn't as convenient
as we thought.

fields.EN:
On the contrary, it's too volatile
to control.
fields.JP:
それどころか、不安定すぎて
こちらの思うようには到底扱えなさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, it's too volatile
to control.

fields.EN: So that means you won your gamble, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんは賭けに勝った……
ということなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just so happened that
Otsuu's gamble came out good.

fields.EN: Yes... That's one way to word it.
