fields.JP: うん……そういうことになるね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... That's one way to word it.

fields.EN:
I know it's weird for me to say
this, but I don't want you to take
such a gamble again, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
その、わたしが言えたことではないけど……
おつうちゃん、もうこの先絶対に、
そんな無茶はしないで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's weird for me to say
this, but I don't want you to take
such a gamble again, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Yes, nothing that will bring
grief to you, my princess.
I promise.
fields.JP:
うん……姫を悲しませたくないからね。
もう無茶はしないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, nothing that will bring
grief to you, my princess.
I promise.

fields.EN:
If the cores are that volatile,
there's no telling what can be
found on the surface.
fields.JP:
でもそんな不安定なものが
地上に上がってもまだあるかもしれないのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the cores are that volatile,
there's no telling what can be
found on the surface.

fields.EN:
I guess it just means we need to
prepare ourselves well.
fields.JP:
これは一層、
気を引きしめないといけないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it just means we need to
prepare ourselves well.

fields.EN:
I appreciate you understanding
the dangers behind the white core.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、アリス。
正しく白い核の怖さを認識してくれて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate you understanding
the dangers behind the white core.

fields.JP:
ううん、ちゃんと教えてくれた
おつうさんのおかげよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In turn, I appreciate you telling
us about it.

fields.EN:
I'm really glad you and Ningyohime-san
joined us, Otsuu-san. Having you both here is
reassuring, right, Gretel?
fields.JP:
本当におつうさんと人魚姫さんが
加わってくれてよかった。とても心強いわ。
ね、グレーテル？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy you and Little Mermaid
joined us. You're both of great
help, isn't that right, Gretel?

fields.EN:
I can at least say you two have
piqued my interest even further.
fields.JP:
そうね、２人のおかげでとても楽しいわ。
まだまだ私の好奇心を刺激してくれるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can at least say you two have
piqued my interest even further.

fields.EN:
You really aren't different at all
no matter what world you're in...
fields.JP:
グレーテルは昔も今も
ほんっとブレないよなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really aren't different at all
no matter what world you're in...

fields.EN: Hehe, that's just like you, Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
ふふ、それでこそ
グレーテルさんって感じだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh heh, that's the Gretel I know.

fields.JP: 褒め言葉として受け取っておくわ

fields.EN:
With everyone here, I think we
can overcome any obstacles.
fields.JP:
……今の僕たちなら、
どんな困難でも乗り越えていけそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
With everyone here, I think we
can overcome any obstacles.

fields.EN:
I can't agree with you more.
It's a miracle we converged like
this after all.
fields.JP:
そうだね、こうしてまた
奇跡的に巡り会えたんだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't agree with you more.
It's a miracle we converged like
this after all.

fields.EN:
We faced a lot, but we did make
it through all of them.
fields.JP:
これまでも困難ばかりだったけど、
わたしたちは全部乗り越えてきたもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We faced a lot, but we did make
it through all of them.

fields.EN:
And, I'm sure there are more
to come, but nothing will falter
the hope I feel within me.
fields.JP:
まだまだ困難はあるだろうけど、
今は希望しか感じないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I'm sure there are more
to come, but nothing will falter
the hope I feel within me.

fields.EN:
If you saw the future of the other
world, then I would love to see
what the future holds here.
fields.JP:
別世界の観測ができたのなら、
次はこの先の未来を観測してみたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you saw the future of the other
world, then I would love to see
what the future holds here.

fields.EN:
We're going to make it to the
surface, and see what the
future holds for us above!
fields.JP:
みんなで地上に出て、
新しい未来をこの目で見るんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to make it to the
surface, and see what the
future holds for us above!

fields.EN:
What the...?! A Marchen's voice
from inside the laboratory?!
fields.JP:
…………！
……メルヒェンの声！？
研究室の中から聞こえたぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?! A Marchen's voice
from inside the laboratory?!

fields.EN:
Ah, Jack-kun. What seems to be the
problem?
fields.JP:
おお……ジャックくん。
どうしたんだね……いきなり？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Jack. What seems to be the
problem?

fields.JP:
……ん？
ああ、これのことかね？

fields.EN: M-Miko-san! What is going on here?!
fields.LOCALIZED: M-Miko! What is going on here?!

fields.EN: Oh, Jack. Why are you here?
fields.JP:
……ああ……ジャック。
どうして、研究室に……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Jack. Why are you here?

fields.EN:
Wait... Are you examining the
Marchen? Isn't it dangerous?!
fields.JP:
これって、もしかして……
メルヒェンを調べてるんですか？
……き、危険はないんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Are you examining the
Marchen? Isn't it dangerous?!

fields.EN:
Why, yes. That's why we have it
strapped down. It can't harm us.
fields.JP:
ええ……
ガッチリ拘束してあるから大丈夫よ。
今は何もできないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. That's why we have it
strapped down. It can't harm us.

fields.EN:
Ah, my dear Marchen-kun... It'll be
quick, so stay nice and still...
fields.JP:
ああ、メルヒェンくん……
いい子だから、もう少し我慢しておくれ。
すぐ済むからな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, my dear Marchen... It'll be
quick, so stay nice and still...

fields.EN:
Good... Good! We're done. It
didn't hurt, did it? You did well,
my dear Marchen-kun.
fields.JP:
よおし……よし……！
これで終わりだ……痛かったね？
よく頑張ったね、メルヒェンくん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good... Good! We're done. It
didn't hurt, did it? You did well,
my dear Marchen.

fields.EN:
Professor, the sample extraction
is complete.
fields.JP:
……博士。
サンプルの採取、終わりました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor, the sample extraction
is complete.

fields.EN:
Ah, thank you, Miko-kun. Once you
analyze the sample, report the
results to me.
fields.JP:
ああ……ありがとう、視子くん。
サンプルの分析結果が出たら、
私のところまで提出してくれたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, thank you, Miko. Once you
analyze the sample, report the
results to me.

fields.EN:
Hopefully the results will help us
in learning more about the
mysteries of the Jail.
fields.JP:
この分析結果が……
ジェイルの神秘に迫る鍵になればいいのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hopefully the results will help us
in learning more about the
mysteries of the Jail.

fields.EN:
Um, I'll excuse myself now. I'm
sorry for barging in earlier...
fields.JP:
あの……それじゃ、僕は失礼します。
突然、押し掛けてしまって……
すいませんでした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'll excuse myself now. I'm
sorry for barging in earlier...

fields.EN:
Ah, yes. I'm sorry to have worried
you, Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
おお、そうかね。
心配をかけて済まなかったね、ジャックくん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, yes. I'm sorry to have worried
you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Oh, that's right... I'm not ready
yet, but there is a favor I wanted
to ask from you.
fields.JP:
そうそう……
君に協力をお願いしたいことがあったんだが、
まだこちらの準備が整ってなくてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's right... I'm not ready
yet, but there is a favor I wanted
to ask from you.

fields.EN:
Can you stop by the laboratory
again later?
fields.JP: 折を見て、研究室に顔を出してくれないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you stop by the laboratory
again later?

fields.EN:
Yes, and it can be when you have
the time. When I'm ready, I'll
give you more details.
fields.JP:
ああ、君の手が空いている時で構わんよ。
その時に準備が出来ていたら、協力をお願いしたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and it can be when you have
the time. When I'm ready, I'll
give you more details.

fields.EN:
Understood. I'll come by again
later.
fields.JP:
……わかりました。
それじゃ、また来ます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. I'll come by again
later.

fields.EN:
You may need to try a few times,
but there's a hot cup of tea in it
for you. Now, if you'll excuse me.
fields.JP:
何度か無駄足を踏ませるかもしれんが……
その時には、お茶でもご馳走しよう。
それじゃあ、頼むよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may need to try a few times,
but there's a hot cup of tea in it
for you. Now, if you'll excuse me.

fields.EN:
Hey, Jack! What'cha doing,
standing around here like that?
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックじゃん！
どしたの、こんなとこで？
ボンヤリしちゃってさー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Jack! What'cha doing,
standing around here like that?

fields.JP:
あ……赤ずきんさん……
あの実は……今さっき……
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood? Well, I was...

fields.JP:
……ふーん。
そんなことがあったんだー

fields.EN:
I know it sounds kind of strange,
but...
fields.JP:
……うまく言えないけど……
なんだか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it sounds kind of strange,
but...

fields.EN:
Oh, Dad seemed weird, right? Like
some sort of mad scientist?
fields.JP:
あ。お父さんが、異常な感じだった？
マッドなサイエンティストに見えた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Dad seemed weird, right? Like
some sort of mad scientist?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Dad is usually like that
when it comes to the Jail or the
Marchens.
fields.JP:
あはは！　お父さんはさ……
ジェイルやメルヒェンのことになると、
いっつも、あの調子なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Dad is usually like that
when it comes to the Jail or the
Marchens.

fields.EN:
I mean, he is a research nut, so
to speak.
fields.JP: お父さんは研究バカだからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, he is a research nut, so
to speak.

fields.EN:
(I wonder if all researchers are
like that...)
fields.JP: （研究者って……ああいうものなのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if all researchers are
like that...)

fields.JP: 博士……あの、ジャックですけど……

fields.EN:
Jack-kun? Ah, what timing! I was just
about to call you here.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、ナイスタイミングだよ！
今、君を呼ぼうと思っていたところでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Ah, what timing! I was just
about to call you here.

fields.EN:
Is it about that favor you wanted
to ask?
fields.JP: ……あ、前に言ってた……協力の件ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it about that favor you wanted
to ask?

fields.EN:
Indeed! I'm sorry to have kept you
waiting, but I just finished my
test preparations.
fields.JP:
そうなんだよ！
やっと実験環境が用意できてね。
待たせて済まなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! I'm sorry to have kept you
waiting, but I just finished my
test preparations.

fields.EN:
Now then, can you go to the Rescue
Center? Miko-kun will give you the
details.
fields.JP:
早速だが、今すぐ救護室へ行ってくれないか。
詳しい説明は視子くんから聞いて欲しい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, can you go to the Rescue
Center? Miko will give you the
details.

fields.EN:
(What are they planning to do
there?)
fields.JP: （救護室って……何をさせられるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What are they planning to do
there?)

fields.EN:
Don't worry. We just need some
blood samples. We didn't have the
proper equipment earlier.
fields.JP:
なに、心配いらないよ、採血をするだけだ。
実験環境の構築が遅れていただけだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. We just need some
blood samples. We didn't have the
proper equipment earlier.

fields.EN:
Understood. I'll head to the
Rescue Center.
fields.JP: ……わかりました。救護室ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. I'll head to the
Rescue Center.

fields.EN:
(Just blood samples? That's not
so bad. I thought they were
planning some huge experiment.)
fields.JP:
（なんだ……採血か。
　もう、すっかり慣れちゃったな。
　もっと大変な実験なのかと思った）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Just blood samples? That's not
so bad. I thought they were
planning some huge experiment.)

fields.EN:
Miko-san? It's me, Jack. The Professor
told me to come and see you.
fields.JP:
視子さん、ジャックです。
博士に言われてきました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko? It's me, Jack. The Professor
told me to come and see you.

fields.JP: アリス！　君も呼ばれたの？

fields.EN:
Yes. The Professor told me to come
here to give a blood sample.
fields.JP:
ええ。
博士に採血に行くようにって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The Professor told me to come
here to give a blood sample.

fields.EN:
Hold on for just a moment. Let me
make some space...
fields.JP:
二人とも、ちょっと待っててね。
今、そのへんを片付けるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold on for just a moment. Let me
make some space...

fields.EN:
Unbelievable... I can't believe he
sent you both over when I'm not
even finished preparing yet...
fields.JP:
まったく……まだ準備の途中なのに……
あの人はせっかちなんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable... I can't believe he
sent you both over when I'm not
even finished preparing yet...

fields.EN:
Okay, done. Both of you, can you
sit over there?
fields.JP: さ、いいわよ。二人ともその椅子にかけて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, done. Both of you, can you
sit over there?

fields.EN:
Now then, your arms. Let me just
get some blood samples...
fields.JP:
それじゃ、腕を出してちょうだい。
採血させてもらうわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, your arms. Let me just
get some blood samples...

fields.EN:
Sure. Um... What are the blood
samples for?
fields.JP:
はい。あの……
これって何のための採血なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. Um... What are the blood
samples for?

fields.JP: え、博士から聞いてない？

fields.EN:
No. He just said that he needed
my blood sample...
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. He just said that he needed
my blood sample...

fields.EN:
It's not right you don't know the
reasons for the sampling. Let me
explain instead.
fields.JP:
説明もなしに採血されたら……不安よね？
ごめんなさい。私から説明するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not right you don't know the
reasons for the sampling. Let me
explain instead.

fields.EN:
We're currently working on
developing an antibody that could
counter Corruption.
fields.JP:
実は『穢れ』に対する抗体を
開発できないかと考えているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're currently working on
developing an antibody that could
counter Corruption.

fields.EN:
An antibody to counter
Corruption... Is that something
that can be made from my blood?
fields.JP:
『穢れ』に対する抗体……
僕の血から抗体を作るんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
An antibody to counter
Corruption... Is that something
that can be made from my blood?

fields.EN:
No. We wish to develop an antibody
that produces the same effect as
the ones found in your blood.
fields.JP:
いいえ、ちがうわ。
あなたの血液中の抗体を分析して、
同様の効果を持つ薬剤を開発したいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. We wish to develop an antibody
that produces the same effect as
the ones found in your blood.

fields.EN: Um, then what is my blood for?
fields.JP: あの……それでは、わたしの血は？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, then what is my blood for?

fields.EN:
Jack's antibodies exhibit stable
effects when used on a particular
Blood Maiden. That's you, Alice.
fields.JP:
ジャックの血液中の『穢れ』抗体が、
もっとも安定して作用する血式少女が……
アリス……あなたなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's antibodies exhibit stable
effects when used on a particular
Blood Maiden. That's you, Alice.

fields.EN:
It's the ideal blood sample. If we can
develop a drug to substitute for the
antibodies, we can reduce Jack's burden.
fields.JP:
実験には最適な血液サンプルなのよ。
抗体の代替薬品を開発することができれば、
ジャックの負担を減らすことができるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll need the best samples for
testing. A working antibiotic may
help alleviate the load for Jack.

fields.EN:
Um, but isn't it faster to just
extract the antibodies in my
blood?
fields.JP:
あの……よくわからないんですけど……
僕の血から抗体を分離するほうが、
もしかして……近道なんじゃないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, but isn't it faster to just
extract the antibodies in my
blood?

fields.JP: そうかもしれないわね。でも……

fields.EN:
It's not like you have all the
blood in the world to spare!
fields.JP: あなたの血は無限にあるわけじゃないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like you have all the
blood in the world to spare!

fields.EN:
Exactly. You need to take better
care of yourself. Now then, let's
get this done, shall we?
fields.JP:
そういうこと。
自分の体も少しは気遣ってね。
さあ、それじゃ採血しましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. You need to take better
care of yourself. Now then, let's
get this done, shall we?

fields.EN:
I'm going to take a bit more than
usual... Don't move... Does it
hurt...?
fields.JP:
ちょっと多めに採るわよ……
二人とも腕を動かさないでね。
痛くない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to take a bit more than
usual... Don't move... Does it
hurt...?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry we have to have you go
through this so often...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry we have to have you go
through this so often...

fields.EN:
No, that wasn't what I was
implying...
fields.JP: いえ、そういう意味じゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that wasn't what I was
implying...

fields.EN:
And it's for developing
the antibody substitute drug...
fields.JP: 抗体開発のためですし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, it is to help develop the
antibiotic.

fields.EN:
I wouldn't expect answers anytime
soon if I were you... It will take
some time to develop...
fields.JP:
期待されると……ツライわね。
おそらく、試薬の開発には……
莫大な時間を必要とするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't expect answers anytime
soon if I were you... It will take
some time to develop...

fields.EN:
I'm sure we could offer more
direct support to you all if we
spent this time differently...
fields.JP:
その時間を他に振り向ければ……
もっと……より意味のある形で、
あなたたちのフォローができるのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we could offer more
direct support to you all if we
spent this time differently...

fields.EN:
Okay, we're done. Thank you for
your time.
fields.JP:
はい、終わったわよ。
お疲れ様……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, we're done. Thank you for
your time.

fields.EN:
Let's see... These are for the
Professor...
fields.JP: こっちは後で博士に提出する分……と
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see... These are for the
Professor...

fields.EN:
(Huh? Are they going to use our
blood for something else?)
fields.JP:
（あれ……？
　抗体の分析とは別に、何かするんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Are they going to use our
blood for something else?)

fields.EN:
What is the Professor planning to
use our blood for?
fields.JP:
博士は僕とアリスの血を使って、
どんな研究をするんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is the Professor planning to
use our blood for?

fields.EN:
I don't know. You'll have to ask
the Professor that. Now, then...
fields.JP:
それは博士に聞いてちょうだい。
私は知らないのよ。
さてと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know. You'll have to ask
the Professor that. Now, then...

fields.EN:
I need to run the samples through gas
chromatography and make the report... Better
submit it before the Professor presses me.
fields.JP:
サンプルをガスクロマトグラフィーにかけて、
報告書の作成か……
博士にせっつかれる前に提出しなきゃね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should put the samples through
gas chromatography first... Better
do it before the Professor asks...

fields.EN: Sounds like a lot of work...
fields.LOCALIZED: Sounds like a lot of work...

fields.EN:
Oh, not at all. I'm sorry if it
sounded like I was complaining.
But...
fields.JP:
ああ、そうでもないのよ。
ごめんなさい……グチっぽかったわね。
ただ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, not at all. I'm sorry if it
sounded like I was complaining.
But...

fields.EN:
Sometimes I'm scared to find out
what he really wants to know...
fields.JP:
あの人が本当は何を知りたがってるのか、
時々怖くなることがあるわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sometimes I'm scared to find out
what he really wants to know...

fields.EN:
Well, I'll do what I can to
support you, so... thanks, and get
a good night's rest...
fields.JP:
ま……そのぶん私は、あなたたちのサポートに
全力を尽くすつもりよ。
ありがとう……お疲れ様
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'll do what I can to
support you, so... thanks, and get
a good night's rest...

fields.EN:
(I wonder what the Professor is
researching that he'd need Alice's
and my blood samples...)
fields.JP:
（博士……この間採血した、僕とアリスの
　血液サンプルで、いったいどんな研究を
　してるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what the Professor is
researching that he'd need Alice's
and my blood samples...)

fields.EN:
Ah, Jack... What brings you to the
laboratory?
fields.JP: あら、ジャック……研究室に用事なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Jack... What brings you to the
laboratory?

fields.EN:
Oh, nothing really... I was just
curious about what the Professor
was researching.
fields.JP:
ううん、そうじゃないんだけど……
博士の研究が気になって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, nothing really... I was just
curious about what the Professor
was researching.

fields.EN:
I see... I was wondering about it
too. Miko-san's antibody substitute
drug looks like it'll take a while...
fields.JP:
そう……わたしも気になっていたの。
視子さんの抗体代替薬は時間かかりそうだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Same here. Miko did say it
was going to take a while to come
up with an antibiotic...

fields.EN: Yeah, Miko-san did say that, didn't she?
fields.JP: うん、そんなこと言ってたよね……視子さん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, she did say that, didn't
she?

fields.EN:
I just hope our blood helps the
Professor, too...
fields.JP:
博士も、僕らの血を何かに役立ててくれたら、
うれしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just hope our blood helps the
Professor, too...

fields.EN:
Say, Jack? Since we're here, why
don't we ask him?
fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャック。
ちょうど良い機会ですもの……
これから博士に聞いてみましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack? Since we're here, why
don't we ask him?

fields.EN:
Sounds good. I guess it wouldn't
hurt, as long as we don't disturb
whatever he's doing...
fields.JP:
そうだね。
研究の邪魔をしないように……
ちょっとだけなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds good. I guess it wouldn't
hurt, as long as we don't disturb
whatever he's doing...

fields.EN: Ah, Jack-kun and Alice-kun, what timing.
fields.JP:
おお。ジャックくん、アリスくん……
いいところに来たね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, Jack and Alice, what timing.

fields.EN:
Is there something you need from
us?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there something you need from
us?

fields.EN:
Take a look at this petri dish
here...
fields.JP: このシャーレを見たまえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Take a look at this petri dish
here...

fields.EN:
It looks like... some kind of
flesh...
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like... some kind of
flesh...

fields.EN:
Doesn't ring a bell, does it? The
flesh you see here is from the
core you brought back.
fields.JP:
……わからないかね？
これはね……このシャーレの中の肉片は……
君たちが持ち帰ってくれた核なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't ring a bell, does it? The
flesh you see here is from the
core you brought back.

fields.EN: It looks like it's still alive...
fields.JP: 何だか、生きているみたい……
fields.LOCALIZED: It looks like it's still alive...

fields.EN:
Indeed. The core continues to live
inside this petri dish!
fields.JP:
そうとも。
このシャーレの中で核は生き続けているのだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. The core continues to live
inside this petri dish!

fields.EN:
Look at how it can stay alive,
even as a simple piece of flesh.
fields.JP:
こんな肉片になってもだよ？
驚異の生命力だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at how it can stay alive,
even as a simple piece of flesh.

fields.EN:
And, in these vials are the blood
samples we got from the both of
you.
fields.JP:
そして……この試験管に入っているのが、
先日、採血した君たちの血液だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, in these vials are the blood
samples we got from the both of
you.

fields.EN: Now then, take a closer look...
fields.JP: いいかね？　よおく見ていたまえ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, take a closer look...

fields.EN:
First, I'll pour a little of Jack-kun's
blood onto the piece of flesh in
the dish... just a tiny amount...
fields.JP:
まずジャックくんの血液を、シャーレの中の
肉片に少量……ほんの少量を注ぐよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
First I will add a single drop of
Jack's blood into the dish...

fields.EN:
The core shrinks and wails with
Jack's blood. Sad, considering
the core can't escape the dish.
fields.JP:
このように核は悲鳴をあげて収縮する……
ふふ……シャーレの中に逃げ場などないのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The core shrinks and wails with
Jack's blood. Sad, considering
the core can't escape the dish.

fields.EN:
Now then, I'll add Alice-kun's
blood...
fields.JP: そして……今度はアリスくんの血を注ぐ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I'll add Alice's
blood...

fields.EN:
Something is... growing out from
the core...
fields.JP: 何か……核から伸びているわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something is... growing out from
the core...

fields.JP: アリスの血を……飲んでる……！？

fields.EN:
Yes. The core reacts negatively to
Jack-kun's blood, whereas it seems to
accept Alice-kun's.
fields.JP:
そうだ。ジャックくんの血液には拒絶反応を
示したが、アリスくんの血液は好みのようだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The core reacts negatively to
Jack's blood, whereas it seems to
accept Alice's.

fields.EN:
Did you notice? Not only does the
core mimic the characteristics of
organic and inorganic materials...
fields.JP:
……見たかね？
このように核は有機物や無機物を吸収し、
それらの特性を獲得するのみならず……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you notice? Not only does the
core mimic the characteristics of
organic and inorganic materials...

fields.EN:
It can even reconstruct their composition!
And that is the true essence of mimicry!
fields.JP:
その組成を再構築することすら可能なのだよ！
そして、これが『擬態』の本質なのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Its will can also be
reconstructed as well! This is the
truth behind mimicry!

fields.EN:
So that's mimicry... It's the
first time I've seen something
like that...
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that's mimicry... It's the
first time I've seen something
like that...

fields.EN:
Since the Jail's maturation, it
has stabilized to the point where
it doesn't mimic as actively.
fields.JP:
そうだろうとも。ジェイルが成長を遂げて安定
してからは、ここ……内部に対する擬態活動は
活発ではないようだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since the Jail's maturation, it
has stabilized to the point where
it doesn't mimic as actively.

fields.EN:
But that applies to the inside of
the Jail, which shows slower
growth than the outside.
fields.JP:
おそらく外部への拡張は続いているのだろうが、
現存する内部の成長はごく緩やかなものになった
のだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that applies to the inside of
the Jail, which shows slower
growth than the outside.

fields.EN:
Yes, the inside seems to have come
to the end of its growth cycle,
similar to any other creature.
fields.JP:
あらゆる生物が、成体期には成長がほぼ止まった
かのように見えるように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, the inside seems to have come
to the end of its growth cycle,
similar to any other creature.

fields.EN:
If we can intervene in and control the core's
mimicry... we may be able to control the
Jail itself. It could help us conquer it!
fields.JP:
核の擬態活動に介入制御することができれば……
ジェイルを自由に操作できるかもしれん……
ジェイル攻略のひとつの可能性だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we can influence the core's
mimicry, we may be able to control
the Jail to help with our escape!

fields.EN:
(I'm not surprised at Alice's
reaction after seeing that...)
fields.JP:
（アリス……あんなものを見せられたら
　無理もない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not surprised at Alice's
reaction after seeing that...)

fields.EN:
Um, Professor? I don't see that
Marchen that was held here
before...
fields.JP:
あの、博士……
この間、拘束されてたメルヒェンは……
もういないみたいですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Professor? I don't see that
Marchen that was held here
before...

fields.EN:
Oh, that? We were done with it, so
I handed it over to Towa-kun to take
care of it.
fields.JP:
……ああ、あれかね？
あれは、もう用が済んだからね。
永遠くんに頼んだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that? We were done with it, so
I handed it over to Towa to take
care of it.

fields.EN: (What did he ask Kadowaki-san to do?)
fields.JP: （門脇さんにって……何を頼んだんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What did he ask him to do?)

fields.EN:
That aside, doesn't this stimulate
your interest? How much of Alice-kun's
blood is needed for it to mimic?
fields.JP:
そんなことより……興味が湧かないかね？
どのくらいの血液を与えれば……この核が
アリスくんの擬態として機能するか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside, doesn't this stimulate
your interest? How much of Alice's
blood is needed for it to mimic?

fields.EN:
Jack, let's leave. I'm... a bit
tired.
fields.JP:
ジャック、もう失礼しましょう。
その、少し疲れたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, let's leave. I'm... a bit
tired.

fields.EN:
Ah, I can't blame you. You don't often
get to see research results this stimulating.
fields.JP:
ああ、無理もないだろうね。
これだけ刺激的な研究成果も、なかなか見られる
ものではないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, how rude of me. Seeing such
inspiring results is something
that may be too much to handle.

fields.EN:
We're sorry to have bothered you,
Professor...
fields.JP: 博士……研究中、お邪魔しました
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're sorry to have bothered you,
Professor...

fields.EN:
Ah, come back at any time. I do
have many more interesting things
to show.
fields.JP:
ああ。また、いつでも遊びきてくれたまえ。
もっと……興味深いこともあるのでね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, come back at any time. I do
have many more interesting things
to show.

fields.EN:
I'm sure that was something quite
important to his experiments,
but... it wasn't very pleasant.
fields.JP:
たぶん、大事な研究なんだろうけど……
あんまり、気分のいいものじゃなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure that was something quite
important to his experiments,
but... it wasn't very pleasant.

fields.EN:
The flesh in the dish... The
Marchen laughed with my voice...
fields.JP:
……わたしの声で笑っていたわ。
シャーレの中で……メルヒェンが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The flesh in the dish... The
Marchen laughed with my voice...

fields.EN:
I'm fine... It's just that... it
scared me...
fields.JP:
……大丈夫よ
ただ少し……ゾッとしただけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine... It's just that... it
scared me...

fields.EN:
Say, Jack? You heard the Professor
say that he handed the Marchen
over to Kadowaki-san, right?
fields.JP:
……ねえ、ジャック。
さっき博士はメルヒェンの処理を、
門脇さんに頼んだって言っていたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack? You heard the Professor
say that he handed the Marchen
over to Mr. Kadowaki, right?

fields.EN:
Yeah. It sounded as if he handed
it over to be discarded or
something...
fields.JP:
うん。
研究に使った後の……なんて言うか……
廃棄物的なニュアンスだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. It sounded as if he handed
it over to be discarded or
something...

fields.EN:
Is there such a facility like that
around where Kadowaki-san is
stationed? A disposal facility...?
fields.JP:
あそこに……門脇さんのところに、
そんな設備があったかしら？
メルヒェンを廃棄処理するような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there such a facility like that
around where Mr. Kadowaki is
stationed? A disposal facility...?

fields.EN:
Even if the Marchen was weakened,
it still is a threat, so I doubt
it was just let loose.
fields.JP:
でもさ……いくら弱ってるとはいえ、
相手はメルヒェンだから……。
適当に放置しとくことはないんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if the Marchen was weakened,
it still is a threat, so I doubt
it was just let loose.

fields.EN:
Of course you're right, but... it
just bothered me.
fields.JP:
……ええ、そうは思わないわ。
ただ、何だか気になったものだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course you're right, but... it
just bothered me.

fields.EN:
(The Professor seems to put all
his emphasis into research with
everything else left for last...)
fields.JP:
（確かに博士は研究第一で、用が済んだら
　後のことはどうでもいいように見える……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Professor seems to put all
his emphasis into research with
everything else left for last...)

fields.EN:
(He's so different when he's like
that. Definitely not like when he
cares for Akazukin-san...)
fields.JP:
（研究者って、そういうものなのかもしれない
　けど……赤ずきんさんや僕たちを気遣って
　くれる姿とは、同じ人とは思えない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's so different when he's like
that. Definitely not like when he
cares for Red Riding Hood...)

fields.EN:
Maybe we should speak with Mr.
Kadowaki-san...
fields.JP:
…………
門脇さんに聞いてみようか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we should speak with Mr.
Kadowaki...

fields.EN:
Hm? What's the matter, kiddo?
Something wrong with the Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
ん？　どうした、小僧……
メアリガンの調子でも悪いか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What's the matter, kiddo?
Something wrong with the Mary Gun?

fields.JP: え？　いえ、そんなことないです！

fields.EN:
Um... I was just sort of passing
by, that's all...
fields.JP: ええと……取り立てて用事はないんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I was just sort of passing
by, that's all...

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... You must be busy.
I'll get going.
fields.JP:
……す、すいません……
忙しいですよね……帰ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... You must be busy.
I'll get going.

fields.EN:
C'mon, take it easy! I was kicking
back a bit, too. I've got time to
talk.
fields.JP:
まあ、そう言うなよ！
俺もサボってたとこだ。しばらく付き合えよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, take it easy! I was kicking
back a bit, too. I've got time to
talk.

fields.EN:
C'mon, sit down. I'll check your
Mary Gun while we're at it.
fields.JP:
そこ、座れよ。
ついでにメアリガンの調子をみてやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, sit down. I'll check your
Mary Gun while we're at it.

fields.EN:
Now then... Hm... Looks like the
Mary Gun is okay.
fields.JP:
どら？
んー……メアリガンは問題なさそうだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then... Hm... Looks like the
Mary Gun is okay.

fields.EN:
You want to say something, don't
ya? Go ahead. Spill it.
fields.JP:
……なんか言いたいことがあるんだろ？
話してみろよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You want to say something, don't
ya? Go ahead. Spill it.

fields.EN:
Um... Haru-san, what do you think about
Michiru-san?
fields.JP:
あの……ハルさんはミチルさんのこと……
どう思いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... What's your thoughts on
Michiru?

fields.EN:
Michiru? Ah, you mean Oohime-san? Why
do you ask?
fields.JP:
ああ、大陽女さん……ね。
どうしてだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru? Ah, you mean Oohime? Why
do you ask?

fields.EN:
Miko-san seemed to dislike Michiru-san, so...
Haru-san, I was wondering what you think
of her...
fields.JP:
視子さんは……ミチルさんのことを
嫌ってるようだったから……
ハルさんはどう思ってるのかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko doesn't seem to like Michiru,
so I wanted to ask how you felt
about her...

fields.EN:
Ah... In Miko's case, let's just
say it's a woman's intuition.
fields.JP:
あー。
あいつの場合、女の第六感ってやつだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... In Miko's case, let's just
say it's a woman's intuition.

fields.EN: Um, I'm not sure I follow...
fields.JP: あの……意味がわからないんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, I'm not sure I follow...

fields.EN:
Miko's a scientist to the core, so
she doesn't take kindly to folks
harping on about the illogical.
fields.JP:
……まあ、視子は学者だからな。
ああいった非論理的な手合いとは、
相性が悪いんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko's a scientist to the core, so
she doesn't take kindly to folks
harping on about the illogical.

fields.EN:
But Miko-san said herself that they
support the Dawn by growing and
cooking food supplies.
fields.JP:
でも、炊き出しや食糧の生産供給なんかで、
黎明の不足を補ってくれてるって……
視子さん、そうも言ってたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Miko said herself that they
support the Dawn by growing and
cooking food supplies.

fields.EN:
Miko can get too tense about things.
Maybe it's something like a sense of rivalry?
fields.JP:
あいつも肩に力が入ってるところがあるからな。
ライバル意識みたいなもんなんじゃねえの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She has her pride as someone who
supports others, so maybe she just
looks at them as rivals.

fields.EN:
Ah, but don't tell Miko what I
said. She'd kill me if she found
out.
fields.JP:
……おっかねえから、俺がそんな風に言ってた
なんて、視子にはバラすなよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but don't tell Miko what I
said. She'd kill me if she found
out.

fields.EN:
But, I have to admit... That
order, and in particular, Oohime-san,
is shady as hell.
fields.JP:
まあ、あの教団や……とりわけ大陽女さんが、
胡散臭えってのは事実だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have to admit... That
order, and in particular, Oohime,
is shady as hell.

fields.EN:
But she probably gets frustrated
because she can't find any solid evidence.
fields.JP:
けど、確かな証拠を見つけられないんで、
視子も苛ついてるんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Miko just feels uneasy
about them because she has no
definitive evidence against them.

fields.EN:
U-Um... Does that mean Miko-san doubts
the Order of the Sun?
fields.JP:
あ、あの……それって、
視子さんがタイヨウを疑ってるってことですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you made it sound as if she's
doubting the Order of the Sun.

fields.EN:
Since you're not a core member...
you may be able to view the Order and
Oohime-san without needless preconceptions.
fields.JP:
組織の中枢メンバーじゃない、おまえなら……
下手な先入観を持たずにあの教団や大陽女さんを
見ることができるかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since you're new here, I'm sure
you're able to see them and Oohime
without bias...

fields.EN: What do you mean by that, Haru-san?
fields.JP:
ハルさん……
それって、どういう意味なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that, Haru?

fields.EN:
Anyway, I'm done checking your
Mary Gun.
fields.JP: よし！　メアリガンの点検終了だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, I'm done checking your
Mary Gun.

fields.EN:
Stop by anytime, Jack. You being
here gives me a good reason to
slack off.
fields.JP:
ま、気軽に顔出せよ、ジャック。
おまえが来ると、サボりのいい口実になるからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop by anytime, Jack. You being
here gives me a good reason to
slack off.

fields.EN:
Uh, I don't really want to be
blamed for it...
fields.JP: サボりの口実になるのはちょっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I don't really want to be
blamed for it...

fields.EN: Heh, heh... Lighten up, would ya?
fields.JP: はは。そう堅苦しく考えるなって
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh, heh... Lighten up, would ya?

fields.EN:
(That sounded as if Haru-san wanted
me to observe the Order of the Sun
myself...)
fields.JP:
（ハルさん……僕自身の目で、タイヨウ教団を
　観察してみろって言ってるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That sounded as if Haru wanted
me to observe the Order of the Sun
myself...)

fields.EN:
Hiya, Jack-san! What brings ya here
today?
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん！
今日はどうしたんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hiya, Jack! What brings ya here
today?

fields.EN:
Oh, nothing really... I'm just
taking a stroll. You look pretty
busy today.
fields.JP:
ううん、特に用事はないんだけど……
ちょっと時間ができたから。
……なんだか、忙しそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, nothing really... I'm just
taking a stroll. You look pretty
busy today.

fields.EN:
Yup! I'm putting together all the
things Boss wanted here...
fields.JP:
そうなんすよ。
師匠から頼まれた品物を、
こうやって揃えてるんすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I'm putting together all the
things Boss wanted here...

fields.EN:
Can ya believe it? He wants little
ol' me to take them to him! I'm
no delivery person, y'know?!
fields.JP:
これ全部、後で師匠んとこまで届けるんすよ？
うちはデリバリーサービスはやってないっつの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can ya believe it? He wants little
ol' me to take them to him! I'm
no delivery person, y'know?!

fields.EN: Guess I'm just a gofer to him...
fields.JP: ……まあ、体のいい使いっ走りっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Guess I'm just a gofer to him...

fields.EN:
(Despite what she's saying, she
really is attached to Haru-san...)
fields.JP:
（くらら、憎まれ口は叩いてても、ハルさんに
　すごく懐いてるんだよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite what she's saying, she
really is attached to Haru...)

fields.EN:
Well, I guess having that scary
face of his roaming about would be
bad... Even Marchens avoid him.
fields.JP:
でもまあ、あのコワモテがお買い物ってのも、
黎明の風紀に悪そうっすからね……
メルヒェンも裸足で逃げ出すってくらいっすから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess having that scary
face of his roaming about would be
bad... Even Marchens avoid him.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Now that's too much!
Marchens wouldn't avoid Haru-san, even
if he did look scary.
fields.JP:
あはは……それは、ひどいよ！
いくら、ハルさんが相手でも、
さすがにメルヒェンは逃げないんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Now that's too much!
Marchens wouldn't avoid Haru, even
if he did look scary.

fields.EN:
You'd think I'm joking, right?
Well, I'm not. I heard it
directly from my older sister...
fields.JP:
や、まんざら冗談でもないんすよ、これ。
自分、姉貴から直接聞いたんすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'd think I'm joking, right?
Well, I ain't. In fact, I got that
info from Big Sis Red.

fields.EN:
Well, the avoiding part may be a
bit too much, but Boss isn't
really targeted by 'em.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンが逃げ出すってのは、
ちょっとオーバーっすけど……
襲われにくいってのは本当らしいっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, the avoiding part may be a
bit too much, but Boss isn't
really targeted by 'em.

fields.EN:
You heard it from Akazukin-san?
You can't be serious, though.
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさんから？　本当なのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard it from Red Riding Hood?
You can't be serious, though.

fields.EN:
Well, Boss was part of a search
unit before the Blood Team. If
Sis says it, it's gotta be true.
fields.JP:
以前は師匠も調査隊に入ってたんすよ。
血式部隊が本格的に活動する前ですけど……
同行してた姉貴が言うんだからマジっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Boss was part of a search
unit before the Blood Team. If
Sis says it, it's gotta be true.

fields.EN:
I kinda do feel for the Marchens.
I mean, I'd rather chase cute
girls than an old guy like him!
fields.JP:
まあ、自分はメルヒェンの気持ちもわかるっすね。
どうせ襲うなら、あんなオッさんよりも、
美少女の方がいいに決まってるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kinda do feel for the Marchens.
I mean, I'd rather chase cute
girls than an old guy like him!

fields.EN:
Uh, can Marchens tell the
difference between cute girls and
old guys like him?
fields.JP:
……メルヒェンって、美少女とオッさんの区別
なんてするの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, can Marchens tell the
difference between cute girls and
old guys like him?

fields.EN:
Ah! You said it too, Jack-san! I'll tell Boss
while I'm running errands that you called him
an old man!
fields.JP:
あー！　ジャックさんも言ったっすね！
自分、パシリついでに師匠に伝えとくっす！
ジャックさんがオッさんって言ってたって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oooh! You said it! I'm gonna tell
Boss that you called him an oldie!

fields.JP: え！？　ちょ、ちょっと待ってよ！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! I'm just pullin' your
leg. Well, I'd best be going now!
fields.JP:
あはは！　冗談っすよ。
じゃ、自分はこれで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! I'm just pullin' your
leg. Well, I'd best be going now!

fields.EN:
(Is it even possible to not get
targeted by Marchens?)
fields.JP:
（でも、メルヒェンに襲われにくいなんて、
　本当にあるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is it even possible to not get
targeted by Marchens?)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I'll speak with Haru-san
about it...)
fields.JP: （ハルさんに、聞きに行ってみよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I'll speak with Haru
about it...)

fields.EN:
I see... Marchens not targeting
me, eh?
fields.JP:
……なるほど。
メルヒェンが俺を襲わない……ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Marchens not targeting
me, eh?

fields.JP: ハルさんは……気づいていたんですか？

fields.EN:
Sort of. Well, I'm not so sure
about it, but maybe...
fields.JP:
まあな……
俺にも、確かなことはわからないんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sort of. Well, I'm not so sure
about it, but maybe...

fields.EN:
Maybe it's because I'm good-
looking? Even the Marchens know
not to waste a guy like me.
fields.JP:
いい男だからじゃねぇか？
メルヒェンも殺すのが惜しいってな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's because I'm good-
looking? Even the Marchens know
not to waste a guy like me.

fields.EN:
Stop with the silent treatment.
Say something.
fields.JP: ……なんか言えって。気まずいだろうが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop with the silent treatment.
Say something.

fields.EN:
At the very least, the "old guy"
part is totally wrong.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、くららの言ってたやつは
違うと断言したい
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least, the "old guy"
part is totally wrong.

fields.EN:
Oh, uh... I'm sure she meant it as
a joke.
fields.JP: あはは……それも冗談だと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh... I'm sure she meant it as
a joke.

fields.EN:
But if Miko heard what you said,
knowing her, she'd go right into
research about it.
fields.JP:
しかし、今のおまえの言葉を視子が聞いたら、
大真面目に研究を始めそうで怖いな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if Miko heard what you said,
knowing her, she'd go right into
research about it.

fields.EN:
Ah! Maybe you'll become our
secret anti-Marchen weapon!
fields.JP: 対メルヒェンの秘密兵器ですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! Maybe you'll become our
secret anti-Marchen weapon!

fields.EN:
Give me a break. No way I'm gonna
get dissected by the Professor and
Miko.
fields.JP:
いやいや。
博士と視子に斬り刻まれるのはごめんだな。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Give me a break. No way I'm gonna
get dissected by the Professor and
Miko.

fields.EN:
In any case, that's one weird
rumor. Next time, bring me
something more my speed, ya hear?
fields.JP:
しかしまあ、妙なとこで妙なネタにされてる
もんだな。今度はもっとシブいやつで頼むぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, that's one weird
rumor. Next time, bring me
something more my speed, ya hear?

fields.EN:
(Haru-san will never tell me anything
more. He'll just try to steer the
conversation elsewhere.)
fields.JP:
（こういう反応の時のハルさんは、
　どう切り込んでも絶対に喋らない……
　はぐらかされるだけだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haru will never tell me anything
more. He'll just try to steer the
conversation elsewhere.)

fields.EN:
(Hm... Marchens being able to
choose  who they wants to attack
or not...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても……メルヒェンが襲う相手を、
　個別認識している事なんてあるんだろうか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm... Marchens being able to
choose  who they wants to attack
or not...)

fields.EN:
Hey, Jack. Came down to get your
Mary Gun tuned?
fields.JP:
おう、ジャック。
毎度、お馴染みメアリガンの調整か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Jack. Came down to get your
Mary Gun tuned?

fields.EN:
Sure, if it'll give me a chance to
slack off.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, if it'll give me a chance to
slack off.

fields.EN:
Looks like you're learning how
things work around here. C'mon,
gimme your arm. I'll check it out.
fields.JP:
おまえも言うようになったな。
どれ……腕を出せよ。
一応、メアリガンも診とくか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're learning how
things work around here. C'mon,
gimme your arm. I'll check it out.

fields.JP:
……そんなわけで、
博士も、とても喜んでくれて……

fields.EN:
Um, Haru-san... do you and the Professor
not get along?
fields.JP:
あの、ハルさんって……
もしかして、博士と仲が悪いんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, do you and the Professor not
get along?

fields.EN:
The way you react when I talk
about the Professor is unusual.
Almost as if you didn't care...
fields.JP:
なんだか……博士の話になると、
日頃とは受け答えが違う気がして……
まるで、どうでもいいみたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The way you react when I talk
about the Professor is unusual.
Almost as if you didn't care...

fields.EN:
No. We've been great friends
for a long time. Why do you ask?
fields.JP:
……そうか？
大の仲良しだよ、昔からな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? We were the best of
friends a long time ago.

fields.EN:
I wonder if we'll really be able
to escape from the Jail.
fields.JP: ……ジェイル脱出なんて、本当に出来るのかね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if we'll really be able
to escape from the Jail.

fields.EN: Don't you want to escape, Haru-san?
fields.JP:
ハルさんは……
ここから脱出したくないんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't you want to escape, Haru?

fields.EN:
Whether I do or not doesn't really
change much for me...
fields.JP:
……まあ、してもしなくても、
似たようなもんだっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whether I do or not doesn't really
change much for me...

fields.EN:
Oh, but I guess I'd be out of a
job.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I guess I'd be out of a
job.

fields.EN:
(This isn't the usual Haru-san... He's
a key member of the Dawn, but it's
like he doesn't want to escape...)
fields.JP:
（これは、いつもの軽口じゃない……
　ハルさんは黎明の中枢にいるのに、
　ジェイル脱出を望んでない……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't the usual Haru... He's
a key member of the Dawn, but it's
like he doesn't want to escape...)

fields.EN:
In any case, I'm planning on
supporting you guys and gals as
needed.
fields.JP:
ま、なんにせよ……
俺は、お前らを支えていくつもりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I'm planning on
supporting you guys and gals as
needed.

fields.EN:
Just leave the calibration of your
Mary Gun to me.
fields.JP: こいつのメンテも任しとけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just leave the calibration of your
Mary Gun to me.

fields.EN:
And... done! Come by to slack off
again anytime.
fields.JP:
ほい、点検終わったぜ！
また、いつでもサボりに来いよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... done! Come by to slack off
again anytime.

fields.EN:
You're not going to say anything
else to me?
fields.JP: 何も……話してはくれないんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not going to say anything
else to me?

fields.EN:
Wipe off that sad-looking mug of
yours, and just keep your eyes
straight ahead.
fields.JP:
ま、お前は前だけ見てろ。
不景気なツラしてねえでな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wipe off that sad-looking mug of
yours, and just keep your eyes
straight ahead.

fields.EN:
(Maybe Haru-san has different plans
from the Professor...)
fields.JP:
（もしかしたら、ハルさんには……
　博士とは別の思惑があるのかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Haru has different plans
from the Professor...)

fields.EN:
Blood pressure is normal... Looks
like the results came back fine,
despite your long captivity.
fields.JP:
……血圧は正常ね。簡易血液検査の方でも、
特に悪い数値は出てなかったし……大丈夫。
長い間収監されていたにしては、健康体よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood pressure is normal... Looks
like the results came back fine,
despite your long captivity.

fields.EN: I see. That's good to know.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. That's good to know.

fields.EN:
I understand that you want to protect her.
But if you keep doing reckless things,
you'll eventually die... Please be careful.
fields.JP:
あなたがあの子を護りたい気持ちはわかるわ。
でも、無茶なことを続ければ、いずれ死ぬ……
気をつけてちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand how you feel, wanting
to protect her, but you need to be
careful. You could die, you know.

fields.JP: 別に……アリスのことだけじゃ……

fields.EN:
I just want to be of use to
everyone...
fields.JP: ただ……僕も、みんなの役に立ちたいだけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just want to be of use to
everyone...

fields.EN:
Let me give it to you straight. I
sense potential in you, so I want
you to be more cautious.
fields.JP:
はっきり言うわ。
これは独断だけど、あなたには可能性を感じて
いるの。だからこそ、慎重に振舞ってほしいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me give it to you straight. I
sense potential in you, so I want
you to be more cautious.

fields.JP: ありがとう……ございます……

fields.EN:
(I think this is the first time
someone's thought about me like
that...)
fields.JP:
（そんな風に言ってもらえたのは、初めてかも
　しれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think this is the first time
someone's thought about me like
that...)

fields.EN:
Um, so I went to the Order of the
Sun, and... they're quite unique.
fields.JP:
その……タイヨウ教団に行ってみました。
不思議なところですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, so I went to the Order of the
Sun, and... they're quite unique.

fields.EN:
Oohime-san is somehow mysterious,
and Hitsuka-san is kind of scary...
fields.JP:
大陽女さんって人は、何だか不思議な人ですし、
陽司さんってどこか怖いし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime was really mysterious,
and Hitsuka sounded pretty mean...

fields.EN:
But... it felt like everyone there
revered them... I wondered if that's
what religious organizations are like...
fields.JP:
でも……みんなあの人たちを敬ってる感じで……
宗教団体って、そういう場所なのかなあって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I could tell everyone there
admired them, kind of like some
religious cult...

fields.EN:
I see... Well, I won't stop you
from going, especially after I
urged you to check them out...
fields.JP:
そう……まあ、行くなとは言えないしね。
私も、『行ってみれば』なんて言っちゃったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Well, I won't stop you
from going, especially after I
urged you to check them out...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. I seem to get emotional
when the conversation is about
the Order...
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい。
教団のことになると、どうも感情的になる
きらいがあるわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I seem to get emotional
when the conversation is about
the Order...

fields.EN:
I've wondered about this before... Miko-san,
do you dislike those people?
fields.JP:
前も少し思ったんですけど……視子さんはあの人
たちのことが嫌いなんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been wondering... Why don't
you like them?

fields.EN:
It's not that I don't like them...
It's more that I just can't get
along with them.
fields.JP:
嫌いというか……
ああしたものが苦手なのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not that I don't like them...
It's more that I just can't get
along with them.

fields.EN:
I'm a researcher, so I only accept
data I can physically confirm.
That's why I look for the truth.
fields.JP:
私は研究者だから、自分の目やデータで確認した
ものしか信じられないし、そうして真実に到達
しようとしているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a researcher, so I only accept
data I can physically confirm.
That's why I look for the truth.

fields.EN:
That's why I don't understand the point of
passing down this longing for the sun when
they can barely even remember it themselves.
fields.JP:
だから、覚えてるかどうかも怪しいような太陽
への憧れを、ああして語り伝えることの意義が、
私には理解できないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't really understand them,
with their evangelism and their
baseless admiration of the sun.

fields.EN:
But... Isn't it okay, as long as
there are people out there who
can be saved by their words?
fields.JP:
でも……それで気持ちが救われる人がいるなら、
誰かの役には立ってるんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... Isn't it okay, as long as
there are people out there who
can be saved by their words?

fields.EN:
The Order runs soup kitchens and comes
to barter food with the Dawn... but
whatever they do, they need labor.
fields.JP:
教団は炊き出しをしたり、黎明と食べ物の物々
交換をしに来たりするけど……何をするにしても
労働力というものは要るのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They cook for and trade various
products with us. Everything
requires cooperative work.

fields.EN:
That said, I feel like they're
gathering believers for labor.
fields.JP:
その労働力を確保するために、信者を集めて
いるのではないか……そんな風に思えることすら
あるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I feel like they're
gathering believers for labor.

fields.EN:
But if that's what needs to be
done to live, then...
fields.JP: でも、そうしてみんなで生きていくためなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if that's what needs to be
done to live, then...

fields.EN:
Then they should simply say so and
recruit volunteers... Maybe thinking that
way is an occupational habit of mine.
fields.JP:
それならそう言って希望者を募ればいい……
そう考えるのは、私の職業病なのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then they should just say so, and
find people to work for them. 
That's my opinion, at least.

fields.EN:
Not to mention, I'm curious about
how they can actually grow food
like that in this situation.
fields.JP:
それに……この状況で、どうやってあんな風に
作物を生産できるというのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention, I'm curious about
how they can actually grow food
like that in this situation.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: ……それは、どういう意味ですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.JP: （視子さん……何を言おうとしたんだろう……？）

fields.EN:
With how questionable that Oohime
is, Hitsuka is pretty much the
acting leader of the Order.
fields.JP:
……それに、あの大陽女のオツムのゆるさじゃ、
横にいる陽司って人があの教団の実質的なトップ
だと考えて間違いないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how questionable that Oohime
is, Hitsuka is pretty much the
acting leader of the Order.

fields.EN:
Historically, religious groups always have
human and social backing... They aren't
something one person can run entirely alone.
fields.JP:
でも歴史上、宗教団体の成立には人的、社会的な
バックボーンが必ず存在するもの……
純粋に個人が一手に担えるものではないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we examine history, all
religious orders have someone that
acts as the group's backbone.

fields.EN:
Normally, there should be people behind
Oohime and Hitsuka who support and aid
them—and who also want to make use of them.
fields.JP:
通常なら、大陽女や陽司の背後には、必ずそれを
支持・援助し、かつ利用しようとする人たちが
いる筈なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't maintain order alone.
Someone has to be supporting
Oohime and Hitsuka from behind.

fields.EN:
And in complying with that person,
whoever has the most charisma is
pushed to the leader position.
fields.JP:
そして、いわばそうした人たちの要請を受ける
形で、ある種のカリスマ性を持つ人物が教祖と
して押し上げられてくるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And in complying with that person,
whoever has the most charisma is
pushed to the leader position.

fields.EN:
So that's how it was...? That's
history from the old world, right?
Miko-san, you really know a lot...!
fields.JP:
そういうものなんですか……！
それ、昔の世界の歴史ですよね？
視子さんはいろいろ詳しいんですね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that how it works? I'm
surprised you have so much
historical knowledge!

fields.EN:
I've just had the time to read
various materials from times past.
fields.JP:
遺された資料を読む時間だけはあったから……
それだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've just had the time to read
various materials from times past.

fields.EN:
As far as I know, the Order came
from nowhere. There's no trace of
anyone supporting its beginnings.
fields.JP:
……でも私の知る限りでは、あの教団はある時
突然誕生したの。大陽女や陽司に所属母体や
支持者がいたという情報も無いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As far as I know, the Order came
from nowhere. There's no trace of
anyone supporting its beginnings.

fields.EN:
That's the basis for why they seem
suspicious to me...
fields.JP: だから……胡散臭すぎるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the basis for why they seem
suspicious to me...

fields.EN:
Couldn't you say that they're
there because the people are
seeking the sun?
fields.JP:
みんなが太陽を求めてるから……じゃ、
駄目なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Couldn't you say that they're
there because the people are
seeking the sun?

fields.EN:
I suppose... The sun was touted as
a god by the ancients, so I guess
it's universal across all ages...
fields.JP:
……そうね。まあ太陽は昔から神として崇められ
ていたしね。こんな状況じゃ、ああいうのも必要
なのかもしれないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose... The sun was touted as
a god by the ancients, so I guess
it's universal across all ages...

fields.EN:
But, know this... You can't find
salvation from the Jail through
religion...
fields.JP:
でも宗教なんかじゃ、このジェイルからは救われ
ないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, know this... You can't find
salvation from the Jail through
religion...

fields.EN:
Looks like your heart rate is
higher than normal. Your urine
samples are of concern, as well...
fields.JP:
……少しいつもより心拍数が早いわね。
尿検査でも少し気になる値があるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like your heart rate is
higher than normal. Your urine
samples are of concern, as well...

fields.EN:
Does that mean I won't be able to
use the Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
それって、メアリガンが使えなくなるって
ことですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean I won't be able to
use the Mary Gun?

fields.EN:
Your results don't point to
that, but your reaction does...
fields.JP:
特にどれも正常値は超えてないわ。
どちらかというと、あなたの今のその反応よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your results don't point to
that, but your reaction does...

fields.EN:
You're stressed... I can't believe
how much more stressed you are now
than when you first arrived!
fields.JP:
……ストレスが溜まってるのよ。
ここへ来たばかりの頃より、ストレス度が
上がってるってどういうこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're stressed... I can't believe
how much more stressed you are now
than when you first arrived!

fields.EN:
It's not like I know I'm stressed,
you know?
fields.JP: じ、自分では自覚ないんですけど！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like I know I'm stressed,
you know?

fields.EN:
Honestly... I understand the Mary Gun has
given you a strong sense of duty. But don't
confuse the means with the objective.
fields.JP:
まったく……メアリガンを得て、あなたが
使命感を強く感じているのはわかるわ。
でも、手段と目的を取り違えては駄目よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable... I understand your
stance now that you have the Mary
Gun, but you need to stay focused.

fields.EN:
Remember your promise with Haru-san?
The Mary Gun was made for the sole
purpose of keeping everyone alive.
fields.JP:
ええ、そう。ハルさんとも約束した筈でしょう。
メアリガンはあなたたちが生き残るための手段に
過ぎないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember your promise with Haru?
The Mary Gun was made for the sole
purpose of keeping everyone alive.

fields.EN: You're not alive for the Mary Gun.
fields.JP:
メアリガンのためにあなたが生きてるわけじゃ
ないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not alive for the Mary Gun.

fields.EN:
But, this is the only way I can
help...
fields.JP: でも……僕にできることは、それくらいしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, this is the only way I can
help...

fields.EN:
Too serious. You should learn a
thing or two from Kaguya.
fields.JP:
……真面目すぎ。
少しはかぐやを見習うべきかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too serious. You should learn a
thing or two from Kaguya.

fields.EN:
You need to relax. Keep up this
pace, and you'll just drop. Enjoy
life a little.
fields.JP:
肩に力が入りすぎなのよ。
その気負いだけでいずれ潰れるわ。
……少しは生きることも楽しみなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need to relax. Keep up this
pace, and you'll just drop. Enjoy
life a little.

fields.EN:
...Miko-san, I don't think I want to hear that
from you...
fields.JP: ……視子さんには言われたくない気が……
fields.LOCALIZED: And this is coming from you...

fields.EN:
So, you can still make snide
remarks? Good. You're excused.
fields.JP:
……ま、軽口が出てくるならいいわ。
お疲れさま
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you can still make snide
remarks? Good. You're excused.

fields.JP: ありがとうございます。……あの

fields.EN:
Miko-san, your surname is 'Ueshima,' right?
That means you have memories of your family.
I'm kind of jealous...
fields.JP:
視子さんって、『上島』って苗字がありますよね。
それってやっぱり、家族の記憶があるってことです
よね。なんだかうらやましいなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your last name is "Ueshima,"
right? That means you must have
memories about your family.

fields.EN:
It's true that I'm one of the very
few here who actually knows
their last name.
fields.JP:
確かに……今ではこの世界で苗字を名乗っている
人は少ないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true that I'm one of the very
few here who actually knows
their last name.

fields.EN:
I barely remember my parents. They probably
died when the world became like this...
By the time I noticed, I was an orphan.
fields.JP:
親の記憶なんて、私にもほとんどないわ。
こんな世界になった時におそらく両親は死んだ
のね……気づいた時には孤児だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I don't have any memories of
my parents. I supposed my parents
died when this place was born.

fields.EN:
(I'm a bit leery to ask this now,
but...)
fields.JP: （それじゃ……聞いてみたら悪いかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm a bit leery to ask this now,
but...)

fields.JP: あの、それじゃあ『上島』って……

fields.EN:
That's the last name of my mentor,
the person I admired.
fields.JP:
ふふ……そうね。
これは……私の師匠というか、憧れていた人の
苗字なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the last name of my mentor,
the person I admired.

fields.EN:
What my true last name was isn't
of importance now.
fields.JP:
私にとって元の苗字なんて、覚えていたところで
意味は無いものだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What my true last name was isn't
of importance now.

fields.EN:
And, I wanted to carry on her
will, so I just decided to use her
last name as mine...
fields.JP:
あの人の意思を継ぎたくて、勝手に名乗ってると
いったところかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I wanted to carry on her
will, so I just decided to use her
last name as mine...

fields.EN:
I see... So where is this person
now?
fields.JP:
そうだったんですか……
その人は、今は……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So where is this person
now?

fields.EN:
She died 15 years ago during a
mission to the Tower.
fields.JP: 死んだわ。十五年前、塔の攻略作戦でね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She died 15 years ago during a
mission to the Tower.

fields.EN:
I bet you feel bad for asking, but
don't. They're just facts. It's a
part of the Dawn's history now.
fields.JP:
悪いことを聞いたと思ってるんでしょうけど、
気にしてないわ。事実だもの。
黎明の歴史に過ぎないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet you feel bad for asking, but
don't. They're just facts. It's a
part of the Dawn's history now.

fields.EN:
(She must be in pain... Especially
since she took that person's
name...)
fields.JP:
（でも、悲しくないはずがない……じゃなければ
　名前を受け嗣いだりなんか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must be in pain... Especially
since she took that person's
name...)

fields.EN:
The Professor spoke about it
before, but that incident nearly
dismantled the Dawn.
fields.JP:
博士も話していたけれど、あの時黎明は中枢を
一度に失い、一度崩壊しかけたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor spoke about it
before, but that incident nearly
dismantled the Dawn.

fields.EN:
Ueshima-sensei—'Sensei'—and Dawn's other core
members died at the Tower... entrusting the
Professor's life and mind to the future.
fields.JP:
通称『先生』……上島先生を含め、黎明の中枢を
担っていた人は、みんな塔で戦死したわ。
……博士の生命と頭脳を未来に託してね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doctor Ueshima and key members
of the Dawn died at the Tower,
leaving only the Professor.

fields.EN:
Then Miko-san, you've known the Professor
since long ago...
fields.JP:
じゃあ……視子さんは、昔から博士とは知り合い
だったんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you've known the Professor from
that long ago...

fields.EN:
...I was still a little child back then. I was
only helping Sensei alongside the adults...
fields.JP:
……あの頃はまだ小さな子供で、大人たちに
混じって、先生の手伝いをしてただけだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was still a child back then, and
I only assisted Dr. Ueshima with
her duties.

fields.EN:
But the people around me back then gradually
died in battle during the Jail research...
and now I've ended up in charge here.
fields.JP:
でも、その頃の周りの人たちも、ジェイル研究の
間にだんだん戦死していって……今では私が
ここの責任者になってしまったというわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But since then, other researchers
have died one-by-one, and now I'm
left to carry the load.

fields.EN:
Yes... I suppose it would be a lie
to say that I've recovered from it
already.
fields.JP:
……そうね。気持ちの整理がついているといったら
嘘になるわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I suppose it would be a lie
to say that I've recovered from it
already.

fields.EN:
Last time, Haru-san was saying
something about escaping here not
mattering much to him...
fields.JP:
このあいだ、ハルさんが『脱出してもしなくても
似たようなもん』って言ってたんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Last time, Haru was saying
something about escaping here not
mattering much to him...

fields.EN:
Is Haru-san against escaping from the
Jail?
fields.JP:
ハルさんはジェイル脱出計画には反対……
なんでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is Haru against escaping from the
Jail?

fields.EN:
I just think that old man is
trying to be cynical or something.
fields.JP:
ま、あのオッさんはただ斜に構えてるだけだと
思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just think that old man is
trying to be cynical or something.

fields.EN:
But as for what will happen when
the Tower grows high enough, our
being able to escape or not...
fields.JP:
ただ……塔が目標の高さまで成長し切った時に、
いったい何が起きるのか……本当にそこから
脱出できるのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But as for what will happen when
the Tower grows high enough, our
being able to escape or not...

fields.EN:
...Is just us betting on the best
outcome. After all, this will be
the first time for everyone.
fields.JP:
それは全て、可能性に賭けているとしか
言いようがないのも本当ね。
何しろ、前例が無いんだもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Is just us betting on the best
outcome. After all, this will be
the first time for everyone.

fields.EN:
There are a lot of things we don't
know about the Jail yet, like the
talking Nightmares...
fields.JP:
ナイトメアが喋れることがわかったり……
ジェイルにはまだ、わからないことだらけ
だし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are a lot of things we don't
know about the Jail yet, like the
talking Nightmares...

fields.EN:
Yes, and sometimes I think maybe
there was a more efficient way of
approaching things from the onset.
fields.JP:
……そうね。実はもっと前提から……
つまり、他により効率の良い方法があるんじゃ
ないかって、時々思うことはあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and sometimes I think maybe
there was a more efficient way of
approaching things from the onset.

fields.EN:
But we are limited on resources,
so our only option is to continue
focusing on our plan.
fields.JP:
でも、私たちの調査能力は限られているし、
現状、全てのリソースをこの計画に注いでるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we are limited on resources,
so our only option is to continue
focusing on our plan.

fields.EN:
So unless we have solid proof
against it, we need to carry it
out with all we have.
fields.JP:
だから……反証を持たない以上は、この計画に
沿って進めるしかないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So unless we have solid proof
against it, we need to carry it
out with all we have.

fields.EN:
(So Miko-san does have her doubts
about the plan...)
fields.JP: （視子さんも疑問は持ってたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So Miko does have her doubts
about the plan...)

fields.EN:
I guess that's the general gist of
what Haru-san was getting at.
fields.JP:
ハルさんが言ってたのも、そんな感じのことじゃ
ないかしらね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that's the general gist of
what Haru was getting at.

fields.EN:
I'm such a horrible adult for
instilling anxiety in someone on
the front-lines like yourself.
fields.JP:
ふふ。前線で戦ってるあなたに、こんな不安を
与えるような愚痴を言ってたら、大人失格ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm such a horrible adult for
instilling anxiety in someone on
the front-lines like yourself.

fields.EN:
We want to know the truth, too.
Thank you very much.
fields.JP:
僕たちだって、本当のことを知っていきたいん
です。だから……ありがとうございます
fields.LOCALIZED:
We want to know the truth, too.
Thank you very much.

fields.JP: お役に立ったなら、光栄よ
ほらぁ……ダメだよ、目を離しちゃあ！
……あれ？　何か起きてるのかな？

fields.EN:
C'mon, it looks like it can still
move. It was about to get away!
fields.JP:
ほら。コイツ、まだ動けるみたいじゃない。
逃げちゃうとこだったよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, it looks like it can still
move. It was about to get away!

fields.JP:
……あっははは！
すまんすまん！
このオレとしたことが……
赤ずきんさん！　門脇さん！
あの……何があったんですか？
ああ。ジャックにアリスか

fields.EN:
Ah, the kid and the newcomer!
Well, this is embarrassing...
fields.JP:
おお、小僧に新入りか！
いやあ、こいつはみっともないとこを
見られちまったなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, the kid and the newcomer!
Well, this is embarrassing...

fields.JP: 永遠……あんた、いい加減名前覚えなよ……

fields.EN:
(I thought he didn't like us, but
I guess it's just that he didn't
remember our names...)
fields.JP:
（少し嫌われてるのかと思ったけど、
　名前、覚えるのが苦手なだけだったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought he didn't like us, but
I guess it's just that he didn't
remember our names...)

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Well, not a major issue,
but...
fields.JP:
ははは。
いやあ、別に大したことじゃないんだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Well, not a major issue,
but...

fields.EN:
Huh... So a Marchen that was
supposed to be discarded, becoming
a runaway isn't a major issue, eh?
fields.JP:
へぇ……廃棄処理予定のメルヒェンが
逃げ出そうとしてたんだけど……
大したことじゃないんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... So a Marchen that was
supposed to be discarded, becoming
a runaway isn't a major issue, eh?

fields.EN:
Where's your sense of duty? You
should know that Marchens sent
from Dad need to be discarded.
fields.JP:
あんた、ちょっと職務怠慢。
お父さんのとこからメルヒェン引き上げたら、
速攻で処分するってのが決まりでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where's your sense of duty? You
should know that Marchens sent
from Dad need to be discarded.

fields.EN:
Sure, fine, it's all my fault.
Dad, Dad, Dad. Is that all you can
say?
fields.JP:
……はいはい、オレが悪うございました！
ははは！　お父さん、お父さん、お父さん……。
寝ても覚めても、お父さんか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, fine, it's all my fault.
Dad, Dad, Dad. Is that all you can
say?

fields.EN:
(Is he purposely going easy
against the Marchen? It's as if he
was playing with it...)
fields.JP:
（この人……
　わざと手加減して痛めつけてる……！？
　まるで嬲ってるみたいな……でも、まさか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is he purposely going easy
against the Marchen? It's as if he
was playing with it...)

fields.EN:
If there's something you want to
say, say it to my face.
fields.JP: 言いたいことがあるなら、はっきり言いなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there's something you want to
say, say it to my face.

fields.EN:
Ah, really? Okay then. You see
this Marchen here? I'm tired of
these types already!
fields.JP:
おお、そうか？　そんなら、言わしてもらうわ。
このメルヒェンな……
このタイプには、もう飽き飽きしてんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, really? Okay then. You see
this Marchen here? I'm tired of
these types already!

fields.EN:
They don't even put up a fight!
All they do is moan. If you really
want me to work...
fields.JP:
抵抗するわけでもねえし、反応も悪いときた！
せいぜいが哀れっぽい声を上げるぐらいでな。
オレに真っ当な仕事をさせたかったらよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They don't even put up a fight!
All they do is moan. If you really
want me to work...

fields.EN:
Bring me one that's more worth killing!
Something new that'll raise my motivation
and keep me entertained for a long time!
fields.JP:
もっと殺し甲斐のあるヤツを連れて来いよ！
オレの勤労意欲をアップさせるような、
目新しくて長く楽しめるようなヤツをよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Bring me one that's worth
killing! Get me one that's going
to motivate me to actually work!

fields.JP:
…………ハ！
やっぱビョーキだよ、あんた

fields.EN:
Well then, I'll finish this one
off myself.
fields.JP: ……なら、コイツはあたしが始末しとく
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I'll finish this one
off myself.

fields.EN:
Now, hold on there! This one is
better than nothing. I'm going to
kill it myself!
fields.JP:
……おっと、待った！
こんなカスでも、ないよりゃマシだ。
もちろん……オレが殺るさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, hold on there! This one is
better than nothing. I'm going to
kill it myself!

fields.JP:
…………
はぁ、好きにしなよ。
行こう……ジャック、アリス

fields.LOCALIZED:
Mr. Kadowaki, we'll be leaving
now...

fields.EN:
Sorry for the ruckus. Must have
been a bad day. Come back again
later. I'll just get back to work.
fields.JP:
ああ。また、ゆっくり遊びに来いよ。
今日は、日が悪かったみたいだからな。
……オレは職務に励むとするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for the ruckus. Must have
been a bad day. Come back again
later. I'll just get back to work.

fields.EN:
I heard that Kadowaki-san was
handling the Marchens that the
Professor finished studying...
fields.JP:
博士が研究に使った後のメルヒェンは……
門脇さんが処理してるって聞いたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard that Mr. Kadowaki was
handling the Marchens that the
Professor finished studying...

fields.EN: He's playing with them, isn't he?
fields.LOCALIZED: He's playing with them, isn't he?

fields.EN:
Yup, pretty much. That's... his
pastime...
fields.JP:
うん、大抵はそう。
あれ、あいつの趣味なんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, pretty much. That's... his
pastime...

fields.JP: あの、博士はこのことは？

fields.EN:
He just lets Towa handle
everything, so...
fields.JP: 永遠に全部任せてるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He just lets Towa handle
everything, so...

fields.JP:
だっははははは……！
うあっはははははは…
ははは…いてぇええぇ…！

fields.EN: He's really not a bad person...
fields.JP: 普段は悪い奴じゃないんだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED: He's really not a bad person...

fields.EN:
Come on! You can do better than
that!
fields.JP: ほら！　もっと暴れろよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on! You can do better than
that!

fields.EN:
(Even if it was a Marchen, that
was really disturbing...)
fields.JP:
（いくら相手がメルヒェンでも……こういうのは
　……気分がいいもんじゃないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if it was a Marchen, that
was really disturbing...)

fields.EN: Say, Jack? Let's stop him already.
fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャック……もう、いいじゃない？
止しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Say, Jack? Let's stop him already.

fields.EN:
You know how the captured Marchens
are being disposed of now, right?
fields.JP:
黎明が捕獲したメルヒェンを、
どう処理しているのかについては……
もう充分にわかったでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how the captured Marchens
are being disposed of now, right?

fields.EN:
You mean how Kadowaki-san is
killing them for pleasure?
fields.JP: ……門脇さんが、面白半分に虐殺してる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean how Mr. Kadowaki is
killing them for pleasure?

fields.EN:
It didn't seem like that back
then, but I wonder if that's
really true.
fields.JP:
あの時はそんな風に見えたけど……
本当に、そうだったのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It didn't seem like that back
then, but I wonder if that's
really true.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Something didn't feel right about
Kadowaki-san and Akazukin-san
back then.
fields.JP:
……あの日、門脇さんも赤ずきんさんも、
ちょっと様子がおかしかった気がしてさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something didn't feel right about
Mr. Kadowaki and Red Riding Hood
back then.

fields.EN:
When Kadowaki-san noticed us
watching them argue, it felt like
he...
fields.JP:
二人が言い合いしてるところに、
ちょうど僕らが行き合わせたもんだから、
門脇さんも……何て言うか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When Mr. Kadowaki noticed us
watching them argue, it felt like
he...

fields.JP: ……露悪的な反応になってしまった？

fields.EN:
Yeah... It just felt like that. It
sure wasn't the same Kadowaki-san
that we know.
fields.JP:
……うん。
そんな感じだったんじゃないかと思うんだ。
いつもの門脇さんらしくなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It just felt like that. It
sure wasn't the same Mr. Kadowaki
that we know.

fields.EN: I'm not so sure about that...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not so sure about that...

fields.EN:
We didn't really see the Marchen
being killed or anything, either.
fields.JP:
結局、僕らはメルヒェンが処理されるところを、
見たわけじゃないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't really see the Marchen
being killed or anything, either.

fields.EN:
I just think we should know how
the captured Marchens are being
discarded...
fields.JP:
黎明が捕獲したメルヒェンを、
最終的にどんな風に処理しているのか……
ちゃんと知っておきたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just think we should know how
the captured Marchens are being
discarded...

fields.EN:
I see... I guess we should learn a
bit more about it.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
知っておくべきかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I guess we should learn a
bit more about it.

fields.JP: うん。門脇さんに直接聞いてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's go and ask Mr. Kadowaki.

fields.EN:
Hey, there! Hahaha! Nice to see
you two together again! What
brings you here?
fields.JP:
やあ、お二人さん！
ははは！　いつも仲がいいね！
オレに、なんか用かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, there! Hahaha! Nice to see
you two together again! What
brings you here?

fields.JP: （……やっぱり、いつもの門脇さんだ）

fields.EN:
Sure thing! Is it okay we talk
while I feed her?
fields.JP:
ああ、かまわないよ。
コイツに餌をやりながらでいいか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure thing! Is it okay we talk
while I feed her?

fields.EN:
I didn't know you owned a cat,
Kadowaki-san.
fields.JP:
その猫、どうしたんですか？
門脇さんが飼っているんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you owned a cat,
Mr. Kadowaki.

fields.EN:
I don't own her. She was chased
by a Marchen and ran in here.
fields.JP:
いや、オレが飼ってるってわけじゃない。
ちょっと前にメルヒェンに追われて、
ここに逃げ込んできてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't own her. She was chased
by a Marchen and ran in here.

fields.EN:
So she's more like the Dawn's pet.
Our guys here put together some
scraps for her to eat.
fields.JP:
黎明本部全体で飼ってるようなもんさ。
有志が協力して、乏しい食糧配給から、
コイツの食い扶持を捻出してるのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So she's more like the Dawn's pet.
Our guys here put together some
scraps for her to eat.

fields.EN:
She doesn't have a name yet. Got
any suggestions?
fields.JP:
まださ。
現在、募集中なんだ。
いい名前、無いかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't have a name yet. Got
any suggestions?

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Just let me know if you
come up with a good one!
fields.JP:
ははは。
思いついたらでいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Just let me know if you
come up with a good one!

fields.EN:
Maybe I can help bring some food
for her, too...
fields.JP:
……わたしも協力しようかしら……
猫ちゃんの餌……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe I can help bring some food
for her, too...

fields.EN:
Really? That would help a lot! Did
you hear that? Hey now, eat
slowly. Tastes good, right?
fields.JP:
そうか？　助かるよ！
よおし、よし……うまいか？
ゆっくり食えよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? That would help a lot! Did
you hear that? Hey now, eat
slowly. Tastes good, right?

fields.EN:
(I can't imagine Kadowaki-san
acting like how he did before...)
fields.JP:
（門脇さん……
　やっぱり、いつもあんなことする人には
　思えない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't imagine Mr. Kadowaki
acting like how he did before...)

fields.EN:
So, what is it again? You wanted
to ask me something, right?
fields.JP:
……それで何だい？
オレに、なんか用があったんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what is it again? You wanted
to ask me something, right?

fields.EN:
Um... What do you usually do with
Marchens once you're done researching
them? Like the one from the other day...
fields.JP:
あの……研究の済んだメルヒェンって、
いつもどんな風に処理しているんですか？
この間のやつもそうですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
About the Marchens... Do you
usually treat them like that? You
know, like the last one...

fields.EN:
I hurt it until it couldn't move,
then cut it to pieces, so all's
good now!
fields.JP:
この間のヤツなら、
動けなくなるまで痛めつけてから、
バラバラに斬り刻んでやったから安心していいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hurt it until it couldn't move,
then cut it to pieces, so all's
good now!

fields.EN:
I'm pretty much in charge of
handling all the Marchens to be
discarded.
fields.JP:
ここでのメルヒェンの廃棄処理は、
オレに一任されていてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm pretty much in charge of
handling all the Marchens to be
discarded.

fields.EN:
You should've seen the one before
that! It lasted a while! Not as
much energy, but boy was it fun!
fields.JP:
この間のヤツなんかは、案外しぶとくてね！
思ったよりは、楽しめたよ。
まあ、新味には欠けるけどね。ははは！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should've seen the one before
that! It lasted a while! Not as
much energy, but boy was it fun!

fields.EN:
Why don't you just end it quickly?
Why go through all the hassle?
fields.JP:
……どうして、一思いに殺さずに……
そんなに……手間をかけるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you just end it quickly?
Why go through all the hassle?

fields.EN:
Oh, come on! Stop with that face
of yours! They're our enemies, and
they deserve to be treated so.
fields.JP:
なんだよ、おい！？　そんな顔するなって！
あいつらは人類の敵じゃないか。なあ？
何をしたって構わないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on! Stop with that face
of yours! They're our enemies, and
they deserve to be treated so.

fields.EN:
But, torturing them like that
isn't necessary...
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, torturing them like that
isn't necessary...

fields.EN:
Hey, that's not fair! You folks
get to have all the fun, but not
me? This place is a real bore.
fields.JP:
おいおい！　お前らばっか楽しんでないで、
オレにも少しはストレス解消させてくれよ？
ここは娯楽も少ないんだからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, that's not fair! You folks
get to have all the fun, but not
me? This place is a real bore.

fields.EN:
Yeah... Um, sorry to have bothered
you, Kadowaki-san...
fields.JP:
うん……
あの、門脇さん、それじゃ……
お仕事中、邪魔してすいませんでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Um, sorry to have bothered
you, Mr. Kadowaki...

fields.EN:
Hm? No problem! I was just taking
a break anyway!
fields.JP:
ん？
ああ、気にするなよ！
休憩時間みたいなもんだ。なあ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? No problem! I was just taking
a break anyway!

fields.EN:
Next time, send me a new one to
kill! I'm counting on you!
fields.JP:
今度は是非、新種を刻んでみたいね！
よろしく頼むぜ、お二人さん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next time, send me a new one to
kill! I'm counting on you!

fields.EN:
No, I'm sorry... I wanted to learn
more, too...
fields.JP:
いいえ、わたしも……
わたしも、知りたかったもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm sorry... I wanted to learn
more, too...

fields.EN:
(I don't really understand Kadowaki-san...
Why isn't anyone stopping him?)
fields.JP:
（門脇さんのことが、よくわからない……
　どうしてみんな止めないんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't understand why he's
doing that... Why isn't anyone
stopping him?)

fields.JP:
（……みんな、同じように思ってるんだろうか？
　誰か、知ってる人はいないのかな……？）

fields.EN:
Keep your arm still... It may hurt
a bit.
fields.JP:
……そのまま腕を動かさないでね？
ちょっとだけ痛いかもしれないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep your arm still... It may hurt
a bit.

fields.EN:
I replaced the Mary Gun drain pipe's
winged needle with an indwelling one. It
should make attachment and removal easier.
fields.JP:
メアリガンのドレーンパイプの挿管部を、
翼状針から留置針へ交換しておいたわ。
脱着がいくぶん楽になる筈よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I changed the winged needle on the
drain pipe to an indwelling one.
It should make it easier to use.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much. That needle
hurt a bit, so this helps a lot.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
実は針、ちょっと痛かったから……助かります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much. That needle
hurt a bit, so this helps a lot.

fields.EN:
I suggested modifying the needle,
but that old man said that guys
should be able to bear it...
fields.JP:
針の改良を提案したら、あの不良中年、
『男ならちょっとくらい痛くたって我慢しろ』
だなんて言ってたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suggested modifying the needle,
but that old man said that guys
should be able to bear it...

fields.EN:
What is he going to do if things
like this negatively affect the
missions?
fields.JP:
実際に作戦行動に支障を来したら
どうするつもりなのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is he going to do if things
like this negatively affect the
missions?

fields.EN: Heh... That does sound like Haru-san.
fields.JP: あはは……まあ、ハルさんらしいですよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh... That does sound like Haru.

fields.EN:
If you develop any inflammation,
report it to me right away.
fields.JP: まあ、炎症が出るようなら、すぐに報告して
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you see any swelling, be sure
to let me know.

fields.EN:
We're done here. Is there
something else that's bothering
you?
fields.JP:
……処置は済んだわよ？
なに？　どこか具合でも悪い？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're done here. Is there
something else that's bothering
you?

fields.EN:
...No, that's not it. Um... Miko-san, do you
know about the disposal of Marchens?
fields.JP:
……いえ、そうじゃないんです。
あの……視子さんは……
メルヒェンの廃棄についてご存知ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, sort of... Um, what do you
know about how the Marchens
are being disposed?

fields.EN:
Ah, you must be talking about
Kadowaki-kun... You saw it?
fields.JP:
ああ……その話？
門脇くんの件ね。
……あれを見ちゃったのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, you must be talking about
Kadowaki... You saw it?

fields.EN:
I know what you want to say. I'm
not very proud of what's going on,
either.
fields.JP:
あなたの言いたいことはわかるわ。
私も、あれは感心しない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know what you want to say. I'm
not very proud of what's going on,
either.

fields.EN:
The Marchens may be our enemies,
but... to play with them like that
until their death is...
fields.JP:
確かにメルヒェンは僕らの敵だけど……
あれは……無意味な嬲り殺しです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchens may be our enemies,
but... to play with them like that
until their death is...

fields.EN:
It feels much different coming
from someone actually fighting
the Marchens, but... you're right.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンと戦ってる子の口から聞くと
新鮮だけど……
……ま、それはそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels much different coming
from someone actually fighting
the Marchens, but... you're right.

fields.EN:
That's no different from the
torturing the Marchens do to the
humans they capture.
fields.JP:
あれじゃ、まるで……
投獄した人間にメルヒェンがやってる拷問と
同じじゃないかって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's no different from the
torturing the Marchens do to the
humans they capture.

fields.EN:
Um... Miko-san, could you ask Kadowaki-san
to stop? If it came from you, maybe he...
fields.JP:
あの……視子さんから門脇さんに、
やめてもらうように言ってもらえませんか？
視子さんの言葉なら、門脇さんも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it possible for you to tell Mr.
Kadowaki to stop? Maybe he would
listen to you.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I won't do that.
And you don't say anything to him
anymore, either.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、それはお断りよ。
あなたも彼に余計なことを言わないでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I won't do that.
And you don't say anything to him
anymore, either.

fields.EN:
No matter what anyone says,
nothing can be done.
fields.JP:
誰が何を言ったところで、
どうにもならないことだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter what anyone says,
nothing can be done.

fields.EN:
When Kadowaki-kun was young, Marchens killed
his parents before his eyes. Their bodies
were apparently in a terrible state...
fields.JP:
彼はね、門脇くんは……まだ幼い頃、
目の前で両親をメルヒェンに殺されてるのよ。
ご遺体は……ひどい状態だったそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kadowaki's parents were badly
mutilated by the Marchens right in
front of him as a child.

fields.EN:
Most members of the Dawn went
through similar experiences, and
each try to overcome their trauma.
fields.JP:
……黎明にいる人間のほとんどは、
彼と似たような体験をしているわ。
各々が、そのトラウマを克服しようとしている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most members of the Dawn went
through similar experiences, and
each try to overcome their trauma.

fields.EN:
So you're saying Kadowaki-san's
way of killing the Marchens is his
way of overcoming that trauma?
fields.JP:
じゃあ……メルヒェンの虐殺を続けることが……
門脇さんのトラウマを克服する手段……
……と、いうことですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're saying Mr. Kadowaki's
way of killing the Marchens is his
way of overcoming that trauma?

fields.EN:
In his case, when his parents were
killed, a part of his mind
broke...
fields.JP:
まあ……そうね。
両親を殺害された時、
彼の心はちょっと壊れちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
In his case, when his parents were
killed, a part of his mind
broke...

fields.EN:
He's able to somehow maintain his
sanity by doing what he does out
there.
fields.JP:
彼は、あの虐殺を繰り返すことで、
どうにか精神のバランスを保っているってわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's able to somehow maintain his
sanity by doing what he does out
there.

fields.EN:
Kadowaki-kun isn't as tough as he looks.
I can say that for certain... Stopping
him would only make things worse.
fields.JP:
門脇くんは、見た目ほどタフじゃないのよ。
これは断言してもいいけど……
彼を制止すれば、より事態は悪化するわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
He isn't as tough as he looks.
I do know that stopping him will
only worsen his condition.

fields.EN:
Yes. And, if that happens, there's
no telling how it will affect all
of us here.
fields.JP:
ええ。それが……具体的にどんな形で、
私たちの身に降りかかるかわからないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. And, if that happens, there's
no telling how it will affect all
of us here.

fields.EN:
So it's best to leave him alone
like that?
fields.JP:
それじゃ、このままにしておくのが……
一番、いい方法なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it's best to leave him alone
like that?

fields.JP: そういうことになるわね

fields.EN:
I think you've spent enough time
here already. You should go back
now, Jack.
fields.JP:
今日は、無駄話しすぎたわ。
もう、いいわよ、ジャック。お疲れさま
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you've spent enough time
here already. You should go back
