now, Jack.

fields.JP: それじゃ、自分はちょっと……

fields.EN: Are you going to Haru-san's place?
fields.JP: ひょっとして……ハルさんのところに行くの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you going to Haru's place?

fields.EN:
Figured my assistant duties need
answering to! Gets pretty busy
when ya got two jobs.
fields.JP:
そろそろ助手の仕事の方も溜まってそうっす
からね。二足のわらじは大変っすよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Figured my assistant duties need
answering to! Gets pretty busy
when ya got two jobs.

fields.EN:
By the way, is Haru-san like your dad
or something?
fields.JP:
ひょっとして……くららって、ハルさんと
親子か何かなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, is Haru like your dad
or something?

fields.JP: そ……そんなわけないじゃないっすか！！
（っていうか……どうして照れてるの？）

fields.EN:
I was an orphan, and Boss picked
me up and took me under his care.
fields.JP:
自分……孤児だったっすけど、師匠に拾われた
んすよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was an orphan, and Boss picked
me up and took me under his care.

fields.EN: Huh... Guess Haru-san has a soft side.
fields.JP: へえ……ハルさん、いいとこあるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh... Guess Haru has a soft side.

fields.EN:
I learned how to fidget with
gadgets, making chump change
fixing things in the city.
fields.JP:
自分……解放地区の街で、見よう見まねで
ちょっとした修理なんかで小銭稼いでたっす
けど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I learned how to fidget with
gadgets, making chump change
fixing things in the city.

fields.EN:
But that wasn't enough for me to
buy food, so I was a bad egg,
stealin' and things...
fields.JP:
それだけじゃ食えなくて、スリとかをやって
どうにか生きてたんすよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that wasn't enough for me to
buy food, so I was a bad egg,
stealin' and things...

fields.EN:
Then one day, I tried to snatch
some cash from the Boss, and
he caught me red-handed.
fields.JP:
それでまあ、その日もせっせとスリに励んでたっす
けど、たまたま相手が師匠でして……まんまと
捕まったんすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then one day, I tried to snatch
some cash from the Boss, and
he caught me red-handed.

fields.EN:
Yeah, Haru-san doesn't sound like the
type to let something like that
slide.
fields.JP:
ハルさん、そういうとこぼんやりしてなさそう
だもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, Haru doesn't sound like the
type to let something like that
slide.

fields.EN:
Right? He lectured me, then let me
go, but I was so mad that I kept
trying to steal money from him.
fields.JP:
そうなんすよー。その時は説教されて解放されたん
すけど、なんか悔しくて……自分、何度もリベンジ
したんすよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? He lectured me, then let me
go, but I was so mad that I kept
trying to steal money from him.

fields.EN:
And you were caught each time,
right?
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you were caught each time,
right?

fields.JP: そうなんす……あれは口惜しいっすね……

fields.EN:
After all that, he decided to
bring me in here.
fields.JP:
で、なんだかんだで、最終的に引き取られる
ことになったんす
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all that, he decided to
bring me in here.

fields.EN:
Haru-san looks intimidating at first glance.
Didn't you think it might be dangerous to keep
challenging him?
fields.JP:
ハルさんて一見コワモテだけど、
何度もリベンジしたら危なそうだとか
思わなかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you kept approaching
him, especially with how gruff he
looks.

fields.EN:
Well, I just thought... he could
do anything he wants with me...
fields.JP: 師匠になら……何されてもいいかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I just thought... he could
do anything he wants with me...

fields.JP: えっ？　ひょっとして……

（くららは、ほんとにハルさんのことが好き
　なんだな……）

fields.EN:
Y-Ya better not tell Boss what I
said!
fields.JP: い、今の話……師匠には内緒っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Ya better not tell Boss what I
said!

fields.EN:
Hey, this looks like something
Alice would like...
fields.JP: あ。これ、アリスが好きそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, this looks like something
Alice would like...

fields.EN:
Why not get it for her? I'll make
it cheap! Go ahead and splurge!
fields.JP:
お安くするっすから、ドーンとプレゼントしちゃ
どうっすか？　ドーンと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not get it for her? I'll make
it cheap! Go ahead and splurge!

fields.EN:
Uh, I don't have that much money
to splurge...
fields.JP:
『ドーンと』ってあたりで、僕の財布じゃ無理
そうなのがわかるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I don't have that much money
to splurge...

fields.EN:
That's where a man's
ability to provide comes in!
fields.JP: そこが男の甲斐性っすよ！

fields.EN:
I don't really have that kind
of ability to provide, so I'll pass...
fields.JP: 僕……甲斐性ないからいいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'm not really a boss, so I'm
fine...

fields.EN:
You ain't gonna nab good gals like
that! C'mon, splurge!
fields.JP:
そんなこと言ってちゃ女の子にモテないっすよ！
さあ、ドドーンと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You ain't gonna nab good gals like
that! C'mon, splurge!

fields.EN:
(Th-This is bad... I need
to change the subject somehow...)
fields.JP:
（こ、このままじゃマズイ……なんとか
　話題を変えないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has an edge against me... I'd
better change the subject.)

fields.EN:
B-By the way, remember you told
me how you came here?
fields.JP:
そ、そういえばさ、
以前に、なんだかんだで黎明に引き取られたって
言ってたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-By the way, remember you told
me how you came here?

fields.EN:
I wouldn't mind hearing how you
joined the Dawn!
fields.JP:
なんだかんだって、実際どんなことがあったのか
聞きたいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't mind hearing how you
joined the Dawn!

fields.JP: いきなりどうしたんすか？

fields.EN:
Y-You know? The Dawn only brings
people here as official staff
members, so...
fields.JP:
ほ、ほら、黎明ってどうやら関係者っていうか、
スタッフって形しか迎えてないみたいだから、
少し気になって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You know? The Dawn only brings
people here as official staff
members, so...

fields.EN:
Yeah, that's true. Now that I can say it,
Jack-san, I was a little surprised when you
showed up.
fields.JP:
あー。確かにそういうとこあるっすねー。
今だから言うと、ジャックさんが来た時には、
ちょっと意外だったっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you're right. To be honest,
when ya came here, I was a bit
surprised.

fields.EN:
Yeah, it was surprising for me
too, and... I felt out of place...
fields.JP:
うん……
僕も意外だったし、肩身も狭かったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it was surprising for me
too, and... I felt out of place...

fields.EN:
I was impressed that everyone saw your ability
right from the start, Jack-san!
fields.JP:
むしろ、みんな最初っからジャックさんの能力
見抜いてたんだなって、感心したっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was impressed how everyone knew
about your powers just by lookin'
at ya!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I'm not so sure about
that.
fields.JP: あはは……それは、どうなんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I'm not so sure about
that.

fields.EN:
(They only started treating me
differently once they heard how my
blood stopped Alice's Skelter...)
fields.JP:
（でも確かに……僕の血がアリスの暴走を止めた
　って話が出てから、対応が変わったような
　気はする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They only started treating me
differently once they heard how my
blood stopped Alice's Skelter...)

fields.EN:
In my case, I bet the Boss saw how
awesome of a girl I am, and...
fields.JP:
まあ自分の場合は……きっと師匠が、自分を
いい女だって見抜いて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In my case, I bet the Boss saw how
awesome of a girl I am, and...

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Aren't ya gonna say
something?! Don't make me finish
that on my own!
fields.JP:
な、何かツッコんでくださいっすよ！
置いてけぼりは惨めじゃないっすか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Aren't ya gonna say
something?! Don't make me finish
that on my own!

fields.EN:
Well, to be honest, I'm not sure
why the Dawn is letting me stay
here.
fields.JP:
まあ正直なところ、なんで自分が黎明に置いて
もらえることになったのかは、よくわかって
ないんすよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, to be honest, I'm not sure
why the Dawn is letting me stay
here.

fields.EN:
Maybe Haru-san asked the Professor
to keep you here?
fields.JP:
やっぱり、ハルさんが博士に口利きして
くれたのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe Haru asked the Professor
to keep you here?

fields.EN:
Speaking of the Professor, he
asked me where my name came
from when I first got here.
fields.JP:
うーん……あ！
そういえば、引き取られたばっかの頃に、
博士から自分の名前の由来を聞かれたっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of the Professor, he
asked me where my name came
from when I first got here.

fields.EN:
(Oh, wait. He asked me that,
too...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, wait. He asked me that,
too...)

fields.EN:
Anyway, do you know where you got
your name, Jack-kun?
fields.JP:
……ところでジャックくん。
君は自分の名前の由来を知っているかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, do you know where you got
your name, Jack?

fields.EN:
Yes. Did your parents give it to
you?
fields.JP:
ああ。両親に付けてもらったのか、
もしくは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Did your parents give it to
you?

fields.EN:
I don't know... I lost my parents
when I was young, and I don't
really remember much from then...
fields.JP:
……知らないんです。
僕、幼い頃に両親を亡くして、
その頃の記憶がほとんど無くて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know... I lost my parents
when I was young, and I don't
really remember much from then...

fields.EN:
He looked really disappointed when
I told him my grandma gave me my
name.
fields.JP:
それで、死んだ婆ちゃんがつけてくれたって
言ったらすごくガッカリされたんす
fields.LOCALIZED:
He looked really disappointed when
I told him my grandma gave me my
name.

fields.EN:
(Is there something about where
we got our names that matters to
him...?)
fields.JP:
（名前の由来に……
　一体どんな意味が……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is there something about where
we got our names that matters to
him...?)

fields.EN:
I told the Boss afterwards, and he
said to not let it bother me, and
that he'd teach me his trade...
fields.JP:
そのことを後で師匠に言ったら、
気にしなくていい、お前は手先が器用だから
俺が仕込んでやる……って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told the Boss afterwards, and he
said to not let it bother me, and
that he'd teach me his trade...

fields.EN:
Now that I think about it, guess
that means the Professor didn't
really want me here.
fields.JP:
……今思うと、自分を黎明に置いとくのを
博士に反対されたってことだったんすかね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I think about it, guess
that means the Professor didn't
really want me here.

fields.EN:
Well, that just means I need to
become a full-fledged Blood Weapon
craftsman!
fields.JP:
こーなったら、一人前の血式武器製造士に
なるしかないっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that just means I need to
become a full-fledged Blood Weapon
craftsman!

fields.EN:
I'm gonna make the Professor wanna
keep me here!
fields.JP: それで、博士に自分を認めさせてやるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna make the Professor wanna
keep me here!

fields.EN:
I'm sure you'll be able to be one,
Clara. I'm rooting for you!
fields.JP:
くららなら、絶対なれると思うよ。
僕も応援するよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you'll be able to be one,
Clara. I'm rooting for you!

fields.EN:
Wh-What's with the cheer?! Not
like I'm gonna make it free for
ya!
fields.JP:
な、何すかいきなり？
おだてたって、お代は負けないっすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What's with the cheer?! Not
like I'm gonna make it free for
ya!

fields.EN:
Clara, do you have this in any
other colors?
fields.JP: くらら、これと色違いのやつってある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara, do you have this in any
other colors?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Looks like I'm out of
stock... You don't like that
color?
fields.JP:
えーと……今は品切れっすねー
色違いじゃないと駄目なんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Looks like I'm out of
stock... You don't like that
color?

fields.EN:
Well, Kaguyahime asked me to get this
for her, but she said she wanted
a particular one...
fields.JP:
実は、かぐや姫に買い物を頼まれたやつなんだ
けど……この色がいいっていうのがあるんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Kaguya asked me to get this
for her, but she said she wanted
a particular one...

fields.EN:
Jack-san, maybe you're surprisingly suited
to being a servant?
fields.JP:
ジャックさんって、案外下僕体質の持ち主じゃ
ないっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, seems like you've got the
talent for being a first-class
gofer...

fields.EN: Huh? Um, I don't think so...
fields.JP: えっ。そ、そんなことはないと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Um, I don't think so...

fields.EN:
You gotta be like the Boss or the
Professor and let others do your
work for ya!
fields.JP:
もっと博士や師匠みたいにドーンと人をパシらせ
てくださいっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gotta be like the Boss or the
Professor and let others do your
work for ya!

fields.EN:
Ugh, that reminds me... I can't
believe they want me to do all
this...
fields.JP:
……ったく忙しいのに、どんだけいろいろ人を
コキ使うつもりっすかねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, that reminds me... I can't
believe they want me to do all
this...

fields.JP: また……いろいろ配達なの？

fields.EN:
Um, I was going to ask you
something, but if you're busy, I
can come back later...
fields.JP: あの、忙しかったら今度にするけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I was going to ask you
something, but if you're busy, I
can come back later...

fields.EN:
I was wondering about the
Professor and Haru-san... They don't
seem to get along very well.
fields.JP:
博士とハルさんって、どういう関係なのかなって
思ってさ……すごく関係がいいようには見えない
気がするっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was wondering about the
Professor and Haru... They don't
seem to get along very well.

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'm not sure how they know
each other. Boss just says he's
known the Professor a long time.
fields.JP:
うーん。自分も詳しいことは知らないっすねー。
師匠も、昔からの知り合いだってくらいしか
言わないっすしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'm not sure how they know
each other. Boss just says he's
known the Professor a long time.

fields.EN:
Yeah, he doesn't really touch on
that subject much. I wonder how
long ago he means...
fields.JP:
確かにあんまり話してくれないよね。
昔からって、どれくらいなんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, he doesn't really touch on
that subject much. I wonder how
long ago he means...

fields.JP: それも詳しくは聞いたことないっすね……

fields.EN:
If the Professor's the only key
member who survived, those old
guys probably go way back.
fields.JP:
博士は初期の黎明中枢の唯一の生き残りだって
ことっすし、師匠もオッさんだから、まあ古株
ってとこだと思うっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Professor's the only key
member who survived, those old
guys probably go way back.

fields.EN:
But it doesn't seem like the Boss
likes talking about it...
fields.JP:
なんかあんまり話したがってないように見える
んすよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it doesn't seem like the Boss
likes talking about it...

fields.EN:
So, he doesn't tell you either,
then...
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, he doesn't tell you either,
then...

fields.JP: ど、どういうことっすか？

fields.EN:
You know... you're the closest to Haru-san,
Clara, so I thought maybe he'd tell you more
things.
fields.JP:
ほら……くららはハルさんと一番親しいだろう
から、くららにはいろいろ話すのかなって
思ってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know? I thought he would speak
with you more freely, given how
close you are to him.

fields.EN:
Y-You're not getting a discount
just because you're flattering me!
fields.JP: お……おだてたって何も出ないっすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're not getting a discount
just because you're flattering me!

fields.EN:
But, I see what you're gettin'
at...
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I see what you're gettin'
at...

fields.EN:
Boss and the Professor are kinda
similar, but... different in some
ways.
fields.JP:
師匠と博士って、どこか同じ匂いがするんすけど
……なんか違うんすよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss and the Professor are kinda
similar, but... different in some
ways.

fields.JP: 同じ匂いだけど……何か違う？

fields.EN:
Mmm... I guess it's almost like
how one stinks and the other just
smells like an old man...
fields.JP: うーん……加齢臭と老人臭の違いっすかね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I guess it's almost like
how one stinks and the other just
smells like an old man...

fields.EN:
Stinks and smells like an old
man... Got it. I'll let Haru-san know
that.
fields.JP:
加齢臭と老人臭……
それ、ハルさんにも言っとくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stinks and smells like an old
man... Got it. I'll let Haru know
that.

fields.EN:
H-Hey! P-Please, you can't do that
to me!
fields.JP: ちょ！　それは勘弁してくださいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! P-Please, you can't do that
to me!

fields.EN:
(But, I guess Clara can sense
something strange about them...)
fields.JP:
（くららも二人の間の違和感みたいなものを
　感じてるんだなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, I guess Clara can sense
something strange about them...)

fields.EN:
(The Order of the Sun... I guess
it's best for me to see for myself
what they're about...)
fields.JP:
（タイヨウ教団か……どういう人たちなのかは、
　たしかに自分の目で確かめるのが一番だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Order of the Sun... I guess
it's best for me to see for myself
what they're about...)

fields.EN:
(But this feels almost like I came
to spy on them...)
fields.JP: （で、でも……何だかスパイみたいで嫌だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But this feels almost like I came
to spy on them...)

fields.EN:
(I hope they don't chase me out
like last time...)
fields.JP: （この前みたいに追い返されたらどうしよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope they don't chase me out
like last time...)

fields.JP:
あ、ジャック。
遊びに来てくれたの？

fields.EN:
Um, have you always been
cooperating with the Dawn like
this?
fields.JP:
あのう……黎明のみんなとは、前から
こんな風に協力し合ってるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, have you always been
cooperating with the Dawn like
this?

fields.EN:
Ooh! I need to show you something!
Over here, here!
fields.JP:
それより……見て見て！
こっちこっち……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! I need to show you something!
Over here, here!

fields.EN:
(Hitsuka-san won't like seeing me
holding hands with her like
this...)
fields.JP:
（こんな風に手を引っ張られてるとこを
　陽司さんに見られたら、大騒ぎになるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hitsuka won't like seeing me
holding hands with her like
this...)

fields.EN:
Look! Cabbage, carrots, um... I
think those are radishes. Oh,
and...
fields.JP:
キャベツに、にんじんに、えーと……
あっちは大根？　あと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look! Cabbage, carrots, um... I
think those are radishes. Oh,
and...

fields.EN:
(Look at all those vegetables...
I've never seen so many in my
life...)
fields.JP:
（作物がこんなにたくさん……
　こんなの、初めて見た……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at all those vegetables...
I've never seen so many in my
life...)

fields.EN:
Everyone must have worked hard
to grow them. So, you share them
with the Dawn, too?
fields.JP:
……ここの人たちがいっしょうけんめい育てて、
それを黎明にも配ってくれてたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone must have worked hard
to grow them. So, you share them
with the Dawn, too?

fields.EN:
Correct! But, we can grow more if
the sun comes out.
fields.JP:
あたりー。
でもね、お日様が出れば、もっともっと育つよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Correct! But, we can grow more if
the sun comes out.

fields.EN:
The sun... I've never seen it
before.
fields.JP: お日様……僕、見たことないんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sun... I've never seen it
before.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you will soon. You're
going to bring it to us.
fields.JP:
お日様、きっともうすぐ見られるよ。
……あなたが運んできてくれるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you will soon. You're
going to bring it to us.

fields.EN:
Jack? Do you like the beginning
or the end of a story?
fields.JP:
ジャックはね、お話の始めと終わり、
どっちが好き？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Do you like the beginning
or the end of a story?

fields.EN:
I like the beginning. It makes me
excited to see what's going to
happen next.
fields.JP:
わたしはお話の始めが好き。これから何が
起きるのか、わくわくさせてくれるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like the beginning. It makes me
excited to see what's going to
happen next.

fields.EN:
But, before you can start a story,
you need to close out the old one.
fields.JP:
でも、物語を始めるためには、前の物語を
閉じなければならないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, before you can start a story,
you need to close out the old one.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... That'll be our little
secret. You go home quietly. Or
else Chii-chan is going to be very mad.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。いまのは二人だけの内緒。
ジャックはこっそり帰るのよ？
でないと、ちーちゃんに怒られちゃう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... That'll be our little
secret. You go home quietly. Or
else Chii is going to be very mad.

fields.JP: ちーちゃん！　こんなの見つけたよー

fields.EN:
Michiru-sama, please don't call me
that...
fields.JP: ミチル様。その呼び方は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru, please don't call me
that...

fields.JP: それより、誰かいたような……？

fields.EN:
Michiru was talking with the
veggies. I asked them to grow
bigger. Heh, heh...
fields.JP:
みちる、野菜さんとお話ししてたの。
大きく育ってねって……ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru was talking with the
veggies. I asked them to grow
bigger. Heh, heh...

fields.EN:
(Looks like I got away in the nick
of time...)
fields.JP: （……どうにか見つからずに済んだみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like I got away in the nick
of time...)

fields.JP: （……あの人、『姉さん』って言ってたな……）

fields.EN:
Your anemia looks fine. How is
it? Have you noticed anything
unusual when using the Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
……貧血の方は問題ないようね。
どう？　メアリガンの使用で異状は感じない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're able to be out
and about. So, do you feel okay
using the Mary Gun?

fields.EN: Yes. I think it's working great!
fields.JP: はい。順調だと思います！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I think it's working great!

fields.EN:
That's good. You've been coming properly
for your regular examinations, too, so
keep using it carefully from now on.
fields.JP:
……ならいいわ。
定期的な検査にもきちんと来てくれてるし、
これからも注意深く使ってちょうだいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear. You do come
by here periodically, so I'm sure
it will be fine, but be careful.

fields.JP: わかりました……ところで

fields.EN:
I went to the Order of the Sun and
saw their fields...
fields.JP:
あの、このあいだタイヨウ教団の畑を見せて
もらったんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I went to the Order of the Sun and
saw their fields...

fields.EN:
I'm surprised how they can
actually grow so many things in
the Jail!
fields.JP:
ジェイルの中でも、あんなに作物が育つん
ですね！　びっくりしました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised how they can
actually grow so many things in
the Jail!

fields.EN:
Of course they wouldn't grow.
There's no sun.
fields.JP: 育つわけないじゃない。……陽も射してないのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course they wouldn't grow.
There's no sun.

fields.EN:
Most vegetation require sunlight
to grow. The vegetation in turn
feeds the chickens and cows.
fields.JP:
たいがいの植物は、太陽の光を浴びて育つのよ。
そして、それを食べて鶏や牛は育つの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most vegetation require sunlight
to grow. The vegetation in turn
feeds the chickens and cows.

fields.EN:
Whether we like it or not, we have
to live in unison with what the
Jail can provide.
fields.JP:
私たちは好むと好まざると、ジェイルと共棲して
いくしかないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whether we like it or not, we have
to live in unison with what the
Jail can provide.

fields.EN:
I'm quite pleased at how sharp
you are. I don't need to be so
blunt about things.
fields.JP:
察しがいいようで助かるわ。
はっきりとした言葉を使わずに済むものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite pleased at how sharp
you are. I don't need to be so
blunt about things.

fields.EN:
I want you to keep this to
yourself. I'd hate to see anyone
here fold under the truth.
fields.JP:
でも、公言はしないでもらいたいの。
想像力の働かない人は多かれ少なかれいるし、
そんな人たちのショックまで負いたくないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to keep this to
yourself. I'd hate to see anyone
here fold under the truth.

fields.EN:
One more thing. Do you know this? They
say that if you keep consuming Jail
cells, your intelligence declines.
fields.JP:
もう一つ。これは知ってるかしら？
ジェイルの細胞を摂取し続けると、知能が衰えると
言われているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing... It's said that
continued intake of the Jail can
adversely affect one's mind.

fields.EN:
Remember, that's also why we're
trying to escape as soon as
possible...
fields.JP: ……だから、時間との戦いでもあるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember, that's also why we're
trying to escape as soon as
possible...

fields.EN:
(Those vegetables were made by the
Jail...)
fields.JP: （じゃあ、あの作物は……ジェイルの……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Those vegetables were made by the
Jail...)

fields.EN: Is it okay for me to bother you?
fields.JP: 今日は、何も言わないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is it okay for me to bother you?

fields.EN:
I have no choice, as Michiru-sama
trusts you.
fields.JP:
君はミチル様に信頼されている。
仕方あるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no choice, as Lady Michiru
trusts you.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much! I'll keep the
promise I made!
fields.JP:
……ありがとうございます！
約束は守ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much! I'll keep the
promise I made!

fields.EN:
Um... can I ask something? Didn't
you call Michiru-san 'Nee-san' the other day?
fields.JP:
あの……ところで聞きたいんですけど、
このあいだ、ミチルさんのことを『姉さん』って
呼んでませんでしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, do you mind I ask something?
Is it true that you call Michiru
"sister?"

fields.JP: （あ！　つい『ミチルさん』って呼んじゃった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot! I just called her by her
name!)

fields.JP: みちる、ちーちゃんのおねえさんだよ

fields.EN:
Wh-What she's trying to say is
that we admire Oohime-sama as...
fields.JP:
こ……これは、つまり……
我々は皆、大陽女様の……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What she's trying to say is
that we admire Lady Oohime as...

fields.EN:
Why hide it? Oyayubi-chan and the
girls know already.
fields.JP:
おやゆびちゃんたちは知ってるのに、
どうして隠すの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why hide it? Thumbelina and the
girls know already.

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime and the others...?
So you really are Hitsuka-san's
older sister, Michiru-san...!
fields.JP:
親指姫たちが……？
じゃあ本当にミチルさんは、陽司さんのお姉さん
なんですね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina? So Michiru really is
Hitsuka's older sister, then?

fields.EN:
We have our reasons, so I've asked
them to keep it secret. And you too,
Nee-san—please don't say much in public...
fields.JP:
……事情があるんだ。
彼女たちにも公言しないよう、頼んでいる。
姉さんも頼むから、あまり人前では……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have our reasons, so I've asked
them to keep it secret. You should
watch what you say in public.

fields.EN:
Jack's okay. It's a secret between
me and Jack, and Oyayubi-chan and
the girls. Heh, heh...
fields.JP:
ジャックはへいきだもの。
ジャックと、おやゆびちゃんたちと、みちる
たちのひみつだね……ふふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's okay. It's a secret between
me and Jack, and Thumbelina and
the girls. Heh, heh...

fields.EN:
(They really don't sound like bad
people...)
fields.JP:
（こうして話してみると、悪い人たちには
　思えないんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They really don't sound like bad
people...)

fields.EN:
(But, it's probably true that
there's a huge secret that the
Order is hiding...)
fields.JP:
（でも、ここの教団に何か秘密があるのは、
　たぶん確かなんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, it's probably true that
there's a huge secret that the
Order is hiding...)

fields.EN:
Come to think of it... I heard Oyayubihime
and the other two were raised here
when they were little...
fields.JP:
そういえば……親指姫たち三人は、小さい頃
ここで育てられたって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, I heard that
Thumbelina, Snow White, and
Sleeping Beauty were raised here.

fields.EN:
It was nice to have younger
sisters. They huddled around Chii-chan,
and Chii-chan smiled more back then.
fields.JP:
……妹ができたみたいで、うれしかったなあ。
ちーちゃんにもなついてて、ちーちゃんも
今よりもっと笑ってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was nice to have younger
sisters. They huddled around Chii,
and Chii smiled more back then.

fields.EN:
But, they don't come here anymore,
ever since the Professor took
them. So sad, right, Chii-chan?
fields.JP:
でも、はかせが連れてってから、遊びに来て
くれなくなっちゃって……
さびしいよね、ちーちゃん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, they don't come here anymore,
ever since the Professor took
them. So sad, right, Chii?

fields.EN:
They have their duties,
so it can't be helped, Nee-san.
fields.JP:
……あの子達にも役目があるから、仕方ない
んだよ、姉さん
fields.LOCALIZED:
They have their duties, so it
can't be helped.

fields.EN:
(That's right... There's something
I wanted to ask, but I hope now is
the right time...)
fields.JP:
（そういえば、前から気になってたんだっけ……
　今なら聞けるかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... There's something
I wanted to ask, but I hope now is
the right time...)

fields.JP: あの……『ちーちゃん』というのは……？

fields.EN:
Chii as in "Chiaki." That is his
name. But he gets embarrassed and
when I say it...
fields.JP:
千昭。この子の……わたしの弟の名前。
でも恥ずかしがって、そう呼ぶと怒るの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chii as in "Chiaki." That is his
name. But he gets embarrassed and
when I say it...

fields.EN:
So silly. He's always just the
cutest younger brother. Heh,
heh...
fields.JP:
わたしにとっては、いつまでだって
可愛い弟なのにね……ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So silly. He's always just the
cutest younger brother. Heh,
heh...

fields.EN:
Again, we have our reasons...
which is why we asked those three
to keep it quiet, too.
fields.JP:
事情が……あるんだ……
あの三人にも伏せておくよう、頼んでるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Again, we have our reasons...
which is why we asked those three
to keep it quiet, too.

fields.EN:
I won't say anything to anyone
else...
fields.JP: ……あの、誰にも言いませんから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't say anything to anyone
else...

fields.JP: そうしてもらえると、助かる……

fields.EN:
(Maybe he really is a nice
person...)
fields.JP:
（この人は、本当は心が優しい人なのかも
　しれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe he really is a nice
person...)

fields.EN:
Um, do you mind I ask one other
thing?
fields.JP: あの……もうひとつだけ、いいですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, do you mind I ask one other
thing?

fields.EN:
You said they lived here... Didn't the
believers find Blood Maidens disgusting?
Were they able to get along with everyone?
fields.JP:
親指姫たちと暮らしてたって言ってましたけど、
……血式少女のことは、気持ち悪くないんですか？
信者の人たちとも仲良くできてたんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did Thumbelina and the others get
along with everyone here, even
though they're Blood Maidens?

fields.EN:
I've never thought about it
before. Why do you ask?
fields.JP:
そんなことを考えたことは一度も無いけど……
どうしてそんなことを？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never thought about it
before. Why do you ask?

fields.EN:
It's because Alice, and from what
I've heard, Kaguyahime... went through
a lot living with normal people...
fields.JP:
アリスやかぐや姫……普通の人たちの中にいて、
いろいろあったみたいだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because Alice, and from what
I've heard, Kaguya... went through
a lot living with normal people...

fields.EN:
That's so strange. Everyone who
lives here is one and the same.
fields.JP:
……へんなの。ここで生きてるひとは、誰だって
おなじなのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's so strange. Everyone who
lives here is one and the same.

fields.EN:
Everyone is trying their best to
live and seek light from the sun.
fields.JP:
みんな、太陽の光に焦がれながら、いっしょう
けんめい生きているだけなのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone is trying their best to
live and seek light from the sun.

fields.EN:
(She's quiet, but strangely
convincing... No wonder people
gather around her...)
fields.JP:
（静かで……不思議な説得力……
　この人がみんなの心を集めるだけのことは、
　ちゃんとあるんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's quiet, but strangely
convincing... No wonder people
gather around her...)

fields.EN:
What everyone seeks isn't me. It's
the light from the sun. That will
come soon.
fields.JP:
みんなが望んでいるのは、わたしじゃなくて
太陽の光……そしてその日は遠くはないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
What everyone seeks isn't me. It's
the light from the sun. That will
come soon.

fields.JP: そんな日が、本当に来るんですか？

fields.EN:
You have many doubts, but you
need to move forward in faith.
fields.JP:
あなたはたくさん疑って、それでも疑わずに
まっすぐすすまなくちゃ……でしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have many doubts, but you
need to move forward in faith.

fields.EN:
Hehe... One little bird-san, two little
bird-sans... I wonder which little
bird-san will fly toward the sun?
fields.JP:
くすくす……ことりさんがいちわ、にわ……
おひさまにむかってとんでくのはだあれ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... One little birdie, two
little birdies... I wonder which
birdie will fly to the sun.

fields.EN:
The strong little bird-san can break
through the wall in the sky. But if it gets
too close to the sun... Hehe... Hehe...
fields.JP:
おそらのかべをやぶれるのは、つよい小鳥さん。
でも、おひさまにちかづきすぎると……
……くすくす……くすくす……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The strongest birdie will go
through the wall in the sky. But,
too close to the sun and... Heh...

fields.EN:
She's like this sometimes. It
could be that she's pushing
herself too much as the Oohime...
fields.JP:
……時々、こうなるんだ。
大陽女だなんて、無理をさせ過ぎているのかも
しれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's like this sometimes. It
could be that she's pushing
herself too much as the Oohime...

fields.EN:
I thought she was sharing a
prophecy...
fields.JP: 預言、なのかと思ってました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought she was sharing a
prophecy...

fields.EN:
She did sometimes say things that
sounded like prophecies! But she
wasn't like this before...!
fields.JP:
預言めいたことを言うことはあったさ！
けど、前はこんなんじゃなかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She did share her divine words
with everyone before... But, not
like this!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... Don't let this bother
you. Also, I need you to...
fields.JP:
……すまない。
どうか、気にしないでもらえないか？
それから、このことは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... Don't let this bother
you. Also, I need you to...

fields.JP: はい……誰にも何も言いません

fields.EN:
Chii-chan... I am tired. I wish to take
a nap.
fields.JP:
……ちーちゃん。みちる、つかれちゃった。
おひるねしたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chii... I am tired. I wish to take
a nap.

fields.EN: Ah... yeah, Nee-san. Sorry I didn't notice...
fields.JP:
あ……ああ、姉さん。
気付かなくてごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Yes, dear sister... I'm
sorry I didn't notice before.

fields.EN: Now then, if you'll excuse us...
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, if you'll excuse us...

fields.EN:
Uh, yes... Sorry to have bothered
you.
fields.JP:
あ……はい。
今日はありがとうございました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, yes... Sorry to have bothered
you.

fields.EN:
(Having doubts, but moving onward
with fath...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Having doubts, but moving onward
with fath...)

fields.EN:
(Miko-san told me crops shouldn't be
able to grow here... and what these crops
really are... How should I ask about it?)
fields.JP:
（視子さんから聞いた、ここでは作物は育たない
　筈だってこと……この作物の正体のこと……
　どんな風に聞けばいいんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(According to Miko, this place
isn't fit to grow food. How should
I bring this up...?)

fields.EN:
(Do they even know about it in the
first place?)
fields.JP:
（そもそもここの人たちは、あのことを知ってる
　んだろうか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Do they even know about it in the
first place?)

fields.EN:
I can't let you see Michiru-sama
now.
fields.JP:
何度来ても、ミチル様に直接お目通りさせる
わけにはいかない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't let you see Lady Michiru
now.

fields.EN:
Um... I actually wanted to ask you something
today, Hitsuka-san...
fields.JP: その……今日は、陽司さんに話が聞きたくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I actually wanted to speak
with you today...

fields.EN:
Yes. I wanted to ask about the
crops you have here...
fields.JP: はい。その、ここで栽培している作物のことで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I wanted to ask about the
crops you have here...

fields.JP: 何か問題でもあったのかね？

fields.EN:
(This isn't going to be easy, but
I need to ask...)
fields.JP: （聞きにくいけど……聞いてみなきゃ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't going to be easy, but
I need to ask...)

fields.EN:
Is it true that the produce is
part of the Jail?
fields.JP:
……あれがジェイルの一部だというのは、
本当なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it true that the produce is
part of the Jail?

fields.EN:
Why are you growing food that
could adversely affect the minds
of the people who eat them?
fields.JP:
食べると知能が衰えると言われているものを、
どうして作って人に食べさせているんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you growing food that
could adversely affect the minds
of the people who eat them?

fields.EN:
Let me ask you this. What else
would we eat to survive?
fields.JP:
……では聞こう。
ならば、何を食して生命を繋げばいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me ask you this. What else
would we eat to survive?

fields.EN:
Hmph... As I thought, you
ignorant, shackled child.
fields.JP:
……何も知らない、飼いならされた
小僧のくせに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... As I thought, you
ignorant, shackled child.

fields.EN:
I may be ignorant, but that's why
I want to know.
fields.JP: 知らないから……知りたいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may be ignorant, but that's why
I want to know.

fields.EN:
What purpose is there for you to
know?
fields.LOCALIZED:
What purpose is there for you to
know?

fields.JP:
もー。ふたりとも！
ケンカはだめだよ？

fields.EN:
(She always seems to appear out of
nowhere.)
fields.JP: （この人、いつもふらっと現れるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She always seems to appear out of
nowhere.)

fields.JP: ジャックが来たの、あっちから見えたから

fields.EN:
More importantly... Jack-kun, was it? I'd like
you to stop addressing her so familiarly.
fields.JP:
それよりも、ジャックくんだったか。
この方を馴れ馴れしく呼ばないで
もらいたいのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before going any further, I need
you to stop calling her by name.

fields.EN:
It won't be taken fondly by our
believers.
fields.JP: ……信者たちにも示しがつかないのでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It won't be taken fondly by our
believers.

fields.JP: す、すみません……あの、でも……
（この人、やっぱり『姉さん』って言ってた）

fields.EN:
Chii-chan, he's going to bring the sun
to us. A dear friend we've been
waiting for.
fields.JP:
ちーちゃん。
この子は太陽を運んできてくれる子。
ずっと待ってたお友達。だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chii, he's going to bring the sun
to us. A dear friend we've been
waiting for.

fields.EN:
If that's what you think, so be
it. I haven't heard you say that
for some time now...
fields.JP:
……あなたが言うのなら、従うよ。
もう、滅多に聞けなくなってしまった言葉
なのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's what you think, so be
it. I haven't heard you say that
for some time now...

fields.EN: Heh, heh... Chii-chan is a good child.
fields.JP: ふふ。ちーちゃんはいい子ね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh, heh... Chii is a good child.

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, was it? I will allow you to
come here so long as you are by
yourself.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん。
君一人で来るならば、今後はここの立ち入りを
許可しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, was it? I will allow you to
come here so long as you are by
yourself.

fields.JP: あ、ありがとうございます

fields.EN:
But, I need you to promise me that
you will not disclose what you
see, hear, or do here.
fields.JP:
ただし……ここで見聞きしたものは、一切誰にも
話さないよう、約束してもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I need you to promise me that
you will not disclose what you
see, hear, or do here.

fields.JP: では、今月の分は確かに……

fields.EN: Thank you for the food supplies.
fields.JP: 食料品、確かに受け取らせて頂きました
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you for the food supplies.

fields.EN:
Hee hee... They're very delicious
vegetables bathed in moonlight.
fields.JP:
くすくす……おつきさまの光をあびた、
とってもおいしいやさいなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Delicious vegetables
with a touch of sunlight.

fields.EN:
Indeed... We're grateful for your
continued support.
fields.JP:
……そうですね。
教団のご協力には、とても助かっていますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed... We're grateful for your
continued support.

fields.JP:
ごきょうりょくだねー！
くすくす……ごきょうりょくー！
はーい。おこられちゃったー

fields.EN:
We appreciate what you do as well.
We're able to preach to the people
because of the Dawn.
fields.JP:
……黎明の活動があってこそ、
我々は人々への呼びかけに専念できる……
非常にありがたいことです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We appreciate what you do as well.
We're able to preach to the people
because of the Dawn.

fields.EN:
I suppose our cooperation is
beneficial. We hope we can
continue this relationship.
fields.JP:
では、持ちつ持たれつということで……
今後ともよろしくお願いしますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose our cooperation is
beneficial. We hope we can
continue this relationship.

fields.EN:
(They make food of suspicious origin,
eat it, and live on without anyone
ever mentioning what it is...)
fields.JP:
（出所の怪しい食料を作り、それを食べ、
　誰もそれには触れずに生きている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They bring food of unknown 
origin, and we eat them without
question...)

fields.EN:
(We fight the Marchens and use
their carcasses to create our
weapons...)
fields.JP:
（僕らはメルヒェンを狩りながら、その
　残骸を武器にして戦ってる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We fight the Marchens and use
their carcasses to create our
weapons...)

fields.EN:
(We need to do what we can to get
out of this situation as soon as
possible...)
fields.JP:
（こんな状況をどうにかするには、僕らが
　がんばって、少しでも早くここから
　脱出するしかないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We need to do what we can to get
out of this situation as soon as
possible...)

fields.JP:
あ！　ジャックだー！
ジャックーーー！！

fields.EN:
(She's acting a lot like a kid
now...)
fields.JP:
（きょ……今日はなんだか
　いつもより子供じみてる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's acting a lot like a kid
now...)

fields.JP:
ミチル様……
ジャックくん、申し訳ない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru... Please excuse her,
Jack.

fields.EN: Michiru wants to play with Jack!
fields.JP: みちる、ジャックと遊びたいー
fields.LOCALIZED: Michiru wants to play with Jack!

fields.EN: Oohime-sama seems really fond of you.
fields.JP:
大陽女様ってば、
ジャックにずいぶん懐いてるみたいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like she's really fond of
you.

fields.JP: そ、そんなこと……ないんじゃないかな？

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Jack's special. Just
like how the Professor is special
to you.
fields.JP:
ふふ……ジャックは特別なの。
あなたにとって、博士が特別なように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Jack's special. Just
like how the Professor is special
to you.

fields.EN:
Wha-?! Th-Those are two different
things!
fields.JP:
なっ……！
い、一緒にしないでよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Th-Those are two different
things!

fields.EN:
Akazukin, don't let what
she says bother you.
fields.JP: 赤ずきん。相手にしては駄目よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, don't let what
she says bother you.

fields.EN:
Hey, Jack. Does Blue Bird-san come to see
you too?
fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャック。
青い鳥さん、ジャックのところにも来る？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack? Does the blue bird go
to Jack, too?

fields.EN:
Blue Bird-san tells
Michiru all sorts of things...
The Dawn's Blue Bird-san... Hee hee...
fields.JP:
みちるにね、いろんなことおしえてくれるの。
……黎明の、青い鳥さん……くすくす……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The blue bird tells Michiru a lot
of things. The Dawn's blue bird.
Heh, heh...

fields.JP: ジャック、またあそびにきてね？

ミチル様……！
で、では、私たちはこれで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru...! If you'll excuse
us...

fields.EN:
Did you see that? She's getting
nuttier by the day...
fields.JP:
……全く、あいつのイカれ具合、
ますますひどくなってる気がするよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you see that? She's getting
nuttier by the day...

fields.EN:
Well, don't let what you saw
bother you, Jack.
fields.JP:
まあ、
ジャックもあんまり気にしない方がいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, don't let what you saw
bother you, Jack.

fields.EN:
(The Dawn's blue bird... What did
she mean by that?)
fields.JP:
（『黎明の青い鳥』……
　どういう意味だったんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Dawn's blue bird... What did
she mean by that?)

fields.JP: （ミチルさんの様子も、確かにおかしい）

fields.EN:
(A lot of things have been going
on lately. I wonder if they're all
connected...)
fields.JP:
（このところ、いろんなことが急激に
　起きてる気がする。
　それと、関係あるんだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A lot of things have been going
on lately. I wonder if they're all
connected...)

fields.EN:
(What's the matter? Chiaki-san doesn't
look good...)
fields.JP:
（どうしたんだろう。
　千昭さん、すごく元気がないみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's the matter? Chiaki doesn't
look good...)

fields.EN:
I... don't know what to do
anymore.
fields.JP:
正直……どうしていいか、
もうわからないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... don't know what to do
anymore.

fields.EN:
Look at her... She's hardly ever
sane these days...
fields.JP:
見ての通りさ。
姉さんが正気でいる時間は、もうほとんど
無いんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at her... She's hardly ever
sane these days...

fields.JP: あおいとりさん、どこだろー？

fields.EN:
My sister was a little unusual from
childhood... She was a girl who would
say things that sounded like prophecies.
fields.JP:
……姉は、子供の頃から少し変わっててね。
預言めいたことを言う少女だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My sister was... a bit peculiar
when she was little. She had
always spoken in a cryptic manner.

fields.EN:
Some treated her like a priestess,
while others despised her presence
and sought to harm her.
fields.JP:
そんな姉を巫女だと祭り上げる人もいれば、
忌み嫌い、暴行を働こうとする人もいたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some treated her like a priestess,
while others despised her presence
and sought to harm her.

fields.EN:
It sounds just like what happened
to Alice and Kaguyahime...
fields.JP: アリスやかぐや姫に起きたことと同じだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounds just like what happened
to Alice and Kaguya...

fields.EN:
People fear what they don't know,
and they will either revere or
eliminate it.
fields.JP:
そうさ。
人は異質なものを怖れ、崇めるか排除するか
どちらかで対処しようとする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
People fear what they don't know,
and they will either revere or
eliminate it.

fields.EN:
Reverence and malice are the same. People
hurl violent feelings at someone one-sidedly,
never seeing them as another human being.
fields.JP:
崇拝も悪意も同じことさ。
暴力的な感情をただ一方的に相手に投げかける。
相手も同じ人間だとは、決して考えない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Reverence and hatred lead people
to see the object as something
different from them.

fields.EN:
Our world here is small... Which
is why those emotions are ever
more prevalent...
fields.JP:
こんなに狭い世界の中ですらそうだ。
……いや、狭い世界だからこそ、
激しく表れるのかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our world here is small... Which
is why those emotions are ever
more prevalent...

fields.EN:
It's quite laughable that we're
trying to bring hope to the
people.
fields.JP:
そんな僕らが、人々に希望を与えようなんて、
笑わせるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's quite laughable that we're
trying to bring hope to the
people.

fields.EN:
But, we don't have a choice. My
sister isn't a Blood Maiden and
has no power to combat hatred.
fields.JP:
……でも、仕方なかったんだ。
姉は血式少女じゃない。自力で人々の悪意を
跳ね返す力はない
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we don't have a choice. My
sister isn't a Blood Maiden and
has no power to combat hatred.

fields.EN:
That's why I established the
Order, to protect my sister from
the people. To keep them away...
fields.JP:
だから、僕は姉を護るために……人々から
遠ざけるために、教団を作ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I established the
Order, to protect my sister from
the people. To keep them away...

fields.EN:
I negotiated with the Dawn to let
us stay here, but... they doubt us
at every single turn.
fields.JP:
黎明に話を付けて、ここに置いてもらって……
でも、黎明も一枚岩ではないからね。
……何かあるごとに、僕らが疑われる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I negotiated with the Dawn to let
us stay here, but... they doubt us
at every single turn.

fields.EN:
I suppose the pressure slowly led
my sister to her current state...
fields.JP:
そんなストレスもあったんだろうか……
姉はそれから次第に正気を失っていったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose the pressure slowly led
my sister to her current state...

fields.EN:
She wasn't like this before. All I
wanted was to protect her... What
went wrong?!
fields.JP:
前はこんなんじゃなかったんだ。
僕はただ、姉さんを護ろうとしただけなのに、
どうしてこうなってしまったんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She wasn't like this before. All I
wanted was to protect her... What
went wrong?!

fields.JP: ちーちゃん。ないてるの？

fields.EN:
Chii-chan, we made this place together
as a beacon of hope. Not for me.
fields.JP:
ちーちゃん。
ここはふたりでつくった、みんなの希望だよ？
わたしのためじゃ、ないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chii, we made this place together
as a beacon of hope. Not for me.

fields.JP: じゃあ……希望って何なのかな？

fields.EN:
Michiru's Blue Bird-san went somewhere.
But Jack will find Blue Bird-san.
fields.JP:
みちるの青い鳥さん、どこかへ行って
しまったの。でも、ジャックがきっと、捕まえる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru's blue bird went
somewhere. But, Jack will catch
the blue bird.

fields.EN:
Shhh... Everyone wakes up from bad
dreams. That is our hope.
fields.JP:
しーっ。怖い夢は、かならず醒める。
……それがわたしたちの希望だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shhh... Everyone wakes up from bad
dreams. That is our hope.

fields.EN:
(If I catch this "blue bird," will
Michiru-san return to her normal
self?)
fields.JP:
（僕が『青い鳥』を捕まえたら……
　ミチルさんは元に戻るんだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I catch this "blue bird," will
Michiru return to her normal
self?)

fields.JP: あ、ジャックさん、いらっしゃいっす！

く、くらら！
どうしてここに……？

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! There's only one reason
why I'd be here!
fields.JP:
ふっふーん。自分がここにいる理由……
答えは一つしかないっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! There's only one reason
why I'd be here!

fields.EN:
I finally became a Blood Weapon
craftsman!
fields.JP: ついに、血式武器製造士になったっすー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I finally became a Blood Weapon
craftsman!

fields.EN:
Uh, but more like a working
apprentice, and only when the Boss
isn't around.
fields.JP:
って言っても、師匠が留守の間だけの
見習い製造士っすけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but more like a working
apprentice, and only when the Boss
isn't around.

fields.EN: She said she was going out for a bit with Sis.
fields.JP:
なんか、姉さんと一緒にちょっと出かけて
くるって言ってたっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something about going out with our
sleek Sis or something.

fields.EN:
Oh, but Boss taught me all the
basics, so there's nothing to
worry about!
fields.JP:
まあ、基本的なことは師匠から叩き込まれて
るんで、安心してほしいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but Boss taught me all the
basics, so there's nothing to
worry about!

fields.EN:
I found this, and I was trying to
figure out if it could be used for
something.
fields.JP:
こんなものを見つけたんですけど、
何かに使えないかと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found this, and I was trying to
figure out if it could be used for
something.

fields.JP: ジャックは「圧力モーター」をハルに渡した

fields.EN:
It's a damn good item you have
here! I can probably strengthen
the Mary Gun with this.
fields.JP:
いいモン見つけてきたな！
これでメアリガンを強化できるかもしれん
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a damn good item you have
here! I can probably strengthen
the Mary Gun with this.

fields.EN:
Yeah, hand over the Mary Gun. You
just wait right there!
fields.JP:
ああ、メアリガンを借りるぜ。
……ちょっと待ってな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, hand over the Mary Gun. You
just wait right there!

fields.EN: Thanks for waiting. Here ya go.
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks for waiting. Here ya go.

fields.EN:
It looks the same, but the 
propulsion and shooting range of
your blood increased.
fields.JP:
見た目は変わってねぇが……
血液の噴射力が増して、飛距離が随分と伸びたぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks the same, but the 
propulsion and shooting range of
your blood increased.

fields.JP: ありがとうございます！

fields.EN:
(I hope I can be of more help to
everyone now...)
fields.JP:
（これで、今までよりもっとみんなの役に
　立てるといいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope I can be of more help to
everyone now...)

fields.EN: Hey, kiddo. What brings you here?
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, kiddo. What brings you here?

fields.EN:
Um, I found something that I
thought would help...
fields.JP:
あの、また使えそうなものを見つけたので、
持ってきたんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I found something that I
thought would help...

fields.EN: Good work! Now, hand it over.
fields.JP:
おー、でかした！
見せてみろ
fields.LOCALIZED: Good work! Now, hand it over.

fields.JP: ジャックは「圧力モーター」をハルに渡した

fields.EN:
Good... Looks like this is gonna
work. Let me strengthen your Mary
Gun with it.
fields.JP:
……よし、確かに使えそうだな。
メアリガンを強化してやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good... Looks like this is gonna
work. Let me strengthen your Mary
Gun with it.

fields.JP: ハルさん、ありがとうございます！

fields.EN:
Hey there, Jack. You came to get
your Mary Gun tuned up?
fields.JP:
おー、ジャック。
メアリガンの点検にでもきたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey there, Jack. You came to get
your Mary Gun tuned up?

fields.EN:
I just wanted to show you
something.
fields.JP: ちょっと、見て欲しいものがあるんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just wanted to show you
something.

fields.EN:
Oh? You found something you think
is gonna help?
fields.JP:
ほう。また何か使えそうなものでも見つけて
きたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? You found something you think
is gonna help?

fields.EN:
Yes. But, it's a little different
than usual...
fields.JP: はい。でも、いつものとは形が違って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. But, it's a little different
than usual...

fields.EN:
[Jack gives the "Precision
Pressure Motor" to Haru.]
fields.JP: ジャックは「精巧な圧力モーター」をハルに渡した
fields.LOCALIZED:
[Jack gives the
"Fancy Hydraulic Motor"
to Haru.]

fields.EN: Do you think it will help?
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you think it will help?

fields.EN:
Help? You gotta be kidding! This
stuff is damn rare!
fields.JP:
使えそうなんてモンじゃねぇ。
こりゃ、大層なレアものだぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Help? You gotta be kidding! This
stuff is damn rare!

fields.EN:
All right, hand me the Mary Gun.
I'll get started right away.
fields.JP:
よし、メアリガンを貸せ。
すぐに取り掛かるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, hand over the Mary Gun.
I need to get working on it,
pronto.

fields.EN:
Thanks for waiting! This should
really give it all the juice it
needs!
fields.JP:
待たせたな！
こいつはそうとう出力が上がってるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for waiting! This should
really give it all the juice it
needs!

fields.JP: ありがとうございます！

fields.EN:
The amount of blood that's used
shouldn't change, but give it a
try.
fields.JP:
噴射する血液の量自体は変わってねえはずだが、
念のために試し撃ちしてみろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The amount of blood that's used
shouldn't change, but give it a
try.

fields.EN:
(All right... I just pull the
trigger...)
fields.JP: （よし。いつも通りに引き金を引いて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All right... I just pull the
trigger...)

fields.JP: お、おい、大丈夫かジャック！

fields.EN:
I didn't expect you to get pushed
back by the propulsion... Guess
it's a bit too powerful...
fields.JP:
まさか、出力が強すぎておまえ自身が後ろに
吹き飛ばされちまうとはな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect you to get pushed
back by the propulsion... Guess
it's a bit too powerful...

fields.EN:
(This is amazing, but I can't use
it like this...)
fields.JP: （確かにすごかったけど、これじゃあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is amazing, but I can't use
it like this...)

fields.EN:
Mmm... I guess I'll add a switch
to it so that you can adjust the
propulsion...
fields.JP:
うーん……ひとまず、噴射力をスイッチで
切り替えられるように手を加えるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I guess I'll add a switch
to it so that you can adjust the
propulsion...

fields.EN:
(Even if he does add a switch,
I'm not sure it's going to help
much...)
fields.JP:
（……切り替えできるようにしてもらっても、
　使い道があるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if he does add a switch,
I'm not sure it's going to help
much...)

fields.JP: あれ？　ジャックさん、どうしたんすか？

fields.EN:
I found this, and I was trying to
figure out if it could be used for
something.
fields.JP:
こんなものを見つけたんだけど、
何かに使えないかと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found this, and I was trying to
figure out if it could be used for
something.

fields.EN: Well, you mind I take a look?
fields.JP: ふむ、ちょっと見せてほしいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, you mind I take a look?

fields.JP: ジャックは「圧力モーター」をくららに渡した

fields.EN:
You're in luck, Jack-san! I may be
able to strengthen the Mary Gun
with this!
fields.JP:
お手柄っすよ、ジャックさん！
これでメアリガンを強化できるかもしれないっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're in luck, Jack! I may be
able to strengthen the Mary Gun
with this!

fields.EN:
Really, really! You mind I borrow
your Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
本当っす！
メアリガンを借りていいっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really, really! You mind I borrow
your Mary Gun?

fields.EN:
Huh? Um... You're going to work
on it, Clara?
fields.JP:
え……？
その、くららが改造してくれるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Um... You're going to work
on it, Clara?

fields.EN:
Aw c'mon... You don't trust me?
Do I gotta be the Boss to handle
it?
fields.JP:
あー、やっぱり、
師匠じゃないと信用できないっすか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw c'mon... You don't trust me?
Do I gotta be the Boss to handle
it?

fields.EN:
Uh, that's not it! Um, then can
you handle it?
fields.JP:
あ、いや、そんなことないよ！
それじゃあ、お願いしようかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, that's not it! Um, then can
you handle it?

fields.EN:
Of course! Leave it all to little
ol' me!
fields.JP:
心配ご無用！
自分にバッチリお任せっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! Leave it all to little
ol' me!

fields.JP: ジャックさん、お待たせしたっす！

fields.EN:
Well, it looks the same, but your
blood can shoot out a lot farther
now!
fields.JP:
見た目はおんなじっすけど、
血液の飛距離がガツンと伸びたはずっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it looks the same, but your
blood can shoot out a lot farther
now!

fields.EN:
(I hope I can be of more help to
everyone now...)
fields.JP:
（これで、今までよりもっとみんなの役に
　立てるといいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope I can be of more help to
everyone now...)

fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん！
今日はどうしたんすか？

fields.EN:
Um, I found something that I
thought would help...
fields.JP:
また使えそうなものを見つけたから
持ってきたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I found something that I
thought would help...

fields.EN:
Seriously? C'mon, let me take a
look at it!
fields.JP:
マジっすか？
ぜひぜひ見せてほしいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously? C'mon, let me take a
look at it!

fields.JP: ジャックは「圧力モーター」をくららに渡した

fields.EN:
Looks like I can use this... You
mind if I borrow your Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
……これは、確かに使えそうっすね。
またメアリガンをちょっと貸りるっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like I can use this... You
mind if I borrow your Mary Gun?

fields.EN:
Hiya, Jack-san! Came to get your Mary
Gun checked up?
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん。
メアリガンの点検にでもきたっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hiya, Jack! Came to get your Mary
Gun checked up?

fields.EN:
I just wanted to show you
something...
fields.JP: ちょっと、見て欲しいものがあるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just wanted to show you
something...

fields.JP:
おー、また何か使えそうなものを
見つけてきたんすね？

fields.EN:
Yeah, but I've never seen this
before...
fields.JP: うん。でも、いつものとは形が違って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but I've never seen this
before...

fields.EN:
[Jack gives the "Precision
Pressure Motor" to Clara.]
fields.JP: ジャックは「精巧な圧力モーター」をくららに渡した
fields.LOCALIZED:
[Jack gives the
"Fancy Hydraulic Motor"
to Clara.]

fields.JP: ジ、ジャックさん、これって……！

fields.EN: Do you think it will help?
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you think it will help?

fields.EN:
Forget help! If Boss was here,
he'd go bonkers over it!
fields.JP:
使えそうなんてモンじゃないっす！
もし師匠がここにいたら大興奮っすよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Forget help! If Boss was here,
he'd go bonkers over it!

fields.EN:
Let me get this set up with the
Mary Gun!
fields.JP: さっそくメアリガンに組み込んでみるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me get this set up with the
Mary Gun!

fields.EN:
Whew... Done! It should be a lot
more powerful than before.
fields.JP:
ふーっ、できたっす……！
そうとう出力が上がってるはずっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... Done! It should be a lot
more powerful than before.

fields.EN:
The amount you use shouldn't
change, but... Ya mind givin' it a
try?
fields.JP:
噴射する血液の量は変わってないはずなんで、
念のために試し撃ちしてみてほしいっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
The amount you use shouldn't
change, but... Ya mind givin' it a
try?

fields.EN:
(All right... I just pull the
trigger...)
fields.JP: （よし。いつも通りに引き金を引いて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All right... I just pull the
trigger...)

fields.EN:
I never expected the output to be so strong
that Jack-san himself
would be blown backward...
fields.JP:
まさか、出力が強すぎてジャックさん自身が
後ろに吹き飛ばされるとは思わなかったっす……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect ya to get pushed
back like that. Must be too strong
or somethin'...

fields.EN:
(This is amazing, but I can't use
it like this...)
fields.JP: （確かにすごかったけど、これじゃあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is amazing, but I can't use
it like this...)

fields.EN:
Mmm... For now, I'll add a switch
so you can change the blood's spray force.
fields.JP:
うーん……ひとまず、噴射力をスイッチで
切り替えられるようにしてみるっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I guess I'll add a switch
so you can adjust the flow...

fields.EN:
(Even if she does add a switch,
I'm not sure it's going to help
much...)
fields.JP:
（……切り替えできるようにしてもらっても、
　使い道があるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if she does add a switch,
I'm not sure it's going to help
much...)

fields.JP:
この巨大な『眼』みたいなもの……
何だろう……

fields.EN:
All I know is that they're all
over the place, and are pretty
eerie...
fields.JP: そうね……どこにでもあって、気味が悪いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I know is that they're all
over the place, and are pretty
eerie...

fields.EN:
It almost feels like we're being
watched...
fields.JP: 何だか、ずっと見られているような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It almost feels like we're being
watched...

fields.EN:
I heard that the Jail consumed a
city that was once here, and
mimicked a ton of stuff from it.
fields.JP:
……ジェイルってさ、昔ここにあった街を
飲み込んで、いろいろ擬態して出来てるんだって
聞いたんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard that the Jail consumed a
city that was once here, and
mimicked a ton of stuff from it.

fields.EN:
Which kinda explains why there's
all sorts of things from long ago
here and there.
fields.JP:
だから昔にあったものの名残が、あちこち
くっついてたり落ちてたりしてるみたいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which kinda explains why there's
all sorts of things from long ago
here and there.

fields.EN:
So, maybe this eye thing is some
sort of ornament from long ago.
fields.JP:
だから……昔、こんなでっかい眼みたいな飾りが
あった、とか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, maybe this eye thing is some
sort of ornament from long ago.

fields.EN:
Well, no use thinking about it
now.
fields.JP: ま、深く考えてもしょうがないんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, no use thinking about it
now.

fields.EN:
Even Dad said that there are a lot
of things we don't know about this
place.
fields.JP:
わかんないこともまだいっぱいあるって、
お父さんも言ってたしさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even Dad said that there are a lot
of things we don't know about this
place.

fields.EN:
This eye... I feel like it's
looking in a different direction
now...
fields.JP:
この『眼』……
さっきとは向きが変わっている気がするの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This eye... I feel like it's
looking in a different direction
now...

fields.EN: You mean the eye is moving...?
fields.LOCALIZED: You mean the eye is moving...?

fields.EN:
Huh? Doesn't really look like it
changed at all...
fields.JP:
うーん。あたしには特に変わったようには
見えないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Doesn't really look like it
changed at all...

fields.EN:
Never really paid close attention
to it before, but I guess we
should keep our own eyes on it.
fields.JP:
……今まであんまり気にしてなかったけど、
これからは気をつけて見てみることにしようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never really paid close attention
to it before, but I guess we
should keep our own eyes on it.

fields.EN:
Who knows? Maybe there's
something going on behind it...
fields.JP:
もしかしたら……本当に何かあるのかも
しれないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows? Maybe there's
something going on behind it...

fields.EN: In any case, it really is eerie...
fields.JP: それにしても……本当に気味が悪いわね
fields.LOCALIZED: In any case, it really is eerie...

fields.EN:
(After hearing that, I feel like
it's looking right at me. Great,
now I'm getting spooked...)
fields.JP:
（……僕もだんだん見られてる気がしてきて、
　落ち着かなくなってきたかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After hearing that, I feel like
it's looking right at me. Great,
now I'm getting spooked...)

fields.EN:
There are a lot of Marchen
carcasses around, but...
fields.JP:
……メルヒェンの死体って、よくあちこちで
見かけるけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are a lot of Marchen
carcasses around, but...

fields.EN:
This carcass is particularly
creepy... Look at how its stomach
burst open...
fields.JP:
この死体は、特に気味が悪いよね……
お腹だけ大きく裂けてる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This carcass is particularly
creepy... Look at how its stomach
burst open...

fields.EN:
I heard that some animals eat
their prey from the inside, but...
fields.JP:
……動物たちの場合は、先に獲物の内臓を食べる
場合があるというけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard that some animals eat
their prey from the inside, but...

fields.JP: 動物って……そうなんですか？

fields.EN: According to a book I read, yes.
fields.JP: ええ。書庫の本に書いてあったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: According to a book I read, yes.

fields.JP: アリスって、勉強家だよね

fields.EN:
It's just that I like reading...
It's nice and soothing to read
books, that's all...
fields.JP:
その……読書って向いてるみたいなの。
落ち着くというか……それだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I like reading...
It's nice and soothing to read
books, that's all...

fields.EN: Completely the opposite of you, Aka-nee!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Completely the opposite of Sister
Red!

fields.EN: Yup, I prefer moving and stuff!
fields.JP: ま、あたしは体を動かしてなんぼだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, I prefer moving and stuff!

fields.EN:
I wonder if the Marchens feed off
their own...
fields.JP:
……メルヒェン同士でも
食い合いをするものなのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if the Marchens feed off
their own...

fields.EN:
Hmm... Never seen anything like
that before.
fields.JP: うーん……見たことないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... Never seen anything like
that before.

fields.EN:
Well, if it's just killing
Marchens, anyone can do that.
fields.JP:
まあ死体ってだけで言えばさ、普通の人でも
倒せなくはないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if it's just killing
Marchens, anyone can do that.

fields.EN:
Yup. From what I heard, there were
a lot of strong people in the Dawn
who could.
fields.JP:
うん。特に、昔の黎明には強い人がいっぱい
いたって話だし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. From what I heard, there were
a lot of strong people in the Dawn
who could.

fields.EN:
You're referring to the members
who went on the expedition to the
Tower 15 years ago, right?
fields.JP: ……十五年前に塔の探索をしたという人たちね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're referring to the members
who went on the expedition to the
Tower 15 years ago, right?

fields.EN:
That was before there was such a
thing as a Blood Team.
fields.JP: なにしろ血式部隊なんてまだ無かった頃だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was before there was such a
thing as a Blood Team.

fields.EN:
They all fought the Marchens for
the Dawn we see today. And they
built the District from scratch.
fields.JP:
みんなでどうにかメルヒェンたちに対抗して、
今の黎明の大元を創っていったんだよね。
イチから解放地区を整備してってさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They all fought the Marchens for
the Dawn we see today. And they
built the District from scratch.

fields.EN:
They must have really been
something...
fields.JP: 昔の人たちは、すごかったんだなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They must have really been
something...

fields.EN:
Getting back on topic, even if you
weren't as strong, you could still
beat a Marchen with a few others.
fields.JP:
話を戻すけどさ、昔の黎明の人までは
いかなくても、数人がかりで頑張れば
メルヒェンくらいはなんとか倒せるってわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Getting back on topic, even if you
weren't as strong, you could still
beat a Marchen with a few others.

fields.EN:
Oh! Like how strong Kadowaki-san
is!
fields.JP: あ！　門脇さんは強いですよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh! Like how strong Mr. Kadowaki
is!

fields.EN:
Yup! Towa keeps training himself
so that he could beat the Marchens
on his own!
fields.JP:
あはは。そうだね。
永遠なんかは一人でメルヒェン退治するのが
目標で、筋トレしてるし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Towa keeps training himself
so that he could beat the Marchens
on his own!

fields.EN: Sure isn't my cup of tea...
fields.JP: 物好きもいたものです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure isn't my cup of tea...

fields.EN:
You have to admit, that's pretty
admirable.
fields.JP: 立派な努力じゃありませんこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have to admit, that's pretty
admirable.

fields.EN:
...We don't know anything about
these particular carcasses, right?
fields.JP:
……これについては何もわからない、という
ことね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...We don't know anything about
these particular carcasses, right?

fields.EN:
(I wonder what Haru-san wants with
me...)
fields.JP: （ハルさんからの用事って、なんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what Haru wants with
me...)

fields.EN:
(The Mary Gun made it a lot safer
for everyone to fight the
Marchens.)
fields.JP:
（このメアリガンのおかげで、
　みんなの戦いはだいぶ安全になったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Mary Gun made it a lot safer
for everyone to fight the
Marchens.)

fields.EN:
(I'd better thank Haru-san and Miko
when I get the chance...)
fields.JP:
（ハルさんたちに……
　ちゃんと、お礼を言っとかなきゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'd better thank Haru and Miko
when I get the chance...)

fields.JP: あの……ハルさん、ジャックです

fields.EN: Ah, you're here! Come on in.
fields.JP:
おー、来たか！
入れよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, you're here! Come on in.

fields.JP: 体の方は、もう何ともない？

fields.EN:
I gotta hand it to you for coming
back in one piece...
fields.JP:
……よく、生きて帰って来たな
褒めてやるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I gotta hand it to you for coming
back in one piece...

fields.EN:
It's thanks to you and Miko-san for making
the Mary Gun, Haru-san. Thank you very much!
fields.JP:
メアリガンの……
ハルさんと視子さんのおかげです。
ありがとうございました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And it's all because of you and
Miko for making the Mary Gun.
Thank you very much!

fields.JP: ま、せいぜい感謝しといてくれ

fields.EN: Um, so you wanted to see me...?
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, so you wanted to see me...?

fields.EN:
Oh, yeah... Miko's here, so I
wanted to overhaul the Mary Gun
and adjust the body connectors.
fields.JP:
おお、メアリガンのオーバーホールだ。
ちょうど視子もいることだし……
ついでに生体接合部の調整もしとくか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, yeah... Miko's here, so I
wanted to overhaul the Mary Gun
and adjust the body connectors.

fields.EN:
Sure, as you wish... Jack? Sit
over here and show me your arm.
fields.JP:
はいはい……仰せのままに。
ジャック、そこの椅子にかけて、
腕を出してちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, as you wish... Jack? Sit
over here and show me your arm.

fields.EN:
Ready? I'm going to release the
safety lock...
fields.JP:
……いいか？
メアリガンのセーフティを解除するぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ready? I'm going to release the
safety lock...

fields.EN:
Hemostasis, clear. You can relax
now, Jack. Let me check your blood
pressure, too.
fields.JP:
止血処置完了……
ジャック、もう楽にしていいわよ。
血圧も測っておくわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hemostasis, clear. You can relax
now, Jack. Let me check your blood
pressure, too.

fields.EN:
(They looked tense... I didn't
know it was so difficult to remove
the Mary Gun...)
fields.JP:
（メ……メアリガンを外すだけでも、
　こんなに大変なんだなあ……緊張した……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They looked tense... I didn't
know it was so difficult to remove
the Mary Gun...)

fields.JP:
血圧、問題無し。
ドレーンの詰まりも見ておくわ。
……どうかした、ハルさん？

fields.EN:
The compressor isn't working right... Well,
we did have to improvise it on the spot.
I guess I'll replace the condenser...
fields.JP:
コンプレッサーの調子が悪ィな……
まあ、現場合わせのぶっつけ本番だったからな。
コンデンサーを交換しとくか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The compressor isn't optimal...
Guess it didn't calibrate too
well. I better replace it...

fields.EN:
Drain pipe cleansing, complete.
The cartridge... is unused.
Hemostatic ampule, normal...
fields.JP:
……ドレーンパイプの清掃、終わり。
カートリッジは未使用のまま……
うん、止血剤アンプルの方は問題ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Drain pipe cleansing, complete.
The cartridge... is unused.
Hemostatic ampule, normal...

fields.EN:
We have an applicator to help stop
any unusual bleeding. We made it
from those magnolia leaves.
fields.JP:
ああ、トラブルが起きた時のために、
止血剤のアンプルが組み込んであるの。
ほら、例のホオノキの葉から精製したものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have an applicator to help stop
any unusual bleeding. We made it
from those magnolia leaves.

fields.EN:
(So it prevents me from over-
bleeding...? They really packed
this with a lot of things...)
fields.JP:
（止血剤ってことは……血が出過ぎないように
　ってことなのかな……？
　いろんなものが組み込まれてるんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So it prevents me from over-
bleeding...? They really packed
this with a lot of things...)

fields.EN:
That should do it... Wish we had
actual parts and not recyclables,
but not much we can do about it...
fields.JP:
……まあ、こんなもんだろ。
もう少し信頼性が欲しいとこだが……
ほとんどが流用部品だしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That should do it... Wish we had
actual parts and not recyclables,
but not much we can do about it...

fields.EN:
I didn't know there were so many
parts involved in making the Mary
Gun...
fields.JP:
メアリガンって……
こんなに……手がかけられてたんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know there were so many
parts involved in making the Mary
Gun...

fields.EN:
Thank you... I'll take good care
of it!
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
メアリガン……大切に使わせてもらいます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you... I'll take good care
of it!

fields.EN:
Uh, okay... Well, we're done. You
can go now. If you feel something
weird, be sure to let us know.
fields.JP:
お、おう……済んだぞ！　
もう、帰ってよし！
調子が悪くなったら、すぐに言えよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, okay... Well, we're done. You
can go now. If you feel something
weird, be sure to let us know.

fields.EN:
Will do! Thank you again, Haru-san,
Miko-san!
fields.JP:
はい！　ハルさん、視子さん……
ありがとうございました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will do! Thank you again, Haru,
Miko!

fields.EN:
Well, do your best. In any case, it's
not a bad thing to keep protecting what
you yourself believe is precious...
fields.JP:
まあ、頑張れや。
何にせよ、自分にとって大切だと思えるものを
守っていくってのは悪くない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, do your best. After all,
it's not often you get to protect
what's precious to you...

fields.EN:
...I should head back too. I've stayed quite
a while. See you, Haru-san. Let's go, Jack.
fields.JP:
……私も帰るわ。だいぶ長居しちゃった。
それじゃね、ハルさん。
行きましょ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I'd better leave now, too.
See you later... Let's go, Jack.

fields.EN: Did you see Haru-san's face just now?
fields.JP: さっきのハルさんの顔……見た？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you see Haru's face just now?

fields.EN:
I can't believe that old man
blushed... I've never seen him
like that before.
fields.JP:
……やあねえ、照れちゃって……
あのオヤジのあんな顔、初めて見たわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe that old man
blushed... I've never seen him
like that before.

fields.EN:
R-Really? I didn't notice at
all...
fields.JP:
そ、そうなんですか？
全然わからなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Really? I didn't notice at
all...

fields.JP:
『自分の大切なものを……
　守っていくのは悪くない』……か

fields.EN: Well, that was quite a treat.
fields.JP:
ジャック……
今日は面白いものが見れたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, that was quite a treat.

fields.JP: はいはい荷物通るっすよーーー！

fields.EN:
Oh, yeah... You know, about the
Nightmare speaking...
fields.JP:
……あ、そうだ！
ねえくらら、ナイトメアが喋った件の
ことだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, yeah... You know, about the
Nightmare speaking...

fields.JP: うわわっ！　申し訳ないっす！！

fields.EN:
...So I got caught up in being busy and forgot
to give the Professor the message Jack-san
asked me to deliver...
fields.JP:
……ってわけで、ついつい忙しさにかまけて、
ジャックさんに頼まれてた伝言、博士に
伝えるの忘れてたっす……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So I completely forgot about
letting the Professor know about
the talking Nightmare.

fields.JP: ……あはは。多分そうなんだろうなって思ったよ

fields.EN:
I'm so sorry... Like, I already
got yelled at by the Boss, too...
fields.JP:
マジで申し訳ないっす……
実は、師匠からも怒られまして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry... Like, I already
got yelled at by the Boss, too...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. Looks like someone
told the Professor anyway.
fields.JP:
そんなに気にしなくていいよ。
誰かが話してくれてたみたいで、博士には
ちゃんと伝わってたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. Looks like someone
told the Professor anyway.

fields.EN:
I was helpin' the Boss out late
into the night, but I don't recall
seein' anyone but us.
fields.JP:
あの後自分、師匠のとこで夜中まで
手伝いしてたんすけど、部屋の前、
誰も通らなかったような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was helpin' the Boss out late
into the night, but I don't recall
seein' anyone but us.

fields.EN:
Guess that means someone must
have told the Professor after I
left.
fields.JP:
……ってことは、自分が帰った後に
誰か起き出して、博士と話したんすかねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess that means someone must
have told the Professor after I
left.

fields.JP: あれ？　どうしたっすか、ジャックさん？

fields.EN:
Um... I guess you're right. I fell
asleep right after I asked you to
relay the message.
fields.JP:
あ……いや、そうだね。
僕もあの後、ぐっすり寝ちゃってたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I guess you're right. I fell
asleep right after I asked you to
relay the message.

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, I heard you almost
showed up late to the morning meeting~?
fields.JP:
そういや、朝の会議、遅刻しかけたって
聞きましたよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, and I heard you were late
to the morning meeting?

fields.EN:
(Did someone wake up in the middle
of the night to let the Professor
know?)
fields.JP: （本当に誰か、夜中に起き出したのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did someone wake up in the middle
of the night to let the Professor
know?)

fields.JP: （……誰が博士に伝えたんだろう……？）

fields.EN:
So, that wasn't part of the
mission, then...
fields.JP: では……あれは作戦行動ではなかったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that wasn't part of the
mission, then...

fields.JP: シンデレラが……まさかあんな……

fields.EN:
Calm down, Akazukin-san. She's alive...
That's what matters.
fields.JP:
落ち着いて、赤ずきんさん。
生きていたんだもの……よかったじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down... She's alive, so all's
well.

fields.JP: う……うん。そうなんだ……だけどさ……

fields.EN:
I told you Cinderella went into the
Prison Area on her own initiative...
and all by herself, right...?
fields.JP:
シンデレラが独断で……しかも一人で
独房エリアに入ったって話はしたよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remember how I told you about
Cinderella going out by herself?

fields.EN:
Yes. Cinderella-san said something so reckless
that I ended up arguing with her a little...
fields.JP:
ええ。わたしときたら、シンデレラさんが無茶な
ことを言うものだから、ちょっとした言い合いを
してしまったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I recall having a bit of an
argument over that thoughtless
action.

fields.EN:
It's good you said it straight to
her. But, I wasn't able to scold
her at all...
fields.JP:
あ、あのくらい言ってくれた方が良かったんだよ
……あの子にはさ。あたしには言えなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's good you said it straight to
her. But, I wasn't able to scold
her at all...

fields.EN:
All I know is that you and the
Professor were really worried.
fields.JP:
でも……あなたと博士がとても心配していたことは
よく伝わってきたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I know is that you and the
Professor were really worried.

fields.EN:
We actually gave up on
Cinderella... So we tried not to
dwell on her...
fields.JP:
あたしたち、ほんとに諦めてたんだよ……
シンデレラのことを。だから、考えないように
してた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We actually gave up on
Cinderella... So we tried not to
dwell on her...

fields.EN:
You couldn't believe how happy
we were when she came back
alive...
fields.JP:
だから……生きて戻ってきた時には、そりゃ
嬉しくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You couldn't believe how happy
we were when she came back
alive...

fields.EN:
That's why I wasn't able to scold
her... I'm such a bad sister...
fields.JP:
それできつく叱れなかったってわけ。
お姉さん失格だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I wasn't able to scold
her... I'm such a bad sister...

fields.EN:
Do you mind listening to me a bit
longer? You're about the only
person I talk to about this...
fields.JP:
……聞いてくれる？
こんなの、多分あんたにしか話せない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind listening to me a bit
longer? You're about the only
person I talk to about this...

fields.EN:
A while back, I... killed a Blood
Maiden.
fields.JP: ……あたしさ。血式少女を殺したことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
A while back, I... killed a Blood
Maiden.

fields.EN:
(Is that why Akazukin-san didn't want
to talk much about Blood Skelter...?)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんが……
　ブラッドスケルター化についてあまり
　話したがらなかったのは、そのせい……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that why she doesn't like
talking about Blood Skelter?)

fields.EN:
So that's what you meant when you
said "lost" someone...
fields.JP:
……『犠牲を出した』というのは、そういう意味
なのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that's what you meant when you
said "lost" someone...

fields.EN: I kind of suspected it before...
fields.LOCALIZED: I kind of suspected it before...

fields.EN:
If there was no way to counteract
Blood Skelter, the only option is
leaving the person behind.
fields.JP:
今まで、ブラッドスケルター化には
打つ手が無かった……だとすれば、暴走した
その人を置いて撤退するしか手はないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there was no way to counteract
Blood Skelter, the only option is
leaving the person behind.

fields.EN:
And... I don't think that's a bad
call.
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... I don't think that's a bad
call.

fields.EN:
That's not it... I... killed the
person myself.
fields.JP: ……違うんだ。あたしの手で殺したんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not it... I... killed the
person myself.

fields.EN:
I got my first Blood Weapon on my
10th birthday. I went to one of
the areas, wanting to test it out.
fields.JP:
昔さ、あたしがまだ十歳の頃のことだったんだ。
誕生日に初めて血式武器……このハサミを貰った
あたしは、早速独房エリアに行ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got my first Blood Weapon on my
10th birthday. I went to one of
the areas, wanting to test it out.

fields.EN:
That's when I saw a Blood Maiden
surrounded by Marchens. I saved
her. Her name was Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
そこで、見つけたんだ。まだ小さな血式少女を。
メルヒェンに囲まれてて……あたしが助けたら
人魚姫だって名乗ったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's when I saw a Blood Maiden
surrounded by Marchens. I saved
her. Her name was Little Mermaid.

fields.EN:
She was already being consumed
by Corruption, and suffering badly
from her injuries...
fields.JP:
でも……その子はもう、穢れが目一杯で、
怪我して苦しんでて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was already being consumed
by Corruption, and suffering badly
from her injuries...

fields.EN:
She was in her Blood Skelter
state, right?
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was in her Blood Skelter
state, right?

fields.EN:
I think those Marchens around
her triggered it. I honestly don't
remember much from then...
fields.JP:
決定打はメルヒェンたちの追撃だったと思う。
その時のことは、正直あまり覚えてない……
……でも
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think those Marchens around
her triggered it. I honestly don't
remember much from then...

fields.EN:
When I came to, I was holding the weapon
I'd swung, her blood dripping from it...
and her berserk corpse lay there...
fields.JP:
気がついた時には、あたしは振り下ろした武器を
構えてて、武器からはその子の血が滴ってて……
暴走した姿のその子の死体が転がってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the time I noticed, she was
dead in front of me. And I was
covered in her blood...

fields.EN:
Haru-san came right after, and he
consoled me, saying there was
nothing else I could have done...
fields.JP:
後ろには、遅れて合流したハルさんが
立っててさ……『仕方なかった』って慰めて
くれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru came right after, and he
consoled me, saying there was
nothing else I could have done...

fields.EN:
Yes... I would say the same, too.
At least you helped to end her
misery.
fields.JP:
……ええ。仕方がなかったことだと思うわ。
せめて、終わらせてあげて良かったのだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I would say the same, too.
At least you helped to end her
misery.

fields.EN:
Dad later examined her body and
discovered Blood Skelter. He said
it was proof how dangerous it was.
fields.JP:
あとでお父さんが、その子の死体を調べて、
ブラッドスケルター化って現象について……
その怖ろしさについて知ることができたって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad later examined her body and
discovered Blood Skelter. He said
it was proof how dangerous it was.

fields.EN:
But... I hear her voice every now
and then. I can feel the sensation
of splitting open her body...!
fields.JP:
でも……でも……たまに蘇るんだよ。
暴走したあの子の叫び声だとか……
あの子を切り裂いた時の肉の感触が……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I hear her voice every now
and then. I can feel the sensation
of splitting open her body...!

fields.EN:
Someone behind me said, "There's no choice
but to put her down!" But... even so, I...!
fields.JP:
後ろで誰かが言ったんだよ！
『始末するより仕方ない』って！
でも……だからって、あたし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone said that ending her life
was the only way! But... But...!

fields.EN:
You've held that inside all this
time, haven't you?
fields.JP:
……あなたは、ずっとひとりでそれを
抱えていたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've held that inside all this
time, haven't you?

fields.EN:
If I were that girl, I would've
been grateful that you ended
my suffering...
fields.JP:
でも、もしわたしがその人だったら……
終わらせてくれたこと……感謝しているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I were that girl, I would've
been grateful that you ended
my suffering...

fields.EN:
So, please... You don't need to
suffer like this anymore...
fields.JP: だから、もう苦しまなくてもいいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, please... You don't need to
suffer like this anymore...

fields.EN:
(I didn't know she's been through
all that...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know she's been through
all that...)

fields.EN:
(So that's why she was panicking
back when Alice entered Blood
Skelter...)
fields.JP:
（だから……アリスが暴走した時、あんなに
　必死になったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So that's why she was panicking
back when Alice entered Blood
Skelter...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I shouldn't have listened
in on their conversation...)
fields.JP:
（なんだか……偶然とはいえ、
　勝手に聞いちゃって申し訳なかったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I shouldn't have listened
in on their conversation...)

fields.EN:
Sorry for all that... It's not
like I wanted to have someone
feel bad for me.
fields.JP:
見苦しいとこ、見せちゃったね……
同情してもらいたくて話したわけじゃないのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for all that... It's not
like I wanted to have someone
feel bad for me.

fields.EN:
But, I guess it was for
the best to share this
with someone...
fields.JP:
でも……やっぱり誰かに聞いてもらいたかった
のかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I guess it was for
the best to share this
with someone...

fields.EN:
Yes, and... thank you for sharing
it with me.
fields.JP: いいえ。話してくれて、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and... thank you for sharing
it with me.

fields.EN:
I never want to lose anyone like
that again...
fields.JP:
だからさ……
あたし、もう二度と仲間を失いたくないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I never want to lose anyone like
that again...

fields.EN:
With Jack with us, at least we can
fight without worrying about it...
fields.JP:
……でも、今はジャックのおかげで
あたしたちは必要以上に暴走を怖れずに
戦えるようになったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Jack with us, at least we can
fight without worrying about it...

fields.EN:
You can't imagine how much I
appreciate that...
fields.JP: ……どれだけ感謝しても、足りないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't imagine how much I
appreciate that...

fields.EN: Oh? You found this out there?
fields.JP: ……ほう。こんな物が独房エリアに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? You found this out there?

fields.EN:
Yup. It didn't have much written
on it, but I figured you should
know, Dad.
fields.JP:
うん。何てことない内容だったんだけど、
念のためお父さんにも報告した方がいいと思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. It didn't have much written
on it, but I figured you should
know, Dad.

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san sure acts like
a kid in front of the
Professor...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん、博士の前ではほんとに
　子供みたいになるなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood sure acts like
a kid in front of the
Professor...)

fields.EN:
I didn't expect something like
this to be found in this area...
fields.JP:
それにしても……こんなもの独房エリアに
落ちてるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect something like
this to be found in this area...

fields.EN: I wonder who wrote this memo...
fields.JP: このメモ、いったい誰が書いたのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder who wrote this memo...

fields.EN:
Well, it is written nicely. I'm a
bit jealous... My penmanship is
pretty horrible.
fields.JP:
かなり綺麗な字だよね……！
あたし、そんなに字がうまくないから
……ちょっとうらやましいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is written nicely. I'm a
bit jealous... My penmanship is
pretty horrible.

fields.EN:
Yes. Judging from the handwriting,
it looks like it was written
by someone very meticulous.
fields.JP:
ええ。筆跡を見る限り、ずいぶんと几帳面な
人が書いたように思えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From the looks of it, it seems
like the person who wrote it was
very studious.

fields.EN: This is merely a guess, but...
fields.LOCALIZED: This is merely a guess, but...

fields.EN:
I told you that Dawn once organized
investigation teams to explore and research
the Prison Area and the Jail Tower, didn't I?
fields.JP:
かつて黎明は調査隊を組んで、独房エリアや
『監獄塔』を探索研究していたのは話したね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remember how I told you about
the Dawn sending units out to the
areas, right?

fields.EN:
Yes, and that became the basis of
the missions we're undertaking
now.
fields.JP:
ええ……それが現在の作戦行動の基礎となった
のよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and that became the basis of
the missions we're undertaking
now.

fields.EN:
Exactly. The structure inside here changes
over time, and above all, there's no
telling when you might lose your life.
fields.JP:
その通りだよ。ここの内部は時間とともに構造も
変化するし、何よりいつ命を落とすとも限らない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. This world is constantly
changing, and there's no telling
when our lives may be at risk.

fields.EN:
That said, I believe one of them
must have written this to relay to
future members searching the area.
fields.JP:
……だから、後に探索する者のために、探索者の
誰かが書き残しておいたものなのだろうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I believe one of them
must have written this to relay to
future members searching the area.
