(There's no denying... He took on
the form of a Nightmare!)
fields.JP:
（だってこの姿はどう見ても
　ナイトメア……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no denying... He took on
the form of a Nightmare!)

fields.EN:
Hey! Don't you dare lay a finger
on my princess, you hear?!
fields.JP:
おい！　姫に指一本でも触れてみろ
タダじゃ済まさないぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Don't you dare lay a finger
on my princess, you hear?!

fields.JP: （そうだ、僕は必ず姫を守るんだ……）

fields.EN:
(I need to "repay" my debt by
protecting Ningyohime...!)
fields.JP:
（人魚姫を守るっていう
　『恩返し』を成し遂げるんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to "repay" my debt by
protecting Little Mermaid...!)

fields.EN:
(What the...? My head...
My chest... It hurts...!)
fields.JP:
（急に頭がクラクラして……
　胸も……苦しいっ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What the...? My head...
My chest... It hurts...!)

fields.JP:
（くっ……こんな時に……
　また起きてしまうなんて……！）

fields.EN:
(Calm yourself...
If I faint here, who will protect
my dear princess...!)
fields.JP:
（落ち着け、落ち着け……
　僕が倒れたら誰が姫を守るんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Calm yourself...
If I faint here, who will protect
my dear princess...!)

fields.EN:
(I need to protect her
at all costs!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to protect her
at all costs!)

fields.EN:
(I can sense something odd in
my mind, but... it feels warm and
cozy...)
fields.JP:
（頭に……ぐちゃぐちゃの思考が……
　でもほんの少し……温かい……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can sense something odd in
my mind, but... it feels warm and
cozy...)

fields.EN:
(Is this coming from Jack...?
This warmth... is his soul?)
fields.JP:
（これはジャックの感覚……？
　この温かさは……彼の残った心……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is this coming from Jack...?
This warmth... is his soul?)

fields.EN: Wait... Is it really you, Jack?
fields.JP: まさか、ジャック……君なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait... Is it really you, Jack?

fields.EN:
(I don't sense any hostility from
him. It doesn't seem like he'll
attack, but...)
fields.JP:
（襲ってくる気配はない。
　敵意はなさそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't sense any hostility from
him. It doesn't seem like he'll
attack, but...)

fields.EN:
(Wait... Come to think of it, both
the dizziness and the palpitations
have stopped before I knew it...)
fields.JP:
（あれ、そういえば眩暈も動悸も、
　いつのまにか収まってる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... Come to think of it,
the pain and dizziness is...
gone?)

fields.EN:
Say, Jack?
Can you hear me?
fields.JP:
なあ、ジャック
僕の声が聞こえるかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack?
Can you hear me?

fields.JP: ジャック！　やっぱり君は……！
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……あ゛り、ず……
ま゛も……る……ちぎぎぎ……

fields.EN:
(Jack... So, your soul is still
residing within you...)
fields.JP:
（ジャック……君はやっぱり
　まだ心が残って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jack... So, your soul is still
residing within you...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

おづう……んぎちち……
……いぎで……みみみ……
ナイトメア・ジャック

……よがっ……た……
みちち……んぎぎっ……

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm alive.
Your thought is appreciated.
fields.JP:
……ああ、生きてたよ。
心配してくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm alive.
Your thought is appreciated.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan?
You can speak with Jack-san?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、
ジャックさんとお話ができるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu?
You can speak with Jack?

fields.EN:
I don't know why, but...
I suppose I can...
fields.JP:
自分でも不思議なんだけど……
どうやらそうみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know why, but...
I suppose I can...

fields.JP: 完全には分からないけれどね……

fields.EN:
But, I do know Jack has no
intention of harming us.
It looks like we're safe for now.
fields.JP:
でもジャックに敵意がないことは分かった。
今のところ、危険性はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I do know Jack has no
intention of harming us.
It looks like we're safe for now.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I see...
I suppose that's a bit of a relief.
fields.JP:
そっか……
それは少しだけ、よかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
I suppose that's a bit of a relief.

fields.EN:
Not that we should be happy
about this...
fields.JP: 手放しでは喜べないけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that we should be happy
about this...

fields.EN:
(That said, I don't know whether
it'll stay safe like this, or if
it's only being quiet for now...)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ、ずっと安全なのか、
　今だけおとなしいだけなのか、
　分からないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't know if he'll be like
this the whole time, or maybe
turn on us down the line...)

fields.EN:
(His words are hard to tell,
and I can't really comprehend
him fully.)
fields.JP:
（言葉も拙くて、
　いまいち要領を得ないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(His words are hard to tell,
and I can't really comprehend
him fully.)

fields.EN:
(There's so little going for
him to make me fully trust him...)
fields.JP:
（完全に心を許すには、
　根拠が心許ないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's so little going for
him to make me fully trust him...)

fields.EN:
This is all happening so
suddenly. I have no idea
what's going on here...
fields.JP:
短い間に色々ありすぎて、
わたし、もうよく分からないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is all happening so
suddenly. I have no idea
what's going on here...

fields.EN:
True. It's best to determine what
is really going on, but first we
need to find a safer place.
fields.JP:
確かに、しっかりと状況確認したいですね。
ですが姫、ここは危険のようだ。
ひとまず安全な場所を探しましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. It's best to determine what
is really going on, but first we
need to find a safer place.

fields.EN: Jack! Aren't you going to come?
fields.JP: どうしたジャック、早く行くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack! Aren't you going to come?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

……ぼ……にぎぎ……
いっ……しょ……みちちい……？

fields.EN:
There's no need to worry.
Now come, let's go!
fields.JP:
もしかして遠慮してるのか？
いいからほら、行くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no need to worry.
Now come, let's go!

fields.EN:
(I wonder why I understand
Jack like this...?)
fields.JP:
（でもどうして僕が、
　ジャックの感覚を理解できるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why I understand
Jack like this...?)

fields.EN:
(I don't know why, but what I do
know is that I will protect my
princess no matter what...)
fields.JP:
（分からない……でも、何があろうと
　姫だけは絶対に守るんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't know why, but what I do
know is that I will protect my
princess no matter what...)

fields.EN:
I know it's late to ask, but
are you all right, my princess?
fields.JP:
今さらだけど姫、
どこも怪我はしてないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's late to ask, but
are you all right, my princess?

fields.EN:
I'm fine. Actually, you look
worse than I do, Otsuu-chan.
Are you okay?
fields.JP:
わたしは平気だよ。
おつうちゃんこそ大丈夫なの？
傷だらけじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. Actually, you look
worse than I do, Otsuu.
Are you okay?

fields.EN:
There you go again.
I worry how you always care
for others more than yourself.
fields.JP:
姫は、そうやってすぐに自分のことより
他人を優先させてしまうだろう？
だから、心配なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go again.
I worry how you always care
for others more than yourself.

fields.EN:
We don't have an infirmary here,
so be sure you care for even the
tiniest of scratches, okay?
fields.JP:
医務室が近くにあるわけでもないから、
ちょっとの傷でもちゃんと言うんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have an infirmary here,
so be sure you care for even the
tiniest of scratches, okay?

fields.EN:
I'm really okay, Otsuu-chan. When we fell,
Jack-san protected me from the fall...
fields.JP:
本当に大丈夫なの、おつうちゃん。
崖から落ちる時にね、ジャックさんが
守ってくれたの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, really, I'm fine.
When we fell, Jack covered and
protected me from the fall.

fields.EN:
Thank you for protecting my
princess, Jack.
fields.JP:
ジャック、姫を守ってくれて
本当にありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for protecting my
princess, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

んぎぎ……たす……
ごががが……ぎぎ……よが……
ジャックさんはなんて？

fields.EN: He says he's glad Princess was saved.
fields.JP:
姫が助かってよかった、
って……そう言ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said he's happy to have
helped you, my princess.

fields.JP:
そっか……
ジャックさんは優しいのね

fields.EN:
Jack...
It looks like I owe you one.
fields.JP:
ジャック……
君には借りが出来ちゃったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...
It looks like I owe you one.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぢぎ……だずげ……だ……
いぎぎ……ぎぐ……

fields.EN:
He said it's nothing,
and that he saved you
because he wanted to.
fields.JP:
助けたかったから助けた。
だから気にしなくていいってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said it's nothing,
and that he saved you
because he wanted to.

fields.JP: ジャックさん、優しいのね

fields.EN:
(I will remember what you did
for her, Jack...)
fields.JP:
（それでも僕は、これを借りだと思うよ 
　……ジャック）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I will remember what you did
for her, Jack...)

fields.JP: メルヒェン！　いつの間に！？

fields.EN:
It looks like we can't run...
I suppose we have to fight.
fields.JP: 逃げ切れない……やるしかないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like we can't run...
I suppose we have to fight.

fields.EN:
Jack!
Are you able to fight?
fields.JP:
ジャック！
君は戦えるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack!
Are you able to fight?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぐご……ぐご……
ヴァァァァァァァッ！

fields.EN:
Good!
It looks like he'll help!
fields.JP: よし！　戦えるみたいだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good!
It looks like he'll help!

fields.EN:
I was able to tell what he said
this time!
fields.JP: うん……これはわたしにも分かった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was able to tell what he said
this time!

fields.EN:
Jack is a Nightmare now,
so the battle should be in
our favor!
fields.JP:
今のジャックはナイトメアだ！
これならこっちが断然有利のはずだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is a Nightmare now,
so the battle should be in
our favor!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぐごごっ……！
ごが……ぎぎぎぎ……っ！！
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎぎ……
ぐぎぇぇぇぇぇぇっっ！！

fields.EN:
(I'm synching with him...?!
I feel like my head is splitting!)
fields.JP:
（僕までつられて……！？
　苦しい……頭が割れそう、だ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm synching with him...?!
I feel like my head is splitting!)

fields.EN:
What's the matter?!
Is it that bad?!
fields.JP:
どうしたの！？
立ってられないくらいつらいの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?!
Is it that bad?!

fields.EN:
Heh... I'm... fine...
Don't worry about me... Tch!
fields.JP:
はは……平気、さ……
心配しなくても、このくらい……うっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I'm... fine...
Don't worry about me... Tch!

fields.EN:
Of course I'm worried!
You look horrible, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
どう見ても大丈夫じゃないよ！
おつうちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I'm worried!
You look horrible, Otsuu!

fields.EN:
(Calm down...
I don't want to needlessly bring
worry to my princess...)
fields.JP:
（早く収まれ……
　じゃないと、姫に心配させてしまう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Calm down...
I don't want to needlessly bring
worry to my princess...)

fields.JP: ほら、無理しないでおつうちゃん

fields.EN:
Here, let me hold you and pat you
on your back. It should calm you
down a bit.
fields.JP:
こうしてるとね、落ち着くんだよ？
抱きしめて背中をトントンって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, let me hold you and pat you
on your back. It should calm you
down a bit.

fields.EN:
(She's right...
I can feel the pain subsiding...)
fields.JP:
（本当だ……
　苦しいのが、引いていく……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right...
I can feel the pain subsiding...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Thank you, my princess...
I feel a lot better now...
fields.JP:
……ありがとう、姫……
だいぶ良くなったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, my princess...
I feel a lot better now...

fields.EN:
Look at that sweat...
What happened there, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、すごい汗だよ……
いったい何があったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at that sweat...
What happened there, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
I don't know...
The moment Jack went into pain,
I went into pain, too...
fields.JP:
分からない。
ジャックが苦しそうにしてたら僕まで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know...
The moment Jack went into pain,
I went into pain, too...

fields.EN:
Something didn't feel right during
the battle, too.
fields.JP: さっきの戦いでもおかしな感じがしたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something didn't feel right during
the battle, too.

fields.EN:
Each time Jack attacked,
I could feel a surge of emotions
swell from inside me...
fields.JP:
ジャックが敵に攻撃する度に、
僕の中に強い感情が沸き上がってきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each time Jack attacked,
I could feel a surge of emotions
swell from inside me...

fields.EN:
Maybe you're able to feel Jack-san's
emotions inside you.
fields.JP:
もしかして、ジャックさんの感情が
伝わってきたんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe you're able to feel Jack's
emotions inside you.

fields.EN:
I mean, you understand how Jack-san feels,
right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
だって、おつうちゃんはジャックさんの
心が分かるんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, you do understand what
Jack is saying and how he feels,
right?

fields.EN:
That makes me think that you
and Jack are somehow connected.
fields.JP:
それって、二人の心が何かで繋がってる
ってことじゃないかと思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That makes me think that you
and Jack are somehow connected.

fields.JP: 僕とジャックが繋がってる……

fields.EN:
Jack-san looked like he was
suffering terribly. I'm sure
he was desperately resisting.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんもすごく苦しそうだった。
きっと、必死で抵抗していたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack looked like he was suffering.
I'm sure he was trying to fight
his form to retain his kindness.

fields.EN:
Jack-san is so kind that he didn't want his
heart to become a Nightmare too.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんはとっても優しいから、
心までナイトメアになりたくなかったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He must be trying to avoid
becoming a Nightmare at heart.

fields.EN:
(Maybe she's right. I don't know
why, but I do feel strangely
connected to Jack.)
fields.JP:
（姫の言う通りかもしれない。
　理由は判らないけどジャックとの
　繋がりのようなものは確かに感じる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she's right. I don't know
why, but I do feel strangely
connected to Jack.)

fields.EN:
(That indescribable pain must
have come from his soul fighting
to preserve his sanity.)
fields.JP:
（あの言葉にできない苦しみは、
　狂気に染まりそうになった心が軋んで
　悲鳴をあげていたようだった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That indescribable pain must
have come from his soul fighting
to preserve his sanity.)

fields.EN:
I don't think it's a good idea
to have Jack-san fight.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんはもう、
戦いに参加させない方がいいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think it's a good idea
to have Jack fight.

fields.EN:
(A madness that felt both savage
and comforting... Something that
I would strangely have enjoyed...)
fields.JP:
（暴力的で、でも甘くて心地よい、
　思わず身を委ねたくなるような……狂気）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A madness that felt both savage
and comforting... Something that
I would strangely have enjoyed...)

fields.EN:
(I guess that's how it feels
to be... a Nightmare...)
fields.JP:
（あれが……あの感情が、
　きっとナイトメアなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess that's how it feels
to be... a Nightmare...)

fields.EN:
Is this place... a prison...?
I guess we won't find
the exit around here.
fields.JP:
ここは……牢獄かな？
だとしたら出口はこっちじゃないかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this place... a prison...?
I guess we won't find
the exit around here.

fields.JP: そうだな、引き返そうか……

fields.EN:
You're the one we saw
earlier!
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the one we saw
earlier!

fields.EN:
You're... the two who were
in prison, right?
fields.JP: 君たちは……確か上で捕まってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're... the two who were
in prison, right?

fields.JP: こんな場所までどうやって……！？

fields.EN:
Thank goodness!
Looks like we're saved!
fields.JP:
あぁ～助かったでござる～！
拙者助かったでござる～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness!
Looks like we're saved!

fields.EN:
I can't believe there are
more imprisoned here!
fields.JP:
こんなところに
捕まってる人たちがいたなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe there are
more imprisoned here!

fields.EN:
Loos like our luck hasn't run
out yet. Can you let us out...
fields.JP:
まだ俺たちにもツキは残ってるみたいだな。
ちょうどいい、ここから出し……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Loos like our luck hasn't run
out yet. Can you let us out...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
う、うしっ、後ろっ、化け物っ……！！
ナイトメア・ジャック
ひぃぃ何か喋ったぁぁぁっ！！

fields.EN:
Hey! Look behind you!
You got a monster there!
fields.JP:
おい！　気づいてねえのか！？
後ろに化けもんいるってんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Look behind you!
You got a monster there!

fields.EN: Please, make a run for it!
fields.LOCALIZED: Please, make a run for it!

fields.EN:
Ah... It's all right, everyone. Jack-san isn't
scary.
fields.JP:
ああ……大丈夫ですよ、みなさん。
ジャックさんは怖くありませんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, we're fine, everyone.
There's nothing to be afraid of.

fields.EN:
Yes. Jack is a Nightmare,
but... he's kind. He's harmless.
fields.JP:
そう、ジャックはナイトメアだけど……
優しいんだ。害はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Jack may have become a
Nightmare, but he's still as kind
as he was before.

fields.EN:
Wait...
I heard that name before...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...
I heard that name before...

fields.EN:
Don't tell me he's that guy who
was in the cell next to us?
fields.JP: もしかして、俺たちの隣の牢にいた奴か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me he's that guy who
was in the cell next to us?

fields.EN:
There should've been a girl
called Alice with him, but...
Is that really Jack?
fields.JP:
アリスって女が一緒にいたんだが……
……そのジャックか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There should've been a girl
called Alice with him, but...
Is that really Jack?

fields.JP: そういえば知り合いだったみたいだね

fields.EN:
We only spoke behind the walls,
so we never had the chance to
see anyone's face.
fields.JP:
お互い壁越しに話してただけで、
顔も見たことがなかったけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We only spoke behind the walls,
so we never had the chance to
see anyone's face.

fields.EN:
Still, you're hard pressed to find
someone who's willing to talk
in this god-forsaken place.
fields.JP:
だが、こんなクソッタレな場所じゃ、
話ができるってだけで貴重な相手だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, you're hard pressed to find
someone who's willing to talk
in this god-forsaken place.

fields.EN:
We talked about how we would
escape from this place one day...
fields.JP:
いつかここを脱獄してやるって、
ずっと話してたよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We talked about how we would
escape from this place one day...

fields.JP:
ってことは本当に
そのジャックなんだな？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Don't worry. You were friends
with them once before.
fields.JP:
大丈夫、心配しなくていいよ
彼らは以前の君と……友人だったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. You were friends
with them once before.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
That's some makeover he has
there... What the hell happened?
fields.JP:
短い間にずいぶんな変わりようじゃねえか。
いったい何があったんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's some makeover he has
there... What the hell happened?

fields.EN: I guess that's about I can say...
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess that's about I can say...

fields.EN:
I see. So the ones who were
causing all the stir up there
were you folks.
fields.JP:
そうか、あの暴れてた人間たちは
おまえらだったんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So the ones who were
causing all the stir up there
were you folks.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens, eh?
I heard of them through rumors,
but actually see one is...
fields.JP:
血式少女……ね。
噂には聞いてたが、おまえらが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens, eh?
I heard of them through rumors,
but actually see one is...

fields.EN:
Say, are you sure the thing
behind you is Jack?
fields.JP:
ねえ、その子、
本当にあのジャックなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, are you sure the thing
behind you is Jack?

fields.EN:
We don't know why this happened,
but we do know for sure that the
Nightmare here is Jack-san.
fields.JP:
こうなった理由は分からないですけど、
でもこのナイトメアは確かに
ジャックさんなんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know why this happened,
but we do know for sure that the
Nightmare here is Jack.

fields.EN:
Guess I shouldn't be surprised
coming from this warped world...
fields.JP: こんな世界なら……何でもあり、か
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess I shouldn't be surprised
coming from this warped world...

fields.EN:
Jack, you really were as
brave as I thought you'd be.
fields.JP:
ジャック、やっぱりおまえは
俺の見込んだ通り、勇気のある奴だったよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, at least I was right about
you. You're definitely one tough kid.

fields.EN:
It's a shame you ended up looking
like that, but... well, let's get along.
fields.JP:
そんな姿になっちまったのは残念だけどよ、
でもまあ――よろしくな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too bad you turned into that
ugly-looking thing, but...
Here's hoping we get along.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Let me open the cell.
Stand back...
fields.JP:
今から牢を開ける。
少し下がっててくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me open the cell.
Stand back...

fields.EN:
That makes it twice you let us
out. Thank you.
fields.JP:
２回も助けてくれて
本当にありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That makes it twice you let us
out. Thank you.

fields.EN:
Yeah, what a lifesaver.
Thanks a million.
fields.JP:
ああ、助かったぜ。
ありがとな、おまえら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, what a lifesaver.
Thanks a million.

fields.EN:
Why don't you save the thanks
until we get out of here. There's
no telling when we'll be attacked.
fields.JP:
礼を言うのはまだ早いよ。どこから
メルヒェンが襲ってくるか分からない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you save the thanks
until we get out of here. There's
no telling when we'll be attacked.

fields.EN:
Damn it! There goes being happy
about getting out of the cell!
fields.JP: くそっ、牢から出てすぐこれかよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it! There goes being happy
about getting out of the cell!

fields.EN:
Everyone, please stay behind me
and Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
みなさん、わたしとおつうちゃんの
後ろに隠れてて下さい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, please stay behind me
and Otsuu!

fields.EN:
Wait just a second, my princess...
Something's not right...
fields.JP:
……いや、ちょっと待ってくれ姫。
なにか様子がおかしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait just a second, my princess...
Something's not right...

fields.EN:
What's with that Marchen?
What's it doing?
fields.JP: なんだ……このメルヒェンの動きは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with that Marchen?
What's it doing?

fields.JP: どこかに案内しようとしてる……？

fields.EN:
(Could it be a trap?
It's risky to assume it's safe
following it...)
fields.JP:
（罠か……？
　ついていくのは危険だろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Could it be a trap?
It's risky to assume it's safe
following it...)

fields.EN:
(But with everyone tired, and with
more in the party, I'd rather like
to avoid unnecessary battles...)
fields.JP:
（けど僕も姫も疲労が溜まっている上に、
　さらには民間人を抱えている。
　できるなら不要な戦闘は避けたい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But with everyone tired, and with
more in the party, I'd rather like
to avoid unnecessary battles...)

fields.EN: I dunno. It doesn't look very smart.
fields.JP: あまり知性があるようには見えねえよな
fields.LOCALIZED: I dunno. It doesn't look very smart.

fields.EN:
Say, Marchen?
Are you trying to lead us
because of Jack here?
fields.JP:
なあメルヒェン、
もしかしてジャックがいるからなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Marchen?
Are you trying to lead us
because of Jack here?

fields.EN:
I suppose we don't have much
of a choice. Let's see where it
wants to take us.
fields.JP:
仕方ない。
……ついて行ってみるか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we don't have much
of a choice. Let's see where it
wants to take us.

fields.EN:
It's not like there are many of
them around, so can't we make
a run for it?
fields.JP:
なぁ、メルヒェンは多くないし、
今なら逃げられるんじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like there are many of
them around, so can't we make
a run for it?

fields.EN:
I wouldn't count on it.
Look behind you...
fields.JP:
いや、止めておいた方がいいね。
後ろ見てみなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't count on it.
Look behind you...

fields.EN:
Huh, so there are a lot more
of them looking from afar...
fields.JP:
なるほど、遠巻きに
たくさん見てやがるのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, so there are a lot more
of them looking from afar...

fields.EN:
We'll find the right timing to
run, but now is not the time.
fields.JP:
いつかは逃げるけど、もう少し待とう。
チャンスはいつか来る
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll find the right timing to
run, but now is not the time.

fields.EN:
Well, why don't we use our time
now to introduce ourselves then?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、今のうちに
自己紹介でもしませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, why don't we use our time
now to introduce ourselves then?

fields.EN:
This isn't exactly the best time
to make introductions, you know?
fields.JP: 自己紹介って……緊張感ねえなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This isn't exactly the best time
to make introductions, you know?

fields.EN:
No, I think it's a splendid idea.
Not knowing who you are makes it
difficult to work together.
fields.JP:
いや、いざという時に名前も分からないと、
連携の取りようもない。いい案だと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I think it's a splendid idea.
Not knowing who you are makes it
difficult to work together.

fields.JP: 必要性はまあ、分かるんだけどよ……

fields.EN:
...So let me see. The lady there
is Kaede, and the guy with the
ponytail is Itsuki.
fields.JP:
――では、そちらの女性がカエデ、
ポニーテールの人がイツキ、だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So let me see. The lady there
is Kaede, and the guy with the
ponytail is Itsuki.

fields.EN:
Yeah, thanks for saving us
back there.
fields.JP: 本当に助かったよ、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, thanks for saving us
back there.

fields.EN:
The person with the hairband is
Takumi-san, and you two are Mamoru-san
and Hikari-chan, right?
fields.JP:
そしてヘアバンドの人がタクミさん、
で、マモルさんにヒカリちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The person with the hairband is
Takumi, and you two are Mamoru
and Hikari, right?

fields.EN: Don't ya forget about me, okay?
fields.JP: あたいのこと、覚えといてよね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't ya forget about me, okay?

fields.EN:
So you're Otsuu-kun,
Ningyohime, and Jack... right?
fields.JP:
そっちが、おつうくんに人魚姫、
そしてジャック……だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me see...
You're Little Mermaid, she's
Otsuu, and that's... Jack, right?

fields.EN:
Why yes, pleased to meet
everyone...
fields.JP:
はいっ、よろしくお願いします
みなさん――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, pleased to meet
everyone...

fields.EN:
The Marchens are...
filing in order?
fields.JP: メルヒェンが整列を始めた……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchens are...
filing in order?

fields.JP: ふふ……来たか、人間どもよ

fields.EN:
Welcome to my labyrinth.
I have been waiting for you.
fields.JP:
ようこそ、ワレの迷宮へ。
ワレは貴様たちを待っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Welcome to my labyrinth.
I have been waiting for you.

fields.EN:
A Marchen...? Wait... it
can speak the human language...?
fields.JP:
メルヒェン……？
……待て、人間の言葉を喋っている……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Marchen? No... It's...
She's speaking our language.

fields.EN:
But, she's controlling all these
Marchens...
fields.JP: でもメルヒェンを従えているよ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she's controlling all these
Marchens...

fields.JP: 君はいったい何者なんだ？

fields.EN: Hm, you ask who I am?
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm, you ask who I am?

fields.EN:
So, you are asking...
for my name, are you?
fields.JP:
それは……
ワレの『名前』を聞いておるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you are asking...
for my name, are you?

fields.EN:
(I can't let her think she has the
upper hand. I need to be strong!)
fields.JP:
（弱いと思われたら終わりだ、
　ここは強気に攻めるべき……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't let her think she has the
upper hand. I need to be strong!)

fields.EN:
That's right!
State your name, now!
fields.JP: そうだ！　名前と素性を明かしてもらおう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right!
State your name, now!

fields.EN:
Hm... I suppose this is what
my "name" is supposed to be,
but I am not sure myself.
fields.JP:
ふむ……実を言うと、
これが本当にワレの名前なのか、
自信はないのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I suppose this is what
my "name" is supposed to be,
but I am not sure myself.

fields.EN:
Yes, I am the lord of this
labyrinth. I am Hameln,
the great Demon Kyng!
fields.JP:
そうだ、ワレはこの迷宮を支配する者……
魔王ハーメルンと呼びゅぎゃよい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I am the lord of this
labyrinth. I am Hameln,
the great Demon Kyng!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
I didn't hear you well.
Could you repeat that?
fields.JP:
……ごめん、もう１回
言ってもらってもいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
I didn't hear you well.
Could you repeat that?

fields.EN:
I am Hameln,
the great Demon Lyyrd!
fields.JP: そうだ、ワレはこの迷宮を支配しゅるもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am Hameln,
the great demyon lyyrd!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
To add, she slurred more
than her first try...
fields.JP: しかも今度は前半で噛んじゃったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, she slurred more
than her first try...

fields.EN:
Um, can I ask you something,
Hameln?
fields.JP: ちょっといいか、ハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, can I ask you something,
Hameln?

fields.EN:
You can't say a single word
well, can you?
fields.JP: 一言でも噛めるんだねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't say a single word
well, can you?

fields.EN:
What are you doing here?
I'm assuming you're the one who
sent the Marchen to lead us here.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンはここで何をしてるんだ？
それに僕たちを連れてこさせたのは
君だよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing here?
I'm assuming you're the one who
sent the Marchen to lead us here.

fields.EN:
Indeed. I ordered them to
gather you humans here.
fields.JP:
いかにも。こやつらに命じて、
人間どもを集めさせたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I ordered them to
gather you humans here.

fields.JP: 何が目的で人間を集めてるんだ？

fields.EN:
(I suppose its to torture us
like all the others...)
fields.JP:
（やはり拷問とか、
　そういう目的なんだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose its to torture us
like all the others...)

fields.EN:
As you can see, there are no
other humans here. I was playing
with them for my entire life.
fields.JP:
見ての通り、ここには人間がおらぬ。
ワレはここで生まれてからずっと
こやつらと遊んでおったのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you can see, there are no
other humans here. I was playing
with them for my entire life.

fields.EN:
But, none of them can speak.
I was getting quite bored when
I found this...
fields.JP:
なんせこやつらは言葉が通じぬ。
いい加減に退屈になってきたところで、
ワレはこんなモノを見つけた
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, none of them can speak.
I was getting quite bored when
I found this...

fields.EN:
I read this to learn that these
"humans" can speak. Hence,
I had them lead you all here.
fields.JP:
これを読んで、人間という
言葉が通じるヤツらがいることを知った。
それでこやつらに連れてこさせたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I read this to learn that these
"humans" can speak. Hence,
I had them lead you all here.

fields.EN:
In other words, you will become
my servants and play tag with me!
fields.JP:
つまり貴様らは、ワレの下僕として
一緒に『鬼ごっこ』で遊ぶ必要があるにょだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You will all become my slaves,
and will play tag with me...
forevyr!

fields.EN: Way to slip your line there.
fields.JP: 肝心なところで噛むね
fields.LOCALIZED: Way to slip your line there.

fields.EN:
So you call it tag, but how are
you planning to play it with this group?
fields.JP:
で、鬼ごっこって言うけど、このメンツで
どういう感じで遊ぶつもりなんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, when you say "tag"
what are you really trying
to say?

fields.EN:
What? You don't know the rules
to the game? Let me show you...
You there! Run!
fields.JP:
なんだルールを知らんのか？
なら教えてやる！　おいお前、逃げろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? You don't know the rules
to the game? Let me show you...
You there! Run!

fields.EN:
(She really does have control
over these Marchens...)
fields.JP: （メルヒェンに本当に命令できるんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She really does have control
over these Marchens...)

fields.EN:
Listen well!
You will run like shown!
I will then chase after you!
fields.JP:
いいか？　貴様らはこうやって逃げる！
ワレはそれを追いかける！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen well!
You will run like shown!
I will then chase after you!

fields.EN:
Once I catch you,
I will crush you like so...!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I catch you,
I will crush you like so...!

fields.EN:
So that's the game: this
is what happens if I catch you!
fields.JP: とまあ、ワレに捕まったらこうなる遊びだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Simple, yes?
You run and I chase.

fields.JP: おいおい、勘違いしすぎだろ……

fields.EN:
What?! I learned it from this
manga! It must be correct!
fields.JP:
何を言う、漫画に描いてあったのだ！
これが正しい遊び方に決まっておる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! I learned it from this
manga! It must be correct!

fields.EN:
Her eyes... changed color!
Is she a Marchen?
fields.JP:
目の色まで変わってるし……！　本当に
この子、メルヒェンとかじゃないの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her eyes... changed color!
Is she a Marchen?

fields.EN:
No... Her eyes turned pink after
being exposed to Marchen blood.
She's...
fields.JP:
いえ、メルヒェンの返り血で
ピンク色に変化したあの瞳は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... Her eyes turned pink after
being exposed to Marchen blood.
She's...

fields.EN:
Yes, Hameln is...
a Blood Maiden!
fields.JP:
ああ、間違いない。
ハーメルンは血式少女だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, Hameln is...
a Blood Maiden!

fields.JP:
血式少女？
本当かよ、それ！

fields.EN:
What are you all pratting about?
Now, let's play by letting me
crush you all!
fields.JP:
何をごちゃごちゃ話しておる？
さあ、楽しく叩き潰させてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you all pratting about?
Now, let's play by letting me
crush you all!

fields.JP: これ、やばいパターンよね……？

fields.EN:
We should teach her what the
proper rules are.
fields.JP: ちゃんとルールを教えた方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should teach her what the
proper rules are.

fields.JP:
そ、そうですね。
早く訂正しないと……！

fields.EN:
Run as far as you can!
It's not fun if I catch you
too quickly!
fields.JP:
ちゃんと遠くまで逃げるのだぞ！
すぐ終わってはつまらぬからな！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Run as far as you can!
It's not fun if I catch you
too quickly!

fields.EN:
Then I'll count ten
seconds and chase you! Oooone...
fields.JP:
では１０秒数えたら追いかけるぞ！
いーち…………
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to count to ten.
Ready? One...

fields.EN:
My princess, I doubt we have time.
She started to count.
fields.JP:
姫、あいつカウント始めてしまった！
もう訂正してる時間はない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My princess, I doubt we have time.
She started to count.

fields.EN:
I suppose we should run while
we still can. Let's hurry!
fields.JP:
みんな、こうなったら
逃げるしかない！　行くぞっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we should run while
we still can. Let's hurry!

fields.JP: 姫！　みんなの先導を頼む！
僕は最後尾からついてくから！
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Thank you, Jack. You escape with everyone too.
I'm counting on you... to take care of them.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、ジャック。
君も一緒に逃げてくれ。
みんなを……頼む
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Jack.
But, you run ahead with them.
Please stay with them.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
どこか隠れるとこないの！？

fields.EN:
No such place here!
Just keep running!
fields.JP:
そんなものない！
いいから走れ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No such place here!
Just keep running!

fields.JP: くっ……走るのは苦手だってのに……

fields.EN:
You really need to build up some
stamina. Even a girl like this is beating you.
fields.JP:
あんたねぇ、ちったぁ体力つけなよ。
こんな女の子にまで負けてんじゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
You folks really have to get some
exercise. All the girls here are
way healthier than you.

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff...
I'd rather... focus on...
my aptitudes... thank you...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff...
I'd rather... focus on...
my aptitudes... thank you...

fields.EN:
Do your best! I'm sure we'll be
safe once we get out of here!
fields.JP:
頑張って！　逃げ切ったら
きっと帰れるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do your best! I'm sure we'll be
safe once we get out of here!

fields.JP: とは言っても……もう、足が……
イツキ！　転んでんじゃねえ、起きろっ！！

fields.EN:
N-Never mind me!
Just keep running!
fields.JP:
ぼ、僕のことはいいっ！
気にせず逃げるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Never mind me!
Just keep running!

fields.EN:
Oh? So, you're first, eh?
Guess you're my first prey!
fields.JP:
おや、最初は貴様か！
では捕まえるぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? So, you're first, eh?
Guess you're my first prey!

fields.EN:
Stop!
I won't let you kill him!
fields.JP:
止まって下さい！
この人は殺させはしませんっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop!
I won't let you kill him!

fields.EN:
Princess! Bravado and
foolhardiness are two
separate things!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess! Bravado and
foolhardiness are two
separate things!

fields.EN:
It doesn't matter who I get!
Here I go!
fields.JP: 誰でもよい！　では行くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't matter who I get!
Here I go!

fields.EN:
Damn it! I'll face you, Hameln!
Here I gooooo!
fields.JP:
くそっ、僕が相手だハーメルン！
うおおおおっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it! I'll face you, Hameln!
Here I gooooo!

fields.JP:
ふはははは！
なかなかやるではないか！

fields.EN:
But it seems I am the true victor!
Take th--... Eep!
fields.JP: だがこれでワレの勝ちだ――ぶぎゅっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it seems I am the true victor!
Take th--... Eep!

fields.JP: はっ、自分のマント踏んでコケやがったっ！

fields.EN:
Oww...
I can't believe I just did that...
fields.JP:
いたたた……ワレとしたことが
ドジを踏んでしまうとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oww...
I can't believe I just did that...

fields.JP: みんな、今のうちに逃げるぞ！

fields.EN:
My princess, please don't
do that again.
That was too close for comfort.
fields.JP:
姫、もうあんなことはしないでくれ。
さっきは肝を冷やした
fields.LOCALIZED:
My princess, please don't
do that again.
That was too close for comfort.

fields.EN:
There were other methods
available to save Itsuki back
there.
fields.JP:
あんな風にかばおうとしなくても、
イツキを助ける方法はあるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
There were other methods
available to save Itsuki back
there.

fields.EN:
So please, I don't want you to
ever sacrifice yourself like that
again.
fields.JP:
だからもう、自分を犠牲になんて
しないでほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, I don't want you to
ever sacrifice yourself like that
again.

fields.JP:
そうだよね……
ごめんなさい、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I will protect you
and those you want to protect.
fields.JP:
姫も、姫が守りたい者も
僕がしっかりと守ってみせましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I will protect you
and those you want to protect.

fields.JP: ……だから、もう無茶はしないでくれ

fields.EN:
So, how much farther do we have
to run? I'm running outta gas...
fields.JP:
ちょっと、どこまで走ればいいの～
もう限界……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how much farther do we have
to run? I'm running outta gas...

fields.EN:
Y-Yes, I don't think I can
hold up much longer...
fields.JP:
さ、さすがにっ、
私もそろそろキツいかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes, I don't think I can
hold up much longer...

fields.EN:
Until we run from her!
C'mon, let's keep going!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンから逃げ切るまで！
ほら頑張って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until we run from her!
C'mon, let's keep going!

fields.EN:
That would be encouraging if we
only knew where our goal was...
fields.JP:
そうは言ってもな、
終わりが見えないんじゃあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would be encouraging if we
only knew where our goal was...

fields.EN:
Hahahaha! Good! Gooood!
Run like there's no tomorrow!
fields.JP:
ふっははははっ！　いいぞいいぞ！
もっと逃げてみせるのだー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha! Good! Gooood!
Run like there's no tomorrow!

fields.EN: She's already caught up to us!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンのやつ、
もう追いついて来やがった！
fields.LOCALIZED: She's already caught up to us!

fields.EN:
Hey, Otsuu!
How about we split and go our
separate ways?
fields.JP:
おいおつう！
バラバラに逃げるってのはどうだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Otsuu!
How about we split and go our
separate ways?

fields.EN:
Not bad of an idea!
It's better than everyone
getting caught at once!
fields.JP:
それ、いいかも。
このまま全員やられるよりは、
生存率は上がるだろうし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not bad of an idea!
It's better than everyone
getting caught at once!

fields.EN:
But that would also greatly increase the
chance that someone ends up being sacrificed.
fields.JP:
それだと誰かが犠牲になる
確率も跳ね上がる
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, that also means that
someone will die for sure!

fields.EN:
She's right!
We can't let a single person die!
fields.JP:
そうです！
絶対に誰も犠牲にしてはいけません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right!
We can't let a single person die!

fields.EN:
Well yeah, but there's no
other way now!
fields.JP:
んなこと言ったって、
他にいい案ないんだろうが……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well yeah, but there's no
other way now!

fields.EN:
Even so, we will somehow
protect and save everyone!
fields.JP:
そうですが、
それでもみなさんは絶対に守ります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, we will somehow
protect and save everyone!

fields.EN:
I understand my princess's
feelings all too well, and I'd
like to comply, so...
fields.JP:
まあ、姫の気持ちは痛いほど分かるし、
僕もできればそうしたいし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand my princess's
feelings all too well, and I'd
like to comply, so...

fields.EN:
Me and my princess will
buy us all some time.
fields.JP:
そうだね、少なくとも僕と姫が
時間は稼ぐからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me and my princess will
buy us all some time.

fields.EN: That's why we all have to run together.
fields.JP: だからみんな一緒に逃げるんだ

fields.EN:
(I'll protect my princess.
Simple as that.)
fields.JP:
（僕が姫を守る。
　それですべては丸く収まる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'll protect my princess.
Simple as that.)

fields.EN:
Oh? So now you two are going
to face me?
fields.JP: おや、今度は貴様ら２人が相手か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? So now you two are going
to face me?

fields.EN:
Stop it already, Hameln!
This isn't tag!
fields.JP:
おいハーメルンいい加減にしろ！
こんなのは鬼ごっこじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it already, Hameln!
This isn't tag!

fields.EN:
We'll teach you the proper rules
of tag, so please stop!
fields.JP:
鬼ごっこのちゃんとしたルール、
教えてあげますから、だから止まって下さい
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll teach you the proper rules
of tag, so please stop!

fields.EN:
That's right!
Stop with all this already!
fields.JP:
そうだ！　もうこんな
意味のないことをするな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right!
Stop with all this already!

fields.EN:
I told you I wanted to play.
This is to pass my time, so
there's no stopping now!
fields.JP:
言ったろう、これは遊びだ。
ワレの退屈しのぎだ。意味は充分にあるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you I wanted to play.
This is to pass my time, so
there's no stopping now!

fields.EN:
I'll listen to what you have to
say after I'm done!
fields.JP:
貴様らの知ってるルールとやらは、
これが終わったらちゃんと聞いてやる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll listen to what you have to
say after I'm done!

fields.EN:
So just stay still, and take
what's coming!
fields.JP:
だから今はおとなしく
ワレに捕まるがいいっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So just stay still, and take
what's coming!

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff...
N-Not bad at all...
fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
や、やるではないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff...
N-Not bad at all...

fields.EN:
This tag game is very fun!
Let's continue!
fields.JP:
だが鬼ごっこというものは楽しいものだな！
もっと一緒に遊ぼうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This tag game is very fun!
Let's continue!

fields.EN:
I can't believe she still has the
strength in her to continue...
fields.JP: 無尽蔵か、ハーメルンの体力は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe she still has the
strength in her to continue...

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. We were
moving all about, fighting for our
lives until now...
fields.JP:
しょうがないよ、こっちは今日１日、
ずっと命懸けの戦いだったんだもん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped. We were
moving all about, fighting for our
lives until now...

fields.EN:
Come now! Don't tell me you're
done already!
fields.JP:
ほらどうした！　まさかもう終わりなんて
言うのではあるまいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now! Don't tell me you're
done already!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ジャック……
まさか、戦うつもりなのか？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(If Jack and I hold it back together, we might
at least be able to let everyone escape.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックと二人で食い止めたら、
　みんなを逃がすくらいはできる
　かもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I may be able to save everyone
else with Jack's help.)

fields.EN:
(But what will happen
to Jack and me after that...)
fields.JP:
（だけど、その後で僕やジャックが
　どうなってしまうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, lord I know what to do
about me and Jack...)

fields.EN:
You do know that we change
roles the moment you tag
someone, right?!
fields.JP:
鬼ごっこは誰かを捕まえたら
その時点で鬼は交代だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do know that we change
roles the moment you tag
someone, right?!

fields.EN:
Come to think of it...
I do recall reading about that.
fields.JP:
そういえば……
そんなルールだったかもしれぬ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it...
I do recall reading about that.

fields.EN:
Well then, come and get me!
When you do, it's our turn
to chase after you!
fields.JP:
だから俺を捕まえろ！
それでおまえの鬼は終わりだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, come and get me!
When you do, it's our turn
to chase after you!

fields.EN:
Are you mad, Mamoru?!
If you do that, you'll...!
fields.JP:
おいマモルどういうつもりだ！
そんなことしたら君が！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you mad, Mamoru?!
She's going to...!

fields.EN:
Shut up!
You're not in the best of state
too, you know!
fields.JP:
うるせえ！
おまえだってもうボロボロだろうが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up!
You're not in the best of state
too, you know!

fields.JP:
駄目だよマモル！
絶対に駄目なんだからっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't, Mamoru!
You're not going to make it!

fields.EN:
If you're going to bait her,
I will too!
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're going to bait her,
I will too!

fields.EN:
No, I'll do it!
Let an adult show you
how it's done!
fields.JP:
いや、ならあたし！
ここは大人に任せるもんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'll do it!
Let an adult show you
how it's done!

fields.EN:
It would demean my manhood
letting a lady sacrifice herself
in place of me. I will do it.
fields.JP:
女性を犠牲にしてまで
生き延びるのはあまりにも格好悪いな。
……僕が捕まろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It would demean my manhood
letting a lady sacrifice herself
in place of me. I will do it.

fields.EN:
Uh, so I guess I have to... um,
kinda follow along too, eh?
fields.JP:
や、やっぱこの流れ……
……乗らないと、ダメ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, so I guess I have to... um,
kinda follow along too, eh?

fields.EN: I-I-I'm prepared to sacrifice myself too!
fields.JP:
じじ、自分だってっ、
ぎ、ぎぎ犠牲になる覚悟は
あるんだからっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I-I can put myself up
t-t-to danger, too!

fields.EN:
Don't try to put up a front
if you're scared!
fields.JP: 怖いんなら無理しないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't try to put up a front
if you're scared!

fields.EN: O-Of course I'm scared! But... but still...
fields.JP:
そ、そりゃあ怖いさ！
でもっ、でもさあ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-And you ain't?!
L-Like I have a choice!

fields.EN:
All of you, shut up!
I'm the one who said it first,
so leave her to me!
fields.JP:
うるせえおまえら！　俺が言い出したんだ、
いいから俺に任せろっての！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All of you, shut up!
I'm the one who said it first,
so leave her to me!

fields.EN:
That's why I absolutely won't
let you sacrifice yourself, Mamoru!
fields.JP:
だからマモルが犠牲になるのは
絶対に駄目なの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said, if you're going to
face her, I will too!

fields.EN:
Why you...!
I said it first, so I'll do this!
fields.JP:
あめぇ！　こういうのは
早い者勝ちなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why you...!
I said it first, so I'll do this!

fields.JP: やばい！　みんな逃げるんだ！

fields.EN:
What the...?!
How'd you close in so fast?!
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?!
How'd you close in so fast?!

fields.EN:
I need to ask you something.
Why isn't everyone running?
fields.JP:
少し疑問なのだが……
どうして貴様らは皆、逃げない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to ask you something.
Why isn't everyone running?

fields.EN:
My minions will run the moment
danger strikes without regard for
each other.
fields.JP:
ワレの下僕どもは、いつだって
危険になれば互いを見捨てていくぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
My minions will run the moment
danger strikes without regard for
each other.

fields.EN:
There's no way we'd leave one
of us behind. We're all in this
together - friends, you know?
fields.JP:
置いて逃げるなんてするわけねえだろ。
だって俺たちは仲間なんだからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we'd leave one
of us behind. We're all in this
together - friends, you know?

fields.EN:
Yeah, friends.
We're not like your
Marchen buddies.
fields.JP:
そうだ仲間だ。
メルヒェンどもと一緒にすんじゃねえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, friends.
We're not like your
Marchen buddies.

fields.EN:
Friends... I'm quite surprised
what was drawn in the manga
actually exists...
fields.JP:
仲間……まさか漫画に描いてあったものが
実在するとは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends... I'm quite surprised
what was drawn in the manga
actually exists...

fields.EN:
Friends, are you?! Delightful!
I would love to have friends
like you, too!
fields.JP:
貴様らは仲間なのか！
いいのぅ！　ワレもそんな仲間がほしいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends, are you?! Delightful!
I would love to have friends
like you, too!

fields.EN:
Uh... Come to think of it, I think
I saw someone down that way
who wanted to be your friend.
fields.JP:
あー……さっきあっちで見たわ、
おまえの仲間になりたいってやつ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Come to think of it, I think
I saw someone down that way
who wanted to be your friend.

fields.JP: マモル、嘘はよくないよ
ばかっ、ヒカリ言うなっての！

なんだと！
今のは嘘だったと言うにょか！？

fields.EN: Oh... What is with this girl? She's cute...
fields.JP: やだ……なにこの子、かわいい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh man... Cute...
I think I'm falling for her...

fields.EN:
Hm... Where can I go to get
these "friends" anyway?
fields.JP:
むぅ……ではどこに行けば
ワレも仲間に出会えるのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Where can I go to get
these "friends" anyway?

fields.EN:
Ah! That's right!
I can become friends with you!
fields.JP:
はっ……！　そうだ！
貴様らの仲間になればいいのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! That's right!
I can become friends with you!

fields.EN: It doesn't seem like she's lying.
fields.JP: 嘘は……言ってないだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED: It doesn't seem like she's lying.

fields.JP: とはいえ、この変わりようは……

fields.EN:
I always wanted this "friend"
thing ever since I read it in
the manga.
fields.JP:
漫画で『仲間』というものを見てからな、
ワレはずっといいなと思っておったのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I always wanted this "friend"
thing ever since I read it in
the manga.

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose we are friends
now! Great to meet you!
fields.JP:
だから今からワレは貴様らの仲間だ！
よろしくな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose we are friends
now! Great to meet you!

fields.EN:
Oh, but I suppose my status
would change being your friend...
fields.JP:
ああ、仲間になるにあたって、
ワレは肩書きを変えねばならんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I suppose my status
would change being your friend...

fields.EN:
I was the great Demon King, but
now I shall be a hero to protect
and guide you all!
fields.JP:
さっきは迷宮の支配者『魔王』と言ったが、
今からワレは皆を守り導く『勇者』だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was the great Demon King, but
now I shall be a hero to protect
and guide you all!

fields.EN:
What kind of manga did
this girl grow up reading...?
fields.JP:
いったいどんな漫画を読んで
育ったの、この子……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now I'm interested in
reading the manga she read...

fields.EN:
Uh, well... I suppose all's
well that ends well...
fields.JP:
ま、まあ鬼ごっこが終わるなら、
とりあえずは……いいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... I suppose all's
well that ends well...

fields.EN:
Having someone as strong as
her join us is quite assuring.
fields.JP:
一緒に行動するとなれば、
これほど頼もしい人はいないですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Having someone as strong as
her join us is quite assuring.

fields.EN:
Well then, Hameln...
We welcome you as our friend.
fields.JP:
じゃあハーメルン、
これから僕たちは『仲間』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, Hameln...
We welcome you as our friend.

fields.EN:
Now, as our friend, you need
to remember to not use
force against us, okay?
fields.JP:
いいかい、じゃあこれからは
仲間を殴ったりしちゃ駄目だからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, as our friend, you need
to remember to not use
force against us, okay?

fields.EN:
Friends are supposed to help each
other, and you must never hurt them, okay?
fields.JP:
仲間は助け合うものであって、
決して傷つけてはいけませんよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends are supposed to help
each other at all times.

fields.EN:
Hm! Understood!
I am a hero now, so I will
protect and guide you all!
fields.JP:
うむ！　分かっておる！
なんたってワレは『勇者』！
皆を守り導く者だからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm! Understood!
I am a hero now, so I will
protect and guide you all!

fields.EN:
What a weird turn of events...
Oh well...
fields.JP:
成り行きで変なことになったけど……
……まあいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a weird turn of events...
Oh well...

fields.EN:
This place is quite dark...
Were you seriously living here?
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと暗い道だな……
本当にこんな場所に住んでるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is quite dark...
Were you seriously living here?

fields.JP: うむ！　心配せずについて来るがいい！

fields.EN:
I've got no complaints as long
as we can find a place to rest.
fields.JP:
安全に休めるんなら
どこだっていいさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've got no complaints as long
as we can find a place to rest.

fields.EN:
I wonder what Hameln-chan's home is
like...
fields.JP:
ハーメルンちゃんの家って
どんな感じなんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what Hammy's home is
like...

fields.JP: ワレの名はハーメルンチャンではない！

fields.EN:
Adding -chan is a sign of closeness.
In other words, it's proof we're friends.
fields.JP:
『ちゃん』づけは親しみの証だ。
つまり仲間の証ってことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's using a nickname.
It's used to imply that you're
a friend.

fields.EN:
I see!
Well then, you are all free
to call me "Hameln-chan" as you wish!
fields.JP:
なんと！　そうであったか！　ならば許す！
『ハーメルンちゃん』と呼ぶがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see!
Well then, you are all free
to call me "Hammy" as you wish!

fields.EN: Yeah, but I won't call you that.
fields.JP:
まあ俺はちゃんづけで
呼ばねえけどな
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, but I won't call you that.

fields.EN:
This party's a bit rowdier now...
Hey, I can see light up ahead.
fields.JP:
一気に騒がしくなったなぁ……
……っと、先が明るくなってきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
This party's a bit rowdier now...
Hey, I can see light up ahead.

fields.EN:
We're here!
This is my home!
fields.JP:
着いたな！
ここがワレの家だぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're here!
This is my home!

fields.EN:
It's spacious, and the sights
are just something...
fields.JP:
吹き抜けになってて
すごく、いい景色……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's spacious, and the sights
are just something...

fields.EN:
Man, this place is open. I can
see the Jail Tower from here.
fields.JP:
遠くに監獄塔まで見えるのか。
すげえ広々と感じるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Man, this place is open. I can
see the Jail Tower from here.

fields.EN:
Ah, so we're at a subway
platform.
fields.JP: なるほど、地下鉄のホームか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, so we're at a subway
platform.

fields.EN:
I must say, this place is quite
relaxing considering we're
deep down under.
fields.JP:
これは確かに、
地の底の中では快適だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, this place is quite
relaxing considering we're
deep down under.

fields.EN:
It's an old kind of vehicle powered by
electricity, Hikari-chan.
fields.JP:
昔の電気で動く乗り物だよん、
ヒカリちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
There used to be things called
"trains" that used to move
with electricity.

fields.EN:
I see. An ancient ruin.
I'm surprised you found such
a place, Hameln.
fields.JP:
なるほど、昔の施設跡か。
よく見つけたな、ハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. An ancient ruin.
I'm surprised you found such
a place, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Heh heh!
This is my go-to place!
fields.JP: ふふふ、ワレのとっておきの場所だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh!
This is my go-to place!

fields.EN:
Looks like we can rest safely
here. Thank you, Hameln.
fields.JP:
ここなら安心して休めそうだ。
ありがとうハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we can rest safely
here. Thank you, Hameln.

fields.EN:
We are friends, after all!
I will protect and guide you!
fields.JP:
なんたって仲間だからな！
守り導くのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We are friends, after all!
I will protect and guide you!

fields.JP: やべーチョロイぞこいつ

fields.EN:
Hey! Don't say that!
She's letting us rest here,
you know?
fields.JP:
こーら！　休ませてくれてるんだから
そういうこと言わないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Don't say that!
She's letting us rest here,
you know?

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, Mamoru-san, are you and
the others residents
of the Liberated District?
fields.JP:
そういえば、マモルさんたちも
解放地区の住人なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, aren't
you folks residents of the
Liberated District?

fields.EN:
Hm? Oh, me and Hikari lived
in a small village near the
Liberated District.
fields.JP:
ん？　ああ俺とヒカリは
解放地区の近くにあった集落出身だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Oh, me and Hikari lived
in a small village near the
Liberated District.

fields.EN:
Me and four-eyes here lived
in the Liberated District.
fields.JP: あたしとこの眼鏡は解放地区にいたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me and four-eyes here lived
in the Liberated District.

fields.EN:
I'd prefer you to call me by
name...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd prefer you to call me by
name...

fields.EN:
I was in the Liberated District
too. I worked on Dawn's manufacturing team~
fields.JP:
オレっちも解放地区で、
黎明の製造班にいたんだぜ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I was there too!
In fact, I was working as a
member of Dawn's dev team!

fields.EN:
You can count on me to work
on your weapons and things.
fields.JP:
武器とか必要なら寄ってくれよな～
用立てするぜ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can count on me to work
on your weapons and things.

fields.EN:
Oh, you were with Dawn?!
Maybe we've met before.
fields.JP:
まあ！　黎明にいらしたんですか！
もしかしたらどこかで
お会いしていたかもしれませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you were with Dawn?!
Maybe we've met before.

fields.EN:
If we're talking about Dawn,
then four-eyes was a former
member of the research team.
fields.JP:
それを言うなら、この眼鏡は
黎明の元・研究班だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we're talking about Dawn,
then four-eyes was a former
member of the research team.

fields.EN: Former? What are you doing now?
fields.JP: 元？　じゃあ今は違うんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Former? What are you doing now?

fields.JP:
イツキさんとも
お会いしていたかもしれませんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe we've met before too then.

fields.EN:
So, Otsuu-chan and Ningyo-chan,
you were in the Liberated District?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、おつうちゃんと人魚ちゃんは、
解放地区にいたんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you and Otsuu are from the
Liberated District then?

fields.EN: And that's how we met everyone.
fields.JP: ――それでみんなに出会ったんだ

fields.EN:
That was rough... Otsuu-chan, Ningyo-chan,
you both went through a lot...
fields.JP:
大変だったね、
おつうちゃんも人魚ちゃんも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite something...
You both went through a lot.

fields.EN:
I'm glad we were at
least able to save all of you.
fields.JP:
みなさんだけでも
助けることができてよかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're just glad we were able
to help you folks.

fields.EN:
Mind you, we're still underground,
but thanks. You're a lifesaver.
fields.JP:
まだ地の底だけどな。
でも助かったぜ、本当
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind you, we're still underground,
but thanks. You're a lifesaver.

fields.EN:
I'm sure there are more to talk
about, but may I suggest we
take a rest already?
fields.JP:
話題に事欠かないけど、
みんな、ひとまず休まないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure there are more to talk
about, but may I suggest we
take a rest already?

fields.EN:
True. I think I'm about to drop.
We can head back to the
Liberated District after we rest.
fields.JP:
そうだね。僕もそろそろ限界だよ。
少し休んで、そしたら解放地区へ戻ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. I think I'm about to drop.
We can head back to the
Liberated District after we rest.

fields.JP: 『解放地区』とはどんなところなのだ？

fields.EN:
It's where our friends live,
Haa-chan.
fields.JP:
わたしたちの仲間が
たくさんいる場所だよ、ハーちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's where our friends live,
Hammy.

fields.JP: なんと！　まだ仲間がいるのか！？

fields.EN:
Astounding!
I want to go there, too!
fields.JP:
それはすごい！
ワレはぜひとも解放地区に行きたいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Astounding!
I want to go there, too!

fields.JP: え、ハーメルンついて来んの？

fields.EN:
Of course!
I am your friend after all!
fields.JP:
もちろんだ！
なんせワレは貴様らの仲間だからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course!
I am your friend after all!

fields.EN:
I don't see why not. So long as
she understands what being a
friend is about. Yawn...
fields.JP:
いいんじゃないか……？
仲間の概念が分かってくれさえすれば、
心強いことは間違いないし……ふぁあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see why not. So long as
she understands what being a
friend is about. Yawn...

fields.EN:
If you say so...
Guess we got a troublemaker
in the group now.
fields.JP:
おつうがそう言うなら仕方ねぇ。
……ったく、うるせぇのが増えちまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you say so...
Guess we got a troublemaker
in the group now.

fields.EN:
It'll be a lot more lively now,
that's for sure.
fields.JP: 賑やかになりそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be a lot more lively now,
that's for sure.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
What...?
Is something wrong with him?
fields.JP:
なんだ……？
彼の様子がおかしいぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...?
Is something wrong with him?

fields.JP: もしかして、寝てるんじゃない？
こっちも寝ちゃったねぇ

fields.EN:
Well, Otsuu-chan and Jack-san were
doing a lot back there.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんもジャックさんも、
ずっと頑張ってたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Otsuu and Jack were
doing a lot back there.

fields.EN:
Let's let them sleep.
Like, I think we should go to
sleep, too.
fields.JP:
寝かせてあげましょう。
ってかあたしたちも少し寝ようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's let them sleep.
Like, I think we should go to
sleep, too.

fields.EN:
Yeah, may as well sleep while
we still have the chance.
fields.JP: だな。寝られる時に寝ておかないとな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, may as well sleep while
we still have the chance.

fields.JP:
ふふ、おやすみなさい、
おつうちゃん……

ん……？
どうしたハーメルン
ナイトメア・ジャック
ふああ、おはようハーメルンちゃん……

fields.EN:
How much longer are you going
to sleep?! This is so boring!
fields.JP:
いつまで寝ておるのだ！
いい加減にワレは退屈だぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How much longer are you going
to sleep?! This is so boring!

fields.EN:
Ah, it looks like we've been
asleep for quite a while.
fields.JP: ああ……けっこう寝てたみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, it looks like we've been
asleep for quite a while.

fields.EN:
Takumi, you better wake up or
else Hameln is going to wake you
up with force.
fields.JP:
タクミ、そろそろ起きないと
ハーメルンにぶっ叩かれるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Takumi, you better wake up or
else Hameln is going to wake you
up with force.

fields.JP:
ウッス！
自分、メッチャ起きてるであります！

fields.EN: You people really have no stamina.
fields.JP: まったく、貴様らは体力がないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you all needed
to sleep that long.

fields.EN:
By the way, the clothes you're
wearing are so beautiful, Hameln-chan!
fields.JP:
それにしてもハーメルンちゃん、
また随分と素敵な服だね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, the clothes you're
wearing are so beautiful, Hameln!

fields.EN:
Yes, it gives you a much different
look. You look great in it.
fields.JP:
うん、前と全然印象が違うね。
とても似合ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it gives you a much different
look. You look great in it.

fields.EN:
Doesn't it! I am a hero, so I have
to wear the proper attire!
fields.JP:
そうであろう！　ワレはもう勇者だからな！
相応の服に着替えさせてもらったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't it! I am a hero, so I have
to wear the proper attire!

fields.JP: 形から入るタイプかよ……

fields.EN:
Leave her be.
I think looks are important, too.
fields.JP:
まあいいじゃないか。
見た目は大事だと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave her be.
I think looks are important, too.

fields.EN:
At least it's a lot easier to
speak with her now.
fields.JP:
断然、今の方が話しかけやすい
雰囲気してるしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least it's a lot easier to
speak with her now.

fields.EN:
Well, here's to hoping we all
get along, Haa-chan.
fields.JP: 改めてよろしくね、ハーちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, here's to hoping we all
get along, Hammy.

fields.EN:
All right, I think it's best we
get going now, but before
doing so...
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあみんな、
そろそろ出発しようと思うんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, I think it's best we
get going now, but before
doing so...

fields.EN:
Mamoru? You folks didn't fall
down here, did you?
fields.JP:
マモル、君たちはまさか
崖を落ちてきたわけじゃないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru? You folks didn't fall
down here, did you?

fields.EN:
Hell no. We found a bridge,
while running that led us
down here.
fields.JP:
そりゃあな。俺たちは上で
この地下洞窟に繋がる橋を見つけたんだ。
で、こっちに逃げてきたってわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hell no. We found a bridge,
while running that led us
down here.

fields.EN:
That also means that we can get
back up from there. No worries.
Itsuki knows the way back.
fields.JP:
だからそこを通れば、上に戻れる。
なに、道は覚えてる……イツキが
fields.LOCALIZED:
That also means that we can get
back up from there. No worries.
Itsuki knows the way back.

fields.EN:
Thanks for passing the buck to
me, but... yes, I do remember the
way back.
fields.JP:
自信満々に僕に頼るのはどうかと思うが、
確かに覚えているよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for passing the buck to
me, but... yes, I do remember the
way back.

fields.EN:
All right! Let's head on back to
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
よし！　じゃあ今度こそ
解放地区に戻れるな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Let's head on back to
the Liberated District!

fields.JP: やっとここまで戻ってこられた……！

fields.EN: It felt like forever getting here.
fields.JP:
こうしてみると、
ずいぶん長かったような気がするね
fields.LOCALIZED: It felt like forever getting here.

fields.JP:
ん……？
姫、何かおかしくないか？

fields.EN:
I don't recall the place being
in such a bad state, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
覚えてる限りこんなに破壊されて
なかったよね、おつうちゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't recall the place being
in such a bad state, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Isn't it because you girls were
fighting the Marchens?
fields.JP:
おまえらがメルヒェンと戦ったから
じゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it because you girls were
fighting the Marchens?

fields.EN:
I don't think that's the cause
of all this.
fields.JP: いや、そうじゃないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think that's the cause
of all this.

fields.EN:
It look like a force greater than
what any lone battle can exhibit
rampaged through here...
fields.JP:
戦闘の痕跡というより大きな力が
ここを通り、破壊していった。
そういう風に見える
fields.LOCALIZED:
It look like a force greater than
what any lone battle can exhibit
rampaged through here...

fields.EN:
(Itsuki's right. I'm quite sure
we didn't cause this much
destruction in our battles...)
fields.JP:
（イツキの言う通りだ。
　あの時の戦闘ではこんな破壊は
　なされてなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Itsuki's right. I'm quite sure
we didn't cause this much
destruction in our battles...)

fields.JP: いったい何があったって言うんだ……？

fields.EN:
I-I'm not getting good vibes
from this...
fields.JP: な、なんか不気味な雰囲気だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not getting good vibes
from this...

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Hikari.
I'm with you.
fields.JP:
安心しろヒカリ。
俺がついてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Hikari.
I'm with you.

fields.EN:
I don't sense any other presence
here, but we better keep an eye
out on our surrounding.
fields.JP:
この辺りに他の気配はないけど、
用心するに越したことはない。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't sense any other presence
here, but we better keep an eye
out on our surrounding.

fields.JP: だからみんな、気をつけて戻ろう
みなさん、解放地区見えました！

fields.EN:
Mmm! Smell the fresh air
of freedom!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm! Smell the fresh air
of freedom!

fields.EN:
I must say, it feels very good
to be in a familiar place.
fields.JP:
見慣れた場所に来ると、
やはり安心感が違うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, it feels very good
to be in a familiar place.

fields.EN:
Let's go and let everyone know
we're back!
fields.JP: みんな！　早く無事を知らせに行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go and let everyone know
we're back!

fields.JP: ……待ってくれ、何かおかしいぞ

fields.EN:
This isn't looking good...
Let's go!
fields.JP: 嫌な予感がする……みんな、急ごう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This isn't looking good...
Let's go!

fields.JP: 誰か！　無事な方はいませんかー！
なんだってこんなことに……！

おつうちゃん！
待ってってばぁ！

fields.EN:
Everyone, stay away from here!
It could be dangerous!
fields.JP: 危ないからみんなは外で待ってて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, stay away from here!
It could be dangerous!

fields.EN: I can't just leave you like this, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
そんな、おつうちゃんを
放っておけないよ！

fields.EN:
Yeah, now's the time we work
together as a team.
fields.JP:
ああ、こんな時だからこそ
固まって行動すべきだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, now's the time we work
together as a team.

fields.JP: どうしたのだ、おつうは

fields.EN:
Are you sure you want to come
with us? I can guarantee you that
there's nothing good ahead.
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、ここから先はきっと
楽しいことは１つもない。それでも来る？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you want to come
with us? I can guarantee you that
there's nothing good ahead.

fields.EN:
Of course I'll come.
I am your friend after all.
fields.JP:
もちろんだ。
何があってもワレは仲間だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I'll come.
I am your friend after all.

fields.EN:
Thank you...
I'm counting on you.
fields.JP: ありがとう。その言葉、信じる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...
I'm counting on you.

fields.JP: おいおつう！　ちょっと落ち着け！
無事でいてくれ、みんな――
ハルさん！　視子さん！

fields.EN:
This can't be happening...
Haru-san... Miko-san...
fields.JP:
嘘ですよね……
ハルさん、視子さん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This can't be happening...
Haru... Miko...

fields.EN:
(Haru-san's eyes were gouged out,
and Miko-san's limbs are torn apart.)
fields.JP:
（両目がないのが……ハルさん。
　四肢がないのが……視子さん）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haru's eyes were gouged out,
and Miko's limbs are torn apart.)

fields.EN:
(They don't look like them at
all, but my mind is telling me
that it's them...)
fields.JP:
（どこからどう見ても記憶の
　２人とはかけ離れているのに、
　間違いなく２人と断言できてしまう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They don't look like them at
all, but my mind is telling me
that it's them...)

fields.EN:
(No matter how I look at things,
they're... dead!)
fields.JP:
（どう見ても、
　死んでるって断言できてしまう……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No matter how I look at things,
they're... dead!)

fields.EN: What a horrible way to die...
fields.JP: ひでえ殺し方しやがる……
fields.LOCALIZED: What a horrible way to die...

fields.EN: Who would've done such a thing?!
fields.JP: いったい誰がこんなことを……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Who would've done such a thing?!

fields.EN:
Now calm down, Otsuu.
Whoever did this is still nearby.
fields.JP:
落ち着くんだ、おつう。
この人たちを襲った者はまだ近くにいるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now calm down, Otsuu.
Whoever did this is still nearby.

fields.EN:
Yeah. I can roughly tell from the
way the blood is flowing and their
body temperature. They might still—
fields.JP:
ああ。血の流れ方と体温でおおよそね。
もしかしたらまだ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm guessing based on the bleeding
and the warmth of the corpses.
It could be possible that...

fields.EN:
I can't leave her alone!
Everyone, wait here!
fields.JP:
おつうを１人にはできねえ！
みんなはここで待ってろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't leave her alone!
Everyone, wait here!

fields.EN: All the more reason for us to go too!
fields.JP: それならなおさら、私たちも行くよ！

fields.EN:
It's dangerous no matter where
we are!
fields.JP: ここに残っても危険なのは変わりない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's dangerous no matter where
we are!

fields.EN:
No! Whoever or whatever
caused all this is nearby!
fields.JP:
ここを壊滅させたやつが
すぐそこにいるんだ！　来るな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Whoever or whatever
caused all this is nearby!

fields.EN:
If anything, I think it'd be more dangerous
to leave only the noncombatants behind...
fields.JP:
むしろ非戦闘員だけ残していく方が
危ないと思うけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me say that it's more
dangerous to leave the weak
out here in the open.

fields.JP:
そうは言ってもよ、
やっぱり心配なんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she's worrying the heck
out of me!

fields.EN:
We're going to lose Otsuu if we
keep arguing like this, so I will
protect everyone here.
fields.JP:
迷っている間におつうは行ってしまうぞ。
心配するな、貴様らはワレが守ってやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to lose Otsuu if we
keep arguing like this, so I will
protect everyone here.

fields.EN:
Thanks Hameln!
I'm counting on you!
fields.JP:
くそっ……ハーメルン、
よろしく頼むぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks Hameln!
I'm counting on you!

fields.JP:
そこのおまえ！
その人から離れろ！

血……もっと……たく
……さん……ぎ……出ろ……

fields.EN:
Damn it... I wanted to avenge
my dad and mom someday... Agh...!
fields.JP:
グゾッ……親父やお袋の……
仇……いづか取りたがっだのによぉ……
あっ、が……がぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it... I can't even avenge
my dad and mom...
Urgh...

fields.JP:
今助けます！
うぉぉぉぉぉっ！

うわっ！！
なっ……なんだこの威力……！

fields.EN:
Tch! I can't get near it.
I can't even find an opening!
fields.JP:
くっ……しかもこいつ意外と
隙がなくて近づけない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch! I can't get near it.
I can't even find an opening!

fields.JP:
ほら……シ……ぬの……
ぐげげ……ね……え…………

fields.EN:
Kadowaki-san!
Please, get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP:
門脇さん！？　
しっかりして下さい門脇さんっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mr. Kadowaki!
Please, get a hold of yourself!

fields.JP: 内臓が……引っ張り出されてる……

fields.EN:
Hm... That one there is quite
formidable...
fields.JP:
そやつ……けっこう
ヤバめな雰囲気を放っておるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... That one there is quite
formidable...

fields.EN:
Aaaaah!
We gotta get outta here!
fields.JP:
ひぃぃぃっ！
アイツ絶対やばいって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaaaah!
We gotta get outta here!

fields.EN:
Yeah, we better run while
we still can!
fields.JP: おい、逃げた方がいいぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we better run while
we still can!

fields.EN:
I've never seen a Nightmare
like that before...
fields.JP:
何……このナイトメア……
こんなおぞましいの、初めて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen a Nightmare
like that before...

fields.EN:
You all stand back.
I will take care of it.
fields.JP:
貴様らは下がっておれ。
ここはワレが引き受けよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You all stand back.
I will take care of it.

fields.EN:
I'm joining, too.
I'll make it pay for what
it's done.
fields.JP:
僕もやる。
絶対に後悔させてやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm joining, too.
I'll make it pay for what
it's done.

fields.EN:
(I have to be careful...
It's way stronger than anyone
I've ever fought before...)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ……これまで戦ってきたどの敵も
　比較にならないほど強そうだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to be careful...
It's way stronger than anyone
I've ever fought before...)

fields.EN:
Be careful, Otsuu.
One wrong move and it's over.
fields.JP:
おつう、気をつけろ。
気を抜くとやられかねぬぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be careful, Otsuu.
One wrong move and it's over.

fields.EN:
Understood.
You be careful too, Hameln.
fields.JP:
ああ、分かってる。
ハーメルンも気をつけてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood.
You be careful too, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Foolish!
Turning its back on us?!
fields.JP: ふははは！　背を向けるとは愚かな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Foolish!
Turning its back on us?!

fields.JP:
ハーメルン！
追わなくていい！！

fields.EN: You don't need to go after it...
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't need to go after it...

fields.JP: むぅ……おつうが言うなら仕方あるまい

fields.EN:
Our top priority is to make sure
that everyone's safe...
fields.JP:
今は、みんなが無事であることの方が
大事だからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our top priority is to make sure
that everyone's safe...

fields.EN:
(I don't understand... We should have
welcomed a new Blood Maiden into our
group and celebrated together...)
fields.JP:
（意味が分からない……本当なら
　僕たちは新しい血式少女を仲間にして、
　喜び合っていたはずなのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's going on? I was supposed
to come back with a new Blood
Maiden who would join us.)

fields.EN:
(Why did this happen...?
What am I supposed to do...?)
fields.JP:
（なのになんでこんなことに……
　いったいどうすればいいんだよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There are no happy faces to
greet us back... What am
I supposed to do...?)

fields.JP:
門脇さん！
お願い目を覚まして！
うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！

fields.EN:
Why?! Why was everyone killed?!
Why...?! Why?!
fields.JP:
なんで！？　どうしてみんな
殺されなければいけないの！？
なんで……なんでよぉ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why?! Why was everyone killed?!
Why...?! Why?!

fields.EN:
I can't take this anymore!
Everyone I cared about! Dead!
I don't want this...!
fields.JP:
もういや……！
大好きなみんながいなくなるの、
もういやだよぉ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't take this anymore!
Everyone I cared about! Dead!
I don't want this...!

fields.EN:
You taught me that we should
hug each other when things are
going bad.
fields.JP:
つらい時はこうやって抱きしめるって、
姫が教えてくれたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You taught me that we should
hug each other when things are
going bad.

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……
ふ、う……うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁんっ！！

fields.EN:
All I could do was to embrace
Ningyohime crying in sorrow.
fields.JP:
泣きじゃくる人魚姫を、
僕はただ抱きしめることしか出来なかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I could do was to embrace
Little Mermaid crying in sorrow.

fields.EN:
How much time has passed?
Everyone was speechless.
fields.JP:
いったいどのくらいの時間
そうしていただろう。
誰もが、無言だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
How much time has passed?
Everyone was speechless.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime calmed down,
and we went searching the area
from end to end.
fields.JP:
そして人魚姫が落ち着いてから、
僕たちは解放地区を隅まで見て回った
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid calmed down,
and we went searching the area
from end to end.

fields.EN:
I feared for the worst, and it
became a reality. There were
no survivors.
fields.JP:
半ば予想はしていたけど、
生き残った人は誰もいなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feared for the worst, and it
became a reality. There were
no survivors.

fields.EN:
Every human, every animal...
Everything with life was killed
as if in sheer hatred.
fields.JP:
まるで命ある者をすべて憎むかのように、
人も動物も、何もかも皆殺しだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Every human, every animal...
Everything with life was killed
as if in sheer hatred.

fields.EN:
I can only assume that Nightmare
I saw did all this...
fields.JP:
これもすべて、あの謎のナイトメアが
やったこと――なのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only assume that Nightmare
I saw did all this...

fields.EN:
And now, I sigh with relief that
we didn't fight it after looking
at the destruction it caused.
fields.JP:
破壊の痕を見る限り、
正直あの場で戦いにならなくて
良かったと思うばかりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And now, I sigh with relief that
we didn't fight it after looking
at the destruction it caused.

fields.EN:
If we fought, someone would have
died. We all could have died...
fields.JP:
戦っていれば、間違いなく僕たちの誰か、
あるいは全員が殺されていただろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we fought, someone would have
died. We all could have died...

fields.EN:
To be safe, we completely sealed the routes
from the City Streets to other areas, since we
think the mysterious Nightmare fled that way.
fields.JP:
だから念のため謎のナイトメアが
逃げたと思われる、元街道沿いから
別の場所への道は完全に塞いでおいた
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be safe, we sealed the paths
to the City Streets where we
believe the Nightmare ran off to.

fields.EN:
The only areas that connect are
the Liberated District, Hameln's
Cave, and the Graveyard area.
fields.JP:
元街道沿いから行けるのは、
今はこの破壊されつくした解放地区や
ハーメルンの洞窟、元墓所エリアくらいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only areas that connect are
the Liberated District, Hameln's
Cave, and the Graveyard area.

fields.EN: We should be safe... for now.
fields.JP:
少なくともこれで当面の安全は確保できた
……はずだ
fields.LOCALIZED: We should be safe... for now.

fields.EN:
Dawn's structures were mostly
toppled and reduced to rubble.
fields.JP:
黎明の建物は損傷が酷く、
そのほとんどが瓦礫となって
崩れてしまっていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dawn's structures were mostly
toppled and reduced to rubble.

fields.EN:
Because of the damage, we haven't been able
to search inside. We never found the body
of the Professor, Dawn's de facto leader.
fields.JP:
おかげで内部の捜索はできていない。
黎明の実質的な長でもある博士の遺体は
見つからずじまいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't search inside, and we
couldn't find the assumed body
of our professor.

fields.EN:
I'm sure he would have offered
us a glimmer of hope, even in
the darkness we're in...
fields.JP:
博士がいてくれたら、こんな状況でも
もっと希望を持てただろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure he would have offered
us a glimmer of hope, even in
the darkness we're in...

fields.EN:
I would have wanted to wallow in
sadness, but doing so would do
nothing for our cause.
fields.JP:
絶望に沈み、この先どうすればいいのか、
何も思いつかないような有様だったけど
ここにいても何も進展はしない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would have wanted to wallow in
sadness, but doing so would do
nothing for our cause.

fields.JP: それだけは確かだった

fields.EN:
Heh... I suppose this is what it
truly means to be in despair.
fields.JP: 何て言うか……はは、絶望的だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I suppose this is what it
truly means to be in despair.

fields.EN:
Otsuu...
You rest a bit, you hear?
fields.JP: おつう、おまえ少しは休め
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu...
You rest a bit, you hear?

fields.EN:
Strange... I can't sleep.
I don't even feel tired.
fields.JP:
なんだろうね、眠れないんだ。
疲れも何も感じないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Strange... I can't sleep.
I don't even feel tired.

fields.EN:
Mamoru, shouldn't you be
beside Hikari?
fields.JP:
それよりもマモルは
ヒカリのそばにいてあげないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, shouldn't you be
beside Hikari?

fields.EN:
The village you came from was
probably... um...
fields.LOCALIZED:
The village you came from was
probably... um...

fields.EN:
It's fine. You don't have to
choose your words. The fact is,
the settlement was wiped out.
fields.JP:
いいさ、言葉を選ばなくて。
全滅だったのは事実だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can tell it to me straight.
Without doubt the place is
probably destroyed.

fields.EN:
Kaede is with Hikari now.
Sometimes it's best to let
girls have a one-on-one.
fields.JP:
ヒカリには今、カエデがついてくれてる。
女同士の方がいいこともある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaede is with Hikari now.
Sometimes it's best to let
girls have a one-on-one.

fields.EN:
Well, she asked to be left alone
for a while, so I decided to honor
her request...
fields.JP:
うん……１人になりたいって、
だからそっとしておくことにしたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, she asked to be left alone
for a while, so I decided to honor
her request...

fields.EN:
If only there was something
good to talk about now...
fields.JP:
こういう時、少しでも何か
希望が持てる話題があるといいのにな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only there was something
good to talk about now...

fields.EN:
Well, we couldn't even find
Professor's body, too...
fields.JP:
黎明の博士の遺体も
見つからなかったしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we couldn't even find
Professor's body, too...

fields.JP: あれだけ探してなかったんだもんな……

fields.EN:
Hame-chan, it's harder to have
a smile on our face now,
you know?
fields.JP:
ハメちゃん、さすがに今
元気になれってのは無理だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy, it's harder to have
a smile on our face now,
you know?

fields.EN:
Hm, but being down like this
isn't going to change matters.
fields.JP:
むぅ、だが落ち込んでても
何も変わらないではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, but being down like this
isn't going to change matters.

fields.EN:
Now is the time we stand proud!
We must let our passion aflame,
and begin our retaliation!
fields.JP:
そう、ここからだ！
ここからワレらの反撃が始まるって感じで
闘志を燃やそうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now is the time we stand proud!
We must let our passion aflame,
and begin our retaliation!

fields.JP: だから無理だって言ってんだろ

fields.EN:
Hm... No here, no there.
So, what will make you come back
to your normal self thyen?!
fields.JP:
ぬう……あれもムリ、これもムリ！
じゃあいったいどうしたら貴様らは
元気になるって言うにょだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... No here, no there.
So, what will make you come back
to your normal self thyen?!

fields.EN:
You're all alive, aren't you?!
You can do anything
if you're alive!
fields.JP:
貴様らはまだ生きてるではないか！
生きていれば何とかなる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're all alive, aren't you?!
You can do anything
if you're alive!

fields.EN:
You got that from your manga,
didn't you?
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got that from your manga,
didn't you?

fields.EN: Indeed! Those words hit me hard!
fields.JP:
うむ！　あのセリフには
心が震えたぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Indeed! Those words hit me hard!

fields.EN:
Sheez...
So those aren't your words then.
fields.JP: んだよ、漫画のセリフかよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sheez...
So those aren't your words then.

fields.EN:
Hear me out. Are you sure everyone
was killed? You don't know for
sure, do yyew?!
fields.JP:
や、待てっ、
それに本当に全員死んだのか！？
まだ分からにゃいではにゃいか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hear me out. Are you sure everyone
was killed? You don't know for
sure, do yyew?!

fields.EN:
Heh...
You're slurring too much, Hameln-chan.
fields.JP:
はは……ハーメルンちゃん、
噛みすぎだよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh...
You're slurring too much, Hammy.

fields.JP: ヒカリ！　もういいのか？

fields.EN:
Yeah... I'm feeling much better.
Sorry for making everyone worry.
fields.JP:
うん……だいぶよくなったよ。
みんな、心配かけてごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, a bit...
I'm sorry to be such a burden...

fields.EN:
I overheard, but what Hameln said
is true. We need to pick ourselves
up and think of the future.
fields.JP:
聞こえてたけど、
ハーメルンの言うことも一理あるよ。
みんな、少し前向きに考えない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I overheard, but what Hameln said
is true. We need to pick ourselves
up and think of the future.

fields.JP: カエデ！　よくぞ言った！

fields.EN:
So, are we sure there are no
survivors?
fields.JP:
ねえ、本当に誰も
生き残っていないのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, are we sure there are no
survivors?

fields.EN:
We couldn't find the bodies of
any of the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
血式少女たちの遺体は、
誰一人としてありませんでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
We couldn't find the bodies of
any of the Blood Maidens.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I'm fine...
I'm sorry to have worried you all.
fields.JP:
もう大丈夫だから……
ごめんなさい、みなさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine...
I'm sorry to have worried you all.

fields.EN:
Heh... Well, guess we still got
some juice in us.
fields.JP:
へっ……みんな意外と
前向きじゃねえか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Well, guess we still got
some juice in us.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime? Otsuu?
Do you mind continuing where
you each left off?
fields.JP:
じゃあ人魚姫、おつう、
話の続きをお願いできるかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid? Otsuu?
Do you mind continuing where
you each left off?

fields.EN:
Yes. There were actually more of
us in Dawn.
fields.JP:
はい――わたしたちのような血式少女は、
黎明にまだ何人かいたのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. There were actually more of
us in Dawn.

fields.EN:
But, we didn't find their bodies
there at all.
fields.JP:
だけど誰一人の遺体も、
あの場所にはなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we didn't find their bodies
there at all.

fields.EN:
Which means that it's highly
likely that they escaped and
went into hiding.
fields.JP:
ということは、生き残って
どこかに避難した可能性が高いんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that it's highly
likely that they escaped and
went into hiding.

fields.EN:
If we can somehow find them,
I'm sure we will be able to face
the Marchens again.
fields.JP:
ですから彼女たちに合流できれば、
もっとメルヒェンたちに
対抗できるようになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we can somehow find them,
I'm sure we will be able to face
the Marchens again.

fields.EN:
I see, and that would help us
retaliate against those monsters
again.
fields.JP:
なるほど、それこそが
反撃の糸口になる……ってことだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see, and that would help us
retaliate against those monsters
again.

fields.EN:
Yes. I'd like to suggest we use
this place temporarily as a base
to find the other Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
うん。だからひとまずここを拠点に、
血式少女たちを探したいと思うんだけど、
どうかな、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I'd like to suggest we use
this place temporarily as a base
to find the other Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Your story holds hope and a
decent level of reality.
I'm in agreement with you.
fields.JP:
だいぶ現実的で希望の持てる話だ。
僕は賛成だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your story holds hope and a
decent level of reality.
I'm in agreement with you.

fields.EN:
Me too.
We need to have the right people
to fight again.
fields.JP:
あたしも賛成。
まず戦力を増やさないとね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too.
We need to have the right people
to fight again.

fields.EN:
Heck, I'm all in if it means that
we're gonna build better defenses.
fields.JP:
あっしも、守りが堅くなるなら
喜んで手伝いやすぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heck, I'm all in if it means that
we're gonna build better defenses.

fields.EN:
Me too!
There's still hope left.
fields.JP: 私も！　希望が見えてきたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too!
There's still hope left.

fields.EN:
All right then, let's go and
find every single one of them!
fields.JP: 上等だ、全員見つけてやろうぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right then, let's go and
find every single one of them!

fields.EN:
I guess we're all in agreement.
Haa-chan? Do you mind if...
fields.JP:
ってことなんだけど、
ハーちゃん……この場所いいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we're all in agreement.
Hammy? Do you mind if...

fields.EN:
Hahaha! No need to say more!
You are free to use my place
as you please!
fields.JP:
ふはは！　もちろん構わぬ！
ワレの隠れ家、存分に使うがよいぞ貴様ら！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! No need to say more!
You are free to use my place
as you please!

fields.EN:
Thank you...
We're in your debt, Hameln.
fields.JP:
ありがとう……
恩に着るよ、ハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...
We're in your debt, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Now then! Let us depart and
search for those friends of yours!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ貴様ら！
その仲間になりそうな奴らを
共に見つけようぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then! Let us depart and
search for those friends of yours!

fields.JP:
（よかった……
　これでひとまず希望が見えた）

fields.EN:
(Still, that Nightmare I saw back
at Dawn was odd...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、
　あの黎明で出会ったナイトメア……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Still, that Nightmare I saw back
at Dawn was odd...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's just me, but when it
ran, I felt an indescribably negative
