emotion... a dark, negative feeling.)
fields.JP:
（気のせいだろうか、あいつが逃げる時
　とてもネガティブな……言い知れない
　負の感情を感じた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe it's just me, but when it
ran, I felt a surge of evil run
through my body...)

fields.JP: （いったいあいつは何者なんだろうか……）

fields.EN:
(I need to run...
They're going to kill me...)
fields.JP:
（逃げなきゃ……
　捕まったら殺される……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to run...
They're going to kill me...)

fields.EN:
(But why?
Why is everyone after me...?!)
fields.JP:
（でも何故？
　どうしてみんな追ってくるの……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But why?
Why is everyone after me...?!)

fields.EN:
(What did I do?
Why are they coming after me?!)
fields.JP:
（私が何をしたって言うの？
　何で追われなきゃいけないの……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What did I do?
Why are they coming after me?!)

fields.JP:
（ようやく、あの人間たちを
　振り切ることができた……）

（嬉しいな……どんなに探しても
　見つけられなかったのに……）

fields.EN:
(It's been a while since I saw
other humans, but... she wasn't among them.)
fields.JP:
（でも久々に人間を見たけれど、
　あの中には……いなかったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's been a while since I saw
people, but no one was in there.)

fields.JP: おい起きろっ、ジャックってば
ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Heh, I'm surprised that you'd
be dreaming, Jack.
fields.JP:
はは、ジャックも夢見るんだな
ビックリしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, I'm surprised that you'd
be dreaming, Jack.

fields.EN:
(I'm the only one who can sense
Jack's intentions like this. I'm
glad we're sharing a body...)
fields.JP:
（ジャックの意思が感覚として分かるの、
　僕だけだもんな。同居してよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm glad I was with him.
After all, I'm able to share his
thoughts and feelings.)

fields.EN:
I know it wasn't a good dream,
but...
fields.JP:
決していい夢では
なかったかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it wasn't a good dream,
but...

fields.EN:
I'm sure you'll dream something
better soon, Jack.
fields.JP:
いつかいい夢が
見られるといいな、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you'll dream something
better soon, Jack.

fields.EN:
In any case, looks like the
day finally arrived.
fields.JP:
それにしてもジャック、
ようやくこの日が来たな
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, looks like the
day finally arrived.

fields.EN:
The search for the Blood Maidens
finally starts today. No telling what
everyone will say if I'm late...
fields.JP:
ついに今日から血式少女の捜索開始だ。
遅刻したらみんなに何言われるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're finally ready to search for
the lost Blood Maidens. No telling
what would happen if we're late.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Jack, I'm a bit busy now.
fields.JP: ジャック、今ちょっと手が離せない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, I'm a bit busy now.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Just a moment, Jack. Wrapping
this around me is a lot more
painstaking than it looks... Oof!
fields.JP:
ちょっと待っててジャック。
このさらしを巻くってのが
思いのほか面倒でさ……んしょっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a moment, Jack. Wrapping
this around me is a lot more
painstaking than it looks... Oof!

fields.EN:
This takes... so much of...
my time... every morning!
fields.JP: 毎朝……すごく、手間がかかる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This takes... so much of...
my time... every morning!

fields.EN:
But, I can't avoid it.
I am a prince after all.
fields.JP:
でも手は抜けない。
なんたって僕は王子さまだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I can't avoid it.
I am a prince after all.

fields.JP:
よし、できた。
どうだい？　ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I can't believe it's been weeks
since all that happened...
fields.JP:
それにしても
あれからもう数週間経ったのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe it's been weeks
since all that happened...

fields.EN:
So, how are things, everyone?
I did suggest making this our
base, but are there any issues?
fields.JP:
で、どうだったみんな。
ここを拠点にするって言ってはみたけど、
住むには難しいかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how are things, everyone?
I did suggest making this our
base, but are there any issues?

fields.EN:
It's great that there are no
enemies, but it's lacking a lot
in terms of general living.
fields.JP:
敵がいないって意味ではいい場所だが、
居住のために作られた施設でもない。
住むにはいろいろ足りねぇだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's great that there are no
enemies, but it's lacking a lot
in terms of general living.

fields.EN:
If so, we could use this place to
sleep, and look for what we need
back at the Liberated District...
fields.JP:
じゃあ最悪、ここは寝床だけにして、
必要なものは、また解放地区に探しに行く
しかないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, we could use this place to
sleep, and look for what we need
back at the Liberated District...

fields.JP: ……おまえの意見はどうなんだ、イツキ

fields.EN:
Well, it seems as if we can use
this location as a base just fine.
fields.JP:
ざっと見た感じだが、
何とか拠点にできると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems as if we can use
this location as a base just fine.

fields.EN:
Well... there's no denying this place
needs a major overhaul... mainly so
we can make somewhere to sleep.
fields.JP:
まあ……かなりの大改造が
必要な点は否めないがな……
主に寝床を作るという意味で
fields.LOCALIZED:
We do need to modify the place
a bit, though. In particular, we
need a decent area to sleep in.

fields.EN:
Electricity and water sources are
available, so fixing them up
a bit should make them work fine.
fields.JP:
最低限必要な電気と水道は生きてたから、
ちょっと修理すれば使えるようになるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Electricity and water sources are
available, so fixing them up
a bit should make them work fine.

fields.EN: Heh heh! Leave that to me!
fields.JP: ふっふっふ、拙者に任せておくがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh heh! Leave that to me!

fields.EN:
Oh, so it's finally
your time to shine, Takumi.
fields.JP: お、タクミもついに輝く時が来たか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, finally a time and place for
Takumi to shine.

fields.EN:
I've always been shining!
Like, shining all the time!
fields.JP:
輝いてるよ！？
ボクチンいつだって輝きっぱなしだよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've always been shining!
Like, shining all the time!

fields.EN:
Oh, we know that.
We're counting on you, Takumi.
You too, Kaede, Itsuki!
fields.JP:
分かってるって。
頼りにしてるからね、タクミ。
それにカエデもイツキも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, we know that.
We're counting on you, Takumi.
You too, Kaede, Itsuki!

fields.EN:
Did you hear that, my princess?!
It looks like there is hope
after all!
fields.JP:
姫、よかったな！
これで希望がさらに見えてきた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you hear that, my princess?!
It looks like there is hope
after all!

fields.JP: そうだね……おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
I believe building a place to
sleep will be quite difficult.
fields.JP:
それで、さっきも言ったように、
住居を作るのが最も大変だと思う。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe building a place to
sleep will be quite difficult.

fields.EN:
Which means you need some
muscles, right? Leave that to me
and Takumi.
fields.JP:
つまりは力仕事だな。
まかせとけ俺とタクミでどうにかする
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means you need some
muscles, right? Leave that to me
and Takumi.

fields.EN:
We're about the only ones
here who can flex their muscles.
fields.JP:
力仕事に向いてそうなのは、
俺たちくらいしかいねぇだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're about the only ones
here who can flex their muscles.

fields.EN:
Uh, but I have to fix up the
infrastructure here. Why don't you
ask someone else?
fields.JP:
あたいはインフラの整備があるし？
他を頼ってほしいな～なんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but I have to fix up the
infrastructure here. Why don't you
ask someone else?

fields.JP: んなこと言っても他に誰が……

fields.EN:
Hm? What is it?
Why are you looking at me?
fields.JP:
……ん？　なんだおまえたち。
ワレの顔をじろじろ見て
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What is it?
Why are you looking at me?

fields.EN:
Hameln, you're really strong,
aren't you?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、お前確か
すっごい力持ちだったよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, you're really strong,
aren't you?

fields.EN:
Indeed! I do boast having
impressive strength!
fields.JP: その通り、力には自信があるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! I do boast having
impressive strength!

fields.JP: よしよし、労働力確保だ

fields.EN:
Huh? You're going to let a little
girl do manual labor? Horrible.
fields.JP:
えー、マモルこんなちっちゃな女の子を
肉体労働にかり出すの？　ひどいなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You're going to let a little
girl do manual labor? Horrible.

fields.EN:
She may look small, but she's far
stronger than any of us can compare with.
fields.JP:
見てくれは小さくても、
こいつには俺たちじゃ比べものに
ならないくらいの力がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, she may be a runt,
but she's way stronger than
any of us here.

fields.EN:
Don't you remember what she
did back when we played tag?
fields.JP:
ヒカリだって見ただろう？
あの鬼ごっこの時に
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you remember what she
did back when we played tag?

fields.EN:
There's no reason not to have
Hameln help us.
fields.JP: ハーメルンを使わない手はないぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no reason not to have
Hameln help us.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what you're talking
about, but I can help if you want.
fields.JP:
なんか知らんが、
手伝えることなら手伝ってやるぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what you're talking
about, but I can help if you want.

fields.EN:
That's great, Hameln!
I'll check with you later!
fields.JP:
助かるぜハーメルン！
あとでよろしくな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's great, Hameln!
I'll check with you later!

fields.EN:
I'll go ahead and get the
electricity and water fixed,
while Hame-chan does her part!
fields.JP:
ハメちゃんが頑張ってくれてる間に
電気と水道はばっちり直しとくぜ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll go ahead and get the
electricity and water fixed,
while Hammy does her part!

fields.EN:
Good! With this "electricity"
thing, I can read my manga
in a brighter area, correct?
fields.JP:
うむ！　その電気とやらがあれば漫画を
もっと明るい場所で読めるのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good! With this "electricity"
thing, I can read my manga
in a brighter area, correct?

fields.EN:
Now, now, let her be. It's important to
Hameln-chan.
fields.JP:
まあまあ、いいじゃない。
ハーメルンちゃんには大事なことなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, let her be.
It must be important to her.

fields.EN:
The infrastructure's taken care of.
What do we do once everything's set up?
fields.JP:
インフラ整備の件はこれでいいとして、
体制が整ったあとはどうする？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Assuming we have the
infrastructure operational,
what to do we afterward?

fields.EN:
Our main objective is to survive.
Once that's secured, we should
look for the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
当面の目的は、生き延びること。
それから他の血式少女を探す
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our main objective is to survive.
Once that's secured, we should
look for the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN: Both are gonna take some time.
fields.JP: どっちも長丁場になりそうだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Both are gonna take some time.

fields.EN:
I'm prepared for it.
That's why we should set up our
base here.
fields.JP:
覚悟はしてる。
そのためにここに拠点を作るんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm prepared for it.
That's why we should set up our
base here.

fields.EN:
We should also set roles for
each of us since we're in it
for the long haul.
fields.JP:
長く共同生活を送るためにも
おのおの役割を決めておいた方がいいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should also set roles for
each of us since we're in it
for the long haul.

fields.EN:
Yeah, it wouldn't be efficient if
we all went searching together.
fields.JP:
また全員でぞろぞろ探索しに行くってのも
あまり効率的とは言えねえしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it wouldn't be efficient if
we all went searching together.

fields.EN:
I assume it would be best for me,
my princess, and Jack to search
for the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
僕と姫、それにジャックは
血式少女たちの捜索でいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume it would be best for me,
my princess, and Jack to search
for the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
I will go, too!
My power should prove useful!
fields.JP:
もちろんワレも同行するぞ！
この力、必要であろう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will go, too!
My power should prove useful!

fields.EN:
That's true, but we need someone
to guard the area.
fields.JP:
それはありがたいけど、
ここの安全は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's true, but we need someone
to guard the area.

fields.EN:
I can take care of that while
you all go out on your search.
fields.JP:
お前らがいない間は、
俺が警備を引き受ける
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can take care of that while
you all go out on your search.

fields.EN:
I'll also keep an eye out on
the area. You never know if one
of them comes wandering in here.
fields.JP:
ついでに、この辺の探索もやっておく。
生き残った連中が迷い込んでくるかも
しれねぇしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll also keep an eye out on
the area. You never know if one
of them comes wandering in here.

fields.EN:
Are you sure you can handle
all that?
fields.JP:
大丈夫なのか？
そんなに一人で抱えこんで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you can handle
all that?

fields.EN:
Don't you worry.
It's just something that comes
with guard duty.
fields.JP:
んなこと言われなくても分かってるって。
探索つっても、門番と警備のついでに、
その辺を見てまわるだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry.
It's just something that comes
with guard duty.

fields.EN:
And, I'll make a run for it
if something ain't going right.
fields.JP: ヤバイと思ったらとっとと逃げるさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I'll make a run for it
if something ain't going right.

fields.EN:
You girls are gonna need as much
muscle as possible, especially
with all those Marchens out there.
fields.JP:
それに、おまえらはメルヒェンどもが
ウヨウヨいるとこに行くことになるんだ。
戦力は少しでも多い方がいいだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You girls are gonna need as much
muscle as possible, especially
with all those Marchens out there.

fields.EN:
I guess you're going to be
carrying a great load for us while
we're gone...
fields.JP:
そうか……
僕たちがいない間はマモルにかなり
負担をかけてしまうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you're going to be
carrying a great load for us while
we're gone...

fields.EN:
Don't you worry.
I like keeping myself busy
anyway.
fields.JP:
気にすんなっての。
元々こういう方が性に合ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry.
I like keeping myself busy
anyway.

fields.EN:
I can leave my minions here if it
will help ease worries!
fields.JP: 心配なら、ワレの下僕を残しておくぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can leave my minions here if it
will help ease worries!

fields.EN:
Then I'll work on improving your weapons,
Otsuu-chan — yours and everyone else's!
fields.JP:
じゃあワイは、そんなおつうちゃんたちの
武器の改良やな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna be modifying you
girls' weapons!

fields.EN:
You're gonna be all over me after
seeing my mad mod skills that
I learned courtesy of Dawn!
fields.JP:
黎明で学んだ血式武器の改良技術、
見たらきっと惚れてまうで！
四の五の言わんとワイに任せとき～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're gonna be all over me after
seeing my mad mod skills that
I learned courtesy of Dawn!

fields.EN:
I suppose I can use my experience
that I amassed from researching
the Jail and the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
僕は……これまでの経験を生かして、
ジェイルと血式少女の研究……でいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I can use my experience
that I amassed from researching
the Jail and the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
You could say I'm carrying
on the Professor's will.
fields.JP: 博士の遺志を継いで、ってところだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'd be the successor to
Professor.

fields.EN: I guess you can call it that.
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess you can call it that.

fields.EN:
I'm sure I can offer invaluable
information to you Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
きっと有用な情報を
君たち血式少女に提供しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure I can offer invaluable
information to you Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
I'm gonna prep daily necessities,
and stuff that may help out on
your search.
fields.JP:
あたしは生活用品から探索に役立つもの、
色々な道具の配給と整理をやるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna prep daily necessities,
and stuff that may help out on
your search.

fields.EN:
Yeah, you totally look the type
of keeping things in order.
fields.JP: あーなんか整列させるの上手そうだよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you totally look the type
of keeping things in order.

fields.EN:
You got it! And, if anyone dare
puts the goods out of place
I'm gonna kick their behinds!
fields.JP:
分かってるじゃんっ。
そうだよ、ちゃんと並ばないヤツは
いつだって蹴っ飛ばしてやるからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got it! And, if anyone dare
puts the goods out of place
I'm gonna kick their behinds!

fields.EN:
Um... Well, I guess I can...
fetch water?
fields.JP:
えーじゃあ私は
どうしようかなぁ……水汲みとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Well, I guess I can...
fetch water?

fields.EN:
I can do that.
You can be our go-to doctor.
fields.JP:
そんなん俺がやるっつーの。
おまえは救護室とかだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can do that.
You can be our go-to doctor.

fields.EN:
Huh?!
But, I only know how to patch up
minor injuries and things!
fields.JP:
ええっ！？
私、簡単な手当てくらいしかできないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?!
But, I only know how to patch up
minor injuries and things!

fields.EN:
Even that's a major help in
this place. I'll make sure have
the stuff you need later.
fields.JP:
それができるだけでも、
ここではありがたいってこと。
必要な物資は後で届けるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even that's a major help in
this place. I'll make sure have
the stuff you need later.

fields.EN:
Hikari, each one has an aptitude,
and having you man our infirmary
would be of great help to all.
fields.JP:
そうだなヒカリ、適材適所だ。
君が救護室にいてくれれば、
みんな救われると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikari, each one has an aptitude,
and having you man our infirmary
would be of great help to all.

fields.EN:
Okay then...
If everyone says so.
I'll do my best.
fields.JP:
……分かった。
みんながいいなら私、頑張るね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay then...
If everyone says so.
I'll do my best.

fields.EN:
Everyone...
Thank you so very much.
fields.JP:
みなさん、
本当にありがとうごさいます……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone...
Thank you so very much.

fields.EN:
No need to thank us.
We're all in this together.
fields.JP:
礼なんか言うなって。
助け合いなんて仲間なら当たり前だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to thank us.
We're all in this together.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! We have a plan now!
Well, it is time I announce the
name of our base of operations!
fields.JP:
ふはは、決まったようだな！
では最後にこの拠点の名前を発表するのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! We have a plan now!
Well, it is time I announce the
name of our base of operations!

fields.JP:
お……おう、
一応聞いておいてやるよ
いいか貴様ら聞いて驚け――

その名も『ハーメルン解放地区』！
どうだ、カッコよかろう！！

fields.EN: I'm not sure where to start...
fields.JP: どこからどう突っ込んでいいのかな
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not sure where to start...

fields.EN:
I don't recall us liberating
anything here...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't recall us liberating
anything here...

fields.EN:
I suppose you could say
Hameln was liberated from her
labyrinth...
fields.JP:
まあハーメルンが世に解き放たれた
という意味ではギリギリ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you could say
Hameln was liberated from her
labyrinth...

fields.EN:
I bet she just wanted to toss
the word "Liberated District" in.
fields.JP: 解放地区って言いたかっただけだろうが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet she just wanted to toss
the word "Liberated District" in.

fields.JP: そんにゃことはにゃいぞ！！

fields.EN:
Oh, so I hit the mark... You're
really stumbling over your words, Hameln-chan.
fields.JP:
あ、図星なんだ……
すっごい噛んじゃってるし
ハーメルンちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, you may be right, Mamoru...
I mean, did you hear Hammy's
super slur?

fields.EN: I-I am not stumbling over my words!!
fields.JP: ぜんぜん噛んでにゃい！！

fields.EN:
Well, we are borrowing her place,
so I guess we can call it that.
fields.JP:
まあハーメルンの住まいを間借りしてるし、
名前はそれでいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we are borrowing her place,
so I guess we can call it that.

fields.EN:
Hmph! You should accept the fact
that you all like that name!
fields.JP:
ふ、ふんっ、気に入ったのなら
素直に言えばよいものを！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! You should accept the fact
that you all like that name!

fields.EN:
In any case it's settled...
Hameln Liberated District it is!
fields.JP:
まあよい、
ではハーメルン解放地区で決定だな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case it's settled...
Hameln Liberated District it is!

fields.JP: ハーメルン解放地区、ねえ……

fields.EN:
I'm surprised myself that I'm
already getting used to it...
fields.JP:
まあ、言い慣れるとこれはこれで
しっくりきてしまうのが恐ろしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised myself that I'm
already getting used to it...

fields.EN:
All right, I'm ready.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Jack.
fields.JP:
よし、着替え完了。
おまたせ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, I'm ready.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Yeah. The real search starts
today. Let's do our best together.
fields.JP:
ああ、今日から本格的に捜索開始だ。
一緒に頑張ろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it's time we begin our
expeditions. Let's do our best.

fields.EN:
All that worries me now is
Ningyohime... She hasn't been
her self recently...
fields.JP:
さて、人魚姫は大丈夫かな……
色々ありすぎて、最近塞ぎがちだったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
All that worries me now is
Little Mermaid... She hasn't been
her self recently...

fields.EN:
I need to support her
no matter what...
fields.JP: ちゃんと僕がそばにいてあげないとな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to support her
no matter what...

fields.JP:
みんな、すまない。
遅くなった

fields.EN:
Looks like we have everyone here
now. Let's begin.
fields.JP:
これで全員揃ったな。
では始めようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we have everyone here
now. Let's begin.

fields.JP:
さて今日から早速、血式少女の
捜索になるわけだが……

fields.EN:
You mentioned that we should
search the Aquarium Ruins
first, right?
fields.JP:
うん。まずは元解放地区から近い
水族館跡エリアって話だったよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mentioned that we should
search the Aquarium Ruins
first, right?

fields.EN:
You girls haven't went there
before?
fields.JP: そこは未知の場所だったりするのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You girls haven't went there
before?

fields.EN:
No, we did long ago,
though there's no telling how
bad the place is now.
fields.JP:
昔、探索したことあるよ。
でもこうなってしまった今は、
安全とは言いがたいだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, we did long ago,
though there's no telling how
bad the place is now.

fields.EN:
Indeed. Which is why I would
like to ask for you all to be
very careful out there.
fields.JP:
ああ。だから探索チームは、
決して無理をしないでほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. Which is why I would
like to ask for you all to be
very careful out there.

fields.EN:
We'll be careful. If we go down, we won't be
able to bring the Blood Maidens back together.
fields.JP:
僕たちが倒れたら、もう血式少女を
再結集させられなくなるからね。
気をつけるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course we will. After all,
if we perish, there wouldn't
be anyone else left to fight.

fields.EN:
That's not it, Otsuu-chan. That matters too,
but more than anything, we just want everyone
to come back safely.
fields.JP:
そうじゃないよ、おつうちゃん。
そのことも大事だけど、何より
みんな無事で帰ってきてほしいだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just so you know, it's beyond
just losing. We simply want you
all to be safe.

fields.EN:
Yeah, no one wants to see
anyone hurt like before anymore.
fields.JP:
ああ、これ以上仲間が傷つくのは、
もう見たくないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, no one wants to see
anyone hurt like before anymore.

fields.EN:
And yet, we need to rely on
you all again. I'm truly sorry
you have to go through all this.
fields.JP:
それでも君たちに託すしかないのが、
本当に申し訳ないのだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, we need to rely on
you all again. I'm truly sorry
you have to go through all this.

fields.EN:
Ah, I see. I didn't know you
all felt that way. I'm sorry.
We'll be back safe, I promise.
fields.JP:
そっか……うん、ごめん。
心配してくれてありがとうみんな。
ちゃんと無事で帰ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I see. I didn't know you
all felt that way. I'm sorry.
We'll be back safe, I promise.

fields.EN: I'm sure you'll keep your promise.
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sure you'll keep your promise.

fields.EN:
By the way, how many of them
Blood Maidens are lost right now?
fields.JP:
それで探すっていう血式少女は、
何人いるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, how many of them
Blood Maidens are lost right now?

fields.EN:
Besides me and Princess,
there were six others in Dawn.
fields.JP: 僕と姫を除いて、黎明にはあと６人いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides me and Princess,
there were six others in Dawn.

fields.EN:
Akazukin is one of them.
She's the one who was back there
when we freed Mamoru.
fields.JP:
まずは『赤ずきん』……
マモルたちの解放に行った時に
一緒に行動してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood is one of them.
She's the one who was back there
when we freed Mamoru.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, we lost her in all
the chaos back then...
fields.JP:
でも、あの時の混乱で
離れ離れになっちゃってね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, we lost her in all
the chaos back then...

fields.EN:
I only saw them from a distance,
but they were all incredibly
strong, so I'm sure she'll be okay.
fields.JP:
遠目に見ただけだけど、
全員すげえ強かったから、
きっと大丈夫だって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember her hacking away
at the Marchens, so I'm pretty
sure she's okay.

fields.EN: Yup, I'm sure of it, too!
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, I'm sure of it, too!

fields.EN:
Of course, the other person
who was there that went missing
is Alice.
fields.JP:
それとこれも同じく、
一緒に行動していた『アリス』。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, the other person
who was there that went missing
is Alice.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ジャック……ああ、分かってるよ
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
As you can see, Alice is someone
very important to Jack. That's why
I want to make sure we find her.
fields.JP:
この通り、アリスはジャックの大切な人だ。
だから必ず見つけ出してあげたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you can see, Alice is very
important to Jack, so I would like
to find her as soon as possible.

fields.EN:
We were neighbors for a long
time, too. I can't treat this
like it has nothing to do with us.
fields.JP:
俺らも長いことお隣さんだったからな。
他人事とは思えねぇよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I was next to them back in
the cell, so I wouldn't mind
having her back, too.

fields.JP: うん。もう家族みたいなものだよね！

fields.EN:
We also had Kaguyahime.
I recall her staying behind at
the Dawn headquarters.
fields.JP:
そして次が『かぐや姫』。
彼女は黎明に残っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
We also had Kaguya.
I recall her staying behind at
the Dawn headquarters.

fields.EN:
Finally, the three sisters,
Oyayubihime, Shirayukihime, and
Nemurihime, to make six.
fields.JP:
そして『親指姫』『白雪姫』『眠り姫』の
三姉妹で、６人だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally, the three sisters,
Thumbelina, Snow White, and
Sleeping Beauty, to make six.

fields.EN:
But I'm not sure whether those
sisters would help our cause
or not.
fields.JP:
まあ、親指姫たち三姉妹は
協力してくれるか分からないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm not sure whether those
sisters would help our cause
or not.

fields.EN:
A bit...
In any case, I'll do my best.
fields.JP: ちょっとね……とにかく最善は尽くすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A bit...
In any case, I'll do my best.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you will. As for the
Aquarium Ruins, is there anywhere
there they could hide?
fields.JP:
そうしてくれると信じてるよ。
それで、水族館跡エリアには潜伏できそうな
場所ってのはあるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you will. As for the
Aquarium Ruins, is there anywhere
there they could hide?

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'm not sure there are
any really good hiding spots
there.
fields.JP:
うーん……潜伏できそうな場所って
言われると難しいけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'm not sure there are
any really good hiding spots
there.

fields.EN:
But, it is close to the former
Liberated District, so someone may
have run away there.
fields.JP:
でも元解放地区から近い水族館跡エリアは
逃げ込むのに最適とも言えるから、
もしかしたら誰かいるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it is close to the former
Liberated District, so someone may
have run away there.

fields.EN:
If no one fled this way, the
Aquarium Ruins—the only area
we can reach—look promising.
fields.JP:
こっち側に誰も逃げてきてないなら、
唯一行ける水族館跡エリアは
期待できそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since no one came this way,
I think it's safe to say someone
may be in hiding there.

fields.EN:
Looks like we have a bit of
hope now.
fields.JP:
よっしゃ、作戦が決まると
希望が出てくるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we have a bit of
hope now.

fields.EN:
Well then, we'll depart as soon
as we're ready.
fields.JP:
じゃあ準備ができ次第、
僕たちは出発するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, we'll depart as soon
as we're ready.

fields.JP:
あ……う、うん
大丈夫だよ、わたしは

fields.EN:
Everyone's doing their best,
so I need to do my best, too.
fields.JP:
みんな頑張ってるし、
わたしも負けてられないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone's doing their best,
so I need to do my best, too.

fields.EN:
Is there something on your mind
that you'd like to talk about,
Princess?
fields.JP:
姫、何か抱えてるなら
僕に相談をしてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there something on your mind
that you'd like to talk about,
Princess?

fields.EN:
Oh, no. Nothing at all.
I'm fine, really.
fields.JP:
ううん、本当に大丈夫だよ。
何も心配要らないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, no. Nothing at all.
I'm fine, really.

fields.JP:
そうか？
それならいいんだけど……

fields.EN:
(It's hard to see her faking such
an obvious front like that...)
fields.JP:
（その明るい振る舞いが
　空元気だって分かるだけに、つらいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's hard to see her faking such
an obvious front like that...)

fields.EN:
(Ningyohime can be a bit
stubborn at times, but...)
fields.JP:
（でもこういう時の人魚姫、
　頑固だからなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Little Mermaid can be a bit
stubborn at times, but...)

fields.EN:
I'm always on your side,
Princess. Please never forget that.
fields.JP:
いつだって僕は姫の味方だからね。
それだけは忘れないでほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please remember that I'm always
here by your side, Princess.

fields.EN:
The place is so quiet
and spooky...
fields.JP:
なんだか静まりかえってて
不気味だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place is so quiet
and spooky...

fields.EN: There may be a Nightmare around.
fields.JP:
ここにもナイトメアが
いるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED: There may be a Nightmare around.

fields.EN:
We've run into Nightmares so often lately
that we've gotten numb to them, but we
still need to watch out for Marchens, too.
fields.JP:
それに最近ナイトメアに
出会いすぎて麻痺してるけど、
メルヒェンだって気をつけないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
We know too well how dangerous
Nightmares are, but we need to be
careful of the Marchens, too.

fields.EN: Hah! I will crush them with ease!
fields.JP:
なに、そんな奴ら
ワレがすぐに粉砕してくれる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hah! I will crush them with ease!

fields.EN:
I'm counting on you.
But, we need to avoid battles that
can be avoided, okay?
fields.JP:
頼りにしてる……
けど、無駄な戦闘は避けないと
駄目だからな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm counting on you.
But, we need to avoid battles that
can be avoided, okay?

fields.EN:
Hmph!
You don't need to tell me that!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph!
You don't need to tell me that!

fields.EN:
Either the prisoners were
relocated, or they're already...
fields.JP:
囚人はどこかに連れ去られたか……
それとももう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Either the prisoners were
relocated, or they're already...

fields.EN:
Whatever the reason, it looks
like the place is deserted now.
fields.JP:
どっちにしろ、ここはもう
捨てられたようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever the reason, it looks
like the place is deserted now.

fields.EN:
It feels weird, especially since
this is where I met
Ningyohime...
fields.JP:
でも、ここで出会ったんだよな……
人魚姫とは
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels weird, especially since
this is where I met
Little Mermaid...

fields.EN:
Oh? She lived here, did she?
How interesting!
fields.JP:
ほう、人魚姫はここに住んでいたのか！
これは興味が湧くな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? She lived here, did she?
How interesting!

fields.EN: Did Ningyohime make a hideout like mine, too?
fields.JP:
やっぱりワレのように
隠れ家を作っていたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how did you make home
out of this place?

fields.EN: No, I didn't have a hideout...

I see, you didn't... Then how
did you and Otsuu become companions?
fields.JP:
そうか、ないのか……
では、おつうとはどのような感じで
仲間になったのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I see. Then how do you and
Otsuu meet?

fields.JP: さあワレに話すがいい！

fields.EN:
...We're in the middle of a mission
now, so I'll tell you once we're
back at the base, Haa-chan.
fields.JP:
……今は作戦中だから、
また拠点に戻ったら話すね、ハーちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll tell you later when we return
to our base, Hammy...

fields.EN:
Hm, is that so?
I trust you will keep your word.
fields.JP:
むぅ、そうであるか……
じゃあ約束だぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, is that so?
I trust you will keep your word.

fields.EN:
(Princess isn't well after all...
She's been like that for quite
some time now...)
fields.JP:
（姫……やっぱり元気がないな。
　ここのところずっとだから心配だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Princess isn't well after all...
She's been like that for quite
some time now...)

fields.EN:
Promise you'll tell me later!
Promise!
fields.JP: 絶対、絶対聞かせてもらうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Promise you'll tell me later!
Promise!

fields.JP: ちょっと待って、みんな
どうかしたの、おつうちゃん
辺りが白くなってきた……！

fields.EN:
Princess? I'm quite delighted
that you're hugging me like this,
but I can't move...
fields.JP:
姫？　嬉しいけど
そんなに抱きつかれたら動けない――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess? I'm quite delighted
that you're hugging me like this,
but I can't move...

fields.EN:
No...
I don't want to fight those
monsters any more...
fields.JP:
やだよ……
もうこんな化け物戦いたくないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No...
I don't want to fight those
monsters any more...

fields.EN:
(She's shaking...
I can even hear her heartbeat
pounding in frenzy...)
fields.JP:
（姫……こんなに震えて……
　それに心臓の音もすごい
　激しく伝わってくる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's shaking...
I can even hear her heartbeat
pounding in frenzy...)

fields.EN:
Don't you worry, Princess.
Just come and stand behind me.
fields.JP:
大丈夫ですよ姫。
さあ僕の後ろに下がっていてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry, Princess.
Just come and stand behind me.

fields.EN:
There's nothing for you to be
afraid of.
fields.JP:
はは、何にも怖いことなんて
ありませんからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing for you to be
afraid of.

fields.EN:
You two, give me a little time.
There's something I want to try.
fields.JP:
２人とも、ちょっと試したい
ことがあるから、少し時間をくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to test something out,
so let me handle this.

fields.EN:
You! Nightmare!
We have no intention of bringing
harm to you!
fields.JP:
そこのナイトメア！
僕たちは君に危害を加える気はない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You! Nightmare!
We have no intention of bringing
harm to you!

fields.EN:
(I was able to communicate with
Jack, so maybe I can communicate
with it, too!)
fields.JP:
（ジャックとは意思の疎通が図れたんだ、
　僕ならできるかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was able to communicate with
Jack, so maybe I can communicate
with it, too!)

fields.EN: Please, can you let us pass?
fields.JP:
だからどうかここを
通してくれないだろうか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Please, can you let us pass?

fields.EN:
There's no reason for us to
fight!
fields.JP:
僕たちは敵対する理由は
きっとないはずだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no reason for us to
fight!

fields.JP: グ、グルゥゥゥゥゥァアッ！

fields.EN:
Tch...
I guess it was worth the try...
fields.JP:
くっ……期待したけど、
駄目だったか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch...
I guess it was worth the try...

fields.EN:
(Does that mean there's something
different about Jack?)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりジャックだけが
　特別なんだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Does that mean there's something
different about Jack?)

fields.JP: 貴様、ワレを誰だと思っておる……

fields.EN:
Insolent fool!
I will crush you!
fields.JP: この無礼者め、叩き潰してくれる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Insolent fool!
I will crush you!

fields.EN:
Hameln!
There's no way to kill it!
fields.JP:
ハーメルン！
そいつは何をやっても死なないんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln!
There's no way to kill it!

fields.EN: You never know until you try!
fields.JP:
そんなこと、やってみなければ
分からないのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: You never know until you try!

fields.JP:
なっ！？
傷がすぐに塞がったぞ！？

fields.EN: I told you! That thing is immortal!
fields.JP:
だから言っただろう！
そいつは不死身なんだって！

fields.EN:
So what now?!
You better not be telling me
to run!
fields.JP:
じゃあどうすればいいのだ！？
まさか戦うなとでも言うつもりか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So what now?!
You better not be telling me
to run!

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, that's all
we can do! We need to run!
fields.JP:
ああ、そうだ。
コイツからは逃げるしかない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, that's all
we can do! We need to run!

fields.JP: ぬぬ……ワレが背中を向けるなど……！

fields.EN:
I understand how you feel,
but we need to run, now!
fields.JP:
気持ちは分かるけど、
今は逃げるぞハーメルン！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand how you feel,
but we need to run, now!

fields.EN:
Princess, let's go. There's no
way we can end our lives here.
fields.JP:
姫、さあ行くよ。こんなところで
終わるわけにはいかないだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, let's go. There's no
way we can end our lives here.

fields.JP:
みんなどうしてあんなことに……
もうイヤ……イヤだよぅ……！

fields.EN:
We tried so hard, and
everyone still dies... They die...!
fields.JP:
あんなに頑張っていたのに
みんな死んじゃう、死んじゃうよぉ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did so much, and yet everyone
keeps dying! Dying...!

fields.EN:
(That seals it... What she saw
back at Dawn traumatized her
badly.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりこの間の黎明での出来事に、
　かなりのショックを受けている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That seals it... What she saw
back at Dawn traumatized her
badly.)

fields.EN:
Hey, Otsuu!
I thought we were running!
fields.JP:
おいおつう！
逃げるのではなかったのか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Otsuu!
I thought we were running!

fields.EN:
Come on, Princess, stand up. If we
die here, everyone who died before
us will have died for nothing.
fields.JP:
ほら姫、立って。
ここで死んだらそれこそ
全員無駄死にだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please stand up, Princess.
We can't die here for the sake
of all that the other's have done.

fields.EN:
You're right...
I'm so sorry, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
そう……だよね。
ごめんね、おつうちゃん。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
I'm so sorry, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Tch! How degrading!
The next time we meet,
I will make you pay!
fields.JP:
くっ、なんという卑怯なやつめ！
いつか絶対その無礼を後悔させてやるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch! How degrading!
The next time we meet,
I will make you pay!

fields.JP:
ハーメルン、今だ！
こっちに来い！
まったく遅いぞおつう！

fields.EN:
Sorry about that.
Now, let's run!
fields.JP:
ああ、すまない！
じゃあとりあえず逃げるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry about that.
Now, let's run!

fields.JP: ようやく、振り切れたな……

fields.EN:
I can't believe there
was something that cowardly...
fields.JP: まさかあんな卑怯なやつがいるとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe that thing can't
be defeated...

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, that's the truth.
We just have to make sure we
avoid encountering it again.
fields.JP:
認めたくないけど、仕方ないんだ。
なんとか鉢合わせないように、
探索を続けていくしかない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, that's the truth.
We just have to make sure we
avoid encountering it again.

fields.EN:
How I wouldn't want to get this
expedition over with soon.
fields.JP: 早めに終わらせたいところだね、まったく
fields.LOCALIZED:
How I wouldn't want to get this
expedition over with soon.

fields.EN:
Princess?!
Get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP: 姫！　しっかりするんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess?!
Get a hold of yourself!

fields.JP: はぁーっ……はぁーっ……ふふっ
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
She's not entering her
Genocide state...
It's like Alice's one...
fields.JP:
これは、ジェノサイド化じゃない
アリスの時と同じ未知の変化……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's not entering her
Massacre state...
It's like Alice's one...

fields.JP:
姫！　人魚姫！
気をしっかり持つんだ！
はははっ……あはっ、ははっ……っ！

fields.EN:
I'm here for you.
Please, calm down...
fields.JP:
僕がついてるから。
大丈夫だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm here for you.
Please, calm down...

fields.JP: きゃはっ！　きゃはははっ！！
た、助かったハーメルン
ははっ……はは、はっ……あはぁっ

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what's happening, but
what I do know is that she isn't
the same Ningyohime I know.
fields.JP:
よくは分からないが、
人魚姫はまともではないようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what's happening, but
what I do know is that she isn't
the same Little Mermaid I know.

fields.EN:
Don't worry!
She's just panicking, that's all!
fields.JP:
これは、違うんだ……！
姫は一時的にちょっとパニックに
なってしまってるだけなんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry!
She's just panicking, that's all!

fields.EN:
You're companions, so I understand
why you want to believe that, Otsuu.
But Ningyohime's eyes say otherwise.
fields.JP:
仲間だからな、おつうがそう思いたい
気持ちは分かるぞ。だが人魚姫の目は
そうは言っておらん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand you wanting to cover
for her, but her eyes says
otherwise.

fields.EN:
I don't want to strike her
either, but if we do nothing,
we'll both perish, Otsuu!
fields.JP:
ワレも攻撃などしたくはないが、
黙っていたらやられるぞ、おつう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to strike her too,
but if we don't do something
we'll both perish!

fields.EN:
Please, stop...
Princess, please calm down...
fields.JP:
そんな、２人ともやめてくれ……
姫、頼むから正気に戻ってよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, stop...
Princess, please calm down...

fields.JP: きゃはっ！　きゃははっっっ！！

fields.EN:
Hey, are you really the same Ningyohime?!
What's with this strength...?!
fields.JP:
おい貴様、本当にいつもの人魚姫か！？
なんだこの強さは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?!
What's with her power?!

fields.EN:
Tch! I can't keep up...!
Why you...! Urgh!
fields.JP:
くっ……なんという動きっ……
このっ……うぐっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch! I can't keep up...!
Why you...! Urgh!

fields.EN: Don't worry, it's just a scratch.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だ、おつう。
こんなものかすり傷だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry, it's just a scratch.

fields.EN:
I'll buy some time for you,
so do something, quick!
fields.JP:
だからワレが時間を稼いでいるうちに、
どうするか早く決断するのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll buy some time for you,
so do something, quick!

fields.EN:
Tch... Princess, you have to
come to your senses!
Hameln's out friend!
fields.JP:
くっ……姫、どうか戻ってよ……！
ハーメルンは仲間だろ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... Princess, you have to
come to your senses!
Hameln's out friend!

fields.JP:
きゃはっ……ぁぁぁ……
…………きゃははははははっ！！
そっち行ったぞ、おつう！

それでも僕は
姫を攻撃なんてできない……！
ナイトメア・ジャック

ジャック……！
僕を、庇ってくれたのか……
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎちち……おづ……う……
み……まま……もももも……

fields.EN:
Urgh...!
I can feel his pain!
fields.JP: くっ……！！　痛みの感覚が……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh...!
I can feel his pain!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... That must have
hurt... You're bleeding badly...
fields.JP:
ごめんな……痛かったろう……！
血もこんなに噴き出して……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... That must have
hurt... You're bleeding badly...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Otsuu! Look!
Little Mermaid is...

fields.JP:
あれ……わた、し……
今何を……？

fields.EN: Princess... Are you... back to normal...?
fields.JP:
姫……元に……
戻ってくれたのか……？

fields.EN:
I don't know what happened, but
it's no surprise that she'd pass
out with the power she showed.
fields.JP:
よく分からぬが、
あれほどの力をいきなり振るえば、
反動で気絶してもおかしくはないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what happened, but
it's no surprise that she'd pass
out with the power she showed.

fields.EN:
Hameln...
I'm sorry, but can we return to
the base?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン……悪いんだけど、
一旦拠点に戻ってもいいかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln...
I'm sorry, but can we return to
the base?

fields.EN:
We can't exactly take Princess
with us like this, and more than
anything, I'm worried about her.
fields.JP:
このまま姫を連れて行く
わけにもいかないし、何より心配なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way she can come
with us with how she is now.

fields.EN:
I'm glad you brought it up.
I would've suggested the same.
fields.JP:
もちろんであるぞ。
貴様が言い出さなかったら
ワレが言い出すところだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you brought it up.
I would've suggested the same.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime is our friend,
so keeping her safe is our top
priority.
fields.JP:
なんせ仲間のピンチだからな。
人魚姫のことが最優先であるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid is our friend,
so keeping her safe is our top
priority.

fields.JP: ありがとうハーメルン……

fields.EN:
She's just unconscious,
that's all. But it'd be best for
her to rest for a while.
fields.JP:
気絶してるだけだから、大丈夫。
今はそっとしておこうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's just unconscious,
that's all. But it'd be best for
her to rest for a while.

fields.EN:
You scared us when you were
heaving Ningyohime back.
fields.JP:
いきなり人魚姫を背負って
戻ってきた時は肝を冷やしたぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You scared us when you were
heaving Little Mermaid back.

fields.EN:
In any case, we're glad you're
all safe.
fields.JP: 本当、無事でよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, we're glad you're
all safe.

fields.EN:
Hey, Otsuu.
So, what happened back at the
Aquarium Ruins?
fields.JP:
おい、おつう。
水族館跡エリアでいったい何があった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Otsuu.
So, what happened back at the
Aquarium Ruins?

fields.EN:
That made it the second time
I've seen that transformation,
and I still don't know what it is.
fields.JP:
見るのはこれで二度目だけど、
やっぱり僕の知らない変化だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That made it the second time
I've seen that transformation,
and I still don't know what it is.

fields.EN:
But that's not the point.
The point is, I couldn't do
anything to help...
fields.JP:
いや、そんなことどうでもいい
僕には何もできなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that's not the point.
The point is, I couldn't do
anything to help...

fields.EN:
All I could do was watch as
she went mad...!
fields.JP:
姫がおかしくなっていくのを、
ただ見ていることしかできなかったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I could do was watch as
she went mad...!

fields.EN:
Calm down.
It's not your fault.
fields.JP: 落ち着け。おまえのせいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down.
It's not your fault.

fields.EN:
Actually, I found records of
a similar phenomena that you
just described.
fields.JP:
……その現象に該当するだろう記述、
つい最近見たぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Actually, I found records of
a similar phenomena that you
just described.

fields.EN:
Yeah. It should be among the Professor's
documents we brought from the former
Liberated District... Ah, here it is.
fields.JP:
ああ。確か元・解放地区から持ってきた
博士の資料の中に……あ、あった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I believe I have it right
here with the other documents we
recovered from Dawn. Let's see...

fields.EN:
C-Calm down, Otsuu.
Let me get the papers together.
fields.JP: お、落ち着けおつう、ちゃんと教えるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
C-Calm down, Otsuu.
Let me get the papers together.

fields.EN:
It says here that Blood Maidens
enter a state called "Genocide"
when they are covered with blood.
fields.JP:
……まず血式少女には、血を多く浴びると
覚醒する『ジェノサイド化』がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
It says here that Blood Maidens
enter a state called "Massacre"
when they are covered with blood.

fields.EN:
That I know. Every Blood Maiden
who joined was taught that.
fields.JP:
ああ、それは知っている。
血式少女なら絶対に教わることだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That I know. Every Blood Maiden
who joined was taught that.

fields.EN:
It also says that there's one
other state to the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
そしてそれとは別に実はもう１つ、
血式少女には隠された現象がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also says that there's one
other state to the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
It's called "Blood Skelter."
Do you know this?
fields.JP:
それが『ブラッドスケルター化』……
だそうだ。聞いたことはあるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's called "Blood Skelter."
Do you know this?

fields.EN:
What...?
I never heard that before...
fields.JP:
知らない……！
そんなの、聞いたこともない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...?
I never heard that before...

fields.EN:
One enters Blood Skelter when
they accumulate "Corruption,"
often through intense stress.
fields.JP:
『ブラッドスケルター化』は、
極度のストレスにより溜まる『穢れ』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
One enters Blood Skelter when
they accumulate "Corruption,"
often through intense stress.

fields.EN:
So, it seems like Blood Maidens
awaken into that state when they
have too much Corruption in them.
fields.JP:
この『穢れ』が蓄積されている状態で、
覚醒すると発生してしまう、と記されている
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it seems like Blood Maidens
awaken into that state when they
have too much Corruption in them.

fields.EN:
Does that mean that
Ningyohime was under intense stress
the whole time?
fields.JP:
ってことは、人魚姫は極度のストレスに
さらされ続けていたってこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean that Little
Mermaid was under intense stress
the whole time?

fields.EN:
I believe so...
She was quite reclusive after the
destruction of Dawn.
fields.JP:
心当たりは……ある。
黎明での出来事から姫は
塞ぎっぱなしだったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe so...
She was quite reclusive after the
destruction of Dawn.

fields.EN:
So, her body kept accumulating
this Corruption thing...
fields.JP:
それで人魚姫はその『穢れ』ってやつを
溜め込んじまったってことか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, her body kept accumulating
this Corruption thing...

fields.EN:
Based on records and what has
happened thus far, I assume this
applies to all Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
記述と実際の出来事、
話を総合すると、これは君たち血式少女に
おそらく共通しているものだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Based on records and what has
happened thus far, I assume this
applies to all Blood Maidens.

fields.JP:
なんだよ……そんなの僕、
全然知らなかったよ……

fields.EN:
But, why wouldn't the professor
tell us that? I thought he trusted
us...
fields.JP:
どうして博士はそれを僕たちに
公表してくれなかったんだ？
僕たちは信用されてな――
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, why wouldn't the professor
tell us that? I thought he trusted
us...

fields.EN:
About that, the professor has
a classified file regarding
an experimental subject "S."
fields.JP:
博士の資料には、
被検体Ｓについてという項目がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
About that, the professor has
a classified file regarding
an experimental subject "S."

fields.EN:
I read through it, and...
I'm not surprised the professor
didn't disclose the information.
fields.JP:
その記述を見る限り、確かにこれは
公表できたものではないかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I read through it, and...
I'm not surprised the professor
didn't disclose the information.

fields.JP: 何よ、もったいつけた言い方すんなっての
そうだぜ、早く言えっての

fields.EN:
I wasn't planning on holding back
the information, but...
fields.JP:
そんなつもりはないんだが……
まあいい。そこにはこう書いてある
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't planning on holding back
the information, but...

fields.EN:
Apparently it was too dangerous to
actually carry out the experiment. The
record then refers to 'Test Subject S.'
fields.JP:
まず、危険なため実験には
踏み切れなかったらしい。
その上での被検体Ｓ、という記述だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It stated that the experiment he
had planned was dangerous, so he
didn't move forward with it.

fields.EN:
Yet, he had this classified, which
would mean that Blood Skelter was
something out of coincidence.
fields.JP:
つまりは偶然ブラッドスケルター状態が
発現してしまったのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yet, he had this classified, which
would mean that Blood Skelter was
something out of coincidence.

fields.EN:
And what does that mean? ...In the
end, all we've been able to do is observe.
fields.JP:
それが意味するところは何か？
……結局観測しか出来てないってことさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, this is all
speculation, but...

fields.EN: What are you trying to say?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you trying to say?

fields.EN:
There's no known way of exiting
Blood Skelter. The file has that
written in bold letters.
fields.JP:
何も分かっていないということだ。
元に戻る方法は『現在のところナシ』と
はっきり記されている
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no known way of exiting
Blood Skelter. The file has that
written in bold letters.

fields.EN:
Wait...
So, if someone enters
Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
じゃあ１度『ブラッドスケルター化』
してしまったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...
So, if someone enters
Blood Skelter...

fields.JP: もう戻らないってのか？

fields.EN:
You have to be kidding...
We hold that risk inside of us?
fields.JP:
なんだよそれ……
そんな性質を秘めているっていうのか、
僕たち血式少女っていうのは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have to be kidding...
We hold that risk inside of us?

fields.EN:
Wait! Me too?!
That's quite a pain.
fields.JP:
もしかしてワレもなのか！？
それはちと……困る
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait! Me too?!
That's quite a pain.

fields.EN:
Wait a second. Princess is back to
normal. She's already out of this
Blood Skelter thing, right?
fields.JP:
待ってくれ。姫は今、
落ち着きを取り戻している。
それでもブラッドスケルター中なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a second. Princess is back to
normal. She's already out of this
Blood Skelter thing, right?

fields.EN:
I don't know... Judging from the
symptoms I'd like to say it's gone,
but it may only be lying dormant.
fields.JP:
それは……どうだろう。
症状的には解除されたと言いたいけど、
でも潜伏してるだけかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't say for sure.
I suppose she is "out" of it,
but it could come back again.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but that's about all
I can say for now.
fields.JP: はっきりと言えなくてすまない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but that's about all
I can say for now.

fields.EN:
But, she is okay now, right?
That means she's all right.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、今は大丈夫なんだろ？
なら人魚姫はもう大丈夫だろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she is okay now, right?
That means she's all right.

fields.EN: Yup, I'm sure she's okay now.
fields.JP: うん、人魚姫は戻っているよ、絶対
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, I'm sure she's okay now.

fields.EN:
I would love to say that, too.
But, I want to be sure as one
wrong move could spell doom.
fields.JP:
もちろんそう思いたいけどな。
でもこればかりは、下手に判断すると
取り返しがつかなくなる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would love to say that, too.
But, I want to be sure as one
wrong move could spell doom.

fields.EN:
So, you're assuming it's
still inside her then...
fields.JP: 仮に潜伏していたら……ってことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're assuming it's
still inside her then...

fields.EN:
For Princess's peace of mind, I want
to determine her condition for certain...
fields.JP:
姫を安心させるためにも、
はっきりとさせてあげたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would like to get her state
clarified for the sake of her
and everyone.

fields.JP: わたしなら、もう大丈夫です

fields.EN:
Princess?!
What are you doing here?!
fields.JP: 姫！　どうして起きてきたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess?!
What are you doing here?!

fields.EN: You should rest a bit longer.
fields.JP: そうだよ、今は安静にしていた方がいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You should rest a bit longer.

fields.EN:
She's right. I can tell you what
we conversed later, so please
rest a bit more.
fields.JP:
この話は後で必ず君にも伝える。
だから今は休んでおいた方がいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. I can tell you what
we conversed later, so please
rest a bit more.

fields.EN:
No, I want to explain what
happened to me...
fields.JP:
いいえ、今お話ししたいのです。
わたしに起こったこと、ぜんぶ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I want to explain what
happened to me...

fields.EN:
I suppose arguing isn't an option.
Fine... But, I need you to rest if
you don't feel well, understood?
fields.JP:
仕方ない。では具合が悪くなったら
すぐに横になるんだ。　いいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose arguing isn't an option.
Fine... But, I need you to rest if
you don't feel well, understood?

fields.EN:
It's... hard to explain.
This "Blood Skelter" I overheard
brought darkness to my soul.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化、
というものになった時、わたしは
言い知れぬ心の闇に飲まれました
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's... hard to explain.
This "Blood Skelter" I overheard
brought darkness to my soul.

fields.EN:
I felt my body flaring up,
and my vision started to blur.
I couldn't tell what was going on.
fields.JP:
頭の芯がのぼせたように熱くて、
目の前のことがぼんやりとしか
認識できない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt my body flaring up,
and my vision started to blur.
I couldn't tell what was going on.

fields.EN:
The only emotion left was the
desire to destroy everything in
front of me. That was all...
fields.JP:
残った感情は、
目の前のものを破壊し尽くしたい。
ただ、それだけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I could tell was that
I felt the urge to... destroy.

fields.EN:
But when Jack-san's blood splattered
on me, I felt the darkness
disappearing for within me...
fields.JP:
ですが、偶然にも
ジャックさんの血を浴びた瞬間、
そんな心の闇がすっと消えていったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when Jack's blood splattered
on me, I felt the darkness
disappearing for within me...

fields.EN:
The destructive urge subsided, and I
went back to being able to see the people
important to me as important again.
fields.JP:
破壊衝動は収まり、ちゃんと大事なひとを
大事だと思えるように戻ったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
My sense of destruction was
quelled, and I was able to
remember who my friends are again.

fields.EN:
That's why I was able to somehow
avoid harming Otsuu-chan and Haa-chan...
fields.JP:
だからおつうちゃんも
ハーちゃんも、傷つけずに済んだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I was able to somehow
avoid harming Otsuu and Hammy...

fields.EN:
So, Jack's blood was the catalyst
in bringing you back to normal?
fields.JP: ジャックの血が、人魚姫を正常に戻した？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Jack's blood was the catalyst
in bringing you back to normal?

fields.EN:
It looks like you saved me again.
Thank you, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、また助けてくれたのね。
ありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like you saved me again.
Thank you, Jack...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
So, we're talking about the blood
from Nightmares?
fields.JP: つまりはナイトメアの血ってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we're talking about the blood
from Nightmares?

fields.EN:
Well, let's extract blood from
Jack. You think he'd mind if
I did that, Otsuu?
fields.JP:
よし、ジャックの血を採取してみよう。
おつう、採血しても大丈夫だな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's extract blood from
Jack. You think he'd mind if
I did that, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
Well...
It seems he's okay with that.
fields.JP: ああ、うん……大丈夫、みたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well...
It seems he's okay with that.

fields.EN:
Very well.
Jack, just bear with me...
fields.JP: じゃあジャック、ちょっと血をもらうぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well.
Jack, just bear with me...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack said you can take more
blood from him.
fields.JP:
ジャックが、
もっと血を採ってもいいってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack said you can take more
blood from him.

fields.EN:
No, this should suffice.
Thank you, Jack.
fields.JP:
いや、これだけで大丈夫だ。
ありがとうジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, this should suffice.
Thank you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Now then... Otsuu? Hameln?
Show me your palms.
fields.JP:
じゃあおつう、ハーメルン。
２人ともちょっと手を出してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then... Otsuu? Hameln?
Show me your palms.

fields.EN:
There...
Do you feel anything different
with his blood on your hands?
fields.JP:
どうだ？　手にかけられて、
何か変化はあるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There...
Do you feel anything different
with his blood on your hands?

fields.EN:
Mmm... I think I feel a bit
lighter?
fields.JP:
うーむ……何か軽くなったような気が
するようなしないような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I think I feel a bit
lighter?

fields.EN:
I guess I feel a bit better
inside, like a bit of stress
is going away.
fields.JP:
なんとなく心の淀んだ感じが
なくなった気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I feel a bit better
inside, like a bit of stress
is going away.

fields.EN:
I suppose neither of you are in
Blood Skelter, so there's no way
to confirm its effects yet.
fields.JP:
まあブラッドスケルター化してないから、
はっきりとは分からない……か
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose neither of you are in
Blood Skelter, so there's no way
to confirm its effects yet.

fields.EN:
But I can tell it did
something to me.
fields.JP: でもやっぱり効果はある気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I can tell it did
something to me.

fields.EN:
(And, even if it had some effect,
I'd rather not have this used
as some form of means...)
fields.JP:
（でも効果があるとしても、
　あまりしたくないかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And, even if it had some effect,
I'd rather not have this used
as some form of means...)

fields.EN:
(When I can feel Jack's heart being
shaken while his blood is being drawn...)
fields.JP:
（血を抜かれたジャックの心が、
　揺さぶられているのを
　感じてしまうとね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After all, I could tell how Jack
felt while his blood was being
extracted from him...)

fields.EN:
We don't have the proper
equipment, so I can't evaluate
his blood sample.
fields.JP:
今は機材がないから、ジャックの
血液成分を分析することができない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have the proper
equipment, so I can't evaluate
his blood sample.

fields.EN:
But taking Ningyohime's and Otsuu's
accounts together, we can expect a
certain Corruption-dissipating effect.
fields.JP:
だが人魚姫やおつうの話を総合すると、
穢れに対して一定の消失効果に期待が持てる
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, my theory is that it does
have some effect on Corruption
based on your feedback.

fields.EN:
I'll make sure we don't rely too
much on Jack's blood, so I'd love
to test his blood out further.
fields.JP:
だから深追いしない程度に、
これから試していってもらえないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll make sure we don't rely too
much on Jack's blood, so I'd love
to test his blood out further.

fields.EN:
Right... But we need to make sure we don't
borrow too much of Jack-san's blood...
fields.JP:
そうですね……でもジャックさんの血を
借りすぎないようにしないとですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, as long as we don't draw
too much blood from him...

fields.EN:
Yes, I'd rather not inconvenience
Jack as much as possible.
fields.JP:
うん、なるべくならジャックに
迷惑はかけたくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'd rather not inconvenience
Jack as much as possible.

fields.EN:
Drawing blood out is one thing,
but doing so does take a toll on
his mental state.
fields.JP:
血を抜くって行為はもちろんだけど、
何より精神的負担をかけてしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Drawing blood out is one thing,
but doing so does take a toll on
his mental state.

fields.EN:
Yes, and I don't think we want
to abuse Jack-san's kindness...
fields.JP:
優しいジャックさんに
そんな負担はかけたくないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and I don't think we want
to abuse Jack's kindness...

fields.EN:
I guess the best thing is
for us to avoid entering our
Blood Skelter state.
fields.JP:
だから『ブラッドスケルター化』には
細心の注意を払うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess the best thing is
for us to avoid entering our
Blood Skelter state.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
That's an impressive
way to sleep...
fields.JP: 相変わらずジャックは器用に寝るなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's an impressive
way to sleep...

fields.EN:
I better get some rest, too.
There's nothing to laugh at
about not having enough sleep.
fields.JP:
僕もそろそろ寝ないとな。
寝不足なんて笑えないしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better get some rest, too.
There's nothing to laugh at
about not having enough sleep.

fields.EN:
I suppose it'd be best to
leave Princess behind on the
next expedition.
fields.JP:
やはり次の探索には
姫は連れて行かない方がいいよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose it'd be best to
leave Princess behind on the
next expedition.

fields.EN:
If she goes berserk like the last
time, she'll start blaming
herself again.
fields.JP:
またブラッドスケルター化したら、
たぶん姫は更に自分を責めるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she goes berserk like the last
time, she'll start blaming
herself again.

fields.EN:
Even if she doesn't go wild,
just being out there can bring
back bad memories.
fields.JP:
たとえブラッドスケルター化しなくても、
探索に行けば色々嫌なことを
思い出させてしまいそうだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if she doesn't go wild,
just being out there can bring
back bad memories.

fields.JP: おつうちゃん……起きてるよね？
姫？　うん、起きてるよ

fields.EN:
Is there a problem?
If you're having trouble sleeping
I can...
fields.JP:
どうしましたか、姫。
眠れないのでしたら僕がそばに――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a problem?
If you're having trouble sleeping
I can...

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan...
I'm going out on the next
expedition no matter what.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……わたし、
次の探索行くからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu...
I'm going out on the next
expedition no matter what.

fields.EN:
Are you sure? You're not in the
best shape possible yet.
You don't need to overdo yourself.
fields.JP:
……大丈夫なのかい？　まだ体調
戻ってないなら、無理しなくても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure? You're not in the
best shape possible yet.
You don't need to overdo yourself.

fields.EN:
...I understand that you don't want me to go,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
……おつうちゃんがわたしを
行かせたくないのは分かるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand that you'd rather
have me stay behind...

fields.EN:
I won't deny that...
I don't want you to come with us.
fields.JP:
……うん。
僕は姫を次の探索には行かせたくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't deny that...
I don't want you to come with us.

fields.EN:
I don't want to see you get hurt.
So, can you please stay behind,
for me?
fields.JP:
もう姫が傷つくのは見たくないんだ。
だからどうか、残ってくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to see you get hurt.
So, can you please stay behind,
for me?

fields.EN:
I'm really happy you feel that way,
Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんのその気持ち、
とっても嬉しいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really appreciate your thoughts.
I really do...

fields.EN: But Otsuu-chan, when you and I first met...
fields.JP:
でもね、わたしとおつうちゃんが
初めて出会ったあの時……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, do you remember what you
said when we first met?

fields.EN:
You were the one who said you wanted us to
become husband and wife, right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
夫婦になりたいって言ってくれたのは、
おつうちゃんだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said that you wanted us
to become a family, right?
A husband and wife...

fields.EN:
Well yes, but what does
that have to...
fields.JP:
それはそうだけど、
どうして今その話を……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well yes, but what does
that have to...

fields.EN:
Husband and wife are supposed to stay
together, no matter when or what happens.
fields.JP:
夫婦というものは、いつ如何なる時でも
一緒にいなければいけないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
People become husbands and
wives so that they become as one.

fields.EN:
So no matter what hardships they face,
they're supposed to overcome them together.
fields.JP:
だからたとえどんな困難にぶつかろうとも、
一緒に乗り越えなければいけないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That also means that, no matter
what happens, they need to stay
together.

fields.EN:
That's what it means to
be husband and wife, you know?
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what it means to be
bound together as a family.

fields.JP:
おつうちゃんの
プロポーズは本気だったって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You proposed to me back then,
to become husband and wife.

fields.EN:
You are serious about it, right?
Or, am I just being delusional?
fields.JP:
そう思ってるのは
わたしだけじゃ……ないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are serious about it, right?
Or, am I just being delusional?

fields.EN:
Well then, I'm going with you.
We need to overcome the perils
together, right?
fields.JP:
じゃあわたしも探索に行く。
一緒に、この困難を乗り越えよう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I'm going with you.
We need to overcome the perils
together, right?

fields.EN:
I've already decided. You're
someone precious to me, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
もう決めたの。おつうちゃんは
わたしにとって大事なひと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to make me stay.
You're someone special to me,
Otsuu.

fields.EN:
All the more reason why I need
to go with you.
fields.JP: だからわたしは、一緒に行くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the more reason why I need
to go with you.

fields.EN:
(Once she has her mind set
nothing will make her budge...)
fields.JP:
（姫はこうなったら
　決して譲らないんだよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Once she has her mind set
nothing will make her budge...)

fields.EN:
...All right. I'll prove that our
marriage vow is real. Princess,
let's go exploring together.
fields.JP:
……分かったよ。
夫婦の誓いが本物だと証明する。
姫、一緒に探索に行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I'll prove to you that my
proposal was serious. We'll
go on the expedition together.

fields.JP:
本当にっ？
ありがとう、おつうちゃんっ！

fields.EN:
Whoa! Princess! Calm down!
You're going to wake Jack up.
fields.JP:
わわっ、姫っ！？　そんなにはしゃいだら
ジャックが起きちゃうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Princess! Calm down!
You're going to wake Jack up.

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I was just so happy, so...
fields.JP: ごめんなさい、嬉しくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I was just so happy, so...

fields.EN:
You're right. I don't want to
wake up Jack-san, too.
fields.JP: 寝ているジャックさんを起こしちゃ悪いよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. I don't want to
wake up Jack, too.

fields.EN:
Then, Otsuu-chan, see you tomorrow.
Good night.
fields.JP:
じゃあおつうちゃん、
また明日ね。おやすみなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, good night.
See you in the morning.

fields.EN:
I haven't seen her smile like
that in a while...
I guess this ended well for now.
fields.JP:
姫に少し笑顔が戻ったな……
なら、これでよかったのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't seen her smile like
that in a while...
I guess this ended well for now.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, Dawn told
me that I proposed to her
because of my Blood Libido, but...
fields.JP:
でも夫婦になろうって話、
後で黎明では『血式リビドー』の
せいだって言われたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, Dawn told
me that I proposed to her
because of my Blood Libido, but...

fields.EN:
There's no way I proposed to
her just because of my primal
urge within me...
fields.JP:
そんな血式少女の個々の衝動が
僕に夫婦になろうって言わせただなんて、
あるわけないじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way I proposed to
her just because of my primal
urge within me...

fields.EN:
I said it because it was you,
Princess, and I know you feel the same way!
fields.JP:
だって僕は相手が姫だったから
言ったんだし、姫だって
そう思ってくれてる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I proposed to her because it
was Princess, and she also
knows that.

fields.EN:
That's right... It's not because
of my Blood Libido...
fields.JP:
そう、これは決して
『血式リビドー』なんてものじゃないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right... It's not because
of my Blood Libido...

fields.EN:
That's exactly why I'm so weak when
Princess says things like that to me...
fields.JP:
だからこそ、あんな風に
姫に言われると弱いよなぁ……僕
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, maybe it does have
to do with how I can't seem to
fight back against her...

fields.EN:
That's right... Princess and
I vowed to become husband and wife.
fields.JP:
そうだよな……
僕と姫は夫婦を誓い合ったんだよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case...
I did propose to her, but...

fields.EN:
Thinking back, I can't believe
I asked her for her hand in
marriage like that...
fields.JP:
にしても、今思うと何でいきなり僕は
あんな大胆なことを言えたんだろう～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking back, I can't believe
I asked her for her hand in
marriage like that...

fields.EN:
Thinking about it is so
embarrassing...!
fields.JP:
思い出すほどなんて言うか、
恥ずかしい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking about it is so
embarrassing...!

fields.JP: よし、みんな準備はいいな？
ふはは、ワレは待ちくたびれたぞ！
大丈夫……準備はできてるよ

fields.EN:
(She seemed so happy last night,
but I guess the pressure is still
hard on her.)
fields.JP:
（昨日の夜は喜んでいたけど、いざ出発
　となるとやっぱり不安なんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She seemed so happy last night,
but I guess the pressure is still
hard on her.)

fields.JP:
（まあいいさ。一緒に乗り越える、
　そう決めたんだから）

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Itsuki?
Did we forget something?
fields.JP:
どうしたイツキ、慌てて追いかけてきて。
僕たち忘れ物はないぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Itsuki?
Did we forget something?

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff... I just... wanted
to show everyone some things we
found from the professor's files.
fields.JP:
ぜぇっ……ぜぇっ……
いや、博士の新しい資料を見つけたから、
出る前に見せておきたいと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff... I just... wanted
to show everyone some things we
found from the professor's files.

fields.EN:
Yeah, it had something about
a "core" found in each prison
area.
fields.JP:
ああ。資料によると、各ダンジョンの
独房エリアにはどうやら『核』と
呼ばれるものがあるらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it had something about
a "core" found in each prison
area.

fields.EN:
And it says that destroying the
core removes the Nightmare's immortality...
fields.JP:
で、その核を破壊すると、
なんとナイトメアの不死性を消せると……
そう記載されているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It says that you can make the
Nightmare there vulnerable
by destroying this "core" thing.

fields.EN:
What luck! I'm glad you brought
this up to us before we left.
fields.JP:
それってかなりすごい発見じゃないか！
出発前に聞いておけてよかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What luck! I'm glad you brought
this up to us before we left.

fields.EN:
Yeah, that's why I came after you
guys. Figure this could mean
life or death, y'know?
fields.JP:
ああ。これを知ると知らないとじゃ
生死を分けるからな……だから追ってきた。
間に合ってよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, that's why I came after you
guys. Figure this could mean
life or death, y'know?

fields.EN:
Hm... So that means I can
now eke judgment out of that
insolent fool before.
fields.JP:
ほう……あの無礼者に
ワレの鉄槌をついに喰らわせてやれるのだな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... So that means I can
now eke judgment out of that
insolent fool before.

fields.EN:
Well done, Itsuki!
I praise thee!
fields.JP:
イツキよ！
褒めてつかわそうっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well done, Itsuki!
I praise thee!

fields.EN:
There is hope after all,
especially now that we know we can
actually defeat those monsters!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアを倒す手段がある……
一気に希望が湧いてきたな、みんな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is hope after all,
especially now that we know we can
actually defeat those monsters!

fields.JP:
ふははっ！
やってやろうぞ、おつう！

fields.EN:
Don't worry!
We're going to do this, together!
fields.JP:
ううん、大丈夫！
一緒に乗り越えようね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry!
We're going to do this, together!

fields.EN:
Oh? Seems like she's ready, too!
No need to stall any longer!
fields.JP:
おっ、人魚姫もやる気ではないか！
では乗り込むぞ貴様ら！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Seems like she's ready, too!
No need to stall any longer!

fields.EN:
(Is Princess really going to be
okay? But, she was serious about
what she said last night...)
fields.JP:
（大丈夫かなぁ……姫。
　でも昨日の夜のあれは、
　本気だったしな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is Princess really going to be
okay? But, she was serious about
what she said last night...)

fields.JP: よし、今度こそ出発だみんな！

fields.EN:
If you have something you want
to say, you should say it properly.
fields.JP:
言いたいことがあるなら、
ちゃんと言った方がいいのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should speak louder
if you want people to hear you.

fields.EN:
Something I want to say...?
No, nothing in particular...
fields.JP:
言いたいこと……？
ううん、特にないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speak louder...?
Well, there isn't anything I want
to say right now.

fields.EN:
Then you're far too listless. You
should say what's on your mind properly!
fields.JP:
それにしては随分と
元気がなさ過ぎるのだ。
ちゃんと言った方がいいのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's odd. You sure look like
you have something on your mind.
What is it?

fields.EN:
Well, nothing...
Nothing that needs to be said...
fields.JP:
ううん、本当に
言いたいことないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, nothing...
Nothing that needs to be said...

fields.EN:
Come now! All you need to do
is to raise your voice and
yell what's inside you!
fields.JP:
駄目だー！
とにかく、大きな声を出して
叫んでみれば分かるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now! All you need to do
is to raise your voice and
yell what's inside you!

fields.EN:
That's right! It feels great to
let all that inside you go!
You can say whatever you please!
fields.JP:
そうだ！　大声で叫ぶとな、
とってもスッキリとするのだ！
言葉は何だっていいのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! It feels great to
let all that inside you go!
You can say whatever you please!

fields.EN:
If it's embarrassing,
then I extend my offer
to yell with you!
fields.JP:
そして１人が恥ずかしいと言うなら、
ワレが特別に一緒にやってやるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's embarrassing,
then I extend my offer
to yell with you!

fields.EN:
Say anything!
Yelling, by itself, will make you
feel better!
fields.JP:
とにかく何でもいいのだ！
叫べばそれでスッキリだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say anything!
Yelling, by itself, will make you
feel better!

fields.EN:
Okay, let me try...
Um, can you yell with me then?
fields.JP:
……分かった、やってみる。
一緒にお願いしてもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let me try...
Um, can you yell with me then?

fields.EN: Of course! Now imitate me and shout it out!
fields.JP:
もちろんだ！
ではワレをマネて叫ぶのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course!
Now, copy what I say,
but in your own words!

fields.JP: ワレこそは勇者ハーメルンであるぞー！
わ、われこそは勇者人魚姫であるぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I am the hero,
Little Mermaid!

fields.EN:
What?! I'm the hero!
That's not your title!
fields.JP:
なっ！？　勇者はワレなのだ！
人魚姫は使っては駄目なのだー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! I'm the hero!
That's not your title!

fields.EN:
I am the great hero,
Hameln!
fields.JP: ワレこそは大勇者ハーメルンであるぞー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the great hero,
Hameln!

fields.EN:
I am the great hero,
Ningyohime!
fields.JP: われこそは大勇者人魚姫であるぞー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the great hero,
Little Mermaid!

fields.EN: You took the Great Hero too!

You're the one who said to
copy you...
fields.JP:
ハーメルンが真似ろって
言ったんだろうに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the one who said to
copy you...

fields.EN:
And... do you mind I ask what
you're both doing?
fields.JP: というか、２人とも何をしてるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... do you mind I ask what
you're both doing?

fields.JP: な！　スッキリするであろう！？

fields.EN:
...You're right! Why was I
worrying about it all by myself?!
fields.JP:
……そうだよね！
わたし何を１人で悩んでいたんだろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
Why was I all down on myself
earlier?

fields.EN:
Well, all is good so long as what
you do brings a smile to your
face, Princess.
fields.JP: でも姫が笑顔になったのなら……よかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, all is good so long as what
you do brings a smile to your
face, Princess.

fields.EN:
Oh?!
Otsuu, perhaps that there is...
fields.JP:
おおっ！？
おつう、もしかしてあれではないのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh?!
Otsuu, perhaps that there is...

fields.EN:
Yes...
That has to be the core!
fields.JP:
……これだ。
これが核に違いない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes...
That has to be the core!

fields.JP: ついに見つけたんだね！

fields.EN:
Once we destroy this core,
we'll be able to defeat the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
あとはこの核を破壊すれば、
僕たちはナイトメアに勝てるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we have to do now is destroy
it so that we can make the
Nightmare vulnerable!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack? What's the matter?
Is there something bothering you?
fields.JP:
ジャック……？　どうしたんだ？
何か気になることでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? What's the matter?
Is there something bothering you?

fields.EN:
Don't you dare lay a finger on
Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP: おつうちゃんに手を出すなーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you dare lay a finger on
Otsuu!

fields.JP: すごい馬鹿でかい声だな……！

fields.EN:
Hahaha! And, I suppose it is
because of me!
Well done, Ningyohime!
fields.JP:
ふはは、ワレの教えのタマモノだな！
いいぞ人魚姫っ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! And, I suppose it is
because of me!
Well done, Little Mermaid!

fields.EN:
I'm not going to lose any more
of those precious to me...!
fields.JP:
もう、わたしは目の前の大事なひとを
決して失ったりしない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not going to lose any more
of those precious to me...!

fields.EN: So, Otsuu-chan, let's all fight together!!
fields.JP: だからおつうちゃんたち、一緒に戦おう！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Everyone, let's get rid of it!

fields.EN:
Well said, Ningyohime!
I shall fight alongside you!
fields.JP:
よく言ったぞ人魚姫！
ワレとともに戦おうではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said, Little Mermaid!
I shall fight alongside you!

fields.EN:
I suppose there's no way to hold
my dear princess back once she's
like this...
fields.JP:
まったく、姫はこういう時
頑固だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose there's no way to hold
my dear princess back once she's
like this...

fields.EN:
And...
I wouldn't want it any other way!
fields.LOCALIZED:
And...
I wouldn't want it any other way!

fields.JP: 姫、動きのキレが違ってたよ

fields.EN:
Indeed!
I knew I could count on you!
fields.JP: うむ。一緒に戦っていて頼もしかったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
I knew I could count on you!

fields.EN:
Really? Th-Thank you...
This is so embarrassing...
fields.JP:
そう？　あ、ありがとう……
でも、ちょっと恥ずかしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? Th-Thank you...
This is so embarrassing...

fields.EN:
Now then, let's get rid of this
core before the Nightmare
shows up.
fields.JP:
よし、ナイトメアが来る前に
核を破壊しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's get rid of this
core before the Nightmare
shows up.

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
Is it because...
we destroyed the core?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it because...
we destroyed the core?

fields.EN:
I suppose so...
It sounded like the Jail
was wailing...
fields.JP:
たぶんそうだろう……
これはきっとジェイルの悲鳴だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose so...
It sounded like the Jail
was wailing...

fields.EN:
Okay...
We should be able to defeat
the Nightmare now.
fields.JP:
よし……これでナイトメアを
倒せるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay...
We should be able to defeat
the Nightmare now.

fields.JP: ふはは、次に会った時が楽しみだぞ……！

fields.EN: Let us go, and find that...
fields.JP: よし、じゃあ早速倒しにだな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Let us go, and find that...

fields.EN:
Haa-chan!
Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
ハーちゃん、
今回は本当にありがとう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy!
Thank you so very much!

fields.JP:
な、なんだいきなり。
ワレは何もしておらぬぞ……？

fields.EN:
That's not true!
Haa-chan, you helped me a lot!
fields.JP:
ううん、そんなことないよ！
ハーちゃんにわたし、すっごく助けられたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true!
You helped me, a lot!

fields.JP: ワレはいつのまに助けてたのだ！？

fields.EN:
I was nervous about the Nightmare,
Blood Skelter, and things...
fields.JP:
ナイトメア、それにブラッドスケルター……
色んなことでわたし、ずっと不安だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was nervous about the Nightmare,
Blood Skelter, and things...

fields.EN:
But remember when you told me
we should shout together, Haa-chan?
fields.JP:
でもハーちゃんが一緒に大声で叫ぼう、
って言ってくれた時にね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you remember when you told
me to yell along with you?

fields.EN:
It was then it dawned on me that
I don't need to carry all my
worries alone.
fields.JP:
わたし、どうして
一人で悩んでいたんだろうって思ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was then it dawned on me that
I don't need to carry all my
worries alone.

fields.EN:
So I followed your lead, Haa-chan, and
shouted out, 'I want to protect Otsuu-chan!'
fields.JP:
だからね、ハーちゃんに習って
大きな声で『おつうちゃんを守りたい！』
って想いを口にしたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I yelled back then
with all my heart that I was
going to protect Otsuu.

fields.EN:
And you know what?
All that worry and anxiety I had
just went away like nothing.
fields.JP:
そうしたらね？　今までの不安が嘘みたいに
すーっと心が軽くなったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you know what?
All that worry and anxiety I had
just went away like nothing.

fields.EN:
I see...
So, you overcame your inner
worries and fears...
fields.JP: そっか……不安に打ち勝ったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
So, you overcame your inner
worries and fears...

fields.EN:
I sure did! I made sure I yelled
loud, and guess what? I was able
to move freely like never before.
fields.JP:
色んな不安に勝てたよ。声に出せたよ。
すくんでた身体、動いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sure did! I made sure I yelled
loud, and guess what? I was able
to move freely like never before.

fields.EN:
Yes, and I can vouch that you were
amazingly strong and beautiful
like never before.
fields.JP:
うん。姫はこれまでで最高に強く、
頼もしく、そして格好良かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and I can vouch that you were
amazingly strong and beautiful
like never before.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: See? Even Jack agrees with me.
fields.JP: ほら、ジャックも「その通りだ」って
fields.LOCALIZED: See? Even Jack agrees with me.

fields.EN:
And it's all thanks to Haa-chan.
Thank you for teaching me how to
overcome my anxieties.
fields.JP:
本当にハーちゃんのおかげだね。
不安は必ず出るもので、解消するもの……
それに気づかせてくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
And it's all thanks to Hammy.
Thank you for teaching me how to
overcome my anxieties.

fields.EN:
Uh... Wh-Why, of course!
I knew my words would help you!
fields.JP:
そ、そうであろう、そうであろう！
いやはや、ワレの助言はバッチリだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Wh-Why, of course!
I knew my words would help you!

fields.EN:
You don't know what she's saying
right, Hameln?
fields.JP: ハーメルン、絶対分かってないだろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't know what she's saying
right, Hameln?

fields.EN:
Of course I do!
I know exactly whyat she's saying!
fields.JP:
わ、分かっておるわ！
そにょくらいっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I do!
I know exactly whyat shez shaying!

fields.EN:
(There she goes again...
Yeah, she's completely clueless.)
fields.JP:
（あ、噛んでる。
　やっぱ分かってないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There she goes again...
Yeah, she's completely clueless.)

fields.EN:
What was all that worrying about?
If only I knew sooner.
fields.JP:
あーあ。こんな簡単なことだったなんて。
もっと早く気づいてればよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
What was all that worrying about?
If only I knew sooner.

fields.EN:
No, I think you found out at the
best of times.
fields.JP: いや、最高のタイミングだったさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I think you found out at the
best of times.

fields.EN:
Oh, but I need to apologize
to you, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
で、でもね、わたしおつうちゃんに
謝らなくちゃいけないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I need to apologize
to you, Otsuu!

fields.EN:
I don't believe there's anything
for you to apologize about.
fields.JP: 謝ることなんて何もないと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't believe there's anything
for you to apologize about.

fields.EN:
Well... You know when I said
we were going to go through
this together?
fields.JP:
ううん……この前わたし、
夫婦は困難を一緒に乗り越えるって、
そう言ったでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... You know when I said
we were going to go through
this together?

fields.EN:
And yet, Otsuu-chan, I couldn't properly
tell you how worried I was...
fields.JP:
なのにわたし、おつうちゃんに
ちゃんと不安を打ち明けられなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, I didn't tell you how
worried I was inside...

fields.EN:
That was really unfair and wrong.
I'm so sorry...
fields.JP:
それはとてもずるいことなの。
本当に、ごめんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was really unfair and wrong.
I'm so sorry...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. You just kept your
thoughts to yourself so that
I wouldn't be worried.
fields.JP:
いいよ。不安を打ち明けたら
きっと僕も不安に駆られるって、
そう思ったんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. You just kept your
thoughts to yourself so that
I wouldn't be worried.

fields.EN:
On the contrary, let me apologize
to you for having you worried
about me.
fields.JP:
こっちこそ、そんな風に
気を遣わせてしまってごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, let me apologize
to you for having you worried
about me.

fields.EN: You didn't do anything wrong, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP: おつうちゃんは何も悪くないよ！

fields.EN:
Okay, then I think we're even.
From here forward, we can go
through this all together.
fields.JP:
じゃあ……これからは互いに今まで以上に
助け合っていくってことにしようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then I think we're even.
From here forward, we can go
through this all together.

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……！
うん、約束する！

むっ……！
辺りが急に霧がかってきたぞ……！

fields.EN:
That means the Nightmare
is nearby...
fields.JP:
ということは
ついにナイトメアに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means the Nightmare
is nearby...

fields.JP: 感動の再会ってやつだな

fields.EN:
W-We are going to fight it,
right?
fields.JP: も、もちろん戦うんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We are going to fight it,
right?

fields.EN:
Yes... We destroyed the core,
so all that's left is to see if we
can really defeat it now.
fields.JP:
ああ。核を破壊したんだ、
ナイトメアに勝てるかどうか
試してみようじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... We destroyed the core,
so all that's left is to see if we
can really defeat it now.

fields.EN:
I've been waiting for this...
I despise running or losing.
fields.JP:
待ちわびたぞ、この時を……
ワレは逃げるのも負けるのも大嫌いなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been waiting for this...
I despise running or losing.

fields.EN:
How ironic... I'm with you, too.
I'm also the kind of person who
wants to repay what is due.
fields.JP:
奇遇だな。僕もだ。
受けた借りは必ず返す主義なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How ironic... I'm with you, too.
I'm also the kind of person who
wants to repay what is due.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
That's right, Jack...
We're not going to lose. We both
have someone we hold precious.
fields.JP:
そうだね、ジャック。
僕らは負けない。負けられない。
お互い、大切な人がいるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Jack...
We're not going to lose. We both
have someone we hold precious.

fields.EN:
I guess we're here, so we may
as well try and beat it...
fields.JP:
そう、だね……ここまで来たら、
やっつけてやりたいね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we're here, so we may
as well try and beat it...

fields.EN:
I want to prove that normal
people can beat it, too!
fields.JP:
人間にもできるんだって、
証明したいよ、わたし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to prove that normal
people can beat it, too!

fields.EN:
Well said. We're going to prove
that the professor's research
was correct.
fields.JP:
ああ。博士の遺した研究の成果を、
僕たちが実現するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said. We're going to prove
that the professor's research
was correct.

fields.JP: 潰した部位が、復活しない……！

fields.EN: We can crush it to smithereens!
fields.JP:
ぶっ潰すことができる、
というわけだな！
fields.LOCALIZED: We can crush it to smithereens!

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、ハーちゃん！
やっつけよう！
もちろんだぞ、人魚姫っ！

fields.EN:
Yeah, let's finish it
once and for all!
fields.JP: ああ！　一気に攻めきろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, let's finish it
once and for all!

fields.EN:
