Yes we did...
We really did it, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
うん……倒したよ……
おつうちゃん……倒したんだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes we did...
We really did it, Otsuu!

fields.EN:
We really, really beat that
Nightmare!
fields.JP:
ついに、ついにナイトメアを
倒せたんだね、わたしたち！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We really, really beat that
Nightmare!

fields.EN:
Indeed!
This is quite the victory for us!
fields.JP: うむっ！　完璧に倒したなっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
This is quite the victory for us!

fields.EN:
Even that immortal Nightmare
isn't immortal anymore...!
fields.JP:
不死身のナイトメアも、
これでもう不死身じゃない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This proves that the Nightmares
aren't invulnerable!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……よがっ……
み゛ん……ぶぶぶ、じ……

fields.EN:
Well said, Jack.
We're alive and we couldn't
have asked for any better.
fields.JP:
……ああ。そうだね、ジャック。
僕らは生きてる。それが一番の結果だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said, Jack.
We're alive and we couldn't
have asked for any better.

fields.EN:
We need to let everyone know
about this as soon as possible!
fields.JP:
解放地区のみんなにも
はやく教えてあげたいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to let everyone know
about this as soon as possible!

fields.JP: うんっ！　早く伝えに行こう！

fields.EN:
We shall return triumphant!
This will mark the beginning of
Hameln, the legendary hero!
fields.JP:
ふふん、そうだな、伝えねばなるまいな！
勇者ハーメルン伝説の始まりを！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We shall return triumphant!
This will mark the beginning of
Hameln, the legendary hero!

fields.EN:
I'm sure all will be pleased!
After all, they will be witness to
the beginning of a legend!
fields.JP:
皆きっと喜ぶであろうな！
伝説の幕開けに立ち会えることに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure all will be pleased!
After all, they will be witness to
the beginning of a legend!

fields.EN:
Haa-chan, you were so cool.
I'm sure everyone will be surprised!
fields.JP:
ハーちゃん格好良かったもんね。
みんなも驚くと思うよっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure everyone will be
surprised with how cool you were.

fields.EN:
Um, let me remind you that
we're not returning to glorify
you, Hameln...
fields.JP:
いや、伝えるのは
ハーメルン伝説じゃないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, let me remind you that
we're not returning to glorify
you, Hameln...

fields.EN:
We're returning to report back
that we put down the Nightmare.
fields.JP: ナイトメア討伐についてだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're returning to report back
that we put down the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Hahaha!
Of course, do not worry, Otsuu!
fields.JP:
ふはははっ！
細かいことは気にするな、おつう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha!
Of course, do not worry, Otsuu!

fields.EN:
(Speaking of, we couldn't
communicate with the Nightmare,
but I could read its emotions...)
fields.JP:
（そういえばここのナイトメア、
　会話はできなかったけど
　なんとなく感情は読み取れたな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Speaking of, we couldn't
communicate with the Nightmare,
but I could read its emotions...)

fields.EN:
(In fact, when the Nightmare fell,
I was able to feel its negative
emotions flow through me...)
fields.JP:
（うん……間違いない。
　ナイトメアが倒れる時、
　一気に負の感情が流れてきたからな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In fact, when the Nightmare fell,
I was able to feel its negative
emotions flow through me...)

fields.EN:
(I wonder why I'm able to
understand their feelings...)
fields.JP:
（いったい僕のこの能力は
　なんなんだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why I'm able to
understand their feelings...)

fields.EN:
Oh, by the way, I don't think
I saw any Blood Maidens in this
area at all.
fields.JP:
あっ……そういえば
この水族館跡エリアには血式少女、
いなかったね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, by the way, I don't think
I saw any Blood Maidens in this
area at all.

fields.EN:
The place is close to the former
Liberated District, so maybe they
went into hiding deeper inside.
fields.JP:
元解放地区に近すぎるから、
危険と判断してもっと奥に逃げたのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place is close to the former
Liberated District, so maybe they
went into hiding deeper inside.

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Ningyohime! We're
strong! We'll catch up with them soon!
fields.JP:
なに、心配するでない人魚姫！
ワレらは強い！　すぐに合流できるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fear not, Little Mermaid!
With my strength, I'm sure we will
converge with them soon!

fields.EN:
I guess you're right...
We will find them, right?
fields.JP:
そうだよね……
きっとすぐに再会できるよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you're right...
We will find them, right?

fields.EN:
We sure will. We also have hope
now that we know that we can
defeat Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ああ、絶対に見つけられるさ。
僕たちはナイトメアを倒せるって
希望を手に入れたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We sure will. We also have hope
now that we know that we can
defeat Nightmares.

fields.EN:
That just means greater hope
awaits us in the future.
fields.JP:
だから、もっと大きな希望に
手が届くに決まってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That just means greater hope
awaits us in the future.

fields.EN:
Just bear with a bit longer,
my comrades. We'll find you all
soon enough!
fields.JP:
待っててくれ、血式少女隊のみんな。
絶対に探し出してみせるから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just bear with a bit longer,
my comrades. We'll find you all
soon enough!

fields.EN:
(It's been a long while since
I visited the Tocho Metropolitan
Building...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、都庁なんて懐かしいなぁ……
　もうどれくらいぶりだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's been a long while since
I visited the Tocho Metropolitan
Building...)

fields.EN:
(I remember taking naps here.
The breeze felt really good.)
fields.JP:
（この場所でよくお昼寝したっけ。
　たまに吹く風が気持ちいいんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I remember taking naps here.
The breeze felt really good.)

fields.EN:
(I also liked how you had great
views from here.)
fields.JP: （で、あっちは眺めがよくて好きだったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I also liked how you had great
views from here.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder if it's still
properly there. I'll go take a look.)
fields.JP:
（まだちゃんと残ってるかな。
　ちょっと見に行ってみよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if the scenery has
changed? I should go and take
a look.)

fields.JP:
のごっでで……い……ぎぎ……
……ほじ……いな……

fields.EN:
(Looks like nothing changed.
Good to know...)
fields.JP:
（ちゃんとお気に入りの場所も残ってた。
　変わってなくて……よかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like nothing changed.
Good to know...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I should scope the
area out a bit...)
fields.JP:
（どうしよう、
　もう少し見て回ろうかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I should scope the
area out a bit...)

fields.JP: この場所はいったい何……？

fields.EN:
(After finally getting here,
I have to take flight again!)
fields.JP:
（せっかく都庁に着いたのに、
　どうしてまだ逃げないといけないの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After finally getting here,
I have to take flight again!)

fields.EN:
(Then again, if I stay here any
longer they'll find me.
I need to get away...)
fields.JP:
（でもここにいたら見つかってしまう。
　悔しいけど、ここを離れないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Then again, if I stay here any
longer they'll find me.
I need to get away...)

fields.EN:
There's no telling what's in
store, so keep your guard up!
fields.JP:
みんな、何が出るか
分からないから油断しないでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling what's in
store, so keep your guard up!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
やっと起きたか、ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack really does sleep a lot.
Looks like he was dreaming again, too.
fields.JP:
本当にジャックはよく寝るなぁ。
また夢を見ていたみたいだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must've been some dream.
You were really deep in sleep.

fields.EN:
Well, the day's starting,
so get yourself ready.
I got myself ready, too.
fields.JP:
さあ、目をしゃっきりさせるんだ。
僕は着替え終わったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, the day's starting,
so get yourself ready.
I got myself ready, too.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

づう……ぐぎぎ……
ぼぐ…………いげ……ぐる……

fields.EN:
True, not like there's anything
for you to ready.
Well, let's go then.
fields.JP:
まあジャックは準備ないもんな。
じゃあ行こうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
True, not like there's anything
for you to ready.
Well, let's go then.

fields.EN:
Good morning.
So, about today, what should...
fields.JP:
おはようみんな。
今日の探索なんだけど、どうする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning.
So, about today, what should...

fields.EN:
Hahaha! It is all thanks to me!
All praise thee!
fields.JP:
ふはは！　ワレのおかげであるぞ！
皆の者、ひざまづくがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! It is all thanks to me!
All praise thee!

fields.EN:
Why, may I ask, are you standing
on the chair like that, Hameln?
fields.JP:
どうしたんだハーメルン、
椅子の上になんか立って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, may I ask, are you standing
on the chair like that, Hameln?

fields.EN:
Hark!
I have attained greatness again!
fields.JP: おつうよ、またワレは活躍してしまったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hark!
I have attained greatness again!

fields.EN:
Um, do you mind explaining
what's going on, Princess?
fields.JP: どういうことなんだ、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, do you mind explaining
what's going on, Princess?

fields.EN:
Well, it looks like Haa-chan just
got us new information.
fields.JP:
ハーちゃんがね、
新しい情報を持ってきてくれたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it looks like Hammy just
got us new information.

fields.EN:
To be specific, her familiar
apparently got some info
for us.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンは使い魔を
使役しているようなんだが、
そいつが情報を仕入れてきてくれたらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be specific, her familiar
apparently got some info
for us.

fields.EN:
There's been someone sighted
at the Dorm area.
fields.JP: 旧学生街エリアで人影を目撃した、と
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's been someone sighted
at the Dorm area.

fields.EN:
Why, of course!
My familiar is very skilled,
just lyke me!
fields.JP:
もちろんだ！
ワレの使い魔は優秀なのでありゅ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why of course!
My familiar is very skilled,
just lyke meh!

fields.EN:
Yeah, so she's been like this
from the moment she woke up.
fields.JP:
だもんで、コイツは朝からずっと
調子に乗ってやがるってわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, so she's been like this
from the moment she woke up.

fields.EN: All praise be the hero, Hameln!
fields.JP:
貴様ら、勇者ハーメルンを
たたえるがいいー！
fields.LOCALIZED: All praise be the hero, Hameln!

fields.EN:
In any case, that's great news.
So Hameln, do you know who
this someone is?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、お手柄だな。
どんな風貌だったとか、分かるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, that's great news.
So Hameln, do you know who
this someone is?

fields.EN:
W-Well, not really.
It was "someone" for sure though.
fields.JP:
そ、そこまでは分からぬ。
人影だったとしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, not really.
It was "someone" for sure though.

fields.EN: Y-You dare spat on me, Mamoru?!
fields.JP: わ、ワレを侮辱するのか、マモル！
fields.LOCALIZED: Y-You dare spat on me, Mamoru?!

fields.EN: Come now, stop fighting you two.
fields.JP: こーら、２人ともケンカしないの
fields.LOCALIZED: Come now, stop fighting you two.

fields.EN:
Regardless, it is Haa-chan who
brought us the information.
fields.JP:
ハーちゃんのおかげなのは
間違いないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, it is Hammy who
brought us the information.

fields.EN:
Before going further...
Please get off the chair, Hameln.
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、
とりあえず僕の椅子から降りてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before going further...
Please get off the chair, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Whatever the case, at least we
have a great lead now!
fields.JP: でもでも、すっごい有力情報だよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever the case, at least we
have a great lead now!

fields.EN:
Hopefully we can put it
to good use.
fields.JP: この調子でどんどんいきたいところだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hopefully we can put it
to good use.

fields.EN:
Oh hey, before I forget...
You mind taking this with you?
fields.JP:
そうだ、これ出来上がったから
持って行ってくんな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh hey, before I forget...
You mind taking this with you?

fields.JP: ……銃？　でも反対側の先は注射？

fields.EN:
Ningyo-chan asked me to make this. It
sticks a needle into Jack, draws up his
blood, and shoots it like a water gun.
fields.JP:
人魚ちゃんに頼まれてたモン。
ジャックに針を刺して血を吸い上げて、
水鉄砲の要領で飛ばす装置
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lil' Mermaid asked me to make
it. You draw blood from Jack with
it, then shoot it like a pistol.

fields.EN:
There's no telling when we'll
go into Blood Skelter, right?
fields.JP:
わたしたち、いつまた
ブラッドスケルター化するか
分からないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling when we'll
go into Blood Skelter, right?

fields.EN:
True... I'm quite sure we're going
to need to rely on Jack's blood
down the line.
fields.JP:
そうだね、ジャックの血を借りる時が
この先もまだまだあると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... I'm quite sure we're going
to need to rely on Jack's blood
down the line.

fields.EN:
Jack-san is kind enough to harm
himself to share his blood
with us.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん優しいから、
きっと自分で自分を傷つけて、
血をわけてくれると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is kind enough to harm
himself to share his blood
with us.

fields.EN:
But that also means he's in
pain, and seeing that is just
too much.
fields.JP:
でもそれはとても痛みを伴うでしょう？
見てるだけでも痛ましいのだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that also means he's in
pain, and seeing that is just
too much.

fields.EN:
I see. It draws the blood up like a syringe...
If it's done well, it probably won't hurt.
fields.JP:
なるほどね。
注射のようにして吸い上げる……、
上手にやれば痛みはないだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So the needle acts as a
syringe to draw blood, which
should ease the pain.

fields.EN: Hm, Jack was in pain for sure.
fields.JP: 確かにジャック、少し痛がっていた
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm, Jack was in pain for sure.

fields.JP:
（それをちゃんと分かって、
　気遣ってくれてたなんて）

fields.EN:
Thank you, Princess.
Thank you, Takumi.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、姫。
そしてタクミ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Princess.
Thank you, Takumi.

fields.EN:
No prob at that! That's my job!
So yeah, put it to good use,
will you?
fields.JP:
それがしの仕事は完璧でござる！
……ってことで、まあ活用してくれな
fields.LOCALIZED:
No prob at that! That's my job!
So yeah, put it to good use,
will you?

fields.EN:
I'll be sure to take
good care of it.
fields.JP: 大事に使わせてもらうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll be sure to take
good care of it.

fields.EN:
Mmm... I wonder who that
someone is at the Dorm area.
fields.JP:
それにしても旧学生街エリア、
誰がいるんだろうね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I wonder who that
someone is at the Dorm area.

fields.EN:
If the figure in the report was alone,
I'm almost certain it was a Blood Maiden...
fields.JP:
情報にあった人影が単独なら、
ほぼ確実に血式少女だと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that "someone" is alone,
odds are likely that someone
is a Blood Maiden.

fields.JP: おねーちゃんだといいなぁ……

fields.EN:
Yes! That's Akazukin-oneechan.
She's very dependable.
fields.JP:
はい！　赤ずきんおねーちゃんです。
とっても頼りになるんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our dear sister Red Riding Hood!
She's really reliable!

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, you mean that girl
we saw back when we escaped,
right?
fields.JP:
ああ、最初の脱獄の時、
遠目に見たうちの１人か
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, you mean that girl
we saw back when we escaped,
right?

fields.EN:
When all's said and done, Akazukin was
the one who led us along. Honestly, having
her with us would be really reassuring.
fields.JP:
なんだかんだ、赤ずきんが
僕たちを引っ張ってくれていたからね。
正直、いてくれたらかなり心強いよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She made sure we got as far as we
could back then. It'd be great if
we can converge with her.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I guess I'm a little
uneasy now that onee-chan isn't here.
fields.JP:
そうだね……おねーちゃんがいない
今は少し不安……かな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sure hope that will happen.
It does feel a bit uneasy without
her around...

fields.EN:
Wow, she sounds like a
really dependable older sister!
fields.JP:
へえ～、すごい頼りになる
お姉さんなんだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that means she's trusted
by you all.

fields.EN:
If someone like that can join,
then this place will become even
more safer.
fields.JP:
そんな人が加わってくれたら、
この場所もさらに安心だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If someone like that can join,
then this place will become even
more safer.

fields.JP: どうした？　ハーメルン

fields.EN:
Who is this Akazukin?!
How dare she gather all your
trust!
fields.JP:
ワレを差し置いて頼られるなんて、
なんなのだ、その赤ずきんという奴はー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who is this Red Riding Hood?!
How dare she gather all your
trust!

fields.EN:
I am the hero here! Hameln!
I'm supposed to be your hero!
fields.JP:
ワレという勇者がいるのに！
ワレという勇者がいるのにーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the hero here! Hameln!
I'm supposed to be your hero!

fields.JP: お、落ち着くんだハーメルン

fields.EN: We're counting on you too, Haa-chan... okay?
fields.JP: ハーちゃんも頼りにしてるから、ね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we're counting on you
too, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Hmph... Is that so?
I guess that just means that
person will be my rival!
fields.JP:
ふっ……そうか、
これがライバルという奴なのだな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... Is that so?
I guess that just means that
person will be my rival!

fields.EN:
Just you wait, Akazukin!
My sworn rival!
fields.JP:
待っておれ、赤ずきん！
我がライバルよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just you wait, Red Riding Hood!
My sworn rival!

fields.EN: So, this is the Dorm area...
fields.JP: ここが旧学生街エリア……
fields.LOCALIZED: So, this is the Dorm area...

fields.JP: ここも何だか不気味だね……

fields.EN:
Something about this place
just isn't right...
fields.JP: 雰囲気も今までと全然違うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something about this place
just isn't right...

fields.JP: なんだ貴様ら、怖じ気づいたのか？

fields.EN:
I am here! You may board
my mud boat with confidence!
fields.JP:
ワレがいるのだ！
泥船に乗ったつもりでいるがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do not fear! I am here!
Don't leave everything to me!

fields.EN: A mud boat would make me twice as worried...
fields.JP: 泥船じゃ不安倍増じゃないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would have been assuring
if only you left out the "don't."

fields.EN:
I-I was just testing you!
That was totally not me making
a myshtake!
fields.JP:
い、今のは貴様らを試しただけだ！
決して間違えたわけではにゃい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I was just testing you!
That was totally not me making
a myshtake!

fields.JP: 間違えたわけではない！

fields.EN:
Oh, we know what you were
trying to say. We'll be sure to
rely on you, Haa-chan.
fields.JP:
分かってるよハーちゃん。
大船に乗ったつもりでいるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, we know what you were
trying to say. We'll be sure to
rely on you, Hammy.

fields.EN:
Indeed!
Place your burdens upon me!
fields.JP: そうであるぞ、ワレを頼るがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
Place your burdens upon me!

fields.EN:
In any case, I've never been here
before, so let's be careful.
fields.JP:
だけど、このエリアには今まで
入ったことがない。慎重に行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I've never been here
before, so let's be careful.

fields.EN:
Okay. There's no telling what's
in store for us here.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
何が起こるか分からないもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. There's no telling what's
in store for us here.

fields.EN:
Well said!
Let us be very careful!
fields.JP:
そうだぞ貴様ら！
慎重に行くのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said!
Let us be very careful!

fields.EN:
Uh, do you mind living to your
words? Don't go ahead of us
like that!
fields.JP:
言ったそばからハーメルン、
そんなに１人で先行しないでくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, do you mind living to your
words? Don't go ahead of us
like that!

fields.EN:
Death is always right beside us.
That's why we need to be even more careful.
fields.JP:
いつだって死が隣り合わせなんだ。
だから僕たちはもっと慎重にならないと。
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place could be a death trap.
We really need to be more careful.

fields.EN:
I want to make sure we make it
out alive, so I'm counting on
you... Hameln, the hero.
fields.JP:
生存の確率は可能な限り上げたい。
……期待してるんだよ、勇者ハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to make sure we make it
out alive, so I'm counting on
you... Hameln, the hero.

fields.EN:
W-Well, if you say so!
I shall protect you both!
fields.JP:
う、うむっ！
ちゃんと貴様らを守ってみせるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, if you say so!
I shall protect you both!

fields.EN:
This place is a lot larger
than I thought...
fields.JP:
予想していたより
だいぶ広いな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is a lot larger
than I thought...

fields.EN:
This just makes it harder to find
that person Haa-chan's familiar saw.
fields.JP:
これじゃハーちゃんの使い魔が
見たっていう人影も、見つけるの大変だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This just makes it harder to find
that person Hammy's familiar saw.

fields.EN:
If that someone is staying put,
I'm sure we'll find that person
sooner than later.
fields.JP:
人影が動かないでいるなら、
見つけるのは時間の問題だろうけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that someone is staying put,
I'm sure we'll find that person
sooner than later.

fields.EN:
And, if it was a Blood Maiden,
odds are likely she's hiding
from the Marchens.
fields.JP:
血式少女なら、メルヒェンどもに
見つからないように隠れているだろうし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, if it was a Blood Maiden,
odds are likely she's hiding
from the Marchens.

fields.EN:
I suppose we're about the only
ones here strutting around so
openly.
fields.JP:
堂々と歩いておるのは
きっとワレらくらいであろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we're about the only
ones here strutting around so
openly.

fields.EN:
Was she just wandering around here
like us?
fields.JP: しかも堂々と歩き回ってるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Was she just wandering around here
like us?

fields.EN:
We're looking for our friends.
We heard they may be here,
so we came by to check.
fields.JP:
僕たちは知り合いを探しててね。
ここにいるかもしれないって情報があって、
それでやって来たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're looking for our friends.
We heard they may be here,
so we came by to check.

fields.EN:
Normal humans would have a
difficult time even coming here.
fields.JP:
普通の人間は、
ここまで来るのも大変だと思うのだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Normal humans would have a
difficult time even coming here.

fields.JP: 僕たちはそれなりに鍛練を積んでるからね

fields.EN:
Trained...
That still means there's a limit
to what you can do.
fields.JP:
鍛錬……ね。
限界はあると思うけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Trained...
That still means there's a limit
to what you can do.

fields.EN:
So, Tsuu... may I ask what
that being is behind you?
fields.JP:
そう……では、つう。
あなたの後ろにいる、明らかに
人間ではない者は何者？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Otsuu... may I ask what
that being is behind you?

fields.EN:
Hold up.
Before I answer, who are you?
fields.JP:
待ってくれ。
その前に君こそ何者なんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold up.
Before I answer, who are you?

fields.EN:
Answering my question with a
question will only kill the
question I asked, wouldn't it?
fields.JP:
質問を質問で返したら、
私の最初の質問は永久に闇の中に
葬られると思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Answering my question with a
question will only kill the
question I asked, wouldn't it?

fields.EN:
Fine...
I suppose I can illuminate
you a bit.
fields.JP:
……まあいいわ。
少しはあなたたちの疑問にも答えましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
I suppose I can illuminate
you a bit.

fields.EN:
Wait a second...
What do you mean you're
a Nightmare?
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って、ナイトメアって
いったいどういう意味なの……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a second...
What do you mean you're
a Nightmare?

fields.EN:
You look human
through and through!
fields.JP: どこからどう見ても人間ではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You look human
through and through!

fields.EN: Yes but looks can be deceiving.
fields.JP: 事実なのだから仕方ないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes but looks can be deceiving.

fields.EN:
The area is turning white...!
You're... telling the truth?!
fields.JP:
辺りが真っ白に……！？
まさかこの方、本当に……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The area is turning white...!
You're... telling the truth?!

fields.JP: グレーテルハ……ボクガマモル……

fields.EN:
I WILL DEFEAT THEM...
FOR YOU...
fields.JP: ボクガ……タオシテアゲルカラネ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I WILL DEFEAT THEM...
FOR YOU...

fields.JP: くっ、こんなところでいきなり……！
待ってヘンゼル兄さん
ワカッタヨグレーテル……
ナイトメアと本当に通じ合っている！？

fields.EN:
Wait... that Nightmare can
talk, too?!
fields.JP:
というか、言葉を喋る
ナイトメアがここにも！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... that Nightmare can
talk, too?!
They're just like you and Jack!

fields.EN: The Nightmare Hansel-niisan, and I, Gretel—
fields.JP:
ナイトメアのヘンゼル兄さんと、
この私、グレーテル――
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you can see, my brother,
Hansel, is a Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Therefore, it only makes sense
that I'm a Nightmare too, yes?
fields.JP:
私がナイトメアということ、
信じてもらえた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Therefore, it only makes sense
that I'm a Nightmare too, yes?

fields.EN:
So, you're Nightmares and
siblings at that?
fields.JP: ナイトメアの兄妹というのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're Nightmares and
siblings at that?

fields.EN:
Now then, let me ask...
Who is that large fellow?
fields.JP:
では次はこちらの番よ。
そちらのでかいのは、いったい何者？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let me ask...
Who is that large fellow?

fields.EN:
I performed the grace of
introductions. I'd like to assume
you'd do the same, too.
fields.JP:
私たちはちゃんと自己紹介したのだから、
あなたたちも答えてもらうわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I performed the grace of
introductions. I'd like to assume
you'd do the same, too.

fields.EN:
This Nightmare is Jack. He's
an important companion of ours.
fields.JP:
このナイトメアはジャック。
僕たちの大事な仲間だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare you see here
is Jack. He's our friend.

fields.EN:
Jack, who are you? Where were you
born, and how have you lived until now?
fields.JP:
ねえジャック、あなたは何者？
どこで生まれて、どうやって生きてきたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Jack... Who are you?
Where were you born and
what brought you here?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I can interpret for Jack
if you'd...
fields.JP: ジャックのことなら僕が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can interpret for Jack
if you'd...

fields.EN:
I'm talking to Jack now...
So, tell me all about you, Jack.
fields.JP:
私はジャックから聞きたいの。
ねえ教えてジャック？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm talking to Jack now...
So, tell me all about you, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

あ゛り゛……ず……
んぎぎ……あ゛り゛ず……

fields.EN:
(Tch! I can feel Jack's pain
running through me!)
fields.JP:
（くっ……ジャックの
　苦しみが伝わってくる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Tch! I can feel Jack's pain
running through me!)

fields.JP: ジャック……落ち着くんだ……

fields.EN:
Jack-san! Otsuu-chan!
Get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、おつうちゃんも……
しっかりして……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Otsuu!
Get a hold of yourself!

fields.EN:
(This suffering... He
doesn't even understand himself...)
fields.JP:
（この苦しみ……自分でも
　自分のことが分かってないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This pain... It seems as if he
can't figure out what's going on.)

fields.EN:
(I thought I understood how Jack
felt, but it seems I was direly
wrong...)
fields.JP:
（感覚的にジャックのこと
　分かった気になっていたけど……
　全然だったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought I understood how Jack
felt, but it seems I was direly
wrong...)

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, I don't
exactly know why Jack turned
into a Nightmare...)
fields.JP:
（確かに僕は、
　ジャックが何故ナイトメアに
　なったか分かっていない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, I don't
exactly know why Jack turned
into a Nightmare...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ありす……んぎ……
……ありす……ありす……？

fields.EN:
(It must have something to do
with Alice...)
fields.JP:
（やはりアリスと
　関係しているんだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must have something to do
with Alice...)

fields.EN:
Hm... You seem to be a bit
different from Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
ふぅん……どうやらヘンゼル兄さんとは
違う性質のナイトメアのようね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... You seem to be a bit
different from my brother, Hansel.

fields.EN:
You can understand what I say,
but you can't speak well.
Interesting...
fields.JP:
こちらの言葉は同じように理解する。
けれどあまり上手くは喋れない、と。
なるほどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can understand what I say,
but you can't speak well.
Interesting...

fields.EN:
Jack, tell me more about yourself.
Try and remember who you are.
fields.JP:
ねえジャック、もっとあなたのこと教えて？
ほら、自分のこと、思い出して？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, tell me more about yourself.
Try and remember who you are.

fields.EN:
Stop it right there!
Can't you see Jack is in pain,
you fool!
fields.JP:
やめぬか愚か者！
ジャックが苦しんでおるだろうが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it right there!
Can't you see Jack is in pain,
you fool!

fields.JP: それは……私に対して言っているのかしら？

fields.EN: Who else would I be talking to?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Who else would I be talking to?!

fields.EN:
Too bad...
I was going to let you all go
without a fight.
fields.JP:
せっかくこのまま
帰してあげようと思ったのにね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too bad...
I was going to let you all go
without a fight.

fields.EN:
Those showing aggression towards
me needs to be eliminated.
Isn't that right, Hansel-niisan?
fields.JP:
敵意があるなら、
侵入者として処理しなければいけないわ。
ねえ、ヘンゼル兄さん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those showing aggression towards
me needs to be eliminated.
Isn't that right, Hansel?

fields.JP:
シンニュウシャナラ……
……ミナゴロシダヨ…………

fields.EN:
Looks like they're serious...
Let's get out of here...
fields.JP:
聞く耳持たなそうだ……
みんな、逃げるぞ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like they're serious...
Let's get out of here...

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、しっかりして！

fields.EN:
I'm fine, Princess...
I feel a bit better now...
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、姫……
だいぶ治まってきたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine, Princess...
I feel a bit better now...

fields.EN:
Let me guard our rear!
Let's get moving!
fields.JP:
貴様ら、しんがりはワレに任せておけ。
では行くぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me guard our rear!
Let's get moving!

fields.JP: どうにか……逃げ切れたね……

fields.EN:
I assume we can't defeat that
Nightmare yet.
fields.JP: どうせあいつも今は倒せぬのだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume we can't defeat that
Nightmare yet.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, Gretel
called that Nightmare 'Hansel-niisan'...
fields.JP:
それにしてもグレーテル、あのナイトメアを
『ヘンゼル兄さん』って呼んでたな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The fact that Gretel girl called
the Nightmare her brother
bothers me...

fields.EN:
I assume they really are
brother and sister...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume they really are
brother and sister...

fields.EN:
I could at least tell they were
living together for a while now.
fields.JP: 一緒に暮らしていた様子ではあったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could at least tell they were
living together for a while now.

fields.EN:
I never expected Nightmares to
be so talkative.
fields.JP:
そもそもナイトメアというのは
こんなに喋るものだったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I never expected Nightmares to
be so talkative.

fields.EN:
Well, the one at the Aquarium
Ruins didn't speak one bit.
fields.JP:
水族館跡エリアのナイトメアは
まったく喋らなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, the one at the Aquarium
Ruins didn't speak one bit.

fields.EN:
Yes, and it didn't seem to
respond to us, too.
fields.JP:
うん。話しかけても
何の反応もなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and it didn't seem to
respond to us, too.

fields.EN:
I thought we may be able to
talk it out with them since we're
able to talk with Jack, but...
fields.JP:
ジャックが喋っているから、
他のナイトメアも話せば分かるって
あの時は思ったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought we may be able to
talk it out with them since we're
able to talk with Jack, but...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ああ、なんでもないんだよジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(If only everyone could
communicate like Jack...)
fields.JP:
（みんなジャックのように
　話せればいいんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If only everyone could
communicate like Jack...)

fields.EN:
I suppose this just means that
there are some Nightmares that
can talk.
fields.JP:
ということは、ナイトメアは喋る奴と
喋らない奴がいる、ということか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose this just means that
there are some Nightmares that
can talk.

fields.EN:
Jack is an exception of the norm.
I mean, he was human.
fields.JP:
ジャックはかなりの例外だよ。
だって元は人間なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is an exception of the norm.
I mean, he was human.

fields.JP: じゃあヘンゼル……さんも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...
Does that mean Hansel is...?

fields.EN:
I don't know. We don't have enough
information to make that call.
fields.JP:
それは分からない。
決めつけるには情報が足りなすぎる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know. We don't have enough
information to make that call.

fields.EN:
To add, I'm still puzzled with
Gretel. She asserts herself as
being a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
意味が分からないのはグレーテルもだ。
自分自身をナイトメアって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, I'm still puzzled with
Gretel. She asserts herself as
being a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
But if they're actual siblings,
then that would make her a
Nightmare, too.
fields.JP:
本当に兄妹なら、
ナイトメアということになるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if they're actual siblings,
then that would make her a
Nightmare, too.

fields.EN:
She looked like any other girl.
I wonder what makes her think
she's a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
どう見ても人間にしか見えなかったよ。
なんでそんな風に思ってるのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She looked like any other girl.
I wonder what makes her think
she's a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
There are too many things we don't
know about them.
fields.JP: 分からないことだらけだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are too many things we don't
know about them.

fields.EN:
(I could've assumed Gretel was
like me if she didn't call herself
a Nightmare...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルが自身をナイトメアだと
　言わなければ、僕とジャックの関係と
　同じだと思えたんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I could've assumed Gretel was
like me if she didn't call herself
a Nightmare...)

fields.EN:
You know, it just dawned on me,
but that "someone" here, could it
be Gretel-san?
fields.JP:
ねえ、このエリアにいる人影って、
グレーテルさんのことなのかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, it just dawned on me,
but that "someone" here, could it
be Gretel?

fields.EN:
That could be very well possible
though it's too early to jump to
that conclusion.
fields.JP:
そうかもしれない。
でも決めつけるには早いかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That could be very well possible
though it's too early to jump to
that conclusion.

fields.EN:
After all, if I was on the run,
and I came here, I would try to
hide from the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
仮に僕がこのエリアに逃げてたら、
ナイトメアからは隠れようとするから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, if I was on the run,
and I came here, I would try to
hide from the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
No point agonizing over it. Whether we're
searching for the Blood Maidens or defeating
the Nightmare, we have to go deeper.
fields.JP:
悩んでおっても仕方あるまい。
血式少女を探すのもナイトメアを倒すのも、
奥に進まねばならぬのだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
No use worrying at this point.
We just need to find our missing
Blood Maidens, period.

fields.EN:
You're right...
It's no use worrying with how
things are now.
fields.JP:
……ハーメルンの言うとおりだな。
ここで悩んでいてもしょうがない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
It's no use worrying with how
things are now.

fields.EN:
Let's just keep an eye out for
Hansel and Gretel, and keep on
the move.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルとグレーテルに
気をつけながら、奥に進もうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's just keep an eye out for
Hansel and Gretel, and keep on
the move.

fields.JP: あなたたち、まだいたのね

fields.EN:
I thought you'd all have
ran off by now.
fields.JP: てっきり逃げ帰ったと思ったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought you'd all have
ran off by now.

fields.EN:
Do you think we'd really
run away?
fields.JP:
この程度のことで
逃げ帰るわけなかろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think we'd really
run away?

fields.EN:
This is my warning to you...
Leave.
fields.JP:
警告するわ。
引き返しなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my warning to you...
Leave.

fields.EN:
Any further and I will need to
kill you. Leave now, and I will
let you all go in peace.
fields.JP:
これ以上進むなら、
あなた達を殺さなければならない。
今ここで引き返すなら、見逃すわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Any further and I will need to
kill you. Leave now, and I will
let you all go in peace.

fields.EN:
We didn't come here to harm you.
We just came here looking for
our friends.
fields.JP:
僕たちは危害を加えるつもりはない。
ただ人を探してるだけなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't come here to harm you.
We just came here looking for
our friends.

fields.EN:
She's right.
Please, can you let us through?
fields.JP:
そうなんです……
だからお願い、通して下さい
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right.
Please, can you let us through?

fields.EN: Why won't you let us through?
fields.JP: どうしてそんなに頑なに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Why won't you let us through?

fields.EN:
Would you let intruders step
into your home?
fields.JP:
誰だって自分の家に勝手に
入られたくはないものでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would you let intruders step
into your home?

fields.EN:
Home...?
This place is your home?
fields.JP:
……自分の家？
ここが君の家だっていうのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Home...?
This place is your home?

fields.EN:
Aren't you scared of all the
Marchens around here?
fields.JP:
こんな場所に住んで
メルヒェンが怖くないんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aren't you scared of all the
Marchens around here?

fields.EN:
Why, they're all quite cute.
That includes the rowdier ones,
too.
fields.JP:
あら、かわいいじゃない。
たまに騒々しいのも含めて、ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, they're all quite cute.
That includes the rowdier ones,
too.

fields.EN:
Oh? So you command them too,
just like me?
fields.JP: ほう……ワレと同じく使役するか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? So you command them too,
just like me?

fields.EN:
Command?
I never thought of it that way.
fields.JP:
使役……そんなこと、
考えたこともなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Command?
I never thought of it that way.

fields.EN:
I basically let Hansel-niisan
handle all the important things.
fields.JP:
大事なことはすべて、
ヘンゼル兄さんにお願いするもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I basically let my brother Hansel
handle all the important duties.

fields.EN:
Gretel, I need to ask, but are you
and Hansel really related?
fields.JP:
グレーテル、君は本当に
あのナイトメアと兄妹なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, I need to ask, but are you
and Hansel really related?

fields.EN:
But... it is true that Hansel-niisan
and I look far too different.
I genuinely wonder why.
fields.JP:
ただ……ヘンゼル兄さんと
あまりにも姿が違うのも確かね。
そこは純粋に疑問に思っているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, but I do admit we do look
starkly different. I've been
pondering about myself.

fields.EN:
That said, none of the humans that
came here displayed the kind of
power I hold.
fields.JP:
でも今までやって来た人間の誰も、
私のような力は持っていなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, none of the humans that
came here displayed the kind of
power I hold.

fields.EN:
Therefore, I must not be human.
The powers I hold is similar to
that of Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
だから私は人間ではないと思うわ。
この力はヘンゼル兄さんに近いもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Therefore, I must not be human.
The powers I hold is similar to
that of Hansel.

fields.EN:
But, you aren't entirely sure that
you are a Nightmare, right?
fields.JP:
ではナイトメアだと、ご自分で
確信を持っているわけではないのですね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you aren't entirely sure that
you are a Nightmare, right?

fields.EN:
I suppose. I simply compared
traits and qualities to come
to my conclusion.
fields.JP:
そうね。ナイトメアと人間、どちらに
より近いか考察した結果に過ぎないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose. I simply compared
traits and qualities to come
to my conclusion.

fields.JP: けっしき少女？　それは何かしら？

fields.EN:
Hm, perhaps you point towards
a special breed of humans,
and if so...
fields.JP:
特別な人間？
そうだとすると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, perhaps you point towards
a special breed of humans,
and if so...

fields.EN:
What? Why the silent treatment?
We're asking you a question.
fields.JP:
なんだいきなり黙り込みおって。
今はワレらが質問しておるのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Why the silent treatment?
We're asking you a question.

fields.EN:
(She's so deep in thought that
she can't hear Hameln...)
fields.JP: （聞こえてない……すごい集中力だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so deep in thought that
she can't hear Hameln...)

fields.EN:
Tsuu and the others made it
this far practically unscathed.
fields.JP: つうたちは、ほぼ無傷でここまで来てる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu was able to get here
practically unscathed...

fields.EN:
They also avoided Hansel-niisan without
losing a single person... Hm...
fields.JP:
しかもヘンゼル兄さんから
誰も欠けることなく逃げきってみせた。
つまり――
fields.LOCALIZED:
They also avoided Hansel without
losing a single person... Hm...

fields.EN:
I suppose that means you girls
are one of these "Blood Maidens?"
fields.JP:
あなたたちこそが、
その血式少女ということかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that means you girls
are one of these "Blood Maidens?"

fields.EN:
Quite intuitive.
Indeed, we are Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
理解が早いな。
そうだ、僕たちは血式少女だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite intuitive.
Indeed, we are Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Speaking with Jack may enlighten
me on the secrets of who Hansel-niisan
and I truly are.
fields.JP:
ジャックに色々話を聞ければ、私と
ヘンゼル兄さんのことも分かるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking with Jack may enlighten
me on the secrets of who Hansel
and I truly are.

fields.EN:
Jack, I would love to learn
more about you...
fields.JP:
ねえジャック、
私はあなたのことをもっと知りたいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, I would love to learn
more about you...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

んぎぎ……ぼぐど……
おばなし…………？

fields.EN:
Why yes. I would like to learn
how you came to be and more.
fields.JP:
ええそうよ。
ジャックの生まれた時のこととか、
色々と知りたいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. I would like to learn
how you came to be and more.

fields.EN:
So, why don't we "speak?"
Come now...
fields.JP:
だからね、お話ししましょう？
ほら……ほら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, why don't we "speak?"
Come now...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぼぐ……ぼぐ……
……ぐぎご……ごわい……

やめてくれグレーテル！
ジャックが怯えている！！

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Jack-san...
There's nothing to be afraid of...
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、大丈夫ですからね……
何も怖いことなんてありませんから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Jack...
There's nothing to be afraid of...

fields.EN:
Jack has a hard time thinking
about himself. So please, I'd
appreciate it if you'd step back.
fields.JP:
ジャックは自分のことを考えるの、
苦手なんだ。これ以上の質問は駄目だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack has a hard time thinking
about himself. So please, I'd
appreciate it if you'd step back.

fields.EN:
Well, I did come here simply to
give you my warning.
fields.JP:
それに今回の接触の目的は
警告だしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I did come here simply to
give you my warning.

fields.EN: So, are you going to leave?
fields.JP: お、諦めて退く気になったか？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, are you going to leave?

fields.EN:
Why yes, I will.
But I need you all to leave, too.
fields.JP:
ええ、退くわ。
だけどあなたたちも退きなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, I will.
But I need you all to leave, too.

fields.EN:
This is my last warning. If you go
any further, you leave me no
choice. I will resort to force.
fields.JP:
最終警告よ。ここより先に進むなら、
全力をもって排除させてもらうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my last warning. If you go
any further, you leave me no
choice. I will resort to force.

fields.EN:
Gretel, wait! We heard there was
someone else here, but are you
sure no one else is around?
fields.JP:
待ってくれグレーテル！　このエリアで
人影を見たって情報があったんだ。
君たち以外に誰かいないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, wait! We heard there was
someone else here, but are you
sure no one else is around?

fields.EN:
I don't believe so. If a human
came in, Hansel-niisan would
have eliminated them by now.
fields.JP:
いないと思うわ。だって人間が入ったら
ヘンゼル兄さんが排除してくれるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't believe so. After all,
my dear brother would have
eliminated that person by now.

fields.EN:
Though I hear there's a dangerous
human... no, some hairy monster farther
in that might be a human or a Marchen.
fields.JP:
まあこの奥のエリアには物騒な人間……
いえ、毛だらけの人間だかメルヒェンだか
わからない化け物がいるって聞くけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, if anything there is this
strange... hairy creature that
is beyond here.

fields.JP:
本当か！？
それってどんな……

fields.EN:
No, I don't know who
or what it is.
fields.JP: さあ、どんな者かしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I don't know who
or what it is.

fields.JP: それじゃあ、警告はしたわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I have to make due
on my warning to you.

fields.JP: グレーテル！　教えてくれ！

fields.EN:
We just turned the corner,
didn't we?
fields.JP: たった今、角を曲がったばかりだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We just turned the corner,
didn't we?

fields.JP: いったいどういうことだ……？

fields.EN:
Hmph! Who cares?
So, Otsuu, don't tell me you're
planning on leaving now.
fields.JP:
ふん、あんな奴どうでもよいわ。
それよりおつうよ、どうするつもりだ？
まさか引き返すなどと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! Who cares?
So, Otsuu, don't tell me you're
planning on leaving now.

fields.EN:
Of course not. My friends may
not be here, but we did get an
interesting tidbit from her.
fields.JP:
もちろん進む。
このエリアには仲間はいないみたいだけど、
有力な情報が得られたしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not. My friends may
not be here, but we did get an
interesting tidbit from her.

fields.EN:
She said there was a dangerous
human in the area ahead. Maybe...
fields.JP:
この先のエリアに物騒な人間、
って言ってたもんね。もしかしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, she did say it was some
kind of hairy creature. Maybe...

fields.EN:
Yes, there's a chance that
creature is one of the Blood
Maidens. We need to move on.
fields.JP:
うん、血式少女隊の誰かの可能性が高い。
これは何としても奥に行かなくちゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, there's a chance that
creature is one of the Blood
Maidens. We need to move on.

fields.EN:
I'm also interested in Gretel.
She could be a Blood Maiden, too.
fields.JP:
それにグレーテルのことも気になる。
もしかしたら彼女は血式少女かもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm also interested in Gretel.
She could be a Blood Maiden, too.

fields.EN:
Well, it does take something to
be able to live here.
fields.JP:
ここで生きていられるってことは、
そうかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it does take something to
be able to live here.

fields.EN:
But, if we go on, we'd be going
against Gretel-san's warning...
fields.JP:
じゃあ先に進む？
グレーテルさんの警告には逆らうことに
なっちゃうけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, if we go on, we'd be going
against Gretel's warning...

fields.EN:
We have no need to heed her
words! Now off we go!
fields.JP:
ワレらが警告に従う義理などないわ。
では行くぞ貴様ら！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have no need to heed her
words! Now off we go!

fields.EN:
I suppose we're done with all
that.
fields.JP:
これで仕掛けのある場所は
通りすぎたかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we're done with all
that.

fields.JP:
どうやら通りすぎたみたいだよ、
おつうちゃん
ナイトメア・ジャック

んぎぎ……ぼぐ……
……だいじょ……ぎ……ぶ……

fields.EN:
I can't believe they installed
something like that. What a nuisance...
fields.JP:
よくもまあ、あんなものを設置したものだ。
まったく、面倒な……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't imagine the amount of
trouble needed to set that up...

fields.EN:
Well, it at least made a statement
that intruders aren't welcome.
fields.JP: すごい侵入者の拒みようだったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it at least made a statement
that intruders aren't welcome.

fields.EN:
Even more why I feel a bit bad
we're moving against Gretel-san's
will.
fields.JP:
本当に進んでほしくないって
分かっただけに、グレーテルさんには
少し申し訳ないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even more why I feel a bit bad
we're moving against Gretel's
will.

fields.EN:
You truly are kind, Princess.
We'll try and get Gretel to see
that we're not her enemies.
fields.JP:
姫は優しいね。次にグレーテルに会ったら、
もう一度敵意がないことを説明しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You truly are kind, Princess.
We'll try and get Gretel to see
that we're not her enemies.

fields.EN:
I didn't expect you to make it
through.
fields.JP: まさか突破されるとは思わなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect you to make it
through.

fields.EN:
Still proceeding even after
I said all that, I see.
fields.JP: あれだけ忠告したのに、引き返さないとはね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still proceeding even after
I said all that, I see.

fields.JP: 待ってくれ、もう１度話を聞いてくれ！

fields.EN:
I already gave you my final
warning. There's nothing for us
to talk about.
fields.JP:
最終警告はした。
今さらその話をするつもりはないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I already gave you my final
warning. There's nothing for us
to talk about.

fields.EN:
I suppose we need to fight her,
Otsuu.
fields.JP: やはり戦うしかないのではないか、おつう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we need to fight her,
Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Tch... Isn't there a way
to get through to her?
fields.JP: くっ、聞いてもらえないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... Isn't there a way
to get through to her?

fields.JP:
あなたたち、ジャックとは
どこで出会ったの？
それが分かれば、あるいは……

fields.EN: So, not from around here then.
fields.JP: この周辺というわけではないのね
fields.LOCALIZED: So, not from around here then.

fields.EN:
That means there's no correlation
between Jack and Hansel-niisan based on
where they were born.
fields.JP:
ジャックとヘンゼル兄さんの
生まれた場所に共通性が
あるわけではないのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means there's no correlation
between Jack and Hansel based on
where they were born.

fields.EN:
Or, maybe the way they speak is
because of that. Unless each
Nightmare has a trait their own.
fields.JP:
喋り方の違いなどはむしろ生まれた
場所が原因？　それともナイトメアにも
個性があるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or, maybe the way they speak is
because of that. Unless each
Nightmare has a trait their own.

fields.EN:
If similarities are innate to Nightmares and
differences come from their environments...
maybe the individuality hypothesis is right.
fields.JP:
似てる部分はナイトメア生来のもので、
違う部分は育った環境によるものなら……
個性という仮定は正しいのかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Individuality could be possible
if the location of their birth
offers environmental differences.

fields.EN:
Jack was a former human.
His style of speech was from the
moment he became a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
いや、ジャックは元々人間だったんだ。
ナイトメアになった瞬間からあの喋り方だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack was a former human.
His style of speech was from the
moment he became a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
You don't need to tell her
that, Otsuu.
fields.JP: 親切に答えてやる必要はないぞ、おつう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to tell her
that, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
No, it's fine. I don't want her to
think Jack is some kind of
monster.
fields.JP:
いや、いいんだ。
こんなにも優しいジャックを
ただの化け物だと思われたくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it's fine. I don't want her to
think Jack is some kind of
monster.

fields.EN:
If what you said is true, that is
quite amazing.
fields.JP: ……それが本当なら驚くべき話ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If what you said is true, that is
quite amazing.

fields.EN:
I heard of humans turning into
Marchens, but turning into
a Nightmare is a first.
fields.JP:
人間がメルヒェンになる話は聞くけれど、
ナイトメアになるというのは初めてだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard of humans turning into
Marchens, but turning into
a Nightmare is a first.

fields.EN:
Do you mind telling me how
exactly he became a Nightmare?
fields.JP:
どういう経緯でそうなったのか、
詳しく教えてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind telling me how
exactly he became a Nightmare?

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、どうする……？

fields.EN:
I know what you're thinking,
Princess. I don't want to say too
much, but...
fields.JP:
……姫が言いたいことは分かるよ。
これ以上は僕も言いたくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know what you're thinking,
Princess. I don't want to say too
much, but...

fields.EN:
But if we can't move forward, we're
stuck. With Dawn gone, we need to
find everyone before it's too late...
fields.JP:
でもこの先に進めないと手詰まりだ。
黎明がない今、早くみんなと合流しないと
手遅れになりかねない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we don't do something, we're
stuck. We need to find everyone
as soon as possible.

fields.JP: （ジャックには悪いけど、少しだけ……）

fields.EN:
If I say more, will you let
us through?
fields.JP:
ジャックのことを話したら、
通してくれるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I say more, will you let
us through?

fields.EN:
No. Letting you pass will only
bring danger to us.
fields.JP:
……それはお断りよ。
通行を許可すると、私たちが危険だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. Letting you pass will only
bring danger to us.

fields.EN: We won't harm you, Gretel-san. We promise!
fields.JP:
わたしたちはグレーテルさんに
一切危害を加えません！
fields.LOCALIZED: We won't harm you, we promise!

fields.EN:
We just need to get through.
We won't do anything else!
fields.JP:
ただ通過させて下さるだけでいいんです。
絶対に余計なことはしませんから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We just need to get through.
We won't do anything else!

fields.EN:
Everyone who comes here says
something similar.
fields.JP:
昔からここを訪れる人間は、
みんな同じことを言うのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone who comes here says
something similar.

fields.EN:
We only need to get through, so
that we can get to the next area!
fields.JP:
僕たちは本当に先のエリアに
行きたいだけなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We only need to get through, so
that we can get to the next area!

fields.EN:
A human once made it through, and
I let that person go. Do you know
what happened?
fields.JP:
昔ね、ここの仕掛けを解いた人間を
逃がしてあげたことがあるの。そうしたら
どうなったと思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A human once made it through, and
I let that person go. Do you know
what happened?

fields.EN:
That human brought his allies
and attacked us, all the while
rallying to kill us "monsters."
fields.JP:
今度は大勢の仲間を引き連れて、
私たちを襲ってきたわ。化け物は死ねって
言いながらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That human brought his allies
and attacked us, all the while
rallying to kill us "monsters."

fields.EN:
Since then, I've killed any who
were able to actually get through.
See, the set-up won't work twice.
fields.JP:
だからそれ以来、仕掛けを突破した者は
殺すことにしているの。１度解かれてしまえば
次は足止めにはならないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since then, I've killed any who
were able to actually get through.
See, the set-up won't work twice.

fields.JP: そういうわけで……死んでくれる？

fields.EN:
ANYONE WHO TROUBLES
GRETEL... I WON'T FORGIVE THEM...
fields.JP:
グレーテルヲコマラセルヤツハ……
……ユルサナイ…………
fields.LOCALIZED:
I WON'T LET ANYONE LIVE...
IF THEY BRING TROUBLE TO GRETEL...

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, please believe us! We really
haven't done anything...!
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、信じて下さい！
わたしたちは本当に何も……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, you have to trust us!
We're really not...!

fields.EN:
That's enough, Ningyohime!
They're in no condition to reason!
fields.JP:
人魚姫、やめておくのだ！
やはりこいつら、聞く耳持たん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's enough, Little Mermaid!
They're in no condition to reason!

fields.EN:
Tch...
Let's make a run for it!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch...
Let's make a run for it!

fields.EN: Don't get cocky just because you're immortal!
fields.JP: 不死身だからって調子に乗りおって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
They only kept at us because
they're invincible.

fields.EN:
Regardless, it's going to be
difficult getting through them
at this rate.
fields.JP:
でもこれじゃあ
通り抜けるのは厳しいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, it's going to be
difficult getting through them
at this rate.

fields.EN:
Isn't there any way we can
somehow reason with them?
fields.JP:
どうしたらわたしたちのこと、
信じてもらえるかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't there any way we can
somehow reason with them?

fields.EN:
Well, they don't seem open to
negotiations right now.
fields.JP:
このエリアを抜けることについては、
交渉する気が完全にないみたいだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, they don't seem open to
negotiations right now.

fields.EN:
There is no need for negotiations.
We just need to fight our way
through.
fields.JP:
話し合いなど必要ない。
力づくで通ればいいだけのことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is no need for negotiations.
We just need to fight our way
through.

fields.JP: ハーちゃんそれは駄目だよ！

fields.EN:
Gretel-san is just trying to protect
her home...
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんは自分たちの
住処が脅かされるって思って、
拒絶してるだけなんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel is just trying to protect
her home...

fields.EN:
That may be so, but honoring
that won't get us through...
fields.JP:
それはそうだけど、
僕たちも先に進まなければいけないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That may be so, but honoring
that won't get us through...

fields.EN:
Hmph! If anything, it's their
fault for not listening to us.
fields.JP: ふん、聞き分けのない向こうが悪いのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! If anything, it's their
fault for not listening to us.

fields.EN:
Hameln's right. We tried reasoning
with them, but they won't even
listen to us.
fields.JP:
……ハーメルンの言うとおりだ。
僕たちは何度も分かってもらおうとした。
でも信じてくれなかったじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln's right. We tried reasoning
with them, but they won't even
listen to us.

fields.EN:
We need to get through, and if
they stand in our way, we need to
force our way through.
fields.JP:
僕たちは通り抜ける。立ち塞がるなら、
もうぶつかり合うしかないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to get through, and if
they stand in our way, we need to
force our way through.

fields.EN:
Well said, Otsuu!
Now we're talking!
fields.JP:
よく言った、おつう！
そうでなければな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said, Otsuu!
Now we're talking!

fields.EN:
But... there isn't any real
reason for us to fight...
fields.JP:
そんな……わたしたち、
ぶつかり合う必要ないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... there isn't any real
reason for us to fight...

fields.EN:
Princess, we can't be running
away at every encounter.
fields.JP:
姫、いつまでも逃げ続けてる
わけにはいかないだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, we can't be running
away at every encounter.

fields.JP: それは……そうなんだけど……

fields.EN:
First we destroy the core here. If
they still won't listen to reason
we'll just have to beat Hansel.
fields.JP:
とりあえず核を破壊する。
その上でまだ聞き分けてもらえないなら、
ヘンゼルを倒すしかないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
First we destroy the core here. If
they still won't listen to reason
we'll just have to beat Hansel.

fields.EN:
Even so, I still don't want to
give up hope...
fields.JP:
それでもわたし……
最後まで諦めたくないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, I still don't want to
give up hope...

fields.EN:
I'd like to believe Gretel will
give in and let us through once
Hansel is no longer immortal, too.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルが不死身じゃなくなれば、
グレーテルも観念して通してくれる……
と思いたいところさ、僕も
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope Gretel will let us
pass once she knows Hansel
isn't invincible anymore...

fields.EN:
We should give her a warning
instead, telling her that we'll
beat them if they don't let us go.
fields.JP:
逆にワレらから警告してやればいいのだ。
通す気がないなら倒す、とな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should give her a warning
instead, telling her that we'll
beat them if they don't let us go.

fields.EN:
You may be right. Showing a strong
front may help us avoid a fight.
fields.JP:
そうだね。強気に出た方が、
ぶつかり合わずに済むかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be right. Showing a strong
front may help us avoid a fight.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぼも……ぐぎぎ……
がん……ばぐ……？

fields.EN:
Yes, we may need your help.
We're counting on you, Jack.
fields.JP:
ああ。もしかしたらジャックにも
頑張ってもらうかも。頼りにしてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we may need your help.
We're counting on you, Jack.

fields.EN:
In any case, we need to make sure
Hansel can be defeated.
fields.JP:
とにかくヘンゼルを倒せる状態に
しておくのが大事だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, we need to make sure
Hansel can be defeated.

fields.EN:
Good, then let's go and search
for the core.
fields.JP:
そうだな。
では核を探すとしようではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good, then let's go and search
for the core.

fields.EN: Ah! So this must be the core!
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah! So this must be the core!

fields.EN:
Sure looks like it.
If we can destroy it...
fields.JP:
うん、間違いないね。
これさえ破壊すれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure looks like it.
If we can destroy it...

fields.EN:
Maybe we can avoid hurting
Gretel-san and the others...
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんたちと
傷つけ合わずに済むかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then maybe we can resolve things
without fighting Gretel.

fields.EN:
That does depend on them,
though...
fields.JP: それは向こうの出方次第……だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That does depend on them,
though...

fields.EN:
And sure enough, the guardian of
the core is here.
fields.JP: む、やはり番人がおったか
fields.LOCALIZED:
And sure enough, the guardian of
the core is here.

fields.EN:
All right, let's get rid of it!
Get ready, Princess!
fields.JP:
よし、さっさと倒してしまおう。
姫、行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's get rid of it!
Get ready, Princess!

fields.EN: Okay, no other Marchen in sight.
fields.JP: よし、もうメルヒェンはいないな
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, no other Marchen in sight.

fields.EN:
Hm, then let's destroy the core
while we still can.
fields.JP:
うむ。おつうよ、
さっさと核を破壊するのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, then let's destroy the core
while we still can.

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
That must mean the core was
destroyed for good.
fields.JP: うん。確かに核を破壊したって証だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must mean the core was
destroyed for good.

fields.EN:
It also means we now have a way
to get through here.
fields.JP: これでワレらの道が開けたということだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also means we now have a way
to get through here.

fields.EN:
First, let's find Hansel and the others.
We need to tell them he's no longer immortal.
fields.JP:
まずはヘンゼルたちを探そう。
もう不死身じゃないってことを伝えるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
First we need to find Hansel and
Gretel. We need to tell them that
Hansel isn't invincible any more.

fields.EN:
At that point, we should be
able to get through smoothly.
fields.JP: そして堂々とこのエリアを通り抜けよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
At that point, we should be
able to get through smoothly.

fields.EN:
Yes, I hope they will listen
to reason now...
fields.JP:
うん……今度こそ
分かってもらわないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I hope they will listen
to reason now...

fields.EN:
But, we still need to prepare for
battle. After all, they haven't
been open to reason all this time.
fields.JP:
人魚姫よ、戦いの覚悟もしておくのだぞ。
何しろ向こうは聞き分けが悪いからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we still need to prepare for
battle. After all, they haven't
been open to reason all this time.

fields.EN:
That's where we need to do our
best so they listen, Haa-chan.
fields.JP:
そうならないように頑張らなきゃ
いけないんだよ、ハーちゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's where we need to do our
best so they listen, Hammy.

fields.EN:
They still may attack us, so like
Hameln said, we should be ready
for battle, Princess.
fields.JP:
でも問答無用で襲ってくる可能性もある。
姫、ハーメルンの言うとおり、いつでも
動けるようにしておくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They still may attack us, so like
Hameln said, we should be ready
for battle, Princess.

fields.EN:
Gretel must have heard the Jail's
wail, so we should be prepared for
anything to come.
fields.JP:
グレーテルにもジェイルの悲鳴は
聞こえてるだろう。油断せずに行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel must have heard the Jail's
wail, so we should be prepared for
anything to come.

fields.EN:
What did you girls do?
I heard the Jail screaming.
fields.JP:
あなたたち、いったい何をしたの？
急にジェイルが悲鳴を上げたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What did you girls do?
I heard the Jail screaming.

fields.EN:
We destroyed the core in this area.
Sorry, but Hansel isn't immortal anymore.
fields.JP:
このエリアの核を破壊したんだ。
悪いけど、ヘンゼルはもう不死身じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We destroyed the core in this
area. Hansel isn't invincible
any more.

fields.EN:
That means that we don't need
to run from you any more!
fields.JP:
これで貴様らから
逃げる必要もなくなったということだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means that we don't need
to run from you any more!

fields.EN:
We really have no intention of harming you
or the others, Gretel-san!
fields.JP:
わたしたちは本当にグレーテルさんたちに
危害を加えるつもりはないんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We really don't want to bring
harm to you or Hansel!

fields.EN:
And, this is coming from the
perpetrators who destroyed
the core...
fields.JP:
そんなことをしておいて
よく言うわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, this is coming from the
perpetrators who destroyed
the core...

fields.EN:
This was the only way we could
get through to you.
fields.JP:
こうでもしないと、
話し合いにすらならなかったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This was the only way we could
get through to you.

fields.EN:
Please, you need to let us
through! That's all we want to do!
fields.JP:
お願いです、わたしたちを通して下さい！
それ以外は本当に何も望みませんから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, you need to let us
through! That's all we want to do!

fields.JP:
……駄目よ。
やはり信用できないわ

fields.EN:
ANYONE WHO TROUBLES
GRETEL... I WON'T FORGIVE THEM...
fields.JP:
グレーテルヲコマラセルヤツハ……
……ユルサナイ…………
fields.LOCALIZED:
I WON'T LET ANYONE LIVE...
IF THEY BRING TROUBLE TO GRETEL...

fields.JP: やっぱり聞いてくれないか……！
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぼくだち……ぎぎ……
なに、も…………じな……い……
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……みんば……
いいびど……んぎぃ……じんじで……

fields.EN:
(If only she understood Jack's
kind words...)
fields.JP:
（ジャックの優しい言葉が
　届いてくれれば……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If only she understood Jack's
kind words...)

fields.EN:
THIS HOUSE OF CANDIES...
IS GRETEL'S HOME...
fields.JP:
コノオカシノイエハ……
グレーテルノバショダ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
THIS HOUSE OF CANDIES...
IS GRETEL'S HOME...

fields.EN:
ALL WHO TRY TO TAKE IT...
ARE ALL BAD...
BAD MUST BE DESTROYED...
fields.JP:
ウバオウトスルニンゲンハ……
……ワルイヤツバカリ……
ワルイヤツハ……タオス…………
fields.LOCALIZED:
ALL WHO TRY TO TAKE IT...
ARE ALL BAD...
BAD MUST BE DESTROYED...

fields.EN:
We're not here to take
anything away from you!
Please, you have to trust us!
fields.JP:
奪ったりしません！
どうか信じて下さい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're not here to take
anything away from you!
Please, you have to trust us!

fields.EN:
Why are you so desperate?
Why don't you just stay where
you belong?
fields.JP:
そこまでして通ろうとしなくても、
自分たちの住処で過ごしていれば
いいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you so desperate?
Why don't you just stay where
you belong?

fields.EN:
That way, you and I wouldn't
have to go through all this.
fields.JP:
そうすれば互いに
関わり合うこともないと思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That way, you and I wouldn't
have to go through all this.

fields.EN:
That's not possible.
Our main goal is to get out
of the Jail, after all.
fields.JP:
それはできない。僕たちの最終目標は、
ジェイルから脱獄することだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not possible.
Our main goal is to get out
of the Jail, after all.

fields.EN:
Get out of the Jail?
Do you really want to leave
this place that badly?
fields.JP:
ジェイルから脱獄……？
そんなにここを出たいというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Get out of the Jail?
Do you really want to leave
this place that badly?

fields.EN:
Gretel may not understand, but if
Marchens capture us humans, they'll
keep torturing us until we die...
fields.JP:
グレーテルは分からないかもしれないけど、
メルヒェンに捕まれば、僕たち人間は
死ぬまで拷問され続けるからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may not see it, but we
humans are destined for torture
if caught by the Marchens.

fields.EN:
That's right. That's why we need
to find our friends.
fields.JP:
そうです。だからわたしたちは
仲間を集めなければならないんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. That's why we need
to find our friends.

fields.EN:
And to do that, we need to get
past here. So please, can you
let us through?
fields.JP:
そのためにこの先に行きたいのです。
お願いです、通りたい、それだけなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
And to do that, we need to get
past here. So please, can you
let us through?

fields.JP: なるほど、事情は理解したわ

fields.EN:
That said, do you have a plan
on how to actually escape from
the Jail?
fields.JP:
それで、肝心の脱獄とやらは
どうやって行うつもりなのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, do you have a plan
on how to actually escape from
the Jail?

fields.EN:
If we can find our friends... If
we find Akazukin, we can at
least fend against the Marchens!
fields.JP:
だけど仲間を集めれば……
赤ずきんに会えれば、もっとメルヒェンに
対抗できるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we can find our friends... If
we find Red Riding Hood, we can at
least fend against the Marchens!

fields.EN:
And with Onee-chan, I'm sure escape
from the Jail is possible!
fields.JP:
そうです、おねーちゃんがいれば、
脱獄も夢じゃありません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And with Sis, I'm sure escape
from the Jail is possible!

fields.EN:
Dawn's professor is also missing,
but I'm sure he knows a way
out, too!
fields.JP:
それに今は行方不明だけど、
黎明の博士なら、きっと脱獄の方法も
知っているはずなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dawn's professor is also missing,
but I'm sure he knows a way
out, too!

fields.EN:
Unbelievable... Your supposed
plan is simply a cobble of
hope and fantasy.
fields.JP:
呆れた。あなたたちの計画は全部、
希望的観測ばかりじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable... Your supposed
plan is simply a cobble of
hope and fantasy.

fields.EN:
You have nothing substantial to
support your escape. I suggest
you just leave and stay put.
fields.JP:
何の根拠もないし、
計画と呼べるものじゃないわ。
帰っておとなしく過ごすべきね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have nothing substantial to
support your escape. I suggest
you just leave and stay put.

fields.JP: 希望を目指して何が悪いんだ！

fields.EN:
If we don't try, then all that
waits us is a slow death!
fields.JP:
何も分からないからって
抗うことを止めたら、それこそ僕たちは
生きながら死んでしまう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we don't try, then all that
waits us is a slow death!

fields.EN:
Otsuu, that's enough.
We're wasting our time trying
to reason with her.
fields.JP:
おつうよ、もういいではないか。
話すだけ時間の無駄というものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, that's enough.
We're wasting our time trying
to reason with her.

fields.EN:
Indeed. This is a waste of my
time. Now, leave.
fields.JP:
そのとおり、時間の無駄だわ。
さっさと帰りなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. This is a waste of my
time. Now, leave.

fields.EN:
I, the hero, Hameln is going
to pave our way through here!
fields.JP:
この勇者ハーメルンが
道を切り開く、と言っておるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I, the hero, Hameln is going
to pave our way through here!

fields.EN:
I see. Well then, I suppose
I will eliminate you all
with force.
fields.JP:
……そう。じゃあもういいわ。
全力で排除させてもらう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Well then, I suppose
I will eliminate you all
with force.

fields.EN:
Everyone, calm down!
Let's try to talk over this...
fields.JP:
みんな、落ち着いて……
もう１度話し合いましょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, calm down!
Let's try to talk over this...

fields.EN:
ELIMINATE...
I WON'T LET ANYONE LIVE...
IF THEY BRING TROUBLE TO GRETEL...
fields.JP:
ハイジョ……
グレーテルヲコマラセルヤツハ……
ハイジョスル……
fields.LOCALIZED:
ELIMINATE...
I WON'T LET ANYONE LIVE...
IF THEY BRING TROUBLE TO GRETEL...

fields.EN:
GRETEL... STAND BACK...
YOU DON'T NEED TO FIGHT...
fields.JP:
グレーテルハ……サガッテテ……
タタカワナクテイイカラネ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
GRETEL... STAND BACK...
YOU DON'T NEED TO FIGHT...

fields.JP: ありがとう、ヘンゼル兄さん

fields.EN:
Princess, it's no use.
We need to take up arms!
fields.JP:
姫、もう駄目だ。
戦うしかない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, it's no use.
We need to take up arms!

fields.JP: 貴様ら、気を抜くでないぞ！

カラダガ……ナオラナイ……
チカラガハイラナイ……

fields.EN:
It's working!
Let's finish it off!
fields.JP:
効いておるぞ！
このまま倒しきるのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's working!
Let's finish it off!

fields.JP:
イタイ…………
デモ……グレーテルヲマモルンダ……

fields.EN: Looks like Hansel-niisan is in danger.
fields.JP: ヘンゼル兄さん……押されているわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like Hansel is in danger.

fields.EN:
Why don't we stop already?
There's no need for us to fight.
fields.JP:
ねえ、もうやめましょう？
互いに争う必要なんてないんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we stop already?
There's no need for us to fight.

fields.EN:
LEAVE...
LEAVE OUR HOUSE OF CANDIES...
fields.JP:
デテイケ……
オカシノイエカラ……デテイケ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
LEAVE...
LEAVE OUR HOUSE OF CANDIES...

fields.EN:
Princess... Hansel won't
stop until he defeats us.
fields.JP:
姫……もう僕たちを倒すまで
ヘンゼルは止まらないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel won't stop any more,
Princess...

fields.EN:
That's why we have no choice
but to steel ourselves and defeat him.
fields.JP:
だから僕たちも覚悟を持って
倒すしかないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The best we can do is show our
respect by defeating it with
all we got.

fields.EN:
That's right, Ningyohime. We have to
keep moving forward. Steel yourself for it.
fields.JP:
そうだぞ人魚姫。
ワレらはこの先に進まねばならぬ。
だから覚悟を持つのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Little Mermaid.
We need to move onward,
so hold some resolve.

fields.EN:
You don't need to tell me
that, but... But...!
fields.JP:
それは分かってるよ……！
けど、けど……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to tell me
that, but... But...!

fields.EN:
If we hesitate, we'll be the ones taken
down. Princess, please... steel yourself.
fields.JP:
躊躇していたらこっちがやられる。
姫、お願いだ……覚悟を決めてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to lose if we don't
keep moving. So please, bear for
what's to come, Princess.

fields.EN:
I WON'T LOSE...
TO BAD PEOPLE...!
fields.JP: ワルモノニハマケナイ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I WON'T LOSE...
TO BAD PEOPLE...!

fields.JP: 来るぞ、貴様ら構えるのだ！
ココカラデテイケーーーーッ！！

fields.EN: Brother Hansel-niisan, are you all right?
fields.JP: ヘンゼル兄さん、大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED: Brother Hansel, are you all right?

fields.EN:
Stepping in my way, are you?
Do you want to be crushed first?
fields.JP:
そのまま傍観しておればよいものを、
間に入るなど……先に殺されたいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stepping in my way, are you?
Do you want to be crushed first?

fields.EN:
I have no intention
of being crushed.
fields.JP: そんな気は毛頭ないのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention
of being crushed.

fields.EN:
But, I do know that our odds of
winning is slim to none.
fields.JP:
でも私たちの勝算が
限りなく低いのも確かね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I do know that our odds of
winning is slim to none.

fields.JP: じゃあもう、降参してくれるか？

fields.EN:
I won't let anyone take away
the place Hansel-niisan and I belong.
fields.JP:
私とヘンゼル兄さんの居場所は
誰にも奪わせない
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one will take our home
from us.

fields.EN:
Why yes.
I lose any chance of winning if
I don't take up arms.
fields.JP:
そう言ってる。
戦わなければ勝利の可能性はゼロだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes.
I lose any chance of winning if
I don't take up arms.

fields.EN:
Please, give up already.
If not...
fields.JP: もう諦めてくれ。じゃないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, give up already.
If not...

fields.EN: I suppose there's no other choice.
fields.JP: そこまで望むなら仕方あるまい
fields.LOCALIZED: I suppose there's no other choice.

fields.EN:
We will never surrender.
Now then, shall we continue?
fields.JP:
私たちは決して屈しない。
さあ、殺し合いの続きをしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
We will never surrender.
Now then, shall we continue?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan... Haa-chan...
Please put your weapons down.
fields.JP:
――おつうちゃん、ハーちゃん、
ちょっと武器を下げてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Hammy...
Please put your weapons down.

fields.EN:
Princess?! What are you saying?!
If we do that, they'll...
fields.JP:
姫！？　何を言ってるんだ
そんなことしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess?! What are you saying?!
If we do that, they'll...

fields.EN:
We've gone this far. The time for
talking is done, Ningyohime!
fields.JP:
そうだぞ人魚姫！
話し合いなど今さら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've gone this far. The time for
talking is done, Little Mermaid!

fields.EN: I said to put your weapons down!
fields.JP: 武器を下ろしてって言ってるの！
fields.LOCALIZED: I said to put your weapons down!

fields.EN:
Urgh... F-Fine, Princess.
Hameln, put your weapon down, too.
fields.JP:
う……わ、分かったよ姫。
ハーメルンも、下ろしてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh... F-Fine, Princess.
Hameln, put your weapon down, too.

fields.EN:
(There's nothing I can do to budge
Princess when she's like this...)
fields.JP:
（こうなった姫はもう
　絶対に引き下がらない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's nothing I can do to budge
Princess when she's like this...)

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, please put your weapon
down, too.
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんも
武器を下ろして下さい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, please put your weapon
down, too.

fields.EN:
What are you planning?
I would appreciate it if you'd
kept your distance.
fields.JP:
ちょっとあなた、何……？
近づいて来ないでくれるかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you planning?
I would appreciate it if you'd
kept your distance.

fields.EN:
No. I need you to put down your
weapon, now.
fields.JP:
それはお断りします。
さあ早く武器を下ろして下さい
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I need you to put down your
weapon, now.

fields.JP: 来ないでって言ってるでしょう！

fields.EN:
Ningyohime, step back while
Otsuu is taking Gretel's attacks!
fields.JP:
人魚姫、おつうがグレーテルの攻撃を
引き受けてる今のうちに下がるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Step back, Little Mermaid!
Otsuu has you covered!

fields.JP: 下がらないよハーちゃん

fields.EN:
You're right... I definitely
wasn't prepared enough.
fields.JP: 確かにわたし、覚悟が足りてなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I probably didn't have the resolve
for this to happen...

fields.JP: 馬鹿者！　さらに近づくなど……！

fields.EN:
I don't know what you're planning,
but... you have my attention.
fields.JP:
何をする気か知らないけど
……面白そうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what you're planning,
but... you have my attention.

fields.EN:
Thank you for putting
your weapon down.
Otsuu-chan? You do the same, too.
fields.JP:
武器を下げてくれてありがとうございます。
さ、おつうちゃんも下ろして
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for putting
your weapon down.
Otsuu? You do the same, too.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Gretel-san, but can I put a little
Marchen blood on you?
fields.JP:
ごめんなさいグレーテルさん、
ちょっとこの『メルヒェンの血』を
つけさせて下さい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but can I put a little
bit of Marchen blood on you?

fields.EN:
I don't mind, but what are you trying
to do by putting Marchen blood on me...?
fields.JP:
構わないけど、メルヒェンの血をつけて
何がしたいというの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine, but what purpose
will that serve?

fields.EN:
You'll know soon enough.
Now then...
fields.JP: すぐに分かります。では……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'll know soon enough.
Now then...

fields.EN:
I had my suspicions,
but this proves it.
Gretel is a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
薄々思っていたけど、
やっぱり、血式少女だったのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had my suspicions,
but this proves it.
Gretel is a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
I recall you mentioning that
before. So, am I this "Blood
Maiden," too?
fields.JP:
以前少し話したわね。
私もその血式少女だというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I recall you mentioning that
before. So, am I this "Blood
Maiden," too?

fields.EN:
Yes. Gretel-san, your eyes turning pink from
the Marchen blood proves you're one of us.
fields.JP:
ええ。グレーテルさんの瞳が、
メルヒェンの血に反応してピンク色に
なっているのが証拠です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Your eyes turning pink from
the Marchen blood proves you're
one of us.

fields.EN:
This is how we identify
and gather Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
わたしたちはこうやって、
血式少女を判別し、集めているのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is how we determine who is
a Blood Maiden.

fields.JP:
グレーテルノメ……
……キレイナピンクイロ……
なるほどね……納得したわ

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, do you remember what Otsuu-chan
said before of our objective?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん。前におつうちゃんが話した
わたしたちの目的……覚えていますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, do you remember what Otsuu
said before of our objective?

fields.EN: You mean to escape from the Jail?
fields.JP: このジェイルを脱獄するってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED: You mean to escape from the Jail?

fields.EN:
Yes. In order to do so, we need as
many Blood Maidens on our side.
fields.JP:
そうです。わたしたちはそのために
血式少女を集めているんです。だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. In order to do so, we need as
many Blood Maidens on our side.

fields.JP:
わたしたちの仲間に、
なってくれませんか？

fields.EN:
Do you believe me to trust you
after the many times you've
denied my warnings to leave?
fields.JP:
何度警告しても引き返さず、
ここまで侵入したあなたたちを
信用しろとでも言うつもり？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you believe me to trust you
after the many times you've
denied my warnings to leave?

fields.EN:
Hansel-san, Gretel-san, I don't want to fight
either of you, and I don't intend to damage
your home.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルさんともグレーテルさんとも、
わたしは戦いたくありません。そして
お２人の家を荒らすつもりもありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't want to fight. We also
don't want to do anything to your
home.

fields.EN:
But, if you still can't believe
my words, please... kill me.
fields.JP:
ですから……信用して頂けないのであれば、
今ここでわたしを殺して下さい
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, if you still can't believe
my words, please... kill me.

fields.JP: なな、何を言ってるんだ姫！？
そうだぞ！　ヤケになるでない！！

fields.EN:
I can see your resolve now,
so just move back already!
fields.JP:
姫の覚悟は分かったから、
だからもう下がるんだ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can see your resolve now,
so just move back already!

fields.EN:
I'm going to prove that we don't
need to fight!
fields.JP:
争う必要なんてないんだって、
わたしが証明してみせる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to prove that we don't
need to fight!

fields.EN:
I will fight the moment you're in
danger, though. You're not going
to stop me from saving you.
fields.JP:
でもいつでも姫を助けられるように、
武器は構えさせてもらう。これだけは
絶対に譲らないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will fight the moment you're in
danger, though. You're not going
to stop me from saving you.

fields.EN:
That should be okay.
I'll make sure I stop the
bloodshed.
fields.JP: 大丈夫。絶対にこれ以上血は流させない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That should be okay.
I'll make sure I stop the
bloodshed.

fields.EN:
You're obviously causing chaos
among your group, but what are
you really planning here?
fields.JP:
……あなた、仲間まで困惑してるけど、
いったいどういうつもりなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're obviously causing chaos
among your group, but what are
you really planning here?

fields.EN:
I already told you.
We have no intention to fight,
and I want you to join us.
fields.JP:
わたしの気持ちは伝えたとおりです。
敵意はない。そして仲間になってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I already told you.
We have no intention to fight,
and I want you to join us.

fields.EN:
If we were of no threat, then
we wouldn't have had to go
through this, right Gretel-san?
fields.JP:
そもそも、敵意がないことを
証明できれば、グレーテルさんは
問題なかったのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we were of no threat, then
we wouldn't have had to go
through this, right Gretel?

fields.EN:
Like I said, if you don't trust me
you can kill me.
fields.JP:
敵意がないということを信用できなければ、
殺して下さいとわたしは言いました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said, if you don't trust me
you can kill me.

fields.EN:
But, you haven't killed me yet.
That means you trust me, yes?
fields.JP:
わたしはまだ殺されていません。なら信用して
頂けたということでいいですね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you haven't killed me yet.
That means you trust me, yes?

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, if you come with us, I'm sure
there'll be plenty of interesting things
you'll like.
fields.JP:
それに、わたしたちについてくれば、
きっとグレーテルさんが好きな
『面白いこと』がたくさんありますよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you come with us, there's
bound to be a lot of interesting
things for you to observe.

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
You are quite interesting.
You've piqued my interest.
fields.JP:
ふふ……あなた、面白いわね。
少し興味が湧いたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
You are quite interesting.
You've piqued my interest.

fields.JP: いいでしょう、殺さないであげる
じゃあ信用して頂けたということですね！
そう取ってもらって構わないわ

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan, do you mind
I join them?
fields.JP:
……ねえヘンゼル兄さん、
この人たちの仲間になってもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dear brother Hansel, do you mind
I join them?

fields.EN:
IF THAT'S WHAT YOU WANT...
GRETEL...
fields.JP:
グレーテルガソウシタイナラ……
……ソウスルトイイヨ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
IF THAT'S WHAT YOU WANT...
GRETEL...

fields.EN: BECAUSE THAT WOULD MAKE YOU HAPPIEST...
fields.JP: ソレガイチバン……シアワセダカラ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
YOU SEEM HAPPIER...
THAT WAY, TOO...

fields.EN:
Thank you very much,
Hansel-san, Gretel-san!
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます！
ヘンゼルさん、グレーテルさん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much,
Hansel, Gretel!

fields.EN:
So, not only did she end the
fighting, but also brought them
in as allies...
fields.JP:
戦いを止めるだけでなく、
仲間にするとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, not only did she end the
fighting, but also brought them
in as allies...

fields.JP: 今回はさすがに肝を冷やしたけどね……

fields.EN:
Still, I couldn't have asked for a
better result. You did very well,
Princess.
fields.JP: でも最高の結果だよ。さすが姫だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, I couldn't have asked for a
better result. You did very well,
Princess.

fields.EN:
All I did was place my trust
in Gretel-san...
fields.JP:
わ、わたしはグレーテルさんを
信じただけだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I did was place my trust
in Gretel...

fields.EN:
Indeed, and that makes you
quite interesting.
fields.JP: なかなかに面白い子ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed, and that makes you
quite interesting.

fields.EN:
She is my pride princess,
after all. Now then, here's to
hoping that we all get along.
fields.JP:
うちの自慢の姫だ。
じゃあ２人とも、これからよろしくな
fields.LOCALIZED:
She is my pride princess,
after all. Now then, here's to
hoping that we all get along.

fields.EN:
That was pretty darn lucky you
found a new Blood Maiden
during the expedition!
fields.JP:
知り合いの血式少女を探してたら
新しい血式少女と出会うって、
なんかすげえラッキーじゃねえか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was pretty darn lucky you
found a new Blood Maiden
during the expedition!

fields.EN:
I understand it was quite the
ordeal, but in any case,
this is good news.
fields.JP:
……大変だったみたいだが、
結果としては嬉しいニュースだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand it was quite the
ordeal, but in any case,
this is good news.

fields.EN:
Sounds like you looked
pretty cool, Ningyo-chan?
fields.JP:
ずいぶんカッコよかったみたいじゃん、
人魚ちゃん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounded like you really
nailed it good, kiddo.

fields.JP: そ、そんなことないです……

fields.EN:
H-Hey! That's my precious baby!
Don't mess with it!
fields.JP:
それはオレの大事な機械だから
あまりいじらないでっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! That's my precious baby!
Don't mess with it!

fields.EN:
Come now, a little fidgeting
won't hurt.
fields.JP: 何よ、ちょっとくらいはいいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, a little fidgeting
won't hurt.

fields.JP: あっ、そのボタン押しちゃダメェっ！

fields.EN:
It's not moving...
Well, that was boring.
fields.JP:
動かなくなったわ。
つまらない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not moving...
Well, that was boring.

fields.EN:
Uh, looks like Gretel just
made Takumi cry...
fields.JP:
おいおい、
タクミが泣いてるぞグレーテル
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, looks like Gretel just
made Takumi cry...

fields.EN:
Yeah, and it looks like she lost
interest quickly, too.
fields.JP: って、もう興味なくしてるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and it looks like she lost
interest quickly, too.

fields.EN:
Next, it looks like she's interested in
the Professor's books Itsuki brought back...
fields.JP:
次はイツキが持ってきた
博士の書物が気になってるみたいだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look. She's rustling around with
the professor's documents...

fields.EN:
We've got a lively crew now.
Jack, Hansel, Gretel, Hameln...
fields.JP:
それにしてもジャックだろ、
あとヘンゼルにグレーテル……
ハーメルンもそうだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've got a lively crew now.
Jack, Hansel, Gretel, Hameln...

fields.EN:
Yup, lively and each pretty
distinct in their own way.
fields.JP:
うん、個性的な仲間ばかり
増えていくねえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, lively and each pretty
distinct in their own way.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

へん……ぜる……
ごのへや……ぜまい……？

ナントカダイジョウブダヨ……
……ジャック……

fields.EN:
Jack and Hansel seem to be
getting along fine.
fields.JP: 和んでるなぁ、ジャックとヘンゼル
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack and Hansel seem to be
getting along fine.

fields.EN:
Indeed. It looks like the Hero
Hameln's Party is growing ever
larger!
fields.JP:
うむ、勇者ハーメルン一行も
段々と大所帯になってきたな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. It looks like the Hero
Hameln's Party is growing ever
larger!

fields.EN:
Uh, we're not part of your
hero fantasy, and we're not called
the Hero Hameln's Party...
fields.JP: だからその団体名やめろっての
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, we're not part of your
hero fantasy, and we're not called
the Hero Hameln's Party...

fields.EN:
Whatever. It's good to see more
on our side.
fields.JP: 何にせよ、仲間が増えるのはいいことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever. It's good to see more
on our side.

fields.EN:
Now then, Otsuu?
We got some new info while
you were out.
fields.JP:
さておつう、君たちがいない間に
こっちも新しい情報を入手したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, Otsuu?
We got some new info while
you were out.

fields.EN:
Apparently a new settler who found
this place witnessed 'a mysterious
blue-haired girl rampaging.'
fields.JP:
この場所を見つけて新しく入ってきた
入植者が『謎の青髪の少女が暴れている』
場面を目撃したらしくてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We got word that a mysterious,
blue-haired girl was running
around in a frenzy out there.

fields.EN:
That sounds like a Blood Maiden
in Blood Skelter, but...
Does the description ring a bell?
fields.JP:
おそらくブラッドスケルター化した
血式少女だと思うんだが……
心当たりはあるかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds like a Blood Maiden
in Blood Skelter, but...
Does the description ring a bell?

fields.EN:
I don't recall any Blood Maiden
in Dawn with blue hair...
fields.JP:
黎明に青い髪の血式少女は
いなかったはずですが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't recall any Blood Maiden
in Dawn with blue hair...

fields.EN:
Alice and Akazukin don't
have blue hair, do they?
fields.JP:
アリスや赤ずきんてのは
青い髪じゃないんだな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice and Red Riding Hood don't
have blue hair, do they?

fields.JP: はい……青髪ではありません

fields.EN:
I tried to recall my days back at
Dawn, and I can't recall anyone
fitting the bill, too.
fields.JP:
僕も黎明時代を思い返してみたが、
該当者がいないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I tried to recall my days back at
Dawn, and I can't recall anyone
fitting the bill, too.

fields.EN:
