Oho! So, that means we have
a new Blood Maiden?
fields.JP: お、ではまた新しい血式少女か！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! So, that means we have
a new Blood Maiden?

fields.EN:
Could also mean we could man
our frontlines better.
fields.JP:
もしかしたらまた戦力が
増えるかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could also mean we could man
our frontlines better.

fields.EN:
If that's true, it would be
surprising to know there are
more of them out there.
fields.JP:
しかしまだまだ
新しい血式少女がいるとはね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's true, it would be
surprising to know there are
more of them out there.

fields.JP: いやいや、彼女はおそらく死んだはず……

fields.EN:
Hm?
Did you say something, Otsuu?
fields.JP: ん、何か言ったかおつう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm?
Did you say something, Otsuu?

fields.JP: ああ、いや何でもないよ

fields.EN:
Fascinating... There are so many
things I still don't know here.
Quite interesting, indeed.
fields.JP:
すごいわ。
まったく知らないことばかり。
これは……楽しいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fascinating... There are so many
things I still don't know here.
Quite interesting, indeed.

fields.EN:
Well, it's good to know that
you're enjoying your time here.
fields.JP: 喜んでもらえたならよかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's good to know that
you're enjoying your time here.

fields.EN:
I need to acquire more knowledge.
Isn't that right, Hansel-niisan?
fields.JP:
これからは色々と知識を
身につけていかなきゃね、ヘンゼル兄さん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to acquire more knowledge.
Isn't that right, Hansel?

fields.EN: GRETEL... YOU'LL LEARN IT IN NO TIME...
fields.JP: グレーテルナラスグダヨ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
YOU WILL ONLY GET SMARTER...
GRETEL...

fields.EN:
I'm sure you'll learn it
in no time too, Hansel-san.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルさんも、
きっとすぐに身につきますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you'll find something
that will interest you too,
Hansel.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎちち……ぼぐど……
いじょ……がん……ばど……

fields.EN:
Jack said he'll help you,
Hansel.
fields.JP:
ジャックも手伝ってくれるって。
よかったな、ヘンゼル
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack said he'll help you,
Hansel.

fields.EN:
Well, with what we went through,
this was quite a tiring day...
fields.JP: しかしさすがのワレも疲れたのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, with what we went through,
this was quite a tiring day...

fields.JP: よし、今日はとりあえず解散するか

fields.EN:
Kaede, do you mind preparing
Hansel and Gretel's room?
fields.JP:
カエデ、悪いがヘンゼルとグレーテルの
部屋を用意してあげてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaede, do you mind preparing
Hansel and Gretel's room?

fields.EN:
Oh wait. Do we even have a room
large enough to fit Hansel?
fields.JP:
って、ヘンゼルが入れる部屋なんて
ここ以外にあったか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh wait. Do we even have a room
large enough to fit Hansel?

fields.EN:
(Good, looks like
they can't see me...)
fields.JP: （よかった、なんとか隠れられた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Good, looks like
they can't see me...)

fields.EN:
I wonder if there are more
towers like these elsewhere.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、こんな風に
様々な場所に監獄塔があるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if there are more
towers like these elsewhere.

fields.EN:
If there's more than one,
then there's likely to be more
somewhere out there.
fields.JP:
２つめが見つかった以上、
可能性としては大いにあり得るわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there's more than one,
then there's likely to be more
somewhere out there.

fields.EN:
So, what the heck is
happening around the world?
fields.JP:
だとしたら……
世界はどうなってるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what the heck is
happening around the world?

fields.EN:
Maybe there is no "world"
on the surface any more...
fields.JP:
もしかしたら地上なんて……
もう存在しないんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe there is no "world"
on the surface any more...

fields.EN:
H-Hey, stop it!
We can't just give up!
fields.JP:
だ、駄目っ！
希望をしっかり持たないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, stop it!
We can't just give up!

fields.EN:
It's still worth considering
as a possibility.
fields.JP: でも考察はするべきよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's still worth considering
as a possibility.

fields.JP: （何か不安がってるみたいだ……）
ねえ……ジャックはどう思う？

fields.EN:
So, what the heck is
happening around the world?
fields.JP:
だとしたら……
世界はどうなってるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what the heck is
happening around the world?

fields.EN:
Maybe there is no "world"
on the surface any more...
fields.JP:
もしかしたら地上なんて……
もう存在しないんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe there is no "world"
on the surface any more...

fields.EN:
H-Hey, stop it!
We can't just give up!
fields.JP:
だ、駄目っ！
希望をしっかり持たないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, stop it!
We can't just give up!

fields.EN:
It's still worth considering
as a possibility.
fields.JP: でも考察はするべきよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's still worth considering
as a possibility.

fields.JP: （何か不安がってるみたいだ……）
ねえ……ジャックはどう思う？

fields.EN:
(I shouldn't be eavesdropping.
I need to get away now...)
fields.JP:
（いけない。聞き耳立てるより、
　今は逃げなくちゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I shouldn't stay here much
longer. I better run while
I still can...)

fields.EN:
After it!
Jack, back us up!
fields.JP:
追うわよみんな！
ジャックは援護お願いっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
After it!
Jack, back us up!

fields.JP: ジャックってば！　起ーきーろーっ！！
ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Finally awake...
Were you dreaming again?
fields.JP:
やーっと起きたかジャック。
また夢でも見ていたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally awake...
Were you dreaming again?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぐき…………もう……
じゅっばる……じがん……？

fields.EN:
Hm? Why yes, it's time
we depart.
fields.JP:
ん？　ああ、そうだよ。
出発時間だ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Why yes, it's time
we depart.

fields.EN:
I'm all ready.
Now, let's get going.
fields.JP:
ほら、僕はもう着替え終わってる。
ジャックがいいなら行くぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm all ready.
Now, let's get going.

fields.EN:
This place is pretty darn
cramped.
fields.JP: この部屋も狭くなったもんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is pretty darn
cramped.

fields.EN:
Well, we do have two
big guys here now.
fields.JP: まあデカイのが２人ばかしいるしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we do have two
big guys here now.

fields.EN:
So, Itsuki, do you have intel
on where this blue-haired
girl is?
fields.JP:
それでイツキ、この前話してた
青い髪の少女の居場所は分かったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Itsuki, do you have intel
on where this blue-haired
girl is?

fields.EN:
I asked the witnesses again, but they were
so desperate to escape that they don't
clearly remember where it happened...
fields.JP:
それが……目撃した者に改めて
聞いたんだが、逃げるのに必死で
場所をはっきり覚えていないそうだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have any solid
information. It seems everyone
was in chaos, so...

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. If the girl
they'd encountered had gone into
Blood Skelter, they could have died.
fields.JP:
仕方ありませんよ。出会った少女が
ブラッドスケルター化していたとしたら、
死ぬところだったでしょうから
fields.LOCALIZED:
The chaos couldn't have been
helped. Whoever saw the girl
would be running for their lives.

fields.EN:
I suppose that means we
don't have any clues to work
off of...
fields.JP:
それじゃあそっちの
手がかりはないのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that means we
don't have any clues to work
off of...

fields.EN:
If that's the case, we should just
head through the Dorm area
as planned.
fields.JP:
なら当初の予定どおりに、
旧学生街エリアの奥に向かおうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's the case, we should just
head through the Dorm area
as planned.

fields.EN:
So we're going beyond where
Gretel was, right?
fields.JP: グレーテルの住処の先であるな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we're going beyond where
Gretel was, right?

fields.EN:
Yeah. I thought we'd investigate that
monster Gretel told us about—the hairy thing
she couldn't tell was human or Marchen.
fields.JP:
ああ。グレーテルが教えてくれた、
毛だらけの人間だかメルヒェンだか
わからない化け物とやらを探ろうと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I figured we could see what
this creature is that Gretel was
talking about.

fields.EN:
You did fight us to get beyond
our abode after all.
fields.JP:
そのために私たちと
戦っていたわけだものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You did fight us to get beyond
our abode after all.

fields.EN: Well then, I will go with you.
fields.JP: いいわ。私も一緒に行くわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well then, I will go with you.

fields.JP: ヘンゼルはどうしようか？

fields.EN:
WILL KILL...
ALL WHO HARMS GRETEL...
fields.JP:
グレーテルヲキズツケルヤツ……
…………タオス……
fields.LOCALIZED:
WILL KILL...
ALL WHO HARMS GRETEL...

fields.EN:
I'm sure having Hansel-san along
would be great, but...
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルさんがいれば
心強いのは確かですが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure having Hansel along
would be great, but...

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan's core is already destroyed.
He's lost his regenerative ability, so
he'd only be a burden if he came with us.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんはもう核を破壊されている。
修復能力はもう失われているから、この先
一緒に来ても足手まといになるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel's core is already
destroyed. It just makes him
a burden more than anything now.

fields.EN:
Uh... You know, you could
use a different word.
fields.JP:
なんつーか……
もうちょっと言葉の選び方ってモンが
あるんじゃねえか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... You know, you could
use a different word.

fields.EN:
I was being precise. That said, if
bringing Hansel-niisan along is a risk,
leaving him is a sane option.
fields.JP:
事実を客観的に述べただけよ。
一緒に来たらヘンゼル兄さんは危険、
ならば置いていくのが正しいと思うけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was being precise. That said, if
bringing Hansel along is a risk,
leaving him is a sane option.

fields.EN:
W-Well, word choice aside,
I'm sure she's saying it because
she cares about Hansel-san.
fields.JP:
ま、まあ……言葉はともかく、
ヘンゼルさんを思ってのことでしょうし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, word choice aside,
I'm sure she's saying it because
she cares about Hansel.

fields.EN:
I DO AS GRETEL SAY...
I STAY BEHIND...
fields.JP:
グレーテルノイウトオリニスル……
オルスバン……スル……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I DO AS GRETEL SAY...
I STAY BEHIND...

fields.EN:
You're so nice, Hansel!
How about we play some games
while they're gone?
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルは偉いねえ！
じゃあ私と一緒に遊ぼっか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so nice, Hansel!
How about we play some games
while they're gone?

fields.JP: ヒカリトアソンデ……マッテル……

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you're getting
along so well with Hansel.
fields.JP:
すごいなヒカリ……
もうヘンゼルと仲良くなってるなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you're getting
along so well with Hansel.

fields.EN:
Hikari is pretty easy to win over,
so I bet Hansel can relax around her.
fields.JP:
ヒカリはチョロいからな。
ヘンゼルも安心できるんだろうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, she's a bit fluttery on the
top, so I bet she matches well
with Hansel.

fields.EN:
Hey, what do you mean
I'm easy to win over, Mamoru?!
fields.JP: ちょっとチョロいって何よマモル！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Mamoru! I heard that!
I'm not fluttery on the top!

fields.EN:
I don't know what 'easy to win over' means,
but you're the first human who's gotten along
with Hansel-niisan. I'm honestly impressed.
fields.JP:
チョロい……が何か分からないけど、
ヘンゼル兄さんと打ち解けた人間は初めて。
素直にすごいと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fluttery? I'm not sure what that
means, but I am impressed that you
can get along with Hansel.

fields.EN:
Huh? Really?
Not like I did anything special...
fields.JP:
え、そう……？
何か照れるね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Really?
Not like I did anything special...

fields.EN:
Hikari, do you mind staying here
with Hansel?
fields.JP:
じゃあヒカリ、この後ヘンゼルと
ちょっと残ってくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikari, do you mind staying here
with Hansel?

fields.EN:
I want to see if Hansel also has
blood qualities similar to that
of Jack.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルにもジャックのような
血の力があるか、調べておきたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to see if Hansel also has
blood qualities similar to that
of Jack.

fields.JP: よし、じゃあ出発しようか

fields.EN:
Hikari-chan, everyone, please take care of
Hansel-san, okay?
fields.JP:
ヒカリちゃん、みなさん、
ヘンゼルさんをよろしくお願いしますね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, please take care of
Hansel, okay?

fields.EN: So, this is the Waterside area...
fields.JP: ここが旧河川・沼エリアか……
fields.LOCALIZED: So, this is the Waterside area...

fields.EN:
Sure feels different from the
other places...
fields.JP: これまでとまた違った雰囲気……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure feels different from the
other places...

fields.EN:
The location isn't very welcoming
to be called a home.
fields.JP: ここは何だか住みづらそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The location isn't very welcoming
to be called a home.

fields.EN:
Living at my abode back at base
is quite a thing in comparison,
isn't it!
fields.JP:
ハーメルン解放地区は住んだら
他には行けない心地よさであろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Living at my abode back at base
is quite a thing in comparison,
isn't it!

fields.JP: いいえ、決してそんなことはないけれど

fields.EN:
What?!
I'm going to kick you arht!
fields.JP:
何をー！？
追い出すぞきしゃまっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?!
I'm going to kick you arht!

fields.EN:
Been a while since you
stumbled over your words.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't heard you slur in
a while now.

fields.EN: I didn't stumble over my words!!

I would keep your voice down to
avoid gathering attention.
fields.JP:
あまり騒ぐと無駄にメルヒェンを
呼び寄せることになるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would keep your voice down to
avoid gathering attention.

fields.EN: You don't have to tell me that!
fields.JP: そんなの分かってるのだー！
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't have to tell me that!

fields.JP: （この２人、絶対に相性よくないな……）

fields.EN: Or rather, the howl of a 'monster,' perhaps.
fields.JP: もしくは『化け物』の遠吠え、かしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be accurate, it sounded like
some monster roared.

fields.EN:
Hm, and if this "monster" is who
we're after, then we need to
be really careful...
fields.JP:
なるほど……これが僕たちの目的の
ものだとすると、慎重に行かないとな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, and if this "monster" is who
we're after, then we need to
be really careful...

fields.JP: 遠吠えって、ちょっと怖いね……

fields.EN:
Not to worry my dear princess.
I will protect you from danger,
be it monster or beast.
fields.JP:
大丈夫ですよ、姫。どんな獣も化け物も、
僕が追い払ってみせましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to worry my dear princess.
I will protect you from danger,
be it monster or beast.

fields.EN:
O-Okay...
I'm counting on you, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
う、うん……
頼りにしてるね、おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Okay...
I'm counting on you, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
It feels like we're a lot
closer to where the roar
came from.
fields.JP:
あの遠吠えにだいぶ
近づいてきたんじゃないか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels like we're a lot
closer to where the roar
came from.

fields.EN:
Which means that there's
a Nightmare nearby.
fields.JP: ナイトメアが近くにおるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that there's
a Nightmare nearby.

fields.JP:
うぅぅ……ぐぎぎ……
……がぁぁ……ぐ…………

fields.EN:
It's the Nightmare that
destroyed our former base,
Dawn!
fields.JP:
僕たちの前の拠点、
黎明を滅ぼしたナイトメアさ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's the Nightmare that
destroyed our former base,
Dawn!

fields.JP: うぅぅ……ぐぁぁぁーーっ！！
な、なんなのだ、いきなり！？
手が出せる状況じゃないよ！

fields.EN:
There's no way we want to
get mixed up in their fight!
fields.JP:
巻き込まれて乱戦、
なんてなったら大変だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we want to
get mixed up in their fight!

fields.EN:
(If we were to assist, it would
be that hairy creature, but...)
fields.JP:
（どちらかに加勢するなら、
　毛玉の化け物に違いないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If we were to assist, it would
be that hairy creature, but...)

fields.EN:
A true monster versus monster
battle.
fields.JP: まさに化け物対化け物ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
A true monster versus monster
battle.

fields.EN:
It looks as if the hairy monster
is at a disadvantage.
fields.JP:
戦況としては毛玉の化け物が
押されている感じね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks as if the hairy monster
is at a disadvantage.

fields.EN:
There's no way we can beat
the Nightmare now, so we need to
be ready to run at any moment.
fields.JP:
少なくともナイトメアは今は倒せない。
いつでも逃げられるようにしてないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we can beat
the Nightmare now, so we need to
be ready to run at any moment.

fields.EN: That Nightmare is looking at us!
fields.JP: しかもナイトメアの方だぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: That Nightmare is looking at us!

fields.EN:
Everyone! If it comes our way,
we're going to run, got it?!
fields.JP:
みんな、ナイトメアがこっちに
来るようなら、すぐ逃げるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! If it comes our way,
we're going to run, got it?!

fields.JP: 危ないところだったね……

fields.EN:
All is well as long as
we're safe...
fields.LOCALIZED:
All is well as long as
we're safe...

fields.EN:
(Why did that Nightmare run
off like that?)
fields.JP:
（でもどうして、あのナイトメアは
　急に逃げ出したんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why did that Nightmare run
off like that?)

fields.EN:
(And, what's with the emotions
coming from it?)
fields.JP:
（それにあのナイトメアから
　流れてきた感情……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And, what's with the emotions
coming from it?)

fields.EN:
(I sensed it being surprised,
and... sad?)
fields.JP:
（あの感情は驚き……
　それと……悲しみ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I sensed it being surprised,
and... sad?)

fields.EN:
Say, Tsuu?
What do you plan on doing with
that hairy monster?
fields.JP:
ねえ、つう。
それであの毛玉の化け物は
どう対処するつもり？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu?
What do you plan on doing with
that hairy monster?

fields.JP: ということは、人間なのか……？

fields.EN:
I suppose that could explain
why it has so much hair.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、あの毛玉は
髪の毛ということになるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that could explain
why it has so much hair.

fields.EN:
(It's trying to keep us back...
What to do...)
fields.JP:
（すっごい威嚇してる……
　どうしようか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's trying to keep us back...
What to do...)

fields.EN:
Come now, there's nothing to
be afraid of. Do you want some
candy?
fields.JP:
ほら、怖くないよ。
お菓子、食べる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, there's nothing to
be afraid of. Do you want some
candy?

fields.EN: Don't worry, we won't hurt you.
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry, we won't hurt you.

fields.JP: ほーらいい子いい子ー

ん～～～～～！
いいひと！　いいひと！
さすがとしか言えない……
あなたはなんてお名前なの？

はぐはぐ……ラプ……
……ラプンツェル！

fields.EN:
Okay, so Rapu-chan then.
Where did you come from, Rapu-chan?
fields.JP:
じゃあラプちゃんだね。
ラプちゃんはどこから来たのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, so Rappy then.
Where did you come from, Rappy?

fields.JP:
どこでもない！
ずっと、ここ！

fields.EN:
So, she wandered around
this area all by herself?
fields.JP:
ずっと独房エリアを１人で
彷徨っていたのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, she wandered around
this area all by herself?

fields.EN:
She can face a Nightmare
head-on all by herself...
fields.JP:
１人でナイトメアに
真っ向から立ち向かえるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, she tried to fight
that Nightmare by herself.

fields.EN:
Tsuu, you don't suppose she's
a Blood Maiden, do you?
fields.JP:
つう、ラプンツェルは
血式少女なのではないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you don't suppose she's
a Blood Maiden, do you?

fields.EN:
That's what I thought, too.
No, that has to be it.
fields.JP: 僕も思った……それ以外あり得ないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I thought, too.
No, that has to be it.

fields.EN:
Princess? Do you mind splashing
a bit of this Marchen blood?
fields.JP:
姫、ちょっとメルヒェンの血を
その子にかけてもらってもいいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess? Do you mind splashing
a bit of this Marchen blood?

fields.JP: 分かった、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
That proves it...
Rapunzel is a Blood Maiden!
fields.JP:
よし、ラプンツェルは
確かに血式少女だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That proves it...
Rapunzel is a Blood Maiden!

fields.EN:
Okay, well Rapu-chan?
How about you come with us?
fields.JP:
じゃあラプちゃん、
わたしたちと一緒に行かない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, well Rappy?
How about you come with us?

fields.EN:
She doesn't seem to understand
what you just said.
fields.JP: あまりよく分かってないみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't seem to understand
what you just said.

fields.EN:
You... Look like fish...
Look tasty...
fields.JP:
なんか……おさかなみたい。
おいしそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You... Look like fish...
Look tasty...

fields.EN:
Whatever the reason... she's
grown even more attached to her.
fields.JP: 理由はともあれ……さらに懐いたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, despite the reason, it seems
like she's attracted to her.

fields.EN:
And, it also looks like she'll
follow us now!
fields.JP: 何だか着いてきそうな雰囲気ではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, it also looks like she'll
follow us now!

fields.JP: じゃあこのまま出発しましょう

お魚って……
まぁ……いいけれど……
じゃあラプちゃん、一緒に――

fields.EN: Rapu-chan, you're not wearing any clothes!
fields.JP: やだ、ラプちゃん服着てないじゃない！

fields.EN:
There's no way we can have her
around naked...
fields.JP:
さすがにその状態で
連れ回すのは何だか気が引けるね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we can have her
around naked...

fields.EN:
So, it looks like you were
able to find a Blood Maiden
quite easily.
fields.JP:
なるほど、今回は早速
血式少女を見つけられたんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it looks like you were
able to find a Blood Maiden
quite easily.

fields.EN:
You've been on quite a
lucky streak lately! I'm moved!
fields.JP:
最近ツキまくってるじゃないのー！
アタシ感動しちゃう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lucky you! We're so on a roll
it makes me wanna shout!

fields.EN:
I'm happy that a new member joins
Hameln's heroic party!
fields.JP:
勇者ハーメルンの仲間が
また増えてワレは嬉しいぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy that a new member joins
Hameln's heroic party!

fields.EN:
I hate to dampen things, but it
isn't all good news.
We met "that" Nightmare...
fields.JP:
でも嬉しいニュースばかりではないんだ。
出たんだ……あのナイトメアが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hate to dampen things, but it
isn't all good news.
We met "that" Nightmare...

fields.EN:
You mean the one that destroyed
Dawn?
fields.JP: もしかして黎明を滅ぼしたナイトメアか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean the one that destroyed
Dawn?

fields.EN:
I see...
It ran off to that area, eh?
fields.JP:
なるほど、そっちの方に
逃げてやがったのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
It ran off to that area, eh?

fields.EN:
It went deeper in, so I'm sure
we'll encounter it again if we
search the area thoroughly.
fields.JP:
奥へ逃げていったから、
あのエリアを探索するのであれば、
また遭遇する可能性は充分あるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It went deeper in, so I'm sure
we'll encounter it again if we
search the area thoroughly.

fields.EN:
I put some clothes I had on hand
on Rapu-chan!
fields.JP:
ラプちゃんに服、
適当に見繕ったよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I put some clothes I had on hand
on Rappy!

fields.EN:
Huh...
Rapunzel looks quite cute in that.
fields.JP:
へえ……ラプンツェル、
ちゃんとすればとても可愛いじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...
Rapunzel looks quite cute in that.

fields.EN:
Indeed!
You're not the same as before!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
You're not the same as before!

fields.EN:
She looks so good and sweet
that I'd almost wanna eat her!
fields.JP:
確かに、アタシ
食べちゃいたいくらいだわ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She looks so good and sweet
that I'd almost wanna eat her!

fields.JP:
おーーーー
ひとがいっぱいーーーー

fields.EN:
That looks so good on you,
Rapu-chan!
fields.JP: ラプちゃん洋服似合ってるよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
That looks so good on you,
Rappy!

fields.JP:
えへへ～～～
ありがとーーーーー

fields.EN:
Say, Rapunzel?
Do you mind I ask you about that
Nightmare you fought back there?
fields.JP:
なあラプンツェル、
ちょっとあの謎のナイトメアについて
聞いてもいいか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Rapunzel?
Do you mind I ask you about that
Nightmare you fought back there?

fields.EN: It's the monster you were fighting, Rapu-chan.
fields.JP: ラプちゃんが戦ってた化け物のことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, that monster you were
fighting?

fields.EN:
That one! It came here
recently and was rampaging!
fields.JP:
あいつ！　さいきんやってきて、
あばれてたあいつ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That thing! Thing came by and
made plenty problems!

fields.JP:
ああ、そいつのことだと思う。
続けてくれ、ラプンツェル

fields.EN: Um, there was another bad one here originally!
fields.JP: あのね、もともとヤなやつはべつにいた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, more bad problem was
with other one!

fields.EN:
Is she talking about the
Nightmare...  I mean, the monster
that's stationed there?
fields.JP:
あのエリアに最初からいた
ナイトメア……化け物のことかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is she talking about the
Nightmare...  I mean, the monster
that's stationed there?

fields.EN:
That monster so strong!
Rapunzel was always in danger!
fields.JP:
でもあいつはもっとつよくて……
ラプンツェル、いつもあぶなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That monster so strong!
Rapunzel was always in danger!

fields.EN:
It was killing everything that moved
except that one... It was really awful...
fields.JP:
あいつ、あいついがいの
うごいてるやつぜんぶ……ころしてた……
すごくたいへんだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Monster was killing everything...
So bad...

fields.EN:
I see... It must have been tough.
Well, you're fine with us now.
fields.JP:
そっか……大変だったね。
もう大丈夫だからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... It must have been tough.
Well, you're fine with us now.

fields.EN:
I see... That sounds just like
what happened with Dawn.
Hm, killing everything in sight...
fields.JP:
なるほど……黎明の時と同じだな。
とにかく目につくものすべて殺す……か
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... That sounds just like
what happened with Dawn.
Hm, killing everything in sight...

fields.EN:
Since Nightmares are connected
with an area's core, I doubt it
can wander outside of its locale.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは核と繋がっているから、
普通はエリアから出てこないと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since Nightmares are connected
with an area's core, I doubt it
can wander outside of its locale.

fields.EN:
Right. The core makes the Nightmare
impossible to kill.
fields.JP:
核のおかげで不死性が
保たれているんだもんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. The core makes the Nightmare
impossible to kill.

fields.EN:
And yet, that Nightmare can
move between areas...
Quite intriguing...
fields.JP:
だが、あのナイトメアはエリア間を
移動する……。いったい何なのだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, that Nightmare can
move between areas...
Quite intriguing...

fields.EN:
You don't suppose that
Nightmare is "Snark?"
fields.JP:
もしかしてあのナイトメアこそ
『スナーク』なんじゃないか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't suppose that
Nightmare is "Snark?"

fields.JP: スナーク？　なんだ、そりゃ

fields.EN:
It's a Nightmare called the
king of Nightmares—one of the
strongest class of Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアの王……と言われる
最強クラスのナイトメアのことさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's called the king of
Nightmares. It's the strongest of
all the Nightmares around.

fields.EN:
Strongest?! Are you saying that
it's stronger than me?!
fields.JP:
最強！？　なんだと、
ワレよりも強いというのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Strongest?! Are you saying that
it's stronger than me?!

fields.EN:
At the very least, we have no
chance against it in our current
state.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、今の僕たちじゃ
太刀打ちできないんじゃないかな。
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least, we have no
chance against it in our current
state.

fields.EN:
I recall hearing about this
"Snark" creature from before.
fields.JP:
僕もそのスナークについては
多少聞きかじっているよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I recall hearing about this
"Snark" creature from before.

fields.EN:
It was the very one that killed
the founding members of
Dawn...
fields.JP:
なんせ昔、黎明の初期メンバーを
惨殺した奴だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was the very one that killed
the founding members of
Dawn...

fields.EN:
Yes... I heard it was strong, and
equally vicious and merciless...
fields.JP:
ああ……恐ろしいほどの強さと
残虐性を持った奴らしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I heard it was strong, and
equally vicious and merciless...

fields.EN:
The only one who survived the
attack was the professor.
He's currently lost, too.
fields.JP:
その時に生き残ったのは博士だけ。
そしてその博士もこの間の黎明壊滅の時に
行方不明だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only one who survived the
attack was the professor.
He's currently lost, too.

fields.EN:
That sounds just like what
happened back there at the
Dawn place.
fields.JP: そう聞くと、やり口が似てるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds just like what
happened back there at the
Dawn place.

fields.EN:
At the very least,
I can deduce that the Nightmare
holds tremendous power.
fields.JP:
確かにあのナイトメア、
計り知れない力を有していそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least,
I can deduce that the Nightmare
holds tremendous power.

fields.EN:
And, it's roaming around freely.
Isn't that dangerous...?
fields.JP:
そんな化け物が、
自由に動き回ってるんだ……
なんかとても怖いよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, it's roaming around freely.
Isn't that dangerous...?

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I'll be sure to
protect our place here.
fields.JP:
心配すんなって。この解放地区は
俺がしっかり守ってやるからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I'll be sure to
protect our place here.

fields.EN:
Even so, I doubt we stand much
chance with our current
defenses...
fields.JP:
とはいえ、そんな奴相手に
解放地区の守備を固めたところで
どれだけ効果があるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, I doubt we stand much
chance with our current
defenses...

fields.EN:
Great work, Brainiac!
Way to dampen the mood!
fields.JP:
バカっ！　こういう時に
そんな更にテンション下がるようなこと
言うんじゃねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great work, Brainiac!
Way to dampen the mood!

fields.EN:
Humans are always at a
disadvantage here, so we have to
at least stay strong in our heart!
fields.JP:
いつだってあたしたち人間が
分が悪いってのは分かってんだよ。
だからせめて心では負けるなっての！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Humans are always at a
disadvantage here, so we have to
at least stay strong in our heart!

fields.EN:
So if anything, now is the time
to liven up the mood, you hear?
fields.JP:
だーかーら、こういう時はもっと
明るいこと話すもんなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if anything, now is the time
to liven up the mood, you hear?

fields.EN:
Okay! How about we get a bit
more info from Rapu-chan on who
she is?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ハイ！
新しい仲間であるラプちゃんのこと、
もっと知りたいなー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! How about we get a bit
more info from Rappy on who
she is?

fields.EN:
Ooh, that sounds good!
I wouldn't mind getting to know
her better, too!
fields.JP:
わ、いいですね！
わたしも聞きたいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh, that sounds good!
I wouldn't mind getting to know
her better, too!

fields.JP: ラプちゃんの生まれはどこ？

fields.EN: Dunno! When I realized it, I was there!
fields.JP:
わかんない！
きづいたらあそこにいたーーー！
な、なんという予想外の答え……

fields.EN:
Okay, then what kind of things
did you eat out there?
fields.JP: じゃあ何食べて生きてたんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then what kind of things
did you eat out there?

fields.JP:
なに……たべて……？
……えーっとね……あれ！

fields.EN:
W-Wall?
You mean the Jail's wall?
fields.JP:
か、かべって……
ジェイルの壁のことかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wall?
You mean the Jail's wall?

fields.JP: うん！　かべたべてた！

fields.EN:
Oh, you didn't know?
It's quite delectable.
fields.JP: あら。なかなかいけるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you didn't know?
It's quite delectable.

fields.JP: お前も食べてたのかよ……
あとはメルヒェン！　おいしいよ！

fields.EN:
I see...
That never dawned on me.
fields.JP: なるほど……その発想はなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
That never dawned on me.

fields.EN:
Um, that doesn't need to
dawn on you...
fields.JP: いや、そこ感心するとこじゃねえから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, that doesn't need to
dawn on you...

fields.EN:
Sure, I thought the Jail walls
and Marchen blood were sweet...
but that taste is, like, crazy.
fields.JP:
確かにジェイルの壁もメルヒェンの血も、
甘いとは思ったけどよ……あれは
なんていうか、ヤバイ味だぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well to be fair, I knew the Jail's
walls and Marchen blood was
sweet, but you shouldn't eat them.

fields.JP: あはは！　ここたかーい！
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……のぼっだら……
あ……あぶな……ぎぎよ……

ラプンツェル、
ジャックに登っちゃ駄目だって
ここきにいったーーー！
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Oh well...
At least Jack doesn't seem
to mind at all.
fields.JP:
ジャックもなんだか
楽しそうだし……まあいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh well...
At least Jack doesn't seem
to mind at all.

fields.EN:
Ooh! Rapunzel was trying
to make babies!
fields.JP:
でねーー？　ラプンツェル、
こどもつくるのがんばってたの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! Rapunzel was trying
to make babies!

fields.EN:
Uh...
Did I just hear her right?
fields.JP: あ……あたしの聞き間違いじゃないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh...
Did I just hear her right?

fields.JP:
でもなかなかできないのー！
ラプンツェル、もっとがんばるの！！

fields.EN:
Hmm... Even I really
can't understand this one...
fields.JP:
うーん……これはさすがに
ちょっと理解できないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I hope she's trying
to say something else...

fields.EN:
I guess I can ask her about
that another time.
fields.JP: 今度またちゃんと、聞くことにしようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I can ask her about
that another time.

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan? Are you taking
Rapu-chan on the next exploration?
fields.JP:
ねえおつうちゃん、
次の探索、ラプちゃんは連れて行くの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu?
Are you planning on bringing
Rapunzel along on the next outing?

fields.EN:
Well, I would feel terrible
dragging such a young child
to the dangers outside...
fields.JP:
そこなんだけど……
幼い子を連れて行くのは
少しかわいそうな気がして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I would feel terrible
dragging such a young child
to the dangers outside...

fields.EN:
But, she was able to fight a
Nightmare by herself.
She could prove really helpful.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはあの
ナイトメアと渡り合っているのよ？
充分な戦力だと思うけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she was able to fight a
Nightmare by herself.
She could prove really helpful.

fields.EN:
I suppose...
It's not like we have the luxury
anyway...
fields.JP:
それもそうだな……
今はなりふり構ってる場合でもないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose...
It's not like we have the luxury
anyway...

fields.EN:
All right, let's bring her
with us, and...
Welcome to the party, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
……じゃあ連れて行くことにしよう。
改めてよろしくな、ラプンツェル
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's bring her
with us, and...
Welcome to the party, Rapunzel.

fields.JP: うん！　よろしくーーーー！！

fields.EN:
Yes. Now we can fight the
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
ああ。これで
ようやくナイトメアと戦えるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Now we can fight the
Nightmare.

fields.EN: Look! The guardian of the core!
fields.JP: ほれ、核の番人が出てきたぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Look! The guardian of the core!

fields.JP: うーー！　うぅぅぅーー！！

fields.EN:
If things get dangerous get
behind me, Rapu-chan!
fields.JP:
ラプちゃん、危なくなったら
わたしの後ろに来るんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If things get dangerous get
behind me, Rappy!

fields.EN:
Work as a team, and we'll be
able to get through just fine!
fields.JP:
みんな、お互いに
カバーしあって突破するぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Work as a team, and we'll be
able to get through just fine!

fields.EN:
That was supposed to be the
guardian? What a joke.
fields.JP:
これで番人とは
随分と笑わせてくれるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was supposed to be the
guardian? What a joke.

fields.JP:
気が合うな！
まったくそのとおりなのだ
でもハーメルン、疲れてないか？
そ、そんなことにゃいのだ！

fields.EN: Yeah, you stumbled over your words.

Fine... I'll just assume you're
not tired.
fields.JP:
まあ、疲れてない……
……ということにしておくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I'll just assume you're
not tired.

fields.EN: All right, let's destroy the core.
fields.JP: よし、それじゃあ核を破壊するぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: All right, let's destroy the core.

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
Now we can face the Nightmare in
this area.
fields.JP:
これでこのエリアも
ナイトメアに立ち向かっていけるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now we can face the Nightmare in
this area.

fields.EN:
I can't wait to face it!
Let's go!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアと戦う時が楽しみだ。
では行くぞ貴様らー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't wait to face it!
Let's go!

fields.EN:
Ahaha! Blood all over!
So much blood! So fun!
fields.JP:
あははっ！　ちがいっぱいっ！
いっぱいでてくるっ！　たのしいー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahaha! Blood all over!
So much blood! So fun!

fields.EN:
Wha-?! What are you doing with
that dead Marchen?!
fields.JP:
なっ……！　メルヒェンの死体で
何をやっているの……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! What are you doing with
that dead Marchen?!

fields.EN:
She's stabbing it repeatedly...
Is she... playing?
fields.JP:
何度も突き刺して……
もしかして遊んでいる……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's stabbing it repeatedly...
Is she... playing?

fields.JP:
いっしょにやるー？
たのしいよー！！

fields.EN:
We needed to kill that Marchen
so that we can live, but...
fields.JP:
確かに、わたしたちは生きるために
そのメルヒェンを殺す必要があったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We needed to kill that Marchen
so that we can live, but...

fields.EN:
The Marchen fought only to protect
the Jail. We just fought because
it was for survival.
fields.JP:
でもメルヒェンもジェイルを守るという
掟のためにわたしたちを襲っただけ。
互いに生きるために行っていることなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchen fought only to protect
the Jail. We just fought because
it was for survival.

fields.EN:
Fighting can't be helped now,
but once everything is done...
Please, leave it alone.
fields.JP:
ぶつかり合うのは仕方ない。
でも戦いが終わったら……
もうそれ以上汚すのは、やめてあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting can't be helped now,
but once everything is done...
Please, leave it alone.

fields.EN:
Indeed! Stabbing is a weak
choice. It's faster to simply
burn it to smithereens!
fields.JP:
うむ、何度も刺すのはまどろっこしい。
パパッと焼き尽くすのがいいのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! Stabbing is a weak
choice. It's faster to simply
burn it to smithereens!

fields.EN:
On the contrary, repeated stabbing
is useful in ensuring that the
target is indeed dead.
fields.JP:
いいえ、ちゃんと生命活動が停止したか、
確認のために刺し続けるのは有効よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, repeated stabbing
is useful in ensuring that the
target is indeed dead.

fields.EN:
Uh, that's not what Princess
wanted to try and relay...
fields.JP:
いや、姫が言ってるのは
そういうことじゃないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, that's not what Princess
wanted to try and relay...

fields.EN:
(If Princess heard those two
they would be in for a scolding
of their lives...)
fields.JP:
（まったく、姫に聞こえてたら
　２人とも怒られてるぞ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If Princess heard those two
they would be in for a scolding
of their lives...)

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan, all I ask is that you
respect life and what used to
contain that life.
fields.JP:
ラプちゃん、どうか命、
それ自体には敬意を持ってあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, all I ask is that you
respect life and what used to
contain that life.

fields.EN:
Um... Um...
No stabby if it's dead?
fields.JP:
んっと、んっと、
しんだらもうさしちゃだめ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Um...
No stabby if it's dead?

fields.EN:
Okay! Rapunzel won't stab
dead Marchens!
fields.JP:
わかった！　ラプンツェル、
もうしんだメルヒェンささないっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Rapunzel won't stab
dead Marchens!

fields.EN:
Very good, Rapu-chan.
That's a good girl.
fields.JP:
ラプちゃんはいい子ね。
よしよし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very good, Rappy.
That's a good girl.

fields.EN:
Mmm...!
I likey getting my head rubbed!
fields.JP:
ん～～～！
あたまナデナデされるの、すきー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...!
I likey getting my head rubbed!

fields.EN:
Oh my, Rapu-chan, your
beautiful hair is all dirty.
fields.JP:
あらら、ラプちゃんせっかくの
綺麗な髪の毛が汚れちゃってるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, your beautiful hair is
all dirty now.

fields.EN:
You have blood and... some
debris stuck in there.
fields.JP:
血はべっとり付いてるし、
小さな瓦礫の破片も絡んじゃってる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have blood and... some
debris stuck in there.

fields.JP:
えっ！？　うそっ！？
やだやだやだーーーー！

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan, don't spit on your hair
like that!
fields.JP:
ラプちゃん髪の毛にツバなんて
つけちゃ駄目だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, don't spit on your hair
like that!

fields.EN:
Wanna clean...
Sob... Wanna keep clean...
fields.JP:
きれいにしないと……
ぐすっ、きれいにしないと……っ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wanna clean...
Sob... Wanna keep clean...

fields.EN:
(I see... Rapunzel doesn't know
any other way of cleaning
herself.)
fields.JP:
（そうか……ラプンツェルはそれ以外、
　綺麗にする方法を知らないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... Rapunzel doesn't know
any other way of cleaning
herself.)

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan, just use a handkerchief.
Here, let me wipe you clean.
fields.JP:
ラプちゃん、そういう時は
ハンカチを使うといいよ。
ほら、拭いてあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, just use a handkerchief.
Here, let me wipe you clean.

fields.JP:
ほんとう？　
うぅ、人魚ありがと……！

fields.EN:
I need to keep hair clean...
Rapunzel can't make babies
if dirty...
fields.JP:
かみのけすてきにしないと
ラプンツェル、こどもつくれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to keep hair clean...
Rapunzel can't make babies
if dirty...

fields.EN: I recall you saying that before.
fields.JP: 前も言ってたね、そんなこと
fields.LOCALIZED: I recall you saying that before.

fields.EN: Why do you want babies, Rapu-chan?
fields.JP: ラプちゃんはどうしてこどもがほしいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why do you want babies, Rappy?

fields.EN:
I don't think your hair is
important. It's just that...
you're not ready for babies yet.
fields.JP:
その、髪の毛のことよりも
身体がまだ産むには早いんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think your hair is
important. It's just that...
you're not ready for babies yet.

fields.EN:
Urrh...
I need to keep hair clean...
fields.JP:
うぅ……とにかく、
かみのけはきれいにしておかないとなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh...
I need to keep hair clean...

fields.EN:
Even at her age she wants babies,
so she tries to keep her
hair clean...
fields.JP:
まだ幼いのに、こどもを作りたい、
そのために髪の毛をきれいにする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even at her age she wants babies,
so she tries to keep her
hair clean...

fields.EN:
I assume that may be Rapunzel's
Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
それこそがラプンツェルの
血式リビドーなんじゃないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume that may be Rapunzel's
Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
An obsession that's hard for others
to understand. What Rapunzel is
describing right now fits that exactly.
fields.JP:
他人には理解しがたい強迫観念。
まさに今のラプンツェルの話がそうだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
A forced sense of urgency that
other's can't relate to. Her
desire seems to fit that bill.

fields.EN:
I see...
I guess it can't be helped then.
fields.JP: なるほど……それじゃあ仕方ないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
I guess it can't be helped then.

fields.EN:
Wanting to keep herself clean
almost sounds like Cinderella.
fields.JP:
身なりをきれいにしたがるって、
なんだかシンデレラみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wanting to keep herself clean
almost sounds like Cinderella.

fields.EN:
Hm? Who's that?
Don't tell me that person is
more noticeable than me...
fields.JP:
ん？　誰だそいつは？　まさかワレより
偉くて目立ってる……などとは言うまいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Who's that?
Don't tell me that person is
more noticeable than me...

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Hameln.
Not many can stand up to being
as "noticeable" as you...
fields.JP:
安心するんだ、ハーメルンより
目立つ奴はなかなかいない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Hameln.
Not many can stand up to being
as "noticeable" as you...

fields.EN:
Indeed!
I am the most noticeable
one around!
fields.JP:
そうであるかー！
ワレがいっちばん目立つのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
I am the most noticeable
one around!

fields.EN:
So you're avoiding saying
which one is more impressive.
fields.JP: 偉いかどうかは伏せるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see we're turning the blind eye
to whether that's a good thing or
bad thing.

fields.EN:
Neither of them is more
impressive than the other...
fields.JP: いや、どっちも偉いとかないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Trust me, neither of them hold
"good" noticeable qualities...

fields.EN:
You've piqued my interest.
Who is this "Cinderella?"
fields.JP:
でも私も少し気になってきたわ。
シンデレラとは何者？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've piqued my interest.
Who is this "Cinderella?"

fields.EN:
She's a Blood Maiden who was
always well-dressed, and held
a big heaping of pride.
fields.JP:
シンデレラは昔いた血式少女で……
いつも自信満々で、身だしなみには
特に気をつかう奴だったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's a Blood Maiden who was
always well-dressed, and held
a big heaping of pride.

fields.EN:
Hm, and I assume she is one
of those who went missing?
fields.JP: ふむ、そやつも今回はぐれてしまったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, and I assume she is one
of those who went missing?

fields.EN:
No... Cinderella disappeared much
earlier, when we were still children.
fields.JP:
いや……シンデレラはもっと昔……
幼い頃に行方不明になってしまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not exactly... Cinderella went
missing before the attack on Dawn.

fields.EN:
After she went missing, everyone
started to leave Dawn to join
the Order of the Sun...
fields.JP:
……しかもその後に他のみんなも
黎明を抜けてタイヨウ教団に
行ってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After she went missing, everyone
started to leave Dawn to join
the Order of the Sun...

fields.EN:
You make it sound like you
lost quite a number of allies.
fields.JP: そんなに仲間がいなくなってしまったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You make it sound like you
lost quite a number of allies.

fields.EN:
Yes... Most of the Blood Maidens
left. It was quite saddening...
fields.JP:
うん。一気に血式少女がいなくなって
とても悲しかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Most of the Blood Maidens
left. It was quite saddening...

fields.EN:
And, what is this
"Order of the Sun?"
fields.JP: タイヨウ教団とは何なのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, what is this
"Order of the Sun?"

fields.EN:
Everyone, I think it's best we
concentrate our efforts on finding
and defeating the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
みんな、とりあえずこの話は一旦止めて、
ナイトメアを倒すことに集中しないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, I think it's best we
concentrate our efforts on finding
and defeating the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
It's not a good idea to hang
around the prison area for long,
too.
fields.JP:
独房エリアに留まり続けるのは
あまり得策とは思えないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not a good idea to hang
around the prison area for long,
too.

fields.EN:
You're right!
Off we go to kill the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
それもそうだな！
さっさとナイトメアをぶっ殺しに行くのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right!
Off we go to kill the Nightmare!

fields.JP:
ら、ラプちゃん、
そんな言葉づかいは駄目だよ

fields.EN:
Fine...
Let's go and hunt down the
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
……仕方ないわね。
まずはナイトメアの討伐にいきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
Let's go and hunt down the
Nightmare.

fields.JP: ここで一気にケリをつけるぞ、みんな

fields.EN:
Will do, Otsuu.
I'll end its misery.
fields.JP:
もちろんだ、おつう。
ワレが蹴散らしてくれるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will do, Otsuu.
I'll end its misery.

fields.JP:
ラプちゃん、わたしたちから
離れちゃだめだよ

fields.EN:
Rapunzel hate it!
It keeps getting up!
fields.JP:
あいつ、なんどきずつけてもなおるから、
ラプンツェルきらい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel hate it!
It keeps getting up!

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Rapunzel.
We destroyed its core, so it
can be defeated now.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だ、ラプンツェル。
さっき核を破壊したから、
もう不死性は失われている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Rapunzel.
We destroyed its core, so it
can be defeated now.

fields.EN:
It just means we can
kill it!
fields.JP: たおせる、ということだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just means we can
kill it!

fields.JP:
たおせる……？
やっつけられる……？

fields.EN:
That's right. The Nightmare can't
heal itself anymore.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。あのナイトメアは、
もう傷は治らないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. The Nightmare can't
heal itself anymore.

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean its
attacks have gotten weaker, though.
fields.JP:
だからといって、攻撃が弱くなった
わけではないけれどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean it's weak
though.

fields.EN:
Gretel's right. It's not like
it got weak or anything.
fields.JP:
グレーテルの言うとおりだ。倒せるように
なっただけで、雑魚になったわけじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel's right. It's not like
it got weak or anything.

fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、みんな、
油断せずに行くぞ！

fields.EN:
We did it!
We destroyed a part of its body!
fields.JP: やった、部位を破壊できたよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did it!
We destroyed a part of its body!

fields.EN:
Hmph!
Nothing is impossible with me!
fields.JP: うむ、ワレにかかればこのくらい余裕なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph!
Nothing is impossible with me!

fields.EN:
We can beat meanie!
So good!
fields.JP:
やなやつ、たおせそう！
すごいすごい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can beat meanie!
So good!

fields.EN:
Working in unison should end
this quick.
fields.JP:
このまま上手く連携を取って、
さっさと撃破してしまいましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Working in unison should end
this quick.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, we're just a bit away
from beating that "meanie!"
Let's do this!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、やなやつ、
もうちょっとで倒せるぞ！　頑張ろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, we're just a bit away
from beating that "meanie!"
Let's do this!

fields.JP: うんっ！　ラプンツェルがんばるーー！！
よし、みんな畳みかけるんだ！
たおした、たおしたーーーーっ！！

fields.EN:
Looks like it was no match
against us.
fields.JP: 僕たちの連携には敵わなかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like it was no match
against us.

fields.EN:
No Nightmare can stand in
my way!
fields.JP:
ワレの前ではナイトメアなど
塵も同じなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No Nightmare can stand in
my way!

fields.EN:
I suppose this covers the search
around this prison area.
fields.JP:
これでこの独房エリアも
探索は終わったかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose this covers the search
around this prison area.

fields.JP: でも全然見つからないね……

fields.EN: What did you expect to find?
fields.JP: 何が見つからないのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: What did you expect to find?

fields.EN:
I was hoping we'd find the lost
Blood Maidens and the professor.
Where could they have gone...?
fields.JP:
黎明にいた他の血式少女や博士です……
こんなに探しているというのに、
まだ誰も見つかりません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hoping we'd find the lost
Blood Maidens and the professor.
Where could they have gone...?

fields.EN: It will be all right, Princess.
fields.LOCALIZED: It will be all right, Princess.

fields.EN:
It's a long way from Dawn's former
Liberated District. Everyone just
hasn't made it here, that's all.
fields.JP:
ここは黎明の元解放地区からは
かなり遠い。だからみんな来てないだけさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This area is a fair distance away
from the old Dawn headquarters.
This place is a bit too far.

fields.EN:
There are more places to search,
so I'm sure they ran there.
fields.JP:
まだ探索してない場所はいっぱいある。
きっとそっちの方に逃げているんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are more places to search,
so I'm sure they ran there.

fields.EN:
It's a bit too early to go into
despair if you haven't searched
all there is yet.
fields.JP:
探索してない場所があるのなら、
悲しむのはまだ早いと言えるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a bit too early to go into
despair if you haven't searched
all there is yet.

fields.EN:
We have a lot more people than
before now! Just follow me and
I'm sure all will end well!
fields.JP:
仲間は増えていってるのだ！
くよくよせずにワレについて来るがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have a lot more people than
before now! Just follow me and
I'm sure all will end well!

fields.JP:
そうだね……
うん、みんなありがとう……

fields.EN:
Let's go search a different
location. We're bound to find
someone elsewhere.
fields.JP:
また別の場所を探索しよう。
そしてみんなを見つけ出すんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go search a different
location. We're bound to find
someone elsewhere.

fields.EN:
(Still, it has been a long time
since this many members of Dawn's
Blood Maiden squad were missing...)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ、こんなにも黎明の
　血式少女隊のメンバーがいないなんて、
　あの時以来だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That said, it's strange that we
haven't met a single Blood Maiden
with the Dawn yet.)

fields.EN:
(I remember back when I cried
when Cinderella and the three
sisters went missing...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラや親指姫たち三姉妹が
　急にいなくなったあの時……
　よく陰で泣いたっけ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I remember back when I cried
when Cinderella and the three
sisters went missing...)

fields.EN:
(I don't want to go through that
ever again. I will find my lost
friends...)
fields.JP:
（もうあんな思いはしたくない。
　絶対に他の仲間と合流するんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't want to go through that
ever again. I will find my lost
friends...)

fields.EN:
I'm sure Akazukin and the
others are alive. We'll find them
sooner than later.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんも他のみんなも、絶対に生きてる。
諦めずに探せば、いつか再会できるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Red Riding Hood and the
others are alive. We'll find them
sooner than later.

fields.EN:
Yes... Yes we will, Otsuu-chan.
I won't give up hope!
fields.JP:
そう……そうだよね、おつうちゃん。
諦めちゃ駄目だよね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Yes we will, Otsuu.
I won't give up hope!

fields.EN:
Oho! What will power!
I can't be losing to you!
fields.JP:
おお、燃えておるな人魚姫。
ワレも負けてはおれぬな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! What will power!
I can't be losing to you!

fields.EN:
We have more Blood Maidens than
before, and Hameln Liberated
District is growing by the day.
fields.JP:
新しい血式少女は増え、
ハーメルン解放地区もだんだん発展してる
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have more Blood Maidens than
before, and Hameln Liberated
District is growing by the day.

fields.EN:
There's nothing to worry about.
Let's keep things going!
fields.JP:
そうだ、悲観する要素なんてないんだ。
だからみんな、これからも頑張ろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing to worry about.
Let's keep things going!

fields.JP:
（どうしてそんなにしつこく
　追ってくるの……！）

fields.EN:
(Do they hate me that much?!
I didn't do anything!)
fields.JP:
（そんなに私が憎いの？
　私は何もしてないのに……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Do they hate me that much?!
I didn't do anything!)

fields.EN:
It's trying to run!
Surround it!
fields.JP:
そっち行ったよ！
囲むんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's trying to run!
Surround it!

fields.EN: Very well, I shall intercept it!
fields.JP: それならわたくしが先回りいたしますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well, I shall intercept it!

fields.JP:
……ぐご……づがまる……
がご……わげには……

なっ！？
予想外に小回りが効きますわね！

fields.EN:
Cinderella! Just block its path!
Don't get ahead of yourself!
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、進路を塞ぐだけでいい！
あまり１人で先行しないで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella! Just block its path!
Don't get ahead of yourself!

fields.EN:
(Why...?
What did I do to deserve this?!)
fields.JP:
（どうして……
　私が何をしたって言うの……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why...?
What did I do to deserve this?!)

fields.JP:
（お願いだから、
　もう放っておいて……！）

fields.EN:
(They kept coming, and coming.
So tired...)
fields.JP: （何度も何度も……もう疲れたよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They kept coming, and coming.
So tired...)

fields.JP:
ぎ……ぎぎ……
やず……みだい……

fields.EN:
(Why...?
Why is everyone coming after me?)
fields.JP:
（もう嫌だ……
　みんなが私を追いかけてくる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why...?
Why is everyone coming after me?)

fields.EN:
(There's no one here as kind
as Ningyohime...)
fields.JP:
（ここには……人魚姫みたいに
　優しい人間がいない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no one here as kind
as Little Mermaid...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

おづう……おぎで……
ぎぎ……ねぇ……おぎで……

fields.EN:
Hrm... What's the matter, Jack?
It's still early...
fields.JP:
ん……どうしたんだジャック……
まだ起きる時間じゃないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hrm... What's the matter, Jack?
It's still early...

fields.EN:
Shoot! I need to hurry!
Who knows what they'll say to
me if I'm late!
fields.JP:
ヤバい、早くしないと遅刻する！
遅れたらみんなに何て言われるか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot! I need to hurry!
Who knows what they'll say to
me if I'm late!

fields.EN:
Thanks, Jack!
If you didn't wake me up,
I would've been late for sure!
fields.JP:
助かったよジャック、
起こしてくれなかったらもっとヤバかった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, Jack!
If you didn't wake me up,
I would've been late for sure!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
どう……いだじまじで……おづう……

fields.EN:
I need to get myself wrapped...
Seriously, thank you, Jack.
fields.JP:
早くサラシ巻かないと……
ほんと、ありがとうなジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to get myself wrapped...
Seriously, thank you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Good morning, Hameln...
Uh, why are you standing on
the chair again?
fields.JP:
おはようハーメルン、って……
また椅子の上に立ってどうした？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning, Hameln...
Uh, why are you standing on
the chair again?

fields.EN:
Something like she has a super
announcement. What a show-off,
right?
fields.JP:
大発表とやらがあるんだとよ。
ったく、すぐに調子に乗りやがる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something like she has a super
announcement. What a show-off,
right?

fields.EN:
Oh? Is that how you treat someone
with important information to
share?
fields.JP:
お、いいのか貴様そんな態度を取って。
せっかくワレが有力な情報を授けて
やろうというのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Is that how you treat someone
with important information to
share?

fields.EN:
Yeah, especially when you're
itching to give that information.
fields.JP:
喋りたくてさっきから
ウズウズしてんじゃねーか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, especially when you're
itching to give that information.

fields.EN: Fine, Mamoru! Then I won't tell you!
fields.JP: ではマモル、貴様には教えてやりゃにゅ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine! I won't share the
information with you, Mamyoru!

fields.EN: Yeah, you stumbled over your words.
I-I didn't stumble over my words!!

fields.JP: あーやっぱこの流れ落ち着くわー

fields.EN:
Don't say it like I do this
all the time!
fields.JP: 定番みたいに言うでないわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't say it like I do this
all the time!

fields.JP:
ねージャックー
ちょっとうでだしてー
ナイトメア・ジャック

らぶ……づぇる……
んぎぎ……ご、ごう……？

ありがとー！
わーおちるー！　のぼらないとー！

fields.EN:
Looks like she's having fun
fooling around with Jack.
fields.JP:
こっちはこっちで
ぶら下がって遊んでやがるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like she's having fun
fooling around with Jack.

fields.EN: Best of friends already, I see.
fields.JP: ジャックとはすっかり仲良しだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Best of friends already, I see.

fields.EN:
Excuse me, but can you tell us
what you want to share?
fields.JP:
で、早く話してくれないかしら。
話が進まないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Excuse me, but can you tell us
what you want to share?

fields.EN:
She's right.
Hameln, do you mind telling us
what you want to share?
fields.JP:
そうだな。ハーメルン、
そろそろ教えてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right.
Hameln, do you mind telling us
what you want to share?

fields.JP: 教えて下さいハーメルンさまっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please tell us!
Oh great lord Hameln!

fields.EN:
Oho! So you all want to know,
do you? I knew you all would!
fields.JP:
おお聞きたいか！？
そうだろう、そうだろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! So you all want to know,
do you? I knew you all would!

fields.EN:
Well, my familiar brought me new
information! This time, it's about
an area filled with dead Marchens!
fields.JP:
実はワレの使い魔がまた情報を
仕入れてきたのだ。今度はメルヒェンの
死体が大量にあるエリアという話なのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, my familiar brought me new
information! This time, it's about
an area filled with dead Marchens!

fields.JP: メルヒェンの死体が……たくさん？

fields.EN:
There have been battles all
around the Jail, and it's normal
to see dead Marchens.
fields.JP:
うむ、ここ最近はジェイルのいたるところで
大規模な争いが起きているようでな、
メルヒェンの死体は、まあ珍しくはない
fields.LOCALIZED:
There have been battles all
around the Jail, and it's normal
to see dead Marchens.

fields.EN:
So, this particular area has more
dead bodies than elsewhere?
fields.JP:
だけどそのエリアは他に比べても
尋常じゃない数の死体があると……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this particular area has more
dead bodies than elsewhere?

fields.EN:
Precisely, Otsuu!
Odd, don't you think?
fields.JP:
そういうことだ、おつう。
これは何かあると思わぬか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Precisely, Otsuu!
Odd, don't you think?

fields.JP: そうだね……確かに気になるな

fields.EN:
Normal humans aren't able to kill
Marchens so easily.
fields.JP:
そもそも普通の人間は、
メルヒェンを簡単には殺せない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Normal humans aren't able to kill
Marchens so easily.

fields.EN:
That's why I think it's worth investigating
what caused all those dead Marchens.
fields.JP:
だから大量のメルヒェンの死体の原因は、
探る価値があると思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that there's good
reason to check that area out.

fields.EN:
You're not going to say that
there's a high likelihood of
finding a Blood Maiden?
fields.JP:
血式少女の可能性が高い、
とは言わないのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not going to say that
there's a high likelihood of
finding a Blood Maiden?

fields.EN:
It could also be that mysterious
Nightmare, so I can't assume
that's so.
fields.JP:
謎のナイトメアの可能性もあるからね。
断定はできないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could also be that mysterious
Nightmare, so I can't assume
that's so.

fields.EN:
Well, we don't know who may
be the cause of the deaths, but...
fields.JP:
そいつのせいかどうかは
分からないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we don't know who may
be the cause of the deaths, but...

fields.EN:
I do feel like something is direly
wrong throughout the Jail since
we lost Dawn...
fields.JP:
黎明がなくなってから、ジェイル全体に
異質な何かが蠢いているような、
そんな不気味な感覚がする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do feel like something is direly
wrong throughout the Jail since
we lost Dawn...

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right. I don't
know what Dawn was like, but I
can sense something is different.
fields.JP:
そうね、黎明は知らないけど、
以前に比べたら空気感が変わったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right. I don't
know what Dawn was like, but I
can sense something is different.

fields.EN:
It's almost as if there's a giant
bug crawling behind a thin wall.
A bit unnerving, yes?
fields.JP:
壁の１枚向こうを巨大な芋虫が
這いずり回ってるような……
そんな不快な空気よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's almost as if there's a giant
bug crawling behind a thin wall.
A bit unnerving, yes?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel don't like the feel
now, too.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもさいきん
なんかいやーなかんじしてたよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel don't like the feel
now, too.

fields.EN:
If all the Blood Maidens here are
sensing the same thing, then it
must mean something is happening.
fields.JP:
それぞれ別の場所で暮らしていた血式少女が
みんな同じことを言うってことは……
きっと正しいんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If all the Blood Maidens here are
sensing the same thing, then it
must mean something is happening.

fields.EN:
I guess it means that we need
to be even more careful than
before.
fields.JP:
じゃあ今まで以上に警戒して
探索に当たった方がいいね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it means that we need
to be even more careful than
before.

fields.EN:
Yes, so be sure not to let your
guard down.
fields.JP: そうだな。油断しないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, so be sure not to let your
guard down.

fields.EN:
Okay, let's head out to that area
with the dead Marchens.
fields.JP:
じゃあそのメルヒェンの死体が
大量にあるエリアに行ってみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let's head out to that area
with the dead Marchens.

fields.EN:
It looks likely to have been done
by a human—especially a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
人間の仕業、とりわけ血式少女の
可能性が高そうだものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's plausible that the
deaths were caused by Blood
Maidens.

fields.EN:
Don't forget about that
mysterious Nightmare.
Be very careful out there.
fields.JP:
さっきも言ったが、
謎のナイトメアの可能性もある。
充分に気をつけてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't forget about that
mysterious Nightmare.
Be very careful out there.

fields.EN: So, Haa-chan, which area is this?
fields.JP:
それでハーちゃん、
今度はどこのエリアなの？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, Hammy, which area is this?

fields.EN:
All right. All the Blood Maidens
and Jack will head there.
fields.JP:
じゃあ血式少女全員、
それとジャックで準備して向かおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. All the Blood Maidens
and Jack will head there.

fields.JP: みんな、本当に気をつけてね……？

fields.EN:
Don't worry.
We'll be back soon enough.
fields.JP:
すぐに戻るから、
心配しないで待っていてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry.
We'll be back soon enough.

fields.EN:
So, this is the Temple area...
Quite the difference in
environment.
fields.JP:
ここが旧寺院エリアね……
なるほど、随分と雰囲気が変わるものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this is the Temple area...
Quite the difference in
environment.

fields.JP: え、そうかなラプちゃん……

きゃははっ……
はははははーーーっ！！

fields.EN:
It sounds like someone
is in battle.
fields.JP: 誰かが戦ってるようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounds like someone
is in battle.

fields.EN:
The roars I'm hearing are
pretty ferocious...
fields.LOCALIZED:
The roars I'm hearing are
pretty ferocious...

fields.EN:
It could be that mysterious
Nightmare... Let's keep our
guards up.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルの時のように、
あの謎のナイトメアの可能性もある。
警戒しながら行こう、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could be that mysterious
Nightmare... Let's keep our
guards up.

fields.EN:
Look at all these
dead Marchens...
fields.JP:
メルヒェンの死体の数、
だんだん増えてきてるな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at all these
dead Marchens...

fields.EN:
I guess it means that we're
getting close to the cause of
their deaths.
fields.JP: 元凶に近づいているってことだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it means that we're
getting close to the cause of
their deaths.

fields.JP: あっ、あそこ、だれかいる！

fields.EN: That's quite a battle going on.
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと激しい戦いを
繰り広げているな
fields.LOCALIZED: That's quite a battle going on.

fields.EN:
I think it's safe to assume that
whoever is fighting is the cause
of all these dead Marchens.
fields.JP:
どうやら今戦っている者が
ここまでのメルヒェンの死体を
築き上げたようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's safe to assume that
whoever is fighting is the cause
of all these dead Marchens.

fields.EN: Who in the world could it be?
fields.LOCALIZED: Who in the world could it be?

fields.JP: きゃはっ！　きゃははははっ！！

fields.EN: So this is where you were...!
fields.JP: こんな場所にいたのか……！
なんだ、知っておるのか？

fields.EN:
That's Kaguyahime...
A member of Dawn's
Blood Maidens!
fields.JP:
あいつはかぐや姫……
黎明の血式少女隊で一緒だった仲間だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's Kaguya...
A member of Dawn's
Blood Maidens!

fields.EN:
I see. So I guess we finally
meet someone you used to know.
fields.JP:
そうか、ついに貴様らの昔の
仲間に会えたのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So I guess we finally
meet someone you used to know.

fields.EN:
Yes, but...
I can't be too happy just yet...
fields.JP:
ああ……
でも手放しでは喜べないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but...
I can't be too happy just yet...

fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん！
わたしです、人魚姫です！
きゃーーーーっはぁっ！

fields.EN:
It's no use, she can't hear us...
Kaguya-chan is in Blood Skelter...!
fields.JP:
駄目、声届かない……かぐやちゃん、
ブラッドスケルター化してる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use...!
Kaguya is in Blood Skelter!

fields.EN:
Just as the documents said. If I remember
right, they said it can't currently be cured.
fields.JP:
資料で読んだとおりね。
確か、現状治せないと書いてなかったかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see that the reports I read are
quite accurate... I believe it
also said that it can't be cured.

fields.EN:
Not quite. She should return
to normal with Jack's blood.
fields.JP:
いや、ジャックの血を浴びせれば
元に戻るはずなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not quite. She should return
to normal with Jack's blood.

fields.EN:
Yes, that's how I was saved
the last time, too.
fields.JP:
はい。以前のわたしが
それで助かりましたから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, that's how I was saved
the last time, too.

fields.EN:
Well then, let's get this
over with.
fields.JP: じゃあさっさとやってしまいましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, let's get this
over with.

fields.EN:
Easier said than done. It took
a lot from me to even
stop Ningyohime back then.
fields.JP:
そうは言っても、なかなかに難しいのだ。
なんせ以前こうなった人魚姫は、
ワレでも大変だったぐらいだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Easier said than done. It took
a lot from me to even stop Little
Mermaid back then.

fields.EN:
That girl! Coming here!
Grr! Grrrrr!
fields.JP:
あのにんげん、こっちくる！
うぅーー！　うぅぅーーーーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That girl! Coming here!
Grr! Grrrrr!

fields.JP:
ハーメルン！
２人で止めるぞ！
了解なのだ！　貴様らは下がっておれ！

きゃはははははっ！
はっはぁーーーーっ！

fields.EN:
(Way to remind me of how
powerful Blood Skelter is...)
fields.JP:
（ブラッドスケルター化……
　やはりすごい力だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Way to remind me of how
powerful Blood Skelter is...)

fields.EN:
(Kaguya isn't a close range
fighter, but her blows are
still amazingly powerful...)
fields.JP:
（近距離戦が苦手なかぐやでも、
　一撃が重い……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya isn't a close range
fighter, but her blows are
still amazingly powerful...)

fields.EN:
Say, Kaguya? I know you put
a lot of effort into things, but
how about going easy on us?
fields.JP:
なあかぐや……頑張り屋の君も
こんな時くらい手を抜いてはどうかな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Kaguya? I know you put
a lot of effort into things, but
how about going easy on us?

fields.EN:
Kaguya-chan! It's me, Ningyohime!
Please, get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん！
お願い思い出して、人魚姫です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya! It's me, Little Mermaid!
Please, get a hold of yourself!

fields.EN:
It's no use...!
Our words aren't reaching her!
fields.JP: 駄目か……やっぱり声は届かないか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use...!
Our words aren't reaching her!

fields.EN:
What now? Do you want me to
find an opening so that I can
use Jack's blood?
fields.JP:
で、どうする気？　隙を見て
ジャックの血をかければいいのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What now? Do you want me to
find an opening so that I can
use Jack's blood?

fields.EN: No, in this state she'll just dodge it...
fields.JP:
いや、この状態だと
避けられてしまう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... It's going to be difficult
to try and splatter Jack's blood
on her like this...

fields.EN:
Jack does have a limit to how much
blood he can spare. I'd rather
pacify her before using his blood.
fields.JP:
ジャックの血も無限じゃない。
何とかしておとなしくさせた上で
血をかけたいところだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack does have a limit to how much
blood he can spare. I'd rather
pacify her before using his blood.

fields.JP: くっ、すばしっこい奴め！
きゃはははっ！　っきゃはぁっ！！

fields.EN:
I don't want to harm Kaguya-chan...
But at this rate...
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃんを傷つけたくはない……
でもこのままじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to harm Kaguya...
But at this rate...

fields.EN:
Princess, it can't be
helped. Let's steel ourselves—
fields.JP: 姫、仕方ない。覚悟を決めよう――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, it can't be helped...
We need to prepare for the
worst...

fields.EN:
—to incapacitate Kaguya
without killing her, no matter what!!
fields.JP:
絶対にかぐやを殺さずに
無力化する覚悟を！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The worst is that we stop her
without killing her!

fields.EN:
Kaguya! Sorry, but we may have to
bruise you a bit! Here we go!
fields.JP:
かぐや！　多少の傷は勘弁してくれ！
じゃあ行くぞっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya! Sorry, but we may have to
bruise you a bit! Here we go!

fields.EN: We got her down for a bit...
fields.JP: 何とか、かぐやを無力化できたな……
fields.LOCALIZED: We got her down for a bit...

fields.EN:
We didn't harm her too bad.
I doubt she'll die or anything.
fields.JP:
深手は負わせていないはずよ。
命に別状はないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't harm her too bad.
I doubt she'll die or anything.

fields.EN:
Fighting without using your
full force is amazingly tiring...
fields.JP: 手を抜いて戦うのも疲れるものなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting without using your
full force is amazingly tiring...

fields.EN:
All right, let's splash her with
Jack's blood while we still can!
fields.JP:
よし、今のうちに
ジャックの血をかけるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's splash her with
Jack's blood while we still can!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Jack-san...
We'll borrow a bit of your blood
again...
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、ごめんなさい……
少し血をお借りしますね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Jack...
We'll borrow a bit of your blood
again...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

い……いよ……
づづづ……かって……

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, I'm going to pour Jack-san's
blood on Kaguya-chan, so please hold
her down!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、
ジャックさんの血をかけるから、
かぐやちゃんを押さえておいて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, I'm going to pour Jack's
blood on Kaguya, so please hold
her down!

fields.EN:
You got it!
Leave it to me, Princess!
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got it!
Leave it to me, Princess!

fields.JP:
あぁぁっ……！
うがぁぁぁぁぁっ……！！
おとなしくするんだ、かぐや！

fields.EN: Please come back to us... Kaguya-chan...!
fields.JP:
これで戻ってきて……
かぐやちゃん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please... Come back to us...
Kaguya...!

fields.EN: Get a hold of yourself, Kaguya!
fields.JP: そうだ、戻ってこいかぐや！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Get a hold of yourself, Kaguya!

fields.JP:
おつう、さん……？
人魚、姫……さん……？

fields.EN: I'm so glad you're back, Kaguya-chan!
fields.JP: かぐやちゃん、無事でよかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm so glad you're back, Kaguya!

fields.EN:
It seems Jack's blood can revert
the Blood Skelter state even when
it has been a while...
fields.JP:
長いことブラッドスケルター化しても
ジャックの血で元に戻るのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems Jack's blood can revert
the Blood Skelter state even when
it has been a while...

fields.EN:
I was a bit worried about that.
There was no assurance that it
could reverse a prolonged state.
fields.JP:
僕もそこが不安だったんだ。
絶対の特効薬という保証はなかったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was a bit worried about that.
There was no assurance that it
could reverse a prolonged state.

fields.JP: 元に戻ってくれて、本当によかった……

fields.EN:
I'm... fine...
I can still... fight...
fields.JP:
大丈夫……わらわは……
まだやれる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... fine...
I can still... fight...

fields.EN:
Please... Please...
Let me stay here... please...
fields.JP:
だから……お願い……
……ここに……いさせて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please... Please...
Let me stay here... please...

fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん！？
ねえ目を開けてっ！！

fields.EN:
It's okay, Princess.
She just lost consciousness.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だ、姫。
かぐやは気を失っただけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay, Princess.
She just lost consciousness.

fields.EN: Oh, I see... What a relief...
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I see... What a relief...

fields.EN:
But there's no question Kaguya is
in a dangerous condition. Everyone,
let's return to the base for now.
fields.JP:
でもかぐやが危ない状態には違いない。
みんな、１度拠点に戻ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, it doesn't mean she's fine.
We should head back right away.

fields.EN:
You're right.
It's dangerous to carry her
around here like this.
fields.JP:
そうだな。
このまま連れて歩くのは危険すぎるしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right.
It's dangerous to carry her
around here like this.

fields.EN:
Yup! So hungry, too!
Rapunzel wanna go home!
fields.JP:
うん、おなかすいたー！
ラプンツェルかえるー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! So hungry, too!
Rapunzel wanna go home!

fields.EN:
I agree. It makes sense to heal
her before heading out on our
expedition again.
fields.JP:
戻ってこのひとを治してからの方が、
結果的には探索も進むわね。異論ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I agree. It makes sense to heal
her before heading out on our
expedition again.

fields.EN:
It's settled.
Let's go back and get Kaguya
checked by Hikari.
fields.JP: よし、じゃあ戻ってヒカリに看てもらおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's settled.
Let's go back and get Kaguya
checked by Hikari.

fields.EN:
A day passes as Hikari
watches over Kaguyahime...
fields.JP: ヒカリにかぐや姫を預けた次の日……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A day passes as Hikari
watches over Kaguya...

fields.EN:
Well, it's great that you were
finally able to meet one of the
girls you used to be with!
fields.JP:
にしても昔の仲間と再会できたってのは
最高にいいニュースじゃねえか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's great that you were
finally able to meet one of the
girls you used to be with!

fields.JP: うん、ようやく再会できたよ

fields.EN: I wonder if Kaguya-chan is okay...
fields.JP: かぐやちゃん、大丈夫かなぁ……

fields.EN: Why don't you go and check on her?
fields.JP: 心配なら見てくればいいじゃん
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't you go and check on her?

fields.EN:
I don't want to wake her up
in case she's sleeping.
fields.JP:
でももし寝ていたら
起こしてしまうかもしれませんし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to wake her up
in case she's sleeping.

fields.EN:
C'mon, you should rest a
bit more...
fields.JP: 無理しちゃ駄目だって～
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, you should rest a
bit more...

fields.EN:
Good morning, Kaguya.
Are you okay?
fields.JP:
おはようかぐや。
もう動いて大丈夫なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning, Kaguya.
Are you okay?

fields.EN:
No you're not.
It's only been a day.
fields.JP:
大丈夫じゃないよぉ～
まだ昨日の今日だよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No you're not.
It's only been a day.

fields.EN:
Well, I can tell you're a bit
better than yesterday, that's for
sure.
fields.JP:
まあ一晩経って、少しは
よくなったように見えるけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I can tell you're a bit
better than yesterday, that's for
sure.

fields.EN:
I'm sure sitting down to talk
is okay.
fields.JP: 少し喋るくらいはいいんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure sitting down to talk
is okay.

fields.JP: もう、しょうがないなぁ……

fields.EN:
It has been a while,
Otsuu-san, Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
……改めてお久しぶりです、
おつうさん、人魚姫さん
fields.LOCALIZED:
It has been a while,
Otsuu, Little Mermaid...

fields.EN:
And... thank you everyone for
saving me...
fields.JP:
そしてみなさんも……
助けて下さってありがとうございます……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... thank you everyone for
saving me...

fields.EN: May I ask where I am?
fields.JP:
それで、ここはいったい
どこなのでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: May I ask where I am?

fields.JP: かぐやちゃん、それはね――

fields.EN:
I see... So Otsuu-san, Mamoru-san,
and the rest of you built this
new Liberated District...
fields.JP:
なるほど……それでおつうさんたちと
マモルさんたちで、新たに解放地区を
作り上げたというのですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So, this is the new
Liberated District built by
all of you here.

fields.EN:
How wonderful...
A new beacon of hope for mankind.
fields.JP:
なんて素晴らしい……
人類にはまだまだ希望がありますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
How wonderful...
A new beacon of hope for mankind.

fields.EN:
Hell yeah! We're not done for yet!
It's our turn to fight and win
back what we lost!
fields.JP:
おうよ、俺たち人間は
まだまだ負けちゃいねえ。
ってかこっから大逆転だぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hell yeah! We're not done for yet!
It's our turn to fight and win
back what we lost!

fields.EN:
Sorry to ask while you're still
recovering, Kaguya, but can you tell
us what happened up to this point?
fields.JP:
それで病み上がりのところ
悪いんだけどさ、かぐや。
これまでの経緯を教えてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry to ask, but do you mind
telling us what happened?

fields.EN:
I know it will pain you, but we
need as much information as
possible on what you went through.
fields.JP:
つらいかもしれないが、
黎明壊滅からの君の動向を
どうか話してくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it will pain you, but we
need as much information as
possible on what you went through.

fields.EN:
On the day Dawn was annihilated...
we fought a mysterious Nightmare,
trying somehow to protect everyone.
fields.JP:
黎明が壊滅したあの日……
あたしたちは何とかみんなを守ろうと、
謎のナイトメアと戦いました
fields.LOCALIZED:
We fought against a mysterious
Nightmare on that very day
Dawn fell...

fields.EN:
Nothing we tried could stop it.
If we kept fighting, we all would
have been killed...
fields.JP:
ですがどうしても勝てませんでした。
このままでは全員殺されてしまう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing we tried could stop it.
If we kept fighting, we all would
have been killed...

fields.EN:
It was then that Akazukin-san
gave me orders to run.
fields.JP:
そんな時でした。
赤ずきんさんがあたしに、
逃げるよう指示を出したのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was then that Red Riding Hood
gave me orders to run.

fields.EN:
We didn't have the luxury of
selecting a rally point.
All we could do was scatter.
fields.JP:
落ち合う場所すら決める時間はなく、
とにかくバラバラに逃げる、それだけで
あたしたちは精一杯でした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't have the luxury of
selecting a rally point.
All we could do was scatter.

fields.EN:
I ran, and ran, and ran...
I ran as far as I could...
fields.JP:
あたしは逃げて……
逃げて逃げて、とにかく逃げて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I ran, and ran, and ran...
I ran as far as I could...

fields.EN:
I went through various areas,
but none felt safe. I was afraid
the entire time, and by then...
fields.JP:
色々な独房エリアに行きました。
でもどこにも安らげる場所はなく……
不安で不安で、気づいたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I went through various areas,
but none felt safe. I was afraid
the entire time, and by then...

fields.JP: ブラッドスケルター化してた、か

fields.EN:
I see...
I'm sorry to have made you recall
all that.
fields.JP:
なるほど……
つらい話をさせてすまないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
I'm sorry to have made you recall
all that.

fields.EN:
It's okay. You all saved my life.
Talking about what happened
is the least I can do.
fields.JP:
いいえ。こうやって
助け出してくださったんです、
お話くらい、いくらでも構いません
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay. You all saved my life.
Talking about what happened
is the least I can do.

fields.EN:
What you said brings me hope.
Now I'm sure that Akazukin
is alive out there!
fields.JP:
でもこれでさらに希望が見えた。
赤ずきんは絶対に生きてる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you said brings me hope.
Now I'm sure that Red Riding Hood
is alive out there!

fields.EN:
You're right!
I'm sure she's safe!
fields.JP: そうだね！　絶対生きてるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right!
I'm sure she's safe!

fields.EN:
Let's head on back out to the
Temple area.
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあもう１度、
旧寺院エリアの探索に向かうとしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's head on back out to the
Temple area.

fields.EN:
Then you must be completely
exhausted, Kaguya-chan, so you should rest...
fields.JP:
じゃあ、かぐやちゃんは疲れ果てて
いるだろうから、安静にしててもらって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, I'm sure you're tired,
so just stay rest for a while...

fields.EN:
We should head out with the
same members.
fields.JP:
そうね、昨日と同じ
メンバーで臨みましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should head out with the
same members.

fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと待って下さいみなさん！
あたしも行きますっ！

fields.EN:
What are you saying,
Kaguya-chan?! You need to stay in bed!
fields.JP:
何言ってるのかぐやちゃん！
寝てなきゃ駄目だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying?!
You need to rest.

fields.EN:
S-See? I'm not injured or tired
at all...! So I'm definitely going...!
fields.JP:
ほ、ほら怪我も疲れもありません……！
だから絶対に行きます……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-See? I'm not hurt at all!
I will go with you no matter what!

fields.EN:
Am I imagining it, or do you
look like you're in a lot of pain?
fields.JP: すっごくつらそうに見えるのは気のせい？
ぜ、ぜんぜんそんなことはないのですよ～

fields.EN:
Hehe, you've always been
this serious, Kaguya-chan.
fields.JP:
ふふ、かぐやちゃんは昔から
こんな感じで真面目なんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Kaguya has always been
like this. So earnest, right?

fields.EN:
But Kaguya-chan, you don't
have to push yourself right now...
fields.JP:
でもかぐやちゃん、
今は無理しなくていいんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, there's no need for you to
force yourself right now.

fields.EN:
Just leave it up to us this time,
okay?
fields.JP: 今回はわたしたちに任せて、ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just leave it up to us this time,
okay?

fields.JP: いえ……行きます、行きますよ……！

fields.EN:
(Hard to imagine that Kaguya
used to be super lazy...)
fields.JP:
（かぐやの奴、もっと昔は
　あんなにグータラだったのにな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hard to imagine that Kaguya
used to be super lazy...)

fields.EN:
(I'm not sure what happened,
but she went from lazy to serious
all of a sudden.)
fields.JP:
（何があったか知らないけど、ある日を境に
　急に真面目で積極的になったよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not sure what happened,
but she went from lazy to serious
all of a sudden.)

fields.EN:
W-Well, I slept a whole night!
Why, I've never felt better!
fields.JP:
ほ、ほら一晩ぐっすり寝ましたし！
今のあたしは絶好調ですし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I slept a whole night!
Why, I've never felt better!

fields.EN:
I'm fine, really!
I will go with all of you no
matter what you say!
fields.JP:
とにかく大丈夫です！
あたしはみなさんについていくと
決めたのです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine, really!
I will go with all of you no
matter what you say!

fields.EN:
How delightful! I like your
unwavering will!
You shall come with us!
fields.JP:
気に入った！　根性があってよいぞ！
おつうよ、連れて行ってやろうではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How delightful! I like your
unwavering will!
You shall come with us!

fields.JP: かぐや……何か思い詰めてないか？

fields.EN:
I was going to mention that, too.
I sense some anxiety coming
from you.
fields.JP:
ええ、不安が見え隠れしている
気がするのだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was going to mention that, too.
I sense some anxiety coming
from you.

fields.EN: You really can't push yourself, Kaguya-chan...
fields.JP:
本当に無理しちゃ駄目だよ、
かぐやちゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really shouldn't push
yourself, Kaguya...

fields.JP: まあ……そこまで言うなら……

fields.EN:
Good! You will follow in my
path towards dominance!
fields.JP:
よし！　ではワレとともに
覇道を突き進むぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good! You will follow in my
path towards dominance!

fields.EN:
Uh, we have no intention of
attaining dominance...
fields.JP:
いや、覇道とか
突き進むつもりはないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, we have no intention of
attaining dominance...

fields.EN:
Everyone, hold it right there.
Marchens...
fields.JP:
みんな、ストップ。
……メルヒェンの群れだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, hold it right there.
Marchens...

fields.EN:
(Hm...
Kaguya isn't at her best yet...)
fields.JP: （かぐやはまだ本調子じゃないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm...
Kaguya isn't at her best yet...)

fields.EN:
Let's see...
How about we find another
way through?
fields.JP: どうする？　迂回する？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see...
How about we find another
way through?

fields.EN:
I believe it's simpler to just
get through them by force.
fields.JP:
あのくらい、突破してしまえば
いいと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe it's simpler to just
get through them by force.

fields.JP: メルヒェンやっつけるー！

fields.EN:
You're getting me worried, but
if everyone is okay with that...
fields.JP:
……心配だけど、
みんなが大丈夫と言うなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're getting me worried, but
if everyone is okay with that...

fields.EN:
That was a lot easier
than I thought.
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was a lot easier
than I thought.

fields.EN:
Indeed!
They didn't stand a chance!
fields.JP:
あのくらいの敵、
余裕すぎるくらいだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
They didn't stand a chance!

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、うごきたりない！

fields.EN:
Kaguya, you're forcing yourself,
aren't you?
fields.JP: かぐや、やっぱり無理してるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, you're forcing yourself,
aren't you?

fields.EN:
N-Not at all...
I'm totally fine...
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことないです。
あたしは全然平気ですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Not at all...
I'm totally fine...

fields.JP:
そうは言っても、
どう見てもつらそうだし……

fields.EN:
I just did a bit too much there.
I'll get my fighting sense back
right away.
fields.JP:
ちょっと勢い余って
激しい攻撃を繰り出してしまっただけです。
すぐに感覚取り戻しますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just did a bit too much there.
I'll get my fighting sense back
right away.

fields.EN:
If you aren't at your best,
then you should go back.
We don't want you to burden us.
fields.JP:
調子悪いなら足手まといだから、
戻って休んでた方がいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you aren't at your best,
then you should go back.
We don't want you to burden us.

fields.EN:
True... You may have the will to
move forward, but being useless
won't help us. Go and rest!
fields.JP:
そうだな、根性あっても
役立たずだったら意味はないしな！
今は休むがよいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... You may have the will to
move forward, but being useless
won't help us. Go and rest!

fields.EN:
I-I'm fine! I may not look it,
but I haven't felt this good
before!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫です！　みなさんには
本調子に見えないかもしれませんが、
実はあたし絶好調なんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm fine! I may not look it,
but I haven't felt this good
before!

fields.EN:
So please, you can count
on me...!
fields.JP:
ですからこの先、
おおいに期待して下さいね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, you can count
on me...!

fields.JP: ねえ姫、やっぱりかぐやの奴……

fields.EN: Yeah, she really is hiding something...
fields.JP: うん、やっぱり何か隠してるよね……
（かぐやが疲労してるのは明白だ……）
（でも、どうしてそれを隠すんだ……？）

fields.EN:
Now, let's get going!
I'm going ahead of you all!
fields.JP:
さあ行きましょう！
ほら、あたし先行っちゃいますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, let's get going!
I'm going ahead of you all!

fields.EN:
She seems fine for now,
so I suppose we can respect
her want to move forward.
fields.JP:
まあ今のところ大丈夫だし、
ここは本人の意思を尊重しようか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She seems fine for now,
so I suppose we can respect
her want to move forward.

fields.EN:
I suppose... Then I'll keep
a close eye on Kaguya-chan...
fields.JP:
仕方ないね……じゃあわたし、
かぐやちゃんのことしっかり見ておくね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose...
Well, I'll keep an eye on
Kaguya, just in case.

fields.JP: またメルヒェンの群れだわ
まったく、わんさか沸くのだな

fields.EN:
Let's make our way through
by getting rid of them.
fields.JP:
迂回なんて言わずに、
さくっと倒してしまいましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's make our way through
by getting rid of them.

fields.EN:
Are you sure you're fine
with that, Kaguyahime?
fields.JP: かぐや姫はそれでいいのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you're fine
with that, Kaguya?

fields.EN:
W-Why of course!
Now, let's get going...
fields.JP:
も、もちろんです！
さあ蹴散らしましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Why of course!
Now, let's get going...

fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん……
やっぱり何かおかしい……

fields.EN:
She's hiding something all right.
Hopefully nothing bad will come
from it...
fields.JP:
ああ、何か隠してる。
変なことにならなければいいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's hiding something all right.
Hopefully nothing bad will come
from it...

fields.JP: よし貴様ら、ワレに続くのだ！

fields.EN:
Fine...
Let's just get rid of them!
fields.JP: 仕方ない、とりあえず倒そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
Let's just get rid of them!

fields.JP: 今回もワレの敵ではなかったな！！
かぐや、やっぱりこれ以上は……

fields.EN:
What are you saying?
I'm... absolutely... fine...
fields.JP:
何を言ってるんですか……
あたしは全然……平気ですって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying?
I'm... absolutely... fine...

fields.JP: もういいよ、かぐやちゃん！

fields.EN:
You're obviously pushing
yourself, Kaguya-chan. If you keep
fighting, it'll be dangerous...!
fields.JP:
どう見てもかぐやちゃん、無理してる。
これ以上戦ったら、危ないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
