It's obvious that you're pushing
yourself too hard. Any further
and things will go for the worse!

fields.EN:
I'm happy that you're worried
about me, but... I'm...
I'm really fine... Really...
fields.JP:
心配してくれるのはっ……嬉しいですが……
あたしは……本当に大……丈夫です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy that you're worried
about me, but... I'm...
I'm really fine... Really...

fields.EN:
I'm happy that you're trying
to do your best for us, but...
fields.JP:
わたしたちを気づかって
無理してくれてるのは嬉しいよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy that you're trying
to do your best for us, but...

fields.EN:
But if you collapse from exhaustion
or slow down and get hurt,
Kaguya-chan... I'd hate that even more.
fields.JP:
でもかぐやちゃんが疲労で倒れたり、
動きが鈍って怪我でもしたら……
その方が嫌だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's going to hurt all of us
if you get sick or injured...

fields.EN:
We'll do our best even without
you, Kaguya-chan, so go back and rest...
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん抜きでも、わたしたち
頑張るから。だから戻って休んで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can move on without you,
so please go back and rest.

fields.JP:
えっ……？
ど、どうしたのかぐやちゃん……？

fields.EN:
You're planning on getting
rid of me, aren't you?!
fields.JP:
そうやってわらわだけ、
捨てるつもりなんでしょう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're planning on getting
rid of me, aren't you?!

fields.EN:
(Her way of speaking went
back to how it used to be...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She sounds like she's back
to normal now...)

fields.EN:
Getting rid...?
Absolutely not.
Why would we...?
fields.JP:
捨てる、って……
そんなつもりないよ……
どうしてそんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Getting rid...?
Absolutely not.
Why would we...?

fields.EN:
You all get to keep trying! Meanwhile you'll
make me a creepy experiment subject, call
me useless, and send me back to the herd!
fields.JP:
あなたたちだけそうやって頑張って！
わらわは不気味な実験の被験体にしたり、
役立たずだ、って群れに帰すんでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You all keep pushing yourselves,
but you're going to use me as a
guinea pig and let me loose after!

fields.EN:
Wh-What are you talking about? I
was just worried about you, Kaguya-chan...!
fields.JP:
な、何を言っているの？
わたしはただ、かぐやちゃんの身体が
心配だったから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What are you talking about?
I was just worried that you're
pushing yourself too far...

fields.EN:
Stop it!
All this caring is hurting me
more than anything!
fields.JP:
きれいごとは止めて！
あなたたちのその心配が
わらわを苦しめてるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it!
All this caring is hurting me
more than anything!

fields.JP: それにどうして気づかないの！？

fields.EN:
Wait, Kaguya!
What in the world are you saying?!
fields.JP:
待て、かぐや！
君はいったい何を言ってるんだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, Kaguya!
What in the world are you saying?!

fields.EN:
I'm going to be abandoned
if I don't leave results!
fields.JP:
結果を残さなければ、
わらわは捨てられてしまうのです……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to be abandoned
if I don't leave results!

fields.EN:
What's going on?
Kaguya, calm down and tell us
what's on your mind.
fields.JP:
どういうことだ……？
かぐや、ちょっと順を追って
説明してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's going on?
Kaguya, calm down and tell us
what's on your mind.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but Princess and
I would like some private time
with Kaguya...
fields.JP:
……ごめん、みんな。
ちょっと僕と姫とかぐや、
３人だけで話がしたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but Princess and
I would like some private time
with Kaguya...

fields.EN:
Fine with me.
I have a feeling this is something
I shouldn't get involved in.
fields.JP:
構わないわよ。
何やら立て込んでるみたいだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine with me.
I have a feeling this is something
I shouldn't get involved in.

fields.EN:
Thank you.
We'll go over there for a moment.
fields.JP:
助かるよ。
じゃあちょっと向こうで話してくる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you.
We'll go over there for a moment.

fields.EN:
Okay, what was all that about?
You said something about being
a guinea pig, and being abandoned.
fields.JP:
それで、さっきのはいったい
どういう意味なんだ？　実験体とか
捨てられるとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, what was all that about?
You said something about being
a guinea pig, and being abandoned.

fields.EN:
You remember how Cinderella-san
and the sisters went missing?
fields.JP:
昔、シンデレラさんがいなくなって、
そして後を追うように三姉妹が
いなくなったでしょ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remember how Cinderella
and the sisters went missing?

fields.EN:
That's what made me act like
I was all serious and earnest.
fields.JP:
そのせいでわらわは、こんな風に
頑張り屋のキャラを作らなければ
いけなくなったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what made me act like
I was all serious and earnest.

fields.EN:
If not, they would've done their
experiments on me, or would've
sent me back to where I came from.
fields.JP:
そうしないと不気味な実験を受けさせたり、
元いた里に捨てに行くぞって言われて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If not, they would've done their
experiments on me, or would've
sent me back to where I came from.

fields.EN:
I needed to fake my front
as someone useful in
order to survive...
fields.JP:
だからわらわは、前向きで積極的な、
役に立ってるんだぞってキャラを見せて
何とか生きてきたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I needed to fake my front
as someone useful in
order to survive...

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, that was
about the time when you
started to change...
fields.JP: その時から……だったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, that was
about the time when you
started to change...

fields.EN:
I only tried my best to survive.
If I had a choice, I wouldn't have
done all this.
fields.JP:
ええ。そうしなければ生きられないから
頑張っているだけで、本当は嫌々なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I only tried my best to survive.
If I had a choice, I wouldn't have
done all this.

fields.EN:
(So, this was all faked.
Guess her general laziness was
in her all along.)
fields.JP:
（キャラを作ってただけで、
　グータラ気質は変わってなかったのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So, this was all faked.
Guess her general laziness was
in her all along.)

fields.EN:
(But, why bring up Cinderella
and the Oyayubihime sisters?)
fields.JP:
（でもシンデレラや親指姫たち
　三姉妹のせいって……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, why bring up Cinderella
and the Thumbelina sisters?)

fields.EN:
So please, don't sabotage
me like that.
fields.JP:
だから嫌なのに頑張ってるわらわを
蹴落とすような真似はしないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, don't sabotage
me like that.

fields.EN:
Of all the...!
We're not trying to sabotage
anything!
fields.JP: そんなつもりはない！　心外だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of all the...!
We're not trying to sabotage
anything!

fields.EN:
But you were trying everything to
stop me from doing my best!
fields.JP:
だって現にあなたたちはわらわを
頑張らせないように仕向けてるじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you were trying everything to
stop me from doing my best!

fields.EN:
That's not true!
We were going to have you come
with us after you got better!
fields.JP:
そんなことはないよ！
具合をよくしてもらってから、一緒に
行動するつもりだったの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true!
We were going to have you come
with us after you got better!

fields.EN:
Sure, and I'm supposed to believe
that? You know, this is a waste of
time. I'm going on ahead.
fields.JP:
どうでしょうね？
まあこんな話をしていても疲れるだけです。
わらわは先に進むとします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, and I'm supposed to believe
that? You know, this is a waste of
time. I'm going on ahead.

fields.EN:
Hey, wait! Kaguya!
You've got the nerve to...!
fields.JP:
おい待てかぐや！
今のはあんまりじゃないか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, wait! Kaguya!
You've got the nerve to...!

fields.EN:
Don't let her bother you.
You did nothing wrong.
fields.JP:
あまり気にしちゃ駄目だからね。
姫は何も悪くないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't let her bother you.
You did nothing wrong.

fields.EN:
Still, it is true that I hurt
Kaguya-chan...
fields.JP:
でも、わたしがかぐやちゃんを
傷つけていたのは事実だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, it is true that I hurt
Kaguya...

fields.EN:
I guess you can hurt people without meaning
to, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
思いもよらないことで人を傷つけてしまう、
なんてことがあるんだね、おつうちゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess good intentions don't
always mean they're good for
others...

fields.EN:
(What was thought to be helpful
turned out to be hurting Kaguya...)
fields.JP:
（良かれと思ってやったことが、
　かぐやを傷つけていた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What was thought to be helpful
turned out to be hurting Kaguya...)

fields.EN:
(Good intentions don't
always mean they're good...)
fields.JP: （たとえそんなつもりはなくても……か）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Good intentions don't
always mean they're good...)

fields.JP: 行っちゃったわね、かぐや姫

fields.EN:
Heh heh... Maybe there was
something behind the scenes at
Dawn that you're not aware of...
fields.JP:
ふふふ、黎明では何か、
あなたたちが知らない事柄が
動いていたのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... Maybe there was
something behind the scenes at
Dawn that you're not aware of...

fields.EN:
(There are a lot of things
I don't know about...)
fields.JP:
（確かに僕の知らないこと、
　いっぱいある……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There are a lot of things
I don't know about...)

fields.EN: What the hell is going on...?
fields.JP: いったい何だっていうんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: What the hell is going on...?

fields.JP:
おおっ！
やっと核に辿り着いたな！

fields.EN:
Now we can defeat the Nightmare
here!
fields.JP:
これでこのエリアのナイトメアも
倒せるようになるな！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now we can defeat the Nightmare
here!

fields.EN:
I see... So destroying that will
make it possible for us to
kill the Nightmare...
fields.JP:
なるほど……この核とやらを破壊すれば、
ナイトメアを倒せるのですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So destroying that will
make it possible for us to
kill the Nightmare...

fields.EN:
There must be a guardian
around here. Be careful.
fields.JP:
きっと番人がいるはずだ。
みんな気をつけて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There must be a guardian
around here. Be careful.

fields.EN:
All we need to do is to defeat
that Marchen? If so, leave this
to me!
fields.JP:
あのメルヒェンを倒せばいいのですね？
ならばわらわにお任せ下さい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we need to do is to defeat
that Marchen? If so, leave this
to me!

fields.EN:
Kaguya! Don't face it alone!
There's no telling what it
can do!
fields.JP:
かぐや！　１人で突っ込むな！
何があるか分からないんだぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya! Don't face it alone!
There's no telling what it
can do!

fields.EN:
You're only saying that so
that I'd back off!
fields.JP:
そんなこと言って、
またわらわに何もさせない気なんでしょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're only saying that so
that I'd back off!

fields.JP:
むこうからも
もういっぴきでたーーーー！

fields.EN:
I need to show results!
I need to take care of it on
my own!
fields.JP:
わらわも成果を上げるのです……！
これは誰にも譲りません……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to show results!
I need to take care of it on
my own!

fields.EN:
Kaguya isn't aware of the other
one there!
fields.JP: かぐやの奴め、気づいておらぬ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya isn't aware of the other
one there!

fields.JP: かぐやちゃん！　後ろっ！！

fields.EN:
Otsuu!
You shielded me from it?!
fields.JP:
おつう！？
あなた、わらわをかばって……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu!
You shielded me from it?!

fields.EN:
Hah, this is nothing...
Thank goodness you're safe...
fields.JP:
こんなのたいしたことないさ……
それより君が無事ならよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hah, this is nothing...
Thank goodness you're safe...

fields.EN: Hey, Otsuu! Are you all right?!
fields.JP: おいおつう！　大丈夫か！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Otsuu! Are you all right?!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

おづ……おづ、う……
ぎぎぎ……だだ、だいじょ……

心配してくれてありがとうジャック。
僕は大丈夫だよ……

fields.EN:
Why...? If you can't move anymore,
you'll be the one in trouble, Otsuu...
won't you?
fields.JP:
どうして……？
動けなくなったら困るのは
おつうでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why...?
Why would you put yourself
in harms way?

fields.EN:
I have no clue what's making you
so jittery, but...
fields.JP:
かぐや……君が何を恐れているのか、
それは分からないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no clue what's making you
so jittery, but...

fields.EN:
We're friends...
Of course I'll do what I can to
save you...
fields.JP:
一緒に戦う仲間なんだ、
助けるのは当たり前だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're friends...
Of course I'll do what I can to
save you...

fields.EN:
Oh, and I don't want
Ningyohime to cry, too...
fields.JP: それに人魚姫も悲しむしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I don't want
Little Mermaid to cry, too...

fields.EN:
I'm okay!
Let's... get rid of them!
fields.JP:
みんな、僕は大丈夫だ……！
一気に倒しきるぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm okay!
Let's... get rid of them!

fields.EN:
Well said, Otsuu!
Let's end this quick!
fields.JP:
よく言ったおつう！
ならばさっさと片付けるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said, Otsuu!
Let's end this quick!

fields.EN:
Yes, so that we can patch
Otsuu-chan up right away!
fields.JP:
そして早くおつうちゃんを
手当てしましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, so that we can patch
Otsuu up right away!

fields.JP:
ぐるるるるる……！
やなやつ、たおす……！
まったく、世話が焼けるわね

fields.EN:
Concentrate on the battle
at hand, Kaguya...
fields.JP:
かぐや、とにかく今は
戦いに集中するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Concentrate on the battle
at hand, Kaguya...

fields.EN:
Oh, and by the way...
You owe me for this!
fields.JP: そしてこれは貸しだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and by the way...
You owe me for this!

fields.EN:
There's no one left
to stop us now.
fields.JP:
これでもう私たちを
妨げる者はいないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no one left
to stop us now.

fields.EN:
Yes...
Now then, let's destroy this core.
fields.JP:
そうだな……
では貴様ら、核を破壊するぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes...
Now then, let's destroy this core.

fields.EN:
Come now, help us destroy
the core, Kaguya.
fields.JP:
ほら、かぐやも。
一緒に破壊しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, help us destroy
the core, Kaguya.

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
I can't get used to how creepy
that sounds...
fields.JP: 何度聞いても不気味だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't get used to how creepy
that sounds...

fields.JP: これがジェイルの……悲鳴……

fields.EN:
Right. Doing this lets us strip
the Nightmare of its immortality.
fields.JP:
そう、こうすることで、
ナイトメアの不死性を奪うことができるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Destroying the core
makes the Nightmare in the area
vulnerable to our attacks.

fields.EN:
Indeed! The Nightmare stands
no chance against us once the
core is crushed!
fields.JP:
核さえ壊せば、ナイトメアの奴は
丸裸も同然なのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! The Nightmare stands
no chance against us once the
core is crushed!

fields.EN:
Whew...
Would you mind if I rest a bit?
fields.JP:
ふぅ……ちょっと
一息つかせてくれないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew...
Would you mind if I rest a bit?

fields.EN:
I'm fine, really.
You worry too much, Princess.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だって。
もう、姫は心配性だなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine, really.
You worry too much, Princess.

fields.EN:
If you can't move and become
useless, you'll be the next one
used as a test subject, Otsuu...
fields.JP:
動けなくて使い物にならなくなったら、
今度はおつうが実験体になってしまうのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to be used in the
experiment if you can't prove
yourself useful...

fields.EN:
So why did you shield me like
that?!
fields.JP:
なのにどうしてわらわを
かばったりなんかしたんですか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So why did you shield me like
that?!

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what you're getting
at, but Dawn is gone for good...
fields.JP:
よく分からないけどさ……
黎明はもうこの世に存在しないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what you're getting
at, but Dawn is gone for good...

fields.EN:
We were there, and we saw most
everyone who was with Dawn dead.
fields.JP:
僕たちも黎明壊滅の最後に
その場にいたけど、ほとんどの人が
死んでしまってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were there, and we saw most
everyone who was with Dawn dead.

fields.EN:
After that, we searched outside thoroughly
too. But there wasn't a single survivor.
fields.JP:
あの後、外もくまなく探したりした。
でも生存者は皆無だったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We even searched the area,
but not a single soul was in
sight.

fields.EN:
So this "experiment" you keep
bringing up isn't something you
need to worry about already.
fields.JP:
だからかぐやの言う『実験』なんて
心配しなくていいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this "experiment" you keep
bringing up isn't something you
need to worry about already.

fields.JP: そ……そうだったんですね

fields.EN:
Only the Professor is missing, so another
Dawn might arise somewhere again, but...
fields.JP:
博士だけは行方不明だから、またどこかで
新しい黎明が生まれるかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, the professor went missing,
so maybe he's started a new Dawn
somewhere else...

fields.EN:
(I sure hope that's the case,
but...)
fields.JP:
（個人的には
　そう願いたいところだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I sure hope that's the case,
but...)

fields.EN:
No matter what happens, I'll never
let Kaguya be sacrificed for some experiment.
fields.JP:
たとえ何があっても、絶対にかぐやを
実験とやらの犠牲にはさせないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter what happens,
we'll never let you go through
any experiment, ever.

fields.EN:
That's right, Kaguya-chan. I won't
let anyone do anything horrible to you.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、かぐやちゃんに
酷いことなんてわたしが許さないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Kaguya.
I won't let anyone do anything
horrible to you.

fields.EN:
But was Dawn planning to carry
out some horrible experiment on Kaguya?
fields.JP:
でも黎明がそんな酷い実験とやらを
かぐやにやろうとしていたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tell me, did Dawn really do
experiments on you, Kaguya?

fields.JP: （正直、にわかには信じがたい……）

fields.EN:
(But, if that's true, then my view
of Dawn will probably change
quite drastically...)
fields.JP:
（でもそれが真実なら、
　僕の中の黎明の見方が変わってきそうだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, if that's true, then my view
of Dawn will probably change
quite drastically...)

fields.EN:
Do you mind sharing
us the details?
fields.JP: よかったら詳しく聞かせてくれるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind sharing
us the details?

fields.EN:
After Cinderella and the
three sisters disappeared...
One day, I happened to overhear something.
fields.JP:
シンデレラや三姉妹がいなくなった後……
ある日、わらわは偶然聞いてしまったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
After Cinderella, Thumbelina, and
her sisters went missing, I just
happened to hear a conversation...

fields.EN:
We do need Kaguyahime to shape-up
and start working...
fields.JP:
そろそろかぐや姫にもしっかり
働いてもらわねばな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We do need Kaguya to shape-up
and start working...

fields.EN:
But, she closed herself inside
her room...
fields.JP:
でもかぐや姫はなかなか
部屋から出てきてくれません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she closed herself inside
her room...

fields.EN:
Hm... If so, then maybe we should
send her back to where she came
from.
fields.JP:
ふむ……もしも無理そうならば、
一旦里に帰すとしようか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... If so, then maybe we should
send her back to where she came
from.

fields.EN:
No wait... I could also experiment
on her by applying enough stress
to test her Corruption.
fields.JP:
いや、ずっと調べたかった
ストレスを与えての『穢れ』の実験を
行うのもいいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No wait... I could also experiment
on her by applying enough stress
to test her Corruption.

fields.EN:
I understand that the data from
the experiment can help us
greatly, but...
fields.JP:
そのデータが採れれば今後の発展に
おおいに役立つのは分かりますが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand that the data from
the experiment can help us
greatly, but...

fields.EN:
I can only hope Kaguyahime is a
bit more cooperative...
fields.JP: かぐや姫が協力的だといいのだがな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope Kaguya is a
bit more cooperative...

fields.EN:
After hearing that,
I got scared...
fields.JP:
こっそり話を聞いてしまったわらわは
怖くなってしまって、それで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After hearing that,
I got scared...

fields.EN:
Which led you to making up that
front of yours.
fields.JP:
頑張り屋で働き者の
キャラを作り上げたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which led you to making up that
front of yours.

fields.EN:
Yes... I thought that way I wouldn't
be made into a test subject or
sent back to the village...
fields.JP:
はい……そうすれば実験体にされることも、
里に帰されることもないと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I thought being cooperative
and willing would help me avoid
their plans...

fields.EN:
You didn't want to go back
to where you came from?
fields.JP: 里に帰るのは嫌だったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't want to go back
to where you came from?

fields.EN:
No, never mind.
You don't need to say anything.
fields.JP: いや、やっぱり言わなくていい
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, never mind.
You don't need to say anything.

fields.JP: そうだね、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
(I have a feeling I shouldn't
pursue that subject.)
fields.JP:
（何かそれはあまり深く
　聞いてはいけない気がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have a feeling I shouldn't
pursue that subject.)

fields.EN:
(It could only add to Kaguyahime's
suffering.)
fields.JP:
（聞けばもっとかぐや姫の
　傷をえぐってしまいそうだし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It could only add to Kaguya's
suffering.)

fields.JP: （だからこれ以上は止めておこう……）

fields.EN:
In any case, Dawn is no more.
There are no experiments to
worry about.
fields.JP:
さっきも言ったけど、もう黎明はない。
だから実験なんてもうないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, Dawn is no more.
There are no experiments to
worry about.

fields.EN:
Experiments on Corruption... They were
doing them from quite an early stage.
We only learned about it recently...
fields.JP:
穢れの実験……
大分早い時期からしていたのね。
私たちが知ったのは最近なのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
An experiment on Corruption...
It sounds as if this was known way
before we even heard of it.

fields.JP: なにかいったーぐれー？
ふふ……何も言ってないわよ

うにゅー？　そっかー
きのせいー

fields.EN:
Oh and Kaguya?
This is a bit difficult for me
to say, but...
fields.JP:
そしてかぐや、
ちょっと言いづらいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh and Kaguya?
This is a bit difficult for me
to say, but...

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, where you came from
may not be around any more...
fields.JP:
悲しいことに、もしかしたら
もう里もないかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, where you came from
may not be around any more...

fields.EN:
So you don't need to worry
about that, too.
fields.JP: だからそれももう心配しなくていいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you don't need to worry
about that, too.

fields.EN:
I see...
It looks like I didn't think well
of what was going on...
fields.JP:
そう……わらわは
先走りすぎたんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
It looks like I didn't think well
of what was going on...

fields.EN:
You got injured because of my
misconception, too...
fields.JP:
そのせいでおつうに怪我を
負わせてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got injured because of my
misconception, too...

fields.EN:
It's okay now. We know
it was a misunderstanding.
fields.JP:
いいんだよ、もう。
誤解だって分かったんだからさ

fields.EN:
That settles everything. Nothing's
binding you anymore, Kaguya-chan.
fields.JP:
これでぜんぶ解決だね。かぐやちゃんは
もう何に縛られることもないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it looks like most of your
worries are gone now. There's
nothing holding you back, Kaguya.

fields.EN:
So there's no need for you to
force yourself to go on missions.
fields.JP:
だからこれからは
嫌々探索をしなくてもいいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So there's no need for you to
force yourself to go on missions.

fields.EN:
But, I do owe Otsuu and
everyone here...
fields.JP: でもおつうたちには世話になったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I do owe Otsuu and
everyone here...

fields.EN:
Is it okay that I assume you need
me to be around?
fields.JP:
その、なんだかんだわらわがいないと
２人とも困るんでしょ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it okay that I assume you need
me to be around?

fields.EN:
Yeah...
We really need you to be around.
fields.JP:
……ああ。
いてくれないと非常に困る……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah...
We really need you to be around.

fields.EN:
Without your strength, Kaguya-chan,
things will be very tough from here on...
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃんの力がないと、
この先とてもきついな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Without your help, it would only
make matters difficult for our
expeditions.

fields.EN:
Heh... I see.
Well, I suppose I can't help it.
I will join in your efforts.
fields.JP:
ふふ、それなら仕方ないですね。
一緒についていきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I see.
Well, I suppose I can't help it.
I will join in your efforts.

fields.EN:
Oh, but in exchange, I need you
to have an open ear in listening
to my problems.
fields.JP:
その代わり、たまに愚痴を
聞いてくれるのが条件ですよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but in exchange, I need you
to have an open ear in listening
to my problems.

fields.EN:
If that's all you're asking for
then I'm more than happy to
accommodate...
fields.JP: ……僕でよければ、いつだって聞くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's all you're asking for
then I'm more than happy to
accommodate...

fields.EN:
You can add me in, too.
You can talk to me at any time.
fields.JP: わたしも。いつでも呼んで？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can add me in, too.
You can talk to me at any time.

fields.EN:
Heh heh... I guess we're set then.
You're going to so regret
what you said.
fields.JP:
ふふ、では契約成立です～
覚悟して下さいね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... I guess we're set then.
You're going to so regret
what you said.

fields.EN:
(Urgh...
I have a feeling she's right.)
fields.JP:
（う……何だか安請け合いしたことを
　後悔しそうな気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Urgh...
I have a feeling she's right.)

fields.JP: どうやら話はついたようだな！

fields.EN:
Apparently there's another person
joining the Hero Hameln's Party.
fields.JP:
勇者ハーメルン御一行に
１名追加……ですって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Apparently there's another person
joining the Hero Hameln's Party.

fields.EN:
Is that so!
What good news!
fields.JP:
おおっ！
それはよい心がけである！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that so!
What good news!

fields.EN:
Uh, can we stop calling
ourselves that...?
fields.JP:
その団体名そろそろ
定着しそうだからもうやめよう！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, can we stop calling
ourselves that...?

fields.EN:
I couldn't have imagined that a
day would come when we'd be
looking for Nightmares...
fields.JP:
最初の頃は逃げ回っていたのに、
今では探しにいくようになるなんてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't have imagined that a
day would come when we'd be
looking for Nightmares...

fields.EN:
It just means we're that much
stronger now!
fields.JP:
それだけワレらが
強くなったということだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just means we're that much
stronger now!

fields.EN:
I think you're right.
Still, it's not like we can beat
them easily...
fields.JP:
確かにそうかもしれないね。
でも……やっぱり余裕は持てないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you're right.
Still, it's not like we can beat
them easily...

fields.EN:
If we start having this much composure
in front of Nightmares, maybe we'll
be the ones people call monsters~
fields.JP:
ナイトメアを前にして余裕を
持つようになったら、こっちが化け物と
呼ばれるかもしれませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if we could beat them easily
then it'd be better noted that
we're Nightmares, and not them.

fields.JP: 面白いこと言うわね、あなた

fields.EN:
Despite that potentially being
true, we are still humans, so we
still need to be wary.
fields.JP:
でもあながち間違ってなさそう。
私たちは人間だから、油断はできないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite that potentially being
true, we are still humans, so we
still need to be wary.

fields.JP:
いやなやつきたー！
うぅぅ……ぐるるる……

fields.EN:
We will win, no matter what!
Everyone, prepare for battle!
fields.JP:
だがワレらは絶対に勝つのだ！
貴様ら、戦闘準備を急ぐのだっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We will win, no matter what!
Everyone, prepare for battle!

fields.EN:
That's right. We have to win,
no matter what! Let's do this!
fields.JP:
そうだ、負けていい戦いは
いつだってないんだ！　行くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. We have to win,
no matter what! Let's do this!

fields.JP: 貴様、やはり根性あるな！

fields.EN:
Well, I'd rather not... uh...
Ahem...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'd rather not... uh...
Ahem...

fields.EN:
Thank you...
I'll keep at it.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます～
わらわ、もっと頑張ります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...
I'll keep at it.

fields.EN:
(Even if that's your faked front
I know you really did your best.)
fields.JP:
（それが作ったキャラであれ、
　頑張ってるのは確かだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if that's your faked front
I know you really did your best.)

fields.EN:
All right, just a little more!
I'm counting on you, Kaguya!
fields.JP:
よし、もう少しだ！
かぐや、頼りにしてるからな！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, just a little more!
I'm counting on you, Kaguya!

fields.EN:
The Nightmare is preparing to
move again! Be careful!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアが体勢立て直した！
みんな、気をつけて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare is preparing to
move again! Be careful!

fields.JP: かったー！　やなやつきえろー！

fields.EN:
I'm still amazed that there are
so many Nightmares that lack
communication means.
fields.JP:
しかし、本当に意思疎通が
図れないナイトメアばかりね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still amazed that there are
so many Nightmares that lack
communication means.

fields.EN:
Well done!
You all did great!
fields.JP:
うむ、貴様ら、
今回もいい働きぶりだったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well done!
You all did great!

fields.JP: うん、みんなすごく頑張ったよね！

fields.EN:
I'm impressed that we were able
to actually move in unison like
that...
fields.JP:
ほんと、みんな上手いこと
連携取れたもんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm impressed that we were able
to actually move in unison like
that...

fields.EN:
Say! Kaguya was super!
So cool!
fields.JP:
ねーねー、いまのたたかい、
かぐやーすごいかっこよかったー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say! Kaguya was super!
So cool!

fields.EN:
True, she shined brightly on the
battlefield! Without her splendid
support, I may have faltered!
fields.JP:
確かに、いい動きだったな！
かぐやの素晴らしい活躍がなかったら
ワレももっと苦戦したかもしれぬ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
True, she shined brightly on the
battlefield! Without her splendid
support, I may have faltered!

fields.EN:
Really?
You're all making this a big deal.
fields.JP:
そうでしたか～？
わらわなどまだまだです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?
You're all making this a big deal.

fields.EN:
O-Of course, I do have pride that
I did help quite a bit.
fields.JP:
ま、まあわらわも
多少は貢献できた自負はありますけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course, I do have pride that
I did help quite a bit.

fields.EN: I'm really glad you were with us, Kaguya-chan.
fields.JP:
ほんと、かぐやちゃんが
いてくれて助かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's great that you were with us.

fields.JP: それならっ……よかったです……
む、どうしたのだかぐやよ

fields.EN:
No...
To be honest, I'm at my limit...
fields.LOCALIZED:
No...
To be honest, I'm at my limit...

fields.JP:
ははっ……いきなり
素直になったな

fields.EN: Well, I did do my part.
fields.JP: 仕事はきっちりこなしましたからね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I did do my part.

fields.EN:
Okay, let's rest a bit
before we leave.
fields.JP:
じゃあみんな、
少し休んでから出発しようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let's rest a bit
before we leave.

fields.EN:
Are you planning on returning
back to the base, Tsuu?
fields.JP:
どうするのつう。
このまま拠点に戻るのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you planning on returning
back to the base, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
No, I wanted to explore this
place a bit further.
fields.JP: いや、もう少しだけ探索したい
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I wanted to explore this
place a bit further.

fields.EN:
We don't have any leads, so
I want to see if there's a way
to get to another area from here.
fields.JP:
僕たちは今、次の手がかりが
まったくない状況だ。だから他のエリアへの
入り口がないか探しておきたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have any leads, so
I want to see if there's a way
to get to another area from here.

fields.EN:
Yeah, let's do that, Otsuu-chan. The biggest
threat is gone now.
fields.JP:
そうだね、そうしようおつうちゃん。
最大の脅威はもうないんだもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds like a good idea.
It's not like there are any
major threats now.

fields.EN:
As long as we don't let our guard
down, the chance of losing to any
remaining enemies is slim to none.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアを倒した今、
油断さえしなければ私たちが
負ける要素はほぼないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as we don't let our guard
down, the chance of losing to any
remaining enemies is slim to none.

fields.EN:
Well, let's start our search for
a way to another area after
we rest ourselves.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ休憩で
さらにコンディションを盤石にして、
それから入り口探しを始めよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's start our search for
a way to another area after
we rest ourselves.

fields.EN:
Oh? Looks like the rubble is
blocking our way.
fields.JP:
あら、ガレキが邪魔で
先に進めないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Looks like the rubble is
blocking our way.

fields.EN:
Is there any other way
through here?
fields.JP: 他に道はありましたっけ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there any other way
through here?

fields.EN:
I'm not sure...
At the very least, it seems as if
this will lead us to another area.
fields.JP:
いや、どうだろう……
少なくともこの先が別のエリアに
繋がってるのは間違いなさそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure...
At the very least, it seems as if
this will lead us to another area.

fields.EN:
Yup...
I smell something different there.
fields.JP:
うん……むこう、
べつのにおいかんじる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup...
I smell something different there.

fields.EN: Well then, leave this to me!
fields.JP: どれ、ワレがどけてやろう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Well then, leave this to me!

fields.JP:
なんと！？
ビクともしないだとっ！？

fields.EN:
I doubt you could with all
this rubble...
fields.JP:
さすがにこの規模の
ガレキじゃ無理だろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt you could with all
this rubble...

fields.JP: なんと無礼なガレキであるかー！！
じゃあつぎラプンツェルやるー！

fields.EN:
Oh, you?
All right, if you succeed I will
give you a special reward!
fields.JP:
お、次は貴様か。
よし、ガレキを見事どかしたら
何か褒美をやろうー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you?
All right, if you succeed I will
give you a special reward!

fields.JP:
ほんとにー？
じゃあおいしいものちょうだいね！
う～～ぜんぜんこわれないよ～～～～

fields.EN:
What should we do, Otsuu-chan? We can't
move on like this...
fields.JP:
どうしようおつうちゃん。
これじゃ先に進めないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What should we do?
We can't move on like this...

fields.EN:
I think Shirayukihime would be
able to get us through here.
fields.JP:
……白雪姫なら
この壁をどうにかできそうですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think Snow White would be
able to get us through here.

fields.JP:
白雪姫……？
そいつはどこにいるのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White?!
Where is this one?!

fields.EN:
Bring her here at once and remove
this insolent rubble!!
fields.JP:
すぐに連れてきて、
この無礼なガレキをどかすのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bring this Snow White here, so
that we can remove these insolent
rubbles!

fields.EN:
I think Shirayukihime is with...
the Order of the Sun.
fields.JP:
……白雪姫はタイヨウ教団に
今もいると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think Snow White is with...
the Order of the Sun.

fields.EN:
It's a group that helps the weak
by offering sanctuary, and feeding
and caring for orphans.
fields.JP:
炊き出しや孤児院、それに避難場所などを
提供して弱者に手を差し伸べてる団体さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a group that helps the weak
by offering sanctuary, and feeding
and caring for orphans.

fields.EN:
Say, Ningyo?
Is Order of the Sun tasty?
fields.JP:
ねーにんぎょー
たいようきょうだんっておいしいのー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Fishy?
Is Order of the Sun tasty?

fields.EN:
You can't eat the Order, but I'm
sure they can give you tasty
food over there.
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団は食べられないけど、
そこに行けばおいしいごはんは
食べさせてくれると思うよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't eat the Order, but I'm
sure they can give you tasty
food over there.

fields.EN:
Tasty food!
Rapunzel wanna eat tasty food!
fields.JP:
おいしいごはん！
ラプンツェルおいしいごはん、たべたい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tasty food!
Rapunzel wanna eat tasty food!

fields.EN:
You'll have tasty food when we
return, so please hold on a
bit longer, okay?
fields.JP:
とりあえず拠点に戻ったら
おいしいごはん食べさせてあげるから、
もう少しだけ我慢して……ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'll have tasty food when we
return, so please hold on a
bit longer, okay?

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime is the Order's
second-in-command, touted
as the "Second Hitsuka."
fields.JP:
それで、白雪姫はそのタイヨウ教団の
副教祖として『二代目陽司』と呼ばれる
地位にいるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is the Order's
second-in-command, touted
as the "Second Hitsuka."

fields.EN: So, we just need to go there!
fields.JP: ほう、なら次はそこに行けばいいのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED: So, we just need to go there!

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I don't know
where the Order is now.
fields.JP:
残念だけど、今はタイヨウ教団が
どこにいるのかまでは分からない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I don't know
where the Order is now.

fields.EN:
Even if we do find them,
I doubt they would lend us a hand.
fields.JP:
それに見つけたとしても、
協力はしてくれないだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if we do find them,
I doubt they would lend us a hand.

fields.EN: Why do you think they wouldn't cooperate?
fields.JP: どうして協力してくれないと思うの？

fields.EN:
Did something happen between
you folks?
fields.JP: 何かまずいことでもあるのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did something happen between
you folks?

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime and her sisters think
that Cinderella killed the First
Hitsuka... Chiaki.
fields.JP:
……実は、白雪姫たち三姉妹は、
シンデレラがタイヨウ教団の初代陽司である
千昭を殺したと思ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White and her sisters think
that Cinderella killed the First
Hitsuka... Chiaki.

fields.EN:
Since we were with Dawn, just like
Cinderella, I doubt they would
trust us so easily...
fields.JP:
シンデレラと同じく黎明にいた僕たちは、
そう簡単には信用してもらえないだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since we were with Dawn, just like
Cinderella, I doubt they would
trust us so easily...

fields.JP: いだい……！　ごべん、なだい……！

fields.EN:
(I have to be bullied here, too?
Stop... I don't want this...)
fields.JP:
（ここでも私はいじめられるの……？
　もういやだ……どうして……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to be bullied here, too?
Stop... I don't want this...)

fields.EN:
Y-Y-You there! Go away!
Stop teasing it!
fields.JP:
そ、そ、その子から、はなれて！
いじめちゃ、だめ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Y-You there! Go away!
Stop teasing it!

fields.EN:
(A... human?
She's trying to save me?)
fields.JP:
（この子、人間……？
　私を、助けてくれてる？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A... human?
She's trying to save me?)

fields.EN:
(Throwing rocks isn't
going to stop it...)
fields.JP:
（あ……石を投げた……
　駄目だよ、そんなことしたら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Throwing rocks isn't
going to stop it...)

fields.EN:
(She's going to get hurt...
I need to save her, but...
I can't move...)
fields.JP:
（ああ……この子がいじめられちゃう……
　助けなきゃ……でも痛くて動けない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's going to get hurt...
I need to save her, but...
I can't move...)

fields.EN:
(She's picking up a rock?
But, she's not big enough to use
it to fight...)
fields.JP:
（あ、瓦礫を拾って攻撃を……
　無理だよ、そんなに小さいのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's picking up a rock?
But, she's not big enough to use
it to fight...)

fields.EN:
(She hit it?!
But now she's covered
in its blood...)
fields.JP:
（あ、当たった！
　でも、血が女の子にかかって……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She hit it?!
But now she's covered
in its blood...)

fields.EN:
(Her hair is turning white...
And her eyes... are turning pink.)
fields.JP:
（女の子の、髪が白く……
　目が、ピンクに……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her hair is turning white...
And her eyes... are turning pink.)

fields.EN:
(By the time I noticed, the area
was covered with dead Marchens.)
fields.JP:
（気付いたら、辺りはメルヒェンの
　死体だらけだった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(By the time I noticed, the area
was covered with dead Marchens.)

fields.EN:
(Her hair and eyes returned to
normal, but I was so scared that
I couldn't thank her.)
fields.JP:
（あの子の髪と目は、いつのまにか
　元に戻っていたけど、私は怖くて
　お礼も言えなかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her hair and eyes returned to
normal, but I was so scared that
I couldn't thank her.)

fields.EN:
(It seems like she was scared,
too. She ran away from me when
I tried to talk to her.)
fields.JP:
（だけど、あの子も怖がっていたみたいで、
　声をかけようとしたら逃げられて
　しまった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It seems like she was scared,
too. She ran away from me when
I tried to talk to her.)

fields.EN:
(But that was the beginning of
our peculiar relationship...)
fields.JP:
（でもそれからだ、あの子との
　奇妙な交流が始まったのは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But that was the beginning of
our peculiar relationship...)

fields.EN:
(We could each tell we were
scared of each other, so we
didn't really get together.)
fields.JP:
（互いにどこか怖がっていたから、
　接触はしなかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We could each tell we were
scared of each other, so we
didn't really get together.)

fields.EN:
(But, if I left food, she would
sing a beautiful song for me.
This kept going for a while.)
fields.JP:
（けれど、こちらがご飯をそっと置けば、
　遠くからあの子が歌声でお礼をくれたり、
　ささやかながらも交流は続いた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, if I left food, she would
sing a beautiful song for me.
This kept going for a while.)

fields.EN:
(We didn't have the courage to
speak with each other, but...)
fields.JP:
（言葉をかけあう勇気はまだ
　どちらにもなかったけれど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We didn't have the courage to
speak with each other, but...)

fields.EN:
(We both could tell we wanted
to become friends...)
fields.JP:
（互いに仲良くなりたいという
　意思だけは感じていた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We both could tell we wanted
to become friends...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Looks like you woke me up
at the right time.
Thanks, Jack.
fields.JP:
……ちょうどいい時間だな。
ありがとうジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you woke me up
at the right time.
Thanks, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎぎ……どう……
……いだじま……ぎちち……

fields.EN:
We should head to the laboratory
early today. I'm sure Rapunzel and
Hansel would like to see you.
fields.JP:
今日は少し早く研究室に行こうか。
ラプンツェルやヘンゼルもきっと、
ジャックに会いたがってるだろうし
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should head to the laboratory
early today. I'm sure Rapunzel and
Hansel would like to see you.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぼぐ……んぎぎ……
あ……いだい……ぎぃ……

fields.EN:
Heh, you can't wait to meet
them too, do you?
fields.JP: あはは、ジャックも楽しみなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, you can't wait to meet
them too, do you?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
（じゃあさっさとサラシ巻いちゃおう）
おはよう、おつうちゃん！

fields.EN:
P-Princess!
Don't come in like that!
fields.JP:
ひっ、姫っ！
いきなり入ってこないでよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Princess!
Don't come in like that!

fields.EN:
Oh, you just woke up?
Sorry.
fields.JP: あ、起きたばっかりだった？　ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you just woke up?
Sorry.

fields.EN:
I'm almost done, so please
wait outside!
fields.JP: もう、着替えるまで外で待ってて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm almost done, so please
wait outside!

fields.EN:
Oh, you don't have to worry about
me. It's not like I'll tease
your kinked hair and things.
fields.JP:
寝癖とか、わたしは気にしないから
そのまま着替えていいよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you don't have to worry about
me. It's not like I'll tease
your kinked hair and things.

fields.EN:
Th-That's not the point!
A lady shouldn't be ogling
a person changing!
fields.JP:
ちっ、違うって！　
レディが着替えを覗くなんていけません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's not the point!
A lady shouldn't be ogling
a person changing!

fields.EN:
Oh, come on, Otsuu-chan. We're close enough
for that, aren't we?
fields.JP: あら、わたしとおつうちゃんの仲じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh come now, we've known
each other long enough.

fields.EN:
P-Princess, you came for a
reason, right?
fields.JP: 姫っ、な、何か用事があったんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Princess, you came for a
reason, right?

fields.EN:
Oh, that's right!
I got good news, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
あ、そうそう！
すごいニュースだよ、おつうちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's right!
I got good news, Otsuu!

fields.EN:
We know where Oyayubi-chan
and the girls are!
fields.JP: 親指ちゃんたちが見つかったって！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We know where Thumby
and the girls are!

fields.EN:
(So we know where Oyayubihime,
Shirayukihime, and Nemurihime
are?)
fields.JP:
（行方の分からなかった
　親指姫・白雪姫・眠り姫が
　見つかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So we know where Thumbelina,
Snow White, and Sleeping Beauty
are?)

fields.JP: それは最高にいい知らせだ！

fields.EN:
Right? Everyone seems to be in the lab, so
I want you to come soon too, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
でしょ？
みんな研究室にいるみたいだから、
おつうちゃんも早く来てほしいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? Everyone's at the
laboratory, so you mind
swinging by as quick as you can?

fields.EN:
Got it.
I'll head there once I change
my clothes.
fields.JP:
うん、分かったよ。
着替えたらすぐに行く
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it.
I'll head there once I change
my clothes.

fields.EN:
Then I'll go on ahead, Otsuu-chan.
See you later too, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
じゃあ先に行ってるね、おつうちゃん。
ジャックさんも、また後で
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, I'll be there.
I'll see you later too, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Is she gone...?
She really caught me off guard...
fields.JP:
姫は行ったな……？
ああもう、ビックリした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is she gone...?
She really caught me off guard...

fields.EN:
This is so embarrassing...
I can't believe she saw me nude...
fields.JP:
いきなり姫に裸を見られるなんて……
もう……ほんと恥ずかしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is so embarrassing...
I can't believe she saw me nude...

fields.JP: そうそう、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
No way, Otsuu-chan... your breasts didn't
get bigger again, did they?
fields.JP:
まさかおつうちゃん……
また胸が大きくなったわけじゃないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Did your...
breasts get bigger recently?

fields.EN:
N-N-Not at all!
Nothing changed, really!
fields.JP:
そそ、そんなことないよ！
全然変わってないって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-N-Not at all!
Nothing changed, really!

fields.EN:
I-I'm telling the truth!
If you'd like, you can check them
out yourself...
fields.JP:
ほほ、本当だよ！　
なんなら触って確かめ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm telling the truth!
If you'd like, you can check them
out yourself...

fields.EN:
No, wait! What did I just say?!
J-Just let me change, okay?!
fields.JP:
って僕は何を言ってるんだ……！
とっ、とにかく変わってないからっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, wait! What did I just say?!
J-Just let me change, okay?!

fields.EN: Sorry to keep you all waiting.
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry to keep you all waiting.

fields.JP: 本当だ……ぴんぴんしてるのね

fields.EN:
Michiru, thank goodness you're
safe, too.
fields.JP:
それに……ミチルも。
無事なようで何よりだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru, thank goodness you're
safe, too.

fields.EN:
You really are mixey-mixey
as usual, aren't you?
fields.JP: おつうも相変わらず混ざった子ねー。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are mixey-mixey
as usual, aren't you?

fields.EN:
(Seems like Michiru's unique
choice of words is the same
as before...)
fields.JP:
（ミチルの方こそ、相変わらず
　よく分からない言葉のチョイスだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems like Michiru's unique
choice of words is the same
as before...)

fields.EN:
Well, let's begin.
First let me explain how we
found everyone...
fields.JP:
よし、では始めようか。
まず教祖さんたちに会った経緯なんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's begin.
First let me explain how we
found everyone...

fields.EN:
We got a lot more people living
here than before, right? But the
place still isn't very well-known.
fields.JP:
ここも段々と人が増えてきたとはいえ、
まだまだ他の人間に知られていないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We got a lot more people living
here than before, right? But the
place still isn't very well-known.

fields.EN:
So we formed a team to look
for survivors at the former
Liberated District.
fields.JP:
だから探索隊を組んで、元の解放地区に
助けを求めてやってきた生存者がいないか、
見に行ってきたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we formed a team to look
for survivors at the former
Liberated District.

fields.EN: Lo and behold, they found us.
fields.JP: そしたら……みちるたちと出会ったの
fields.LOCALIZED: Lo and behold, they found us.

fields.EN:
It freaked me out when they
brought back the founder of the
Order of the Sun with them!
fields.JP:
ビックリしたよ、
まさかタイヨウ教団の教祖さんを
連れて帰ってくるとは思わなかったからさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It freaked me out when they
brought back the founder of the
Order of the Sun with them!

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, like, the moment I saw
her I was, like, frozen in place.
fields.JP:
いやぁ、さすがのおいらも驚いて
仕事の手を止めちまったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, like, the moment I saw
her I was, like, frozen in place.

fields.EN:
More like you weren't doing
anything in the first place...
fields.JP: タクミは最初からサボってただろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
More like you weren't doing
anything in the first place...

fields.JP: ねえ、キョーソサンってなにー？

fields.EN:
She's the one who established
the religious institution of
the Order of the Sun.
fields.JP: 宗教の創始者のことね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's the one who established
the religious institution of
the Order of the Sun.

fields.JP:
シューキョー？　ソーシシャ？
うぅ、わかんない……

fields.EN:
Um, she's the person who
leads everyone.
fields.JP: えっとね、みんなを導く人のことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, she's the person who
leads everyone.

fields.EN:
What?! She bears the same fate
as I, the hero?!
fields.JP:
なんだと！？　勇者であるワレと同じ宿命を
背負ってるというのか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! She bears the same fate
as I, the hero?!

fields.EN:
Well, it's more like she leads
those lost in their way. Not like
some hero thingy.
fields.JP:
いや、勇者的な導きというより、
道に迷った人を導く感じ……かなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's more like she leads
those lost in their way. Not like
some hero thingy.

fields.EN:
Okay! Thanks Hikarin!
Rapunzel wants to make
babies with Hikarin!
fields.JP:
なるほどー！　ありがとうヒカリン！
ラプンツェル、ヒカリンのこどもがほしー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Thanks Hikarin!
Rapunzel wants to make
babies with Hikarin!

fields.EN:
Uh, do you mind if we continue
with the story?
fields.JP: みんな、悪いけど話を進めてもいいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, do you mind if we continue
with the story?

fields.EN:
Before we continue, why don't
we take a seat.
fields.JP: ほら、とりあえずみんな座りなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before we continue, why don't
we take a seat.

fields.EN:
All right... So Mamoru's group met
everyone at the former Liberated
District... and then what?
fields.JP:
話を戻すけど、元解放地区で
マモルたちと鉢合わせたのはそっちも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right... So Mamoru's group met
everyone at the former Liberated
District... and then what?

fields.EN:
Well, we also went there
hoping there were survivors, too.
fields.JP:
そう、わたしたちも生存者がいないか探しに
元解放地区に行ったんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we also went there
hoping there were survivors, too.

fields.EN:
Yeah. It just so happened we met at
the same time. Sheer luck, really.
fields.JP:
タイミングよく鉢合わせられて
ラッキーだったぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. It just so happened we met at
the same time. Sheer luck, really.

fields.EN:
I didn't expect a new Liberated
District was being built here...
fields.JP:
まさかここに新たな解放地区を
作ってるとはね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect a new Liberated
District was being built here...

fields.EN:
We were looking for survivors and
Blood Maidens, using this place
as our base of operations.
fields.JP:
ここを拠点にしながら、
血式少女のみんなや生存者を探していたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were looking for survivors and
Blood Maidens, using this place
as our base of operations.

fields.EN:
I'm glad you're all here. It's
been a long while since we met
after you all left for the Order.
fields.JP:
ほんと、みんなに会えてよかったよ。
３人がタイヨウ教団に行っちゃってからは
あまり会う機会もなかったしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you're all here. It's
been a long while since we met
after you all left for the Order.

fields.EN:
Yes, how long has it been since
we all talked like this together?
fields.JP:
そうだね、こうして再会するのって
どれくらいぶりだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, how long has it been since
we all talked like this together?

fields.EN:
It almost feels like we haven't
met since forever.
fields.JP: わらわも懐かしく感じます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It almost feels like we haven't
met since forever.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki was worried about
you all, too. I'm so happy we've
finally met!
fields.JP:
白雪も、みなさんが無事かどうかも
分からなかったですから……本当に
会えてよかったです……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White was worried about
you all, too. I'm so happy we've
finally met!

fields.EN:
It's been tough on your side
too, right Otsuu-chan? You know, it'd
be great if...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんたちも、
今まで大変だったでしょう？
よかったらこれからは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's been tough on your side
too, right Otsuu? You know, it'd
be great if...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki, Nemu, we didn't
come here to chat.
fields.JP:
白雪、ネム、
わたしたちは遊びに来たわけじゃないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, Sleepy, we didn't
come here to chat.

fields.JP:
う……ごめんなさい……
親指姉様……

fields.EN:
Now, now, Oyayubi.
It's been a long while since we
met after all...
fields.JP:
まあまあ、親指。
久しぶりの再会なんだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, Thumbelina.
It's been a long while since we
met after all...

fields.EN:
The Order of the Sun is currently
hiding in a place between
the prison grounds.
fields.JP:
現在、タイヨウ教団は
独房エリアと独房エリアの間にある
隙間のような場所に隠れてるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Order of the Sun is currently
hiding in a place between
the prison grounds.

fields.EN:
Michiru and the members of the
Order are somehow surviving
there. Just barely.
fields.JP:
ミチルを始めとして、
わたしたちも教団員たちもみんな、
かろうじて暮らしている状態だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru and the members of the
Order are somehow surviving
there. Just barely.

fields.EN:
That place is only temporary,
though. We're all looking for a
safer place to call home.
fields.JP:
隠れ場所はあくまで一時しのぎ……
ずっと住み続けられる場所じゃないわ。
だから次の安全な場所を探していたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That place is only temporary,
though. We're all looking for a
safer place to call home.

fields.EN:
W-Well, how about you all
come here?
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, how about you all
come here?

fields.EN:
That's when Michiru had a vision
of a safe haven for us.
fields.JP:
そんな時、ミチルがお告げをくれたの。
安全な場所を示すお告げをね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's when Michiru had a vision
of a safe haven for us.

fields.EN:
Beyond the grace of beauties...
Beyond the lost bounties...
fields.JP:
華やぐ美の先……
今は亡き栄華の向こう側……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beyond the grace of beauties...
Beyond the lost bounties...

fields.EN:
The location just beyond the Art Alley
area. The problem is that there's
a Nightmare blocking our way.
fields.JP:
旧芸術通りエリアの先よ。
だけどナイトメアがいて通れないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The location just beyond the Art Alley
area. The problem is that there's
a Nightmare blocking our way.

fields.EN:
I don't have much choice, so that's
why we came here to ask you for help.
fields.JP:
だから不本意だけど、
協力をお願いしに来たの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have much choice, so that's
why we came here to ask you for help.

fields.EN:
Well, that's a unique way of
asking for help.
fields.JP: それ、人にモノを頼む態度じゃねえだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's a unique way of
asking for help.

fields.EN:
Indeed. You should bow and plead
for help. Maybe then we'd be
willing to... Urgh?!
fields.JP:
そうだな、どうか助けて下さい、
とひれ伏すがいいぞ。そうしたら
助けてやらんことも……もがっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. You should bow and plead
for help. Maybe then we'd be
willing to... Urgh?!

fields.EN:
Haa-chan, I need you to be quiet
for a while. Please...
fields.JP:
ハーちゃん、今はちょっとだけ
静かにしてて……お願いっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy, I need you to be quiet
for a while. Please...

fields.EN:
Personally, I would love
to assist you in your endeavor.
fields.JP:
僕の意見を言わせてもらえば、
正直、手助けできるならしてあげたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Personally, I would love
to assist you in your endeavor.

fields.EN:
Simply put, our area here lacks
the proper means to accommodate 
all of those in your order.
fields.JP:
何故なら、タイヨウ教団全員を
今すぐにこの解放地区に受け入れる
体制は整えられない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Simply put, our area here lacks
the proper means to accommodate 
all of those in your order.

fields.EN:
But I don't want to leave them to die. And
if we can establish another safe place, we
should help them for the future as well.
fields.JP:
かといって見殺しにはしたくない。
それに、安全な場所がもう１つできるなら、
今後のためにも手を貸すべきだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't let our brethren suffer,
so we should offer our assistance
and help them find a safe haven.

fields.EN:
(It seems as if Oyayubihime
doesn't trust us...)
fields.JP:
（親指姫は、やはり僕たちを
　あまり信用してないみたいだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It seems as if Thumbelina
doesn't trust us...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe helping her will break
the ice between us...)
fields.JP:
（手助けすれば、打ち解けることが
　できるかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe helping her will break
the ice between us...)

fields.EN:
You're right. It's a good thing
for people to have a place
to call home.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。イツキの言うとおり、
人間の住める場所が増えるのはいいことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. It's a good thing
for people to have a place
to call home.

fields.EN:
If you'd like, we're more than
happy to help, Oyayubi.
fields.JP: 親指、僕たちでよければ手伝わせてもらうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you'd like, we're more than
happy to help, Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
I see...
Well, I guess I'll thank you.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Well, I guess I'll thank you.

fields.EN:
Let me go, Ningyohime!
I need to teach her a lesson... Urgh!
fields.JP:
放せ人魚姫っ！　ワレはあやつを
殴らねば気が済ま……もががっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me go, Little Mermaid!
I need to teach her a lesson... Urgh!

fields.EN:
How do you know it's safe beyond
the Art Alley area?
fields.JP:
でも、どうして通れない旧芸術通りエリアの
向こうが安全だと分かるんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How do you know it's safe beyond
the Art Alley area?

fields.EN:
It's where Michiru was
born and raised.
fields.JP: それはみちるが生まれ育った場所だからー
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's where Michiru was
born and raised.

fields.EN:
I know the place so well that
it's like a book I've read
over and over again.
fields.JP:
だから何度も読み返した本みたいに、
ぜんぶ分かっちゃうものなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know the place so well that
it's like a book I've read
over and over again.

fields.JP:
生まれ育った……？
そう……なんですか～……？

fields.EN:
Well, I'm sure she knows something
we don't regarding the location.
fields.JP:
まあ僕たちには
知り得ない根拠があるんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm sure she knows something
we don't regarding the location.

fields.EN:
We'll go as soon as we're ready.
Lead the way, Oyayubi.
fields.JP:
じゃあ親指、準備が出来たら
すぐに行こう。道案内は任せたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll go as soon as we're ready.
Lead the way, Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
Things should go a lot smoother
with three more Blood Maidens,
but please... be careful.
fields.JP:
血式少女が３人増えて
だいぶ安定したとは思うけど、
油断はしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Things should go a lot smoother
with three more Blood Maidens,
but please... be careful.

fields.EN:
Oh, Shirayuki and Nemu will
come, but they're not going to
fight.
fields.JP:
あ、白雪とネムは同行はさせるけど、
戦いには参加させないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Snow White and Sleepy will
come, but they're not going to
fight.

fields.JP: どうしてですか、親指姉様！？

ボクも……戦う……
親指姉さま……

fields.EN:
I said no! You're not ready yet!
I won't let you get in harm's way!
fields.JP:
駄目よ！　あなたたちはまだ未熟！
危険だから絶対に戦うのは許可しない！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I said no! You're not ready yet!
I won't let you get in harm's way!

fields.JP: 分かればいいの。さあ、行くわよ

fields.EN: All right, off we go then.
fields.JP: よし……それじゃあ出発しようか
fields.LOCALIZED: All right, off we go then.

fields.EN:
The place sure is different from
the other areas...
fields.JP: また今までとガラッと雰囲気が違うね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place sure is different from
the other areas...

fields.EN:
This is uncharted territory for
us, so let's be careful.
fields.JP:
そうだね。初めての場所だし、
気をつけて進もうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is uncharted territory for
us, so let's be careful.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki, Nemu, stay close
behind me, you hear?
fields.JP:
白雪、ネム。
わたしの後ろから離れては駄目よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, Sleepy, stay close
behind me, you hear?

fields.EN:
Say, Gretel? Maybe it's just me,
but isn't the Jail Tower taller
than before?
fields.JP:
ねえグレーテル、
気のせいかもしれないけど……
監獄塔、高くなってるとは思わないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Gretel? Maybe it's just me,
but isn't the Jail Tower taller
than before?

fields.EN:
There's no way we can measure it
accurately, but it sure seems
like it.
fields.JP:
正確に測る術がないから目測だけど……
確かに昔に比べて高くなっていると思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we can measure it
accurately, but it sure seems
like it.

fields.EN:
I noticed that, too...
It's almost like it's growing...
fields.JP:
わたしも……段々と
大きくなってる気がしてた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I noticed that, too...
It's almost like it's growing...

fields.EN:
Do you think something strange
is going on with it?
fields.JP:
何かが監獄塔に起きている、
ということなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think something strange
is going on with it?

fields.EN:
I don't know...
I only noticed that it looks
taller recently...
fields.JP:
分からない。
ただ、昔はそんな風に
思うことはなかったってことは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know...
I only noticed that it looks
taller recently...

fields.EN:
You're probably right.
I only noticed it recently, too...
fields.JP: やっぱり、最近大きくなったのかもしれないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're probably right.
I only noticed it recently, too...

fields.JP: それ、気のせいじゃないかもね

fields.EN:
I haven't paid close attention to
it, so I can't tell how different
it is now, but...
fields.JP:
わたしは最近の塔を
あまり見てなかったから、
変化までは分からない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't paid close attention to
it, so I can't tell how different
it is now, but...

fields.EN:
I just happened to remember
the professor's words...
fields.JP:
でも思い出したのよ。
博士が言ってた言葉を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just happened to remember
the professor's words...

fields.EN:
Professor? He said something
about the Jail Tower?
fields.JP:
博士が……？
監獄塔について……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor? He said something
about the Jail Tower?

fields.EN:
Yes. He said something about
growing the Jail Tower to reach
the surface.
fields.JP:
ええ。『監獄塔を伸ばせば、
地上に出られるかもしれない』ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. He said something about
growing the Jail Tower to reach
the surface.

fields.EN: I heard him say that before, too.
fields.JP: それ、わらわも聞いたことあります～
fields.LOCALIZED: I heard him say that before, too.

fields.EN:
He did?! Why wasn't I told about
this important piece of
information?!
fields.JP: それ、とっても大事な情報じゃないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He did?! Why wasn't I told about
this important piece of
information?!

fields.EN:
What'd you expect?
"Growing the Jail Tower," didn't
make sense back then, you know?
fields.JP:
そうは言っても、博士の言葉を聞いた時は
『塔を伸ばす』なんて意味不明だったもの
しょうがないでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What'd you expect?
"Growing the Jail Tower," didn't
make sense back then, you know?

fields.EN:
If that's true, then if that tower
grows tall enough, we may
be able to...
fields.JP:
でも、その話が本当なら、
監獄塔を伸ばしていけばいつか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's true, then if that tower
grows tall enough, we may
be able to...

fields.EN:
We may be able to escape from
this world we live in.
fields.JP: この世界から脱出できるかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may be able to escape from
this world we live in.

fields.EN:
Aha!
I see we've found an objective!
fields.JP: なるほど、それがワレらの目的なのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aha!
I see we've found an objective!

fields.EN:
Yeah, but do any of you know
how that tower grows?
fields.JP:
でも『監獄塔を伸ばす』って、
どうやればいいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but do any of you know
how that tower grows?

fields.JP:
確かにどうやっていいものか……
分からないですね～……

fields.EN:
But it is taller now, right?
If we wait long enough, then...!
fields.JP:
でも、前より伸びているのは
確かなんですよね？　ならそのうち……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it is taller now, right?
If we wait long enough, then...!

fields.EN:
That's right. A day will come when
we can escape to the surface!
fields.JP: そうだ、地上に出られる日は来るさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. A day will come when
we can escape to the surface!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Our goal is to search for the remaining Blood
Maidens while we help the Jail Tower grow.
fields.JP:
残りの血式少女を探しながら、
監獄塔を伸ばす……

fields.EN: I guess that's our final goal!
fields.JP: それがわたしたちの目標だね……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess that's our final goal!

fields.EN:
All right! Now that we got our
goal set, let's get moving!
fields.JP:
よし、そうと決まれば
さっさと先へ進むぞ、貴様らっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Now that we got our
goal set, let's get moving!

fields.EN:
Destroying the core takes
away the Nightmare's immortality.
fields.JP:
……つまりその『核』ってのを破壊すると、
ナイトメアの不死性を奪える、と？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're telling me that
destroying this "core" thing will
make Nightmares vulnerable?

fields.EN:
That's right. It seems like
the core is linked to
the area's Nightmare.
fields.JP:
そうなんだ。その独房エリアの核と
ナイトメアは繋がっているみたいでさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. It seems like
the core is linked to
the area's Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Hm...
I never heard that before.
fields.JP: ふーん……それは初耳だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...
I never heard that before.

fields.EN:
So, if we destroy the core then
we can actually face them?
fields.JP:
じゃあ核を壊せば、もう逃げ続けなくても
いいんですね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, if we destroy the core then
we can actually face them?

fields.EN:
Destroying the core only makes it possible
to hurt the Nightmare. It doesn't make
the Nightmare itself any weaker.
fields.JP:
とは言っても、傷を負わせられるように
なるだけで強いことには変わりないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can, but you have to remember
that they're still strong
regardless.

fields.EN:
She's right. You'd have to face it
with everyone or else.
fields.JP:
そうですね～全員が全力で当たらないと、
無事では済まないでしょうね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. You'd have to face it
with everyone or else.

fields.EN:
But, there's only so much space
to attack, so we'd have to
limit how many of us can attack.
fields.JP:
でもさすがにこれだけの人数が一斉に
ナイトメアに攻撃はできないでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, there's only so much space
to attack, so we'd have to
limit how many of us can attack.

fields.EN:
If so, we should have left some
of us back at your base.
fields.JP:
なら解放地区に血式少女を残すべきよ。
どうして誰も残してこないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, we should have left some
of us back at your base.

fields.EN:
Unless of course you don't
really care what happens to
everyone at the base.
fields.JP:
もしかして解放地区の人間なんて
どうでもいいって思ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unless of course you don't
really care what happens to
everyone at the base.

fields.EN:
What are you saying?!
We all worked together to come
up with this plan of action!
fields.JP:
そうじゃない！
これは僕たちみんなで考えたプランなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying?!
We all worked together to come
up with this plan of action!

fields.EN:
Yeah. After talking with everyone in the
Liberated District, we decided all of
us would search for the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
そうなの、解放地区のみんなと話し合って、
わたしたちは全員で血式少女の捜索に
当たることになっているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We talked with everyone at
the base and decided to put the
Blood Maidens to work outside.

fields.EN:
Like Kaguya said, we need to face
the Nightmares with all we have
if we want to win.
fields.JP:
さっきも言ったけど、ナイトメアは
全員が全力で当たらなければ勝てないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like Kaguya said, we need to face
the Nightmares with all we have
if we want to win.

fields.EN:
I know we can't attack at once,
but we need someone as backup
in case someone falls.
fields.JP:
そりゃあ一斉には攻撃できないさ。
でも仮に誰かが倒れたら、フォローする
者が必要になってくるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know we can't attack at once,
but we need someone as backup
in case someone falls.

fields.EN:
We need a way to treat and carry
anyone who falls. Otherwise, sooner
or later we'll all be wiped out.
fields.JP:
倒れた誰かを介抱する、そして連れ帰る……
それができるようにしておかないと、
わたしたちはいつか全滅しちゃう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That person can patch the fallen
and take them back. We need to
make sure someone makes it back.

fields.EN:
But it is true that the Liberated
District's defenses are not as
ideal when we're gone.
fields.JP:
私たちがいない間、
解放地区の防衛力が下がるのは確かね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it is true that the Liberated
District's defenses are not as
ideal when we're gone.

fields.EN:
But Hansel-niisan and Hameln's
familiar are in the Liberated District...
fields.JP:
でも解放地区にはヘンゼル兄さんと
ハーメルンの使い魔がいる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why my brother Hansel
and Hameln's familiar stays
behind.

fields.EN:
Our current set-up is made so
that we increase everyone's
odds of survival.
fields.JP:
どっちが全員の生存確率が
高いかって話ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our current set-up is made so
that we increase everyone's
odds of survival.

fields.EN:
Indeed! Our plan will ensure that
we will survive, so all you need
to do is shut up and follow along!
fields.JP:
そういうことだ！　今の布陣が、
ワレらが最も生き延びられるものなのだ。
貴様は黙ってついてくればいいのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! Our plan will ensure that
we will survive, so all you need
to do is shut up and follow along!

fields.EN:
Then why not have your familiar destroy the
core, Hameln? That would solve it, wouldn't
it?
fields.JP:
ならハーメルンの使い魔に
核を壊させればいいじゃない。
それで解決でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then just let Hameln's familiar
destroy the core. Sounds a lot
simpler to me.

fields.JP: ワレの使い魔にそこまでの力はない

fields.EN:
So, how about sending out
that Nightmare? Jack, was it?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ジャックだっけ？
そこのナイトメアに行かせたら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how about sending out
that Nightmare? Jack, was it?

fields.EN:
He's not like some expendable
item!
fields.JP:
ジャックを使い捨てみたいに
言わないでくれ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's not like some expendable
item!

fields.EN:
Jack-san is an important companion
of ours. Besides, we just said this...
fields.JP:
ジャックさんはわたしたちの
大事な仲間です。それにさっきも
言ったじゃないですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is our precious friend.
Also, I believe we brought this
up, but...

fields.EN:
You don't need to tell me twice.
You're referring to Blood Skelter,
right?
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化のことね。
分かってるわよ、それくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to tell me twice.
You're referring to Blood Skelter,
right?

fields.EN:
That doesn't negate that he's a
Nightmare. He may turn on us
at any time.
fields.JP:
その件についてだって、ジャックがいつ
襲ってくるか分からないじゃない。
ナイトメアなのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't negate that he's a
Nightmare. He may turn on us
at any time.

fields.EN:
We could draw his blood for use
as a special medicine, and then kill him.
fields.JP:
だったら特効薬である血だけ抜いて、
さっさと殺すべきだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'd make more sense to just
kill him and drain him of all
his blood.

fields.EN:
His blood starts degenerating
from the moment it leaves his body.
fields.JP:
それは……無理ね。イツキと調べたけど、
ジャックの血は体外に放出された瞬間から
劣化していくんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not possible. We conducted
research, and it turns out that
his blood degenerates in air.

fields.EN:
Unless we use it immediately, its
Corruption-reducing effect decreases.
fields.JP:
抜いてすぐに使わないと、
ブラッドスケルター化の『穢れ』を
落とす効果は減少していくのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The effectivity of his blood to
get rid of Corruption is lost
unless it's used fresh.

fields.EN:
More than that, Jack is our
companion. Don't say 'kill him' so lightly.
fields.JP:
それ以上にジャックは僕たちの仲間だ。
殺せなんて軽々しく言わないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even beyond that, Jack is our
friend. I'd appreciate you not
using words like that on him.

fields.EN:
I can only hope he doesn't
strike us from behind.
fields.JP: ……背後から襲われなければいいけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope he doesn't
strike us from behind.

fields.EN:
Even if Jack has a possibility of
turning against us, the benefits
far outweigh the risks.
fields.JP:
仮にジャックが暴走するかもしれなくても、
一緒に連れて行くメリットの方が大きいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if Jack has a possibility of
turning against us, the benefits
far outweigh the risks.

fields.EN:
You don't want to enter Blood
Skelter and kill your sisters, do you?
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化して、
妹たちを殺したくはないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You wouldn't want to kill your
own dear sisters if you enter
Blood Skelter, would you?

fields.EN:
You take that back!
That would never happen!
fields.JP:
そんなことには決してならないわ！
変な言いがかりは止めてくれる！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You take that back!
That would never happen!

fields.EN:
Sure. We are only cooperating for
a short time. I have no intention
of seeking your understanding.
fields.JP:
まあ……ここを抜けるまでの関係だものね。
理解してもらわなくても結構だけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. We are only cooperating for
a short time. I have no intention
of seeking your understanding.

fields.EN:
Let's stop right there. We've got
a job to do finding the core
and defeating the Nightmare here.
fields.JP:
とにかく！　早く核を探して、
ナイトメアを倒そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's stop right there. We've got
a job to do finding the core
and defeating the Nightmare here.

fields.EN:
Speaking of the core... Tsuu,
you were talking about how the
Jail Tower looked taller, but...
fields.JP:
そうそう、つう。核といえば、
監獄塔が伸びたって話をしたけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of the core... Otsuu,
you were talking about how the
Jail Tower looked taller, but...

fields.EN:
I think it's probably because we
destroyed the cores, or because
we defeated the Nightmares...
fields.JP:
おそらく核を破壊したからか、
ナイトメアを倒したからか……だと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suspect it actually grew because
we've been destroying the cores
and the Nightmares.

fields.JP:
あっ……！
それは確かにありうるかも……！

fields.EN:
We only started thinking the Jail Tower
was growing after we began destroying the
cores... The timing really does line up!
fields.JP:
監獄塔が伸びたって思い始めたのは、
わたしたちが核を壊すようになってから……
確かに時期が一致するね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It does sound about right... We
only noticed recently, since we
began our expeditions.

fields.EN:
If that theory is wrong,
you may end up in danger later.
fields.JP:
その憶測が間違ってたらどうするの？
後々危険な目に遭うかもしれないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if that theory is wrong?
You're just going to put yourself
in harm's way.

fields.EN:
Do these "cores" really exist
in the first place? I haven't
seen one before.
fields.JP:
それに核なんて本当に存在するの？
見たことないんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do these "cores" really exist
in the first place? I haven't
seen one before.

fields.EN:
Why you little...!
How dare you question
us like that!
fields.JP:
貴様さっきから
いったい何様のつもりなのだーーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why you little...!
How dare you question
us like that!

fields.EN:
For someone who needs our help,
you sure know how to complain!
fields.JP:
助けてもらう立場のくせして、
文句ばっかり言いおって！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
For someone who needs our help,
you sure know how to complain!

fields.EN:
Hameln, I know how you feel,
but you need to calm down!
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、気持ちは分かるけど
ちょっと落ち着けっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, I know how you feel,
but you need to calm down!

fields.EN:
Don't stop me, Otsuu! Listen, our goal
is the same: defeat the Nightmare.
So just shut up and come with us!
fields.JP:
止めるなおつう！　いいか、
ナイトメアを倒す目的は一致してるのだ、
なら黙ってついてくればいいのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You, listen up! Our common goal is
to defeat the Nightmare, so all
you need to do is listen to us!

fields.EN:
If the Marchens become enraged
after we destroy core after core
and attack humans en masse...
fields.JP:
核をどんどん壊した結果、
怒ったメルヒェンたちが大挙して
人間を攻めてきたらどうするのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, you listen! What if the
Marchens lay siege on the humans
after destroying the cores?!

fields.EN:
I'm not going to let your plans
drag us all into your mess!
fields.JP:
わたしたちまで巻き込まれるのは
願い下げだって言ってるの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not going to let your plans
drag us all into your mess!

fields.EN:
And what if it turned out it had
nothing to do with the Jail Tower
growing? That'd be an utter disaster!!
fields.JP:
しかも監獄塔が伸びるのとは
無関係だった……なんていったら、
目も当てられないじゃないの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if your theory is wrong?!
All the effort, and for what?
Nothing!

fields.EN:
S-Oyayubi-neesama...
They are trying to help us,
so please calm down...
fields.JP:
お……親指姉様……
助けてもらってるんですから、
それ以上は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sister Thumbelina...
They are trying to help us,
so please calm down...

fields.EN:
Whose side are you on?!
Shut up, and leave this to me!
fields.JP:
あんたたちはどっちの味方なの！？
いいから黙ってなさいっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whose side are you on?!
Shut up, and leave this to me!

fields.EN:
Oh no, you're the one who
should shut up!
fields.JP: 何を言ってる、黙るのは貴様の方だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no, you're the one who
should shut up!

fields.JP: なんか……ラプンツェルいらいらする……！
みんなっ！　ケンカは駄目っ！！

fields.EN:
She's right! Just calm down!
We need to... Hm?
Gretel...?
fields.JP:
そうだ、みんな落ち着くんだ……！
……グレーテル？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right! Just calm down!
We need to... Hm?
Gretel...?

fields.EN:
That destroying cores and defeating
Nightmares makes the Jail Tower grow...
yes, that's certainly speculation.
fields.JP:
核を壊せば、ナイトメアを倒せば
監獄塔が伸びる……確かに憶測ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true that the destruction of
the cores and Nightmares growing
the tower is merely a theory.

fields.EN:
Mind you, though, that theories
are meant to be verified to
determine its validity.
fields.JP:
でも憶測から始めて検証していくことでしか
結果は分からないものよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind you, though, that theories
are meant to be verified to
determine its validity.

fields.EN:
If things end up beyond
repair, it'll be too late.
fields.JP:
だからその結果、取り返しが
つかなくなったらどうするのって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why I'm saying that
it's dangerous to act on your
plan...

fields.EN:
Oh? But, defeating Nightmares
is something definitely beneficial
for humans, yes?
fields.JP:
あら、ナイトメアを倒したら
確実に人間にとっては有益じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? But, defeating Nightmares
is something definitely beneficial
for humans, yes?

fields.EN:
Also, I believe your "Marchens
lay siege" comment is a theory
too, yes?
fields.JP:
それに、怒ったメルヒェンが大挙して
攻めてくるって……それこそ憶測でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, I believe your "Marchens
lay siege" comment is a theory
too, yes?

fields.EN:
I think that's about enough.
This is no time to be arguing
among ourselves.
fields.JP:
ほらみんな、もういいだろう？
今は仲間割れしてる場合じゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think that's about enough.
This is no time to be arguing
among ourselves.

fields.JP: ふん、ワレは先に行くぞ
あっ、ちょっと待ってハーちゃん！

fields.EN: How did it come to this...
fields.JP: （ああもう、どうしてこんなことに……）

fields.EN: They came quite deep into the area...
fields.JP: だいぶ奥まで来ましたね～

fields.EN:
But, we still can't find
the core...
fields.JP: でもまだ核見つからないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we still can't find
the core...

fields.JP: やなやつのけはい、まだしない！

fields.EN:
This place is a lot more expansive
than I thought.
fields.JP: 思ったより広いかもね、このエリア
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is a lot more expansive
than I thought.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……づがべだら……
ぼぐが……ば……ごぶ……

fields.EN:
If you can help carry someone
when they can't move that'd
be great, Jack.
fields.JP:
誰か動けなくなったら、
その時はよろしく頼むよ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can help carry someone
when they can't move that'd
be great, Jack.

fields.EN:
Say, Hameln, was it?
Why don't you use your familiar
to find this core thing?
fields.JP:
ねえハーメルン、だったかしら。
あなたの使い魔で核の場所とやらを
さっさと見つけてくれないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Hameln, was it?
Why don't you use your familiar
to find this core thing?

fields.JP: ワレに指図するでない……！

fields.EN:
It's safer and easier than us
having to roam the area
aimlessly, right?
fields.JP:
わたしたちが闇雲に歩き回るよりは、
使い魔に探させた方が手間が省けるし、
よっぽど安全でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's safer and easier than us
having to roam the area
aimlessly, right?

fields.EN:
My familiar is working hard
too. What do you think my servant is?
fields.JP:
使い魔だって頑張ってくれておるわ！
ワレの下僕を何だと思っておる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My familiar isn't some kind
of tool! It can get tired, too!

fields.EN:
Isn't this the time and place
to use your familiar?!
fields.JP: こういう時の使い魔でしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't this the time and place
to use your familiar?!

fields.EN:
No! I can't word it right, but...
It just feels wrong to use it
how I please!
fields.JP:
違う！
使い魔だから何をしても良いというのは、
上手く言えぬが、なにか違うのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! I can't word it right, but...
It just feels wrong to use it
how I please!

fields.EN:
(That's surprising... Who would've
expected Hameln to say that? Guess
she's changing for the good.)
fields.JP:
（驚いたな……。
　ハーメルンがこんなこと言うなんて。
　少しは成長したってことなのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's surprising... Who would've
expected Hameln to say that? Guess
she's changing for the good.)

fields.JP: （でも、それ以上に変わったのは……）

fields.EN:
Just do what you have to do
to find it! That's about all
you're useful for!
fields.JP:
いいから早く見つけなさいよ！
そのくらいしか取り得がないくせに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just do what you have to do
to find it! That's about all
you're useful for!

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama!
That's saying a bit too much!
fields.JP: 親指姉様！　それは言い過ぎですよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dear sister!
That's saying a bit too much!

fields.EN:
Hmph! Surprising that came
from someone who can't do
anything!
fields.JP:
ふん、自力では何もできないくせに、
口だけはいっちょ前だな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! Surprising that came
from someone who can't do
anything!

fields.EN:
Wh-What?!
I was just saying the obvious!
fields.JP:
なっ、何よ当たり前の
意見を言っただけじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What?!
I was just saying the obvious!

fields.EN:
Fool! If you want to speak
do so after you've proven
you are of some help!
fields.JP:
偉そうに意見したければ、
少しは役に立てと言っておるのだ愚か者！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fool! If you want to speak
do so after you've proven
you are of some help!

fields.EN:
Now, now...
No need to fight...
fields.JP:
ちょっと２人とも、
ケンカはいけませんってば……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now...
No need to fight...

fields.EN:
Gretel, Kaguya, look
after those two for a bit.
fields.JP:
グレーテル、かぐや、
２人をちょっと頼む……

fields.EN:
If I had the option I'd like to
decline, but... Fine...
fields.JP:
面倒だから断りたいけど……
まあいいわ、引き受けたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I had the option I'd like to
decline, but... Fine...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki, Nemuri, do
you mind I borrow you two
for a moment?
fields.JP: 白雪、眠り、ちょっといいか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, Sleepy, do
you mind I borrow you two
for a moment?

fields.EN:
I don't recall Oyayubi
ever being like that, but
what happened to her?
fields.JP:
親指のやつ、昔はあんな性格じゃ
なかったと思うんだけど……
いったい何があったんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't recall Thumbelina
ever being like that, but
what happened to her?

fields.EN:
I'd like to know too. Oyayubi-chan
was never that prickly before...
fields.JP:
わたしも聞きたい。
前の親指ちゃんはあんなに
とげとげしくなかったもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd like to know, too.
She was never that aggressive
before...

fields.EN:
I think it probably started
when Oyayubi-neesama was
betrayed by Cinderella-san...
fields.JP:
たぶんきっかけは……
親指姉様がシンデレラさんに裏切られた、
そこからだと思います……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it all started when she
was betrayed by Cinderella...

fields.EN:
Cinderella-san's sudden betrayal and
disappearance, and the conflict
within the Order took its toll...
fields.JP:
仲良しだったシンデレラさんが
急に裏切った上に消えてしまったこと、
そして教団内での派閥争い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella's sudden betrayal and
disappearance, and the conflict
within the Order took its toll...

fields.EN:
I think all the stress impacted
Oyayubi-neesama's doubtful and
suspicious behavior...
fields.JP:
そうした積み重ねが、
今の親指姉様の疑心暗鬼な性格を
作り上げてしまったんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think all the stress impacted
dear sister's doubtful and
suspicious behavior...

fields.EN:
The decisive thing was Hitsuka-san...
the fact that onii-sama was killed
by Cinderella-san.
fields.JP:
決定的だったのは、陽司さん……
お兄様がシンデレラさんに殺された、
その事実です
fields.LOCALIZED:
The biggest impact has to be
when our brother, Hitsuka,
was killed by Cinderella...

fields.EN:
Since then, Oyayubi-neesama has been on edge,
never knowing who might betray her or when...
fields.JP:
それ以来、親指姉様はいつ誰が裏切るか
分からないと……神経を尖らせているのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since then, she's been on edge
of who or when she may be
betrayed...

fields.EN:
She... doesn't trust...
anyone... but those...
close to her...
fields.JP:
本当に……仲のいい……
……人以外…………信用……
できなく……なっちゃった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She... doesn't trust...
anyone... but those...
close to her...

fields.EN:
So that's why she's so suspicious
of everyone and everything going
on around her...
fields.JP:
だからあんなに疑り深く……
なってしまったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that's why she's so suspicious
of everyone and everything going
on around her...

fields.EN:
She doesn't want to be betrayed,
so she decided not to trust
anyone in the first place...
fields.JP:
もう裏切られたくない、
なら最初から信用しない、か
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't want to be betrayed,
so she decided not to trust
anyone in the first place...

fields.EN:
That makes a lot of sense.
I suppose that's her way of
protecting herself.
fields.JP:
なるほどね……納得したよ。
それこそ身を守るためなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That makes a lot of sense.
I suppose that's her way of
protecting herself.

fields.EN:
I still can't say for certain
that Cinderella is the culprit.
fields.JP:
でもね白雪、眠り。僕は
シンデレラが犯人とは限らないと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, let me add, I don't think
Cinderella really did kill
Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
Yup... I don't think Cinderella-san
would do something like that, too.
fields.JP:
うん……わたしもシンデレラさんが
そんなことをするとは到底思えないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... I don't think Cinderella
would do something like that, too.

fields.EN:
But... when onii-sama was killed,
judging by what the person who barely
escaped said...
fields.JP:
でも……お兄様が殺された事件の時、
かろうじて逃げ出した人の話を聞く限り……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when our brother was killed,
the person who barely escaped
gave description of the culprit...

fields.EN:
The descriptions given pretty
much matches Cinderella-san's
description...
fields.JP:
犯人の姿は、どう考えてもシンデレラさんと
特徴が一致してしまうんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The descriptions given pretty
much matches Cinderella's
description...

fields.EN: It doesn't look like it was simply a mistake.
fields.JP:
何かの間違いってわけじゃ……
…………ないみたいだな…………
fields.LOCALIZED:
From the sound of it, I suppose
what you're saying is the truth...

fields.EN:
Ever since Cinderella killed
their brother, the fates of those
three sisters have gone awry.
fields.JP:
（シンデレラが陽司を殺してから、
　三姉妹の運命がおかしくなった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The sisters aren't like before
ever since Cinderella killed
Hitsuka...)

fields.EN:
(The smiles they shared aren't
there any more...)
fields.JP: （前はもっと明るい姉妹だったのにな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The smiles they shared aren't
there any more...)

fields.EN:
(Isn't there a way for them to
be like how they once were?)
fields.JP:
（どうにかしてもう一度、
　昔みたいに戻れないか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Isn't there a way for them to
be like how they once were?)

fields.JP: それはこっちの台詞よっ！！

fields.EN:
Come now...
Please, you both should stop...
fields.JP:
ああもう……２人とも、
それ以上はダメですって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now...
Please, you both should stop...

fields.JP: 親指ちゃん……ハーちゃん……！
いいかげんやめろ２人ともっ！！

fields.EN:
(Damn it...
Isn't there anything we can do?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Damn it...
Isn't there anything we can do?)

fields.EN:
Huge carnivorous plants are
growing in clusters everywhere.
fields.JP:
巨大な食虫植物……かしらね。
至るところに群生しているようだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like a giant carnivorous
plant... It also looks like there
are more of them here.

fields.EN:
I'm not getting good vibes
from it. It's probably best to
not go near it.
fields.JP:
見るからに危険そうだな……
あまり近づきたくはないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not getting good vibes
from it. It's probably best to
not go near it.

fields.JP: どうしようか、おつうちゃん……？

fields.EN:
Mmm... Maybe we can attack
it from a distance, but...
fields.JP:
うーん……遠くから攻撃して
仕留められればいいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Maybe we can attack
it from a distance, but...

fields.JP: そっか！　ネムちゃんなら！

fields.EN:
Nemu-chan said that she can shoot
her arrow at that plant!
fields.JP:
みなさん！　ネムちゃんが弓矢で
あの食虫植物を射抜いてくれるそうです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy said that she can shoot
her arrow at that plant!

fields.JP: ゆみや？　みたいみたい！！

fields.EN:
Can you please take care
of it, Nemu-chan?
fields.JP: じゃあネムちゃん、お願い！
