fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please take care
of it, Sleepy?

fields.JP: えっ……ちょっと待ってよ！

fields.EN:
Our agreement was that you
would take us safely past
this area, right?
fields.JP:
わたしたちを無事にこの独房エリアの
向こうに連れて行く、それが契約内容よね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our agreement was that you
would take us safely past
this area, right?

fields.EN:
If so, you shouldn't put us
in harm's way like this.
fields.JP:
だとするなら、わたしたちを
危険な目に遭わせないようにしてよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, you shouldn't put us
in harm's way like this.

fields.EN:
What if it can stretch its
tentacle? That would make it
dangerous, even from a distance.
fields.JP:
攻撃したネムに食虫植物が反応して、
弦が伸びてくる……なんてことになったら
いくら遠くから弓矢とはいえ危険でしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if it can stretch its
tentacle? That would make it
dangerous, even from a distance.

fields.EN: What are you trying to get at?
fields.JP: 何が言いたいのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you trying to get at?

fields.EN:
You accepted to take us,
so you should take care of this
so that we can go through safely.
fields.JP:
ここは依頼を引き受けたあんたたちが、
先に通って安全を確保すべきだと思うのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You accepted to take us,
so you should take care of this
so that we can go through safely.

fields.EN:
What we need to know is
what effect the plant's trap has.
fields.JP:
まあ確かに、あの食虫植物の罠に
どんな効果があるのか知る必要はあるわね、
ハーメルン？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we do need to know what
that plant truly does...
Say, Hameln...

fields.EN:
But, we don't have any means
to strike it from a distance.
fields.JP:
でもわらわたちに、あそこの食虫植物まで
届く遠距離攻撃なんてないですよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we don't have any means
to strike it from a distance.

fields.EN:
That's because you weren't prepared,
right? Anyway, don't rely on our strength.
fields.JP:
それはそっちの準備不足でしょう？
とにかくわたしたちの力に頼らないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's your problem.
Whatever the reason, I don't want
you folks to abuse our powers.

fields.EN:
It's not like we have a choice.
Can't you at least cooperate?
fields.JP:
そんなこと言われても……
ここは協力してくれないか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like we have a choice.
Can't you at least cooperate?

fields.EN:
That's right, Oyayubi-neesama! Otsuu-chan
and the others have helped us all this way!
fields.JP:
そ、そうですよ親指姉様！
ここまでずっと、おつうちゃんたちに
助けられてきたじゃないですか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-She's right, dear sister!
They did their best to bring us
this far after all!

fields.EN:
I can help protect Nemu-chan if
something happens, so...
fields.JP:
いざとなったら白雪がネムちゃんを
ちゃんと守ります、だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can help protect Sleepy if
something happens, so...

fields.EN:
I told you to be quiet,
Shirayuki!
fields.JP: あんたは黙ってて白雪！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you to be quiet,
Snow White!

fields.EN:
We're not going to take risks,
and that's final!
fields.JP:
とにかく、わたしたちは危ない橋を
渡る気は一切ないんだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're not going to take risks,
and that's final!

fields.EN:
Why do you keep saying such
horrible things, Oyayubi-neesama?!
fields.JP:
どうして親指姉様はそんなに
ひどいことばかり言うんですかっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you saying such
horrible things?!

fields.EN:
It can't be helped!
This is so that we can survive!
fields.JP:
仕方ないでしょう白雪っ！
わたしたちが生き残るためなのよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped!
This is so that we can survive!

fields.EN:
If so, we should be helping
each other!
fields.JP:
だったら尚のこと、みんなで力を
合わせればいいじゃないですか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, we should be helping
each other!

fields.EN:
Can't you see how they risked
themselves to help protect us?
fields.JP:
ここまでの道中、みなさんが
どれだけ白雪たちを守ってくれたか
分からないんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can't you see how they risked
themselves to help protect us?

fields.EN:
And yet you don't even thank them,
Oyayubi-neesama! And now you're
treating her like a disposable pawn...!
fields.JP:
それなのに親指姉様は感謝もしない！
挙げ句の果てには捨て石にするかのような
その仕打ち……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yet, not a single word of thanks
from you! You've been treating
them like some kind of tool!

fields.EN:
What happened to the kind person
you used to be, Oyayubi-neesama?!
fields.JP:
昔の優しい親指姉様は
どこに行ってしまったんですか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where is the kind sister
Thumbelina I used to know?!

fields.EN:
I-I'm not any different from
before! I'm just doing this for
the better of us!
fields.JP:
わっ……わたしは何も変わってないわ！
これだってあなたたちのためを思って……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not any different from
before! I'm just doing this for
the better of us!

fields.EN:
You never would have chosen an
option that might sacrifice someone
before, Oyayubi-neesama...!
fields.JP:
昔の親指姉様だったら、
誰かが犠牲になりかねない選択肢なんて
決して選びませんでした……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You would never have suggested
them to risk themselves for us!

fields.JP: ２人とも、ちょっと落ち着いて……！

fields.EN:
Princess is right!
Just calm down already!
fields.JP:
姫の言うとおりだ、
互いに少し冷静になれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess is right!
Just calm down already!

fields.JP:
けんかはよくないって、
ヒカリンがいってたっ！！

fields.EN:
Shirayuki, it'll be all fine...
You know that everything will be
okay if you leave it to me, right?
fields.JP:
……もういいわ。白雪、もういいから。
わたしに任せておけばすべて上手くいく……
これまでもそうだったでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, it'll be all fine...
You know that everything will be
okay if you leave it to me, right?

fields.EN:
Whenever you don't know how to
answer, you always try to silence us by force.
fields.JP:
……返答に困るとそうやっていつも、
白雪たちを無理矢理に黙らせるばかり……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You always try to stop us from
speaking when you know you're
wrong!

fields.EN:
I've had enough! Shirayuki won't get through
here by sacrificing
Otsuu-chan and the others!!
fields.JP:
……もういいです！
白雪はおつうちゃんたちを犠牲にしてまで
ここを抜けたくありません！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've had enough! I will not have
them risk themselves needlessly
even if we had to get through!

fields.JP: どうしてわたしを置いていくの……？

fields.EN:
I-I just didn't want them to
get hurt...
fields.JP:
わたしは……あんたたちに
万が一があったらって思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I just didn't want them to
get hurt...

fields.EN:
I see... Oyayubi, you wanted to
protect your younger sisters no matter what...
fields.JP:
そうか……親指、君は妹たちを何としても
守りたかったんだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You wanted to protect them at
all costs right?

fields.EN:
Don't cry, Oyayubi-chan. I'm sure
Shirayuki-chan and the others will
understand if you tell them how you feel.
fields.JP:
親指ちゃん、泣かないで。
白雪ちゃんたちを大事に思う気持ち、
ちゃんと話せば伝わるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't cry, Thumby.
I'm sure they'll understand if
you tell them how you feel.

fields.EN:
She's right. Just apologize, and
let them know how you really feel.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。ちゃんと謝って、
気持ちをしっかり伝えれば分かってくれるさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Just apologize, and
let them know how you really feel.

fields.EN:
And in order to do that, we need
to bring them back.
fields.JP:
そのためにも、
まずは連れ戻しに行かなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And in order to do that, we need
to bring them back.

fields.EN: This area is dangerous with just those two.
fields.JP:
確かに、あの２人だけでは
この独房エリアは危険でしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This prison area is quite
dangerous, even for those two.

fields.EN:
What are you doing?
We need to go after them.
fields.JP: ほらどうした、早く追いかけるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing?
We need to go after them.

fields.EN:
*sob*
You don't have to tell me...!
fields.JP: うぅ……分かってるわよぉ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sob*
You don't have to tell me...!

fields.JP: よし、じゃあ追いかけよう！

白雪！　ネム！
どこにいるのっ！　返事して！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White! Sleepy!
Where are you?!

fields.EN:
They have to be around here
somewhere!
fields.JP: まだそんなに遠くには行ってないはずだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
They have to be around here
somewhere!

fields.JP: うん、絶対大丈夫だからね！
どうしたんですか、ラプンツェルさん？

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's growl can only mean
one thing...
fields.JP: ラプンツェルが威嚇ってことは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's growl can only mean
one thing...

fields.EN:
Yes, and sure enough, the place
has gotten quite hazy.
fields.JP: そうね、白い闇が出てきたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and sure enough, the place
has gotten quite hazy.

fields.JP: つまりナイトメアだな……！
みなさん、あそこですっ！

fields.EN:
Shirayuki will protect you
no matter what, Nemu-chan...!
fields.JP:
ねっ……ネムちゃんは
絶対に白雪が守りますからっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White will protect Sleepy
no matter what...!

fields.EN:
Damn it!
We need to go and help them, now!
fields.JP:
２人ともやばい……！
みんな、すぐに助けに――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it!
We need to go and help them, now!

fields.JP: う……うあああああああっ！！

fields.EN:
What are you doing to my
precious little sisters...!!
fields.JP: わたしのかわいい妹たちに何をする……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the hell did you do to 
my sisters?!

fields.EN:
Don't you dare lay a finger on
them! I'll kill you! Kill you!
Kill...!
fields.JP:
妹たちに指一本でも触れてみろ……！
殺して殺して殺し尽くしてやる……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you dare lay a finger on
them! I'll kill you! Kill you!
Kill...!

fields.EN:
They need someone to protect them!
That someone is me!
They need me!
fields.JP:
２人にはわたしが必要なの、
わたしが守ってあげないといけないの、
それが絶対に必要なの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
They need someone to protect them!
That someone is me!
They need me!

fields.EN: You should rely on us more.
fields.JP:
……白雪たちをもっと
頼って下さってもいいんですよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can trust us a bit more,
dear sister...

fields.JP: 守るんだ守るんだ守るんだ……

fields.EN: I'm going to protect my sisters!
fields.JP: 妹たちはわたしが守るんだぁぁぁぁっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm going to protect my sisters!

fields.EN: I'll join Oyayubihime and support her.
fields.JP: 仕方ない、とにかく親指に加勢するぞ！

fields.EN:
Right, and we'll make an opening
to save them!
fields.JP: うんっ、まずはチャンスを作り出そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, and we'll make an opening
to save them!

fields.JP: ようやく振り切ったな

fields.EN:
I would appreciate it if we
didn't have to run so often.
fields.JP:
毎度のことだけど
あまり走らせないでほしいわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would appreciate it if we
didn't have to run so often.

fields.JP: でも全員無事でよかったです～

fields.EN:
Yes, but...
Jack, are you all right?
fields.JP:
本当にね……
ジャックは大丈夫か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but...
Jack, are you all right?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

やなやつのにおい、きえた！
よかったー!

fields.EN:
I'm glad you're both safe,
Shirayuki-chan, Nemu-chan!
fields.JP:
白雪ちゃんもネムちゃんも
無事でよかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you're both safe,
Snow White, Sleepy!

fields.JP:
みなさん……
本当にありがとうございました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
Thank you for saving us...

fields.EN:
Well, hopefully you won't do
something like that the next time.
fields.JP:
これに懲りたら、
もう勝手に動かないでほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, hopefully you won't do
something like that the next time.

fields.EN:
Uh, but...
I understand why, though...
fields.JP:
まあ……その、
事情は分かるんだけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but...
I understand why, though...

fields.EN: I've become too suspicious of everyone.
fields.JP:
わたし……少し疑心暗鬼に
なりすぎてたみたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like I've been approaching
things wrong the whole time...

fields.EN:
I didn't trust you all, even after
you did everything for us...
fields.JP:
ここまでずっと守ってきてくれたのに、
わたし……信用してなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't trust you all, even after
you did everything for us...

fields.EN:
I just kept thinking about what to
do if you betrayed us, or what if
you were deceiving us...
fields.JP:
わたしたちを騙そうとしてたらどうしよう、
裏切られたらどうしようって……
そんなことばかり考えてた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just kept thinking about what to
do if you betrayed us, or what if
you were deceiving us...

fields.EN:
My sisters are too good-natured,
so I had to be the strict one.
fields.JP:
白雪もネムもお人好しすぎるから……
だからわたしがしっかりしなくちゃって、
そう思ってたの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White and Sleepy trust others
too easily, so I had to step-up by
acting as a sieve for them...

fields.EN:
Mmm...
Rapunzel not angry or mad at you.
fields.JP:
んー？
ラプンツェルおこってないよー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...
Rapunzel not angry or mad at you.

fields.JP: そう言ってくれると助かるわ……

fields.EN:
You risked your lives to save my sisters,
so I'm truly sorry I doubted you so much.
fields.JP:
命を賭けて妹たちを助けてくれたんだもの、
疑いすぎたことは本当に謝るわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm really sorry for acting the
way I did after all that you've
done to save my sisters...

fields.EN:
So, you finally see the
grandeur that is me!
fields.JP: やっとワレの偉大さが分かったか、まったく！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you finally see the
grandeur that is me!

fields.EN:
That aside... I have no intention
of giving thanks until our
objective has been achieved.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、こちらの目的が達成されるまでは
お礼の言葉を言うつもりはないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside... I have no intention
of giving thanks until our
objective has been achieved.

fields.EN:
(But, at least she's opened up
a bit... I think?)
fields.JP:
（まあ……多少は心を
　開いてくれた……のかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, at least she's opened up
a bit... I think?)

fields.JP: あんたたちも……ごめんね

fields.EN:
Please don't use Otsuu-chan and the others as
disposable pawns anymore... okay?
fields.JP:
……もうおつうちゃんたちを
捨て石にするようなことは嫌ですよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, please don't treat them
like tools any more, okay?

fields.EN:
How about a handshake to
call it all good?
fields.JP:
じゃあ握手！
はい、これでみんな仲直りだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about a handshake to
call it all good?

fields.EN:
I see their relationship requires
a bit more mending...
fields.JP:
これはまだわだかまり、
解けてないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see their relationship requires
a bit more mending...

fields.EN:
Yes, it doesn't seem like they've
bridged their gap of their
differences...
fields.JP: うん、溝が埋まった感じがしないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it doesn't seem like they've
bridged their gap of their
differences...

fields.EN:
Can Shirayuki join in battle,
too?
fields.JP: 白雪もこの先の戦いに参加させて下さい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can Snow White join in battle,
too?

fields.EN:
What...?
Do you know what you're saying,
Shirayuki?!
fields.JP:
白雪！？
あんた何を言ってるか分かってるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...?
Do you know what you're saying,
Snow White?!

fields.EN:
I understand, Oyayubi-neesama.
Even so, Shirayuki is asking you.
fields.JP:
分かってます、親指姉様。
その上で白雪はお願いしているのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do, and that's why I'm asking
if I could partake in battle.

fields.EN:
I don't want to be protected
all the time.
fields.JP:
白雪は、ずっと守られてばかり
いるのがもう嫌なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to be protected
all the time.

fields.EN:
I want you to properly acknowledge me,
Oyayubi-neesama... so please let me fight too.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと親指姉様に認めてほしい……
だから、戦いに参加させてもらいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to accept me for who
I am, so I want to join in battle.

fields.JP:
そんな……ダメよ２人とも……！
危険すぎるわ……！

fields.EN:
Nothing you say will sway me.
I cannot listen to your orders
Oyayubi-neesama.
fields.JP:
いいえ、もう決めました。
こればかりは親指姉様の言葉を
聞くわけにはいきません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing you say will sway me.
I cannot listen to your orders
dear sister.

fields.EN:
Give it up, Oyayubi.
It looks like they made up their
mind.
fields.JP:
……諦めろ、親指。
２人の意思は固いみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Give it up, Thumbelina.
It looks like they made up their
mind.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki-chan and Nemu-chan are
a lot stronger than you think,
Oyayubi-chan. They'll be fine.
fields.JP:
白雪ちゃんもネムちゃんも、
親指ちゃんが思ってる以上に
しっかりしてるよ。だから大丈夫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snowy and Sleepy are a lot
stronger than you think.
I'm sure they'll be fine.

fields.EN:
Yes, we're counting on you,
Shirayuki, Nemuri.
fields.JP: よろしく頼むよ、白雪、眠り
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we're counting on you,
Snow White, Sleepy.

fields.EN:
Whether you can repair your relationship
with your sisters depends on whether
you acknowledge them, Oyayubihime.
fields.JP:
（三姉妹のわだかまりが解けるかどうかは、
　親指が妹たちを認められるかどうかに
　かかってるってわけだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whether they get along from here
depends on if Thumbelina will
respect their choice.)

fields.EN:
Then let's move on and
counterattack the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
じゃあナイトメアに反撃するために
先に進もう、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's get going and find
the Nightmare's core.

fields.EN: See? I told you these existed.
fields.JP: ほらね、本当にあっただろう？
fields.LOCALIZED: See? I told you these existed.

fields.EN:
Y-You don't have to rub it in.
I can see it for myself.
fields.JP:
う、うるさいわね、
見れば分かるわよそんなことっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You don't have to rub it in.
I can see it for myself.

fields.EN:
But, um...
I'm sorry I doubted you.
fields.JP: でもその……疑って悪かったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, um...
I'm sorry I doubted you.

fields.EN: That means you owe me one.
fields.LOCALIZED: That means you owe me one.

fields.EN: Now then, it's time to fight.
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, it's time to fight.

fields.EN:
No, the core is protected by a
guardian.
fields.JP:
いいえ、核は常に番人によって
守られているみたいなんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, the core is protected by a
guardian.

fields.EN:
Hmph!
There's no way we'd lose to it!
fields.JP:
ふん、こんなところで
負けてなんていられないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph!
There's no way we'd lose to it!

fields.EN:
My sentiments exactly.
Now, let us finish it off quick.
fields.JP:
そういうこと。
さっさと倒してしまいましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
My sentiments exactly.
Now, let us finish it off quick.
Snow White will do her best!

fields.EN:
Please, don't worry so much.
We're fine, Oyayubi-neesama.
fields.JP:
そんなに心配しないで下さい……
白雪たちは大丈夫です、親指姉様
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, don't worry so much.
We're fine, sister Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
I think watching over them is part of
an older sister's duty too.
fields.JP: 見守ってあげるのも姉の務めだと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's a fine duty to simply
watch over them, Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
Ah...
You don't need to tell me that.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah...
You don't need to tell me that.

fields.EN: Now then, let us destroy the core.
fields.JP: さあ、核を破壊しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, let us destroy the core.

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！
たぶん、ジェイルの鳴き声だよ

fields.EN:
Wouldn't you agree that the
wailing can help prove that the
Jail Tower is growing?
fields.JP:
この鳴き声も、監獄塔が伸びるっていう
仮説を裏付けてくれそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't you agree that the
wailing can help prove that the
Jail Tower is growing?

fields.EN:
All right! Now, let's go and
hunt down the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
よし、ではあのナイトメアを
倒しに行こうではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Now, let's go and
hunt down the Nightmare!

fields.EN:
We can finally help the
Order and the Oyayubi-chan
sisters by beating it.
fields.JP:
そうだね。それでようやく
親指ちゃんたちを……タイヨウ教団の
ひとたちを助けられるんだもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can finally help the
Order and the Thumbelina
sisters by beating it.

fields.JP: じゃあ行こうか、みんな
辺りが白くなってきた……！

fields.EN:
Which could only mean...
The Nightmare is nearby...
fields.JP:
ということは……
ナイトメアはすぐそこですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which could only mean...
The Nightmare is nearby...

fields.JP: いっ、いました！　あそこ！
こんどこそやっつける！

ここが正念場だよ！
みんな、頑張ろう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are we all ready?
Everyone, let's do our best!

fields.EN:
I need to repay the debt
I owe my sisters from before.
fields.JP:
さっきの妹たちへの借りを
返させてもらうわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll finish it so that I pay back
what we sisters owe you!

fields.EN:
Great to hear, but make sure
you don't lose your cool like
before, got it?
fields.JP:
意気込みはいいけれど、
さっきみたいに我を忘れたりしないでね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great to hear, but make sure
you don't lose your cool like
before, got it?

fields.EN:
I-I'm absolutely fine!
I'm as calm as ever!
fields.JP:
だっ……大丈夫よっ！！
わたしは今とても冷静だわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm absolutely fine!
I'm as calm as ever!

fields.EN:
Hmph! It seems so.
Now then, after me!
fields.JP:
ふん、大丈夫なようだな。
では貴様ら、ワレに続くのだっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! It seems so.
Now then, after me!

fields.JP: よし、厄介な部位を破壊したぞ！

fields.EN:
Looks like it's taking a toll
on it quite badly.
fields.JP: だいぶ効いてるみたいね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like it's taking a toll
on it quite badly.

fields.JP: 今のうちに一気に畳みかけるぞ！
少し肩の力を抜くんだ、親指

fields.EN:
With their help, the battle is
turning in our favor. Don't overdo it.
fields.JP:
親指や白雪、眠りのおかげで
だいぶ戦いが有利に運べてる。
だからあまり気負いすぎないでいこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You girls are making this battle
a lot easier. Relax, we're
going to win this.

fields.JP: グルゥ……グルアアアアッ！！
よし、あと一息だみんなっ！！

fields.EN:
And, we won because everyone
pitched in.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、みんなの力で
倒したんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, we won because everyone
pitched in.

fields.EN: Were we of help in battle?
fields.JP:
白雪たちは……
ちゃんと戦えていましたか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Were we of help in battle?

fields.EN:
Why yes! You all fought well!
I praise thee!
fields.JP:
うむ！　貴様らはしっかりと
戦えておったぞ！　褒めてつかわそう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes! You all fought well!
I praise thee!

fields.JP:
白雪たちもちゃんと戦って……
そして倒せたんですね……

fields.EN:
We really did it, Nemu-chan!
We were able to beat it!
fields.JP:
やったねネムちゃんっ！！
白雪たち、ちゃんと倒せたね……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We really did it, Sleepy!
We were able to beat it!

fields.EN:
Oh, look at them hugging
each other.
fields.JP: あら、抱き合っちゃってますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, look at them hugging
each other.

fields.EN:
Why wouldn't they? They fought
and proved themselves. Of course
they'd be happy for themselves.
fields.JP:
自分たちがちゃんと役に立てるんだって
証明できたんだ、嬉しいに決まってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why wouldn't they? They fought
and proved themselves. Of course
they'd be happy for themselves.

fields.EN: I guess they were able to fight...
fields.JP: ２人とも、しっかりと戦えていたわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess they were able to fight...

fields.EN:
Haha... I don't know. As their older sister,
I'm happy, but I also feel a little lonely...
fields.JP:
あはは、何だろう、
姉として嬉しいんだけどね、
でもちょっと寂しいというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I'm not sure how I feel.
I guess I feel happy and a bit
sad at the same time...

fields.EN:
(It must feel weird seeing those
who she protected being able
to stand on their own...)
fields.JP:
（親指としては、守るべき妹たちが
　巣立っていった気分なんだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must feel weird seeing those
who she protected being able
to stand on their own...)

fields.EN:
We can take everyone in
the Order to a safe place.
fields.JP:
よし、とにかくこれでタイヨウ教団の
みんなを安全な場所に連れて行けるわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess we can finally
rally the Order together to get
to our destination!

fields.EN:
Thanks for everything, girls.
Thanks, Otsuu.
fields.JP:
手伝ってくれてありがとうね、
おつう、それにみんなも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for everything, girls.
Thanks, Otsuu.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ど……ぎぎ……いだじま……
……んぎ…………じで……

fields.EN:
(Jack looks happy seeing the
smiles on the three sister's
faces.)
fields.JP:
（親指たちに笑顔が戻って、
　ジャックも嬉しそうだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jack looks happy seeing the
smiles on the three sister's
faces.)

fields.EN:
So, finally giving thanks,
are you?!
fields.JP: やっとお礼の言葉を言ったな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, finally giving thanks,
are you?!

fields.EN:
I assume your safe haven is
supposed to be beyond here.
fields.JP:
それで、その安全な場所とやらは
この先にあるのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume your safe haven is
supposed to be beyond here.

fields.EN:
According to Michiru, yes, it
should be beyond this area.
fields.JP:
ミチルが言ってた安全な場所は、
おそらくこの先にあるはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
According to Michiru, yes, it
should be beyond this area.

fields.JP: いったいどんなところなんだろう……？

fields.EN:
There aren't very many places
in the Jail that can be called
"safe."
fields.JP:
なかなか安全って言い切れる場所って、
今このジェイルにあるとは思えないのですけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
There aren't very many places
in the Jail that can be called
"safe."

fields.EN:
True. Even the safe haven that was
the previous Liberated District
was destroyed completely...
fields.JP:
確かに、元の解放地区だって
あれだけ警備が厳重だったのに
壊滅しちゃったんだもんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. Even the safe haven that was
the previous Liberated District
was destroyed completely...

fields.EN: We'll find out when we get there.
fields.JP: 行ってみれば分かるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll find out when we get there.

fields.EN:
Indeed. It's no use making
assumptions now.
fields.JP:
その通りね。
ここで推測してても意味はないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. It's no use making
assumptions now.

fields.EN:
How about we all go and take
a look at the place then?
fields.JP: じゃあみんなで見に行ってみましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about we all go and take
a look at the place then?

fields.EN:
Sounds good.
All right, let's head on out.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
よしみんな、出発しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds good.
All right, let's head on out.

fields.EN:
Okay...
This should be the location
Michiru was leading us to.
fields.JP: よし……ここね、ミチルが言ってた場所は
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay...
This should be the location
Michiru was leading us to.

fields.JP: えっ、ちょっと待ってくれ親指

fields.EN:
What?!
So, we're at the enemy's
main base of operations?!
fields.JP: なんと！　敵の本拠地ではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?!
So, we're at the enemy's
main base of operations?!

fields.EN:
A-Are you sure this place is
supposed to be safe?
fields.JP:
こ、こんな場所が
本当に安全なんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-Are you sure this place is
supposed to be safe?

fields.EN:
She's right, Oyayubi!
There's no way this place is safe!
fields.JP:
そうだよ親指、どう見ても
監獄塔の中が安全とは思えない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Thumbelina!
There's no way this place is safe!

fields.EN:
I understand what you're saying,
but Michiru did say the place
is safe.
fields.JP:
あんたたちが言いたいことは分かるわよ。
でも大丈夫らしいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand what you're saying,
but Michiru did say the place
is safe.

fields.EN:
She said that there are two
entrances into the tower.
fields.JP:
ミチルが言うにはね、
監獄塔には２つの入り口があるんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
She said that there are two
entrances into the tower.

fields.EN:
There's supposed to be another way
in besides the main entrance.
fields.JP:
そう。正面の入り口とは別に
もう１つ入り口があるって話よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's supposed to be another way
in besides the main entrance.

fields.EN:
The other entrance only lets you climb
partway, and there aren't any Marchens there.
fields.JP:
で、そっちは途中までしか上れないけど、
メルヒェンが一切いないんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
That entrance leads to a dead-end,
but in turn, there are no Marchens
there.

fields.EN:
That's quite intriguing.
A location in enemy territory
where there are no enemies...
fields.JP:
それ、少し楽しいわね。
敵の本拠地なのに敵が来ない場所……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite intriguing.
A location in enemy territory
where there are no enemies...

fields.EN:
Maybe you're so close to the
Marchens that you can slip
under their radar.
fields.JP:
近すぎて、逆にメルヒェンたちに
疑われたりもしないのかなぁ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe you're so close to the
Marchens that you can slip
under their radar.

fields.JP: もしかしたら、そうかもしれませんね

（でもあの親指が、
　よくそんな話を信じたもんだ……）

fields.EN:
I have to ask, with how doubtful
you are at nature, what made
you believe this?
fields.JP:
疑問なのだけど、あなた疑り深いのに
よくその話を信じたわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to ask, with how doubtful
you are at nature, what made
you believe this?

fields.EN:
If I heard that from anyone else, I wouldn't
believe it. But since Michiru said it...
fields.JP:
他の人に聞いた情報だったら、
わたしは信じなかったわ。でもこの話を
したのは他でもないミチルだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I didn't believe it at
first. But, it did come from
Michiru, so I won't doubt it.

fields.EN:
Michiru's words are sometimes
cryptic, but for some reason,
what she says turns out right.
fields.JP:
ミチルの予言って
まるで訳が分からないけど、
確かに当たるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru's words are sometimes
cryptic, but for some reason,
what she says turns out right.

fields.EN:
She also said she was born here,
so I figured it'd be best to
believe her words.
fields.JP:
それにミチルは、
ここで生まれたから分かるって言ったの。
だからわたしも信じることにしたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She also said she was born here,
so I figured it'd be best to
believe her words.

fields.EN:
Of course, I'm going to make
sure the place is safe first.
fields.JP:
とは言っても、改めて
中の確認はするけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, I'm going to make
sure the place is safe first.

fields.EN:
Right. It's always good to
make sure things are safe.
fields.JP:
そうだね、安全確認は
いつだってちゃんとするべきだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. It's always good to
make sure things are safe.

fields.EN:
I'm simply interested to see what
the inside of the tower is like.
fields.JP:
私は純粋に監獄塔の中を
見てみたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm simply interested to see what
the inside of the tower is like.

fields.JP: じゃあ行ってみましょうか？

fields.EN:
Wait! We're going in?!
I may be a hero, but I'm still
tired after all that happened.
fields.JP:
まだ先へ進むのか！？
さすがのワレも今日はもう疲れたぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait! We're going in?!
I may be a hero, but I'm still
tired after all that happened.

fields.JP: うーんちょっとだけだから
ねーラプンツェルおなかすいたー

fields.EN:
We did take down the Nightmare,
so I wouldn't mind taking a nap
now.
fields.JP:
でも今日はナイトメアも倒してるし、
確かに休みたいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did take down the Nightmare,
so I wouldn't mind taking a nap
now.

fields.EN:
I guess...
Maybe we should head on back.
fields.JP:
そうだな……
確かにそろそろ帰るべきかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess...
Maybe we should head on back.

fields.EN:
We've reached a good stopping point
in the exploration. Let's head
back for today and come again.
fields.JP:
そうだね。探索もひと段落したし、
今日はもう戻って、また出直そうよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found the place, so we can
always come back later.

fields.EN:
She's right!
The tower isn't moving anywhere!
Let's come back later!
fields.JP:
そうだぞ！　監獄塔は逃げやしないからな！
また改めて来ればいいのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right!
The tower isn't moving anywhere!
Let's come back later!

fields.EN:
Too bad. I wouldn't have minded
seeing what it was like today.
fields.JP: 中が見たかったのだけど……仕方ないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too bad. I wouldn't have minded
seeing what it was like today.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぃぎ……ヘンゼル……
……じん……ばいじでる……ちぎ……

fields.EN:
Jack says everyone at the
base may worry if we don't return.
fields.JP:
ジャックの言うとおり、
そろそろ帰らないと拠点のみんなも
心配するかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's right. We should head back.
No purpose in keeping everyone
in wait back at base.

fields.EN:
I guess you're right. It's safer
if we rest well, and then come
back in case something happens.
fields.JP:
まあ何があるか分からないって考えれば、
一旦戻って休んで、それから出直した方が
何かあってもしっかり対処できそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you're right. It's safer
if we rest well, and then come
back in case something happens.

fields.EN: I think that's the right call.
fields.JP: うん、そっちの方が確実だね
fields.LOCALIZED: I think that's the right call.

fields.EN:
All right. Let's head on back
to the Liberated District.
fields.JP: よし、じゃあ一旦解放地区に戻ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. Let's head on back
to the Liberated District.

fields.EN:
Man, just standing around here
doing nothing is really gonna
take a toll on me...
fields.JP:
しかし何もせずに立ちっぱなしってのも
感覚鈍りそうだぜ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Man, just standing around here
doing nothing is really gonna
take a toll on me...

fields.EN:
I wish Hameln had prepared a familiar
gatekeeper that could actually talk.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンも門番の使い魔、
喋れる奴を用意してくれたらなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only Hameln's familiars
actually spoke...

fields.EN:
Heck, guess I should be happy
that it actually understands
what we're saying.
fields.JP:
まあ言葉を理解してくれるだけ、
ありがてえけどよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heck, guess I should be happy
that it actually understands
what we're saying.

fields.EN:
How's things going, Mamoru?
Here, something to bite on.
fields.JP: マモル、お疲れ！　はい差し入れー
fields.LOCALIZED:
How's things going, Mamoru?
Here, something to bite on.

fields.EN:
Thanks.
How's things on your side?
fields.JP:
お、さんきゅ。
そっちの仕事はどうだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks.
How's things on your side?

fields.EN:
Yeah, but that's a good thing.
You don't want people to be
flooding in to get patched up.
fields.JP:
ま、救護室が暇なのは人類にとって
最も喜ぶべきことだと思うぜ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but that's a good thing.
You don't want people to be
flooding in to get patched up.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I guess having slow days
like this is a good thing.
fields.JP:
……だな。俺たちが暇なのは
歓迎すべきことなんだよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I guess having slow days
like this is a good thing.

fields.EN: The patrol came back right on time.
fields.JP:
おっ、見回りが帰ってきた。
時間通り……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh hey, our friendly neighborhood
familiar guard came back...

fields.EN:
What the?!
What the hell happened to you?!
fields.JP: おい！　お前血だらけじゃねえか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the?!
What the hell happened to you?!

fields.JP: おいおい、何があったってんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, get a hold of yourself!

fields.JP: こっちに来るなヒカリ！

fields.EN: But! I need to patch it up!
fields.JP: でもその子の手当てしなきゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: But! I need to patch it up!

fields.EN:
It's dangerous outside the walls,
so you stay inside there.
fields.JP:
拠点の外に出たら危険だから
ヒカリは出るなっての――
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's dangerous outside the walls,
so you stay inside there.

fields.JP:
ち……もっと……いっぱい……
……ぎろろ……こっちに……

fields.EN:
It's that Nightmare that
attacked Dawn!
fields.JP: 黎明にいた……ナイトメア……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's that Nightmare that
attacked Dawn!

fields.EN:
Damn it!
Of all the things to come...!
fields.JP:
よりによってこいつに
嗅ぎつけられるなんてな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it!
Of all the things to come...!

fields.EN:
I'm not even sure my weapon
is gonna even work against it.
fields.JP:
くそっ……こんな普通の武器が
どこまで通じるってんだか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not even sure my weapon
is gonna even work against it.

fields.JP:
ほしぃ……ぐろろ……
ち……ち…………

fields.EN:
What the?! I told you not to come!
It's that thing that destroyed
Dawn!
fields.JP:
馬鹿野郎！　来んなって言っただろ！
黎明滅ぼした奴だぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the?! I told you not to come!
It's that thing that destroyed
Dawn!

fields.EN:
But, I can't let that poor
familiar die out here!
We can all make a run for it!
fields.JP:
でもその使い魔を
置いてくのはかわいそうだよ……！
ね、みんなで逃げよう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I can't let that poor
familiar die out here!
We can all make a run for it!

fields.EN:
It's no use...
The familiar is...
fields.JP: 駄目だ、その使い魔はもう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use...
The familiar is...

fields.EN:
Just get back in and let everyone
know to escape from here!
fields.JP:
とにかくだ、お前は今いる仲間
全員を避難させるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just get back in and let everyone
know to escape from here!

fields.EN:
I'll have another familiar
search for Otsuu and the others.
fields.JP:
それと別の使い魔におつうたちを
探してくるように命令しといてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let another familiar know to
get in touch with Otsuu and the
others!

fields.EN: What are you going to do?!
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you going to do?!

fields.EN:
There's no way we can both
make a run against it...
fields.JP:
２人とも背を向けて
逃げ切れる相手じゃねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we can both
make a run against it...

fields.EN:
Hold it off even one second
longer. We're relying on you, Hikari.
fields.JP:
だから俺が時間を稼ぐ。
１秒でも長くあいつを止めるから、
その間に頼んだぜ、ヒカリ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll buy you some time.
I'm counting on you to get
everyone out of here!

fields.EN:
But, you're not a Blood Maiden!
You need to run, too!
fields.JP:
そんな、血式少女でもないのに無茶だよ！
一緒に逃げよう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you're not a Blood Maiden!
You need to run, too!

fields.EN:
If we both bite the dust, everyone
inside is gonna die! Just go!
fields.JP:
今ここで２人して死んだら拠点は全滅だ！
いいからさっさと行けってんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we both bite the dust, everyone
inside is gonna die! Just go!

fields.JP:
……分かった。
みんなの避難は任せて

fields.EN: But, don't you dare die on me!
fields.JP: だからマモル、絶対に死なないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED: But, don't you dare die on me!

fields.EN:
Damn it, let's do this!
Not sure how long I'll last,
but I'm gonna stop you here!
fields.JP:
よし、俺も腹を決めたぜ。
どこまでやれるか知らねえけど、
ねばってやる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it, let's do this!
Not sure how long I'll last,
but I'm gonna stop you here!

fields.EN:
THIS PLACE IS PRECIOUS TO ALL.
I WILL FIGHT, TOO.
fields.JP:
ココハミンナノダイジナバショ……
ボクモイッショニマモル……
fields.LOCALIZED:
THIS PLACE IS PRECIOUS TO ALL.
I WILL FIGHT, TOO.

fields.EN:
Thanks... And, I'm gonna apologize
to you now. I thought you were all
creepy and things.
fields.JP:
……悪いヘンゼル、俺ずっとお前は
物静かで不気味な奴だって思ってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks... And, I'm gonna apologize
to you now. I thought you were all
creepy and things.

fields.EN:
He was so passionate... and so cool.
I'm sorry I misunderstood him on my own.
fields.JP:
でもそんなことなかった。
お前はこんなにも熱くてかっこいい。
ほんと、勝手に誤解してごめんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess I couldn't have been more
wrong. You've got the heart.
Sorry man, you're the best.

fields.EN:
Everyone is kind... That's
why I want to protect everyone.
fields.JP: ミンナヤサシイ……ダカラミンナマモル……
fields.LOCALIZED:
EVERYONE IS KIND HERE, HENCE
I WILL FIGHT FOR ALL.

fields.EN:
Yeah, let's do this, Hansel.
You and me, together!
fields.JP:
ああ、守ろうぜヘンゼル。
俺とお前で！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, let's do this, Hansel.
You and me, together!

fields.EN:
Go away... Gaaah...
If not... die...
fields.JP:
じゃま……ぎきき……
する、なら……しね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go away... Gaaah...
If not... die...

fields.JP: よしヘンゼル、同時に行くぞ！！

fields.EN: I won't let you pass here.

Gaah... Get... out...
of my... way...
fields.JP:
ぐげ……げ…………もう……
じゃま……スるな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gaah... Get... out...
of my... way...

fields.JP: ヘンゼル、もういい逃げろっ！！

fields.EN:
THIS IS GRETEL'S HOME NOW.
EVERYONE'S HOME...
I WILL PROTECT NO MATTER WHAT...
fields.JP:
グレーテルノカエルバショ……
ミンナノバショ……ダカラマモル……
fields.LOCALIZED:
THIS IS GRETEL'S HOME NOW.
EVERYONE'S HOME...
I WILL PROTECT NO MATTER WHAT...

fields.EN:
You're not immortal anymore, are
you?! With wounds like that, you'll...!
fields.JP:
お前はもう不死身じゃねえんだろ！？
そんな傷負ったらもう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You idiot! You're not invincible
anymore! Another hit, and...!

fields.EN:
Damn it... Move, legs...! These
wounds are nothing compared to Hansel's...!!
fields.JP:
くそっ……動け俺の足……！
こんな傷、ヘンゼルに比べたら……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it! Stupid legs, move!
I can't let my wounds get in
my way!

fields.EN:
I WON'T LET... YOU GO...
I WON'T... LET YOU... THROUGH...
fields.JP:
トオサ……ナイ……
ココハゼッタイ……トオ……サナイ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I WON'T LET... YOU GO...
I WON'T... LET YOU... THROUGH...

fields.EN:
How dare you do this to my
precious companions and familiars...!
fields.JP:
貴様、よくもワレの大事な仲間や
使い魔たちを……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare you do all this
to my friends and familiars!

fields.JP: ヘンゼル兄さん、今助けるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm here to assist, dear brother
Hansel.

fields.JP: くっ……相変わらず逃げ足の速い……！

（悲しいような……
　何かに苦しんでいるような……）

fields.EN: We need to help Hansel and the others.
fields.JP:
そんなことより今は
ヘンゼルたちを助けないと……
fields.LOCALIZED: I need to go and help Hansel!

fields.JP: ヘンゼルさん、しっかりして下さい！

fields.EN:
Hikarin said she can make
hurty go away quick!
fields.JP:
ヒカリンがいたいのとんでけってやれば
なおるっていってた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikarin said she can make
hurty go away quick!

fields.JP: だからヘンゼルのいたいのとんでけー！！

fields.EN:
Thanks to you, everyone
is safe. So hang in there.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル、君のおかげでみんなは無事だ。
だからしっかりするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel, you did fine.
Everyone's safe now,
so get some rest.

fields.EN:
Wait...
Hansel-niisan... can you see us?
fields.JP:
もしかしてヘンゼル兄さん……
目が見えてないの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...
Hansel... can you see us?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
JACK... PROTECT EVERYONE...
GRETEL... IN PLACE... OF ME...
fields.JP:
ジャック……ボクノカワリニ……
グレーテル、ト……ミンナヲ……
マモッテ……ホシイ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
JACK... PROTECT EVERYONE...
GRETEL... IN PLACE... OF ME...

fields.EN:
I CAN'T MOVE... ANY MORE...
PLEASE... JACK...
fields.JP:
ボクハモウ……ウゴケナイカラ……
オネ……ガイダジャック……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I CAN'T MOVE... ANY MORE...
PLEASE... JACK...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック
なあに、ヘンゼル兄さん

fields.EN:
I WILL DIE SOON...
I AM SORRY... I COULDN'T KEEP...
MY PROMISE... TO... PROTECT YOU...
fields.JP:
ボク……モウシンジャウケド……
ズットマモルッテ……キメタノニ……
マモレナクテ……ゴメンヨ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I WILL DIE SOON...
I AM SORRY... I COULDN'T KEEP...
MY PROMISE... TO... PROTECT YOU...

fields.EN:
You protected me when it
mattered most, Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんは一番大切な時に
ちゃんと守ってくれたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, you did protect
me when it was needed the most.

fields.EN:
In fact, you saved everyone, too.
Everyone can now greet a new
day tomorrow because of you.
fields.JP:
私も、みんなも救われた。
全員が無事に明日を迎えられるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, you saved everyone, too.
Everyone can now greet a new
day tomorrow because of you.

fields.EN:
So be proud of what you did.
I can vouch that your death was
something of great value.
fields.JP:
だから悔やまず誇りを持って。
この死は価値のあるものだと、
私が認めるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
So be proud of what you did.
I can vouch that your death was
something of great value.

fields.EN:
THANK YOU, GRETEL...
I PROTECTED... EVERYONE...
fields.JP:
ウン……アリガトウグレーテル……
ボクチャント……マモッタ……ヨ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
THANK YOU, GRETEL...
I PROTECTED... EVERYONE...

fields.JP: ヘンゼル兄さん……さようなら
うわああヘンゼルきえちゃだめーーーー！！
ナイトメア・ジャック

へん……ぜる……ぎぎぎ……
や……だよ……

fields.EN:
Nightmares don't leave a
body behind when they die...?
fields.JP:
くそっ……
ナイトメアは身体も残らねえのかよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it...
Nightmares can't leave anything
when they die...?

fields.EN:
How dare it die without my
permission! How dare it...!
Sniff...
fields.JP:
ワレに断りなく勝手に死におって……！
許さぬ……許さぬぞ……ぐすっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare it die without my
permission! How dare it...!
Sniff...

fields.JP:
うぁぁぁぁぁん……！
ヘンゼルがきえちゃったよう……！
うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁん！

fields.EN:
Everyone... I know this hurts, but so
Hansel's death won't be in vain, let's block
the path that Nightmare came through...
fields.JP:
みんな……つらいけどヘンゼルの死を
無駄にしないためにも、あのナイトメアが
現れた道を塞いでしまおう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but... we need to block
the path that Nightmare came from
before we mourn Hansel's death.

fields.EN:
If I let any more people be
sacrificed, I won't be able to face Hansel.
fields.JP:
そうであるな……これ以上犠牲を出しては
ヘンゼルに顔向けできぬわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... Leaving the place
open for another attack will only
sadden Hansel...

fields.EN:
Hm... I'm curious as to why that
Nightmare ran like that when
we returned...
fields.JP:
それにしても……どうして
あのナイトメアは私たちが帰ってきたら
逃げてしまったのかしらね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I'm curious as to why that
Nightmare ran like that when
we returned...

fields.EN:
(She's right... I feel like it
runs every time we meet...)
fields.JP:
（……確かに、いつも僕たちが現れると
　逃げていく気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right... I feel like it
runs every time we meet...)

fields.EN:
Otsuu... sorry, but can you look
after everyone at the base too...?
fields.JP:
おい、おつう……悪いが拠点の
みんなのフォローも頼めるか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Otsuu? I hate to ask this,
but would you mind, sort of... telling
everyone inside what happened?

fields.EN:
Yeah, you can leave that to me.
I'll let them know everything is
fine now, and... thanks, Mamoru.
fields.JP:
ああ、任せてくれ。
もう大丈夫だって伝えてくるよ。
マモルも、本当にありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you can leave that to me.
I'll let them know everything is
fine now, and... thanks, Mamoru.

fields.EN:
Everyone here kept their cool
because you gave the right orders,
right?
fields.JP:
拠点がパニックになってないのは、
きっとマモルが最初に的確な指示を
出してくれたからだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone here kept their cool
because you gave the right orders,
right?

fields.EN:
So, it's not like you didn't do
anything.
fields.JP:
何もできなかった、
なんてことは絶対にないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it's not like you didn't do
anything.

fields.EN:
We're going to make it through
all this, and find a way out of
this place...
fields.JP:
……僕たちは絶対に生き延びる。
そして必ず、このジェイルから抜け出すんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to make it through
all this, and find a way out of
this place...

fields.EN:
I kept having small
interactions with Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
（それからもしばらく、
　人魚姫とのささやかな交流は続いた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My awkward, yet enjoyable time
with Little Mermaid continued...)

fields.EN:
I kept looking for a chance to
talk to her, but I couldn't find one.
fields.JP:
（その間に声をかけるきっかけを
　探し続けたものの、思った以上に難しく、
　なかなか見つかりはしなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I couldn't muster the strength to
speak to her during the time. It
was much harder than I thought.)

fields.EN:
(But my feelings towards her,
wanting to become friends grew
larger by the day...)
fields.JP:
（それでも仲良くなりたい、
　その想いだけは膨らむばかりで……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But my feelings towards her,
wanting to become friends grew
larger by the day...)

fields.EN:
(I tried convincing myself that
I should take the initiative...)
fields.JP:
（ただ偶然に身を任せて
　出会うのを待っているだけでは駄目だと、
　自分に言い聞かせ始めていた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I tried convincing myself that
I should take the initiative...)

fields.EN:
(So, I started to make my move,
slowly but surely. I waited a
short bit after placing the food.)
fields.JP:
（それからは少しだけ積極的に動き始めた。
　食事を用意することも忘れなかったけど、
　ほんの少し、待ってみたりもした）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So, I started to make my move,
slowly but surely. I waited a
short bit after placing the food.)

fields.EN:
(Even then, the moment we see
each other, we each ran off...)
fields.JP:
（でも互いの姿を見てしまうと、
　ある時はこちらが、ある時はあちらが
　やはり逃げてしまうのだった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even then, the moment we see
each other, we each ran off...)

fields.EN:
(Seeing her kept making me
yearn to become her friend...)
fields.JP:
（仲良くなりたい……その想いが、
　姿を見たことでさらに膨らんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seeing her kept making me
yearn to become her friend...)

fields.EN:
(Oddly enough, I felt as if she
felt the same way too, almost
to a conviction...)
fields.JP:
（それは向こうも同じだと、
　確信に近い思いもまたあった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oddly enough, I felt as if she
felt the same way too, almost
to a conviction...)

fields.EN:
(I finally made up my mind.
I will talk to her.
We will become friends.)
fields.JP:
（だから、ついに決心をした。
　今度こそちゃんと声をかけよう。
　そして仲良くなろう、と）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I finally made up my mind.
I will talk to her.
We will become friends.)

fields.EN:
The day after I decided to talk to
her, I stopped seeing Ningyohime entirely.
fields.JP:
（……それなのに、声をかける
　決意をした次の日から、人魚姫の姿を
　まったく見なくなってしまった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, it was then that Little
Mermaid went missing...)

fields.JP:
（いつものように置いておいた食事も、
　手つかずで残ったままだった。
　次の日も、その次の日も……）

fields.EN:
(I didn't give up. I began my
search for Ningyohime. Time
flew by as if it was nothing...)
fields.JP:
（それでも諦めずに人魚姫を探し続けた。
　時間はどんどん過ぎていった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't give up. I began my
search for Little Mermaid. Time
flew by as if it was nothing...)

fields.EN:
(I wonder how long it took...
I finally realized...
Ningyohime was not here any more...)
fields.JP:
（あれから何日が経ったか……
　さすがに人魚姫はいないのだと、
　ようやく理解した……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder how long it took...
I finally realized... Little
Mermaid was not here any more...)

fields.JP:
ぎぎ……にんぎょ……びめ……
……もう……いな……ぎちち……

fields.EN:
(If she's not here then there's
no reason for me to be here...)
fields.JP:
（人魚姫がいないなら……
　この独房エリアに用はないよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If she's not here then there's
no reason for me to be here...)

fields.EN:
(I'll head back to
the Metropolitan Building...)
fields.JP: （いつも過ごしてた都庁に……戻ろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'll head back to
the Metropolitan Building...)

fields.JP:
（人魚姫……
　どこに行っちゃったんだ……）

fields.EN:
(Finally left the place where
I met Ningyohime, but...)
fields.JP:
（人魚姫と出会ったあの場所から
　やっと出たと思ったのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Finally left the place where
I met Little Mermaid, but...)

fields.JP:
（今度はまた変な場所に
　迷い込んじゃったな……）

ぎぎぎ……こごは……
ど……ごなの……んぎ……

fields.EN:
The Underground Cavern? Isn't
the Metropolitan Building this way?
fields.JP:
（地下洞窟……？
　都庁はこっちじゃないのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(An underground cavern...?
Guess I took the wrong turn...)

fields.EN:
(Or, is this the right direction?
I don't recall seeing any other
path...)
fields.JP:
（違うのかなあ……
　でも他に道あったかなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Or, is this the right direction?
I don't recall seeing any other
path...)

fields.EN:
(Yes, I'm sure I'm on the
right path...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yes, I'm sure I'm on the
right path...)

fields.JP:
（どうしよう、
　だんだん不安になってきた……）

fields.EN:
(I better go back
the way I came...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better go back
the way I came...)

fields.EN:
(H-Huh?
I don't recall a fork in the
path here...)
fields.JP:
（あ、あれっ？
　さっきこんな分かれ道なんて
　あったっけ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(H-Huh?
I don't recall a fork in the
path here...)

fields.EN:
(Which way did I come from?
Um... Right...?)
fields.JP:
（どっちだっけ……
　ええと……右だったはず……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Which way did I come from?
Um... Right...?)

fields.JP: （あれ、こんな場所に見覚えない……）

fields.EN:
(I must have taken the wrong
turn again...)
fields.JP:
（おかしい、どこかで
　道を間違えたんだ、きっと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I must have taken the wrong
turn again...)

fields.EN:
(I better go back, but...
to where?)
fields.JP:
（どこだろう、分かるところまで
　また戻らないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better go back, but...
to where?)

fields.JP: （駄目だ……完全に迷ってしまった……）

fields.EN:
(I kept wandering in circles in
the underground cavern...)
fields.JP:
（――それから地下洞窟を
　彷徨う日々が始まった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I kept wandering in circles in
the underground cavern...)

fields.EN:
(I barely made it by with whatever
meager food I can find.)
fields.JP:
（食料を必死に探しても、
　見つかるのはほんのわずか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I barely made it by with whatever
meager food I can find.)

fields.EN:
(Each day passes as I scrounge
for food...)
fields.JP:
（そのわずかな食料のために
　必死になる毎日……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Each day passes as I scrounge
for food...)

fields.EN:
I was no longer in any position to worry
about reaching the Metropolitan Building.
Just surviving took everything I had.
fields.JP:
（気づけば都庁どころではなくなっていた。
　その日を生き延びるのに精一杯だった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(By then, I forgot about leaving.
Instead, I was simply trying to
survive.)

fields.EN:
(Ten years pass... After all the
wandering, something happened...)
fields.JP:
（そうして１０年以上も彷徨うはめに
　なった結果、身体に変化が起こった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ten years pass... After all the
wandering, something happened...)

fields.EN:
(My body slowly started to adapt
to the underground cavern's harsh
environment.)
fields.JP:
（過酷な地下洞窟の環境に適応して、
　身体が不自然に変化していったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My body slowly started to adapt
to the underground cavern's harsh
environment.)

fields.EN:
(At the same time, I gradually
forgot the words I no longer used...)
fields.JP:
（そして、それと同時に
　使うことのなくなった言葉を、
　段々と忘れていった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I also slowly lost my ability
to speak...)

fields.EN:
I was being chased by humans, but by
a stroke of luck I ended up back at my
hometown, the Metropolitan Building.
fields.JP:
（その自分が今、人間に追われて、
　不幸中の幸いか故郷である都庁に着いた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now I'm being hunted by humans,
which ironically brought me back
to the Metropolitan Building.)

fields.EN:
(It was so long since I was here
that it brought tears to my eyes.)
fields.JP:
（あまりの懐かしさに、
　思わず涙が溢れた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It was so long since I was here
that it brought tears to my eyes.)

fields.EN:
(It was then that it struck me...
I want to show Ningyohime
the sights here...)
fields.JP:
（そして『この景色を見せたい』と、
　唐突に人魚姫のことを思い出した）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It was then that it struck me...
I want to show Little Mermaid
the sights here...)

fields.JP:
（１０年経った今でも、
　思い出して胸が温かくなる……）

fields.EN:
(I still want to meet her.
I want to thank her...)
fields.JP:
（私は今でも人魚姫に会いたい。
　そして一言、お礼を言いたい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I still want to meet her.
I want to thank her...)

fields.EN:
(I want to thank her for
saving me...)
fields.JP:
（あの時、助けてくれて
　ありがとう……って）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I want to thank her for
saving me...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Are you all right, Jack?
You were mumbling something.
fields.JP:
大丈夫かジャック。
うわごとのように何か呟いてたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you all right, Jack?
You were mumbling something.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

だい……じょ……ぶ……
んぎぎ……

fields.EN:
Well, if you say so...
I'm all changed and ready.
How about you, Jack?
fields.JP:
それならいいんだけど……
僕はもう着替え終わったよ。
ジャックはどうだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you say so...
I'm all changed and ready.
How about you, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

いづで……もぎちちっ……
んぎっ……いげるっ……

fields.EN: Sounds like you're all good to go.
fields.JP: お、気合い入ってるなジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: Sounds like you're all good to go.

fields.EN:
Well, no wonder.
You want to keep that promise
between you and Hansel...
fields.JP:
そうだよな。
ヘンゼルと約束したんだもんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, no wonder.
You want to keep that promise
between you and Hansel...

fields.EN:
Seeing Hansel die stopped us
from taking further action.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルの死を目の当たりにした僕らは、
次の行動へと動きだせずにいた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing Hansel die stopped us
from taking further action.

fields.EN:
Surprisingly enough, the first
person to take action was Gretel.
fields.JP:
その中で、最初に立ち上がったのは、
意外にもグレーテルだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surprisingly enough, the first
person to take action was Gretel.

fields.EN:
The first thing she did was
to suggest that everyone
rest themselves.
fields.JP:
グレーテルはまずみんなに
身体を休めることを提案した
fields.LOCALIZED:
The first thing she did was
to suggest that everyone
rest themselves.

fields.EN:
After we rest, I suggest we return to the
Jail Tower we're investigating for the Order.
fields.JP:
そして一休みしたら、
タイヨウ教団のために調査していた
監獄塔にまた行こうと提案した
fields.LOCALIZED:
She also suggested to go back
to the Jail Tower once we're
ready.

fields.EN:
No one could say anything to Gretel. She was
the one who felt Hansel's death most deeply.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルの死に最も感じるものが
あるだろうグレーテルの言葉に、
僕たちは誰も、何も言えなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one could say no to her.
She should've been hit hardest
with Hansel's death.

fields.EN:
We didn't want to have Hansel's
death end in vain, so we went
our ways to rest ourselves.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルの死を無駄にしない……
それが前に進むことだと改めて思った
僕たちは、まずしっかり休んだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't want to have Hansel's
death end in vain, so we went
our ways to rest ourselves.

fields.EN:
The next day, we took action
and went to the Jail Tower with
Michiru in tow...
fields.JP:
そして翌日、ミチルたちを連れて、
監獄塔に向かったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The next day, we took action
and went to the Jail Tower with
Michiru in tow...

fields.EN:
Welcome back, Otsuu. I'm glad
the leader and everyone else are safe.
fields.JP:
おかえり、おつう。
教祖さんたちも無事なようでよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Welcome back, Otsuu.
I can only assume everyone was
okay.

fields.EN: So, what's it like in the tower?
fields.JP: で、どうだったんだ監獄塔の中は
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what's it like in the tower?

fields.EN:
We didn't encounter a single
Marchen.
fields.JP: メルヒェンには、一切出くわさなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't encounter a single
Marchen.

fields.EN:
Just as Michiru said, there
aren't any Marchens here at all.
fields.JP:
ミチル、本当に君の言うとおり
メルヒェンがまったくいなかったな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was exactly how Michiru said
it would be.

fields.EN:
It also wasn't as deep as
I thought. There were only so many
floors inside there.
fields.JP:
それに上の階層もどこまであるのか、
調べるの大変だなって思ったけど、
意外と少なかったしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also wasn't as deep as
I thought. There were only so many
floors inside there.

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
Being under the sun always feels
good.
fields.JP:
ふふ……お日様の下はいつだって
居心地いいって決まってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
Being under the sun always feels
good.

fields.EN:
As for the front entrance,
it wasn't as accessible
as I thought.
fields.JP:
でも反対の……正面口って言うのかな、
そっちはすぐ回り込めると思ったけど、
行けなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for the front entrance,
it wasn't as accessible
as I thought.

fields.EN:
So, there were loads of Marchens
around there?
fields.JP: メルヒェンが大量にいたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, there were loads of Marchens
around there?

fields.EN:
No. We simply couldn't get there
because a huge wall was blocking
our way.
fields.JP:
いや、そもそも大きな壁に遮られていて、
それで辿りつけなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. We simply couldn't get there
because a huge wall was blocking
our way.

fields.EN:
The lower section is completely
separated, with a double-helix structure.
fields.JP:
ということは……あの監獄塔は、
下の方だけ完全に分離した
二重螺旋構造……なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So... that tower's inside is kinda
like a walled spiral?

fields.EN:
At the very least, we could tell
that the place is sectioned, and
that there are no Marchens at all.
fields.JP:
少なくとも私たちが調査した方の
監獄塔は、きっちり分断されていて
完全にメルヒェンの姿はなかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least, we could tell
that the place is sectioned, and
that there are no Marchens at all.

fields.EN:
Guess that means the Order can
call that place a home then.
fields.JP:
じゃあタイヨウ教団は
そこに住めそうだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess that means the Order can
call that place a home then.

fields.JP:
じゃあこれで
この件はひと段落って感じだね

fields.EN:
I'd like the three of you
to cooperate with our group.
fields.JP:
なあ親指、白雪、眠り。
相談なんだけど……よかったら３人とも、
僕たちに協力してくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Thumbelina, Snow White,
Sleepy... Why don't you three help
us for a bit?

fields.EN:
If we all work together, I'm sure
we can do a lot, just like finding
your safe haven.
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団の人たちの安全な場所を
見つけたように、力を合わせればもっと
色々なことができると思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we all work together, I'm sure
we can do a lot, just like finding
your safe haven.

fields.EN:
(...and we'll find the remaining
Blood Maidens, make the Jail
Tower grow...)
fields.JP:
（残りの血式少女を探して、
　監獄塔を伸ばす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...and we'll find the remaining
Blood Maidens, make the Jail
Tower grow...)

fields.JP: （そして、いつかはここから脱獄を……）

fields.EN:
We are a member of the Order
of the Sun, so we can't make
that call on our own.
fields.JP:
わたしたちはタイヨウ教団に
所属してるし、勝手には決められないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We are a member of the Order
of the Sun, so we can't make
that call on our own.

fields.EN:
Going round and round.
Getting lost and lost.
fields.JP: くるくる回ってぐるぐる迷子……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Going round and round.
Getting lost and lost.

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu... These three are
like lost kittens. They don't
know where they are.
fields.JP:
ねえ、おつう。この三姉妹はね、
まだ迷子で迷子の子猫ちゃんなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu... These three are
like lost kittens. They don't
know where they are.

fields.EN:
Do you mind caring for them?
I'm sure you'll help them find
their way back onto the road.
fields.JP:
だから導いてあげてくれる？
あなたなら、きっと迷子を連れ帰る抜け道を
見つけられると思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind caring for them?
I'm sure you'll help them find
their way back onto the road.

fields.EN:
So that means Oohime-san gave
them permission to stay, right...?
fields.JP:
でも、それ大陽女さんの
許可が出たってことだよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean she's going
to let them stay with us?

fields.EN:
Michiru can do some and not some.
Otsuu can do some and not some.
Simple, right?
fields.JP:
みちるにはできなくて、おつうには
できる……そういうものもあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru can do some and not some.
Otsuu can do some and not some.
Simple, right?

fields.EN:
I guess that means we're going
to be with Otsuu's group...
fields.JP:
なら……わたしたちはおつうたちと
一緒に行くわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that means we're going
to be with Otsuu's group...

fields.EN:
Well, bye-bye!
Come and visit any time.
fields.JP:
はーい行ってらっしゃーい。
いつ遊びに来てくれてもいいからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, bye-bye!
Come and visit any time.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki, Nemu...
What about you two?
fields.JP:
白雪、ネム。
あんたたちはどうする？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, Sleepy...
What about you two?

fields.EN:
S-Shirayuki will go with Otsuu-chan and the
others too!
fields.JP:
しっ、白雪もおつうちゃんたちと
一緒に行きますっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Snow White will stay with
them, too!

fields.EN:
I guess it's settled then.
I suppose we can spare some time
to help lend a hand.
fields.JP:
決まりね。じゃあおつう、
しょうがないから手伝ってあげるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it's settled then.
I suppose we can spare some time
to help lend a hand.

fields.JP: 相変わらず偉そうにしおって……！

fields.EN: Oh? So she's like you then?
fields.JP: まあ、ハーメルンにそっくり
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? So she's like you then?

fields.JP: いっ、一緒にするでにゃいわ！！

fields.EN:
We're not even going to call out
that you already stumbled over your words...
fields.JP:
もう噛んでることを
突っ込んでもあげないのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we're not even going to
bother how she slurred, are we?

fields.JP: じゃあ３人とも、これからよろしく！

fields.EN:
With more on board, I need to
do even more...
fields.JP:
親指たちも加わってくれたし、
これからもっと頑張らなくちゃな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With more on board, I need to
do even more...

fields.EN: Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to face Hansel.
fields.JP:
じゃないと、ヘンゼルに合わす
顔がないもんな、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we want to make
Hansel proud. Isn't that right,
Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Hm... Gretel was quite calm,
but I wonder if she's all right...
fields.JP:
そういえば昨日、グレーテルは
冷静だったけど……大丈夫かな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Gretel was quite calm,
but I wonder if she's all right...

fields.EN:
Looks like you've been on quite
a lucky streak lately! I'm moved!
fields.JP:
っと、もうこんな時間！
せっかく早く起きたのに、
急がないと遅刻する！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at the time!
Way to waste my morning hours.
We better hurry!

fields.EN:
Huh? A white haired person
is on a rampage?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? A white haired person
is on a rampage?

fields.EN:
Indeed!
My trusty familiar brought us
this highly important information!
fields.JP:
そうだ！　ワレの優秀な使い魔が仕入れた
極上の情報であるぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
My trusty familiar brought us
this highly important information!

fields.JP: さすがハーメルン、やるじゃん！
そうであろう、そうであろう！
もしかしたらおねーちゃんかも！！

fields.EN:
You may be right.
Knowing Akazukin,
I'm sure she's alive out there.
fields.JP:
そうだね、姫。赤ずきんの奴なら
絶対生きてるはずだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be right.
Knowing Red Riding Hood,
I'm sure she's alive out there.

fields.EN:
The white hair may signify that
this person is in Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
でも白い髪、なんでしょう？
ということはブラッドスケルター化
してる可能性があるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The white hair may signify that
this person is in Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
It's going to be quite risky if
that is Akazukin, and
if she is in Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
……仮にただでさえ強い赤ずきんが
ブラッドスケルター化していたら、
かなり危険なのは間違いないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's going to be quite risky if
that is Red Riding Hood, and
if she is in Blood Skelter...

fields.EN:
That won't stop you from going,
will it?
fields.JP: それでも、もちろん行くんですよね～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That won't stop you from going,
will it?

fields.EN:
Yes.
We need to meet up with her.
fields.JP:
ああ、行くさ。
赤ずきんなら何としても合流したい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes.
We need to meet up with her.

fields.EN:
To add, she is a Blood Maiden,
so having her on board is a must.
fields.JP:
そうでなくても、
血式少女なら押さえておきたいところだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, she is a Blood Maiden,
so having her on board is a must.

fields.EN:
Aka-nee might know a lot
more useful information too...
fields.JP:
確かに、赤姉ならもっと詳しく
色々な情報を知っているかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She could also have a bunch of
useful information, too.

fields.EN:
And, she's also all the Blood
Maiden's onee-chan!
fields.JP:
血式少女のわたしたち
みんなのおねーちゃんだもんね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, she's also all the Blood
Maiden's big sis!

fields.EN:
I would love to hear what she
knows about the Jail Tower.
fields.JP:
監獄塔についてもっと詳しい何かを
知ってるのなら、ぜひ聞きたいものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would love to hear what she
knows about the Jail Tower.

fields.EN:
Maybe she knows where
Alice went, too.
fields.JP:
あとはもうひとりの血式少女、
アリスの行方とかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she knows where
Alice went, too.

fields.EN: Yeah, Aka-nee should be able to do something.
fields.JP: うん、赤姉なら何とかしてくれそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose she'll be of help
more than anything.

fields.EN:
Urrh... This Akazukin...
She's not here, and yet she's
garnering this much attention?!
fields.JP:
むむっ……また赤ずきんとやらか！
いないのに、そこまで期待されるとは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... This Red Riding Hood...
She's not here, and yet she's
garnering this much attention?!

fields.JP: ぐぬぬ……我が生涯のライバルめ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr...!
She is, indeed, my rival to be!

fields.EN:
Uh, we're counting on you
too, Hameln-chan...
fields.JP:
ハーメルンちゃんにも
期待してるから……ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, we're counting on you
too, Hammy...

fields.EN:
Are you kidding? There's no
comparison between Aka-nee
and Hameln.
fields.JP:
何言ってんのよ、赤姉とハーメルンじゃ
天と地ほど差があるっての
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you kidding? There's no
comparison between Sister Red
and Hameln.

fields.EN:
Wha-?!
What did you say again?!
fields.JP:
なーっ！？
貴様言ってはならんことを言ったな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?!
What did you say again?!

fields.EN:
Oh, come on... Do we have to
go through this again?
fields.JP: おいおい、ケンカはやめろって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on... Do we have to
go through this again?

fields.EN:
She's right. Just drop it.
We need to go and find Onee-chan!
fields.JP:
そうだよ！　そんなことしてないで
早くおねーちゃん探しに行こうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Just drop it.
We need to go and find Sis!

fields.EN:
(Princess is really fired up since
it could be Akazukin.)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんかもとなったら、
　姫が俄然やる気だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Princess is really fired up since
it could be Red Riding Hood.)

fields.JP: じゅんびできたらしゅっぱつー！
ここが元繁華街エリア……ですか

fields.EN:
This is where this "white haired"
person is?
fields.JP:
このどこかにその『白い髪の人間』
とやらがいるんですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is where this "white haired"
person is?

fields.EN:
They say the one who lets their
guard down at times like this
is the one who gets attacked...
fields.JP:
気を抜くでないぞ貴様ら。
だいたいこういうのは油断した者が
襲われる決まりになって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't let your guard down.
You never know when something
will strike...

fields.EN:
I guess you let your guard
down, didn't you?
fields.JP: 油断した者が……何だったかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you let your guard
down, didn't you?

fields.EN:
I suppose. I doubt anyone besides
you could have avoided that
attack.
fields.JP:
でもハーメルンじゃなかったら
いきなりの奇襲を防げたかどうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose. I doubt anyone besides
you could have avoided that
attack.

fields.EN: So you were the white-haired human...!
fields.JP: 白い髪の人間って、君だったのか……！

fields.EN:
I thought it was Akazukin-san,
but...
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさんかと思ったら……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought it was Red Riding Hood,
but...

fields.JP: 生きて……いらしゃったんですね……！

で、でもその姿は
どういうことなの……！？

fields.EN:
She looks no different from
back when she went missing!
fields.JP:
最後に見た時と同じ……
幼いままだなんて……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She looks no different from
back when she went missing!

fields.JP: いったいどういうことなんだ……！？
そんなこと、どうだっていいわよ

fields.EN:
I finally found you...
I need to avenge Chii...!
fields.JP: やっと見つけた……ちーの仇……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I finally found you...
I need to avenge Chii...!

fields.EN:
Hitsuka-san was our vice leader.
The three sisters looked up to
him like an older brother.
fields.JP:
陽司さん……タイヨウ教団の副教祖で、
三姉妹が兄のように慕っていた人だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's Hitsuka... He was second in
command at the Order. He treated
the sisters like real siblings.

fields.EN:
I see.
You're referring to the person
Cinderella killed.
fields.JP:
ああ……前に言ってたシンデレラに
殺されたという人間ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see.
You're referring to the person
Cinderella killed.

fields.EN: I don't want to believe that's a fact.
fields.JP: それが事実だなんて信じたくないけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still don't believe that's
true, though...

fields.EN:
You know this Blood
Skelter state is dangerous.
fields.JP:
貴様ら、気を抜くでない！
この状態が危険なのは知ってるであろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep your guard up!
We're in serious trouble here!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……み、んな……
ぼぐの……う……じろ……に……

fields.EN:
Let's be careful...
If you get injured, go behind
Jack for cover.
fields.JP:
慎重に対処しよう、みんな……
もしも傷を負ったらジャックの後ろに
退避するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's be careful...
If you get injured, go behind
Jack for cover.

fields.JP: なんてデタラメな速さですか……！

fields.EN:
Blood Skelter can be quite a
nuisance...
fields.JP: やはりブラッドスケルター状態は厄介ね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Skelter can be quite a
nuisance...

fields.EN: Did you kill Chii while laughing like that?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ！！　ちーのことも
そうやって笑いながら殺したのか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella! You must have killed
Chii all the while laughing
like that!

fields.EN:
Oyayubi, I know how you
feel, but you need to calm down!
fields.JP: 親指、気持ちは分かるけど落ち着け！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina, I know how you
feel, but you need to calm down!

fields.EN: I'm gonna tear her to shreds!
fields.JP: バラバラにしてぶっ殺してやるっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm gonna tear her to shreds!

fields.JP: 馬鹿者！　無闇に突っ込むでない！！

fields.EN:
Damn it! Let's go and cover
Oyayubi!
fields.JP:
仕方ない！　みんな、
親指をフォローするぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it! Let's go and cover
Thumbelina!

fields.EN:
I knew it would be a pain
facing someone
in Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
さすがにこの状態の者を
相手にするのは……骨が折れるな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it would be a pain
facing someone
in Blood Skelter...

fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
殺して…………やる……

fields.EN:
Oyayubi, move back and rest.
You need to calm yourself.
fields.JP:
親指、ちょっと下がって休むんだ。
そして気持ちを落ち着けてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina, move back and rest.
You need to calm yourself.

fields.EN:
Princess! Cinderella isn't moving
as quickly now! Go and get Jack's
blood!
fields.JP:
姫、シンデレラの動きが鈍った
今のうちにジャックの血を頼む！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess! Cinderella isn't moving
as quickly now! Go and get Jack's
blood!

fields.EN: Jack-san, let me borrow some of your blood!
fields.JP: ジャックさん、少し血をお借りします！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry! I'll borrow some
of your blood, Jack!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Good! Her hair and eyes
are back to normal!
fields.JP: よし！　髪の色も瞳の色も戻ったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good! Her hair and eyes
are back to normal!

fields.JP: さすがねジャックの血は
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still surprised with how
well Jack's blood works...

fields.JP:
シンデレラ……
よかった、戻ってくれた……
どうして、わたしこんなところに……

fields.EN:
Your question isn't surprising
considering you were in Blood
Skelter for a long while.
fields.JP:
……ずっとブラッドスケルター化
していたのなら、当然こうなるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your question isn't surprising
considering you were in Blood
Skelter for a long while.

fields.JP:
うぅ……今までいったい何が
起きていたっていうの……？

fields.EN:
It feels like a very long time has
passed, and I don't understand anything.
fields.JP:
なんだかすごく長い時間が経ったような……
何も、分かりませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels like I was out forever...
I don't remember anything...

fields.JP:
シンデレラ。
僕だよ、つうだよ

つう……あのおつう……？
え……でも……

fields.EN:
I suppose you're still confused,
and your mind muddled.
Do you know me?
fields.JP:
ずっとこの状態だったから
記憶が混乱しているのかもしれませんね。
わらわのことは分かりますか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're still confused,
and your mind muddled.
Do you know me?

fields.EN:
K-Kaguya?
B-But the Kaguya I know was
still a little girl...
fields.JP:
か、かぐや……？
で、でもわたしの知ってる
かぐやはもっと幼くて…
fields.LOCALIZED:
K-Kaguya?
B-But the Kaguya I know was
still a little girl...

fields.JP: じゃあ白雪のことは分かりますか？

fields.EN:
Shirayuki?
But... you were small, too.
fields.JP:
白雪……？
でも、でも……。
こ、こんな大人じゃありませんでしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White?
But... you were small, too.

fields.EN:
It doesn't seem like her memories
have faded.
fields.JP: 忘れている、というわけではないみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't seem like her memories
have faded.

fields.EN:
Everyone you see here was
with you back at Dawn.
fields.JP:
分かるかい？　
ここにいるのはシンデレラと黎明で
一緒に過ごした仲間だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone you see here was
with you back at Dawn.

fields.EN:
Otsuu, Ningyohime, Kaguya,
Nemu, Shirayuki...
I do remember you all, but...
fields.JP:
おつう、人魚姫、かぐや、ネム、白雪……
ええ、なんとなく分かる……でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, Little Mermaid, Kaguya,
Sleepy, Snow White...
I do remember you all, but...

fields.EN: Everyone is different from the people I knew.
fields.JP:
わたしが知っているみんなと違う…！
いったい、何がありましたの……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something isn't right...
What is happening here...?

fields.EN:
Everyone, you need to slow down.
It's obvious that your information
is merely confusing her.
fields.JP:
みんな、ちょっと待ちなさい。
混乱してる者にみんなで話しかけても
余計に混乱させるだけだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, you need to slow down.
It's obvious that your information
is merely confusing her.

fields.EN:
Let me see...
So, do you know what your
name is?
fields.JP:
……仕方ないわね。
ねえあなた、自分の名前は分かる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me see...
So, do you know what your
name is?

fields.EN:
Do you think I'm stupid?
I know my own name.
It's "Cinderella."
fields.JP:
ば、バカにしないで下さるかしら。
自分の名前がシンデレラだってことくらい、
当たり前に分かってますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think I'm stupid?
I know my own name.
It's "Cinderella."

fields.EN:
Shouldn't you be telling me
your name before you ask?
fields.JP:
そういうあなたこそ
名前を名乗るべきですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shouldn't you be telling me
your name before you ask?

fields.EN:
Well, nice to meet you.
The name is Gretel.
Now... the next question.
fields.JP:
初めまして、私はグレーテル。
じゃあ次の質問に移るわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, nice to meet you.
The name is Gretel.
Now... the next question.

fields.EN:
Cinderella, what is the last
thing you remember?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、あなたの覚えてる中で
最後の記憶はいったい何かしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, what is the last
thing you remember?

fields.EN: It's no use asking her that.
fields.JP: そんなこと、いくら聞いたって無駄よ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's no use asking her that.

fields.EN:
She'll tell whatever convenient
lies she needs to survive.
fields.JP:
だってこいつは自分が生き延びるために、
どうせ都合のいい嘘をつくはずだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's only going to lie to you
so that she can get away.

fields.EN:
We should end her life here,
now!
fields.JP:
だから今すぐ
こいつの息の根を止めるべきよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should end her life here,
now!

fields.JP:
何を言ってるのか
分かりませんわ、親指姫……
まだしらばっくれる気！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't you try to get away!

fields.EN: Why did you kill Chii? Spit it out!
fields.JP: どうしてちーを殺した！　吐け！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did you kill Chii?!
Why?!

fields.JP:
殺す……？　何、それ……っ
意味が……分かりま、せんわ……

fields.EN: Still playing dumb? Then die like this.
fields.JP:
まだとぼけるか……！
ならこのまま死ね……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This again?!
I'm gonna kill you!

fields.EN:
I have no clue... what you're...
Please... Can't... breathe...
fields.JP:
何のこと……かさっぱり……ですわ……
お願い、やめてっ……！　息が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no clue... what you're...
Please... Can't... breathe...

fields.EN:
Let me go, Otsuu!
Let me go!
fields.JP: 放せおつう！　放せぇぇぇぇぇっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me go, Otsuu!
Let me go!

fields.JP: ぐすっ……ひどいですわ、親指姫……
待てシンデレラ！　待ちやがれぇぇっ！！

fields.EN:
I understand you want to avenge
Chii, but you should at least
hear her out.
fields.JP:
仇を討ちたいっていう気持ちは分かるよ。
でも話を聞いてからでもいいだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand you want to avenge
Chii, but you should at least
hear her out.

fields.EN:
She just got out of Blood Skelter.
You could at least let her get
back to her senses first.
fields.JP:
特に今はブラッドスケルター状態が
解けたばかりで混乱してるんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She just got out of Blood Skelter.
You could at least let her get
back to her senses first.

fields.EN:
Yeah. Let's hear the truth from Cinderella-san
herself, okay?
fields.JP:
うん。ちゃんと真相を
シンデレラさんの口から聞こう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I think it's best to hear
what she has to say.

fields.EN:
I second that. I'm sure you can
mete vengeance after hearing
what she has to say.
fields.JP:
復讐をするにしても、きっと
話を聞いてからの方がいいわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I second that. I'm sure you can
mete vengeance after hearing
what she has to say.

fields.EN:
I'll force her to talk, and when
that's done, then I'll kill her.
fields.JP:
真実をシンデレラの口から吐かせて、
その上できっちり殺してやるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll force her to talk, and when
that's done, then I'll kill her.

fields.EN:
I don't want her killed, but we
can't persuade her any further right now.
fields.JP:
（殺させたくなんかないけど……
　今はこれ以上言い聞かせるのは
　無理だろうな……）

fields.EN:
Otsuu, shouldn't we go after
Cinderella? We're going to
lose her.
fields.JP:
シンデレラとやらを追うなら
早くした方がいいのではないか、おつう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, shouldn't we go after
Cinderella? We're going to
lose her.

fields.JP:
……そうだな。
とにかく今は先に進もう

fields.EN:
(There are too many unknowns...
We need to know the truth...)
fields.JP:
（色々と分からないことだらけだし、
　とにかく真実を知らないとな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There are too many unknowns...
We need to know the truth...)

fields.EN:
A pendant with a glass slipper
trinket? Is this Cinderella's?
fields.JP:
ガラスの靴のペンダント……
これは……シンデレラの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A pendant with a glass slipper
trinket? Is this Cinderella's?

fields.JP: どうやら落としていったみたいですね

fields.EN:
You're probably right.
I'll hold onto this, just in case.
fields.JP:
そうみたいだね。
とりあえずこのペンダントは
僕が持っておくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're probably right.
I'll hold onto this, just in case.

fields.EN: Where did Cinderella-san run off to?
fields.JP:
シンデレラさん、いったいどこまで
行っちゃったんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED: Where did Cinderella run off to?

fields.EN:
She was so flustered that she probably
ran off without any destination in mind.
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと混乱していたようだから
当てもなく、って感じでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how flustered she was,
I can only assume she wouldn't
be too far away.

fields.EN:
Cinderella-san is back to normal now.
She could hardly mow down Marchens like this.
fields.JP:
それはまずくないですか……？
今のシンデレラさんは普通の状態、
メルヒェンを蹴散らせるとはとても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not good. Cinderella may
be able to fight Marchens,
but with how she is now...

fields.EN:
Yeah... She's at risk out here.
We need to find her quick.
fields.JP:
うん。一刻も早く
合流しないと危ないだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... She's at risk out here.
We need to find her quick.

fields.JP: あっ！　シンデレラさん！

fields.EN:
We were looking for you!
It's dangerous to be alone, so...
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、探したよ！
１人でいると危ない、だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were looking for you!
It's dangerous to be alone, so...

fields.EN: You're not getting away this time!
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not getting away this time!

fields.EN:
I'm gonna force you to talk,
and then I'll kill you!
fields.JP:
すべて吐かせて、
その上で殺してやる！　覚悟しろ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna force you to talk,
and then I'll kill you!

fields.JP:
なっ……！
反撃してきた……！？

fields.EN:
You were crying until
just now... What is this?
fields.JP:
くっ……！　さっきまで泣いてたくせに、
何なのよいったい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch!
So, all that crying was just
a front, wasn't it?!

fields.JP: そうか、それがお前の本性ってわけ！？

fields.EN:
Put your weapons down,
both of you!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Put your weapons down,
both of you!

fields.EN:
Otsuu, I doubt your words will
reach them.
fields.JP:
おつう、あの雰囲気は
言葉で収められるものではないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, I doubt your words will
reach them.

fields.EN:
Right. I think it'd be wiser for all of us to
step in and stop them before one of them dies.
fields.JP:
そうね、どちらかが死ぬ前に
みんなで止めに入った方が賢明だと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
May I suggest we intervene
physically? I doubt words will
save them from imminent death.

fields.EN:
You're right. Let's try and stop
them without injuring them
too badly!
fields.JP:
そうだな……みんな、
なるべく怪我させないように止めるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. Let's try and stop
them without injuring them
too badly!

fields.EN:
Finally...
Things are a bit quieter now.
fields.JP:
よし、ようやく
おとなしくなってくれたか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally...
Things are a bit quieter now.

fields.EN:
She resisted quite well despite
not being in Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化してないのに
なかなかの抵抗だったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She resisted quite well despite
not being in Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
Now then...
You're going to talk, now!
fields.JP:
さあ観念しろ……
今度こそ吐いてもらう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then...
You're going to talk, now!

fields.JP: なっ！？　また逃げおった！！
シンデレラさん行かないで！

fields.EN:
Why would Cinderella-san
run like that?
fields.JP:
どうして逃げるんですか……
シンデレラさん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why would Cinderella
run like that?

fields.EN:
There's no reason to run
if she didn't do anything...
fields.JP:
何もしていないと言うなら、
逃げる必要はないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no reason to run
if she didn't do anything...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎぎ……
おいがげ……んぎぃ……る……？

fields.EN:
No, I think we better go after
her after we rest ourselves a bit.
fields.JP:
いや、追いかけずに
みんなのコンディションを
整えてからにしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I think we better go after
her after we rest ourselves a bit.

fields.EN:
Hm, something about Cinderella
wasn't quite right...
fields.JP:
でも今のシンデレラ……
何か様子が変じゃなかったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, something about Cinderella
wasn't quite right...

fields.EN:
Yes, I can't believe that's the
same person who was bawling
earlier.
fields.JP:
そうですね……さっきまで
泣いてた人の振る舞いとは思えません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I can't believe that's the
same person who was bawling
earlier.

fields.EN:
Maybe she's so unstable that
she's acting randomly now?
fields.JP:
精神的に追い詰められて、
それでああなってしまった、とか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she's so unstable that
she's acting randomly now?

fields.EN:
What do you think, Oyayubi?
Something about her felt off...
fields.JP:
なあ、親指も今のシンデレラは
おかしかったと思わないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you think, Thumbelina?
Something about her felt off...

fields.EN:
There's obvious murderous intent
in her eyes—not a trace of hesitation.
fields.JP:
あいつ今……明らかに殺意があった。
瞳の中にためらいの感情なんて
微塵も見えなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could tell she wanted to
kill us... I could see it in her
eyes...

fields.JP: そんな、何かの間違いじゃ……！

fields.EN:
I need to kill her...
I can't let what happened to Chii
happen to others...
fields.JP:
絶対に殺さなきゃ……これ以上
ちーと同じ犠牲者を出しちゃいけない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to kill her...
I can't let what happened to Chii
happen to others...

fields.JP:
（そもそも、シンデレラと陽司さんの間で
　何かあったのか……？）

fields.EN:
(Did something happen between them that could
make people think Cinderella might even kill
Hitsuka-san...?)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラが陽司さんを殺しても
　おかしくないと思われてしまいそうな
　何かが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did something happen between
them that instigated Cinderella
to the point of killing him?)

fields.EN:
Can I assume the concept of
capturing Cinderella for the
sake of interrogation is ongoing?
fields.JP:
それで、シンデレラを捕まえて
話を聞くというのは続行でいいのよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can I assume the concept of
capturing Cinderella for the
sake of interrogation is ongoing?

fields.EN:
Of course.
At least I can vouch on
the capturing part.
fields.JP:
続行でいいわ。
捕まえるという点に関してはね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course.
At least I can vouch on
the capturing part.

fields.EN: After that, I'll handle it properly.
fields.JP:
そこからはわたしが
上手くやるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
After that, what I do with her
is of my own.

fields.JP: （その先を聞きたくない台詞だな……）

fields.EN:
Let's keep going.
Regardless of our motive, we
can't leave her alone out here.
fields.JP:
ともかく、先に進もう。
何であれ１人のシンデレラを
放置するのは危険だからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's keep going.
Regardless of our motive, we
can't leave her alone out here.

fields.EN: Where did Cinderella run off to?
fields.JP: シンデレラの奴、どこに行った……
fields.LOCALIZED: Where did Cinderella run off to?

fields.EN:
I won't let her get away...
I'll make her pay...
fields.JP:
今度こそ絶対に逃がさない……
絶対、思い知らせてやる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't let her get away...
I'll make her pay...

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime, why did that girl
earlier kill this "Chii" person?
fields.JP:
なあ白雪姫よ。
そもそも先ほどのおなごは何故
ちーという奴を殺したのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, why did that girl
earlier kill this "Chii" person?

fields.JP: そそ、それはですね、ええと……

fields.EN:
I lack any insight, so anything
you can provide is appreciated.
fields.JP:
何か知ってるのなら教えてくれぬか？
ワレにはよく分からなすぎてな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I lack any insight, so anything
you can provide is appreciated.

fields.EN:
To be specific, Shirayuki doesn't
really know...
fields.JP:
白雪は答えを持ち合わせては
いない、と言いますか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be specific, Snow White doesn't
really know...

fields.EN:
Cinderella was scared of Chii.
She tried to avoid him whenever
possible.
fields.JP:
シンデレラの奴は
ちーのことを怖がっていたわ。
あまり近づこうともしなかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella was scared of Chii.
She tried to avoid him whenever
possible.

fields.EN:
I bet that has something to do
with what she did.
fields.JP:
だからきっと、
それがキッカケだったんだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet that has something to do
with what she did.

fields.EN:
She was scared so she killed
him? Uh, okay... I don't get it.
fields.JP:
怖がっていたから殺したのか？
なるほど……いや、分からぬぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was scared so she killed
him? Uh, okay... I don't get it.

fields.EN:
Wait a moment. I heard how
Cinderella-san was scared of Hitsuka-san,
but...
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って。シンデレラさんが
陽司さんを怖がっていたという件は、
わたしも聞いたことがあるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a moment. I heard how
Cinderella was scared of Hitsuka,
but...

fields.EN:
I recall that was only because
Hitsuka-san kept pestering her about
the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
でもそれは、
単に陽司さんに血式少女について
色々質問されただけって話だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I recall that was only because
Hitsuka kept pestering her about
the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Besides, he asked both me and Otsuu-chan
those questions too, you know?
fields.JP:
それに、その質問は
わたしもおつうちゃんもされたよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be frank, he asked us questions
about the Blood Maidens, too.

fields.EN:
