fields.JP: まったく……あんた達は相変わらずね
おつうとにんぎょラブラブー

fields.EN:
Whatever. It's good to see it's
fixed now.
fields.JP: ま、なんにしても直ってよかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever. It's good to see it's
fixed now.

fields.JP:
にんぎょげんきになった！
よかったー！

fields.EN:
It couldn't have been fixed
without everyone's help...
Thank you!
fields.JP:
これもみんなのおかげ……
本当にありがとう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It couldn't have been fixed
without everyone's help...
Thank you!

fields.EN:
If only there was a way to repay
you all...
fields.JP: なにかお礼ができるといいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only there was a way to repay
you all...

fields.JP: 別にお礼なんていいわよ

fields.EN: Ooh! I wanna hear Ningyo sing!
fields.JP: じゃあ、にんぎょの歌が聞きたい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ooh! I wanna hear Fishy sing!

fields.EN: I guess that's not a bad idea.
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess that's not a bad idea.

fields.EN:
That would be nice. To add, you'd
be able to check the mic to ensure
it actually works.
fields.JP:
そうね、わたしもいい考えだと思うわ
ちゃんと直ったかどうかテストも
しなくちゃいけないんだし、一石二鳥ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would be nice. To add, you'd
be able to check the mic to ensure
it actually works.

fields.EN:
Please, we ask that you sing for
us as payment for our labor.
fields.JP:
姫の笑顔のために働いた我々に、
どうか、その歌声をお聞かせください
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, we ask that you sing for
us as payment for our labor.

fields.EN:
Um, okay...
This is embarrassing, but...
I'll do my best!
fields.JP:
う、うん……
ちょっと恥ずかしいけど、がんばるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, okay...
This is embarrassing, but...
I'll do my best!

fields.EN:
(Her singing is so relaxing to
hear... Hm? It looks like the
recording feature is on...)
fields.JP:
（姫の歌はいつ聞いても癒されるね。
　……あれ？　姫のマイク『録音』って
　書いてる部分、光ってないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her singing is so relaxing to
hear... Hm? It looks like the
recording feature is on...)

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, I think
she left the switch on...)
fields.JP:
（そういえば、さっきスイッチ入れて
　そのままのような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, I think
she left the switch on...)

fields.EN:
(Oh well...
No need to bother her singing...)
fields.JP:
（……まぁいいか。
　水を差すのもなんだしね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh well...
No need to bother her singing...)

fields.JP: とってもすてきだったわ

fields.EN:
I can't find the right words for
it, but your song had a touch of
sadness to it...
fields.JP:
上手く言えないけど、
なんだかすごく切ない歌……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't find the right words for
it, but your song had a touch of
sadness to it...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……いまの……
……うだ……もっど……ぎぎだい……

fields.EN:
Heh, looks like Jack liked
your singing, too.
fields.JP:
はは、ジャックも
とても気に入ったみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, looks like Jack liked
your singing, too.

fields.EN:
Mmm! So marvelous!
I can see why Otsuu-chan wanted to
hear you sing so desperately!
fields.JP:
きゃー！　す・て・き！
おつうちゃんがハマるのも分かるわー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm! So marvelous!
I can see why Otsuu wanted to
hear you sing so desperately!

fields.EN:
Th-That was amazing!
You're way better than Shirayuki!
fields.JP:
す、すごいです！
白雪なんかと比べ物にならないくらい
綺麗な歌でした！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That was amazing!
You're way better than Snow White!

fields.EN:
Well done, Ningyohime!
I wouldn't have minded hearing
you sing the entire day!
fields.JP:
さすが人魚姫だな！
ずっと聞いていたいくらいだったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well done, Little Mermaid!
I wouldn't have minded hearing
you sing the entire day!

fields.EN:
Princess, your voice is the
greatest in the world.
fields.JP: やはり姫の歌は世界一ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, your voice is the
greatest in the world.

fields.EN:
Urrh... Th-Thank you, but...
This is so embarrassing...
fields.JP: うぅ……うれしいけど恥ずかしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... Th-Thank you, but...
This is so embarrassing...

fields.EN:
(Yes, Princess's smile is truly
befitting of her.)
fields.JP: （ああ、やっぱり姫には笑顔が一番だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yes, Princess's smile is truly
befitting of her.)

fields.EN:
We're finally going to do a full
search of the tower...
fields.JP: ついに監獄塔の探索だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're finally going to do a full
search of the tower...

fields.EN:
I better get myself prepared
real well...
fields.JP:
これまで以上に気合いを
入れていかなきゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better get myself prepared
real well...

fields.EN:
Good morning, Otsuu-chan.
Did you finish changing?
fields.JP:
おはようおつうちゃーん、
着替え終わったー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning, Otsuu.
Did you change your clothes
already?

fields.EN:
Good morning, Princess.
I just finished.
fields.JP:
おはよう、姫。
うん、ちょうど終わったところだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning, Princess.
I just finished.

fields.EN:
I thought I'd finally get to see you panic
today, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
今日こそは慌てふためくおつうちゃんを
見られるかと思ったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I was going to be able
to see you get all flustered.

fields.EN:
Heh... Do you really think
a prince would do that in front
of his princess?
fields.JP:
ふふ、王子たる僕が
そんな場面を姫に見せるわけないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Do you really think
a prince would do that in front
of his princess?

fields.EN:
I'm pretty sure I saw you like
that before.
fields.JP: 少し前に見た気がするけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm pretty sure I saw you like
that before.

fields.EN:
Uh... That was only because you
caught me off guard.
fields.JP: うっ……あれは突然のことで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... That was only because you
caught me off guard.

fields.JP:
あはは、おつうちゃん意外と
照れ屋さんだよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh!
Look at you blush!

fields.JP: も、もうっ、からかわないでくれ姫！

うふふふっ……あっ
そういえば
姫？　どうかしたのかい？

fields.EN:
I took a look at the Jail Tower
and noticed that the top was
close to the surface.
fields.JP:
さっき監獄塔をふと見たら、
先端がもう地上近くまで伸びてるんだなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I took a look at the Jail Tower
and noticed that the top was
close to the surface.

fields.EN:
I guess we actually do have
a chance of escaping from here.
fields.JP:
このまま上手くいけば、
本当にジェイルから脱獄できるかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we actually do have
a chance of escaping from here.

fields.EN:
Which means that whatever we
face may be the last we'll have
to overcome...
fields.JP:
……ひょっとしたら、
これが最後の戦いになるかもしれないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that whatever we
face may be the last we'll have
to overcome...

fields.EN:
I can only hope so.
Just the thought of leaving here
is great, but...
fields.JP:
うん、そうであってほしいね。
でもここから脱獄することも嬉しいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope so.
Just the thought of leaving here
is great, but...

fields.EN:
...all I need is you to be with
me. That alone brings great joy
beyond anything.
fields.JP:
今も昔も、僕には姫が
そばにいてくれるだけでいいんだ。
それで充分、嬉しいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...all I need is you to be with
me. That alone brings great joy
beyond anything.

fields.EN:
So, I will promise you again
that I will protect you, my
dear princess.
fields.JP:
だからこれからも僕が
しっかりとお守り致しますよ、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I will promise you again
that I will protect you, my
dear princess.

fields.EN:
Yup... Thank you...
I can't be happier...
fields.JP:
うん……ありがとう……
とっても嬉しい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... Thank you...
I can't be happier...

fields.JP: ……そういえばジャックさんは？

fields.EN:
Ah, well it looks like he's
taken a liking to staying in
Alice's room.
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックなら
すっかりアリスの部屋に馴染んでるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, well it looks like he's
taken a liking to staying in
Alice's room.

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、ちょっと寂しい？

fields.EN:
Well, I'd be lying if I said no.
After all, he's been here all
this time.
fields.JP:
ここに来てからずっと一緒だったからね、
寂しくないと言えば嘘になるかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'd be lying if I said no.
After all, he's been here all
this time.

fields.EN:
But, this is Jack's desire.
I'm happy that he's with Alice
now.
fields.JP:
でもジャックの望みだからね。
アリスと一緒にいられるようになってよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, this is Jack's desire.
I'm happy that he's with Alice
now.

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, I wonder
if he's still seeing his
nightmares...)
fields.JP:
（そういえば……アリスに出会えたし、
　悪夢はもう見てないのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, I wonder
if he's still seeing his
nightmares...)

fields.EN:
Yeah. I'm glad Jack-san and Alice-san were
able to reunite with each other...
fields.JP:
そうだね、ジャックさんもアリスさんも
お互い再会できてよかったよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm happy that they were
able to meet again, too.

fields.EN:
You can tell how happy they
are being together.
fields.JP: お互いにすごく喜んでるもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can tell how happy they
are being together.

fields.EN:
But, I am a bit worried that
they're too close to each other.
fields.JP:
ただ……あの二人の結びつきは強すぎて、
正直、少し心配だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I am a bit worried that
they're too close to each other.

fields.EN:
If one is lost, the other will
lose their will to live.
fields.JP:
どちらかが欠けてしまったら、
もう片方も生きてはいられない
fields.LOCALIZED:
If one is lost, the other will
lose their will to live.

fields.EN:
Even if they don't take their own
lives, the one left behind will
just be a hollow of themselves.
fields.JP:
たとえ生きていたとしても、
それはもう以前のジャックや
アリスではなくなっている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if they don't take their own
lives, the one left behind will
just be a hollow of themselves.

fields.EN:
At least that's how it feels like
looking at them...
fields.JP: そんな危うさを感じるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least that's how it feels like
looking at them...

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry.
I wasn't trying to cause any
problems here.
fields.JP:
す、すまない。
姫を不安にさせるつもりはなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry.
I wasn't trying to cause any
problems here.

fields.JP: きっと僕の考えすぎだね。

fields.EN:
(What about me? If I'm worried
about them, what about me and
Princess?)
fields.JP:
（じゃあ僕は……？
　ジャックやアリスの愛情の強さに
　驚いている僕の、姫への想いは？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What about me? If I'm worried
about them, what about me and
Princess?)

fields.EN:
(No... I'm just thinking too much.
Nothing will change our
relationship...)
fields.JP:
（いや、そんなことない……
　僕だって姫への気持ちは誰にも……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... I'm just thinking too much.
Nothing will change our
relationship...)

fields.JP: い、いや、なんでもないよ姫

fields.EN:
You're not good at hiding things.
You do know that right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
……おつうちゃんってば、
隠しごとが下手なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not good at hiding things.
You do know that right, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
I bet you thought we were similar
to Jack-san and Alice. Or, maybe
comparing ourselves to them.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんたちに
自分を重ねてるでしょう？
敵わないって思ってるでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet you thought we were similar
to Jack and Alice. Or, maybe
comparing ourselves to them.

fields.EN:
You may not realize it, Otsuu-chan, but you
care about me just as much as those two care
about each other, you know?
fields.JP:
気づいてないかもしれないけど、
あの二人と同じくらい、おつうちゃんも
わたしのこと、大事にしてくれてるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may not notice it, but you're
treating me no different
than how they treat each other.

fields.EN:
But you know what?
Try not to do something brash
like what Jack-san did, you hear?
fields.JP:
だからね……？
あの時のジャックさんのように
無茶したりしないでね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you know what?
Try not to do something brash
like what Jack did, you hear?

fields.EN:
Do you really think that I'm
fit to be your prince?
fields.JP:
そう、かな……
僕は姫の王子様として相応しいかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you really think that I'm
fit to be your prince?

fields.EN:
Yup! I've received your feelings loud and
clear, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
うんっ。おつうちゃんの想い、
ちゃーんと受け取ってますっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, I really think you're
my prince!

fields.EN:
I see... It's good to know that
my feelings are getting through
to you...
fields.JP:
そっか……そうだったんだね。
僕の気持ちは、ちゃんとまっすぐに
姫に届いてるんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... It's good to know that
my feelings are getting through
to you...

fields.EN:
Oh, don't thank me.
I'm the one who should be
giving thanks.
fields.JP:
ううん、お礼なんて言わないで。
それはわたしの台詞だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, don't thank me.
I'm the one who should be
giving thanks.

fields.EN:
Your feelings, Otsuu-chan... and Jack-san's,
and everyone else's too...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんの想い……
それにジャックさんたち、
他のみんなもそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your feelings towards me,
and Jack's feelings,
and everyone's feelings...

fields.EN:
They each have their own form, but
if everyone's feelings brings them
happiness, it makes me happy, too.
fields.JP:
それぞれ形はいびつかもしれないけど、
みんなが自分を幸せに思ってるなら、
それがわたしの幸せなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They each have their own form, but
if everyone's feelings brings them
happiness, it makes me happy, too.

fields.EN:
I guess that means everyone will
have to become happier than they
are now.
fields.JP:
じゃあみんな今以上に幸せに
ならないといけないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that means everyone will
have to become happier than they
are now.

fields.EN:
(If everyone's happiness brings
joy to Princess, then I must make
sure we all escape from here!)
fields.JP:
（みんなの幸せが姫の幸せだって言うなら、
　絶対に脱獄しないとな……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If everyone's happiness brings
joy to Princess, then I must make
sure we all escape from here!)

fields.EN:
Looks like we're all here.
Let's begin.
fields.JP:
よし、全員揃ったな。
じゃあ始めようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we're all here.
Let's begin.

fields.EN:
As everyone knows, we're going
to be searching the Jail Tower.
fields.JP:
次の探索は、みんなも分かってるとおり
監獄塔内部の調査だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As everyone knows, we're going
to be searching the Jail Tower.

fields.EN:
So, we're finally going to
scour that place...
fields.JP: いよいよ監獄塔に乗り込むのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we're finally going to
scour that place...

fields.EN: Not that we have much choice now.
fields.JP: 残すところは、ってやつですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Not that we have much choice now.

fields.EN:
I-I guess we really, really need
to be careful.
fields.JP:
さ、さすがに今まで以上に
気を引きしめないといけませんよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I guess we really, really need
to be careful.

fields.EN:
There is nothing to fear,
Shirayukihime! Victory shall be ours
as it has been thus far!
fields.JP:
恐れることはないぞ、白雪姫。
ここまで勝ち抜いてきたワレらだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is nothing to fear, Snow
White! Victory shall be ours
as it has been thus far!

fields.EN:
Unlike you, Shirayuki is a bit
more grounded.
fields.JP:
ウチの白雪はあんたと違って
繊細なのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unlike you, Snow White is a bit
more grounded.

fields.EN:
But, she does have a point.
It is true that we've made it
through everything thrown at us.
fields.JP:
でもイイコト言ってる。
ここまでみんな勝ち抜いてきたってのは
揺るがない事実だしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she does have a point.
It is true that we've made it
through everything thrown at us.

fields.EN:
Yup, we came this far, so I'm sure
everything will be all right,
Shirayuki-chan.
fields.JP:
うん。みんなでここまで来た。
大丈夫だよ、白雪ちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, we came this far, so I'm sure
everything will be all right,
Snow White.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel not scared with
everyone here!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、みんなといっしょなら
こわくなんてないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel not scared with
everyone here!

fields.EN:
I-I suppose you're right...
We did make it this far...
I'm sure we'll be all right!
fields.JP:
そ……そうですよね。
みんなで乗り越えてきたんですもんね。
今度だって大丈夫ですよね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I suppose you're right...
We did make it this far...
I'm sure we'll be all right!

fields.EN:
Yup... Yup...! With
everyone... I'll be okay...!
fields.JP:
うんっ、うんっ……！
みんな……となら……大丈夫……！

fields.EN:
Now, if the tower has grown as
high as we think, we may be able
to escape from here.
fields.JP:
それで、だ。
もしも監獄塔が上まで伸びきっていたら、
今回で脱獄できるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, if the tower has grown as
high as we think, we may be able
to escape from here.

fields.EN:
Of course, we won't leave anyone
behind even if we can escape.
fields.JP:
でももちろん、脱獄できるとしても
ここに残るみんなを置いていくってわけじゃ
ないから安心してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, we won't leave anyone
behind even if we can escape.

fields.EN: C'mon, not like we'd doubt you.
fields.JP: 今さらお前らを疑ったりするかよ
fields.LOCALIZED: C'mon, not like we'd doubt you.

fields.EN:
We'll secure an escape route
once we find the way out.
fields.JP:
脱獄できる場合は、
脱出ルートを確保した後に
みんなを誘導するから
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll secure an escape route
once we find the way out.

fields.EN:
Wait a second...
About the Order of the Sun...
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って、あのさ、
タイヨウ教団のみんなも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a second...
About the Order of the Sun...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. We'll make sure
they will all escape with us, too.
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ親指。脱獄する時は、
僕たちが把握している人々は全員連れて行く
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. We'll make sure
they will all escape with us, too.

fields.EN:
Might I remind you there's
something left unanswered.
fields.JP:
でもその前に考えなければ
いけないことがあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Might I remind you there's
something left unanswered.

fields.EN:
Yes, we should assume that
Nightmare is somewhere inside
the tower.
fields.JP:
ええ。監獄塔にあのナイトメアが
いないとも限らない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we should assume that
Nightmare is somewhere inside
the tower.

fields.EN:
Not to worry. All we have to do
is kill it, then make our escape.
fields.JP:
大丈夫さ。むしろぶっ殺して
堂々と脱獄してやればいいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to worry. All we have to do
is kill it, then make our escape.

fields.EN:
I agree. I will show it its place,
and prove that I am the greatest
of them all.
fields.JP:
同感だ。今度はきっちりとワレの強さを
身体に刻み込んでやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I agree. I will show it its place,
and prove that I am the greatest
of them all.

fields.EN: Um, I'd rather not encounter it...
fields.JP:
そ、そうぐうしないに越したことは
ないんじゃないかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, I'd rather not encounter it...

fields.EN:
Yup, I'd rather not see you girls
come back all beaten up and
such.
fields.JP:
うん。無茶はしないでほしいな。
みんながボロボロになって帰ってくるの、
もう見たくないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, I'd rather not see you girls
come back all beaten up and
such.

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Hikari. Our objective
is to escape, and not to try and
defeat that Nightmare.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、ヒカリ。目的は脱獄。
無理にこちらから探すつもりはないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Hikari. Our objective
is to escape, and not to try and
defeat that Nightmare.

fields.JP:
そうだよ、無茶はだめだよ
おねーちゃん？

fields.EN:
You're dependable, Akazukin, but you need to
hold yourself back a little more!
fields.JP:
赤ずきんは頼もしいが
もう少し自分を抑えねばな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood needs to find the
right balance between her power
and self-control!

fields.JP:
偉そうにふんぞり返ってるけど、
あなたもよハーメルン？

fields.EN:
The first person to pounce
seeing Marchens and Nightmares
is you...
fields.JP:
メルヒェンやナイトメアを見ると
まず飛びかかるのってあんたよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The first person to pounce
seeing Marchens and Nightmares
is you...

fields.EN:
I'm counting on both Akazukin
and Hameln, which is why you
both need to play things safer.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんもハーメルンも、
とても頼りにしてる。だからこそ、
自らを危険に晒しすぎないでほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm counting on both Red Riding
Hood and Hameln, which is why you
both need to play things safer.

fields.EN:
She's right. You can't imagine
how often Hikari gripes about
not having enough supplies.
fields.JP:
そうだぜ、傷薬や包帯が
いくらあっても足りやしねえって
ヒカリがいつもぼやいてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. You can't imagine
how often Hikari gripes about
not having enough supplies.

fields.EN:
N-Not true! W-Well, it is true
that I worry about them a lot,
but...
fields.JP:
そ、そんなこと言った覚えないよ！？
もちろんいつも心配するけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Not true! W-Well, it is true
that I worry about them a lot,
but...

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose we'll get through
this so you don't have to worry
any more. Isn't that right, Jack?
fields.JP:
なら今回で終わりにして、
これ以上心配させないようにしてみせるわ。
ねえ、ジャック？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose we'll get through
this so you don't have to worry
any more. Isn't that right, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

んぎ……ぎ……
ありす……も……ずごじ……だ……

fields.EN:
I can tell you both are
ready for this.
fields.JP: アリスもジャックも気合いは充分だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can tell you both are
ready for this.

fields.EN:
Everyone, be sure you aren't
missing anything before you
all leave.
fields.JP:
みんな、出発に当たって何か
不足してるものはないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, be sure you aren't
missing anything before you
all leave.

fields.EN:
This may be the last, so make
sure you got all yer stuff. You
can consult stuff with me, too.
fields.JP:
これが最後かもしれないなら、
みんな準備は万端にしとけよー？
何なら悩み相談にだって乗っちゃうぜ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This may be the last, so make
sure you got all yer stuff. You
can consult stuff with me, too.

fields.EN:
I haven't seen you this proactive
in awhile, Takumi.
fields.JP:
おいおい、どうしたんだタクミ、
いつになくやる気を見せて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't seen you this proactive
in awhile, Takumi.

fields.EN:
Oh c'mon, I'm just showing how
appreciative I am!
fields.JP:
そんなん、感謝してるからに
決まってるだろぉぉぉ～～～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh c'mon, I'm just showing how
appreciative I am!

fields.EN:
I mean, I only made it this far because of you
and the others, Otsuu-chan!!
fields.JP:
こんなオレがここまで
生き残れたのは、おつうちゃんたちの
おかげなんだからよぉぉぉ～～～～！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, I was able to survive only
cuz of all you girls, you know?

fields.EN:
Come now, we're the ones who
appreciate what you've done
for us.
fields.JP:
何言ってるんだよ、タクミ。
それはこっちの台詞だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, we're the ones who
appreciate what you've done
for us.

fields.EN:
Yup, she's right, and that goes
for everyone here.
fields.JP:
うん、わたしたちこそ
みんなに感謝してるんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, she's right, and that goes
for everyone here.

fields.JP:
マモルさん、ヒカリちゃん、
イツキさん、カエデさん、タクミさん……

fields.EN:
If we didn't meet you all, there's
no telling if we would've made it
this far.
fields.JP:
５人に出会えてなかったら、
わたしたちこそ、ここまで来られなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we didn't meet you all, there's
no telling if we would've made it
this far.

fields.EN:
Yes, which is why we're the ones
who need to thank you all.
fields.JP:
だから、ありがとうってのは
こっちの台詞なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, which is why we're the ones
who need to thank you all.

fields.JP: おつうちゃん……人魚ちゃん……！

fields.EN:
Why yes, we wouldn't have been
able to explore as heroes without
meeting all of you.
fields.JP:
そうだな、確かに貴公らに
出会ってなかったら、ワレも
勇者として旅立てなかったしな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, we wouldn't have been
able to explore as heroes without
meeting all of you.

fields.EN:
If anything, I at least appreciate
acquiring the knowledge base you
all amassed here.
fields.JP:
ここに来なかったら、
様々な知識を得る機会を逃していたわ。
それについては感謝するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anything, I at least appreciate
acquiring the knowledge base you
all amassed here.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel like this place!
Plenty food! Thanks!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもここにきてたのしいし、
おなかいっぱいたべられるようになった！
いつもありがとう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel like this place!
Plenty food! Thanks!

fields.EN:
With Dawn gone, we were able
to live our lives only because
of everyone here.
fields.JP:
黎明がなくなって……それでもまだ
こうして人間らしく生きていられるのは、
みなさんのおかげですよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Dawn gone, we were able
to live our lives only because
of everyone here.

fields.EN:
Thank you so much for helping everyone
in the Order of the Sun even though
we showed up out of nowhere.
fields.JP:
いきなり押しかけたのに、
タイヨウ教団のみんなを助けてくれて
本当にありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for helping out the Order
even after all that happened.

fields.EN:
Yes, thank you for preparing such
a wonderful place we could call home.
fields.JP:
安心して暮らせる場所を築いて下さって、
本当にありがとうございます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, thank you for preparing such
a wonderful place we could call home.

fields.EN:
Everyone... make... nice...
place to... sleep... Thanks...
fields.JP:
みんなの……おかげで……
いつもボク……ぐっすり眠れた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone... make... nice...
place to... sleep... Thanks...

fields.EN:
I do appreciate how you all
treated me well as a newcomer.
fields.JP:
右も左も分からないわたしに、
優しくしてくれてありがとう、ですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do appreciate how you all
treated me well as a newcomer.

fields.EN:
Without you folks, there's no way
I could have fought again.
Thanks.
fields.JP:
５人がいなかったら、
あたしはこうしてまた戦えていなかった。
本当にありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Without you folks, there's no way
I could have fought again.
Thanks.

fields.EN:
And, I'll never forget how you all
accepted me and Jack in.
fields.JP:
わたしとジャックを受け入れてくれた恩、
絶対に忘れないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I'll never forget how you all
accepted me and Jack in.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
C'mon, girls. Cut it out.
We're all friends now.
fields.JP:
おいおい、よせよ……
仲間なんだから当たり前だぜ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, girls. Cut it out.
We're all friends now.

fields.EN:
We wouldn't have survived if
we didn't meet Otsuu and everyone
at the very beginning, you know?
fields.JP:
あの時おつうたちに
出会ってなかったら、僕らの命はなかった。
こちらこそ感謝しかないさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We wouldn't have survived if
we didn't meet Otsuu and everyone
at the very beginning, you know?

fields.EN:
Yup, and Hameln provided us with
a new place to call home.
fields.JP:
そうそう。それにハーメルンのおかげで
こうして新たな住処が作れたわけだし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, and Hameln provided us with
a new place to call home.

fields.EN:
Not to forget all the trouble you
girls went through for everyone.
It made me want to do more!
fields.JP:
それにみんなが危険を
冒してくれてるんだもん。
私も頑張らなきゃって思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to forget all the trouble you
girls went through for everyone.
It made me want to do more!

fields.EN:
Like, I don't think I can repay
all of ya no matter what I do.
fields.JP:
オレにできること全部差し出しても、
まだまだ全然感謝しきれないんだぜ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, I don't think I can repay
all of ya no matter what I do.

fields.EN:
This is all so bizarre. I mean, it
all started with us meeting them
by coincidence, then Hameln...
fields.JP:
今思うと不思議だね……
あんな地の底で、偶然５人に出会って、
そしてハーメルンに遭遇して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is all so bizarre. I mean, it
all started with us meeting them
by coincidence, then Hameln...

fields.EN:
And that led us to building this
place up to call our home.
fields.JP:
それが今こうして、
拠点を作りあげるまでに至ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that led us to building this
place up to call our home.

fields.EN:
Hameln was something back then.
Like how she misunderstood
what it meant to play chase.
fields.JP:
あの時のハーメルンは
やばかったよな。鬼ごっこを完全に
履き違えてやがったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln was something back then.
Like how she misunderstood
what it meant to play chase.

fields.EN:
I never expected someone to
think that playing chase would
mean to kill the chased.
fields.JP:
捕まったら叩き潰される鬼ごっこなんて、
あの時は死ぬかと思ったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I never expected someone to
think that playing chase would
mean to kill the chased.

fields.EN:
Urgh... I-I don't ever recall
that happyenyng!
fields.JP:
うっ……そ、そんな
昔のことは忘れたにょらっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh... I-I don't ever recall
that happyenyng!

fields.EN:
I'm glad we found out how much you
really care about your friends, Hameln-chan.
fields.JP:
でもハーメルンちゃんは
本当はこんなに仲間想いなんだって、
知ることができてよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just glad that we all found
out how much she cared about
her friends.

fields.EN: W-Why, I am a hero, after all!
fields.JP: ワ、ワレは勇者であるからなっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: W-Why, I am a hero, after all!

fields.EN:
Yes, and we're counting on
every one of you.
fields.JP:
……そうだな。頼りにしてる。
もちろん、他のみんなもだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and we're counting on
every one of you.

fields.EN:
We wouldn't be here without
each and everyone here, so...
fields.JP:
……ここにいる誰か１人でも欠けてたら、
今こうして笑いあえてねえ、って思う
だからよ…………
fields.LOCALIZED:
We wouldn't be here without
each and everyone here, so...

fields.EN:
Yes, we'll make this our last.
Now, let's get ready to go.
fields.JP:
ああ、これで終わりにする――
そのつもりで行こう、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we'll make this our last.
Now, let's get ready to go.

fields.EN:
The entrance...
All right, let's get ready.
fields.JP:
ようやく監獄塔入り口だ……
みんな、気を引きしめて行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The entrance...
All right, let's get ready.

fields.JP: あれ、あそこに誰かいる……

fields.EN: What are you two doing here?!
fields.JP: どうしてこんなところに！？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you two doing here?!

fields.EN:
This is the enemy's base!
A-Are you hurt?!
fields.JP:
ここは最前線ですよ！？
お、お怪我はありませんか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is the enemy's base!
A-Are you hurt?!

fields.EN:
I asked Clara to bring me here
and she obliged.
fields.JP:
くららにお願いしたら、
快く引き受けてくれたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I asked Clara to bring me here
and she obliged.

fields.EN:
Heh heh! If Oohime-san
asks, it's no trouble at all!
fields.JP:
あははっ、大陽女さんの頼みなら
お安い御用っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! Like I'd refuse the
request of the big-shot herself!

fields.EN:
Hey, Clara! You should know
better than to bring her out here!
fields.JP:
ちょっとくらら！
あんたね、外は危険なんだから
ミチルを連れ出したりしちゃ駄目でしょ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Clara! You should know
better than to bring her out here!

fields.EN:
You too, Michiru!
You have any idea what this
place is?!
fields.JP:
ミチルもミチルよ！
ここがどんな場所かぐらい、
分かってるでしょ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Michiru!
You have any idea what this
place is?!

fields.EN:
This is the Jail Tower.
It's Michiru's neighbor.
fields.JP:
ここは監獄塔。
いまのみちるのご近所さんよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is the Jail Tower.
It's Michiru's neighbor.

fields.EN:
Yup, a close, but super far
neighbor just to come to.
fields.JP:
そっすねー、でも近いはずなのに、
思ったより遠回りしたっすねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, a close, but super far
neighbor just to come to.

fields.JP:
ご近所って……
あんたたちってば…………はぁ……

fields.EN:
Nope.
That's why Clara is here.
fields.JP:
だいじょうぶよ。
そのためにくららの力を借りたし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nope.
That's why Clara is here.

fields.EN:
Oh, and Michiru is really feeling
good today. I can tell where the
Marchens are crawling.
fields.JP:
それに今ね、みちる精神が機敏なの。
だからちかくのメルヒェンの場所とか、
だいたい分かるんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and Michiru is really feeling
good today. I can tell where the
Marchens are crawling.

fields.EN:
(I don't know where her
confidence is coming from, but
I do know she's not scared.)
fields.JP:
（謎の根拠としか言えないけど、
　怖がってないってことは自信が
　あるんだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't know where her
confidence is coming from, but
I do know she's not scared.)

fields.JP:
（相変わらずミチルは
　不思議な人だなぁ……）
わぁっ！？　いつの間にっ！？

fields.EN:
(How'd she get so close?!
No wait! Her face is so close!)
fields.JP:
（一気に目の前に……！？
　ってか顔が近い……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How'd she get so close?!
No wait! Her face is so close!)

fields.EN:
Michiru has something to say
to Otsuu.
fields.JP: みちるね、おつうに話があって来たの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru has something to say
to Otsuu.

fields.EN:
I didn't know before, but now
that I'm close to the tower,
I know now...
fields.JP:
昔はわからなかったの……。
でも監獄塔にいつづけたことで、
精神が機敏になってるいまならわかるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know before, but now
that I'm close to the tower,
I know now...

fields.EN:
(Her eyes are so beautiful...
It almost feels like it's
entrancing me...)
fields.JP:
（どこまでも深くて綺麗な瞳……
　見つめていると吸い込まれそうだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her eyes are so beautiful...
It almost feels like it's
entrancing me...)

fields.EN:
Um, Otsuu isn't like the other
Blood Maidens. Otsuu is a child 
led by the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
あのね、おつうは
『血式少女に導かれた子』なの。
他の血式少女とはちがうの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Otsuu isn't like the other
Blood Maidens. Otsuu is a child 
led by the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan isn't like the other
Blood Maidens?
fields.JP: おつうちゃんが他の血式少女と違う……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu isn't like the other
Blood Maidens?

fields.EN:
You need to be more specific.
What of her is different?
fields.JP:
具体的に言ってほしいものね、教祖。
つうのどこが他と違うのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need to be more specific.
What of her is different?

fields.EN:
It's like hearing a very silent
and faint sound you can only hear
by listening...
fields.JP:
しずかに耳をかたむけていたら
微かにきこえてきた……そんなかんじ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's like hearing a very silent
and faint sound you can only hear
by listening...

fields.EN:
So please take good care of
Otsuu, okay?
fields.JP:
だからみんな、
おつうを大事にしてあげてね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please take good care of
Otsuu, okay?

fields.EN:
Uh... She's always cryptic like
this so just take her words with
a grain of salt.
fields.JP:
あー……みんな、大陽女はいつも
こんな調子だからさ、頭の片隅にでも
入れといてくれればいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... She's always cryptic like
this so just take her words with
a grain of salt.

fields.EN:
But she does have a strange
power that can't be denied...
fields.JP:
でも、完全には否定できない、
何か不思議な説得力みたいなものが
ありますね～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she does have a strange
power that can't be denied...

fields.EN:
Um, I'm not sure what it's about,
but you can be sure I'll take good
care of Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
よく分からないけど、
わたし、おつうちゃんをもっと大事にする
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'm not sure what it's about,
but you can be sure I'll take good
care of Otsuu.

fields.EN:
P-Princess!
You shouldn't hold my hands
in front of everyone!
fields.JP:
ひ、姫っ……
みんなの前で手を繋ぐなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Princess!
You shouldn't hold my hands
in front of everyone!

fields.EN:
(N-Not that I don't want it,
but this is all too sudden!)
fields.JP: （う、嬉しいけど急に大胆すぎて……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(N-Not that I don't want it,
but this is all too sudden!)

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
Take good care of her, okay?
fields.JP:
ふふふ、そんな感じで
大事にしてあげてね、みんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
Take good care of her, okay?

fields.EN:
(How'd she move away from me
so quickly?!)
fields.JP:
（たった今まで目の前にいたのに、
　いつの間にあんな遠くに……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How'd she move away from me
so quickly?!)

fields.EN: Well, good luck, all of ya!
fields.JP:
それじゃあみなさん、
頑張ってくださいっすー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, good luck, all of ya!

fields.EN:
Hey, wait! I'll take you both
back to the Order!
fields.JP:
あ、ちょっと待ちなさい！
さすがにタイヨウ教団まで見送るわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, wait! I'll take you both
back to the Order!

fields.JP: さらっと去っていったね……

fields.EN: They came and went like nothing...
fields.JP: いつの間にか消えたって感じだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: They came and went like nothing...

fields.EN:
Ugh... She's always like that,
without a care in sight...
fields.JP:
ああもう、いつも人の心配なんて
どこ吹く風なんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh... She's always like that,
without a care in sight...

fields.JP:
（ミチルもくららも、本当に不思議で
　トリッキーな人たちだな……）

fields.EN:
(I have a feeling they'd do just
fine together...)
fields.JP:
（あの分なら、なんか帰りも
　大丈夫な気がしてしまう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have a feeling they'd do just
fine together...)

fields.JP: じゃあ行こう、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
Oh, uh!
You can let go of me now!
fields.JP: ってさすがに手、離すね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh!
You can let go of me now!

fields.EN:
Why?
A holding of hands is a sign of
affection.
fields.JP:
手を繋ぐのは親愛の証。
別にいいと思うけれど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why?
A holding of hands is a sign of
affection.

fields.EN:
W-Well, you never know when
Marchens may attack!
fields.JP:
い、いやすぐにメルヒェンが
襲ってくるかもしれないしさ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, you never know when
Marchens may attack!

fields.JP: あ、おつうちゃんかわいい

も、もう姫ってば！
みんなも、ほら行くぞ！！
どんどん広がっていきます……！

fields.EN:
Looks like there is a Nightmare
here, too.
fields.JP:
やはり監獄塔にもナイトメアは
いるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like there is a Nightmare
here, too.

fields.EN:
Of course there is. This place is
our enemy's base.
fields.JP:
それはそうであろう。
なんせ敵の本拠地であるからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course there is. This place is
our enemy's base.

fields.EN:
It doesn't seem the Nightmare
actually found us yet.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、あちらは私たちをまだ
捕捉はしてないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't seem the Nightmare
actually found us yet.

fields.EN: But... It is coming our way...
fields.JP: でもこっちに向かってきてるね……
fields.LOCALIZED: But... It is coming our way...

fields.JP:
ぐるる……やなやつ、
ちかづいてくる……！

fields.EN:
Tch... Not that I'd mind charging
at it now, but...
fields.JP:
くっ……今すぐぶった切って
やりたいけど……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... Not that I'd mind charging
at it now, but...

fields.EN:
There's nothing we can do unless
we destroy the core here.
fields.JP:
核を破壊してない今は
僕たちにできることはない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing we can do unless
we destroy the core here.

fields.EN:
We should run and hide like how
I did before. We'll find the right
opportunity to strike later.
fields.JP:
わたしがそうしたように、
逃げて隠れて、チャンスを窺うべきだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should run and hide like how
I did before. We'll find the right
opportunity to strike later.

fields.JP: そうだね、アリスさんの言うとおりだよ

fields.EN:
Move away slowly...
We'll make a run for it if it
finds us...
fields.JP:
うん。みんな、そっと動いて。
気づかれたら全力で逃げるぞ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Move away slowly...
We'll make a run for it if it
finds us...

fields.JP:
気づかれたっ！
みんな、走るんだっ！！

fields.EN:
I'll cover our back!
Everyone, go on ahead!
fields.JP:
ワレがしんがりを務める！
貴様らは先に行け！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll cover our back!
Everyone, go on ahead!

fields.EN:
Everyone, we have to
lose them, no matter what!!
fields.JP: みんな、絶対に振り切るぞ！！

キェァ……！
キェェェェァァアアアアッ！！

fields.EN:
The place looks like a storm
passed...
fields.JP: 何か、無残に荒れてるね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place looks like a storm
passed...

fields.EN:
I can only assume this tree was
once pretty darn huge before...
fields.JP:
この木、折れちゃってるけど
元は立派だったんでしょうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only assume this tree was
once pretty darn huge before...

fields.EN:
I read about it before, but
I believe it's called a "sakura,"
or a cherry blossom tree.
fields.JP:
たしか『桜』という木よ
本で読んだことがあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I read about it before, but
I believe it's called a "sakura,"
or a cherry blossom tree.

fields.EN:
I bet we'll find more of them
once we get out of here...
fields.JP:
脱獄すれば……きっと
こういった樹木があるんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet we'll find more of them
once we get out of here...

fields.EN:
Well, hopefully they aren't in as
bad of a shape as this one.
fields.JP: それにしても見事にぐちゃぐちゃねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, hopefully they aren't in as
bad of a shape as this one.

fields.EN:
I see some structures too, but
they're all in ruins.
fields.JP:
建物っぽいものもあるが、
見事に破壊し尽くされておるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see some structures too, but
they're all in ruins.

fields.EN: I wonder what this place was for?
fields.JP:
ここはいったいどんな
場所だったんでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder what this place was for?

fields.EN:
This place seems to house
a trove of information, enough
to keep me here forever.
fields.JP:
興味はあるわね……
調査の限りを尽くしたいほどに
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place seems to house
a trove of information, enough
to keep me here forever.

fields.JP: ねえおつうちゃん、これって……！

fields.EN:
A core?!
So there it is!
fields.JP:
これは核……！
こんなところにあったのか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A core?!
So there it is!

fields.JP: おつう、早速破壊しちゃってよ

fields.EN:
Wait... I sense something
behind the tree...
fields.JP: 待って。木の陰に何かいるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... I sense something
behind the tree...

fields.EN:
Come out! Do you think you can
strike us from the shadows
like that?!
fields.JP: 番人よ、隠れて隙でも窺っておったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come out! Do you think you can
strike us from the shadows
like that?!

fields.JP:
いや、待てハーメルン。
何か様子がおかしい

fields.EN:
She's right... I don't sense it
being hostile... It's more like...
it's afraid?
fields.JP:
確かに……敵意が弱々しいというか……
これはもしかして……怯えている？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right... I don't sense it
being hostile... It's more like...
it's afraid?

fields.EN:
So you're telling me the guardian
of the core is cowering in fear?
fields.JP:
核の番人が核そっちのけで
隠れてたというのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're telling me the guardian
of the core is cowering in fear?

fields.EN:
I doubt it would just leave the
core to its fate...
fields.JP:
さすがに核を放って
逃げるようなことはしないようだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt it would just leave the
core to its fate...

fields.EN: So, what is it scared of then?
fields.JP: いったい何に怯えているっていうんだ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what is it scared of then?

fields.JP: ……あるいは、もっと別の何かね

fields.EN:
We can think about it later.
Let's just crush that thing!
fields.JP:
もー面倒だからさっさと
核破壊しようよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can think about it later.
Let's just crush that thing!

fields.JP: それもそうだな、赤ずきんよ

fields.EN:
Wait... I can sense its hostility
directed towards us now...
fields.JP: 何だ、急に敵意が膨れ上がった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... I can sense its hostility
directed towards us now...

fields.EN:
I guess it can tell we're not
going to leave here without
destroying the core.
fields.JP: 見逃してくれないと悟ったのであろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it can tell we're not
going to leave here without
destroying the core.

fields.EN:
That just means it's going to
come at us with all its might!
fields.JP: つまりはやけくそってことじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That just means it's going to
come at us with all its might!

fields.JP: よしみんな、一気に蹴散らそう！

fields.EN:
Yup. Shirayuki, Nemu,
are you all right?
fields.JP:
みたいね。
白雪、ネム、怪我はない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Snow White, Sleepy,
are you all right?

fields.EN: Well, let's get rid of the core.
fields.JP: じゃあ核を破壊するぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, let's get rid of the core.

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！
またジェイルが鳴きましたわね……

fields.EN:
I can only hope this will lead
us to our escape...
fields.JP:
きっと、これでまた
脱獄に近づいたんじゃないかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope this will lead
us to our escape...

fields.EN:
By the way, I wonder what was
scaring that guardian.
fields.JP:
それにしても、さっきの番人は
どうして怯えていたんだろうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, I wonder what was
scaring that guardian.

fields.EN: (I know it's only a hunch, but...)
fields.JP: （あの番人の様子から察するに……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I know it's only a hunch, but...)

fields.EN:
(I have a feeling that mysterious
Nightmare brought this place
to ruins...)
fields.JP:
（もしかしてここを破壊したのは
　あの謎のナイトメアなんじゃ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have a feeling that mysterious
Nightmare brought this place
to ruins...)

fields.EN:
Say, Alice? Did you by any chance
awake here?
fields.JP:
ねえアリス、君はもしかして
ここで目が覚めたのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Alice? Did you by any chance
awake here?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I can't really
recall what it was like then...
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい、目覚めた時のことが
あまり思い出せないのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I can't really
recall what it was like then...

fields.EN:
What I can say for sure is that
it wasn't over here.
fields.JP:
でもここでないことだけは
断言できるわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I can say for sure is that
it wasn't over here.

fields.EN:
I would assume that awakening here
would have left the prominence of
the tree within your memory.
fields.JP:
ここで目覚めたのなら、
この桜の木が記憶に残りそうだものね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would assume that awakening here
would have left the prominence of
the tree within your memory.

fields.EN:
I would assume so, too. The very
fact that I don't recall the tree
here is proof of my memory.
fields.JP:
ええ。その記憶がわたしには
いっさいないから……だから違うはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would assume so, too. The very
fact that I don't recall the tree
here is proof of my memory.

fields.EN:
(If so, that would mean there's
another core somewhere within
the tower.)
fields.JP:
（そうだとするなら、監獄塔には
　核がもう１つあることになる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If so, that would mean there's
another core somewhere within
the tower.)

fields.EN:
(After all, Alice did say earlier
that she woke up near a core...)
fields.JP:
（『目覚めた時に核がそばにあった』って
　アリスは言っていたのだから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After all, Alice did say earlier
that she woke up near a core...)

fields.EN:
What's up, Otsuu?
We should get going.
fields.JP: 何やってんのおつう、ほら先に進むわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's up, Otsuu?
We should get going.

fields.EN:
It seems you have a lot more to
ponder about, yes?
fields.JP:
まだまだ考えなければいけないことは
たくさんありそうね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems you have a lot more to
ponder about, yes?

fields.EN:
Yeah... But first we need to
defeat the Nightmare here.
fields.JP:
うん……だけど今は先に
ナイトメアを倒そう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... But first we need to
defeat the Nightmare here.

fields.JP: よしみんな、先に進もう
いたっ！　ナイトメア！！

fields.EN:
If we can defeat it, we should be
one-step closer to our escape!
fields.JP:
ここを突破すれば、きっと
脱獄まであと少しだ、みんな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we can defeat it, we should be
one-step closer to our escape!

fields.EN:
That's what I need to hear to
get me a bit more motivated!
fields.JP:
そう聞くと、いつも以上に
やる気が沸いてきますね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I need to hear to
get me a bit more motivated!

fields.JP:
ぐるるるる……！
ラプンツェルたちはまけない……！

fields.EN:
Why yes, Rapu. Let us show it
our grace in battle!
fields.JP:
そうですわね、ラプ。
わたしたちの連携、見せてあげますわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, Rappy. Let us show it
our grace in battle!

fields.EN:
It's the tower's Nightmare!
Don't let your guard down!
fields.JP:
監獄塔のナイトメアだ、
今まで以上に気を引きしめて戦うぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's the tower's Nightmare!
Don't let your guard down!

fields.EN:
It looks like our attacks are
working!
fields.JP: わたしたちの攻撃、効いてるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like our attacks are
working!

fields.EN:
Yup, it's strong, but we're just
as strong, too!
fields.JP:
うん、確かに強いけど、
全然負けてないよわたしたち……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, it's strong, but we're just
as strong, too!

fields.EN:
Yeah... Just a little more and
we'll be able to hear its
sweet death cry!
fields.JP:
そうだね……もう少しで
ナイトメアの断末魔が聞けるね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Just a little more and
we'll be able to hear its
sweet death cry!

fields.EN:
But it isn't giving up yet!
The Nightmare's hostility against
us is growing!
fields.JP:
でもさすがはナイトメア、
敵意がまったく消えませんね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it isn't giving up yet!
The Nightmare's hostility against
us is growing!

fields.EN:
Well then, I suppose it needs to
feel my power at its fullest!
fields.JP:
ならば今一度ワレの強さを
その目に焼き付けさせてやるぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I suppose it needs to
feel my power at its fullest!

fields.EN:
In any case, now's our chance!
Let's finish it!
fields.JP:
ああ、今がチャンスだ。
みんな、一気に叩き込もう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, now's our chance!
Let's finish it!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
これでスッキリしたね
やったね、おねーちゃん！

fields.EN:
I guess we're that much closer
to escaping from this place!
fields.JP:
これで脱獄が
グッと近づいたってわけよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we're that much closer
to escaping from this place!

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Otsuu-chan?
You don't look too well...
fields.JP:
どうしたんですか、おつうちゃん。
何か不安要素でも……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Otsuu?
You don't look too well...

fields.EN:
No, it's still a long way to the top of the
Jail Tower. I was just thinking we don't
know what might happen before we get there.
fields.JP:
いや、監獄塔の
てっぺんまではまだまだ長い。
何があるか分からないって思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I was just thinking that we
still have a long ways to go
before we reach the top.

fields.EN:
Yes. I strongly suggest we keep
moving and not assume this was
the last of our hurdles.
fields.JP:
そうね、これで終わりだと
考えない方がいいかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I strongly suggest we keep
moving and not assume this was
the last of our hurdles.

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right. There is
no telling what still lies ahead.
fields.JP:
確かに、何があるか分かりませんもんね。
はい、気を引きしめます……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right. There is
no telling what still lies ahead.

fields.EN:
Right. Let's keep going, and make
sure we have our guard up.
fields.JP:
そういうわけでみんな、
この先も油断せずに進もう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Let's keep going, and make
sure we have our guard up.

fields.JP: 辺りの雰囲気が変わったね……

fields.EN:
Judging by how high we climbed,
I assume we just entered the upper
level of the tower.
fields.JP:
上がってきた高さを考えると、
どうやらちょうどここから上層階みたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Judging by how high we climbed,
I assume we just entered the upper
level of the tower.

fields.EN:
So we must at least be halfway
through this place.
fields.JP: なるほど、やっと半分を超えたところか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we must at least be halfway
through this place.

fields.EN:
So far, so good.
If things keep up then...
fields.JP: 順調ですね～この調子で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So far, so good.
If things keep up then...

fields.JP: ヴォゥァァァァァアアアアア……

fields.EN:
I haven't heard anything
like it before!
fields.JP: なんて不気味な鳴き声でしょうか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't heard anything
like it before!

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、これって……

fields.EN:
Yes, there's only one existence
that could unleash such
a horrible roar...
fields.JP:
うん。声や鳴き方は違えど、
こんなおぞましい存在は他にない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, there's only one existence
that could unleash such
a horrible roar...

fields.EN:
B-But we already defeated the
Nightmare here!
fields.JP:
で、でもナイトメアなら
下で倒したじゃないですの……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But we already defeated the
Nightmare here!

fields.EN:
I assume there's another Nightmare
guarding the upper levels...
fields.JP:
上層は上層で別のナイトメアが
支配している……ということのようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume there's another Nightmare
guarding the upper levels...

fields.JP: まったく、面倒な限りだな

（このナイトメア……
　もしかして怯えている……？）

fields.EN:
(Yes, I can feel its fear...
But why...?)
fields.JP:
（うん……確かにナイトメアの感情は
　怯えとして僕に伝わってきている……。
　これはいったい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yes, I can feel its fear...
But why...?)

fields.EN:
How many more times do we have to
face that Nightmare?!
fields.JP:
ちょっと、あと何回ナイトメアと
遭遇しなくてはいけないんですか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How many more times do we have to
face that Nightmare?!

fields.EN:
It'll be fine... I don't see the
area getting white, and the
roar came from afar.
fields.JP:
……大丈夫だよ。ひとまず辺りに
白い闇は見えないし、鳴き声だって遠い
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be fine... I don't see the
area getting white, and the
roar came from afar.

fields.EN:
I'm sure things will be okay
so long as we keep our guard up.
fields.JP:
慎重に、油断せずに
進んでいけば大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure things will be okay
so long as we keep our guard up.

fields.EN:
Yes, I don't think that Nightmare
is anywhere near us.
fields.JP: そうね、距離はあると思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I don't think that Nightmare
is anywhere near us.

fields.EN:
We're so close...
Let's do our best
to make it through!
fields.JP:
あと少しだもんね……
今度も絶対、突破しようね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're so close...
Let's do our best
to make it through!

fields.EN:
Of course we will, Princess.
We will make it through for sure.
fields.JP:
ああ、もちろんだよ姫。
ここまで来たんだ、絶対に突破しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course we will, Princess.
We will make it through for sure.

fields.JP: じゃあみんな、気をつけて進もう

fields.EN:
That Nightmare hasn't appeared in
front of us at all!
fields.JP:
何なのよ、ナイトメアの奴、
全然現れないじゃない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Nightmare hasn't appeared in
front of us at all!

fields.EN:
If we don't run into it,
I think that's better, though...
fields.JP:
出会わないならその方が
いいとも思いますけどね～……

fields.EN:
Yes, at least not while we haven't
found the core here.
fields.JP:
核を見つけていない今は、
その方がいいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, at least not while we haven't
found the core here.

fields.EN:
Even if we do find our way out of
Jail, we'll need to defeat it to
secure a route for everyone else.
fields.JP:
でも、仮に監獄塔のてっぺんから脱獄する
というのなら、一般人の避難のためにも
いつかはナイトメアを倒さないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if we do find our way out of
Jail, we'll need to defeat it to
secure a route for everyone else.

fields.EN:
But that doesn't mean you can do
anything once you find the core,
got it?
fields.JP:
でも核を見つけたとしても、
あまり無理はしないようにしようね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that doesn't mean you can do
anything once you find the core,
got it?

fields.EN:
Understood. It would defeat all
purpose if we fall here.
fields.JP:
うん。無理をして倒れたら
それこそ脱獄できなくなるしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. It would defeat all
purpose if we fall here.

fields.EN:
I still don't understand what's
going on with the roaring though.
fields.JP:
でも何なの……遭遇はしないのに、
たまに鳴き声だけは聞こえるなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still don't understand what's
going on with the roaring though.

fields.JP: ヴォゥァァァァァァ……ァァ……

fields.EN:
There it goes again!
This is getting irritating!
fields.JP:
ほらまた！
もう、イライラするわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There it goes again!
This is getting irritating!

fields.EN:
It is a bit grating, for sure.
It's like it's pacing itself so
that we're only so close to it.
fields.JP:
確かに、タチが悪いわね。
まるでつかず離れず追われてるみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is a bit grating, for sure.
It's like it's pacing itself so
that we're only so close to it.

fields.EN:
Tsuu, you do know that it is
absolutely necessary to destroy
the core here, yes?
fields.JP:
つう、無理はしないと言うけど、
核の破壊だけは必須だと思うのだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you do know that it is
absolutely necessary to destroy
the core here, yes?

fields.EN:
Of course... Not being able to
face the Nightmare leaves a great
risk for all of us.
fields.JP:
うん、そうだね……
ナイトメアと戦えないのが
やっぱり一番怖いからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course... Not being able to
face the Nightmare leaves a great
risk for all of us.

fields.EN:
We should prioritize finding the
core, while keeping our distance
with that Nightmare.
fields.JP:
みんな……核を見つけることを
最優先に、それまではナイトメアからは
極力距離を取ろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should prioritize finding the
core, while keeping our distance
with that Nightmare.

fields.EN:
I guess that is the safest
approach we have now.
fields.JP: そうだね、それが一番安全だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that is the safest
approach we have now.

fields.EN:
In that sense, it's good we can
hear the Nightmare's roar. Let's
keep our distance, and head on.
fields.JP:
そういった意味では鳴き声は
ナイトメアの位置を特定しやすい。
離れながら進もう、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that sense, it's good we can
hear the Nightmare's roar. Let's
keep our distance, and head on.

fields.JP: あっ！　みつけたよー！！

本当ですわ！
これは間違いなく核ですわね！

fields.EN:
I didn't expect to find it without
encountering the Nightmare...
fields.JP:
まさか１度もナイトメアに遭遇せずに
核に辿り着くとは思わなかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect to find it without
encountering the Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Yes, it is a bit odd considering
we've met Nightmares before
reaching the core before.
fields.JP:
そうね、今までこんなことは
なかったものね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it is a bit odd considering
we've met Nightmares before
reaching the core before.

fields.EN:
It just means we're lucky!
I guess we're that much closer
to victory now!
fields.JP:
だがこれはまたとないチャンス！
これでワレらの勝利がまた近づいたな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just means we're lucky!
I guess we're that much closer
to victory now!

fields.EN: But, could it be that easy...?
fields.LOCALIZED: But, could it be that easy...?

fields.EN:
(There's no way this is a
trap, right?)
fields.JP:
（いや、罠だとか
　そんなことはないはず……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no way this is a
trap, right?)

fields.EN:
Now then, let's get rid of the
core.
fields.JP:
よしみんな、早速だけど
核を破壊しようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's get rid of the
core.

fields.JP:
ぎ……とお……ざな……
ち…………ち……ぎぎぎ……

fields.EN: Of all the places we need to meet!
fields.JP:
よりにもよって
こんな場所で出るなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Of all the places we need to meet!

fields.EN:
Just when we were about to
destroy the core, too!
fields.JP: 核を破壊するところだったのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just when we were about to
destroy the core, too!

fields.EN:
I suppose it can't be helped.
All, follow me!
fields.JP:
仕方ないな……貴様ら、
ここであのナイトメアを迎え撃つぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose it can't be helped.
All, follow me!

fields.JP: ちょっと待ってくれハーメルン、みんな
おつうちゃん、どうしたの……？
何か様子がおかしいと思わないか？

fields.EN:
Hm, I don't sense any aggression
from it...
fields.JP: ……そうね、攻撃してくる様子はないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, I don't sense any aggression
from it...

fields.EN:
It also doesn't look like it'll
get out of our way.
fields.JP:
かといって、
どいてくれる気配もないけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also doesn't look like it'll
get out of our way.

fields.JP:
ぎ……ぎぎ…………
ちちち……がえ……れ……
どうする、って言われても……

fields.EN:
It's quite obvious it isn't an
enemy that we can rid ourselves of
so easily...
fields.JP:
さっさと排除……と
簡単に言えぬ相手ではあるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's quite obvious it isn't an
enemy that we can rid ourselves of
so easily...

fields.EN:
It did fend against all of us
before, so going against it
without a plan is dangerous.
fields.JP:
そうね、仮にもわたしたちの攻撃を
あっさりと凌いだナイトメアよ。
迂闊には飛びかかれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It did fend against all of us
before, so going against it
without a plan is dangerous.

fields.EN:
Isn't there any good way to
avoid facing it?
fields.JP:
な、何とか上手く切り抜ける方法は
ないでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't there any good way to
avoid facing it?

fields.JP: ぐるる……どかないとおこるよ……！

fields.EN:
Rapu, don't go near it.
We need to put some distance
against it.
fields.JP:
ラプ、近づくのはやめなさいな。
今は距離を取りますわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, don't go near it.
We need to put some distance
against it.

fields.EN:
(Is this Nightmare suffering
because of its primal nature
and some other force?)
fields.JP:
（もしかしてこのナイトメア……
　『本能』と『何か』の間で
　苦しんでいる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is this Nightmare suffering
because of its primal nature
and some other force?)

fields.EN:
(That has to be it... I can sense
it. If so, then we may be able
to negotiate with it...)
fields.JP:
（うん、そうだ間違いない……。
　じゃあそれで僕たちを攻撃できないなら、
　交渉の余地があるんじゃないか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That has to be it... I can sense
it. If so, then we may be able
to negotiate with it...)

fields.JP: みんな、ちょっと聞いてほしいんだ

fields.EN:
We may be able to move onward
without facing it by...
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、僕たちは
この謎のナイトメアと戦わなくても
先に進めるかもしれ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may be able to move onward
without facing it by...

fields.EN: This is a waste of time...
fields.JP: ……ああもう、まどろっこしいっての
fields.LOCALIZED: This is a waste of time...

fields.EN:
This Nightmare isn't intelligent enough
to be investigating anything. I told
you, there's no point thinking about it.
fields.JP:
何かを探れるほどこのナイトメアは
知能を持ち合わせてなんかいないよ
考えるだけ無駄だってば
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't have any real
intelligence, so it's a waste of
time thinking up a plan.

fields.EN:
So come on, let's all hurry up and
kill it. Then my wish—and everyone's
wish—will come true, right?
fields.JP:
だからさ、ほら、早くみんなで
殺しにかかろうよ。それであたしの願いも、
みんなの願いだって叶うんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we need to do is go against
it all at once and kill it.
Simple as that.

fields.EN:
Wait, it's dangerous trying to
face it without a...
fields.JP: いや、無闇に戦うのは危険だって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, it's dangerous trying to
face it without a...

fields.EN:
What? So we're just going to stare
at each other forever? No way I'm
game for such a plan.
fields.JP:
じゃあここでずっと睨めっこしてるっての？
あたしはそんなのゴメンだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? So we're just going to stare
at each other forever? No way I'm
game for such a plan.

fields.EN:
Onee-chan, I thought we promised that
you would stay calm.
fields.JP:
おねーちゃん、
無茶はしないって約束したよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis, I thought we promised that
you would stay calm.

fields.EN:
I know that, but I am calm.
I'm simply giving us an option
to simply do away with it.
fields.JP:
したよ。覚えてる。でも別にこれは
無茶じゃない。ただの提案だよ。
倒そうって言ってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know that, but I am calm.
I'm simply giving us an option
to simply do away with it.

fields.EN:
Fighting it may lead to unwanted
casualties. So avoiding conflict
is the best course of action.
fields.JP:
戦えば犠牲が増えるかもしれない。だから
倒さずとも進めるなら、それが最善だろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting it may lead to unwanted
casualties. So avoiding conflict
is the best course of action.

fields.EN:
We may be able to face it without
resorting to violence.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、戦わずに
この状況を乗り切れるかもしれないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may be able to face it without
resorting to violence.

fields.JP: おつう、それ本気で言ってるの？

fields.EN:
Of course I'm serious. We may be
able to escape without fighting,
so please, bear with me for a bit.
fields.JP:
もちろん本気だよ。
戦わずにみんなが脱獄できるかもしれない。
だからお願いだから我慢してくれ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I'm serious. We may be
able to escape without fighting,
so please, bear with me for a bit.

fields.EN:
Please, Onee-chan... I'm sure Otsuu-chan has
this thought out, so we can give
her a chance.
fields.JP:
お願い、おねーちゃん。
おつうちゃんに何か考えがあるなら、
それを試してからでもいいでしょ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, Sis... I'm sure Otsuu has
this thought out, so we can give
her a chance.

fields.EN:
That's not happening...
That's because what we see there
is probably Snark...
fields.JP:
……いや、駄目だね。
だってあのナイトメアはおそらく
『スナーク』だからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not happening...
That's because what we see there
is probably Snark...

fields.JP: そ……そうだったんですか……！？

fields.EN:
If that's true, then there's no
other option but to defeat it...
fields.JP:
確かにそうだとするなら……
倒さないって選択肢はないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's true, then there's no
other option but to defeat it...

fields.EN:
Yup. Snark is an enemy of all
humanity. It has to die for the
future of everyone.
fields.JP:
うん。『スナーク』は人間の敵。
殺さなければ人類に未来はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Snark is an enemy of all
humanity. It has to die for the
future of everyone.

fields.JP:
赤ずきん……あの謎のナイトメアは多分
『スナーク』じゃないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, that probably
isn't Snark...

fields.JP: だとしたらいったい何なんですの……？

fields.EN:
Otsuu, what's holding you back?
Don't tell me you're making this
all up to stop me.
fields.JP:
おつう、どうして躊躇うの？
まさかあたしを止めるためにでまかせ
言ったってワケ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, what's holding you back?
Don't tell me you're making this
all up to stop me.

fields.EN:
What I'm going to say is probably
going to be quite shocking...
fields.JP:
みんな、今からかなり
ショッキングな話をするよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I'm going to say is probably
going to be quite shocking...

fields.JP: ……聞かせてもらおうじゃない

fields.EN:
Have any of you ever thought of
what that Nightmare actually is?
fields.JP:
みんな、そもそもだけど、
そこにいるナイトメアの正体って
考えたことあるかい……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Have any of you ever thought of
what that Nightmare actually is?

fields.JP: このナイトメアの、正体……？
だから『スナーク』だってば

いや、そうじゃないんだ。
そこにいるナイトメアは実は……
謎のナイトメアの正体は？
謎のナイトメアの正体は？

fields.EN:
That Nightmare is a former
member of Dawn...
fields.JP:
そこにいるナイトメアは実は……
元黎明の人間なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Nightmare is a former
member of Dawn...

fields.EN:
What...?
Are you sure about that?
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...?
Are you sure about that?

fields.EN:
Yes... We already know there
are Nightmares that are born
from humans, right?
fields.JP:
うん……ナイトメアというのは、
人間が擬態化してなるケースもあるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... We already know there
are Nightmares that are born
from humans, right?

fields.JP: ……確かにジャックさんがそうだね

fields.EN:
That Nightmare we see is a
former human...
fields.JP:
だから、そこのナイトメアは
元は人間なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Nightmare we see is a
former human...

fields.EN:
Why it appeared in front of us
at each instance is because it
has something to do with us.
fields.JP:
そして行く先々で僕たちの前に現れたのは、
僕たちにゆかりのある人間だったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why it appeared in front of us
at each instance is because it
has something to do with us.

fields.EN:
I see... So, like Jack-san, that Nightmare is
acting based on memories from when it was
human, is that what you're saying?
fields.JP:
なるほど……ジャックさんのように、
そこのナイトメアも人間の時の記憶を持って
行動している……ということですね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So you're saying that
it's acting based on its memory of
its former human self?

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm sure it keeps appearing
in front of us in an effort to
meet us...
fields.JP:
そう……生き残った僕たちに会いたい……
そんな想いできっと行動していたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm sure it keeps appearing
in front of us in an effort to
meet us...

fields.EN:
But Nightmares are born with
the innate urge for destruction,
which led it to attack.
fields.JP:
でもナイトメアには破壊衝動がある。
だから襲ってきた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Nightmares are born with
the innate urge for destruction,
which led it to attack.

fields.EN:
Mmm... Okay, I get what you want
to say, but if that is a former
member of Dawn, who is it?
fields.JP:
ふーん……まあ言ってることは
理解できたよ。じゃあそこのナイトメアは
黎明の誰だって言うの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Okay, I get what you want
to say, but if that is a former
member of Dawn, who is it?

fields.EN:
I don't know, but everything we
know points to it being a former
member of Dawn.
fields.JP:
それは分からない……
ただこれまでの情報が、黎明の人間
だって指し示している……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know, but everything we
know points to it being a former
member of Dawn.

fields.EN: So we don't know anything then...
fields.JP: 肝心のところが分からないんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED: So we don't know anything then...

fields.EN:
But if we find out who it is, then
we may be able to bring its memory
back to avoid further conflict.
fields.JP:
でもそれが誰だか解き明かせば……
もしかしたら記憶を呼び覚ましたりして、
ここを切り抜けられるんじゃないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we find out who it is, then
we may be able to bring its memory
back to avoid further conflict.

fields.EN: But how will we find out?
fields.LOCALIZED: But how will we find out?

fields.JP:
どうしたのだグレーテルよ。
突然笑い出したりなんかして

fields.EN:
Oh, I was just amused by how
bad of a theory that was.
fields.JP: ずいぶんと穴の空いた推理だと思ってね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I was just amused by how
bad of a theory that was.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP:
なっ……僕の推理のどこに
穴があるって言うんだ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Tsuu, you're forgetting something
very important.
fields.JP: つう、あなた大事なことを失念しているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you're forgetting something
very important.

fields.EN:
I believe you heard this from
Itsuki, too...
fields.JP:
これはイツキから
報告を受けているはずだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe you heard this from
Itsuki, too...

fields.EN:
All the humans of Dawn were
found and accounted for as
dead, correct?
fields.JP:
そもそも黎明の人間って、
全員死体が見つかったはずよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the humans of Dawn were
found and accounted for as
dead, correct?

fields.EN:
That's right... I recall him
saying something like that before.
fields.JP:
そうだったわ。
確かにわたしもその報告は聞いたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right... I recall him
saying something like that before.

fields.EN:
Yes, he reported that everyone
in Dawn was found dead.
fields.JP:
ええ、そうでしたね……
報告では黎明の人間は全員死亡でしたね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, he reported that everyone
in Dawn was found dead.

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……
それ、忘れていたの……？

fields.EN:
Otsuu, you... you're
completely off the mark...!
fields.JP:
おつう、あんたね……
全っ然的外れじゃないの……！

（しまった……大事なことを
　僕は忘れていた……）

fields.EN:
That Nightmare is a Blood Maiden
just like us.
fields.JP:
そこにいるナイトメアは、
僕たちと同じ血式少女だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Nightmare is a Blood Maiden
just like us.

fields.EN:
At the very least we have all the
Blood Maidens back from Dawn
here and accounted for.
fields.JP:
少なくとも黎明時代に把握されていた
血式少女はここに全員いますよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least we have all the
Blood Maidens back from Dawn
here and accounted for.

fields.EN:
The other Blood Maidens not a
former member of Dawn are Alice-san,
Haa-chan, Gretel-san, and Rapu-chan.
fields.JP:
あとは、アリスさんにハーちゃん、グレーテルさん
それから……ラプちゃんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The other Blood Maidens not a
former member of Dawn are Alice,
Hammy, Gretel, and Rappy.

fields.EN:
Wait, that means we have all
the Blood Maidens here.
fields.JP:
ということは、血式少女は
全員が今ここにいるではないか、おつう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, that means we have all
the Blood Maidens here.

fields.EN:
Are you telling me there's another
Blood Maiden we don't know about?
fields.JP:
もしかして他にあたしたちの知らない
血式少女がいるとでも言うの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you telling me there's another
Blood Maiden we don't know about?

fields.EN:
Do you remember a certain Blood
Maiden who appeared in front of
us in the form of a Marchen?
fields.JP:
……でも血式少女と同じ姿形の
メルヒェンがいたことがあったじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you remember a certain Blood
Maiden who appeared in front of
us in the form of a Marchen?

fields.EN:
It's the same. The core mimicked
the Nightmare, just like how it
mimicked Cinderella.
fields.JP:
今回も、シンデレラの時のように
核に擬態化されてるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's the same. The core mimicked
the Nightmare, just like how it
mimicked Cinderella.

fields.EN:
But that Nightmare there isn't
mimicking the image of whoever
it's trying to mimic...
fields.JP:
でもそこのナイトメアは
わたしの時みたいに、見た目を
似せてはいないけれども……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that Nightmare there isn't
mimicking the image of whoever
it's trying to mimic...

fields.EN:
She's right. It doesn't matter who
it mimicked. Like Aka-nee said,
we just have to beat it.
fields.JP:
そうよ。誰の擬態かなんてどうでもいい。
赤姉の言うように倒せばいいだけじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. It doesn't matter who
it mimicked. Like Sister Red said,
we just have to beat it.

fields.EN: I see what you're getting at now.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see what you're getting at now.

fields.EN:
(It looks like Gretel understands
where I'm trying to lead my
conclusion to...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルは僕の言いたいことを
　察したようだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like Gretel understands
where I'm trying to lead my
conclusion to...)

fields.EN: This world is ever so cruel...
fields.JP: 本当に、この世界は残酷だわ
fields.LOCALIZED: This world is ever so cruel...

fields.EN:
Hey! Don't just come to an understanding
between the two of you—explain it properly!
fields.JP:
ちょっと！　二人だけで納得してないで、
ちゃんと説明しなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey!
What do you mean by that?!

fields.EN:
What Akazukin said isn't
correct. It isn't a Blood Maiden
we don't know about.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんの言う、
僕たちの知らない血式少女じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
What Red Riding Hood said isn't
correct. It isn't a Blood Maiden
we don't know about.

fields.EN:
We had the answer in front of us
all along. Cinderella's situation
was our way to the answer.
fields.JP:
答えはずっと前から提示されていた。
それこそ、シンデレラの件がヒントだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
We had the answer in front of us
all along. Cinderella's situation
was our way to the answer.

fields.EN:
Hurry and get to the conclusion!
What are you trying to get at?!
fields.JP:
ええい、勿体ぶるでない！
早く教えるがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hurry and get to the conclusion!
What are you trying to get at?!

fields.EN:
The Nightmare in front of us is a
transformed figure of the true
Blood Maiden...
fields.JP:
つまり、そこにいるナイトメアこそが
本物の血式少女が変化した姿で
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare in front of us is a
transformed figure of the true
Blood Maiden...

fields.EN:
That means the mimic of that
Blood Maiden is with us.
fields.JP:
僕たちの中に、擬態化したニセモノが
混じっているっていうことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means the mimic of that
Blood Maiden is with us.

fields.JP: そんな……わたしたちの中に……
ニセモノがいる、ですって……

fields.EN:
Jack is proof that humans can
transform into Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ジャックの事例を踏まえても、
ナイトメアは人間そのものが変化を遂げる
場合があるってことは分かっている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is proof that humans can
transform into Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Therefore it isn't hard to assume
something similar happened.
That would answer a lot of things.
fields.JP:
間違いない。そう考えれば、
いろんなことに辻褄が合うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Therefore it isn't hard to assume
something similar happened.
That would answer a lot of things.

fields.EN:
The mimic doesn't know they're
a mimic themselves. It's living the
life of the Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
もちろん擬態された人は、自分自身が
擬態化された存在だなんて知らないと思う。
知らずに血式少女として生きている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The mimic doesn't know they're
a mimic themselves. It's living the
life of the Blood Maiden.

fields.JP: そのニセモノは誰、おつう……！

核に擬態化されてる
血式少女、それは…………

fields.EN:
The Blood Maiden mimic is...
you, Cinderella...
fields.JP:
核に擬態化されてる血式少女、
それは…………シンデレラ、君だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maiden mimic is...
you, Cinderella...

fields.JP: そんな……シンデレラ……なの……？

fields.EN:
Th-That's not true!
I'm the real Cinderella!
fields.JP:
ちっ、ちがいますわ！
わたしは本物！　本物ですわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's not true!
I'm the real Cinderella!

fields.EN:
No, you're simply a mimic and the
real Cinderella is the Nightmare
in front of us.
fields.JP:
違うんだ……君は核に擬態化された存在で、
本物はそこにいるナイトメアなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, you're simply a mimic and the
real Cinderella is the Nightmare
in front of us.

fields.EN:
That would make sense...
We thought we defeated all the
mimics, but you're also...
fields.JP:
そう考えれば辻褄が合うんだ……
核に擬態化されたニセモノだけを
倒したと思ったけど、君自身もまた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would make sense...
We thought we defeated all the
mimics, but you're also...

fields.EN:
Liar! Cinderella not fake!
Rapunzel knows!
fields.JP:
うそだー！　シンデレラは
にせものなんかじゃないよ！！
ラプンツェルわかるもん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Liar! Cinderella not fake!
Rapunzel knows!

fields.EN:
Sh-She's right, Otsuu.
That's a bit loose ended to assume
she's a mimic.
fields.JP:
そ……そうよおつう、
その推理はちょっと強引が過ぎるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sh-She's right, Otsuu.
That's a bit loose ended to assume
she's a mimic.

fields.EN:
All the fakes back then were in
her human form, so why would this
one be different?
fields.JP:
そうです、だってあの時、
他のニセモノはすべて人間の姿でした。
なのに何故本物だけ違う姿に……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the fakes back then were in
her human form, so why would this
one be different?

fields.EN:
W-Well... If you look at Jack,
humans can turn into Nightmares
and...
fields.JP:
そ、それは……
ジャックの例を挙げれば分かるように、
人間だってナイトメアになるわけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... If you look at Jack,
humans can turn into Nightmares
and...

fields.EN:
Yes, Jack may be a case sample,
but that doesn't prove
Cinderella is a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
そうね、ジャックの例があるわね。
でもそれが『シンデレラがナイトメア』
という証拠にはならないのでは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, Jack may be a case sample,
but that doesn't prove
Cinderella is a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
If your assumption was true,
there's a chance everyone here
is a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
それを言ってしまえば、
ここにいる全員がナイトメアである
可能性があるということになるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If your assumption was true,
there's a chance everyone here
is a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
But... it is true that the core
mimicked Cinderella...
fields.JP:
それは……でも……
シンデレラが核に擬態化されたことが
あるのは確かなことで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... it is true that the core
mimicked Cinderella...

fields.EN:
Wait a moment... We already
destroyed the core that mimicked
Cinderella-san.
fields.JP:
待ってください。あの時シンデレラさんに
擬態していたという核は破壊しましたよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a moment... We already
destroyed the core that mimicked
Cinderella.

fields.EN:
If Cinderella-san is an existence mimicked by
the Core, then how do you explain the
Cinderella-san standing here...?
fields.JP:
シンデレラさんが核の擬態化した存在
と言うのなら、ここにいるシンデレラさんは
どう説明をつけるのです……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Cinderella's existence is part
of the core, then how do you
explain why she's still with us?

fields.EN:
W-Well... The core here must have
mimicked...
fields.JP:
そっ……それは……
ここの核を新たに見つけて、擬態化……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... The core here must have
mimicked...

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan... Cinderella-san was with us
the whole time since she
joined us.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……
シンデレラさんは合流して以来、
ずっとわたしたちと一緒にいたよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Cinderella was with us
the whole time since she
joined us.

fields.EN:
Yup! Rapunzel always
sleeps with her!
fields.JP:
そうだよ！　よるはラプンツェルと
いっしょにねてるんだから！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Rapunzel always
sleeps with her!

fields.EN:
See? I don't think there's a way
a core could've snuck a mimic
into us...
fields.JP:
ね？　みんなの目を盗んで
ここまで来る時間なんてなかったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? I don't think there's a way
a core could've snuck a mimic
into us...

fields.EN:
If you can't answer, you should
just admit that you were wrong.
This is getting us nowhere.
fields.JP:
言葉に詰まるのなら
潔く間違いを認めなさい、つう。
これ以上は見苦しいわよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can't answer, you should
just admit that you were wrong.
This is getting us nowhere.

fields.JP: ……どうやら時間の無駄だったみたいだね
（これで合ってると思ったのに……）

fields.EN:
The Blood Maiden mimic is...
you, Akazukin...
fields.JP:
核に擬態化されてる血式少女、
それは…………赤ずきん、君だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maiden mimic is...
you, Red Riding Hood...

fields.JP:
……ちょっとおつう、
それ本気で言ってる……？

fields.EN:
Th-That's right, Otsuu-chan...! Even so,
calling her onee-chan is a bit...
fields.JP:
そ、そうだよおつうちゃん……！
いくら何でもおねーちゃんだなんて、
そんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sh-She's right!
That's our Sis all right!

fields.EN:
...Princess. I'm sorry,
but... it can only be Akazukin...
fields.JP:
……姫。残念だけど……
赤ずきんしかあり得ないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Princess...
It's quite obvious she's the fake.

fields.EN:
Because she's harbored enough hatred
all this time to want to kill that
mysterious Nightmare over there...
fields.JP:
何故ならここまでずっと、そこの
謎のナイトメアを殺したいと願い続けるほど
強い憎悪を持っているから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's exhibited an unusual wanton
for killing Nightmares...

fields.EN:
That intense hatred of yours, Akazukin,
was mimicked and became that Nightmare
right there... That's what happened...
fields.JP:
その赤ずきんの強い憎しみが、
擬態化してそこのナイトメアに
なった……そういうことだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her deep hatred towards that
Nightmare manifested into the
Nightmare we see in front of us.

fields.EN:
Hey! Are you trying to tell me
that I'm trying to kill myself?!
fields.JP:
はっ、じゃあ何？
あたしはずっとあたしを殺そうとしている、
そう言いたいワケ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Are you trying to tell me
that I'm trying to kill myself?!

fields.EN:
That's right... The part of you split off as
pure hatred became a Nightmare, and you've
always instinctively seen it as dangerous.
fields.JP:
そうだ……憎悪だけが切り離され
ナイトメアと化した自分を、君はずっと
本能的に危険だと思い続けているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Your instincts told
you that the manifestation of your
hatred needs to be destroyed.

fields.EN:
With how often we were attacked,
you tried to kill your own self
in desperation.
fields.JP:
事実、僕たちは何度も襲われた……
それが見ていられなくて、赤ずきん、
君は自分を殺したがってるんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how often we were attacked,
you tried to kill your own self
in desperation.

fields.EN:
You're really gonna get it from
me after this, Otsuu...
fields.JP: いくらおつうでも、それは許せないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're really gonna get it from
me after this, Otsuu...

fields.EN:
There's no way I would want
to kill Dad or anyone in Dawn!
fields.JP:
あたしが大好きなお父さんや
黎明のみんなを殺すわけがないでしょっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way I would want
to kill Dad or anyone in Dawn!

fields.EN:
Oh, and may I remind you that
I was almost killed by that
Nightmare over there?!
fields.JP:
それにあたしはそこの
ナイトメアに殺されそうになったことを
はっきりと覚えてる！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and may I remind you that
I was almost killed by that
Nightmare over there?!

fields.EN:
That's because the Nightmare there
doesn't want to be killed.
fields.JP:
それは……ナイトメアの君も
殺されたくはないだろうから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because the Nightmare there
doesn't want to be killed.

fields.EN:
Say, Tsuu? Can you tell me where
Akazukin's hatred of that
Nightmare is coming from?
fields.JP:
ねえ、つう。
赤ずきんがここまでそこのナイトメアを
憎むようになった理由は何かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? Can you tell me where
Red Riding Hood's hatred of that
Nightmare is coming from?

fields.EN:
It's because the professor and
everyone at Dawn was killed.
fields.JP:
それは、博士や黎明のみんなが
殺されたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because the professor and
everyone at Dawn was killed.

fields.EN:
As a result, Akazukin's
hatred manifested and separated
itself from her, yes?
fields.JP:
その結果、赤ずきんは憎悪を切り離して
ナイトメアを産んだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As a result, Red Riding Hood's
hatred manifested and separated
itself from her, yes?

fields.EN:
That's odd. That Nightmare we see
in front of us was the one that
killed the members of Dawn.
fields.JP:
あら、それだとおかしいわね？
博士や黎明の人間を殺したのが、
そもそも、そこのナイトメアなのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's odd. That Nightmare we see
in front of us was the one that
killed the members of Dawn.

fields.EN:
That Nightmare existed before
Akazukin's hatred.
fields.JP:
そう、赤ずきんが憎悪を抱く前から、
そこのナイトメアは存在しているのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Nightmare existed before
Red Riding Hood's hatred.

fields.EN: W-Well, you could be right, but...
fields.LOCALIZED: W-Well, you could be right, but...

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……
おねーちゃんにちゃんと謝って！

fields.EN:
That's fine, Ningyo.
Everyone makes mistakes.
fields.JP:
いいよ人魚……
間違うことは誰にでもある……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine, Mermie.
Everyone makes mistakes.

fields.EN:
But let me be clear, Otsuu...
There are some things you should
never dare say.
fields.JP:
ただね、おつう。
言ってはならない言葉ってのが、
この世にはあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But let me be clear, Otsuu...
There are some things you should
never dare say.

fields.EN:
So you better not say I killed
Dad ever again.
fields.JP:
もう絶対にあたしがお父さんを
殺しただなんて言わないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you better not say I killed
Dad ever again.

fields.EN:
(What a horrible call!
Tch! I failed...!)
fields.JP:
（僕はなんて軽率な推理を……
　くっ……駄目だ、失敗だ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a horrible call!
Tch! I failed...!)

fields.EN:
The Blood Maiden mimic is...
you, Alice...
fields.JP:
核に擬態化されてる血式少女、
それは…………アリス、君だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maiden mimic is...
you, Alice...

fields.JP: え……ちょっと待って……わたし……？

fields.EN:
That's not something to joke about. Even if
it's Otsuu-san, I may get angry depending on
your answer.
fields.JP:
さすがにそれは冗談にならないわ。
いくらおつうさんとはいえ、
返答次第では怒るわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not funny at all. You
better have a good reason
or else.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Alice...
I'm not joking or anything.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、アリス。
僕も冗談でこんなことは言わない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Alice...
I'm not joking or anything.

fields.EN:
Stop it... I was imprisoned with
Jack in the cell area. Otsuu-san,
you know that better than anyone!
fields.JP:
そんなやめてよ……わたしは
ジャックと独房エリアに囚われていた、
それはおつうさんがよく知ってるでしょ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you kidding? You know very
well that I was imprisoned
with Jack!

fields.EN:
If I wasn't human, then there's
no way I would've been kept
in prison with the others!
fields.JP:
擬態化した存在なら……人間じゃないなら、
独房に囚われたりなんてしないはずよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I wasn't human, then there's
no way I would've been kept
in prison with the others!

fields.EN:
You may be right, but that's not
the right timing. You mimicked
her later.
fields.JP:
うん……そうかもね。
だから君が擬態化したのは、
それより後なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be right, but that's not
the right timing. You mimicked
her later.

fields.EN:
To be specific, it was after we
freed Alice and Jack.
fields.JP:
具体的には僕たちがアリスやジャックを
独房から解放した後だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be specific, it was after we
freed Alice and Jack.

fields.EN:
So you're telling me that
it was the real Alice until
we freed them?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、あの時までは
アリスは本物だったってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're telling me that
it was the real Alice until
we freed them?

fields.JP: うん……そういうことだね

fields.EN:
That's a bit harsh of a conclusion
don't you think? That's a hurtful
thing to say...
fields.JP:
ちょっと……決めつけが過ぎるわ……
わたしもさすがに傷つく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a bit harsh of a conclusion
don't you think? That's a hurtful
thing to say...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Alice...
I have solid proof...
fields.JP:
ごめんねアリス……
でも、揺るぎようのない証拠があるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Alice...
I have solid proof...

fields.JP: 証拠なんてあるんですの……？
何なのおつう、その証拠ってやつは……！

fields.EN:
If you have enough evidence to suspect me
that much, then show it to me already,
Otsuu-san...
fields.JP:
そこまでわたしを疑うだけの
証拠があるっていうなら、早く見せてよ
おつうさん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're so sure, show me this
"proof" of yours.

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……
本当にそんな証拠、あるの……？

fields.EN:
Yes, the proof is in front of us,
and has been for a long time
now...
fields.JP:
うん……証拠なら目の前にあるんだ。
それもずっと前から、すぐ近くに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, the proof is in front of us,
and has been for a long time
now...

fields.JP:
みんな、ジャックの
身体を見てくれるかな……
ナイトメア・ジャック

んぎぎ……？
ぼぐ……ぎぃぎ……な……に……？

fields.EN:
(I'm sorry, Jack... I'm going to
bring grief to Alice...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、アリスを悲しませるような
　ことをして、ごめんな……ジャック）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm sorry, Jack... I'm going to
bring grief to Alice...)

fields.EN:
Jack's body has the proof of
Alice being a mimic.
fields.JP:
アリスが擬態化された存在の証拠は、
ジャックの身体にある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's body has the proof of
Alice being a mimic.

fields.EN:
Where on Jack-san is that proof,
Otsuu-chan...?
fields.JP:
ジャックさんのどこに
証拠があるというの、おつうちゃん……？

fields.EN:
The proof that Alice is a mimic
is...
fields.JP:
アリスが擬態化された存在、
その証拠がある場所は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The proof that Alice is a mimic
is...

fields.JP: その証拠がある場所は……
その証拠がある場所は……

fields.EN:
The proof that Alice is a mimic
is... right over here.
fields.JP:
アリスが擬態化された存在、
その証拠がある場所は……ここだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The proof that Alice is a mimic
is... right over here.

fields.EN: Hey, Jack, is there something there?
fields.JP:
ねえねえ、じゃっくの
そのばしょになにかあるのー？

fields.EN:
This small scar you see here is
proof that Alice is a mimic.
fields.JP:
うん、この部分こそがアリスが
擬態化された存在だっていう証拠だよ。
ほら、ここに小さな傷があるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This small scar you see here is
proof that Alice is a mimic.

fields.EN:
Uh, Otsuu? How in the world
is that supposed to be proof?
fields.JP:
ねえおつう、その傷が
いったいどう証拠になるっていうのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, Otsuu? How in the world
is that supposed to be proof?

fields.JP: だからジャックのこの傷こそ……

fields.EN:
I know you've been going through
a lot recently, but I didn't think
it'd be this bad...
fields.JP:
最近、根詰めすぎてたとは思ったけど、
ここまでとは思わなかったな……
