fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you've been going through
a lot recently, but I didn't think
it'd be this bad...

fields.EN:
So, what are you trying to tell
us, Otsuu-san?
fields.JP:
ねえ……いったいどういうこと、
おつうさん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what are you trying to tell
us, Otsuu?

fields.JP: どこが証拠よ、馬鹿馬鹿しい……！

fields.EN:
Urh... I'm sorry...
Something must've gotten to me...
fields.JP:
う……ごめん……
ちょっとどうかしてたよ、僕……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urh... I'm sorry...
Something must've gotten to me...

fields.EN:
(What am I doing?!
This isn't solving anything!)
fields.JP:
（何をやってるんだ、僕は……
　推理にもなってないじゃないか……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What am I doing?!
This isn't solving anything!)

fields.EN: I'm done with hearing you, Otsuu.
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm done with hearing you, Otsuu.

fields.JP: そんな、待ってくれ赤ずきん！
もう黙ってろって言ってんのよっ！！
そんなもん食らうかぁっ！

fields.EN:
You destroyed the core while dodging its
attack? As expected of you, Akazukin!
I'll join in!
fields.JP:
攻撃を避けながら核を
破壊するとは、さすがは赤ずきん……！
どれ、ワレも加勢するぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She destroyed the core, while
avoiding its attack? Well done!
I will join now!

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！
ジェイルが鳴いてます……！

fields.EN:
That means we can fight that
Nightmare now!
fields.JP:
じゃあこれであのナイトメアとも
ちゃんと戦えるってわけね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means we can fight that
Nightmare now!

fields.EN:
Tch...!
I couldn't stop the fight!
fields.JP: くっ……止められなかった……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch...!
I couldn't stop the fight!

fields.JP: こうなったら仕方ないよ、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
Onee-chan destroyed the core for us,
so let's just get rid of that
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
幸いにもおねーちゃんが
核を破壊してくれた。だから
あの謎のナイトメアをやっつけよう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis destroyed the core for us,
so let's just get rid of that
Nightmare.

fields.JP: でも……あのナイトメアは……

しね……しね……んぎぎ……ぎがが……
んちちち……んぎぎぎぃぃぃぃぃぃっ！！

fields.EN:
(It's no use! It lost any sanity
it had with the destruction of
the core!)
fields.JP:
（駄目だ、核が破壊されて
　完全に我を失っている……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's no use! It lost any sanity
it had with the destruction of
the core!)

fields.EN:
What are you doing, Otsuu?!
Hurry and join us!
fields.JP:
何をやっているのだおつう！
早く加勢せぬか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing, Otsuu?!
Hurry and join us!

fields.JP: さ、行こうおつうちゃん！

fields.EN:
We'll defeat it, and survive
through this together, Princess!
fields.JP:
うん、こうなったら倒して
絶対に生き延びよう、姫！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll defeat it, and survive
through this together, Princess!

fields.JP: でもこれで終わったね……

ぎごご……が……んぎぎぃぃ……
ぎきぃぃぃぃぃぃぃぃぃぃ……
すっごく、くるしんでる……

fields.EN:
The destruction of the core
must be affecting it...
fields.JP:
やはり核を破壊したことが
響いているのでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The destruction of the core
must be affecting it...

fields.JP: そうかもしれませんわね……

何だっていいよ……
さあ、トドメを刺してやる……

fields.EN:
I'll finally avenge the death
of Dad and everyone at Dawn!
fields.JP:
お父さんの……黎明のみんなの仇、
今こそ取らせてもらう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll finally avenge the death
of Dad and everyone at Dawn!

fields.JP:
ぎぎぎ…………
ぎぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！

そんな……！
まだ動けるんですか……！？

fields.EN:
It's definitely at
the brink of death.
fields.JP: いえ、瀕死なのは間違いないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's definitely at
the brink of death.

fields.EN:
Like a candle about to burn out,
it's trying to muster its last
remaining strength.
fields.JP:
あれは、燃え尽きる寸前のロウソクよ。
最後に命の火を激しく燃やそうとしている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like a candle about to burn out,
it's trying to muster its last
remaining strength.

fields.JP: あっ！　逃げましたわ！

fields.EN:
Urgh!
I can't get myself to run...!
fields.JP: ぐぬっ……足に力が入らぬ…………！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh!
I can't get myself to run...!

fields.EN:
I can't believe how fast it's
running...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe how fast it's
running...

fields.EN:
(We need to finish it off...
But, everyone is at their limit.)
fields.JP:
（ここまで来たんだ、倒しきらないと……。
　でも、みんな疲労が限界だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We need to finish it off...
But, everyone is at their limit.)

fields.EN:
I'm not gonna let it get away
after we got this far!
fields.JP:
ここまで追い詰めたのにトドメが
刺せないなんて、そんなの……っ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not gonna let it get away
after we got this far!

fields.EN:
(But...
I can barely keep myself up...)
fields.JP:
（でも僕も……
　もう立っているので精一杯だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But...
I can barely keep myself up...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack may be able to get
that Nightmare!
fields.JP:
そうか、ジャックなら
あのナイトメアに追いつけるかも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack may be able to get
that Nightmare!

fields.EN:
No! Don't go, Jack!
You're in just as bad of 
a shape as us!
fields.JP:
駄目……っ！　ジャック行かないで、
あなただってボロボロなのよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Don't go, Jack!
You're in just as bad of 
a shape as us!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎぎ……あ゛……り゛ず……
……お゛い……がげる……んぎぎぎ……

ジャック……いい、から……
追い……かけなく……て……うっ

fields.EN:
Alice-san?!
Get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP:
アリスさん！？
しっかりしてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice?!
Get a hold of yourself!

fields.EN:
Don't worry. It looks like
she just lost consciousness.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. It looks like
she just lost consciousness.

fields.JP: じゃっく、いっちゃったね……

fields.EN:
I suppose we should place our
trust in Jack now...
Isn't that right, Akazukin?
fields.JP:
そうだな。こうなれば、
あとはジャックに任せようではないか……
……なあ、赤ずきん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we should place our
trust in Jack now...
Isn't that right, Red Riding Hood?

fields.EN: Not that I have a choice...
fields.LOCALIZED: Not that I have a choice...

fields.EN:
How is everyone?
Is anyone hurt badly?
fields.JP:
みんな、傷の具合はどう？
動けないって人はいる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How is everyone?
Is anyone hurt badly?

fields.EN:
Besides Alice-san, I think everyone
is fine.
fields.JP:
アリスさん以外、
みんな大丈夫みたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides Alice, I think everyone
is fine.

fields.JP: おつうよ、これで終わったのか……？

fields.EN:
We destroyed all the cores known.
We should be able to escape...
fields.JP:
ここまでの核はすべて破壊したね。
だからもしかしたら脱獄でき――
fields.LOCALIZED:
We destroyed all the cores known.
We should be able to escape...

fields.EN:
Is it because we destroyed that
core? Or maybe it has something
to do with that Nightmare...
fields.JP:
核を破壊したせいなのかしら？
それともさっきのナイトメア
が逃げたことで何かが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it because we destroyed that
core? Or maybe it has something
to do with that Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Then explain it properly
so even I can understand!
fields.JP:
だから、ワレにも分かるように
ちゃんと説明するのだ！

fields.EN:
It seems as if the tower is
starting to crumble.
fields.JP: どうやら監獄塔が崩壊し始めてるようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if the tower is
starting to crumble.

fields.JP: なっ、なんだとーーーーっ！？
こ、これは急いで脱出した方が……

fields.EN:
Y-You're right! At this rate,
we're all going to die!
fields.JP:
そ、そうね。早くしないと
わたしたち全員潰されるわよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're right! At this rate,
we're all going to die!

fields.JP: アリスは……ボクが、背負う……！
ネムちゃん、白雪も手伝いますっ！

fields.EN:
Let's get going.
I remember our path out,
so let me lead the way.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ行きましょうか。
道は覚えてるからついてきて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's get going.
I remember our path out,
so let me lead the way.

fields.EN:
Go on ahead of me...
I'll wait for Jack to return.
fields.JP:
……先に行ってくれ、みんな。
僕はここに残ってジャックを待つよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go on ahead of me...
I'll wait for Jack to return.

fields.EN:
Me too. I can't leave here,
especially when there's no one
around for Jack-san to return to.
fields.JP:
わたしも。ジャックさんと落ち合う場所を
決めてない以上、離れられないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too. I can't leave here,
especially when there's no one
around for Jack to return to.

fields.EN:
Are you kidding?!
This place could fall any moment!
fields.JP:
そうは言っても、
いつ崩落してもおかしくないんですよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you kidding?!
This place could fall any moment!

fields.EN:
C'mon, let's get out of here!
You'll both die if you stay here!
fields.JP:
ほら、もう危険よ！！
ここにいたら確実に死ぬわよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, let's get out of here!
You'll both die if you stay here!

fields.EN: But I can't leave Jack-san alone!
fields.JP:
でもジャックさんを
一人にするなんてできないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: But I can't leave Jack alone!

fields.EN:
I'm sure he'll return,
so I'll stay behind!
fields.JP:
きっと戻ってくる。
だから僕はそれを信じて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure he'll return,
so I'll stay behind!

fields.EN:
Hell no!
I'm taking you both, even if it
means dragging you!
fields.JP: 駄目、脱出するよ、２人とも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hell no!
I'm taking you both, even if it
means dragging you!

fields.EN:
You two are always telling me not to
overdo it, but you're the ones overdoing it?!
fields.JP:
二人とも、あたしにずっと
『無茶しないで』って言っといて、
自分たちだけは無茶するの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like you both had the gall telling
me to stay calm! Look at you!

fields.EN:
I won't let you both stay!
We're escaping from here alive...
All of us!
fields.JP:
絶対に待つことは認めない。
みんなで生きて脱獄するんでしょ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't let you both stay!
We're escaping from here alive...
All of us!

fields.EN:
Shirayuki doesn't want to leave
Jack-san behind too, but we need to
trust him, and make our escape.
fields.JP:
白雪たちだって、つらいです。
でも……ジャックさんを信じて、
今は脱出を選択するんですよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White doesn't want to leave
Jack behind too, but we need to
trust him, and make our escape.

fields.EN:
I'm sure we'll meet him again.
If you want to trust him, trust
that he'll meet you again!
fields.JP:
ジャックとはきっと再会できる。
信じるならそれを信じなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we'll meet him again.
If you want to trust him, trust
that he'll meet you again!

fields.EN:
Yes, I'll place my trust on him,
and make our escape.
Thank you, everyone...
fields.JP:
うん。ジャックを信じて、今は脱出する。
みんな、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'll place my trust on him,
and make our escape.
Thank you, everyone...

fields.EN:
Th-This place won't last much
longer!
fields.JP: わわ、もう持たないですわよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-This place won't last much
longer!

fields.EN:
I presume we only have a few
moments to spare. Now, this way.
fields.JP:
もう待たないわよ？
さあこっちよ、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I presume we only have a few
moments to spare. Now, this way.

fields.EN:
(I'm trusting you that we'll meet
again, Jack!)
fields.JP:
（ジャック……絶対に会えるって
　信じてるからな……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm trusting you that we'll meet
again, Jack!)

fields.EN:
Who would've thought that the
Jail Tower would crumble like
that...
fields.JP:
まさか監獄塔が
完全に崩れ去るとはな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who would've thought that the
Jail Tower would crumble like
that...

fields.JP: みんな間一髪、だったわね
なんにもなくなっちゃった……

fields.EN:
We were in there just a moment
ago, weren't we?
fields.JP:
さっきまであそこに……
いたんですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were in there just a moment
ago, weren't we?

fields.EN:
I can't believe we're still alive
after all that...
fields.JP:
自分が生きてるのが
信じられないですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe we're still alive
after all that...

fields.EN: I'm glad we made it out...
fields.JP: ほんと脱出できてよかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad we made it out...

fields.EN:
But, with the tower gone,
what shall we do about our
escape from here?
fields.JP:
でも監獄塔から
脱獄するはずでしたのに……
それがもうないとなると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, with the tower gone,
what shall we do about our
escape from here?

fields.EN:
Does this mean our hope to
escape is gone for good?
fields.JP:
これでもうわたしたちの
希望は潰えちゃったのかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does this mean our hope to
escape is gone for good?

fields.EN:
What are you saying?
Of course we have hope.
fields.JP:
何を言っておる、貴様ら。
これからではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying?
Of course we have hope.

fields.EN:
She's right. After all, we are
still alive.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、これからだよ。
だって僕たちはまだ生きてるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. After all, we are
still alive.

fields.JP:
ここは……？
え、監獄塔の外……？
そうですよ、アリスさん

ねえ、ジャックは！？
ジャックはどこ！？

fields.EN:
It's fine, Alice.
We'll meet Jack again.
fields.JP:
……大丈夫だよ、アリス。
ジャックとはまた再会できるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine, Alice.
We'll meet Jack again.

fields.JP:
はーいみんな、
みちるについてきてねーーー

fields.EN:
Whew, Oohime-san, if you hadn't
noticed me, I'd have been flattened!
fields.JP:
いやー大陽女さんが気づいてくれなかったら
自分、ぺしゃんこだったっすよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ya know boss, if you didn't find
me I would've been pancake!

fields.JP: あっ！　ミチル、くらら！！

fields.EN:
It looks like everyone at the
Order made it out!
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団のみなさんも
無事だったんですね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like everyone at the
Order made it out!

fields.EN:
So long as we're alive
hope is on our side.
fields.JP:
生きていれば、
こうして希望はあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So long as we're alive
hope is on our side.

fields.EN:
That's why I'm sure we can
meet up with them again,
and find a way to escape.
fields.JP:
だから再会だって、
脱獄だって絶対にできるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I'm sure we can
meet up with them again,
and find a way to escape.

fields.EN:
The proof that Alice is a mimic
is... right over here.
fields.JP:
アリスが擬態化された存在、
その証拠がある場所は……ここだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The proof that Alice is a mimic
is... right over here.

fields.EN:
Jack-san's right hand?
Are you referring to that
hairpin?
fields.JP:
ジャックさんの右手……？
もしかして、その飾りですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's right hand?
Are you referring to that
hairpin?

fields.JP: うん。これこそが証拠だ

fields.EN:
It's a very special hairpin that
Jack got from Alice when he
was still human.
fields.JP:
ジャックがまだ人間だった頃に、
アリスから預かった大事な髪飾りだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a very special hairpin that
Jack got from Alice when he
was still human.

fields.EN:
When he turned into a Nightmare
the hairpin melded into his body.
fields.JP:
そしてナイトメアになる時に一緒に
取り込まれて……こうして移植されたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When he turned into a Nightmare
the hairpin melded into his body.

fields.EN:
I remember now...
Alice-san told Jack-san...
fields.JP:
わたしも思い出した……
アリスさんは、気絶したジャックさんに
こう言ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember now...
Alice told Jack...

fields.JP: 「髪飾りを預かっていて」って

fields.EN:
I see... Come to think of it,
it sure looks similar to Alice's
hairpin.
fields.JP:
なるほど、そういう経緯であったか。
言われてみれば確かにアリスの髪飾りと
そっくりであるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Come to think of it,
it sure looks similar to Alice's
hairpin.

fields.EN:
That's the point. Jack has Alice's
hairpin on him.
fields.JP:
そう……問題はそこなんだ
アリスの髪飾りはジャックが持っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the point. Jack has Alice's
hairpin on him.

fields.EN:
Which means, Alice, it's strange
that you're wearing your hairpin right now...
fields.JP:
ということはアリス、
君が今、髪飾りをつけているのは
どう考えてもおかしいんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that it's strange
that Alice has her hairpin on her.

fields.EN:
Huh? But, I had it with me
all along...
fields.JP:
え……？　でもわたし、
本当にずっとつけていたもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But, I had it with me
all along...

fields.EN:
You had it since you awakened
inside the tower, correct?
fields.JP:
監獄塔で目覚めた時から、
ずっとつけているのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You had it since you awakened
inside the tower, correct?

fields.EN:
That's right. There's no way
I would take my precious hairpin
that I got from Jack off me.
fields.JP:
そ、そうよ。ジャックにもらった大事な
髪飾りだもの、肌身離さずつけているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. There's no way
I would take my precious hairpin
that I got from Jack off me.

fields.EN:
If so, that would make matters
odd as there are two hairpins
here in front of us.
fields.JP:
だとするとおかしいわね？
まったく同じデザインの髪飾りが
２つあることになってしまうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, that would make matters
odd as there are two hairpins
here in front of us.

fields.EN:
Or, are you going to tell me that
you got it while in Blood Skelter.
One with the same design to boot.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化してる間に
同じデザインの髪飾りを手に入れた、
とでも言うつもりかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or, are you going to tell me that
you got it while in Blood Skelter.
One with the same design to boot.

fields.EN:
We know accessories can be
mimicked. It was the same back
when Cinderella was mimicked.
fields.JP:
こうしたアクセサリーも
一緒に擬態化できるということは、
シンデレラの時で分かっている
fields.LOCALIZED:
We know accessories can be
mimicked. It was the same back
when Cinderella was mimicked.

fields.EN:
That's right... I do recall the
fake having the same pendant
as me.
fields.JP:
確かに……ニセモノも
わたしと同じペンダントを持っていましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right... I do recall the
fake having the same pendant
as me.

fields.EN:
Wait... Are you telling me that
my hairpin is fake?
fields.JP:
そんな……わたしの髪飾りが
ニセモノだって言うの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Are you telling me that
my hairpin is fake?

fields.EN:
No... I'm saying that you yourself
are a fake.
fields.JP:
違うわアリス。あなたも含めて
ニセモノだって言ってるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... I'm saying that you yourself
are a fake.

fields.JP:
ちょっとグレーテル、
言い方ってもんがあるでしょ

fields.EN:
In any case, it isn't possible for
the true Alice to have the hairpin
with her.
fields.JP:
まあとにかく……アリスが髪飾りを
してるってのは、本来あり得ないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, it isn't possible for
the true Alice to have the hairpin
with her.

fields.EN:
Which means that you're actually
a mimic created from a core,
Alice.
fields.JP:
だからアリス、
君は核に擬態化された存在なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that you're actually
a mimic created from a core,
Alice.

fields.EN:
But...
This can't be... I'm... I'm...
fields.JP:
そん……な……
嘘だわ……わたしはわたしよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...
This can't be... I'm... I'm...

fields.EN:
Okay, so we know that the Alice
here is a fake...
fields.JP:
……なるほど、アリスが擬態化された
存在だってのはあたしも分かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, so we know that the Alice
here is a fake...

fields.EN:
So, why does that make that lowly
Nightmare there Alice?!
fields.JP:
で、それだとどうして
そこのクソナイトメアが本物の
アリスだってことになるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, why does that make that lowly
Nightmare there Alice?!

fields.EN:
I don't want to even imagine this,
but...
fields.JP: 考えたくもない話なんだけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to even imagine this,
but...

fields.EN:
What if... What if I accidentally
killed Princess?
fields.JP:
……もしもさ、もしも僕が姫を
何かの間違いで殺めてしまったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if... What if I accidentally
killed Princess?

fields.EN:
I would try to get rid of reality.
I would want to destroy everything
in this world...
fields.JP:
……僕は、そんな事実を取り消したくなる。
この世界をぜんぶ壊してしまってでもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would try to get rid of reality.
I would want to destroy everything
in this world...

fields.EN:
The person who hurt Jack back then
was Alice who was in her Blood
Skelter state.
fields.JP:
あの時ブラッドスケルター化したアリスは、
人間だったジャックを斬りつけた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The person who hurt Jack back then
was Alice who was in her Blood
Skelter state.

fields.JP: わたしが……ジャックを傷つけた……！？

fields.EN:
The real Alice probably thought to
herself that she killed Jack.
fields.JP:
本物のアリスはおそらく、その時に
ジャックを殺してしまったと思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The real Alice probably thought to
herself that she killed Jack.

fields.EN:
She probably wanted to somehow
alter the reality that she killed
Jack by wishing upon a core.
fields.JP:
その『殺した』という事実を
どうにか書き換えたくて、それで核に
願ったんだと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She probably wanted to somehow
alter the reality that she killed
Jack by wishing upon a core.

fields.EN:
She may have wished to return
back to herself before she
harmed Jack...
fields.JP:
『ジャックを傷つける前の
　自分に戻りたい』ってね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She may have wished to return
back to herself before she
harmed Jack...

fields.EN:
But, she knew well enough that
she can't get rid of the fact that
she killed Jack...
fields.JP:
でも同時に『殺した』という事実が
覆らないことも理解しているから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she knew well enough that
she can't get rid of the fact that
she killed Jack...

fields.EN:
So she wished for the end to
this world, and... turned into
a Nightmare...
fields.JP:
だから『ジャックがいないこの世界を
滅ぼしてしまいたい』とも願って……
自らがナイトメアになったんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
So she wished for the end to
this world, and... turned into
a Nightmare...

fields.EN:
The Nightmare... No... Nightmare
Alice began to wreak destruction
to all.
fields.JP:
そのせいで敵も味方も関係なく、そこの
ナイトメア……いや、ナイトメア・アリスは
破壊の限りを尽くしていたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare... No... Nightmare
Alice began to wreak destruction
to all.

fields.EN:
It is true that the Nightmare here
can be called an amalgamation
of hatred itself.
fields.JP:
確かに、そこのナイトメアは
憎悪のかたまりと表現するのが
正しそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is true that the Nightmare here
can be called an amalgamation
of hatred itself.

fields.EN:
But there was one thing Nightmare
Alice wouldn't do...
fields.JP:
でも、ナイトメア・アリスにも
手が出せないものがあったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there was one thing Nightmare
Alice wouldn't do...

fields.EN:
Humans, Marchens, Nightmares... We've seen
her run away several times, even though
she keeps killing every living thing.
fields.JP:
人間、メルヒェン、ナイトメア……
生きているものすべてを殺し続ける彼女が
逃げる場面を、僕たちは何度か見ている
fields.LOCALIZED:
She destroyed all that came within
her sight, but she ran from us
many times...

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, we kept
meeting the Nightmare, but it
always ran away...
fields.JP:
そういえば……わたしたちは何度も
遭遇してきたけど、結局いつもナイトメアが
逃げていったんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, we kept
meeting the Nightmare, but it
always ran away...

fields.EN:
So you're saying it ran away
because Jack-san was around?
fields.JP:
それはすべて、ジャックさんが
いたからってことなの……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're saying it ran away
because Jack was around?

fields.EN:
That's right. Nightmare Alice ran
away when she saw Jack.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、姫。
ナイトメア・アリスが逃げるのは、
いつもジャックと出会った時だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Nightmare Alice ran
away when she saw Jack.

fields.EN:
Do you remember when we split
out party into two?
fields.JP:
前に二手に分かれて
探索したことがあっただろう？
その時だって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you remember when we split
out party into two?

fields.EN:
Ah... The Nightmare ran away
the moment Jack-san arrived!
fields.JP:
あ……っ！　ジャックさんが
駆けつけた瞬間にナイトメアは
逃げていった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... The Nightmare ran away
the moment Jack arrived!

fields.EN:
Nightmare Alice was scared...
Scared that she would harm
Jack again.
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・アリスは恐れていたんだ。
自分がまたジャックを傷つけることを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Alice was scared...
Scared that she would harm
Jack again.

fields.EN:
I can only assume whatever
residual sanity she had left
made her run.
fields.JP:
きっと、彼女のわずかに残った理性が、
そうさせていたんだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only assume whatever
residual sanity she had left
made her run.

fields.JP: でも、ナイトメアは同種を殺さないわ

fields.EN:
It could be possible it didn't
attack Jack because he's a
Nightmare...
fields.JP:
ジャックがナイトメアだから、
同じナイトメアを攻撃できなかった
っていう可能性だって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could be possible it didn't
attack Jack because he's a
Nightmare...

fields.EN: Have you forgotten who killed Hansel-niisan?
fields.JP:
あなたはヘンゼル兄さんが
誰に殺されたのか、忘れたのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
May I remind you who killed
my brother Hansel?

fields.EN:
Tsuu, assuming your theory is
correct, what are you going to do?
fields.JP:
つう、あなたの仮説が正しいとして、
どうするつもりなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, assuming your theory is
correct, what are you going to do?

fields.EN:
I assume you're not going to
let it get away.
fields.JP:
まさか、このまま見逃してあげよう
なんて言い出すわけじゃないでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume you're not going to
let it get away.

fields.EN:
I think Jack might be able
to persuade Nightmare Alice.
fields.JP:
僕は、ジャックがナイトメア・アリスを
説得できるんじゃないかと思っているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I can communicate with
Nightmare Alice.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

んぎぎ……あ゛り゛……ず……？
……どっぢ……ぎぃ……どっ……ぢ……？
ナイトメア・ジャック

んぎぎぎ……わがら……な……
んぎぃぃぃぃぃっ……！

fields.EN:
Calm down, Jack...
What's causing you to...
fields.JP:
落ち着けジャック、
何がそんなに苦しいって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Jack...
What's causing you to...

fields.EN:
(Shoot...! I can feel Jack's
suffering flowing into me...)
fields.JP:
（しまった……ジャックの苦しいって
　感覚が僕にも流れ込んできて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot...! I can feel Jack's
suffering flowing into me...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

んぎごご……あ゛り゛ず……
あ゛……り゛す……！
ジャック、落ち着け……落ちつくんだ……！

fields.EN:
The Nightmare is heading
towards Jack-san!
fields.JP: ナイトメアがジャックさんの元に……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare is heading
towards Jack!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

じゃっ……く……
ぎぎ……じゃっく……じゃっく！

fields.EN:
Huh? Why are you turning your back on us?
You think you can fool us with that fake
act and escape, you damn Nightmare?!
fields.JP:
は、なに背中向けてんの？
嘘の演技であたしたちから逃れようって
つもりかクソナイトメアぁっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Trying to use the situation
to your good, eh? You aren't
getting away so easily!

fields.JP: なっ……！　どうして避けないっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?!
Why didn't you guard yourself?!

fields.EN:
Is it worried about Jack-san to the
point that it doesn't care about
what's happening around it?
fields.JP:
自分のことなんかどうでもいいくらい、
ジャックさんのことを心配してるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it worried about Jack to the
point that it doesn't care about
what's happening around it?

fields.EN:
Jack... gh...et... a...
hollld... Ggh... I...m...
Ggh... Hhee...re...
fields.JP:
じゃっく……じっがり……じ……
で……わだ……し……ぎぎ……ごごに……
……ぎぎ……い……るよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... gh...et... a...
hollld... Ggh... I...m...
Ggh... Hhee...re...

fields.JP: この強い想いは……まさしく……
ありすがふたりいるみたい……

fields.EN:
That just makes it harder to
refute Otsuu's theory now.
fields.JP: これで信憑性が増したわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That just makes it harder to
refute Otsuu's theory now.

fields.EN:
It's hard to believe, but seeing
what's happening here...
fields.JP:
認めたくはないですが……
この姿を見せつけられると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's hard to believe, but seeing
what's happening here...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

どっ……ぢ……？
ぎぎぎ……ぼぐ……どっぢ……
まも……る……？

fields.EN:
(Tch... Jack's in a state of panic
because there's two of her
here...!)
fields.JP:
（くっ、アリスが２人いるから、
　ジャックの奴パニック状態なんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Tch... Jack's in a state of panic
because there's two of her
here...!)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎ……ぎぃぎ……
わがら……ない……わが……ら……

fields.EN:
No... Don't succumb to the
core, Jack!
fields.JP:
駄目っ……核に身を
委ねちゃ駄目よ、ジャックっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... Don't succumb to the
core, Jack!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
んぎぃぃぃぃぃぃぃっ！！

fields.EN:
Alice! Look at you!
Hurry, lick my blood!
fields.JP:
アリス酷い顔色じゃないか！
さあ、僕の血を舐めるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice! Look at you!
Hurry, lick my blood!

fields.EN:
B-But Jack...
I'm just a burden to you...
fields.JP: で、でもまたジャックに迷惑を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But Jack...
I'm just a burden to you...

fields.JP: そんなことないよ！　ほら早く！
ナイトメア・ジャック
やっと起きたか、ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack really does sleep a lot.
Looks like he was dreaming again, too.
fields.JP:
本当にジャックはよく寝るなぁ。
また夢を見ていたみたいだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must've been some dream.
You were really deep in sleep.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

んぎぎ……ぼぐど……
おばなし…………？

fields.EN:
Jack, I would love to learn
more about you...
fields.JP:
ええそうよ。
ジャックの生まれた時のこととか、
色々と知りたいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, I would love to learn
more about you...

fields.EN:
So, why don't we "speak?"
Come now...
fields.JP:
だからね、お話ししましょう？
ほら……ほら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, why don't we "speak?"
Come now...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぼぐ……ぼぐ……
……ぐぎご……ごわい……

やめてくれグレーテル！
ジャックが怯えている！！

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Jack-san...
There's nothing to be afraid of...
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、大丈夫ですからね……
何も怖いことなんてありませんから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Jack...
There's nothing to be afraid of...

fields.EN:
JACK... PROTECT EVERYONE...
GRETEL... IN PLACE... OF ME...
fields.JP:
ジャック……ボクノカワリニ……
グレーテル、ト……ミンナヲ……
マモッテ……ホシイ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
JACK... PROTECT EVERYONE...
GRETEL... IN PLACE... OF ME...

fields.JP: ジャック……ボクノカワリニ……
ミンナヲ……マモッテ……ホシイ……
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Ggh... Pro...tekkkt...
Bboth... Ggh...
Ppprt...kt... bh...th...
fields.JP:
ぎちち……どっぢ……も……
どっ……ぢも……ぎぃぃ…………
……まも……ら……なぎゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ggh... Pro...tekkkt...
Bboth... Ggh...
Ppprt...kt... bh...th...

fields.EN:
Jack-san suddenly jumped towards
the core...
fields.JP: ジャックさんが突然核に飛び込んで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack suddenly jumped towards
the core...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ジャック……本当にジャックなの……

fields.EN:
Jack?!
He fused with Nightmare Alice?!
fields.JP:
ジャック……まさかナイトメア・アリスと
融合したのか……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack?!
He fused with Nightmare Alice?!

fields.EN:
It looks like he wished upon the
core to protect Alice.
fields.JP:
どうやらアリスと同じように、
ジャックも核に願ったようね。
『アリスを守りたい』と
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like he wished upon the
core to protect Alice.

fields.EN:
Wait...
Is that why he fused with Alice?!
fields.JP:
その結果が……
このアリスとひとつになった姿なの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...
Is that why he fused with Alice?!

fields.EN:
Not only that, but it looks like
the core was fused together, too.
fields.JP: それどころか、核も取り込んでいるみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only that, but it looks like
the core was fused together, too.

fields.EN:
That means we can't destroy the
core!
fields.JP: それじゃあ……壊せないじゃないですか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means we can't destroy the
core!

fields.EN:
You could also say that he
absorbed the Nightmare's
weakness inside him.
fields.JP:
逆に言えば、弱点を自ら身体に
取り込んだとも言えるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could also say that he
absorbed the Nightmare's
weakness inside him.

fields.EN:
I suppose that just means we
need to cut him down to reach
the core...
fields.JP:
そうだな、ぶった切ればいい……
そういうことであるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that just means we
need to cut him down to reach
the core...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック＆アリス

あ゛り゛……ず……は……
ぼぐが…………まぼる……！
ぎぎぃぃぃぃぃぃあぁぁぁぁぁっ！！

fields.EN: His voice is laced with hatred!
fields.JP: なんて憎悪に溢れた声ですか……！
fields.LOCALIZED: His voice is laced with hatred!

fields.JP: ジャックが……ジャックが……！

fields.EN:
Hm? There's something next
to it...
fields.JP:
ん？　傍らに
もう一体転がっておるぞ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? There's something next
to it...

fields.JP: あれは……人間のジャック！？

fields.EN:
I...
I need to protect everyone!
fields.JP:
ぼ……くは……
みん……な……まもる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I...
I need to protect everyone!

fields.EN:
It seems Jack made two wishes as
well. And those two contradictory
wishes split Jack into two...
fields.JP:
ジャックもまた２つ願ったようね。
そして、矛盾する２つの願いが、
ジャックを二人に分離した……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like he had conflicting
wishes, which led to the
separation we're seeing here.

fields.EN:
Which means this Jack is the
Jack that wants to protect
everyone...
fields.JP:
こちらのジャックは人間として、
『みんなを守りたい』と願ったジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means this Jack is the
Jack that wants to protect
everyone...

fields.EN:
And that Jack-san only wished to
stay by Alice-san's side, so he
fused with her Nightmare form...
fields.JP:
そして、あちらはただアリスさんの側に
いることを願ったジャックさん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And the Jack that wanted to
protect Alice fused with her
Nightmare form...

fields.EN:
(I can feel your unwavering will,
Jack...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、伝わってくるよジャック。
　君の強い意志が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can feel your unwavering will,
Jack...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック＆アリス

fields.EN:
Ggh... Ddie...!
Ttea...szze... Aahll...izz...
Sooo... aahlll... dddie...!
fields.JP:
ぎぎぎ……し……ね……
……あ゛り゛ず……いじ……ぐぎぃぃ……
める……やづは……じ……ね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ggh... Ddie...!
Ttea...szze... Aahll...izz...
Sooo... aahlll... dddie...!

fields.EN:
Simply amazing, Jack...
You're protecting everything you
want by dividing yourself in two.
fields.JP:
ジャック……きみはすごいな。
自分を２つに引き裂いてでも、
すべてを守ろうとするんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Simply amazing, Jack...
You're protecting everything you
want by dividing yourself in two.

fields.EN:
Nightmare Jack fused with Nightmare
Alice to protect her, and now
he's trying to eliminate us.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアのジャックは、
ナイトメア・アリスを守るために融合し、
私たちを排除しようとしているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Jack fused with
Nightmare Alice to kill us.

fields.EN:
The human form Jack was born
to protect us all.
fields.JP:
そして人間型のジャックは、
私たちみんなを守るために生まれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
The human form Jack was born
to protect us all.

fields.EN:
I don't think it's hard to see
who we should back-up.
fields.JP: どちらと戦うべきかは一目瞭然ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think it's hard to see
who we should back-up.

fields.EN:
But... But...!
That's both Jack-san and Alice-san there!
fields.JP:
でも……！　でも……！
あれは……あそこにいるのは、
ジャックさんとアリスさんなんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... But...!
That's both Jack and Alice there!

fields.EN:
You're right, but... that's why
we need to fight them...
fields.JP:
姫の言う通りだ。
でも、だからこそ戦うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right, but... that's why
we need to fight them...

fields.EN:
Jack refused to give up either living
or protecting someone precious to
him. So I won't give up either.
fields.JP:
生きること、大切な人を守ること、
ジャックはどちらも諦めなかった
だから僕も諦めない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack didn't give up hope trying
to protect his loved one and
everyone, so we can't give up too!

fields.EN:
Jack! Alice! I will take up arms
if you intend on harming Princess
and everyone here!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　アリス！　君たちが、
姫を、仲間たちを傷つけようとするなら、
僕は戦う！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Alice! I will take up arms
if you intend on harming Princess
and everyone here!

fields.EN: I see... Now I get it.
fields.JP: なるほどね……分かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... Now I get it.

fields.JP: ジャックめ、やるではないか……！
そんな……どうしてこんなことに……

fields.EN:
Prepare yourself, Ningyohime.
We need to keep moving, even
at the loss of something precious.
fields.JP:
覚悟を決めなさい、人魚姫。
結局、私たちは何かを諦めながら
それでも前に進むしかないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Prepare yourself, Little Mermaid.
We need to keep moving, even
at the loss of something precious.

fields.EN:
This can't be happening...
Are you... Jack?
fields.JP:
嘘よ……どういうことなの……
本当にジャックなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This can't be happening...
Are you... Jack?

fields.EN:
But... there's no way I can hold
your hand like this!
fields.JP:
でもっ、でもっ、手を差し伸べられても、
わたし取るなんてできないわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... there's no way I can hold
your hand like this!

fields.EN:
I was the one who sent you to
the brink of death!
fields.JP:
だってジャックを瀕死にさせたの、
わたしだって聞いたもの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was the one who sent you to
the brink of death!

fields.JP: それにわたし、ニセモノだし……！！

ジャック……
どうしてそこまで……

fields.EN:
I want to protect you...
No... I will protect you...
fields.JP:
こんど……こそ、まもり……たい……
……いいや……まも……る……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to protect you...
No... I will protect you...

fields.EN:
I forgot how stubborn you can
be...
fields.JP:
……もう、ジャックってば
ほんとこういう時は強引なんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I forgot how stubborn you can
be...

fields.EN:
You're right...
Whatever the case...
I will protect you...
fields.JP:
そう……かも……
とに…………かく……まもる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
Whatever the case...
I will protect you...

fields.EN:
I don't care who I really am now!
I'm going to fight to protect Jack
and everyone here!
fields.JP:
もう自分が何者かとか、そんなの
どうでもいいわ！　わたしはここにいる
ジャックとみんなを守るっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't care who I really am now!
I'm going to fight to protect Jack
and everyone here!

fields.EN:
All right, everyone, get ready!
There's no longer any room to
persuade that Nightmare! So—
fields.JP:
よし、みんな準備はいいな！
もうあのナイトメアに説得の余地はない！
だから――
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's get ready!
Our objective is to defeat the
Nightmare in front of us!

fields.EN:
We'll defeat it, and make our
escape from here!
fields.JP:
絶対に倒して、
みんなで脱獄を果たそう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll defeat it, and make our
escape from here!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック＆アリス
ぐぎぃぃぃぁぁぁぁぁぁああっ！！
ナイトメア・ジャック＆アリス
ナイトメア・ジャック＆アリス
ナイトメア・ジャック＆アリス
ごめんな……ジャック、アリス……

fields.EN:
Jack-san... Alice-san...
Why did it come to this...?
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……アリスさん……
どうして……どうして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Alice...
Why did it come to this...?

fields.EN:
It can't be helped...
We needed to fight for our
lives, too.
fields.JP:
仕方あるまい……
殺さねば殺されてたのだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped...
We needed to fight for our
lives, too.

fields.EN:
I know I got my revenge, but...
What's this weird feeling inside
me...?
fields.JP:
仇、取ったはずなのに、
何だろうね、この気持ち……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I got my revenge, but...
What's this weird feeling inside
me...?

fields.EN:
Nightmare Jack-san is gone now, but
the human form of Jack-san is alive
and with us now...
fields.JP:
ナイトメアのジャックさんは
消えてしまいましたが……でもまだ人間の
ジャックさんが生きています……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Jack is gone now, but
the human form of Jack is alive
and with us now...

fields.JP:
だから、まだ完全に
ジャックさんを失ったわけでは……

fields.EN:
Jack...?
Get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP:
ジャック！？
ねえちょっと、しっかりして！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...?
Get a hold of yourself!

fields.JP: お願い、消えないでジャック！
ジャックさんまで、そんな……！

fields.EN:
Compared with the tremendous power
those Nightmares possessed, this Jack
didn't have much power of his own.
fields.JP:
あのナイトメア達の強大な力に対して、
このジャックは大きな力を
持ち合わせてなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The human Jack lacks the power
Nightmare Jack held.

fields.EN:
Which means that this Jack was
manifested by whatever residual
power that was left in the core.
fields.JP:
つまり核の最後の力で
生まれた儚い存在……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that this Jack was
manifested by whatever residual
power that was left in the core.

fields.EN:
With the core gone, there's
nothing that can give him life...
fields.JP:
核は消えた。
生命力を与えてくれる源はもうない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With the core gone, there's
nothing that can give him life...

fields.JP:
くっ……何か……
何か方法はないのか……？

fields.EN:
The area... is turning white?!
But it can't be?!
fields.LOCALIZED:
The area... is turning white?!
But it can't be?!

fields.JP: このタイミングでだと……！

fields.EN:
Th-There's no way we can
face one now...!
fields.JP:
も、もう戦う力なんて
残ってませんよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-There's no way we can
face one now...!

fields.EN:
Hmph! We did destroy the core,
so we just need to muster whatever
strength is left inside us!
fields.JP:
ふんっ、核は破壊したのだ！
最後にもうひとふんばりすればいいのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! We did destroy the core,
so we just need to muster whatever
strength is left inside us!

fields.EN:
Wait... There's no telling if the
core we destroyed belongs to
the Nightmare closing in.
fields.JP:
待ちなさい。これまで破壊した核が、
このナイトメアのものとは限らないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... There's no telling if the
core we destroyed belongs to
the Nightmare closing in.

fields.EN:
We found two of them, so it
could be possible there are three.
fields.JP:
すでに２つの核を見つけてるのよ
３つ目があったとしてもおかしくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found two of them, so it
could be possible there are three.

fields.EN:
As usual... we run. It's not a
good idea facing it without
knowing we destroyed its core.
fields.JP:
いつも通り、逃げるんだ。
やつの核を破壊したという確証がない限り
戦うのは得策じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
As usual... we run. It's not a
good idea facing it without
knowing we destroyed its core.

fields.EN:
And... no matter how you look at
it, everyone is close to their limit.
fields.JP:
それに……、
どう見てもみんな”限界”が近い
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're also not in the best of
shape, either...

fields.EN:
Alice! Jack! Hurry!
A Nightmare is closing in!
fields.JP:
アリス！　ジャック！　急ぐんだ！
すぐそこまで来ている！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice! Jack! Hurry!
A Nightmare is closing in!

fields.JP: ジャック、ほら逃げるわよ……！

fields.EN:
Jack...? Why did you push me back?
We need to get...
fields.JP:
ジャック……何で突き飛ばすの……？
一緒に逃げなきゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...? Why did you push me back?
We need to get...

fields.EN:
I'm fine...
It's not like I'm going to last
much longer anyway...
fields.JP:
ぼくは……いいよ……
もう……なが……く……ないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine...
It's not like I'm going to last
much longer anyway...

fields.EN:
Alice... Run while...
the Nightmare... attacks me...
fields.JP:
さ……アリス……ぼく……が……
おそわれ…………てる……あい、だ……
……に……にげ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... Run while...
the Nightmare... attacks me...

fields.EN:
Stop that right now!
This is no time to be joking!
fields.JP: 何言ってるの！　怒るわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop that right now!
This is no time to be joking!

fields.EN:
I'm... sorry... but...
I'm going to... disappear soon...
fields.JP:
ごめ……ん……でも……
……もう……きえて……しま……から……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... sorry... but...
I'm going to... disappear soon...

fields.EN:
Alice! There's no time! At
least you get over here! Hurry—
fields.JP:
アリス！　もう間に合わない！
あんただけでもこっちに来なさい！
早く――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice! We need to go, now!
Come here, quickly!

fields.JP: ヴォゥァァァァアアアア！！

fields.EN: Why...? Why did you... take my place...?
fields.JP:
どう……して……どうし……
て……みがわ……り……なんか……に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why...? Why...?
Why did... you do that...?

fields.JP:
ぼくは……もう……きえ……
……てしまう……のに……

fields.EN:
Even if you disappear ten seconds from now...
for those ten seconds... I'll stake my life...
fields.JP:
たとえあなたが、１０秒後に、
消えようと……その１０秒の、ために……
わたしは命を、賭ける、わ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll protect you with...
my life... even if... you...
disappear... shortly...

fields.EN:
The Jack... I see... needs...
a smile... on his face...
fields.JP:
わたしの、瞳の中の、ジャックは……
いつも笑顔で……生きて……なきゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jack... I see... needs...
a smile... on his face...

fields.EN:
Alice... Alice...!
No...! This... can't be happening!
fields.JP:
アリス……アリス……
そん……な……しっか……り……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... Alice...!
No...! This... can't be happening!

fields.EN:
I finally... was able to...
protect... Jack...
fields.JP: やっと……ジャックのこと……守れた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I finally... was able to...
protect... Jack...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... My blood...
got on your face...
fields.JP:
ごめん……ね……わたしの血で、
ジャックの顔まで、汚し……ちゃった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... My blood...
got on your face...

fields.EN:
Aah... It's so... strange...
I feel... so happy now...
fields.JP:
ああ……不思議……
わたし、いま、すごく……幸せ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah... It's so... strange...
I feel... so happy now...

fields.EN:
I wonder... if this feeling...
is fake... just like me...
fields.JP:
ねえ、この気持ちも……
ニセモノ、なのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder... if this feeling...
is fake... just like me...

fields.EN:
Jack... please... show
me your smile one last time...
fields.JP:
ねえジャック……お願、い……
最後に……笑顔を見せ……て…………
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...? Please... show me...
your face... one... last time...

fields.EN:
Yes... Your smile...
Thank you... Jack...
fields.JP:
うん……その笑顔。
ジャック……ありが……とう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Your smile...
Thank you... Jack...

fields.EN:
Alice... I'm the one...
who should... thank you...
fields.JP:
アリス……ぼくの……
ほう……こそ……ありが……と……

fields.EN:
It can't be... We went through all
that only for them to die?
fields.JP:
そんな……ここまで頑張ったのに……
どうして２人が死ななきゃ
いけないんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be... We went through all
that only for them to die?

fields.EN:
Jack... after he finally
regained his human form...!
fields.JP:
ジャックめ、せっかく人の姿を
取り戻したというのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare Jack die on us!
And after he gained his human
form again, too!

fields.EN:
That... wasn't a fake.
Alice's feelings were genuine
and true...
fields.JP:
ニセモノ、なんかじゃありませんわ……
アリスの想いは本物でした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That... wasn't a fake.
Alice's feelings were genuine
and true...

fields.EN:
Damn it...
That Nightmare is going to pay!
fields.JP:
くそっ……あのナイトメア、
絶対に許さない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it...
That Nightmare is going to pay!

fields.EN:
Akazukin, don't go out
on your own.
fields.JP: 赤ずきん、絶対に飛び込んでは駄目よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, don't go out
on your own.

fields.EN:
She's right. We can't beat it now.
I know it's vexing, but we need
to run!
fields.JP:
そうだ。今は勝てる見込みが薄い。
悔しいし仇は取りたいけど、
逃げるしかないんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. We can't beat it now.
I know it's vexing, but we need
to run!

fields.EN:
But... we can't leave Alice-san's body
there like that!
fields.JP:
でもアリスさんの亡骸をあそこに
置いたままなんて………！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... we can't leave Alice's body
there like that!

fields.EN:
Princess, I know how you feel... But we're
all at death's door right now. It takes
everything we have just to escape...
fields.JP:
姫。気持ちは分かる……
だけど僕たちは今みんな瀕死。
自分たちが逃げるので精一杯だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand how you feel...
But we're in a predicament, and
we need to make a run for it.

fields.EN:
Carrying Alice's body with us will
only spell our doom.
fields.JP:
アリスを抱えたまま逃げれば、
その先に待っているのは間違いなく全滅よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Carrying Alice's body with us will
only spell our doom.

fields.EN:
It's not easy to leave her body
behind, but we need to run with
all our might!
fields.JP:
うん。だからつらいけど、
今はアリスを置いて、とにかく
全力で逃げるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not easy to leave her body
behind, but we need to run with
all our might!

fields.EN:
It's coming at us!
Run for it!
fields.JP:
来たっ！
みんな、逃げるぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's coming at us!
Run for it!

fields.EN:
Don't stop, everyone! If we can
make it just a little farther,
we might be able to shake it...!
fields.JP:
みんな止まるなっ！
もう少し行けばやり過ごせるかも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep running!
We need to keep pace just a little
longer!

fields.EN:
Kaguya?! What are you doing?!
If you want to survive, run!
fields.JP:
かぐやよ、何をしておる！
死にたくなければ進むのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya?! What are you doing?!
If you want to survive, run!

fields.EN:
Easy for you to say...
I'm not the type... to keep
running like this...
fields.JP:
まったく、無茶を言うのですよ……
こういうのは、わらわの……
がらじゃないのです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Easy for you to say...
I'm not the type... to keep
running like this...

fields.EN:
Hameln's right. At the very least,
those of us who are left have to survive...!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンの言うとおりだよ。
残ったあたしたちだけでも
生き延びないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln is right!
We need to survive!

fields.JP: 待ってください、親指姫はどこですの！？

fields.EN:
Shirayuki-chan and Nemu-chan
aren't here, either!
fields.JP: 白雪ちゃんとねむちゃんもいないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White and Sleepy
aren't here, either!

fields.EN:
Wha...! Since when have those three
been missing?! Doesn't anyone remember?!
fields.JP:
なっ……！　３人はいつからいない……！？
誰か覚えてないか……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Where did they go to?!
Does anyone know?!

fields.EN:
Now that you mention it,
I don't sense the Nightmare
behind us any more.
fields.JP:
そういえばすぐ背後にあった
ナイトメアの気配も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that you mention it,
I don't sense the Nightmare
behind us any more.

fields.EN:
Everyone, go ahead!
I'm going to go and find them!
fields.JP:
みんなは先に行け！
親指たちは僕が探しにいく！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, go ahead!
I'm going to go and find them!

fields.EN: No! We need to stay together!
fields.JP: ダメだよ！　バラバラになっちゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED: No! We need to stay together!

fields.EN:
Of all people, you need to
calm down.
fields.JP:
落ち着きなさい！
あなたが冷静でなくてどうするの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of all people, you need to
calm down.

fields.EN: I'm going back to find them...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm going back to find them...

fields.EN:
Hurry! We may be able to hide
from it around that corner!
fields.JP:
２人とも早くっ！　あの角を曲がれば
隠れてやり過ごせるかもしれないわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hurry! We may be able to hide
from it around that corner!

fields.JP:
はい、親指姉様っ！
ネムちゃん、行きますよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood, Sister Thumbelina!
Let's hurry, Sleepy!

fields.EN:
I... can't run... any more...
Can't... stand...
fields.JP:
ち……力、もう……入ら……ない……
ボク……立て、ない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... can't run... any more...
Can't... stand...

fields.EN:
Don't you dare lay a finger
on her!
fields.JP: わたしの妹に汚い手で触るな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you dare lay a finger
on her!

fields.JP: さ、ネムちゃん今のうちです……！

ボク、もう……だ……
……お……てって……おね……

馬鹿。置いていくわけ……
ないでしょ……

fields.EN:
She's right, Nemu-chan.
Shirayuki will always be
with you, too...
fields.JP:
そうですよ、ネムちゃん。
白雪たちはいつだって一緒ですよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Sleepy.
Snow White will always be
with you, too...

fields.EN:
So, you two.
I have a proposal...
fields.JP:
でさ、２人とも。
ちょっと提案があるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you two.
I have a proposal...

fields.EN:
That Nightmare is really getting
on my nerves...
fields.JP:
わたしさ、あのナイトメアに
いい加減に頭にきちゃってるのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Nightmare is really getting
on my nerves...

fields.EN:
So I wanted to strike at it
to show that we're not going
down so easily.
fields.JP:
だからさ、ちょっと反撃して
一矢でも報いたいなー、なんて
思ってるわけなんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I wanted to strike at it
to show that we're not going
down so easily.

fields.EN:
Nope, I'm not gonna face it
to buy us time.
fields.JP:
ううん、違うの。
時間稼ぎとかじゃないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nope, I'm not gonna face it
to buy us time.

fields.EN:
This is just my most
selfish wish...
fields.JP:
これはもっと傲慢で、
わがままなわたしの願い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is just my most
selfish wish...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
Do you both mind fighting
alongside me...?
fields.JP:
白雪、ネム、ごめんね……
二人とも、その……どうか一緒に……
わたしと戦ってくれない、かな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
Do you both mind fighting
alongside me...?

fields.EN:
As the elder here, my role should
be to buy you both time to run.
fields.JP:
時間稼ぎして二人を逃がすのが
姉としての役目だとは思ってる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the elder here, my role should
be to buy you both time to run.

fields.EN:
But... I want to face it together
as sisters...
fields.JP:
でもね、わたし……
三人で一緒に、立ち向かいたいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I want to face it together
as sisters...

fields.EN:
Considering everything that's
happened, I know it's a selfish
request. But... will you help me...?
fields.JP:
……今までのことを考えると
都合がいいお願いだってのは分かってる。
でも……協力してくれないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm asking a lot here,
but... will you help?

fields.EN:
Finally...
Finally, my dream comes true...
fields.JP: やっと、やっとそれが叶うんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally...
Finally, my dream comes true...

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama, ask us more
confidently. We'll follow you
anywhere, no matter how far...
fields.JP:
親指姉様、もっと堂々と頼んで下さい。
白雪たちはどこだって、どこまでだって
ついていくんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, ask us for help.
We will always do everything for
you, sister Thumbelina.

fields.EN: I don't know what to say...
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't know what to say...

fields.EN:
...Thank you. I'm sorry I couldn't
remain your older sister to the very end...
fields.JP:
……ありがとう。
最後まで姉を突き通せなくて……
ごめんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks...
I'm sorry I can't be the older
sister you always wanted...

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama, no matter what happens,
you'll always be the nee-sama we love...
fields.JP:
親指姉様は、いつだって、
何があろうと大好きな姉様ですよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were always the sister
we wanted, sister Thumbelina...

fields.EN:
You're my... nee-sama... the one
I'm proud of... so kind... and strong...
fields.JP:
ボクの……自慢の……
優しくて……強い……姉さまだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My favorite... My pride...
My kind... My strong... sister...

fields.EN:
I feel so happy now...
I should've done this a long
time ago...
fields.JP:
嬉しいな……もっと早く
こうしていればよかったかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel so happy now...
I should've done this a long
time ago...

fields.EN:
Come at us!
We're not like before now!
fields.JP:
さあかかってきなさい！
今のわたしたちは強いわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come at us!
We're not like before now!

fields.EN:
Yes! We won't lose to anyone or
anything!
fields.JP: そうですね、誰にも負ける気がしません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! We won't lose to anyone or
anything!

fields.JP: ヴォヴォアアアアアアッ！！

fields.EN:
Sister... if we...
are ever... born again...
fields.JP:
姉、さま……ボクたち……
生まれ……かわって、も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister... if we...
are ever... born again...

fields.EN:
We... wish... that we...
will... be sisters... again...
fields.JP:
また……３人……
姉妹でいたい……ですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We... wish... that we...
will... be sisters... again...

fields.EN:
Of course... we will...
I'm sure... we will... Together...
fields.JP:
大丈……夫……わたしたち……
……なら……きっとまた……一緒に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course... we will...
I'm sure... we will... Together...

fields.EN:
It can't be... C'mon, wake up...
There's a Nightmare waiting
to be beaten up...
fields.JP:
そんな、嘘でしょ……？
ほら、三人とも早く起きなさいよ……
ナイトメアがそばにいるじゃないの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be... C'mon, wake up...
There's a Nightmare waiting
to be beaten up...

fields.EN:
It's too late.
The Nightmare isn't taking
action against them...
fields.JP:
……手遅れよ
ナイトメアがもう反応していない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's too late.
The Nightmare isn't taking
action against them...

fields.EN:
And?! What are you trying to
tell me?!
fields.JP: 何が言いたい、グレーテル！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And?! What are you trying to
tell me?!

fields.JP:
現実を見なさい！
あの三人は、死……

fields.EN:
Stop it you two!
This is no time to fight amongst
ourselves!
fields.JP:
やめろ二人とも！
今はそんなことをしてる場合じゃないだろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it you two!
This is no time to fight amongst
ourselves!

fields.EN:
Look! The Nightmare sustained
some damage!
fields.JP:
見ろ、貴様ら！　
ナイトメアの身体に傷がついているぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look! The Nightmare sustained
some damage!

fields.EN:
(Wait... So that means it doesn't
have a core?! But... we're not
ready to fight it yet...)
fields.JP:
（ということは、やつは核を失っている！？
　だけど、みんながこんな状態じゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... So that means it doesn't
have a core?! But... we're not
ready to fight it yet...)

fields.JP:
親指ちゃん……白雪ちゃん……
ねむちゃん……なんで……なんで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby... Snow White...
Sleepy... Why...? Why...?

fields.EN:
I let... more die on me... again!
Damn it.... Damn it! Damn it!
fields.JP:
あたしは……また……死なせて……！
くそっ、くそっ、くそっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I let... more die on me... again!
Damn it.... Damn it! Damn it!

fields.EN:
This is no time to wallow in self-loathing.
Do what you have to do. You're our older
sister, Akazukin-san, aren't you?
fields.JP:
自分を責めている時じゃないです
やるべきことをやるのですよ、
赤ずきんさんは、おねーさんでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is no time to wallow in
self-loathing. You're our older
sister, right?

fields.JP: ヴォヴォアアアアアアッ！！

fields.EN:
(Everyone is already on the brink of death,
and they're about to hit their limit...!
We really shouldn't fight right now!)
fields.JP:
（みんな瀕死な上に、今にも限界が……！
　やっぱり、今は戦うべきじゃない！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're already at our limit!
We can't fight it now!)

fields.EN:
Let's run!
We need to find someplace where
we can rest ourselves!
fields.JP:
逃げるぞ、みんな！
今はとにかく態勢を立て直すんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's run!
We need to find someplace where
we can rest ourselves!

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff... A door that closes after
a set time... I'm glad we made it through.
fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
一定時間で閉まる扉……
通ってしまえばありがたいね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff...
It's good to have a timed portal
that can close behind us...

fields.EN:
So, I guess that buys us
a bit of time now...
fields.JP: これでしばらくは時間が稼げるよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I guess that buys us
a bit of time now...

fields.EN:
Akazukin, Kaguyahime, hurry!
The door is about to close...
fields.JP:
さあ、赤ずきんとかぐや姫も
早く来るんだ。もう扉が閉まるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, Kaguya, come on.
The portal is about to shut.

fields.EN: Well, we've been thinking a bit...
fields.JP:
いや、ちょっとかぐやと一緒に
考えたんだけどさあ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, we've been thinking a bit...

fields.EN:
Yes, there's something
I've been thinking about...
fields.JP: ええ、ちょっと思うことがあるんですよ～
何をしておる赤ずきん、かぐや姫！！
おねーちゃん、かぐやちゃん、どうして！

fields.EN:
You know, I think now's about the
time I start acting like an older
sister.
fields.JP:
いやぁ、ここらでお姉さん、
ちょっと本気出しちゃおうかなーなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, I think now's about the
time I start acting like an older
sister.

fields.EN:
Yes, we figured the two of us
can easily dispatch the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
はい、軽くナイトメアを
ひねってこようかと思った次第です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we figured the two of us
can easily dispatch the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
What are you two saying...?
You're joking, right...?
fields.JP:
何言ってるんだよ２人とも……
冗談だよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying...?
Stop it...

fields.EN:
I've caused a lot of problems
for you guys, you know?
fields.JP:
今回はみんなにずっと迷惑を
かけてばかりだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've caused a lot of problems
for you guys, you know?

fields.EN:
So, let me at least act like an
older sister one last time.
fields.JP:
だから最後くらい
お姉さんっぽいことさせてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, let me at least act like an
older sister one last time.

fields.JP:
おねーちゃんは、いつだって
ちゃんとおねーちゃんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis!
You're always my older sister!

fields.EN:
That's so sweet to hear, Ningyo.
But honestly? I'm sick of
feeling like I'm in a wolf's belly.
fields.JP:
嬉しいこと言ってくれるね、人魚。
……でも、ずっと狼の腹の中は嫌なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's so sweet to hear, Mermie.
But honestly? I'm sick of
feeling like I'm in a wolf's belly.

fields.EN:
I'm also getting tired of holding
back this anger that's been
swelling inside me...
fields.JP:
それにさ……
いい加減、この黒い怒りを抑え込むのにも、
嫌気が差して来たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm also getting tired of holding
back this anger that's been
swelling inside me...

fields.EN:
I've hit my limit too. I figured going with
Akazukin-san would at least make me feel like
I'm doing some work~
fields.JP:
わらわも、もう限界なんですよ。
だったら赤ずきんさんに同行した方が、
働いてるような気がしまして～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've hit my limit, too. Which is why
I figured it would feel like I'm
helping if we fought together.

fields.EN:
What are you saying, Kaguya?!
You've always been a huge help!
fields.JP:
何を言ってるんだ、かぐや！
君はいつだって真面目に働いてきた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying, Kaguya?!
You've always been a huge help!

fields.EN:
That's right! It's not like you
were a burden to us or anything!
fields.JP:
そうだぞ、決して
足手まといなんかではなかったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! It's not like you
were a burden to us or anything!

fields.EN:
Then I'll say goodbye while I'm still not a
burden. It was noisy and nothing but trouble,
but surprisingly, I had fun with all of you.
fields.JP:
では足手まといじゃないまま、お別れです。
騒がしくて、面倒なことばかりでしたけど、
意外と楽しかったですよ、みなさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Well, I appreciate it.
I know I caused a lot of trouble,
but it was fun being with you all.

fields.EN:
Hehe... The moon wasn't where
I was meant to return after all.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、わらわの帰る場所は
月ではありませんでしたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... I suppose I won't
return to the moon after all...

fields.EN:
Stop it right this instant,
and come here, now!
fields.JP:
何を馬鹿なこと言ってるんだ！
２人とも今すぐ戻ってこい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it right this instant,
and come here, now!

fields.EN:
That's right, Onee-chan! Kaguya-chan!
Please come here!
fields.JP:
そうだよ、おねーちゃんも
かぐやちゃんも戻ってきてよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Sis! Kaguya!
Please come here!

fields.EN:
I've already made my decision.
So long, you guys...
fields.JP:
もう決めたんだよ。
じゃあ……バイバイ、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've already made my decision.
So long, you guys...

fields.EN:
And, may good fortune shine
upon you all...
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, may good fortune shine
upon you all...

fields.JP: 駄目だ、行くなーーーっ！！
戻ってきてってばぁーーーっ！！

fields.EN:
Unbelievable!
Everyone's doing their own thing!
fields.JP:
どいつもこいつも、
抱え込みおって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable!
Everyone's doing their own thing!

fields.JP: もうすこしですわ、ラプ

fields.EN:
Rapunzel... Cinderella...
What are you two...?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、シンデレラ、
いったい何をして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel... Cinderella...
What are you two...?

fields.EN:
Whew...
We made it through all right.
fields.JP: ……ふぅ、上手く抜けられましたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew...
We made it through all right.

fields.EN:
Wha-?! How did you two
get around?!
fields.JP:
なっ、どうやってそっちに
回り込んだんだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! How did you two
get around?!

fields.EN:
Oh my, there was a small hole
in the wall. I figured Rapu and I
would be able to fit through.
fields.JP:
そこ、壁の小さな穴からですわ。
わたしとラプなら通れると思ったんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, there was a small hole
in the wall. I figured Rappy and I
would be able to fit through.

fields.JP: すごいよシンデレラさん、ラプちゃん！

fields.EN: Yeah, great! Then hurry and open the door!
fields.JP:
うん、最高だ！
じゃあ早く扉を開けてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, great job!
Now, hurry and open the portal!

fields.EN: Oh my, but... that I can't do.
fields.JP: それは……ちょっとできないんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh my, but... that I can't do.

fields.EN:
Why not? It's best if we all
go after them together!
fields.JP:
どうしてだ？　みんなで行った方が
いいに決まってるじゃないか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not? It's best if we all
go after them together!

fields.EN:
Um... Rapunzel's one is
coming soon...
fields.JP:
あのね、ラプンツェルもね、
もうちかいの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Rapunzel's one is
coming soon...

fields.JP:
だからね、みんなといっしょには
いられないの……

fields.EN:
She's about to enter
Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化……
しそうなんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's about to enter
Blood Skelter...

fields.EN:
Both me and Rapu
are already at our limits.
fields.JP:
その限界が近いって……
わたしもラプも感じてるんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Both me and Rappy
are already at our limits.

fields.EN:
Jack isn't here anymore, so
there's no way to recover
someone from Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
もうジャックはいない……
ブラッドスケルター化を解く術はない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack isn't here anymore, so
there's no way to recover
someone from Blood Skelter...

fields.EN:
That's right, Gretel. That's
why we absolutely can't open this door.
fields.JP:
そうですわ、グレーテル。
だからこの扉は絶対に開けられませんの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Gretel. That's why
we won't open the portal.

fields.EN:
But... But that doesn't mean
you should be on the other side...
fields.JP:
そんな……じゃあなおさら、
そっちに行っちゃ駄目だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... But that doesn't mean
you should be on the other side...

fields.EN:
Then you two stop fighting! We'll bring
Akazukin and the others back ourselves...!
fields.JP:
だったら、二人はもうこれ以上戦うな！
赤ずきんたちは僕たちが連れ戻すから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come back! You don't need to
fight! We'll find a way to bring
the others back!

fields.EN: Oh no, you girls need to run.
fields.JP:
いいえ、おつうたちは
逃げなきゃ駄目ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh no, you girls need to run.

fields.EN:
Leave baddie to Rapunzel!
Gonna beat it up!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアはラプンツェルたちに
まかせてね。かならずやっつけるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave baddie to Rapunzel!
Gonna beat it up!

fields.EN:
Otsuu, thank you for recognizing
the true me back then.
fields.JP:
おつう、あの時本物のわたしを
ちゃんと見つけてくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, thank you for recognizing
the true me back then.

fields.EN:
It felt like a prince came and
made me wear the perfect pair
of glass slippers.
fields.JP:
まるで脱げたガラスの靴を履かせに
きてくれた王子さまみたいでしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It felt like a prince came and
made me wear the perfect pair
of glass slippers.

fields.EN:
Yup! Otsuu is prince!
Rapunzel wanted to make
babies with prince, but...
fields.JP:
うん、おつうはおうじ……
ラプンツェル、おうじといつか
こどもつくりたかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Otsuu is prince!
Rapunzel wanted to make
babies with prince, but...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel happy you found me!
Bye-bye! Otsuu! Everyone!
fields.JP:
でもラプンツェルをみつけて
くれただけでもうれしいからいいや！
ばいばい、おつうー、みんな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel happy you found me!
Bye-bye! Otsuu! Everyone!

fields.JP: シンデレラさぁぁぁん！！
ラプンツェル！　戻れぇぇぇっ！！

fields.EN:
Everyone is acting more like a
hero than me...
fields.JP:
ワレよりも、みんなの方がずっと、
勇者のようではないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone is acting more like a
hero than me...

fields.EN:
And... what's this feeling...?
My chest... hurts?
fields.JP:
それに、この気持ち……
とても胸が痛いのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... what's this feeling...?
My chest... hurts?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel said I beat baddie.
Does that make me a liar?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、ナイトメアを
かならずやっつけるなんていっちゃった。
うそつきにならないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel said I beat baddie.
Does that make me a liar?

fields.EN:
No, that was perfect.
You need a strong front
to hold a strong heart.
fields.JP:
でもそれでいいんですわ、ラプ。
心を強く持たなきゃだめなんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that was perfect.
You need a strong front
to hold a strong heart.

fields.EN:
Yup! Right?! I thought I'd regret it
even more than swallowing a thousand needles!
fields.JP:
そうだよね、いいよね！
はりせんぼんのむよりも
こうかいしちゃうとおもったからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Right?!
I rather lie than... lose... hope?

fields.EN:
Hehe, swallowing a thousand
needles would be nothing to us now anyway.
fields.JP:
ふふ、針千本なんて今のわたしたちには
ぜんぜん平気ですものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh dear, a white lie is the
least of our concerns now,
isn't it?

fields.EN:
Especially compared to what's
headed towards us...
fields.JP:
そう……この先に
いるものに比べれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Especially compared to what's
headed towards us...

fields.JP: ねえシンデレラ……て、つなごう？

fields.EN:
Rapu?
Are you... worried about me?
fields.JP: ラプ……あなたわたしを心配して……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy?
Are you... worried about me?

fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもこわいから……
だから、て……つなごう？

fields.EN:
Thank you, Rapu...
Why, I don't feel scared any more.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、ラプ……
うん、これでわたしも、もう
怖くないですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Rappy...
Why, I don't feel scared any more.

fields.EN:
Tch... It's difficult to find an
opening with just the two of us.
fields.JP:
くっ……２人だとどうしても
攻撃の隙が作りづらいですね……
どうすれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... It's difficult to find an
opening with just the two of us.

fields.EN:
Akazukin! Kaguya!
We've come to assist!
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、かぐや！
加勢しますわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood! Kaguya!
We've come to assist!

fields.JP: ラプンツェルたちもてつだうよー！

って、シンデレラさん、
ラプンツェルさん！？

どうしてここに！？
と、とにかくすぐに戻りなさい！
嫌です！　戦いますわ！

fields.EN:
Do you even know what's
happening?! Just hurry up
and leave!
fields.JP:
今がどんな状況か分かってんの！？
いいから早く戻りなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you even know what's
happening?! Just hurry up
and leave!

fields.EN:
She's right! You're both still
young! If you survive, then...
fields.JP:
そうです！　二人はまだ幼いのですから
しっかり生き延びなければ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right! You're both still
young! If you survive, then...

fields.EN:
Were you lying when you told
us we were full-fledged fighters?!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルたちをまえに
いちにんまえっていったのは、
うそだったの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You lie to Rapunzel that I can't
fight?!

fields.EN:
She's right! I thought you already
saw us as partners in battle!
fields.JP:
そうですわ、わたしたちだって
戦えるって、認めてくれたんじゃ
なかったんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right! I thought you already
saw us as partners in battle!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... I didn't see the
resolve you both had coming here.
fields.JP:
二人も覚悟して来てるんですよね……
それなのに、ごめんなさい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... I didn't see the
resolve you both had coming here.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I'm sorry I treated you two
like kids just now...
fields.JP:
うん……その覚悟をちゃんと
拾ってあげなくて……本当にゴメン……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I'm sorry I treated you two
like kids just now...

fields.JP: 分かって下さればいいんですのよ？
じゃあいっしょにたたかおうね！

fields.EN:
Kaguya...
You're glad they came, right?
fields.JP: かぐや、あんた今ホッとしたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya...
You're glad they came, right?

fields.EN:
That's right, Akazukin-san. Who wouldn't be
happy after being given this much hope?
fields.JP:
それはそうですよ、赤ずきんさん。
こんなにも希望を分けてもらって、
嬉しくないわけないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who wouldn't be? They showed
up just in time to give me the
hope I needed.

fields.EN:
Heh, same here. I was thinking
like we were goners, you know?
fields.JP:
はは、同感。あたしも実は、
もう駄目かなーって思ってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, same here. I was thinking
like we were goners, you know?

fields.EN:
Thanks, Rapu, Cinderella.
How about we go in and beat
that thing up?
fields.JP:
ありがとうラプ、シンデレラ。
あたしらでいっちょ突撃しようか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, Rappy, Cinderella.
How about we go in and beat
that thing up?

fields.JP: ヴォヴォアアアアアアッ！！

fields.EN:
It's time we show that damn
Nightmare a thing or two!
fields.JP:
あのクソナイトメアに
キツイ一撃ぶちかませぇぇぇっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's time we show that damn
Nightmare a thing or two!

fields.EN:
Great, I found the lever
that opens and closes the door...!
fields.JP: よし、開閉レバー見つけたぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great! I found the lever to open
the portal!

fields.EN:
That took a lot longer than
expected...
fields.JP:
思ったより時間が
かかってしまったわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That took a lot longer than
expected...

fields.EN:
It's coming from around that
corner there!
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's coming from around that
corner there!

fields.EN:
Why...?
Why did this have to happen...?
fields.JP:
どうして……どうしてみんな
こんなことになっちゃうんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why...?
Why did this have to happen...?

fields.JP: グレーテル……息のある者はどうだ……？

fields.EN:
Onee-chan... Rapu-chan... Cinderella-san...
Kaguya-chan... Everyone... Nooooo!!
fields.JP:
おねーちゃんも……ラプちゃんも……
シンデレラさんも、かぐやちゃんも……
みんな……いやぁぁぁぁっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis... Rappy... Cinderella...
Kaguya... Everyone...
Noooooooo!

fields.EN:
To sacrifice their lives for a
few mere scratches...
fields.JP:
これだけ命を賭けて、
与えた傷はほんのわずか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To sacrifice their lives for a
few mere scratches...

fields.EN: I can't take it any longer!
fields.JP: ワレはもう、我慢ならんぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't take it any longer!

fields.EN:
(I want revenge just as much as Hameln!
But everyone is clearly at their limit,
both in stamina and Corruption...)
fields.JP:
（僕もハーメルンと同じく仇を討ちたい！
　ただ、どうみてもみんな体力も穢れも
　限界を迎えている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I want to avenge their deaths,
too! But, everyone is at their
limit...)

fields.EN:
(I can tell that I'm at my
limit, too...)
fields.JP:
（なによりもわかる……
　僕も限界がかなり近いことが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can tell that I'm at my
limit, too...)

fields.EN:
(I better prepare myself for the
worst and protect Princess and
the others...)
fields.JP:
（こうなったら姫やみんなを守るために、
　僕が覚悟を決めて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better prepare myself for the
worst and protect Princess and
the others...)

fields.EN:
Wait a minute, Hameln.
If you want to fight, do so with
the odds of winning on your side.
fields.JP:
待ちなさいハーメルン。
どうせ戦うなら、確実な方法でいくべきよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute, Hameln.
If you want to fight, do so with
the odds of winning on your side.

fields.EN: Do you have a plan, Gretel?
fields.JP: グレーテル……何か策があると言うのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you have a plan, Gretel?

fields.EN:
Why yes. But, we need to move to
a different place to enact it.
Can you two come with us?
fields.JP:
ええ、そうよ。でもここでは
実行できないから場所を移しましょう。
つうたちもいいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. But, we need to move to
a different place to enact it.
Can you two come with us?

fields.EN:
Understood...
Let's see this plan of yours.
fields.JP:
…………分かった、
貴様の策に乗ってやろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood...
Let's see this plan of yours.

fields.JP: えぐっ……おつう、ちゃん……ぐすっ

fields.EN:
I know it's hard,
but we need to keep running...
fields.JP: つらいけど今は逃げるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's hard,
but we need to keep running...

fields.EN:
So, Gretel, what's this plan of
yours?
fields.JP:
グレーテルよ、その策とやらは
いったい何なのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Gretel, what's this plan of
yours?

fields.EN:
I can't disclose it yet.
Just follow me.
fields.JP:
まだ話せないわ。
いいからついてきて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't disclose it yet.
Just follow me.

fields.JP: ではどこに向かっておるのだ？

fields.EN:
A place that would work perfectly
to enact my plan.
fields.JP: 策を実行するのに最適な場所よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A place that would work perfectly
to enact my plan.

fields.EN:
Mmm...! Mind you I don't have
much strength left in me to run
much further.
fields.JP:
ぐぬ……いつまでも逃げ続ける体力など
残ってはおらぬからな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...! Mind you I don't have
much strength left in me to run
much further.

fields.EN:
(We only have four of us
remaining...)
fields.JP:
（あれだけたくさんいた仲間が、
　もう今は僕たち４人だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We only have four of us
remaining...)

fields.EN:
(If everyone weren't this close to death...
If we hadn't fought Nightmare Alice and the
others, it wouldn't have ended like this...)
fields.JP:
（みんなこんな瀕死の状態じゃなければ……
　ナイトメアのアリス達と戦わなければ、
　こんな運命にはならなかったのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If only we didn't fight Nightmare
Alice, we wouldn't be in this
predicament...)

fields.EN:
(The darkness in me is swelling!
At this rate, I'm going to enter
Blood Skelter, too!)
fields.JP:
（一気にどす黒い感情が……！！　
　だめだ！　このままじゃ近いうちに
　ブラッドスケルター化してしまう！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The darkness in me is swelling!
At this rate, I'm going to enter
Blood Skelter, too!)

fields.EN:
(I won't last much longer...
I have to sacrifice myself so that
the others can be saved...)
fields.JP:
（もう僕も長くない、
　やっぱりもう捨て身でなんとかして……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I won't last much longer...
I have to sacrifice myself so that
the others can be saved...)

fields.EN:
Urrh! Gretel!
How much longer will this take?!
What is this plan of yours?!
fields.JP:
あーもうグレーテルよ！
いつになったら着くのだ！
策ってのはいったい何なのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh! Gretel!
How much longer will this take?!
What is this plan of yours?!

fields.JP:
ねえちょっといいかしら
つう、人魚姫
どうしたグレーテ……うぶっ！？
うっ……んぐっ……ごくん……ぶはっ！

fields.EN:
What was that about?!
I thought I was going to
suffocate!
fields.JP:
いきなり口の中につっこむなんて、
僕を窒息させる気か！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What was that about?!
I thought I was going to
suffocate!

Don't worry, I didn't mean
to harm you.

fields.EN: What did you make me swallow?!
fields.JP:
いったい、何を飲ませたんだ
グレーテル……！？
fields.LOCALIZED: What did you make me swallow?!

fields.EN:
It's an antidote that can remove
Corruption.
fields.JP: 今飲ませたのは穢れを取り除く薬
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's an antidote that can remove
Corruption.

fields.EN:
The effect is tiny, but
it's better than nothing, right?
fields.JP:
効果は微々たるものだけど、
ないよりはましでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It only can do so much, but it
feels a bit better, yes?

fields.JP: 人魚姫、あなたも飲みなさい

fields.EN:
I have to hand it to you for
coming up with an antidote.
fields.JP:
……さすがグレーテル、
そんなものまで作り上げていたなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to hand it to you for
coming up with an antidote.

fields.EN:
Well done, Gretel!
But, I assume this isn't what
you meant by your plan.
fields.JP:
やるではないかグレーテルよ。
だが、この程度ではあるまい
策とやらを聞かせるがいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well done, Gretel!
But, I assume this isn't what
you meant by your plan.

fields.JP: あ、あれ……なんだか身体が……

fields.EN:
Princess?! Gretel!
What...ugh, what was... that...?
fields.JP:
姫！？
グレーテル、いったい何を飲ま……せ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess?! Gretel!
What...ugh, what was... that...?

fields.EN:
Urrh... Feeling... sleepy...
That... sleeping pill...? Why...?
fields.JP:
くっ……急に眠気が……
そ…そうか、あの時の睡眠薬……なんで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... Feeling... sleepy...
That... sleeping pill...? Why...?

fields.EN:
Why yes, sleeping pills.
I'm sorry I had to resort to
deception.
fields.JP:
ええ、そうよ。
騙してごめんなさい、つう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, sleeping pills.
I'm sorry I had to resort to
deception.

fields.EN:
Heh heh... Sleeping helps ease
the soul, so I wasn't lying when I
said it clears some Corruption.
fields.JP:
ふふ、寝れば少しはストレスが取れるから、
穢れを取り除く薬に偽りはないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... Sleeping helps ease
the soul, so I wasn't lying when I
said it clears some Corruption.

fields.EN:
What in the world are you
planning, Gretel?
fields.JP:
グレーテル、これはいったい
どういうことなのだ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What in the world are you
planning, Gretel?

fields.EN: Don't tell me you're giving up...
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't tell me you're giving up...

fields.EN:
We're at our limit, and are in
danger of entering Blood
Skelter.
fields.JP:
私たちはすでに戦力的にも体力的にも限界、
その上ブラッドスケルター化する危険もあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're at our limit, and are in
danger of entering Blood
Skelter.

fields.EN:
There isn't much that can be done
in this state, nor would a plan
help much at all if any.
fields.JP:
そんな状況でできる策など
有りはしないし、有ってもたかが知れている
fields.LOCALIZED:
There isn't much that can be done
in this state, nor would a plan
help much at all if any.

fields.EN:
You aren't planning on using
them as bait so we can run,
are you?!
fields.JP:
まさか、眠らせたおつうたちを
囮にして逃げる気か……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You aren't planning on using
them as bait so we can run,
are you?!

fields.EN:
That's a nice plan. The old me
would've carried it out without hesitation.
fields.JP:
いいわね、その策。
昔の私なら迷わず実行していたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that sounds like a plan.
The old me would've
probably done that.

fields.EN:
If that's not it, then what are
you planning to do?
fields.JP: 違うのだな？　では何をする気だ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's not it, then what are
you planning to do?

fields.EN:
Hameln, do you remember what
the leader of the Order said?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、あなたあの教祖の
言葉を覚えてるかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, do you remember what
the leader of the Order said?

fields.EN:
You mean the one at the entrance?
Didn't she say something about
a child led by the Blood Maidens?
fields.JP:
監獄塔の入り口におった奴だな。
確か『血式少女に導かれた子』だったか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean the one at the entrance?
Didn't she say something about
a child led by the Blood Maidens?

fields.EN:
Right. That leader seemed to think
Tsuu had some kind of special power.
fields.JP:
そう。あの教祖はつうに何か特別な力が
あると、そう考えている様子だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I could tell that she knew
something special about Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Tsuu is... unique. After all,
she was able to communicate
with Jack.
fields.JP:
確かにつうには不思議な力がある。
ジャックと意思疎通ができたりしたのも、
その一つなのでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu is... unique. After all,
she was able to communicate
with Jack.

fields.JP: で、それがどうしたと言うのだ

fields.EN:
I want to place my bets on Tsuu
and whatever it is that makes her
"special."
fields.JP:
私は、それに賭けてみようと思うの。
つうの『特別な力』とやらにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to place my bets on Otsuu
and whatever it is that makes her
"special."

fields.EN:
Don't you think this situation is
strange? It's like everything's
designed to keep Tsuu alive.
fields.JP:
ここまでの状況も不思議だと思わない？
あらゆる要素がつうを生かそうと
しているかのよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you think this situation is
strange? It's like everything's
designed to keep Otsuu alive.

fields.EN:
Thinking about it that way, everything
that's happened until now almost feels
like 'fate decided in advance.'
fields.JP:
そう思うと、まるで今までの出来事が
『あらかじめ決められた運命』のように
感じてしまうのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking back, it almost feels
like our future was predetermined
by some fate.

fields.EN:
So, your choice to place your
bets on her is also part of it?
fields.JP:
貴様が……賭けをしようと考えている、
それすらも……か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, your choice to place your
bets on her is also part of it?

fields.EN:
Why yes. The answer I came to
is probably something that was
determined by fate, too.
fields.JP:
ええそうよ。私がこの局面で
ひねり出した考え、それですらきっと
もう決まっていたことなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. The answer I came to
is probably something that was
determined by fate, too.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you're trusting
something that isn't factual.
fields.JP:
驚いたぞグレーテル、
貴様がそのようなあやふやなものを
選択するとはな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you're trusting
something that isn't factual.

fields.JP:
論理的ではないと？
……ふふ、案外そうでもないのよ？

fields.EN: Because we have no other options left.
fields.JP:
何故なら、これ以外の選択肢が
私たちには残されていないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I analyzed our options and
concluded that no other
choices remain.

fields.EN:
With all of us at our limits, we have no
moves left. If this keeps up, we'll just
be backed into a corner little by little.
fields.JP:
すべてが限界の私たちに打つ手はなく、
このままではじわじわと詰んでいくだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're at our limits, so whatever
we do, we're destined for failure.

fields.EN:
But, I believe we still have a
chance by betting on Tsuu. The
probabities remain grim, though.
fields.JP:
それならつうの『特別な力』とやらに
賭けた方がまだ勝算があると判断したの。
針の穴を通すような確率かもしれないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I believe we still have a
chance by betting on Otsuu. The
probabities remain grim, though.

fields.JP:
なるほどな。だが人魚姫まで
眠らせたのは何故なのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... But, why Little Mermaid?

fields.EN:
In any case, my bet won't work
if we die here now.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、この作戦も
ここで私たちが死ねば何の意味もない
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, my bet won't work
if we die here now.

fields.EN:
I need a powerful partner to help
protect Tsuu and Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアからつうと人魚姫を守るには、
強力で頼もしいパートナーが必要なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need a powerful partner to help
protect Otsuu and Little Mermaid.

fields.EN: I see! So that's where I come in!
fields.JP:
なるほど、そこで
ワレの出番というわけだな！
fields.LOCALIZED: I see! So that's where I come in!

fields.EN:
Exactly.
I'm counting on you, Hameln.
fields.JP:
そういうこと。
頼りにしてるわ、ハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly.
I'm counting on you, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Leave it to me!
Now, let us go, Gretel!
fields.JP:
任せておけ！
では共に行くぞ、グレーテル！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave it to me!
Now, let us go, Gretel!

fields.EN:
...I really am Hansel-niisan's
younger sister after all.
fields.JP: ……やはり私もヘンゼル兄さんの妹なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dear brother Hansel, I suppose
we are siblings after all...

fields.EN:
Because I'm facing this
for the sake of the future.
fields.JP: だって、未来のために立ち向かうんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I took a stand for the future,
just like you...

fields.JP:
（僕は……そうか、
　意識を失ってたのか……）

fields.EN:
It doesn't seem to be around...
Princess, what happ-...
fields.JP:
は、いないみたいだ……。
姫……いったい何が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't seem to be around...
Princess, what happ-...

fields.JP:
うぅ……ハーちゃん……
死んじゃ嫌だよ……！

fields.EN:
Your hand... so warm...
I'm sorry... Please... hold my
hand... a bit stronger...
fields.JP:
人魚姫の……手……あ、温かいな……
すまぬが、もう少し……強く握、って……
は……くれぬだ……ろうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your hand... so warm...
I'm sorry... Please... hold my
hand... a bit stronger...

fields.JP: 何故か、とても……寒くて……な……

fields.EN:
Okay... I'll hold tight...
So please don't die, Haa-chan...!!
fields.JP:
うん、握る……ぎゅっと握るから、
だから死なないでハーちゃん……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... I'll hold real tight...
So please... Don't die!

fields.EN:
Oh...? Otsuu... You're awake...
I'm sorry, but... could you hold...
my other hand...?
fields.JP:
おお、おつうも……目が覚めたか……
すまぬが……おつう、も……反対の手……
握って……くれぬ、だろうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh...? Otsuu... You're awake...
I'm sorry, but... could you hold...
my other hand...?

fields.JP: ああ、もちろんだハーメルン……！

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... My hands...
are so... bloody...
fields.JP:
こん、な……血まみれの手で……
ぐっ……悪い、が……な……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... My hands...
are so... bloody...

fields.EN: There's nothing to be sorry about!
fields.JP: 何も悪いことなんてないさ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: There's nothing to be sorry about!

fields.EN:
I... I wasn't... a hero...
I was... the Demon King...
to the end...
fields.JP:
……ワレは……最後……
勇者ではなく……魔王……であった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... I wasn't... a hero...
I was... the Demon King...
to the end...

fields.EN:
I couldn't... save Gretel...
What kind of... hero...
is that...?
fields.JP:
グレーテルを……守れなかった、その時……
そんな勇者など……いらぬ、と……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't... save Gretel...
What kind of... hero...
is that...?

fields.EN:
I thought... I'd become a Demon
King... who defeats enemies without mercy...
fields.JP:
敵を容赦なく倒す……魔王になって
……やると……そう……思ったのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I then... became the... Demon
King... to... destroy all...

fields.EN:
But then... I think I finally
understood... what Mamoru and the
others meant by 'companions'...
fields.JP:
でも、その時……マモルたちが
言ってた……『仲間』が……やっと……
分かった気が……した、のだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it was then... I finally...
knew what... Mamoru meant...
by being... a friend...

fields.JP:
おい目を開けろハーメルン！
開けろってばぁっ！！

ハーちゃん……ハーちゃん……！
うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁん！！

うわぁぁぁん……ハーちゃん……！
グレーテルさん……あぁぁぁ……

fields.EN:
Open your eyes!
I never asked for this to happen!
fields.JP:
目を開けてよ……！
こんなのやだよ、ねえ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Open your eyes!
I never asked for this to happen!

fields.EN:
Why did they do this?!
We could've fought against it
together!
fields.JP:
どうして２人とも……そんな無茶を……！
僕たちみんなで立ち向かえば
よかったじゃないか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did they do this?!
We could've fought against it
together!

fields.JP:
ひぐっ……もうやだ……
……えぐっ……うぁぁ……！

fields.EN:
(Is there any meaning in having
a future with no one around?)
fields.JP:
（こんな、みんないなくなった未来に
　意味なんてあるのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is there any meaning in having
a future with no one around?)

fields.JP: なんで……こんなことに……うぅ……

fields.EN:
(That's right... Now's my time to
finally repay what I owe...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……今こそ
　『僕の恩返し』の時なんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... Now's my time to
finally repay what I owe...)

fields.EN:
(I want to wipe Princess's tears.
I promised her I'd protect her.)
fields.JP:
（姫の涙を拭ってやりたい。
　守るって、決めたじゃないか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I want to wipe Princess's tears.
I promised her I'd protect her.)

fields.EN:
(But, how can I stop her tears?
How can I pay back what I owe
to her?)
fields.JP:
（どうすれば涙を拭ってあげられる？
　どうすれば恩を返せる？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, how can I stop her tears?
How can I pay back what I owe
to her?)

fields.EN:
(She saved me all this time...
It's now or never for me to
do what I can for her!)
fields.JP:
（僕はずっと助けられてきた……
　今ここで人魚姫に恩を返さなくて
　いつ返すって言うんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She saved me all this time...
It's now or never for me to
do what I can for her!)

fields.EN:
(Owe... Repay what I owe...
I will repay all that
is due to her!)
fields.JP:
（恩返しを……姫に恩返しを、
　絶対に恩返しをするんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Owe... Repay what I owe...
I will repay all that
is due to her!)

fields.JP: あがぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！
