fields.EN: What's wrong, Otsuu-chan?! Stay with me!!
fields.JP:
どうしたのおつうちゃん、
しっかりして！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What happened?!
Please stay with me!!

fields.EN:
I couldn't bear it if I lost you too,
Otsuu-chan...!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんまでいなくなったら
わたしもう耐えられないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What am I going to do if
I lose you now?!

fields.JP:
……なんでみんな
こんなことになってしまったの……？

fields.EN:
I should've died in everyone's
place if I knew this was
going to happen...
fields.JP:
みんなが死ぬくらいなら
わたしが代わりに死ねばよかったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should've died in everyone's
place if I knew this was
going to happen...

fields.JP:
ひ……め…………
……うっ……うあぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！

fields.EN:
(Everyone was left on the verge
of death because of Nightmare Alice...!)
fields.JP:
（みんなナイトメア・アリスのせいで
　瀕死になってしまった……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everything went for the worse
because of Nightmare Alice!)

fields.EN:
(What would've happened if
Alice didn't enter Blood
Skelter in the first place?)
fields.JP:
（そもそもあの時、アリスが
　ブラッドスケルター化しなかったら？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What would've happened if
Alice didn't enter Blood
Skelter in the first place?)

fields.EN:
(What if Jack didn't turn into
a Nightmare?)
fields.JP:
（あの時ジャックが
　ナイトメアにならなければ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What if Jack didn't turn into
a Nightmare?)

fields.EN:
(Was Cinderella at fault for
the peculiar predicament
between the three sisters?)
fields.JP: （三姉妹の境遇はシンデレラのせいでは？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Was Cinderella at fault for
the peculiar predicament
between the three sisters?)

fields.EN:
(Were we the ones who made
Cinderella enter Blood Skelter?)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラがブラッドスケルター化
　したのは、僕たちのせいでは？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Were we the ones who made
Cinderella enter Blood Skelter?)

fields.EN:
(Huh...? A world where
everyone is living happily?!)
fields.JP:
（あれ、みんなが
　幸せに暮らしている世界！？）
うあぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！

fields.EN:
(I remember now...
I understand everything now...)
fields.JP:
（すべて思い出した……
　……だからもう、すべて理解できる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I remember now...
I understand everything now...)

fields.EN:
(Everything... What the cause of
everything is... What this world
truly is...)
fields.JP:
（これまでに起きた出来事の原因も……
　この『世界』についても、すべて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everything... What the cause of
everything is... What this world
truly is...)

fields.JP:
あぐぁぁあっ……ぐぅぅっ……！
……うがぁぁぁぁっ……！！

fields.EN:
What can I do to help
Otsuu-chan?!
fields.JP:
どうすれば苦しそうなおつうちゃんを
助けてあげられるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What can I do to help
Otsuu?!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Otsuu-chan!
I can't do anything...!
fields.JP:
ごめんね、おつうちゃん……！
わたし何もできなくて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Otsuu!
I can't do anything...!

fields.EN:
(No... it's coming... I can't
let Princess see what comes next...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、駄目だ……来る……。
　この先はもう、姫には見せられない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's no use... It's coming...
I can't show myself to Princess.)

fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
大丈、夫だよ……姫……

おつうちゃん……！
まだ起き上がっちゃ駄目だよ……！

いいんだ……それよりも姫、
よく聞いてほしい……

fields.EN:
I'll do something about this
now... so don't ever follow me...
fields.JP:
今から僕が何とかするから……
だから絶対に追いかけてきちゃ駄目だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll do something about all this,
so... don't look at me...

fields.EN:
What do you...?
Ah... Wait! Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
それって、どういう……
あっ、待っておつうちゃん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you...?
Ah... Wait! Otsuu!

fields.JP: 絶対に覗いちゃ駄目だからね！！

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan...
What... are you going to do...?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……
何を……する気なの……？

この方向は……
もしかして上に向かった……？

fields.EN:
Why did she tell me not to
look at her? Is she trying to tell
me not to come after her?
fields.JP:
覗いては駄目？　どういうことなの……？
追いかけてはいけないの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did she tell me not to
look at her? Is she trying to tell
me not to come after her?

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、
すごい必死な感じだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I could tell was that she was
really serious...

fields.EN:
But even if she tells me not to...
I can't just leave Otsuu-chan
when she's suffering so much...
fields.JP:
でも、駄目だなんて言われても……
あんな苦しそうなおつうちゃんを
放ってはおけないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there's no way I can just
leave her... Her suffering
was so immense...

fields.EN:
I need to find her...
I need to find Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
行かなきゃ……
追いかけなきゃ、おつうちゃんを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to find her...
I need to find Otsuu...

fields.JP:
どうしよう、おつうちゃん
ここにもいない……

あっ……！　あれは……
また別のナイトメア……！？

fields.EN:
It found me!
I-I need to run...!
fields.JP:
見つかっちゃった……！
どうしよう、逃げないと――
fields.LOCALIZED:
It found me!
I-I need to run...!

fields.EN: I told you not to look at me...
fields.JP: 絶対に覗いちゃ駄目だと言ったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: I told you not to look at me...

fields.EN:
But... Princess would
look anyway, wouldn't she?
fields.JP: でも、姫は見ちゃうよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should've known better that you
would come after me.

fields.EN:
You're kind and strong. You love singing...
and sometimes you do reckless things.
fields.JP:
優しくて強い。
歌が大好きで……
ときどき、無茶をする
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so kind and strong. You
like singing, and you sometimes
make the boldest of decisions...

fields.EN:
I loved and adored
all that you were.
fields.JP: そんな君が愛しくて、大好きだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I loved and adored
all that you were.

fields.JP: もしかして……おつうちゃん……？

fields.EN:
That's right, Princess.
I'm Tsuu, the one you bonded
to in matrimony...
fields.JP:
そうだよ、姫。
君と夫婦の契りを交わした、つうだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Princess.
I'm Otsuu, the one you bonded
to in matrimony...

fields.EN:
What's happening...? Were you a Nightmare,
Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
今何が起きてるの……？
おつうちゃんはナイトメアだったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's going on?
Were you... a Nightmare?

fields.EN:
This is all too much...
Please, tell me what's going on.
fields.JP:
いきなりすぎて全然分からないよ……
お願い、ちゃんと教えて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is all too much...
Please, tell me what's going on.

fields.EN:
I know what I'll say will sound
unbelievable, but please listen
with an open mind.
fields.JP:
突拍子もない話に
聞こえるかもしれないけど……
どうか聞いてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know what I'll say will sound
unbelievable, but please listen
with an open mind.

fields.EN:
I... was a Nightmare that traveled
from the future to the past to
save you.
fields.JP:
……僕は姫を救うために、未来から
過去へと飛んだナイトメア……だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... was a Nightmare that traveled
from the future to the past to
save you.

fields.EN:
I used to live as a Nightmare at
a place called the Metropolitan
Building, "Tocho."
fields.JP:
元々は『都庁』と呼ばれる場所で、
僕はナイトメアとして生きていた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I used to live as a Nightmare at
a place called the Metropolitan
Building, "Tocho."

fields.EN:
It seems I was born without the
powers of a Nightmare.
I was weak...
fields.JP:
僕は中途半端なナイトメアに生まれた
みたいで、力なんて全然なかった。
ひ弱だったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I was born without the
powers of a Nightmare.
I was weak...

fields.EN:
The Marchens where I was
were all powerful, and soon
they chased me out.
fields.JP:
しかも都庁のメルヒェンはどいつも強く、
僕は段々と居場所を失っていったんだ。
ナイトメアがメルヒェンに追われたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchens where I was
were all powerful, and soon
they chased me out.

fields.EN:
As I ran, I came upon the Aquarium
Ruins, and that's where I met
Ningyohime...
fields.JP:
そして逃げるように遠くに出かけた僕は、
たまたま水族館跡エリアに迷い込んで……
そして『人魚姫』に出会ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As I ran, I came upon the Aquarium
Ruins, and that's where I met
Little Mermaid...

fields.EN:
You treated me kindly, even in
this unsightly state.
fields.JP:
こんな化け物の姿の僕に、
姫はとても親切にしてくれたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You treated me kindly, even in
this unsightly state.

fields.EN:
But I was a coward. I kept running
away, worried that Princess might be
frightened of me or come to hate me...
fields.JP:
だけど僕は臆病で、姫に怖がられたり
嫌われたりしたらどうしよう……って、
ずっと逃げていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I kept avoiding you, too shy
to say anything, too scared of
being despised by you...

fields.EN:
I kept telling myself I'd talk to you today...
I wonder how many days passed like that...
fields.JP:
今日こそは声をかけようって思って、
いったい何日が過ぎただろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But after some time passed,
I decided to talk to you,
and searched for you for days.

fields.EN:
By the time I finally mustered
the courage, Princess was already
gone from the Aquarium Ruins.
fields.JP:
ついに勇気を振り絞った時には、
姫はもう水族館跡エリアからいなくなってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the time I mustered the courage
to speak, you went missing.

fields.EN:
Having no reason to stay anymore,
I decided to return to my abode.
But I couldn't find my way back.
fields.JP:
それで仕方なく都庁に帰ろうとしたけど……
帰り道が分からなくなってしまったんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Having no reason to stay anymore,
I decided to return to my abode.
But I couldn't find my way back.

fields.EN:
I lost my way into the underground
cavern, and soon became a
wandering Nightmare...
fields.JP:
そして僕は、地下洞窟を彷徨う
ナイトメアになっていった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I lost my way into the underground
cavern, and soon became a
wandering Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Time passed, then one day
I finally met some humans, but
they quickly moved in to attack.
fields.JP:
そんなある日、僕は久しぶりに
人間に出会ったんだけど……
その人間たちは僕を見るなり襲ってきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Time passed, then one day
I finally met some humans, but
they quickly moved in to attack.

fields.EN:
Those humans were Akazukin
and the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
それが赤ずきんたち、
その時の血式少女たちだったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those humans were Red Riding
Hood and the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised they attacked.
Look at me... I probably would've
done so, too.
fields.JP:
まあその時は今よりも化け物の姿だったから、
襲ってくるのも仕方ないよね……
今ならその気持ちはよく分かるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised they attacked.
Look at me... I probably would've
done so, too.

fields.EN:
Of course, back then, I thought
to myself how horrible humans
were...
fields.JP:
その時はなんて酷い
人間たちだろうって思ったけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, back then, I thought
to myself how horrible humans
were...

fields.EN:
So... what happened with Onee-chan
and the others? Did you fight...?
fields.JP:
それで……おねーちゃんたちとは
どうなったの？　戦ったの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So... Did you fight Sis?
What happened?

fields.EN:
I used fakes of me as bait,
and ran. There was no way
I could take them all on at once.
fields.JP:
いいや、偽者を囮にしてひたすら逃げたよ。
敵うわけないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I used fakes of me as bait,
and ran. There was no way
I could take them all on at once.

fields.EN:
I kept running, and soon I came
back to the Metropolitan Building.
That's when I heard...
fields.JP:
でたらめに逃げる内に都庁に出たんだけど、
赤ずきんたちが追いかけてきて、
そこで聞いたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept running, and soon I came
back to the Metropolitan Building.
That's when I heard...

fields.EN:
...that you died from entering
Blood Skelter at the Aquarium
Ruins.
fields.JP:
姫は、水族館跡エリアで
ブラッドスケルター化して
死んだ……って
fields.LOCALIZED:
...that you died from entering
Blood Skelter at the Aquarium
Ruins.

fields.EN:
The moment I heard that, I couldn't sit still,
so I made the Metropolitan Building Jail grow.
fields.JP:
それを聞いた僕はいてもたっても
いられなくなって、都庁のジェイルを
成長させた
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moment I heard that, I made
the Metropolitan Building grow
as fast as I could.

fields.EN:
A Jail that grows large produces
a large core—a special core that
can mimic a wish to its fullest...
fields.JP:
成長したジェイルは大きな核を生み出す。
『願いを最大限擬態化してくれる』という、
特別な核をね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
An area that grows large enough
produces a special core that can
mimic one's wish perfectly.

fields.EN:
We Nightmares call this
special core, "Witchcraft."
fields.JP:
それを僕たちナイトメアは、
『ウィッチクラフト』って呼んでいるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We Nightmares call this
special core, "Witchcraft."

fields.EN:
You know how we tried to
escape by making the Jail
Tower grow, right?
fields.JP:
今まで僕たちは、監獄塔を伸ばして
脱獄するって考えていただろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how we tried to
escape by making the Jail
Tower grow, right?

fields.EN:
The Jail Tower grows in tandem
with the jail, but that alone
isn't enough to escape.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの成長に伴って、
監獄塔は確かに伸びるよ。
でもそれで脱獄なんてできないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail Tower grows in tandem
with the jail, but that alone
isn't enough to escape.

fields.EN:
Of course, maybe a Witchcraft
core would have been born to
grant the wish.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、脱獄を願えば叶う何かに
擬態化してくれるかもしれないけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, maybe a Witchcraft
core would have been born to
grant the wish.

fields.JP: まあ、今となってはどうでもいい話さ

fields.EN:
In any case, I was able to grow
the tower to reach the moon to
inseminate it.
fields.JP:
結末はすごく単純だ。僕は監獄塔を伸ばし、
上の月に届かせて、受精させた。
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I was able to grow
the tower to reach the moon to
inseminate it.

fields.EN:
That brought about a Witchcraft
core, to which I earnestly prayed...
fields.JP:
そして産まれたウィッチクラフト……
大きな核に強く願ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That brought about a Witchcraft
core, to which I earnestly prayed...

fields.JP: そっか……そう願ってくれたんだね……

fields.EN:
Before I knew it, I had become a Blood Maiden
and was at the Aquarium Ruins before Princess
died. This world began from that point.
fields.JP:
気付けば僕は血式少女となって、
姫が死んでしまう前の水族館跡エリアにいた。
この世界は、そこから始まってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and it worked. I became a
Blood Maiden in this world before
you died at the Aquarium Ruins.

fields.EN:
The reason I came here...
Well, I don't think I need to
explain much else now...
fields.JP:
そして今、僕がここに来たのは……
つまりはそういうことだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The reason I came here...
Well, I don't think I need to
explain much else now...

fields.EN:
I came to pray upon
this Witchcraft core again...
fields.JP:
強い願いを擬態化して叶えてくれる、
このウィッチクラフトに……
願いに来たんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I came to pray upon
this Witchcraft core again...

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan... what were you going to wish for?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんは、
何を願うつもりだったの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, what are you planning to
wish for?

fields.EN:
If there's a body, it may be
possible to bring someone back to life...
fields.JP:
死体があれば、人は蘇らせることが
できるかもしれないんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may be able to bring back
someone from the dead so long
as their body is within range.

fields.EN:
I want to bring everyone that died
back to life.
fields.JP: だから、死んでいったみんなを蘇らせたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to bring everyone that died
back to life.

fields.EN:
...What about the people from Dawn? No,
not just them—what about everyone else
who's been brutally murdered up to now?
fields.JP:
……黎明の人は？
ううん、それだけじゃない、
他に今まで惨殺された人は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What about the members of Dawn?
Or how about all the people who
died in the past?

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan? Was everyone happy
in a world where I wasn't alive?
fields.JP:
ねえ、おつうちゃん。
わたしが生きてない時間軸では、
みんなは幸せだった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? Was everyone happy
in a world where I wasn't alive?

fields.JP: お願い、ちゃんと答えて

fields.EN:
Yes... Or, at least I think they
were happy.
fields.JP: うん……幸せだったと、思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Or, at least I think they
were happy.

fields.EN:
Cinderella was an adult, and the
bad air between the sisters
didn't exist.
fields.JP:
その時間軸では
幼いままのシンデレラもいないし、
仲の悪そうな三姉妹もいなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella was an adult, and the
bad air between the sisters
didn't exist.

fields.EN:
Alice and Jack were humans, and
they all were working together.
fields.JP:
何より、アリスもジャックも人間のままで、
みんなと行動を共にしていたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice and Jack were humans, and
they all were working together.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, do you mind if I
come closer?
fields.JP: おつうちゃん、側に行ってもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, do you mind if I
come closer?

fields.EN:
P-Princess!
You shouldn't come near me now...
fields.JP:
ひ、姫……！？
僕、今はこんな姿だから近づかない方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Princess!
You shouldn't come near me now...

fields.EN: I want to hug you, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: 抱きしめさせて、おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED: I want to hug you, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Thank you for doing all that
you've done for me.
fields.JP:
わたしのためにそこまでしてくれて、
本当にありがとうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for doing all that
you've done for me.

fields.EN:
What you did filled my life
with happiness.
fields.JP:
おかげで、わたしは
いっぱいいっぱい幸せだったよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you did filled my life
with happiness.

fields.EN:
Which is why I don't think you
should wish to reverse what has
happened.
fields.JP:
でもね、こんな風に、
なかったことにしちゃうのはダメだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why I don't think you
should wish to reverse what has
happened.

fields.EN:
I think we all do our best when
fate gives us things that
can't be changed.
fields.JP:
取り返しがつかなくて、
だから精一杯にがんばろうって思える――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think we all do our best when
fate gives us things that
can't be changed.

fields.EN:
That's what it means to live
in the "present."
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what it means to live
in the "present."

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan? You should wish for
something else.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんが願うべきは、
もっと違うことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? You should wish for
something else.

fields.EN:
Let's return this world
to the way it was meant
to be. Let's live properly, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
この世界を、本来あるべき姿に戻そう
正しく生きよう、おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should return this world to
its proper order. We should live
as fate originally intended.

fields.EN:
No... No, no, no!
I don't want to lose you!
fields.JP:
いやだ……いやだいやだ！
姫を失うなんて絶対にいやだっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... No, no, no!
I don't want to lose you!

fields.EN:
I don't want to lose you
ever again!
fields.JP: 僕はもう二度と姫を失いたくないんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to lose you
ever again!

fields.EN:
Then is it okay for everyone from Dawn,
everyone from the Liberation District...
all the Blood Maidens to stay dead?
fields.JP:
じゃあ黎明のみんな、解放地区のみんな……
血式少女のみんなは死んだままでいいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we can't leave all the Blood
Maidens, the members of Dawn,
everyone dead, right?

fields.EN:
Is a future without a single one
of them a happy future, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
誰かが欠けている未来でも、
おつうちゃんは幸せだって言えるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is a future without a single one
of them a happy future, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
But...!
Of course I want them all alive...
fields.JP:
それはっ……！
……そんなの、もちろんいやだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...!
Of course I want them all alive...

fields.EN:
I was only concerned about you...
But, I found out that I also cared
about everyone we were with...
fields.JP:
前は、姫さえいればいいって思ってた……
だけど……気づいたらみんなのことも
大好きで、すごく大事で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was only concerned about you...
But, I found out that I also cared
about everyone we were with...

fields.EN:
There's no one I love more than you,
Princess. That's certain. But... I love
everyone else too much to want to lose them...
fields.JP:
姫が一番大好きだ、それは絶対だ。
でも、でもみんなも失いたくないくらい
大好きなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no one I love more than
you, Princess. But, I don't want
all of our friends to remain dead...

fields.EN: What am I supposed to do?!
fields.LOCALIZED: What am I supposed to do?!

fields.EN: That's how I feel about you...
fields.JP: これがわたしの、きもちだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's how I feel about you...

fields.EN: You feel the same about me...
fields.LOCALIZED: You feel the same about me...

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、愛してるよ……

fields.EN:
So, my dear prince, the time has
come for you to repay me for
what you owe.
fields.JP:
けどね、恩を返してほしい時が来たの。
ねえ、わたしの王子さま
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, my dear prince, the time has
come for you to repay me for
what you owe.

fields.EN:
Indeed...
I am your prince, after all.
fields.JP:
……そうだったね。
僕は君の王子さまだったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed...
I am your prince, after all.

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm your prince. I'm the
perfect prince to protect you,
and to grant your wish.
fields.JP:
そう、僕は王子なんだ。姫を守り、
姫の願いを叶える、そんな完璧な王子なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm your prince. I'm the
perfect prince to protect you,
and to grant your wish.

fields.EN:
Oh, and I also know there's no way
I can change your mind once you've
made a choice.
fields.JP: それに、こうなったら姫は頑固だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I also know there's no way
I can change your mind once you've
made a choice.

fields.EN:
Sorry to be such
a stubborn princess.
fields.JP: わがままな姫で、ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry to be such
a stubborn princess.

fields.EN:
Well now, a bit of stubbornness
makes you cuter, my dear princess.
fields.JP:
なーに、多少わがままな方が
可愛らしいというものですよ、姫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, a bit of stubbornness
makes you cuter, my dear princess.

fields.JP: ありがとう、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
Princess, I love you too. ...Let's meet
again someday, at the far end of the future.
fields.JP:
姫、僕もあなたを愛しています。
……いつか未来の果てで、お会いしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you more than anything.
I pray that we will meet again
one day in the future...

fields.EN:
Yes... I may be inexperienced, but please
take care of me for the rest of our lives.
fields.JP:
はい……ふつつか者ですが、
末永くよろしくお願い致します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... And when we meet,
we'll be joined in matrimony again.

fields.EN:
It's time we depart.
Please, watch your step...
fields.JP:
さあ、出発しましょう。
お足元にお気をつけて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's time we depart.
Please, watch your step...

fields.EN:
Bring to us the true
"present" of this world...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bring to us the true
"present" of this world...

fields.EN:
No! Don't come any closer!
Please! It hurts!
fields.JP:
いやっ、こないでっ！
おねがいっ、いたいってばぁっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Don't come any closer!
Please! It hurts!

fields.EN:
Ten of you ganging up on such
a little girl... I won't forgive you!
fields.JP:
こんな小さな子に
１０体でよってたかって……許さない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you're all ganging
up on such a little girl!
You're all gonna pay!

fields.EN:
Shoot! There's too many!
If this keeps up...!
fields.JP:
くそっ……数が多い……！
このままじゃやられる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot! There's too many!
If this keeps up...!

fields.JP:
……あはっ、あははははは！
あーっはっはっは！
あはっ……！　死ね死ね死ねぇっ！
あははっ！　あははははははっ！

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff... That was pretty tough,
but... I'm glad I managed to save her...
fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
結構しんどかったけど……
でも助けられてよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff...
That was tiring, but... thank
goodness she's safe, I think...

fields.EN:
It's gonna be all right!
We'll get you back and get
Miko to patch you up!
fields.JP:
だ……大丈夫！　すぐに帰って、
ミコに手当てしてもらうから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's gonna be all right!
We'll get you back and get
Miko to patch you up!

Who are you...?
Are you my dear sister...?

fields.JP: あたし、赤ずきんだよ。あんたは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me? I'm Red Riding Hood.
And you?

fields.JP: わたし……わたしは、人魚姫……

fields.EN:
Don't you worry! We'll meet up
with Haru, and take you back
to Dawn!
fields.JP:
安心して。すぐにハルと合流して、
黎明に連れてってあげるから。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry! We'll meet up
with Haru, and take you back
to Dawn!

fields.EN:
Hey! Look!
We just have to go around that
corner, and...
fields.JP:
あっ！　あそこだ！
あとはあの角を曲がれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Look!
We just have to go around that
corner, and...

fields.EN:
More of them...! Sorry,
Ningyo, I'm putting you down!
fields.JP:
またいっぱいきた……！
ごめんニンギョ、おろすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
More of them...?!
Sorry! Can you wait over here,
Little Mermaid?

fields.EN: I'm... okay...! Onee-chan will protect you...!
fields.JP:
だいっ……じょうぶっ……！
おねーちゃんが、守ってあげるから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... okay...!
Let big sis' here handle this!

fields.JP: っ！　ニンギョに、触るなあああああっ！

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff... Finally, done...
Ningyo, are you...
all... right...?
fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
よし、ぜんぶ倒した……
ニンギョ、だい……じょう、ぶ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff... Finally, done...
Little Mermaid, are you...
all... right...?

fields.EN:
Ningyo... your legs...
They turned into... a fish tail?
fields.JP:
ニンギョ……あんた、足が……
魚の尾っぽになって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid... your legs...
They turned into... a fish tail?

fields.EN:
Ouch! What are you doing,
Ningyo?!
fields.JP: 痛いっ！　何するの、ニンギョ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ouch! What are you doing,
Little Mermaid?!

fields.JP: ガゥ！　ガァァァァッ！！

fields.EN:
Aagh! S-Stop it! That hurts!
Ningyo!
fields.JP:
ぎゃあっ！　やめて、
やめてよニンギョ！　痛いよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aagh! S-Stop it! That hurts!
Little Mermaid!

fields.JP: グガァァァァァァァッ！！
い……いやだああああああああああっ！

ちっちゃい……
おねー……ちゃん……？

そ、そっか…………
よかっ……た……

fields.EN:
She wasn't a Marchen.
She was definitely a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP: メルヒェンではないな。血式少女だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She wasn't a Marchen.
She was definitely a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
I can't believe we found a Blood
Maiden. But then you let her die.
I'm disappointed in you, Haru-kun.
fields.JP:
新たな血式少女を見つけたと思ったら、
まさか死なせてしまうとは……ハルくん、
君がついていながら、残念だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe we found a Blood
Maiden. But then you let her die.
I'm disappointed in you, Haru.

fields.EN:
According to Akazukin,
this girl, Ningyohime, had an
awakening we're not aware of.
fields.JP:
しかし、どういう事だろうな……
赤ずきんの話によると、この人魚姫は、
私達がまだ知らない覚醒の仕方をしたようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
According to Red Riding Hood,
this girl, Little Mermaid, had an
awakening we're not aware of.

fields.EN:
Yeah. I didn't actually
see it myself, but...
fields.JP:
ああ。俺も見たわけじゃねぇから
何とも言えないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I didn't actually
see it myself, but...

fields.EN:
...From what I heard, even though she
adored Akazukin, she attacked without
warning and couldn't be reasoned with.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんを慕ってたはずなのに、問答無用で
襲ってきて、言葉も通じなかったって話だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...From what I heard, despite the
girl's fondness for Red,
she still jumped her.

fields.EN:
Could it be that there's another
level to the awakening?
A true awakening, so to speak?
fields.JP:
覚醒にはもう一段階ある……？
正の覚醒と負の覚醒……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could it be that there's another
level to the awakening?
A true awakening, so to speak?

fields.EN:
Based on what Akazukin
reported, Ningyohime was
covered in Marchen blood.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんの話では、
人魚姫はメルヒェンの血を浴びた。
それは確かなようです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Based on what Red Riding Hood
reported, Little Mermaid was
covered in Marchen blood.

fields.EN:
She was also quite frightened.
Maybe that could be playing a role
in what happened.
fields.JP:
あとは異様なまでに怯えていたようです。
もしかしたら、それが関係している可能性も
あるかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was also quite frightened.
Maybe that could be playing a role
in what happened.

fields.EN:
Duh, like, a young girl witnessing
a bloodbath, that would scare the
wits out of anyone.
fields.JP:
あんな幼い子が目の前で
血まみれの殺し合いを見せられたんだ、
怯えるのもしょうがねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Duh, like, a young girl witnessing
a bloodbath, that would scare the
wits out of anyone.

fields.EN:
Miko's suggestion is worth noting.
Maybe the girl's mental stability
was broken from the bloodshed.
fields.JP:
いや、考慮の余地はある。
血を浴びすぎて、殺戮を見せつけられて……
心の均衡でも崩れたか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko's suggestion is worth noting.
Maybe the girl's mental stability
was broken from the bloodshed.

fields.EN:
If so, she may have entered an
uncontrollable state. Let us call
it "Blood Skelter" for now...
fields.JP:
だとしたら、この異常な制御不能状態は、
さしずめ『ブラッドスケルター状態』……
……といったところか
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, she may have entered an
uncontrollable state. Let us call
it "Blood Skelter" for now...

fields.JP: なるほど、ブラッドスケルター……ね

fields.EN:
I suppose I should conduct further
research using Marchen blood to...
fields.JP:
これはメルヒェンの血を使って、
さらなる実験をする必要があるな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I should conduct further
research using Marchen blood to...

fields.EN:
Excuse me, but I noticed that
Ningyohime's body isn't
rotting at all...
fields.JP:
そういえば、この人魚姫の死体……
一向に腐りませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Excuse me, but I noticed that
Little Mermaid's body isn't
rotting at all...

fields.EN:
Indeed.
That is also quite peculiar.
fields.JP: そうだ、ここも異常な点だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed.
That is also quite peculiar.

fields.EN:
Could it be that it is because
she died during Blood Skelter?
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、ブラッドスケルター化
してる状態で死んだからか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could it be that it is because
she died during Blood Skelter?

fields.EN:
(It looks like she ate the
food I left for her...)
fields.JP:
（今日も、私が用意したごはん、
　食べてくれたみたい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like she ate the
food I left for her...)

fields.EN:
(I'm so happy she took it...
I sure wouldn't mind talking
with her...)
fields.JP:
（嬉しいなあ……でももっと
　ちゃんとお話をしてみたいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm so happy she took it...
I sure wouldn't mind talking
with her...)

fields.EN:
(I feel like the longer I wait,
the more I'll regret it...)
fields.JP:
（何だか早くしないと
　後悔しそうな気がするし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel like the longer I wait,
the more I'll regret it...)

fields.EN:
(Well then, I'll try talking to
her tomorrow!)
fields.JP:
（よし、決めた！
　明日こそあの子に話しかけよう！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well then, I'll try talking to
her tomorrow!)

fields.JP:
ぎぎ……あじだ……
だのじ、み……ぎちち……だな……

fields.EN:
(I wanted to see Princess,
but wouldn't barging in to her
room a bit tactless?)
fields.JP:
（姫に会いたくて部屋の前まで来たけど、
　いきなり来たら迷惑じゃないかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wanted to see Princess,
but wouldn't barging in to her
room a bit tactless?)

fields.EN:
(Coming here every day may
be too much for her, too...)
fields.JP:
（それに、毎日何度も何度も訪ねてるし、
　さすがに気持ち悪がられるんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Coming here every day may
be too much for her, too...)

fields.EN:
Mmm...
A good reason to visit her...
fields.JP: うーん……何かいい理由は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...
A good reason to visit her...

fields.JP: あれ？　おつうちゃん？

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, did you come to see me?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、もしかしてわたしに
会いに来てくれたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you come to see me?

fields.EN:
Huh?!
N-Not at all! I just happened
to pass by.
fields.JP:
えっ！？
い、いや、たまたま通りかかっただけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?!
N-Not at all! I just happened
to pass by.

fields.EN:
Uh... Th-That's right!
I-I was just going to go back
to my room!
fields.JP:
えっと……そ、そう！
ち、ちょうど部屋に戻るところだったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Th-That's right!
I-I was just going to go back
to my room!

fields.EN:
But Otsuu-chan, you already passed your room,
didn't you?
fields.JP:
でも、おつうちゃんの部屋、
もう通り過ぎてるよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you do know you already
went past your room, right?

fields.EN:
Th-That aside, how are things,
Princess?!
fields.JP: ひ、姫の方こそいったいどうしたんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That aside, how are things,
Princess?!

fields.EN:
Were you planning on coming
to see me, perhaps?
fields.JP:
もしかして、僕に会いに行こうと
してたのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Were you planning on coming
to see me, perhaps?

fields.EN:
I wanted to talk with you, Otsuu-chan,
so I came to see you. I was surprised
to find you in front of my room.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんとお話したくて、
会いに行こうとしたら部屋の前に
いるんだもん。びっくりしちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to talk with you, so
it was a surprise seeing you
here in front of my room.

fields.EN:
So if you came because you wanted
to talk with me too, Otsuu-chan,
that would've made me happy...
fields.JP:
だから、おつうちゃんも
わたしとお話したくて来てくれたのなら、
嬉しかったんだけどなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It would've been great if you
actually came by to see me.

fields.EN:
I see... you're going back to your
room already, Otsuu-chan. That's too bad...
fields.JP:
そっかぁ、おつうちゃんは、
もう部屋に戻っちゃうんだ。
残念だなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're heading back, right?
Mmm... Too bad.

fields.EN:
I'd be so happy if you said you
wanted to talk with me, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんがわたしと話したいって、
そう言ってくれたらとっても嬉しいのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would've been soooo happy if
you said you came to talk to me.

fields.EN:
I give up!
Yes! I came because I wanted to
see you, Princess.
fields.JP:
降参だ！
本当は、姫に会いたくて来たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I give up!
Yes! I came because I wanted to
see you, Princess.

fields.EN:
Really?! Why didn't you say so
earlier?! Come on in!
Let me brew you some tea.
fields.JP:
ほんと！　嬉しい！
じゃあ、部屋に入って！
美味しいお茶を淹れてあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?! Why didn't you say so
earlier?! Come on in!
Let me brew you some tea.

fields.EN:
As you command, my dear princess.
I will follow you to your bidding.
fields.JP:
仰せのままに、姫。
どこへなりとも、一生ついていくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you command, my dear princess.
I will follow you to your bidding.

fields.EN:
(Unbelievable... She toyed with
my heart ever so easily...)
fields.JP:
（まったく、そうやって君は、
　僕の心をいとも簡単に弄ぶんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Unbelievable... She toyed with
my heart ever so easily...)

fields.EN:
(But, that is also what makes
her so attractive.)
fields.JP:
（だけど、そのちょっと意地悪なところも、
　すごく魅力的だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, that is also what makes
her so attractive.)

fields.EN:
(Taken advantage by love...
An apt description of me indeed.)
fields.JP:
（惚れた弱み、なんて言うけど、
　全くその通りだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Taken advantage by love...
An apt description of me indeed.)

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness!
I made it in time!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness!
I made it in time!)

fields.JP:
（ああ……
　いつ聞いても姫の歌はいい……）

fields.EN:
O-Otsuu-chan?!
Since when were you there?!
fields.JP:
お、おつうちゃん！？　
いつからそこに居たの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Otsuu?!
Since when were you there?!

fields.EN: I just came a short while ago.
fields.LOCALIZED: I just came a short while ago.

fields.EN:
Aw...
I thought you wouldn't notice.
fields.JP:
も、もう……
今日こそは気づかれないと思ったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw...
I thought you wouldn't notice.

fields.EN:
Do you think I wouldn't notice?
I would follow you no matter
where you would go.
fields.JP:
僕が姫の美声を聞き逃すわけがないだろう？
たとえ地球の裏側に居ても、
こうして駆けつけるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think I wouldn't notice?
I would follow you no matter
where you would go.

fields.EN:
That aside, do you mind singing
a bit more for me?
fields.JP:
それよりも、もっと僕に歌を
聴かせてくれないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside, do you mind singing
a bit more for me?

fields.EN:
Geez, Otsuu-chan! You keep saying embarrassing
things, so that's enough for today!
fields.JP:
もう！　おつうちゃんが恥ずかしいこと
ばっかり言うから、今日はお終いです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Stop it with all your
sweet talk! No more for you!

fields.EN:
That's quite unfortunate.
But... are you sure about that?
fields.JP:
それは本当に残念だ。
でもいいのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite unfortunate.
But... are you sure about that?

fields.EN:
I'm sure you want to sing a bit
more, yes?
fields.JP: 本当はまだ歌い足りないんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you want to sing a bit
more, yes?

fields.JP: そ、そんなことないもん

fields.EN:
I've been with you for as long as
forever. I know you're lying just
by the expression on your face.
fields.JP:
僕が普段どれだけ姫の事を見ていると
思っているんだい？　顔を見れば、
それくらい分かるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been with you for as long as
forever. I know you're lying just
by the expression on your face.

fields.EN:
Geez... You can be mean sometimes,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
もう……
おつうちゃんはたまにいじわるだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
You really know how to tease
others, don't you?

fields.EN:
I am still very much a child, you
know? That's why I have this knack
of teasing the girl I love.
fields.JP:
僕は子供っぽいからね。
だから、大好きな女の子に、
ついいじわるしてしまうんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am still very much a child, you
know? That's why I have this knack
of teasing the girl I love.

fields.EN:
Hey...!
Okay then. Just one song, though.
fields.JP:
……もう。
分かった。そこまで言うなら歌ってあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey...!
Okay then. Just one song, though.

fields.JP: もう……ずるいなぁ、おつうちゃんは
ナイトメア・ジャック

ちぎぎ……うだ……
うぎ……ぎぎ……

fields.EN: Did you come to listen too, Jack?
fields.JP: ジャックも聴きに来たのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you come to listen too, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぢぎ……うぎぎ……
ぎぎ……ぎ……
ジャック、踊ってるのかい？
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……だのじい……
ぎぎ……ぎ……
ははっ、なかなか上手じゃないか

fields.EN:
Princess, it's me.
Can I come in?
fields.JP:
姫、僕だけど。
入っていいか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, it's me.
Can I come in?

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん？
うん、どうぞ

fields.EN:
Hi Otsuu-chan.
What brings you here today?
fields.JP:
いらっしゃい。おつうちゃん。
今日はどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hi Otsuu.
What brings you here today?

fields.EN:
There's something I wanted to
show you.
fields.JP: 姫に、見てもらいたい物があって来たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's something I wanted to
show you.

fields.EN:
I wrote some lyrics to the song
you always sing.
fields.JP:
実は、いつも姫が歌ってる歌に、
歌詞をつけてみたんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wrote some lyrics to the song
you always sing.

fields.EN: Really? You mind I take a look?
fields.JP: そうなんだ。読んでもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? You mind I take a look?

fields.EN:
Sure. I can only hope you'll
like what I have there...
fields.JP:
もちろん。
喜んでくれるといいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. I can only hope you'll
like what I have there...

fields.EN:
Let's see...
"My dear prince, your eyes gracing
me fills my heart..."
fields.JP:
えっと……わたしの好きな王子様。
あなたに見つめられるだけで
わたしの胸は――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see...
"My dear prince, your eyes gracing
me fills my heart..."

fields.EN:
So, how is it?
I wrote it based on the view of
a prince.
fields.JP:
どうかな？
王子様をテーマに書いてみたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how is it?
I wrote it based on the view of
a prince.

fields.EN:
It actually sounds more like it's
being read in the view of a
princess.
fields.JP:
王子様っていうより、
お姫様の気持ちって感じかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It actually sounds more like it's
being read in the view of a
princess.

fields.EN:
Hee hee... But I think that's just like you,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
ふふ……
でも、とってもおつうちゃんらしいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
But it's soooo like you.

fields.EN:
Thank you. I'm happy you went
through the trouble to write this,
but it's a bit embarrassing.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。とっても嬉しいよ。
でも、歌うのはちょっと照れくさいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. I'm happy you went
through the trouble to write this,
but it's a bit embarrassing.

fields.JP: ええっ！？　ど、どうして！？

fields.EN: The lyrics are too cute for me...
fields.JP: だって、わたしには可愛すぎるもの
fields.LOCALIZED: The lyrics are too cute for me...

fields.EN:
C-Cute...? S-So, you're telling
me that my lyrics are as sweet
as strawberries?
fields.JP:
か、可愛い……そんなばかな……
この僕が書いた歌詞が、
甘々ストロベリーだと言うのかい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
C-Cute...? S-So, you're telling
me that my lyrics are as sweet
as strawberries?

fields.JP: あまあまストロベリー！

fields.EN:
Ningyo! Where sweets?!
Rapunzel want some!
fields.JP:
にんぎょ！　おかしはどこ！？
ラプンツェルもたべたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fishy! Where sweets?!
Rapunzel want some!

fields.EN:
Huh? S-Sweets?
Oh, um... I don't have any with
me now...
fields.JP:
え？　お、お菓子？
えーっと……今お菓子はないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? S-Sweets?
Oh, um... I don't have any with
me now...

fields.EN:
Huh? But, I hear sweet
strawberries.
fields.JP:
えー？　だってさっき、
かしがあまあまストロベリーってきこえた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But, I hear sweet
strawberries.

fields.EN:
Oh, it was just a comparison to
the lyrics I wrote.
fields.JP:
それはお菓子のことじゃなくて、
僕の歌詞のことだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, it was just a comparison to
the lyrics I wrote.

fields.JP:
どういうことー？
かしっておかしのことじゃないの？

fields.EN:
Um... The sweets we were talking
about is this...
fields.JP:
えっと……さっきわたしが言ってた
『かし』は、食べ物じゃなくてこれの事なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... The sweets we were talking
about is this...

fields.EN:
It's words for a song.
It's called "lyrics."
fields.JP:
歌に言葉をのせたもの。
それが歌詞っていうのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's words for a song.
It's called "lyrics."

fields.EN:
"My dear prince... your eyes...
gracing... me fills... my heart...
with... sweet choc...olates..."
fields.JP:
わたしのすきなおうじさま
あなたにみつめられるだけで、
むねにチョコレートのようなあまさが――
fields.LOCALIZED:
"My dear prince... your eyes...
gracing... me fills... my heart...
with... sweet choc...olates..."

fields.EN:
R-Rapunzel!
Keep it down, will you?!
fields.JP:
ら、ラプンツェル！
声に出さなくていいから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Rapunzel!
Keep it down, will you?!

fields.JP: （うう、急に恥ずかしくなってきた！）
ラプちゃん、どうだった？

チョコとかイチゴとかでてきて、
とってもおいしそうだったよ！

fields.EN:
Heh, you're right.
Just like Otsuu-chan, nice and sweet.
fields.JP:
ふふ、そうだね。
おつうちゃんらしくて可愛いよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, you're right.
Just like Otsuu, nice and sweet.

fields.EN:
Urrh... I'll be back next time
with a piece befitting of a true
prince!
fields.JP:
うう……つ、次はかっこいい王子様風の
歌詞を作って来るから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... I'll be back next time
with a piece befitting of a true
prince!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel wanna real sweets
next time.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、つぎはたべもののほうの
『かし』がいいなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel wanna real sweets
next time.

fields.EN:
(I finally got the bracelet
I asked Takumi to make for me.
Now, to find Princess...)
fields.JP:
（タクミに頼んでいたブレスレットが
　ようやく完成した。
　さっそく姫にプレゼントしに行こう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I finally got the bracelet
I asked Takumi to make for me.
Now, to find Princess...)

fields.JP: （さて、姫はどこにいるのかな……）

fields.EN:
It's okay to play, but you really
have to keep things a bit cleaner
around here.
fields.JP:
もう……遊ぶのはいいですけど、
あんまり散らかしちゃだめですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay to play, but you really
have to keep things a bit cleaner
around here.

fields.JP: う……ごめんなさいですわ

fields.EN:
Just be careful the next time.
Now then, let's play.
fields.JP:
次から気をつけてくれればいいんですよ
じゃあ……何して遊びましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just be careful the next time.
Now then, let's play.

fields.JP: ちゃんとごめんなさいできたご褒美にね

fields.EN:
I'm not a child, so I'm not that
interested in playing...
fields.JP:
わたくし子供じゃありませんから、
遊んでほしくなんてありませんけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not a child, so I'm not that
interested in playing...

fields.EN:
Oh, that's too bad. I wanted to play with you,
Cinderella-san.
fields.JP:
そっか、残念だなぁ。
わたしはシンデレラさんと
遊びたいんだけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, too bad. And just when
I wanted to play with you.

fields.EN:
B-But, if you really want to play
then I suppose I can oblige!
fields.JP:
ま、まあ、人魚姫がどうしてもと言うなら
考えてあげなくもなくってよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, if you really want to play
then I suppose I can oblige!

fields.EN:
(She's there, but the timing isn't
great with the others around.)
fields.JP:
（姫を見つけたはいいけど、
　ちびっこたちの前じゃムードがなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's there, but the timing isn't
great with the others around.)

fields.JP: ありがとうにんぎょ！　たのしかったよ！

fields.EN:
Well, it wasn't as bad
as I expected...
fields.JP: まあ、楽しくないこともなくってよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it wasn't as bad
as I expected...

fields.EN: Yup, let's play again next time!
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, let's play again next time!

fields.JP:
（どうやらちびっこたちは満足して、
　帰って行ったみたいだな）

fields.EN:
Ningyohime!
I have a favor to ask!
fields.JP:
人魚姫～！　
ちょっとお願いしたいことがあるんです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid!
I have a favor to ask!

fields.JP: あれ？　かぐやちゃんと……おつうちゃん？

fields.EN:
(Wha-?! Of all the times
Kaguya has to intervene!)
fields.JP:
（くっ……！
　かぐや、なんてタイミングの悪い！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wha-?! Of all the times
Kaguya has to intervene!)

fields.EN:
Oh, you're here too, Otsuu.
Perfect timing.
fields.JP:
おつうも一緒にいるんですね～。
丁度いいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're here too, Otsuu.
Perfect timing.

fields.EN:
My room is quite messy now,
and I was hoping you'd help.
fields.JP:
わらわの部屋がちょっと散らかってて、
片付けるのを手伝ってほしいんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
My room is quite messy now,
and I was hoping you'd help.

fields.JP: そ、それくらい自分でやりなよ！

fields.EN:
Oh, but I do take pride that my
room is so messy that no person
can get the place clean.
fields.JP:
自慢じゃないですが、
一人だと一生終らない自信があります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I do take pride that my
room is so messy that no person
can get the place clean.

fields.EN:
Uh, that's nothing you should
be proud about...
fields.JP: 本当に自慢にならないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, that's nothing you should
be proud about...

fields.EN:
So how about it? Can you help?
Oh, and I will repay you for
helping me clean.
fields.JP:
なので、お手伝いをお願いします～。
あ、お礼ならしますから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So how about it? Can you help?
Oh, and I will repay you for
helping me clean.

fields.JP: わたしはべつに構わないけど……

fields.EN:
Fine...
You owe me one, got it?
fields.JP:
……わかったよ。
これは貸しだからな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
You owe me one, got it?

fields.EN:
Thank you very much.
I knew I could count on you too,
Otsuu.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます～
やっぱり、おつうは頼りになりますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much.
I knew I could count on you too,
Otsuu.

fields.EN: W-We have to clean this place up?
fields.JP: こ、これを片付けるのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: W-We have to clean this place up?

fields.JP: あ、足の踏み場も無いね……

fields.EN:
I told you the place can't be
cleaned.
fields.JP:
わらわひとりじゃ一生終らないって、
言ったじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you the place can't be
cleaned.

fields.EN:
I didn't expect you to have
explained your room literally...
fields.JP: まさか、言葉通りの意味だったとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect you to have
explained your room literally...

fields.EN:
If we three work together,
I'm sure we'll get this done!
fields.JP:
さ、三人でやればすぐに終わるよ！
が、がんばろうね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we three work together,
I'm sure we'll get this done!

fields.EN:
Unbelievable...!
Again, you owe me one!
fields.JP:
ああ、もう！
これは貸しだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable...!
Again, you owe me one!

fields.EN:
Thank you so very much.
I'll come and ask for your help
when my room gets messy again.
fields.JP:
今日は本当に助かりました～
また、散らかってきたら
よろしくお願いしますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you so very much.
I'll come and ask for your help
when my room gets messy again.

fields.JP: そうなる前に自分で掃除しろ！

fields.EN:
She ran away...
Lazy as usual, I guess...
fields.JP:
逃げた……
結局、怠け者のまんまじゃないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She ran away...
Lazy as usual, I guess...

fields.EN:
Well, that's done, so now back to
talking with...
fields.JP:
……まぁ、いい。
これでやっと落ち着いて姫と話が――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's done, so now back to
talking with...

fields.EN:
Ah! There you two are!
I've been looking for you girls!
fields.JP:
おお！　こんなところにいたか！
二人とも探したぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! There you two are!
I've been looking for you girls!

fields.JP: ハーちゃん、どうしたの？

fields.EN:
I found out that heroes need a
legendary sword!
fields.JP:
実はな、勇者には伝説の剣というものが
必要だという事が分かったのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found out that heroes need a
legendary sword!

fields.EN:
Yes! Unfortunately, I have none
on me! So, I was going to search
for one.
fields.JP:
うむ！
しかし困ったことに、我は持っていない！
それで、探しに行こう思うのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! Unfortunately, I have none
on me! So, I was going to search
for one.

fields.EN:
Maybe next time...
I'm a bit tired after doing some
clean up earlier.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、また今度にしてくれないか。
ちょっとさっきの掃除で疲れててね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe next time...
I'm a bit tired after doing some
clean up earlier.

fields.EN:
Hm... Well, it can't be helped if
you're tired! By all means, go and
rest in your room!
fields.JP:
ふむ……疲れてるのなら仕方ないな！
ゆっくり部屋で休むといいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Well, it can't be helped if
you're tired! By all means, go and
rest in your room!

fields.EN:
Yeah... I'll do that.
Well, see you both tomorrow.
fields.JP:
うん……そうさせてもらうよ。
それじゃ、また明日ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I'll do that.
Well, see you both tomorrow.

fields.JP: ふむ。よっぽど疲れていたようだな

fields.EN:
I'm sorry Haa-chan, but I need to
go after Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
ハーちゃん、わたしちょっと、
おつうちゃんのところに行ってくる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry Hammy, but I need to
go after Otsuu!

fields.JP: 二人ともどうしたのだ……？
（はぁ……今日は本当に間が悪い）

fields.EN:
(I know Princess is kind, and
that's what I like about her.)
fields.JP:
（姫が誰にでも優しいのは分かってる。
　そこが好きっていうのもあるけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know Princess is kind, and
that's what I like about her.)

fields.EN:
(But if only she kept her eyes on
me just for a short moment...
Or, am I being greedy?)
fields.JP:
（もう少しだけ僕のこと見てほしい――
　そう思うのは、わがままなのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But if only she kept her eyes on
me just for a short moment...
Or, am I being greedy?)

fields.EN:
I guess I can give her this
later...
fields.JP:
このプレゼントは……
また今度、渡せばいいか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I can give her this
later...

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff...! Otsuu-chan... I finally found
you!
fields.JP:
ハァハァ……！
おつうちゃん……やっと見つけた！

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, I noticed you were a bit
fidgety, but was there something
you wanted?
fields.JP:
だって……おつうちゃん……
ずっとそわそわしてて……
……わたしに、なにか用が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, I noticed you were a bit
fidgety, but was there something
you wanted?

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、プレゼント交換しようよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we swap gifts with each
other?

fields.JP: じゃあ、まずわたしからね？
ひ、姫？　いったいどういう……

fields.EN:
Shhh, quiet.
You're going to miss my gift.
fields.JP:
ほら、静かに。
わたしのプレゼント、聞き逃しちゃうよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shhh, quiet.
You're going to miss my gift.

fields.EN:
(I can already feel my sullen
feeling melting away...)
fields.JP:
（なんだろう……さっきまでの気持ちが、
　全部溶けていく気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can already feel my sullen
feeling melting away...)

fields.JP: （僕は姫のことが好きなんだな……）
……ご清聴、ありがとうございました

fields.EN:
Thank you...
What a wonderful gift.
fields.JP:
……ありがとう。
最高のプレゼントだったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...
What a wonderful gift.

fields.EN:
That's great to hear.
So, Otsuu-chan, now it's your turn.
You do have a gift for me, right?
fields.JP:
本当？　
じゃあ、次はおつうちゃんの番だね。
プレゼント、用意してあるんだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's great to hear.
So, now it's your turn.
You do have a gift for me, right?

fields.EN:
You can read me like a book,
can't you Princess?
fields.JP: ……姫はなんでもお見通しだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can read me like a book,
can't you Princess?

fields.EN:
Heh heh! How much do you think I usually
keep my eyes on you, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
ふふふ、そうだよ。
わたしが普段どれだけ、
おつうちゃんのことを見てると思ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! You know me!
I always have my eyes on you,
you know?

fields.JP: 本当に、姫には敵わないな……

fields.EN: Well, here's my gift to you.
fields.JP: これが僕からのプレゼントだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, here's my gift to you.

fields.JP:
わぁ……！
これ、ブレスレット？

fields.EN:
I had Takumi make it. I thought
it would look great on you.
fields.JP:
タクミに作ってもらったんだ。
姫に似合うかなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had Takumi make it. I thought
it would look great on you.

fields.EN:
Thank you...!
It'll be my treasure!
fields.JP:
うれしい……
ずっと大事にするね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...!
It'll be my treasure!

fields.EN:
(And you're my treasure...
Well, that's embarrassing to say
even if I am her prince...)
fields.JP:
（僕も一生、君を大事にするよ――
　なんて、さすがに王子様でも照れくさい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And you're my treasure...
Well, that's embarrassing to say
even if I am her prince...)

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan?
Why do you like me?
fields.JP:
ねえねえ、おつうちゃん。
何でそんなにわたしの事が好きなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu?
Why do you like me?

fields.JP: うーん、なんとなく聞いてみたくなったの

fields.EN:
(Don't fret, Otsuu...
This question was expected the
moment we bonded in marriage.)
fields.JP:
（だが、慌てることはない。
　夫婦ならこの類の質問は必ず来ると
　思っていたよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Don't fret, Otsuu...
This question was expected the
moment we bonded in marriage.)

fields.JP:
あ、ごめんね。
答えにくい質問だったかな……

fields.EN:
Not at all. I was just trying to
get my thought straight with all
the things that I like about you.
fields.JP:
そんなことあるわけないだろう？
姫の好きなところはたくさんあり過ぎて、
何から言おうか迷っていたのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. I was just trying to
get my thought straight with all
the things that I like about you.

fields.EN:
Let me go one-by-one here.
I love your beautiful signing,
kind heart, appearance...
fields.JP:
じゃあ、一つ一つ答えていくよ。
綺麗な歌声に、優しい心、外見も
余すことなく僕は好きだし、それに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me go one-by-one here.
I love your beautiful signing,
kind heart, appearance...

fields.EN:
What's the matter?
I have a lot more to say?
fields.JP:
どうしたんだい？
まだ全然答えてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?
I have a lot more to say?

fields.EN:
I appreciate your words, but
that's not what I wanted to
hear.
fields.JP:
褒めてくれるのは嬉しいけど、
今わたしが聞いてるのは、
そういうことじゃないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate your words, but
that's not what I wanted to
hear.

fields.EN: W-What do you mean by that?
fields.JP:
そ、そういうことじゃないって、
どういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED: W-What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, you know how you asked me to
marry you the very first time we met?
fields.JP:
ほら、おつうちゃんって
初めて会ったときにいきなり、
結婚してって言ってきたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how you asked for
my hand in marriage the very
first time we met?

fields.EN:
How come?
Because I love you.
fields.JP:
何でって……
それこそ好きだからとしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How come?
Because I love you.

fields.EN:
Well, that's nice, but...
How can you fall in love when
we've only just met?
fields.JP:
それは……そうなんだろうけど、
初対面で、普通そこまで好きになるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's nice, but...
How can you fall in love when
we've only just met?

fields.EN:
To be honest, it took me a while to fall for
you, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
正直、わたしがおつうちゃんのことを
好きになったのはしばらく経ってからだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, it took me awhile
for me to really like you.

fields.JP: えっ！？　そうだったの！？

fields.EN:
Besides, Otsuu-chan, I seem to remember you
knew my name even though I hadn't introduced
myself...
fields.JP:
それに、わたしが名乗ってないのに、
おつうちゃんはわたしの名前を
知ってた気がするし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, how come you
knew my name when we've only met
for the first time back then?

fields.EN:
Maybe I'm remembering things
wrong since it was awhile back.
fields.JP:
でも、ずっと昔のことだし、
ただの勘違いなのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe I'm remembering things
wrong since it was awhile back.

fields.EN:
(Now that she mentioned it,
I seem to have loved her since
forever.)
fields.JP:
（言われてみれば、
　僕はこの意識が芽生えた時から、
　姫の事が好きだったような気がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that she mentioned it,
I seem to have loved her since
forever.)

fields.EN:
(I don't really recall much from
memory, and I don't have a reason,
but my feelings for her are true.)
fields.JP:
（それ以前の記憶はない。
　理由も分からない。
　だけど、僕にとっては大切な感情だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't really recall much from
memory, and I don't have a reason,
but my feelings for her are true.)

fields.EN:
I'm sure there was something
that happened, but I think we can
sum it all up as being fate.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、
何かきっかけがあるのかもしれないけど、
それも含めて、きっと運命だったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure there was something
that happened, but I think we can
sum it all up as being fate.

fields.EN:
What's important is now.
My love towards you will never
change, no matter what.
fields.JP:
それに、大事なのは今だ。
僕が姫のことが好きなのは、
この先、何があっても変わらない
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's important is now.
My love towards you will never
change, no matter what.

fields.EN:
Well, I'm just happy we're having
this conversation, since it's been
awhile since we talked like this.
fields.JP:
ふふ、そうだね。
でも、最近こんな風に昔を思い出すことが
無かったから、嬉しいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm just happy we're having
this conversation, since it's been
awhile since we talked like this.

fields.EN:
We've been too busy to reminisce
how long we've been together
in matrimony.
fields.JP:
最近忙しかったからね。
それにしても、もう夫婦になって
結構経つんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've been too busy to reminisce
how long we've been together
in matrimony.

fields.EN:
Yup, it's been a long while
all right...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, it's been a long while
all right...

fields.EN:
I'll say it again - I love you.
I will always be with you.
I will protect you no matter what.
fields.JP:
改めて誓うよ。僕は姫が好きだ。
だから、僕は一生君の側にいる。
何があっても絶対守る
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll say it again - I love you.
I will always be with you.
I will protect you no matter what.

fields.EN:
Yes, and I wouldn't expect
anything less, my prince...
fields.JP:
はい。こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします。
……わたしの王子様
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and I wouldn't expect
anything less, my prince...

fields.EN:
Say, you mind I ask what kind of
wedding you two had?
fields.JP:
そう言えば、おつうと人魚姫は
どんな結婚式をしたのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, you mind I ask what kind of
wedding you two had?

fields.EN:
You two are married, right? I read
in a manga that people who marry
have weddings.
fields.JP:
うむ！　おつうと人魚姫は夫婦なのだろう？
夫婦になるには結婚式をしないといけないと、
どこかの漫画に書いてあったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You two are married, right? I read
in a manga that people who marry
have weddings.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, I don't think
we had a wedding.
fields.JP: そういえば結婚式はしてないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, I don't think
we had a wedding.

fields.EN:
Well, we were destined by fate
to be together from the very
beginning.
fields.JP:
僕たちは出会った瞬間から強い運命で
結びついていたからね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we were destined by fate
to be together from the very
beginning.

fields.JP: そんな必要もなかったというわけさ

fields.EN: I see. So, what about now?
fields.JP:
なるほどな。
では、これからするのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. So, what about now?

fields.EN:
Not that we'll have one right
away. There are just way
too many things we're missing.
fields.JP:
と言っても、今すぐじゃないけどね。
結婚式をするには、足りないものが
多すぎるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that we'll have one right
away. There are just way
too many things we're missing.

fields.EN:
I see. We don't have churches,
wedding dresses, or ministers
around.
fields.JP:
そういえばそうだな。
ここには、教会もウェディングドレスも
無ければ、神父もいないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. We don't have churches,
wedding dresses, or ministers
around.

fields.EN:
Right? If we're going to hold a
wedding, I want to do it after the
escape in the best way possible.
fields.JP:
そういうことだ。
どうせやるなら脱獄してから、
皆を呼んで最高の結婚式をするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? If we're going to hold a
wedding, I want to do it after the
escape in the best way possible.

fields.EN:
Another good reason for me
to want to escape from this place.
fields.JP: そのためにも、一日でも早く脱獄しないとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Another good reason for me
to want to escape from this place.

fields.EN:
That went well... Hameln seemed
quite interested. If only we could
hold our wedding now...
fields.JP:
なんて、ハーメルンには強がってみたけど、
姫との結婚式……したかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That went well... Hameln seemed
quite interested. If only we could
hold our wedding now...

fields.EN:
I want to have a wedding with you too,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: わたしもおつうちゃんと結婚式したい
fields.LOCALIZED: I want to have a wedding, too.

fields.JP: ひ、姫！？　なんでここに！？

fields.EN:
We're husband and wife.
Is it surprising to see me here?
fields.JP:
だって夫婦だもの
いつも一緒でしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're husband and wife.
Is it surprising to see me here?

fields.EN:
I suppose not.
I can't argue your logic.
fields.JP: そう言われると反論の余地もない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose not.
I can't argue your logic.

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
So, Otsuu-chan, aren't we going to have our
wedding?
fields.JP:
ふふふっ。
それでおつうちゃん、結婚式しないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
So, we're not going to have our
wedding?

fields.EN:
I'd love to have one, but what
I said to Hameln isn't a lie. We
simply don't have the means here.
fields.JP:
したいけどさ、ハーメルンに
言ったことも嘘じゃないんだよ。
実際ここには、結婚式に必要なものがない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd love to have one, but what
I said to Hameln isn't a lie. We
simply don't have the means here.

fields.JP:
そうかな？
わたしはそうは思わないよ

fields.EN:
A wedding is where an exchange of
vows is done, right? Then all we
need is the pair to be here.
fields.JP:
結婚式は互いに愛を誓いあうものでしょ？
なら、愛し合ってる二人がいれば、
それでいいとわたしは思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A wedding is where an exchange of
vows is done, right? Then all we
need is the pair to be here.

fields.EN:
You're right... We'll have a proper wedding
after we escape. For now, let's have a
wedding just for the two of us here.
fields.JP:
確かに……そうだね。
ちゃんとした結婚式は脱獄した後にして、
今ここで、二人だけの結婚式をしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. We can have a formal
wedding after our escape. Shall we
exchange our vows for now?

fields.EN:
I vow to love you, Princess,
and care for you as long as
we both shall live.
fields.JP:
僕は姫を……
人魚姫だけを一生愛し続けることを、
ここに誓います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I vow to love you, Princess,
and care for you as long as
we both shall live.

fields.EN:
I vow to love you, Otsuu-chan,
and care for you as long as
we both shall live.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんを愛し続けることを、
ここに誓います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I vow to love you, Otsuu,
and care for you as long as
we both shall live.

fields.JP: 僕と結婚してください

どうやら僕たち、
勘違いしてたみたいだね

fields.EN:
...Yeah. We've already had a
wedding just for the two of us like this.
fields.JP:
……だね。
だって、この二人だけの結婚式は
もうしてたもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... We already held a wedding
like this before.

fields.EN:
I vowed to be your prince
when we first met.
fields.JP:
初めて会ったあの時、
僕は君だけの王子になることを誓った
fields.LOCALIZED:
I vowed to be your prince
when we first met.

fields.EN: And I accepted your proposal, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: わたしはおつうちゃんの求婚を受け入れた
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I accepted you to be my
husband.

fields.EN:
Let's keep this little wedding just
between the two of us a secret from
everyone, and do it again sometimes.
fields.JP:
この二人だけの結婚式は、
みんなに内緒でたまにしようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about we have our exchange
of vows in private again?

fields.EN: As you wish, my dear princess...
fields.JP: よろこんで、僕のお姫様……
fields.LOCALIZED: As you wish, my dear princess...

fields.EN: Now, let's hear it as promised!
fields.JP: では、約束通り話してもらおうか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now, let's hear it as promised!

fields.JP:
約束……？
なにかしてたっけ？

fields.EN:
You promised to me that you'd
tell me about how you and Ningyohime met!
fields.JP:
水族館跡エリアで、おつうと人魚姫の二人が
どうやって出会ったか、教えてくれると
約束しただろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You promised to me that you'd
tell me about how you and Little
Mermaid met!

fields.EN:
Don't tell me you're going to
break the promise...
fields.JP: まさか……約束を破るのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me you're going to
break the promise...

fields.EN: I... suppose I did promise that.
fields.JP: そ、そういえばそんな約束もしてたね
fields.LOCALIZED: I... suppose I did promise that.

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Haa-chan.
She won't break promises.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、ハーちゃん。
約束を破るつもりはないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Hammy.
She won't break promises.

fields.JP: ならば、早く話すがよい！

fields.EN:
Um... I don't know since when,
but I've been at the Aquarium
Ruins for as long as I remember.
fields.JP:
えっと……わたしは気づいたら
水族館跡エリアに居たの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I don't know since when,
but I've been at the Aquarium
Ruins for as long as I remember.

fields.EN:
Then one day, I was being
chased by a Marchen when...
fields.JP:
それで、ある時メルヒェンに
襲われそうになって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then one day, I was being
chased by a Marchen when...

fields.EN: I arrived gallantly to save her!
fields.JP: そこを僕が華麗に助け出したというわけさ
fields.LOCALIZED: I arrived gallantly to save her!

fields.EN:
Oh? That sounds like something
from a manga! So then what?!
fields.JP:
ほう！　まるで漫画のようだな！
それで、どうなったのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? That sounds like something
from a manga! So then what?!

fields.EN:
After Otsuu-chan saved me, she suddenly
asked for my hand in marriage.
fields.JP:
助けてくれたおつうちゃんは、
初対面のわたしにいきなり、
結婚して欲しいって言ってきたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
After Otsuu saved me, she suddenly
asked for my hand in marriage.

fields.EN:
So soon? I thought marrying is
something done between lovers.
fields.JP:
いきなりか？
結婚とは、愛し合ってる二人が
するものじゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So soon? I thought marrying is
something done between lovers.

fields.EN:
Yup, I was so surprised,
that I just rambled asking
Otsuu to become my prince.
fields.JP:
うん。だから、わたしびっくりしちゃって。
思わず『王子様になって欲しい』って、
答えちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, I was so surprised,
that I just rambled asking
Otsuu to become my prince.

fields.EN:
That would explain why Otsuu
is like that in front of you.
fields.JP:
なるほど。
それで、おつうは人魚姫の前だと
あんな感じなんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would explain why Otsuu
is like that in front of you.

fields.EN:
And so we exchanged our vows, and
I became Princess's prince—and hers alone.
fields.JP:
そうして二人は夫婦の契りを交わし、
僕は晴れて姫だけの王子となったのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we exchanged our vows,
and I became her prince.

fields.EN:
I see...
But what you did was quite weird,
Otsuu.
fields.JP:
なるほど……。
だが、やはりおつうの行動が謎だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
But what you did was quite weird,
Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Did you meet Ningyohime before
her rescue?
fields.JP:
おつうは人魚姫とどこかで
出会っていたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you meet Little Mermaid before
her rescue?

fields.EN:
No. I was in love with her
before I knew it.
fields.JP:
いや、会ってないよ。
ただ、気が付いたら
もう姫の事が好きだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I was in love with her
before I knew it.

fields.JP:
だから、ずっとずっと会いたくて
仕方なかった

fields.EN:
Once I saw her, I couldn't hold
back my urge, so I asked her
to marry me.
fields.JP:
それで、実際に会ったら感極まって、
気づいたら求婚してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I saw her, I couldn't hold
back my urge, so I asked her
to marry me.

fields.EN:
I see, I see... I know what
they call someone like you, Otsuu!
fields.JP:
なるほどなるほど……
我は、おつうみたいのを
なんて呼ぶか知っているぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
I know what you are now!

fields.EN:
Hm, you searched aimlessly for
someone you don't know, but you
liked, right?
fields.JP:
うむ。よく知りもしない人を、
一方的な好意で探し回っていたのだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, you searched aimlessly for
someone you don't know, but you
liked, right?

fields.EN:
Wait...
What are you trying to get at?
fields.JP: いや、ちょっと待て……それって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...
What are you trying to get at?

fields.EN:
Yes! Someone like you is called a
stalker, right, Otsuu? I read it in a manga!
fields.JP:
うむ！　おつうみたいなのを
ストーカーと言うのだろう？
漫画に描いてあったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're like one of those creepers!
I saw it in one of the manga
before!

fields.EN: No! Don't lump me in with people like that!
fields.JP: 違う！　僕をそんなのと一緒にするな！

fields.EN:
Now that I think about it, most
people won't ask someone to marry
them the moment they meet someone.
fields.JP:
でも今思えば、普通は会ってすぐに、
結婚を申し込んだりしないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I think about it, most
people won't ask someone to marry
them the moment they meet someone.

fields.JP: つまり、ストーカー王子か
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see!
You're the prince of creepers!

fields.EN:
I-It's okay, Otsuu-chan! Even if you're a
stalker, I still love you!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫だよ！　おつうちゃん！
たとえおつうちゃんがストーカーでも、
おつうちゃんのことは大好きだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't worry, Otsuu!
I like you for who you are,
even if you are a creeper!

fields.EN:
Huh? What? Why?
Otsuu-chan! Are you all right?!
fields.JP:
え？　え？　なんで？
おつうちゃんしっかりー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What? Why?
Otsuu! Are you all right?!

fields.EN:
(I'm not sure if I should be
happy or sad...)
fields.JP:
（嬉しいけど……
　素直に喜べない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not sure if I should be
happy or sad...)

fields.JP:
あの……じゃあ、久しぶりに
お願いしてもいい？

fields.EN:
You're so clingy.
But, sure, c'mon.
fields.JP:
人魚は甘えん坊だなぁ。
いいよ、おいで
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so clingy.
But, sure, c'mon.

fields.EN:
(Hm? I hear Princess's voice from
Akazukin's room.
What are they doing?)
fields.JP:
（ん？　赤ずきんの部屋から、
　姫の声が聞こえる。
　……なにしてるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? I hear Princess's voice from
Red Riding Hood's room.
What are they doing?)

fields.EN:
Akazukin, do you mind
if I come in for a moment?
fields.JP: 赤ずきん、ちょっといいかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, do you mind
if I come in for a moment?

fields.JP: おつうか？　入っていいぞー
今ここから姫の声が……なぁっ！？
見ての通り取り込み中だよ
おつうちゃんが血を吐いた！？

fields.EN:
Ouch...
This was a bit too much for her.
fields.JP:
あちゃぁ……
おつうには刺激が強すぎたかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ouch...
This was a bit too much for her.

fields.EN:
I-I'm fine...
I'm totally and completely fine!
fields.JP:
ま、まだだよ……
このくらいのことじゃ僕は負けない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm fine...
I'm totally and completely fine!

fields.EN:
Th-There must be a reason
behind this... Why were you and
Akazukin cuddling?!
fields.JP:
な、何か理由があるはずだ……
姫！　どうして赤ずきんと
抱き合ってるんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-There must be a reason
behind this... Why were you and
Red Riding Hood cuddling?!

fields.EN:
Um, well... We've been doing
this a lot from before.
fields.JP: その、実は昔から……よくしてもらってたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... We've been doing
this a lot from before.

fields.EN: Wow, this is too much for me.
fields.JP: さ、流石にかわいそうになってきた……
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow, this is too much for me.

fields.EN:
Aah...! Wh-What should I...?!
Otsuu-chan... Otsuu-chan...!
fields.JP:
あわわっ！　ど、どうしよう！
おつうちゃんが、おつうちゃんが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah...! Wh-What should I...?!
Otsuu... Otsuu...!

fields.EN:
C'mon now, relax.
Breathe in... Breathe out...
fields.JP:
ったく、話が進まないでしょ
ほら、深呼吸
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon now, relax.
Breathe in... Breathe out...

fields.EN:
Breathe in... Mmm...
Breathe out... Aah...
fields.JP:
う、うん……すー、はー……
す－、はー……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Breathe in... Mmm...
Breathe out... Aah...

fields.EN:
Now then...
Hey, snap out of it, Otsuu.
fields.JP:
さてと、そんじゃ次はこっちだ。
おーい、生き返れー。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then...
Hey, snap out of it, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Your imagination is getting the
better of you.
fields.JP:
別に、おつうが想像してるような
事じゃないからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your imagination is getting the
better of you.

fields.EN:
Really, really.
Ningyo, you have to explain a bit
better.
fields.JP:
本当だって。
人魚もちゃんと説明しなきゃダメでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really, really.
Mermie, you have to explain a bit
better.

fields.EN:
Uh... Before that, you mind
letting go of each other...?
fields.JP: ていうか……いつまで抱き合ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Before that, you mind
letting go of each other...?

fields.JP: それで、なんで抱き合ってたの？

fields.EN:
Um, well... I always cuddled with
Onee-chan ever since I was little.
fields.JP:
えっとね、その……
小さいころからさっきみたく、
おねーちゃんに甘えてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... I always cuddled with
Sis ever since I was little.

fields.EN:
I know this is embarrassing, but
I come to Onee-chan to do this every so
often.
fields.JP:
恥ずかしいんだけど、
今でもたまにおねーちゃんに、
甘えたくなるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know this is embarrassing, but
I come to Sis to do this every so
often.

fields.EN:
I know Onee-chan is going through a lot,
so I tried to restrain myself,
but...
fields.JP:
おねーちゃんも大変だったから、
ずっと我慢してたんだけど、
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know Sis is going through a lot,
so I tried to restrain myself,
but...

fields.EN:
I asked her anyway, and she
said okay, so... well...
fields.JP:
さっき話してたら、
いいよって言ってくれて、
つい……その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I asked her anyway, and she
said okay, so... well...

fields.EN:
W-Well, I guess that's fine.
I may be your husband, but I'm
not your sister after all.
fields.JP:
ま、まぁ……それなら、しょうがない
僕は夫だけど、姉にはなれないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I guess that's fine.
I may be your husband, but I'm
not your sister after all.

fields.EN:
Got it? So yeah, you can stop
with your jealousy thing.
fields.JP:
っと、いうことだよ。
だからさ、そんな嫉妬するなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it? So yeah, you can stop
with your jealousy thing.

fields.EN:
Hey, how about you get clingy to
me like before? Sis is always
ready for more clingy.
fields.JP:
あ、なんなら、おつうも昔みたいに甘える？
お姉さんは大歓迎だぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, how about you get clingy to
me like before? Sis is always
ready for more clingy.

fields.EN:
S-Stop it! I'm not a kid any more!
In the first place, I'm not
clingy!
fields.JP:
い、いいよ、もうそんな年じゃない！
だいたい、僕はそんなに甘えたり
しなかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop it! I'm not a kid any more!
In the first place, I'm not
clingy!

fields.JP: え～？　そうだったかなぁ

fields.EN:
I remember you came to my room
crying one night, and...
fields.JP: ほら、夜中に泣きながらあたしの部屋に――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember you came to my room
crying one night, and...

fields.JP: わーーっ！　わーーっ！

fields.EN: Aww, it was gonna be good.
fields.JP: なんだよ、ここからがいいところなのに
fields.LOCALIZED: Aww, it was gonna be good.

fields.EN:
J-Just stop already!
Fine! I owe you one,
so please, stop!
fields.JP:
お、覚えてろよー！
これは貸しだからなーっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Just stop already!
Fine! I owe you one,
so please, stop!

fields.EN:
Um... that secret of yours you mentioned
earlier, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
あ、あの……さっきの、
おつうちゃんの秘密って……

fields.EN:
Mmm... I don't mind continuing
where I left off, but...
fields.JP: んー、話してもいいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I don't mind continuing
where I left off, but...

fields.JP: おねーちゃん、お願いします！

fields.EN:
Okay, but to be fair, I'll tell
Otsuu everything about you,
even the secret stuff.
fields.JP:
あたしが知ってる人魚の秘密も、
おつうに話してもいいならね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, but to be fair, I'll tell
Otsuu everything about you,
even the secret stuff.

fields.JP:
（ノック……？
　こんな時間に誰だろう……）

fields.EN: Do you mind if I come in...?
fields.JP: わたしだけど……入っていい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind if I come in...?

fields.JP: こんばんは、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
Uh, sure...
What brings you here at this hour,
Princess?
fields.JP:
こ、こんばんは姫。
こんな時間にどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, sure...
What brings you here at this hour,
Princess?

fields.EN:
Um... Do you mind if I sleep with
you tonight?
fields.JP: えっと……今日、一緒に寝てもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Do you mind if I sleep with
you tonight?

fields.EN:
Um, well... I, uh... Huh?!
A-Are you serious?
fields.JP:
いや、でもあの、え、えぇっ！？
その、い、いいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... I, uh... Huh?!
A-Are you serious?

fields.EN:
Tee-hee, you're getting too flustered,
Otsuu-chan. We're just
sleeping together, okay?
fields.JP:
ふふっ、おつうちゃん慌てすぎだよ。
一緒に寝るだけだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tee-hee, oh, stop it.
I just want to sleep with you,
that's all.

fields.EN:
(I'm supposed to be
calm in this situation?!)
fields.JP: （本当はちっとも落ち着いてないけどね！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm supposed to be
calm in this situation?!)

fields.JP: それで……一緒に寝てもいい？

fields.EN:
Uh, I'm honored, but...
Is everything okay, Princess?
fields.JP:
えっと、それは実に光栄なんだけど、
姫……なにかあったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I'm honored, but...
Is everything okay, Princess?

fields.EN:
Oh, uh, if you don't want to
talk about it, then...
fields.JP: あ、いや、嫌なら無理に言わなくても――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh, if you don't want to
talk about it, then...

fields.EN:
You remember how I entered
Blood Skelter the last time,
right?
fields.JP:
……この前わたし、
ブラッドスケルター化したでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remember how I entered
Blood Skelter the last time,
right?

fields.EN:
Yes...
Back at the Aquarium Ruins.
fields.JP:
うん……
水族館跡エリアのことだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes...
Back at the Aquarium Ruins.

fields.EN:
You taught me that I can rely
on others, so...
fields.JP:
あのときに誰かに頼ってもいいんだって、
教えてもらったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You taught me that I can rely
on others, so...

fields.EN:
That's why I came to you for help,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
だから、こうしておつうちゃんに、
助けてもらいに来たの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I'm here asking
for your help.

fields.EN:
I was scared sleeping alone tonight, so I
thought I'd sleep better if I was with you,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
今日はなんだか一人で居ると不安で、
おつうちゃんと一緒なら、
安心して寝られると思ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was scared sleeping alone
tonight, so I thought I could
sleep better with you around.

fields.EN:
I-I see...
Well if that's all then...
fields.JP:
そ、そうか。
僕と一緒なら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see...
Well if that's all then...

fields.EN: Or... was I bothering you, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP: それとも、おつうちゃんは……迷惑だった？
fields.LOCALIZED: Am I just being a burden to you?

fields.EN:
Absolutely not. I'm more than
honored to have you sleep
by my side.
fields.JP:
そんなことあるはずないだろ？
姫と一緒に寝られるなんて、
身に余る光栄だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Absolutely not. I'm more than
honored to have you sleep
by my side.

fields.JP: ふふっ、ありがとう。おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
(Well, that went well...
But what should I do?!)
fields.JP:
（とりあえずかっこつけてみたけど、
　どうしよう！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, that went well...
But what should I do?!)

fields.EN:
(Am I able to restrain myself
with Princess sleeping
together with me?!)
fields.JP:
（姫と二人っきりで寝るなんて、
　僕、耐えられるかな！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Am I able to restrain myself
with Princess sleeping
together with me?!)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: We should get to sleep, too.
fields.JP: わたし達も、もう寝よっか
fields.LOCALIZED: We should get to sleep, too.

fields.EN:
(I'm glad Jack is asleep... but part of
me is disappointed, too. It's complicated...)
fields.JP:
（ジャックが寝てて助かったような、
　残念なような……複雑な感じだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not sure how I feel seeing
Jack asleep like that... Was it
good he didn't hear what I said?)

fields.EN:
Holding your hand like this makes me feel so
safe, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
こうしておつうちゃんの手を握ってると、
とっても安心する……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel a lot better with you
holding onto my hand like this.

fields.JP:
そ、そう？
それは光栄だ……

fields.EN:
(Dang it!
I can't sleep like this!)
fields.JP: （寝れない！　これ絶対寝れないよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Dang it!
I can't sleep like this!)

fields.EN:
If only we spent our times like
this all the time..
fields.JP: こんな時間がずっと続けばいいのにね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we spent our times like
this all the time..

fields.EN:
A time where no one dies,
no one gets hurt, no one
needs to fight...
fields.JP:
これ以上誰も死なない、
誰も傷つかなくていい、
戦う必要もない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A time where no one dies,
no one gets hurt, no one
needs to fight...

fields.EN:
If only this time continued
forever...
fields.JP: そんな時間が、ずっと続けばいいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only this time continued
forever...

fields.EN:
Yes... Same here.
If only time froze...
fields.JP:
そうだね……僕も、そう思うよ。
いっそ、時間が止まればいいとさえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Same here.
If only time froze...

fields.EN:
(I shouldn't have been flustered
by her coming. She did say she
came here because she was scared.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……姫は言ってたじゃないか、
　不安だからここに来たって。
　なのに、なんで僕は浮ついてるんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I shouldn't have been flustered
by her coming. She did say she
came here because she was scared.)

fields.EN:
Please don't disappear from me,
Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP: おつうちゃん、いなくなったりしないでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't disappear from me,
Otsuu...

fields.EN:
Of course I won't.
I won't die, too. What prince
would leave his princess alone?
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ。僕は死なない。
姫を一人置いていくなんて、
王子様失格だろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I won't.
I won't die, too. What prince
would leave his princess alone?

fields.EN:
So there's nothing to be scared
of here. Good night.
fields.JP: だから、安心しておやすみ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So there's nothing to be scared
of here. Good night.

fields.JP:
うん……おやすみ。
おつうちゃん……

fields.EN:
(I won't ever leave your side,
my dear princess...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、僕はいなくなったりしない
　なにがあっても君の側を離れない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I won't ever leave your side,
my dear princess...)

fields.JP:
んっ……んん……あれ？
ここ……？

fields.EN:
Oh, right. I went to sleep
in Otsuu-chan's room.
fields.JP:
そっか……昨日は、おつうちゃんの部屋で
寝たんだっけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, right. I went to sleep
in Otsuu's room.

fields.EN:
She looks like any ordinary
girl like this.
fields.JP: こうして寝顔を見ると普通の女の子だね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
She looks like any ordinary
girl like this.

fields.EN:
A prince that's as every bit
a girl as anyone...
fields.JP:
わたしの王子様……
本当は誰よりも乙女なのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
A prince that's as every bit
a girl as anyone...

fields.EN:
I love you... Otsuu-chan. Just as you protect
me, I'll protect Otsuu-chan too.
fields.JP:
好きだよ……おつうちゃん。
あなたがわたしを守ってくれるように、
わたしも、おつうちゃんを守るからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you, Otsuu...
As you will protect me, I will
do the same for you, too.

fields.EN:
Hark! Do know that none of my
friends shall be harmed!
fields.JP: ワレがいる限り、仲間には傷ひとつつけさせん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hark! Do know that none of my
friends shall be harmed!

fields.EN:
Here I go!
Let's see you take thyyss!
fields.JP: 行くぞ！　ワレの一撃を受けてみにょ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here I go!
Let's see you take thyyss!

fields.EN:
(She not only slurred, but also
banged her head in the process...)
fields.JP:

I didn't slur... But it's a good

…………別に噛んでなどいないが、
やはり練習しておいて正解だったな！

I didn't slur... But it's a good
thing I'm practicing now!
Seriously, I didn't slur!

I'm sorry we entered without your
permission, but we were worried

勝手に入ってごめんなさい。

I'm sorry we entered without your
permission, but we were worried
with what we heard from outside.

fields.EN:
N-No need to be sorry.
You came in because you were
worried of me, right?

べ、べつに謝ることは無いぞ

N-No need to be sorry.
You came in because you were
worried of me, right?

fields.EN:
Yup, we didn't want anything

Yup, we didn't want anything

fields.EN:
But why didn't you tell me you
were there earlier? I could have

だが、なぜすぐに声を掛けなかったのだ？
おかげで噛んだところ見られ……
いやいや、噛んではおらぬが

But why didn't you tell me you

fields.EN:
Aha!
You were entranced by me, yes?!

fields.LOCALIZED:
Aha!
You were entranced by me, yes?!

fields.JP:
……そうだね

Haa-chan, what were
you practicing so seriously?
fields.JP:
ハーちゃんは、なにをそんなに、
真剣に練習していたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what were you really
practicing with such sincerity?

fields.EN:
Hahahaha!
I am glad you asked!

ふははははっ！
よくぞ聞いてくれた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha!
I am glad you asked!

fields.EN:
I was training myself to be a
hero to protect you folks!
fields.JP:
ワレは貴様たちを守るために、

fields.LOCALIZED:
I was training myself to be a
hero to protect you folks!

fields.JP: なんだい？　その、勇者の練習って
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What do you mean by that?

fields.JP: 勇者とは仲間を守るもの……

And when the moment comes, a hero has

そして、いざという時には、
誰よりもカッコいいセリフを

fields.LOCALIZED:
And, a hero needs to make a
dramatic entry when needed!

fields.EN:
Where did you pick that info
from...?
fields.JP: いったいどこからそんな知識を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where did you pick that info
from...?

fields.JP: この漫画に書いてあった！

fields.EN:
Mangas are great! I learned about

fields.JP:
漫画はいいぞ！
人間のことや鬼ごっこのことなどは、

fields.LOCALIZED:
Mangas are great! I learned about

fields.JP:
（ああ、あの間違った鬼ごっこの知識は
　ここからきていたのか……）

fields.EN:
Speaking of, chase was quite fun!
How about we have...

そういえば、あの鬼ごっこは楽しかった

Speaking of, chase was quite fun!
How about we have...

You're strong, Haa-chan. If you
played like that, you'd hurt everyone.

ハーちゃんは強いんだから、
あんな風に遊んだらみんなを傷つけちゃう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're too strong. If we did it

fields.EN:
I-I see! I guess it can't be

そ、そうか！　そういう意味か！
うむ、ワレは最強であるからな！

fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see! I guess it can't be
helped! After all, it is true that
I am the strongest here!

fields.EN:
I guess playing chase is out of

fields.JP:
そこまで言うなら諦めるとしよう！
仲間を傷つけるわけにはいかぬからな！

fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess playing chase is out of
the question! As a hero, I can't
be harming my friends!

fields.JP: 分かってくれたならいいの

Well, I promise to you as a hero

fields.JP:
……まぁ、さっきも言ったが貴様らのことは

fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I promise to you as a hero

all danger!

なんだ、その顔は！

What's with that look on your

fields.EN:
Um, but hero aside, we'll be

まあ、勇者かどうかはおいといて、

fields.EN:
Heh heh!

Heh heh!
Hope we all get along!

Indeed!

fields.JP: うむ！　よろしくお願いされてやるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
You can count on me!

Um, I'm not sure what this is

えーと、よく分からないけど……

痛い痛いっ！？

Ow! It hurts!

Wh-What was that about?!

僕の手を握り潰すつもりか！？

I thought I heard Otsuu-chan's scream.

なんだか、おつうちゃんの悲鳴が

Everything is fine.

どうしたもこうしたも、

Yeah, but there's no need to

だからって、
あんなに強く握ることは無いだろう……

Yeah, but there's no need to

In the first place, why the sudden

In the first place, why the sudden

Uh, that doesn't answer my

Uh, that doesn't answer my

Like I said, I wanted to!
No other reason beyond that!

さっきから言っておるだろう。
そうしたいと思ったからそうしたのだ！

Like I said, I wanted to!

Or what? You don't like holding

それともなんだ？
貴様らはワレと手を繋ぐのが嫌なのか？

ねぇ、おつうちゃん。

それなら急に手を繋ぎたくなったことにも、

なんだ、二人でひそひそと……

You said you wanted to hold my

君が手を繋ぎたいって言ったんだろ？

ふ、ふん。最初からそうやって、

Owww! I said it hurts!

さっきも痛がっていたが、

Haa-chan, you're so strong that if

ハーちゃんはとっても力が強いから、

僕は今、メルヒェンが潰れるくらいの力で、

fields.JP: ハーちゃん、手を出して

fields.LOCALIZED:

ハーちゃん、分かる？
手を繋ぐならこのくらいの力でいいの

うん、そう。

もうひとつ言っておくと、

そ、それは嫌だ！

大丈夫よね？

それに、この柔らかくて温かいのは、

fields.EN:
Heh heh.

fields.EN:
You are much more weaker than

貴様たちは思ったよりも脆弱なのだな！

Everyone has their place and

何事も適材適所だ。
気にすることは無い
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone has their place and

fields.JP:
マモルくんが守ってくれてるから、

fields.LOCALIZED:
We can work the best we can

fields.EN:
He's right. And, we can go out

そうだね。僕たちもマモルがいるから、

So don't worry so much.

だからあんまり気にしないでよ。
マモルは十分役に立ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:

Huh, I actually kinda feel

そう言われてみれば……

fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, I actually kinda feel

fields.EN:

ほんとだ……

fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
I feel strangely good now...

fields.EN:
Hahaha!

Hahaha!

fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, do you mind if I try, too?

fields.JP:
む、別に構わないぞ！

fields.LOCALIZED: Uh... I can't get it to play...

fields.EN:

うーん……。
もしかして血式少女しか鳴らせないとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...
Maybe only Blood Maidens can
play it?

fields.JP: それなら、わたしが試してみてもいい？

fields.EN:
Uh, I just thought we should get

here, you know?
fields.JP:
いや、結構時間が経ったからさ！

Uh, I just thought we should get

別に少し笛を吹くくらい、

ワレはばっちくないぞ！

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...

fields.JP: （あれ？　なんだか元気ないな……）

……なにかあったの？

fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a problem?

fields.EN:

So, what's the problem?
fields.JP:
分かるさ。
それで、何があったんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, just a hunch.
