So, what's the problem?

fields.EN:
I just felt like I wasn't being
enough of a hero to protect you
all...
fields.JP:
勇者として仲間を守る。
それが出来ていない気がしてな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just felt like I wasn't being
enough of a hero to protect you
all...

fields.EN:
That's not true.
You've been helping us a lot.
fields.JP:
そんなことはないさ。
ハーメルンにはいつも助けられてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true.
You've been helping us a lot.

fields.EN:
But it feels like the others are
helping more than I am.
fields.JP:
だが、ワレより貴様らの方が、
ずっと役に立っている気がするのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it feels like the others are
helping more than I am.

fields.EN:
I don't understand what Gretel
says, but it sounds like she's
smarter than me.
fields.JP:
グレーテルはワレより頭の良いことを
言っておるような気がするし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't understand what Gretel
says, but it sounds like she's
smarter than me.

fields.EN:
Kaguya is a lot more prudent
than me.
fields.JP: かぐやもワレよりしっかりしておる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya is a lot more prudent
than me.

fields.EN:
You too, Otsuu. You've been
keeping everyone in check better
than me.
fields.JP:
おつうだってそうだ。
なんだかんだで、みんなをまとめておる
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Otsuu. You've been
keeping everyone in check better
than me.

fields.EN:
See? You girls have been doing
more than me!
fields.JP:
そうだ……。
ワレよりおつう達の方が
役に立っている気がするのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? You girls have been doing
more than me!

fields.EN:
I'm not helping that much.
In fact, I hardly think I've been
contributing as much as I'd like.
fields.JP:
僕は役に立ってなんかいないさ。
まだまだ、ぜんぜん足りない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not helping that much.
In fact, I hardly think I've been
contributing as much as I'd like.

fields.EN:
I promised to protect everyone.
Is it still all right for me to
rely on others?
fields.JP:
ワレがみんなを守ると約束したのだ。
なのに、皆に頼ってしまってよいのだろうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promised to protect everyone.
Is it still all right for me to
rely on others?

fields.EN:
You're burdening yourself too
much. You don't need to carry
everyone's load.
fields.JP:
とにかく、考えすぎだよ
ハーメルンだけが頑張ることはないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're burdening yourself too
much. You don't need to carry
everyone's load.

fields.EN:
I don't?
So you mean I'm not needed?
fields.JP:
ワレが頑張らなくていい？
つまり、ワレである必要はない……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't?
So you mean I'm not needed?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
Just forget what I said...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
Just forget what I said...

fields.EN:
I'm fine. I just need some
time to think. You mind leaving
me alone for a bit?
fields.JP:
大丈夫だ。だが……少し一人で考えたい。
今日は帰ってくれぬか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. I just need some
time to think. You mind leaving
me alone for a bit?

fields.EN:
(I meant to keep Hameln from pushing
herself too hard, but it looks like
I only made her worry even more...)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンが気負いすぎないように、
　言ったつもりだったんだけど、
　余計に悩ませちゃったみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess my words just made
matters worse...)

fields.EN:
(It looks like Hameln is still
in her rut...)
fields.JP: （ハーメルン、まだ悩んでいるみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like Hameln is still
in her rut...)

fields.EN:
(I'd like to help her out,
but I don't want to stress her
out like the last time...)
fields.JP:
（相談に乗ってあげたいけど、
　また迂闊なことを言って、
　余計に悩ませたら悪いし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'd like to help her out,
but I don't want to stress her
out like the last time...)

fields.JP: はぁ……どうしたもんかな
溜息なんかついて……どうかしたの？

fields.EN:
It's nothing you need to concern
yourself with.
fields.JP:
いいえ、姫がお気になさるようなことでは
ありませんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nothing you need to concern
yourself with.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan? If you have something
on your mind, say it.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……。
何か悩み事があるならちゃんと話して
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? If you have something
on your mind, say it.

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right...
It's just that something's been
bothering me...
fields.JP:
姫……そう、だね。
ごめん、少し気になってることがあってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right...
It's just that something's been
bothering me...

fields.JP: それって、ハーちゃんのこと？

fields.EN:
Haa-chan hasn't been herself lately.
Do you know anything about it, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
ハーちゃんここ最近何か悩んでるよね。
おつうちゃんは何か知っているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy hasn't been herself lately.
Do you know anything about it?

fields.EN:
She's concerned over how she
can't fulfill her promise of
protecting us.
fields.JP:
……僕たちのこと守るっていう約束を、
出来ていないと悩んでいるらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's concerned over how she
can't fulfill her promise of
protecting us.

fields.EN:
That's not true. Haa-chan
is a dependable companion.
fields.JP:
そんなことない。
ハーちゃんは、頼りになる仲間よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why is she concerned?
She's been nothing short of
a blessing to us.

fields.EN:
I wanted to relay that to her, but
I worded it in a way that made
her more concerned...
fields.JP:
僕もそう言ったつもりなんだけど……
どうも伝え方が悪かったみたいで、
余計に悩ませちゃったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to relay that to her, but
I worded it in a way that made
her more concerned...

fields.EN: So that's why you look worried, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: だから、おつうちゃん困った顔してるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why you have that
frown on your face?

fields.JP:
（はぁ……。
　僕はどうすればいいんだろう）

おつう！　止まるのだ！
そこには――！
おつうちゃん！　ハーちゃん！
なっ！？　だ、大丈夫ですか！？
安心しろ！　ワレもおつうも無事だ！
まったく、人騒がせです～
ハーメルン、ありがとう助かったよ

fields.EN:
Unbelievable!
We're already in enemy territory!
Keep your guard up!
fields.JP:
まったく！　ボーっとするな！
もうここは敵地なのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable!
We're already in enemy territory!
Keep your guard up!

fields.JP:
うん……ごめん。
君の言う通りだ

fields.EN:
Thank goodness you're safe...
As usual, thanks for protecting
us from harm, Haa-chan.
fields.JP:
本当に無事でよかった……ハーちゃん、
いつも守ってくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness you're safe...
As usual, thanks for protecting
us from harm, Hammy.

fields.EN:
As usual? Is that true?
Am I actually of use?
Am I really protecting everyone?
fields.JP:
いつも……？　そうなのか？
ワレはみんなをちゃんと守れているのか？
役に立っているのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
As usual? Is that true?
Am I actually of use?
Am I really protecting everyone?

fields.EN:
I'm happy you're always willing
to carry all my load.
fields.JP:
いつも喜んで面倒なことをしてくれるから、
助かってますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy you're always willing
to carry all my load.

fields.EN:
You do offer yourself to me
as a valuable specimen.
fields.JP: あなたはいつも実験体になってくれるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do offer yourself to me
as a valuable specimen.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure if you're praising
me or not, Gretel...
fields.JP: ……グレーテルのそれは褒めておるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure if you're praising
me or not, Gretel...

fields.EN:
Why yes, I am praising you.
You're of great help.
fields.JP:
ええ、もちろん。
役には立っているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, I am praising you.
You're of great help.

fields.EN:
You just haven't noticed it,
Haa-chan. You've been protecting us all along!
fields.JP:
つまり、ハーちゃんが気づいてないだけで、
わたしたちはいつもハーちゃんに
たくさん守られているんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may not have noticed, but
you've been helping us and
protecting us all along!

fields.EN:
You just saved Otsuu-chan just now,
too! Isn't that right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
今だっておつうちゃんを、
守ってくれたじゃない！
ね、おつうちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You just saved Otsuu just now,
too! Isn't that right, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
Right, and we wouldn't have made
it this far without you, Hameln.
fields.JP:
そうさ、ハーメルンがいたから、
僕たちはここまで来れたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, and we wouldn't have made
it this far without you, Hameln.

fields.EN:
I-I see...
So I am keeping my promise!
I am of help to you all!
fields.JP:
そ、そうか……
ワレはちゃんと約束を守れているのか！
役に立っているんだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see...
So I am keeping my promise!
I am of help to you all!

fields.EN:
Hahahaha! I suppose it is my
duty to protect you all as a hero!
fields.JP:
うむ！　はーっはっはっはっ！
ならばこれからも勇者としてみんなを
守ってやろうではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha! I suppose it is my
duty to protect you all as a hero!

fields.EN:
Amazing...
To think she was all down on
herself just a while ago...
fields.JP:
まったく……。
さっきまで落ち込んでたのに単純なやつだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Amazing...
To think she was all down on
herself just a while ago...

fields.EN:
But hasn't Haa-chan's
personality helped us more than once?
fields.JP:
でも、ハーちゃんのそういうところに、
わたしたちは助けられてるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you have to admit that her
personality has helped us
more than once.

fields.JP:
ふっ……
まあ、そういうことにしておくか

fields.EN:
Otsuu, I need to talk with
you, but you mind if I come in?
fields.JP:
おつう、少し話があるのだが……
入っていいか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, I need to talk with
you, but you mind if I come in?

fields.JP:
ハーメルンかい？
どうぞ、入っていいよ
それで？　話ってなに？
……ワレは、このままでいいのだろうか？

fields.EN:
That came out of nowhere...
You still don't think you're of
help to us?
fields.JP:
これまた急な話だね
まだ、仲間を守れてないと思ってるのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That came out of nowhere...
You still don't think you're of
help to us?

fields.EN:
That's not it.
Well, not exactly...
fields.JP: そうではない。そうではないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not it.
Well, not exactly...

fields.EN:
I know I'm protecting everyone as a
hero. But at the same time, everyone is
protecting me too. Is that really okay...?
fields.JP:
勇者としてみんなを守れているのは分かった、
だが、同時にみんなに守られてもいるのだ。
本当にそれで、いいのだろうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I am of help as a hero,
but that's only because I'm
being protected by everyone.

fields.EN:
I promised to protect everyone,
but wouldn't being protected
myself counter my promise?
fields.JP:
ワレは勇者として仲間を守ると約束した。
他のみんなに守られているようでは、
約束を守れていないのではないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promised to protect everyone,
but wouldn't being protected
myself counter my promise?

fields.EN:
(Is Hameln's persistence in
keeping a promise part of her
Blood Libido...?)
fields.JP:
（もしかして『約束を守る』ということも
　ハーメルンの血式リビドーなのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is Hameln's persistence in
keeping a promise part of her
Blood Libido...?)

fields.EN:
You don't like it when we
protect you?
fields.JP: 僕たちに守られるのは嫌かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't like it when we
protect you?

fields.EN:
Not at all, but that doesn't
seem to go well with the promise
I made...
fields.JP:
嫌、というわけでは無い。
だが、それでは約束が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all, but that doesn't
seem to go well with the promise
I made...

fields.EN:
Say, Hameln...
Are promises important to you?
fields.JP:
ねぇ、ハーメルン。
約束って大事？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Hameln...
Are promises important to you?

fields.EN:
Of course they are!
Promises are meant to be kept!
fields.JP:
大事に決まっているだろう。
約束は守るのが当然なのだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course they are!
Promises are meant to be kept!

fields.EN:
I see. How about we make another
promise then?
fields.JP:
わかった。
なら、もう一つ別の約束をしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. How about we make another
promise then?

fields.EN:
A promise that doesn't have you
constantly protecting us as
a hero...
fields.JP:
ハーメルンが一方的に僕たちを守る、
勇者としての約束じゃなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A promise that doesn't have you
constantly protecting us as
a hero...

fields.EN:
I want you to promise me that
we'll escape from here, and that
we will each protect each other.
fields.JP:
一緒にこのジェイルを脱獄をするんだ。
そのために仲間を守り、仲間に守られる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to promise me that
we'll escape from here, and that
we will each protect each other.

fields.EN:
That's right. This is our promise
with you, as friends.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。
これはハーメルンと僕たちの……
仲間同士の約束だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. This is our promise
with you, as friends.

fields.JP: そうか……それが仲間なのか

fields.EN:
Very well! If so, I have
a promise I want to make with
you as a friend!
fields.JP:
ようやく分かった！　ならば、おつう！
ワレは仲間としてもう一つ約束したい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well! If so, I have
a promise I want to make with
you as a friend!

fields.EN:
I want us to have a grand dance
party once we escape! I will
take care of the music!
fields.JP:
仲間として脱獄できた暁には、
みんなで盛大にダンスパーティをしよう！
無論、演奏はワレが担当する！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want us to have a grand dance
party once we escape! I will
take care of the music!

fields.EN:
Hahaha! That really came out of
nowhere. Good. Now we have
one more thing to look forward to.
fields.JP:
ははは、なにそれ。
でもいいね。
脱獄した後の楽しみが一つ増えたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! That really came out of
nowhere. Good. Now we have
one more thing to look forward to.

fields.EN:
Right?! It will be fun!
Hence, we must all make it out
of the Jail alive!
fields.JP:
だろう！？　楽しみであろう！？
絶対にここから全員無事に脱獄せねばな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right?! It will be fun!
Hence, we must all make it out
of the Jail alive!

fields.EN:
Yes, we'll make it out of here,
each and every one of us.
fields.JP:
うん、誰ひとり欠けることなく、
全員無事に脱獄しよう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we'll make it out of here,
each and every one of us.

fields.JP:
ハーちゃん、そこちがっ……
ダメだってっ……ひゃんっ！？

fields.EN:
Hm...
This is harder than I thought...
fields.JP: むぅ……なかなか難しいのだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...
This is harder than I thought...

fields.EN:
(Princess and Hameln?
What are they doing in there?)
fields.JP:
（姫とハーメルンの声？
　ハーメルンの部屋で何をしてるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Princess and Hameln?
What are they doing in there?)

fields.EN:
Hameln, I thought I heard
Princess's voice in...
fields.JP: ハーメルン、今姫の声が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, I thought I heard
Princess's voice in...

fields.JP:
ふ、ふたりとも！　
いったい、何してるんだ！？

fields.EN:
Oh, um...
It isn't what it seems.
fields.JP:
あ、えっと、あのね？
これは違うの。違うからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um...
It isn't what it seems.

fields.EN:
What are we doing?
Isn't it obvious?
fields.JP:
何と言われても……
見てわかるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are we doing?
Isn't it obvious?

fields.EN:
It only looks like you're both
embracing each other!
fields.JP:
ぼ、僕には抱き合ってるようにしか
見えないけど！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It only looks like you're both
embracing each other!

fields.EN:
Calm down, Otsuu-chan.
There's a good reason behind
all this.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、落ち着いて？
これには事情があるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Otsuu.
There's a good reason behind
all this.

fields.EN:
I-I am calm! I-I would never
lose myself with this.
Yes. I'm calm all right. Calm...
fields.JP:
ぼ、ぼぼ、僕は落ちついてるよ姫。
こんなことで取り乱すわけがないじゃないか。
ああ……落ち着いているとも、僕は冷静だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I am calm! I-I would never
lose myself with this.
Yes. I'm calm all right. Calm...

fields.EN:
What are you blabbing about?
You're acting quite weird today.
fields.JP:
というか、何を言っているのだ？
今日のおつうは変だぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you blabbing about?
You're acting quite weird today.

fields.EN:
N-Never mind me!
Just let go of her!
fields.JP: と、とにかく！　ふたりとも離れてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Never mind me!
Just let go of her!

fields.EN:
You didn't need to pry us apart
like that.
fields.JP: なにも、強引に引きはがすことないではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't need to pry us apart
like that.

fields.EN:
So...
Why were you two... hugging?
fields.JP:
……それで？
結局、二人は何で抱き合ってたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So...
Why were you two... hugging?

fields.EN:
Haa-chan wanted to dance, so I was
just being her partner.
fields.JP:
ハーちゃんがダンスをしてみたいって言ったから、
付き合ってあげてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy wanted to dance, so I was
just being her partner.

fields.EN:
Indeed! I need to make sure I can
dance when the time comes!
fields.JP:
うむ！　いずれみんなと踊るときに、
上手くできなかったらかっこ悪いからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! I need to make sure I can
dance when the time comes!

fields.EN:
But I didn't expect dancing to be
so hard! I was tripping over
myself a number of times!
fields.JP:
しかし、ダンスとはなかなか難しいのだな！
このワレが転びそうになってしまった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I didn't expect dancing to be
so hard! I was tripping over
myself a number of times!

fields.EN:
Oh, I see.
So that's why you two were
hugging each other like that.
fields.JP:
ああ、なるほど。
それで姫が抱きとめたってわけか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see.
So that's why you two were
hugging each other like that.

fields.EN:
I told you it's not what it
seemed...
fields.JP: だから、誤解だって言ったでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you it's not what it
seemed...

fields.EN:
Indeed so. But, I'm a bit jealous
that you were able to dance
with her before me, Hameln.
fields.JP:
ああ、どうやらそうみたいだ。
だけど、ずるいな。
僕を差し置いて姫と踊るなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed so. But, I'm a bit jealous
that you were able to dance
with her before me, Hameln.

fields.EN: Why don't you dance with her then?
fields.JP: なら、次はおつうと人魚姫が一緒に踊るか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't you dance with her then?

fields.EN:
Gladly! I would be honored to
escort my dear princess!
fields.JP:
ああ、願ってもないことさ！
姫のエスコートとは光栄の極みだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gladly! I would be honored to
escort my dear princess!

fields.JP: もう、おつうちゃんったら

fields.EN: Then leave the music to me!
fields.JP: ならば演奏はワレに任せろ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then leave the music to me!

fields.EN:
I did expect this to happen
the moment Hameln said
she'd handle the music.
fields.JP:
正直、ハーメルンが演奏するって言った時点で、
こうなる予感はしてたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I did expect this to happen
the moment Hameln said
she'd handle the music.

fields.EN:
I must say, the mood is a bit
lacking, but...
Would you like to dance?
fields.JP:
少々ロマンチックさに欠けるけど……
姫、わたくしめと踊っていただけますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, the mood is a bit
lacking, but...
Would you like to dance?

fields.EN:
Hahahaha! How's that?!
Catch me if you can!
fields.JP:
ふはははは！！　どうだ！
捕まえられるものなら捕まえてみるがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha! How's that?!
Catch me if you can!

fields.JP: あははははー！！　まてー！　メルンー！

fields.EN:
Like I'd wait!
Come at me with all you got!
fields.JP:
待てと言われて待つやつなどおらん！
ワレを捕まえたければ力づくでこい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I'd wait!
Come at me with all you got!

fields.JP:
いったなー！
これでもくらえーっ！！
ぬおっ！？　ちょっとびっくりした！

fields.EN:
Hmph! Your attacks may hit hard,
but it is of no use if they
don't land on me!
fields.JP:
ふふん！　貴様の攻撃は確かに重いが、
当たらなければどうということはないのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! Your attacks may hit hard,
but it is of no use if they
don't land on me!

fields.EN:
I'll hit you!
Here I go!
fields.JP:
つぎはぜったいあてるからね！
いくよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll hit you!
Here I go!

fields.JP: ふはははっ！　来るがよい！
（あの二人を止めた方がいいんだろうか）

fields.EN:
(No, I better not... "The wise man
does not expose himself needlessly
to danger," they say.)
fields.JP:
（……いや、やめておこう。
　君子危うきに近寄らずだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No, I better not... "The wise man
does not expose himself needlessly
to danger," they say.)

fields.EN:
(That's... Cinderella?
Why is she staring at them?
Does she want to join them?)
fields.JP:
（あれは……シンデレラ？
　ハーメルン達の方をじっと見てる。
　もしかして、一緒に遊びたいのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's... Cinderella?
Why is she staring at them?
Does she want to join them?)

fields.EN:
P-Please, don't scare me like
that! You made me jump!
fields.JP:
い、いきなり話しかけないでください！　
びっくりするじゃないですか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please, don't scare me like
that! You made me jump!

fields.EN:
It's not like I crept up to you
or anything. So, why don't
you join them?
fields.JP:
ぼーっとしていたのは君だろう？
それより、一緒に遊んできたらどうだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like I crept up to you
or anything. So, why don't
you join them?

fields.EN:
M-Me? Join them?
I-I am an adult, mind you!
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことありませんわ！
わたしは大人ですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-Me? Join them?
I-I am an adult, mind you!

fields.EN:
But you were staring at
them pretty intensely...
fields.JP:
それにしては、ずいぶんと熱心に
見つめていたようだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you were staring at
them pretty intensely...

fields.EN:
W-Well... I was just looking
at them to make sure they won't
cause any trouble!
fields.JP:
そ、それは……
あんなにさわいでたら後が大変だと思って
見ていただけですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... I was just looking
at them to make sure they won't
cause any trouble!

fields.EN:
Right? So it's not like I want to
join them in their game of
chase or anything like that!
fields.JP:
でしょう？　だから、決して、わたしも一緒に
追いかけっこしたいとか思っていませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? So it's not like I want to
join them in their game of
chase or anything like that!

fields.EN:
(That's what she says...
She's peeking through the corner
of her eyes at them...)
fields.JP:
（どう見ても一緒に遊びたそうにしてるんだよなー。
　今も、ちらちらハーメルン達の方見ているし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's what she says...
She's peeking through the corner
of her eyes at them...)

fields.EN:
Hm?
If it isn't Otsuu and Cinderella.
fields.JP: んん？　おつうとシンデレラではないか。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm?
If it isn't Otsuu and Cinderella.

fields.JP: どうやら、見つかったみたいだね

fields.EN:
What are you two doing here?
If you have the time, how about
a game of chase?
fields.JP:
こんなところで何をしているのだ？
暇なら貴様らも混ざるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you two doing here?
If you have the time, how about
a game of chase?

fields.JP:
ねー！　ねー！
いっしょにあそぼー！

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I have something
to take care of.
fields.JP:
すまない。
僕は、この後少し用事があるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I have something
to take care of.

fields.JP: そうか……ならば仕方あるまい

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. In my place, Cinderella
can play with you two.
fields.JP:
ごめんね。
代わりにシンデレラが遊んでくれるってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. In my place, Cinderella
can play with you two.

fields.JP:
ほんとう！？
シンデレラ、あそんでくれる！？

fields.EN:
With your speed, you'll be a
worthy opponent! Come at me, both of you!
fields.JP:
貴様の健脚ならば敵として不足はない！
さあ、二人がかりでかかってくるがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your speed should prove quite
challenging! Now then, come at
me at once!

fields.JP:
いったなー！
シンデレラ、ぜったいつかまえようね！
え！？　ちょっ、ちょっと待って――
ふはははは！　さらば！
いくよー！　シンデレラ！

fields.EN:
F-Fine! I suppose I can help!
Wait up, Hameln!
fields.JP:
も、もう！　仕方ありませんわね！
待ちなさい！　ハーメルン！
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine! I suppose I can help!
Wait up, Hameln!

fields.JP: まったく、手間のかかる子だ

fields.EN:
Here we go, Rapu!
Let's see you take our super
combo attack!
fields.JP:
行くわよ！　ラプ！
くらいなさい！　わたしたちの合体技を！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here we go, Rappy!
Let's see you take our super
combo attack!

fields.EN:
A super combo attack?!
That sounds pretty cool!
fields.JP:
が、合体技だと！？　
なんだそのロマン溢れる響きは！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A super combo attack?!
That sounds pretty cool!

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel's curling herself
into a ball... Wait...)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルがボールみたいに
　丸くなって……まさかっ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel's curling herself
into a ball... Wait...)

fields.JP: ゴールデンシュートッッ！！

（け、蹴った！　ハーメルンに向かって
　ラプンツェルをシンデレラが蹴り飛ばした！）
あははははははははっ！！

fields.EN:
Urgh!
I-I didn't expect that!
But, don't you underestimate me!
fields.JP:
ぬおぉっ！？
ま、まさかそんな手で来るとは！
だが、ワレを舐めるなよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh!
I-I didn't expect that!
But, don't you underestimate me!

fields.JP:
う……けほっ、けほっ……
ど、どうだ、この程度へっちゃらなのだ

fields.EN:
I'm amazed you were able to
take that!
fields.JP: 今のを耐えるとは……やりますわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm amazed you were able to
take that!

fields.EN:
I am the greatest!
Do you expect anything less?!
fields.JP: この程度、最強のワレには通じぬ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the greatest!
Do you expect anything less?!

fields.EN:
(They're causing more mayhem
playing than fighting...)
fields.JP: （やれやれ、遊んでるだけで大惨事だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're causing more mayhem
playing than fighting...)

fields.EN:
Hey!
What is going on here?!
fields.JP: こらー！　いったい何騒いでるんですか～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey!
What is going on here?!

fields.JP: と、とっても怒ってますわよ！？

fields.EN:
Look at all the mess you
girls made! Shame on you!
fields.JP:
もう！　いけませんよ！
こんなに散らかして！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at all the mess you
girls made! Shame on you!

fields.EN:
Urrh... Sorry. I guess we went
a bit too wild there.
fields.JP:
ぬぅ、すまないな。
ちょっとやりすぎてしまったようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... Sorry. I guess we went
a bit too wild there.

fields.EN:
Well, if you're going to play,
you need to make sure you're
not causing trouble to others.
fields.JP:
そうですよ～。
人に迷惑をかけるような遊びはいけません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you're going to play,
you need to make sure you're
not causing trouble to others.

fields.EN:
Mmm... We'll clean up the
mess we caused...
fields.JP:
うむ、なので……散らかした分は
自分たちで片付けようと思うのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... We'll clean up the
mess we caused...

fields.EN:
It's fine that you play, but keep
it down a bit. Now then, if
you'll excuse me...
fields.JP:
遊ぶにしても、ほどほどにしてくださいね～？
それではわらわは戻ります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine that you play, but keep
it down a bit. Now then, if
you'll excuse me...

fields.EN:
That went well...
I guess we better call it a day.
fields.JP:
怒られてしまったな。
仕方ない今日はここまでにするか
fields.LOCALIZED:
That went well...
I guess we better call it a day.

fields.EN:
(Cinderella looks like she wanted
to play a bit longer.)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラのあれは、
　もう少し遊びたかったって顔だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella looks like she wanted
to play a bit longer.)

fields.EN:
Why don't you have a game where
you see who can clean the place
up the best?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、こういうのはどうかな？
誰が一番キレイに掃除できるか競争するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you have a game where
you see who can clean the place
up the best?

fields.EN:
Oho! That sounds interesting!
Very well! I will show you I am
also the greatest at cleaning!
fields.JP:
ほう……？　面白そうだな！　いいだろう！　
掃除でもワレが最強だということを教えてやる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! That sounds interesting!
Very well! I will show you I am
also the greatest at cleaning!

fields.JP: ラプンツェルもまけないよー！
シンデレラもやるよね？

fields.EN:
O-Of course! As an adult,
there is no way I can lose here!
fields.JP:
も、もちろんですわ！
大人のわたしが負けるわけありませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course! As an adult,
there is no way I can lose here!

fields.JP: （まったく、手間のかかる子たちだ）

fields.EN:
I think I'll grab a drink to cool
myself down. Hm...?
fields.JP: さて風呂上りに飲み物でも……ん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I'll grab a drink to cool
myself down. Hm...?

fields.JP: いや、こんなところにかぐやの乗り物が

ほんとうだ。
確か、バンブー1号だっけ

fields.EN:
Um...
Maybe I can ride on it...
fields.JP:
……な、なぁ。
今ならこっそり乗れるのではないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um...
Maybe I can ride on it...

fields.EN:
She's going to get angry if you
touch it without her permission.
fields.JP: 勝手に触ったら怒られるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's going to get angry if you
touch it without her permission.

fields.EN:
Oh, come now. It'll be quick.
I always wanted to ride on it.
fields.JP:
なに、ちょっとだけ。
実は前から乗ってみたかったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come now. It'll be quick.
I always wanted to ride on it.

fields.JP: はぁ……一応、僕は止めたからね

fields.EN:
Hmph! No harm done if she
doesn't find out!
fields.JP: ふふん、バレなければ大丈夫だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! No harm done if she
doesn't find out!

fields.EN:
(I can already see where this
is going...)
fields.JP: （やれやれ、この先の展開が想像がつくな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can already see where this
is going...)

fields.JP: で、誰にバレなければ大丈夫なんですか～？

ぬおっ！　か、かぐや！？
いつからそこにいたのだ！？

fields.EN:
It started around when you began touching my
Bamboo One, Hameln-san.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさんが、わたしのバンブー1号を
ペタペタ触っていたあたりからです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just about when you started
touching around with my
Bamboo One.

fields.EN: Tch! I want to ride on it!
fields.JP: ……くっ、こうなれば一瞬だけでも！
fields.LOCALIZED: Tch! I want to ride on it!

fields.EN:
Oh, not giving up, are you?
I won't let you...!
fields.JP:
そこで諦めないんですか！？
そうはさせません～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, not giving up, are you?
I won't let you...!

fields.EN:
H-Hey...
It's dangerous riding around
on it here.
fields.JP: ちょっ、こんなところで走ったら危ない――
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey...
It's dangerous riding around
on it here.

fields.EN:
Are you two all right?!
Oh... Uh...
fields.JP:
二人とも大丈夫か！？
って……うわぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you two all right?!
Oh... Uh...

fields.EN:
Oww...
I didn't expect you to ram
into me...
fields.JP: あたたた……まさか、体当たりとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oww...
I didn't expect you to ram
into me...

fields.EN:
Eek! P-Please!
Get your face off of me!
fields.JP:
はぁぅ……っ、ちょ、ちょっと！
変なところでしゃべらないでください～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eek! P-Please!
Get your face off of me!

fields.EN:
Hrm?!
S-Stop touching me like that!
fields.JP:
んんっ！？
そ、そっちこそ変なところを触るな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hrm?!
S-Stop touching me like that!

fields.EN:
Eep! It's not like I want
to touch you there!
fields.JP:
ひゃぁんっ！？
さ、触りたくて触ってるんじゃないです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eep! It's not like I want
to touch you there!

fields.JP: （こ、これ以上はいろいろダメな気がする！）

ひゃっ！？　
おつうさんもどこ触ってるんですか～！

fields.EN:
If you want to get all touchy,
do that with Ningyohime-san!
fields.JP:
そういうのはわらわじゃなくて、
人魚姫さんとしてください～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you want to get all touchy,
do that with Little Mermaid!

fields.EN:
P-Princess?!
W-Wait! She has nothing to do
with what's going on here!
fields.JP:
ひ、姫と……っ！？
って、違う！　姫は関係ないだろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Princess?!
W-Wait! She has nothing to do
with what's going on here!

fields.EN: J-Just get us out of this!
fields.JP: な、何でもいいから早く助けてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED: J-Just get us out of this!

fields.JP: あれー、みんなで何してるのー？

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel?!
I have a bad feeling about this.)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェル……！
　嫌な予感が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel?!
I have a bad feeling about this.)

fields.EN:
Ooh! I know!
Everyone playing!
Rapunzel wanna play, too!
fields.JP:
あー！　分かった！
みんなであそんでるんだ！
ラプンツェルもまぜて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! I know!
Everyone playing!
Rapunzel wanna play, too!

fields.EN: W-Well, I need to get going...
fields.JP: じ、じゃあ、僕もういくから……
fields.LOCALIZED: W-Well, I need to get going...

fields.EN:
Y-You're leaving us like this?!
We're supposed to be friends!
fields.JP:
み、見捨てるつもりか！？
ワレらは仲間だろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're leaving us like this?!
We're supposed to be friends!

fields.EN:
Friends need to face their share
of trial and tribulation too,
so... Um, good luck!
fields.JP:
仲間だからこそあえて苦難の道を行く……
というわけで、がんばって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends need to face their share
of trial and tribulation too,
so... Um, good luck!

fields.JP:
うわぁっ！？
か、かぐや姫！？　放してくれ！

fields.EN:
Heh heh... You're not getting
away so easily! We're all in this
together!
fields.JP:
ふふふ……逃がしませんよ～！
こうなったら一蓮托生です～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... You're not getting
away so easily! We're all in this
together!

fields.JP: ラプンツェルも、なかまにいれてー！！
あはははは！　どーーんっ！！
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
You remember the set of pens we
gave to Hameln? I wonder what
she's doing with them now.
fields.JP:
ほら、前にマンガ描きセットをハーメルンに
あげただろ？　あれからどうなったかなって、
ふと気になったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remember the set of pens we
gave to Hameln? I wonder what
she's doing with them now.

fields.EN:
She wanted to draw her own manga,
but I wouldn't be surprised if
she's gotten bored by now.
fields.JP:
マンガを描くって張り切ってたけど、
今ごろもう飽きちゃってたりしてな。
あはは
fields.LOCALIZED:
She wanted to draw her own manga,
but I wouldn't be surprised if
she's gotten bored by now.

fields.JP: おつうー！！　おーつーうー！！

fields.EN:
There you are! I've been
looking all over for you!
fields.JP:
こんなところのいたのだな！
探したぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you are! I've been
looking all over for you!

fields.JP:
ハーメルン！？
すごい勢いで走ってきたね

fields.EN:
Heh heh! I couldn't hold myself
back! I wanted to show you
something...
fields.JP:
むふふ、はやる気持ちをおちゃえ
きれなくてな。貴様にどーしても
見せてやりたいものがあるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! I couldn't hold myself
back! I wanted to show you
something...

fields.JP:
なんと！　ついにワレは
マンガを描いたのだー！！

fields.EN:
Oh? You did make your own manga!
That's pretty amazing!
fields.JP: おお、有言実行したんだ！　すごいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? You did make your own manga!
That's pretty amazing!

fields.EN:
Drawing manga was a bit too hard.
Drawing out the borders of each
scene was a major pain.
fields.JP:
でも実を言えば、最初からマンガを
描くのはハードルが高すぎた。
コマ割りというのがくせ者なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Drawing manga was a bit too hard.
Drawing out the borders of each
scene was a major pain.

fields.EN:
So I decided to draw myself
a picture first! Ta-da!
fields.JP:
だからまずはイラストというのを
描いてみたぞ！　じゃじゃーん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I decided to draw myself
a picture first! Ta-da!

fields.EN: This is a drawing of the hero I came up with!
fields.JP: これはワレが考えた勇者の絵だ！

fields.EN:
(...surprisingly good!
I guess it's rude to think that,
but...)
fields.JP:
（意外にうまい！
　いや、意外なんて言ったら失礼だけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...surprisingly good!
I guess it's rude to think that,
but...)

fields.EN:
So, how is it?
I'm open to any candid remarks!
fields.JP: どうだ？　正直に感想を言うがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how is it?
I'm open to any candid remarks!

fields.EN:
It looks really good! You're
amazing, Hameln! I can't believe
you've never done this before!
fields.JP:
うまい！　上手だよ、ハーメルン！
初めて描いたとは思えないくらい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks really good! You're
amazing, Hameln! I can't believe
you've never done this before!

fields.EN:
Oho! I knew it!
I thought I drew it pretty well
myself!
fields.JP:
おおっ、やはりそうか！
ワレもかなりうまく描けたと
思っていたのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! I knew it!
I thought I drew it pretty well
myself!

fields.EN:
It still lacks the finesse of my
holy grail manga, but I'm sure
I'll get better with practice!
fields.JP:
聖なる書物・マンガの絵にはまだまだ
及ばぬが、これから練習しゅれば
絶対もっとうまくなるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It still lacks the finesse of my
holy grail manga, but I'm sure
I'll get better with practice!

fields.EN:
You're right. In any case, I'm
surprised you had the knack
for drawing, Hameln.
fields.JP:
うん、きっとそうだね。
ハーメルンにこんな才能が
あったなんて驚いたなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. In any case, I'm
surprised you had the knack
for drawing, Hameln.

fields.EN: All that manga reading paid off!
fields.JP: マンガをたくさん読み込んできたおかげだな！
fields.LOCALIZED: All that manga reading paid off!

fields.EN:
I still have a lot ahead of me.
I need to draw backgrounds,
borders, dialogues, and more.
fields.JP:
だが、人物を描くだけではマンガはできぬ。
コマ割りも、背景も、いろいろ描けなければ
ならぬのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still have a lot ahead of me.
I need to draw backgrounds,
borders, dialogues, and more.

fields.EN:
I need to improve...
I have stories drawn out in my
mind, too!
fields.JP:
ワレはこのままでは駄目だ。
マンガにしたいストーリーは
たくさん考えているというのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to improve...
I have stories drawn out in my
mind, too!

fields.EN:
(Hameln is actually thinking
this time... I guess that's how
much she likes manga.)
fields.JP:
（おお、ハーメルンが珍しく
　難しいことを考えている。
　それほどマンガが好きなんだなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hameln is actually thinking
this time... I guess that's how
much she likes manga.)

fields.EN:
If you want to portray your story,
you do have other options
besides manga.
fields.JP:
あ、でもさ。ストーリーを表現するなら、
なにもマンガだけが表現方法じゃないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you want to portray your story,
you do have other options
besides manga.

fields.JP: む？　それはどういうことだ？

fields.EN:
For example, since we know you
can draw, you can make storybooks
or even slide shows.
fields.JP:
たとえば、絵が描けるなら
絵本だっていいし、
紙芝居だってアリだと思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, since we know you
can draw, you can make storybooks
or even slide shows.

fields.EN:
Hm, storybooks and slide shows?
I suppose I can do those, too.
But...
fields.JP:
ふむ、絵本に紙芝居か。
それならワレにでも描けそうだな。
だがなぁ、うーむ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, storybooks and slide shows?
I suppose I can do those, too.
But...

fields.EN:
Don't they both sound a bit
too kiddie?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't they both sound a bit
too kiddie?

fields.EN:
Well, I guess those are
targeted at younger audiences.
fields.JP:
あー、まぁ、たしかにマンガより
対象年齢が低いかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess those are
targeted at younger audiences.

fields.EN:
Still, those are options you can
take to express what you have
in mind.
fields.JP:
だけどハーメルンがなにを考えて、
なにを描きたいのか、それを誰かに伝える
手段の一つではあると思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, those are options you can
take to express what you have
in mind.

fields.EN:
Of course, keeping at it with
manga is definitely an option,
too.
fields.JP:
もちろん、もっと練習してマンガ一本で
がんばるっていうのもいいと思うけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, keeping at it with
manga is definitely an option,
too.

fields.EN:
Hm... What you mentioned
is worth exploring...
fields.JP:
……いや、貴様の提案はけんとーしゅる
価値があるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... What you mentioned
is worth exploring...

fields.EN:
I do want to draw mangas, but that
was only because I wanted to
express the story I had in mind.
fields.JP:
ワレはマンガを描きたいが、
マンガを描きたいのは、考えた
ストーリーを表現したいからだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do want to draw mangas, but that
was only because I wanted to
express the story I had in mind.

fields.EN:
What excited me the most reading
my holy grail manga was its
intense story!
fields.JP:
聖なる書物・マンガでワレが
一番コーフンしたのは、絵よりもなによりも、
熱いストーリーなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What excited me the most reading
my holy grail manga was its
intense story!

fields.EN:
I can feel your excitement,
Hameln!
fields.JP: おお、ハーメルンが燃えている……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can feel your excitement,
Hameln!

fields.EN:
You know, you're right, Otsuu.
I shall consider storybooks and
slide shows as an option.
fields.JP:
おつう、貴様の言う通り、
絵本や紙芝居という方法も
けんとーしてみるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, you're right, Otsuu.
I shall consider storybooks and
slide shows as an option.

fields.EN:
I will continue practicing my
manga drawing skills, but
now I have options!
fields.JP:
もちろんマンガの修行も続けるつもりだ。
だがマンガにこだわる必要はにゃいと
わかったのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will continue practicing my
manga drawing skills, but
now I have options!

fields.EN:
Thank you, Otsuu!
You are of great inspiration!
All right! I'll do this!
fields.JP:
ありがとう、おつう！
貴様のおかげだ！
よし！　やるぞ！　ワレは！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Otsuu!
You are of great inspiration!
All right! I'll do this!

fields.JP: その意気だよ、ハーメルン！

fields.EN:
Urrrh!
My battle has just begun!
fields.JP:
ぬおおおっ！
ワレの戦いはまだ始まったばかりだー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrrh!
My battle has just begun!

fields.EN:
Look at her go... It was worth
it giving her the drawing pens.
Isn't that right, Jack?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、すごく楽しそうだな。
マンガ描きセットを拾ってよかったね、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at her go... It was worth
it giving her the drawing pens.
Isn't that right, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Oh, but I hope her "my battle
has just begun" phrase won't
raise any bad flags for her...
fields.JP:
でも、「戦いはまだ始まったばかり」って……。
なんとなく縁起が悪いフレーズな気がするのは
なんでだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I hope her "my battle
has just begun" phrase won't
raise any bad flags for her...

fields.JP: ここがグレーテルの部屋か……
おつうちゃん、もしかして緊張してる？

fields.EN:
Well, it is my first time here.
Let me see if she's in...
fields.JP:
初めて来たから、少しね。
……よし、じゃあノックするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is my first time here.
Let me see if she's in...

fields.EN:
Um, it's me, Tsuu. Princess is
with me, too. Can we come in?
fields.JP:
あの……僕だよ。つう。姫も一緒だ。
入ってもいいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, it's me, Otsuu. Princess is
with me, too. Can we come in?

fields.JP:
おじゃまします……って、あれ？
ヘンゼルはいないのか？

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan is playing with Jack
right now.
fields.JP: ええ、ヘンゼル兄さんはジャックと遊んでいるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel is playing with Jack
right now.

fields.JP: ヘンゼルとジャックが……一緒に遊ぶ……

fields.EN:
It's good that Jack-san has a
friend now.
fields.JP: ジャックさんにお友だちができてよかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's good that Jack has a
friend now.

fields.EN:
I have to say, just thinking about
them playing together is quite
astounding...
fields.JP:
想像しただけでも、すごい強烈な光景だけどね。
ははは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to say, just thinking about
them playing together is quite
astounding...

fields.EN:
I'm intrigued how Nightmares
come together like that.
Now then, what brings you here?
fields.JP:
ナイトメア同士、なにか惹かれ合うものが
あるみたいね。興味深いわ。
……それで、なにか用があって来たんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm intrigued how Nightmares
come together like that.
Now then, what brings you here?

fields.EN: Uh, can we come in first?
fields.JP: じゃあ、ちょっと失礼して……
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, can we come in first?

fields.JP: それで、二人してなにか用かしら？

用っていうほどじゃないんだけど、
なんていうか……

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, we came to see if you were having
trouble getting used to this place. Right,
Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんが慣れない環境で困っていないか、
様子を見に来たんです。ね？　おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were just making sure you're
okay. I mean, I'm sure this is all
new to you. Right, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
What she said. Are you okay
with how things are here?
fields.JP:
うん、そうなんだ。
ここでの暮らしはどうかな。
なにか不自由はない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What she said. Are you okay
with how things are here?

fields.EN:
If there is anything, please feel
free to let us know.
fields.JP: なにかあれば、遠慮せず相談してくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there is anything, please feel
free to let us know.

fields.EN:
I'm glad we came to check on Gretel-san.
You were worried about her, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
ふふ、やっぱり様子を見に来てよかったね。
おつうちゃん、グレーテルさんのこと
心配してたもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's good we came to check on
her. You were all worried about
her anyway.

fields.EN:
You're the one who asked me to
come here with you. As kind as
usual, aren't you?
fields.JP:
でも、様子を見に行こうって誘ってくれたのは
姫のほうだった。やっぱり姫は優しいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the one who asked me to
come here with you. As kind as
usual, aren't you?

fields.EN:
I only gave you a little push because you
looked like you wanted to go, Otsuu-chan.
You're the kind one here.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんが行きたそうにしてたから、
わたしが背中を押しただけだよ。
優しいのはおつうちゃんのほうだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I just nudged you a bit since
it looked like you wanted to go.
So you're the kind one here.

fields.EN:
I assume you're in your own
world right now...
fields.JP:
……なるほど。
これが二人の世界というものなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume you're in your own
world right now...

fields.EN:
Wha-?! I'm sorry!
It's not that we forgot about...
fields.JP:
うわ、ごめん！
別に君のこと忘れてたわけじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! I'm sorry!
It's not that we forgot about...

fields.EN:
Your relationship is no different
from that of a partnership of
the opposite sex.
fields.JP:
あなたたちの仲の良さは、
まるで『つがい』のようだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your relationship is no different
from that of a partnership of
the opposite sex.

fields.EN:
I assumed such courtship was only
possible between a male and
female, but I suppose I was wrong.
fields.JP:
オスとメスでつがいになるものだと
思っていたけれど、メス同士でも
つがいになるものなのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assumed such courtship was only
possible between a male and
female, but I suppose I was wrong.

fields.JP: つ、つがいだなんて、そんな！

fields.EN:
Hm...
So, why are you two so close
to each other?
fields.JP: ふぅん？　では、なぜそんなに仲がいいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...
So, why are you two so close
to each other?

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan and I are husband and wife.
fields.JP: おつうちゃんとわたしは、夫婦なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're actually wed locked as
husband and wife.

fields.JP: ……説明が漠然としていて、よくわからないわ

fields.EN:
I just happened to ask for
Princess's hand in marriage
when we first met.
fields.JP:
僕が初めて姫に会ったとき、
「お嫁さんにしてください」って言ったんだ。
つい、勢いで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just happened to ask for
Princess's hand in marriage
when we first met.

fields.EN:
You mean on first sight? Were you
in heat? Would you have asked for
anyone's hand in marriage then?
fields.JP:
つまり初対面で求愛行動をしたということ？
発情期で誰でもよかったということかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean on first sight? Were you
in heat? Would you have asked for
anyone's hand in marriage then?

fields.EN:
No. It was only because it was
Princess. I guess you can say she
was special to me before we met.
fields.JP:
違うよ。姫じゃなかったら
そうは言わなかった。気がついたときから、
姫のことは特別だったっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. It was only because it was
Princess. I guess you can say she
was special to me before we met.

fields.EN:
I knew that she was the person
of fate upon seeing her.
fields.JP: 僕の運命の人だって、直感でわかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew that she was the person
of fate upon seeing her.

fields.JP: 姫は？　あのときどう思った？

fields.EN:
Well, it did take me by surprise.
But, it didn't sound bad to me
at all.
fields.JP:
いきなりお嫁さんにしてほしいなんて
言われたから、びっくりしちゃった。
でも、全然嫌じゃなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it did take me by surprise.
But, it didn't sound bad to me
at all.

fields.EN:
By the time I knew it, I asked
Otsuu-chan to become my prince instead
of being my wife.
fields.JP:
だからわたしも思わずおつうちゃんに、
「お嫁さんじゃなくて王子様になって」
ってお願いしたんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the time I knew it, I asked
Otsuu to become my prince instead
of being my wife.

fields.EN:
That doesn't make sense... In any
case, I can already see that logic
won't explain your relationship.
fields.JP:
お嫁さんと王子様では、まったく別物だけど……。
あなたたちの馴れ初めを論理的に解釈することは
難しそうだ、ということだけはわかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't make sense... In any
case, I can already see that logic
won't explain your relationship.

fields.EN:
But the illogical parts are interesting too...
Emotions and motives that can't easily be
explained in words... You two are wonderful.
fields.JP:
でも、論理的でないところも面白い……。
言葉では簡単に説明することができない感情、
行動理由……。素晴らしいわ、あなたたち
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it also interests me how logic
won't work here... Primal urges?
Emotions? Quite interesting...

fields.EN:
You both interest me to no end
as specimens.
fields.JP: 観察対象として、ますます興味が湧いてきたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You both interest me to no end
as specimens.

fields.EN:
So, have you both had intercourse
already?
fields.JP: ねえ、あなたたちはすでに性交渉はしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, have you both had intercourse
already?

fields.EN:
What's with your flustering?
I just wanted to confirm facts.
fields.JP:
なにを動揺しているの？
私は事実を確認しただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with your flustering?
I just wanted to confirm facts.

fields.EN:
W-We have a very clean and pure
relationship! We wouldn't...!
fields.JP:
ぼ、僕達は、清らかな、関係だから！
そういうことは、全然……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We have a very clean and pure
relationship! We wouldn't...!

fields.EN:
Oh, not yet? If you do decide to
have intercourse, do let me sit
in so that I can observe.
fields.JP:
まだなの？　だったら初めてのときは、
私も同席させてもらってもいいかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, not yet? If you do decide to
have intercourse, do let me sit
in so that I can observe.

fields.EN:
S-Stop that! Things like that
aren't something you show to
others publicly!
fields.JP:
こ、困るよ！
そもそも、そういうのは誰かに見せる
ようなことじゃないと思うし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop that! Things like that
aren't something you show to
others publicly!

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、論点がずれてる……

fields.EN:
I'll observe away from your view.
I can even blend myself into the
surrounding if that would help.
fields.JP:
邪魔にならないように見ているわ。
なんなら、背景に同化してもいいけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll observe away from your view.
I can even blend myself into the
surrounding if that would help.

fields.EN:
That's not the point!
You know, we're done!
Let's get going!
fields.JP:
そういう問題じゃないんだってば。
とにかく、この話はこれでおしまい！
じゃあ、僕達はこれで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not the point!
You know, we're done!
Let's get going!

fields.JP: あの、グレーテルさん、失礼します！

fields.EN:
Hm, interesting... "Wife" and
"prince"... Could those words be
rooted to their Blood Libido?
fields.JP:
……お嫁さんに、王子様。
それも血式リビドー由来の言葉だったのかしら。
面白い二人。研究意欲を掻き立てられるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, interesting... "Wife" and
"prince"... Could those words be
rooted to their Blood Libido?

fields.EN:
And then there's what she said
about 'ever since I became aware'...
fields.JP: それに、「気がついたときから」ね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also intrigues me that they
don't have an explanation of
the "why" to their attraction.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens... There's so much
to research here... Heh heh...
fields.JP:
『血式少女』か……。
色々と調べることが多そうね。ふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens... There's so much
to research here... Heh heh...

fields.EN:
Hm? Look over there...
Gretel's... smiling?!
fields.JP:
……ん？　うわ。姫、あれを見て。
グレーテルがすごく笑ってる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Look over there...
Gretel's... smiling?!

fields.EN:
You're right...
I wonder if she had something
nice happen.
fields.JP: 本当だ。なにかいいことでもあったのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
I wonder if she had something
nice happen.

fields.EN:
Nice doesn't even begin to describe that
smile. For Gretel to be grinning like that...
could it be a sign of some great upheaval?
fields.JP:
いや、いいことがあったなんてレベルじゃないよ。
あのグレーテルがあんな満面の笑みを浮かべる
なんて、天変地異の前触れじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice would be an understatement to
describe her smile. I'd even say
it's an omen of something to come.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, it looks like Gretel-san is eating
something...
fields.JP:
ねえ、おつうちゃん。グレーテルさん、
なにか食べてるみたいだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Otsuu? It looks like she's
eating something.

fields.EN:
*munch* *munch*
What are you two doing there?
*munch* *munch*
fields.JP:
もぐもぐ……あら。
二人とも、そんなところでなにを
コソコソしているの？　もぐもぐ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* *munch*
What are you two doing there?
*munch* *munch*

fields.EN:
Uh, um... We noticed you were
smiling, so we were just wondering
if everything was all right.
fields.JP:
ああ、うん。
グレーテルがあんまりいい笑顔だったから、
どうしたのかなと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, um... We noticed you were
smiling, so we were just wondering
if everything was all right.

fields.EN:
*munch* I'm just eating sweets.
What a delight. *munch*
fields.JP:
お菓子を食べていたの。もぐもぐ。
至福のときとは、このことを言うのねもぐもぐ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* I'm just eating sweets.
What a delight. *munch*

fields.EN:
(She's talking while eating...
She must really like those
sweets...)
fields.JP:
（話してる間も食べるのをやめようとしない……。
　どれだけ好きなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's talking while eating...
She must really like those
sweets...)

fields.EN:
I thought sweets were a rarity
down here. Where did you get them?
fields.JP:
だけど、お菓子ってすごく貴重ですよね。
どこで手に入れたんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought sweets were a rarity
down here. Where did you get them?

fields.JP: もぐもぐ、これはヘンゼル兄さんにもらったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got them *munch* from *munch*
my brother, Hansel. *munch*

fields.JP: ヘンゼルさんにもらったって……

fields.EN:
To be precise, I got a part
of Hansel-niisan's body. *munch*
fields.JP:
正確には、ヘンゼル兄さんの体の一部を
もらったということよ。もぐもぐ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be specific, *munch*
I picked these from his body.
*munch*

fields.JP: （う、グロいことを想像してしまった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Urp...
I wish I didn't hear that...)

fields.JP: もぐもぐ、ええ、もぐもぐもぐ……
はは、よっぽどおいしいみたいだね

fields.EN:
You're going to have to find
your own as these are mine.
*munch* *munch*
fields.JP:
これは私の分だから、あげられないわよ？
もぐもぐ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to have to find
your own as these are mine.
*munch* *munch*

fields.EN:
W-We're fine, thank you.
Right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
わ、わたしたちは大丈夫です。
ね？　おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We're fine, thank you.
Right, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
Y-Yes...
We're not hungry, so... have fun.
fields.JP:
う、うん。
僕達は大丈夫だから、気にせず食べてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes...
We're not hungry, so... have fun.

fields.EN:
(There's no way I want to eat
them, especially now that I know
she got them from Hansel's body.)
fields.JP:
（っていうか元がヘンゼルの体だと思うと、
　ちょっとな。どんなにおいしいとしても、
　全然食欲が湧かない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no way I want to eat
them, especially now that I know
she got them from Hansel's body.)

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you like sweets.
I didn't expect you to like them
that much.
fields.JP:
……それにしても、本当にお菓子が好きなんだな。
いつもの君とは大違いで意外だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you like sweets.
I didn't expect you to like them
that much.

fields.EN:
Yes. I love sweets... anything sweet.
Eating them fills me with happiness. You
could almost say my instincts demand them.
fields.JP:
ええ。お菓子が……甘い物が好きなの。
甘い物を食べている間は幸福感に満ちているわ。
本能が求めていると言っても過言ではないほど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, anything sweet is good to me.
I'm instinctively attracted to the
consuming of sweets. *munch*

fields.EN:
*munch* This must be my Blood
Libido. I suppose I have no choice
but to accept it as fate. *munch*
fields.JP:
もぐもぐ……これが私の血式リビドー
なんでしょうね。もはや運命として
受け入れるしかないわもぐもぐ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* I suppose this is my
*munch* Blood Libido.
I can't stop *munch* it.

fields.EN:
(Even if it was her Blood Libido,
I'm a bit worried all those sweets
will add to her weight...)
fields.JP:
（でも、いくら血式リビドーだからって
　甘い物食べまくってたら、太るんじゃないか？
　大丈夫かな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if it was her Blood Libido,
I'm a bit worried all those sweets
will add to her weight...)

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel-san? May I suggest that you
move a bit after eating?
fields.JP:
あ、あの、グレーテルさん。
食べたあとは、そのー、運動とか
したほうがいいかもしれません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel? May I suggest that you
move a bit after eating?

fields.EN:
(Looks like Princess was thinking
the same thing as me.)
fields.JP: （あ、姫も僕と同じこと心配したんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like Princess was thinking
the same thing as me.)

fields.EN:
Exercise? They do say moderate exercise is
good for your health. I'll keep that in mind.
fields.JP:
運動？　たしかに適度な運動は
健康にいいというわね。心に留めておくわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Move? As in exercise? I suppose
a balance is needed here.
I'll keep that in mind.

fields.JP: うん、それがいいと思う……

fields.EN:
Mmm... Where could Princess
have gone?
fields.JP:
うーん、いないなぁ、姫。
どこに行ったんだろう……ん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Where could Princess
have gone?

fields.EN:
There she is! But... what is she
doing with Gretel and Hikari?
fields.JP:
いた！　……でも、なにをしてるんだろう。
姫とグレーテルとヒカリの組み合わせって、
あんまりないような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There she is! But... what is she
doing with Gretel and Hikari?

fields.EN:
There you are, Princess.
So, what are you three doing here?
fields.JP:
やあ、姫。探したよ。
三人でなにをしてたんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you are, Princess.
So, what are you three doing here?

fields.EN:
Hikari-chan and I were teaching
Gretel-san how to make sweets.
fields.JP:
わたしとヒカリちゃんで、グレーテルさんに
お菓子作りを教えてたところなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were about to show Gretel
how to bake some sweets.

fields.EN:
(I'm actually more surprised that
Gretel is going to make sweets...)
fields.JP:
（そもそもグレーテルが料理するって、
　似合わないというか意外というか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm actually more surprised that
Gretel is going to make sweets...)

fields.EN:
Heh heh... You look surprised
seeing me here, learning how to
make sweets.
fields.JP:
ふふ、私が料理なんて似合わない、
とでも言いたげな顔ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... You look surprised
seeing me here, learning how to
make sweets.

fields.EN:
Not at all. I just didn't expect
you to be the cooking-type.
So, why now?
fields.JP:
別にそんなことはないって。
ちょっと意外だっただけだよ。
……だけど、どうしてお菓子作りを？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. I just didn't expect
you to be the cooking-type.
So, why now?

fields.EN:
Simple. Because Hansel-niisan can't
regenerate any more with the
destruction of the core.
fields.JP:
理由はいたってシンプルよ。
ヘンゼル兄さんの核が破壊されて、
体が修復されなくなってしまったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Simple. Because Hansel can't
regenerate any more with the
destruction of the core.

fields.EN:
Unlike before, I can't have him endlessly
supply me with his body... sweets... anymore,
so from now on I'll have to manage on my own.
fields.JP:
今までのように、体を……甘い物を
無限に提供してもらえるわけではなくなったから、
これからは自力でどうにかしなければいけないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to find a different way to
get my sweets since the supply
isn't endless as before.

fields.EN:
(She sure is calm, even if it is
about Hansel. I guess that's just
Gretel being Gretel...)
fields.JP:
（ヘンゼルのことなのに、相変わらずクールだな。
　まぁ、グレーテルらしいといえば、
　らしいけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She sure is calm, even if it is
about Hansel. I guess that's just
Gretel being Gretel...)

fields.EN:
I suppose my want for sweets is
my purpose here. Is there anything
else you want to know?
fields.JP:
体が甘い物を欲するから。
それ以上の理由がいるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose my want for sweets is
my purpose here. Is there anything
else you want to know?

fields.JP: ああ、なるほど……。すごく君らしいね

fields.EN:
Want to make some with us, Otsuu-kun? We don't
have many ingredients, so nothing elaborate,
but it might be a nice change of pace.
fields.JP:
おつうくんも一緒に作ってみる？
あまり材料がないから大したものは作れないけど、
気晴らしになるかもよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about you, Otsuu? We don't
have very many ingredients,
but you wanna make some sweets?

fields.EN:
No, I'm fine. Thank you.
I'll just watch.
fields.JP:
いや、僕は遠慮しておこう。
ここで見学させてもらうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm fine. Thank you.
I'll just watch.

fields.EN:
(Heh heh... And, if timing proves
right, I may snitch a bite
just a bit.)
fields.JP:
（あわよくば、お菓子が出来上がったら
　つまみ食いでもさせてもらおうかな。ふふ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Heh heh... And, if timing proves
right, I may snitch a bite
just a bit.)

fields.EN:
So, Gretel-san, first put a little bit
of salt in the bowl.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、グレーテルさん。
そこのボウルに塩を少々入れて
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Gretel, first put a little bit
of salt in the bowl.

fields.EN:
How many grams are you speaking
of here?
fields.JP: 少々って何グラムのこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How many grams are you speaking
of here?

fields.JP: えっと、だいたい一つまみくらいかな
（グレーテル、納得できなさそうな顔してるなぁ）

fields.EN: Next, add the egg yolk and mix it evenly...
fields.JP: 次に卵黄を加えてまんべんなく混ぜて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next, add some egg yolk and
stir it for a bit.

fields.EN: What exactly do you mean by 'evenly'?
fields.JP: まんべんなくって、具体的にどれくらいのこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How long do you mean by
"a bit?"

fields.EN:
Let me show you. Here...
Just whisk it like this, and...
fields.JP:
じゃあ、わたしがお手本を見せますね。
こうやってぐるぐるかき混ぜて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me show you. Here...
Just whisk it like this, and...

fields.EN:
There... That should do it.
Next we add the flour like so...
fields.JP:
……うん、これくらいです。
さらにこっちの粉を加えて、と
fields.LOCALIZED:
There... That should do it.
Next we add the flour like so...

fields.EN:
With that done, let's use this
spatula to lightly mix the flour
and the base...
fields.JP:
これが終わったら、次はゴムベラで
ざっくりと混ぜ合わせて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With that done, let's use this
spatula to lightly mix the flour
and the base...

fields.EN:
What does 'roughly mix' mean? Should
I mix it thoroughly, or avoid mixing
it too much? That's far too vague.
fields.JP:
ざっくり混ぜるってなに？　よく混ぜればいいの？
それともあまり混ぜないほうがいいの？
表現がざっくりしすぎているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Describe what you mean by "lightly
mix." Are you implying we
shouldn't mix it at all?

fields.JP: それはだから、なんて言えばいいのかな……

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, we'll take care of the mixing, so
could you warm the milk?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、そっちは
わたしたちがやっておきますから、
この牛乳を温めてくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tell you what. We'll take care of
the mixing, so can you go ahead
and warm the milk?

fields.EN:
Understood. To what temperature
do you need the milk warmed to?
fields.JP: わかったわ。何度に加熱すればいいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. To what temperature
do you need the milk warmed to?

fields.EN: Just warm it to about skin temperature.
fields.JP: ひと肌くらいでいいですよ

fields.EN:
...And exactly how many degrees is
'skin temperature'? Body temperature
differs from person to person.
fields.JP:
……ひと肌とは、何度のこと？
体温は人によって個人差があるでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Room temperature? Temperature
differs depending on the room.

fields.JP: あう……それはそうなんですけど……

fields.EN:
The details have been very vague.
Is the making of sweets conducted
this loosely?
fields.JP:
さっきから感覚的な表現が多くて困るわ。
お菓子作りとは、なんて曖昧さに
満ちたものなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The details have been very vague.
Is the making of sweets conducted
this loosely?

fields.EN:
Just a matter of observation, but
if you keep that up, you're not
going get any sweets made.
fields.JP:
見学者として言わせてもらうけど、
細かいこと気にしてたら、
いつまで経ってもお菓子ができないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a matter of observation, but
if you keep that up, you're not
going get any sweets made.

fields.JP: ……！　たしかにその通りだわ

fields.EN:
I don't blame you for being
specific. I mean, that is you
after all.
fields.JP:
なんでもきっちり数字で理解したくなるのは、
君の性格なんだろうけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't blame you for being
specific. I mean, that is you
after all.

fields.EN:
Hm, I suppose I'm not meant to be
making my own sweets. But I can't
let that thwart my endeavor.
fields.JP:
そうね。お菓子作りは性に合わないの
かもしれない。……でも、それを言い訳にして
お菓子作りを断念するわけにはいかないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, I suppose I'm not meant to be
making my own sweets. But I can't
let that thwart my endeavor.

fields.EN:
Wow! I can see you're really
serious about this!
fields.JP: すごい。気合いがみなぎってる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow! I can see you're really
serious about this!

fields.EN:
We'll help you as much as we
can, Gretel-san! Let's do this!
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、わたしたちも応援します！
一緒にがんばりましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll help you as much as we
can, Gretel! Let's do this!

fields.EN:
(Those two are taking Gretel's
words too positively. She's saying
that because she wants sweets...)
fields.JP:
（いや、単に食欲に突き動かされてるだけ
　だよね。二人ともなんか感動してるけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Those two are taking Gretel's
words too positively. She's saying
that because she wants sweets...)

fields.EN:
(Still, the concept she's willing
to go through all this for sweets
must prove she really likes them.)
fields.JP:
（でもグレーテルが曖昧な表現を
　受け入れてまでお菓子作りを優先させるなんて、
　よっぽど甘い物が好きなんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Still, the concept she's willing
to go through all this for sweets
must prove she really likes them.)

fields.EN:
Hm? What are you girls doing
here?
fields.JP:
おっ？
貴様ら、こんなところに集まって
なにをしているのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What are you girls doing
here?

fields.EN:
Oh, Hameln. Ningyohime and Hikari are teaching
Gretel how to make sweets. I'm just watching.
fields.JP:
あ、ハーメルン。
人魚姫とヒカリが、グレーテルに
お菓子作りを教えてるんだ。僕は見学
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln? Princess and Hikari is
teaching Gretel how to make
sweets.

fields.EN:
Sweets, you say? That sounds fun!
Here, let me taste test it for
you girls.
fields.JP:
なに、菓子作りだと？
面白そうなことをしているな。
どれ、ワレが味見をしてやろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sweets, you say? That sounds fun!
Here, let me taste test it for
you girls.

fields.JP: ハーちゃん、まだ作ってる途中だよ

fields.EN:
Yup. Eating batter raw is only
going to make your tummy sore.
fields.JP:
そうそう。
生地の状態で食べたら、お腹壊しちゃうよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Eating batter raw is only
going to make your tummy sore.

fields.EN:
Hmph! My stomach can handle
anything! Now, hand me over
that bowl of batter!
fields.JP:
ふふん、それしきのことで
下すようなワレの腹ではないわ！
その生地を寄越すがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! My stomach can handle
anything! Now, hand me over
that bowl of batter!

fields.EN:
Uh, I... have to go now.
I'll see you all layter...
fields.JP:
で、では、ワレはこれで……、
し、しちゅれいするぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I... have to go now.
I'll see you all layter...

fields.JP: さ、お菓子作りを再開しましょう

fields.EN:
(Gretel was terrifying just now...! She
was absolutely serious about killing
me. It wasn't just an empty threat.)
fields.JP:
（さっきのグレーテル、すごく怖かった……！
　あの殺気は絶対本気だったぞ。
　殺すって、ただの脅し文句じゃなかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She scared the daylight out of
me! She really meant what
she said there!)

fields.EN:
(I better not snitch a bite.
I don't want to die yet...)
fields.JP:
（僕もつまみ食いしようと思ってたけど、
　やっぱりやめておこう。
　命は惜しいもんな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better not snitch a bite.
I don't want to die yet...)

fields.EN:
...I'm worried about Gretel. Lately
she's always been off by herself, spacing out.
fields.JP:
……グレーテルのこと、心配だな。
近頃、ずっと一人でぼんやりしてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm worried about Gretel.
She's been like that for days
now...

fields.EN:
Do you think she's depressed
after all...? About Hansel-san...
fields.JP:
やっぱり落ち込んでるのかな。
ヘンゼルさんのこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess what happened to Hansel
was too much for her to fathom...

fields.EN: Even she can get s-s... sentimental, huh.
fields.JP:
あやつでも、しぇ、しぇ……センチメンタル、
になることがあるのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose she has emotions
just like any one of us...

fields.EN:
Maybe we should leave her alone. Or
listen and cheer her up... But what if
that just becomes unwanted meddling...?
fields.JP:
そっとしてあげたほうがいいのかな。
それとも話を聞いて励ましたほうが……
いや、いらぬおせっかいになったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Should we just leave her alone?
Maybe I should talk to her...
No wait...

fields.EN:
If you're going to spend time
wondering, spend it on action!
Here, let me show you...
fields.JP:
くよくよ悩むくらいなら、
さっさと行動を起こせばいいだろう。
よし、ワレが手本を見せてやる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're going to spend time
wondering, spend it on action!
Here, let me show you...

fields.EN:
W-Wait! Gretel might be hurt, so
maybe you shouldn't just rush in like that...
fields.JP:
わわ、ちょっと待った！
グレーテルは傷ついてるかもしれないんだから、
そんないきなり行かないほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Just a second!
This might not be the best time
to be bothering Gretel...

fields.JP: ……でも、わたしもハーちゃんに賛成だな

fields.EN:
I'm sure Gretel-san is hurt, but I think she's
just as lonely too.
It's like she's all alone...
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんはきっと傷ついてるけど、
それと同じくらい孤独を抱えてるんだと思う。
一人ぼっちになっちゃったみたいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure she's hurt, but I also
think she's also suffering from
solitude...

fields.EN:
Yup, but maybe she might not see
that. That's why we should try and
approach her from our side.
fields.JP:
うん。だけど今は心に余裕がなくて、
それを忘れちゃってるかもしれない。だから
わたしたちから寄り添った方がいいと思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, but maybe she might not see
that. That's why we should try and
approach her from our side.

fields.EN:
We don't need to talk to her.
Just be by her side in her time
of need. Don't you think so?
fields.JP:
たくさん言葉をかけたりしなくたって、
傍にいるだけで、なにか違うかもしれないでしょ？
……普通はそうだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't need to talk to her.
Just be by her side in her time
of need. Don't you think so?

fields.EN:
I'm amazed at how quickly you were
able to come to a conclusion over
something I couldn't figure out.
fields.JP:
……姫。君はすごいな。
僕が迷っていたことに、
すぐに答えを見つけてしまうんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm amazed at how quickly you were
able to come to a conclusion over
something I couldn't figure out.

fields.EN:
You couldn't decide because you're kind,
Otsuu-chan. Now, let's go see Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんが迷っていたのは、
おつうちゃんが優しいからだよ。
さ、グレーテルさんのところに行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You weren't able to make a
decision because you're kind.
Now, let's go see Gretel.

fields.EN:
Tsuu? Ningyohime, Hameln?
What brings you three here?
fields.JP: ……つう？　人魚姫に、ハーメルンまで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? Little Mermaid, Hameln?
What brings you three here?

fields.EN:
Um, if you don't mind, can we
join you?
fields.JP:
あの、お邪魔じゃなければ、
一緒にいてもいいですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, if you don't mind, can we
join you?

fields.EN:
What were you doing all by
yourself? Are you depressed after all?
fields.JP:
一人でなにをしてたんだ？
やっぱり落ち込んでるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What were you doing here all
by yourself? We're you suffering
or something?

fields.EN:
Suffering?
What are you talking about?
fields.JP: ？　落ち込む……？　なんのことかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Suffering?
What are you talking about?

fields.EN:
Um, I know it's difficult with
what happened to Hansel-san,
but we're here for you.
fields.JP:
その、ヘンゼルさんがあんなことに
なっちゃって……。やっぱり辛いですよね。
わたしたちでよければ、いつでも力になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I know it's difficult with
what happened to Hansel,
but we're here for you.

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan?
Oh, you mean how he's dead?
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんがって……。
ああ、死んでしまったこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel?
Oh, you mean how he's dead?

fields.EN:
(Wow, she's taking it well.
I'd even say she's borderline
cold-hearted...)
fields.JP:
（なんだかすごくドライだな。
　冷たいっていうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow, she's taking it well.
I'd even say she's borderline
cold-hearted...)

fields.EN:
Just because Hansel-niisan died doesn't
seem like a reason for me to be depressed.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんが死んだからといって、
私が落ち込む理由にはならないと思うけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see why I should suffer
over my dear brother Hansel's
death.

fields.EN:
You don't need to put up a front.
You're free to say what you...
fields.JP:
強がらなくてもいいんだよ？
僕達の前でくらい、本音で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to put up a front.
You're free to say what you...

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan died. He isn't here now.
That's the fact.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんは死んだ。もういない。
それがすべてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel died. He isn't here now.
That's the fact.

fields.EN:
But... aren't you really sad? Hansel, whom
you looked up to like an older brother, died.
fields.JP:
そんな……本当に悲しくないのか？
兄と慕っていたヘンゼルが、死んだんだぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, aren't you sad?
Your brother died.

fields.EN:
Actually, I think it's something to be
glad about. Hansel-niisan didn't die in vain.
fields.JP:
むしろ喜ばしいことだと思うわ。
ヘンゼル兄さんは無駄死にしたわけじゃ
なかったのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, I'm very happy
that he died with a cause.

fields.EN:
You could've worded it better!
He died for the sake of everyone!
fields.JP:
その言い方はないんじゃないか？
ヘンゼルは仲間を助けるために
犠牲になったんだぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could've worded it better!
He died for the sake of everyone!

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、落ち着いて

fields.EN:
I can't calm down! Gretel, that
attitude is far too heartless!
Hansel was more human than you!
fields.JP:
落ち着いてられないよ！
グレーテルの態度はあまりにも薄情だ！
これならヘンゼルのほうがまだ人間らしかった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I won't! Gretel, I expected
more from you! Hansel was more
of a human than you!

fields.EN:
I don't understand why you're
seemingly upset.
fields.JP:
なぜあなたがそんなに激昂するのか、
理解できないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't understand why you're
seemingly upset.

fields.EN:
Hmm. So to Gretel, Hansel was like a
servant? I wouldn't be particularly
sad if one of my servants died either.
fields.JP:
ふーむ、つまりグレーテルにとって、
ヘンゼルは下僕のようなものだったということか？
ワレも、下僕が死んでも別に悲しまないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Hansel was more a subordinate
than a brother? I wouldn't be sad
if that was so, too.

fields.EN:
That's not true, too. I suppose
what I feel is something
incomprehensible to others.
fields.JP:
……その感情とも違うと思うわ。
人には理解されない感情ということかしら。
もしくは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true, too. I suppose
what I feel is something
incomprehensible to others.

fields.JP: あっ、言うだけ言って行っちゃった……
ハハハ！　相変わらずマイペースなのだな！

fields.EN:
(...But maybe I went too far.
Gretel has always been unusual,
and I just lost my temper.)
fields.JP:
（……でも、さすがに言いすぎたかな。
　グレーテルが変わってるのは今に始まったこと
　じゃないのに、ついカッとなっちゃった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What in the world did I say to
her? She's as usual, and yet
I got angry over her demeanor.)

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, Gretel-san doesn't seem sad about
Hansel-san's death, but I don't think that's
because she's cold-hearted.
fields.JP:
……おつうちゃん、グレーテルさんは
ヘンゼルさんの死を悲しんでいないみたいだけど、
それは冷たいからじゃないと思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? It doesn't look like Gretel
is sad, but I don't think it's
because she's cold-hearted.

fields.EN:
Gretel-san just thinks differently from us.
She's actually a kind person.
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんはわたしたちとは
違う考え方をしているだけで、
本当は優しい人なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's kind as anyone else, but
it's just that she thinks very
differently from us.

fields.EN:
What do you mean by that,
Princess?
fields.JP: 姫？　それってどういう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean by that,
Princess?

fields.JP: それはそうと、おつうちゃん
（あれ？　もしかして、怒ってる？）

fields.EN:
You could've worded yourself
better. That really came out bad.
fields.JP:
さっきの言い方はひどくなかった？
もっと違う言い方があったと思うんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could've worded yourself
better. That really came out bad.

fields.JP: う……それは自分でも思った。反省してる

fields.EN:
Well, make sure you say that
to her next time.
fields.JP: 今度会ったら、ちゃんと謝ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, make sure you say that
to her next time.

fields.EN:
What, Otsuu? Does Ningyohime
already have you under her thumb?
fields.JP: なんだ、おつうは人魚姫の尻に敷かれてるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? You're already being
used and abused by Little Mermaid?

fields.JP: いや、そういうわけじゃ……

fields.EN:
Well, I don't know the details,
but... good luck!
fields.JP: まあよくわからんが、がんばるが良い！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I don't know the details,
but... good luck!

fields.EN:
Haha, thanks... Though that's
pretty flimsy encouragement...
fields.JP:
はは、ありがとう……。
すごく薄い励ましだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha... Um, thanks?
I guess I feel better now?

fields.EN:
(But why did Gretel say what she
said? What does Princess mean
by saying Gretel is kind?)
fields.JP:
（……グレーテルはなんであんなことを
　言ったんだろう。それに、姫が言ってた
　本当は優しい人って、いったい……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But why did Gretel say what she
said? What does Princess mean
by saying Gretel is kind?)

fields.JP: （……なんだか、胸がもやもやする）

うーん、うーん……。
どう謝ればいいんだろう……

fields.EN:
"Gretel, I'm sorry about the
last time."
fields.JP: グレーテル、この間は悪かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Gretel, I'm sorry about the
last time."

fields.EN:
Mmm... That doesn't sound
right. Maybe a bit more casual...
fields.JP:
……うーん、なんか違う気がするな。
もっとこう、さらっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... That doesn't sound
right. Maybe a bit more casual...

fields.JP: グレーテル！　この間はごめん！

fields.EN:
Ugh, that won't work. It shouldn't
sound too casual... Something a
bit more heartfelt...
fields.JP:
あああ、絶対違う。
こんな軽い感じで言っちゃ駄目だよな……。
もっと真心を伝えられるような感じで、こう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, that won't work. It shouldn't
sound too casual... Something a
bit more heartfelt...

fields.JP: グレーテル。この間のことなんだけど

fields.EN:
You were muttering my name to
yourself, and then suddenly got
startled. You're a busy person.
fields.JP:
人の名前をぶつぶつ呼んでいたかと思えば、
急に驚いたりして。忙しい人ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite rude, calling me
and being surprised seeing me.

fields.JP:
（この間は言いすぎたと思って、
　地味にずっともやもやしてたんだよな。
　でも謝る練習を、まさか本人に見られるなんて）

fields.EN:
(Wh-What should I say?
I'm not ready to talk with her
yet...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんて切り出そう。
　まだ心の準備ができていないのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What should I say?
I'm not ready to talk with her
yet...)

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel? Uh, about the last
time... I'm sorry for what I said
then, so...
fields.JP:
あ、あのさ、グレーテル、そのー、
この間のことなんだけど、
悪かったなって反省してて、だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel? Uh, about the last
time... I'm sorry for what I said
then, so...

fields.EN:
Last time?
What are you talking about?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Last time?
What are you talking about?

fields.EN:
You know, when I ranted over
Hansel's death and how you
didn't seem like you cared.
fields.JP:
いや、だから、ヘンゼルが死んだのに
君が悲しんでなくて、
それを僕が責めちゃったことだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, when I ranted over
Hansel's death and how you
didn't seem like you cared.

fields.EN:
(That's it?! After all I was
worried about that's all she
has to say?!)
fields.JP:
（そ、そんなことって！
　こっちはずっともやもやしてたのに、
　すごくサラッと流された……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's it?! After all I was
worried about that's all she
has to say?!)

fields.EN:
I was actually thinking about
what you told me then.
fields.JP:
一応、あれからあなたの言い分のことも
考えてみたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was actually thinking about
what you told me then.

fields.EN:
Huh? You were?
I thought you didn't care.
fields.JP:
え……そうなのか？
どうでもいいのかと思ってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You were?
I thought you didn't care.

fields.EN:
It's not that I'm indifferent. ...I thought
carefully about my own feelings—about why
Hansel-niisan's death doesn't make me sad.
fields.JP:
無関心なわけではないから。
……なぜヘンゼル兄さんの死が悲しくないのか、
自分の感情を突き詰めて考えてみたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Caring isn't the right term. I was
thinking of why I wasn't sad
over Hansel's death.

fields.EN:
My analysis is that I wasn't sad
because I felt proud of
Hansel-niisan's death.
fields.JP:
その結果、私はヘンゼル兄さんの死を誇りに
思っているから、悲しくないのだ、とわかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My analysis is that I wasn't sad
because I felt proud of
Hansel's death.

fields.EN:
Yes. In this Jail, most deaths have
no meaning. But Hansel-niisan died a
meaningful death. I'm very proud of that.
fields.JP:
ええ。この監獄内で、ほとんどの死は意味を
持たない。だけどヘンゼル兄さんは意味のある
死を遂げた。それはとても誇らしいことだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. Death has little meaning
here, but he died with a purpose.
How can I not be proud?

fields.EN:
So I feel pride, but no sadness... At least,
not enough sadness for me to be aware of it.
fields.JP:
だから、誇りはあっても悲しみはないの。
……少なくとも、自覚できるほどは
fields.LOCALIZED:
So my feeling of pride overcame
my feeling of sorrow,
or so I believe...

fields.EN:
(She values purpose over death
itself. I guess that's one way of
approaching death...)
fields.JP:
（死んだこと自体より、
　どう死んだかが大事なんだ。死に対して、
　そんな考え方もあるのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She values purpose over death
itself. I guess that's one way of
approaching death...)

fields.EN:
If Hansel-niisan had died for nothing, I
don't know whether I could have stayed calm.
But hypotheticals are meaningless too.
fields.JP:
仮にヘンゼル兄さんが無駄死にしていたら、
私も冷静でいられたかはわからないわ。
仮定の話なんて、それこそ無意味だけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt I could keep my composure
if he died without meaning. Not
that I can find out now, though.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about the last time,
Gretel. I got all angry without
really understanding you.
fields.JP:
グレーテル……この間は悪かった。
君のことをなんにもわかっていなかったのに、
一方的に怒ったりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about the last time,
Gretel. I got all angry without
really understanding you.

fields.EN:
Not to worry. All it was that
we didn't interface well then.
fields.JP:
構わないわ。意思の疎通がうまく
いかなかっただけのことだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to worry. All it was that
we didn't interface well then.

fields.EN:
That said, I actually need to
apologize to you.
fields.JP: それより、私のほうこそごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I actually need to
apologize to you.

fields.JP: （あのグレーテルが、素直に謝った……！？）

fields.EN:
I wasn't able to properly orate my
feelings to you. Hence, it was my
fault we didn't interface well.
fields.JP:
この間は自分の感情をうまく言語化でき
なかったから。意思の疎通に齟齬が生じたのは、
私のせいだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't able to properly orate my
feelings to you. Hence, it was my
fault we didn't interface well.

fields.EN:
I thought I was observant, but
I suppose I still need to learn
how to properly relay my feelings.
fields.JP:
いろいろなことを観察しているつもりだけど、
自分の感情すら言語化できないようでは、
私もまだまだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I was observant, but
I suppose I still need to learn
how to properly relay my feelings.

fields.EN:
I can at least say I feel a lot
closer to you than before now.
fields.JP: ……なんだか、前より君と近づけた気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can at least say I feel a lot
closer to you than before now.

fields.EN:
Really? I wouldn't know how many centimeters
closer we've become unless I measured it.
fields.JP:
そう？　何センチ近づいたかなんて、
測らなければわからないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that so? I can't fathom how
you can say that without proper
measurements.

fields.EN:
Uh, that's not what I was driving
at, but... You're good as how
you are now.
fields.JP:
ははっ、そういうことじゃないよ。
……でも、そういう君でいいんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, that's not what I was driving
at, but... You're good as how
you are now.

fields.EN: Hm? Well, if you say so.
fields.JP: ？　あなたがいいなら、それでいいけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Well, if you say so.

fields.EN:
(I sort of understand what
Princess meant when she said that
Gretel is kind.)
fields.JP:
（あのとき姫が、グレーテルは優しい人
　だって言った理由が、わかった気がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I sort of understand what
Princess meant when she said that
Gretel is kind.)

fields.EN:
(Don't worry, Hansel.
We'll be here by Gretel's side...)
fields.JP:
（ヘンゼル、グレーテルには僕達がついてるから、
　安心してくれ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Don't worry, Hansel.
We'll be here by Gretel's side...)

fields.EN: Gretel, do you have a moment?
fields.JP: グレーテル、ちょっといいかい
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretel, do you have a moment?

fields.EN:
I would have appreciated it if
you would have let me answer
you before you opened the door.
fields.JP:
……せめてこちらの応答を待ってから
扉を開けてほしかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would have appreciated it if
you would have let me answer
you before you opened the door.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I did knock before
coming in... So, do you have
some time to spare?
fields.JP:
ごめん。でもノックはしたよ。
今、時間はあるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I did knock before
coming in... So, do you have
some time to spare?

fields.EN:
I want to concentrate on reading
right now. Please come back another day.
fields.JP:
今は読書に集中したいんだけど。
また後日にしてちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was busy reading, so maybe
tomorrow.

fields.EN:
Oh, really? That's too bad.
I just came to share some sweets
that I happened to get.
fields.JP:
そうか、もったいないなぁ。
せっかくお菓子が手に入ったから、
お土産に持って来たのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, really? That's too bad.
I just came to share some sweets
that I happened to get.

fields.EN:
Now, where's the sweets?
You brought them here for me, yes?
fields.JP:
さあ、お菓子を早く。
私へのお土産なんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, where's the sweets?
You brought them here for me, yes?

fields.EN:
*munch* *munch*
Mmm... This tastes good.
Thank you, Tsuu.
fields.JP:
もぐもぐ……ごっくん。
はぁ、おいしかった……。
ありがとう、つう
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* *munch*
Mmm... This tastes good.
Thank you, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Well, now you owe me one. Besides, you
really do look happy when you're eating
sweets. I never get tired of watching you.
fields.JP:
まあ、貸し、だからね。
っていうか君、お菓子食べるときは本当に
幸せそうだなぁ。見ていて飽きないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I did owe you. I have to
say I'll never get bored looking
at you eat so happily.

fields.EN:
Oh? My exact same sentiments
to you.
fields.JP: あら、見ていて飽きないのはあなたのほうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? My exact same sentiments
to you.

fields.EN:
I find it quite interesting
observing your relationship with
Ningyohime, but...
fields.JP:
そう、あなた。
人魚姫との関係も興味があるけれど、
それよりも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I find it quite interesting
observing your relationship with
Little Mermaid, but...

fields.EN:
How is it that you can understand a
Nightmare's feelings? Even I couldn't
understand Hansel-niisan's feelings...
fields.JP:
あなたはなぜナイトメアの感情がわかるのかしら。
私でさえヘンゼル兄さんの感情は
わからなかったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just as interested in how you
are able to read a Nightmare's
feelings.

fields.EN:
And by reading the 'fairy tales' related
to us, I can understand the reasons behind
the Libidos of various Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
それに、私たちに関係する『童話』と
呼ばれる書物を読むと、様々な血式少女の
リビドーの理由がわかるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, reading the many fairytales
have made me understand the
reasons behind our libido.

fields.EN:
Yet you're the only one with almost no
Blood Libido... Though you did at least
seem to have that wish to become a 'bride.'
fields.JP:
それなのに、あなただけは血式リビドーが
ないに等しい……。辛うじて、『お嫁さん』
という想いはあったようだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But in your case, you don't have
any real Blood Libido... I suppose
"marriage" may be yours, but...

fields.EN:
You got it wrong, Gretel.
I do have a Blood Libido.
It's "repayment."
fields.JP:
……違うよ、グレーテル。
僕にもちゃんと血式リビドーがある。
……『恩返し』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got it wrong, Gretel.
I do have a Blood Libido.
It's "repayment."

fields.EN:
I have this Libido that makes me want
to repay favors, but whenever I think
about it, my heart starts pounding hard.
fields.JP:
僕は恩返しをしたいというリビドーがあるけれど、
それを考えると動悸が激しくなるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can feel myself getting tense
each time my urge to repay what
I owe rises...

fields.EN:
So when someone thanks me, I say they owe me
one. Then if I feel indebted later, I tell
myself they simply paid that debt back.
fields.JP:
だから誰かに感謝されたときは『貸し』だと
あらかじめ宣言しておいて、いざ恩を感じたときは
『貸しを返された』って考えるようにしている
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I keep saying that I
"owe" someone. That way, I can
"repay" the person later.

fields.EN:
So that's why you emphasized that
I owed you one just now. What a
complicated mental structure...
fields.JP:
だからさっきも、『貸し』だと強調していたのね。
ややこしい精神構造だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So that's why you told me
that you "owed" me one earlier.
Very interesting indeed...

fields.EN:
But that's the only way I can
keep myself from feeling indebted.
fields.JP:
でも、恩を感じないようにするには
そうするしかないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the only way it feels
like I repaid what was due
properly.

fields.EN:
But in the story, "The Grateful
Crane," the crane showed its true
form while repaying...
fields.JP:
それにしても、まだわからないことがあるわ。
鶴の恩返しの話では、『恩返し』のために
本性をさらけ出すことになっているけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But in the story, "The Grateful
Crane," the crane showed its true
form while repaying...

fields.EN:
If so, do you have a "true form"
that lies inside you?
fields.JP:
あなたの『本性』……そんなものが
あるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, do you have a "true form"
that lies inside you?

fields.JP: あはは、どうなんだろう……

fields.EN:
One other thing. You seem overly
attracted to Ningyohime for
no apparent reason.
fields.JP:
それにあなたは、客観的に納得できる理由なく
人魚姫に執着しているように見えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing. You seem overly
attracted to Little Mermaid for
no apparent reason.

fields.EN:
I feel as if I can learn your true
nature if I research on your
attachment to Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
ない、なんて言い切れる？　人魚姫への執着、
その辺りを詳しく調べていけば、あなたの本質を
知ることに繋がるんじゃないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel as if I can learn your true
nature if I research on your
attachment to Little Mermaid.

fields.JP: 考えただけで、わくわくするわ

fields.EN:
(I'm attached to Princess?
My true nature? Is there something
about me that I don't know of?)
fields.JP:
（僕は人魚姫に執着している？
　それに、僕の本質って？
　……僕が知らない僕がいるということなのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm attached to Princess?
My true nature? Is there something
about me that I don't know of?)

fields.JP: （なんだか、嫌だな。気味が悪い……）

fields.EN:
Um... what I feel for Ningyohime
is 'love.' It isn't obsession.
fields.JP:
その……人魚姫への気持ちは、『愛』なんだよ。
執着じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
My attachment to her is based
on love, that's all...

fields.EN:
Love has no reason.
