There is no reason needed to love.
fields.JP:
たしかにこの気持ちに理由はないけれど、
だからこそ『愛』なんだ。
誰かを愛するのに理由なんて必要ないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Love has no reason.
There is no reason needed to love.

fields.EN:
Hm... I don't understand that
emotion well, but that is quite
intriguing.
fields.JP:
ふぅん……？
私にはよくわからない感情だけど、
それも含めて興味深いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I don't understand that
emotion well, but that is quite
intriguing.

fields.EN:
Heh... I guess anything can be
intriguing to you...
fields.JP:
ははは、君にとってはなんでも
研究対象になっちゃうんだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I guess anything can be
intriguing to you...

fields.EN:
(Love... My feelings towards
Princess is love, right?)
fields.JP:
（……『愛』か。人魚姫に対するこの気持ちは、
　本当に『愛』……なんだよな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Love... My feelings towards
Princess is love, right?)

fields.EN: (I have no choice but to believe that...)
How much longer will this take?
fields.JP: いつまで悩んでいるつもり？
fields.LOCALIZED: How much longer will this take?

fields.JP:
せ、急かすんじゃない！
今考えているところだ！

fields.EN:
(Hm? Gretel and Hameln?
What are they doing there?)
fields.JP:
（ん？　グレーテルとハーメルンだ。
　テーブル挟んでなにをしてるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Gretel and Hameln?
What are they doing there?)

fields.EN:
You don't have any other place
to put your stone. The whole
board is white already.
fields.JP:
もう石を打てる場所もほとんどないわよ。
盤上が真っ白けね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have any other place
to put your stone. The whole
board is white already.

fields.EN:
I-I'm not giving up until the
very end!
fields.JP:
そ、それでも最後までワレは
勝負を投げたりしないんだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not giving up until the
very end!

fields.EN:
(They're just playing Othello...
Where did they find it anyway?)
fields.JP:
（ああ、オセロをしてるのか。
　どこかから見つけてきたんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're just playing Othello...
Where did they find it anyway?)

fields.JP: うーん、うーん……よし、ここだ！

fields.EN:
Hahaha! How's that?!
I made a whole lot black!
fields.JP:
ふっふっふ、どうだ！
たくさん黒にひっくり返してやったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! How's that?!
I made a whole lot black!

fields.EN: Then I'll place a white piece here...
fields.JP: なら、私はここに白を打って、と……

fields.EN:
It doesn't seem like you have
any other place to put your stone
so I guess I'll keep going.
fields.JP:
次はあなたの番だけど、
打てる場所がないから、
また私の番になるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't seem like you have
any other place to put your stone
so I guess I'll keep going.

fields.JP: のおおぉお！？　な、なんたることだ！！

fields.EN:
And... there. I win again.
That makes it ten wins in a row.
fields.JP: はい、おしまい。これで私の十戦十勝ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... there. I win again.
That makes it ten wins in a row.

fields.EN:
Ngh! Why are you so good at this?!
Wait! You're not cheating,
are you?!
fields.JP:
うぐぐ、貴様、なぜそんなに強いのだ。
なにかズルをしてるのではあるまいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ngh! Why are you so good at this?!
Wait! You're not cheating,
are you?!

fields.EN:
Cheat? I doubt that, especially
when I've handicapped myself
by giving you the four corners.
fields.JP:
あら、ズルなんてしてないわ。
むしろ最初に四隅にあなたの黒石を置いて、
ハンデまでつけてあげたじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cheat? I doubt that, especially
when I've handicapped myself
by giving you the four corners.

fields.JP: ……ということは、どういうことなのだ？
単純にあなたが弱いということじゃない？

fields.EN: (Ah. Hameln's heart just coughed up blood...)
fields.JP: （あ。ハーメルンの心が血を吐いた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can hear Hameln taking damage
inside her body...)

fields.EN:
F-Fine... So I'm weak at this
game... I suppose I have to
accept that.
fields.JP:
はあ、はあ、いや、たしかに
この白黒ゲームにおいては、ワレは弱い。
それは素直に認めよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine... So I'm weak at this
game... I suppose I have to
accept that.

fields.EN:
But, why am I so weak? Why
can't I beat you? How can I get
better at this game?!
fields.JP:
だが、なぜこんなにも弱いのだ？
なぜ貴様には勝てないのだ？
ワレはどうすれば強くなれるのだ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, why am I so weak? Why
can't I beat you? How can I get
better at this game?!

fields.EN:
Simple. You're weak because
you're not thinking about your
next move.
fields.JP:
答えは簡単よ。
あなたは先のことを考えずに
石を打っているから弱いの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Simple. You're weak because
you're not thinking about your
next move.

fields.EN:
But I am! Like, where I can
place my stone to flip as
many of them as possible!
fields.JP:
先のことなら考えているぞ。
どこに置けば何個ひっくり返せるかとな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I am! Like, where I can
place my stone to flip as
many of them as possible!

fields.EN:
You only put them where you can
flip numbers. You need to think
steps ahead of just one move.
fields.JP:
それよ、弱い理由は。あなたはそのとき
一番多くの石を返せる場所に打つでしょ。
何手も先を読まなければ勝てないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You only put them where you can
flip numbers. You need to think
steps ahead of just one move.

fields.EN:
Remember how you lost turns
because you couldn't place
your stones?
fields.JP:
さっきもそうだったけれど、
あなた、対戦中に何度も打てる場所が
なくなるときがあったでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember how you lost turns
because you couldn't place
your stones?

fields.EN:
For example, you predict: 'If I play here,
she might play there next. Then on my next
turn I won't have anywhere to play.'
fields.JP:
たとえば、「ここに打ったら、次はこう
打たれるかもしれない。そうすれば次に
自分が打てる場所がなくなる」と予測するの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I simply read where you and
I would place our stones, and
moved in a way you lose turns.

fields.EN:
If you do the same, you should
do much better.
fields.JP:
そうしていけば、さっきみたいな失敗は
しなくなるはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you do the same, you should
do much better.

fields.JP: おおっ、なるほど！　貴様、すごいな！

fields.EN:
I'm not sharing anything
special in particular...
fields.JP: これくらいは普通でしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sharing anything
special in particular...

fields.EN: Can I call you my Othello Master?!
fields.JP: オセロ師匠と呼んでもよいか！？

fields.EN:
So all I need to do is watch
out! Haha! I demand a rematch,
Gretel!
fields.JP:
よし、そこさえ注意すればワレが
恐れるものなどなにもない！
グレーテル、貴様に再戦を申し込む！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So all I need to do is watch
out! Haha! I demand a rematch,
Gretel!

fields.JP: 受けて立つわ。どうせまた私が勝つけれど

fields.EN:
(It looks like Gretel is having
fun. Those two actually pair
well together...)
fields.JP:
（……グレーテル、なんだかんだ言って
　けっこう楽しそうだな。
　あの二人、意外に仲が良いのかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like Gretel is having
fun. Those two actually pair
well together...)

fields.EN:
(I feel a bit sorry for Hameln,
though. I don't see her winning
against Gretel at all...)
fields.JP:
（でもハーメルンは百戦してもグレーテルに
　勝てないだろうな。そう思うとちょっと
　不憫だけど、まぁ、いいか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel a bit sorry for Hameln,
though. I don't see her winning
against Gretel at all...)

fields.JP:
あれ、グレーテル？
なんか様子が……

グレーテルさん？
そんなにフラフラして、大丈夫？
いや、全然大丈夫って感じじゃないよ

fields.EN:
Look at you... You're all pale.
Are you sure you're...?
fields.JP: それに顔色も悪いわ。無理してるんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at you... You're all pale.
Are you sure you're...?

fields.EN:
I'm fine.
Please... leave me alone...
fields.JP:
大丈夫だと……言っているでしょ。
……放っておい……て
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine.
Please... leave me alone...

fields.JP: グレーテルさん！？　た、倒れちゃった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel?!
G-Get a hold of yourself!

fields.EN:
What's with the commotion?
Is something the matter?
fields.JP: 騒がしいですわね。なにかありましたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with the commotion?
Is something the matter?

fields.EN:
Gretel-san looks really sick...
She just fell over just now.
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんが具合悪いみたいで、
急に倒れちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel looks really sick...
She just fell over just now.

fields.EN:
Oh my, that's not good!
We should take her to her room!
fields.JP:
まあ、大変ですわ！
早く部屋にお連れしないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, that's not good!
We should take her to her room!

fields.EN:
Right. Can you help us carry Gretel-san to her
room?
fields.JP:
そうね。グレーテルさんの部屋まで運ぶの、
手伝ってくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind helping us carrying
her to her room?

fields.JP: あ、目を覚ましましたわ

fields.EN:
I'm... in my room?
Why are you all here?
fields.JP: ここは……私の部屋？　なぜあなたたちが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... in my room?
Why are you all here?

fields.EN: Gretel-san, you collapsed in the hallway.
fields.JP: グレーテルさん、廊下で倒れちゃったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You lost consciousness
in the hallway.

fields.EN:
I happened to be passing by, and the three

fields.JP:
そこにわたしが通りかかって、
おつうとアリスの三人がかりで
運んであげましたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, Alice, and myself found
you and brought you here.

fields.EN:
It was a good thing you came
by, Cinderella.
fields.JP: シンデレラが来てくれて助かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was a good thing you came
by, Cinderella.

fields.EN:
Yes, it would've been a bit
difficult with just me and Otsuu-san.
fields.JP:
そうね。おつうさんとわたしの二人だけじゃ
ちょっと大変だったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it would've been a bit
difficult with just me and Otsuu.

fields.EN:
I see...
I'm sorry for the bother.
fields.JP: そうだったの……。迷惑をかけたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
I'm sorry for the bother.

fields.JP: 体調はもういいんですの？

fields.EN:
Why yes, I feel much better now
that I had time to rest.
fields.JP:
ええ、しばらく横になったおかげで、
だいぶ元気よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, I feel much better now
that I had time to rest.

fields.EN:
You surprised us when you just
fell back there.
So, what happened?
fields.JP:
だけど、びっくりしたわ。
突然倒れるんだもの。どうしてあんな
ふらふらな状態になっていたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You surprised us when you just
fell back there.
So, what happened?

fields.EN:
I was conducting research for
two days straight without sleep.
fields.JP:
……つい、研究に没頭してしまったの。
二日ほど連続で徹夜してしまったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was conducting research for
two days straight without sleep.

fields.EN:
Just hearing that is making
me feel tired already...
fields.JP:
聞いただけで、眠くなって
しまいそうですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just hearing that is making
me feel tired already...

fields.EN:
I went to the cafeteria to get a
bite, but I suppose I passed out
on my way back here.
fields.JP:
徹夜明けでなんとか食堂で軽食をとったあと、
部屋に戻ろうとして、力尽きてしまった
というわけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I went to the cafeteria to get a
bite, but I suppose I passed out
on my way back here.

fields.EN:
I need to learn what my limits
are. This was a nice case sample
to experience.
fields.JP:
自分の限界というものを的確に
把握していなければならないということね。
いい勉強になったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to learn what my limits
are. This was a nice case sample
to experience.

fields.JP: （またずいぶん淡々と言うなぁ……）

fields.EN:
That's so you, Gretel-san.
Well, I'm just glad you're feeling
better now.
fields.JP:
まったく、グレーテルさんらしいわ。
まぁ、元気そうでホッとしたけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's so you, Gretel.
Well, I'm just glad you're feeling
better now.

fields.EN:
For a second there I thought you
were badly ill. Well, it's good
it wasn't anything terrible.
fields.JP:
拍子抜けですわね。
悪い病気だったらどうしようかと
思いましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For a second there I thought you
were badly ill. Well, it's good
it wasn't anything terrible.

fields.JP: うん。大したことなくてよかった

fields.EN:
Hm?
Why are you all seemingly
relieved?
fields.JP: ？　あなたたちは安堵しているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm?
Why are you all seemingly
relieved?

fields.EN:
That's because we were worried
about you, of course.
fields.JP: 当たり前ですわ。心配しましたもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because we were worried
about you, of course.

fields.EN:
Gretel-san?
You still don't seem well...
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん？
やっぱりまだ具合が悪いんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel?
You still don't seem well...

fields.EN:
No, I'm fine. It was just that
your reactions were unexpected
with how worried you all were.
fields.JP:
いえ、大丈夫よ。
……ただ、意外だっただけ。
あなたたちは私を心配したのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm fine. It was just that
your reactions were unexpected
with how worried you all were.

fields.EN:
Wait. You didn't know we
were worried about you?
fields.JP: もしかして、わかってなかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. You didn't know we
were worried about you?

fields.JP: ええ。でもようやく気づいたわ

fields.EN:
Most people would know that
naturally... You really are
a strange one.
fields.JP:
普通、すぐわかることですわよ。
やっぱり変わり者ですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most people would know that
naturally... You really are
a strange one.

fields.EN:
I heard worry can take a toll
on one's body.
fields.JP:
心配という感情は、心の負担になり、
肉体にも悪影響を及ぼすと聞いたことがあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard worry can take a toll
on one's body.

fields.EN:
Which means I caused harm
to you all by making you all
worried. I'm sorry...
fields.JP:
私のせいで、あなたたちの心に
負担をかけてしまったということね。
……ごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means I caused harm
to you all by making you all
worried. I'm sorry...

fields.JP: あのグレーテルさんが……！

fields.EN: Maybe spears will rain from the sky...
fields.JP: 空から槍が降るかもな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope this isn't a bad
omen to come...

fields.EN:
That sounded rude...
I do apologize if I feel
I am in the wrong.
fields.JP:
なにやら失礼な物言いをされた
気がするけれど。私だって、
悪いと思えば謝罪くらいするわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounded rude...
I do apologize if I feel
I am in the wrong.

fields.JP:
……グレーテルって、けっこう
面白い方ですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel is... quite unique,
isn't she?

fields.EN:
Unique? I wasn't necessarily
joking there.
fields.JP:
それは私がユニークだということ？
私はジョークを言ったつもりはないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unique? I wasn't necessarily
joking there.

fields.EN:
Unique, not in a bad way, though.
I feel a lot closer to you now.
fields.JP:
でも、わたしも面白いと思ったわ。
親近感が湧くっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unique, not in a bad way, though.
I feel a lot closer to you now.

fields.EN:
I was surprised someone so reliable-looking
collapsed from lack of sleep. ...I guess
you have a slightly absent-minded side too.
fields.JP:
寝不足で倒れちゃうなんて、
しっかりしていそうなのに意外だった。
……ちょっと抜けているところもあるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Might I add I was surprised to
see you drop from sleep depravity
despite your analytical behavior.

fields.EN:
I won't deny what happened.
Thank you for helping me then.
fields.JP:
……否定はしないわ。
助けてくれて、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't deny what happened.
Thank you for helping me then.

fields.JP: 仲間なんだから、当然でしょ

fields.EN:
I see... Friends... Heh heh...
I suppose I can live with that.
fields.JP:
……そうね。仲間か……。
ふふ、こういう新しい感覚も悪くはないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Friends... Heh heh...
I suppose I can live with that.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
今、ジャックの悲鳴が聞こえなかった！？

fields.EN:
It's coming from Gretel's room.
Let's go, Oyayubi!
fields.JP:
グレーテルの部屋からだ。
行ってみよう、親指！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's coming from Gretel's room.
Let's go, Thumbelina!

fields.EN:
You mean how I'm in my
underwear?
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean how I'm in my
underwear?

fields.EN:
No, that's not what I'm asking! Wh-Why are you
attacking Jack dressed like that, with so much
skin showing?!
fields.JP:
いや、そういうことを聞いているんじゃなくて！
なんでそんな、は、肌も露わな姿で
ジャックを襲ってるんだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Wh-Why are you attacking
Jack like that?!

fields.EN:
You're making it sound worse than
it is. I'm just trying to hold him
down by force.
fields.JP:
人聞きの悪いことを言わないで。
どうにか押さえつけようとしている
だけじゃない。力づくで
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're making it sound worse than
it is. I'm just trying to hold him
down by force.

fields.JP:
それ、かなり襲ってる状況に
近いと思うんだけど……

fields.EN:
I needed him to stay calm for
my experiment.
fields.JP: 実験のためには大人しくしてもらうしかないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I needed him to stay calm for
my experiment.

fields.EN:
Why yes. He is a male, so I was
experimenting to see how he would
react to a female.
fields.JP:
ええ。ナイトメア・ジャックは
元々オスなのだから、女に対して
どんな反応を示すか調べるための実験よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. He is a male, so I was
experimenting to see how he would
react to a female.

fields.EN:
Which is why I dressed in this way
so that I could arouse his sexual
desire.
fields.JP:
そのために、性的に興奮すると思われる
格好をしていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why I dressed in this way
so that I could arouse his sexual
desire.

fields.EN: I'm honestly at a loss of words...
fields.JP: どこから突っ込めばいいのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm honestly at a loss of words...

fields.EN:
B-But look at Jack! It's obvious
he doesn't like what you're doing!
Isn't that right, Jack?
fields.JP:
で、でも、ジャックは明らかに嫌がっている！
なぁ？　ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But look at Jack! It's obvious
he doesn't like what you're doing!
Isn't that right, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: See? He's asking you to stop.
fields.JP: ほら、本人も嫌だって言っている
fields.LOCALIZED: See? He's asking you to stop.

fields.EN:
This isn't boding well for my
experiment...
fields.JP: このままでは実験がうまくいかないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This isn't boding well for my
experiment...

fields.EN:
Hm, I see... I know why Jack
isn't sexually aroused by me.
fields.JP:
どうすれば……ハッ、そうか。
ジャックが嫌がるばかりで欲情しない
理由がわかったわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, I see... I know why Jack
isn't sexually aroused by me.

fields.EN:
I lack the sexual appeal as a
female.
fields.JP: 私に色気が足りないことが原因なのね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I lack the sexual appeal as a
female.

fields.EN:
If so, then all I have to do is
to somehow increase my sexual
appeal. Hm... Tsuu?
fields.JP:
謎はすべて解けたわ。
足りない色気は足せばいいだけのこと。
……つう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, then all I have to do is
to somehow increase my sexual
appeal. Hm... Otsuu?

fields.JP: ええっ！？　な、なんで僕が！　お断りだ！

fields.EN:
H-H-Hey! You better not be
telling me to strip myself!
I'm not that kind of girl!
fields.JP:
わわわ、わたしにも脱げっていうの！？
そんな破廉恥な……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-H-Hey! You better not be
telling me to strip myself!
I'm not that kind of girl!

fields.EN:
Hm? Why are you looking at
my chest?
fields.JP:
……ん？　なんか、わたしの胸を
じっと見てるような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Why are you looking at
my chest?

fields.EN:
I wonder if Nightmares hold
Lolita fetishes, too.
fields.JP:
……ナイトメアにも、
ロリータコンプレックスという心理は
あるのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if Nightmares hold
Lolita fetishes, too.

fields.EN:
Wh-Wh-What did you say?!
And after staring at my chest?!
Are you implying I'm not mature?!
fields.JP:
ななな、なんですってぇー！？
なんでわたしの胸を見てその感想なのよ！！
子どもっぽい体つきとでも言いたいの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Wh-What did you say?!
And after staring at my chest?!
Are you implying I'm not mature?!

fields.EN:
I don't know what instigated you,
but there's nothing wrong with
not being physically mature.
fields.JP:
なにが気に障ったかわからないけれど、
幼児体型は悪いことではないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what instigated you,
but there's nothing wrong with
not being physically mature.

fields.EN: You're not helping me one bit!
fields.JP: 心のこもってない慰めなんて聞きたくないー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not helping me one bit!

fields.EN:
I'm not trying to help you.
I was just stating a fact.
fields.JP: 慰めではなく、事実を言っただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not trying to help you.
I was just stating a fact.

fields.EN:
That's not helping at all!
Gretel, just be quiet already!
fields.JP:
全然フォローになってない！
ちょっとグレーテル、もう黙っててくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina's right! You're not
helping! Please, hold your words
for a moment, Gretel!

fields.EN:
Oyayubi? I don't think the size
of a lady's chest is important.
It's the shape.
fields.JP:
親指、えーと、胸は大きさじゃなくて
形だと思うんだ。サイズは重要じゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina? I don't think the size
of a lady's chest is important.
It's the shape.

fields.EN:
Look who's talking! You wear that
sash around your chest to make
it flat! You faker!
fields.JP:
なによ！　おつうなんて、
さらしで胸を押しつぶしてるくせに！
サギよ！　おっぱいサギ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look who's talking! You wear that
sash around your chest to make
it flat! You faker!

fields.JP: （な、なんか変なところに飛び火した！）

fields.EN:
I'll prove you got a huge rack
under there! Strip, now!
fields.JP:
本当はあんたが巨乳だって証拠を
見せてもらうわよ！　脱ぎなさい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll prove you got a huge rack
under there! Strip, now!

fields.EN:
W-Wait! I-I don't have huge
breasts! They're only a bit
above par!
fields.JP:
ちょ、待った！　僕、巨乳じゃないし！
それなりの大きさしかないから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait! I-I don't have huge
breasts! They're only a bit
above par!

fields.EN:
There you go making it sound
like it isn't huge again!
I'm gonna make you go nude!
fields.JP:
それなりの大きさって言い方が、
謙虚なふりして嫌味なのよ！
絶対脱がしてやるわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go making it sound
like it isn't huge again!
I'm gonna make you go nude!

fields.EN:
That would definitely increase her
sexual appeal. Let me help you
for experimental purposes.
fields.JP:
ああ、それなら確実に色気が増すわね。
実験のために私も手伝うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would definitely increase her
sexual appeal. Let me help you
for experimental purposes.

fields.EN:
Uh... Girls?
You're starting to scare me...
fields.JP: え、二人とも、なんか目が怖いんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Girls?
You're starting to scare me...

fields.EN: You're not getting away from us!
fields.JP: こら、逃げるんじゃないわよー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not getting away from us!

fields.EN:
Heh heh... Let's see what you
have under that sash of yours,
shall we?
fields.JP:
ふふ、さらしの下に隠した胸を
晒してもらおうかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... Let's see what you
have under that sash of yours,
shall we?

fields.JP: あら、あんたうまいこと言うわね
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Hm? What's this sweet smell?
Where is it coming from?
fields.JP:
ん？　甘いにおいがする……。
どこから漂ってくるんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What's this sweet smell?
Where is it coming from?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Oh, you mean that room there?
That's... Gretel's room.
fields.JP:
ああ、この部屋から匂ってくるのか。
……って、ここはグレーテルの部屋じゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you mean that room there?
That's... Gretel's room.

fields.EN:
Even if she was eating sweets,
it shouldn't smell this strong...
What is she doing in there?
fields.JP:
仮にお菓子を食べているにしても、
ここまで甘いにおいがするのは不自然だよな。
なにをしているんだ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if she was eating sweets,
it shouldn't smell this strong...
What is she doing in there?

fields.EN:
Hey, Gretel? You there?
I'm coming in...
fields.JP:
おーい、グレーテル。
いるかー？　入るぞー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Gretel? You there?
I'm coming in...

fields.EN:
Whoa, that vanilla scent is
incredibly strong...! It's nothing
like it was out in the hallway.
fields.JP:
うわっ、すごい濃いバニラの香り……！
部屋の中は廊下の比じゃないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh! What's with the vanilla
smell?! Your room smells way
worse than outside!

fields.EN:
Gretel...? Are you okay?
Is the smell getting to you?
fields.JP:
グレーテル、ボーっとしてるけど大丈夫か？
甘いにおいを嗅ぎすぎたんじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel...? Are you okay?
Is the smell getting to you?

fields.EN:
...No, I'm perfectly normal. I'm
simply basking in this feeling of happiness...
fields.JP:
……いいえ、私はいたって正常よ。
ただ幸福感に浸っているだけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm absolutely fine.
I'm simply enjoying the
environment.

fields.EN:
Heh heh... It feels as if I'm
surrounded by piles of sweets. My
facial muscles might completely relax.
fields.JP:
ふふ、まるで大量のお菓子に
囲まれているかのような気分だわ。
顔面の筋肉が弛緩してしまいそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... It's like I'm covered
in sweets... I can feel my face
twitching in joy.

fields.EN:
Is this... the vanilla essence
from before?
fields.JP:
このにおい、もしかして前に拾った
バニラエッセンス……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this... the vanilla essence
from before?

fields.EN:
Yes, I made a pouch infused with
the essence to enjoy its aroma.
Not a bad idea if I say so myself.
fields.JP:
そうよ。バニラエッセンスに一工夫加えて、
香りを楽しめる袋を作ってみたの。
いいアイディアでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I made a pouch infused with
the essence to enjoy its aroma.
Not a bad idea if I say so myself.

fields.EN:
The smell of vanilla is said to
relax one's soul. You're feeling
relaxed too, I assume. Heh heh...
fields.JP:
バニラの香りにはリラックス効果も
あるらしいわ。あなたもだんだんリラックス
してきたんじゃない？　うふふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The smell of vanilla is said to
relax one's soul. You're feeling
relaxed too, I assume. Heh heh...

fields.JP:
（リラックスを通り越して、
　なんかヤバイ雰囲気だな……）

fields.EN:
It's good that you're enjoy the
aroma, but don't you think it's
a bit too strong?
fields.JP:
香りを楽しむこと自体はいいけど、
ちょっとにおいがキツすぎないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's good that you're enjoy the
aroma, but don't you think it's
a bit too strong?

fields.EN:
Is it?
I thought it's well-balanced.
fields.JP: そうかしら？　ちょうどいい香りだと思うわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it?
I thought it's well-balanced.

fields.EN:
You've smelled something so strong
that your sense of smell has gone numb.
Anyway, let's air the room out for now.
fields.JP:
強烈なにおいを嗅ぎすぎて、
嗅覚がマヒしちゃったんだよ。
とにかくいったん換気だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The smell is so strong that it
numbed your senses.
Let me air this place.

fields.EN: Jack, can you open the window?
fields.JP: ジャック、部屋の窓を開けてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, can you open the window?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
The aroma... it's starting to
fade. What a waste...
fields.JP:
ああ、せっかくの香りが薄く
なっていく……。もったいないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The aroma... it's starting to
fade. What a waste...

fields.EN:
Why not enjoy a faint scent instead?
If you keep smelling nothing but
strong aromas, you'll ruin your nose.
fields.JP:
もっとほんのり香らせて楽しめばいいだろ？
濃いにおいばっかり嗅いでたら
鼻が馬鹿になっちゃうぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just enjoy it in small portions.
Too strong and it's really going
to do your senses bad.

fields.EN:
All I need to do is to smell
my own body to calibrate my sense
of smell. Like so...
fields.JP:
大丈夫よ。嗅覚をリセットするには
自分の体臭を嗅ぐといいというわ。
私の手の甲のにおいを嗅げばすぐに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I need to do is to smell
my own body to calibrate my sense
of smell. Like so...

fields.EN:
Hm? The back of my hand
smells like vanilla...
fields.JP: あら、バニラの香りしかしないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? The back of my hand
smells like vanilla...

fields.EN:
Well, you were literally
pickling yourself in here...
fields.JP:
そりゃ、ずっとこの部屋にいたなら
染みついてるだろうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you were literally
pickling yourself in here...

fields.EN:
Wh-Why are you licking your
hand like that?!
fields.JP: って、なに自分の手の甲舐めてるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Why are you licking your
hand like that?!

fields.EN:
My hand smelled so good, so...
Hm, but I guess smell doesn't
necessarily equate to taste.
fields.JP:
甘くておいしそうなにおいがしたから、つい。
でもやはり駄目ね。いくら香りが甘くても、
甘い味はしないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My hand smelled so good, so...
Hm, but I guess smell doesn't
necessarily equate to taste.

fields.EN:
(Gretel does some of the strangest
things some times...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルってときどき
　突拍子もないことをするよなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel does some of the strangest
things some times...)

fields.EN:
It's cruel for a scent to do nothing but whet
your appetite. I don't want just the smell—I
want to actually eat some sweet treats.
fields.JP:
香りで食欲を掻き立てるだけというのは、
残酷なものね。においだけではなく、
やはり実際に甘いお菓子が食べたいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The concept of smell arousing
hunger is quite horrible. I'm
starting to make myself hungry.

fields.JP: ……なんだか空腹になってきたわね

fields.EN:
You don't fight your urges,
do you?
fields.JP: 君って本能に忠実だよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't fight your urges,
do you?

fields.EN:
Uh... I wasn't praising you,
but... Okay...
fields.JP:
あはは……。褒めたわけじゃないけど、
どういたしまして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... I wasn't praising you,
but... Okay...

fields.EN:
(Well, at least she's enjoying
the vanilla essence I found.
It's nice to see her enjoying it.)
fields.JP:
（ま、なんにしてもバニラエッセンスを
　拾ってよかったな。こんなに気に入って
　くれたんだから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, at least she's enjoying
the vanilla essence I found.
It's nice to see her enjoying it.)

fields.EN:
That shrill scream...!
Princess, I'm coming to save you!!
fields.JP:
！　今の絹を裂くような悲鳴は……！
姫、今助けに行きます！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That frail scream...!
Princess! I am coming!

fields.JP: 姫！　僕が来たからには、もう……ん？

fields.EN:
Uh, what's going on here? It
looks like Rapunzel is gently
nibbling on Princess's arm...
fields.JP:
この状況は、いったい……？
姫の腕をラプンツェルが甘噛み
しているように見えるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, what's going on here?
It looks like Rapunzel is
gnawing on your arm...

fields.EN:
That's exactly what's going on...
Please... help... Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
見たまんまの状況だよ。
おつうちゃん、助けてぇ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's exactly what's going on...
Please... help... Otsuu...

fields.EN:
Hey, Rapunzel!
Let go of her!
fields.JP: こら、ラプンツェル！　姫から離れるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Rapunzel!
Let go of her!

fields.JP: あーー！！　おつう、なにするのーー！？

fields.EN:
What do you mean, 'what am I doing'?
Princess is having trouble because of you.
fields.JP:
なにするの、じゃない。
姫が困っているだろう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I took you off of Princess.
She was asking for help.

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm fine.
Thank you, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
うん、大丈夫。
ありがとう、おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm fine.
Thank you, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
It is my duty to come at your
time of need, Princess.
fields.JP: 姫の危機に駆けつけるのは、僕の役目ですから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is my duty to come at your
time of need, Princess.

fields.EN:
So, Rapunzel, why were you
biting on Princess's arm?
fields.JP:
それで、ラプンツェル。
どうして姫に噛みついたりしていたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Rapunzel, why were you
biting on Princess's arm?

fields.JP: だって、おいしそうなんだもん

fields.EN:
Ningyo smell like fish!
So tasty!
fields.JP:
にんぎょ、さかなのにおい！
たべたらおいしそう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fishy smell like fish!
So tasty!

fields.EN:
(How does she even know what fish are? Did
her passion for food make the impossible
possible? A glutton's power is terrifying...)
fields.JP:
（っていうか、なんで魚を知っているんだ？
　食への熱意が不可能を可能にしたとか？
　うーん、食いしん坊、おそるべし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm surprised she knows what a
fish is. In any case, that's some
appetite she has there...)

fields.JP:
わたし、魚くさいのかな。
……くんくん

fields.EN:
You smell like flowers in bloom!
The sweetness of cakes!
You smell good for sure!
fields.JP:
姫は花の香りも霞むほど芳しい香りで、
それでいてお菓子みたいに甘い香りが……
とにかく、いい匂いだと思う！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You smell like flowers in bloom!
The sweetness of cakes!
You smell good for sure!

fields.EN: I like how you smell, Princess.
fields.JP: 僕は姫の香りが大好きだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I like how you smell, Princess.

fields.EN:
Thank you, Otsuu-chan. If you say so, maybe I
don't smell like fish after all.
fields.JP:
……ありがとう。
おつうちゃんがそう言ってくれるなら、
魚くさくはないのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, I guess?
Well, as long as I don't smell
like fish...

fields.EN:
Um, but you went a bit overboard
there... You almost made me blush.
fields.JP:
でも、褒めすぎだよ。
ちょっと恥ずかしくなっちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, but you went a bit overboard
there... You almost made me blush.

fields.EN:
I simply stated what I felt,
my dear princess.
fields.JP: 僕は本心からの言葉を述べたに過ぎません、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
I simply stated what I felt,
my dear princess.

fields.EN:
Okay. So Ningyo not a fish...
She flower and cake!
fields.JP:
……そっかぁ。
にんぎょはさかなじゃなくて、
おはなで、おかしだったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. So Fishy not a fish...
She flower and cake!

fields.EN: So, I can eat her if she cake?
fields.JP: おかしだったら、たべていい？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, I can eat her if she cake?

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
Rapu-chan is a nice girl.
fields.JP: ふふ、ラプちゃんは素直な子だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
Rappy is a nice girl.

fields.EN:
It's understandable she takes words literally
because she's young, but it's troublesome
how faithfully she follows her desires...
fields.JP:
言葉をそのまま真に受けてしまうのは
幼いから仕方ないにしても、
欲望に忠実なのは困ったものだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know her youth is contributing
to her naivety, but that making
her hungry isn't a good thing...

fields.EN:
Well, all we need to do is
to teach her things.
fields.JP:
わたしたちで、これからいろいろ
教えてあげればいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, all we need to do is
to teach her things.

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right, Princess.
It won't be easy, but we'll have
to do our best.
fields.JP:
そうだね、姫。
大変そうだけど、地道にやるしかなさそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right, Princess.
It won't be easy, but we'll have
to do our best.

fields.JP: ねーねー、おしえておしえてーー！
ねーねーヒカリン、ねーってばーー！！
こんにちは、ラプちゃん、ヒカリちゃん

fields.EN:
I see Rapunzel is causing a
commotion, but is there a problem?
fields.JP: ラプンツェルが騒いでるけど、どうかしたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see Rapunzel is causing a
commotion, but is there a problem?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-kun! Ningyohime!
Perfect timing!
Can you two help?
fields.JP:
ああ、おつうくん、人魚姫！
いいところに来てくれた。
ちょっと助けてほしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Little Mermaid!
Perfect timing!
Can you two help?

fields.EN:
Otsuu? Ningyo?
Know how to make babies?
fields.JP:
おつうとにんぎょは、
こどものつくりかた、しってる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? Fishy?
Know how to make babies?

fields.EN:
Oh, I see... Hikari-chan, Rapu-chan asked you
"the" question, so you're in a pickle, right?
fields.JP:
あー、なるほど。
ヒカリちゃんはラプちゃんにそれを聞かれて、
困ってたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see... Rappy's asking you
"the" question, so you're in a
pickle, right?

fields.EN:
She was bound to ask it at some point.
It's also the one question that
adults have problems answering.
fields.JP:
小さい子どもが一度は聞いてくる質問だね。
周囲の大人はいかに答えるかで
頭を悩ませるわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was bound to ask it at some point.
It's also the one question that
adults have problems answering.

fields.EN:
She keeps bugging me about it.
Any thoughts?
fields.JP:
しつこく聞かれて、困っちゃって。
なんて教えればいいと思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She keeps bugging me about it.
Any thoughts?

fields.EN:
Um, Rapunzel wanna make babies.
How make babies?
fields.JP:
ねー、ラプンツェル、こどもつくりたいんだ。
どうやったらつくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Rapunzel wanna make babies.
How make babies?

fields.JP: ……ラプンツェルが？　子どもを？

fields.EN:
(That's right... I forgot her
Blood Libido was her want of
making babies herself. Hm...)
fields.JP:
（そ、そうだった。子どもを作りたい
　っていうのがラプンツェルの
　血式リビドーだったっけ。うーん……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I forgot her
Blood Libido was her want of
making babies herself. Hm...)

fields.JP: ……赤ちゃんは、コウノトリが運んでくるんだよ

fields.EN:
(I told her such a simple lie... She'll
learn the truth someday, but for now I
guess it's fine to leave it at that.)
fields.JP:
（安直な嘘をついてしまった……。
　でもラプンツェルもいつかは真実を知る
　だろうし、今はこう言っておいてもいいよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, there goes the truth...
She'll find out eventually,
so that should work for now.)

fields.EN: Yes, storks bring babies to us.
fields.JP:
うん。赤ちゃんはみんな、
そうして生まれてくるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, storks bring babies to us.

fields.EN:
Ooh! So storks won't drop
babies when they fly?
fields.JP:
へーー！　でも、コウノトリは
あかちゃんおとさないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! So storks won't drop
babies when they fly?

fields.JP: （な、なんでそんなところだけ現実的なんだ？）

fields.EN:
Uh, storks are... very strong,
so they can handle.
fields.JP: あー、コウノトリは力持ちだから大丈夫なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, storks are... very strong,
so they can handle.

fields.EN:
Ooh! Storks super!
So stork come to Rapunzel, too?
fields.JP:
へーー！　コウノトリってすごいね！
じゃあ、ラプンツェルのところにも来るかな、
コウノトリ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! Storks super!
So stork come to Rapunzel, too?

fields.EN:
If you're a good girl then maybe
it'll come when you're an adult.
fields.JP:
いい子にしていたら、いつか……
大人になったころに、来るんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're a good girl then maybe
it'll come when you're an adult.

fields.EN:
Yaaay!
I be good girl then!
fields.JP:
わあーーい！
それじゃあ、いい子にしてるーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yaaay!
I be good girl then!

fields.JP: ほっ、なんとか誤魔化せた……
おつうちゃん、お疲れ様
ありがとう、おつうくん！
それはあり得ないわね

fields.EN:
G-Gretel-san?
You heard what she said?
fields.JP:
グ、グレーテルさん？
話聞いてたんですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
G-Gretel?
You heard what she said?

fields.JP: ぐれー、ありえないって、なにが？

fields.EN:
I'm referring to how a stork
brings babies.
fields.JP:
コウノトリが赤ちゃんを運んでくる
という話よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm referring to how a stork
brings babies.

fields.EN:
H-Hey, Gretel!
What are you doing?!
fields.JP: ちょ、グレーテル！　余計なことは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, Gretel!
What are you doing?!

fields.EN:
Extra? I only told the truth. No matter
how you look at it, the idea that storks
bring babies leaves nothing but questions.
fields.JP:
余計なこと？　私は本当のことを言ったまでよ。
コウノトリが赤ちゃんを運んでくるだなんて、
あらゆる角度から考察しても疑問しか残らないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just going to share her facts.
Storks bringing babies is
simply illogical.

fields.EN:
Really?
So, where babies come from?
How you make babies?
fields.JP:
そうなの……？
それじゃあ、あかちゃんはどこからくるの？
どうやったらこどもができるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?
So, where babies come from?
How you make babies?

fields.EN:
So this is a question about
reproduction. First, the male genitalia
goes into the female genitalia...
fields.JP:
生殖についての質問ということね。
まず、男性器を女性器に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, a question in relation to
reproduction. First, you need
a male and female to...

fields.EN:
Whoa! Stop it right there!
Too much info!
fields.JP: わああっ、そこまで！　それ以上は言うな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Stop it right there!
Too much info!

fields.EN:
Why are you seriously
trying to explain it to her?!
fields.JP: なんでそんなに本気で説明しようとするの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't need to know this!
Not now!

fields.EN:
You don't need a reason to explain the
truth. Why are you the ones refusing
to tell her what really happens?
fields.JP:
真実を説明するのに理由なんていらないわ。
あなたたちこそ、なぜ本当のことを
説明しないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She has the right to know the
truth. Why are you all hiding the
truth from her?

fields.EN:
(Gretel doesn't see our reason
of why we're avoiding the
subject...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、そうか。グレーテル的には、
　そもそもどうして僕達が子どもの作り方を
　隠そうとしているのかが理解できないのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel doesn't see our reason
of why we're avoiding the
subject...)

fields.EN:
Uh... It's because acquiring
knowledge has its steps.
fields.JP:
……あー、ほら、知識を得るには
順序も大切だからだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... It's because acquiring
knowledge has its steps.

fields.EN:
It wouldn't make sense to teach
something without the proper
foundation, right?
fields.JP:
なんの予備知識もなしに
いきなり難しいことを教えたら、
かえって混乱するだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It wouldn't make sense to teach
something without the proper
foundation, right?

fields.EN:
Making babies is a complex matter,
so she'd understand better once
she's old enough to understand.
fields.JP:
子どもの作り方はある意味複雑な話だから、
もう少し大人になってからのほうが
よく理解できると思うんだ。うん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Making babies is a complex matter,
so she'd understand better once
she's old enough to understand.

fields.EN:
You're right. It is quite possible
she would be confused without
the proper biological knowledge.
fields.JP:
……たしかに一理あるわね。
あらかじめ生物学的な知識がなければ、
混乱が生じてしまう可能性があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. It is quite possible
she would be confused without
the proper biological knowledge.

fields.EN:
Which would mean that it will
prove better for her future
to not know the details yet.
fields.JP:
将来のより深い理解のために、
今はあえて教えないということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which would mean that it will
prove better for her future
to not know the details yet.

fields.EN:
Say, stork not right?
So, how you make babies?
fields.JP:
ねー、コウノトリもちがうの？
だったら、こどもってどうやったらつくれるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, stork not right?
So, how you make babies?

fields.JP:
ううーーーー！！
ラプンツェル、ほんとのほんとに、
こどもつくりたいのにーー！！

fields.EN:
Uh, what should we do?
I thought we got through this
too and then...
fields.JP:
ああ、どうしよう。
せっかく納得しかけてくれたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, what should we do?
I thought we got through this
too and then...

fields.EN:
We can't rely on the stork story
any more...
fields.JP: コウノトリの話は、もう使えないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't rely on the stork story
any more...

fields.EN:
Wanting to make babies...
What a troublesome Blood
Libido to have...
fields.JP:
子どもを作りたいって、
なんて厄介な血式リビドーなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wanting to make babies...
What a troublesome Blood
Libido to have...

fields.EN:
Her hair is a lot cleaner now.
I remember how hard it was
just to comb her.
fields.JP:
髪、ずいぶんきれいになってきたね。
梳かし始めは大変だったっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her hair is a lot cleaner now.
I remember how hard it was
just to comb her.

fields.EN:
We're almost done, so just
stay with it a bit longer, okay?
fields.JP: もうすぐ終わるから、大人しくしてるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're almost done, so just
stay with it a bit longer, okay?

fields.EN:
That's unusual... Are
you combing Rapu-chan's hair?
fields.JP:
あれ、珍しいね。
ラプちゃんの髪を梳かしてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's unusual...
Are you cleaning her hair?

fields.EN:
Well, her hair was kinked and
tangled, so we're just combing
her now.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルの髪がすごく絡まってたから、
梳かしてあげることにしたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, her hair was kinked and
tangled, so we're just combing
her now.

fields.EN:
You can't imagine how hard it is
to comb her long hair. Thankfully,
she's been patient with us.
fields.JP:
長いから大変だよ。
でも本人が大人しくしてくれるから、助かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't imagine how hard it is
to comb her long hair. Thankfully,
she's been patient with us.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's long hair important.
I need it clean, so I do my best.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、ながいかみ、だいじ。
だからきれいになるの、がんばる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's long hair important.
I need it clean, so I do my best.

fields.EN: Oh, sorry! The comb got caught in a tangle.
fields.JP: あ、ごめん！　櫛が引っかかっちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry!
Looks like you got a kink here...

fields.EN:
I'm okay...
Make hair plenty clean for me.
fields.JP:
……へいき。
だから、もっときれいきれい、して？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm okay...
Make hair plenty clean for me.

fields.EN:
You got it!
I'll be a bit more careful.
fields.JP: わかった。あたしももっと気をつけて梳かすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got it!
I'll be a bit more careful.

fields.EN:
Well now, that's good you're
able to keep in the pain.
fields.JP: へぇ、痛くても我慢するなんて偉いな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, that's good you're
able to keep in the pain.

fields.EN:
Heh heh!
First time get hair combed.
So happy hair getting pretty.
fields.JP:
えへへ……。
くしでかみとかすの、はじめて。
きれいになるの、うれしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh!
First time get hair combed.
So happy hair getting pretty.

fields.EN:
Huh? Then Rapu-chan, how did
you take care of your hair until now?
fields.JP:
え？　それじゃあラプちゃん、
今までは髪をどうしてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Wait a minute...
So how were you keeping your
hair clean all this time?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel make clean with
spit. All pretty.
fields.JP:
じぶんできれいにしてた。
つばつけて、きれいきれいって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel make clean with
spit. All pretty.

fields.EN:
S-Spit?
That sounds just like what a
cat would do...
fields.JP:
つ、つばで？
そんな、猫じゃないんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Spit?
That sounds just like what a
cat would do...

fields.EN:
Hahaha!
You really are the wild one!
fields.JP: ははっ、本当に野生児だな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha!
You really are the wild one!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel hair important.
I wanna make hair longer.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルのかみ、すごーくだいじ。
もっとながーく、のばすんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel hair important.
I wanna make hair longer.

fields.EN: It's long enough as it is.
fields.JP: 今でも十分長いじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED: It's long enough as it is.

fields.EN:
Nope! More long!
I need hair for babies!
fields.JP:
ううん、もっとながくするの！
いつかこどもをつくるのに、いるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nope! More long!
I need hair for babies!

fields.EN:
You need your hair for babies...?
I'm not getting you.
fields.JP:
子どもを作るのに必要……？
どういうことだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need your hair for babies...?
I'm not getting you.

fields.EN:
Someone gonna use this hair
to make babies with Rapunzel!
I think...
fields.JP:
いつかだれかが、このかみをつかって、
ラプンツェルとこどもをつくってくれるの！
……そんなきがするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Someone gonna use my hair
to make babies with me!
I think...

fields.EN:
(I don't understand what
she's saying, but I guess that's
part of her Blood Libido...)
fields.JP:
（よくわからないけど、
　それも血式リビドーなのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't understand what
she's saying, but I guess that's
part of her Blood Libido...)

fields.EN:
Hm, so your hair is something
really important to you then.
fields.JP:
ふぅん？　とにかく、髪は君にとって
すごく大事なものなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, so your hair is something
really important to you then.

fields.EN:
I guess that also means that
she's a lot more used to
us now, letting us touch her hair.
fields.JP:
そんな大事な髪を任せてくれるなんて、
私たちにもずいぶん慣れてくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that also means that
she's a lot more used to
us now, letting us touch her hair.

fields.EN:
Heh, I guess we should feel
honored.
fields.JP: まったくだ。光栄なことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, I guess we should feel
honored.

fields.EN:
You're such a good girl staying
still the whole time. Look...
Your hair is nice and pretty now.
fields.JP:
よく大人しくしてたね。
ほら、髪が見違えるようにきれいになったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're such a good girl staying
still the whole time. Look...
Your hair is nice and pretty now.

fields.JP: わーい！　ありがとーーーー！！

fields.EN:
Do you mind if we touch your
hair?
fields.JP: わたしたちも触っていい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind if we touch your
hair?

fields.EN:
Wow! It's soooo smooth!
And soft, too!
fields.JP:
わあ、すごくさらさら！
それでいてふんわりしていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow! It's soooo smooth!
And soft, too!

fields.EN:
It feels really good!
Your hair is so beautiful.
fields.JP:
すごくいい手触りだな！
ラプンツェルってこんなにきれいな髪だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels really good!
Your hair is so beautiful.

fields.EN:
(She's unusually embarrassed. She looks
more girlish than usual somehow. I guess
a woman's hair really is her life...?)
fields.JP:
（珍しくて照れてるみたいだ。
　なんだかいつもより女の子らしく見えるな。
　髪は女の命、ってことかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at her blush...
She's just like any other girl
caring for their hair.)

fields.JP: うーー！　ひどいひどいー！！
あ、あの、申し訳ございませんですわ

fields.EN: What are you two fighting about?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you two fighting about?

fields.EN:
Well, it seems as if I angered
Rapu.
fields.JP:
それが、その、わたしがラプを
怒らせてしまったのですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems as if I angered
Rappy.

fields.EN:
Cinderella, you're so mean!
You told Rapunzel to cut her hair!
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、ひどいんだよ！
ラプンツェルのかみ、きれっていうの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella so mean!
She said cut my hair!

fields.EN:
I just thought she would look
cute with shorter hair...
fields.JP: でも、そのほうがかわいいと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just thought she would look
cute with shorter hair...

fields.EN:
No! Rapunzel hair important!
Cut my hair so mean!
You meanie!
fields.JP:
そんなのしらない！
ラプンツェルのかみ、だいじ！　きれなんて、
ひどいひどいひどいーーーー！！！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Rapunzel hair important!
Cut my hair so mean!
You meanie!

fields.JP: シンデレラの、ばかーーーー！！！！
ラプンツェル！　そこまで言うことないだろ？
待って、シンデレラ！　ああ、行っちゃった……

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, you didn't need to
say that. Cinderella was
apologizing.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、シンデレラは
謝ってたじゃないか。それなのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, you didn't need to
say that. Cinderella was
apologizing.

fields.EN: Wha-?! Wh-Why am I about to cry too?
fields.JP:
うわ、な、なんでこっちまで
泣きそうになってるんだ？

シンデレラ、ラプンツェルのこと、
きらいになっちゃったよね……

fields.EN:
(She thinks Cinderella's had enough of her,
and now she's about to cry. Then she shouldn't
have acted like that in the first place...)
fields.JP:
（愛想をつかされたと思って、
　泣きそうになってるのか。だったら最初から
　あんな態度とらなきゃいいのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's sad that Cinderella hates
her now? Well, she shouldn't have
said what she said earlier.)

fields.EN:
Rapu, you do know that Cinderella
didn't suggest you to cut your
hair because she hates you, right?
fields.JP:
ラプ、シンデレラも悪気があったわけじゃ
ないのよ。それはわかる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, you do know that Cinderella
didn't suggest you to cut your
hair because she hates you, right?

fields.EN:
Sure, maybe she lacked some tact,
but you didn't need to say you
hate her, right?
fields.JP:
あの子の言い方もよくなかったかも
しれないけど、あんたも言いすぎよ。
それもわかるわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, maybe she lacked some tact,
but you didn't need to say you
hate her, right?

fields.EN:
You don't want to cut your hair
that much?
fields.JP: ラプ、そんなに髪切るの嫌なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't want to cut your hair
that much?

fields.EN:
I don't wanna... Thinking to cut
hair made me all mad...
fields.JP:
うん、やだ……。かみきるってかんがえたら、
すごくいやで、あたまのなか、
わーってなっちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't wanna... Thinking to cut
hair made me all mad...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel thought Cinderella understood her...
So she got all mad...
fields.JP:
……シンデレラ、ラプンツェルのこと
わかってくれてるとおもってた。
それなのに、っておもったら、なんか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought Cinderella know me...
So I get all mad...

fields.EN:
So you were hurt even more
because you trusted her.
fields.JP: 気を許していた分、余計に傷ついたってことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you were hurt even more
because you trusted her.

fields.EN:
I don't wanna cut hair...
If I cut hair, then I no need
Cinderella...
fields.JP:
……かみ、きりたくないもん。
かみ、きるくらいなら、シンデレラと
なかよくしなくてもいいもん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't wanna cut hair...
If I cut hair, then I no need
Cinderella...

fields.EN:
(That's a harsh statement, but
I can tell she doesn't mean it.)
fields.JP:
（とは言っても、シンデレラに
　未練があるの見え見えだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's a harsh statement, but
I can tell she doesn't mean it.)

fields.EN:
Cinderella likes you, so she was only giving
you advice she thought would be good for
you. You don't have to cut your hair.
fields.JP:
ねえ、ラプ。シンデレラはあんたが好きだから、
自分がいいと思うことをアドバイスしてくれた
だけなの。別に髪は切らなくていいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella likes you, so she gave
you her suggestion. She didn't
tell you to cut your hair.

fields.EN:
You know you went too far there,
right? You want to become friends
with her again, right?
fields.JP:
本当はあんたも言いすぎたって
わかってるんでしょ？　シンデレラと
仲直りしたいと思っているんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know you went too far there,
right? You want to become friends
with her again, right?

fields.EN:
You not wanting to cut your hair,
and you wanting to be friends are
both something you can tell her.
fields.JP:
髪を切りたくないのも、仲直りしたいのも
『素直な気持ち』なら、シンデレラと
もう一度きちんと話してみなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You not wanting to cut your hair,
and you wanting to be friends are
both something you can tell her.

fields.EN:
I'm sure it'll be fine.
You're still young, so you can
make mistakes.
fields.JP:
きっと大丈夫よ。
それにね、小さい頃は失敗していいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure it'll be fine.
You're still young, so you can
make mistakes.

fields.EN:
Everyone grows through mistakes.
What's important is that you don't
make the same mistake again.
fields.JP:
みんな失敗したり間違えたりしながら
大きくなるの。そこで大事なのは、
次は同じ失敗をしないことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone grows through mistakes.
What's important is that you don't
make the same mistake again.

fields.EN:
Then the person you made the mistake
toward should be happy too. After all,
it means they helped Rapunzel grow.
fields.JP:
そうすれば、失敗されたほうの人も
嬉しいはずよ。ラプンツェルの成長を
手伝えたことになるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Cinderella would be happy
to know that she made you do a
mistake, which will make you grow.

fields.EN:
No make same mistake...
Rapunzel make mistake not
saying why I no like cut hair...
fields.JP:
おなじしっぱいをしない……。
ラプンツェルのしっぱいは、すなおに
はなせなかったこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No make same mistake...
Rapunzel make mistake not
saying why I no like cut hair...

fields.EN:
Okay! I talk with Cinderella
next time!
fields.JP:
……わかった！
こんどシンデレラにあったら、
ちゃんとおはなしする！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! I talk with Cinderella
next time!

fields.EN:
That's the spirit!
You do your best, okay?
fields.JP: 偉い！　がんばるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the spirit!
You do your best, okay?

fields.JP: うん！　おやゆび、ありがとー！
やれやれ、世話が焼けるわね

fields.EN:
I left everything to you this
time... Oyayubi, you're really amazing.
fields.JP:
今回は君に任せっきりになっちゃったな。
……親指、君ってすごいんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kudos to you, Thumbelina.
That was pretty darn amazing.

fields.EN:
No, I was just thinking you really are
an older sister. I kind of respect that.
fields.JP:
いや、やっぱり君は『お姉ちゃん』なんだなぁと
思ったんだ。ちょっと尊敬した
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I was just surprised that you
can act like an older sister.

fields.EN:
(It's Rapunzel and Cinderella...!
Could this be the first time they've
properly faced each other since then?)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルとシンデレラだ……！
　もしかして、あのあと二人でちゃんと
　顔合わせるのって、初めてなのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's Rapunzel and Cinderella...
They haven't talked with each
other yet?)

fields.EN:
(I don't know why, but I hid
myself seeing them...
What to do...?)
fields.JP:
（咄嗟に物陰に隠れちゃったけど、
　出ていくタイミングを完全に逃した……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't know why, but I hid
myself seeing them...
What to do...?)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about what I said to
you the last time...
fields.JP:
……先日はひどいことを言って、
申し訳ありませんでしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about what I said to
you the last time...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel was bad!
You not bad, Cinderella!
fields.JP:
わるかったのはラプンツェルなの！
シンデレラ、わるくないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel was bad!
You not bad, Cinderella!

fields.EN:
I really, really didn't want to
cut my hair, and my head got all
confused. But that's Rapunzel's fault.
fields.JP:
かみきるのがいやで、すごくいやで、
あたまのなかぐちゃぐちゃになっちゃった。
でも、それはラプンツェルのせいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't wanna cut my hair.
I got all mad inside.
Rapunzel was bad...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel thought Cinderella
understood how Rapunzel feels about her hair.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルのかみのこと、
シンデレラはわかってくれてるって、
かってにおもってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel thought Cinderella
know what Rapunzel likes.

fields.EN:
But when you said cut hair,
I got sad and mad, so I
said all that...
fields.JP:
でもちがったんだっておもったら、
すごくかなしくて、おこっちゃって、
それでつい、あんなこといっちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when you said cut hair,
I got sad and mad, so I
said all that...

fields.EN:
You've done nothing wrong, Rapu.
It didn't dawn on me that your
hair was so important to you.
fields.JP:
ラプは悪くありませんわ。わたしも、
ラプが大事にしている髪のことなのに、
むしんけいなことを言ってしまいましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've done nothing wrong, Rappy.
It didn't dawn on me that your
hair was so important to you.

fields.EN:
Um, I only mad because it was
you Cinderella. Someone else
no make me mad...
fields.JP:
あのね、どうでもいいひとにいわれたら、
あんなにおこらなかったとおもう。
でも、シンデレラのことはすきだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I only mad because it was
you Cinderella. Someone else
no make me mad...

fields.EN:
Are you trying to imply that you
felt betrayed because you
believed in me?
fields.JP:
きっとラプは、わたしを信じていたのに、
裏切られたと思ったから、
怒ってしまったのですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you trying to imply that you
felt betrayed because you
believed in me?

fields.JP: そうなのかな……？　でも、そうかも

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
You mad of Rapunzel?
You hate Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、ごめんなさい……。
ラプンツェルのこと、おこってる？
もう、きらいになった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
You mad of Rapunzel?
You hate Rapunzel?

fields.EN: Of course not! I love you, Rapu.
fields.JP:
いいえ、まさか！
ラプのことは大好きですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not.
I like you no different from
before, Rappy.

fields.JP:
ほんとう……！？
これからも、ラプンツェルと
なかよくしてくれる？
わーーーーい！！　よかったぁ！

fields.EN:
I know! As a sign of friendship,
may I work on your hair?
fields.JP:
そうですわ！
仲直りの印に、ラプの髪を
かわいく結わせていただけません？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! As a sign of friendship,
may I work on your hair?

fields.EN:
Why yes. Your hair is so long that
there are all kinds of styles we can try.
fields.JP:
はい。ラプの髪は長いので、
アレンジのしがいがありますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, I'm sure with your
long hair there's a lot of
different ways to bunch your hair.

fields.JP: わー、やってやって！　おもしろそー！！

fields.EN:
Well, do you mind coming to
my room then?
fields.JP: では、わたしの部屋へまいりましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, do you mind coming to
my room then?

fields.EN:
(It's good they're back together
again. Rapunzel's apology made
them bond stronger than before.)
fields.JP:
（二人とも仲直りできてよかったな。
　ラプンツェルも素直に謝れたし、
　雨降って地固まるってことか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's good they're back together
again. Rapunzel's apology made
them bond stronger than before.)

fields.EN:
...Still, I was hiding in that
awkward position for so long that my
whole body has gone stiff. Ouch...
fields.JP:
……それにしても、
変な体勢でずっと隠れてたから、
体中が固まっちゃったな。いたた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ouch... I shouldn't have hid
myself like that so suddenly.
I feel a kink in my back...

fields.EN:
I can't let Princess see me
in pain like this...
fields.JP:
うう、こんなみっともないところ、
姫には見せられないや……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't let Princess see me
in pain like this...

fields.EN: Rapunzel? It's unusual for you to sigh.
fields.JP: ラプンツェル？　ため息をつくなんて珍しいな

fields.EN:
She doesn't look too well.
I wonder if there's a problem.
fields.JP:
ちょっと元気なさそうだね。
どうしたんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't look too well.
I wonder if there's a problem.

fields.JP: ため息なんかついて、なにかあったのか？

fields.EN:
If you'd like, we'd be more than
happy to listen.
fields.JP: 悩みごとなら相談にのるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you'd like, we'd be more than
happy to listen.

fields.EN:
Are you sick? We can take you
to the Rescue Center.
fields.JP:
あ、もしかして体調が悪いんじゃないか？
救護室に行くか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sick? We can take you
to the Rescue Center.

fields.EN:
Or maybe you're hungry?
That can bring people a notch
down, too.
fields.JP:
ひょっとして、お腹が空いてるとか。
お腹空くと、元気でなくなっちゃうもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or maybe you're hungry?
That can bring people a notch
down, too.

fields.JP: ふたりとも、ありがとう。でもだいじょうぶだよ

fields.EN:
You sound a lot more calmer
than usual...
fields.JP: こ、心なしか大人びた雰囲気だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sound a lot more calmer
than usual...

fields.EN:
You're definitely not the same
Rapu-chan that I know.
fields.JP: ますますいつものラプちゃんと違う……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're definitely not the same
Rappy that I know.

fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、いつもとおんなじだよ。
ちょっとかんがえごとしてただけ

fields.EN:
(Her thinking is already not
the usual Rapunzel...)
fields.JP:
（それもすでにいつものラプンツェルの
　イメージと違うんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her thinking is already not
the usual Rapunzel...)

fields.EN:
Um, I was thinking about
all sort of emotions.
fields.JP:
あのね、いろんな『きもち』のこと
かんがえてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I was thinking about
all sort of emotions.

fields.EN:
Emotions so strange. Mine keep
changing like clouds in sky.
fields.JP:
きもちって、ふしぎなんだよ。
じぶんのきもちでも、そらのくもみたいに、
かたちをかえてかわっていくの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Emotions so strange. Mine keep
changing like clouds in sky.

fields.EN:
Like clouds, everyone emotion
different. So normal that everyone
no understand each other.
fields.JP:
それでね、みんなべつべつのすなおな
きもちをもってるんだよ。だからちゃんと
わかりあえないときもあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like clouds, everyone emotion
different. So normal that everyone
no understand each other.

fields.EN:
But it's not like you have to
choose only one of those feelings, right?
fields.JP:
でも、どれかひとつしかえらべない
なんてことはないんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that no make them bad.
No need to have same emotion.

fields.EN:
If everyone think about others,
then okay. Everyone happy if
speak feelings with each other.
fields.JP:
みんながみんなのことをだいじにおもえば、
いいんだよね。しあわせになるには、
がんばってはなしあうのがだいじなんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If everyone think about others,
then okay. Everyone happy if
speak feelings with each other.

fields.EN:
You're right. If that was done,
then I'm sure there'd be no
fighting.
fields.JP:
そうだね。そうすれば、きっと誰も
ケンカしなくて済むよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. If that was done,
then I'm sure there'd be no
fighting.

fields.EN:
(I guess Rapunzel's been
thinking a lot since her argument
with Cinderella.)
fields.JP:
（……この間のシンデレラとの一件で、
　ラプンツェルなりにいろいろ考えたの
　かもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess Rapunzel's been
thinking a lot since her argument
with Cinderella.)

fields.EN:
(She can reason and understand
various things, even now.
She must be quite smart.)
fields.JP:
（まだ小さいのに、物事の本質を
　理解しているみたいだ。
　実はけっこう賢い子なのかもな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She can reason and understand
various things, even now.
She must be quite smart.)

fields.JP: 君は大人みたいだな、ラプンツェル

fields.EN:
I think you've matured a bit
after talking with various
people, and thinking about things.
fields.JP:
きっといろんな人と話して、
いろんなことを考えたから、
成長したんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you've matured a bit
after talking with various
people, and thinking about things.

fields.EN:
Then if Rapunzel talks to lots
more people, can Rapunzel become an adult?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、もっとたくさんおはなしすれば、
おとなになれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You say that people think Rapunzel
serious if I talk more?

fields.EN: Then I'll be able to make babies, right?!
fields.JP: そうしたら、こどもつくれるね！

fields.EN:
You can make babies when you're
grown up, right? Rapunzel will talk
lots more and become a grown-up!
fields.JP:
こども、おとなになったらつくれるんだよね？
ラプンツェル、もっとおはなしして、
おとなになる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can be mother, right? I be mature
if I have baby! I can be mature if I
become mother!

fields.EN: Rapunzel become adult and make babies!!
fields.JP: おとなになって、こどもつくるーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: All I need is make babies!

fields.EN:
That's not the kind of 'adult' we mean
here. I don't think she quite understands...
fields.JP:
その場合の大人の意味は
精神的なものじゃないんだけどな。
ちょっとわかってなさそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure if she understands that
being a mother doesn't exactly
equate to being a mature individual.

fields.EN:
I guess there's a lot more ahead
of Rapu-chan before she's able to become
a normal and mature person...
fields.JP:
やっぱりラプちゃんが大人になるのは、
もうちょっと先かもね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess there's a lot more ahead
of Rappy before she's able to become
a normal and mature person...

fields.JP: わああ！　どうしよ！　どーしよーー！！
って、なにをそんなに慌ててるんだ？

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan, it's dangerous
to run around like that.
fields.JP: ラプちゃん、走り回ったら危ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's dangerous running around
like that.

fields.EN: Guree is coming! Guree is comingーー!
fields.JP: ぐれーがくる！　ぐれーがくるー！

fields.EN:
Guree...? You mean Gretel is coming?
Why does that mean we have to panic?
fields.JP:
ぐれー……グレーテルが来る？
なんでそれで慌てなきゃいけないんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretty...? You mean Gretel?
So what if she's coming?

fields.EN:
You're making it sound like
you've met a monster.
fields.JP: あら、人を化け物みたいに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're making it sound like
you've met a monster.

fields.JP: うわー！　おつうたすけてーー！！

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Why are you hiding
behind my back?!
fields.JP: わっ、僕の背中に隠れちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Why are you hiding
behind my back?!

fields.EN: Rapu-chan, are you scared of Gretel-san?
fields.JP: ラプちゃん、グレーテルさんが怖いの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Rappy, are you scared of Gretel?

fields.JP: いったい、なにがあったんだ？

fields.EN:
Nothing really. We got some
cookies from Hikari earlier.
fields.JP:
大したことは、なにも。
さっき二人で、ヒカリから
クッキーをもらったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing really. We got some
cookies from Hikari earlier.

fields.EN:
Really? Do you have some
for us?
fields.JP: いいなぁ。ところで僕達の分は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? Do you have some
for us?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel and I were offered the
cookies, so of course there are
none for you.
fields.JP:
私とラプンツェルがもらったのだから、
ないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel and I were offered the
cookies, so of course there are
none for you.

fields.EN:
I suppose sharing isn't part
of your choice...
fields.JP: 分けるという選択肢は毛頭ないんだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose sharing isn't part
of your choice...

fields.EN:
I consumed my cookies
immediately after obtaining them.
fields.JP: 私はクッキーをもらい、可及的速やかに食したわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I consumed my cookies
immediately after obtaining them.

fields.EN:
That phrasing doesn't really
sound like something you'd use
when talking about eating food...
fields.JP:
その言い方、食べ物を食べるときに
使う表現じゃない気がするけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most people talk about how good
they tasted, not how quickly they
ate them, you know...

fields.EN:
Well, all you did was eat your
cookies, right? So why would
Rapu-chan be...
fields.JP:
でもただ食べただけだったら、
どうしてラプちゃんは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, all you did was eat your
cookies, right? So why would
Rappy be...

fields.JP: うー……、また見てくるよぅ……

fields.EN:
Maybe she was scared of how
you looked at her, Gretel.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは、もしかしてその視線が
怖くて逃げてきたんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she was scared of how
you looked at her, Gretel.

fields.EN:
I simply looked at her in envy
of her cookies. I didn't even ask
to get some.
fields.JP:
私は「くれ」なんてひとことも言っていないわ。
ただ、羨ましいと思って見ていただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I simply looked at her in envy
of her cookies. I didn't even ask
to get some.

fields.EN:
Uu... Rapunzel had no choice,
so Rapunzel gave Guree one cookie...
fields.JP:
うう、ラプンツェル、しかたないから、
ぐれーにクッキー、いちまいあげた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... Rapunzel can't help...
Rapunzel gave a cookie to
Gretty...

fields.EN:
Yes, and it was delicious.
Thank you.
fields.JP: おいしかったわ。ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and it was delicious.
Thank you.

fields.EN:
Then she keep look at me...
So scary, so gave one more.
She keep looking at me, so...
fields.JP:
でも、もっとじーっとみてきた。
だからこわくて、もういちまいあげた。
それでもずっとみてきて、それで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then she keep look at me...
So scary, so gave one more.
She keep looking at me, so...

fields.EN: Oh, I see why you were scared...
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I see why you were scared...

fields.EN:
Gretel, stealing sweets from
a little kid is awfully immature.
fields.JP:
小さい子からお菓子を奪うなんて
大人げないぞ、グレーテル
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, I can't believe you
pressured her to get her cookies.

fields.EN: I didn't steal anything. She gave them to me.
fields.JP: 奪ってなんかいないわ。もらっただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't pressure her.
She just gave hers to me.

fields.EN:
The way you got them is
the problem...
fields.JP:
そのもらい方が大人げないって
言ってるんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The way you got them is
the problem...

fields.JP: そ、そーだ、そーだ！　おとなげないー！

fields.EN:
Please stop trying to stare at
Rapunzel around me. It really is immature...
fields.JP:
僕越しにラプンツェルを
見つめようとするのはやめてくれ。
本当に大人げないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't stare at her like
that. Seriously, you're acting
like some child...

fields.EN:
That's quite a vague description
to use on me. Is it so important
to be acting like an adult?
fields.JP:
その大人げがある、ない、というのは、
とても曖昧で感覚的な表現ね。
大人げというのはそんなに大切なこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite a vague description
to use on me. Is it so important
to be acting like an adult?

fields.EN:
Will I be able to suppress my
Blood Libido if I act like an
adult?
fields.JP:
大人げがあれば血式リビドーは
抑えられるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will I be able to suppress my
Blood Libido if I act like an
adult?

fields.EN:
My Blood Libido is what makes
me seek sweets. I doubt acting
like an adult would help.
fields.JP:
甘い物やお菓子が好きなのは、
私の血式リビドーゆえの本能よ。
大人げなんかで抑えられるものじゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My Blood Libido is what makes
me seek sweets. I doubt acting
like an adult would help.

fields.EN:
On the contrary, not prying her
sweets away is an act of an adult.
She's lucky I'm only staring.
fields.JP:
むしろ本当なら奪いたいところを
理性で抑えたのだから、
凝視するくらい許してほしいものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, not prying her
sweets away is an act of an adult.
She's lucky I'm only staring.

fields.EN:
(I know she's trying to make an
excuse, but I don't want to drag
this on any longer...)
fields.JP:
（へ理屈のような気もするけど、
　これ以上反論できない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know she's trying to make an
excuse, but I don't want to drag
this on any longer...)

fields.EN:
Didn't Hikari-chan share the cookies
to you both? If so, what Rapu-chan got
is rightfully hers.
fields.JP:
だけど、ヒカリちゃんは平等に配ってくれた
んでしょう？　それなら、ラプちゃんが
もらった分はラプちゃんのものですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't Hikari share the cookies
to you both? If so, what Rappy got
is rightfully hers.

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan has the right to eat her cookies.
You can't take them away, Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
クッキーを食べる権利はラプちゃんに
あるんだから、グレーテルさんは
それを邪魔しちゃ駄目です
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Rappy has the right to eat
her cookies. You don't have the
right to take them away.

fields.JP: ……たしかに、その理屈は納得できるわ

fields.EN:
So, no more taking her
sweets, okay?
fields.JP: もうしちゃ駄目ですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, no more taking her
sweets, okay?

fields.JP: よかったね、ラプンツェル

fields.EN:
Yup! Okay, I can eat my last
cookie now!
fields.JP:
うん！　じゃあ、さいごのいちまい、
いただきまーす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Okay, I can eat my last
cookie now!

fields.JP: もう、グレーテルさんったら……

fields.EN:
Urrh... All right...
Here! Last one!
fields.JP:
ううー、しかたないなぁ。
そんなにほしいなら、さいごだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... All right...
Here! Last one!

fields.EN:
Broke in half!
We eat together!
fields.JP:
はい、クッキーはんぶんこ！
いっしょにたべよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Broke in half!
We eat together!

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan, you're such a good
girl!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, you're such a good
girl!

fields.JP: うん。本当、いい子だなぁ
ぼりぼりぼり……ごっくん

fields.EN:
You ate it in one bite without
even taking time to savor it?!
fields.JP: 余韻に浸る間もなく一口で！？

fields.EN:
Hey! Stop staring at Rapunzel's
cookie!
fields.JP:
しかもラプンツェルの残ったクッキーを
また見つめてるし！　いい加減にしなよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Stop staring at Rapunzel's
cookie!

fields.EN:
Heh heh, I'm just joking.
Thank you, Rapunzel.
That was quite delicious.
fields.JP:
ふふ、冗談よ。
ありがとう、ラプンツェル。
……ごちそうさま
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, I'm just joking.
Thank you, Rapunzel.
That was quite delicious.

fields.EN:
Uu... Rapunzel thought
it would get taken again...
Guree is scary... Uu~...
fields.JP:
うう、またとられるかとおもった……。
ぐれーこわい……ううー……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... Almost lost my cookie...
Gretty so scary... Urrh...

fields.EN:
Gretel traumatized Rapu-chan...
I'm not even sure if Gretel was
really joking there...
fields.JP:
ああ、ラプちゃんのトラウマに……。
最後の、本当に冗談だったのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel traumatized Rappy...
I'm not even sure if Gretel was
really joking there...

fields.EN:
I'll assume she was joking
like she said...
fields.JP: わからないけど、冗談だったと思っておこう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll assume she was joking
like she said...

fields.EN:
Is that Rapunzel and Cinderella?
I hear their voice from the
cafeteria...
fields.JP:
わ、ラプンツェルとシンデレラの声だ。
食堂から聞こえてきたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that Rapunzel and Cinderella?
I hear their voice from the
cafeteria...

fields.EN:
Now, now, no need to get
so mad over it...
fields.JP: まあまあ、そう怒らないでよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, no need to get
so mad over it...

fields.EN:
We were only thinking about
you two...
fields.JP: 白雪たちは、お二人のことを想って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were only thinking about
you two...

fields.EN:
You treated Rapunzel and
Cinderella like children! That's mean!!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルとシンデレラを
こどもあつかいした！　ひどいー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel and Cinderella treated
like dummies! Meanie!

fields.EN:
We're well able to handle our
own!
fields.JP: わたしたち、ちゃんと一人前でしてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're well able to handle our
own!

fields.EN:
Um, can I ask what's going on
here? I could hear your voice
from the hallway.
fields.JP:
なあ、なにをそんなに揉めてるんだ？
廊下まで声が聞こえてきたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, can I ask what's going on
here? I could hear your voice
from the hallway.

fields.EN:
Otsuu!
Aka-Aka and Shirayuki so mean!
fields.JP:
あっ、おつうー！
あかあかとしらゆきがひどいんだよー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu!
Reddy and Snow White so mean!

fields.EN:
They were leaving us out from
the expeditions, treating us like
we don't know what we're doing!
fields.JP:
わたしたちを子ども扱いして、
のけ者にしようとしましたのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
They were leaving us out from
the expeditions, treating us like
we don't know what we're doing!

fields.EN:
No, coming back after so long just made
me think... do we really need to send
little kids out on dangerous expeditions?
fields.JP:
いや、久しぶりに戻ってきて、ふと思ったんだ。
危険な探索にわざわざ小さい子どもを
行かせることもないんじゃないかって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just thinking that there's
no need to have them go
out on the expeditions.

fields.EN:
We've got a lot of Blood Maidens
now, so I was discussing with
Shirayuki of keeping them here.
fields.JP:
血式少女の仲間もたくさんいるんだしさ。
別に二人は留守番でもいいんじゃないかって、
白雪に相談してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've got a lot of Blood Maidens
now, so I was discussing with Snow
White of keeping them here.

fields.EN:
Yes. Shirayuki heard Aka-neesama's
suggestion too, and thought it made sense.
fields.JP:
はい。白雪も赤姉様からそのお話を聞いて、
なるほどって思いました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I heard from sister Red how
dangerous it is out there, so
what she said did make sense.

fields.EN:
See?! They really are trying
to leave Rapunzel and the others out!
They're treating us like kids!!
fields.JP:
ほらー！　やっぱりラプンツェルたちを
なかまはずれにしようとしてる！
こどもあつかいしてるーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See?! They don't want us
with them! Treat us like useless!

fields.EN: We're your comrades too, you know?!
fields.JP: わたしたちだって、仲間ですのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're with everyone on our
mission out of here!

fields.EN:
Now, now, calm down for a moment.
They're just trying to think for
the better of you.
fields.JP:
まあまあ、落ち着いて。赤ずきんと白雪は
悪気があったわけじゃないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, calm down for a moment.
They're just trying to think for
the better of you.

fields.EN:
They don't want you two to go
through danger out there.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルやシンデレラのことが心配だから、
危険なことをさせたくないだけなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They don't want you two to go
through danger out there.

fields.EN:
How rude! Are you implying that
we're that useless out there?!
fields.JP:
心配されるほど役立たずだということですの？
屈辱ですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How rude! Are you implying that
we're that useless out there?!

fields.EN:
Urrrrrh! You're treating
us like kids after all!!
fields.JP:
ううーーーー！
やっぱりこどもあつかいだーーーー！！

fields.EN:
You're both Blood Maidens we're
counting on. Without you two we
wouldn't be here.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもシンデレラも、頼りになる
血式少女仲間だよ。二人がいなければ
乗り越えられなかった場面もたくさんあった
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're both Blood Maidens we're
counting on. Without you two we

So, they're worried about you

だけど赤ずきんたちがつい心配するのは、

So, they're worried about you

That's right. You would be worried

そう。君達だって、僕達の誰かが

fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. You would be worried

fields.JP: するよ！　しんぱいする！

fields.EN:
Well, they feel the same way,

それと同じだよ、赤ずきんたちの気持ちも。

Well, they feel the same way,

I'm so sorry... I suppose not

ごめんなさいですわ。
そんなこともわからずに駄々をこねて、

fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry... I suppose not
seeing it in that light proves

...No, we're the ones who should
apologize! Otsuu is right. We really
were treating you two like children.

……いや、こっちこそごめん！
おつうの言う通りだ。たしかに二人のこと
子ども扱いしちゃってた
fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:
Rapunzel-san, Cinderella-san, we see you both

fields.JP:
そうですね。
ラプンツェルさんとシンデレラさんは、

fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but we do see you both

fields.EN:
So lemme take back what

fields.JP:
さっきの発言は撤回するよ。
これからも一緒に探索行ってくれるかな

So lemme take back what

fields.EN: Of course! I'm counting on you!

fields.EN:
Otsuu, you said there were lots of

おつうは、ラプンツェルたちがいなきゃ

Same here! I'm very happy that

fields.LOCALIZED:

No problem, but make sure you both

fields.JP:

fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem, but make sure you both

Huh? Is that... Rapunzel and

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.JP: やっぱりちょっと怖いよ……

fields.JP:

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:

too.
fields.JP:
さて、姫は部屋まで送ったし、
僕もそろそろ寝るとするか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that Princess is back in
her room, I should get to sleep,
too.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, Cinderella... Did you

fields.JP:
ラプンツェルに、シンデレラ……。
寝ぼけて僕の布団に入り込んじゃったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:

fields.JP: ……まったく、仕方ないな。今晩だけだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:

fields.JP:

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.JP:

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、なんかすごいことに

You know, Rapu-chan and Cinderella-san are

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:
You were both sleeping with me

fields.JP:
二人とも、この間はわたしのところで

fields.LOCALIZED:

Look for someone feel good

おつうの胸は、人魚姫のよりも

Your breasts are bigger

やっぱり、おつうちゃんの胸のほうが

大きさなんて無意味です！
姫の慎ましく愛らしい胸こそが

fields.LOCALIZED:
Size doesn't matter! Your cute

fields.LOCALIZED:

ちわげんか、というやつですわ。

fields.LOCALIZED:
They're just arguing over petty

fields.LOCALIZED:

おとーさんは、わんちゃんのジャックの

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:
Thanks for taking the dog out

fields.JP:
おかえりなさい！　おしごとから

おつかれさま！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for taking the dog out

Oh, so in this game I've come home from

fields.JP:
ああ、僕は仕事から帰ってきたあとに

意外と凝った設定……
fields.LOCALIZED:
For playing make believe, this is

fields.JP: いま、ゆうごはんのじゅんびするからね！

fields.EN:
Looks like she's having fun.
I guess it was worth giving

fields.JP:
楽しそうに遊んでるなぁ。
おままごとセットをあげてよかったね、
ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like she's having fun.

fields.EN:
Seeing her happy makes me

うん。ラプンツェルが楽しそうだと、

Seeing her happy makes me
happy, too.

Oh, but are you okay being the

fields.JP:
……ところで犬役だけど、大丈夫？

fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but are you okay being the
family dog? It's not the best of

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Heh, that's good to hear.

fields.JP: はは、よかった。ジャックは優しいね
fields.LOCALIZED:

You really are kind, Jack.

fields.EN:
Daddy! Baby crying!
Take care baby!

おとーさん、あかちゃんぐずってる！

fields.LOCALIZED:
Daddy! Baby crying!

fields.EN:
(Hm, I've never done this before.

fields.JP:
（そんなのしたことないな。

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:
Uh... You're a good baby...
Peek-a-boo! Upsey-daisy!
fields.JP:
よ、よーしよしよし、べろべろばー。
えーと、高い高ーい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... You're a good baby...
Peek-a-boo! Upsey-daisy!

fields.EN:
No do upsey-daisy!
Too dangerous! Need to keep
baby neck straight!
fields.JP:
たかいたかい、しちゃだめなんだよ！
あかちゃんのくび、あぶないんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No do upsey-daisy!
Too dangerous! Need to keep
baby neck straight!

fields.EN:
Ah, I think I heard that before...
You shouldn't shake babies.
Sorry, I won't do that any more.

あー、たしかにそんな話も聞いたこと

fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I think I heard that before...

Daddy! Baby is crying!

fields.JP:
あ、おとーさん、あかちゃんがないてるよ！
おむつみたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Daddy! Baby is crying!
Need change diaper!

You don't know how change diaper?

fields.JP:
もー、おむつもかえられないのー？
しかたないなぁ、おかーさんにかして！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't know how change diaper?
Okay, let mommy do it!

fields.JP: はーい、おむつかえましょうねー

fields.EN:
(She's changing the doll's diaper

a thing or two about babies.)
fields.JP:
（あれ、なんだかおむつ替えの手際が
　いいな。高い高いを注意したことといい、

fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's changing the doll's diaper
pretty quickly. I guess she knows
a thing or two about babies.)

fields.EN:
(I underestimated her...

this make believe play.)
fields.JP:
（ただのごっこ遊びだと思ったけど、

fields.LOCALIZED:
(I underestimated her...
She's a lot more serious about
this make believe play.)

fields.EN:

fields.JP:
しっかりしてるなぁ、ラプンツェル……
いや、お母さんは
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're pretty amazing, Rapunzel.
No, uh... mommy.

fields.EN:
You really studied how to care for

fields.JP:
赤ちゃんのことちゃんと勉強してるんだね。
ご飯作りながら赤ちゃんの世話するなんて、

fields.LOCALIZED:

うん！　こどもほしいから、

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.LOCALIZED:

おとーさんも、いっしょに

fields.EN:

わかったよ、お母さん。

fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds good. After all, Princess

fields.EN:
Princess? What's with the trash

fields.JP: 姫？　そのゴミ袋はいったい……
fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.EN:

fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um, nothing at all...
I'm fine right now.

fields.EN:
Right now?
Oh, so you already threw your
trash away?
fields.JP:
今は……？
あ、もうゴミ捨てしちゃったあととか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right now?
Oh, so you already threw your
trash away?

fields.EN:
Well, if you have any, I can take
them for you.
fields.JP: 少しでもあるなら持って行くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you have any, I can take
them for you.

fields.JP: ……少しであれば、どれほどよかったか

fields.EN:
Huh? What did you just say?
You have a bit more to throw
away?
fields.JP:
え？　今なんて言ったんだ？
少しゴミが溜まってるから
持って行ってほしいって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What did you just say?
You have a bit more to throw
away?

fields.EN: Not at all. You heard me wrong...
fields.JP:
いえ、全然違いますから～。
どんな聞こえ方してるんですか～
fields.LOCALIZED: Not at all. You heard me wrong...

fields.EN:
It's just that I have way too much
trash to throw out so simply...
fields.JP:
むしろ多すぎて、とても気楽に
ゴミ捨てを頼める量では……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I have way too much
trash to throw out so simply...

fields.EN:
Hahaha. How much can you have?
It's not like your room is filled
with trash or anything.
fields.JP:
ははっ、ゴミが多すぎるって大げさな。
別にゴミ部屋ってほどじゃないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. How much can you have?
It's not like your room is filled
with trash or anything.

fields.JP: ま、まさか～。冗談がきついですよ～

fields.EN:
Uh, why the pause?
You're starting to scare me...
fields.JP: いや、その間はなに？　怖いんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, why the pause?
You're starting to scare me...

fields.EN:
...Don't tell me your
room really is a garbage room?
fields.JP:
……まさか、本当にゴミ部屋なんて
ことはないよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me you seriously have
a load of trash to toss out...

fields.EN:
Of course not. None of the trash
I have is rotting, so I can still
handle the smell.
fields.JP:
いえいえ、まさか。
まだ生ゴミ系までは進んでないので、
ニオイとかは大丈夫です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not. None of the trash
I have is rotting, so I can still
handle the smell.

fields.EN:
Smell? You're making excuses here,
aren't you? I'm starting to think
you're like some pack rat...
fields.JP:
な、生ゴミじゃないから
大丈夫っていう発想が、
すでにゴミ部屋の住人じみている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Smell? You're making excuses here,
aren't you? I'm starting to think
you're like some pack rat...

fields.EN:
It's not a garbage room~!
It's just a little untidy~!
fields.JP:
ゴミ部屋じゃありません～！
ただちょっと片づいてないだけです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not a pack rat!
It's just that I haven't cleaned
my place in a bit!

fields.EN:
Now you've got me curious too. I
kind of want to see your room, Kaguya-chan.
fields.JP:
……なんかここまで聞くと、
わたしも興味出てきちゃったな。
かぐやちゃんの部屋、見てみたいかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now you're really making me want
to see what your room is like...

fields.EN: Do you mind if we come in?
fields.JP: ちょっと見せてくれない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind if we come in?

fields.EN:
Come on, how about we just
take a peek instead?
fields.JP: 僕も見たいな。ひと目くらいいいだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on, how about we just
take a peek instead?

fields.EN:
She tripped!
Let's take a look inside!
fields.JP:
かぐやがこけた！
今のうちにちょっと覗かせてもらおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
She tripped!
Let's take a look inside!

fields.JP: ごめんね、かぐやちゃん

fields.EN:
No use hiding it now...
The place is filthy, isn't it?
fields.JP:
……ふん、見られてしまったからには
仕方ないです～。
どうせ汚い部屋と言いたいんでしょ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No use hiding it now...
The place is filthy, isn't it?

fields.EN:
Mmm... The place does need
some cleaning to be done...
fields.JP:
うーん。たしかにちょっと、
片づけないといけないかもね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... The place does need
some cleaning to be done...

fields.EN:
I figured as much. After all,
you were trying to stop us from
looking inside your room.
fields.JP:
やっぱり僕が予想した通りだったな。
部屋をあんなに隠そうとするなんて、
怪しいと思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I figured as much. After all,
you were trying to stop us from
looking inside your room.

fields.EN:
It may look dirty, but I actually
have what I want placed tactically
within reach.
fields.JP:
こ、これはただ散らかってるんじゃなく、
必要な物がすぐに取れるように
計算し尽くされた配置になってるんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It may look dirty, but I actually
have what I want placed tactically
within reach.

fields.EN:
You mentioned yourself that the
place is filthy...
fields.JP:
さっき、どうせ汚い部屋とか
自分で認めてなかったか？
矛盾してるだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mentioned yourself that the
place is filthy...

fields.EN:
Kaguya-chan, you need help cleaning
your place, right?
fields.JP:
もう、かぐやちゃんったら。
本当は一人で片づけるのが大変で
困ってたんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, you need help cleaning
your place, right?

fields.EN:
If you need help, just ask.
We're here for you.
fields.JP:
困ってるなら言ってくれれば手伝うのに。
遠慮しなくていいんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you need help, just ask.
We're here for you.

fields.EN:
Of course.
We're friends, you know?
fields.JP: もちろんだよ。仲間でしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course.
We're friends, you know?

fields.EN:
Well, if you can help,
then please do.
fields.JP: それならお願いします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you can help,
then please do.

fields.JP: うわ、素早い手のひら返し……

fields.EN:
I have no reason to refuse when you're
offering to help~. I'll devote myself
to being the commander, then~.
fields.JP:
せっかく手伝ってくれるというのを、
断る理由なんてありませんから～。
わらわは司令塔に徹しますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no reason not to rely on a
helping hand. Well, I'll be the
advisor then.

fields.JP: なに、さり気なく楽な役割を取ってるんだよ

fields.EN:
How rude. I'm simply assigning
myself a proper role befitting of
my abilities.
fields.JP:
あら、人聞きの悪い～。
合理的に掃除を進めるための
妥当な役割分担です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
How rude. I'm simply assigning
myself a proper role befitting of
my abilities.

fields.EN:
Princess, are you going to let
that fly?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, are you going to let
that fly?

fields.EN:
Why not? I don't mind cleaning.
Now that I've seen the place,
I have to get this place cleaned.
fields.JP:
うん。お片づけって嫌いじゃないし、
このまま放置したら気になっちゃうから
いいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not? I don't mind cleaning.
Now that I've seen the place,
I have to get this place cleaned.

fields.EN:
Fine... If you say so.
Let me help.
fields.JP:
はぁ……、わかった。
姫がそう言うなら、僕も手伝うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... If you say so.
Let me help.

fields.EN: You don't need to force yourself.
fields.JP: 無理しなくていいんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't need to force yourself.

fields.EN:
I'm not, Princess. I'm actually
quite honored to be of assistance
to you.
fields.JP:
無理ではありませんよ、姫。
あなたの手伝いをできるのならば、
この上なく光栄なことです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not, Princess. I'm actually
quite honored to be of assistance
to you.

fields.EN:
(There's no way I can leave her
alone to handle all this...)
fields.JP:
（そもそも、姫だけに重労働なんて
　させられるわけないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no way I can leave her
