alone to handle all this...)

fields.EN:
You're going to help too, Otsuu-san?
Thank you very much.
fields.JP:
おつうさんも手伝ってくれるんですか～？
ありがとうございます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to help, too?
Thank you very much.

fields.EN: You owe me one, got it?
fields.LOCALIZED: You owe me one, got it?

fields.EN: Heh heh, you're both such softies~.
fields.JP: ふふ、二人ともお人好しですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
You're both borderline gullible,
aren't you?

fields.EN:
(Huh? Kaguya?
What's she doing over there?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、かぐや。みんなから離れて
　どうしたんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Kaguya?
What's she doing over there?)

fields.EN:
(What's she doing in the shadows
there? Is she sick?
I better go and check...)
fields.JP:
（急に物陰に隠れた……。
　気分でも悪いのかな。ちょっと見に行こう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's she doing in the shadows
there? Is she sick?
I better go and check...)

fields.EN: I guess this should be fine...
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess this should be fine...

fields.EN:
(There she is... What's she...?
Huh? She took out...
a water sprayer?)
fields.JP:
（いたいた。なにか取り出そうと
　しているぞ。あれは……霧吹き？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There she is... What's she...?
Huh? She took out...
a water sprayer?)

fields.EN:
Heh heh... Time to use one of
my special goof-off items...
the "Worker's Sparkle."
fields.JP:
ふふ、『仕事してる風七つ道具』の一つ、
『努力家のきらめき』を使います～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... Time to use one of
my special goof-off items...
the "Worker's Sparkle."

fields.JP:
（『仕事してる風七つ道具』！？
　……すごく馬鹿馬鹿しい響きのアイテムだな）

fields.EN:
(She's spraying her face with
it... What is she doing?)
fields.JP:
（霧吹きを顔に吹きかけた……。
　なにやってるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's spraying her face with
it... What is she doing?)

fields.EN: I better not forget my neck...
fields.LOCALIZED: I better not forget my neck...

fields.EN:
(She's spraying on her neck...
Wait... Is she faking sweat?
No, she wouldn't...)
fields.JP:
（で、うなじにも吹きかける、と。
　……まさか、あれで汗を演出してるのか？
　いやいや、さすがにそんな馬鹿な）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's spraying on her neck...
Wait... Is she faking sweat?
No, she wouldn't...)

fields.EN:
(But, she did say "goof-off,"
so... Is she seriously...?)
fields.JP:
（……でもさっき、『仕事してる風』って
　言ってたよな。それじゃあやっぱり、
　ひょっとして本当に……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, she did say "goof-off,"
so... Is she seriously...?)

fields.EN:
Good... That should do it.
I bet no one would ever think
of using a spray bottle like this.
fields.JP:
……よし、これくらいでいいでしょう～。
こんなすごい道具、他の人は
思いつかないでしょうね～。ふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good... That should do it.
I bet no one would ever think
of using a spray bottle like this.

fields.EN:
(Okay, it really is stupid...
At least she's right that no one
would use the bottle like that.)
fields.JP:
（……思った以上の馬鹿馬鹿しさだった。
　たしかにそんな道具、
　他の人は思いつかないだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Okay, it really is stupid...
At least she's right that no one
would use the bottle like that.)

fields.EN:
I better head on back...
I need to keep this all as
inconspicuous as possible...
fields.JP:
さてと、そろそろみんなのところに
戻らないと～。不審に思われては
元も子もありませんから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better head on back...
I need to keep this all as
inconspicuous as possible...

fields.JP: かぐやちゃん、すごい汗！

fields.EN:
You worked hard enough to sweat that
much! I don't know when you worked
that hard, but that's amazing!
fields.JP:
そんなにも汗をかくほどがんばったんだな！
いつがんばったのかは知らんが、すごいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very good! I don't know what you
exactly did, but your sweat proves
you must have done something!

fields.EN:
Kaguya, you okay?
You wanna rest?
fields.JP: かぐやー、だいじょうぶ？　ちょっとやすむ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, you okay?
You wanna rest?

fields.EN:
No, this is nothing... If I can
be of use to everyone, it's easy work.
fields.JP:
いいえ、これくらい平気です……。
みなさんの役に立てるなら、軽い物ですから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm fine...
This is nothing for my fine
friends here.

fields.EN:
Well said!
A true friend indeed!
fields.JP: よくぞ言った！　さすがワレの仲間だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said!
A true friend indeed!

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan! Look how hard Kaguya-chan is
working even though she's sweating this
much! Don't you think she's admirable?
fields.JP:
あ、おつうちゃん！
かぐやちゃんがこんなに汗をかきながら
がんばってるの！　すごく偉いと思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Look at how much Kaguya
is doing! She's all sweating and
everything! Isn't she something?

fields.EN:
Uh, yes...
She sure is something...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, yes...
She sure is something...

fields.EN:
(I don't want to dampen the mood
here, but... aren't they a bit too
gullible?)
fields.JP:
（せっかく姫が感動してるのに、
　水を差すことはできない。だけどみんな、
　簡単に騙されすぎじゃないか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't want to dampen the mood
here, but... aren't they a bit too
gullible?)

fields.EN:
Now, let's hurry onward.
Hard-working me will keep doing my best too.
fields.JP:
さあ、先を急ぎましょう。
働き者のわらわも、引き続きがんばりますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, let's get going.
As hard-working as I am,
I shall still lead the way.

fields.EN:
Heh heh, it's nothing much. I'm
only putting in a little effort. Heh heh...
fields.JP:
ふふ、それほどでも。
ただ、少し努力してるだけですから。
ふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... You can praise me
more. After all, I am doing quite
a lot. Heh heh...

fields.EN:
She should put her efforts into
something more productive...
fields.JP: いや、その努力はもっと他に活かそうよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She should put her efforts into
something more productive...

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、なにか言った？

fields.EN:
No...
I'm just mumbling to myself...
fields.JP: いいえ、姫。ただの独り言です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No...
I'm just mumbling to myself...

fields.EN:
*sigh*
I want to hurry and cozy up in
my room...
fields.JP:
はぁ……早く帰って部屋に
こもりたいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*
I want to hurry and cozy up in
my room...

fields.EN:
Urrh... Rapunzel so tired...
No wanna walk...
fields.JP:
はうぅ……ラプンツェルもつかれたー。
もうあるきたくないよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... Rapunzel so tired...
No wanna walk...

fields.EN:
Come now, you shouldn't be
sitting down here like this.
fields.JP:
ああ、こんなところにしゃがみこんだら
駄目だって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, you shouldn't be
sitting down here like this.

fields.JP: でもつかれたんだもん……

fields.EN:
We did walk for quite some time
now, so I'm not surprised if
everyone is exhausted.
fields.JP:
たしかにだいぶ歩いたから、
疲労が溜まっていてもおかしくないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did walk for quite some time
now, so I'm not surprised if
everyone is exhausted.

fields.EN:
It should make walking a little easier.
Here, Rapunzel-san, use it.
fields.JP:
この杖で歩くのが少しは楽になるはずです。
ラプンツェルさんにお貸ししましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It should help make walking
a bit easier. Go ahead and use it.

fields.EN:
Cane? How you use?
Like this?
fields.JP:
つえ？　どうやってつかうの？
こう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cane? How you use?
Like this?

fields.EN:
Whoa! Watch it!
Don't swing it around like that!
fields.JP:
うわっ、危ない！
振り回す物じゃないぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Watch it!
Don't swing it around like that!

fields.EN:
You're supposed to put the tip
to the ground, so that you can
lean on it while walking.
fields.JP:
それは縦に持って、先端を地面につけて、
体を支えるようにしながら歩く物よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're supposed to put the tip
to the ground, so that you can
lean on it while walking.

fields.EN:
Oh, okay!
Got it! Lemme do it!
fields.JP:
そうなんだ！
やるやるー！　やってみる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, okay!
Got it! Lemme do it!

fields.EN: How does it feel using it?
fields.LOCALIZED: How does it feel using it?

fields.EN:
Um, a little easy to walk?
Thanks, Kaguya!
fields.JP:
あのね、なんかちょっとあるきやすい！
ありがとー！　かぐやー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, a little easy to walk?
Thanks, Kaguya!

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you had a
cane on you.
fields.JP: かぐや、杖なんてよく持ってたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you had a
cane on you.

fields.EN:
It's just a showing of my
resolve.
fields.JP: これは、わらわの覚悟の表れなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just a showing of my
resolve.

fields.EN:
I'm prepared to keep moving forward no
matter how tired I get, even if I have to
use this cane! All for everyone's sake!
fields.JP:
わらわはどんなに疲れても、
この杖をついてでも先へ進もうと覚悟して
いるんです！　すべてはみんなのために！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It shows my resolve of moving
forward no matter what!
All for the sake of my friends!

fields.JP: おおー！　なんという心意気だ！

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
I'm more than willing to
bathe in your praises.
fields.JP: ふふ、称賛は随時受付中です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
I'm more than willing to
bathe in your praises.

fields.EN:
Hm? But, you're always riding
on your thing there, so you don't
need a cane, do you?
fields.JP:
……あれ？
でもかぐやは乗り物に乗ってるから、
疲れても杖なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? But, you're always riding
on your thing there, so you don't
need a cane, do you?

fields.JP: さあ！　先に進みましょう！
つえであるくのらくになったーー！
よかったな、ラプンツェル！
……なんか、誤魔化された気がする

fields.EN:
Wait a minute... If she's riding
on that vehicle of hers, why don't
she let Rapunzel ride on it?
fields.JP:
ん？　っていうかそもそも、杖を貸すより、
ラプンツェルをあの乗り物に
乗せてあげればよかったんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute... If she's riding
on that vehicle of hers, why don't
she let Rapunzel ride on it?

fields.EN:
Maybe that cane is one of her
goof-off items... At the very
least, I doubt she even uses it.
fields.JP:
あの杖も『仕事してる風七つ道具』の
一つだったのかも。少なくとも、
絶対に自分で使う用じゃないよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that cane is one of her
goof-off items... At the very
least, I doubt she even uses it.

fields.EN:
She has seven of those items,
eh? She could put her efforts
towards something more fruitful.
fields.JP:
そんな下らない道具を七つも
持ち歩いてるのか……。相変わらず、
努力の方向が激しく間違ってる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She has seven of those items,
eh? She could put her efforts
towards something more fruitful.

fields.EN:
Otsuu!
Hurry it up, will you?!
fields.JP: おつう！　早く来ないと置いて行くぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu!
Hurry it up, will you?!

fields.EN:
Ah, Otsuu-san! Ningyohime-san!
What perfect timing.
fields.JP:
あ、おつうさん～、人魚姫さん～。
ちょうどいいところへ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Otsuu! Little Mermaid!
What perfect timing.

fields.JP: ちょうどいいところへって、どうかしたの？

fields.EN:
Do you mind getting me that
cup of water over there?
fields.JP:
あそこに水の入ったコップがあるので、
ちょっと取ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind getting me that
cup of water over there?

fields.JP: って、君からの距離のほうが近いじゃないか

fields.EN:
Moving is such a bother~. I prepared
some water for the spray bottle,
but I forgot it over there...
fields.JP:
動くのが面倒くさいんです～。
霧吹きに入れる用の水を用意したのに、
あそこに置き忘れてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to move.
I was going to fill my spray
with it.

fields.EN: Oh, uh... You didn't hear that!
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, uh... You didn't hear that!

fields.EN:
(Oh, she's talking about that
water bottle she used before...)
fields.JP: （ああ、あの『仕事してる風七つ道具』か……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, she's talking about that
water bottle she used before...)

fields.EN: Can you get it for me, please?
fields.JP: とにかく、取ってくれませんか～
fields.LOCALIZED: Can you get it for me, please?

fields.JP: ありがとうございます～

fields.EN:
You were within reach...
You sure are lazy, aren't you?
fields.JP:
こんなに近くにあるんだから
自分で取ればいいのに、本当に無精だな。
まったく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were within reach...
You sure are lazy, aren't you?

fields.EN:
But she always does her best,
so I don't mind seeing her
being lazy.
fields.JP:
でもいつもがんばってるんだし、
わたしたちの前でくらい、
だらだらさせてあげようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she always does her best,
so I don't mind seeing her
being lazy.

fields.EN:
How very kind. Just what
I'd expect from my princess.
fields.JP: なんてお優しい。さすがは僕の姫だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How kind of you.
A true princess indeed!

fields.EN:
But, she tries to be as lazy as
possible at all times. It's almost
as if that's her life work...
fields.JP:
……だけど、かぐやは隙さえあれば
だらけているな。むしろだらけることに
全力を出しているというか
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she tries to be as lazy as
possible at all times. It's almost
as if that's her life work...

fields.EN:
Maybe being lazy is her
Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
もしかして、だらけることが
血式リビドーなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe being lazy is her
Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, we don't really
know what Kaguya-chan's Blood Libido is.
fields.JP:
そういえば、かぐやちゃんの
血式リビドーってよくわからないもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, we're
not sure what her Blood
Libido is...

fields.EN:
...I do have a Blood Libido, but it's about
a certain 'thing' that's already been lost~.
fields.JP:
……血式リビドーはありますけど、
すでに失われた『物』に関することなんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do have a Blood Libido. It's in
relation to a few items that were
lost.

fields.EN:
Why yes. Nothing can be done
already, so you can forget
about it.
fields.JP:
そうです～。どうしようもないことなので、
もう放っておいてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. Nothing can be done
already, so you can forget
about it.

fields.EN:
(She sure looks sad...
Maybe she's trying to force
herself to forget...)
fields.JP:
（放っておいてなんて言ってるけど、
　なんだか寂しそうだな。無理やり
　諦めようとしてるだけかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She sure looks sad...
Maybe she's trying to force
herself to forget...)

fields.EN:
Kaguya-chan, that thing must have
been very precious to you. Don't
you still have regrets about it?
fields.JP:
……かぐやちゃん、その『物』が
すごく大切だったんだね。
本当は今も心残りがあるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It must have been something
very precious to you. Don't you
have any regrets?

fields.EN: Not really... It'll never come back anyway~.
fields.JP: 別に……どうせ二度と戻ってこないんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not really... It's not like
I'll ever see any of them again.

fields.EN:
But Blood Libido is something that
can bring intense pain and
suffering.
fields.JP:
だけど、血式リビドーって辛いでしょ。
わたしにもわかるもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Blood Libido is something that
can bring intense pain and
suffering.

fields.EN:
Maybe we can help.
We can look for them on our
expedition and things!
fields.JP:
少しでも力になれないかな？
探索中に見つかる物だったら、
わたしたちも探すの手伝うから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can help.
We can look for them on our
expedition and things!

fields.EN:
No need for that, really.
I'm fine.
fields.JP:
そんなのはしなくて大丈夫です～。
本当に、もういいんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need for that, really.
I'm fine.

fields.EN:
But I can't leave you alone
when you look so sad, Kaguya-chan.
fields.JP:
でもかぐやちゃんがそんな悲しそうな顔
してるのに、放ってなんておけないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But look at you... You look really
depressed. There's no way I can
leave you like that.

fields.JP: そんなこと言わずに、ね？

fields.EN:
If you can at least tell us what
you lost then we can help.
fields.JP:
せめてなにを探せばいいのかだけ
教えてくれない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can at least tell us what
you lost then we can help.

fields.JP: だから……いいって言ってるじゃないですか！

fields.EN:
I'm trying my best to forget about
it! Just leave me alone!
fields.JP:
人ががんばって諦めようとしているんだから、
放っておいてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm trying my best to forget about
it! Just leave me alone!

fields.EN:
You don't know anything!
Mind your own business!
fields.JP:
なにも知らないくせに、首突っ込んで……！
おせっかいなんです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't know anything!
Mind your own business!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... I didn't know you
didn't want us to get involved.
I'm sorry...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんなさい。
そんなに嫌だったなんて……。
わたし、たしかにおせっかいだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... I didn't know you
didn't want us to get involved.
I'm sorry...

fields.EN:
(I've never seen Princess this
depressed before...)
fields.JP: （姫がこんなに悲しそうな顔を……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen Princess this
depressed before...)

fields.EN:
Kaguya, you didn't need to yell
at her like that. She was trying
to help.
fields.JP:
かぐや。そんな言い方はないだろう。
姫は君のためを想って申し出てくれたんだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, you didn't need to yell
at her like that. She was trying
to help.

fields.EN: Well, keep your help to yourself.
fields.JP: 親切の押し売りは迷惑です～
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, keep your help to yourself.

fields.EN:
It's fine, Otsuu-chan. I didn't think
of how Kaguya-chan felt and kept
pestering her.
fields.JP:
いいの、おつうちゃん。
わたしがかぐやちゃんの気持ちも考えず、
無神経なこと言っちゃっただけなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine, Otsuu. I didn't think
of how Kaguya felt and kept
pestering her.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime-san, I know you meant well,
but really, you should mind your own business.
fields.JP:
……人魚姫さんに悪気がないのは
わかっています～。
でも、余計なお世話は迷惑なんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you meant well,
but really, you should mind your
own business.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... I guess I made you worry too,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
……ごめんね。
おつうちゃんにも気を遣わせちゃったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
I guess I made you feel bad,
too...

fields.EN:
You don't need to apologize.
If anything, Kaguya should be the
one to apologize here.
fields.JP:
姫が謝ることなどなにもありません。
せっかくの姫の厚意を無碍にした、
かぐやのほうが悪いんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to apologize.
If anything, Kaguya should be the
one to apologize here.

fields.EN:
But Kaguya-chan is right. Pushing
unwanted kindness on someone is a nuisance.
fields.JP:
でも、かぐやちゃんの言う通りだよ。
親切の押し売りは迷惑って
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she's right...
If she doesn't want help, then
I should mind my own business...

fields.EN:
For Kaguya-chan, it was something
she didn't want others prying into.
fields.JP:
……かぐやちゃんにとっては
踏み込まれたくない問題だったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it was something she
didn't want to have people
getting into.

fields.JP: （たしかにそうなのかもしれない。だけど……）

fields.EN:
That still doesn't mean Kaguya
can talk like that. You really did
nothing wrong.
fields.JP:
……それでも、あんな言われ方をしていい
理由にはなりません。姫はなにも悪くない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That still doesn't mean Kaguya
can talk like that. You really did
nothing wrong.

fields.EN:
(This is awkward...
This is the first time we're face-to face
since Kaguya went on her tirade.)
fields.JP:
（き、気まずい……。この間の一件以来、
　ちゃんと顔を合わせるのは初めてだからな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is awkward...
This is the first time we're face-to face
since Kaguya went on her tirade.)

fields.EN:
(We don't need to apologize,
and I doubt Kaguya would
apologize. What to do...)
fields.JP:
（でもこちらから謝ることでもないし、
　かといってあっちが謝るとも思えないし……。
　どうしたらいいんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We don't need to apologize,
and I doubt Kaguya would
apologize. What to do...)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about the last time.
I think I went too far.
fields.JP:
……この間は、わらわも言いすぎました～……。
すみませんでした～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about the last time.
I think I went too far.

fields.JP: かぐやちゃん、こっちこそごめんね！

fields.EN:
(I guess what happened back then
bothered Kaguya, too...)
fields.JP: （この間のこと、かぐやなりに気にしてたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess what happened back then
bothered Kaguya, too...)

fields.EN:
Thank you for being worried
about me and my Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
お二人とも、先日は血式リビドーのことで
心配してくれて、その……
ありがとうございました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for being worried
about me and my Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
I'm not used to people showing that kind of
concern for me, so I ended up acting harshly~.
fields.JP:
そういう気遣いに慣れていなかったもので、
つい、きつい態度を取ってしまったんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I rarely ever have
anyone worried over me, so
I just went out of control.

fields.EN:
Don't worry. It doesn't bother me
anymore. If there's something
you want to discuss, let us know.
fields.JP:
もう気にしてないよ。
でもなにかあれば相談してね。
わたしたちも力になれるかもしれないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. It doesn't bother me
anymore. If there's something
you want to discuss, let us know.

fields.EN:
We both understand how tough it
is to have a Blood Libido, so come
see us if you want to talk.
fields.JP:
うん。僕達も血式リビドーの
苦しさみたいなものは知っているから、
話したくなったらいつでも聞くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We both understand how tough it
is to have a Blood Libido, so come
see us if you want to talk.

fields.JP: おつうさん、人魚姫さん……

fields.EN:
W-Well, if that's the case, do you
mind if we talk right now?
fields.JP:
そ、それなら……今、聞いてもらっても
いいですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, if that's the case, do you
mind if we talk right now?

fields.EN:
(Maybe Kaguya wanted to talk
about her Blood Libido
all along...)
fields.JP:
（もしかしたらかぐやは、
　ずっと誰かに話を聞いてもらい
　たかったのかもしれないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Kaguya wanted to talk
about her Blood Libido
all along...)

fields.EN:
Do you remember what I said
about my Blood Libido? Well,
it's that I seek "five treasures."
fields.JP:
前にも少しお話しましたが、
わらわの血式リビドーは、ある物……
『五つの宝物を欲する』というものなんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you remember what I said
about my Blood Libido? Well,
it's that I seek "five treasures."

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, those treasures
have been taken away from me, and
I don't know where they are now.
fields.JP:
でもその宝物は取り上げられてしまって、
今はどこにあるのかわからないんです～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, those treasures
have been taken away from me, and
I don't know where they are now.

fields.JP: 取り上げられたって、誰に？

fields.EN:
Hm?
What are you girls doing there?
fields.JP: ん？　お前ら、そんなとこでなにしてるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm?
What are you girls doing there?

fields.EN:
Oh, well, we were just talking
a bit, and...
fields.JP: ああ、うん。ちょっとした立ち話を
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, well, we were just talking
a bit, and...

fields.EN:
Wha-?! What the...?!
What is it?!
fields.JP: うお、びっくりした。なんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! What the...?!
What is it?!

fields.EN:
M-M-M-Mamoru-san!
Th-That thing you have there...
The Swallow's Cowry Shell!
fields.JP:
マ、ママママモルさんっ！
そ、その手に持っているものは……っ、
燕の子安貝～！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-M-M-Mamoru!
Th-That thing you have there...
The Swallow's Cowry Shell!

fields.EN:
Pretty cool, huh? I found it when
I was salvaging for parts at
the old Liberated District.
fields.JP:
ああ、これか。元解放地区を漁ってるときに、
偶然見つけたんだ。へへっ、いいだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pretty cool, huh? I found it when
I was salvaging for parts at
the old Liberated District.

fields.JP:
あ、あの、そそそれは実はその、
わ、わらわは、えーと、その……！

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan... Maybe that's one of
the treasures Kaguya is looking
for...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、もしかして、
あれが『五つの宝物』の一つなんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Maybe that's one of
the treasures Kaguya is looking
for...

fields.EN:
I see... That would explain why
Kaguya is all flustered seeing it.
fields.JP:
そうか。それがいきなり目の前に現れたから、
かぐやはこんなにテンパっているのか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... That would explain why
Kaguya is all flustered seeing it.

fields.EN:
Mamoru, what you have there is
probably something precious
that Kaguyahime lost.
fields.JP:
……マモル。君が見つけたっていうそれは、
もしかしたらかぐや姫が前になくした
大切な物かもしれないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, what you have there is
probably something precious
that Kaguya lost.

fields.EN: Do you mind if we take a look?
fields.JP: 悪いけど、ちょっと見せてもらってもいいか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind if we take a look?

fields.EN:
Thank you...
Kaguya? Is this one of them?
fields.JP:
ありがとう。……かぐや、
これは君の大切な宝物で間違いないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...
Kaguya? Is this one of them?

fields.EN:
Y-Yes... That's it...
It's one of my five treasures...
The Swallow's Cowry Shell!
fields.JP:
は、はい。そうです……。
これはたしかに、わらわの『五つの宝物』の
一つ、『燕の子安貝』です～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes... That's it...
It's one of my five treasures...
The Swallow's Cowry Shell!

fields.EN:
It's amazing we came across
one of your treasures like this.
fields.JP:
話しているちょうどそのときに
見つかるなんて、すごい偶然だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's amazing we came across
one of your treasures like this.

fields.EN:
Uh, um... Mamoru-san?
Do you mind giving it to me?
fields.JP:
あ、あの、マモルさん。
これを譲っていただけますか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, um... Mamoru?
Do you mind giving it to me?

fields.EN:
What do you mean, give it to you?
From what you just said, it was yours
to begin with, right? You keep it.
fields.JP:
譲るもなにも、今の話聞いてたら、
もともとお前の物なんだろ？
お前が持っておけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind? It's yours, right?
Take it.

fields.JP: あ……ありがとうございます～！

fields.EN:
Well, I gotta go now.
Not sure what happened, but you
be careful not to lose it again.
fields.JP:
じゃーな。よくわかんないけど、
大事な物ならもうなくすなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I gotta go now.
Not sure what happened, but you
be careful not to lose it again.

fields.JP: よかったね、かぐやちゃん！

fields.EN:
Otsuu-san... Ningyohime-san...
Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
おつうさん、人魚姫さん、
ありがとうございました～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Little Mermaid...
Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
Heh heh heh heh...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
Heh heh heh heh...

fields.JP: かぐやちゃんったら、すごく嬉しそう

fields.EN:
She did get one of her treasures
back after all.
fields.JP:
大事な宝物が一つでも手元に戻ったんだから、
当然だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She did get one of her treasures
back after all.

fields.EN:
Oh, but that's not the only
reason I'm happy.
fields.JP:
はい～！
……でもそれだけじゃなくて、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but that's not the only
reason I'm happy.

fields.EN:
I'm even happier knowing that
you both were worried about me
to this extent.
fields.JP:
お二人がわらわのことを
自分のことのように心配してくれたのが、
とても嬉しかったんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm even happier knowing that
you both were worried about me
to this extent.

fields.EN:
Because you're an important
friend to us, Kaguya-chan.
fields.JP: だって、かぐやちゃんは大事な仲間だもん

fields.EN:
As long as you're happy,
all is good.
fields.JP: かぐやが元気になってくれてよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you're happy,
all is good.

fields.EN: Yes~. It's all thanks to everyone~.
fields.JP: はい～。みんなのおかげです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you.
And, it's all because of you two.

fields.EN:
(I've never seen Kaguya smile like
that before. It looks like she's a
bit more friendly now.)
fields.JP:
（かぐやのこんな晴れやかな笑顔は
　初めて見たかも。
　前より心を開いてくれたみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen Kaguya smile like
that before. It looks like she's a
bit more friendly now.)

fields.EN:
(I'm just as happy as her now.
I can only hope we can strengthen
our friendship even further.)
fields.JP:
（こっちこそすごく嬉しいよ、かぐや。
　これからも仲良くできるといいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm just as happy as her now.
I can only hope we can strengthen
our friendship even further.)

fields.JP: いいもの持って来たよ！

fields.EN:
Huh, your room is cluttered just
borderline of calling the place
dirty...
fields.JP:
おお、相変わらず微妙な散らかり具合の
部屋だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, your room is cluttered just
borderline of calling the place
dirty...

fields.EN:
Did you come here to pick a
fight? I thought you came here
saying you brought something.
fields.JP:
喧嘩を売りに来たんですか～？
いいものを持って来たと聞いたんですけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you come here to pick a
fight? I thought you came here
saying you brought something.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. We came because
we wanted to give you this...
fields.JP:
ごめんごめん。
実は、これを君に渡したくてさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. We came because
we wanted to give you this...

fields.EN:
These are the other four of
your 'five treasures,' right,
Kaguya-chan? Now you've got all five!
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃんの『五つの宝物』の残り四つ、
これでいいんだよね？
これで五つ全部揃ったね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
These are the four remaining
treasures, right? Here, they're
for you!

fields.JP: きゃあっ、かぐやちゃんが倒れた！

fields.EN:
Uh... Ah... Urh...
I-I was just surprised, and...
I didn't expect...
fields.JP:
あ……あう、あうぅ～。
あまりにも驚いてしまって……
だって、まさか本当に～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Ah... Urh...
I-I was just surprised, and...
I didn't expect...

fields.EN:
Th-These are... These...!
Are...! Uh... Ah...!
fields.JP:
こ、これはたしかにわらわの……
ああう、あうあう～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-These are... These...!
Are...! Uh... Ah...!

fields.EN:
Looks like she's at a loss of
words.
fields.JP: 言葉にならないみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like she's at a loss of
words.

fields.EN:
I didn't expect her to be that
surprised...
fields.JP: これほど驚かれるのは予想外だったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect her to be that
surprised...

fields.EN:
Aah...!
I-I can't hold myself back!
Th-Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
はぁ、はぁ、ああ、
つい興奮してしまいました～。
本当にありがとうございます～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah...!
I-I can't hold myself back!
Th-Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
It's nothing.
We're friends after all.
fields.JP: まぁ、これくらい仲間なんだから当然だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nothing.
We're friends after all.

fields.EN:
Then again, it did take awhile to
get them together, but we wanted
to see you happy, so... yeah...
fields.JP:
たしかにこれをすべて揃えるのは
けっこう大変だったけど、
君に喜んでほしくてね。ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, it did take awhile to
get them together, but we wanted
to see you happy, so... yeah...

fields.EN:
Oh, but you owe us one.
Got it?
fields.JP: あ、でも貸しってことだからね、うん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but you owe us one.
Got it?

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
I don't think Kaguya-chan
is listening anymore...
fields.JP:
たぶんかぐやちゃん、
もう聞いてないと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't think she hears you...

fields.EN:
Aah... My precious treasures
are back in my hand...
Heh heh heh heh...
fields.JP:
ああ～、大事な大事な『五つの宝物』～。
やっとわらわのもとに戻ってきた～。
ふふふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah... My precious treasures
are back in my hand...
Heh heh heh heh...

fields.EN: As long as she's happy, I suppose.
fields.JP: ……まぁ、喜んでくれたならいいけど
fields.LOCALIZED: As long as she's happy, I suppose.

fields.EN:
I didn't know Kaguya-chan could
smile so innocently. I've never
seen that expression before.
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃんってこんなに
無邪気な顔で笑うんだね。
こんな表情、初めて見た
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know she could smile
like that... Who would've known?

fields.EN:
Indeed. I'm really glad we
brought them to her.
fields.JP:
そうですね。
……本当、喜んでくれてよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I'm really glad we
brought them to her.

fields.EN:
Aah...
Thank you so very much...
fields.JP: はぁ……ありがとうございます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah...
Thank you so very much...

fields.EN:
You're welcome. I'm glad those
are back in your hand.
fields.JP:
どういたしまして。
宝物が手元に戻ってよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're welcome. I'm glad those
are back in your hand.

fields.EN:
Why yes...
And, you know what?
fields.JP:
はい～。
でも、それだけじゃなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes...
And, you know what?

fields.EN:
I'm just happy to know you both
went through the trouble of
finding them all.
fields.JP:
二人がこの宝物をがんばって集めて
くれたことが、同じくらい嬉しいんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just happy to know you both
went through the trouble of
finding them all.

fields.EN:
It's not just because I got my treasures back.
Somehow, I feel strangely fulfilled inside~
fields.JP:
宝物が戻ったからだけではなく、なんだか
不思議と心が満たされた感じがします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Getting the treasures back is one
thing, but seeing what you've done
has filled me with great joy.

fields.EN:
We're happy to hear that. I guess
it was all worth the trouble.
Isn't that right, Princess?
fields.JP:
そう言ってもらえると、
僕達の苦労も報われるよ。
……よかったですね、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're happy to hear that. I guess
it was all worth the trouble.
Isn't that right, Princess?

fields.EN:
All done...
It looks better already...
fields.JP: ……よし。これできれいになりました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
All done...
It looks better already...

fields.JP:
あら……？
あなた今、メガネを拭いていたわよね
え？　そ、そうですけど……

fields.EN:
(Kaguya and Gretel?
What could those two be talking
about...?)
fields.JP:
（かぐやとグレーテル……？
　珍しい組み合わせでなに話してるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya and Gretel?
What could those two be talking
about...?)

fields.EN:
I noticed that the lenses lack
the proper corrective features
normally found in other glasses.
fields.JP:
外したメガネをちらりと見たけど、
それ、度が入っていないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I noticed that the lenses lack
the proper corrective features
normally found in other glasses.

fields.EN:
Are you hiding something in
regards to those glasses?
fields.JP:
……ひょっとして、そのメガネには
なにか秘密があるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you hiding something in
regards to those glasses?

fields.EN:
I have no intention of telling
anyone. I'm simply curious why
you wear non-prescription glasses.
fields.JP:
別に口外するつもりはないわ。
ただ、伊達メガネをかける理由に
興味が湧いただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm inquiring purely from
curiosity. I have no intention of
telling others.

fields.EN:
So, you really want to know
the secret of these glasses?
fields.JP: ……わらわの秘密を知りたいと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you really want to know
the secret of these glasses?

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
I must say, you have fine taste in
taking interest in these.
fields.JP:
……ふふふ、これに興味を持つなんて、
目の付け所が違いますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
I must say, you have fine taste in
taking interest in these.

fields.EN:
This is one of my 'Seven Tools for Looking
Like You're Working'—the one commonly
known as 'Working Woman's Intelligence'~.
fields.JP:
これはずばり、『仕事してる風七つ道具』
の一つ、通称『働く女の知性』です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is one of my special goof-off
items... The "Smart Mistress!"

fields.EN:
(Oh, she's going to tell her what
it is? I guess she wanted to
brag about it...)
fields.JP:
（あ、教えちゃうのか。
　……まさか、誰かに自慢しくて
　うずうずしてたんじゃないだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, she's going to tell her what
it is? I guess she wanted to
brag about it...)

fields.EN:
'Seven Tools for Looking Like
You're Working'? That sounds interesting.
fields.JP:
『仕事してる風七つ道具』？
なにやら面白そうね

fields.EN:
The 'Seven Tools for Looking Like You're
Working' are, as the name says, items
that make it look like you're working~.
fields.JP:
『仕事してる風七つ道具』とは、
その名の通り、仕事をしている風を
装うためのアイテムです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
As its name states, the goof-off
items are made to make it look
like you're working.

fields.EN:
With these, you can make others
feel like you're working hard.
fields.JP:
これがあれば、働いていないのに
なんとなく働き者と思わせることが
できるんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
With these, you can make others
feel like you're working hard.

fields.EN:
So you're deceiving others with
them? Your ingenuity is quite
impressive.
fields.JP:
働いていないのに、働き者と思わせる……？
すごいわ。凡人の発想ではないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're deceiving others with
them? Your ingenuity is quite
impressive.

fields.EN:
I'm quite surprised you kept
such items hidden with you.
Do you have more of them?
fields.JP:
七つ道具ということは他にもあるのかしら。
あなたがまさかそんな秘密道具を
持っていたなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite surprised you kept
such items hidden with you.
Do you have more of them?

fields.EN:
I see you're a lady who
appreciates true value.
Let me show you a bit more.
fields.JP:
物の価値がわかる人ですね～。
あなたには特別に、七つ道具の一部を
紹介してあげます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see you're a lady who
appreciates true value.
Let me show you a bit more.

fields.EN:
These glasses were specially
crafted so that an excessive
amount of light reflects off them.
fields.JP:
まずこの伊達メガネ、通称『働く女の知性』は、
レンズに細工がしてあって
光を無駄に反射しやすくなってます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
These glasses were specially
crafted so that an excessive
amount of light reflects off them.

fields.EN:
It hides the wearer's eyes,
thus making it seem like the
wearer is working studiously.
fields.JP:
目元が隠れることで、
なにもしてなくても仕事してる
雰囲気が出るんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It hides the wearer's eyes,
thus making it seem like the
wearer is working studiously.

fields.JP: なるほど。斬新なアイディアだわ

fields.EN:
The glasses also help persuading
others as it makes the wearer look
smarter and more convincing.
fields.JP:
しかもメガネをかけているだけで
頭が良さそうに見えて発言に説得力が出るので、
話し合いのときにはもってこいなんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
The glasses also help persuading
others as it makes the wearer look
smarter and more convincing.

fields.EN:
It's true that people judge others
by their looks. So this uses that
to the wearer's advantage.
fields.JP:
たしかに人は外見でその人間を判断しがちだわ。
それを逆手に取った作戦ということね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true that people judge others
by their looks. So this uses that
to the wearer's advantage.

fields.EN:
(Is she serious...?
Their conversation sounds pretty
stupid, but...)
fields.JP:
（いや、それで納得していいのか？
　話してる内容は果てしなく
　馬鹿馬鹿しく聞こえるんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she serious...?
Their conversation sounds pretty
stupid, but...)

fields.EN:
Next is the 'Worn-Out Notebook and Red
Pen'~. It's a fine piece with every
page of the notebook crumpled up~.
fields.JP:
次に『へろへろの手帳と赤ペン』です～。
メモ帳を一ページずつくしゃくしゃにした
逸品なんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next, the "Weathered Notebook."
It's been crafted so that each
page inside is crumpled.

fields.JP: これはどうやって使うものなの？

fields.EN:
Simply holding onto it will make
it seem like you're taking notes.
fields.JP:
これを持っているだけで、
真面目にメモを取っている雰囲気を
醸し出せるんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Simply holding onto it will make
it seem like you're taking notes.

fields.EN:
When the pages are all worn out, it looks
like you've taken lots of notes, and a red
pen leaves a stronger impression too~.
fields.JP:
ページがヘロヘロだとたくさん
メモしてある感じに見えますし、
ペンも赤色だと印象に残りやすいんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
The pages gives it a well-used
touch, and the red pen that comes
with it adds a bit of flair to it.

fields.EN:
People who are studious are
often favorably looked upon
regardless of their achievements.
fields.JP:
たしかに勤勉な人間は、
成果を出していなくても好感を
持たれやすいものだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
People who are studious are
often favorably looked upon
regardless of their achievements.

fields.EN:
Focusing on looking diligent rather
than actually being diligent...
That's a revolutionary idea.
fields.JP:
実際に勤勉であることより、
勤勉に見えることに重点を置くなんて……。
その発想は画期的だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite impressed that you
placed emphasis on image
than results...

fields.JP: （いや、単に怠け者なだけだろ……）

fields.EN:
Oh, and I have this bottle here
that can be used to make it
look like you're sweating, and...
fields.JP: 他にも、この霧吹きで汗を演出したりとか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I have this bottle here
that can be used to make it
look like you're sweating, and...

fields.JP: 独創的なアイディアね。ふふふ……

fields.EN:
(They're really going at it...
I thought Kaguya's items were
supposed to be secret...)
fields.JP:
（うわぁ、なんか変な盛り上がり方してるけど、
　あんなにバラしちゃ駄目じゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're really going at it...
I thought Kaguya's items were
supposed to be secret...)

fields.EN:
Heh heh. Gretel-san, you really have a good
eye for these things.
fields.JP:
ふふ、グレーテルさんは
目の付け所がいいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh. I have to say again,
you have great tastes.

fields.EN:
I'm more impressed that you
have such an interesting mindset.
fields.JP: あなたこそ、興味深い発想の持ち主だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm more impressed that you
have such an interesting mindset.

fields.EN:
(Well, looks like they're having
fun, so I guess I can leave them
be...)
fields.JP:
（……でもまぁ、本人たちは
　楽しそうだからいいか。
　僕は邪魔しないでおこう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, looks like they're having
fun, so I guess I can leave them
be...)

fields.EN:
(Huh? I hear someone...
Is it coming from those two?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、ひそひそ声が聞こえる……。
　あの二人、内緒話か？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? I hear someone...
Is it coming from those two?)

fields.EN: ...So we can definitely kill them, right?
fields.JP: ……では、確実に殺せるんですね？

fields.EN:
Yes, this poison should do the
trick...
fields.JP: はい、この毒は効きますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, this poison should do the
trick...

fields.EN:
(K-Kill?! Poison?!
Am I hearing them right?!)
fields.JP:
（こ、殺す！？　毒！？
　すごい物騒なワードが聞こえてきたけど！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(K-Kill?! Poison?!
Am I hearing them right?!)

fields.EN:
I still can't believe such filth
appeared in my room...
fields.JP:
はぁ……。まさかわらわの部屋に、
あのような汚らわしいものが出るなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still can't believe such filth
appeared in my room...

fields.EN:
Yes, I know how you feel.
It's quite disgusting to find
roaches running around...
fields.JP:
やっぱり嫌ですよね。
部屋にゴキ……害虫が出るのって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I know how you feel.
It's quite disgusting to find
roaches running around...

fields.EN:
In any case, I'm very happy
you had the poison feed to
use against them.
fields.JP:
このたびは害虫退治用の毒団子を
用意してくださって、本当に助かりました
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I'm very happy
you had the poison feed to
use against them.

fields.EN: I'm glad to be of help.
fields.JP: いえ、お役に立ててよかったです
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad to be of help.

fields.EN:
But, I don't think the poison will
resolve the situation. Um... You
do keep your room clean, right?
fields.JP:
でも毒団子じゃ根本的な解決には
ならないと思うんです。あの……失礼ですが、
ちゃんと掃除してますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I don't think the poison will
resolve the situation. Um... You
do keep your room clean, right?

fields.EN:
I can say that I have everything
positioned, so all that I need
is within reach...
fields.JP:
……必要な物はすべて、
その場から動かなくてもすぐに
手の届くところに配置しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can say that I have everything
positioned, so all that I need
is within reach...

fields.EN:
Um... So, that means your place
isn't clean then?
fields.JP:
えっと、それって散らかってるって
ことじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... So, that means your place
isn't clean then?

fields.EN:
I'm simply decorating my room
so that it fits my lifestyle.
fields.JP:
わらわの生活スタイルに合った
インテリアコーディネートにしてるだけです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm simply decorating my room
so that it fits my lifestyle.

fields.EN:
(I guess that's one way of
wording it? Still, that's a
tough excuse to swallow.)
fields.JP: （物は言いよう！　強引に押し通した！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess that's one way of
wording it? Still, that's a
tough excuse to swallow.)

fields.EN:
I-I see...
You must have... a very lively
room...
fields.JP:
そ、そうですか……。
つまり賑やかなお部屋ということですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see...
You must have... a very lively
room...

fields.EN:
(I guess that's just Shirayuki's
way of trying to keep things
mellow...)
fields.JP:
（そして白雪もマイルドな言い回しに！
　気を遣ってあげたんだなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess that's just Snow White's
way of trying to keep things
mellow...)

fields.EN:
Still, I suggest you reduce the
general clutter in your room. That
would help keep the bugs in check.
fields.JP:
だけどできれば、部屋にある物は
少なくしたほうがいいですよ。
害虫が隠れられる場所をなくすんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, I suggest you reduce the
general clutter in your room. That
would help keep the bugs in check.

fields.EN:
You need to do something other
than using poison if you really
want to get rid of them for good.
fields.JP:
そうじゃないと、毒団子を置くだけじゃ
根本的な解決にならないというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need to do something other
than using poison if you really
want to get rid of them for good.

fields.JP: 部屋の片づけなんて無理です

fields.EN: It's never too late to start.
fields.JP: 諦めるのは早いですよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's never too late to start.

fields.EN:
But, can you imagine what
would happen if one of those
roaches appeared during cleaning?
fields.JP:
無理です。だって片づけの最中に、
物陰からあの害虫が飛び出してきたら
どうするんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, can you imagine what
would happen if one of those
roaches appeared during cleaning?

fields.JP: そ、それは……たしかに怖いです

fields.EN:
Right? The reason I don't clean
my room is because I'm scared
of them.
fields.JP:
そうでしょう？
わらわが部屋を片付けられないのは、
害虫が怖いからなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? The reason I don't clean
my room is because I'm scared
of them.

fields.EN:
(She's lying...
That's not the reason why
she can't clean her room.)
fields.JP:
（絶対嘘だ。かぐやが部屋を片付けられない
　理由は、それじゃないと思う……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's lying...
That's not the reason why
she can't clean her room.)

fields.EN:
Poor Kaguya-san!
To think that you can't clean your
room because of those vermin!
fields.JP:
害虫が怖くて部屋を片付けられないなんて、
かぐやさん、かわいそうです……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Poor Kaguya!
To think that you can't clean your
room because of those vermin!

fields.EN:
Understood...
Let me show you how to make
"Super Roach Poison" then!
fields.JP:
……わかりました。
この毒団子よりもさらに強力な、
『Ｇ滅殺毒団子・改』の作り方をお教えします！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood...
Let me show you how to make
"Super Roach Poison" then!

fields.EN:
(That sounds horrible!
Did Shirayuki really come up
with that name?)
fields.JP:
（なんか物騒なネーミング来た！
　っていうか、白雪がその名称考えたのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That sounds horrible!
Did Snow White really come up
with that name?)

fields.EN:
"Super Roach Poison?!"
That sounds quite potent.
fields.JP:
『Ｇ滅殺毒団子・改』……！？
なんだかすごく効きそうな感じです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Super Roach Poison?!"
That sounds quite potent.

fields.EN:
Kaguya-san, let me explain
how to make it. First...
fields.JP:
ではかぐやさん、『Ｇ滅殺毒団子・改』の
作り方を説明しますね。まず最初に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me explain how you make it.
First you...

fields.EN:
(Kaguya's taking notes? She's not
faking that? She must really hate
those roaches...)
fields.JP:
（おお、あのかぐやが真剣にメモを取っている。
　メモを取っているふりじゃなくて……。
　よっぽど切実なんだなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya's taking notes? She's not
faking that? She must really hate
those roaches...)

fields.EN:
There you have it...
That's how you make it.
fields.JP: ……と、このような方法で作ることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you have it...
That's how you make it.

fields.EN:
I see. I'm very surprised you
use "that" ingredient to make it.
fields.JP:
そうなんですね。
まさかそんな意外な材料を使うなんて、
目からウロコです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. I'm very surprised you
use "that" ingredient to make it.

fields.JP: （意外な材料？　……なにを使うんだ？）

fields.EN:
If possible, can you make one
now so that I can see what it
will end up like?
fields.JP:
でも実物を見ないとよくわからないので、
一度作ってもらっていいですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If possible, can you make one
now so that I can see what it
will end up like?

fields.EN:
(I take that back. Kaguya is lazy.
She's going to make Shirayuki
make it...)
fields.JP:
（あ、白雪に作ってもらって楽するつもりだ、
　これ。そんなに切実じゃなかった。
　しかもよく見ればメモも書いてなさげ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I take that back. Kaguya is lazy.
She's going to make Snow White
make it...)

fields.EN:
You want to see one in the making?
I suppose you should see one made
to truly understand.
fields.JP:
実物ですか……、わかりました。
たしかに説明を聞いただけじゃ
作れないかもしれませんよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You want to see one in the making?
I suppose you should see one made
to truly understand.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much.
Heh heh... That should get rid of
every one of them...
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
ふふふ、これで一匹残らず殲滅です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much.
Heh heh... That should get rid of
every one of them...

fields.EN:
I can guarantee it'll work!
Let's do our best killing them!
fields.JP:
『Ｇ滅殺毒団子・改』なら絶対効きますよ。
がんばって殺しましょうね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can guarantee it'll work!
Let's do our best killing them!

fields.EN:
Yes, we will eradicate them
into oblivion... Heh heh...
fields.JP:
はい。必ず息の根を止めてやりましょう～
ふふふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we will eradicate them
into oblivion... Heh heh...

fields.EN:
(I can't believe how casually they
talk about killing and things.
They're starting to scare me...)
fields.JP:
（話し方はほのぼのしてるのに、
　話してる内容は怖い！　むしろ二人の
　害虫への殺意が地味に怖い！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe how casually they
talk about killing and things.
They're starting to scare me...)

fields.EN:
(I'm interested in the ingredient
Kaguya mentioned, but I better
not get too involved...)
fields.JP:
（意外な材料っていうのは気になるけど、
　知らないでいたほうが身のためかもな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm interested in the ingredient
Kaguya mentioned, but I better
not get too involved...)

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime's still not here...
I thought I told her it's
something important...)
fields.JP:
（大事な話し合いがあるっていうのに、
　時間になってもかぐや姫が来ない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya's still not here...
I thought I told her it's
something important...)

fields.EN:
(Everyone got tired of waiting—some angry,
some worried, and eventually they even played
games to kill time. It's all fallen apart.)
fields.JP:
（待ちくたびれたみんなは怒るやら
　心配するやら、しまいにはヒマつぶしに
　ゲームまで始める始末。もうぐだぐだだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone is so bored waiting that
they're starting to do their own
things. What a waste of time...)

fields.EN:
(I better go and check on Kaguyahime.
Let's see what she has to say...)
fields.JP:
（仕方がないので、僕がかぐや姫の部屋
　まで様子を見に行くことになった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better go and check on Kaguya.
Let's see what she has to say...)

fields.EN: Thanks for coming with me, Jack.
fields.JP: 付き合ってくれてありがとう、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks for coming with me, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
おづう、だぎぎ……べん……ぎぎぎ

fields.EN:
Thanks for caring.
You're a great guy, you know that?
fields.JP:
ああ、僕の苦労をわかってくれるんだね。
なんて優しい奴なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for caring.
You're a great guy, you know that?

fields.EN:
Kaguya.
What's taking you so long?
fields.JP: かぐやー。もう話し合いの時間すぎてるぞー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya.
What's taking you so long?

fields.EN:
(No reply... Don't tell me she
got sick and collapsed inside her room?)
fields.JP:
（返事がない……。
　まさか具合が悪くなって部屋の中で
　倒れてるんじゃないだろうな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No reply...
Maybe she's so sick that
she can't leave her room...)

fields.EN:
Kaguya? Are you in there?
I'm coming in.
fields.JP: かぐやー、いるんだろー？　開けるぞー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya? Are you in there?
I'm coming in.

fields.EN:
Wha-?!
She's down on her bed!
fields.JP:
はっ！
かぐやがベッドの上に倒れてる……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?!
She's down on her bed!

fields.JP: って、違う！　ただ寝てるだけだ！

fields.EN:
Kaguya, wake up.
Come on now.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, wake up.
Come on now.

fields.EN:
You can't be serious!
Most people ask for five minutes,
not five hours!
fields.JP:
ずいぶん大胆な時間を要求してくるね！？
普通そこは五分とかだろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't be serious!
Most people ask for five minutes,
not five hours!

fields.EN:
But... So sleepy...
The pillow is so soft and comfy...
fields.JP:
だって、眠くて……。
この低反発枕が気持ちよすぎるんです～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... So sleepy...
The pillow is so soft and comfy...

fields.EN:
Oh, you're using it?
I didn't notice it since it's so
clean.
fields.JP:
あ、その枕使ってくれてたんだ。
きれいになってたから気づかなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're using it?
I didn't notice it since it's so
clean.

fields.EN:
I washed, dried, then wrapped a
clean towel around it. It feels so
good that I can sleep forever.
fields.JP:
洗って乾かして、きれいな布を巻きつけ
ましたからね～。もう寝心地がよすぎて、
毎晩永眠しちゃいそうです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I washed, dried, then wrapped a
clean towel around it. It feels so
good that I can sleep forever.

fields.EN:
I hope you don't...
Well, I'm just happy you like
it so much.
fields.JP:
はは、永眠は困るな。
でもそこまで気に入ってもらえると
思わなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope you don't...
Well, I'm just happy you like
it so much.

fields.EN:
It won't let me go...
So please, let me sleep for
another six hours...
fields.JP:
もうこの枕と離れられないんです～。
そういうわけなので、あと六時間
寝かせてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It won't let me go...
So please, let me sleep for
another six hours...

fields.EN:
No!
And, no adding to the time!
fields.JP:
だから駄目だって！
何気にさっきより一時間増えてるし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No!
And, no adding to the time!

fields.EN:
I know I should wake up...
But, this is my very best
trying to get myself up...
fields.JP:
わらわだって、これじゃいけないと
思ってるんです～。これでも懸命に
起きようとしてるんですけど～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I should wake up...
But, this is my very best
trying to get myself up...

fields.EN:
That's your best?
Come on, wake up already.
fields.JP:
全然起きれてないじゃん……。
ほら、いい加減起きて
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's your best?
Come on, wake up already.

fields.EN:
Aah... The pillow conforms to my
head beautifully...
I don't want to get up...
fields.JP:
ああ、この甘美な頭のフィット感が
堪りません～。まだ起きたくないです～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah... The pillow conforms to my
head beautifully...
I don't want to get up...

fields.EN:
Otsuu, please~. Go take part
in the discussion as my proxy~.
fields.JP:
おつう、お願いです～。
わらわの代理として、話し合いに
参加してきてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Please...
Can you have the discussion
without me...?

fields.EN:
I'm also a bit thirsty,
so bring me a glass of water...
fields.JP:
あと喉が渇いてきたので、
お水を持ってきてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm also a bit thirsty,
so bring me a glass of water...

fields.EN:
Please don't use me as your
gofer...
fields.JP: 僕をパシらせないでほしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't use me as your
gofer...

fields.EN: Jack-san, can you get me water?
fields.JP: じゃあ、ジャックさんでもいいですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, can you get me water?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
かぐや、ジャックを無駄に困らせないで

fields.EN:
(She's even lazier than before...
There's no way she'll join in
this state...)
fields.JP:
（普段のグータラに拍車がかかってる……。
　こんな状態じゃ話し合いに参加させるのは
　無理そうだな。はぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's even lazier than before...
There's no way she'll join in
this state...)

fields.EN: You must really like that pillow.
fields.JP: その枕、よっぽど気に入ったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: You must really like that pillow.

fields.EN:
Why yes...
I can't let it go...
fields.JP: はい～。もう離れられません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes...
I can't let it go...

fields.EN:
I guess I can let you go...
I know you'll carry your load,
so enjoy your sleep for today.
fields.JP:
まぁ、そこまで言うなら今日のところは
いいや。かぐやはやるときはやってくれるから、
今は寝ていなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I can let you go...
I know you'll carry your load,
so enjoy your sleep for today.

fields.EN:
I knew you'd understand, Otsuu...
Thank you...
fields.JP: おつうは理解がありますね～。助かります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew you'd understand, Otsuu...
Thank you...

fields.EN:
And while you're helping me,
could you go to the bathroom in my
place~? I'm about to wet myself~.
fields.JP:
助かるついでに、わらわの代わりに
お手洗いに行ってきてくれませんか～？
もう漏れちゃいそうで～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, before you go, do you mind
taking me to the bathroom?
I think I'm going to leak...

fields.JP: いや、それは自分で行って

fields.EN:
Oyayubi, it's me.
Do you mind if I come in?
fields.JP: 親指……僕だけど、入っていい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina, it's me.
Do you mind if I come in?

fields.JP:
おつう？
……いいわよ。入って

fields.EN:
What's the matter?
Is there something you need?
fields.JP: どうしたの？　何か用？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?
Is there something you need?

fields.EN:
Nothing in particular.
I just stopped by since I happened
to be around.
fields.JP:
いや、用があるわけじゃないんだけど
近くまで来たから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing in particular.
I just stopped by since I happened
to be around.

fields.JP: そう……まぁ、ちょうどいいわ

fields.EN:
For something I wanted to say
to you.
fields.JP:
あんたが用はなくても、
こっちにはあるってことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For something I wanted to say
to you.

fields.EN:
Now that's unusual,
you wanting to speak with me.
fields.JP:
君が僕と話をしたいだなんて、
珍しいこともあるものだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that's unusual,
you wanting to speak with me.

fields.EN: Is that supposed to be sarcastic?
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that supposed to be sarcastic?

fields.EN:
Not at all.
I'm actually quite honored.
fields.JP:
ふざけてなんかいないさ。
光栄だと言ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all.
I'm actually quite honored.

fields.EN:
So, what it is that you wanted
to say?
fields.JP: それで、いったいどんな話なのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what it is that you wanted
to say?

fields.EN: I-I'm sorry about the last time!
fields.JP: こ、この間は悪かったわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I'm sorry about the last time!

fields.EN:
(Is it about what happened at
the Art Alley area?)
fields.JP: （ああ、旧芸術通りエリアでのことか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is it about what happened at
the Art Alley area?)

fields.EN:
I know I wasn't in the best
condition, but still, I spoke
too harsh to you then...
fields.JP:
こっちも余裕がなかったとはいえ、
ちょっと強く言い過ぎたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I wasn't in the best
condition, but still, I spoke
too harsh to you then...

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm sorry. I was just taken
aback that you would apologize
to me like this.
fields.JP:
ああ、ごめん。
そんな風に素直に謝罪されるとは、
思ってもみなかったから、ついね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm sorry. I was just taken
aback that you would apologize
to me like this.

fields.EN:
But, now I know that you're
finally the Oyayubi that
I used to know.
fields.JP:
でも、やっと僕の知っている親指に
戻ったように感じるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, now I know that you're
finally the Thumbelina that
I used to know.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: あなたの知ってるわたし……？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
You were always the brash type,
but you were never suspicious
of things like that.
fields.JP:
昔の君は少しキツイところはあったけど、
あそこまで疑心暗鬼じゃなかった気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were always the brash type,
but you were never suspicious
of things like that.

fields.EN:
Sorry, but I can't talk to you
much about what happened yet...
fields.JP:
……ごめん。
今は……まだ言えない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, but I can't talk to you
much about what happened yet...

fields.EN: I want to trust you, but...
fields.JP:
おつうのことは、信じたいと思ってる
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED: I want to trust you, but...

fields.EN:
Because I was with Dawn...
even though it's gone now?
fields.JP: 滅びたとはいえ、黎明だったから……か
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even though it's gone, I am
still a member of Dawn, right?

fields.EN:
So many things happened in
the Order after Chiaki's passing.
fields.JP:
初代陽司の千昭が死んでから、
タイヨウ教団にも色々あったのよ
そう、いろいろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So many things happened in
the Order after Chiaki's passing.

fields.EN:
I'll talk a bit more on it once
I can get my mind settled.
fields.JP:
いつか、心の整理がついたら
ちゃんと話すわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll talk a bit more on it once
I can get my mind settled.

fields.EN:
(Which means that she doesn't
want me to ask her any further...)
fields.JP: （つまり、今は聞かないでってことか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Which means that she doesn't
want me to ask her any further...)

fields.JP: ああ、いくらでも待つさ

fields.EN:
(I'm not used to seeing her
apologize so often...
She's taking me off guard.)
fields.JP:
（そんな風に急に素直になられると、
　こっちも調子が狂ってしまうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not used to seeing her
apologize so often...
She's taking me off guard.)

fields.EN:
By the way, how do you like
everyone here? Pretty interesting
crew, isn't it?
fields.JP:
そうだ。新しい仲間たちとはどう？
みんな個性的で面白いだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, how do you like
everyone here? Pretty interesting
crew, isn't it?

fields.JP:
個性的ね。
ずいぶん遠慮した言い方じゃない

fields.EN:
I can at least say that they're
a reliable bunch.
fields.JP:
でも、そうね。
頼りになるとは思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can at least say that they're
a reliable bunch.

fields.EN:
I don't have the smarts as
Gretel does.
fields.JP:
悔しいけど、グレーテルには
頭で敵いそうもないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have the smarts as
Gretel does.

fields.EN:
When it comes to sheer strength
Hameln is top-notch. Too bad
she's a bit loose on the top.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンも強さだけなら申し分ない
……バカだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
When it comes to sheer strength
Hameln is top-notch. Too bad
she's a bit loose on the top.

fields.EN:
She also reminds me a bit of
Aka-nee.
fields.JP: それに、なんだか赤姉を思い出すわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She also reminds me a bit of
sister Red.

fields.EN:
Hameln is straightforward and open.
She's always trying to protect her friends...
That's probably what makes them alike.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンは、裏表がなくて真っ直ぐだ。
いつだって仲間を守ろうとしてくれる……
たぶん、そういうところが似てるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln is straightforward, and
always helps her friends. Those
qualities remind me of sister Red.

fields.EN:
I know I just said I can't
fully trust you, but...
fields.JP:
その、信じきれないとか
言っておいてなんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I just said I can't
fully trust you, but...

fields.EN:
I'm just happy that nothing has
changed with you and Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
おつうや人魚姫は変わってない。
……嬉しかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just happy that nothing has
changed with you and Little
Mermaid.

fields.EN:
I promise you that I won't change,
ever. I also promise you that
I will win your trust.
fields.JP:
なら、約束しよう。
何があっても僕は僕のままでいる。
そしていつか君の信頼を取り戻すと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promise you that I won't change,
ever. I also promise you that
I will win your trust.

fields.EN:
Y-You better keep that promise!
Make me trust you, you hear?
fields.JP: そ、そうよ！　せいぜいがんばんなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You better keep that promise!
Make me trust you, you hear?

fields.EN:
(Is that... Oyayubi?
Who is she with? Is it someone
we saved the last time?)
fields.JP:
（あれは……親指？　
　一緒にいる女性は誰だろう？　
　この間救出した人かな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that... Thumbelina?
Who is she with? Is it someone
we saved the last time?)

fields.EN:
Don't worry.
The sun always looks over us.
fields.JP:
何も心配することなどありません。
タイヨウはいつでもわたし達を
見守ってくれています
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry.
The sun always looks over us.

fields.EN:
As with its warm light, you too
seek solace and peace as you wait
for the coming.
fields.JP:
あの暖かな光のように
あなたも穏やかにその時を
待っていてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
As with its warm light, you too
seek solace and peace as you wait
for the coming.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much.
I will do my best to see the
sun once again.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
タイヨウをもう一度見るまで
頑張ってみます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much.
I will do my best to see the
sun once again.

fields.JP:
わぁっ！？
あ、あんた見てたの！？

fields.EN:
She wanted to join the Order,
so after giving her our teachings,
I was going to show her around.
fields.JP:
……今の人は入団希望者よ。
教団の教えを説いていたの。
今度、連れていって案内するつもりよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She wanted to join the Order,
so after giving her our teachings,
I was going to show her around.

fields.EN:
I see.
Sorry to surprise you like this.
fields.JP:
そうなんだ
驚かせてごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see.
Sorry to surprise you like this.

fields.EN:
I don't mind, but next time let me
know you're here.
fields.JP:
別にいいけど……。
あんたこそ、見てないで声かけなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't mind, but next time let me
know you're here.

fields.EN:
Well, you seemed different from
usual, so I couldn't help staring.
fields.JP:
いやぁ、親指がなんだか普段と違うから
つい見とれてしまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I wasn't sure if I could
bother you. After all, you weren't
acting like yourself there.

fields.EN:
Hmph... I bet you thought
I was out of place there.
fields.JP:
ふん、どうせ似合ってないとか
思ってたんでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... I bet you thought
I was out of place there.

fields.JP: そ、そんなことないって

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. I have roles
here, and I can't be acting like
how I usually do.
fields.JP:
仕方ないでしょ。
こっちにも立場があるんだから。
普段通りってわけにはいかないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped. I have roles
here, and I can't be acting like
how I usually do.

fields.EN: I see. It must be quite tiring.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. It must be quite tiring.

fields.EN:
Honestly, I'm still not used to
this. In a way, it's easier
fighting Marchens.
fields.JP:
正直、未だに教団の活動には慣れないわ。
ある意味メルヒェンと戦ってる方がラクね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, I'm still not used to
this. In a way, it's easier
fighting Marchens.

fields.EN:
Then again, it's not that I don't
like doing this as long as it
helps everyone here.
fields.JP:
でも、この活動も悪くないと思ってるのよ
実際、みんなの助けになってるわけだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, it's not that I don't
like doing this as long as it
helps everyone here.

fields.EN:
Fighting isn't only about defeating
Marchens. Doing this made me realize there
are other ways to protect people's hearts.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンを倒すだけが戦いじゃない。
人の心を守る方法は他にもあるんだって、
この活動をしていて気づかされたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting Marchens isn't
everything. The Order made me see
that there are other ways to help.

fields.JP: メルヒェンを倒す以外の戦いか……

fields.EN:
Oh and Lady Oohime...
I guess I can call her "Michiru"
in front of you.
fields.JP:
まぁ、あと大陽女……
って、あんたの前ならミチルでいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh and Lady Oohime...
I guess I can call her "Michiru"
in front of you.

fields.EN:
It also helps to know that
Michiru's words almost
always come true...
fields.JP:
ミチルの訳分かんない予言が、
よく当たるのも事実だしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also helps to know that
Michiru's words almost
always come true...

fields.EN:
I haven't thought about it before,
but are her omens that accurate?
fields.JP:
正直、僕にはぴんとこないんだけど、
そんなに当たるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't thought about it before,
but are her omens that accurate?

fields.JP: あんたの気持ちもわかるわ

fields.EN:
We were able to get away from
that Nightmare because of
Michiru.
fields.JP:
でも、あのナイトメアから逃げられたのも
ミチルの予言のおかげなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were able to get away from
that Nightmare because of
Michiru.

fields.EN:
Michiru was acting really weird
a short while before the
Nightmare struck.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアが襲ってくる直前、
ミチルの様子がおかしくなったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru was acting really weird
a short while before the
Nightmare struck.

fields.EN:
She was pale, shaking, and scared
out of her wits. It was then she
asked that we all leave the area.
fields.JP:
顔面蒼白で何かに怯えるように震えて……
ともかく、すぐにここから離れようって
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was pale, shaking, and scared
out of her wits. It was then she
asked that we all leave the area.

fields.EN:
But it was too late...
We simply didn't have time to help
everyone in the Liberated District.
fields.JP:
でも、間に合わなかった。
解放地区の住民までは手が回らなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it was too late...
We simply didn't have time to help
everyone in the Liberated District.

fields.JP: 親指たちの責任じゃないよ

fields.EN:
I guess so...
But, we could have helped...
fields.JP:
そうね……そうかもしれない。
でも、もしかしたら助けられたかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess so...
But, we could have helped...

fields.EN:
You may be thinking that you
weren't able to save them, but
if so, you got it all wrong.
fields.JP:
解放地区の人たちを救えなかった。
君はそう思ってるかもしれないけど、
それは間違いだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be thinking that you
weren't able to save them, but
if so, you got it all wrong.

fields.EN:
You were able to save the Order.
Everyone there is alive now.
That's a fact.
fields.JP:
君たちのおかげでタイヨウ教団の人たちは、
こうして無事に生きている。
それだけが間違いない事実だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were able to save the Order.
Everyone there is alive now.
That's a fact.

fields.EN:
Thinking "what if..." will
only drive you into a corner.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら……なんて考えるのは、
自分を追い詰めるだけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wanting to save everyone, and
wishing you could've done more
will hurt you more than anything.

fields.EN:
We sisters made it out alive, so
we're going to have to become the
beacon of hope for the survivors.
fields.JP:
わたしたち姉妹は生き残った。
せめて今生きてる人たちの希望となるように、
隙を見せずしっかりしないといけないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We sisters made it out alive, so
we're going to have to become the
beacon of hope for the survivors.

fields.EN:
I'm sure all will go well the
next time. We'll make sure we
save everyone.
fields.JP: ああ、次はしくじらない。……必ず救う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure all will go well the
next time. We'll make sure we
save everyone.

fields.EN:
I guess we'll just have to each
do our best.
fields.JP: お互いやれるだけのことはやりましょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we'll just have to each
do our best.

fields.EN:
Of course.
I'm counting on you, Oyayubi.
fields.JP:
ああ、もちろん。
頼りにしてるよ、親指
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course.
I'm counting on you, Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
Ugh... H-Hmph! If you're going to
say that much, I guess I have no choice!
fields.JP:
うっ……ふ、ふん！
そこまで言われたら仕方ないわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... H-Hmph!
I guess I can do my best,
just for you!

fields.EN:
(A beacon of hope... I guess being
in the Order changed her in
a number of ways...)
fields.JP:
（人々の希望として隙は見せられない、か。
　親指が以前と少し変わったのは、
　教団という環境のせいかもしれないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A beacon of hope... I guess being
in the Order changed her in
a number of ways...)

fields.EN:
(I wonder what Oyayubi
and the girls went through.)
fields.JP: （親指たちになにがあったのか気になる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what Thumbelina
and the girls went through.)

fields.EN:
(I think I'll talk with her again.
If that won't work, then I'll just
have to wait until she's ready.)
fields.JP:
（もう一度、聞いてみよう。
　それで、ダメだったら今度こそ、
　親指が話してくれるまで待つことにする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think I'll talk with her again.
If that won't work, then I'll just
have to wait until she's ready.)

fields.EN:
Oyayubi, it's me. I want to
talk to you for a bit. Is that okay?
fields.JP:
親指、僕だよ。
ちょっと話があるんだけど、いいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's me.
Do you mind I come in?

fields.EN:
Hi there, Oyayubi.
Sorry to barge in all of a
sudden.
fields.JP:
やあ、親指。
いきなり押しかけてすまない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hi there, Thumbelina.
Sorry to barge in all of a
sudden.

fields.EN:
No problem.
So, what is it?
fields.JP:
別に構わないわよ。
それで、話って何かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem.
So, what is it?

fields.EN:
I recall we didn't talk much
about what happened after
you joined the Order.
fields.JP:
この間、きみから聞けなかった、
タイヨウ教団へ行った後のこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I recall we didn't talk much
about what happened after
you joined the Order.

fields.EN:
You said you'd talk about it
once your mind was settled,
right?
fields.JP:
心の整理がついたら話してくれるって、
そう言っていたよね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said you'd talk about it
once your mind was settled,
right?

fields.EN:
I know it's a bit brash that
I ask about it like this.
fields.JP:
こうやって僕の方から尋ねるのは、
スマートじゃないとは思ったんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's a bit brash that
I ask about it like this.

fields.EN:
But, I wanted to hear what you
had to say.
fields.JP: でも、聞かせてほしいんだ。君のこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I wanted to hear what you
had to say.

fields.EN:
Fine...
I guess I can talk.
fields.JP:
……しょうがないわね。
話してあげるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
I guess I can talk.

fields.EN:
Just for the record, it isn't
because I trust you, got it?!
fields.JP:
別に、あんたのこと信用してるからとか、
そういう理由じゃないんだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just for the record, it isn't
because I trust you, got it?!

fields.EN:
Sure you may still be under
Dawn, but... you're a comrade
in battle and... Um...
fields.JP:
黎明のことはともかく、
今は一緒に戦う仲間なわけで……
だから、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure you may still be under
Dawn, but... you're a comrade
in battle and... Um...

fields.EN:
Oh, right!
It's just my way of showing you
respect!
fields.JP:
えっと……そう！
わたしなりの誠意ってやつよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, right!
It's just my way of showing you
respect!

fields.EN:
Sure, whatever you say.
You're free to take your time
finding trust in me.
fields.JP:
今は、それでもいいよ。
ゆっくり見極めてくれればいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, whatever you say.
You're free to take your time
finding trust in me.

fields.JP: とはいえ、どこから話せばいいかしらね……

fields.EN:
Let's see...
So, everything started with
Chiaki's death...
fields.JP:
そう、きっかけは陽司のちー……
千昭が殺されたことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see...
So, everything started with
Chiaki's death...

fields.EN:
With his passing, the Order went
into chaos. Some even sought to
kill Michiru amid the confusion.
fields.JP:
陽司を失った教団は大混乱に陥ったわ。
中にはミチルの存在を否定して、
命を狙おうとする者たちも現われた
fields.LOCALIZED:
With his passing, the Order went
into chaos. Some even sought to
kill Michiru amid the confusion.

fields.EN:
But, you know Michiru...
The situation didn't even phase
her...
fields.JP:
それでも、ミチルはあんなんだから、
ちっとも気にしてなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you know Michiru...
The situation didn't even phase
her...

fields.EN:
I was worried as heck. Michiru
is like family to me. There's no
way I would leave her alone.
fields.JP:
わたし、心配で。
だって放っておけるわけないじゃない。
ミチルは、家族同然なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was worried as heck. Michiru
is like family to me. There's no
way I would leave her alone.

fields.EN:
Why didn't you discuss it with
the professor or the others in
Dawn?
fields.JP: だったら博士や黎明の皆に相談すれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why didn't you discuss it with
the professor or the others in
Dawn?

fields.EN:
I talked with the professor.
You want to know what he said?
fields.JP:
わたし、博士に相談したの。
そしたらなんて言われたと思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I talked with the professor.
You want to know what he said?

fields.EN:
He said that we shouldn't get
involved with the Order of the Sun
any more.
fields.JP:
もう、教団に関わらない方がいいって、
そう言われたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that we shouldn't get
involved with the Order of the Sun
any more.

fields.EN:
Like I'd listen to that!
The Order raised me there!
fields.JP:
そんなこと、できるわけないじゃない。
あそこは、わたし達が育った場所なのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I'd listen to that!
The Order raised me there!

fields.EN:
He knows that and he still told
me to turn a blind eye... He told
me to let go of my home...
fields.JP:
なのに、関わるなって……
育った場所を捨てろってことじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
He knows that and he still told
me to turn a blind eye... He told
me to let go of my home...

fields.JP: それで、黎明を離れたのか

fields.EN:
The biggest reason why I left
was because I thought
Cinderella killed him.
fields.JP:
一番の理由はね、ちーを殺した犯人が
シンデレラだって思ったからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The biggest reason why I left
was because I thought
Cinderella killed him.

fields.EN:
I thought she spat on my trust,
and destroyed the Order...
fields.JP:
あんなに信頼していたシンデレラに
教団がめちゃくちゃにされた……。
と思ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought she spat on my trust,
and destroyed the Order...

fields.EN:
It felt like everyone I trusted
went against me.
fields.JP:
信じてたもの全部に
裏切られた気分だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It felt like everyone I trusted
went against me.

fields.EN:
I thought that Dawn wasn't the
place for me, which is why us
sisters returned to the Order.
fields.JP:
もう黎明にはいられないと思った。
だから、妹たちを連れて教団に戻ったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought that Dawn wasn't the
place for me, which is why us
sisters returned to the Order.

fields.EN:
It was tough. Michiru suddenly
appointed each one of us to be
the next Hitsuka.
fields.JP:
……教団に戻ってからも大変だったわ。
ミチルったら、いきなりわたし達を
次の陽司に指名するんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was tough. Michiru suddenly
appointed each one of us to be
the next Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
I know I'm not the type to lead
people, but then again, we needed
to bring peace back to the Order.
fields.JP:
がらじゃないのはわかってたけどね。
教団の混乱をおさめるためにも、
わたしたちがやるしかなかったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm not the type to lead
people, but then again, we needed
to bring peace back to the Order.

fields.EN:
It was tiring trying to hold
a front worthy of a Hitsuka.
fields.JP:
本当に大変だったわ。
人前では常に陽司らしく振る舞わなくちゃ
いけないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was tiring trying to hold
a front worthy of a Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
We also had to help Michiru,
especially with how nonchalant
she was with what was happening.
fields.JP:
危機感が足りないミチル達の世話も
しなくちゃいけないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
We also had to help Michiru,
especially with how nonchalant
she was with what was happening.

fields.EN:
Then we had a bunch of guys who
tried to dethrone Michiru as the
leader of the Order.
fields.JP:
ここぞとばかりに、ミチルから教祖の座を
奪おうとするやつらとか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we had a bunch of guys who
tried to dethrone Michiru as the
leader of the Order.

fields.EN:
Some started to pester us sisters
because they didn't like us.
fields.JP:
わたし達姉妹が気に入らないからって、
嫌がらせしてくるやつもいたりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some started to pester us sisters
because they didn't like us.

fields.EN:
Well, for people like that,
I skillfully redirected the
Order's resentment toward Dawn...
fields.JP:
まあ、そういう不埒な連中には
教団の中にある黎明への反感を、
こう上手いこと誘導して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't imagine what I had to do
to get rid of them. I used dirty
tactics that I'm not proud of.

fields.EN: I guess you went through a lot.
fields.JP: な、なかなか苦労してきたみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess you went through a lot.

fields.EN:
Well, I know my means weren't the
best, but I really didn't have
much of an option...
fields.JP:
褒められたやり方じゃないってことは、
わたしもよく分かってる。
でも、そうするしかなかったのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I know my means weren't the
best, but I really didn't have
much of an option...

fields.EN:
Oh, stop it. There's no need to be
so down on yourself. You did what
you could for everyone.
fields.JP:
そんな顔をしないで。
親指は、必死にみんなを守ろうとしたんだ
恥じ入ることはないさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, stop it. There's no need to be
so down on yourself. You did what
you could for everyone.

fields.EN:
Dawn is no more. There's no one
you need to apologize to. We're
all working off a clean slate now.
fields.JP:
それに、黎明はもうないんだ。
今さら詫びる相手もいない。
つまりは、リセットってことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dawn is no more. There's no one
you need to apologize to. We're
all working off a clean slate now.

fields.EN:
(...Even though I said that... the
Professor and everyone in Dawn are dead,
and the Order is still in turmoil.)
fields.JP:
（……なんて言ってはみたものの。
　博士や黎明のみんなは死んでしまった
　そして教団もいまだ混乱の中にある）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite her words, I'm sure
there's a lot of confusion still
among those in the Order.)

fields.EN:
(Hatred, anger, and sorrow are
still swirling around this place.)
fields.JP:
（憎しみや怒り、そして悲しみは、
　ずっとこの場所で渦巻いたままだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With many dead, anger, hatred,
and sorrow still runs through
their group.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe things wouldn't be how it
is if Hitsuka-san was still alive...)
fields.JP:
（陽司さんが生きてたら、
　こんなことにはならなかったのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe things wouldn't be how it
is if Hitsuka was still alive...)

fields.EN:
Like I always say, be careful
and always be on the lookout
for potential trouble!
fields.JP:
だからいつも言っているでしょ！
白雪はもう少し相手を
疑うことを覚えなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I always say, be careful
and always be on the lookout
for potential trouble!

fields.JP: 親指ちゃんと白雪ちゃん？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is it Thumby and Snow White?

fields.EN:
It sure doesn't look like they're
having a casual talk there...
fields.JP:
姉妹で仲良くおしゃべりしてる……
って雰囲気じゃなさそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sure doesn't look like they're
having a casual talk there...

fields.EN:
That was dangerous!
You never know what can happen,
so always keep your guard up!
fields.JP:
今回は本当に危ないところだったのよ！？
誰がいつ狙ってくるか分からないんだから、
常日頃から気をつけなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was dangerous!
You never know what can happen,
so always keep your guard up!

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama... Shirayuki-neesama is...
sorry too... So... please, that's enough...
fields.JP:
親指姉さま……
白雪姉さまも…………反省してる……
だから……もう、そのくらいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina...
Snow White is... sorry...
Please... Enough...

fields.EN: Looks like Nemu-chan was here, too.
fields.JP: ねむちゃんも一緒だったのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like Sleepy was here, too.

fields.JP: いったい何があったんだ？

fields.EN:
Shirayuki was about to be
framed by an advocate of
the first Hitsuka.
fields.JP:
どうもこうもないわ。
白雪が旧陽司派の信者に絡まれて、
ハメられそうになったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White was about to be
framed by an advocate of
the first Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
There's a number of followers
who say that we're not fit to be
a Hitsuka...
fields.JP:
白雪達は陽司に相応しくないって、
言っている人たちです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's a number of followers
who say that we're not fit to be
a Hitsuka...

fields.EN:
To word it bluntly, they don't
like the idea we were assigned
as a Hitsuka.
fields.JP:
要するに、わたし達が陽司なのが
気に入らない連中のことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To word it bluntly, they don't
like the idea we were assigned
as a Hitsuka.

fields.EN: So, what did this follower do?
fields.JP: それで、その信者は何をしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what did this follower do?

fields.EN:
He asked Shirayuki about
Michiru, while faking that he
didn't know about him.
fields.JP:
ミチルのことを知らないふりした信者が、
白雪にミチルのことを聞いたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He asked Snow White about
Michiru, while faking that he
didn't know about him.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki answered saying that
Michiru was a very mysterious
person.
fields.JP:
それで、白雪はついミチルのことを
「天然で不思議な人」って言ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White answered saying that
Michiru was a very mysterious
person.

fields.JP: それが……なにか問題なの？

fields.EN:
It isn't wrong... but...
can't... say that...
fields.JP:
……間違って……ない……けど、
その……言い方は……ダメ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It isn't wrong... but...
can't... say that...

fields.EN:
Some people say that because we
serve Michiru, it's disrespectful to
treat her like a friend or family.
fields.JP:
わたし達はミチルに仕えてる身だから、
友達や家族のように接するのは不敬だ。
って言う奴がいるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some of the followers say that we
should treat Michiru as an icon,
not like someone close to us.

fields.EN:
What's fresh is that the same guy
came and used Shirayuki's words
to cause a bit of a ruckus.
fields.JP:
今回も同じ。
白雪の言葉尻をつかまえて、
大げさに騒いだやつがいたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's fresh is that the same guy
came and used Snow White's words
to cause a bit of a ruckus.

fields.EN:
That's where Oyayubi-neesama
came in to help calm the
situation.
fields.JP:
そこを親指姉様が収めて、
助けてもらったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's where sister Thumbelina
came in to help calm the
situation.

fields.JP: なんて幼稚な嫌がらせだ

fields.EN:
Right?! But even if they try to
cause a stir, we need to act our
roles as Hitsuka...
fields.JP:
そうよ！　でも、嫌がらせだとしても、
わたし達は陽司として振る舞わなくちゃ
いけないのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right?! But even if they try to
cause a stir, we need to act our
roles as Hitsuka...

fields.EN:
That's why I was telling them
to be careful of what they do and
say.
fields.JP:
だから、常日頃から気をつけなさいって
妹たちには言ってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I was telling them
to be careful of what they do and
say.

fields.EN:
Don't trust anyone coming near
you, and never show any weakness
that they can use, got it?!
fields.JP:
近づいてくる人は先ず疑いなさい！
そして絶対に隙を見せないこと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't trust anyone coming near
you, and never show any weakness
that they can use, got it?!

fields.EN:
And you, Nemu! You too!
If you noticed what was happening
go in to help Shirayuki!
fields.JP:
それからネム！　あんたもよ！
気づいてたんだったら、
しっかり白雪をフォローしなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you, Sleepy! You too!
If you noticed what was happening
go in to help Snow White!

fields.EN:
You need to speak up in order
make others listen to you.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと話さないと、
相手には伝わらないのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need to speak up in order
make others listen to you.

fields.EN:
P-Please don't go so hard on
Nemu-chan...!
fields.JP:
ね、ネムちゃんをあんまり
責めないでください……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please don't go so hard on
Sleepy...!

fields.EN:
Nemu-chan did what she could to
help! Shirayuki is the one to blame!
fields.JP:
ネムちゃんは、ちゃんと
フォローしてくれました！
全部、白雪がどんくさいのが悪いんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She did what she could to help!
Snow White is the one to blame!

fields.EN:
I'm not talking about who was
at fault!
fields.JP:
ちょっと、今は誰が悪いとか
そういう話はしていないわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not talking about who was
at fault!

fields.EN:
A-And, not all the followers are
like that!
fields.JP:
そ、それに！　
ああいう信者さんばかりじゃありません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-And, not all the followers are
like that!

fields.EN:
There are plenty of people who say talking
with Shirayuki and Nemu-chan gave them hope!
fields.JP:
白雪やネムちゃんのお話で希望が持てたって、
言ってくれる人だってたくさんいます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are plenty who say they were
saved after talking with us!

fields.EN:
That's Michiru's job. You're only
going to get in her way if you
can't properly control yourself.
fields.JP:
そういうのはミチルの仕事なの。
余計なことをして、それで足下を
すくわれてたら意味ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's Michiru's job. You're only
going to get in her way if you
can't properly control yourself.

fields.EN:
Anyone saying that they were
saved has got to be lying, and...
fields.JP:
だいたい、わたし達と話して希望を持てた
なんて、そんなの嘘に決まって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyone saying that they were
saved has got to be lying, and...

fields.EN:
Oh, uh...
That's not what I...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh...
That's not what I...

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama... is right...
But... so sad...
fields.JP:
……親指姉さまの……
言う通りかもしれない……
……でも……それは……悲しい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina... is right...
But... so sad...

fields.EN:
That was a bit too harsh there,
Oyayubi-chan.
fields.JP: 親指ちゃん、今のは言いすぎだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was a bit too harsh there,
Thumby.

fields.JP:
……分かってる。
わたし、ひどいこと言っちゃった

fields.EN:
Heh...
I guess that might have put the
nail in the coffin for us sisters.
fields.JP:
あはは……
もう、わたし達三姉妹もお終いかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh...
I guess that might have put the
nail in the coffin for us sisters.

fields.EN:
That's not true!
I'm sure everything will be back
to normal if you apologize.
fields.JP:
……そんなことない！
ちゃんと謝ればきっと仲直りできるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true!
I'm sure everything will be back
to normal if you apologize.

fields.EN:
It's no use... We've been hurting
each other like this all along.
It's all over this time...
fields.JP:
無理よ……今まで何回もこうやって、
傷つけてきたんだもの……
今回ばかりはもう無理よ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use... We've been hurting
each other like this all along.
It's all over this time...

fields.EN:
Actually, maybe this is for the best. If
we relied on each other just because we're
sisters, it would hinder our work as Hitsuka.
fields.JP:
むしろ、これでよかったのかも。
姉妹だからって甘えてたら、
陽司の仕事に差し支えるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess this may have been for the
best. We were each getting in our
way of being a Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
We should go our own separate
ways...
fields.JP: だから、お互い距離を取った方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should go our own separate
ways...

fields.JP: しらゆきとねむねむ、ないてた
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White and Sleepy was crying.

fields.EN:
Um, well, they had a bit of an
argument, that's all.
fields.JP: あのね、いま、ちょっとだけ行き違いが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well, they had a bit of an
argument, that's all.

fields.EN:
Oyayubi said to Rapunzel that
you need say feelings.
fields.JP:
おやゆびは、ラプンツェルにいったよ。
きもちは、すなおにいわなきゃだめだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby said to Rapunzel that
you need say feelings.

fields.EN:
Say sorry if you did bad, and
make friends again after sorry.
fields.JP:
わるいことしたら、ごめんなさいって。
ちゃんとあやまってなかなおりしなさいって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say sorry if you did bad, and
make friends again after sorry.

fields.EN:
How come Oyayubi no say sorry?
Was that lie, Oyayubi?
fields.JP:
どうしておやゆびはあやまらないの！　
おやゆびがいったことはうそだったの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How come Thumby no say sorry?
Was that lie, Thumby?

fields.JP: ラプンツェルの言うとおりだ

fields.EN:
Wanting to fill the role of a
Hitsuka, and wanting to apologize
are your honest feelings, right?
fields.JP:
陽司の仕事が大事だという気持ちと、
二人に謝りたい気持ち。
親指にとってどっちも素直な気持ちだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
