fields.JP:
ダ、ダイエットはしていない……？
食事制限は？　運動は？
なにもしていないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're not watching your weight?
You don't watch what you eat,
or exercise?

fields.EN:
It's such a pain in the...
Oh, um... I never saw the need to
do such a thing.
fields.JP:
だって面倒……いえ、その必要を
感じたことはないので。してませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's such a pain in the...
Oh, um... I never saw the need to
do such a thing.

fields.EN:
Genetics... Is it genetics?!
If so, there's nothing I can do!
fields.JP:
体質？　体質ということなんですか？
じゃあ、白雪は絶望的じゃないですか……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Genetics... Is it genetics?!
If so, there's nothing I can do!

fields.EN:
P-Please calm down, Shirayukihime-san.
I really don't think you're fat or anything...
fields.JP:
お、落ち着いてください～
白雪姫さんは、別に太ってないと
思いますけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please, calm down...
I really don't think you're fat
or anything...

fields.EN:
*sob* Please!
You don't have to console me!
fields.JP:
気休めはよしてくださいー！
うっ、ううぅ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sob* Please!
You don't have to console me!

fields.EN:
Uh... This isn't good...
Please don't cry!
fields.JP:
あああ、どうしましょう～！
泣かないでください～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... This isn't good...
Please don't cry!

fields.JP: えっ、ラプンツェルさん？

fields.EN:
Kaguya make Shirayuki cry!
Rapunzel gonna tell!
fields.JP:
かぐやー、しらゆきなかせた！
ラプンツェル、みちゃったーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya make Snow White cry!
Rapunzel gonna tell!

fields.EN:
(Egad, this is only going to
get worse...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Egad, this is only going to
get worse...)

fields.EN:
N-No...
You have this all wrong...
fields.JP: ち、違うんです～、これにはわけが～
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No...
You have this all wrong...

fields.EN:
Kaguya such a meanie!
Shirayuki crying!
fields.JP:
かぐやー、わるいんだー！
しらゆきないてるーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya such a meanie!
Snow White crying!

fields.EN:
P-Please, you have to stop
crying... What to do...?
Um... Uh...
fields.JP:
な、泣かないでください～。
わらわはどうすれば……。
えーと、えーと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please, you have to stop
crying... What to do...?
Um... Uh...

fields.EN:
I-I know! I think Ningyohime-san
is in the know of how to get trim.
fields.JP:
そ、そうです。たぶん人魚姫さんが
スリムの秘訣を知ってると思いますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I know! I think Little Mermaid
is in the know of how to get trim.

fields.JP: ひ、姫、静かにしてないと見つかる……！
あっ、おつうとにんぎょだー！
ああ、ちょうどいいところに……

fields.EN:
Ningyo-chan, please tell me the
secrets in staying slim!
fields.JP:
人魚ちゃん、スリムの秘訣を
教えてください……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid, please tell me the
secrets in staying slim!

fields.JP: わたし、そんなの知らないよー！

fields.EN:
Let's make a run for it before
they drag us into the mess.
fields.JP: 姫、面倒に巻き込まれる前に逃げましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's make a run for it before
they drag us into the mess.

fields.JP: う、うん！　ごめんね、白雪ちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yup!
I'm so sorry, Snow White!

fields.EN:
Hm...?
They're not coming after us...
fields.JP: ……ん？　追って来ないみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...?
They're not coming after us...

fields.EN:
Ah, Hikari-san! You're pretty slim,
aren't you? What do you do to
stay so slim?
fields.JP:
あっ、ヒカリさーん！
ヒカリさんもスリムですよね。
どうやったらその体型を維持できるんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Hikari! You're pretty slim,
aren't you? What do you do to
stay so slim?

fields.EN:
Wh-What is this all of
a sudden?! You're scaring me!
fields.JP:
えええ、いきなりなに！？
怖いんだけどー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! What's this about?!
Stay away from me!

fields.EN:
Ooh... It looks like she found
another target.
fields.JP: あー、別のターゲットを見つけたみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh... It looks like she found
another target.

fields.EN:
Sorry, Hikari...
We'd better leave while we
still can.
fields.JP: ヒカリには悪いけど、今のうちに逃げよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, Hikari...
We'd better leave while we
still can.

fields.JP: （ん？　あそこで言い争ってるのは……）

fields.EN:
No, please, let me!
Shirayuki will fix it good!
fields.JP:
遠慮しないでください。
白雪が縫ってあげますから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, please, let me!
Snow White will fix it good!

fields.EN:
Seriously, it's nothing major.
Don't worry about it.
fields.JP:
いや、本当にいいから。
どうせちょっとなんだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously, it's nothing major.
Don't worry about it.

fields.EN:
Which is why a few stitches will
do the trick. So please, let me
fix it for you!
fields.JP:
ちょっとだからこそ、
ちょっと縫えば直るんですから、
今のうちに直しちゃいましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why a few stitches will
do the trick. So please, let me
fix it for you!

fields.EN:
What are you arguing over?
Something about sewing?
fields.JP:
二人してなんの話だ？
縫うとかどうとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you arguing over?
Something about sewing?

fields.EN:
Oh, Otsuu-chan! I was going to sew
the fray in Aka-neesama's clothes.
fields.JP:
あ、おつうちゃん。赤姉様の服の裾が
ちょっとほつれちゃってるので、
縫ってあげようとしてたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Otsuu! I was going to sew
the fray in sister Red's clothes.

fields.EN:
I'm fine, really. I mean,
I appreciate you wanting to help,
but it's really not worth it...
fields.JP:
別にいいって。申し出はありがたいけど、
なんか……めんどいし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine, really. I mean,
I appreciate you wanting to help,
but it's really not worth it...

fields.EN:
There's no way I can let a fray
go by me! Now please, let me!
fields.JP:
いいえ、ほつれを見つけて
しまったからには放っておけません！
やらせてください！　さあ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way I can let a fray
go by me! Now please, let me!

fields.EN:
(It's not meddling... It's
probably just pure kindness on her part.)
fields.JP:
（おせっかい……じゃなくて、
　ただただ純粋な親切心なんだろうなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know she's just trying to be
helpful, but...)

fields.EN:
Why don't you go ahead and let
her fix it up for you?
fields.JP:
ここまでやってくれるって言ってるんだし、
お言葉に甘えれば？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you go ahead and let
her fix it up for you?

fields.JP: そうですよ。どうぞ甘えてください！

……わかったよ。
んじゃ、やってもらおうかな
では、さっそく縫いますね

fields.EN:
I-I'm fine. I'm sorry.
I just pricked my finger a bit.
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫です。すみません。
ほんの少し針で刺しちゃっただけなんで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm fine. I'm sorry.
I just pricked my finger a bit.

fields.EN:
I'll be done in a jiffy.
Just a little while longer...
fields.JP:
すぐに縫い終わりますから、
待っててくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll be done in a jiffy.
Just a little while longer...

fields.EN:
(She's been pricking herself quite
a lot... It's like she's doing it
at every stitch she makes...)
fields.JP:
（さ、さっきからすごいぶすぶす
　刺してるけど。縫うより指に刺した
　ほうが多いんじゃないか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's been pricking herself quite
a lot... It's like she's doing it
at every stitch she makes...)

fields.JP: ちくちくちく、……と。よし、できました！

fields.EN:
Um, you just stitched my clothing
to your skirt...
fields.JP:
なんか、あたしの服と白雪のスカートが
縫い合わされちゃってるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you just stitched my clothing
to your skirt...

fields.EN:
Whoops! I must've stitched them
together when I had it on my lap.
L-Let me get this fixed!
fields.JP:
あああっ、膝の上に置いてたから
一緒に縫っちゃったみたいです！
す、すみません、すぐ取ります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoops! I must've stitched them
together when I had it on my lap.
L-Let me get this fixed!

fields.EN:
Th-There... I'm so sorry...
Looks like I can't sew something
without getting something wrong.
fields.JP:
と、取りました。すみません。
縫ってあげるなんて張り切ったのに、
こんな結果で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-There... I'm so sorry...
Looks like I can't sew something
without getting something wrong.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki is such a dummy...
I want to help, but all I did was
cause trouble to Aka-neesama...
fields.JP:
白雪は、本当に不器用で駄目な子ですね……。
赤姉様の役に立ちたかったのに、
逆に迷惑かけちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is such a dummy...
I want to help, but all I did was
cause trouble to sister Red...

fields.EN:
No need to get so down on
yourself, Shirayuki. Come on,
say something, Akazukin.
fields.JP:
白雪、そこまで落ち込むことないよ。
赤ずきんも、そう思うだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to get so down on
yourself, Snow White. Come on,
say something, Red Riding Hood.

fields.JP: くくくっ、……あははははっ！

fields.EN:
Huh? Wh-Why are you laughing?
Did I say something funny?
fields.JP:
え？　え？　どうして笑うんですか？
なにかおかしなことでも言いましたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Wh-Why are you laughing?
Did I say something funny?

fields.EN:
So sorry! I was laughing because
of how much of a klutz you are.
Whew, that was funny...
fields.JP:
ははっ、ごめんごめん！
白雪の不器用っぷりがあんまりおかしくてさ。
いやー、笑った笑った
fields.LOCALIZED:
So sorry! I was laughing because
of how much of a klutz you are.
Whew, that was funny...

fields.JP: お、おかしいって……。怒ってないんですか？

fields.EN:
Why would I be angry? I know you're
trying to be helpful here. I'm
happy you're doing this for me.
fields.JP:
怒るわけないじゃん。白雪が親切心で
やってくれようとしたことなんだからさ。
むしろ嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why would I be angry? I know you're
trying to be helpful here. I'm
happy you're doing this for me.

fields.EN: Akazukin, even though you refused at first...
fields.JP: 赤ずきん、最初は断ってたくせに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not making it obvious
if you're refusing her help.

fields.EN:
I figured it wasn't much, but
I changed my mind after seeing
how earnest she was about it.
fields.JP:
これくらい別に縫わなくたっていいと
思ってたけど、白雪ががんばる姿見てたら、
なんか気が変わった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I figured it wasn't much, but
I changed my mind after seeing
how earnest she was about it.

fields.EN:
Aka-neesama, would you let me
try again? I'll do better this time!
fields.JP:
赤姉様、もう一度やらせてくれませんか？
今度はうまくやりますから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will you please let me try again?
I'll do it right this time!

fields.JP: いいよ。もー気の済むまでやっちゃって

fields.EN: Thank you! I'll do my best!
fields.JP: はい！　がんばります！
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you! I'll do my best!

fields.EN:
(Looks like Shirayuki's
clumsiness helped to bring a smile
back on Akazukin's face.)
fields.JP:
（よかった。白雪のおっちょこちょいが
　赤ずきんの沈みがちな気持ちを
　少し元気づけてくれたみたいだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like Snow White's
clumsiness helped to bring a smile
back on Red Riding Hood's face.)

fields.EN: Hey, Nemuri? Are you in there?
fields.JP: おーい、眠りー。いるかー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Sleepy? Are you in there?

fields.JP: あ、よかった。いたんだな
……おつう……おはよう、ございます……

fields.EN:
Good morning, Nemuri.
Not that it's the time of day
to be saying this though...
fields.JP:
おはよう、眠り。
まぁ、おはようっていう時間でもないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning, Sleepy.
Not that it's the time of day
to be saying this though...

fields.EN:
I just happened by, so I wanted
see if you're doing fine.
fields.JP:
部屋の前を通りかかったから、
様子を見て行こうかと思ったんだ。
ちょっと心配だったしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just happened by, so I wanted
see if you're doing fine.

fields.EN:
Well... It seemed like there's
something on your mind,
especially after joining us.
fields.JP:
うん。なんとなく放っておけない
というか……探索するようになってから
不安そうに見えたものだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... It seemed like there's
something on your mind,
especially after joining us.

fields.JP:
心配……してくれた……？
お気遣い、どうも……
え？　あ、こちらこそ、どうも

fields.EN:
So sorry...
to make you worried...
fields.JP:
……その、ご心配おかけして、
……しました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So sorry...
to make you worried...

fields.JP:
……えっと……、……えっと……
ありがとう……

fields.EN:
(It almost feels like she's
forcing herself to speak...)
fields.JP:
（なんだろう、無理になにかしゃべろうと
　しているような……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It almost feels like she's
forcing herself to speak...)

fields.EN:
Um... You're trying to tell me
that you're happy that we're
going on the expeditions together?
fields.JP:
……えーと、探索にいつも一緒に
行けてうれしい、ってことかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You're trying to tell me
that you're happy that we're
going on the expeditions together?

fields.EN:
Hey, I understood you.
I think...?
fields.JP:
おお、当たった。
っていうか、僕もよくわかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, I understood you.
I think...?

fields.EN:
Pillows here... so good...
Feels good... so...
fields.JP:
ここの、枕……好き……。
だから……気持ちよくて……、あの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pillows here... so good...
Feels good... so...

fields.EN:
You like the pillows here?
Can I assume that you're okay
with living here then?
fields.JP:
ここの枕が気持ちよくて好きなんだ？
ってことは、この拠点での生活も
悪くないって思ってくれてるのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You like the pillows here?
Can I assume that you're okay
with living here then?

fields.EN: I think I'm getting good at this!
fields.LOCALIZED: I think I'm getting good at this!

fields.EN:
(I guess I do understand her.
But, it still seems like she's
trying to force a conversation.)
fields.JP:
（地味にすごいな、僕の通訳力。
　……だけど、なんとなく眠りが
　無理してる気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess I do understand her.
But, it still seems like she's
trying to force a conversation.)

fields.EN:
Nemuri, is talking
painful for you, by any chance?
fields.JP:
眠り、もしかして話すのが
辛かったりする？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy, you don't like talking
much, do you?

fields.EN:
You don't need to force a
conversation, you know?
fields.JP:
もしもそうなら、無理に話さなくたって
大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to force a
conversation, you know?

fields.JP: 親指が？　なにか言われてるのか？

fields.EN:
She said... I need to talk...
to be... the Order's...
Hitsuka...
fields.JP:
……ん……。タイヨウ教団の陽司として、
しっかり……話せるように、
ならないといけない……って
fields.LOCALIZED:
She said... I need to talk...
to be... the Order's...
Hitsuka...

fields.EN:
I think... I need to speak...
more often, too...
fields.JP: ボクも……そうしなきゃいけないと思うし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think... I need to speak...
more often, too...

fields.EN:
That's what you call forcing
yourself.
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what you call forcing
yourself.

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'm okay...
Not forcing... myself...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'm okay...
Not forcing... myself...

fields.EN:
I'll do... my best... so that...
I can talk... better...
fields.JP: ちゃんと、話せるように……がんばる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll do... my best... so that...
I can talk... better...

fields.EN:
(It looks like she's forcing herself... But
if she says she's going to try, I don't want
to throw cold water on that either...)
fields.JP:
（無理してるように見えるんだけどな。
　でも本人ががんばるっていうのに、
　水を差すのもどうかと思うし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't look too happy,
but there's no reason for me to
stop her from trying to speak...)

fields.EN:
Well, it's good you're trying, but
make sure you don't force yourself
too hard, okay?
fields.JP:
眠り、がんばるのもいいけど、
無理はしなくていいんだからな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's good you're trying, but
make sure you don't force yourself
too hard, okay?

fields.EN:
(I just hope she doesn't push herself
too hard. I came to check on her,
and now I'm even more worried.)
fields.JP:
（本当、がんばりすぎなきゃいいんだけど。
　……様子を見に来て、
　ますます心配になっちゃったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope she isn't going to do
beyond what's needed...
I better keep a good eye on her.)

fields.EN:
You're pale and you've been
wobbling the whole time.
Are you sick?
fields.JP:
すごく辛そうな顔してるし、
足元もふらふらじゃないか。
具合でも悪いのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're pale and you've been
wobbling the whole time.
Are you sick?

fields.EN:
A-Are you sleepy? I see...
I guess that is just like you...
fields.JP:
ね、眠いのか。そっか……。
君らしいといえば、らしいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy... Oh, uh...
Well, that is your name, so...

fields.EN:
No more...
Need to sleep...
Can't move...
fields.JP:
もう……駄目。
眠くて、仕方なくて……
これ以上、動けない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No more...
Need to sleep...
Can't move...

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Don't be sleeping here?!
You need to sleep in your room!
fields.JP:
わわっ、こんなところで寝ようとしちゃ
駄目だよ！　せめて部屋に戻ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Don't be sleeping here?!
You need to sleep in your room!

fields.EN:
Fine... I'll carry you back to
your room then.
fields.JP:
ああもう、仕方ないな。
おんぶして部屋まで連れて行って
あげるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I'll carry you back to
your room then.

fields.EN: Sure, but you owe me one.
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure, but you owe me one.

fields.JP: おつう、優しい……。ありがとう……

fields.EN: Like I said, you owe me one!
fields.JP: だ、だから貸しだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Like I said, you owe me one!

fields.EN: Now then, get on my back.
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, get on my back.

fields.EN:
I can't... hold back...
from sleeping...
I'm so... bad...
fields.JP:
……どうしても……眠いって……
気持ちだけは、抑えられなくて……。
ボク、駄目な子……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't... hold back...
from sleeping...
I'm so... bad...

fields.JP: 眠り？　なんでそんなこと……

fields.EN: ...I don't think you're a bother, you know.
fields.JP: ……迷惑だなんて、思ってないからな

fields.EN:
Now that I got a chance to look,
you have a pretty neat room.
Look at all the plants...
fields.JP:
こうして改めて見ると、すごい部屋だな。
いろんなところに植物が生えてる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I got a chance to look,
you have a pretty neat room.
Look at all the plants...

fields.EN:
Oops, this isn't the time to be
looking around her room. I'll lay
Nemuri down on the bed... there.
fields.JP:
おっと、部屋を観察してる場合じゃなかった。
眠りをベッドに寝かせてあげて、っと
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. No time for me to be
lounging in your room. There...
Nice and comfy in your bed.

fields.EN:
Whew... Guess that's that.
Now, I just need to leave
without waking her up...
fields.JP:
ふぅ、これでよし。
あとは起こさないように立ち去れば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... Guess that's that.
Now, I just need to leave
without waking her up...

fields.JP: （というか、やけに顔が近い気が……！）

fields.EN:
She's mighty clingy...
Is she dreaming or something?
fields.JP:
なんか甘えられてるような……。
ね、寝ぼけてるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's mighty clingy...
Is she dreaming or something?

fields.EN:
I can't sleep with you, but I can
stay with you, so have a good
sleep, you hear?
fields.JP:
一緒には寝れないけど、
寝るまでは一緒にいてあげるから。
今はゆっくり寝なきゃ駄目だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't sleep with you, but I can
stay with you, so have a good
sleep, you hear?

fields.EN:
Is she asleep...? I guess she
must've been fighting hard to stay
awake the whole time.
fields.JP:
……寝たのか？
こんなにすぐ寝ちゃうなんて、
よっぽど眠いのを我慢してたんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is she asleep...? I guess she
must've been fighting hard to stay
awake the whole time.

fields.EN:
Nemuri, you can sleep without
worrying. ...Good night. Sweet dreams.
fields.JP:
眠り、安心して寝ていいからね。
……おやすみ、良い夢を
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good night, and sleep tight.
May you be blessed with
a good dream tonight...

fields.EN:
Nemu-chan, you're wobbling.
Are you all right?
fields.JP: ねむちゃん、ふらふらだよ。大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy, you're wobbling.
Are you all right?

fields.JP: 辛そうな顔してるけど……

fields.EN:
This has happened before. I think she's
suffering because she's sleepy. Last
time, I took her back to her room.
fields.JP:
前にもこんなことがあったんだけど、
たぶん眠くて辛いんだと思う。
そのときは僕が部屋に連れて帰ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is like deja vu...
She was sleepy the last time,
and probably this time, too.

fields.JP: また眠くなったんだろう？　眠り

fields.EN:
I knew it... She's going to end
up sleeping here, so we should
take her to her room.
fields.JP:
やっぱり。このままだと
ここで寝ちゃいかねないから、
また部屋まで連れて帰ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it... She's going to end
up sleeping here, so we should
take her to her room.

fields.JP: そうだね。ねむちゃん、行こ？

fields.EN:
Come now, if you're going to
sleep, sleep in your bed.
fields.JP: ほら、寝るんならちゃんとベッドで寝て
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, if you're going to
sleep, sleep in your bed.

fields.EN:
No, those are plants!
Your bed is over here!
fields.JP:
いや、そこはなんか変な植物の葉っぱの上！
ベッドはこっち！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, those are plants!
Your bed is over here!

fields.EN: Heh heh, Nemu-chan seems really half-asleep.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ねむちゃんってば
すごく寝ぼけてるみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, it's almost like she's
sleep walking.

fields.JP: え？　今なんて言ったんだ？

fields.EN:
I want to... sleep with you...
again... Otsuu...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to... sleep with you...
again... Otsuu...

fields.EN:
(Uh-oh. The way she said that
could invite a huge misunderstanding...)
fields.JP:
（まずい。なんか今の言い方だと、
　すごく誤解を招くような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot... This isn't going to
go well...)

fields.EN: It's not what you think, Princess.
fields.LOCALIZED: It's not what you think, Princess.

fields.EN:
Please sleep with me...
like the last time... Otsuu...
fields.JP:
あのときみたいに……ボクと寝て？
おつう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please sleep with me...
like the last time... Otsuu...

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、それって……

fields.EN:
Y-You've got this all wrong!
I didn't lay a single finger on
her, ever! I promise!
fields.JP:
ちち違うんです姫！
僕と眠りはやましいことなど、なにも！
天地神明に誓って！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You've got this all wrong!
I didn't lay a single finger on
her, ever! I promise!

fields.EN:
Um... Otsuu...
Did I... do something wrong...?
fields.JP:
あ……えっと……、
おつう、困ってる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Otsuu...
Did I... do something wrong...?

fields.EN:
Nemuri, can you vouch what
I said for me?! Tell her that
we've done nothing wrong!
fields.JP:
眠り、今のはそういう意味じゃ
ないんだって君からも言ってくれ！
姫の誤解を解いてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy, can you vouch what
I said for me?! Tell her that
we've done nothing wrong!

fields.EN:
Of all the sentences she has to
prematurely say! Please, wake
up, Nemuri!
fields.JP:
あああ寝ちゃった！
しかもよくわからないボケを言い残して！
起きてくれ眠りー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of all the sentences she has to
prematurely say! Please, wake
up, Sleepy!

fields.EN:
Wh-What should I do...?
How can I prove I haven't
done anything wrong...?
fields.JP:
どど、どうしよう。
どうやって身の潔白を証明すれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What should I do...?
How can I prove I haven't
done anything wrong...?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, you're blowing this way
out of proportion. I'm fine.
fields.JP: おつうちゃん、慌てすぎ。大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you're blowing this way
out of proportion. I'm fine.

fields.JP: 姫……僕の潔白を信じてくれるのですか？

fields.EN:
I never doubted you from the start,
Otsuu-chan. If anything, I'm happy
you're so kind to everyone.
fields.JP:
最初から疑ってなんていないよ。
むしろ、おつうちゃんがみんなに
優しくて嬉しいくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just happy how kind you
were to Sleepy. I wasn't doubting
you in the slightest.

fields.EN:
You know, I think Nemu-chan just
wants someone to spoil her a little.
fields.JP:
あのね、ねむちゃんはたぶん、
甘えたいだけなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just think Sleepy is just
fawning.

fields.EN:
You helped Nemu-chan when she was staggering
in the hallway, right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんは、廊下でふらふらだった
ねむちゃんを助けてあげたんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You helped her out before,
right?

fields.EN:
She was so happy you were kind to her that
she couldn't help leaning on you. Maybe she's
actually the type who likes being spoiled.
fields.JP:
優しくしてもらったのが嬉しくて、
つい甘えたくなっちゃったんだよ。
もしかして、本当は甘えんぼなのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think she's just happy you
were so kind to her. It could be
she's still a child inside.

fields.EN:
(So she wanted to be spoiled...
Come to think of it, she
was like that before too.)
fields.JP:
（甘えたかったのか……。
　たしかにこの間も、そんな感じだったかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A child inside...
That does sort of describe
Sleepy's actions back then.)

fields.EN:
(I'm pretty amazed she could read
Nemuri like this.)
fields.JP:
（眠りのそういう気持ちに気づけるなんて、
　やっぱり姫はすごいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm pretty amazed she could read
Sleepy like this.)

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan? Why don't we all
have a nap together? I'm getting
sleepy anyway.
fields.JP:
ねぇおつうちゃん、
今日はこのまま三人でお昼寝しよっか。
わたしもなんだか眠くなってきちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? Why don't we all
have a nap together? I'm getting
sleepy anyway.

fields.EN:
As you wish.
I shall escort you to the world
of dreams.
fields.JP:
よろこんで。
夢の世界へエスコートいたしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you wish.
I shall escort you to the world
of dreams.

fields.JP: ふふ、おつうちゃんったら

fields.EN:
We should keep quiet so that
we don't wake up Nemu-chan.
fields.JP:
ねむちゃんが起きちゃわないように、
静かにしようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should keep quiet so that
we don't wake up Sleepy.

fields.EN:
(The room smells quite good...
It must be because of the plants,
Nemuri, and Princess...)
fields.JP:
（……いい匂い。部屋中の植物と……
　眠りと、姫の匂いだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The room smells quite good...
It must be because of the plants,
Sleepy, and Princess...)

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, I'm sleeping together
with Princess right now. Whoa—now that I'm
conscious of it, I'm suddenly really nervous!)
fields.JP:
（……考えてみれば、今、
　姫と一緒に寝ているんだよな。
　うわ、意識したら一気に緊張してきた！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... I'm sleeping with
Princess? And I'm supposed
to sleep?!)

fields.EN:
(I can't wake up now, or else the
two will wake up. I can't even
move a muscle...)
fields.JP:
（でも起きたら二人を起こしちゃうし……。
　この状況で身動きできないって、
　けっこう辛い……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't wake up now, or else the
two will wake up. I can't even
move a muscle...)

fields.EN:
(Well, so long as Nemuri is
happy, I guess this is fine...)
fields.JP: （……まぁ、眠りが幸せそうだから、いっか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, so long as Sleepy is
happy, I guess this is fine...)

fields.EN:
...You're really not being clear.
If you don't need anything, I'm leaving.
fields.JP:
……なんだ、はっきりしないな。
用がないなら、もう行くからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, speak up.
You know... I have to get going.

fields.JP: ねむちゃん、こんにちは

fields.EN:
Did you need something from that person?
It looked like you were talking to them.
fields.JP:
なぁ、今の人になにか用だったのか？
話しかけてたみたいだけど
ゆっくりでいいよ、ねむちゃん

fields.EN:
Ripped part was... embarrassing...
So wanted to... warn...
fields.JP:
あんなとこ、破れてたら……
はずかしい、と……思って……それで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ripped part was... embarrassing...
So wanted to... warn...

fields.JP:
（あんなとこって、どんなとこが
　破れてたんだろう……）

fields.EN:
I see. So you were trying to
let that person know, Nemu-chan?
fields.JP:
そっか。それでねむちゃんは
教えてあげようとしてたんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So, you wanted to let the
person know then?

fields.EN:
If only... I could speak up...
Then maybe...
fields.JP:
もっと、ちゃんと……
うまくしゃべれたら……伝えられたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only... I could speak up...
Then maybe...

fields.JP: やっぱり、ボク……ダメな子……

fields.EN:
That's not true. You shouldn't get
so down on yourself like that.
fields.JP:
そんなことない。
眠りが落ち込む必要なんかないって
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. You shouldn't get
so down on yourself like that.

fields.EN:
She's right. Not everyone can
speak up, you know?
fields.JP:
そうだよ。言いたいことを
うまく伝えられないことなんて、
誰にでもあることだもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Not everyone can
speak up, you know?

fields.EN:
It's not like you tore that
person's clothes or anything.
fields.JP:
そもそも、服の一部が破けていたのは
眠りのせいじゃないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like you tore that
person's clothes or anything.

fields.EN:
If anything, it's that person's
fault for not willing to listen to
what you wanted to say.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと教えてあげようとしたのに、
それを聞かなかったほうが悪いんだよ。
仕方ないさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anything, it's that person's
fault for not willing to listen to
what you wanted to say.

fields.EN:
Each person has their strengths
and weaknesses, so you don't need
to force what you're not good at.
fields.JP:
それに人には向き不向きがあるんだから。
苦手なことを、無理にできるように
ならなくても大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each person has their strengths
and weaknesses, so you don't need
to force what you're not good at.

fields.EN:
But... I still want... to talk...
I want to... help...
fields.JP:
それでも……教えて、あげたかった……。
誰かの、役に……立ちたかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I still want... to talk...
I want to... help...

fields.EN:
If it's... my weakness... then...
No use... to do my best...
fields.JP:
でも……向き、不向きがあるなら……
がんばっても、意味、ない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's... my weakness... then...
No use... to do my best...

fields.EN:
Ah... No, that's not what
I meant.
fields.JP:
あ……。違うの、そういう意味で
言ったわけじゃなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... No, that's not what
I meant.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. We meant no harm. We only wanted to
say you don't need to feel down just because
there's something you're not good at...
fields.JP:
ごめん、僕達に悪気はなかったんだ。
ただ、苦手なことがあっても落ち込む
必要はないって言いたくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. We didn't mean to
denounce what you're doing.
We just wanted to cheer you up.

fields.JP: ……ボク、ちょっと……楽になったかも……

fields.EN:
I thought I had to keep trying all the time...
But now I understand there are things I
still can't do no matter how hard I try...
fields.JP:
ずっと、がんばらなきゃいけないって、
思ってた……。でも、がんばっても、
できないことがあるって、わかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I needed... to do my
best, but... some things...
I don't need... to worry about...

fields.EN: ...I really can't speak well after all...
fields.JP:
……やっぱり、ボク、
うまくしゃべるの……無理……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't... talk well...
and I don't... need to...

fields.EN:
(We tried to cheer her up, but
it only made things worse. She's
giving up on trying her best...)
fields.JP:
（励まそうとしたのに逆効果だった。
　眠りは楽になったんじゃなくて、
　諦めちゃったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We tried to cheer her up, but
it only made things worse. She's
giving up on trying her best...)

fields.EN:
(I didn't think she'd take our
words so badly...)
fields.JP:
（こんな風に落ち込ませることになるなんて、
　思わなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't think she'd take our
words so badly...)

fields.JP:
……なんだか……眠くなって、きた……。
部屋、戻る……

fields.EN:
What should we do, Otsuu-chan? We made
Nemu-chan misunderstand us. I only wanted to
cheer her up...
fields.JP:
どうしよう、おつうちゃん。
ねむちゃんに誤解させちゃった。
励ましたかっただけなのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What should we do? It looks like
we just made things worse for
her...

fields.EN:
I don't think anything we say now
will get through to her.
fields.JP:
……でも、たぶん今はなにを言っても、
眠りの心には届かないだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think anything we say now
will get through to her.

fields.EN:
I hope we can make things
better for her...
fields.JP: この誤解、ちゃんと解けるかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope we can make things
better for her...

fields.EN:
As long as we speak with her
I'm sure things will be all right.
fields.JP:
……うん、大丈夫。
ちゃんと話せば、きっと解けるさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as we speak with her
I'm sure things will be all right.

fields.EN:
(It's Nemuri... What's she doing
there? She looks... sad...)
fields.JP:
（あ……眠りだ。あんなところで
　一人でぼんやりして……。
　心なしか寂しそうだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's Sleepy... What's she doing
there? She looks... sad...)

fields.EN:
Hi there, Nemuri.
Would you mind if I sit here?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hi there, Sleepy.
Would you mind if I sit here?

fields.EN:
Whew... It feels good to have
a break like this, right?
fields.JP: ふぅ。外の空気を吸うと、気持ちいいよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... It feels good to have
a break like this, right?

fields.EN:
Did you come here for a
change of pace too, Nemuri?
fields.JP: 眠りは気分転換しに、ここへ？

fields.EN:
(She's not responding to me well.
I guess what I said back then
is affecting her badly...)
fields.JP:
（反応が鈍いな。前にも増して言葉少な
　だし……。この間のことで、ますます
　話すのが苦手になっちゃったのかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's not responding to me well.
I guess what I said back then
is affecting her badly...)

fields.EN:
(What should I say? I feel like
anything I say will only make
matters worse.)
fields.JP:
（なんて言葉をかければいいんだろう。
　なにを言っても落ち込ませてしまう
　気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What should I say? I feel like
anything I say will only make
matters worse.)

fields.JP: わーい！　ねむねむだー！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, as happy as usual,
aren't you?
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、元気そうだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, as happy as usual,
aren't you?

fields.EN:
Heehee! Nemu-Nemu, your chest is so soft
and feels so nice!
fields.JP:
えへへー、ねむねむのむね、
ふわふわできもちいーなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! I like Sleepy!
Her boobies so soft!

fields.JP:
……ねむねむ？
なんか、いつもとちがう？

fields.EN:
(Looks like Rapunzel noticed
something is wrong with her.)
fields.JP:
（さすがにラプンツェルでも
　眠りの異変に気がついたか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like Rapunzel noticed
something is wrong with her.)

fields.EN:
Nemu-Nemu? You don't like Rapunzel
anymore?
fields.JP:
ねむねむ、もしかして、もしかして……
ラプンツェルのこと、きらいになった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy? You don't like Rapunzel
anymore?

fields.JP: じゃあ、きらいじゃない？
ほんと？　よかったーー！！

fields.EN:
What's the matter?
No wanna talk?
fields.JP:
どうしたの？
あんまりはなしたくないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?
No wanna talk?

fields.JP:
でも、ラプンツェルのことは
きらいじゃないんだよね？

fields.EN:
Heh heh! Rapunzel like
Nemu-Nemu, too!
fields.JP:
えへへー。ラプンツェルも、
ねむねむのことだいすきだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! Rapunzel like
Sleepy, too!

fields.JP:
（心なしか、眠りの表情が
　柔らかくなった……？）
ねむねむ、きょう、あさごはんたべたー？

fields.EN:
Rapunzel eat plenty!
Nemu-Nemu eat plenty, too?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはねー、いっぱいたべたよ！
ねむねむは？　いっぱいたべた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel eat plenty!
Sleepy eat plenty, too?

fields.EN:
No eat much? Ooh!
We eat plenty sweets then!
fields.JP:
そっか、あんまりたべなかったんだね。
じゃあそのぶん、おやつはいっぱいたべようね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No eat much? Ooh!
We eat plenty sweets then!

fields.JP: （あ、眠りが部屋の方向を指さした……）
もしかして、たべるよりねたいの？

fields.EN:
I see~. Then when you take a nap,
can Rapunzel sleep with you too?
fields.JP:
そっかー。それじゃあ、おひるねするとき、
ラプンツェルもいっしょにねていい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. Then Rapunzel can take nap
with Sleepy, too?

fields.JP: わーい！　ねむねむとおひるねだー！

fields.EN:
(Amazing. They're actually having a
conversation. It doesn't have much substance,
but it really is a conversation...!)
fields.JP:
（すごい。会話が成り立ってる。
　あんまり中身のない会話だけど、
　ちゃんと成り立ってる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm surprised they can
communicate so well with each
other...)

fields.EN:
...I see. She was communicating
only through yes-or-no questions and
pointing. Maybe that's easier on Nemuri.
fields.JP:
……そうか。全部イエス、ノーで答えられる
質問と、指さしだけでやり取りしてたんだ。
そのほうが眠りの負担にならないのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're pretty much talking with
yes and no questions. That can
makes things easier for Sleepy.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's casual conversation
must have made things easy, too...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルとの気負わなくていい会話で、
自然と指をさせたのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's casual conversation
must have made things easy, too...

fields.JP: おつう、なにぶつぶついってるのー？

fields.EN:
Oh, I was just impressed,
Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
ああ、いや、ラプンツェルは
すごいなって思っただけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I was just impressed,
Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Heh heh! Thanks!
Nemu-Nemu, you think Rapunzel
is super, too?
fields.JP:
？　えへへ、ほめられちゃったー！
ねむねむも、ラプンツェルすごいっておもう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! Thanks!
Sleepy, you think Rapunzel
is super, too?

fields.EN:
Yaay! Rapunzel happy speaking
with Nemu-Nemu!
fields.JP:
やったー！　ねむねむとおはなしできて、
ラプンツェルたのしかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yaay! Rapunzel happy speaking
with Sleepy!

fields.EN:
Guess you don't need that many
words to express your feelings.
fields.JP:
うまく言葉にできなくても、
気持ちは伝わるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess you don't need that many
words to express your feelings.

fields.EN:
(Nemuri looks a lot better now.
Maybe she sees how you don't need
to say much to express yourself.)
fields.JP:
（眠りの表情、なにかから解放されたような
　感じだな。無理に話さなくていいんだって
　思えるようになったのかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sleepy looks a lot better now.
Maybe she sees how you don't need
to say much to express yourself.)

fields.JP: （今回はラプンツェルに感謝しないとな）

fields.EN:
Hm? What about my pants?
Is there something...
fields.JP:
ん？　俺のズボンを指さして……
なにかついてるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What about my pants?
Is there something...

fields.EN:
What the...?! I didn't know there
was a hole here!
fields.JP:
げげっ！　こんなところに穴が！
いつの間に破れてたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?! I didn't know there
was a hole here!

fields.EN:
I get it. You wanted to tell me
that, didn't you? Well, sorry
I gave you the cold shoulder then.
fields.JP:
……そうか、君はこれを教えて
くれようとしたのか。
この間は邪険にして悪かったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get it. You wanted to tell me
that, didn't you? Well, sorry
I gave you the cold shoulder then.

fields.EN:
Thanks for telling me!
I better hurry and get this
patched up. Thanks again!
fields.JP:
このままじゃまずいから、
ちょっと繕ってくるか。
教えてくれてありがとな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for telling me!
I better hurry and get this
patched up. Thanks again!

fields.JP: 眠り！　今の見てたよ

fields.EN:
Looks like you got through
to him!
fields.JP: ちゃんと伝わったみたいだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you got through
to him!

fields.JP:
……指、さした。
わかって、もらえた……

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, she did
point to her room before when
she was with Rapunzel...)
fields.JP:
（そういえば、ラプンツェルとの会話で
　自然と指さしをしてたっけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, she did
point to her room before when
she was with Rapunzel...)

fields.EN:
I guess you can communicate well
without the talk.
fields.JP:
言葉じゃなくても、言いたいことを
相手に伝えることはできるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you can communicate well
without the talk.

fields.EN:
(She doesn't speak much, but
I think I understand her better
now. She even looks happier now.)
fields.JP:
（相変わらず口数は少ないけど、
　前より意思表示がわかりやすくなったかも。
　表情も明るくなったし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't speak much, but
I think I understand her better
now. She even looks happier now.)

fields.EN: Nemu-chan, you seem a little different now.
fields.JP: ねむちゃん、なんだか少し様子が変わったね

fields.EN:
I don't know how to word it, but
you look a lot more relaxed and
calm now.
fields.JP:
前よりも雰囲気が柔らかくなったっていうか
……肩の力が抜けたっていうのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know how to word it, but
you look a lot more relaxed and
calm now.

fields.JP: なにかいいことでもあったの？

fields.EN:
Otsuu and Rapu taught me...
Thanks...
fields.JP:
おつうと、らぷ……教えてくれた……。
ありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and Rappy taught me...
Thanks...

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan and Rapu-chan?
What did you girls teach her?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんとラプちゃんが？
へー、いいこと教えてあげたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and Rappy?
What did you girls teach her?

fields.EN:
Nothing at all. If anything, we
just sort of gave her the nudge.
fields.JP:
教えたというほどのことじゃないんだけど、
きっかけになることができたというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing at all. If anything, we
just sort of gave her the nudge.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel went as far as showing
us that there's a way Nemuri
can communicate all on her own.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルが大事なことに
気づかせてくれたんだ。
眠りなりの会話方法があるって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel went as far as showing
us that there's a way Sleepy
can communicate all on her own.

fields.EN:
Just take it step-by-step, Nemuri.
You may not talk much, but we
know you're a kind hearted soul.
fields.JP:
話すときも、ゆっくり話せばいいからね。
言葉が少なくたって、僕たちは眠りが
優しい子なのはわかってるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just take it step-by-step, Sleepy.
You may not talk much, but we
know you're a kind hearted soul.

fields.EN: Huh? Not like I did anything.
fields.JP: え？　いや、別に普通だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Not like I did anything.

fields.EN:
You're sleepy? You want us to
take you back to your room?
fields.JP: 眠くなってきたの？　部屋まで送ろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're sleepy? You want us to
take you back to your room?

fields.EN:
You taught me... not to...
force myself...
fields.JP:
無理、しなくていいって……
おつうたち、教えてくれた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You taught me... not to...
force myself...

fields.EN:
I see. Well, I guess you're
good then.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Well, I guess you're
good then.

fields.EN:
...Your steps are steady. Looks like
you'll make it back to your room just fine.
fields.JP:
……足取り、しっかりしてるね。
これなら部屋までちゃんと戻れそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's looking pretty good.
I guess she'll be able to get
back to her room okay.

fields.EN:
I'm just glad that she's not
pressuring herself like before.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
無理しないようになってくれて、
ホッとしたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just glad that she's not
pressuring herself like before.

fields.EN:
Ever since we made Nemu-chan feel
down before, it's been bothering me.
fields.JP:
前にねむちゃんを落ち込ませちゃってから、
ずっと気になってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, seeing her down on herself
after we spoke to her was
bothering me all along...

fields.EN:
I'm glad you and Rapu-chan managed to sort it
out before I knew it, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
でも、いつの間にかおつうちゃんと
ラプちゃんが解決してたんだね。よかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you and Rappy were able
to take care of it.

fields.EN:
I didn't do anything in
particular, really.
fields.JP: 解決したってほどのことはしていないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't do anything in
particular, really.

fields.EN: You know, I'm a bit jealous...
fields.JP:
……だけど、さっきのは
ちょっと妬けちゃったな
fields.LOCALIZED: You know, I'm a bit jealous...

fields.EN:
It felt like you and Nemu-chan were in your
own little world, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんとねむちゃんで、二人の世界ー、
みたいな雰囲気だったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, the way you and Sleepy
were connected, and how I was left
out of it.

fields.EN:
O-Oh, not at all!
I belong to you, body and soul!
fields.JP: そ、そんな！　僕の心は姫一筋です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Oh, not at all!
I belong to you, body and soul!

fields.EN:
Nemuri is a very precious friend,
but you are my fated soulmate!
fields.JP:
眠りは仲間として大事というわけで、
姫は僕の運命の人だから全然違って……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy is a very precious friend,
but you are my fated soulmate!

fields.EN:
Sorry, I'm joking. It was just too funny
watching you panic, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、冗談だよ。
おつうちゃんが慌てるのが
あんまりおかしかったから、つい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just pulling your leg.
Looking at you panic is just
too fun to watch.

fields.EN:
Oh, okay... So, it's a joke then?
You had me scared for a moment...
fields.JP:
な、なんだ、からかわれてたのか。
焦った……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, okay... So, it's a joke then?
You had me scared for a moment...

fields.JP: あ、姫！　それに眠りもこんなところで……

fields.EN:
Yup. If you can keep it down
a little that'd be great.
fields.JP:
うん。気持ちよさそうだから、
起こさないようにしてあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. If you can keep it down
a little that'd be great.

fields.EN:
Understood.
But, why are you two here?
fields.JP:
わかった。
……姫と眠りは、どうしてここへ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood.
But, why are you two here?

fields.EN:
Just a change of pace. I happened
to run into Nemu-chan, so we
decided to go get some fresh air.
fields.JP:
気晴らしだよ。たまたまねむちゃんと
会ったから、ちょっと外の空気を吸いに
行こうかって話になったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, just to pass the time. We
decided to step outside to get
some air.

fields.EN:
Nemu-chan nodded to me when
I asked her out. She looked
happy, I think?
fields.JP:
わたしが誘ったら、ねむちゃん、
「ん……」って頷いたの。
なんだか嬉しそうな顔だったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy nodded to me when
I asked her out. She looked
happy, I think?

fields.EN:
I would think so, too. Even if it
was a nod, I'm sure she was able
to relay her feelings to you well.
fields.JP:
きっと嬉しかったんだよ。
誘ってもらったことも、言葉が少なくても
ちゃんと気持ちが伝わることも
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would think so, too. Even if it
was a nod, I'm sure she was able
to relay her feelings to you well.

fields.JP: （わ、まずい。起こしちゃったか？）

fields.EN:
She's not waking up at all.
She must be deep in sleep.
fields.JP:
……ぜんぜん起きない。
だいぶ深く眠っているんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's not waking up at all.
She must be deep in sleep.

fields.EN:
It didn't take very long for her
to fall asleep. She sort of just
drooped on me.
fields.JP:
ホームに来てしばらくしたら、
眠いって言って、
わたしにもたれかかって寝ちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It didn't take very long for her
to fall asleep. She sort of just
drooped on me.

fields.EN:
I know it's not cold, but she can
catch a cold like this. Shall I
carry her back to her room?
fields.JP:
寒くはないけど、こんなところで
寝たら風邪引かないかな。
僕が部屋までおぶっていこうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's not cold, but she can
catch a cold like this. Shall I
carry her back to her room?

fields.EN:
Thanks, but let's stay a little
longer. Nemu-chan seems to like it here.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。でも、もう少しここにいよう。
ねむちゃんはここが気に入ってるみたいだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, but I think we can stay
out for a little longer. After
all, she does like this place.

fields.EN:
I see... This place is quiet, and
it does feel quite good out here.
fields.JP:
そっか……。たしかにここは静かだし、
開放感があって気持ちいいからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... This place is quiet, and
it does feel quite good out here.

fields.EN:
Oh, I forgot to ask.
What were you talking about with
Nemuri?
fields.JP:
それはそうと、姫、
ここで眠りとなにを話していたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I forgot to ask.
What were you talking about with
Sleepy?

fields.EN: Do you really want to know?
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you really want to know?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? I'm interested
in anything related to you,
my dear princess.
fields.JP:
言うまでもないだろう？
姫のことならなんだって気になるさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? I'm interested
in anything related to you,
my dear princess.

fields.EN:
Heh... Well, I guess I can let
you in on what we talked about.
fields.JP: ふふ、だったら教えてあげようかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Well, I guess I can let
you in on what we talked about.

fields.EN:
You know, we didn't talk about anything
unusual. Just things like how nice the breeze
feels and how the Jail Tower has grown.
fields.JP:
あのね、特に珍しいことなんて
話してないの。風が気持ちいいねとか、
監獄塔が伸びたねとか、そんな話だけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it wasn't anything special.
We just small talked about how it
felt good out here and things.

fields.EN:
Even so, it was so relaxing
chatting with her out here like
this.
fields.JP:
でも、そういう何気ない会話だけなのに、
心地いい時間だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, it was so relaxing
chatting with her out here like
this.

fields.EN:
Being with Nemu-chan calms me.
Maybe because she doesn't talk
much, time feels more relaxed.
fields.JP:
ねむちゃんといると、心が落ち着くの。
たくさん話さない分、ゆったりした時間が
流れるのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't talk much, but maybe
that's why it's so soothing to be
with her, passing the time by.

fields.EN:
It must be tiring having her on
your shoulder like that. Let me
sit next to you...
fields.JP:
姫、ずっと肩を貸していたら疲れるだろ？
僕が姫の隣に座るから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It must be tiring having her on
your shoulder like that. Let me
sit next to you...

fields.EN:
Okay, you can lean on me now.
It should lighten the load a bit.
fields.JP:
ほら、姫は僕に寄りかかって。
そうすれば少しは楽になるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, you can lean on me now.
It should lighten the load a bit.

fields.EN:
Thank you. Hehe, with you and Nemu-chan
sandwiching me, Otsuu-chan, I feel popular.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。
ふふ、おつうちゃんとねむちゃんに挟まれて、
モテモテになった気分だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. I feel like a winner
with you and Sleepy sandwiching
me like this.

fields.EN:
Oh? You want someone else to
love you, even when you know
I am here for you?
fields.JP:
おや。僕というものがありながら、
姫は他の人にもモテたいのですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? You want someone else to
love you, even when you know
I am here for you?

fields.JP: あれ、おつうちゃんってば妬いてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Do I sense someone getting
jealous?

fields.EN:
Of course. I was jealous the
minute I knew you were out on
a date with Nemuri.
fields.JP:
ええ、もちろん。
眠りとデートしていたことにも、
実は妬いているんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. I was jealous the
minute I knew you were out on
a date with Sleepy.

fields.JP: 眠り？　起きてたのか？

fields.LOCALIZED:
She must be having a good
dream...

fields.EN:
Even though she's asleep, it feels
like Nemu-chan is talking with us too.
fields.JP:
寝てるのに、なんだかねむちゃんも
一緒に話してるみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's almost like she's talking
with us, even while sleeping.

fields.EN:
Why hello there, Nemu.
Good to see you.
fields.JP: まあ、ネム。ごきげんよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why hello there, Sleepy.
Good to see you.

fields.EN:
You seem happy.
Did something good happen?
fields.JP:
心なしか、表情が明るいですわね。
なにかいいことでもありましたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You seem happy.
Did something good happen?

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's because the three sisters made up.
I'm glad she looks happy.)
fields.JP:
（三姉妹で仲直りできたからかな。
　嬉しそうでよかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's no wonder since Sleepy and
her sisters are getting along
well again.)

fields.JP: 親指姫や白雪も元気ですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How are Thumbelina and
Snow White?

fields.EN:
That's good to hear. Oh my,
how have I not noticed that
wonderful hairpin of yours.
fields.JP:
それはなによりですわ。
あら、改めて見ますと、
その髪飾り、かわいいですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear. Oh my,
how have I not noticed that
wonderful hairpin of yours.

fields.EN:
The flower matches your hair well.
Come to think of it, you decorated
your room with flowers, right?
fields.JP:
花の色が、髪にとても似合っていますわ。
そういえばあなたの部屋には、
たくさん花があるんでしたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The flower matches your hair well.
Come to think of it, you decorated
your room with flowers, right?

fields.EN:
Taking care of them must be
quite taxing.
fields.JP: やっぱり、植物の世話は大変なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Taking care of them must be
quite taxing.

fields.EN:
How wonderful would it be to live
a life surrounded by flowers. What
is needed to take care of them?
fields.JP:
ああでも、お花に囲まれた生活も素敵ですわ。
どのように育てればいいのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
How wonderful would it be to live
a life surrounded by flowers. What
is needed to take care of them?

fields.EN:
(I see... She's having a hard time
replying since she can't answer
with a simple yes or no.)
fields.JP:
（そうか。イエス、ノーで答えられる
　質問じゃなかったから、
　眠りは戸惑っちゃったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... She's having a hard time
replying since she can't answer
with a simple yes or no.)

fields.EN:
Um, Cinderella? Do you mind asking
questions that are a bit more...
simpler to reply to?
fields.JP:
えーと、シンデレラ。
もう少し簡潔に答えやすい言い方に
してくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Cinderella? Do you mind asking
questions that are a bit more...
simpler to reply to?

fields.EN:
I think Nemuri is far more adept
at raising plants than trying to
actually explain how to do it.
fields.JP:
ほら、眠りは人に説明することよりも、
植物を育てることのほうが得意だと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think Sleepy is far more adept
at raising plants than trying to
actually explain how to do it.

fields.EN:
You've been bombarding her with
questions, so I think it's best to
give her some space to reply.
fields.JP:
あんまり一度にいろいろ聞かれると、
ちょっと戸惑っちゃうかもしれないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've been bombarding her with
questions, so I think it's best to
give her some space to reply.

fields.EN:
Mmm... But there are so many
things I would like to ask...
fields.JP:
むう。では、なんて聞けばいいんですの？
植物について、いろいろ聞きたいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... But there are so many
things I would like to ask...

fields.EN:
What? You want to raise plants,
Cinderella?
fields.JP: シンデレラ、あんた植物育てたいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? You want to raise plants,
Cinderella?

fields.JP:
親指？　どこから湧いて……じゃない、
どうしてここに？

fields.EN:
I just happened to come by,
that's all.
fields.JP:
たまたま通りかかったら、
話し声が聞こえてきたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just happened to come by,
that's all.

fields.EN:
She's saying that it requires a
bit of effort to raise plants.
fields.JP:
ネムの代わりにわたしが答えてあげる。
植物の世話だけど、やっぱりそれなりに大変、
ですって
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's saying that it requires a
bit of effort to raise plants.

fields.EN:
But, it's like a pastime to her,
so taking care of them doesn't
bother her much.
fields.JP:
でも趣味みたいなものだし、
もう慣れちゃったから、
世話するのも苦にはならないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it's like a pastime to her,
so taking care of them doesn't
bother her much.

fields.EN:
The plants really help your room feel
more comfortable. If you'd like to try and
raise them, she can share some.
fields.JP:
なにより部屋の寝心地がよくなるから、
植物は欠かせないの。もしも植物を育てて
みたくなったら、株を分けてあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
The plants really help your room feel
more comfortable. If you'd like to try and
raise them, she can share some.

fields.EN:
I can't believe you were able to
get that all right!
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you were able to
get that all right!

fields.EN:
I'm quite amazed! You really do
know Nemu well!
fields.JP:
すごいですわ！
親指姫はネムの言いたいことが、
ちゃんとわかっていますのね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite amazed! You really do
know Sleepy well!

fields.EN:
Same here. I wouldn't have
imagined so much content from
so little words.
fields.JP:
本当、驚いたよ。
眠りのあの短い言葉だけで、
よく今の長文になったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. I wouldn't have
imagined so much content from
so little words.

fields.EN: Well, I am her sister after all.
fields.JP: まぁね。姉なんだから当然よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I am her sister after all.

fields.EN:
Nemu may not say much, but she
has a lot going on in her head.
She's no dummy, that's for sure!
fields.JP:
それにね、ネムは口数が多くないだけで、
頭の中ではしっかり考えてるんだから。
ネムはすごい子なのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy may not say much, but she
has a lot going on in her head.
She's no dummy, that's for sure!

fields.EN:
With how Nemuri is... well, so
sleepy all the time, I couldn't
have imagined her to be like that.
fields.JP:
少し意外だったな。眠りはふわっとしていて、
こんなにはっきりしたことを考えてるような
イメージじゃなかったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how Sleepy is... well, so
sleepy all the time, I couldn't
have imagined her to be like that.

fields.JP: わたしもですわ。意外な一面ですわね

fields.EN:
Yeah, everyone seems to
misunderstand her like that,
which is a bit vexing to me.
fields.JP:
ボーっとしてるように誤解されやすいのよ、
この子。それがわたしは悔しくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, everyone seems to
misunderstand her like that,
which is a bit vexing to me.

fields.EN:
So that's why you wanted Nemuri to be able to
speak for herself—so your little sister, whom
you're so proud of, wouldn't be misunderstood.
fields.JP:
だから親指は、眠りが自分で話せるように
なってほしかったんだな。
自慢の妹が誤解されないように
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, that's why you wanted her to
speak up, so that she wouldn't
be misunderstood?

fields.EN:
(So she isn't denying it after all.
But with Oyayubi's way of doing things,
it's hard for that to come across...)
fields.JP:
（あ、やっぱり否定はしないんだ。
　でも親指のやり方じゃ、
　なかなか伝わらないよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see. But, I don't think
Thumbelina's plans for Sleepy
is that easy to notice.)

fields.EN:
You're really clumsy about it, even
though you care so much about your sisters.
fields.JP: せっかく妹想いなのに、不器用だなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For being so caring of your
sisters, you always seem to end up
with the short end of the stick.

fields.EN:
Oh, shut up!
Like, I've been trying to change
how I approach things.
fields.JP:
放っておいて！
……ただ、最近考えを変えるように
なっただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, shut up!
Like, I've been trying to change
how I approach things.

fields.EN:
Since they're helping me, I figure
it's only natural that I help
Nemu with her talking.
fields.JP:
わたしも妹たちに助けてもらうことが
あるんだから、ネムがうまく話せないなら、
わたしが伝えてあげればいいんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since they're helping me, I figure
it's only natural that I help
Sleepy with her talking.

fields.EN:
So each of you sisters will cover
each one's back? Sounds like
a plan.
fields.JP:
苦手なことをフォローし合うってことか。
いいね。そういうのって
fields.LOCALIZED:
So each of you sisters will cover
each one's back? Sounds like
a plan.

fields.JP: あの……うれしかった。……ありがとう……

fields.EN:
Y-You don't have to thank me!
I only did what needed to be done!
fields.JP: な、なに言ってるのよ。当たり前でしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You don't have to thank me!
I only did what needed to be done!

fields.EN:
(There she goes again... I guess
they really are sisters with how
easily they get misunderstood.)
fields.JP:
（また素直じゃないんだから。
　誤解されやすいのは姉妹で似てるなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There she goes again... I guess
they really are sisters with how
easily they get misunderstood.)

fields.EN:
I'm so envious of how well they
support each other as sisters...
fields.JP:
いいですわねぇ……。
姉妹で支え合えて、うらやましいですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so envious of how well they
support each other as sisters...

fields.EN:
Even if you don't have sisters, you
have me and everyone else, so you
don't have to be lonely, right?
fields.JP:
姉妹がいなくたって、シンデレラには
僕やみんながいるから寂しくないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need sisters when you
have us, right?

fields.EN:
Heh heh, I suppose you're
right, Otsuu.
fields.JP: ふふっ。そうでしたわね、おつう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, I suppose you're
right, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Um, this is Cinderella's room,
wasn't it?
fields.JP: えーと、ここだよな。シンデレラの部屋って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, this is Cinderella's room,
wasn't it?

fields.EN:
(It's great to see her back, but
I am a bit worried...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラが戻って来てくれてよかった。
　でも、ちょっと心配なんだよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's great to see her back, but
I am a bit worried...)

fields.EN:
(For Cinderella, time passed without
her even knowing it. It must feel like
she's suddenly come to the future...)
fields.JP:
（なんせシンデレラにしてみれば、
　知らないうちに時間が経って、
　未来に来たような感覚だろうし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must feel weird, especially
when time has passed around
you like this.)

fields.EN:
(She might be confused and lonely
about all kinds of things. I need to
support her properly as her friend.)
fields.JP:
（いろいろと混乱したり、
　心細かったりするかもしれない。
　仲間としてしっかり支えてやらないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She could be thoroughly
confused, so I better support her
as a friend.)

fields.JP: なんでですのおおおぉ！？

fields.EN:
Wh-What the...?!
I'm coming in, Cinderella!
fields.JP:
ど、どうしたんだ！？
シンデレラ、入るぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What the...?!
I'm coming in, Cinderella!

fields.EN:
What was that about, Cinderella?
Huh...? Princess? You're here?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、今すごい声が聞こえたけど
……って、姫？　姫も来ていたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What was that about, Cinderella?
Huh...? Princess? You're here?

fields.EN:
Yup. I was a little worried about
Cinderella-san, so I came by.
fields.JP:
うん、ちょっとシンデレラさんのことが
気になっちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, I was a bit worried,
so I swung on by.

fields.EN:
(I see, so she came for the
same reason I did. She truly is
a kind soul...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、そうか。姫も僕と同じ理由で
　来ていたんだ。さすがお優しい……
　じゃなくて！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see, so she came for the
same reason I did. She truly is
a kind soul...)

fields.EN:
Cinderella, didn't you scream
just now?
fields.JP:
ところでシンデレラ、
さっきなにか叫んでなかったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, didn't you scream
just now?

fields.JP: べ、別になにも言ってませんわ
なんでですのー、って聞こえたけど

fields.EN: Then why'd you ask me earlier?
fields.JP: ちゃんと聞こえてたんじゃありませんの……
fields.LOCALIZED: Then why'd you ask me earlier?

fields.EN:
*sigh*... I was just a little
frustrated. Ningyohime is so
kind... almost like an older sister.
fields.JP:
はぁ……。少しくやしかっただけですわ。
人魚姫があまりにも優しくて……
まるでお姉さんみたいで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... It's just that things are
so different. Little Mermaid is
like an older sister now.

fields.EN:
Everyone around me has aged quite
a bit, but now I'm the younger one
here. It just feels... weird.
fields.JP:
いつの間にかみんな大きくなってるんですもの。
昔はわたしのほうが年上だったのにって
思ったら、ふくざつで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone around me has aged quite
a bit, but now I'm the younger one
here. It just feels... weird.

fields.JP: まぁ、それはそうだろうなぁ

fields.EN:
What makes matters worse is
how well-timed Ningyohime
came to visit.
fields.JP:
だいたい、人魚姫がぜつみょうなタイミングで
来るのがいけないんですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What makes matters worse is
how well-timed Little Mermaid
came to visit.

fields.EN:
She came to see me right when I was confused
and anxious, and she was so kind to me!
fields.JP:
ちょうどわたしがとまどって不安に
なっているときに会いに来て、
優しくしてくれるんですもの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You came just when I was trying
to get over the changes, acting
all kind and everything to me.

fields.EN:
It made me feel like I was being
treated like a child... It only made
my feelings even more complicated!
fields.JP:
なんだか子ども扱いされたようで……
ますますふくざつな気分ですわっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt like you were treating me
like I was dumb. You just made
matters worse!

fields.JP: それで嘆いていたわけか……

fields.EN:
I really don't feel like an older sister
now after that. All that yelling made
me feel so immature...
fields.JP:
こんなことでわめいていては、ますます
子どもみたいなのはわかっていますわ。
ぜんぜんお姉さんらしくないですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really don't feel like an older sister
now after that. All that yelling made
me feel so immature...

fields.EN:
Uh, you weren't much of an
older sister from before.
fields.JP:
だけどさ、そもそもシンデレラって、
元からそんなにお姉さんっぽくなかったよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you weren't much of an
older sister from before.

fields.EN:
Akazukin felt like an older
sister, but Cinderella never really
felt that much older than us.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんはお姉さんって感じだったけど、
シンデレラはあんまり年上って感じじゃ
なかったっていうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood was like an older
sister, but yeah... you were immature.

fields.JP: ちょ、ちょっとおつうちゃん……

fields.EN:
But don't worry! You're the same
Cinderella I know, and that's all
that matters!
fields.JP:
でもまぁ、シンデレラはシンデレラだよ。
気にすることないんじゃないかな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But don't worry! You're the same
Cinderella I know, and that's all
that matters!

fields.EN:
Hmph. I don't need cheap consolation.
I'm a failure anyway... You mean I
was never very dependable, don't you?
fields.JP:
ふん。安っぽいなぐさめなんていりませんわ。
どうせわたしは出来そこないですもの。
頼りがいがなかったということですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see what you're getting at.
I know I'm not very reliable...

fields.EN: Huh? No, that's not what I...
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? No, that's not what I...

fields.EN:
I was never good at training, and
I had a lot of trouble using
different kinds of weapons...
fields.JP:
たしかにわたしは昔から訓練も
上手にできなかったし、
武器の扱いも下手でしたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was never good at training, and
I had a lot of trouble using
different kinds of weapons...

fields.EN:
But you were very athletic, and the
best melee fighter among us. I think
you're amazing, Cinderella-san.
fields.JP:
でも、運動神経は良かったよね。
素手での接近戦だって誰より強かったし、
シンデレラさんはすごいと思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you were very athletic, and
the best melee fighter among us.
That alone makes you amazing.

fields.EN:
I only happened to have good
days now and then. More often
I'd panic and make mistakes...
fields.JP:
たまたま調子がいいときがあった
というだけですわ。むしろすぐあせって
ミスしてしまうことのほうが多くて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just in my groove back then.
In fact, I would often miss my
targets from losing focus.

fields.EN:
Everyone misses time-to-time.
I think it's more important we
focus on the good.
fields.JP:
失敗くらい誰にでもあるでしょ？
そんなのより、出来たことを
数えるほうが楽しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone misses time-to-time.
I think it's more important we
focus on the good.

fields.EN:
You do have a tendency of
underestimating yourself, and
overstating your mistakes.
fields.JP:
シンデレラは自分を過小評価する
ところがあるよな。欠点を大げさに
受け止めちゃうというか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do have a tendency of
underestimating yourself, and
overstating your mistakes.

fields.EN:
I couldn't tell back then, but now
that I'm older I know... You
shouldn't underestimate yourself.
fields.JP:
うん。昔はわからなかったけど、
大人になった今ならわかる。
シンデレラはもっと自分を評価すべきだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't tell back then, but now
that I'm older I know... You
shouldn't underestimate yourself.

fields.EN:
She's right. Looking only at the
bad side of things will make
matters worse.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。欠点ばっかり数え上げてたら、
わたしだって落ち込んじゃうもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Looking only at the
bad side of things will make
matters worse.

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right, but I'm
supposed to be the older sister
here...
fields.JP:
それは、たしかに……。
だけど、わたしはお姉さんのはずなのに……。
こんなわたしじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right, but I'm
supposed to be the older sister
here...

fields.EN:
You're still saying that? Being
the older sister, being older or
younger—none of that matters, does it?
fields.JP:
まだそんなこと言ってるのか？
お姉さんとか年上とか年下とか、
そんなの関係ないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're still dwelling on that?
I don't think age is important.

fields.EN: We're precious family in Dawn, aren't we?
fields.JP: 僕達は黎明の大事な家族じゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's important is that we're
a family that came under Dawn.

fields.EN:
Yup! We're all family here!
I'm just happy we can all be
together again.
fields.JP:
うん！　大事な家族だよ。
また一緒にいられるようになって、
すごく嬉しいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! We're all family here!
I'm just happy we can all be
together again.

fields.EN:
Ohohoho! If you insist, I suppose I
have no choice. I'll set the whole
older-sister issue aside for now!
fields.JP:
おーっほっほっほ！　そこまで言うのなら
しかたありませんわね。お姉さん問題は
ひとまず気にしないであげますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Ohohoho! Fine!
I suppose I can turn the blind
eye to our age difference for now!

fields.EN:
How unlike me to forget...
Family... Yes, we are a family!
fields.JP:
ふふ、家族か……。そうでしたわね。
わたしたちは家族でしたわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unlike me to forget...
Family... Yes, we are a family!

fields.EN:
(Looks like she's a bit better
now. She's so simple...
No... So pure...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラが機嫌を直してくれた
　みたいでよかった。それにしても、
　単純……いや、純粋だなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like she's a bit better
now. She's so simple...
No... So pure...)

fields.EN:
(I guess that's how young she was.
Considering she used to be older
than us, this does feel awkward.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりまだ幼いってことか？
　もともとは年上だったのに、
　なんだか不思議な感じだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess that's how young she was.
Considering she used to be older
than us, this does feel awkward.)

fields.EN:
Waaah! What shall I do?
My pendant... Pendant!
fields.JP:
ふえぇ、どうしましょう……！
ペンダントが、ペンダントがー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Waaah! What shall I do?
My pendant... Pendant!

fields.EN:
D-Don't cry! It'll be fine!
You're not helping me one
bit by crying!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫だから泣くな！
貴様に泣かれると、すごーく困るんだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't cry! It'll be fine!
You're not helping me one
bit by crying!

fields.EN:
Um... Here! Look! Fast, right?
See how quickly I can move
side-to-side!
fields.JP:
えーと、ほら、これを見よ！
ちょうこうしょ……じゃない、
ちょうこうそく反復横跳びだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Here! Look! Fast, right?
See how quickly I can move
side-to-side!

fields.JP:
見たか！？　このスピード感！
すごいだろう！！

fields.EN:
(Hameln is trying to stop
Cinderella from crying?)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラが泣いていて、
　ハーメルンはそれを慰めようとしてる、
　ってとこか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hameln is trying to stop
Cinderella from crying?)

fields.EN:
(Uh, but I've never seen such a
weird way of trying to stop
someone from crying before...)
fields.JP:
（でも、泣いてる相手に対して
　あんなヘンテコな慰め方は初めて見た……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh, but I've never seen such a
weird way of trying to stop
someone from crying before...)

fields.EN:
Augh! Stop crying already!
What am I supposed to do?!
fields.JP:
ああー、もう泣くなというに！
ワレはどうしたらいいのだー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Augh! Stop crying already!
What am I supposed to do?!

fields.EN:
I'm not sure, but I know that
what you were doing there
isn't going to do the trick...
fields.JP:
どうしたらって、少なくとも
反復横跳びを披露することじゃ
ないと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure, but I know that
what you were doing there
isn't going to do the trick...

fields.EN:
Otsuu! Perfect timing!
Help me stop Cinderella from
crying!
fields.JP:
おつう！　よいところに来てくれた！
シンデレラが泣いてしまって
困っていたんでゃじょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Perfect timing!
Help me stop Cinderella from
crying!

fields.JP: ハーメルン、シンデレラをいじめたのか？
なななっ、そんなわけあるみゃい！！

fields.EN:
She wasn't teasing me, Otsuu.
She was just helping me with
my training...
fields.JP:
……ちがうんですの、おつう。
ハーメルンはわたしの訓練に
付き合ってくれていただけですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She wasn't teasing me, Otsuu.
She was just helping me with
my training...

fields.EN:
I haven't trained in a long while,
and I didn't want to get in
anyone's way, so...
fields.JP:
もう長いこと訓練なんてしていなかったので、
みんなの足手まといにならないように
しなくてはと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't trained in a long while,
and I didn't want to get in
anyone's way, so...

fields.EN: I see... Well, good for you.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... Well, good for you.

fields.EN:
But once the training was over, I noticed
that my... my precious pendant was gone...
fields.JP:
でも訓練がひとくぎりついて、
気がついたら、わたしの……
大切なペンダントがなくなっていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But sometime during the training
my pendant must have come loose,
and...

fields.EN:
And that's when she started
crying. You can't imagine how
confused I was.
fields.JP:
それで急に泣き出してしまったのだ。
ワレはものすごく焦ったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that's when she started
crying. You can't imagine how
confused I was.

fields.EN:
Pendant? Are you referring to the
one with the glass slipper
trinket on it?
fields.JP:
ペンダントって、
あの小さいガラスの靴のペンダントのことだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pendant? Are you referring to the
one with the glass slipper
trinket on it?

fields.EN:
Yes... I think it flew off during
training.
fields.JP:
はい……。たぶんはげしく動いたときに
落ちてしまったのですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I think it flew off during
training.

fields.EN:
Then it has to be around here
somewhere. It's a good thing it
didn't come off during battle.
fields.JP:
それなら、きっと近くに落ちてるはずだ。
戦闘中とかじゃなくてまだよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then it has to be around here
somewhere. It's a good thing it
didn't come off during battle.

fields.EN:
I-I need that pendant, or else...
I... I...
fields.JP:
でも……あのペンダントがないと、
わたし、わたし……っ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I need that pendant, or else...
I... I...

fields.EN:
Without it I feel unbearably ugly,
and I can't stop feeling anxious...!
fields.JP:
自分がどうしようもなくみにくく思えて、
不安で仕方ないんですの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't help but think that I look
utterly unsightly without it!

fields.EN:
Y-You're fine! Cheer up!
I'll help look too, so stop with
the crying thing!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫だ！　元気を出せ！
ワレらも探してやるから、
そんなにめそめそするな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're fine! Cheer up!
I'll help look too, so stop with
the crying thing!

fields.EN:
Calm down, Cinderella.
I'm sure we'll find it.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、落ち着いて。
きっとすぐに見つかるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Cinderella.
I'm sure we'll find it.

fields.EN:
Indeed!
You're in good hands here!
fields.JP:
そうだぞ！
大船に乗ったちゅもりでいるがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
You're in good hands here!

fields.EN:
And Hameln, be careful while you
search. Whatever you do, don't
step on the pendant and break it.
fields.JP:
それとハーメルン。くれぐれも気をつけて
探すんだぞ。間違ってもペンダントを
踏んで壊したりしないようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, just a fair warning to
you, but be very careful where
you're stepping, got it?

fields.EN:
H-How rude! Y-You don't need
to say that to me!
fields.JP:
な、なぜワレを名指しで念を押す！？
なんとなく失礼な気がするぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-How rude! Y-You don't need
to say that to me!

fields.JP: さあ、さっそく探そうか！

fields.EN:
Hey! Here it is!
This is it, right?
fields.JP: ……あっ、あった！　これだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Here it is!
This is it, right?

fields.JP: こ、これです！　これですわ！！

fields.EN:
So there it is! Good thing we
found it, isn't that right
Cinderella?
fields.JP:
なんだ、そんなところにあったのだな。
見つかってよかったな、シンデレラ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So there it is! Good thing we
found it, isn't that right
Cinderella?

fields.EN:
Why yes! Aah, thank goodness...
Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
はいっ！　ああ、よかった……。
お二人とも、本当にありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes! Aah, thank goodness...
Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
*sigh*... Now I can finally calm down. Without
this, I get so anxious I can hardly stand it.
fields.JP:
はぁ……これで落ち着きましたわ。
これがないと、もう不安で仕方なくって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah... I feel better already.
I can't imagine how life would be
without it.

fields.EN:
You said something about feeling
like you're unsightly?
fields.JP: 醜くく思えて不安、って言ってたっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said something about feeling
like you're unsightly?

fields.EN:
Why yes, without it I lack of any
form of physical beauty...
fields.JP:
はい……。
これをつけていないと、わたしは、
その……ぜんぜん美しくありませんもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, without it I lack of any
form of physical beauty...

fields.EN:
Not at all. Why do you think you
need it to be beautiful?
fields.JP:
別にそんなことはないだろう。
なぜそれがないと美しくないなんて
言うのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. Why do you think you
need it to be beautiful?

fields.EN:
I'm not beautiful... I only look
beautiful because I wear beautiful
things on me.
fields.JP:
だって……わたしはきれいじゃない
からですわ。きれいなもので着飾って、
ようやく少しまともに見えるんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not beautiful... I only look
beautiful because I wear beautiful
things on me.

fields.EN:
I think you're plenty
beautiful just as you are.
fields.JP: 君は普通にしていても十分きれいだと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think you would look any
different without it.

fields.EN:
No... If that's true, then it's only
because this pendant and my other
decorations make me look that way.
fields.JP:
そんな……もしそうだとしたら、
きっとこのペンダントや、他のかざりの
おかげでそう見えているだけですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true... My pendant and
all that I wear makes me who
I am...

fields.EN:
My true form is utterly unsightly,
and miserable...
fields.JP:
本当のわたしなんて……みにくくて……
みすぼらしくて、ぜんぜん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My true form is utterly unsightly,
and miserable...

fields.EN:
Huh, I wouldn't think that in the
slightest. I guess that must be
your Blood Libido...
fields.JP:
うーむ、そんなことないと思うんだがなぁ。
これがけっしきリビドーというやつなのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, I wouldn't think that in the
slightest. I guess that must be
your Blood Libido...

fields.EN:
I recall someone long ago telling
me how beautiful I was...
I think it was my mother.
fields.JP:
それに……昔、「キレイ、キレイ」って、
誰かに言ってもらった記憶がありますの。
たぶん、お母さまに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I recall someone long ago telling
me how beautiful I was...
I think it was my mother.

fields.JP: へぇ、お母さんのことを覚えてるのか？

fields.EN:
I don't recall much, but I do
starkly remember how she said
those words to me...
fields.JP:
ほとんど記憶にはないんですけど、
あの優しい言葉だけは覚えていますわ。
きっとあれはお母さまなんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't recall much, but I do
starkly remember how she said
those words to me...

fields.EN:
I fondly remember my mother's
words bringing great joy to me.
fields.JP:
お母さまにキレイキレイって言って
もらえて、すごくうれしかったことだけは
覚えていますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I fondly remember my mother's
words bringing great joy to me.

fields.EN:
That is why I need to stay
beautiful at all times.
fields.JP:
……だからわたしは、
きれいでなければいけませんの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That is why I need to stay
beautiful at all times.

fields.EN:
But wasn't your mother referring
to you being beautiful, and not
what was on you?
fields.JP:
でも君のお母さんは、そのままの
シンデレラをきれいって言ったんだろう？
だったらそのままでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But wasn't your mother referring
to you being beautiful, and not
what was on you?

fields.EN:
No! I have to dress myself up properly...
I'm not beautiful at all otherwise. I
can't help feeling anxious about it.
fields.JP:
だめですの、ちゃんときかざらないと……
わたしはぜんぜんきれいじゃありませんわ。
どうしても不安になってしまうんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... I need to dress properly...
I'm not beautiful... I need to
keep myself well-dressed...

fields.EN:
I see...
Well, I guess it can't be helped
if that's your Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
……そっか。
血式リビドーじゃ、仕方ないよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Well, I guess it can't be helped
if that's your Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
(Still, I think she can hold a
bit more confidence in herself...)
fields.JP:
（とは言っても、シンデレラには
　もっと自信を持ってもらえると
　いいんだけどな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Still, I think she can hold a
bit more confidence in herself...)

fields.EN:
(Not that there's anything I can
do for her now...)
fields.JP:
（こればかりは僕がいくら言っても、
　どうにもならないか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not that there's anything I can
do for her now...)

fields.EN:
Hm, I see...
Quite the discovery...
fields.JP:
ふむ、なるほど。
これは素晴らしい発見かもしれん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, I see...
Quite the discovery...

fields.EN:
Isn't it? If this theory is
correct, this will greatly advance
our research.
fields.JP:
ええ。この仮説が正しければ、
研究が飛躍的に進むことになるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it? If this theory is
correct, this will greatly advance
our research.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: What are you folks talking about?
fields.JP: やあ。なんの話をしてたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you folks talking about?

fields.JP: え？　あ……なんの話というか、その……

fields.EN:
Otsuu, what timing... I want
you to be in the know with us.
fields.JP:
おつう、ちょうどよかった。
君にも聞いてほしいと思っていたところだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, what timing... I want
you to be in the know with us.

fields.EN:
We found out that the blood sample
we recovered at the old Liberated
District was Cinderella's.
fields.JP:
破壊された元解放地区で回収した
血式少女の血液サンプルが、
シンデレラのものだったと判明したのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found out that the blood sample
we recovered at the old Liberated
District was Cinderella's.

fields.EN:
There are only two or three, but we're
lucky such valuable samples were left behind.
fields.JP:
ほんの２、３個だけだけど、
こんなに貴重な資料が遺されていたなんて
運が良かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have only a couple on hand,
but we're lucky that such a prime
sample was found.

fields.EN:
What wonders await as we
research these samples...
Heh heh...
fields.JP:
ああ、ここからどんな新しい発見が
あるのかしら。ふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What wonders await as we
research these samples...
Heh heh...

fields.EN:
You look quite happy, Gretel.
Is it that much of a discovery?
fields.JP:
グレーテル、嬉しそうだな。
それってそこまで喜ぶようなことなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You look quite happy, Gretel.
Is it that much of a discovery?

fields.EN:
Cinderella's blood samples match
closely to her current blood
samples despite the time lapse.
fields.JP:
簡潔に言えば、この五年前の血液サンプルと
今のシンデレラの血液状態に、
ほとんど変化が見られなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella's blood samples match
closely to her current blood
samples despite the time lapse.

fields.JP: その反応は、よくわかっていないようね

fields.EN:
Listen. It's normally impossible
for blood from five years ago to be
the same as someone's blood now.
fields.JP:
いいかい？　五年前の血液と今の血液が
同じなんて、普通はあり得ないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Under normal circumstances, blood
found five years ago wouldn't keep
it's state.

fields.EN:
Cinderella's body hasn't changed...
or deteriorated at all in five years.
In other words, she hasn't aged!
fields.JP:
シンデレラの体は、五年前から変化……
劣化してない。つまり歳をとっていない
ということなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But her blood hasn't changed much,
which means that the blood hasn't
aged.

fields.EN:
We were discussing why Cinderella
hasn't aged.
fields.JP:
「なぜシンデレラは年を取らなかったのか」。
この問題について僕とグレーテルは議論を重ねた
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were discussing why Cinderella
hasn't aged.

fields.EN:
And at last we arrived at a new
hypothesis: perhaps Cinderella didn't
age because she remained in Blood Skelter!
fields.JP:
そしてついに、「ブラッドスケルター化
していた影響ではないか」という
新しい仮説を導き出したんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That led us to the theory that
Blood Skelter affects the aging
process of Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
That's quite a discovery. Come to
think of it, Cinderella was under
Blood Skelter the whole time.
fields.JP:
おお、それは大発見だな。
たしかにシンデレラはずっと
ブラッドスケルター化していたしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite a discovery. Come to
think of it, Cinderella was under
Blood Skelter the whole time.

fields.EN:
She hasn't changed much in
appearance too, so you folks
may be right.
fields.JP:
外見も変わっていないから、
その仮説は本当に正しいのかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
She hasn't changed much in
appearance too, so you folks
may be right.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack doesn't understand,
huh? Well, I can't blame you.
fields.JP:
ジャックにはわからないか。
まぁ、無理もない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Jack.
This discussion is a bit too
hard for you.

fields.EN:
You were just staring there...
Are you feeling okay?
fields.JP:
いや、なんかぼーっとしてるみたいだったから。
気分でも悪いのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were just staring there...
Are you feeling okay?

fields.EN:
I-I'm absolutely fine...
Look! I've never felt better!
Ohohohoho!
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことありませんわ。
わたしはいつでもシャキッとしていましてよ！
おーっほっほっほー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm absolutely fine...
Look! I've never felt better!
Ohohohoho!

fields.EN:
So, not aging also means that
my beauty is eternal!
fields.JP:
歳をとらないということは、
つまりわたしの美しさをずっと
保てるということですのね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, not aging also means that
my beauty is eternal!

fields.EN:
How delightful!
After all, getting old means that
I would only become decrepit...
fields.JP:
そう、歳をとらないのなら、みにくく
ヨボヨボになっちゃうこともないん
ですもの……。素晴らしいことですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How delightful!
After all, getting old means that
I would only become decrepit...

fields.EN:
(Cinderella must understand. If she
doesn't age, that also means she won't grow.)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラはきっとわかっている。
　老いがないということは、
　成長もしないということだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She knows that getting old is
how one can mature.)

fields.EN:
(She must feel lonely not being
able to age with everyone...)
fields.JP:
（みんなと一緒に歳を重ねることができず、
　一人だけ置いて行かれてしまう孤独……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must feel lonely not being
able to age with everyone...)

fields.EN:
(She's putting on a brave face, but her
feelings must be complicated. ...I'm an
idiot. I said something really insensitive.)
fields.JP:
（強がって見せているけど、
　複雑な心境だろうな。……僕は馬鹿だ。
　無神経なことを言ってしまったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must feel very weird to her...
I should've noticed before I said
all those things...)

fields.JP:
（ん？　なんだかあっちのほうが
　騒がしいみたいだけど……）

fields.EN: Why are you on her side?!
fields.JP: なぜこんな奴を庇うのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why are you on her side?!

fields.EN:
How many times do I have to
say this? Are you stupid?!
fields.JP:
だーかーら、違うんだって
何度言えばわかるのよ！
このアンポンタン！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How many times do I have to
say this? Are you stupid?!

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Cinderella-san. You're not at
fault, so hold your head high.
fields.JP:
大丈夫ですよ。
シンデレラさんは悪くないんですから、
堂々としていればいいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. We know you're fine.
Just stay strong.

fields.EN:
Stop it right there.
Do you have a problem with my
friends here?
fields.JP: はい、そこまで。僕の仲間になにか用か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it right there.
Do you have a problem with my
friends here?

fields.EN:
That girl there killed one of us!
She won't get away from her sins
killing Hitsuka-sama!
fields.JP:
その女はタイヨウ教団の陽司様を
殺害した大罪人だ！
それを庇うなど、言語道断！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That girl there killed one of us!
She won't get away from her sins
killing Hitsuka!

fields.EN:
Like I said, she didn't kill him!
What are those ears on you for?!
fields.JP:
だからシンデレラは千昭を殺してなんか
いないって言ってるでしょ！？
人の話を聞きなさいっての！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said, she didn't kill him!
What are those ears on you for?!

fields.EN:
It's all a misunderstanding.
We explained this already,
and Michiru agreed, too!
fields.JP:
全部誤解なのよ。このことは
前にもきちんと教団で説明したし、
ミチルだってわかってくれたわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's all a misunderstanding.
We explained this already,
and Michiru agreed, too!

fields.EN:
If you're supposed to be one of
the hot-shots here, then you
should listen to her!
fields.JP:
あんたも教団の幹部なら、
その判断に従うべきでしょう！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're supposed to be one of
the hot-shots here, then you
should listen to her!

fields.EN:
Hmph! I bet you tricked Lady
Oohime-sama, tainting her purity!
fields.JP:
ふん！　どうせ姑息な手を使って、
純粋な大陽女様を欺いたのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! I bet you tricked Lady
Oohime, tainting her purity!

fields.EN: W-We wouldn't do such a thing!
fields.LOCALIZED: W-We wouldn't do such a thing!

fields.EN:
Uh, what the hell is
going on here?
fields.JP: おいこら、なに揉め事起こしてんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, what the hell is
going on here?

fields.EN:
Mamoru, what perfect timing. The
person here is apparently a key
member of the Order, and...
fields.JP:
マモル、ちょうどよかった。
この人はタイヨウ教団の幹部らしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, what perfect timing. The
person here is apparently a key
member of the Order, and...

fields.JP: ……ああ、なんとなく事情はわかった

fields.EN:
We got rules around here, and if
you're gonna cause trouble I'm
gonna have to ask you to leave.
fields.JP:
おい、あんた。
こんなところでもルールはあるんだ。
問題を起こすようなら出てってもらうぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We got rules around here, and if
you're gonna cause trouble I'm
gonna have to ask you to leave.

fields.EN: All right, one guest heading home~.
fields.JP: はいはい、一名様お帰りでーす、っと
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure, but only after you leave.

fields.EN:
Unbelievable...
Do you girls have to go through
this every time?
fields.JP:
まったく……。さっきみたいな奴は
珍しくないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable...
Do you girls have to go through
this every time?

fields.EN:
Those in the Order who don't like
seeing us sisters often cause
trouble like that...
fields.JP:
……白雪たちをタイヨウ教団の陽司として
気に食わない人達は、ああしてわざと
問題を起こしてくるんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those in the Order who don't like
seeing us sisters often cause
trouble like that...

fields.EN:
(They can't afford to show weakness
to people like that. That's part of
why Oyayubi became so distrustful...)
fields.JP:
（ああいう連中に隙を見せるわけには
　いかない。親指が疑い深くなったのは、
　そのせいもあったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can see why Thumbelina was
suspecting anyone who came
near her...)

fields.JP:
い……今の人が言っていたことは、
本当なんでしょうか……？

fields.EN:
That was complete bull.
Just forget about it.
fields.JP:
全部でたらめよ。
あんな言葉に耳を貸す必要ないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was complete bull.
Just forget about it.

fields.EN:
She's right, Cinderella.
You've done nothing wrong.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、シンデレラ。
君は悪くないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Cinderella.
You've done nothing wrong.

fields.EN:
But you don't have proof that
I wasn't the perpetrator, right?
fields.JP:
でも……わたしが犯人じゃないという
証拠もありませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you don't have proof that
I wasn't the perpetrator, right?

fields.EN:
M-Maybe I did lay hands on him
when I went into Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
も、もしかしたら本当に、
ブラッドスケルター化したときに、
わたしがやったんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-Maybe I did lay hands on him
when I went into Blood Skelter...

fields.JP: そうじゃないんです、シンデレラさん……！

fields.EN:
How can you be so sure?
I may be the culprit...
fields.JP:
どうして言い切れますの？
そういう可能性だって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How can you be so sure?
I may be the culprit...

fields.EN:
I think it's best we let her in
on all the details...
fields.JP:
……もう、すべてを話したほうが
いいかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's best we let her in
on all the details...

fields.EN:
B-But if what you said is true,
then I was the one who led to
Hitsuka-san's death...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな……。
では、やっぱりわたしのせいで、
陽司さんが……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But if what you said is true,
then I was the one who led to
Hitsuka's death...
