fields.JP: あんたのせいじゃないわ

fields.EN:
But I'm practically the cause. If I
hadn't gone to the Solitary Confinement
Area alone, none of that would have...
fields.JP:
でも、わたしが原因のようなものですわ。
わたしが一人で独房エリアへ行ったり
しなければ、そんなことには……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am at fault... If I didn't go
to the prison area alone, then
none of that would've happened.

fields.EN:
Don't get down on yourself.
Finding faults isn't going to do
anyone good.
fields.JP:
自分を責めないで。
なにが原因かなんて言い出したら
きりがないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't get down on yourself.
Finding faults isn't going to do
anyone good.

fields.EN:
Like, I could even say that it
wouldn't have happened if I didn't
say all those things to you...
fields.JP:
元はと言えば、わたしが酷いこと
言ったりしなければ、あんたが一人で
独房エリアに行くこともなかったんだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, I could even say that it
wouldn't have happened if I didn't
say all those things to you...

fields.EN:
Please, stop! You don't need to
try and cover me like this!
Nothing will change the fact!
fields.JP:
なぐさめなんてやめてください！
なにを言っても、起きてしまったことは
変わりませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, stop! You don't need to
try and cover me like this!
Nothing will change the fact!

fields.JP:
もう、わたしのことなんて
放っておいてください……！

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry for yelling...
I... got out of hand there.
fields.JP:
……大きな声を出したりして、
すみませんでした。
取り乱してしまいましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry for yelling...
I... got out of hand there.

fields.EN:
Please, leave me alone for a
moment. I need to think for
awhile alone...
fields.JP:
少し、一人にしてください。
気持ちを落ち着かせたいんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, leave me alone for a
moment. I need to think for
awhile alone...

fields.EN:
(This isn't good... She hasn't
matured like us mentally...)
fields.JP:
（……心配だな。シンデレラの精神年齢は、
　外見の年齢と同じくらいのはずだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't good... She hasn't
matured like us mentally...)

fields.EN:
(I doubt she can process all
that we told her...)
fields.JP:
（それなのにいきなりあんな真実を
　知らされたら、自分の中でうまく
　処理できないかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I doubt she can process all
that we told her...)

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what else we can
say to her...
fields.JP:
なんて声をかければいいのか、
わかりませんでした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what else we can
say to her...

fields.JP: 僕もだよ。……もどかしいけど

fields.EN:
All we can do now is to grant her
wish by leaving her alone for
a moment...
fields.JP:
ええ。きっと今は、そっとしておくしか
ないんでしょうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we can do now is to grant her
wish by leaving her alone for
a moment...

fields.EN:
Maybe we should check on Cinderella from
time to time, so she doesn't brood over
this and start thinking anything strange...
fields.JP:
シンデレラが思いつめて変なことを
考えないように、ちょくちょく顔を出したほうが
いいかもしれないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better check up on her every so
often so that she doesn't go
astray...

fields.JP:
（シンデレラ……。
　まだ元気なさそうだな……）

あ、シンデレラだー！
ねーねーねー、なにしてんのー？

fields.EN:
Ooh! How 'bout we play?!
Play with Rapunzel!
fields.JP:
じゃあさ、じゃあさ、
ラプンツェルとあそぼーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! How 'bout we play?!
Play with Rapunzel!

fields.JP: ？　げんきない？　おなかすいたの？

fields.EN: Augh! What a pain in the...!
fields.JP: あーもー、見てらんないわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Augh! What a pain in the...!

fields.EN:
(Oyayubi?! She was
eavesdropping on her, too?)
fields.JP:
（って、親指！？
　近くに隠れて見てたのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thumbelina?! She was
eavesdropping on her, too?)

fields.EN:
How many times do I have to tell you
that you weren't at fault?! Cheer up already!
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、あんたは悪くないって
何度も言ってるでしょ？
いい加減、元気出しなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How many times do I need to
tell you that it's okay?!
Get a grip already!

fields.EN:
(I know she's trying to cheer
Cinderella up, but it's hard to
tell with all her yelling...)
fields.JP:
（励ましたいんだろうなぁ。
　あんな逆ギレみたいな言い方じゃ、
　わかりづらいけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know she's trying to cheer
Cinderella up, but it's hard to
tell with all her yelling...)

fields.EN:
If you're in the wrong, then the
same goes for me, too! Why do you
keep blaming yourself?!
fields.JP:
あんたが悪いんなら、わたしだって
悪いんだから！　自分ばっかり
責めるのはおかしいでしょ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're in the wrong, then the
same goes for me, too! Why do you
keep blaming yourself?!

fields.EN:
You're fine, Oyayubihime... I was
the one who went off to the
prison area, not you...
fields.JP:
……親指姫は悪くありませんわ。
独房エリアなんかに一人で行ったのは、
結局はわたしなんですもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're fine, Thumbelina... I was
the one who went off to the
prison area, not you...

fields.EN:
If it was someone else, they
wouldn't have ran off like how
I did...
fields.JP:
もしわたしと同じ状況になったとしても、
他の人ならあんなところに
行かなかったかもしれないんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it was someone else, they
wouldn't have ran off like how
I did...

fields.EN:
Sure, maybe, but that's a moot
point!
fields.JP:
かも、でしょ？　仮定の話をいくら
したってしょうがないじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, maybe, but that's a moot
point!

fields.EN:
Hitsuka-san wouldn't have died if
I didn't run off like that...
fields.JP:
わたしがあの時ぼうそうして、
独房エリアなんて行ったから……
陽司さんが死ぬことになったんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hitsuka wouldn't have died if
I didn't run off like that...

fields.JP:
そんなわたしには、もう生きてる資格
なんてないんですわ……！
……そんなこと、本気で言ってるの……？

おやゆび、ないてる……？
どっかいたいの？

fields.EN:
No, that's not it... When I think
that I'm the one who made you
say you don't deserve to live...
fields.JP:
ううん、そうじゃなくて……。
生きてる資格がないなんて、そんなこと
言わせちゃったのがわたしだと思ったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it's just that hearing
Cinderella say she doesn't deserve
to live cut me deep...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry to make you think that.
I should've apologized from
before...
fields.JP:
ごめん、シンデレラ……。
本当はずっと謝りたかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry to make you think that.
I should've apologized from
before...

fields.EN:
I've regretted all this time that
I didn't properly listen to you.
I was being stubborn back then...
fields.JP:
ちゃんと話を聞いてあげれば
よかったって、ずっと後悔してた。
あのときは意固地になっちゃってたの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I regretted not hearing you out.
I just couldn't get myself
to listen...

fields.EN:
If only I listened and helped you
in your time of need... Maybe then
no one would've gotten hurt...
fields.JP:
謝らなきゃいけないのはわたしのほうだわ。
あんたの話を聞いて、力になっていれば、
誰も傷つかずに済んだのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I listened and helped you
in your time of need... Maybe then
no one would've gotten hurt...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Cinderella...
I really should've apologized
earlier...
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、ごめんなさい。
……もっと早くに謝っていればよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Cinderella...
I really should've apologized
earlier...

fields.EN:
I never imagined you were
suffering in the same way too...
fields.JP:
……あなたも同じように苦しんでいたなんて、
わたし、思いもしませんでしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It didn't dawn on me that you were
in so much pain over me...

fields.EN:
I kept thinking I was the only one
causing all the trouble and
suffering from it...
fields.JP:
悪いのも、苦しんでいるのも、
ぜんぶ自分一人だと思い込んで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept thinking I was the only one
causing all the trouble and
suffering from it...

fields.EN:
(To think they were both blaming
themselves in the same way. At this
rate, neither of them can be saved...)
fields.JP:
（二人とも同じように自分を責めていたなんて。
　これじゃどっちも救われない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess they were both suffering
over the same thing...)

fields.JP: えっとねー、ふたりともだいじょうぶだよ！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel get into fight with
Cinderella before. Cried a lot.
fields.JP:
あのね、ラプンツェルもこのあいだ、
シンデレラとけんかして、ないちゃったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel get into fight with
Cinderella before. Cried a lot.

fields.EN:
But Oyayubi said that was okay.
Kids make mistakes and grow!
fields.JP:
でもね、おやゆびがそれでもいいって
いったんだよ。ちいさいころは、
しっぱいしておおきくなるんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Thumby said that was okay.
Kids make mistakes and grow!

fields.EN: I guess I did say that before...
fields.JP: そういえば、そんな話もしたわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess I did say that before...

fields.EN:
So no worry! Cinderella and Oyayubi
made mistake when little!
Learn from mistake!
fields.JP:
だからだいじょうぶ！　シンデレラとおやゆびが
ちいさいころしっぱいしたことなら、
これからはやらなきゃいいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So no worry! Cinderella and Thumby
made mistake when little!
Learn from mistake!

fields.EN:
You said the person you hurt would
be happier that way too. Right, Oyayubi?
fields.JP:
しっぱいされたひとも、
そのほうがよろこぶんだって。
ね、そうでしょ？　おやゆび！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby said that make mistake
can make everyone happy, too!
Right?

fields.EN:
You're right, Rapu... I just have
to avoid making the same
mistake again.
fields.JP:
……ラプ、あんたの言う通りだわ。
もう同じ失敗を繰り返さなければ
いいだけの話なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right, Rappy... I just have
to avoid making the same
mistake again.

fields.EN: Thanks, I feel a lot better now...
fields.JP: ありがとう。なんだか、すごく気が楽に……
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks, I feel a lot better now...

fields.EN:
Oyayubi? You crying?
Rapunzel make you cry?
fields.JP:
おやゆび？　あれ？　なんでなくの？
ラプンツェル、へんなこといった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby? You crying?
Rapunzel make you cry?

fields.EN:
No, I'm just relieved, that's all.
I appreciate you reminding me
what I said.
fields.JP:
違うの。ホッとしちゃっただけ。
大事なことを思い出させてくれて、
あんたには感謝してる
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm just relieved, that's all.
I appreciate you reminding me
what I said.

fields.EN:
Your words of honesty has lifted
the load that was on me, Rapu.
fields.JP:
ラプの素直な言葉のおかげで、
ずっと胸の奥につかえていたものが
取れたような気がしますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your words of honesty has lifted
the load that was on me, Rappy.

fields.EN:
I guess I was getting a bit too
stubborn there...
fields.JP:
わたしはかたくなだったのかも
しれませんわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I was getting a bit too
stubborn there...

fields.EN:
We just need to be a bit more
honest like her.
fields.JP:
これからはもっと素直になればいいじゃない。
わたしたち
fields.LOCALIZED:
We just need to be a bit more
honest like her.

fields.EN:
Huh? Not sure what happening,
but no crying, right?
fields.JP:
？　よくわかんないけど、
ふたりとも、もうなかない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Not sure what happening,
but no crying, right?

fields.EN:
Why yes, I feel like we're all
great friends again because of
you, Rapu.
fields.JP: ええ、ラプのおかげで仲直りできましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, I feel like we're all
great friends again because of
you, Rappy.

fields.JP: ほんと！？　えへへー、よかった！

fields.EN:
(...Whew, looks like that's settled.
Rapunzel is amazing. Is that what
you'd call wild instinct?)
fields.JP:
（……ふぅ、一件落着か。
　ラプンツェルはすごいな。
　野生の勘、ってやつか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whew... I guess that takes care
of that. Kudos to Rapunzel's
sheer honesty.)

fields.EN:
(Things will still be hard, but those two
have friends who'll support them. Me included,
of course. So I'm sure they'll be fine.)
fields.JP:
（これからも大変なことがあるだろうけど、
　二人には支えてくれる仲間がいる。
　もちろん、僕も。だからきっと大丈夫だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There will be more to face, but
we're all here to help each other,
so it'll all be fine.)

fields.EN:
(Now then, I better take leave.
There's nothing else for me to
see here.)
fields.JP:
（……さてと、そろそろ行くとするか。
　これ以上盗み見するのは野暮だもんな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now then, I better take leave.
There's nothing else for me to
see here.)

fields.EN:
What's the matter with the
sighing?
fields.JP:
どうしたんだ？
ため息なんかついちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter with the
sighing?

fields.EN:
Nothing. Even I have times when I
want to sit alone and brood for a while.
fields.JP:
別に、なんでもありませんわ。
わたしだって、一人でたそがれたい
ときくらいありますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing in particular.
I just happened to sigh,
that's all.

fields.EN:
Oh now, what's with that look?
I feel like you're taunting me
here.
fields.JP:
む。なんですの？　その反応は。
なんだかばかにされてるみたいですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh now, what's with that look?
I feel like you're taunting me
here.

fields.EN:
Of course not.
Why would I do that?
fields.JP: まさか。馬鹿になんてするわけないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not.
Why would I do that?

fields.EN:
Well, your attitude isn't helping!
Hmph!
fields.JP:
その余裕な感じがばかにしてるみたい
だって言ってますのよ！　もうっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, your attitude isn't helping!
Hmph!

fields.EN: Now, now, no need to get angry.
fields.JP: まあまあ、そう怒るなって
fields.LOCALIZED: Now, now, no need to get angry.

fields.EN:
I still can't believe you're all
older than me now! If only...!
fields.JP:
やっぱりおつう達ばっかり先に
大人になるなんて許せませんわ！
わたしだって、わたしだって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still can't believe you're all
older than me now! If only...!

fields.JP:
あれ？　怒ったかと思えば
急に落ち込んで……忙しいな

fields.EN:
Hmph...
Sure, it's not surprising I'm
emotionally unstable, right?
fields.JP: ふん。どうせ、じょうちょふあんていですわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph...
Sure, it's not surprising I'm
emotionally unstable, right?

fields.EN:
...I used to think I was so
inadequate because, unlike you
adults, I was still a child.
fields.JP:
……前は、わたしがふがいないのは、
大人のおつう達と違って
子どもだからだと思ってましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I was lacking only in
age in comparison to you folks.

fields.EN:
But that wasn't true.
Even Rapu had a strong center,
unlike me.
fields.JP:
でも違うってわかりましたわ。
ラプは小さい子なのに、わたしよりしっかりした
『自分』というものを持っていますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that wasn't true.
Even Rappy had a strong center,
unlike me.

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime is doing her best to
get over her own weakness, too.
fields.JP:
親指姫だって、自分に至らない
ところがあれば、それをカバーしようと
努力していますし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina is doing her best to
get over her own weakness, too.

fields.EN:
It all boils down to how each one
approaches themselves. Being old
made no difference.
fields.JP:
要は、どう生きるかなんですのよね。
大人かどうかなんて、関係なかったんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It all boils down to how each one
approaches themselves. Being old
made no difference.

fields.EN:
In that sense, me being worried about
everyone being older than me is
proof of my immaturity...
fields.JP:
大人か子どもかなんて気にしている時点で、
わたしはいつまでも子どもで……
不甲斐ないってことですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that sense, me being worried about
everyone being older than me is
proof of my immaturity...

fields.EN:
Have you been listening to what
I said? What made you say that?
fields.JP:
ちょっ、今の話を聞いてまして？
なんでそうなるんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Have you been listening to what
I said? What made you say that?

fields.EN:
No, Cinderella. Worrying about it means
you're thinking it through yourself, right?
That's impressive.
fields.JP:
いや、シンデレラがそうやって悩んでるのは、
自分でいろいろ考えてるからだろ？
すごいことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm amazed that you're so deep
in thought.

fields.EN:
Someone who's truly inadequate wouldn't worry
about it, and probably wouldn't even realize
they were inadequate in the first place.
fields.JP:
本当に不甲斐ない奴は
悩んだりしないし、そもそも自分が
不甲斐ないことに気づかないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Immature people don't think like
that, and don't notice that they
are immature in the first place.

fields.EN:
...Though I don't really
have anyone like that around me.
fields.JP:
まぁ、僕の周りにはそういう人は
いないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fortunately, there are no real
immature people around me.

fields.EN:
You really did mature, didn't you?
I'm talking about your mental
maturity here.
fields.JP:
……やっぱり、おつうは大人ですわ。
体だけじゃなく心も、という意味ですわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really did mature, didn't you?
I'm talking about your mental
maturity here.

fields.EN:
Come now, I have my own faults.
I keep thinking how I can make
myself better.
fields.JP:
僕だって駄目なところだらけだよ。
もっとしっかりしなきゃって思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, I have my own faults.
I keep thinking how I can make
myself better.

fields.EN:
Heh, whatever you say. Well, I guess
I still have quite a bit to learn.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ひかえめですわね。でもいいですわ。
今のわたしが子どもなら、まだまだ
成長できるということですもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, whatever you say. Well, I guess
I still have quite a bit to learn.

fields.EN:
Just you wait! I'm going to do
my very best to catch up to
you folks!
fields.JP:
たくさんがんばって、今におつう達に
追いついてみせますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just you wait! I'm going to do
my very best to catch up to
you folks!

fields.EN:
Well, that means I need to do
even more so that I can keep
our gap.
fields.JP:
言うね。僕も負けないように
がんばらないとな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that means I need to do
even more so that I can keep
our gap.

fields.EN:
There you go again. Mind you,
I don't like it with that attitude
of yours, acting older than me.
fields.JP:
むぅー。やっぱりその態度、
なんだか余裕な感じで気に入らないですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go again. Mind you,
I don't like it with that attitude
of yours, acting older than me.

fields.EN: Then hurry up, catch up to us, and surpass us.
fields.JP: だったら早く追いついて、追い越せばいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, all you need to do is to
mature inside and act like
you're older than me then.

fields.EN:
You don't have to tell me that!
Like I said, just you wait!
fields.JP:
言われなくてもやってやりますわ。
覚悟しておくことですわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to tell me that!
Like I said, just you wait!

fields.JP:
（また昔みたいに話せるようになって
　よかった……。離れていた時間の分、
　これからはたくさん一緒にいられるといいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm glad we can talk freely like
this again. I'm looking forward to
spending our time together again.)

fields.EN:
Hmm, where should I sit? With this many
empty seats, it's actually hard to choose...
fields.JP:
うーん、どこの席に座ろうかな。
こんなに空いてると、逆に迷うな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Where should I sit?
The place is too open for comfort.

fields.EN:
Oh, Otsuu-chan, look there.
It's Cinderella-san.
fields.JP:
あ。ねぇ、おつうちゃん。
あっちの席でシンデレラさんが食事してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Otsuu, look there.
It's Cinderella.

fields.EN:
*munch* *munch*
It's good to have some time off
like this every so often...
fields.JP:
もぐもぐ……。にぎやかな食事も
楽しいですけど、たまには一人で
ゆっくり食事するのもいいものですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* *munch*
It's good to have some time off
like this every so often...

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm out of water. I'll go get
some. I'll save the side dishes for later...
fields.JP:
……あ、お水がなくなってしまいましたわ。
ちょっともらってきましょう。
おかずは後にとっておいて、と……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh dear, I forgot my water...
I'll finish off my main dish
later...

fields.EN:
Huh? Tasty food here?
No one wants? So waste...
fields.JP:
あれ？　だれもいないのにおかずが
のこってる……。おいしそうなのに、
もったいないなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Tasty food here?
No one wants? So waste...

fields.EN:
Left over, so no one wants.
Rapunzel eat then!
fields.JP:
のこしてあるんだから、
きっともういらないんだよね。
ラプンツェルがたべてあげよっと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Left over, so no one wants.
Rapunzel eat then!

fields.JP: あら、ラプも来ていたんですの？

fields.EN:
I came look for everyone!
Oooh! How about we play?!
fields.JP:
うん！　だれかいないかなーっておもったの！
ねーねー、あそぼー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I came look for everyone!
Oooh! How about we play?!

fields.EN:
Why I'd be delighted.
Oh, but let me first finish my...
Hm?
fields.JP:
いいですわよ。
でも、これを食べ終わってから……あら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why I'd be delighted.
Oh, but let me first finish my...
Hm?

fields.EN:
That's strange... My meal is gone.
I was going to finish off the main
course...
fields.JP:
おかしいですわね。残しておいた
おかずがなくなっていますわ。
最後に食べようと思ってましたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's strange... My meal is gone.
I was going to finish off the main
course...

fields.EN:
Rapu, do you know what happened
to the food that was here?
fields.JP: ラプ、なにか心当たりはありません？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, do you know what happened
to the food that was here?

fields.EN:
Uh... Don't know...
Rapunzel eat left over, so...
fields.JP:
えっと、しらない……。
ラプンツェルがたべたのは、
もういらないおかずだったから……その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Don't know...
Rapunzel eat left over, so...

fields.EN:
That would mean my food
disappeared into thin air.
How unusual.
fields.JP:
ということは、わたしのおかずは
消えてしまったということになりますわね。
ふしぎですわねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would mean my food
disappeared into thin air.
How unusual.

fields.EN:
You really don't know anything?
If you lie, I'll make you swallow
a thousand needles, you know?
fields.JP:
ほんとーに、知りませんの？
もしもうそをついたら、
針千本飲ませちゃいますわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you don't know
anything? You do know that
lying isn't good for you, right?

fields.JP: ふえっ！？　はり、せんぼん……！？

fields.EN:
Cinderella, you can stop teasing
her now.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、脅かすのは
それくらいにしてあげなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, you can stop teasing
her now.

fields.EN:
We saw the whole thing, and we
can tell Rapu-chan didn't mean to do
anything wrong.
fields.JP:
わたしたち一部始終見てたけど、
ラプちゃんに悪気はなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We saw the whole thing, and we
can tell Rappy didn't mean to do
anything wrong.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, you already know that
what you ate was Cinderella's
meal, right?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、自分が食べたおかずは
シンデレラが残しておいたものだって、
もう気づいてるんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, you already know that
what you ate was Cinderella's
meal, right?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... Rapunzel eat it...
Rapunzel thought that food
no one want...
fields.JP:
……うう、ごめんなさい……。
ラプンツェル、たべちゃった……。
もういらないやつだとおもって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... Rapunzel eat it...
Rapunzel thought that food
no one want...

fields.EN:
Fine... It was bad of me that
I left my food behind like that.
fields.JP:
はぁ、仕方ありませんわね。
ここに残していったわたしも悪かったですし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... It was bad of me that
I left my food behind like that.

fields.JP:
まぁ、ちゃんと認めて謝ってくれたん
ですから、それでいいですわ

fields.EN:
U-Um... do I have to
swallow a thousand needles...?
fields.JP:
あ、あの……。はりせんぼん、
のまなきゃいけない……？

fields.EN:
The 'thousand needles' was only
a figure of speech. You don't
actually have to swallow them.
fields.JP:
針千本というのはただの例えですわ。
飲まなくていいですわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I only said that to scare you.
There's nothing to worry about.

fields.EN:
R-Really...?
Whew... So good to hear...
fields.JP: ほ、ほんと……？　はー……よかったぁー
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Really...?
Whew... So good to hear...

fields.EN:
Looks like I scared you a bit more
than necessary. I'm sorry, Rapu.
fields.JP:
思ったよりも怖がらせてしまった
みたいですわね。ごめんなさい、ラプ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like I scared you a bit more
than necessary. I'm sorry, Rappy.

fields.EN:
I fine! But, how come bad?
You know, Otsuu?
fields.JP:
ううん、だいじょうぶ！
でも、なんではりせんぼんなんだろう？
おつう、しってる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I fine! But, how come bad?
You know, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
Huh?! Um...
How can I word this...?
fields.JP: え？　えーと……なんて言えばいいのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Um...
How can I word this...?

fields.EN:
It means you shouldn't lie because it would
make both the other person and yourself feel
as awful as swallowing a thousand needles.
fields.JP:
それはね、相手も自分も針を千本
飲むような辛い気持ちになるから、
嘘ついちゃ駄目だよってことなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When you lie others will feel bad,
so you're not supposed to lie,
got it?

fields.EN:
I'm impressed, Princess!
That is as simple as you could
explain it!
fields.JP: おお、さすが姫！　わかりやすい説明だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm impressed, Princess!
That is as simple as you could
explain it!

fields.JP: へー、つらいきもちかー

fields.EN:
Well, let's make a promise not
to lie again. If you do...
fields.JP:
じゃあ、もううそをつかないって約束
ですわよ。もしも万が一約束を破ったら、
そのときは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's make a promise not
to lie again. If you do...

fields.EN:
Then I'll swallow a thousand
needles together with you, Rapu.
fields.JP:
わたしもラプと一緒に、
針千本飲んであげますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then I'll be in the bad with you,
Rappy.

fields.EN: So please, no more lying, okay?
fields.JP: だから、もううそはだめですわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So please, no more lying, okay?

fields.EN:
Okay! Cinderella not bad!
Rapunzel no make lie!
fields.JP:
わ……わかった！　シンデレラに
はりせんぼん、のませたりしない！
ラプンツェル、うそつかないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Cinderella not bad!
Rapunzel no make lie!

fields.EN: Heh heh... That's good to hear.
fields.JP: ふふ、お願いしますわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh heh... That's good to hear.

fields.EN:
Eek?! H-Hey, don't suddenly
talk to me like that! You startled me!
fields.JP:
ひゃあっ！？
ちょっ、いきなり声かけないでよ！
びっくりするじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yikes! H-Hey, stop it!
Don't creep up on me like that!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, I didn't think you'd be
surprised.
fields.JP: ごめん、そんなに驚くとは思わなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, I didn't think you'd be
surprised.

fields.EN:
Next time let me know you're
going to say something to me!
fields.JP:
次からは、声をかけるときは
前もって声をかけるようにしなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next time let me know you're
going to say something to me!

fields.EN:
That aside, what are you doing
wandering around in front of
Cinderella's room?
fields.JP:
っていうか、ここ、シンデレラの
部屋の前だよな？　こんなところで
なにをウロウロしてたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside, what are you doing
wandering around in front of
Cinderella's room?

fields.EN:
Huh? I was just here, that's all!
Not like I wanted to see her!
fields.JP:
へっ？　べ、別にシンデレラの部屋に
用があったわけじゃないわよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? I was just here, that's all!
Not like I wanted to see her!

fields.JP: なんだか外がうるさいですわね……
ああ、騒がしくてごめん

fields.EN:
Oh my, Otsuu and Oyayubihime?
Is there a problem?
fields.JP:
あら、おつうに親指姫？
なにかありましたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, Otsuu and Thumbelina?
Is there a problem?

fields.EN:
N-No problem at all!
Ah, that's right!
I need to get going...!
fields.JP:
な、なにもないわよ！
わたし、用事を思い出したから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No problem at all!
Ah, that's right!
I need to get going...!

fields.JP: 手紙か？　えーと、宛先は……

fields.EN:
'To Cinderella'...? Oyayubi, were
you trying to give Cinderella a letter?
fields.JP:
『シンデレラへ』……？　親指、シンデレラに
手紙を出そうとしてたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
To Cinderella...
You wrote a letter to Cinderella?

fields.EN:
To me? But, the letter looks
pretty old...
fields.JP:
あら、わたしに？　それにしては
ずいぶん古そうな手紙ですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To me? But, the letter looks
pretty old...

fields.EN:
Augh! Fine!
Yes, that's my letter to you,
Cinderella!
fields.JP:
あーもう！　そうよ。それは
あんたに宛てた手紙よ、シンデレラ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Augh! Fine!
Yes, that's my letter to you,
Cinderella!

fields.EN:
After that fight we had a long
time ago, I wanted to make
amends, so I wrote that letter...
fields.JP:
……あの喧嘩のあと、渡そうと思って
渡せなかった手紙。仲直り……したいと
思って書いたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After that fight we had a long
time ago, I wanted to make
amends, so I wrote that letter...

fields.EN:
Ended up not giving it to you,
but I guess it's embarrassing
to have held onto it for so long.
fields.JP:
でも、結局渡しそびれちゃった。
馬鹿みたいよね。そんなものを
後生大事に持っていたなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ended up not giving it to you,
but I guess it's embarrassing
to have held onto it for so long.

fields.EN:
But, you came wanting to give
me the letter, right?
fields.JP:
でも、またわたしに渡そうと
してくれたんですのよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you came wanting to give
me the letter, right?

fields.JP: それでは。……『シンデレラへ。わたしは』

fields.EN: H-Hey! No reading it out loud!
fields.LOCALIZED: H-Hey! No reading it out loud!

fields.EN:
...So this is what you
were thinking, Oyayubihime.
fields.JP:
……ふぅ。親指姫はこんなことを
思っていましたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I finally understand
what you went through writing
this...

fields.JP: なんて書いてあったんだ？

fields.EN:
I'll keep it secret for the sake of
whoever wrote it.
fields.JP:
それは書いた本人のめいよのためにも
ヒミツにしておきますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will keep it to myself for the
sake of protecting Thumbelina's
pride.

fields.EN:
You're making it sound like
I wrote something weird!
fields.JP:
そ、そんな風に言われたら、
わたしが変な手紙書いたみたい
じゃないのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're making it sound like
I wrote something weird!

fields.EN:
But it's supposed to be an apology letter,
and you don't apologize at all. Heh heh.
fields.JP:
だって謝罪の手紙のはずなのに、
ぜんぜん謝ってないんですもの。ふふっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is weird. For being a
letter to make amends, I didn't
find any words of apology inside.

fields.EN: But, I suppose that is so you...
fields.JP:
でも、それくらいのほうが
あなたらしいですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: But, I suppose that is so you...

fields.EN: ...Hmph. You're cheeky for someone so tiny.
fields.JP:
……ふん、ちっちゃいくせに
生意気なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph...
For being a runt, you sure
talk like an adult.

fields.EN:
Why the nerve of you!
Technically speaking, I am
supposed to be older than you.
fields.JP:
まあ！　本当ならわたしのほうが
年上でしてよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why the nerve of you!
Technically speaking, I am
supposed to be older than you.

fields.EN:
But I look older now! That makes
me the older one here!
fields.JP:
でも見た目はわたしのほうが
お姉さんっぽいでしょ。だったら今は
わたしのほうがお姉さんなんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I look older now! That makes
me the older one here!

fields.EN:
Look who's talking!
You don't look any different from
before!
fields.JP:
見た目だって前とぜんぜん変わってませんわよ！
それなのにお姉さんぶるなんて、
なっとくいきませんわー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look who's talking!
You don't look any different from
before!

fields.EN:
Glad you're great friends again.
You match each other so well.
fields.JP:
仲直りできたみたいでよかったね。
息ぴったりだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad you're great friends again.
You match each other so well.

fields.JP: ほら、やっぱり息ぴったりだ

fields.EN:
Cinderella's been pouting the
whole time, but do you know what's
going on, Jack?
fields.JP:
……なぁ、さっきからシンデレラが
めちゃくちゃむすーっとしてるんだけど。
ジャック、理由とか心当たりあるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella's been pouting the
whole time, but do you know what's
going on, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(Whoa, now she's actually saying
'hmph' out loud! Does she want attention...?)
fields.JP:
（うわ、ついに口でむすーって言い出した！
　構ってほしいのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Great, now she's trying to make
it noticeable...)

fields.EN:
Um... Cinderella?
Is there a problem?
fields.JP:
あ、あのー、シンデレラ？
なにかあったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Cinderella?
Is there a problem?

fields.JP: 別になんでもありませんわ

fields.EN:
(She says it's nothing, but she's
giving off a huge 'pay attention to me' aura.)
fields.JP:
（なんでもないとか言いつつ、
　構ってほしそうなオーラが出てるし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She sure looks like she has a
problem...)

fields.EN:
Um, you're not in a good mood
today, are you?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you're not in a good mood
today, are you?

fields.EN:
Not at all. I was just... getting
a bit frustrated at myself.
fields.JP:
そんなことありませんわ。
……ちょっと、自分にいやけが
さしてるだけですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. I was just... getting
a bit frustrated at myself.

fields.JP: 自分にって……どうかしたのか？

え？　ごめん。
よく聞こえなかったんだけど

fields.EN: I don't look good with rouge on!
fields.JP: 口紅が似合いませんのーーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't look good with rouge on!

fields.EN:
Oh, you're talking about the
lipstick I gave you?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're talking about the
lipstick I gave you?

fields.EN:
Yes! It doesn't look good on me!
Not even in the slightest!
fields.JP:
そうですわ！
もう、ぜんっぜん似合いませんの！
絶望的なほどに！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! It doesn't look good on me!
Not even in the slightest!

fields.EN:
I keep putting it on, but my lips
just turn hideously red!
fields.JP:
せっかくいただいた口紅なのに、
わたしが使ってもくちびるが真っ赤で
ヘンテコになっちゃうんですの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I keep putting it on, but my lips
just turn hideously red!

fields.EN:
Hameln told me with a smile, 'It looks like
you ate a goldfish,' and I was devastated!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンに「金魚食べたみたいだぞ」って
笑顔で言われて、すごくショックでしたわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln laughed at me, telling me
that it looked like I ate a
goldfish! How rude is that?!

fields.JP: だって本当にそのとおりなんですものー！！

fields.EN:
Uh, calm down, Cinderella...
Oh, and your lips won't turn
red eating a goldfish...
fields.JP:
お、落ち着いて、シンデレラ。
金魚を食べても唇は赤くならないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, calm down, Cinderella...
Oh, and your lips won't turn
red eating a goldfish...

fields.EN:
I know that! It's just that what
Hameln was getting at is right!
fields.JP:
それくらいわかってますわ！
でもハーメルンの例えはぜつみょうでしたわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know that! It's just that what
Hameln was getting at is right!

fields.EN:
In other words, this red lipstick
simply doesn't suit me... Red is the
color of an adult woman, isn't it...
fields.JP:
つまりわたしには、この赤い口紅は
似合わないということですわ……。
赤は大人の女性の色なんですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't look good with rouge on me...
I'm just not that dignified...

fields.EN:
D-Don't be so discouraged. Even if
it doesn't suit you now, that's only
because you're still a child...
fields.JP:
そ、そう気を落とさないで。
仮に似合わなかったとしても、
それはまだ君が子どもだからであって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, even if it doesn't look
good on you now, you just need
to be confident about it...

fields.JP: どうせわたしは子どもですわ。ふん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess so. If I don't have confidence,
it just won't look good, huh? Hmph...

fields.JP: （うわぁ、ますますふて腐れちゃった）

fields.EN:
And just when I thought I could
wear make up... I'm so
disappointed in myself...
fields.JP:
お化粧ができると思ってわくわくして
ましたのに、がっかりですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And just when I thought I could
wear make up... I'm so
disappointed in myself...

fields.EN:
...Someday I want to become a
wonderful lady who looks good in lipstick...
fields.JP:
……いつかそのうち、口紅が似合うような、
すてきなレディになりたいですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, I just hope I'll be able
have that kind of confidence
in the future...

fields.EN:
Thanks for trying...
I doubt your hunch is anything
I can look forward to...
fields.JP:
ふふっ、当てになりませんわね。
ありきたりで安っぽい
なぐさめの言葉ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for trying...
I doubt your hunch is anything
I can look forward to...

fields.EN:
Then again, coming from you,
there's a smidgen of hope in
what you said...
fields.JP:
……でもおつうに言われると、
不思議と信じられる気がしますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, coming from you,
there's a smidgen of hope in
what you said...

fields.EN:
You can believe me. Cinderella, I'm
sure you'll grow into a beautiful
woman. You can use the lipstick then.
fields.JP:
信じていいよ。
シンデレラはきっときれいな女の人になる。
口紅はそのときに使えばいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Trust me, you'll do just fine.
You just have to believe in
yourself. That's all there is to it.

fields.EN:
You're right. I'll work hard so I
can become a lady who looks good in lipstick.
fields.JP:
そうですわね。
口紅が似合うレディになれるように、
がんばることにしますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. I just have to try it on.
I have to make the lipstick work for me
instead of the other way around...

fields.EN:
Thank you, Otsuu...
Looks like I have something to
look forward to now.
fields.JP:
おつう、ありがとうございます。
おかげで新しい目標ができましたわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Otsuu...
Looks like I have something to
look forward to now.

fields.EN:
So this must be Akazukin's
room.
fields.JP: あ、ここだね。赤ずきんの部屋
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this must be Red Riding Hood's
room.

fields.EN:
We can come back later if she
isn't. Let's see if she's in.
fields.JP:
留守だったら、また出直せばいいさ。
……じゃあ、ノックするね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can come back later if she
isn't. Let's see if she's in.

fields.EN:
You're not going to knock on
the door?
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not going to knock on
the door?

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry. Something is holding
me back from knocking...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん。心の準備とタイミングが
微妙に合わないというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry. Something is holding
me back from knocking...

fields.EN:
I bet you're just nervous because
it's been a while since you've had
a chance to see her.
fields.JP:
合流してからゆっくり話せて
なかったもんね。久しぶりだから、
ちょっと緊張してるのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet you're just nervous because
it's been a while since you've had
a chance to see her.

fields.EN:
I'm also assuming that she's not
in her best state now, so... Okay,
I'm ready to knock on the door.
fields.JP:
落ち込んでるかもしれないと思うと、
ちょっとね……。でももう大丈夫。
今度こそノックするね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm also assuming that she's not
in her best state now, so... Okay,
I'm ready to knock on the door.

fields.JP: はいはーい。今開けるよー

fields.EN:
Hey, Otsuu and Ningyo.
What's up?
fields.JP:
あれ、おつうと人魚じゃん。
二人してどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Otsuu and Mermie.
What's up?

fields.JP: こんにちは、おねーちゃん

fields.EN:
Uh, you should really see who's at
the door before opening, you know?
Who knows who it could've been.
fields.JP:
っていうか赤ずきん、来たのが誰か
確認くらいしてから扉開けたほうがいいぞ。
なにかと物騒だろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you should really see who's at
the door before opening, you know?
Who knows who it could've been.

fields.EN:
Not like anything bad would've
happened. So what? You came here
to lecture me or something?
fields.JP:
ここでどんな物騒なことがあるっての。
っていうか、なんで来て早々にお説教？
まさかあたしに小言でも言いに来たの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not like anything bad would've
happened. So what? You came here
to lecture me or something?

fields.JP: いや、そういうわけじゃ……

fields.EN:
We just swung by, since we didn't
have much of a chance to talk
with each other.
fields.JP:
あんまりゆっくり話せてなかったから、
ちょっと顔を見にきたんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We just swung by, since we didn't
have much of a chance to talk
with each other.

fields.EN:
Well, that's nice of you.
Did you bring anything for me?
fields.JP: へえ、それは嬉しいな。それで、手土産は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's nice of you.
Did you bring anything for me?

fields.EN:
(She looks like she's okay, but
something about her isn't quite
right...)
fields.JP:
（……パッと見た感じは、元気そうに見える。
　でも、どこか無理しているような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks like she's okay, but
something about her isn't quite
right...)

fields.EN:
Not like I have anything here, but
feel free to stay. I'm sure
there's a lot to talk about.
fields.JP:
ま、なんのもてなしもできないけど、
楽にしてよ。積もる話もあるってもんでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not like I have anything here, but
feel free to stay. I'm sure
there's a lot to talk about.

fields.EN:
Onee-chan, are you doing okay?
Is everything fine?
fields.JP:
……おねーちゃん、体調はどう？
環境が変わって困ってることはない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis, are you doing okay?
Is everything fine?

fields.EN:
Sure, all good.
Things are actually cool here.
fields.JP:
え、特にないけど？　大丈夫だって、
むしろ快適なくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, all good.
Things are actually cool here.

fields.EN:
That's good to hear...
I was a bit worried about you.
fields.JP:
なら、よかった……。
ちょっと心配だったからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear...
I was a bit worried about you.

fields.EN:
To think that the day you girls
would be worried about me would
come... Sis is proud of ya.
fields.JP:
いやー、おつうと人魚に心配される日が
来るなんてなー。二人とも成長してくれて、
お姉さんは嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To think that the day you girls
would be worried about me would
come... Sis is proud of ya.

fields.EN:
You both can stand on your own
two feet, which is good! Guess
I better keep up with ya!
fields.JP:
二人とも、あたしがいない間に
すっかりしっかり者になったね。
これは負けてられないな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You both can stand on your own
two feet, which is good! Guess
I better keep up with ya!

fields.EN:
Which means I have to start
by training myself!
Can't be lazy, after all!
fields.JP:
うーん、まずはトレーニングかな？
体を鍛えないことには
なにも始まらないからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means I have to start
by training myself!
Can't be lazy, after all!

fields.EN: There's nothing to keep up with.
fields.JP:
負けてられないって、
別に勝負じゃないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: There's nothing to keep up with.

fields.EN:
Oh, and muscles! Muscles are
great. Having a healthy body can
lead to a healthy mind!
fields.JP:
筋肉はいいよ？　健全な魂は
健全な肉体に宿るとかなんとか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and muscles! Muscles are
great. Having a healthy body can
lead to a healthy mind!

fields.EN: Um, that came out of nowhere...
fields.JP: ちょっと発想が飛躍しすぎだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, that came out of nowhere...

fields.EN:
C'mon, being healthy is great!
If you stay healthy, then your
mind can be healthy, too...
fields.JP:
でもねぇ、やっぱり体は大事だよ。
……体が元気なら、気持ちだって
つられて元気になるでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, being healthy is great!
If you stay healthy, then your
mind can be healthy, too...

fields.EN:
(What's with that look on her
face? Contrary to what she's
saying, she sure looks sad...)
fields.JP:
（なんだか表情が暗い……。
　前の赤ずきんなら、こんな顔は
　しなかっただろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's with that look on her
face? Contrary to what she's
saying, she sure looks sad...)

fields.EN:
(I guess it's just her way of
trying to cheer herself up.
I better root for her...)
fields.JP:
（でも、本人がせっかく元気になろうと
　がんばってるんだから、
　僕達も応援しなくちゃな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess it's just her way of
trying to cheer herself up.
I better root for her...)

fields.EN:
We're happy as long as you're
fine, Onee-chan... But please, don't
overdo yourself.
fields.JP:
おねーちゃん……元気ならいいの。
でも、無理はしないでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're happy as long as you're
fine, Sis... But please, don't
overdo yourself.

fields.EN:
Yup, thanks! Don't you worry!
I'm all fine...
fields.JP:
うん、ありがと！
あたしは元気だから大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, thanks! Don't you worry!
I'm all fine...

fields.EN:
Heh heh... Heh...
Guess I can't fool you girls...
fields.JP:
はは、とは言ってもなー……。
やっぱりあんたたちの目は誤魔化せないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... Heh...
Guess I can't fool you girls...

fields.EN:
Sorry, I'm really not at my best.
You girls mind leaving me alone
for awhile?
fields.JP:
……ごめん。正直、
今はちょっと本調子じゃないかも。
少し一人にさせてくんない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, I'm really not at my best.
You girls mind leaving me alone
for awhile?

fields.EN:
Sure...
Sorry to have barged in.
fields.JP:
あ……わかった。
いきなり押しかけて、ごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure...
Sorry to have barged in.

fields.EN:
Otsuu, you didn't do anything wrong!
I'm the one who made you worry over me.
I'm a failure as an older sister, huh.
fields.JP:
おつうは悪くないって！
こっちこそ、変な気ぃ遣わせちゃったね。
これじゃお姉さん失格だなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon now, you girls are always
welcome! No need to worry at all.
I am your big sis, you know?

fields.EN:
I'm happy you girls came to visit,
and that's a fact. Feel free to
come again, you hear?
fields.JP:
二人が会いに来てくれたのは嬉しかったよ。
これ、本心だから。また遊びに来てね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy you girls came to visit,
and that's a fact. Feel free to
come again, you hear?

fields.EN:
Okay, we'll be leaving.
But if anything happens,
please let us know.
fields.JP:
うん。じゃあ、今日はこれで帰るね。
……なにかあれば、相談してね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, we'll be leaving.
But if anything happens,
please let us know.

fields.JP: 頼もしいね。ぜひそうさせてもらうよ

fields.EN: She didn't look well at all...
fields.LOCALIZED: She didn't look well at all...

fields.EN:
I could tell Sis was trying to
hold up a front, but that sure
wasn't the Sis I knew before...
fields.JP:
昔なら考えられないくらいだね。
元気に振る舞おうとしてたけど、
なんだか痛々しかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could tell Sis was trying to
hold up a front, but that sure
wasn't the Sis I knew before...

fields.EN:
I don't blame her, especially
after losing so many people
from Dawn...
fields.JP:
黎明の仲間を大勢失ったんだから、
そう簡単には立ち直れないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't blame her, especially
after losing so many people
from Dawn...

fields.JP:
わたしたちでなんとかして
あげられないかな……

fields.EN:
We should keep an eye out on
her for now. I'm sure we'll be
able to help somehow.
fields.JP:
……今はただ、側で見守っていよう。
なにか僕達にできることが
見つかるかもしれないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should keep an eye out on
her for now. I'm sure we'll be
able to help somehow.

fields.EN:
Looks like we're back in front of
Akazukin's room again...
fields.JP:
うーん……。
また赤ずきんの部屋の前まで
来てしまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we're back in front of
Red Riding Hood's room again...

fields.EN:
Onee-chan is trying to act normal in
front of everyone, but...
I'm still worried...
fields.JP:
おねーちゃんは元気そうに振る舞おうと
してるけど、この間のこともあるし、
ちょっと気になっちゃうよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis is trying to act normal in
front of everyone, but...
I'm still worried...

fields.EN:
She did say we can come and visit,
so we just have to knock on her
door like usual.
fields.JP:
まぁ、また遊びに来てって言って
くれたんだし、普通に会いに行けば
いいだけだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She did say we can come and visit,
so we just have to knock on her
door like usual.

fields.JP:
おねーちゃんの部屋から
聞こえてくるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounds like it's coming from
her room...

fields.EN:
She sounded like she's in pain!
Maybe something happened to her!
fields.JP:
苦しそうな声だった。
もしかしたら具合が悪いのかも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She sounded like she's in pain!
Maybe something happened to her!
Red Riding Hood, we're coming in!

fields.EN:
What are you doing?! Stop it!
Stop cutting your hood!
fields.JP:
！　自分でフードを切って……！？
赤ずきん、なにしてるんだ！　やめろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing?! Stop it!
Stop cutting your hood!

fields.EN:
Otsuu... Ningyo...
Why are you two here...?
fields.JP:
おつう……？　人魚……？
どうしてここに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Mermie...
Why are you two here...?

fields.EN:
You didn't answer us, so we just
came in. What in the world
are you doing here?!
fields.JP:
ノックしても返事がないから
勝手に上がらせてもらった。
それより、なんでこんなことを
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't answer us, so we just
came in. What in the world
are you doing here?!

fields.EN:
Onee-chan, I thought your Blood Libido
made you jittery without the hood.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。おねーちゃんは、
フードを被ってないと血式リビドーで
動揺しちゃうのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis, I thought your Blood Libido
made you jittery without the hood.

fields.EN:
Well, yeah... I know it's sad,
but without my hood, I get all
jumpy and anxious and things...
fields.JP:
……うん……そうなんだ。
フードを被ってないと不安で、
落ち着かなくて……情けないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, yeah... I know it's sad,
but without my hood, I get all
jumpy and anxious and things...

fields.EN:
That's only because of your
Blood Libido.
fields.JP: 血式リビドーなんだから仕方ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's only because of your
Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
That's no excuse for me to get
all bent out of shape just because
of my hood...
fields.JP:
それでも嫌なんだ。
フードがないくらいで動揺するような、
こんなダメな自分が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's no excuse for me to get
all bent out of shape just because
of my hood...

fields.EN:
Which is why I figured I sever my
ties to my hood, so that I can
overcome my weakness...
fields.JP:
……だから、フードを切ろうと思ったんだ。
弱点を克服するには、
荒療治しかないかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why I figured I sever my
ties to my hood, so that I can
overcome my weakness...

fields.EN:
You do know that it won't help
you fight your Blood Libido
one bit, right?
fields.JP:
そんな馬鹿なことしたって
血式リビドーには意味がないよ。
赤ずきんだってわかってるだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do know that it won't help
you fight your Blood Libido
one bit, right?

fields.EN:
But I keep thinking to myself
how different things would've
been if I only kept my cool...
fields.JP:
でもさ……やっぱり考えちゃうんだよね。
あのとき、自分がもっとしっかり
していればって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I keep thinking to myself
how different things would've
been if I only kept my cool...

fields.EN:
When that mysterious Nightmare attacked
the Liberation District... it killed my
precious comrades while I could do nothing.
fields.JP:
謎のナイトメアが開放地区を襲って来たとき。
……大切な仲間たちをなすすべもなく殺された
fields.LOCALIZED:
A lot of my friends died when that
mysterious Nightmare attacked
the Liberated District.

fields.EN:
If I'd handled things more calmly,
the outcome might have been different.
...No, it definitely would have.
fields.JP:
あたしがもっと冷静に対処できていれば、
結果は違っていたかもしれない。
……いや、違っていたに決まってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
The results would've been
different if only I had kept my
cool...

fields.EN:
I need to change...
I can't stay the same!
fields.JP:
だから駄目なんだよ、あたしは、
このままじゃ……っ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to change...
I can't stay the same!

fields.EN:
Thanks to you, onee-chan, the other
Blood Maidens were safe. Otsuu-chan
and I—everyone's grateful.
fields.JP:
おねーちゃんのおかげで他の血式少女たちが
無事だったんだよ。わたしもおつうちゃんも、
みんな感謝してる
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were the reason why the Blood
Maidens were able to escape. We're
all in your debt.

fields.EN:
You did everything you could in an
impossible situation, onee-chan. You
should be proud. Don't deny yourself.
fields.JP:
おねーちゃんはどうしようもない状況で
最大限がんばったんだから、誇っていいんだよ。
自分を否定しないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't be so harsh on
yourself. You did the best you can
in the worst of situations...

fields.EN:
You're okay as you are, Onee-chan...
Please, don't treat yourself
like this...
fields.JP:
おねーちゃんは駄目なんかじゃない。
……お願いだから、自分で自分を悪く言わないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're okay as you are, Sis...
Please, don't treat yourself
like this...

fields.EN:
Sorry... I suck at being a big
sis, especially with how I made
you so sad, Ningyo...
fields.JP:
……ごめん。人魚にそんな悲しそうな顔
させちゃうなんて、お姉さん失格だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry... I suck at being a big
sis, especially with how I made
you so sad, Mermie...

fields.JP: 赤ずきん。もうこんなことは……

fields.EN:
No need to say anything. I got it.
Cutting my hood up like this
won't do anything.
fields.JP:
わかってる。もうしないよ。
たしかに、フードを切っても
なんにもならないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to say anything. I got it.
Cutting my hood up like this
won't do anything.

fields.EN:
Still, I need to do something with
my anger and sorrow that's pent
up inside me...
fields.JP:
……でも、どうしたらいいのか
わからないんだ。この怒りや悲しみを
どこに持って行けばいいのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, I need to do something with
my anger and sorrow that's pent
up inside me...

fields.EN:
Don't agonize over it alone. We're
comrades who have lost family too, so
talk to us—even if it's just to vent.
fields.JP:
一人で悩まないで。
わたしたちも家族を失った仲間なんだから、
愚痴でもなんでもいいから話して
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't carry the load yourself. We
all lost something then, so please
talk to us if there's anything.

fields.EN:
Something isn't right with me...
I just get all sullen and down
when I'm by myself...
fields.JP:
……最近のあたし、どっか変なんだ。
誰かと話していれば気が紛れるんだけど、
一人でいるとすぐ気持ちが暗くなっちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something isn't right with me...
I just get all sullen and down
when I'm by myself...

fields.EN:
My head fills with hatred towards
the Nightmare, and then I start
feeling pathetic about myself...
fields.JP:
自分の不甲斐なさとか、ナイトメアへの
憎しみとか、いつの間にかそんなことで
頭がいっぱいになってるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My head fills with hatred towards
the Nightmare, and then I start
feeling pathetic about myself...

fields.EN:
(She's carrying a load way deeper
and darker than I expected...)
fields.JP:
（もしかして、僕が考えていた以上に、
　赤ずきんが心に抱えた闇は
　深いんじゃないか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's carrying a load way deeper
and darker than I expected...)

fields.EN:
I can't keep everyone worried
about me for so long...
I'll be careful next time.
fields.JP:
……でも、あんまりみんなを
心配させるわけにはいかないね。
これからは気をつけるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't keep everyone worried
about me for so long...
I'll be careful next time.

fields.EN:
Onee-chan, can I borrow that hood?
I'd like to get it patched up.
fields.JP:
あ……そうだ。
おねーちゃん、そのフード貸して。
それくらいならわたしが直してあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis, can I borrow that hood?
I'd like to get it patched up.

fields.JP: お、悪いね。お言葉に甘えようかな

fields.EN:
(She's still smiling, but even
I can tell she's really forcing
herself...)
fields.JP:
（いつもみたいに笑って、明るい口調で……。
　だけど、本当はかなり無理してるのかも
　しれないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's still smiling, but even
I can tell she's really forcing
herself...)

fields.JP: このっ！　このおぉっ！！

fields.EN:
I'll slice you to pieces!!
Suffer more! Scream more!! Heh heh...!
fields.JP:
ずたずたに切り刻んでやる！！
もっと苦しめ！　もっと叫べ！！
くくく……っ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll slice you to bits!
Let me hear you scream!
Hahaha!

fields.EN:
Looks like she's getting better,
but...
fields.JP:
赤ずきんの奴、調子を取り戻して
きたのかもしれないな。だけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like she's getting better,
but...

fields.EN:
I feel like her hatred for
Marchens and Nightmares has grown
even stronger than before...
fields.JP:
メルヒェンやナイトメアに対しての憎悪が、
前にも増して強くなっている気がする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't her hatred towards Marchens
and Nightmares a bit... intense?

fields.EN:
Duh... At least she's not clammed
up in her room like before...
fields.JP:
当たり前でしょ。
……まぁ、いつまでも塞いでいるよりは、
元気になったほうがマシだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Duh... At least she's not clammed
up in her room like before...

fields.EN:
She's fighting like there's no
tomorrow... I'm sure there are
other ways to fight than that...
fields.JP:
それにしても、戦い方が豪快というか、
容赦がないというか……。
もっと他にやりようがあるでしょうに
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's fighting like there's no
tomorrow... I'm sure there are
other ways to fight than that...

fields.EN:
What's scary is that it also
looks like she's enjoying it...
fields.JP:
うん……。
それにどこか楽しそうなところもあって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's scary is that it also
looks like she's enjoying it...

fields.EN:
It's as if she's finding joy in
killing...
fields.JP:
まるで殺すこと自体に喜びを感じている
みたいで、なんだか……怖い
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's as if she's finding joy in
killing...

fields.EN:
Huh? That's it?
What a letdown.
fields.JP:
あれ、なーんだ。もう終わり？
つまんないのー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? That's it?
What a letdown.

fields.JP: ……赤ずきん、調子良さそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're... looking good,
Red Riding Hood.

fields.JP: うん！　おかげ様で絶好調だよ！
あ……っ。おねーちゃん、怪我してる！

fields.EN:
Hurt? Oh hey, look at that.
I didn't notice.
fields.JP: 怪我ぁ？　あー、ほんとだ。気づかなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hurt? Oh hey, look at that.
I didn't notice.

fields.EN:
That's what happens when you keep
fighting so recklessly. You must've
cut yourself without even noticing.
fields.JP:
さっきみたいに大雑把な戦い方ばっかり
してるからだよ。知らないうちに
自分で切っちゃったんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
No wonder you're hurt.
You went into battle blindly
without any care of yourself.

fields.EN:
Heh heh! C'mon, it happens.
Won't do it next time!
fields.JP: あはは、そんなこともあるよね。失敗失敗！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! C'mon, it happens.
Won't do it next time!

fields.EN:
Onee-chan, this is no laughing matter.
Here, let me take a look...
fields.JP:
もう、おねーちゃんったら。
笑ってる場合じゃないよ。
手当てするから、傷を見せて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis, this is no laughing matter.
Here, let me take a look...

fields.EN:
Aw, c'mon it's nothing.
Just put some spit on it and
we can call it a day.
fields.JP:
えー、いいよ。
これくらいツバつけときゃ治るって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw, c'mon it's nothing.
Just put some spit on it and
we can call it a day.

fields.EN:
No! There's no telling what would
happen if we leave that alone.
Now, let me see...
fields.JP:
駄目！　放っておいて悪化したら
どうするの？　いいから見せて
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! There's no telling what would
happen if we leave that alone.
Now, let me see...

fields.EN:
Oh, fine...
You really are a worrywart.
fields.JP: はいはい。人魚は心配性だねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, fine...
You really are a worrywart.

fields.JP: ……おねーちゃん、なんだか生き生きしてるね

fields.EN:
Really? I guess you're right.
I can't hold myself back...
fields.JP:
そうかな？　でもまー、たしかにそうかも。
だって嬉しくってさぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? I guess you're right.
I can't hold myself back...

fields.EN:
Now that I'm back in action,
I can go and kill some of them
Marchens and Nightmares!
fields.JP:
やっとリハビリが終わって、思う存分
メルヒェンやナイトメアを殺せるからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I'm back in action,
I can go and kill some of them
Marchens and Nightmares!

fields.EN:
It sure feels good to fight!
Haven't felt this good in awhile!
fields.JP:
いやー、思いっきり戦えるって気持ちいいね！
気分爽快！　やっぱこうでなくっちゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sure feels good to fight!
Haven't felt this good in awhile!

fields.EN:
Hmph... That doesn't look like a
person who can be left alone.
What a pain...
fields.JP:
ふん、あれが放っておいていい顔かっての。
……まったく
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... That doesn't look like a
person who can be left alone.
What a pain...

fields.EN:
(I better keep an eye out on her
so that she doesn't do anything
brash...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんが無茶しないように、
　しばらくは気をつけて見ていたほうが
　いいかもな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better keep an eye out on her
so that she doesn't do anything
brash...)

fields.JP: 死ねっ！！　死んじゃえよ！！
お前たちなんて皆殺しにしてやる！！
はぁ……またあんな雑な戦い方をして

fields.EN:
She's relying on brute force and
wasting a lot of movement. She
never used to fight like that.
fields.JP:
力任せで、動きに無駄が多いな。
前はあんな戦い方じゃなかったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's wasting a lot of energy,
forcing herself into the enemy
line. That really isn't her style.

fields.EN:
I hope she's not overdoing
herself...
fields.JP: 無茶しないでくれるといいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope she's not overdoing
herself...

fields.EN:
But she looks really happy.
It's good that she's finding
enjoyment from this.
fields.JP:
でも生き生きしてるぞ。
きっと楽しいのだな。うんうん
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she looks really happy.
It's good that she's finding
enjoyment from this.

fields.EN: That poses a problem in itself...
fields.JP: あれはあれで問題があると思うけど
fields.LOCALIZED: That poses a problem in itself...

fields.EN: Really? I don't see the problem.
fields.JP: そうか？　元気そうでよいではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? I don't see the problem.

fields.JP: ……まぁ、あなたはそう思うのでしょうね

fields.EN:
I'll beat the crap out of you!
Take this! And this!
fields.JP:
めちゃくちゃにしてやる！！
こんな奴！　こんな奴……っ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll beat the crap out of you!
Take this! And this!

fields.EN:
Looks like she hurt herself in
the process.
fields.JP: 勢い余って自分を傷つけてしまったようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like she hurt herself in
the process.

fields.JP: あーあ、言わんこっちゃない

fields.EN:
Hm, but injuring yourself isn't
good, even if it was while having
fun...
fields.JP:
むむ、楽しくても怪我をして
しまうのはまずいぞ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, but injuring yourself isn't
good, even if it was while having
fun...

fields.JP: おねーちゃん、大丈夫だった？

fields.EN: I'm fine. I just cut myself.
fields.JP: 平気。ちょっと切っただけ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm fine. I just cut myself.

fields.EN: Let me see. I'll patch you up.
fields.JP: 傷、見せて。手当てするから
fields.LOCALIZED: Let me see. I'll patch you up.

fields.EN:
That was dangerous. One wrong
move and you would've been
critically hurt.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、今のは危なかったぞ。
下手をしたら大怪我するところ
だったんだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was dangerous. One wrong
move and you would've been
critically hurt.

fields.EN:
"Whatever you say?!"
You can't be treating yourself
like this!
fields.JP:
そうかもねって……自分のことなんだぞ？
そんな他人事みたいに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Whatever you say?!"
You can't be treating yourself
like this!

fields.EN:
I need to keep going...
or else I won't make it...
fields.JP: こうでもしないと……保てそうにない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to keep going...
or else I won't make it...

fields.EN:
I need to keep my hatred towards
them at peak... That's the only
thing keeping me afloat...
fields.JP:
あいつらを憎んでいないと……
憎しみをぶつけていないと、自分の気持ちが
保てなくなりそうなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to keep my hatred towards
them at peak... That's the only
thing keeping me afloat...

fields.EN:
Leave me alone already...
I'm the only one that will die.
I won't cause you any trouble...
fields.JP:
……だから、放っておいてよ。
無茶やっても死ぬのはあたし一人だ。
みんなに迷惑はかけないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave me alone already...
I'm the only one that will die.
I won't cause you any trouble...

fields.JP: そんな、悲しいこと言わないで

fields.EN:
I find it odd that you said that
your death won't cause trouble.
fields.JP:
みんなに迷惑はかけないですって？
おかしなことを言うのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I find it odd that you said that
your death won't cause trouble.

fields.JP: なにがおかしいって言うのさ

fields.EN:
You're hurt now, and are already
causing trouble to others.
How do you explain that?
fields.JP:
現にあなたが今ここで怪我をして、
迷惑をこうむっているのよ。
その事実はどう説明するの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're hurt now, and are already
causing trouble to others.
How do you explain that?

fields.EN:
Treat yourself however you like, but
unfortunately everyone here is a softhearted
fool who can't just leave you alone.
fields.JP:
あなたが自分をどう扱おうと勝手だけど、
面倒なことに、ここにいるのは
あなたを放っておけないお人好しばかりよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Feel free to treat yourself badly,
but unfortunately for you, most
here are capable enough to care.

fields.EN:
Your one wrong move may
bring all of us down. Do you
mind that at all?
fields.JP:
あなた一人の迂闊な行動が原因で、
全員が危機に晒されることもありうるわ。
それでもあなたは構わないと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your one wrong move may
bring all of us down. Do you
mind that at all?

fields.EN:
Gretel, your brother was killed...
You know how I feel, don't you?
fields.JP:
……グレーテル、あんただって
肉親をナイトメアに殺されたんだから、
あたしの気持ちはわかるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, your brother was killed...
You know how I feel, don't you?

fields.EN:
Similar experiences doesn't equate
to similar trains of thought.
fields.JP:
似た体験をしたからといって、
同じように考えるとは限らないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Similar experiences doesn't equate
to similar trains of thought.

fields.EN:
At the very least, Hansel-niisan wouldn't want
me to act emotionally and die for nothing.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、わたしが感情的に
行動して無駄死にすることを、
ヘンゼル兄さんは望まない
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least, I care enough
to avoid emotional outbursts so
that I don't waste Hansel's death.

fields.EN:
Akazukin, she's right.
Please, you need to stop binding
yourself needlessly to hatred.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、グレーテルの言う通りだ。
これ以上憎しみに囚われないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, she's right.
Please, you need to stop binding
yourself needlessly to hatred.

fields.EN:
I'm fine already...
Let's get going...
fields.JP: 人魚、手当てはもういい。……行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine already...
Let's get going...

fields.JP: （さっき、なにを言おうとしたんだ？）

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
"Binding needlessly in hatred?"
Quite a horrible thing to say.
fields.JP:
ふふ、憎しみに捕らわれないで、ね……。
あなた、ずいぶん残酷なことを言うのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
"Binding needlessly in hatred?"
Quite a horrible thing to say.

fields.JP: 残酷？　それってどういう……

fields.EN:
Hey, we better get going.
We can't let Akazukin
run off like this.
fields.JP:
ほら、みんな行くわよ。
赤ずきんがずんずん一人で先行っちゃうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, we better get going.
We can't let Red Riding Hood
run off like this.

fields.JP: あなたは先頭じゃないでしょ……

fields.EN:
Let's go, Otsuu-chan.
I'm sure we'll have another chance
to speak with Onee-chan.
fields.JP:
行こう、おつうちゃん。
……おねーちゃんとは、またきちんと
話してみればいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go, Otsuu.
I'm sure we'll have another chance
to speak with Sis.

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, do you have a moment?
fields.JP: おつうちゃん、ちょっといい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, do you have a moment?

fields.EN:
Princess? Let me get the
door open...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess? Let me get the
door open...

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, I don't
think we've had the chance to
speak with Akazukin since.)
fields.JP:
（この二人が連れ立って来るなんて珍しい。
　っていうか、あれ以来赤ずきんと
　きちんと話してなかったっけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, I don't
think we've had the chance to
speak with Red Riding Hood since.)

fields.EN:
Um, how can I word this...
Sorry about the last time.
I was in the wrong then.
fields.JP:
あのー、なんていうかさ。
こないだは、ごめん。あたしが悪かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, how can I word this...
Sorry about the last time.
I was in the wrong then.

fields.EN:
My breakdown back then caused
everyone so much trouble.
Not much of a sis, eh?
fields.JP:
感情的になって、みんなに迷惑かけちゃった。
全然お姉さんらしくなかったよね。ははっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My breakdown back then caused
everyone so much trouble.
Not much of a sis, eh?

fields.EN:
Onee-chan has been worried about it the
whole time. She said she wanted to apologize.
fields.JP:
おねーちゃん、ずっと気にしてて、
謝りたいと思ってたんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis wanted to go around to
apologize after all that.

fields.EN:
I felt awkward going alone, so I had
Ningyo come with me. I'm acting less
and less like an older sister...
fields.JP:
一人だと気まずいから、
人魚に連れて来てもらったけど。
ますますお姉さんらしくないなぁ、あたし
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, it felt weird going around
myself, so I had Mermie come with
me. Big sis my butt...

fields.EN:
Don't worry about it. On the
contrary, I should be the one to
apologize for being so brash.
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ。僕のほうこそ、
この間は言いすぎた。ごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry about it. On the
contrary, I should be the one to
apologize for being so brash.

fields.EN:
Ooh, acting like an adult!
You two really have grown up,
haven't you?
fields.JP:
おー、大人な対応！
やっぱりあたしがいない間に、
二人ともずいぶん成長したんだねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh, acting like an adult!
You two really have grown up,
haven't you?

fields.EN:
...You've both become so dependable.
Maybe I can have you listen to me.
fields.JP:
……こんなに頼もしくなったあんたたちになら、
聞いてもらってもいいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess that means I can ask you
something...

fields.EN:
Well, it's more a rant than a
question.
fields.JP:
まー、つまんないグチみたいな
もんなんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's more a rant than a
question.

fields.EN:
You remember how I said I couldn't
keep myself together unless I kept
hating Marchens and Nightmares?
fields.JP:
あのとき、メルヒェンやナイトメアを
憎んでいないと、自分の気持ちを
保てないって言ったじゃん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how I said I needed to
keep my hatred to stay afloat?

fields.EN:
If I was stronger inside, then
maybe that wouldn't be the case.
fields.JP:
あたしの心がもっと強ければ、
たぶんそんなことにはなって
いなかったんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I was stronger inside, then
maybe that wouldn't be the case.

fields.EN:
But I'm weak, so I keep myself
in check by filling myself with
hatred...
fields.JP:
でもあたしは弱いからさ、
憎しみの感情で自分の中をいっぱいにして、
ようやく自分を保っていられる
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm weak, so I keep myself
in check by filling myself with
hatred...

fields.EN:
It's like hating the wolf while in
its belly. Hatred is really my
motivating factor now.
fields.JP:
まるで狼のお腹の中で狼を憎んで
いるような気持ちだよ。
それが今のあたしを支える原動力なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's like hating the wolf while in
its belly. Hatred is really my
motivating factor now.

fields.EN:
My current state is that I keep thinking,
'I hate them, I'll avenge my comrades,'
and somehow use that to keep myself going.
fields.JP:
奴らが憎い、仲間の仇を討ってやるって思い
続けて、どうにか自分を奮い立たせてるのが
あたしの現状
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept myself going by using
hatred to fuel my want for
vengeance.

fields.EN:
I know that's wrong, but I can't
stop myself.
fields.JP:
こんなんじゃ駄目だってことも、わかってる。
……だけど自分じゃどうしようもできなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know that's wrong, but I can't
stop myself.

fields.EN:
Right now, I am hatred itself.
Without it, I'll just be some
kind of hollow.
fields.JP:
憎しみが今のあたしのすべてなんだ。
これがなかったら、きっとあたしは
空っぽになるんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right now, I am hatred itself.
Without it, I'll just be some
kind of hollow.

fields.EN:
(I see... So that's what Gretel
meant when she said "horrible.")
fields.JP:
（そうか。グレーテルが『残酷』だと
　言った意味が、ようやくわかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... So that's what Gretel
meant when she said "horrible.")

fields.EN:
(Getting rid of her hatred is no
different that denying
Akazukin's very existence.)
fields.JP:
（憎しみを捨てろと言うのは、
　赤ずきんのすべてを否定するような
　ものなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Getting rid of her hatred is no
different that denying Red
Riding Hood's very existence.)

fields.EN:
(Akazukin doesn't know what to do
anymore, and right now revenge is the
only thing giving her a reason to live...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんはどうしたらいいのか
　わからなくなっていて、
　今は生きる糧が復讐しかないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't know what to do,
so she's using vengeance as
an excuse for her existence...)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
I didn't see the pains that you
were going through.
fields.JP:
……悪かった、赤ずきん。
僕は君の苦しみを全然理解して
いなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
I didn't see the pains that you
were going through.

fields.EN:
Why are you apologizing?
What you said was correct.
fields.JP:
おつうが謝るなんておかしいよ。
あんたが言ったことは間違ってないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you apologizing?
What you said was correct.

fields.EN:
Trying to keep myself afloat by
using hatred makes me the
odd one here...
fields.JP:
……憎しみを糧にして生きてるなんて、
あたしのほうこそ異常なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Trying to keep myself afloat by
using hatred makes me the
odd one here...

fields.EN:
That's not true. I understand very
well the sorrow and hatred of
losing all those back at Dawn.
fields.JP:
そんなことはない。
黎明の人達を殺された悲しみや憎しみは、
僕にもよくわかる
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. I understand very
well the sorrow and hatred of
losing all those back at Dawn.

fields.EN:
And because I understand that,
there was no way I could deny your feelings.
fields.JP:
それなのに赤ずきんの気持ちを否定するなんて、
できるわけなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, I denounced your
feelings despite sharing the
pains.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan and I hate that Nightmare,
but we want to protect those
close to us for the future ahead.
fields.JP:
あのね、おつうちゃんもわたしも
ナイトメアが憎い気持ちは同じだよ。
でも未来のために今の仲間も大事にしたいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and I hate that Nightmare,
but we want to protect those
close to us for the future ahead.

fields.EN:
I don't think you need to force
yourself to get rid of your
hatred and sorrow.
fields.JP:
憎しみも悲しみも、無理に捨てなくても
いいんだと思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think you need to force
yourself to get rid of your
hatred and sorrow.

fields.JP: ……いいのかな、あたし。……今の自分でも

fields.EN:
Fighting with vengeance at heart
isn't wrong. I won't tell you to
stop with the hating, too.
fields.JP:
仇討ちの気持ちで戦い続けるのは、
きっと間違いじゃないんだと思う。
憎しみを捨てろなんて、もう言わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting with vengeance at heart
isn't wrong. I won't tell you to
stop with the hating, too.

fields.EN:
But, we don't want to see you
overdo yourself. You're a precious
friend and family to us.
fields.JP:
あ、でも無茶してほしくないって
いうのは変わらないよ。
赤ずきんは大事な仲間で、家族なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we don't want to see you
overdo yourself. You're a precious
friend and family to us.

fields.EN:
Seeing you go all in only to have
you come back hurt will only
bring pain to us.
fields.JP:
考えなしな戦い方をされて、
赤ずきんになにかあったら悲しいからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing you go all in only to have
you come back hurt will only
bring pain to us.

fields.EN:
So if you think of us as family, I want you
to hit the brakes before you cross the line.
fields.JP:
だから僕達のことを家族だと思って
くれてるなら、ぎりぎりのところで
ブレーキかけるようにしてほしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if you see us as family too,
then I'd love to see you hold
back a bit.

fields.EN:
Heh... Got it.
Guess I can't refuse a request
from someone in my family.
fields.JP:
ふふっ……わかった。
家族の頼みじゃ、仕方ないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Got it.
Guess I can't refuse a request
from someone in my family.

fields.EN:
Looking back, maybe I was relying on you
and Ningyo. I figured even if I charged
ahead on impulse, you two would stop me.
fields.JP:
今思えば、おつうや人魚に甘えてたのかも。
あたしが勢いに任せて突っ走っても、
二人が止めてくれるって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I was being a bit too
reliant on you girls thinking that
one of you would stop me.

fields.EN:
I bet that made me go nuts out
there. I better get a better grip
of myself.
fields.JP:
そのせいでこんなことになったのかもね。
これからはもっとしっかりしなくちゃなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet that made me go nuts out
there. I better get a better grip
of myself.

fields.EN:
If you charge off again, I'll
scold you, onee-chan, so be ready.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、もしもまた突っ走っちゃうときが
あったら、おねーちゃんを注意するから
覚悟していてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you do go "nuts" out
there again, you can be sure
I'll come and scold you.

fields.EN:
I wouldn't expect anything less.
I'm counting on you.
fields.JP: 頼もしいね。そのときはよろしく頼むよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't expect anything less.
I'm counting on you.

fields.EN:
Oh, and thanks...
Thanks for accepting who I am.
fields.JP:
……二人とも、ありがとう。
あたしの在り方を認めてくれて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and thanks...
Thanks for accepting who I am.

fields.EN:
Akazukin?
What are you doing here?
fields.JP:
赤ずきん？
こんなところでなにしてたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood?
What are you doing here?

fields.EN:
Just wanted to take a breath of
fresh air. What about you, Otsuu?
fields.JP:
ちょっと外の空気が吸いたくなってね。
そう言うおつうは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just wanted to take a breath of
fresh air. What about you, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
Same here. There are a lot of times I have to
stay tense, so I came here to refresh myself.
fields.JP:
僕も同じ。
なにかと気を張ることも多いから、
リフレッシュしに来た
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. I wanted to get some
air, too. After all, there's a lot
going on in my mind now.

fields.EN:
Well, you do have a lot of people
counting on you. You must have
a knack of being a leader.
fields.JP:
たしかにおつうはみんなから
頼られてるからねぇ。
何気にリーダー気質っていうの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you do have a lot of people
counting on you. You must have
a knack of being a leader.

fields.EN:
Compared to that, maybe I was never
really the 'older-sister type' to begin with.
fields.JP:
それに比べてあたしは、
もともと『お姉さん』ってキャラじゃ
なかったのかもなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me, on the other hand? I'm not
much of a leader, or even a
big sis at that.

fields.EN:
Now you're saying that after
all the time you've been our
older sister?
fields.JP:
なにそれ。さんざん自分のこと
お姉さんとか言ってるくせに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now you're saying that after
all the time you've been our
older sister?

fields.EN:
Hey, it's at least true that I am
the oldest, so in that sense
I am a big sis of sorts.
fields.JP:
まー、そこはそれ。
年長者としてお姉さん的立ち位置なのは
確かだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, it's at least true that I am
the oldest, so in that sense
I am a big sis of sorts.

fields.EN:
But ya know, after all the trouble
I caused, it just made me wonder
that I'm not big sis material.
fields.JP:
でもあたしってみんなに迷惑かけちゃう
ことも多いし、もしかしてお姉さんっぽく
なかったかなーとか思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
But ya know, after all the trouble
I caused, it just made me wonder
that I'm not big sis material.

fields.JP:
（そんなこと気にしてたんだ。
　ちょっと意外……）

fields.EN:
Princess and I wouldn't be here today if you
hadn't rescued us in the Aquarium Ruins,
onee-chan.
fields.JP:
おねえちゃんが水族館跡エリアで
僕と姫を保護してくれなかったら、
僕達は今ここにいなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess and I wouldn't be here
today if you didn't bring us to
safety from the Aquarium Ruins.

fields.EN:
Back then, onee-chan, you were more
dependable than anyone. You looked like
a wonderful older sister. You were our hope.
fields.JP:
あのときはおねえちゃんが誰よりも
頼もしくて、素敵なお姉さんに見えた。
僕達の希望だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis, you were reliable and were
our beacon of hope when you
came for us.

fields.EN:
Do you remember what you told
me when I was struggling to find
a way to pay you back?
fields.JP:
助けられてから、僕が恩を感じて
苦しんでいたときも、こう言ってくれたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you remember what you told
me when I was struggling to find
a way to pay you back?

fields.EN:
You mean about how you already
paid me back by joining Dawn
as a Blood Maiden?
fields.JP:
「おつうが血式少女として黎明に来た時点で、
恩は返してもらったよ」……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean about how you already
paid me back by joining Dawn
as a Blood Maiden?

fields.JP: あ、ちゃんと覚えてたんだ

fields.EN:
Same to you. I'm surprised you
even remembered such a thing.
fields.JP:
おつうこそ。
あんなサラッとしたひと言だったのに、
覚えてるなんて思わなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same to you. I'm surprised you
even remembered such a thing.

fields.EN:
That's because those words
saved me.
fields.JP: だって僕は、あの言葉にすごく救われたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because those words
saved me.

fields.EN:
You said I may have the knack of
being a leader, but I'd rather be
someone offering support.
fields.JP:
さっき僕のことをリーダー気質なんて
言ったけど、僕はどっちかと言うと
誰かを支えるほうが性に合うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said I may have the knack of
being a leader, but I'd rather be
someone offering support.

fields.EN:
But you're looking tired now, so
that's why I'm just filling in to
replace you temporarily.
fields.JP:
でも今は赤ずきんが疲れてるみたいだから、
僕達がちょっと代わりにやってるだけなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you're looking tired now, so
that's why I'm just filling in to
replace you temporarily.

fields.EN:
Even now, you're still everyone's
one and only older sister, Akazukin.
fields.JP: 今でもみんなのお姉さんは赤ずきんだけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were and are always our
favorite big sis.

fields.EN:
Oho? Is that so?
Huh? Really?
fields.JP:
……ほうほう、そう思ってたんだー。
へー、ほぉー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho? Is that so?
Huh? Really?

fields.JP: な、なんだよ。その変な反応は

fields.EN:
Oh no, it's just that it's unusual
to hear you talk so earnestly.
You just made my day. Heh...
fields.JP:
いや、おつうが珍しく
本音を話してくれたから、
お姉さん嬉しくってねー。ふふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no, it's just that it's unusual
to hear you talk so earnestly.
You just made my day. Heh...

fields.EN:
C-Cut it out! Unbelievable...
To think you were down on yourself
just a moment ago...
fields.JP:
か、からかうなってば！
ったく、さっきまでへこんでたかと思えば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
C-Cut it out! Unbelievable...
To think you were down on yourself
just a moment ago...

fields.EN:
So sorry.
I was just having a bit of fun
seeing your knee-jerk reaction.
fields.JP:
ごめん、ごめん。
おつうの反応が面白くってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So sorry.
I was just having a bit of fun
seeing your knee-jerk reaction.

fields.EN:
I probably can't hold back the
hatred in me, and I could go
into emotional flashes.
fields.JP:
あたしはこれからも、憎しみのままに
行動して、負の感情を抑えらえない
ことがあるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I probably can't hold back the
hatred in me, and I could go
into emotional flashes.

fields.EN:
But, you still accepted me as-is.
So yeah, thanks.
fields.JP:
だけど、そんなあたしを受け入れて
くれたでしょ。……ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you still accepted me as-is.
So yeah, thanks.

fields.EN:
Why wouldn't I? We are family
after all. Oh, and you don't need
to pay me back for this.
fields.JP:
と、当然だろ？　家族なんだから。
……今回は、貸しにはしないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why wouldn't I? We are family
after all. Oh, and you don't need
to pay me back for this.

fields.EN:
You're a kind kid, Otsuu. Once we
break out of here, I hope I can learn
to live in a different way too.
fields.JP:
優しい子だね、おつうは。
ここを脱獄したら、あたしももっと違う
生き方ができるようになるといいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are a kind soul, Otsuu.
I can only hope you find a new
way of life once we escape.

fields.EN:
Until then, I'll probably cause a
bit more trouble, and we could
get into fights, but...
fields.JP:
それまでは、また面倒かけちゃったり、
揉めたりするかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until then, I'll probably cause a
bit more trouble, and we could
get into fights, but...

fields.EN:
That's no different than sisters
fighting, right?
fields.JP:
そうなったらそうなったで、
そんなのただの姉妹喧嘩だろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's no different than sisters
fighting, right?

fields.EN:
Heh... Took the words out
of my mouth.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Took the words out
of my mouth.

fields.EN: Augh, just give it a try!
fields.JP:
あーもー、ちょっとでいいから
やってみなって！
fields.LOCALIZED: Augh, just give it a try!

fields.JP: 嫌です～。やめてください～！

どうしたんだ。
揉め事じゃないだろうな？

fields.EN:
Otsuu, perfect timing!
You try persuading her too.
fields.JP:
おつう、よいところに来た！
貴様からも説得してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, what perfect timing!
Help us out!

fields.EN:
We want to get Kaguya off
of her vehicle thingy.
fields.JP:
かぐやをこの妙な乗り物から
降ろしたいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We want to get Kaguya off
of her vehicle thingy.

fields.EN:
You have to help me...
Akazukin-san and Hameln-san
have been quite the bother.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんもハーメルンさんも、
しつこくて困ります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have to help me...
Red Riding Hood and Hameln
have been quite the bother.

fields.EN:
I don't know exactly what's going
on, but if Kaguya doesn't want to
get off, then just let her be.
fields.JP:
よくわかんないけど、
本人が降りたくないなら
無理に降ろす必要はないだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know exactly what's going
on, but if Kaguya doesn't want to
get off, then just let her be.

fields.EN:
Hell no! She ain't getting any
exercise in just riding on that
thing of hers.
fields.JP:
甘い！　かぐやってば、いつも
この乗り物に乗ってばっかじゃん。
これじゃ運動不足になっちゃうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hell no! She ain't getting any
exercise in just riding on that
thing of hers.

fields.EN:
What's she gonna do if her health
deteriorates and she gets sick, or
when she needs to run?
fields.JP:
運動不足のせいで、
いざってときに逃げ遅れたり、
病気になったりしたらどうすんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's she gonna do if her health
deteriorates and she gets sick, or
when she needs to run?

fields.EN:
She's right! What are you going to
do if you get adyult... adelt...
adyalt diseases?!
fields.JP:
そうだぞ！　しぇい……しぇいじん病、
とやらになったらどうするのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right! What are you going to
do if you get adyult... adelt...
adyalt diseases?!

fields.EN:
(Adult disease... Guess she can't
get that right...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Adult disease... Guess she can't
get that right...)

fields.EN:
Not moving at all is only going
to make you sick. I can't leave
you like this as your friend!
fields.JP:
とにかく動かなすぎるのは体に毒だよ！
仲間として放っておけないって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not moving at all is only going
to make you sick. I can't leave
you like this as your friend!

fields.EN:
Well, I guess you have a point...
It is true that Kaguya rarely
ever moves herself.
fields.JP:
まぁ、そう言われるとなぁ……。
たしかにかぐやは動かなすぎかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess you have a point...
It is true that Kaguya rarely
ever moves herself.

fields.EN:
Oh, so now you're on their side,
Otsuu-san?!
fields.JP: おつうさんまでそんなことを言うんですか～！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so now you're on their side,
Otsuu?!

fields.EN:
Why not move a bit?
It's not like you need to go
all in to exercise.
fields.JP:
少しくらい動いてみたらどうだ？
軽い運動なら気楽に始められるだろうし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not move a bit?
It's not like you need to go
all in to exercise.

fields.EN:
Eww...
But, what kind of exercise isn't
"all in" then?
fields.JP: え～。軽い運動ってなんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eww...
But, what kind of exercise isn't
"all in" then?

fields.EN: Ooh! Yes, that's not too intense!
fields.LOCALIZED: Ooh! Yes, that's not too intense!

fields.JP: いや、軽くないでしょ。それ

fields.EN:
But it's only half?
It's gotta be easy.
fields.JP: だって半分なんだよ？　軽いよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's only half?
It's gotta be easy.

fields.EN:
Sure, if you got muscles packed
in your brains... I was referring
to activities such as walking.
fields.JP:
脳筋の基準で考えないでくれ。
僕が言いたかったのは、
ウォーキングとかそういうのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, if you got muscles packed
in your brains... I was referring
to activities such as walking.

fields.EN:
Walking~? It's better than running, but what
if I walk so much I get a stress fracture~?
fields.JP:
ウォーキングですか～？
走るのよりはマシですけど、たくさん歩いて
疲労骨折したらどうするんですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Walking? Well, that is better than
running, but what if I get a
sprain from too much walking?

fields.EN:
That would be a bit much... Wait,
you wouldn't actually get a fracture,
right? That's just an example, right?
fields.JP:
それはさすがに……え、
本当に骨折なんかしないよね？
例えだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh come now, no one would...
Um... You never sprained yourself
that way before, right?

fields.EN:
Okay, then how about jump roping?
That's easy to do, and can be done
with just a rope.
fields.JP:
そうだ、だったら縄跳びは？
縄さえあればすぐに始められるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then how about jump roping?
That's easy to do, and can be done
with just a rope.

fields.EN:
But it hurts if the rope hits you.
Worse, what if you strangle
yourself with the rope?
fields.JP:
縄が当たったら痛いじゃないですか～。
それに、縄で首が絞まったら危ないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it hurts if the rope hits you.
Worse, what if you strangle
yourself with the rope?

fields.EN:
Uh, I don't think you'd get your
neck caught by the rope...
fields.JP: いや、どうやったら首が絞まるんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I don't think you'd get your
neck caught by the rope...

fields.EN:
Hm... How about weight lifting?
You know, using lighter weights.
fields.JP:
んー。じゃあ、ダンベル体操はどう？
軽めのダンベル使ってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... How about weight lifting?
You know, using lighter weights.

fields.EN:
If you keep at it every day even
for a short time, it should solve
your lack of exercise, right?
fields.JP:
短い時間でも毎日続ければ、
運動不足は解消できるんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to lift too long,
and just doing it daily should
tone your body good.

fields.JP: でも、ダンベルなんて持ってませんよ～

fields.EN:
No problem! I'll let you borrow
mine! In fact, I brought one
with me!
fields.JP:
それなら大丈夫！
あたしのマイダンベルを貸してあげるから！
ちょうど今持ってきてるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem! I'll let you borrow
mine! In fact, I brought one
with me!

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you had one on you.
Uh, but don't tell me you always
have one with you...
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、よくダンベルなんて持ってたな。
まさか、いつも持ち歩いてるんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you had one on you.
Uh, but don't tell me you always
have one with you...

fields.EN:
Of course not!
I just happened to have one on
me today!
fields.JP: さすがにそれはないよ。今日はたまたま！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not!
I just happened to have one on
me today!

fields.EN:
That should bring Kaguya one-step
closer to good health! It sure
feels good helping others out!
fields.JP:
これでかぐやも健康体に一歩近づくな！
よいことをしたあとは気分がいいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That should bring Kaguya one-step
closer to good health! It sure
feels good helping others out!

fields.EN:
Uh, we don't really know if Kaguya
is healthy or not, but... I guess
you girls were worried about her.
fields.JP:
まぁ、かぐやが不健康だと
決まったわけじゃないけどね。
君達なりにかぐやを心配してたんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, we don't really know if Kaguya
is healthy or not, but... I guess
you girls were worried about her.

fields.JP: 仲間として当然のことだよ！

fields.EN:
Heh... Nice to have good friends,
right Kaguya?
fields.JP: ふふ、いい仲間がいてよかったな、かぐや
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Nice to have good friends,
right Kaguya?

fields.EN: Huh? Um... Kaguya? Where are you?
fields.JP: ……って、あれ？　かぐや、どこだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Um... Kaguya? Where are you?

fields.EN:
What the...?! She's being pinned
down by the weight?!
fields.JP:
ああっ！　いないと思ったら
ダンベルに潰されてたー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?! She's being pinned
down by the weight?!

fields.EN:
This weight must be pretty darn
heavy...
fields.JP:
このダンベル、まさか
めちゃくちゃ重いんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This weight must be pretty darn
heavy...

fields.EN:
Health nothing! You've got a more
serious problem if you can't even
hold this weight!
fields.JP:
こんなのも持てないなんて、
健康不健康以前の問題だよー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Health nothing! You've got a more
serious problem if you can't even
hold this weight!

fields.EN:
(She's weaker than I thought.
