But that would also mean she's
not fit to even exercise...)
fields.JP:
（予想以上の非力さだ。やっぱりかぐやに
　運動は無理かもしれないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's weaker than I thought.
But that would also mean she's
not fit to even exercise...)

fields.EN:
Wow, that's amazing!
I've never seen one like that
before!
fields.JP:
わー、すごいね！
こんなの見たことない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow, that's amazing!
I've never seen one like that
before!

fields.EN:
This flower bloomed this morning
in Nemu-chan's room.
fields.JP:
この花、ネムちゃんの部屋で
今朝咲いたばっかりなんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This flower bloomed this morning
in Sleepy's room.

fields.EN:
That must be a pretty rare flower.
What's it called?
fields.JP: 珍しい種類の花だよね。なんていうの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must be a pretty rare flower.
What's it called?

fields.EN:
We're not sure...
Nemu-chan hasn't seen one like it
before, too.
fields.JP:
それが、よくわからないんです。
ネムちゃんも初めて見るらしくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're not sure...
Sleepy hasn't seen one like it
before, too.

fields.EN:
I guess a seed must've flew in
to her room, and found root in
one of the pots.
fields.JP:
きっとどこかから飛んできた種が
紛れ込んじゃったんですね。
そういうことってよくあるので
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess a seed must've flew in
to her room, and found root in
one of the pots.

fields.EN:
And since it had already sprouted,
she kept growing it, and eventually
it bloomed into this flower.
fields.JP:
それでせっかく芽が出たん
だからって育てているうちに、
こんな花が咲いたんだそうです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sprouted, so Sleepy just
figured she may as well grow
it, and lo and behold, here it is.

fields.EN:
Huh, but it sure is weird.
The flower is as big as my face,
and it looks sort of poisonous.
fields.JP:
それにしても、本当に珍しい花だねー。
花自体が人の顔くらい大きいし、
色も毒々しくて刺激的だし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, but it sure is weird.
The flower is as big as my face,
and it looks sort of poisonous.

fields.EN:
Right? There's this strange allure
to its deep, oddly vibrant colors!
fields.JP:
他の追随を許さないこのすさまじい色合いが、
なんとも言えませんよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? There's this strange allure
to its deep, oddly vibrant colors!

fields.EN:
(I can't see very well from here,
but it doesn't look pretty at
all...)
fields.JP:
（ここからじゃよく見えないけど、
　あんまりきれいな色じゃないような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't see very well from here,
but it doesn't look pretty at
all...)

fields.EN:
The smell is something, too!
Just sniffing it makes my head
feel light and cloudy...
fields.JP:
しかも匂いが……ああ、すっごくいい匂い。
嗅いでると、頭がぽわーんってなってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The smell is something, too!
Just sniffing it makes my head
feel light and cloudy...

fields.EN:
(Would a scent alone normally make
someone that intoxicated...? I hope there
isn't some dangerous substance in it.)
fields.JP:
（普通、匂いだけであそこまで酩酊した
　感じになるか？　……なにか危ない成分でも
　入ってるんじゃないだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Would the flower's aroma cause
such a strange euphoric state?
This isn't sounding good...)

fields.EN:
Whoa, that flower just made a
sound! Do flowers normally make noises?
fields.JP:
わっ、今この花鳴いたよ！
花って鳴くものだっけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, the flower barked!
I didn't know flowers did that?

fields.EN:
It seems to be that kind of species.
It's proof that it's healthy and lively.
fields.JP:
そういう種類みたいなんです。
元気がいい証拠ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, this species must be able
to bark. It really is spunky,
isn't it?

fields.EN:
(She doesn't find that strange?!
There are no flowers that can
bark!)
fields.JP:
（いや、納得しちゃうのか！？
　花が鳴くわけないだろ！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't find that strange?!
There are no flowers that can
bark!)

fields.EN:
Ooh! Look at how it's squiggling.
Boy, it really is active.
fields.JP:
おおっ、しかもうねうね動いてる！
ほんと元気な花だなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! Look at how it's squiggling.
Boy, it really is active.

fields.EN: Uh, but do flowers do this?
fields.JP: ところで花ってこんなに動くものだっけ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, but do flowers do this?

fields.EN:
I think it must be a trait of its
species. It sort of proves how
alive it really is.
fields.JP:
そういう種類なんだと思います。
生きがいい証拠ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it must be a trait of its
species. It sort of proves how
alive it really is.

fields.EN:
(Wait! She can't seriously be
okay with that explanation?!
This is all so wrong!)
fields.JP:
（だからそれで納得していいのか！？
　ちょっとは疑問に思ってくれ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait! She can't seriously be
okay with that explanation?!
This is all so wrong!)

fields.EN:
It's so rare that we figured we
should put the flower someplace
where everyone can see.
fields.JP:
せっかくの珍しい花なので、
みんなが見られるところに
この鉢植えを飾ろうと思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's so rare that we figured we
should put the flower someplace
where everyone can see.

fields.EN:
Sounds like a plan! I'm sure
everyone would appreciate it.
C'mon, let's find a place for it!
fields.JP:
いいねそれ。きっとみんな喜ぶよ！
さっそく飾りに行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like a plan! I'm sure
everyone would appreciate it.
C'mon, let's find a place for it!

fields.EN:
...That monstrous plant looked ready to attack
at any moment. I have nothing but bad feelings
about it. Was it really even a flower?
fields.JP:
……あんな今にも人を襲いそうな
化け物じみた植物、危険な予感しかしない。
っていうかあれ、本当に花だったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That thing sounds more like a
monster than a flower... It's
giving me bad vibes...

fields.EN:
I better take that flower off of
their hands before it causes
any problems...
fields.JP:
被害が出る前に、あの三人から
鉢植えを回収したほうがよさそうだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better take that flower off of
their hands before it causes
any problems...

fields.EN:
Wh-What the...?!
Is there a fight?!
fields.JP: な、なんだ？　誰か戦ってるのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What the...?!
Is there a fight?!

fields.EN:
(It seems like they're training,
but what they're doing is pretty
intense and extreme...)
fields.JP:
（これはまた、激しくやり合ってるな。
　戦闘訓練をしてるみたいだけど、
　それにしたって白熱しすぎだろ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It seems like they're training,
but what they're doing is pretty
intense and extreme...)

fields.EN:
(Even their clothes are falling
apart. They better stop before
they go completely nude...)
fields.JP:
（服も破けちゃって、あちこち
　見えそうでやばいし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even their clothes are falling
apart. They better stop before
they go completely nude...)

fields.JP:
赤ずきん！　アリス！
もうその辺にしておけ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood! Alice!
Stop it already!

fields.EN:
I just happened by.
I'm surprised you girls only
noticed me now.
fields.JP:
今来たばっかりだよ。
僕が来たことにも気づいてなかったのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just happened by.
I'm surprised you girls only
noticed me now.

fields.JP: まーいいや。続きをやるよ、アリス！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, sit back and watch, will ya?
C'mon, let's do this, Alice!

fields.EN:
Don't worry! We're only training
so that we can kick some
Marchen and Nightmare butt!
fields.JP:
当然！　普段から戦闘訓練してないと、
メルヒェンやナイトメアを
ぶっ飛ばせないじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry! We're only training
so that we can kick some
Marchen and Nightmare butt!

fields.EN:
She's right. We need to stay fit,
so that we don't falter when the
need to fight arise.
fields.JP:
その通りよ。
いざというときに体が鈍っていたら、
目も当てられないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. We need to stay fit,
so that we don't falter when the
need to fight arise.

fields.EN:
Well yes, but I don't think you
need to train to the extent your
clothes are falling off...
fields.JP:
それはそうなんだけど、さすがに
そこまで服がぼろぼろになっちゃったら、
いったん止めたほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well yes, but I don't think you
need to train to the extent your
clothes are falling off...

fields.EN:
We can't let that bother us in
an actual fight.
fields.JP: こんなの実戦では恥ずかしがっていられないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't let that bother us in
an actual fight.

fields.EN:
Whether our clothes tear or come off, we'll
keep fighting as long as our bodies can move!
That's what it means to be a Blood Maiden!!
fields.JP:
服が破れようが脱げようが、
体が動く限り戦い続ける！
それが血式少女ってもんでしょ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens are born to fight!
We'll keep going, even if our
clothes come off!

fields.EN:
Uh, I'd appreciate it if you don't
describe us Blood Maidens
like that...
fields.JP:
いや、勝手に変なスローガンみたいなの
作らないでくれ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I'd appreciate it if you don't
describe us Blood Maidens
like that...

fields.EN:
I understand you two are serious,
but I doubt you need to go to
those lengths for training.
fields.JP:
二人が真剣なのはわかったけど、
訓練でそこまで自分を追い込むことは
ないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand you two are serious,
but I doubt you need to go to
those lengths for training.

fields.EN:
I joined only recently.
I can't let my junior state get
in the way of everyone.
fields.JP:
わたしは遅くに仲間になったのよ。
ただでさえかなり後輩なのに、みんなの
足を引っ張ることがあったら申し訳ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I joined only recently.
I can't let my junior state get
in the way of everyone.

fields.EN:
Yeah, and I only came back
recently, too. We need to do a bit
more than the norm to keep up.
fields.JP:
あたしも、戻ってきたのは最近だからね。
余計にがんばらなきゃって思うところはあるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and I only came back
recently, too. We need to do a bit
more than the norm to keep up.

fields.EN:
You know, we don't want to end
up being a load on everyone.
fields.JP: 役に立たないと、って焦るというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, we don't want to end
up being a load on everyone.

fields.EN: Is that what's worrying you two?
fields.JP: 二人とも、そんなこと気にしてたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that what's worrying you two?

fields.EN:
Well, yeah. It's a bit of a
serious subject to us.
fields.JP:
む。そんなことじゃないよ。
けっこー切実なんだからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, yeah. It's a bit of a
serious subject to us.

fields.EN:
We know everyone is nice here,
but we want to catch up to where
you all are at now.
fields.JP:
みんなが優しいことはわかっているけど、
少しでも前からの仲間に追いつきたいと
思ってしまうの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We know everyone is nice here,
but we want to catch up to where
you all are at now.

fields.EN:
I see... I guess I can understand
that feeling, but...
fields.JP:
そっか……。
その気持ちはわかるかもしれない。
でもさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I guess I can understand
that feeling, but...

fields.EN:
Uh, you should really do something
about your clothes there...
fields.JP:
本当にその恰好はどうにかしたほうが
いいと思うんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you should really do something
about your clothes there...

fields.EN:
Yeah, it's a bit torn here and
there.
fields.JP: ま、たしかにあちこち破けてはいるけどねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it's a bit torn here and
there.

fields.EN:
But it's not in our way to the
extent we stop fighting.
fields.JP: 戦いを続行するには問題ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's not in our way to the
extent we stop fighting.

fields.EN:
C'mon, you two should be... you
know? A bit more embarrassed.
fields.JP:
いやいやいや、二人とももう少し
恥じらいを持とうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, you two should be... you
know? A bit more embarrassed.

fields.EN:
Hell no! Is being embarrassed
going to help us win a fight?
fields.JP:
恥じらいで戦いに勝てるの？
勝てないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hell no! Is being embarrassed
going to help us win a fight?

fields.EN:
(They're both too worked up to think
straight. So Alice can be pretty
muscle-brained too when she gets like this...)
fields.JP:
（二人とも、頭に血が昇ってるなぁ。
　こうなるとアリスもけっこう
　脳筋タイプだったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're too excited to reason to
now... I didn't expect Alice to
be like that...)

fields.EN:
Oh my!
What is with your clothes?!
fields.JP: まあぁ！　二人とも、その服はいったい……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my!
What is with your clothes?!

fields.EN: We're in the middle of training.
fields.JP: あたしたち、戦闘訓練をしてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: We're in the middle of training.

fields.EN:
But look at how much skin is
showing! You should be
embarrassed!
fields.JP:
なんてあられもない恰好ですの！？
恥ずかしいですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But look at how much skin is
showing! You should be
embarrassed!

fields.EN:
Even if you were training, you shouldn't
keep going until you end up dressed like that!
fields.JP:
いくら戦闘訓練をしていたからって、
そんな恰好になるまでやるなんて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Training or not, you should not be
in the open in the public's eye!

fields.EN:
I would never expect ladies like
you two to expose yourself like
this!
fields.JP: レディーとしてありえませんわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would never expect ladies like
you two to expose yourself like
this!

fields.EN:
I guess we shouldn't be out
here like this...
fields.JP:
……さすがに、この恰好は
ちょっとまずいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we shouldn't be out
here like this...

fields.EN:
It might be a problem after all...
I feel like I've finally come to my senses.
fields.JP:
まずいかもしれないわね。
……なんだか目が覚めた気分だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... I feel the embarrassment
coming down on me now...

fields.EN:
(They got their cool back! Looks
like my words weren't enough to
get them to look at themselves.)
fields.JP:
（おお、やっと冷静になった！
　僕がいくら言っても
　聞く耳持たなかったのに！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They got their cool back! Looks
like my words weren't enough to
get them to look at themselves.)

fields.EN:
Your words must've resonated
with them, Cinderella.
fields.JP: シンデレラ、君の一言はすごい効果だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your words must've resonated
with them, Cinderella.

fields.EN:
Hm? I didn't say anything
unusual, did I?
fields.JP: はぁ？　意味がわかりませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? I didn't say anything
unusual, did I?

fields.EN:
What's this eerie sounding snicker
coming from?!
fields.JP:
な、なんだ？　どこからともなく
不気味な笑い声が……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's this eerie sounding snicker
coming from?!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
You're right. I can hear it coming
from inside Akazukin's
room.
fields.JP:
本当だ。扉の隙間から聞こえてくるな。
この部屋は……赤ずきんの部屋か
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. I can hear it coming
from inside Red Riding Hood's
room.

fields.EN:
(I'm curious what she's doing in
there... and I'm worried. Maybe
it's okay if I go in for a moment.)
fields.JP:
（部屋の中でなにをしてるのか気になる……。
　心配だし、ちょっと入ってもいいかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what that snicker was
about? Let me take a peek...)

fields.JP: ふふふ、ふーふーふーふーふー……

fields.EN:
(Yikes... She's laughing to
herself. I don't think she even
notices I stepped in a bit...)
fields.JP:
（うわ、一人で笑ってる……。
　僕が入ってきたことにも全然
　気づかないみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yikes... She's laughing to
herself. I don't think she even
notices I stepped in a bit...)

fields.EN:
(What's that...? An altar with...
a red parka on it?)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんの前に祭壇みたいな
　ものがあって、その上には
　赤いパーカーが乗せられている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's that...? An altar with...
a red parka on it?)

fields.EN:
Ahem... Y-You seem like you're
having fun, Akazukin.
Did something good happen?
fields.JP:
あ……赤ずきん、ご機嫌だね。
なにかいいことでもあったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahem... Y-You seem like you're
having fun, Red Riding Hood.
Did something good happen?

fields.EN:
Huh? Otsuu?
Since when were you in my room?
fields.JP:
あれ、おつう。
どうしてアタシの部屋に？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Otsuu?
Since when were you in my room?

fields.EN:
Well, I heard an eerie.. Uh...
I heard you laughing, so I just
wanted to see what's up.
fields.JP:
いや、変な……愉快な笑い声が
廊下まで聞こえてきたから、
どうしたのかと気になって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I heard an eerie.. Uh...
I heard you laughing, so I just
wanted to see what's up.

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm just happy, that's all.
Look at it. This red parka is
perfect in every way.
fields.JP:
だってすごく嬉しいんだもん。
この赤いパーカー、見れば見るほど
あたしの好みにドンピシャで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm just happy, that's all.
Look at it. This red parka is
perfect in every way.

fields.EN:
Mmm... Just looking at it makes
me happy... Heh heh heh...
fields.JP:
あー、見てるだけで幸せ……。
ふふふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Just looking at it makes
me happy... Heh heh heh...

fields.EN:
(She shouldn't be on any illicit
drugs, but the way she's laughing
already sounds completely gone...)
fields.JP:
（いけない薬をやってるわけじゃ
　ないはずなのに、笑い方がすでに
　いっちゃってる感じ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She almost sounds as if she's
delirious coming from the tone
of her laugh...)

fields.EN:
You know how we're all under a lot
of pressure, and how it can really
get to you, right?
fields.JP:
今ってさ、ほら、なにかと大変だったり
辛かったりすることが多いでしょ？
気分が暗くなっちゃうんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how we're all under a lot
of pressure, and how it can really
get to you, right?

fields.EN:
That's where this parka comes in.
Just looking at it makes me feel
happy. It soothes my soul.
fields.JP:
そんなときにこのパーカーを見ると、
それだけで明るい気分になれるの。
精神安定剤みたいなものだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's where this parka comes in.
Just looking at it makes me feel
happy. It soothes my soul.

fields.EN:
I gotta hand it to you for
bringing it to me. I can't thank
you enough for it.
fields.JP:
このパーカーをくれて、ありがとう。
おつうとジャックには感謝してるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I gotta hand it to you for
bringing it to me. I can't thank
you enough for it.

fields.EN:
You're very welcome. I'm happy
you like it this much.
fields.JP:
どういたしまして。
そこまで気に入ってもらえたなら、
僕も嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're very welcome. I'm happy
you like it this much.

fields.EN:
But, if you really like it, how
come you're not wearing it?
I'm sure you'd look good in it.
fields.JP:
でもそんなに気に入ってるなら、
飾ってないで着ればいいじゃないか。
似合うと思うけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, if you really like it, how
come you're not wearing it?
I'm sure you'd look good in it.

fields.JP: 今はまだ、そのときじゃないから

fields.EN:
I'm going to wear it once we
escape from this place. That way
I can enjoy it while I'm happy.
fields.JP:
脱獄して、もっと明るい気持ちで
暮らせるようになったら、このパーカーを
着たいと思うの。だから今は見るだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to wear it once we
escape from this place. That way
I can enjoy it while I'm happy.

fields.EN:
Oh, so that's why you have it
on that... um, altar?
fields.JP: そっか、だから祭壇に祭り上げてるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so that's why you have it
on that... um, altar?

fields.EN:
It's not an altar! You're making
me sound like some weirdo! I just
have it propped onto a pedestal.
fields.JP:
さ、祭壇とか言わないで！
ヘンな宗教じゃないんだから！
きれいな台の上に飾り付けてるだけだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not an altar! You're making
me sound like some weirdo! I just
have it propped onto a pedestal.

fields.EN:
(It sure looks like an altar to
me...)
fields.JP: （それが祭壇チックなんだけどな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It sure looks like an altar to
me...)

fields.EN:
Heh... I can't wait for the day
to come where I can wear this
just for the style...
fields.JP:
ふふ、早くこのパーカーをかわいく
着られる日が来るといいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I can't wait for the day
to come where I can wear this
just for the style...

fields.EN:
Well, I'm sure it'd look cute on
you. Sure wouldn't mind seeing
you wearing it.
fields.JP:
へぇ、かわいい赤ずきんか。
いいね。僕も早く見てみたいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm sure it'd look cute on
you. Sure wouldn't mind seeing
you wearing it.

fields.EN:
S-Stop it. Me, cute in it?
You're making me blush.
fields.JP:
……あ、あんまり想像しないで。
自分でかわいくとか言ったけど、
やっぱりちょっと恥ずかしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop it. Me, cute in it?
You're making me blush.

fields.EN:
Come now, I'm sure it'd look
cute on you, my cute little
Akazukin-chan.
fields.JP:
いいじゃないか。
期待してるよ、かわいい赤ずきんちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, I'm sure it'd look
cute on you, my cute little
Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
Hey!
No teasing your elder, you hear?!
fields.JP: と、年上をからかうんじゃないの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey!
No teasing your elder, you hear?!

fields.JP: この時間ならアリスいるよな……？

fields.EN:
I'm just a bit nervous, since we'd
need to explain what happened
to Jack-san...
fields.JP:
ジャックさんがあの姿になった時のこと、
ちゃんと話さなきゃって思うと……
少し緊張しちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just a bit nervous, since we'd
need to explain what happened
to Jack...

fields.EN:
I'm sure it's not going to sit
very well with her.
fields.JP: アリスにとっては、ショックな話だろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure it's not going to sit
very well with her.

fields.EN:
Still, she has the right to know.
And, we have an obligation to
let her know.
fields.JP:
それでも、彼女には聞く権利がある。
そして僕らには伝える義務がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, she has the right to know.
And, we have an obligation to
let her know.

fields.EN:
It's okay. If you explain it properly, she'll
understand. Princess, you did everything
you could back then. I guarantee it.
fields.JP:
大丈夫、ちゃんと話せば分かってくれる。
あの時、姫は精一杯のことをしたんだ。
僕が保証するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I'm sure she'll
understand. We did what we
could back then.

fields.EN:
Thank you, Otsuu-chan...
I feel a bit better now.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、おつうちゃん。
少し勇気が出て来たよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Otsuu...
I feel a bit better now.

fields.EN:
That's good to hear.
Now, shall we?
fields.JP:
それはよかった。
じゃあ行こうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear.
Now, shall we?

fields.EN:
Alice? It's me, Tsuu.
Can I come in?
fields.JP:
アリス、つうだけど、
ちょっと入ってもいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice? It's me, Otsuu.
Can I come in?

fields.JP:
いらっしゃい、おつうさん。
それに人魚姫さんも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello Otsuu.
Oh, and Little Mermaid.

fields.EN:
Hello there, Alice-san.
It looks like Jack-san is here, too.
fields.JP:
こんにちは、アリスさん。
ジャックさんもいたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello there, Alice.
It looks like Jack is here, too.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Why, hello to you too, Jack.
Oh, and it looks like you've got
the place cleaned-up, Alice.
fields.JP:
ああこんにちは、ジャック。
それにしてもアリス、だいぶ荷物も
整理がついたみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, hello to you too, Jack.
Oh, and it looks like you've got
the place cleaned-up, Alice.

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm finally starting to
settle into place here.
fields.JP: ええ、ようやく落ちついてきたところ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm finally starting to
settle into place here.

fields.EN: So, is there anything you need?
fields.JP:
それで、ここで暮らすに当たって
何か不自由はないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, is there anything you need?

fields.EN:
If you have any particular needs,
or requests feel free to let us
know.
fields.JP:
足りないものとか設備の要望、
それ以外でも問題抱えてるなら
何でも言ってほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you have any particular needs,
or requests feel free to let us
know.

fields.EN:
I'm fine... The facilities here
are actually quite robust.
fields.JP:
足りないものは……ないわ。
設備だって、充分すぎるくらいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine... The facilities here
are actually quite robust.

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, she was in a
cell for a very long time...)
fields.JP:
（そうか……今まで独房エリアに
　ずっといたんだもんな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, she was in a
cell for a very long time...)

fields.EN:
So, no troubles or issues then?
Don't worry. You're free to say
what you want here.
fields.JP:
じゃあ何か問題とかトラブルもないか？
もしも来たばかりでワガママ言えない、
とか遠慮してるなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, no troubles or issues then?
Don't worry. You're free to say
what you want here.

fields.EN:
No, really, there isn't. Jack
and I are alive... That's enough for me.
fields.JP:
ううん、本当にないの。
わたしとジャックが生きてる……
それだけで充分なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm fine, really.
Jack is with me now, and that's
all that matters...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack calls me by my name.
Just hearing that is more than
enough for me...
fields.JP:
こうしてジャックがわたしの名前を
呼んでくれる……それだけで満足なの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack calls me by my name.
Just hearing that is more than
enough for me...

fields.EN:
Jack-san may not have ended up like
this if things were different...
fields.JP:
もしかしたらジャックさんはこんな姿に
ならなくて済んだかもしれないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack may not have ended up like
this if things were different...

fields.EN:
Jack-san got himself critically
injured when he tried to save me
during a fall...
fields.JP:
ジャックさんは、崖から落ちたわたしを
守るために瀕死になって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack got himself critically
injured when he tried to save me
during a fall...

fields.EN:
That led to his transformation
into a Nightmare...
fields.JP:
それでナイトメアに
なってしまったんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That led to his transformation
into a Nightmare...

fields.EN: I'm sorry we couldn't save him...
fields.JP: 助けられなくて……ごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry we couldn't save him...

fields.EN:
But... Jack-san ended up like this
because he saved me...! If only
I'd been the one underneath him...!
fields.JP:
だってっ……わたしを助けたばっかりに
ジャックさんはこんな姿になって……！
わたしが下になっていればっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack wouldn't have to be like
this if only I didn't fall!
It's... It's all my fault!

fields.EN: Here... You don't need to cry.
fields.JP: ……頭を上げて。もう泣かないで
fields.LOCALIZED: Here... You don't need to cry.

fields.EN:
I don't have any bad feelings
toward you two, Ningyohime-san,
Otsuu-san.
fields.JP:
人魚姫さんのこともおつうさんのことも、
わたし本当に恨んでなんかないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have any bad feelings
toward you two, Little Mermaid,
Otsuu.

fields.EN:
On the contrary, I appreciate
how you brought me back so
that I can be with Jack again.
fields.JP:
むしろ、こうしてまたジャックと
再会させてくれてありがとうって思ってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, I appreciate
how you brought me back so
that I can be with Jack again.

fields.EN:
And knowing Jack, he definitely would have
protected you, Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
それにジャックなら
確かに人魚姫さんを守ったと思うから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, thinking how Jack is, he
would have done anything to try
to have saved you.

fields.EN:
So I'm actually proud of
what he did.
fields.JP: むしろ誇らしいくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I'm actually proud of
what he did.

fields.EN:
So please, don't blame yourself.
Jack is here next to me now,
and that's all that matters.
fields.JP:
だからね、そんなに気負わないでほしいの。
ジャックは今こうしてわたしの隣にいる。
それで充分なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, don't blame yourself.
Jack is here next to me now,
and that's all that matters.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: You're patting my head... I'm happy...
fields.JP: 頭撫でてくれるの……嬉しい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're... patting me on my head?
Thank you...

fields.EN:
Jack, you're acting every bit as much
like a prince as I am. I'm a little jealous.
fields.JP:
ジャック、おまえ僕に負けないくらい
王子様してるじゃないか
ちょっと妬けるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, stop making me jealous.
You're acting more like a prince
than me.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
J-Jack... Um, I appreciate it, but
you can stop now. I'm getting a
little embarrassed now...
fields.JP:
じゃ、ジャック……
嬉しいけど、そのくらいにして。
少し恥ずかしくなってきたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Jack... Um, I appreciate it, but
you can stop now. I'm getting a
little embarrassed now...

fields.EN:
I have no intention of blaming
anyone, so please, you can stop
apologizing.
fields.JP:
わたしはもう誰かを責めるつもりはないから
だから、これ以上は謝ったりしないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention of blaming
anyone, so please, you can stop
apologizing.

fields.EN: Oh, uh... I didn't say that.
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, uh... I didn't say that.

fields.EN: I didn't even hear what you said.
fields.JP: ええ、何も聞こえてないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't even hear what you said.

fields.EN:
(But Alice gets so girlish
when it comes to Jack...)
fields.JP:
（しかしアリスはジャックのことになると
　すごく乙女だけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice is very reliable and puts up
strong front towards everyone, but...)

fields.EN:
(She's usually so dignified.
She's really dependable...)
fields.JP:
（普段は凛としていて、
　ホント頼りがいがあるなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She is quite the lady in front
of Jack...)

fields.EN: Alice, do you have a moment?
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice, do you have a moment?

fields.EN:
That's strange...
I'm sure I heard something...
fields.JP: 変だな……中から声はするのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's strange...
I'm sure I heard something...

fields.JP: アリス、聞こえてないのかい？

fields.EN:
Oh well...
Sorry, but I'm coming in.
fields.JP:
……仕方ない、か。
悪いけど、入るよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh well...
Sorry, but I'm coming in.

fields.EN:
Alice? I brought you your new
lingerie that Kaede got for you.
fields.JP:
アリス、カエデから君の分の
新しい下着もらったから届けに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice? I brought you your new
lingerie that Kaede got for you.

fields.EN:
This cup... No...
How about this one? No...
fields.JP:
このカップも……駄目。
こっちも……駄目だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This cup... No...
How about this one? No...

fields.JP: なにをやってるんだい？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
How are you doing, Jack?
No one answered so I welcomed
myself in...
fields.JP:
やあジャック、元気かい。
声をかけても返事がないから
悪いけど勝手に入らせてもらったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How are you doing, Jack?
No one answered so I welcomed
myself in...

fields.JP: それで、アリスは何をしてるんだ……？
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……がっ……ぶ……
みで…………る……

fields.EN:
She's looking at cups?
That's an accurate description...
fields.JP:
カップを見てる？
うん……見たまんまだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's looking at cups?
That's an accurate description...

fields.EN:
The last two... No...
None of them work...
fields.JP:
残りの２つは……やっぱり駄目ね。
ああもう、どれも使えないじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The last two... No...
None of them work...

fields.EN:
Um, Alice? What's with all
those cups?
fields.JP:
ねえアリス、そのたくさんの
カップはいったいどうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Alice? What's with all
those cups?

fields.JP: あっ、やだっ、おつうさん！？

fields.EN:
You should at least knock on
the door if you're coming in.
fields.JP:
もう……入ってくるなら
ノックくらいしてくれないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should at least knock on
the door if you're coming in.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I did, but it
seemed like you couldn't hear
me knocking.
fields.JP:
すまない。何度もしたんだけど、
聞こえてないみたいだったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I did, but it
seemed like you couldn't hear
me knocking.

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... I didn't notice.
How embarrassing...
fields.JP:
そ、そうだったの……
ごめんなさい、気づかなくて……
ああもう、恥ずかしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... I didn't notice.
How embarrassing...

fields.EN:
So, what are you doing with
those cups?
fields.JP:
それで、カップ
ばかり集めてどうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what are you doing with
those cups?

fields.EN:
I think this is because of my
Blood Libido...
fields.JP:
これは血式リビドーのせいなの。
……たぶん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think this is because of my
Blood Libido...

fields.EN:
That's good. You must have learned
about it from Itsuki.
fields.JP:
ああ、血式少女の基礎知識、
イツキにちゃんと習ったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good. You must have learned
about it from Itsuki.

fields.EN:
Yes. I'd wondered about it for a long
time, but after hearing Itsuki-san's
story, it finally made sense.
fields.JP:
ええ。前から不思議に思ってはいたけれど、
イツキさんの話を聞いてようやく納得したの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I was curious as to why
I behaved this way, but talking
with him made me understand why.

fields.EN:
That this strange urge unique to
me comes from being a Blood Maiden,
and that it's perfectly natural.
fields.JP:
この自分にしかない不思議な衝動は、
わたしが血式少女だからで、そしてそれは
当たり前のことなんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that Blood Maidens have
unusual urges which is common
among us.

fields.EN:
Right. Behaviors coming from our
Blood Libido is normal to us.
fields.JP:
そうだね。血式リビドーは僕たち
血式少女にとって決して変なことではないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Behaviors coming from our
Blood Libido is normal to us.

fields.JP:
それでね、わたしの
血式リビドーなのだけど……

fields.EN:
It seems like mine is about me
wanting to hold tea parties...
fields.JP:
どうやら『お茶会を開きたい』っていう
衝動らしくて、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems like mine is about me
wanting to hold tea parties...

fields.EN:
And, that's why you have
these cups out?
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, that's why you have
these cups out?

fields.EN:
Y-Yes... I found a tea set, so
I brought it back with me...
fields.JP:
そ……そうなの……
カップのセットを見つけたから、
つい拾ってきてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes... I found a tea set, so
I brought it back with me...

fields.EN:
At this rate, everyone is going
to assume I'm some kind of
pack rat...
fields.JP:
ああもう、変なモノ拾い集める人だって
思われちゃう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this rate, everyone is going
to assume I'm some kind of
pack rat...

fields.EN:
It'll be fine, Alice. We all have
our own Blood Libido. No one
will make fun of you for it.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよアリス。
僕たちはみんな血式リビドーを持っている。
誰も笑いやしないさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be fine, Alice. We all have
our own Blood Libido. No one
will make fun of you for it.

fields.JP: そ……そうかもしれないけど……

fields.EN:
Don't worry, not a single one of
us will laugh at your about it!
fields.JP:
大丈夫！　笑う奴なんて
僕たちの中には誰もいないさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, not a single one of
us will laugh at your about it!

fields.EN:
(Like, Hameln and Rapunzel brings
things back too, and that isn't
because of their Blood Libido...)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンやラプンツェル辺りは
　リビドーなんて関係なく変なモノを
　拾ってくるからな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Like, Hameln and Rapunzel brings
things back too, and that isn't
because of their Blood Libido...)

fields.EN:
(Compared to some of the
others', Alice's Blood Libido
is quite cute.)
fields.JP:
（アリスのリビドーなんて、
　かわいいものさ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Compared to some of the
others', Alice's Blood Libido
is quite cute.)

fields.EN:
I'm rather interested in your tea
party. Do you mind I join?
fields.JP:
それに僕もお茶会には興味ある。
よかったらいつか同席させてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm rather interested in your tea
party. Do you mind I join?

fields.EN:
I'm glad to hear that, but the
cups I have here are all broken.
fields.JP:
それは嬉しいのだけど……
でもこのカップのセット、
全部壊れてて使い物にならないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad to hear that, but the
cups I have here are all broken.

fields.EN:
So it seems... This one has a
crack, and this one... the handle
is missing.
fields.JP:
あ、ホントだ。こっちはヒビが入ってるし、
こっちは持ち手が取れちゃってるな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it seems... This one has a
crack, and this one... the handle
is missing.

fields.EN:
Too bad they weren't in great
shape when you found them.
fields.JP: せっかく見つけたのに残念だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too bad they weren't in great
shape when you found them.

fields.JP: でもね、わたし諦めないわ

fields.EN:
I'm going to find me a set of
teacups if it's the last thing
I'll do...
fields.JP:
いつかまたどこかで
カップのセットを見つけて、
ちゃんと揃えるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to find me a set of
teacups if it's the last thing
I'll do...

fields.EN:
(I can tell Alice is dead
serious...)
fields.JP:
（おお、アリスから
　とてつもないやる気を感じる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can tell Alice is dead
serious...)

fields.EN:
One day, I'll hold the tea party
with Jack beside me...
fields.JP:
だって、いつかジャックと一緒に
お茶会したいもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
One day, I'll hold the tea party
with Jack beside me...

fields.EN: I'll help you where I can.
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll help you where I can.

fields.EN:
I think it's beautiful seeing
someone doing their best
for their love.
fields.JP:
だって好きな人のために頑張るって、
とっても素敵なことだと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's beautiful seeing
someone doing their best
for their love.

fields.EN: D-Did you hear what I just said, Otsuu-san?!
fields.JP:
もっ、もしかしておつうさん
今のわたしの独り言聞こえてたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Did you hear what I just
said?!

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, Jack always
faces up to eat because the
food dribbles from his mouth.)
fields.JP:
（でもジャックって普通に食べると
　こぼしちゃうから、いつも上向いて
　食べてるよなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, Jack always
faces up to eat because the
food dribbles from his mouth.)

fields.EN:
(Which means that he'd have to
look up to drink, too...)
fields.JP:
（ということはお茶を飲んでる間は
　ずっと上を向いて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Which means that he'd have to
look up to drink, too...)

fields.EN:
(That's going to be one sight to
see when the day comes where
he enjoys a cup of tea...)
fields.JP:
（駄目だ、シュールな絵面しか
　想像できない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's going to be one sight to
see when the day comes where
he enjoys a cup of tea...)

fields.JP: ちょっとお邪魔するね、アリスさん

fields.EN:
Nice to see you, Alice.
Must've been a rough day.
fields.JP:
お疲れ様アリス。
今日も色々大変だったろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice to see you, Alice.
Must've been a rough day.

fields.EN:
Not at all. Having a physical and
training are all part of survival
down here.
fields.JP:
いいえ、定期検査も訓練も、
生き抜くために必要なことだもの。
全然大変なんかじゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. Having a physical and
training are all part of survival
down here.

fields.EN:
Well, if that was me, then I'd be
completely burned out by now.
fields.JP:
アリスはすごいね。
僕だったらもうヘトヘトだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if that was me, then I'd be
completely burned out by now.

fields.EN:
I am the newest member here, so if
anything, I need to do my best so
that I can catch up to everyone.
fields.JP:
今いる血式少女の中で、
わたしが一番新参者だから。
遅れてる分、頑張らないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the newest member here, so if
anything, I need to do my best so
that I can catch up to everyone.

fields.EN:
Well then, Alice-san, I have a present for
you for working so hard!
fields.JP:
じゃあ頑張ってるアリスさんに、
わたしからプレゼント！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I have a surprise for a
certain someone doing their
very best!

fields.EN:
I told Princess about it. Then she
said she wanted to do something to help.
fields.JP:
僕が姫に話したんだ。
そしたら姫が何か力になりたいって
fields.LOCALIZED:
We spoke together to see how
we could be of help to you.

fields.EN:
We happened to find it while investigating
the Solitary Confinement Area the other day.
It's a little damaged, but still usable!
fields.JP:
この前独房エリアに調査に行った時にね、
ちょうど見つけたの。少し壊れてるけど、
まだ使えるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just so happened we found it in
our previous expedition. There's a
small crack, but it'll work fine!

fields.EN:
But... it is something we picked up, and
it's a little damaged, so I'd feel awful
if giving it to you only caused trouble...
fields.JP:
でもその……拾ってきたものだし、
少し壊れてるから逆に迷惑だったら
申し訳ないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but... we did find it, and it
is cracked, so if it doesn't work
then...

fields.EN:
Oh no! Not at all!
I couldn't be happier!
fields.JP:
ううん！　そんなことないわ！
とっても嬉しいっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no! Not at all!
I couldn't be happier!

fields.JP: ありがとう、人魚姫さん！

fields.EN:
You're welcome.
Heh, I'm glad you like it.
fields.JP:
どういたしまして。
ふふ、喜んでくれてよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're welcome.
Heh, I'm glad you like it.

fields.EN:
(Look at her carefully holding the
cup... She must be happy.)
fields.JP:
（掲げてみたりして、
　アリス本当に嬉しそうだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at her carefully holding the
cup... She must be happy.)

fields.EN:
I haven't had such a wonderful
present like this in ages.
fields.JP:
こんなに嬉しいプレゼントは
久しぶりだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't had such a wonderful
present like this in ages.

fields.EN:
What was the last present you
got that you really liked?
fields.JP: 前は何をもらって嬉しかったんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What was the last present you
got that you really liked?

fields.EN:
You mean your hairpin?
Oh, it must be something very
special to you.
fields.JP:
いつもつけてる髪飾り……
そうか、とても大事な贈り物だったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean your hairpin?
Oh, it must be something very
special to you.

fields.JP:
それをプレゼントしたのって、
もしかして……

fields.EN:
Yes... I got it from Jack quite
a while back.
fields.JP:
ええ……ずっと昔に、
ジャックにもらったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I got it from Jack quite
a while back.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
It's your most precious treasure, isn't it,
Alice-san?
fields.JP: アリスさんの、一番大事な宝物だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It must be the most precious thing
in the world to you.

fields.EN:
Yes. This is the one thing I
never want to lose, and I want
to keep wearing it all the time.
fields.JP:
ええ。これだけは絶対になくしたくないし、
いつもつけていたいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I never want to take it
off me.

fields.EN:
I can tell... the way your hand touches the
hair ornament is so gentle, Alice-san...
fields.JP:
分かるよ……髪飾りに触るアリスさんの手、
とても優しいもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can tell it's precious from
looking at the way you carefully
handle it.

fields.EN:
...Long ago I lived in a human settlement,
but at some point they started persecuting me.
fields.JP:
……昔、わたし人間の集落にいたんだけど、
ある時から迫害されるようになっちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I used to live in a village long
ago, where I was feared...

fields.EN:
They said that the color of
my eyes were strange...
fields.JP: 瞳の色がおかしい、って言われて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They said that the color of
my eyes were strange...

fields.EN:
(She must be referring to how
the Blood Maiden's eyes can
change color...)
fields.JP: （血式少女特有の、瞳の色の変化……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must be referring to how
the Blood Maiden's eyes can
change color...)

fields.EN:
I know now that it was because I'm a Blood
Maiden. But back then I knew nothing.
And none of the adults protected me...
fields.JP:
今ならそれが血式少女だからって分かる。
でもその時の自分は何も知らなかった。
そして大人は誰も守ってくれなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know now that this is unique to
Blood Maidens, but back then no
one knew or cared...

fields.EN:
I was harassed and shunned...
It didn't take long for me to
distance myself from others.
fields.JP:
いじめられたり、避けられたり……
わたしは段々と心を閉ざしていったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was harassed and shunned...
It didn't take long for me to
distance myself from others.

fields.EN:
Of course, some people did treat me
decently. But only as far as they could
without becoming targets themselves.
fields.JP:
もちろんまともに接してくれる人も
中にはいたわ。でもそれはあくまで
自分に飛び火しない程度の接し方だったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, some treated me like any
other, but that was only because
they didn't want to look bad...

fields.EN:
I made sure I stayed away from
everyone, and lost any interest in
associating with others...
fields.JP:
だからわたしは心を閉ざしたの。
もう誰にも開くつもりはなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I made sure I stayed away from
everyone, and lost any interest in
associating with others...

fields.EN:
(I can't imagine how horrible of a
life she went through as a child.)
fields.JP:
（子供ながらにそこまで
　決意させるほどに劣悪な環境って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't imagine how horrible of a
life she went through as a child.)

fields.EN:
Through all that, only one person
genuinely cared about me.
fields.JP:
そんな中、たった１人だけが
わたしに構ってくれたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Through all that, only one person
genuinely cared about me.

fields.EN:
I would keep shooing him off,
but he would never give up.
fields.JP:
何度も何度も『あっち行って』って
言ってるのに、その男の子は全然、
これっぽっちも諦めてくれなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would keep shooing him off,
but he would never give up.

fields.EN:
Even if I ran, he'd chase me; if I
hid, he'd find me. If I got angry, he'd
sulk, then start following me again...
fields.JP:
逃げても絶対に追いかけてきて、
隠れても絶対に探し出してきて、
怒ったらしょげるけど、またついてきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I moved away, he'd follow. If I
hid, he would find me. I would get
mad, but he would still follow.

fields.EN:
That certain person must have
been pretty persistent.
fields.JP:
意外と押しが強いんですね、
その男の子って
fields.LOCALIZED:
That certain person must have
been pretty persistent.

fields.EN:
Yes, very...
I finally gave up trying to lose
him.
fields.JP:
ええ、とっても強かった。
先に根負けしたのはわたしの方だったもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, very...
I finally gave up trying to lose
him.

fields.EN:
I asked him why he kept
following me, and he said it was
because I looked lonely...
fields.JP:
どうしてわたしについてくるの？
って聞いたら『寂しそうに見えた』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I asked him why he kept
following me, and he said it was
because I looked lonely...

fields.EN:
That's when I finally
remembered: 'Oh... I was lonely.'
fields.JP:
わたしその時ようやく思い出したの。
『そういえばわたし、寂しかったんだ』って
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's when it struck me that
I wasn't feeling lonely like
before...

fields.EN:
With him constantly following me, I kept
running, hiding, and getting angry... until
I'd forgotten my loneliness and frustration.
fields.JP:
ずっとつきまとわれて、
逃げて隠れて怒ってるうちに、
寂しさや悔しさなんて忘れてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I forgot that I was supposed to
be lonely and sad because of all
his bugging and following me.

fields.EN:
Then I started to laugh... It was
funny thinking how he reminded me
that I was supposed to be lonely.
fields.JP:
それで、わたし久しぶりに笑ったの。
寂しさを忘れてたわたしを『寂しそう』って
追いかけてきたことが面白くて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then I started to laugh... It was
funny thinking how he reminded me
that I was supposed to be lonely.

fields.EN:
I also laughed because I was
happy that someone actually
cared about me...
fields.JP:
……その優しさが嬉しくて。
だからわたし、笑ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also laughed because I was
happy that someone actually
cared about me...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ううん、ないんでもないわジャック

fields.EN:
This hair ornament was the
first present Jack ever gave me...
fields.JP:
この髪飾りは、そんなジャックが
初めてくれたプレゼントなの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you see, it's a special
present from Jack.

fields.EN: Yup, and I can see why.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, and I can see why.

fields.EN:
You were so cute when you talked about
Jack-san, Alice-san...
fields.JP:
ジャックさんのことを話してるアリスさん、
本当にかわいらしいから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were so cute while
talking about it, too.

fields.JP: 見てて微笑ましいよね

fields.EN:
Alice-san in love...
That's so dreamy...
fields.JP:
恋する乙女のアリスさん、
本当に素敵……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice in love...
That's so dreamy...

fields.EN:
Wh-Wh-What are you saying?!
I-I'm not cute...
fields.JP:
そそっ、そんなこと……！
かわいくなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Wh-What are you saying?!
I-I'm not cute...

fields.EN:
You're very cute when
you blush too, Alice-san.
fields.JP:
照れてるアリスさんも
とってもかわいらしいんだよ？
も、もうそれ以上言わないでっ

fields.EN:
B-Back on subject! The cup you gave me,
Ningyohime-san, was the first present in a
long time that made me that happy!
fields.JP:
と、とにかくっ！
人魚姫さんのくれたカップは、
それ以来の嬉しいプレゼントってことなの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-Back on subject! So that's the
last present I got that I was
really happy for!

fields.EN:
Thank you, Alice-san.
I'm glad you liked it.
fields.JP:
ありがとうアリスさん。
プレゼントしてよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Alice.
I'm glad you liked it.

fields.JP: うん、僕もとっても嬉しいよ

fields.EN:
(It's good I discussed with
Princess beforehand. Alice is
more pleased than I thought.)
fields.JP:
（想像以上に喜んでくれたなアリス。
　姫に相談してよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's good I discussed with
Princess beforehand. Alice is
more pleased than I thought.)

fields.EN:
Princess, do you mind coming
with me to see Kaede?
fields.JP:
姫、後でカエデの
ところに一緒に行かないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, do you mind coming
with me to see Kaede?

fields.EN:
Sure. Are you going to get
something from her?
fields.JP: いいけど……何か支給品でももらうの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. Are you going to get
something from her?

fields.EN:
I heard Kaede got some sweets,
and she said she could share
some with us.
fields.JP:
実はカエデが密かに
甘いモノを手に入れたらしくって……
少し分けてくれるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard Kaede got some sweets,
and she said she could share
some with us.

fields.JP:
本当に？
よかったね、おつうちゃん！

fields.EN:
(What...?
Jack's mind is... going out
of control?)
fields.JP:
（これは……
　ジャックの心が乱れてる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What...?
Jack's mind is... going out
of control?)

fields.EN:
I'm fine...
We need to go to Alice's room,
now...!
fields.JP:
うん、大丈夫だ……
それより、アリスの部屋に
行かなくちゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine...
We need to go to Alice's room,
now...!

fields.JP: いったい何があったの、アリスさん！

おつうさん、人魚姫さん……
いえ、その……
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぢぢ……あ゛り゛……ず……
まも…………ぎぎぎるるる……！
ジャック、いったいどうしたんだ！？

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. It's my fault.
I cut my finger from the chipped
cup there...
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい、わたしがいけないんです。
わたしが欠けたカップの縁で
指を切ってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. It's my fault.
I cut my finger from the chipped
cup there...

fields.EN:
Jack then started to go on a
rampage...
fields.JP:
そうしたらジャックが突然
暴れ出してしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack then started to go on a
rampage...

fields.JP: アリスさんが傷を負ったから……？

fields.EN:
I would imagine so. Jack seems to
think that the cup attacked Alice.
fields.JP:
……どうやらそうみたいだね。
アリスがカップに傷つけられたと、
ジャックはそう認識してるみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would imagine so. Jack seems to
think that the cup attacked Alice.

fields.EN:
So he attacked the cup as an
enemy to protect Alice.
fields.JP:
それで『敵』であるカップを
破壊して、アリスを守ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So he attacked the cup as an
enemy to protect Alice.

fields.EN:
I guess Jack-san is really protective
of Alice...
fields.JP:
ちゃんと見守っているんだね、
ジャックさん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess Jack is really protective
of Alice...

fields.EN:
(But Jack hasn't calmed down
a bit...)
fields.JP:
（でもまだジャックの奴、
　興奮したままだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But Jack hasn't calmed down
a bit...)

fields.EN:
(I better tell him everything is
okay now...)
fields.JP:
（早いところ大丈夫だって、
　落ち着けてやらないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better tell him everything is
okay now...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack, it's fine.
No one's going to hurt Alice.
fields.JP:
ジャック、もう大丈夫だ。
アリスを傷つける奴はもういない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, it's fine.
No one's going to hurt Alice.

fields.EN:
See? We're fine...
So just calm down...
fields.JP:
ほら、大丈夫だから……
そうだ、心を落ち着けて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? We're fine...
So just calm down...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

あり……す……ぎぎぎ……
……だい……じょ……ぶぶぶ……？

fields.EN:
Yes she is. Look.
Alice is safe.
fields.JP: ああ、見てごらん、アリスは無事だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes she is. Look.
Alice is safe.

fields.EN:
I'm safe because of you, Jack.
See?
fields.JP:
ほら、あなたのおかげで
わたしは無事よ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm safe because of you, Jack.
See?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

よがっ……だ……
ぐぎぎぎぎ……

（……よかった。
　ようやく落ちついてくれた……）

fields.EN:
Thank you, Otsuu-san...
If you weren't here, things may
not have settled down...
fields.JP:
ありがとう……おつうさん。
あなたが来てくれなかったら、
もしかしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Otsuu...
If you weren't here, things may
not have settled down...

fields.EN:
We just happened to pass by.
Are you hurt elsewhere?
fields.JP:
近くを通りかかった
タイミングでよかったよ。
指先以外に怪我はないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We just happened to pass by.
Are you hurt elsewhere?

fields.JP: ごめんなさい、アリスさん！

fields.EN:
The chipped cup I gave you hurt you,
Alice-san...! If only
I hadn't given it to you!
fields.JP:
わたしが欠けたカップなんて
プレゼントしたせいで、アリスさんに
怪我をさせちゃって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The teacup I gave you hurt you!
If I only didn't give it to you!

fields.EN:
I even ruined your tea party
you had planned for Jack-san...
fields.JP:
その上ジャックさんのために
用意していた大事なお茶会を、
台無しにしてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I even ruined your tea party
you had planned for Jack...

fields.EN:
What's the matter?
You don't look well...
fields.JP:
どうしたの……？
結構苦しそうだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?
You don't look well...

fields.EN:
No, it's just that my head
started hurting a little...
fields.JP: いや、ちょっと頭が痛くなって……

fields.EN:
(It must be from the emotional
rush Jack had earlier that's
only now surging through me...)
fields.JP:
（興奮してたジャックの感情が
　波のように一気に押し寄せたからだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must be from the emotional
rush Jack had earlier that's
only now surging through me...)

fields.EN:
That's must be painful.
Let me take you to Hikari.
fields.JP:
それは大変ね。
ヒカリのところまで連れて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's must be painful.
Let me take you to Hikari.

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Alice-san. I'll take
responsibility for getting Otsuu-chan
back to her room so she can rest.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、アリスさん。
おつうちゃんはわたしが責任もって
部屋に連れてって休ませるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Alice. I'll take her
back to her room to rest.

fields.EN:
I think it's safer to have Jack-san
stay with Otsuu-chan for awhile in case
he gets needlessly excited again.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんもまた興奮した時のために、
おつうちゃんのそばにいた方がいいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's safer to have Jack
stay with Otsuu for awhile in case
he gets needlessly excited again.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぐ……ぎぎ……
わあ゛が……だだだ……

fields.EN:
Then, Alice-san, I'm going now.
I'm really sorry I ruined your tea party...
fields.JP:
じゃあアリスさん、わたし行くね。
お茶会、台無しにしちゃって本当に
ごめんなさい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we'll be going now.
And... I'm really sorry I ruined
your tea party...

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, grab onto my shoulders.
Jack-san? Can you follow me?
fields.JP:
ほらおつうちゃん、
わたしの肩に寄りかかって。
ジャックさんもついてきてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, grab onto my shoulders.
Jack? Can you follow me?

fields.EN:
That unusual to hear Alice
wanting to see us.
fields.JP:
珍しいな、アリスの方から
呼び出してくるのって
fields.LOCALIZED:
That unusual to hear Alice
wanting to see us.

fields.EN:
I think this may actually be the
first time she's asked us to come.
fields.JP:
確かに……もしかしたら
初めてかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think this may actually be the
first time she's asked us to come.

fields.EN:
She did mention to bring Jack
along, too. Maybe she has
something to discuss.
fields.JP:
ジャックを連れてきてとも
言ってたから……何かの相談かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She did mention to bring Jack
along, too. Maybe she has
something to discuss.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

あ゛り゛ず……あ゛り゛ず……
ぐぎぎ……あ゛り゛ずの゛……べや゛……

fields.EN:
Jack-san seems happy about us
going to see Alice-san.
fields.JP:
アリスさんに会えるからだよね、
ジャックさん嬉しそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack seems happy about us
going to see Alice.

fields.EN:
His happy feelings are flowing
through me as I speak.
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックの奴、
すごい喜びの感情で溢れてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
His happy feelings are flowing
through me as I speak.

fields.EN:
Heh, no need to fret.
Alice is beyond the door here.
fields.JP:
はは、慌てなくてもアリスは
このドアの向こうにいるって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, no need to fret.
Alice is beyond the door here.

fields.EN:
It's me, Tsuu.
I'm coming in, Alice.
fields.JP:
僕だ、つうだ。
アリス、入るぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's me, Otsuu.
I'm coming in, Alice.

fields.JP: いらっしゃいおつうさん、人魚姫さん

fields.EN:
I don't have enough teacups,
so I had to improvise a bit.
fields.JP:
まあカップは足りないし、
色々強引に仕上げたものだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have enough teacups,
so I had to improvise a bit.

fields.EN:
Well, I think this is a beautiful
set-up you have here!
fields.JP:
ううん、そんなことない！
とっても素敵なセッティングだと思う！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I think this is a beautiful
set-up you have here!

fields.EN:
(Sure she's using bowls and other
items to cover the lack of cups,
but...)
fields.JP:
（確かにカップ足りなくて
　茶碗とかで代用しちゃってるけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sure she's using bowls and other
items to cover the lack of cups,
but...)

fields.EN:
(That's not what's important.
What's important is that she's
finally holding a tea party.)
fields.JP:
（でも問題はそこじゃない。
　お茶会を開く、それが大事なんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's not what's important.
What's important is that she's
finally holding a tea party.)

fields.EN:
You made it happen yourself,
Alice. That's some impressive initiative.
fields.JP:
自分から叶えたね、アリス。
さすがの行動力だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like your dream came true.
Kudos to getting it all set-up.

fields.JP: ジャックさんも嬉しそう

fields.EN:
Jack, don't you go off like that
before. You don't want to waste
what Alice set-up, do you?
fields.JP:
ジャック、今度は取り乱したりするなよ？
せっかくアリスが準備してくれたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, don't you go off like that
before. You don't want to waste
what Alice set-up, do you?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Okay, I guess we'll make our
leave now.
fields.JP: じゃあ僕たちはこれで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, I guess we'll make our
leave now.

fields.EN:
Let us know how it went,
okay Alice-san?
fields.JP: 後で感想聞かせてね、アリスさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let us know how it went,
okay Alice?

fields.EN:
We brought Jack here like you
wanted. If there's anything else
we can help, let us know.
fields.JP:
ちゃんとジャックは連れてきたし……
まだ何か手伝うことあるなら、するけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We brought Jack here like you
wanted. If there's anything else
we can help, let us know.

fields.EN:
But if we're here, Alice-san, you and Jack-san
can't start your tea party...
fields.JP:
でもわたしたちがいたら、アリスさんは
ジャックさんとお茶会が始められないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, us staying here is only
going to get in the way of you
and Jack's tea party.

fields.EN:
Look at the table. There are places for
you two as well, Otsuu-san, Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP:
ちゃんとテーブルを見て。
おつうさんと人魚姫さんの分もあるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at the set-up.
I have set ready for you and
Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Huh? But wasn't the tea party
supposed to be for you and
Jack?
fields.JP:
えっ、だってお茶会は
アリスとジャックだけの時間じゃあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But wasn't the tea party
supposed to be for you and
Jack?

fields.EN:
I mean, we're more than happy
to join, but are you sure we
won't get in your way?
fields.JP:
誘いは素直に嬉しいけど……
でもいいの？　邪魔にならないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, we're more than happy
to join, but are you sure we
won't get in your way?

fields.EN:
Don't worry.
You're more than welcome to join.
fields.JP:
もう……２人とも気を遣いすぎよ……
邪魔なわけないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry.
You're more than welcome to join.

fields.EN:
I wanted to prepare everything with Jack
and then invite you two... I wanted the
four of us to have a tea party together.
fields.JP:
それにわたしはジャックと一緒に準備して、
そしてあなたたちを呼びたかったのよ？
……４人でお茶会を開きたかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to invite you two after
getting the place set-up with
Jack.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about that, Alice.
It didn't dawn on me that
you were doing this for us.
fields.JP:
ごめん、アリス。
君の思いに気づけなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about that, Alice.
It didn't dawn on me that
you were doing this for us.

fields.EN:
I've wanted to thank you both for a long time,
Otsuu-san and Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
……わたしはね、
おつうさんと人魚姫さんに
ずっとお礼がしたかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to show my thanks
to you two...

fields.EN:
You still don't get it, do you?
That applies to you too,
Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
もう……やっぱり分かってないわね。
人魚姫さんも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You still don't get it, do you?
That applies to you too,
Little Mermaid...

fields.EN:
Huh? But I haven't done anything for you to
thank me for, Alice-san...
fields.JP:
えっ、だってわたし、
アリスさんにお礼言われるようなこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But, I didn't do anything
deserving of thanks from you...

fields.EN:
Otsuu-san, Ningyohime-san, you both saved
Jack and me.
fields.JP:
おつうさんと人魚姫さんは、
わたしとジャックを救ってくれたじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: You both saved me and Jack.

fields.EN:
Sure, Jack may have saved
Ningyohime-san when you fell...
fields.JP:
崖から落ちる時、ジャックは
人魚姫さんを救ったかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, Jack may have saved
Little Mermaid when you fell...

fields.EN:
But, you brought him back without
turning your back on him. Without
you, he wouldn't be here now.
fields.JP:
でもその後ジャックを見捨てずに、
ちゃんとここまで連れてきてくれた。
ジャックだけでは辿り着けなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you brought him back without
turning your back on him. Without
you, he wouldn't be here now.

fields.EN:
Well, it was just the right thing
to do...
fields.JP: それは……当然のことをしただけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it was just the right thing
to do...

fields.EN: You also reunited me with Jack.
fields.JP:
そしてわたしをまた
ジャックに引き合わせてくれた……
fields.LOCALIZED: You also reunited me with Jack.

fields.EN:
I can't begin to tell you
how grateful I am for that...!
fields.JP:
わたしがそのことを
どれだけ感謝しているか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't imagine how much
in debt I am to you...

fields.EN:
I didn't know that...
I'm so sorry I didn't notice...
fields.JP:
そう……思ってくれていたんだね……
なのに、わたしったら気づけなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know that...
I'm so sorry I didn't notice...

fields.EN:
(I also thought that all Alice
needed was Jack.)
fields.JP:
（僕も、心のどこかでアリスは
　ジャックさえいればいいのだと思ってた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I also thought that all Alice
needed was Jack.)

fields.EN:
(But this just shows that Alice
cares about everyone else
as her friend, too.)
fields.JP:
（でも僕たちのことも、
　アリスはしっかり仲間だと
　思ってくれてるんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But this just shows that Alice
cares about everyone else
as her friend, too.)

fields.EN:
Sorry we didn't take notice
earlier.
fields.JP:
アリスの感謝の気持ちに
気づけなくてごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry we didn't take notice
earlier.

fields.EN:
Yes, and that's why you didn't
need to apologize to me when
I got hurt, Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP:
この間カップで怪我した時のことだって、
人魚姫さんが謝る必要はなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and that's why you didn't
need to apologize to me when
I got hurt, Little Mermaid.

fields.EN:
And even so... you've always
been so considerate toward me...
fields.JP:
なのにずっと……
いつもわたしに気を遣ってくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you keep worrying about me,
and put me ahead of yourself...

fields.EN:
Of course, Jack is precious to me,
but everyone here is precious
to me, too.
fields.JP:
わたしはジャックのことを大切に思ってる。
でもみんなのことも同じように大切なの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, Jack is precious to me,
but everyone here is precious
to me, too.

fields.EN: So... shall we have a tea party together?
fields.JP: だから、一緒にお茶会しましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now do you see why I want
to have a tea party with you?

fields.JP:
（そうだ、僕たちが勝手に
　アリスという子を誤解してたんだ）

fields.EN:
(She's way more caring than we
thought she was.)
fields.JP:
（こんなにも
　優しい子だっていうのに……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's way more caring than we
thought she was.)

fields.EN:
We would be honored to join
your tea party, Alice.
fields.JP: ぜひ同席させてくれ、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
We would be honored to join
your tea party, Alice.

fields.EN:
No need to be reserved any more,
you hear?
fields.JP: ……もう遠慮なんてしては駄目よ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to be reserved any more,
you hear?

fields.EN:
Yes. I won't hold back strangely
anymore. So let's enjoy the tea
party for as long as time allows.
fields.JP:
ああ。もう変な遠慮とかはしない。
だから時間の許す限り、お茶会を楽しもう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, understood.
Now then, let's enjoy your tea
party to its fullest, shall we?

fields.EN:
(Today's mock battle was rough... Honestly,
Hameln really doesn't show any mercy...)
fields.JP:
（今日の模擬戦闘はきつかった……
　まったく、ハーメルンの奴ってば
　容赦ないもんな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The mock battle today was
intense... Hameln needs to learn
to control herself...)

fields.EN:
(Ouch... I need to get a poultice from
Hikari, or tomorrow is going to be scary...)
fields.JP:
（いたたた……ヒカリに湿布
　もらわないと明日が怖いな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ouch... I better get myself
patched up with Hikari. No telling
what would happen next...)

fields.JP:
（……ん？
　あれはアリスと……ジャック？）

fields.EN:
Say, Jack? You understand what
I'm saying, right?
fields.JP:
ねえジャックは……わたしの言葉、
分かってくれてるのよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack? You understand what
I'm saying, right?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I thought so. You wouldn't be
here with me if you didn't
understand me.
fields.JP:
ええ、分かってる。何も通じてなかったら、
こんなに一緒にいるなんてできないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought so. You wouldn't be
here with me if you didn't
understand me.

fields.EN:
I'm just happy we can communicate.
It's really nothing short of a
miracle...
fields.JP:
そう、それだけでも奇跡……
本当に嬉しいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just happy we can communicate.
It's really nothing short of a
miracle...

fields.EN:
But, I was hesitant at first...
I wasn't sure you'd understand me
now that you're like that...
fields.JP:
……でもね、実は初めは不安だったの。
ジャックがこのような姿になって……
わたしを分かってくれるかな、って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I was hesitant at first...
I wasn't sure you'd understand me
now that you're like that...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I also didn't know Otsuu-san and
Ningyohime-san well...
fields.JP:
それにおつうさんや人魚姫さんも、
どんな人か分からなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also didn't know Otsuu and
Little Mermaid well...

fields.EN:
So, I was anxious the whole
time here...
fields.JP: だからずっと不安だったの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I was anxious the whole
time here...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. I just happened by
when I overheard you.
fields.JP:
ごめん、たまたま通りかかったら
アリスの言葉が聞こえてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I just happened by
when I overheard you.

fields.EN:
I want you to be candid...
Are you still anxious?
fields.JP:
……正直に話してほしい。
アリスは今も……不安かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to be candid...
Are you still anxious?

fields.EN:
At first, yes... I was even scared
of possibly being treated badly.
fields.JP:
……最初は、言ったとおり不安だったわ。
もしかしてまた酷い扱いを受けるかもって、
勝手に怯えたりもした
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first, yes... I was even scared
of possibly being treated badly.

fields.EN:
After spending all this time with Otsuu-san,
Ningyohime-san, and everyone else, I know
how kind you all are.
fields.JP:
でも、今日までずっと過ごしてきて、
おつうさんや人魚姫さん、他のみなさん……
みんな優しいんだって分かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But after all the time we spent
together, I know for a fact that
everyone here is very kind.

fields.EN:
So if anything, I appreciate
you all being here with me.
fields.JP: だから、今はむしろ感謝しているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if anything, I appreciate
you all being here with me.

fields.EN:
I see...
Well, that's good to hear.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Well, that's good to hear.

fields.JP: 昔も今もそうなのだけど……

fields.EN:
I sometimes lose track of myself
with how I keep thinking of Jack.
fields.JP:
わたしの中でジャックという存在は
とても大きくて、それだからこそ周りが
見えなくなる時がたまにあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sometimes lose track of myself
with how I keep thinking of Jack.

fields.JP: うん……それは充分理解しているよ

fields.EN:
I would often get out of control
when matters concerning Jack
arose.
fields.JP:
以前はジャックのことになると
すぐに自分を見失っていたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would often get out of control
when matters concerning Jack
arose.

fields.EN:
But now you're here, Otsuu-san, along with
Ningyohime-san, who protected Jack...
fields.JP:
でも今は、ジャックを守ってくれた
おつうさんや人魚姫さんがいる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you and Little Mermaid
protected Jack and are here with
us now...

fields.EN:
So even when something happens with
Jack, I can look at it a little more
calmly and objectively than before...
fields.JP:
だから、ジャックのことで何かあっても、
以前より少し冷静で客観的に見られるように
なったの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think that's why I can control
myself better since I know Jack
is in safe hands...

fields.EN:
Jack is still the most important
person to me, but that also goes
to everyone here.
fields.JP:
もちろん、今もジャックが一番大切。
でも、みんなのこともとても大切なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is still the most important
person to me, but that also goes
to everyone here.

fields.EN:
Well, thanks for placing trust in
us, Alice.
fields.JP:
そうか……
信頼してくれてありがとう、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, thanks for placing trust in
us, Alice.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I-I know you don't have any bad intentions,
Otsuu-san, but...
fields.JP:
お、おつうさんはそんなことないって
分かってはいるのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I know you don't have any bad
intentions, but...

fields.EN:
Um, I sometimes... get jealous of
you, seeing how you can
communicate with Jack.
fields.JP:
その、ジャックと意思疎通ができることに、
たまに、嫉妬しちゃうの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I sometimes... get jealous of
you, seeing how you can
communicate with Jack.

fields.EN:
Jack is a very dependable and
cool guy, but the person I love
is someone else, so don't worry.
fields.JP:
ジャックはとても頼りになるし
格好いい男の子だけど、僕の想い人は
別にいるから安心して
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is a gentleman well deserving
of you. I have another person of
destiny, so don't you worry.

fields.EN:
Oh, I see...
That's good to hear...
fields.JP: そ、そうなのね……よかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see...
That's good to hear...

fields.EN:
You do know that the only person
Jack has his sights on now is
you, right?
fields.JP:
それに、ジャックはアリスのことしか
見えてないよ。それくらいは分かるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do know that the only person
Jack has his sights on now is
you, right?

fields.EN:
So it really is like that...?
Is it okay for me to think that way...?
fields.JP:

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: I knew you'd like it, Jack.
fields.JP:
あなたもよさをわかってくれるのね、
ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: I knew you'd like it, Jack.

fields.EN:
Well, that table looks very
fancy with the tablecloth
draped on it.
fields.JP:
へぇ、テーブルクロスをかけるだけで
だいぶ雰囲気が変わるんだね。ただの
テーブルがいつもよりオシャレに見えるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that table looks very
fancy with the tablecloth
draped on it.

fields.EN:
I like how the fold along the
edges are detailed...
fields.JP: この端っこの布の折り方とか凝ってるよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like how the fold along the
edges are detailed...

fields.EN:
I'm trying to place it perfectly
on the table, so I'd appreciate it
if you don't touch it yet.
fields.JP:
そのテーブルクロスはミリ単位で
計算しつくして整えている最中なの。
まだ完成していないから、今は触らないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm trying to place it perfectly
on the table, so I'd appreciate it
if you don't touch it yet.

fields.EN:
(Perfectly, eh? No wonder she
looked busy.)
fields.JP:
（ミリ単位……。
　さっき真剣な顔してたのは、
　そういうわけだったのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Perfectly, eh? No wonder she
looked busy.)

fields.EN:
It's fun thinking of how you want
decorate the table. A tablecloth
can make a big difference.
fields.JP:
テーブルクロスはかけ方を変えるだけでも
違う雰囲気になるから、どういう風に
かけようか考えるのも楽しいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fun thinking of how you want
decorate the table. A tablecloth
can make a big difference.

fields.EN:
One day I'll hold a wonderful tea
party, with everyone sitting
around a large table.
fields.JP:
わたしね、大勢でテーブルを囲むような、
素敵なお茶会パーティを開くのが夢なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
One day I'll hold a wonderful tea
party, with everyone sitting
around a large table.

fields.EN:
I can't wait to get a chance to
set up the table, tea set, and the
decorations to match...
fields.JP:
大きなテーブルに、素敵なティーセット……。
ああ、楽しみだわ。テーブルのセッティングも
どんな風にしようか今から迷っちゃうわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't wait to get a chance to
set up the table, tea set, and the
decorations to match...

fields.EN:
(She looks really happy. It's
almost like seeing a girl getting
dressed for her first date.)
fields.JP:
（本当に楽しみにしてるんだなぁ。
　なんだか初デートの服を選ぶ女の子みたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks really happy. It's
almost like seeing a girl getting
dressed for her first date.)

fields.EN:
I'm sure your tea party will be
wonderful, since you're spending
the time now to plan ahead.
fields.JP:
今のうちにたくさん迷っておけば、
本番もきっと上手にできるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure your tea party will be
wonderful, since you're spending
the time now to plan ahead.

fields.EN:
Thank you. When I hold a tea party someday,
I'll invite you, Otsuu-san, Jack, and everyone
else, of course.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。いつかお茶会パーティを
開くときは、おつうさんとジャックも、
他のみんなも、もちろん招待するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. And, when I do hold
the tea part, you, Jack, and
everyone will be my guest.

fields.EN:
Sounds like a plan.
I bet it'd be fun with the whole
crew around.
fields.JP:
すごく賑やかになりそうだね。
みんなでわいわいやれたら楽しいだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like a plan.
I bet it'd be fun with the whole
crew around.

fields.EN:
Oh, I would also have to prepare
some sweets to match the tea.
fields.JP:
お茶会パーティにはおいしいお菓子も
用意したいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I would also have to prepare
some sweets to match the tea.

fields.EN:
A fair warning... If you do
prepare sweets, be careful of
Gretel... She'd eat them all up.
fields.JP:
そのときはグレーテルにお菓子を
全部食べられちゃわないように、
気をつけないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
A fair warning... If you do
prepare sweets, be careful of
Gretel... She'd eat them all up.

fields.EN:
Heh, you're right. Of course,
all I would need to do is make
more than everyone's fair share.
fields.JP:
ふふ、そうね。できればお茶もお菓子も、
みんなが満足できるくらい用意できれば
一番いいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, you're right. Of course,
all I would need to do is make
more than everyone's fair share.

fields.EN:
When the day comes for the tea
party, I'm sure gathering things
will be much easier than now.
fields.JP:
でもお茶会パーティを開けるころには、
今と違って、きっとなんでも
揃えられるでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
When the day comes for the tea
party, I'm sure gathering things
will be much easier than now.

fields.EN:
(I never thought that old fabric
would be a tablecloth that
would make Alice this happy.)
fields.JP:
（アリスが嬉しそうでよかった。
　ただの古い布だと思ってたけど、
　テーブルクロスの力は侮れないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I never thought that old fabric
would be a tablecloth that
would make Alice this happy.)

fields.EN:
This tablecloth put me one step
closer to attaining my dream.
Thank you...
fields.JP:
このテーブルクロスをもらったおかげで
夢が広がったわ。二人とも、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This tablecloth put me one step
closer to attaining my dream.
Thank you...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Glad you like it. I'll be looking
forward to the day I receive
your invitation to your tea part.
fields.JP:
喜んでもらえてよかった。
いつかみんなとのお茶会パーティに
招待してくれるの、楽しみにしてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad you like it. I'll be looking
forward to the day I receive
your invitation to your tea part.

fields.JP: （そういえば、この辺りで前に……）

fields.EN:
This is where I entered Blood
Skelter, right?
fields.JP:
……わたし、前にこの辺りで
ブラッドスケルター化しちゃったよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is where I entered Blood
Skelter, right?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about the trouble
I caused you then...
fields.JP:
あのときはごめんね。
いっぱい迷惑かけて、
いっぱい心配かけちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about the trouble
I caused you then...

fields.EN:
As long as you're okay, Princess.
Sure I was worried, but you
didn't cause me any trouble.
fields.JP:
姫が無事ならいいんだ。
それに心配はしたけど、
迷惑だなんて少しも思ってないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you're okay, Princess.
Sure I was worried, but you
didn't cause me any trouble.

fields.EN:
So you don't have to force
yourself to remember what
happened here...
fields.JP: ……だから、無理に思い出さなくていい
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you don't have to force
yourself to remember what
happened here...

fields.EN:
Okay... But, it is something that
happened, so I need to accept
what happened...
fields.JP:
うん……。でも自分のことなんだから、
ちゃんと向き合わないといけないかなって
思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... But, it is something that
happened, so I need to accept
what happened...

fields.EN:
To be honest, I was about to
enter Blood Skelter long ago
before then...
fields.JP:
実はね、もっと前にも
ブラッドスケルター化しそうに
なったことがあったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, I was about to
enter Blood Skelter long ago
before then...

fields.JP: え……っ？　そ、そんなの初耳だけど

fields.EN:
It happened so long ago that
I only remembered it when my
Blood Skelter triggered my memory.
fields.JP:
初めてブラッドスケルター化しちゃって、
その感覚でふと思い出したの。
それに、もうだいぶ前のことだったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
It happened so long ago that
I only remembered it when my
Blood Skelter triggered my memory.

fields.EN:
Not that I remember the exact
details, but I think it was before
I met you, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
わたしもはっきりと覚えてる
わけじゃないんだけど、
おつうちゃんと出会う前……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that I remember the exact
details, but I think it was before
I met you, Otsuu...

fields.EN:
Back then I was scared and unsure
of the future. It felt similar to
when I enter Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
あのころは心が不安定で、怖くて、
不安でいっぱいだった。ブラッドスケルター化
したときの心の感覚にすごく近かったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Back then I was scared and unsure
of the future. It felt similar to
when I enter Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
Maybe that's because I was
about to enter Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
あのころは気づかなかったけど、
今思えばブラッドスケルター化
しそうになっていたのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that's because I was
about to enter Blood Skelter...

fields.EN: But you've been fine all this time, right...?
fields.JP:
でも、これまではずっと
大丈夫だったんだよね……？

fields.EN:
Yup. I've never felt that way
since I've met you, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
うん。おつうちゃんと出会ってからは、
あんな風になることはなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I've never felt that way
since I've met you, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
It's probably because you're supporting my
heart, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
きっとおつうちゃんがわたしの心を
支えてくれてるからだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's probably because your
existence helps to keep my
mind at ease.

fields.EN:
Not only that, but you always
protect me too, just like how
you did this time.
fields.JP:
心だけじゃないよ。
いつもわたしのこと守ってくれて、ありがとう。
今回も守ってくれたもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only that, but you always
protect me too, just like how
you did this time.

fields.EN:
It's only natural that I protect
you, Princess.
fields.JP: 僕が姫をお守りするのは当然のことですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's only natural that I protect
you, Princess.

fields.EN:
(Hearing her words is triggering
my memory, too. Maybe...)
fields.JP:
（……だけど、今の姫の話を聞いて
　思い出した。もしかしたら僕も……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hearing her words is triggering
my memory, too. Maybe...)

fields.EN:
Hm? Otsuu-chan?
What's with that face?
fields.JP:
？　おつうちゃん、
なにか難しいこと考えてる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Otsuu?
What's with that face?

fields.EN:
Oh, um... I was just thinking that
maybe I was about to enter
Blood Skelter long ago, too.
fields.JP:
ああ、いや……。ひょっとしたら僕も、
すごく、昔……ブラッドスケルター化しそう
だった危機はあったのかもって思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... I was just thinking that
maybe I was about to enter
Blood Skelter long ago, too.

fields.EN:
There was a time back then that
reminds me of what it's like
to enter Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
なんとなく、思い当たるような
心境だったときがあった気がして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There was a time back then that
reminds me of what it's like
to enter Blood Skelter...

fields.JP: そ、そうだったの？　今は？　今は大丈夫？

fields.EN:
I'm fine. I do have you beside me,
after all.
fields.JP: 大丈夫だよ。僕には姫がいたからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. I do have you beside me,
after all.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you will help me in
some way if I ever enter Blood
Skelter.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化しそうになっても、
きっとそのときは姫に助けられたんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you will help me in
some way if I ever enter Blood
Skelter.

fields.EN:
(Princess made me who I am
now... Because of her, I'm...)
fields.JP:
（そう。姫が僕の心を
　繋ぎとめてくれていたんだ。
　姫がいてくれたから、僕は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Princess made me who I am
now... Because of her, I'm...)

fields.EN:
Thanks for being with me
back then...
fields.JP: あのとき、一緒にいてくれてありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for being with me
back then...

fields.EN:
(Wait... Back when?
I don't recall anything from back
then...)
fields.JP:
（あのときって、いつだ？
　自然と言葉が出てきたけど、
　思い出そうとしても思い出せない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... Back when?
I don't recall anything from back
then...)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. Let me rephrase myself.
Thanks for being with me all
the time, Princess.
fields.JP:
ごめん、間違えた。
あのときじゃなく、いつもだったね。
姫がいてくれるのは
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. Let me rephrase myself.
Thanks for being with me all
the time, Princess.

fields.EN:
I'll always stay with you, Otsuu-chan.
I promise.
fields.JP:
わたしはずっとおつうちゃんと
一緒にいるよ。約束するね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know that I will always be
with you. It's a promise.

fields.JP: むぅ。なーんか陰気臭い場所だな
うん、ちょっと不気味だね……

fields.EN:
Don't you worry, Princess.
Just stay by my side and all
will be fine.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、姫。
でも僕から離れないようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry, Princess.
Just stay by my side and all
will be fine.

fields.EN:
Oho! It's been a while since
I saw someone pass by!
fields.JP: おっ、人が通るなんて久しぶりっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! It's been a while since
I saw someone pass by!

fields.EN: C'mon, you can put your arms down.
fields.JP: やだなー、そんな警戒しないでほしいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: C'mon, you can put your arms down.

fields.EN:
And, she's got a heck of a load
on her back...
fields.JP:
やたらとでかい荷物を持ってるな。
変な奴だぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, she's got a heck of a load
on her back...

fields.EN:
Are you, by any chance,
a survivor? We need to take you
to safety then.
fields.JP:
こんなところに一人でいるなんて、
まさか生き残りか？
すぐに保護しないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you, by any chance,
a survivor? We need to take you
to safety then.

fields.EN:
Now hold on a second there!
No need to worry. I'm not a
survivor or lost or anything.
fields.JP:
ちょーっと待つっす！
自分は生き残りでも迷子でもないっすから、
保護する必要はないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now hold on a second there!
No need to worry. I'm not a
survivor or lost or anything.

fields.EN:
The name's Clara!
I'm just a traveling merchant
roving about the prison area!
fields.JP:
自分はくらら！
独房エリアを転々とする、
さすらいの放浪商人っす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The name's Clara!
I'm just a traveling merchant
roving about the prison area!

fields.EN:
We're going to have to take
you with us by force, then.
fields.JP: よし、保護しよう。無理やりにでも
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to have to take
you with us by force, then.

fields.JP: 捕まえるなら任せておけ！

fields.EN:
Hey! Didn't ya hear me?!
Nobody's forcing me anywhere!
That's what we call an abduction!
fields.JP:
ちょっと人の話聞いてたっすかー！？
無理やり保護って、それただの誘拐っすよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Didn't ya hear me?!
Nobody's forcing me anywhere!
That's what we call an abduction!

fields.EN:
But there's no way you could
travel the prison area at your
age...
fields.JP:
だって信じられないよ。
こんな小さい子なのに、独房エリアを
転々とする放浪商人とか言われても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there's no way you could
travel the prison area at your
age...

fields.EN:
Maybe she bonked her head
and is confused now.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら頭でも打って、
精神が錯乱しちゃってるのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she bonked her head
and is confused now.

fields.EN:
Stop looking at me like that.
I'm a full fledged traveling
merchant, living life on the road.
fields.JP:
そんな憐れみの目で見ないでほしいっす。
こう見えても、自分は放浪商人として
しっかり自立した生活してるっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop looking at me like that.
I'm a full fledged traveling
merchant, living life on the road.

fields.EN:
So, what's this about you being
a traveling merchant?
fields.JP: なぁ、その、ほーろー商人とはなんなのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what's this about you being
a traveling merchant?

fields.EN:
Heh heh, glad you asked!
I make a living selling loot that
I find in the prison area.
fields.JP:
ふふ、よくぞ聞いてくれたっす！
自分は独房エリアで拾った素敵アイテムや
ガラクタを売って生業にしてるんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, glad you asked!
I make a living selling loot that
I find in the prison area.

fields.EN:
You'd be surprised with the kind of
goodies you can find! Not a bad
business, really.
fields.JP:
探せばけっこうなお宝も落ちてるんで、
案外、悪い商売じゃないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'd be surprised with the kind of
goodies you can find! Not a bad
business, really.

fields.EN:
Well duh... But, it's not like
I got a choice.
fields.JP:
危ないっちゃ危ないっすね。
でも他に生きる術もないし、仕方ないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well duh... But, it's not like
I got a choice.

fields.EN:
Then again, I can run fast,
and I got great mojo,
so I'm doing just fine.
fields.JP:
まぁ、逃げ足の速さと運の強さには
自信あるんで、大丈夫っす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, I can run fast,
and I got great mojo,
so I'm doing just fine.

fields.EN:
But it's still tough living on
your own. You should really
come with us...
fields.JP:
だけどやっぱり、一人で生活する
なんて大変じゃない？
わたしたちと一緒に来たほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's still tough living on
your own. You should really
come with us...

fields.EN:
Nah, this is just how I live.
I'm not the type to get myself
corralled with the others.
fields.JP:
いやー、自分は一人で好きに
やってるほうが性に合ってるっすよ。
集団生活には向かないんっすよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nah, this is just how I live.
I'm not the type to get myself
corralled with the others.

fields.EN:
But, I appreciate the thought.
It's good to know there are caring
people out in this dank world.
fields.JP:
でも、心配してくれてありがとうっす。
殺伐とした暮らしをしてるんで、
人情が身に染みるっすねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I appreciate the thought.
It's good to know there are caring
people out in this dank world.

fields.EN: So, what are you selling now?
fields.JP: それで、どんなものを売っているのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what are you selling now?

fields.EN:
Yikes, um... I'm all out today.
Maybe next time. I usually got a
ton of stuff to choose from.
fields.JP:
あー、今日はもう売り物がないんっすよ。
でもなにかご入り用のときは言って
くださいっす。たいていの物は揃えるっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yikes, um... I'm all out today.
Maybe next time. I usually got a
ton of stuff to choose from.

fields.EN:
Great to have met you folks,
and good luck to ya!
fields.JP: ではでは、今後ともご贔屓くださいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great to have met you folks,
and good luck to ya!

fields.EN:
She sure is bold despite her
young age! A true professional!
fields.JP:
幼いのになかなか肝が据わった奴だったな！
あれぞプロの商売人だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She sure is bold despite her
young age! A true professional!

fields.EN:
It's still dangerous for her to
wander around the prison area
by herself...
fields.JP:
だけど、独房エリアを一人で
うろつくなんて危険だなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's still dangerous for her to
wander around the prison area
by herself...

fields.EN:
Then again, she seems to be
doing fine, so maybe we will
see her again.
fields.JP:
そんなことをして生き残れてるなんて、
すごい子だね。また会えるかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, she seems to be
doing fine, so maybe we will
see her again.

fields.EN:
I have a feeling we'll see her
more often than not...
fields.JP:
なんとなく、これからちょいちょい
会うことになる気がするな。
……なんとなくだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a feeling we'll see her
more often than not...

fields.EN:
Mamoru! There you go again!
What were you going to do if
something happened?!
fields.JP:
もう！　マモルはいつも勝手なことして！
何かあったらどうするの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru! There you go again!
What were you going to do if
something happened?!

fields.EN:
My job is to find out what's
happening, you know?
fields.JP:
その何かあるかどうかを
確かめるのが俺の仕事だろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My job is to find out what's
happening, you know?

fields.EN:
C'mon, cut me some slack, will
you? All is well that ends well.
fields.JP:
何もなかったんだからいいじゃねぇか。
本日も異常なしってわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, cut me some slack, will
you? All is well that ends well.

fields.EN:
Oh no you don't!
You shouldn't be stepping outside
by yourself! It's dangerous!
fields.JP:
そういうことを言ってるんじゃないの！
一人で外に出るなんて危ないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no you don't!
You shouldn't be stepping outside
by yourself! It's dangerous!

fields.EN:
Isn't that... Mamoru and Hikari?
They look like they're arguing...
fields.JP:
あれって……マモルとヒカリか。
なにを言い争ってるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't that... Mamoru and Hikari?
They look like they're arguing...

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what they're arguing
about, but we should stop them!
fields.JP:
分からないけど、
ケンカしてるなら止めないと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what they're arguing
about, but we should stop them!
