fields.EN:
I don't know what's going on,
but please stop with the fighting!
fields.JP:
何があったのかは知らないけど、
喧嘩はやめてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what's going on,
but please stop with the fighting!

fields.JP: ああん？　ケンカだと？
二人はケンカしてたんじゃないのか？

fields.EN: Huh? What made you think that?!
fields.JP: ええっ！？　し、してないよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What made you think that?!

fields.JP: でも、さっきまで言い争いを……
あれは別にケンカしてたわけじゃねぇよ

fields.EN: Um, did I jump the gun?
fields.JP: じゃあ、わたしの勘違い……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, did I jump the gun?

fields.EN:
Sorry. It looks like we scared
you there. But don't worry. We're
always like this.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、心配させちゃったみたい。
でも、私たちいつもこんな感じだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. It looks like we scared
you there. But don't worry. We're
always like this.

fields.EN:
I guess it just means you two know
each other too well... So, how
long have you known each other?
fields.JP:
なるほど。気の置けない間柄というわけだ。
ずいぶん長い付き合いみたいだけど、
どれくらいなんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it just means you two know
each other too well... So, how
long have you known each other?

fields.EN:
How long? I dunno... It's been
ever since we were little.
fields.JP:
どれくらいって言われてもな……
もうずっと小さいころからの付き合いだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
How long? I dunno... It's been
ever since we were little.

fields.EN:
Yeah...
By the time we knew it, we were
hanging around each other.
fields.JP:
そうだねー。
物心ついたころにはもう一緒にいたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah...
By the time we knew it, we were
hanging around each other.

fields.EN: We used to live close by, too.
fields.LOCALIZED: We used to live close by, too.

fields.EN:
We lived our lives together ever
since our parents were abducted
by the Marchens.
fields.JP:
それで、両親がメルヒェンに攫われた後も、
ずっと二人で力を合わせて
生きてきたんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We lived our lives together ever
since our parents were abducted
by the Marchens.

fields.EN:
Uh, but I didn't have much trouble
living since Mamoru was in
charge of the food.
fields.JP:
あ、でも、マモルがいたから食べ物で
苦労したことはあまりなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but I didn't have much trouble
living since Mamoru was in
charge of the food.

fields.EN:
He's got a knack of finding food,
for better and for worse...
fields.JP:
マモルって食べ物のこととなると、
ものすごい力を発揮するから
良い意味でも悪い意味でも
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's got a knack of finding food,
for better and for worse...

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: 良い意味でも悪い意味でも？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Uh... Sometimes he'd steal veggies
from someone's crop...
fields.JP: えっと、畑から野菜盗んできたり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Sometimes he'd steal veggies
from someone's crop...

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Only sometimes!
I paid back my dues then with
hard labor!
fields.JP:
た、たまにだよ！
その分、ちゃんと力仕事で返したぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Only sometimes!
I paid back my dues then with
hard labor!

fields.EN:
Unbelievable...
I guess you haven't changed much
since you were a kid.
fields.JP:
やれやれ……
君は子供の頃からあまり変わらないようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable...
I guess you haven't changed much
since you were a kid.

fields.EN:
That said, I was only able to
survive because Mamoru made
sure there was food on the table.
fields.JP:
でも、そうやってマモルが食べ物を持って
きてくれたから、私は生きてこられたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I was only able to
survive because Mamoru made
sure there was food on the table.

fields.EN:
To add, I ate the food he took,
so that makes me his cohort
in crime.
fields.JP: それに私も食べてるから同罪だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, I ate the food he took,
so that makes me his cohort
in crime.

fields.EN:
Hikari's a weird one...
She's gullible, and cries a lot.
fields.JP:
ヒカリはガキの頃からどっか抜けてんだよ
お人好しだし、すぐ泣くし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikari's a weird one...
She's gullible, and cries a lot.

fields.EN:
That's why I have to stay next
to her, so that I can protect her
from her own actions.
fields.JP:
ほっとくのも危なっかしいからよ、
俺がいつでも側にいて守ってやるって
そう決めてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I have to stay next
to her, so that I can protect her
from her own actions.

fields.EN:
I see why you two get along so
well now.
fields.JP: そっか……素敵な幼馴染みなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see why you two get along so
well now.

fields.EN:
That would mean Hikari is
Mamoru's princess.
fields.JP:
なるほど、ヒカリはマモルにとっての
お姫様というわけか
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would mean Hikari is
Mamoru's princess.

fields.JP: べ、別にそんなんじゃねぇよ！

fields.EN:
She's no princess, that's for
sure. Back when were kids, we
took a bath together and she...
fields.JP:
それに、こいつは姫っていうガラじゃねぇし。
小さい頃も風呂に一緒に入ってる時に、
こいつがドジったことがあってな――
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's no princess, that's for
sure. Back when were kids, we
took a bath together and she...

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Don't try to tell Otsuu-kun and the
others something like that! You idiot!
fields.JP:
ちょっ！？　そんなこと、
おつうくん達に話そうとするなー！
このバカー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! What in the world are
you saying! Stop it, dummy!

fields.EN: Ouch! What the hell is that for?!
fields.JP: 痛ぇ！？　なにしやがる！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ouch! What the hell is that for?!

fields.EN:
You should really listen to what
you're saying! You dummy!
fields.JP:
マモルが変な事言おうとするからでしょ！？
バカバカバカーっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should really listen to what
you're saying! You dummy!

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Stop! Ouch!
Now put that down...!
I'm gonna die!
fields.JP:
こら、やめろ！　いだっ！？
つーか、それはマズいだろ！？
本気で死ぬ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Stop! Ouch!
Now put that down...!
I'm gonna die!

fields.EN:
I thought you appreciated me being
around?!
fields.JP: おまえ俺に感謝してたんじゃないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought you appreciated me being
around?!

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean you can
blab about our past like that!
fields.JP: それとこれとは話が別ですー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean you can
blab about our past like that!

fields.EN: They really do go well together.
fields.JP: 二人はとっても仲良しなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: They really do go well together.

fields.EN:
They may fight a lot, but I guess
that proves they're that close to
each other.
fields.JP:
ケンカするほど……って言うけど、
なるほど、こういう間柄のことを言うんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
They may fight a lot, but I guess
that proves they're that close to
each other.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Hm? What's that in your hand,
Jack?
fields.JP: あれ。ジャック、なにを持ってるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What's that in your hand,
Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
A square wooden case with
tools inside? What's this for?
fields.JP:
……ふーむ。四角い木製ケースの中に、
細かい道具がたくさん入ってるな。
なにに使うんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A square wooden case with
tools inside? What's this for?

fields.EN:
It's pretty old, too...
If it was clean then we could've
given just the case to Princess.
fields.JP:
しかもすごいボロボロだし。
もう少しきれいなら、ケースだけでも
姫へのお土産にできたんだけどなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's pretty old, too...
If it was clean then we could've
given just the case to Princess.

fields.EN:
Well, not that we can use it.
Jack, do you mind putting it back
where you found it?
fields.JP:
まぁ、なんにせよ僕達には必要ないものか。
ジャック、落ちてた場所に戻しておいてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, not that we can use it.
Jack, do you mind putting it back
where you found it?

fields.EN:
Oh, Hameln, what's with that
look on your face?
fields.JP:
あ、ハーメルン。
そんな顔して、どうかしたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Hameln, what's with that
look on your face?

fields.EN:
W-Wait... Is that... a set of
manga drawing pens...?
fields.JP:
そ、それは……っ、
マンガ描きセットではないか……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait... Is that... a set of
manga drawing pens...?

fields.JP: え、これ？　このボロボロのやつ？

fields.EN:
I'm sure that's the holy grail of
manga drawing... A set of special
pens. Where did you...?!
fields.JP:
そうだ。それは聖なる書物・マンガを
描くための道具一式のセットだ。
いったいそれをどうしたのだ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure that's the holy grail of
manga drawing... A set of special
pens. Where did you...?!

fields.EN:
Oh, I found it near here.
Um, you want this?
fields.JP:
この近くに落ちてたんだ。
……えーと、欲しいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I found it near here.
Um, you want this?

fields.EN:
O-Okay...
Jack, do you mind handling it
to Hameln?
fields.JP:
わ、わかったよ。
ジャック、それをハーメルンに渡してあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Okay...
Jack, do you mind handling it
to Hameln?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
おおっ、ありがとう！　ありがとう！！

fields.EN:
Of course I am! I can finally draw
manga with this! What kind of
masterpiece will be born?!
fields.JP:
当たり前だ！　これさえあれば、
ワレにもマンガが描けるのだ！
ああっ、どんな名作が生まれるのだろう！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I am! I can finally draw
manga with this! What kind of
masterpiece will be born?!

fields.EN:
Otsuu! Jack! Thank you fyor
giving theym to me! I will show
you my manga as soon as I'm donye!
fields.JP:
おつう、ジャック、これをゆじゅってくれて
ありがとう！　礼に、ワレがマンガを描いたら
真っ先に見しぇてやるからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Jack! Thank you fyor
giving theym to me! I will show
you my manga as soon as I'm donye!

fields.EN:
Urrh...! I can already feel my
creativity bubbling from inside
me!
fields.JP:
ぬおおおおっ、さっそく
そーさく意欲が燃えてきたぞおおぉ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh...! I can already feel my
creativity bubbling from inside
me!

fields.JP: ひゃっほおおおおおぉっ！！

fields.EN:
I didn't expect her to be that
happy...
fields.JP:
……あんなに喜んでもらえるとは
思わなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect her to be that
happy...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I didn't know she had that side
to her. I can't wait to see what
she'll create.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンにあんな一面があるなんて
意外だったなぁ。どんなマンガを見せて
くれるのか楽しみにしていようっと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know she had that side
to her. I can't wait to see what
she'll create.

fields.EN:
Please... Please...
Is anyone there? H-Help...
fields.JP:
誰かー……誰かいーなーいーのー……
ああ……助け……て……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please... Please...
Is anyone there? H-Help...

fields.JP:
タクミ大丈夫か……
って、なんだこれは……！？
機械の部品がいっぱい……

fields.EN:
Is that you, Otsuu-chan?
Ningyo-chan? P-Please... help...
fields.JP:
その声はおつうちゃんに人魚ちゃん……？
お願い、助けてぇ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that you, Otsuu? Little
Mermaid? P-Please... help...

fields.EN:
Wait a minute... Don't tell me
you're buried under these parts?!
fields.JP:
助けてって……まさか、
この部品の山の下敷きになってるのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute... Don't tell me
you're buried under these parts?!

fields.EN:
Y-Yes...
I can't get them off...
fields.JP:
そうなのよー
重くて仕方ないのよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes...
I can't get them off...

fields.EN:
Oh no! We need to hurry
and get him out of there!
fields.JP: 大変！　急いで助けないと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no! We need to hurry
and get him out of there!

fields.EN:
Whew, I thought I was going
to die. Thanks, both of you.
fields.JP:
いやー、死ぬかと思った
ありがとねー二人とも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... I thought I was a goner.
Thanks!

fields.EN:
You're very welcome.
I'm just glad you weren't hurt.
fields.JP:
どういたしまして。
怪我がなくてよかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're very welcome.
I'm just glad you weren't hurt.

fields.EN: Yes... and, you owe us one.
fields.JP: まったく……貸し一つだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... and, you owe us one.

fields.EN:
So, how'd you get under there
anyway?
fields.JP: で、なんであんなところに埋まってたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how'd you get under there
anyway?

fields.EN:
Ya see, I was dismantling a train,
and the pile of parts I took apart
sort of fell on top of me.
fields.JP:
いやさいやさ、電車一機を分解してて
部品をそのまま周りに積んでたら、
そのうち崩れてきちゃってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ya see, I was dismantling a train,
and the pile of parts I took apart
sort of fell on top of me.

fields.EN:
And, that's why you were stuck
under all those parts?
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, that's why you were stuck
under all those parts?

fields.EN:
Yup. I really have to pay more
attention to my surroundings,
especially when I'm focused.
fields.JP:
そういうこと。
いやー、夢中になるとどうも周りが
見えなくなっちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I really have to pay more
attention to my surroundings,
especially when I'm focused.

fields.EN:
Yes, you better be careful
next time.
fields.JP: もう、気をつけないとダメですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, you better be careful
next time.

fields.JP: 次からは気をつけるぜ

fields.EN:
Um, so why were you dismantling
a train in the first place?
fields.JP: それにしても、何で電車を分解してたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, so why were you dismantling
a train in the first place?

fields.EN:
Huh? Cuz I like to, that's why.
Of course, it's also because we
can reuse some of them parts.
fields.JP:
んー？　そりゃ好きだからだよ
一応部品の再利用って理由もあるけど、
やっぱり一番の理由は好きだからだねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Cuz I like to, that's why.
Of course, it's also because we
can reuse some of them parts.

fields.JP: 好きって……分解するのが？

fields.EN:
You got it! I liked taking things
apart from long ago. Used to
dismantle all sorts of stuff.
fields.JP:
そうそう。
昔っから物を分解するのが好きでねー
片っ端から色んなものを分解してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got it! I liked taking things
apart from long ago. Used to
dismantle all sorts of stuff.

fields.EN:
That's something I'll probably
never understand...
fields.JP: 正直、僕にはよく分からない趣味だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's something I'll probably
never understand...

fields.EN:
I don't blame ya, and I don't
expect anyone to understand, too.
fields.JP:
そりゃそうでしょうね
私も分かってもらおうとは特に思ってないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't blame ya, and I don't
expect anyone to understand, too.

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, and you know how
I talk all weird and stuff, right?
Comes from dismantling, too.
fields.JP:
ちなみに、オイラのこの喋り方も
いろいろ分解してたらこうなったんやで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, and you know how
I talk all weird and stuff, right?
Comes from dismantling, too.

fields.EN:
Uh, you mean you took
different speech styles and
put them together to use?
fields.JP:
それって、バラバラになって
元に戻らなくなったってことか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you mean you took
different speech styles and
put them together to use?

fields.EN:
Bingo! Ya know, by the time
I knew it, I couldn't remember
how I used to speak before.
fields.JP:
そのとーり！
いろいろ試してたら、元のしゃべり方が
分からなくなっちゃってねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bingo! Ya know, by the time
I knew it, I couldn't remember
how I used to speak before.

fields.EN:
That's... interesting.
I guess that may happen...
fields.JP:
すごいです……
そういうことってあるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's... interesting.
I guess that may happen...

fields.EN:
Don't be serious, Princess.
All it is, is that he's a weirdo.
fields.JP:
姫、真面目に聞いちゃダメだ。
要するに、変人なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be serious, Princess.
All it is, is that he's a weirdo.

fields.EN:
Weirdo? Oh my, you're gonna
make me tear here! Boo-hoo!
fields.JP:
変人って……ひどいわー
私泣いちゃう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Weirdo? Oh my, you're gonna
make me tear here! Boo-hoo!

fields.EN:
See? He's just enjoying playing
out different styles of speeches.
fields.JP:
ほらね、自分でも楽しんでるんだよ
このキャラクターを
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? He's just enjoying playing
out different styles of speeches.

fields.EN:
Nah, I've still got a long way to go.
I'm no match for you, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
いやいやー俺なんてまだまだ、
おつうちゃんには負けますぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon now, I'm not as good
as how ya speak to Princess.

fields.EN:
Like, you speak and act like
some kinda prince in front of
her.
fields.JP:
なにせ、好きな相手のために、
王子様になりきってるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, you speak and act like
some kinda prince in front of
her.

fields.EN:
Please don't make it sound like
we're the same...
fields.JP: 君の性癖と一緒にしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't make it sound like
we're the same...

fields.EN:
My motivation is love. My love
towards my dear princess brings
out the prince in me.
fields.JP:
姫が姫であるがゆえに、
僕もまた王子様であらねばならない
それはすなわち愛なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My motivation is love. My love
towards my dear princess brings
out the prince in me.

fields.JP:
あの、おつうちゃん……
ちょっと恥ずかしいよ……

fields.EN:
Yup, yup! I definitely
feel a kinship with you,
Otsuu-chan. As fellow weirdos, that is.
fields.JP:
うんうん、やっぱりおつうちゃんには、
シンパシーを感じるな。変人仲間として
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, yup! I can tell for sure now
you're like me. You know, as you
word it, we're "weirdos."

fields.EN:
I see you want to get stuck under
the pile again... Now hold still!
fields.JP:
よし、もう一度部品の下敷きにしてやる
そこを動くなよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see you want to get stuck under
the pile again... Now hold still!

fields.EN:
Wait! Hold it, Otsuu-chan!
Calm down!
fields.JP: 待って待っておつうちゃん落ち着いてー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait! Hold it, Otsuu!
Calm down!

fields.EN:
I need to ask you a favor before
we step out.
fields.JP: 外に出る前にちょっと頼みがあるのだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to ask you a favor before
we step out.

fields.EN:
I'm hoping it doesn't relate to
that vial of blue liquid you
got there...
fields.JP:
まさかと思うけど、頼みっていうのは、
その手に持っている青い液体が関係して
いるんじゃないだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm hoping it doesn't relate to
that vial of blue liquid you
got there...

fields.JP: じゃあ、一気に飲み干してちょうだい

fields.EN: I assure you that it tastes fine.
fields.JP:
味に関しては大丈夫よ
まずくはないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I assure you that it tastes fine.

fields.EN:
That's not really what's
important... So, what is this
anyway?
fields.JP:
確かにまずいのは嫌だけど
問題はそこじゃなくて……
そもそもそれは何？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not really what's
important... So, what is this
anyway?

fields.EN:
It's a potion that I made that
can purge Corruption.
fields.JP: 私が実験で作った穢れを取る薬よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a potion that I made that
can purge Corruption.

fields.JP: え！？　そ、それは本当か！？

fields.EN:
Yes it is.
I actually drank one myself to
confirm.
fields.JP:
ええ、本当よ。
自分で飲んで効果は確かめてあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes it is.
I actually drank one myself to
confirm.

fields.EN:
But, unfortunately, it isn't as
potent as Jack's blood.
fields.JP:
まぁ、ジャックの血よりかは
効果が格段に薄かったけれどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, unfortunately, it isn't as
potent as Jack's blood.

fields.EN:
That's still good, since it can
help lighten the load on Jack.
fields.JP:
いや、それでも十分だ。
これで少しでもジャックの負担を
減らすことができるのならね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's still good, since it can
help lighten the load on Jack.

fields.EN:
Right? So, can you drink it?
If I can get results, I may be
able to increase its potency.
fields.JP:
そう。なら飲んでみてくれないかしら
研究が進めば薬の効果が
上がるかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? So, can you drink it?
If I can get results, I may be
able to increase its potency.

fields.EN: Uh, you sure this is safe?
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, you sure this is safe?

fields.EN:
I said I drank one myself.
If it wasn't safe, I wouldn't be
here.
fields.JP:
効果は確かめたと言ったでしょう
大丈夫じゃなければ、私はここに居ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I said I drank one myself.
If it wasn't safe, I wouldn't be
here.

fields.EN:
And yet, I'm still not convinced
it's safe...
fields.JP: ……なんだろう、なぜか安心できない
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, I'm still not convinced
it's safe...

fields.EN:
Still hesitant, are you? I suppose
my personality is finally getting
in my way now...
fields.JP:
そこまで躊躇するなんて……
日頃の行いかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still hesitant, are you? I suppose
my personality is finally getting
in my way now...

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you even knew
what your personality is like...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you even knew
what your personality is like...

fields.EN:
Why wouldn't I know? That aside,
drink up already. We don't have
all day.
fields.JP:
当たり前でしょう
それより、早く飲んでくれないかしら
出発が遅れるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why wouldn't I know? That aside,
drink up already. We don't have
all day.

fields.EN:
Augh! Are you kidding me?!
If you don't have what it takes
to drink it, I'll do it!
fields.JP:
ええい！　まどろっこしい！
そんなに躊躇するならワレが飲む！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Augh! Are you kidding me?!
If you don't have what it takes
to drink it, I'll do it!

fields.EN:
Gretel made it for us! She said
she drank it herself, so it has
to be fine!
fields.JP:
グレーテルが折角作ってくれたのだぞ？
自分で試したとも言っているのだから、
大丈夫に決まっている！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel made it for us! She said
she drank it herself, so it has
to be fine!

fields.JP: ハーメルン……？　大丈夫か？

fields.EN:
Sh-She's out cold!
H-Hameln! Wake up!
fields.JP:
た、倒れたーっ！？
ちょ、ハーメルン！　しっかりしろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sh-She's out cold!
H-Hameln! Wake up!

fields.EN:
Sh-She's not moving...
Gretel! I thought it was safe!
fields.JP:
は、反応が無い……！？
グレーテル！　大丈夫じゃなかったのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sh-She's not moving...
Gretel! I thought it was safe!

fields.JP:
嘘は言ってないわ
よく見てみなさい

fields.EN:
Why yes. Hm, so she fell asleep,
too... I suppose this effect will
affect anyone who drinks it.
fields.JP:
ええ、見てのとおりよ
それにしても、やっぱり寝てしまうようね
この様子だと誰が使っても同じなのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. Hm, so she fell asleep,
too... I suppose this effect will
affect anyone who drinks it.

fields.EN:
"Too?"
So this happened to you, too?
fields.JP:
やっぱりって……
グレーテルが使ったときも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Too?"
So this happened to you, too?

fields.EN:
I slept like I've never slept
before. It must be the potion's
side effect.
fields.JP:
ええ、寝たわ。それはもうぐっすりと。
おそらく副作用なのでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I slept like I've never slept
before. It must be the potion's
side effect.

fields.EN:
Um, maybe your Corruption purged
because you slept it off. It's no
different from a sleeping potion.
fields.JP:
いや、それってただ寝てストレスが
減ったから穢れが消えたんじゃない？
これってそういう薬なんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, maybe your Corruption purged
because you slept it off. It's no
different from a sleeping potion.

fields.EN:
I guess you're right, but I didn't
lie, did I?
fields.JP:
結果的にはそうなっているわね
でも、嘘は言ってないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you're right, but I didn't
lie, did I?

fields.JP: 確かに言ってないけど……

fields.EN:
By the way, when will Hameln
wake up? Don't tell me she's going
to be sleeping for days...
fields.JP:
それより、ハーメルンはいつ起きるんだ？
まさか何日もこのままってことは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, when will Hameln
wake up? Don't tell me she's going
to be sleeping for days...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I woke up a few
minutes after drinking it.
fields.JP:
安心しなさい。
私の時はほんの十分程度だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I woke up a few
minutes after drinking it.

fields.EN:
The duration may differ depending
on the person, but I would assume
she would wake up faster.
fields.JP:
個人差はあるでしょうけど、
ハーメルンならもっと早いかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
The duration may differ depending
on the person, but I would assume
she would wake up faster.

fields.EN:
Ten minutes, huh...
Fine. I can wait that long.
fields.JP:
十分か……仕方ない
それくらいなら待つか
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few minutes... Fine...
I guess I can wait.

fields.EN:
I hear Princess's singing...
Where is she?
fields.JP:
あ……姫の声だ。
どこかで歌ってるのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hear Princess's singing...
Where is she?

fields.EN:
I can hear her from over at
the station platform.
fields.JP:
姫の歌声はこっちから聞こえてくる。
きっとこの先のホームで歌ってるんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can hear her from over at
the station platform.

fields.EN:
Huh? Jack and Hansel?
Do you mind letting me through?
I want to go and see Princess.
fields.JP:
うわ、ジャックにヘンゼル……。
ちょっとそこをどいてくれないか？
姫の歌を聞きにホームに行きたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Jack and Hansel?
Do you mind letting me through?
I want to go and see Princess.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Um, can you hear me?
I'd like to get through.
fields.JP:
おーい、通れないから
どいてほしいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, can you hear me?
I'd like to get through.

fields.EN:
(It's like they're focusing on
something and can't hear what
I'm saying.)
fields.JP:
（二人とも聞こえてないのか？
　というより、なにかに集中しすぎて
　こっちに意識が向かないというか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's like they're focusing on
something and can't hear what
I'm saying.)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I get it... They're both listening
to Princess sing.
fields.JP:
そうか……。二人とも姫の歌に
聞き入っていたんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get it... They're both listening
to Princess sing.

fields.EN:
I have to hand it to Princess
being able to mesmerize
Nightmares with her voice.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアでさえ夢中にさせる魔法の歌声
ってことかな？　ふふ、さすが姫だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to hand it to Princess
being able to mesmerize
Nightmares with her voice.

fields.EN:
Still, I'd love to go near her,
so I'd appreciate it if you
guys can move aside.
fields.JP:
それはそうと、僕ももっと近くで聞きたいから
そこをどいてほしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, I'd love to go near her,
so I'd appreciate it if you
guys can move aside.

fields.JP: ニンギョヒメノウタ、スキ……
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
It's no use...
They're not paying any attention
to me.
fields.JP:
……やっぱり駄目か。
こっちの声なんて全然聞こえてないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use...
They're not paying any attention
to me.

fields.EN:
Fine... I guess I can listen to
Princess singing from here.
fields.JP:
仕方ない。聞こえづらいけど、
僕はここから聞くとしようかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I guess I can listen to
Princess singing from here.

fields.EN:
Tsuu, what are you doing
blocking the way?
fields.JP:
あら、つう。
通路をふさいでなにをしているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, what are you doing
blocking the way?

fields.EN:
I'd appreciate it if you said that
to Jack and Hansel, not me.
They're the ones blocking the way.
fields.JP:
グレーテル、よく見てよ。
通路をふさいでるのは僕じゃなくて、
ジャックとヘンゼルのほうだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd appreciate it if you said that
to Jack and Hansel, not me.
They're the ones blocking the way.

fields.JP: たしかに言われてみればそのようね

fields.EN:
Maybe you can get through to
Hansel.
fields.JP:
あ、そうだ。グレーテルの声なら
ヘンゼルにも聞こえるかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe you can get through to
Hansel.

fields.EN:
I want to reach the platform, but those two
are so absorbed in Princess's singing they
can't hear me. Could you ask them to move?
fields.JP:
ホームに行きたいんだけど、二人とも
姫の歌声に夢中で僕の声が届かないんだ。
君からもどくように言ってくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd like to head to the platform,
but they're too focused listening.
Can you ask them to move, too?

fields.EN:
Hm... I'm quite intrigued seeing
Hansel-niisan so focused like that...
fields.JP:
ふぅん……。
ヘンゼル兄さんがそこまで夢中になるなんて、
興味深いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I'm quite intrigued seeing
Hansel so focused like that...

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan, it's me.
Can you please move?
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さん、私よ。
そこをどいてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel, it's me.
Can you please move?

fields.EN: Nii-san. Hansel-niisan! Can't you hear me?
fields.JP:
兄さん。ヘンゼル兄さんってば。
聞こえないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dear brother Hansel.
Can you hear me?

fields.EN:
This is a first...
He's not responding to me
at all.
fields.JP:
本当に聞こえてないようね。
こんなことは初めてだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a first...
He's not responding to me
at all.

fields.EN:
Interesting...
Maybe Ningyohime's voice has
the power to mesmerize Nightmares.
fields.JP:
興味深い……。
人魚姫の歌声には、ナイトメアを魅了する
なにかがあるということかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting...
Maybe Little Mermaid's voice has
the power to mesmerize Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Goes to show how beautiful her
singing is. Now, if only Jack
and Hansel moved aside a bit...
fields.JP:
それだけ姫の歌声が魅力的ってことだよ。
ジャック達がどいてくれないのは困るけど、
やっぱり姫はすごいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Goes to show how beautiful her
singing is. Now, if only Jack
and Hansel moved aside a bit...

fields.EN:
I don't understand what's going on
fully, but I suppose your tastes
are similar to that of Nightmares.
fields.JP:
私にはそういうものがよくわからない
けれど、つうの感覚はナイトメアと
同じということかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't understand what's going on
fully, but I suppose your tastes
are similar to that of Nightmares.

fields.EN: You're not praising me, are you?
fields.JP: な、なんか表現に悪意がある気がする……
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not praising me, are you?

fields.JP:
（ああ……、だけど本当に
　きれいな歌声だ……）

fields.EN:
Well, at the very least I'm happy
to see Jack and Hansel so
attracted to Princess's singing.
fields.JP:
姫の歌声にジャックとヘンゼルが夢中に
なってるのは、悪い気はしないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, at the very least I'm happy
to see Jack and Hansel so
attracted to Princess's singing.

fields.EN: Itsuki, do you have a moment?
fields.JP: イツキ、今ちょっといいかい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Itsuki, do you have a moment?

fields.EN:
If it isn't urgent, do you mind
waiting a bit, Otsuu?
fields.JP:
ん？　おつうか。すまない
緊急じゃなければ、少し待っていてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it isn't urgent, do you mind
waiting a bit, Otsuu?

fields.JP: イツキー、ちょっと頼みがあるんだけどー

fields.EN:
I wanted to revamp the sign
to the shop, so I was hoping
you could do the writing bit.
fields.JP:
物資販売所の看板を新しくしようと
思うんだけど、あんたに書いて
もらおうと思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to revamp the sign
to the shop, so I was hoping
you could do the writing bit.

fields.JP: 何故、僕がしなくちゃいけないんだ？

fields.EN:
Yeah, you know how dirty my
handwriting is, right? You can
write good, so... yeah.
fields.JP:
いやー、あたし字が汚いからさー
あんた字綺麗でしょ？　
だからあんたに書いてほしいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you know how dirty my
handwriting is, right? You can
write good, so... yeah.

fields.EN:
You're about the only one
I can rely on here.
fields.JP: こんなこと頼めるのあんたしかいないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're about the only one
I can rely on here.

fields.JP: ありがと！　さっすがイツキ！

fields.EN:
Ooh! Nice! I knew I could
count on you, Itsuki!
fields.JP:
おおー！　いいできじゃない！
やっぱりイツキに頼んでよかったわー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! Nice! I knew I could
count on you, Itsuki!

fields.EN:
Well, I'll stop by again if
something comes up!
fields.JP: また何かあったらよろしくねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'll stop by again if
something comes up!

fields.EN:
Glad that's over...
Now then, back to...
fields.JP:
やれやれ……
さて、作業に戻ろ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad that's over...
Now then, back to...

fields.EN:
Itsuki-chan, ya around?
I've got a help request for ya!
fields.JP:
イツキちゃんいるー？
用事があるんだけどー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Itsuki, ya around?
I've got a help request for ya!

fields.JP:
今度はタクミか……
僕は今忙しいんだが

fields.EN:
C'mon, it'll be quick!
I promise!
fields.JP: 大丈夫大丈夫、すぐすむから
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, it'll be quick!
I promise!

fields.JP: まったく……それで、何の用だ？

fields.EN:
My tools are getting a bit rusty,
so you got any good magic salve
that can get rid of em rust?
fields.JP:
今使ってる工具がちょっと錆びてきててねー
錆び落としの薬品とかない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
My tools are getting a bit rusty,
so you got any good magic salve
that can get rid of em rust?

fields.EN:
No, and why did you think I'd
have something like that?
fields.JP: ない。というか何故あると思った？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, and why did you think I'd
have something like that?

fields.EN:
A hunch?
I figured you'd be able to
do something about it, Itsuki.
fields.JP:
なんとなく？
イツキならどうにかしてくれるかなーって
fields.LOCALIZED:
A hunch?
I figured you'd be able to whip
up something pronto.

fields.EN:
Take this... It's no magic salve,
but it should do the trick.
fields.JP:
薬品はないが、代用できそうなものならある
これを持って行け
fields.LOCALIZED:
Take this... It's no magic salve,
but it should do the trick.

fields.EN:
I knew I could count on you, Itsuki-chan!
Uh, wait... This is vinegar... You sure this
stuff works?
fields.JP:
さっすがイツキちゃん
頼りになるわーって、これ、お酢じゃん
本当に落ちるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew I could count on ya!
Uh, wait... This is vinegar...
You sure this stuff works?

fields.EN:
It will. Trust me.
Boil the vinegar then submerge
your tools in it.
fields.JP: 落ちる。騙されたと思って熱して漬けてみろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It will. Trust me.
Boil the vinegar then submerge
your tools in it.

fields.EN:
Oh? I'll give it a try right away.
Thanks man!
fields.JP:
ほうほう。さっそく戻って試してみるよ
ありがとねー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I'll give it a try right away.
Thanks man!

fields.JP:
ワレの大事な勇者グッズが
壊れてしまったのだ！

fields.EN:
What... What am I supposed to do?!
Without them my hero power will
go down!
fields.JP:
どうしよう！　どうすれば良い！？
これでは勇者としての力が落ちてしまう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What... What am I supposed to do?!
Without them my hero power will
go down!

fields.EN: Calm down. I can fix them easily.
fields.JP:
……落ち着け。
この程度すぐに直してやる
fields.LOCALIZED: Calm down. I can fix them easily.

fields.EN: Yes, so stay put, will you?
fields.JP: ああ、だから待っていろ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, so stay put, will you?

fields.EN: Hey, Itsuki, can ya help me out?
fields.JP: おーい、イツキー頼みがあんだけどー
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Itsuki, can ya help me out?

fields.EN:
Itsuki, do you mind helping me
a bit?
fields.JP: イツキー、お願いがあるんだけどー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Itsuki, do you mind helping me
a bit?

fields.EN:
What in the...?!
Fine! Just stand in line!
fields.JP:
ええい、次から次へと！
そこに順番に並べ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What in the...?!
Fine! Just stand in line!

fields.JP:
ふぅ……
ようやくひと息つける

fields.EN:
Ah, I'm sorry. I'm sure I could've
done my work earlier if there
weren't so many distractions.
fields.JP:
ああ、すまない。待たせたな
邪魔が入らなければもう少し、
早く作業が終わったんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I'm sorry. I'm sure I could've
done my work earlier if there
weren't so many distractions.

fields.JP: ううん、気にしてないよ

fields.EN:
I'm just amazed at how many
people rely on you.
fields.JP:
それにしても、
ずいぶん頼まれごとされてたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just amazed at how many
people rely on you.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure why, but this happens
to me all the time.
fields.JP:
なぜかは分からんが、
昔からよく頼みごとをされるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure why, but this happens
to me all the time.

fields.EN:
I can tell why. You kept an open
ear, even for Hameln.
fields.JP:
うん。なんか見ててそんな気がした
ハーメルンのあの頼み事も
ちゃんと聞いてたし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can tell why. You kept an open
ear, even for Hameln.

fields.EN:
Hameln's requests are often
the most humbug of them all.
fields.JP:
正直、ハーメルンの頼みごとが
一番大変だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln's requests are often
the most humbug of them all.

fields.EN:
To add, she comes by
frequently.
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, she comes by
frequently.

fields.EN:
Do you want me to tell Hameln
to back off a bit?
fields.JP:
本当、お疲れ様
ハーメルンには僕が一言、
言っておこうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you want me to tell Hameln
to back off a bit?

fields.EN:
No, that's not needed.
Hameln's requests actually offer
a good change of pace.
fields.JP:
いや、そこまでしなくていい
ハーメルンの頼み事は、
いい気分転換になるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's not needed.
Hameln's requests actually offer
a good change of pace.

fields.EN:
Really?
Well, whatever you say then.
fields.JP:
そうなのかい？
じゃあ、やめておくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?
Well, whatever you say then.

fields.EN:
So, what was it you needed from
me?
fields.JP: そんなことより、用件はなんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what was it you needed from
me?

fields.JP:
あ、忘れてた
えっと……あはは

fields.EN:
Don't tell me you wanted to ask
something forgettable...
fields.JP:
……まさか、君までしょうもない
頼み事なんじゃないだろうな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me you wanted to ask
something forgettable...

fields.EN:
*sigh*
I'm not a handyman, you know?
fields.JP:
はぁ……
僕は便利屋じゃないんだがな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*
I'm not a handyman, you know?

fields.EN:
(Itsuki is checking Hansel's blood
out to see if it can help purge
Corruption like Jack's blood.)
fields.JP:
（今、ヘンゼルは血液検査を受けている。
　ジャックのように穢れを減らす効果が
　あるかどうかを調べるためだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Itsuki is checking Hansel's blood
out to see if it can help purge
Corruption like Jack's blood.)

fields.EN:
(He should be back with the
results shortly. All this waiting
is pretty nerve-wracking...)
fields.JP:
（もうすぐ結果が出るはずだけど、
　付き添いの僕まで緊張してきた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He should be back with the
results shortly. All this waiting
is pretty nerve-wracking...)

fields.EN:
Why so tense? It's not as if
you're going to affect the
results.
fields.JP:
緊張しているようね。
あなたが緊張しようがリラックスしようが、
結果に変わりはないというのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why so tense? It's not as if
you're going to affect the
results.

fields.EN:
I know that, but I can't help
myself.
fields.JP:
そんなのわかってるよ。
でも緊張しちゃうものは仕方ないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know that, but I can't help
myself.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, Hansel's blood
doesn't have the purging effect
like Jack's blood.
fields.JP:
残念だが、駄目そうだ。
ヘンゼルの血液には穢れを軽減するような
効果は見られない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, Hansel's blood
doesn't have the purging effect
like Jack's blood.

fields.EN:
Then that means reducing Corruption
is an effect unique to Jack's blood...
fields.JP:
となると、穢れの軽減はジャックの血液特有の
効果ということかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would mean that Jack's blood
contains a substance that can
reduce the effects of Corruption.

fields.EN:
Hansel is our only comparison sample, so I
can't say for certain, but it's a problem
that we have no other way to investigate.
fields.JP:
比較対象のサンプルがヘンゼルしか
いないからなんとも言えないが、
他に調べる術がないのは困ったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we only have Hansel's blood to
compare with, so there's no
conclusive result here.

fields.EN:
Does this all mean that we're
going to have to continue using
Jack's blood?
fields.JP:
これからもジャックに負担をかけて
しまうかもしれないってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does this all mean that we're
going to have to continue using
Jack's blood?

fields.EN:
(I was hoping Hansel's blood would
have the same properties, but I
guess that'd be too convenient.)
fields.JP:
（ヘンゼルの血にジャックの血と同じ
　ような効果があればって期待したけど、
　そう都合よくはいかないか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was hoping Hansel's blood would
have the same properties, but I
guess that'd be too convenient.)

fields.EN:
SORRY I COULDN'T HELP...
BURDENING JACK...
fields.JP:
チカラニナレナクテ、ゴメン……。
ジャック、タイヘン……
fields.LOCALIZED:
SORRY I COULDN'T HELP...
BURDENING JACK...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぢが……がが……。
まぼ、でるる……ありが……ぎぎぎ

fields.EN:
We appreciate your help, Hansel.
You protecting our base is more
than enough help.
fields.JP:
僕もジャックも、ヘンゼルには感謝してる。
いつも解放地区を守ってくれてるんだから、
それだけで十分だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We appreciate your help, Hansel.
You protecting our base is more
than enough help.

fields.EN:
He's right. There's no reason for
you to apologize, Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
そうよ。ヘンゼル兄さんが謝罪する
ようなことはなにもないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right. There's no reason for
you to apologize, Hansel.

fields.EN:
Yes, we appreciate you making
sure that this place is safe.
fields.JP:
うん。ヘンゼルはいつも解放地区を
守ってくれてるだろ？
それだけでも十分感謝してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we appreciate you making
sure that this place is safe.

fields.EN:
This examination wasn't pointless. We
learned that Nightmare blood doesn't always
have the same Corruption-reducing effect.
fields.JP:
今回の検査も無駄ではなかった。
穢れを軽減する効果が、ナイトメアの血に
等しくあるわけではないとわかったのだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that the results weren't in
vain. We now know that Nightmares
don't all have the same blood.

fields.EN:
So yes, thank you, Hansel.
You helped us discover something
new.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、ヘンゼル。
貴重な発見をさせてもらったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So yes, thank you, Hansel.
You helped us discover something
new.

fields.EN:
Jack, we'd like to keep using your
blood from now on. Will you cooperate with us?
fields.JP:
さて、ジャック。
君にはこれからも血を使わせてもらい
たいんだが、協力してもらえるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, do you mind helping
us with a sampling of your
blood again, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I'm sorry you have to go through
all this for us...
fields.JP:
ごめんな。ジャックにたくさん負担を
押し付ける形になっちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry you have to go through
all this for us...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Thank you, Jack.
Your kindness is appreciated.
fields.JP:
がんばってくれるのか？
ありがとう、ジャック。
君は優しいね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Jack.
Your kindness is appreciated.

fields.EN:
(Despite his looks, he really is
still the Jack we know.)
fields.JP:
（こんな姿になっていても、
　やっぱり中身は出会ったときの
　優しいジャックのままなんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite his looks, he really is
still the Jack we know.)

fields.EN:
(I need to do my best to
show my appreciation of what
Jack has done...)
fields.JP:
（ジャックに感謝して、僕も彼に
　報えるようにがんばっていこう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to do my best to
show my appreciation of what
Jack has done...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

あー、なんかおいしそうな
甘い匂いがするなぁ
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
A vial? There's some kind of
liquid inside...
fields.JP:
小瓶？　中に液体が入ってるな。
甘い匂いの元はこれだったのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
A vial? There's some kind of
liquid inside...

fields.EN:
I wonder what it's for?
Maybe some kind of perfume?
Smells a bit too sweet though...
fields.JP:
なにに使うものなんだろう。
香水ってやつかな？
でもそれにしては匂いが強烈だけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what it's for?
Maybe some kind of perfume?
Smells a bit too sweet though...

fields.EN:
I smell something sweet coming
from you two. Do you have some
sweets there?
fields.JP:
こっちのほうからなにやら甘い香りが
するわね。お菓子でもあるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I smell something sweet coming
from you two. Do you have some
sweets there?

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, no. Here...
We found this vial with some kind
of sweet smelling liquid inside.
fields.JP:
残念だけどお菓子じゃないよ。
ほら、これ。やたらと甘い匂いのする
液体が入った小瓶が落ちてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, no. Here...
We found this vial with some kind
of sweet smelling liquid inside.

fields.EN:
I believe that's vanilla essence.
It's used to make sweets.
fields.JP:
……それは、お菓子作りに使われる
バニラエッセンスという香料よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe that's vanilla essence.
It's used to make sweets.

fields.EN: Huh... So, that's what it's for.
fields.JP: へぇ、お菓子作りに使うのか
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh... So, that's what it's for.

fields.JP: ええ、珍しいものが落ちていたわね

fields.EN:
(She just took it out of Jack's
hand without permission...)
fields.JP: （あ、さりげなくジャックの手から奪った……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She just took it out of Jack's
hand without permission...)

fields.EN:
You don't need this.
Isn't that right?
I know I'm right. Agreed?
fields.JP:
これはあなたたちには不要なものよね？
そうでしょう？　そうに違いないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need this.
Isn't that right?
I know I'm right. Agreed?

fields.JP: う、うん。たしかに不要だね……

fields.EN:
I'll hold onto this.
Are there any problems?
fields.JP: これは私が預かるわ。問題ないわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll hold onto this.
Are there any problems?

fields.EN:
None at all...
You're fine too, Jack?
fields.JP: うん、まぁ……。ジャックもいいよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
None at all...
You're fine too, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
There she goes...
She looked very happy there...
fields.JP: すごくいい笑顔で行っちゃった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There she goes...
She looked very happy there...

fields.EN:
(When it comes to sweets or anything
that interests her, she moves
incredibly fast... As always...)
fields.JP:
（お菓子関係とか興味のあることには、
　めちゃくちゃ迅速だな。相変わらず……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(As usual, Gretel is very forceful
when it comes to sweets...)

fields.EN:
Mmm...
I wonder if there's anything good
around here...
fields.JP: んー、なにかいい物でも落ちてないかなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...
I wonder if there's anything good
around here...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
お、なにか見つけたのか？
ナイトメア・ジャック

なべ、ぼうぢょ、ぢょ……、
いっばば……
鍋と包丁？　どれどれ

fields.EN:
They're made of wood and are quite
small. What are these good for?
fields.JP:
……って、なんだこれ。鍋も包丁も
木で作られてるぞ。しかもちっちゃいし。
こんなのなんに使うんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're made of wood and are quite
small. What are these good for?

fields.EN:
There's more wooden bowls here...
They still don't look useful.
fields.JP:
他にも木製のボウルやおたまがあるな……。
でもどれも実際に使えなさそうなのばっかりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's more wooden bowls here...
They still don't look useful.

fields.EN:
Wait a minute...
Are these toys by any chance?
fields.JP:
あ。もしかしてこれは、
子どもがごっこ遊びに使うっていう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute...
Are these toys by any chance?

fields.JP: おつうとジャックだーー！！
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack, are you all right?!
Rapunzel! Don't tackle him
like that!
fields.JP:
ジャックが吹っ飛んだー！？
ちょっとラプンツェル、
体当たりしちゃ駄目だろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, are you all right?!
Rapunzel! Don't tackle him
like that!

fields.EN:
Ooh...! Make-believe play set!
I wanna!
fields.JP: それ、おままごとセット！　ほしいー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh...! Make-believe play set!
I wanna!

fields.EN:
So these are toys...
You want them, Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
ああ、やっぱりおままごとの道具なんだ、これ。
ラプンツェル使うのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So these are toys...
You want them, Rapunzel?

fields.EN:
Yup!
I can practice having babies!
fields.JP:
うん！
こどもつくるれんしゅう、できる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup!
I can practice having babies!

fields.EN:
No, that's misleading. You
mean you can practice imagining
how to raise a child, right?
fields.JP:
いや、それは語弊があるよね？
子どもを育てるイメージトレーニングが
できるって意味合いのことだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That came out bad...
You mean to train yourself when
you do have babies, right?

fields.EN:
C'mon! I wanna!
Rapunzel wanna toys!
fields.JP:
ねーねー、それちょーだい！
ラプンツェルほしい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon! I wanna!
Rapunzel wanna toys!

fields.EN:
Sure, go ahead. Not that they
help with our expedition.
Here you go...
fields.JP:
まぁ、いいよ。
別に探索に関係ないものだし、
持って行きな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, go ahead. Not that they
help with our expedition.
Here you go...

fields.JP: わーい！　ありがとー！！

fields.EN: I can practice make babies plenty!
fields.JP:
これでこどもつくるれんしゅう、
いっぱいするね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I can practice make babies plenty!

fields.EN:
Uh, like I said, you need to
rephr---
She's gone...
fields.JP:
だから子どもを作る練習って表現は……
って、もういないし。早っ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, like I said, you need to
rephr---
She's gone...

fields.EN:
(I guess she still is a kid.
Never thought she'd be so happy
getting some toys.)
fields.JP:
（でも、あんなおもちゃで喜ぶなんて
　やっぱり子どもだな。ふふっ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess she still is a kid.
Never thought she'd be so happy
getting some toys.)

fields.EN:
Shoot. Almost forgot.
I need to help Jack up...
fields.JP:
……あ、忘れてた。
ジャックが吹っ飛ばされたままだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot. Almost forgot.
I need to help Jack up...

fields.EN:
Whew... So tired...
I can't move a single finger
already...
fields.JP:
は～、疲れましたね～。
もうくたくたです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... So tired...
I can't move a single finger
already...

fields.EN:
Uh, you can't be tired...
You've been riding on Bamboo
One the whole time.
fields.JP:
いや、かぐやはずっと
バンブー１号に乗ってただろ？
それほど疲れてないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you can't be tired...
You've been riding on Bamboo
One the whole time.

fields.EN:
How rude~. Believe it or not, I'm
working hard in all sorts of ways, you know~?
fields.JP:
失礼な～。
こう見えて、いろいろがんばって
働いているんですよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How rude...
I am moving much more than
it seems.

fields.JP: いろいろは、いろいろです～

fields.EN:
Please come up with a better
excuse...
fields.JP: 誤魔化すにしても雑だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please come up with a better
excuse...

fields.EN:
*yawn* All that work is making me
sleepy now... Well, good luck,
everyone...
fields.JP:
ふあ～。働きすぎて、
眠くなってきてしまいました～。
あとはよろしくお願いします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
*yawn* All that work is making me
sleepy now... Well, good luck,
everyone...

fields.JP:
えぇ、それってサボリだろ……。
まったく……
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
You found something?
It looks like a cushion, but it
sure is dirty...
fields.JP:
なにか見つけたのか？
……って、またえらくボロボロなもの
拾ったな。クッションか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You found something?
It looks like a cushion, but it
sure is dirty...

fields.EN:
Huh, it's too flat and hard to be
a cushion. Well, it's too dirty
for us to use, so...
fields.JP:
でもクッションにしては平たいし、
微妙に硬いな……。なんにせよ、
こんなにボロボロじゃ使い物にならないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, it's too flat and hard to be
a cushion. Well, it's too dirty
for us to use, so...

fields.EN: Oh? Oh my, oh my, oh my...
fields.JP: あら？　あらあらあら～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? Oh my, oh my, oh my...

fields.EN:
I thought you went to slack
off...
fields.JP: あれ、サボりに行ったんじゃなかったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought you went to slack
off...

fields.EN:
I was only resting. That aside,
that thing Jack-san is holding...
fields.JP:
サボりじゃありません、休憩です～。
それより、ジャックさんが持ってるそれは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was only resting. That aside,
that thing Jack is holding...

fields.EN: It's just some junk Jack found.
fields.JP: ジャックが見つけてきたゴミだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's just some junk Jack found.

fields.EN:
Are you kidding?! That's no junk!
It's the legendary pillow of
softness!
fields.JP:
ゴミとか言わないでください～！
それは伝説の低反発枕に違いありません～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you kidding?! That's no junk!
It's the legendary pillow of
softness!

fields.EN:
Uh, legendary?
Are you sure it's that great?
fields.JP:
え、伝説の……？
そんなにすごいものなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, legendary?
Are you sure it's that great?

fields.EN:
Sure it's dirty and all, but I am
positively sure that's the
legendary pillow.
fields.JP:
たしかにだいぶボロボロになって
しまってますけど、それは間違いなく
伝説の低反発枕です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure it's dirty and all, but I am
positively sure that's the
legendary pillow.

fields.EN:
They say using it promises such
wonderful sleep that it feels as
though you could sleep forever~
fields.JP:
それを使えば、まるで永遠に
眠れるかのごとく素晴らしい睡眠が
約束されるといいます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
The pillow is said to offer sleep
so deep that its user will never
wake up again.

fields.EN:
Are you sure it's safe to use?
Your description sounds similar
to when someone dies...
fields.JP:
永遠に眠るって、永眠だよねそれ。
大丈夫なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure it's safe to use?
Your description sounds similar
to when someone dies...

fields.EN:
Aah, I would never have expected
to have stumbled upon the
legendary pillow here.
fields.JP:
ああ、こんなところで伝説の低反発枕に
出会えるなんて思いませんでした～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah, I would never have expected
to have stumbled upon the
legendary pillow here.

fields.EN:
So, um... Do you mind giving that
to me?
fields.JP:
……あの～、それをわらわに譲って
くれませんか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, um... Do you mind giving that
to me?

fields.EN: Well, it's junk to us, so... here.
fields.JP: まぁ、こんなゴミでいいならどうぞ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, it's junk to us, so... here.

fields.EN:
You don't know value even when you
see it, do you? It just means it's
best in my hands and not yours.
fields.JP:
だからゴミじゃありません～！
も～、価値がわからない人ですね～。
やっぱりわらわがもらって正解です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't know value even when you
see it, do you? It just means it's
best in my hands and not yours.

fields.EN:
Heh heh... I will test this out as
soon as we return. I will savor
the greatest of sleep with this!
fields.JP:
ふふ、戻ったらさっそく
これを使って寝てみます～。
きっと究極のだらだらが実現しますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... I will test this out as
soon as we return. I will savor
the greatest of sleep with this!

fields.EN:
Glad she's happy she got it.
I guess one man's trash is
another man's treasure.
fields.JP:
……本気で喜んでるみたいだなぁ。
僕ならあんなボロい枕、願い下げだけど。
価値観は人それぞれってことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad she's happy she got it.
I guess one man's trash is
another man's treasure.

fields.JP: あれ？　みんな集まってどうしたんだい？

fields.EN:
We were discussing how we
can allocate our roles with the
lack of manpower.
fields.JP:
僕たちは少なくなった人員を、
どこにどう割り振るか相談していたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were discussing how we
can allocate our roles with the
lack of manpower.

fields.EN:
That's right. The other survivors
fled to the tower with the members
of the Order.
fields.JP:
ああ、そうか……
タイヨウの信者と一緒に住民たちも
監獄塔に避難したから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. The other survivors
fled to the tower with the members
of the Order.

fields.EN:
Not we can do anything about it
now, so we just have to figure
things out ourselves.
fields.JP:
ま、あんなことがあったんじゃ仕方ないよ
残ったあたしらでやれることをやらないとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not we can do anything about it
now, so we just have to figure
things out ourselves.

fields.EN:
We've got to fix the facilities,
and get the Liberated District up
and running again.
fields.JP:
破損した施設や解放地区の補修、
体制の立て直し、やることがいっぱいだぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've got to fix the facilities,
and get the Liberated District up
and running again.

fields.EN:
You folks could've fled to the
tower with everyone, too.
Why didn't you all leave?
fields.JP:
……マモル達も監獄塔に
避難してもよかったんだよ？
なんで、一緒に行かなかったんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You folks could've fled to the
tower with everyone, too.
Why didn't you all leave?

fields.JP: 俺達が行くわけないだろ

fields.EN:
There are no facilities in the
tower that could provide support
to you Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
監獄塔には君たち血式少女をサポートする
ための施設も余裕もないだろうからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are no facilities in the
tower that could provide support
to you Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Not like we could do anything
there with how they got zilch
infrastructure ya know?
fields.JP:
仮に施設を移行出来ても、
向こうのインフラじゃ施設が使えないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not like we could do anything
there with how they got zilch
infrastructure ya know?

fields.EN:
No use for us to be with em if
none of the facilities works,
right?
fields.JP:
血式武器の強化や研究施設が機能しないなら、
僕たちが向こうに行っても意味ないからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
No use for us to be with em if
none of the facilities works,
right?

fields.EN:
Wait... So, you mean you all
stayed behind for us?
fields.JP:
それってつまり……
僕たちのために残ったってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... So, you mean you all
stayed behind for us?

fields.EN:
We're here to help support you
girls, no matter what.
fields.JP:
こういう時こそあんた達のサポートが
できなきゃ意味ねぇからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're here to help support you
girls, no matter what.

fields.EN:
To add, we decided to stay
behind for us, too.
fields.JP: それに、これはあたし達のためでもあるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, we decided to stay
behind for us, too.

fields.EN:
Well, I was actually going to send Hikari
over there even if she had to go by herself.
fields.JP:
まぁ、本当はヒカリだけでも、
向こうに行かせる気だったんだけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but I was wanting Hikari
to go with them, but...

fields.EN: You know, she had a fit over it.
fields.JP: こっちに残るって聞かなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: You know, she had a fit over it.

fields.EN:
We can't fight Marchens and
Nightmares ourselves, but...
fields.JP:
私たちにはメルヒェンやナイトメアを倒す
ことはできないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't fight Marchens and
Nightmares ourselves, but...

fields.EN:
We'll fight by staying here to
support you girls. No way I'm
turning my back on you!
fields.JP:
ここでみんなを支えること。
それが私たちにとっての戦いなんだよ！
だから、私は逃げないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll fight by staying here to
support you girls. No way I'm
turning my back on you!

fields.EN:
See what I mean?
She's been blowing steam like
this the whole time.
fields.JP: な？　ずっとこの調子なんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
See what I mean?
She's been blowing steam like
this the whole time.

fields.EN:
But, this place is dangerous.
There's no telling when the
Nightmare or Marchens will strike.
fields.JP:
でも、やっぱりここは危険だよ
いつまたナイトメアやメルヒェンが
襲ってくるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, this place is dangerous.
There's no telling when the
Nightmare or Marchens will strike.

fields.EN:
It'd be best if we could offer
protection, but we can't split our
party right now...
fields.JP:
本当は僕たちが護衛できればいいんだけど、
探索を進めるためにもパーティを
削るわけにはいかないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'd be best if we could offer
protection, but we can't split our
party right now...

fields.EN:
Well, security has gotten stricter
since Hansel disappeared, but we're
not the only ones who remain.
fields.JP:
まぁ、確かにヘンゼルがいなくなって、
警備は厳しくなったが、残ったのは
なにも俺達だけじゃないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Hansel gone, our defenses
are a bit sucky, but we're not
completely defenseless.

fields.EN:
Yup, and we still have Hameln's
familiars with us, too.
fields.JP:
そうそう、ハーメルンの下僕たちだって
いるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, and we still have Hameln's
familiars with us, too.

fields.EN:
Oh, and you'd be surprised that
there are some survivors who want
to stay behind to offer support.
fields.JP:
それに、あんた達を助けるために残る！
っていう、根性のある奴らが結構いるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and you'd be surprised that
there are some survivors who want
to stay behind to offer support.

fields.EN:
We're planning on offering them
roles to help maintain our limited
defenses and facilities.
fields.JP:
その人達と協力して、
警備や施設の運用もすることになってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're planning on offering them
roles to help maintain our limited
defenses and facilities.

fields.EN:
We also got basic equipment and
gears ready.
fields.JP: 装備もある程度そろえた
fields.LOCALIZED:
We also got basic equipment and
gears ready.

fields.EN:
So we should be able to at least
fend ourselves against Marchens.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアはムリだとしても、
メルヒェンなら撃退するくらいは、
できるはずだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we should be able to at least
fend ourselves against Marchens.

fields.EN:
And as a Nightmare countermeasure,
we built a deep shelter with a narrow
entrance that huge body can't fit through.
fields.JP:
それにー、ナイトメア対策として
あの巨体が入れない入り口が狭くて
深いシェルターも作ったしねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heck, we even made the portal
into our shelter small so that the
Nightmare can't come in.

fields.EN:
And when push comes to shove,
we'll all make a mad dash for it,
so we'll be fine!
fields.JP:
いざとなったら、
みんなでそこに逃げるから大丈夫だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And when push comes to shove,
we'll all make a mad dash for it,
so we'll be fine!

fields.EN: I don't know what to say...
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't know what to say...

fields.EN:
C'mon, cheer up. We've came this
far. It's only natural for us to
see everything through to the end.
fields.JP:
そんな顔すんなよ。
ここまでずっと一緒にやって来たんだ、
最後まで付き合うのは当然だろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, cheer up. We've came this
far. It's only natural for us to
see everything through to the end.

fields.EN:
He's right. It's also not like us
to leave our friends behind.
fields.JP:
そうね。仲間を置いて逃げるのは
性に合わないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right. It's also not like us
to leave our friends behind.

fields.EN:
Even if you told us to go into
hiding, we'll follow you girls
no matter what!
fields.JP:
今さらどっか行けとか言われても、
意地でもついて行くからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you told us to go into
hiding, we'll follow you girls
no matter what!

fields.EN:
And, you do need us to offer
support, yes?
fields.JP:
君たちも、僕らのサポートがないと
なにかと困るだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, you do need us to offer
support, yes?

fields.EN:
You're gonna need us around cuz
you'll need to get your weapons
taken care of with the road ahead.
fields.JP:
武器はすぐに消耗するしねー
しかも強い敵と戦うなら、
より強い武器は絶対に必要だよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're gonna need us around cuz
you'll need to get your weapons
taken care of with the road ahead.

fields.EN:
We're all in this together.
So rely on us as much as you need.
fields.JP:
俺達は仲間だ。
だから、どんどん頼ってくれていい
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're all in this together.
So rely on us as much as you need.

fields.EN:
Ah, but we're no use fighting them
Marchens and Nightmares, so we're
gonna have to rely on you girls...
fields.JP:
と言っても、肝心なメルヒェンとか
ナイトメアとの戦いは、お前たちに
任せっきりなのが情けないけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but we're no use fighting them
Marchens and Nightmares, so we're
gonna have to rely on you girls...

fields.EN:
Not to worry. We'll take care of
them, and it's only because you're
all behind us.
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ
みんなのおかげですごく助かってるし、
そのおかげで僕たちも戦えてるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to worry. We'll take care of
them, and it's only because you're
all behind us.

fields.EN:
That's good to hear.
So yeah, uh... we're counting
on you.
fields.JP:
そう言ってもらえるとありがたいな。
まあ、その……頼りにしてるぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear.
So yeah, uh... we're counting
on you.

fields.JP: それはこっちのセリフだ

fields.EN:
I can't be happier having you all
as friends...
fields.JP:
一番最初に仲間になったのが君たちで、
本当によかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't be happier having you all
as friends...

fields.JP: どうもー、まいどっすー！

fields.EN:
Huh? Clara?
What are you doing here?
fields.JP:
えっ、くらら？
こんなところで会うなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Clara?
What are you doing here?

fields.EN:
Well, I am a traveling merchant,
ya know? I'll appear wherever and
whenever there's a chance.
fields.JP:
そりゃ、放浪商人っすからね。
神出鬼没、どこに現れても
不思議じゃないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I am a traveling merchant,
ya know? I'll appear wherever and
whenever there's a chance.

fields.EN:
Traveling merchant... I still
can't believe a kid like you is
doing such a dangerous thing.
fields.JP:
放浪商人か……。君みたいな子どもが
そんな危険な仕事をしてるなんてなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Traveling merchant... I still
can't believe a kid like you is
doing such a dangerous thing.

fields.EN:
Hey, it's a job and a good one at
that. It's a helluva lot better
than when I was stealing things.
fields.JP:
でもまっとうな仕事っすよ？
昔は盗っ人をしてたんで、
それに比べればはるかにマシっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, it's a job and a good one at
that. It's a helluva lot better
than when I was stealing things.

fields.EN:
I had to do that to survive.
But I've made my dues and
all clean now.
fields.JP:
生き抜くためには仕方なかったんっすよ。
でも今はすっぱり足を洗ったから大丈夫っす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had to do that to survive.
But I've made my dues and
all clean now.

fields.EN:
Did you know I was at Dawn, too?
One helluva life to have, right?
fields.JP:
そのあともいろいろあって、
一時期は黎明のお世話になってたことも
あったんっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you know I was at Dawn, too?
One helluva life to have, right?

fields.EN:
I never knew you were with them.
So, why did you leave Dawn?
fields.JP:
え、初耳だな。
それならどうして黎明を離れちゃったんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I never knew you were with them.
So, why did you leave Dawn?

fields.EN:
Well, not like I wanted to leave.
I was sort of, you know, expelled
from there.
fields.JP:
自分の意思で離れたんじゃなくて、
追い出されちゃったんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, not like I wanted to leave.
I was sort of, you know, expelled
from there.

fields.EN:
Can't help it, really. Dawn had so
many people that they couldn't
keep everyone.
fields.JP:
ま、仕方ないっす。黎明も人が
多かったみたいで、たぶんそれ以上は
食い扶持を増やせなかったんっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can't help it, really. Dawn had so
many people that they couldn't
keep everyone.

fields.EN:
At first they said I might be
a 'Blood Maiden,' but in the
end they found out I wasn't.
fields.JP:
自分は最初、「けっしきしょうじょ」？
じゃないかって言われてたんっすけど、
結局違うとわかったんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
They brought me on thinking I was
one of em Blood Maidens, but
I guess I wasn't suited to be one.

fields.EN:
So why keep me there, right?
Heck, I wouldn't, too. Heh heh!
fields.JP:
期待されてたのと違ったなら、
追い出されても文句は言えないっすよ。
あはは
fields.LOCALIZED:
So why keep me there, right?
Heck, I wouldn't, too. Heh heh!

fields.EN:
So, that's why you became a
traveling merchant... But, aren't
you scared of the Marchens?
fields.JP:
それから放浪商人になったのか……。
だけど、もしもメルヒェンに
襲われたらどうするんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that's why you became a
traveling merchant... But, aren't
you scared of the Marchens?

fields.EN:
Heh heh! Not to worry!
My boss taught me where all
the hidden passages are here!
fields.JP:
ふふ、それはご心配なくっす。
実は師匠に教わった秘密の抜け道を
たくさん知ってるっすからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! Not to worry!
My boss taught me where all
the hidden passages are here!

fields.EN:
After I was thrown out of Dawn, a
creepy traveling merchant found
me. He became my teacher of sorts.
fields.JP:
自分が黎明に捨てられて困ってたら、
ちょーっと気味の悪い放浪商人の師匠が
拾ってくれたんっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
After I was thrown out of Dawn, a
creepy traveling merchant found
me. He became my teacher of sorts.

fields.EN:
One man's trash is another man's
treasure, they say! You never know
what can happen in life, right?
fields.JP:
まさに捨てる神あれば拾う神ありっすね！
人生なにがあるかわかんないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One man's trash is another man's
treasure, they say! You never know
what can happen in life, right?

fields.EN:
Boss taught me the trade and
the hidden passages, and ta-da!
Here I am!
fields.JP:
その師匠から独房エリアの抜け道を
たくさん教わって、仕事も継いで
今に至るってわけっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss taught me the trade and
the hidden passages, and ta-da!
Here I am!

fields.EN:
You sure went through a lot...
I'm glad that person found you.
So, are you working with him now?
fields.JP:
いろいろ苦労したんだな……。
でもその師匠って人に会えてよかったね。
今も一緒に仕事してるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sure went through a lot...
I'm glad that person found you.
So, are you working with him now?

fields.EN:
Uh, he sort a disappeared. He said
he was gonna go someplace then
"poof," I haven't seen him since.
fields.JP:
あー、それがっすね……。
師匠はあるとき、ふらっとどこかに行くって
言ったきり、姿を見せなくなっちゃったんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, he sort a disappeared. He said
he was gonna go someplace then
"poof," I haven't seen him since.

fields.EN:
He's a tough one, so I doubt
anything bad happened, but
it does bother me a bit...
fields.JP:
師匠のことだから滅多なことは
ないと思うんっすけど、
やっぱり気にはなるっすよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's a tough one, so I doubt
anything bad happened, but
it does bother me a bit...

fields.EN: I don't blame how you feel...
fields.JP: そっか。気持ちはわかるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't blame how you feel...

fields.EN:
(This person sounds mighty
suspicious... No... He sounds
like a unique person...)
fields.JP:
（だけど、そんな怪しげ……じゃない、
　特殊な人がいるなんて知らなかったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This person sounds mighty
suspicious... No... He sounds
like a unique person...)

fields.EN:
Hm? Wait a second...
You mentioned something
important earlier...
fields.JP:
……ん？　そういえば、さっき
「けっしきしょうじょ」って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Wait a second...
You mentioned something
important earlier...

fields.EN:
That's right! Didn't you say
something about you possibly
being a "Blood Maiden?!"
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! Didn't you say
something about you possibly
being a "Blood Maiden?!"

fields.EN:
Well, I don't have anything to sell
today, so I'll be heading off! Please
keep giving me your business!
fields.JP:
まっ、今日は売り物もないんで
そろそろ退散するっす！
またご贔屓にっすー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh shoot, look at that!
I left my goods behind!
Gotta go, see ya!

fields.EN:
It sounded as if Clara is supposed
to be a Blood Maiden, but...
Maybe I interpreted it wrong...
fields.JP:
くららは血式少女って言ったように
聞こえたけど、聞き違いかもな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounded as if Clara is supposed
to be a Blood Maiden, but...
Maybe I interpreted it wrong...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ジャック、なにか見つけたのか？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
A tangled cord? No wait...
An earphone?
fields.JP:
絡まったコード？
……じゃなくて、イヤホンか？
ずいぶんごちゃごちゃしてるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
A tangled cord? No wait...
An earphone?

fields.EN:
What a strange earphone... It has
a single plug with six speakers...
So, it's a one-for-three earphone?
fields.JP:
あれ、このイヤホン変なの。
プラグは一つなのに、スピーカーが六つ……
三人分もある。三人で音楽聞けっていうのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a strange earphone... It has
a single plug with six speakers...
So, it's a one-for-three earphone?

fields.EN:
But there are no players to play
music with here... Not much of
a use for us, I guess...
fields.JP:
でも今の時代、そもそも音楽を
再生する機械自体がないからなぁ。
こんなの持ってても仕方ないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there are no players to play
music with here... Not much of
a use for us, I guess...

fields.EN: You don't need it too, right Jack?
fields.JP: ジャックもいらないよな？
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't need it too, right Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Well, guess we'll toss it then.
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, guess we'll toss it then.

fields.EN:
(I've never heard Shirayuki yell
so loudly before...)
fields.JP:
（びっくりした。白雪のこんな大声
　聞くなんて初めてかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never heard Snow White yell
so loudly before...)

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、その手に持って
いるものは……！

fields.EN:
Y-You mean this? Jack found it,
and we were about to throw
it away.
fields.JP:
こ、この変なイヤホン？
今そこでジャックが拾った
ガラクタだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You mean this? Jack found it,
and we were about to throw
it away.

fields.JP:
親指姉様！　ネムちゃん！
ちょっと来てくださーい！
どうしたのよ、大声出しちゃって
二人とも、これを見てください！
こ、これは伝説の三又イヤホン！！
伝説！？　そんなすごいものだったのか？

fields.EN:
Duh! It's so rare that there are
no other one like it throughout
the world!
fields.JP:
そうよ！　これは世界一周したって
見つからないレベルの、超レアなお宝！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Duh! It's so rare that there are
no other one like it throughout
the world!

fields.EN:
I never thought I'd ever see it...
It's like it was made for us
sisters to use!
fields.JP:
まさか実物を見られるとは思わなかったわ。
三人用のイヤホンなんて、まるでわたし達の
ためにあるかのようじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I never thought I'd ever see it...
It's like it was made for us
sisters to use!

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, may I ask what you were
going to do with it?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、このイヤホンは
どうするんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, may I ask what you were
going to do with it?

fields.EN:
Well, I thought we didn't need
it, so I was going to throw it
away...
fields.JP:
いや、特にいらないから捨てようと
思ってたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I thought we didn't need
it, so I was going to throw it
away...

fields.EN: Do you mind giving it to us then?!
fields.JP: 捨てるならください！　ぜひ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind giving it to us then?!

fields.JP: ありがとうございます！

fields.EN:
I'm happy to see you girls
happy.
fields.JP:
よかったね。そんなに喜んでもらえると、
こっちも嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy to see you girls
happy.

fields.EN:
(Huh, it's as if the earphone was
meant for them to have...)
fields.JP:
（ふふ、三又イヤホンか。
　まるでこの三姉妹の手に渡るために
　見つかったみたいだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh, it's as if the earphone was
meant for them to have...)

fields.EN:
So, this is the professor's
research papers...
fields.JP: これが博士の研究資料か……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this is the professor's
research papers...

fields.JP:
（なにか少しでもわかればと思ったけど、
　予想以上に難しいことばかり書いてあって、
　僕には理解不能だな）

fields.EN:
(I can at least tell it has
something to do with the
Blood Maidens...)
fields.JP:
（血式少女について気になることが
　あったんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can at least tell it has
something to do with the
Blood Maidens...)

fields.JP:
私が来ただけでそんなに驚くなんて、
不可解な反応ね

fields.EN:
S-Sorry.
You just caught me off guard.
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん。
ちょっと集中していたもので……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry.
You just caught me off guard.

fields.EN:
Well now, that's quite unusual to
see you reading through those
papers.
fields.JP:
あなたが博士の研究資料を読むなんて、
珍しいこともあったものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, that's quite unusual to
see you reading through those
papers.

fields.EN:
Is there something in there that
would detract your attention to
the surroundings that much?
fields.JP:
それほど集中するなんて、
いったいどんな興味深いことが
書いてあったのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there something in there that
would detract your attention to
the surroundings that much?

fields.EN:
I was just curious, so I was
reading through them, but I have
no clue what it's trying to say.
fields.JP:
いや、この内容は僕にはさっぱりだよ。
ただちょっと気になることがあって、
調べたいと思ってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just curious, so I was
reading through them, but I have
no clue what it's trying to say.

fields.EN:
Earlier, Cinderella said, 'At least
seven Blood Maidens are needed.' I was
wondering why it had to be seven...
fields.JP:
前にシンデレラが言っていた、
「血式少女は最低７人必要」って話。
あれはなんで７人だったのかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella brought up that the
professor wanted seven Blood
Maidens...

fields.EN:
So I was hoping to find out why,
but the content is too hard for
me to decipher.
fields.JP:
それで博士の研究資料を読んでみたん
だけど、僕には難しすぎたみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I was hoping to find out why,
but the content is too hard for
me to decipher.

fields.EN:
Seven...
I think I know why.
fields.JP:
なぜ７人か、ね……。
たぶん私はその理由を知っているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seven...
I think I know why.

fields.EN:
It's only a theory. After all, the
professor is dead and there's no
way to confirm at this point.
fields.JP:
たぶん、よ。博士から直接聞いたわけでは
ないし、当の本人も死んでしまっているから
確認のしようもないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's only a theory. After all, the
professor is dead and there's no
way to confirm at this point.

fields.EN:
But, I can still theorize based on
context to come up with a
possible reason.
fields.JP:
推論の域を出ないけど、ある程度論理的な
仮説なら話せるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I can still theorize based on
context to come up with a
possible reason.

fields.EN:
That's better than nothing.
Can you tell me why?
fields.JP: それでもいい。教えてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's better than nothing.
Can you tell me why?

fields.JP: 研究資料の、この部分を見て

fields.EN:
You see how the papers mention
that there are seven prison areas
that need to be explored?
fields.JP:
いい？　いずれ進行しなければならない
独房エリアは「７つ」と記載されているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You see how the papers mention
that there are seven prison areas
that need to be explored?

fields.EN:
This leads to one possible
conclusion. Do you need me to
tell you that?
fields.JP:
このことから得られる結論は一つ。
……もうわかるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This leads to one possible
conclusion. Do you need me to
tell you that?

fields.EN:
Um... The number of Blood Maidens
and the areas are the same, so...
fields.JP:
えっと……。
必要な血式少女と独房エリアの数が
同じ……ということは……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... The number of Blood Maidens
and the areas are the same, so...

fields.EN:
(I have a hunch where this is
leading to, but at the same time
I don't want to know already...)
fields.JP:
（わかりたくないけど、わかる気がする。
　でも、まさかそんなことが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have a hunch where this is
leading to, but at the same time
I don't want to know already...)

fields.EN:
At this rate, we may not need
to fight.
fields.JP: この分なら、私達は戦わずに済むかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this rate, we may not need
to fight.

fields.EN:
(I hoped her theory isn't what
just dawned on me, but...)
fields.JP: （ああ……やっぱりそういうことか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hoped her theory isn't what
just dawned on me, but...)

fields.EN:
One Blood Maiden would be
sacrificed at each prison area...
fields.JP:
……つまり、一つの独房エリアにつき、
血式少女一人を犠牲にするという計算か
fields.LOCALIZED:
One Blood Maiden would be
sacrificed at each prison area...

fields.EN:
It's only my theory. But it doesn't
seem the professor thought of the Blood
Maidens as mere disposable pawns either.
fields.JP:
あくまでも私の推論だけど。
でも、博士も血式少女を単なる使い捨ての駒と
考えていたわけではなさそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just a theory... That said,
the professor at least thought
about the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Look here... It's his notes
in relation to Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
ここにブラッドスケルターに
関する記述があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look here... It's his notes
in relation to Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
"Be wary of the Blood Maiden's
stress levels to avoid the
dangers of Blood Skelter..."
fields.JP:
本当だ。「ブラッドスケルター化のリスクを
考慮すると、血式少女に過度のストレスを
与えるべきではない」……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Be wary of the Blood Maiden's
stress levels to avoid the
dangers of Blood Skelter..."

fields.EN:
It also says to prioritize your
needs, so at the very least you
girls weren't guinea pigs to him.
fields.JP:
研究時以外は可能な限り彼女たちの意思を
尊重する方針を取る、とも書いてあるわ。
モルモットのように扱われなくてよかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also says to prioritize your
needs, so at the very least you
girls weren't guinea pigs to him.

fields.EN:
That would explain why we had
so much freedom and perks
while there...
fields.JP:
だから僕達は自由が与えられて、
待遇もよかったわけか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would explain why we had
so much freedom and perks
while there...

fields.EN:
(I suppose I should be happy,
but if what Gretel theorized is
true, that would mean...)
fields.JP:
（それはありがたいことだ。
　だけど、もしもグレーテルが考えたような
　理由だったとしたら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose I should be happy,
but if what Gretel theorized is
true, that would mean...)

fields.EN:
(We were only irreplaceable pawns
to him to be used when needed...)
fields.JP:
（ただの捨て駒ではないけど、
　「代えの利かない捨て駒」として
　扱われていたってことじゃないか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We were only irreplaceable pawns
to him to be used when needed...)

fields.EN:
Gretel, you mind I ask you a
favor? Can you please keep this
a secret to Princess?
fields.JP:
……グレーテル、頼みがある。
この話は姫には黙っていてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, you mind I ask you a
favor? Can you please keep this
a secret to Princess?

fields.EN:
Hm, how about in exchange for
some sweets?
fields.JP: そうね、甘い物で手を打ってもいいわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, how about in exchange for
some sweets?

fields.EN:
I have no reason to keep it
secret from her. My offer is a
win-win for us both, yes?
fields.JP:
私には人魚姫に黙っていなければ
ならない理由がないもの。
ウィンウィンでいきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no reason to keep it
secret from her. My offer is a
win-win for us both, yes?

fields.EN:
Really?
This is a win-win situation?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?
This is a win-win situation?

fields.EN:
If you have a problem with
that, negotiations are over, you know?
fields.JP: 文句があるなら交渉決裂だけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no obligation to keep
what I know secret.

fields.EN:
F-Fine... I'll get you some
sweets then.
fields.JP: わ、わかったよ。甘い物だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine... I'll get you some
sweets then.

fields.EN:
(Gretel may be kind at heart,
but she sure is wily, too...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルって思慮深いかと思えば、
　ときどきちゃっかりしてるよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel may be kind at heart,
but she sure is wily, too...)

fields.JP: （ああ、いつ聞いても姫の歌声は最高だな……）
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(Jack is focused on her singing,
too. I guess her singing does
resonate with Nightmares.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックも相変わらず熱心に聞いてるし。
　姫の歌の素晴らしさはナイトメアにも
　通じるってことだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jack is focused on her singing,
too. I guess her singing does
resonate with Nightmares.)

fields.EN:
(I feel like all the toils and
burdens melt away when listening
to her sing...)
fields.JP:
（大変なことも辛いこともたくさんあるけど、
　姫の歌声を聞くだけで全部癒されていく
　気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel like all the toils and
burdens melt away when listening
to her sing...)

fields.EN: Shhh! You need to keep quiet.
fields.LOCALIZED: Shhh! You need to keep quiet.

fields.EN:
(I hear something... Maybe I'm
just hearing things amid
Princess's beautiful song...)
fields.JP:
（？　今、誰かの話し声がしなかったか？
　姫の歌に集中してたから
　よく聞き取れなかったけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hear something... Maybe I'm
just hearing things amid
Princess's beautiful song...)

fields.EN:
(Hm? What are those three
hiding there for?)
fields.JP:
（あの三人、なんであんなところで
　こそこそ隠れてるんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? What are those three
hiding there for?)

fields.JP: やあ、こんなところでなにしてるんだ？

fields.EN:
Same here. I didn't expect
you girls to be so surprised.
fields.JP:
いや、こっちもびっくりしたよ。
そんなに驚くなんて思わなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. I didn't expect
you girls to be so surprised.

fields.EN:
Huh? Rapu-chan? Cinderella-san?
Nemu-chan? What are you all...?
fields.JP:
え……っ？　ラプちゃんにシンデレラさんに
ねむちゃん？　どうしてここに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Rappy? Cinderella?
Sleepy? What are you all...?

fields.JP: あー！　うたうのやめちゃったぁ

fields.EN:
Yes, we would love to hear
more of your singing.
fields.JP: そうですわ。もっと聞きたかったですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we would love to hear
more of your singing.

fields.EN:
Hm? You three came here to
hear her sing? Why do you
need to hide like this?
fields.JP:
ん？　君達は姫の歌を聞きに
来てたってことか？
なら、どうしてこそこそしてたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? You three came here to
hear her sing? Why do you
need to hide like this?

fields.JP: だってにんぎょ、はずかしがりやだもん！

fields.EN: She did run off the last time.
fields.JP: 前は逃げられてしまいましたものね
fields.LOCALIZED: She did run off the last time.

fields.EN:
We tried to approach
Ningyohime to hear her sing before.
fields.JP:
以前も人魚姫の歌声にひかれて、
もっとよく聞きたくて近くまで
行ったことがありましたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We tried to approach Little
Mermaid to hear her sing before.

fields.EN:
But, she ran off saying she was
embarrassed singing in front
of us.
fields.JP:
でもそのときはわたし達の前で
歌うことを恥ずかしがって、
逃げてしまったのですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she ran off saying she was
embarrassed singing in front
of us.

fields.JP: そんなことがあったんだ……

fields.EN:
W-Well, I'm not used to singing
in front of everyone, so I was too
embarrassed to sing...
fields.JP:
だ、だって、あんまりみんなに
注目されると緊張するし、
恥ずかしいし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I'm not used to singing
in front of everyone, so I was too
embarrassed to sing...

fields.EN: Which is why we were hiding.
fields.JP: だから隠れて聞いていたんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Which is why we were hiding.

fields.EN:
(Not surprising at all... She does
get embarrassed, even when
it's only me listening.)
fields.JP:
（たしかに、聞いているのが僕だけでも
　よく照れてるもんな。他のみんなの
　前では緊張しちゃうのも当然か）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not surprising at all... She does
get embarrassed, even when
it's only me listening.)

fields.EN:
(I suppose her singing in front of
me is proof that I'm special to
her.)
fields.JP:
（それでも僕の前では歌ってくれるってことは、
　やっぱり僕は姫の特別なんだって自惚れても
　いいのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose her singing in front of
me is proof that I'm special to
her.)

fields.EN:
Ningyo sing really good.
Why embarrassed?
fields.JP:
にんぎょのうた、すっごくじょーずだよ？
なんではずかしいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fishy sing really good.
Why embarrassed?

fields.JP: だって……わたし、オンチだし……

fields.EN:
You're better than good!
Your singing is better than anyone
around!
fields.JP:
オンチだなんて、とんでもない！
姫の歌声は他の誰よりも素晴らしいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're better than good!
Your singing is better than anyone
around!

fields.EN:
Hold confidence, Princess.
I would love to see you grace
everyone with your singing.
fields.JP:
姫は自分の歌に自信を持っていいよ。
僕は姫の歌声をもっとたくさんの人に
聞いてもらいたいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold confidence, Princess.
I would love to see you grace
everyone with your singing.

fields.EN:
Indeed. I'm sure hearing
everyone's praise will give the
needed boost to her confidence.
fields.JP:
それはいいですわね。たくさんの人に
ほめられれば、人魚姫も自信を
持てるようになると思いますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I'm sure hearing
everyone's praise will give the
needed boost to her confidence.

fields.EN:
I like Ningyo's song!
Makes me happy!
fields.JP:
にんぎょのうた、すき！
きいてると、しあわせなきもちになる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like Fishy's song!
Makes me happy!

fields.EN:
Your singing should be heard
by the masses.
fields.JP:
人魚姫の歌はもっと多くの人に
聞いてもらうべきレベルですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your singing should be heard
by the masses.

fields.EN:
See? I like your singing, too.
How about singing for everyone
once in awhile?
fields.JP:
みんなもこう言ってるし、
僕も姫の歌が大好きだな。どう？
みんなの前で堂々と歌ってみたら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? I like your singing, too.
How about singing for everyone
once in awhile?

fields.EN:
No! I can't! And please, don't
praise me like this!
This is so embarrassing!
fields.JP:
いやーっ！　やっぱり無理
そんなに褒めないで恥ずかしいーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! I can't! And please, don't
praise me like this!
This is so embarrassing!

fields.EN:
P-Princess?! S-She ran off...?
Was she that embarrassed?
fields.JP:
ひ、姫！？　え、逃げ出しちゃうほど
恥ずかしかったのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Princess?! S-She ran off...?
Was she that embarrassed?

fields.JP: あー、またにげられちゃったー

fields.EN:
She really is shy when it comes
to her singing, isn't she?
fields.JP: 歌のことになると、本当にシャイですわねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She really is shy when it comes
to her singing, isn't she?

fields.EN:
I completely misread her.
I didn't expect her to be that
embarrassed...
fields.JP:
まさかここまで恥ずかしがるなんて……。
姫の奥ゆかしさを甘く見てたな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I completely misread her.
I didn't expect her to be that
embarrassed...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
We can hear Princess sing
some other time...
fields.JP: 姫の歌は、また次の機会にね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can hear Princess sing
some other time...

fields.EN:
Everything I do feels futile...
I just don't feel like I'm doing
anything now...
fields.JP:
最近気が滅入ってしまって……
なにをやっていても憂鬱なんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everything I do feels futile...
I just don't feel like I'm doing
anything now...

fields.EN:
I recommend you take some time
off, and take a sip of tea to calm
yourself.
fields.JP:
そういう時はお茶でも飲んで、
一度気分をリセットするのがいいですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I recommend you take some time
off, and take a sip of tea to calm
yourself.

fields.JP: ん？　一緒にいるのは……

fields.EN:
Wait... Isn't that the person who
was causing trouble to the three
sisters?
fields.JP:
この前、三姉妹に絡んでた
信者じゃないか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Isn't that the person who
was causing trouble to the three
sisters?

fields.EN:
You're right...
But, they seem to be getting
along fine.
fields.JP:
本当だ……
でも、なんだか仲良さそうだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
But, they seem to be getting
along fine.

fields.EN: I thought he didn't like us.
fields.JP:
あの信者は僕たちのことを
嫌っていると思ってたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I thought he didn't like us.

fields.EN:
Oh, that's just Hikari doing
her thing there.
fields.JP: ああ、ありゃヒカリの特技だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's just Hikari doing
her thing there.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: ヒカリの特技って、なんだいそれ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.JP: なんだと言われても見ての通りだよ

fields.EN:
Whether they're good or bad, angry or crying,
before they know it they open up to Hikari.
fields.JP:
そいつが良いやつでも嫌なやつでも、
怒っていようが泣いていようが、
いつの間にかヒカリに腹を割っちまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter who it is, everyone
seems to rely on Hikari.

fields.EN:
It's probably because Hikari herself
always opens her heart to everyone she meets.
fields.JP:
たぶん、ヒカリ本人がいつでも誰にでも
心を開いて接してるからだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's because she earnestly
listens to anything that comes
by her.

fields.EN:
That's amazing! Come to think of
it, we always feel a lot better
with Hikari-chan around.
fields.JP:
素敵な特技だね！
確かに、わたしたちもヒカリちゃんの優しさには
いつも心癒されてる気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's amazing! Come to think of
it, we always feel a lot better
with Hikari around.

fields.EN:
But, it freaks the heck out of me
when I see her.
fields.JP: 見てるこっちはヒヤヒヤしてしょうがねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it freaks the heck out of me
when I see her.

fields.EN:
She doesn't know how to doubt
people. She's just gullible,
that's all.
fields.JP:
あいつは人を疑うってことを知らない。
お人好しすぎるんだよ、まったく
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't know how to doubt
people. She's just gullible,
that's all.

fields.EN:
I see. Which is why you come and
see her like this to make sure
nothing is wrong.
fields.JP:
なるほど。だからマモルはこうやって
いつもヒカリを見守ってるのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Which is why you come and
see her like this to make sure
nothing is wrong.

fields.EN: I was just doing my rounds...
fields.JP: み、見回りのついでだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I was just doing my rounds...

fields.JP: まあ、そういうことにしておこうか

fields.EN:
Still, being so approachable
