is like a special skill that only
she can use.
fields.JP:
しかし、どんな相手も心を開かせるなんて
考え方によっちゃすごい特技だな。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, being so approachable
is like a special skill that only
she can use.

fields.EN: If only she only seduced people...
fields.JP: 人だけだったらよかったんだけどな……
fields.LOCALIZED: If only she only seduced people...

fields.EN:
Thank you very much. I feel
a lot better now.
Now then, if you'll excuse me...
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます
すこし、楽になりました
それでは失礼します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much. I feel
a lot better now.
Now then, if you'll excuse me...

fields.EN:
No problem at all!
Don't push yourself too hard,
you hear?
fields.JP: いえいえ、あまり無理しないでくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem at all!
Don't push yourself too hard,
you hear?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack? Hameln's familiar?
What brings you here?
fields.JP:
ジャック、それにしもべさんも
どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Hameln's familiar?
What brings you here?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
That must have hurt. You must be sad. If you
can, I hope you won't think badly of everyone.
fields.JP:
つらかったね。悲しいよね。
もし、できることならみんなのこと
悪く思わないであげてほしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must have been painful... If
anything, I can only hope that you
won't let it bother you too much.

fields.EN:
I don't think anyone hates you
folks. It's just that everyone is
anxious of the situation.
fields.JP:
みんなはただ不安なだけなんだよ
ジャックたちのことを嫌ってる
わけじゃないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think anyone hates you
folks. It's just that everyone is
anxious of the situation.

fields.EN:
Don't worry. At least we know
that you're really kind, Jack.
fields.JP:
大丈夫。私たちはジャックが
優しい人だってちゃんと分かってる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. At least we know
that you're really kind, Jack.

fields.EN:
This applies to all our kind
familiars, too. You're all our
friends.
fields.JP:
しもべさん達も、いつも頑張ってくれてる
私達の大切な仲間だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This applies to all our kind
familiars, too. You're all our
friends.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
You're very welcome. Oh, would
you like to come to the infirmary?
We can have some tea.
fields.JP:
どういたしまして
あ、診療所に来る？
一緒にお茶飲もうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're very welcome. Oh, would
you like to come to the infirmary?
We can have some tea.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Okay, to the infirmary we go!
fields.JP: じゃあ、診療所にれっつごー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, to the infirmary we go!

fields.EN:
Why is she able to communicate
with Jack and the familiars?
fields.JP:
なんでジャックやしもべたちと
意思疎通ができてるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why is she able to communicate
with Jack and the familiars?

fields.EN:
Beats me. Last time I asked, she
told me that it's just a hunch.
fields.JP:
分からん。あいつが言うには、
『なんとなく分かる』らしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beats me. Last time I asked, she
told me that it's just a hunch.

fields.EN:
Thanks to that, lately she's
been hugely popular not only with
humans, but with nonhumans too.
fields.JP:
おかげで最近は人間だけじゃなくて、
人間以外からも大人気だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess that would explain why
Jack and the familiars are all
so attached to her...

fields.EN:
Is it just me, or does Hikari
have powers even greater than
Blood Maidens...?
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、僕ら血式少女よりも
ヒカリの方がすごいんじゃないかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it just me, or does Hikari
have powers even greater than
Blood Maidens...?

fields.EN:
No, not a chance.
You can come up with a better
nickname than that.
fields.JP:
嫌だよそんなあだ名。
もうちょっとマシなのにしてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, not a chance.
You can come up with a better
nickname than that.

fields.EN:
You sure? I thought the nickname
was pretty cool.
fields.JP:
そうかなぁ？
けっこういいと思ったんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sure? I thought the nickname
was pretty cool.

fields.EN:
I'd appreciate it if you put a
bit more thought into it...
fields.JP:
そんな適当な思いつきじゃなくて、
もうちょっと考えてつけてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd appreciate it if you put a
bit more thought into it...

fields.JP: えー、そこまでいうことないでしょう

fields.EN:
Looks like you're having fun
here.
fields.JP: 二人とも、随分楽しそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're having fun
here.

fields.EN:
Well, if it isn't the three
sisters.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if it isn't the three
sisters.

fields.EN:
What timing. Can you girls
back me up here?
fields.JP:
ちょうどいいところに来てくれた。
君たちからも言ってやってくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What timing. Can you girls
back me up here?

fields.EN: Um, what are you talking about?
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, what are you talking about?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan says the nickname I went to all
that trouble to give her has terrible taste.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんがさ、せっかくつけてあげた
あだ名をセンスが悪いって言うのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She said that the nickname I made
for her is horrible.

fields.EN:
I didn't say that. I'm just asking
you to put a bit more thought
into it.
fields.JP:
そこまでは言ってないよ。
もっとこう、考えてつけてくれと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't say that. I'm just asking
you to put a bit more thought
into it.

fields.EN:
Hm... A nickname?
Sounds fun. Why don't you make
one for me?
fields.JP:
ふーん。あだ名ね……面白そうじゃない
わたしにもつけてみてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... A nickname?
Sounds fun. Why don't you make
one for me?

fields.EN:
Shirayuki would like to get a
nickname, too!
fields.JP: 白雪もあだ名をつけてもらいたいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White would like to get a
nickname, too!

fields.EN:
Heh, well now, guess I gotta
get a bit more serious here!
fields.JP:
いやぁ、そんな風に期待されると、、
あたしもはりきっちゃうなぁ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, well now, guess I gotta
get a bit more serious here!

fields.EN:
Now then, let me see...
Hm...
fields.JP:
じゃあ、気合入れてつけるわよー
えーっと……ちょっと待ってねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let me see...
Hm...

fields.EN:
Don't come up with any weird
one, you hear?
fields.JP: あんまり変なの付けるんじゃないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't come up with any weird
one, you hear?

fields.JP: なんだか、ドキドキします……
はい！　ととのいました！
なんだその合いの手は……

fields.EN:
Uh, that's a lot different from
what you gave me...
fields.JP: 僕の時とずいぶん違うんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, that's a lot different from
what you gave me...

fields.EN:
Huh? Um, is the "noise" pointing
to how loud and clumsy I am?
fields.JP:
え……それって、白雪が
おっちょこちょいだからですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Um, is the "noise" pointing
to how loud and clumsy I am?

fields.EN:
I've got a bad feeling
about this...
fields.JP: なんだか急に嫌な予感がしてきたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've got a bad feeling
about this...

fields.JP: はぁっ！？　なによそれ！
あはははっ、ぴったりじゃないか！

fields.EN:
Heh heh... I-I'm sorry,
Oyayubi-neesama... But, that's
actually... Heh heh...
fields.JP:
んふふふっ……
ご、ごめんなさい親指姉さま……
だめって分かってるんですけど……うぷぷっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... I-I'm sorry, sister
Thumbelina... But, that's
actually... Heh heh...

fields.EN:
Heh... It suits you
perfectly, Oyayubi-neesama.
fields.JP: んふっ……親指姉さまにピッタリ

fields.EN:
Why are you all laughing too?! I'm the
eldest daughter! I'm the oldest, you know?!
fields.JP:
あんた達まで何笑ってるのよ！
わたしは長女よ！　一番年上なのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop laughing!
I'm the oldest here!
And, I'm not tiny!

fields.EN:
You got me...
That's a brilliant nickname,
Kaede.
fields.JP:
いや、ほんと……
カエデ、ナイスなあだ名だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got me...
That's a brilliant nickname,
Kaede.

fields.EN:
Urrh...!
You're all asking for it!
fields.JP:
うぐぐぐっ……！
いいわ！　あんたら全員覚悟しなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh...!
You're all asking for it!

fields.JP: やばっ、逃げるよみんな！
わわっ、こりゃまずいっ
ご、ごめんなさい親指姉さまぁ！
ごめんな……さい……うぷぷっ
まちなさい！　こらー！
ナイトメア・ジャック
なんだジャック、クレヨンを見つけたって？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Oh, that's not a crayon.
It's a lipstick.
fields.JP:
ああ、それはクレヨンじゃないよ。
口紅っていうんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's not a crayon.
It's a lipstick.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
It's a cosmetic that's used on
lips. Girls used to apply it
as part of their makeup.
fields.JP:
唇に塗る化粧品だよ。
昔の女性はこういうもので
身だしなみを整えていたらしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a cosmetic that's used on
lips. Girls used to apply it
as part of their makeup.

fields.EN:
Hm, maybe I can give this to
Princess. She's beautiful as-is,
but I'm sure she'd like this.
fields.JP:
そうだ。これを姫にプレゼントしようかな。
姫は化粧なんかしなくても十分美しいけど、
こういうのって女の子が喜びそうだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, maybe I can give this to
Princess. She's beautiful as-is,
but I'm sure she'd like this.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Hm? Cinderella?
Did you find something?
fields.JP:
あ、シンデレラ。
なにかいい物でも見つかったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Cinderella?
Did you find something?

fields.EN:
W-Why yes... And, it's in your
hand, Otsuu.
fields.JP:
は、はい……っ。今、まさに目の前に、
おつうの手の中に……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Why yes... And, it's in your
hand, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
In my hand? Oh, you mean this
lipstick?
fields.LOCALIZED:
In my hand? Oh, you mean this
lipstick?

fields.EN:
Please! Can you please give that
to me?!
fields.JP:
お願いですわ、どうかそれを
ゆずってくださいませんか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please! Can you please give that
to me?!

fields.EN:
(I was going to give it to
Princess...)
fields.JP:
（姫へのプレゼントにって
　思ってたんだけどなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was going to give it to
Princess...)

fields.EN:
Um, do you mind I ask why
you want it?
fields.JP:
えーと、どうして口紅が欲しいのか
聞いてもいいか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, do you mind I ask why
you want it?

fields.EN:
Just like accessories and one
other item, cosmetics are
essential in making one beautiful.
fields.JP:
お化粧品は、アクセサリーと並んで
自分をきれいにきかざるための
三種の神器だからですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just like accessories and one
other item, cosmetics are
essential in making one beautiful.

fields.EN:
Lipsticks are rare to come by, so
I do hope you can give me that!
Please, Otsuu!
fields.JP:
口紅なんてめったに手に入らない貴重品ですわ。
どうしてもそれが欲しいんですの。
お願いしますわ、おつう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lipsticks are rare to come by, so
I do hope you can give me that!
Please, Otsuu!

fields.EN:
(I don't know if she knows how to
use this, but she seems serious...)
fields.JP:
（子どもが使うものじゃないけど、
　こうも熱心に頼まれると……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't know if she knows how to
use this, but she seems serious...)

fields.EN:
Fine. Not that I was going to
use it myself, so... here.
fields.JP:
……わかった。
どうせ僕には必要ないものだし、いいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine. Not that I was going to
use it myself, so... here.

fields.EN:
Thank you so very much!
Aah! I couldn't be happier!
fields.JP:
ありがとうございますっ！
ああ、とってもうれしいですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you so very much!
Aah! I couldn't be happier!

fields.JP: 喜んでもらえてよかったよ

fields.EN:
(It would've been great to see
Princess use it, but I bet she
would've given it to Cinderella.)
fields.JP:
（姫が口紅をつけたところも
　見てみたかったけど、きっと姫でも
　同じ行動をとっていただろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It would've been great to see
Princess use it, but I bet she
would've given it to Cinderella.)

fields.EN:
(Speaking of, I wonder what
Cinderella meant by
"one other item?")
fields.JP:
（ところで三種の神器の残り一つは
　なんだったんだろう。ちょっと気になる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Speaking of, I wonder what
Cinderella meant by
"one other item?")

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
You found some clothes?
Let me see...
fields.JP: 服があったって？　どれどれ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You found some clothes?
Let me see...

fields.JP: ああっ！　そ、その服は……っ！
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(A red colored, hooded parka?!
This is perfect!)
fields.JP:
（いい感じのフード付きパーカー、
　しかも色は赤！
　この服は彼女にぴったりだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A red colored, hooded parka?!
This is perfect!)

fields.JP:
赤ずきん！　赤ずきーん！
ちょっとこっち来てー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood! Red Riding Hood!
Come over here!

fields.JP: そんな大声で呼んで、なにかあった？
これ！　この服！　ジャックが見つけたんだ！

fields.EN:
This would look perfect on you.
See? Even the design is a
perfect match to you.
fields.JP:
これ、君に似合いそうだと思ったんだ。
どう？　こういうデザイン、好きでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This would look perfect on you.
See? Even the design is a
perfect match to you.

fields.EN:
This is amazing! The shape and
size of the hood is perfect!
The red is right up my alley, too!
fields.JP:
わぁ、すごくいいよ、この服！
フードの形や大きさも最高だし、
赤い色も情熱的であたし好みだし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is amazing! The shape and
size of the hood is perfect!
The red is right up my alley, too!

fields.EN: So, you mind I have this?!
fields.JP: ねぇ、この服もらっちゃっていいの！？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, you mind I have this?!

fields.EN:
Of course. You're fine too,
right Jack?
fields.JP: もちろんだよ。ジャックも構わないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. You're fine too,
right Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Great! Wow, you just made my day!
I never expected to come across
something as good as this!
fields.JP:
やったー！　うわぁ、めちゃくちゃ嬉しい！
こんなのが見つかるなんて思わなかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great! Wow, you just made my day!
I never expected to come across
something as good as this!

fields.JP: おつう、ジャック、ありがとう！！

fields.EN: I'm glad to see you happy.
fields.JP: そんなに喜んでもらえると、こっちも嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad to see you happy.

fields.EN:
(It's been awhile since I saw her
this happy. I'm glad she can still
put a smile on her face.)
fields.JP:
（こんな無邪気に喜ぶ赤ずきんを見るのは
　久しぶりだな。最近沈みがちだったから、
　笑顔が見られてよかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's been awhile since I saw her
this happy. I'm glad she can still
put a smile on her face.)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ジャック！？　どうかしたのか！？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
A large cloth fell on your head?
Are you okay?
fields.JP:
大きな布が頭の上に落ちてきたのか。
大丈夫だったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A large cloth fell on your head?
Are you okay?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I don't blame you for being
surprised. Hm, is this some kind
of bed sheet?
fields.JP:
そりゃ驚くよな、
こんな大きい布が降ってきたら。
元はシーツかなにかか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't blame you for being
surprised. Hm, is this some kind
of bed sheet?

fields.EN:
It's a bit tough and old...
Not that we need it, so let's
just leave it here.
fields.JP:
でもごわごわしてて、すごく古そうだな。
使い道もないし、持ち帰る必要はないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a bit tough and old...
Not that we need it, so let's
just leave it here.

fields.EN:
Oh? Did you find something
interesting?
fields.JP: あら、なにかめぼしい物でも見つかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Did you find something
interesting?

fields.EN:
Not at all. Just a plain old cloth
that fell on Jack's head.
fields.JP:
いや、めぼしくはないんだけどね。
この古い布がジャックの上に降ってきてさぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. Just a plain old cloth
that fell on Jack's head.

fields.EN:
Wha-?! You took that out of my
hand before I knew it!
fields.JP: って、早っ！　今、一瞬で布奪ってったね！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! You took that out of my
hand before I knew it!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
二人とも、この布はテーブルクロスよ

fields.EN:
You use it to cover a table with.
It's an essential piece to
have a tea party.
fields.JP:
これをテーブルの上にかけて使うの。
お茶会のときには欠かせないアイテムよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You use it to cover a table with.
It's an essential piece to
have a tea party.

fields.EN:
The way it's draped can make a
huge difference with how the tea
party will fare.
fields.JP:
テーブルクロスのかけ方にもいろいろあって、
お茶会を盛り上げる影の立役者と言っても
過言ではないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The way it's draped can make a
huge difference with how the tea
party will fare.

fields.JP: （アリス、だんだん熱が入ってきてる……）

fields.EN:
This is no ordinary cloth, that's
for sure! It's very precious!
fields.JP:
そういうわけで、この布は
ただの古い布じゃないわ。
とても価値のある物なのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is no ordinary cloth, that's
for sure! It's very precious!

fields.EN:
If you don't have any use for
it, do you mind I have it instead?
fields.JP:
いらないなら、これはわたしが
もらってもいいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't have any use for
it, do you mind I have it instead?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Sure, not like we'd use it.
I think it's best in your caring
hands, Alice.
fields.JP:
うん。特に使うわけでもないし、
この布はアリスが持っていたほうが
いいみたいだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, not like we'd use it.
I think it's best in your caring
hands, Alice.

fields.EN:
Thank you! I'm going to wash it
clean the moment we return.
fields.JP:
ありがとう……！
帰ったらこのテーブルクロスを
きれいに洗濯してみるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you! I'm going to wash it
clean the moment we return.

fields.EN:
I hope someday I can use this and have
a wonderful tea party with Jack. Hee hee...
fields.JP:
そのうち、これを使ってジャックと
素敵なお茶会ができたらいいな。ふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look forward to the tea party
I'll prepare using this.

fields.EN:
A piece of paper?
There's something written on it.
fields.JP: 紙きれ……？　なにか書いてあるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
A piece of paper?
There's something written on it.

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、どうしたの？
なにかいい物でも見つけたとか？

fields.EN:
Oh, I just happened to step on
this piece of paper. Looks like
some kind of memo...
fields.JP:
姫、赤ずきん。
今、この紙きれを拾ったんだ。
なにかのメモみたいなんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I just happened to step on
this piece of paper. Looks like
some kind of memo...

fields.JP: なんて書いてあったの？

fields.EN:
It's a bit smudged and hard to
read, but... It looks like some
adventurer wrote it.
fields.JP:
ちょっと文字が薄れて読みにくいけど、
えーと……。昔ここを冒険した人の備忘録が
書かれてるみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a bit smudged and hard to
read, but... It looks like some
adventurer wrote it.

fields.EN:
That's helpful. But who
left a memo like this for us?
fields.JP:
へぇ、ありがたいね。
でも誰がそんなメモを残して
くれたんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That may prove useful.
But, why would someone leave a
memo here?

fields.JP: うーん……。たしかに謎だね

fields.EN:
Say, you mind I take a look
at it?
fields.JP: ……ねぇ、それ、もうちょっとよく見せて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, you mind I take a look
at it?

fields.JP:
（赤ずきん、真剣な顔でメモを
　観察してるな……）

fields.EN:
I knew it... I recall seeing
something like this before.
fields.JP:
……やっぱりだ。
あたし、前にこれと似たようなメモを
見たことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it... I recall seeing
something like this before.

fields.EN:
Yup. I found a similar memo back
when I was exploring a prison
area. I gave that one to Dad.
fields.JP:
うん。前に独房エリアを探索している時に
見つけて、お父さんに渡したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I found a similar memo back
when I was exploring a prison
area. I gave that one to Dad.

fields.EN:
He said it might be a memo left
by someone from the old Dawn
for adventurers who came later.
fields.JP:
そしたら、昔の黎明の人が
後の冒険者のために残したメモ
じゃないかって言ってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that the memo was
probably something left behind
for others to follow.

fields.EN:
At least that's what Dad said.
He had no proof, but I believe
what he said.
fields.JP:
証拠はないけどね。
でもお父さんはそういう風に考えてたよ。
あたしもそうだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least that's what Dad said.
He had no proof, but I believe
what he said.

fields.EN:
I guess many have tried to escape
from here before. This memo must
be a historic relic of sorts...
fields.JP:
今までもたくさんの人達がジェイル脱獄を
目指してきたんだな。そのメモは歴史的な
遺物みたいなものなのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess many have tried to escape
from here before. This memo must
be a historic relic of sorts...

fields.EN:
I wonder what happened to
the person who left this memo...
fields.JP:
そのメモを残してくれた人は
どうなったんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what kind of person
left this memo...

fields.EN:
I don't know. They may have
made it back safely, or they may
have left and never returned.
fields.JP:
わからない。
無事に帰ってきたかもしれないし、
行ったきり戻れなかったかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows? That person may have
survived, or maybe died along the
way.

fields.EN:
Even though they were in danger themselves,
they desperately left this memo behind. I
wonder what they must have been feeling...
fields.JP:
自分も危険にさらされているのに、
その中でも必死にこのメモを残してくれたんだ。
いったいどんな想いだったんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoever it is, the person left the
memo amid their own perils.
A lot must have happened...

fields.EN:
Maybe they wanted to leave later adventurers
even a little knowledge... and entrust us with
what they couldn't accomplish themselves.
fields.JP:
後の冒険者に少しでも知識を遺そうとして……。
自分が果たせなかったことを
あたし達に託したかったのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that person knew they
wouldn't make it, so they left
it behind for the future.

fields.EN:
You may be right...
And if so, we need to do our best
to fulfill that person's will.
fields.JP:
そうかもしれない……。
僕達はその想いに報いるためにも、
がんばらないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be right...
And if so, we need to do our best
to fulfill that person's will.

fields.EN:
I'm sure we'll make it out
of here with everyone.
fields.JP:
わたし達が力を合わせれば、
きっと大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we'll make it out
of here with everyone.

fields.EN:
Yeah, and this person who wrote
the memo may have survived, too.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。それにこのメモを書いた人が
死んじゃったと決まったわけじゃないんだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and this person who wrote
the memo may have survived, too.

fields.EN:
Maybe they stubbornly
managed to survive after all?
fields.JP: 案外、しぶとく生き残ったかもしれないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may just happen to meet
the person, you know?

fields.EN: Heh, I can only hope for the best.
fields.JP: ふふっ、そうかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh, I can only hope for the best.

fields.EN:
Well, here's to hoping we make
the best use of the memo.
Now, let's get going.
fields.JP:
さあ、あたし達は先を急ごう。
このメモの情報をありがたく受け取ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, here's to hoping we make
the best use of the memo.
Now, let's get going.

fields.JP: ？　おつうちゃん、これなんだろう？

fields.EN:
Look at the wall.
There's a door like thing there.
fields.JP: ほら、この壁際。扉みたいなのがあるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at the wall.
There's a door like thing there.

fields.EN:
You're right...
I didn't notice it there.
fields.JP: 本当だ。薄汚れてて気づかなかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
I didn't notice it there.

fields.EN:
I wonder if this will lead us
to another area.
fields.JP:
開くのかな？
この向こうはなにがあるんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if this will lead us
to another area.

fields.EN:
Don't go near it, Princess.
It could be dangerous so we need
to be careful.
fields.JP:
姫、むやみに近づくのは危険だ。
ここはもっと慎重に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't go near it, Princess.
It could be dangerous so we need
to be careful.

fields.JP:
タダシイアイテムヲ、
セッテイシテクダサイ

fields.EN:
Who's that?!
Where is the voice coming from?!
fields.JP: え、今の誰だ！？　どこから声が……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who's that?!
Where is the voice coming from?!

fields.EN: SET THE CORRECT ITEM TO OPEN THE DOOR.
fields.JP:
タダシイアイテムヲ、セッテイスレバ、
トビラガヒラキマス
fields.LOCALIZED:
SET THE CORRECT ITEM
TO OPEN THE PORTAL.

fields.JP:
……ひょっとして、
この扉がしゃべったのか？

fields.EN:
It sounded really weird...
Like, it was a human, but it
didn't feel very human...
fields.JP:
変な声だったね。人間の言葉なのに、
人間の声じゃないみたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounded really weird...
Like, it was a human, but it
didn't feel very human...

fields.EN:
It said something about setting an
item, right? What item? Is this
supposed to be a trap?
fields.JP:
正しいアイテムを設定すれば扉が開く、って
言ってたよな。正しいアイテムってなんだ？
なにかの罠なのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It said something about setting an
item, right? What item? Is this
supposed to be a trap?

fields.EN: You mean the door is lying?
fields.JP: この扉が嘘をついてるってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED: You mean the door is lying?

fields.EN:
Whoa! It is talking!
Wait... It understands what we're
saying?
fields.JP:
うわっ、びっくりした。こいつ、
僕達の言ってることがわかるのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! It is talking!
Wait... It understands what we're
saying?

fields.EN:
I WAS CREATED TO ONLY
TELL THE TRUTH.
fields.JP:
ワタシハ、ウソヲツケナイヨウニ、
ツクラレテイマス
fields.LOCALIZED:
I WAS CREATED TO ONLY
TELL THE TRUTH.

fields.EN:
Created? Ah, so maybe this is
that "AI" thing people made
in the past.
fields.JP:
作られて……？
そうか、きっとこれは昔の人間が作った
『ＡＩ』ってやつなんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Created? Ah, so maybe this is
that "AI" thing people made
in the past.

fields.EN:
I don't know the details, but
it's supposed to be some computer
that can think for itself.
fields.JP:
細かくは知らないけど、
学習するコンピュータらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know the details, but
it's supposed to be some computer
that can think for itself.

fields.EN:
I heard it used to help people
back in the old days to make
everyone's life easier.
fields.JP:
昔はそういうのがたくさんあって、人間の
生活を支えていたんだって聞いたことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard it used to help people
back in the old days to make
everyone's life easier.

fields.EN:
Huh, so it must have been working
like this the whole time.
That's so amazing.
fields.JP:
へぇ、じゃあこの子はずっとここで
働いていたんだ。偉いねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, so it must have been working
like this the whole time.
That's so amazing.

fields.EN: Hm? It's not talking any more.
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? It's not talking any more.

fields.JP:
タダシイアイテムヲ、
セッテイシテクダサイ

fields.EN: It's saying the same thing again.
fields.JP: あ、また同じこと言ってる……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's saying the same thing again.

fields.EN:
Maybe it can only speak whatever
that was programmed, and doesn't
understand everything we say.
fields.JP:
人間の言葉が全部わかるわけじゃなくて、
決められたやりとりしかできないのかも
しれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it can only speak whatever
that was programmed, and doesn't
understand everything we say.

fields.EN: SET THE CORRECT ITEM TO OPEN THE DOOR.
fields.JP:
タダシイアイテムヲ、セッテイスレバ、
トビラガヒラキマス
fields.LOCALIZED:
SET THE CORRECT ITEM
TO OPEN THE PORTAL.

fields.EN:
Yes, yes, we heard.
We'll come back once we have
this "correct item" you need.
fields.JP:
はいはい、それはわかったよ。
今は正しいアイテムってのを持って
いないから、またそのうちな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, yes, we heard.
We'll come back once we have
this "correct item" you need.

fields.EN:
We better make sure we don't
forget about this. We may need
to go beyond the door.
fields.JP:
正しいものがあれば扉が開くんだね。
なにかのときのためにも、
ちゃんと覚えておこうっと
fields.LOCALIZED:
We better make sure we don't
forget about this. We may need
to go beyond the door.

fields.EN:
Indeed. We'll try the door once
we can find whatever it needs.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
正しいアイテムが手に入ったら、
この扉を開けてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. We'll try the door once
we can find whatever it needs.

fields.JP:
【西】元墓所エリア
【東】地下洞窟エリア

【西】元街道沿いエリア
【北】水族館エリア

fields.EN:
You can buy or sell items at the
general store.
fields.JP: 物資販売所では、アイテムを売買できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can buy or sell items at the
general store.

fields.EN:
Items are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to stop by
periodically.
fields.JP:
アイテムは物語の進行に応じて変更されるため、
時折り確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Items are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to stop by
periodically.

fields.EN:
You can accept work orders and
cultivate Blood Flowers at the
new Liberated District.
fields.JP:
依頼所では、ハーメルン解放地区の住人からの
依頼を受けたり、ハーメルンの下僕を使用して
血花の植付や、収穫が行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can accept work orders and
cultivate Blood Flowers at the
new Liberated District.

fields.EN:
You can obtain various rewards by
completing work orders, so take on
as many as you can.
fields.JP:
依頼を達成すると報酬が得られるため、
積極的に受けてみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can obtain various rewards by
completing work orders, so take on
as many as you can.

fields.EN:
Work orders are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to check on
them from time to time.
fields.JP:
依頼は物語の進行に応じて追加されるため、
時折確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Work orders are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to check on
them from time to time.

fields.EN:
You can strengthen Blood Maidens'
abilities at the Laboratory with
Blood Crystals gained in battle.
fields.JP:
研究室では、戦闘で手に入る『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女の能力を強化できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can strengthen Blood Maidens'
abilities at the Laboratory with
Blood Crystals gained in battle.

fields.EN:
You can also expand skill slots
and change jobs.
fields.JP:
『スキル枠拡張』では所持スキル数の増加、
『職業変更』では現在の職業を変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also expand skill slots
and change jobs.

fields.EN:
Raise and lower Blood Maidens'
levels with "Blood Devolution."
fields.JP:
『血式退化』では、血式少女のレベルを下げて
再び育て直すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Raise and lower Blood Maidens'
levels with "Blood Devolution."

fields.EN:
You can also appraise Blood Packs
and transfuse appraised Blood
Packs to the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
また、所持しているユ血液の鑑定を行い、
鑑定したユ血液の注入も行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also appraise Blood Packs
and transfuse appraised Blood
Packs to the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Use Blood Crystals to increase
the number of skill slots in
"Expand Skill Slots."
fields.JP:
スキル枠拡張では『血晶』を使用して
所持するスキル数を増やすことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Blood Crystals to increase
the number of skill slots in
"Expand Skill Slots."

fields.EN:
Once you expand your skill slots,
select "Set Skills" from the menu
to confirm.
fields.JP:
スキル枠を拡張したら、
メニューの『スキルセット』で忘れずに
スキルをセットしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once you expand your skill slots,
select "Set Skills" from the menu
to confirm.

fields.EN:
Use Blood Crystals to change
between unlocked jobs.
fields.JP:
『血晶』を使用することで、
解放されている職業に
変更することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Blood Crystals to change
between unlocked jobs.

fields.EN:
Use Job Unlock Rights and Blood
Crystals to change a Blood
Maiden's job.
fields.JP:
職業変更では、『職業解放権利』と『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女の職業を変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Job Unlock Rights and Blood
Crystals to change a Blood
Maiden's job.

fields.EN:
When you change jobs, you retain
the same level, but stats change
according to the job chosen.
fields.JP:
職業を変更すると、レベルを保持したまま
職業に応じたステータスに変化します
fields.LOCALIZED:
When you change jobs, you retain
the same level, but stats change
according to the job chosen.

fields.EN:
Various skills are available to
each job, and can be viewed via
"Skill Creation".
fields.JP:
また、その職業で習得可能なスキルが
新たに追加されるため、『スキルメイク』を
確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Various skills are available to
each job, and can be viewed via
"Skill Creation".

fields.EN:
You gain Job Unlock Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.
fields.JP:
職業解放権利は、
一定レベル上がるごとに入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain Job Unlock Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.

fields.EN:
Once a job is unlocked, you can
freely change jobs at any time.
fields.JP:
一度職業解放した職業には、
いつでも自由に変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once a job is unlocked, you can
freely change jobs at any time.

fields.EN:
You can lower a Blood Maiden's
level with Devolution Rights and
Blood Crystals.
fields.JP:
血式退化では、『退化権利』と『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女のレベルを下げられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can lower a Blood Maiden's
level with Devolution Rights and
Blood Crystals.

fields.EN:
Select the preset amount of levels
to devolve when executing Blood
Devolution.
fields.JP:
血式退化を行うと、
項目に書かれた数値分、レベルが下がります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Select the preset amount of levels
to devolve when executing Blood
Devolution.

fields.EN:
Depending on the chosen amount
to devolve, you gain CP and stat
bonuses.
fields.JP:
また、下げたレベルに応じて、
ＣＰやステータス上昇ボーナスが得られます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Depending on the chosen amount
to devolve, you gain CP and stat
bonuses.

fields.EN:
By executing Blood Devolution, you
can level a Blood Maiden again
with boosted stats.
fields.JP:
血式退化することで、強さを底上げした状態で
血式少女を育て直すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
By executing Blood Devolution, you
can level a Blood Maiden again
with boosted stats.

fields.EN:
You gain Devolution Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.
fields.JP:
退化権利は、
一定レベル上がるごとに入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain Devolution Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.

fields.EN:
Blood Packs are used to learn
Blood Pack Skills.
fields.JP:
ユ血液は、血式少女に注入すると
『ユ血液スキル』を習得させることができる
特殊なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Packs are used to learn
Blood Pack Skills.

fields.EN:
Blood Pack Appraisal is used to
appraise and determine the
content of Blood Packs.
fields.JP:
『ユ血液鑑定』を行うと、
選択したユ血液のスキルの内容を
鑑定することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Pack Appraisal is used to
appraise and determine the
content of Blood Packs.

fields.EN:
Use Blood Pack Transfusion to
learn skills. Used Blood Packs
are lost during the process.
fields.JP:
『ユ血液注入』を行うと、
鑑定済みのユ血液を消費し、
血式少女にスキルを習得させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Blood Pack Transfusion to
learn skills. Used Blood Packs
are lost during the process.

fields.EN:
Up to 99 Blood Packs can be
transfused. The more used,
the stronger the skill effect.
fields.JP:
同じユ血液は最大９９個まで注入でき、
注入した分、スキルの効果が強化されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Up to 99 Blood Packs can be
transfused. The more used,
the stronger the skill effect.

fields.EN:
You can gain Blood Packs through
Blood Farming and Blood Flowers.
fields.JP:
ユ血液は、
『ブラッドファーム』や『血花代行』で
入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can gain Blood Packs through
Blood Farming and Blood Flowers.

fields.EN:
You can strengthen gear at the
"Blood Weapon Factory" by using
Blood Crystals gained in battle.
fields.JP:
血式武器製造所では、戦闘で手に入る『血晶』を
使用して、装備品を強化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can strengthen gear at the
"Blood Weapon Factory" by using
Blood Crystals gained in battle.

fields.EN:
Your gear can be strengthened
20 times.
fields.JP: 装備品の強化は、最大２０回まで行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your gear can be strengthened
20 times.

fields.EN:
You can purge a Blood Maiden's
Corruption using Nightmare Jack's
blood through "Purge."
fields.JP:
浄化では、ナイトメア・ジャックの血液を
使用して、血式少女に溜まった
『穢れ』を浄化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can purge a Blood Maiden's
Corruption using Nightmare Jack's
blood through "Purge."

fields.EN:
Purging will deteriorate Nightmare
Jack's mind, so the number of
purges possible is limited.
fields.JP:
浄化を行うと、ナイトメア・ジャックの精神が
不安定になり、限界に達すると
浄化は行えなくなります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Purging will deteriorate Nightmare
Jack's mind, so the number of
purges possible is limited.

fields.EN:
By purging, you gain resistance
to Corruption and bonuses to the
Blood Maiden's maximum HP or SP.
fields.JP:
浄化すると、『穢れ耐性』がアップするほか、
ＨＰかＳＰの上限値にボーナスが付与されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
By purging, you gain resistance
to Corruption and bonuses to the
Blood Maiden's maximum HP or SP.

fields.EN:
The effects of purging stay until
either the Blood Maiden is KO'd,
or you leave the dungeon.
fields.JP:
浄化の効果は、血式少女が戦闘不能になる、
もしくは次にダンジョンから帰還するまでの間
持続します
fields.LOCALIZED:
The effects of purging stay until
either the Blood Maiden is KO'd,
or you leave the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Use the Left Stick to move the screen,
and use the touch screen/Right Stick to
rub the blood on the Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
浄化は、Ｌスティックで画面を動かし、
血式少女に振りかけたジャックの血液を
タッチスクリーンを通じて塗り込むことで行います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use the Left Stick to move the screen,
and use the touch screen/Right Stick to
rub the blood on the Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
The purge is successful if you
can rub all of the blood spots into
her body within a set amount of time.
fields.JP:
制限時間内に全て塗り込むことができれば、
浄化成功です
fields.LOCALIZED:
The purge is successful if you
can rub all of the blood spots into
her body within a set amount of time.

fields.EN:
Once successful, you can skip the
rubbing portion for that Blood
Maiden when conducting a purge.
fields.JP:
一度成功した血式少女は、次回から
行為を省略して浄化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once successful, you can skip the
rubbing portion for that Blood
Maiden when conducting a purge.

fields.EN:
You can use the skip feature for
the purging process on multiple
Blood Maidens to save time.
fields.JP:
省略浄化は、複数の血式少女にまとめて
行うこともできるので、活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can use the skip feature for
the purging process on multiple
Blood Maidens to save time.

fields.EN:
Free Purge is a mode where you
can conduct a purge without a
time limit.
fields.JP:
フリー浄化は、時間制限なしで
じっくり浄化できるフリーモードです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Free Purge is a mode where you
can conduct a purge without a
time limit.

fields.EN:
Note that, even if successful, no
resistance or benefits will be
gained.
fields.JP:
ただし、成功しても
『穢れ耐性』アップなどの恩恵は得られません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that, even if successful, no
resistance or benefits will be
gained.

fields.EN:
Note that, even if successful, no
resistance or benefits will be
gained.
fields.JP:
ただし、成功しても
『穢れ耐性』アップなどの
恩恵は得られません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that, even if successful, no
resistance or benefits will be
gained.

fields.EN:
You can select "Check Affection",
"Manage Storage" or "Library"
from Tsuu's Room.
fields.JP:
つうの部屋では、
『友情度チェック』、『格納庫整理』、
『ライブラリ』を行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can select "Check Affection",
"Manage Storage" or "Library"
from Otsuu's Room.

fields.EN:
Access "Check Affection" to see
the affection level between Tsuu
and the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
『友情度チェック』では、つうに対する
血式少女の友情度を確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Access "Check Affection" to see
the affection level between Otsuu
and the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Access "Manage Storage" to store
and remove items from storage,
and to sell items.
fields.JP:
『格納庫整理』では、
格納庫にアイテムを預けたり、取り出したり、
アイテムの売却ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Access "Manage Storage" to store
and remove items from storage,
and to sell items.

fields.EN:
Use "Library" to view work orders,
character profiles, the Jail
Creature Manual, and tutorials.
fields.JP:
『ライブラリ』では、依頼、ジェイル内生物図鑑、
キャラクターのプロフィール、チュートリアルを
確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use "Library" to view work orders,
character profiles, the Jail
Creature Manual, and tutorials.

fields.EN:
You can also view work orders, the
Jail Creature Manual, Profile, and tutorials
from the "Library" option in your main menu.
fields.JP:
依頼、ジェイル内生物図鑑、プロフィール、
チュートリアルは、メニューにある
『ライブラリ』でも確認することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also view work orders, the
Jail Creature Manual, Profile, and tutorials
from the "Library" option in your main menu.

fields.EN:
You can give "Surprise Items" to
any of the Blood Maidens in their
rooms.
fields.JP:
血式少女の部屋では、
『サプライズアイテム』を渡すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can give "Surprise Items" to
any of the Blood Maidens in their
rooms.

fields.EN:
There are two types of surprise
items - gifts and interior items.
fields.JP:
サプライズアイテムには、
『プレセント』と『インテリア』の２種類あります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are two types of surprise
items - gifts and interior items.

fields.EN:
Raise a Blood Maiden's affection
by giving them items. You may get
items in return, too.
fields.JP:
プレゼントを渡すことで、友情度がアップし、
プレゼントのお礼として、アイテムが貰えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Raise a Blood Maiden's affection
by giving them items. You may get
items in return, too.

fields.EN:
The level of affection can trigger
various events, open new skills,
and can affect the story, too.
fields.JP:
友情度を上げるとさまざまなイベントが発生し、
スキルを習得したり、シナリオに影響を与えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The level of affection can trigger
various events, open new skills,
and can affect the story, too.

fields.EN:
Interior items change a Blood
Maiden's room décor.
fields.JP:
また、インテリアは、
血式少女の部屋が実際に模様替えされます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interior items change a Blood
Maiden's room décor.

fields.EN:
Once you've given an interior
item, you can freely use it to redecorate.
fields.JP:
一度渡したインテリアであれば、
自由に模様替えを楽しむことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interior items can be freely
changed at any time.

fields.EN:
There are various treasures and
collection points within a dungeon
where you can obtain items.
fields.JP:
ダンジョンには、宝箱や採取ポイントなど
アイテムを入手できる場所が存在するほか、
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are various treasures and
collection points within a dungeon
where you can obtain items.

fields.EN:
There are also various Gimmicks, such as doors
opened by levers and traps that deal damage.
fields.JP:
レバーで開く扉やダメージを受けるトラップなど、
さまざまなギミックが存在します
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are also various gimmicks,
such as levers to open portals,
and perilous traps.

fields.EN:
Areas traversed are shown in the mini
map towards the left. Press the Left
Stick to swap the map size.
fields.JP:
歩いた場所の情報は、画面左の『ミニマップ』に表示
され、Ｌスティックボタンを押すと、
ミニマップの表示切替ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Areas traversed are shown in the mini
map towards the left. Press the Left
Stick to swap the map size.

fields.EN:
Press the Y Button + Down
Button to view the Detailed Map.
fields.JP:
また、Ｙボタン＋下ボタンで
『詳細マップ』の確認もできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Y Button then Down Button
to access the map details.

fields.EN:
On the Detailed Map, select a location
that has already been revealed to activate
Auto-Pilot and move there automatically.
fields.JP:
詳細マップで開示済みの場所を指定すると、
その場所まで自動で移動ができる
オートパイロットを実行できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can access Auto-Pilot in the
map details by selecting the
location you wish to move to.

fields.EN:
You can even use Auto-Pilot
across different floors.
fields.JP:
オートパイロットは階層をまたいで
使用可能なため、うまく活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can even use Auto-Pilot
across different floors.

fields.EN:
There are icons in the dungeon
marking events, items, tips, and
more.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内には、イベントが起こるポイントや
アイテムが採取できるポイント、ヒントとなる
看板など、さまざまなアイコンがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are icons in the dungeon
marking events, items, tips, and
more.

fields.EN:
Be sure to check the icons on the
map to help you on your journey.
fields.JP:
画面上に表示されるアイコンを見極め、
スムーズに探索を進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure to check the icons on the
map to help you on your journey.

fields.EN:
All areas are connected to other
areas.
fields.JP: 全てのエリアは、地続きにつながっています
fields.LOCALIZED:
All areas are connected to other
areas.

fields.EN:
For example, the Underground
Cavern is connected to the City
Streets, Aquarium Ruins, and Dorm.
fields.JP:
例えば地下洞窟エリアは、『元街道沿いエリア』
『水族館跡エリア』『旧学生街エリア』へつながり、
ダンジョン内のどこかから行くことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, the Underground
Cavern is connected to the City
Streets, Aquarium Ruins, and Dorm.

fields.EN:
Check for "sign" icons within the
dungeon to see how you can get
from one area to another.
fields.JP:
どこから新たなエリアへ行けるのかは、
ダンジョン内の『看板』アイコンで確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Check for "sign" icons within the
dungeon to see how you can get
from one area to another.

fields.EN:
Once you've reached an area, you can
travel directly to it from the overall map.
fields.JP:
また、一度たどり着いたエリアは、
全体マップから直接移動できるようになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Any areas you've already reached
can be directly accessed from the
map.

fields.EN:
The Jail has 3 desires: Hunger,
Libido, and Sleep. Satisfying them
yields various benefits.
fields.JP:
ジェイルには、『食欲』『性欲』『睡眠欲』の
三つの欲求があり、満たしてやることで
さまざまな恩恵を受けることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail has 3 desires: Hunger,
Libido, and Sleep. Satisfying them
yields various benefits.

fields.EN:
The three desire gauges are displayed at
the top right of the screen, and gradually
fill as their desires are satisfied.
fields.JP:
三つの欲求は画面右上に表示されており、
欲求が満たされると徐々にゲージが溜まって
いきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The desires' gauges are displayed
at the top-right corner, and
change as they are fulfilled.

fields.EN:
"Hunger" is satisfied by attacking
enemy weak points and causing
Blood Splatters during battle.
fields.JP:
『食欲』は、戦闘中に敵の弱点を突くなどして
『血しぶき』を発生させることで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Hunger" is satisfied by attacking
enemy weak points and causing
Blood Splatters during battle.

fields.EN:
"Libido" is satisfied by finding
treasure, collection points, and
emotion points.
fields.JP:
『性欲』は、ダンジョン内にある
宝箱や採取ポイント、エモーションポイントを
調べることで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Libido" is satisfied by finding
treasure, collection points, and
emotion points.

fields.EN:
"Sleep" is satisfied by taking
action without incurring damage
while the Jail is sleeping.
fields.JP:
『睡眠欲』は、まれに発生するジェイルの
睡眠タイム中に、ダメージを受けずに
行動することで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Sleep" is satisfied by taking
action without incurring damage
while the Jail is sleeping.

fields.EN:
When any of the 3 desires reach
their limits, a "Jail Bonus"
roulette activates.
fields.JP:
いずれかの欲求のゲージがＭＡＸになると
『ジェイルボーナス』が発生し、
ボーナス内容のルーレットが開始されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
When any of the 3 desires reach
their limits, a "Jail Bonus"
roulette activates.

fields.EN:
You gain special benefits,
depending on the roulette's
results.
fields.JP:
ルーレットが止まった項目の内容によって、
さまざまな恩恵が受けることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain special benefits,
depending on the roulette's
results.

fields.EN:
The moon icon left of the three desires shows
which desire the Jail wants most. Satisfying
it raises that gauge by a larger amount.
fields.JP:
また、三大欲求の左にある月のアイコンは、
ジェイルが最も求めている欲求を表しており、
満たすことで多めにゲージが上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moon icon on the left of the
desires' gauges shows which will
be filled faster during that time.

fields.EN:
The Jail has mood shifts, which
is represented on the top right
during dungeon crawling.
fields.JP:
ジェイルには機嫌があり、
ジェイルの機嫌は、メーターとして、
探索画面の右上に表示されています
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail has mood shifts, which
is represented on the top right
during dungeon crawling.

fields.EN:
Fighting increases the mood gauge,
and filling the Hunger, Libido,
and Sleep gauges lowers the gauge.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの機嫌は戦うたびに上昇していき、
『食欲』『性欲』『睡眠欲』を満たすと減少します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting increases the mood gauge,
and filling the Hunger, Libido,
and Sleep gauges lowers the gauge.

fields.EN:
As the Jail's mood gauge
increases, so does the difficulty
of the enemies that appear.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの機嫌が悪くなっていくと、
出現する敵が強くなっていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the Jail's mood gauge
increases, so does the difficulty
of the enemies that appear.

fields.EN:
Filling the mood gauge may
summon a Nightmare without
any notice.
fields.JP:
さらに、ジェイルの機嫌が悪くなりすぎると
ナイトメアが突然現れることもあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Filling the mood gauge may
summon a Nightmare without
any notice.

fields.EN:
You may come across areas within
a dungeon that are linked by a
chain.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内には、
床の先に鎖が伸びている場所があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may come across areas within
a dungeon that are linked by a
chain.

fields.EN:
Going onto the chain activates
Tightrope Walking to get across
to the other side.
fields.JP:
その鎖に乗ると、不安定な足場を進んでいく
『綱渡りギミック』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Going onto the chain activates
Tightrope Walking to get across
to the other side.

fields.EN:
You will automatically move
forward, but will need to balance
yourself using the Right Stick.
fields.JP:
綱渡り中は自動で前進していきますが、
常に『Ｒスティック』でバランスを取る必要が
あります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You will automatically move
forward, but will need to balance
yourself using the Right Stick.

fields.EN:
Tilt the Right Stick to keep the
balance point at the center of the
bar on the screen.
fields.JP:
画面上に表示されるバーの中心に
ポイントが来るようにＲスティックを傾けながら
進んでいきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tilt the Right Stick to keep the
balance point at the center of the
bar on the screen.

fields.EN:
Blood Farm lets you plant "+" type
Blood Crystals in dungeons with the
ZL Button to grow Blood Flowers.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内では、ＺＬボタンで
『＋系』の血晶を地面に埋めて血花を育てる
『ブラッドファーム』を行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Farm lets you plant "+" type
Blood Crystals in dungeons with the
ZL Button to grow Blood Flowers.

fields.EN:
An area of 3 x 5 squares can be
planted, and battles will make the
Blood Flowers grow.
fields.JP:
正面３列、距離５マスの範囲に埋めることができ、
埋めた状態で戦闘をこなすことで、
『苗』→『蕾』→『花』と血花が成長します
fields.LOCALIZED:
An area of 3 x 5 squares can be
planted, and battles will make the
Blood Flowers grow.

fields.EN:
Covering these squares with Blood
Toss will change the Blood Flower
color and increase its rank.
fields.JP:
血花に、『血投げ』などで
血を付着させると、色が変化し、
血花がランクアップします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Covering these squares with Blood
Toss will change the Blood Flower
color and increase its rank.

fields.EN:
Once bloomed, you can harvest them
by searching them or by using
Hameln's "Magnetic Piccolo."
fields.JP:
『花』に成長した血花は、直接調べるか
血式能力『磁力ピッコロ』を使用して
収穫することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once bloomed, you can harvest them
by searching them or by using
Hameln's "Magnetic Piccolo."

fields.EN:
You will gain various items and
equipment based on the rank and
the Blood Crystal planted.
fields.JP:
収穫すると、埋めた血晶の種類に応じた、
アイテムや装備品が手に入ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You will gain various items and
equipment based on the rank and
the Blood Crystal planted.

fields.EN:
Harvest two or more at once with "Magnetic
Piccolo" to trigger an "Update Chance,"
which may improve the equipment you receive.
fields.JP:
『磁力ピッコロ』で２つ以上まとめて収穫すると、
装備品がよくなる可能性がある
『アップデートチャンス』が発動します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Magnetic Piccolo to harvest
them at once to gain a chance to
get better equipment.

fields.EN:
You can grow only up to 15 Blood Flowers
per floor, so be careful where you plant them.
fields.JP:
１フロアにつき、１５個までしか
血花を育てることはできませんので、
埋める際には注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you can only plant up
to 15 squares each dungeon floor.

fields.EN:
Some areas have sparkling squares.
These are called Blood Farm Zones.
fields.JP:
また、独房エリアには
フロア毎に『ブラッドファームゾーン』という
キラキラと光る特殊なマスがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some areas have sparkling squares.
These are called Blood Farm Zones.

fields.EN:
Blood Flowers grown in Blood Farm
Zones yield different items when harvested.
fields.JP:
『ブラッドファームゾーン』で成長した血花は、
収穫できるアイテムも変わります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The items and equipment gained
using these squares are different
than usual.

fields.EN:
Look for these special squares on
the map. They are colored purple,
so check them out.
fields.JP:
マップ上でも、紫色のマスで表示されるので、
見つけたら血花を育ててみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look for these special squares on
the map. They are colored purple,
so check them out.

fields.EN:
You may come across portals
that can only be accessed by
using items.
fields.JP:
独房エリア内には、
鍵などで閉じられた扉があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may come across portals
that can only be accessed by
using items.

fields.EN:
These can be opened by using
Action Items.
fields.JP:
そういった扉は、
『アクションアイテム』を使用して突破します
fields.LOCALIZED:
These can be opened by using
Action Items.

fields.EN:
Using the wrong item incur various
penalties, such as taking damage
and encountering enemies.
fields.JP:
間違ったアイテムを使用すると、
ダメージを受けたり、敵に遭遇する
ペナルティが発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using the wrong item incur various
penalties, such as taking damage
and encountering enemies.

fields.EN:
If you don't have the right item,
search the area well as it is
likely somewhere in the area.
fields.JP:
開錠に必要な『アクションアイテム』を
持っていない時は、
独房エリア内から探し出しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't have the right item,
search the area well as it is
likely somewhere in the area.

fields.EN:
Jail Manage lets you, to an
extent, control the results
of the Jail Bonus roulette.
fields.JP:
『ジェイルマネージ』とは、
『ジェイルボーナス』のルーレットの効果を
ある程度制御できる機能です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Control lets you, to an
extent, control the results
of the Jail Bonus roulette.

fields.EN:
The Jail Bonus results can be
fixed by using J-Pieces in
Jail Manage.
fields.JP:
『ジェイルマネージ』では、
ルーレットの効果が設定された『Ｊピース』
という特殊なアイテムを使用します
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail Bonus results can be
fixed by using J-Pieces in
Jail Control.

fields.EN:
Setting the J-Pieces grants you
the chance of the roulette
landing on your J-Piece.
fields.JP:
『ジェイルマネージ』で、
『Ｊピース』を設定することで、その効果が
ルーレットの項目に選ばれる可能性があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Setting the J-Pieces grants you
the chance of the roulette
landing on your J-Piece.

fields.EN:
J-Pieces can be found in
dungeons, and can only be used
in Jail Manage.
fields.JP:
『Ｊピース』は、独房エリア内で入手でき、
入手した独房エリアの『ジェイルマネージ』でのみ
使用できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Pieces can be found in
dungeons, and can only be used
in Jail Control.

fields.EN:
TriJail can increase your
risks, but returns a greater
reward in battle.
fields.JP:
『トライジェイル』とは、
敵を強くするなど探索に縛りを設けることで、
代わりに多大な恩恵を受けられるシステムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Trial can increase your
risks, but returns a greater
reward in battle.

fields.EN:
TriJail restrictions and benefits apply
only while exploring the area you set out for.
fields.JP:
『トライジェイル』の縛りと恩恵は、
出発先のエリア探索中にのみ適応されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The limits placed through Jail
Trial applies only to the dungeon
area you are currently in.

fields.EN:
Beware as you can add limits
during your expedition, but can't
remove them until you leave.
fields.JP:
探索中はメニューから追加の設定ができますが、
縛りの追加のみで、縛りの解除はできませんので
注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beware as you can add limits
during your expedition, but can't
remove them until you leave.

fields.EN:
While exploring, you can add restrictions
from the menu, but you can't remove them. In
return, you'll receive substantial benefits.
fields.JP:
探索中に、メニューから追加の設定ができますが、
縛りの追加のみで、縛りの解除はできません
代わりに多大な恩恵を受けられるシステムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Trial lets you to add limits
during your expedition so that
you can gain greater rewards.

fields.EN:
Blood Abilities are special
abilities the Blood Maidens can
use inside the dungeon.
fields.JP:
『血式能力』は、血式少女がダンジョン内で
発動できる特殊能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Abilities are special
abilities the Blood Maidens can
use inside the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Available abilities appear at the bottom
left. Switch with the Right Stick, and
press the B Button to activate one.
fields.JP:
使用できる能力は画面左下に表示されており、
Ｒスティックの左右で切り替え、
Ｂボタンで発動できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toggle through abilities with the
Right Stick, and activate them
with the B Button.

fields.EN:
Note that you will use SP when
activating each Blood Ability.
fields.JP: また、能力の発動にはＳＰを消費します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you will use SP when
activating each Blood Ability.

fields.EN:
Some Blood Abilities are required to progress
through dungeons, so if you get stuck while
exploring, review your available abilities.
fields.JP:
ダンジョンを進むために『必須な能力』も
ありますので、探索に行き詰まったら
能力を見直してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some dungeons require certain
Blood Abilities in order to clear
the area.

fields.EN:
Tsuu can create an orb with her
power, "Bamboo Weaver."
fields.JP:
つうの血式能力【バンブーウィーバー】は
目の前に球体を出現させる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu can create an orb with her
power, "Bamboo Weaver."

fields.EN:
The orb can be used to fill holes
to create a path, or to activate
floor gimmicks.
fields.JP:
丸い穴が開いた床に、球体を落して
道を作ったり、床のスイッチに
球体を置いて作動させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The orb can be used to fill holes
to create a path, or to activate
floor gimmicks.

fields.EN:
It can also be used to block
Nightmares, so use it to your
advantage as much as possible.
fields.JP:
また、ナイトメアに対して障害物としても
利用できるので、活用してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can also be used to block
Nightmares, so use it to your
advantage as much as possible.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime can unleash a blast
of cold with "Frozen Tear."
fields.JP:
人魚姫の血式能力【フローズンティアー】は、
目の前に冷気を放つ能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid can unleash a blast
of cold with "Frozen Tear."

fields.EN:
It can be used to douse flames,
and to freeze liquids.
fields.JP:
燃え盛る炎に使うことで、炎を消したり、
液体に使うことで、凍らせることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can be used to douse flames,
and to freeze liquids.

fields.EN:
If you get stuck while exploring,
look around for places where you can use it.
fields.JP:
探索に行き詰まった場合は、
使用できる場所がないか探してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can't find a way through a
dungeon, see if Little Mermaid's
power can help get you through.

fields.EN:
Alice can use her power, "Rabbit
Jump" to jump across 5 squares.
fields.JP:
アリスの血式能力【ラビットジャンプ】は、
前方５マス分ジャンプできる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice can use her power, "Rabbit
Jump" to jump across 5 squares.

fields.EN:
It is best used when trying to
jump over gaps and chasms.
fields.JP:
行く手にある大きな溝を超える時に
使用することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is best used when trying to
jump over gaps and chasms.

fields.EN:
If you come across an area you
need to get across, try using
her power to get through.
fields.JP:
探索中、他の能力でも乗り越えられない
溝があった時に活用してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you come across an area you
need to get across, try using
her power to get through.

fields.EN:
Nightmare Jack's "Wonder Hole" creates a point
where you can save and
escape from the dungeon.
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックの能力【ワンダーホール】は、
『セーブ』『ダンジョンからの脱出』ができる
ポイントを設置する能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Jack uses "Rabbit Hole."
This creates a save point and an
escape route out of the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Save points in dungeons can only be placed in
certain locations, so use Wonder Hole saves
to help you progress through your exploration.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内のセーブポイントは配置場所が
限られているため、ワンダーホールでのセーブを
活用して探索を進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can only set save points in
certain areas, so create save
points as you find them.

fields.EN:
Placing a new Wonder
Hole automatically removes
the one you placed previously.
fields.JP:
新たなワンダーホールを設置すると、
以前に設置したものは自動的に消滅します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that setting a new Rabbit
Hole will erase any previous
Rabbit Hole that was set.

fields.EN:
Akazukin can use "Body
Nipper" to sever and cut through
various parts of the dungeon.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんの血式能力【ボディニッパー】は
さまざまなものを切ることができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood can use "Body
Nipper" to sever and cut through
various parts of the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Use it in front of objects and
places you think can be severed
to access new areas or items.
fields.JP:
切れそうな対象の前でボディニッパーを使うと、
新しい道を開くことができたり、
アイテムを入手できたりします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it in front of objects and
places you think can be severed
to access new areas or items.

fields.EN:
The Body Nipper ability may be
useful if you can't seem to find a
way through the dungeon.
fields.JP:
探索に行き詰まった場合には、
ボディニッパーで切れる場所を探してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Body Nipper ability may be
useful if you can't seem to find a
way through the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime uses "Poison Bomb."
Using it will set a poison time
bomb on the floor.
fields.JP:
白雪姫の血式能力【ポイズンボム】は、
時限式の毒爆弾を設置することで、
爆発を発生させる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White uses "Poison Bomb."
Using it will set a poison time
bomb on the floor.

fields.EN:
You can use it to destroy certain
walls, or to inflict direct damage
onto Nightmares.
fields.JP:
壊せそうな壁を吹き飛ばしたり、
ナイトメアに直接ダメージを与えることもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can use it to destroy certain
walls, or to inflict direct damage
onto Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Note that you will take damage
or be poisoned if you're too close
to the bomb when it activates.
fields.JP:
ただし、爆発時に近くにいると、
自分たちもダメージや毒を受けてしまうため
十分に注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you will take damage
or be poisoned if you're too close
to the bomb when it activates.

fields.EN:
Nemurihime uses "Rose Arrow,"
which shoots an arrow 7 squares
in the direction you're facing.
fields.JP:
眠り姫の血式能力【ローズアロー】は、
前方７マス先に向かって、
イバラの矢を放つことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty uses "Rose Arrow,"
which shoots an arrow 7 squares
in the direction you're facing.

fields.EN:
Use it to activate switches you
can't normally reach, or when you
need to aim from afar.
fields.JP:
行けない場所にあるスイッチを押したり、
遠くから何かを狙わなければならない場合
などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it to activate switches you
can't normally reach, or when you
need to aim from afar.

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime uses "Tiny Princess,"
which allows you to shrink certain
items.
fields.JP:
親指姫の血式能力【プチプリンセス】は
所持している特定のアイテムを小さくする
ことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina uses "Tiny Princess,"
which allows you to shrink certain
items.

fields.EN:
Try using it on items you need to
shrink, or when the item works
better when shrunk.
fields.JP:
何かを小さくする必要があったり、
小さくすることで便利になりそうなアイテムが
ある場合に発動してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Try using it on items you need to
shrink, or when the item works
better when shrunk.

fields.EN:
You can also return the shrunk
item back to normal size.
fields.JP:
また、小さくしたアイテムは、
元の大きさに戻すことも可能です
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also return the shrunk
item back to normal size.

fields.EN:
Cinderella uses "Twelve Dash."
This gives the party the ability
to move quickly for 12 seconds.
fields.JP:
シンデレラの血式能力【１２ダッシュ】は、
１２秒間、自分たちの速度を上げることが
できる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella uses "Twelve Dash."
This gives the party the ability
to move quickly for 12 seconds.

fields.EN:
Use it when you're in a rush, or
when you need to access places you
can't normally walk to.
fields.JP:
急ぐ必要がある場合や、普段のスピードでは
通れない場所がある場合に試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it when you're in a rush, or
when you need to access places you
can't normally walk to.

fields.EN:
Note that you'll be stunned for a
short while if you run into a wall
or any objects, so be careful.
fields.JP:
ただし、壁や物にぶつかってしまうと、
少しの間、動けなくなるため注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you'll be stunned for a
short while if you run into a wall
or any objects, so be careful.

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime uses "Bamboo Guard." This
will allow you to nullify damage
from traps for 10 seconds.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫の血式能力【タケプロテクター】は、
１０秒間だけ、あらゆるトラップのダメージを
無効化する能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya uses "Bamboo Guard." This
will allow you to nullify damage
from traps for 10 seconds.

fields.EN:
You also have a chance of
nullifying attacks from a
Nightmare during "Chase."
fields.JP:
また、『虐殺鬼ごっこ』中に、ナイトメアからの
攻撃をたまに無効化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also have a chance of
nullifying attacks from a
Nightmare during "Chase."

fields.EN:
Use it when you want to avoid
damage from traps, or when you
need to escape from Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ダメージを受けずに進みたい場合や
ナイトメアから逃げ切りたい場合などに
能力を活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it when you want to avoid
damage from traps, or when you
need to escape from Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's Blood Ability,
"Hair!," extends her hair
5 squares ahead and lets her grab objects.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルの血式能力【ヘアー！】は、
前方５マス先に向かって髪を伸ばし、
物をつかむことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel uses "Hair Flair." This
lets you reach items 5 squares in
the direction you're facing.

fields.EN:
Use it to open treasure chests you
can't reach, activate things, or
when you need to grab onto things.
fields.JP:
手が届かない場所にある宝箱を開けたり、
何かを作動させたり、つかまったりしなければ
ならない場合などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it to open treasure chests you
can't reach, activate things, or
when you need to grab onto things.

fields.EN:
Gretel's Blood Ability, "Bread
Portal," lets her throw breadcrumbs
3 squares ahead and use them to warp.
fields.JP:
グレーテルの血式能力【ブレッドポータル】は
前方３マス先に向かってパンくずを投げ、
それを利用してワープする能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel uses "Bread Portal." This
creates a warp point 3 squares
in the direction you're facing.

fields.EN:
Use the ability once to toss the
bread crumbs, and use it again to
warp to where you tossed it.
fields.JP:
能力を発動してパンくずを投げた後、
もう一度能力を発動することで
パンくずの場所にワープできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use the ability once to toss the
bread crumbs, and use it again to
warp to where you tossed it.

fields.EN:
This can be helpful when you need
to access locations you can't
normally get to.
fields.JP:
歩きでは行けない場所に
渡りたい場合などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This can be helpful when you need
to access locations you can't
normally get to.

fields.EN:
Hameln uses "Magnetic Piccolo."
This attracts items using her
pipe's magnetic powers.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンの血式能力【磁力ピッコロ】は、
笛の音色で磁力を発生させ、
物を引き寄せることができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln uses "Magnetic Piccolo."
This attracts items using her
pipe's magnetic powers.

fields.EN:
It affects any items within 3 rows
and 5 squares in your direction.
Use it to drag items towards you.
fields.JP:
正面の３列、距離５マスに効果があります。
引き寄せられそうな物を見つけた場合に
試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It affects any items within 3 rows
and 5 squares in your direction.
Use it to drag items towards you.

fields.EN:
Coming in contact with an icon
shaped like a memo in the dungeon
will initiate a battle.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン探索中に
メモの形をしたアイコンに触れると
戦闘が始まります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Coming in contact with an icon
shaped like a memo in the dungeon
will initiate a battle.

fields.EN:
Win the battle to gain a memo with
tips on clearing the dungeon.
fields.JP:
戦闘に勝利することで、
ダンジョンを進む際のヒントが書かれた
『メモ』を手に入れることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Win the battle to gain a memo with
tips on clearing the dungeon.

fields.EN:
You can view memos you've found
through the "Others" tab under
"Item."
fields.JP:
手に入れたメモは、アイテムの
『その他』のタブでいつでも確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view memos you've found
through the "Others" tab under
"Item."

fields.EN:
Wandering Merchants are merchants
that you may encounter during
your dungeon expedition.
fields.JP:
放浪商人は、ダンジョン探索中に
まれに出会う商人です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wandering Merchants are merchants
that you may encounter during
your dungeon expedition.

fields.EN:
The merchant sells rare items that
can't normally be purchased at the
store.
fields.JP:
購入できる品々は、物資販売所では買えない
装備品や珍しいアイテムばかりです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The merchant sells rare items that
can't normally be purchased at the
store.

fields.EN:
Defeat all enemies to win a battle.
If every party member is KO'd, it's game over.
fields.JP:
戦闘では、全ての敵を倒すと勝利、
パーティメンバー全員が戦闘不能になると
ゲームオーバーになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Win battles by defeating all
enemies. The battle ends if
everyone in your party is KO'd.

fields.EN:
The turn order is determined by
the character's agility, from
highest to lowest.
fields.JP:
戦闘が始まると、全キャラクターで
ＡＧＩの高い順に行動がまわってきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The turn order is determined by
the character's agility, from
highest to lowest.

fields.EN:
Tsuu has 5 different commands:
Attack, Skill, Defend, Item,
and Escape.
fields.JP:
主人公のつうには、
『攻撃』『スキル』『アイテム』『防御』『逃げる』の
コマンドがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu has 5 different commands:
Attack, Skill, Defend, Item,
and Escape.

fields.EN:
The Blood Maidens have 4
commands: Attack, Skill, Defend,
and Escape.
fields.JP:
他の血式少女には、
『攻撃』『スキル』『防御』『逃げる』の
コマンドがあります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maidens have 4
commands: Attack, Skill, Defend,
and Escape.

fields.EN:
"Attack" conducts normal attacks.
"Skill" conducts special attacks
that consume SP.
fields.JP:
『攻撃』は通常攻撃、
『スキル』はＳＰを使用した特殊攻撃
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Attack" conducts normal attacks.
"Skill" conducts special attacks
that consume SP.

fields.EN:
"Defend" reduces damage from
enemies, and "Escape" may
let you escape from battle.
fields.JP:
『防御』は敵からのダメージ軽減、
『逃げる』は逃走を試みるコマンドです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Defend" reduces damage from
enemies, and "Escape" may
let you escape from battle.

fields.EN:
You can gain EXP, Blood Crystals,
items, or weapons when you win
battles.
fields.JP:
敵をすべて倒して勝利すると、
『経験値』や『血晶』が手に入るほか、
アイテムや武器が手に入ることもあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can gain EXP, Blood Crystals,
items, or weapons when you win
battles.

fields.EN:
A basic battle technique is to hit
enemy weaknesses with elemental attacks.
fields.JP:
戦闘の基本要素に
『属性攻撃で敵の弱点を突く』という
テクニックがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
One of the most basic things to
remember during battle is to
attack enemy weak points.

fields.EN:
There are 4 elements, each with
their own weakness.
Fire > Wind > Earth > Water > Fire
fields.JP:
属性は火、風、土、水の４種類あり、
『火は風に強い』『風は土に強い』
『土は水に強い』『水は火に強い』関係です
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 4 elements, each with
their own weakness.
Fire > Air > Earth > Water > Fire

fields.EN:
Attacking an enemy's weak point
not only increases damage, but
may also cause "Blood Splatters."
fields.JP:
敵を弱点属性で攻撃すると、
大きなダメージを与えられるだけでなく、
『血しぶき』を発生させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Attacking an enemy's weak point
not only increases damage, but
may also cause "Blood Splatters."

fields.EN:
Causing Blood Splatters will fill
the Blood Maidens' Blood Splatter
icon.
fields.JP:
血しぶきが発生すると、
血式少女の『返り血アイコン』が少しずつ
満たされていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Causing Blood Splatters will fill
the Blood Maidens' Blood Splatter
icon.

fields.EN:
Once the icon is filled, the Blood
Maiden will enter "Genocide" mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンがＭＡＸになると、次の行動順に
強力な『ジェノサイドモード』に変身します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once the icon is filled, the Blood
Maiden will enter "Massacre" mode.

fields.EN:
During Genocide mode, the Blood
Maiden's stats increase, and they
can access powerful skills.
fields.JP:
ジェノサイドモードでは、ステータスが上昇し、
強力な専用スキルも使用できるため、
積極的に狙っていきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
During Massacre mode, the Blood
Maiden's stats increase, and they
can access powerful skills.

fields.EN:
They will exit Genocide mode after
a set amount of turns.
fields.JP:
ジェノサイドモードは、
数回行動すると解除されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
They will exit Massacre mode after
a set amount of turns.

fields.EN:
You can also make Blood Splatters
by causing Criticals, or by
defeating enemies with "Overkill."
fields.JP:
血しぶきは、
大ダメージを与えて倒す『オーバーキル』や
『クリティカル』などでも発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also make Blood Splatters
by causing Criticals, or by
defeating enemies with "Overkill."

fields.EN:
When Blood Splatter has built up
in a Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter
icon, you can "Lick" the blood.
fields.JP:
血しぶきが発生し、血式少女の
『返り血アイコン』が溜まっている場合に、
それを『舐める』ことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can "Lick" a Blood Maiden when
their Blood Splatter icon has
accumulated a certain amount.

fields.EN:
Selecting whom you want to lick
will activate that Blood Maiden's
"Blood Soul Skill."
fields.JP:
『誰の血を舐めるのか』を選択することで、
その血式少女の『魂血スキル』が発動します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Selecting whom you want to lick
will activate that Blood Maiden's
"Blood Soul Skill."

fields.EN:
"Blood Soul Skills" are skills
that offer healing and other
restorative properties.
fields.JP:
『魂血スキル』は、
基本的に補助回復系の癒しの技です
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Blood Soul Skills" are skills
that offer healing and other
restorative properties.

fields.EN:
The Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter
icon is emptied once they are
licked.
fields.JP:
血を舐められた血式少女の
『返り血アイコン』は、０に戻ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter
icon is emptied once they are
licked.

fields.EN:
Use Genocide mode to gain power,
or use Blood Soul Skills for
restorative effects.
fields.JP:
『ジェノサイドモード』で強くなるか、
『魂血スキル』で態勢を立て直すか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Massacre mode to gain power,
or use Blood Soul Skills for
restorative effects.

fields.EN:
How you use Blood Splatter will be
key in determining victory or
defeat.
fields.JP:
血しぶきを戦況によってどう使い分けるかが
戦闘のカギを握っています
fields.LOCALIZED:
How you use Blood Splatter will be
key in determining victory or
defeat.

fields.EN:
Corruption builds up in Blood
Maidens when someone is KO'd,
takes massive damage, or more.
fields.JP:
血式少女は、パーティメンバーの戦闘不能、
大ダメージを受けるなど、心が乱れることで
『穢れ』が溜まっていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Corruption builds up in Blood
Maidens when someone is KO'd,
takes massive damage, or more.

fields.EN:
As Corruption fills, the Blood
Splatter icon slowly changes to a
murky color.
fields.JP:
『穢れ』が溜まると、
返り血アイコンが次第に『濁った色』へと
変化していきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
As Corruption fills, the Blood
Splatter icon slowly changes to a
murky color.

fields.EN:
If the Blood Splatter icon fills
while murky, the Blood Maiden will
enter "Blood Skelter" mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンが濁った状態でＭＡＸになると、
暴走状態である『ブラッドスケルターモード』に
変身してしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Blood Splatter icon fills
while murky, the Blood Maiden will
enter "Blood Skelter" mode.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens in Blood Skelter
will randomly attack both enemies
and allies.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルターモードの血式少女は、
敵・味方の見境なく攻撃を行います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens in Blood Skelter
will randomly attack both enemies
and allies.

fields.EN:
Blood Skelter can be ended using
Life Purge, when the battle ends,
or when you are KO'd.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルターモードは、
『いのちがけじょうか』『戦闘終了』『戦闘不能』
でしか解けることはありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Skelter can be ended using
Life Purge, when the battle ends,
or when you are KO'd.

fields.EN:
The murkier the Blood Splatter
icon, the greater your chances of
entering Blood Skelter mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンの濁りが濃いほど
ブラッドスケルターモードになる可能性が
高いため、アイコンの状態には注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The murkier the Blood Splatter
icon, the greater your chances of
entering Blood Skelter mode.

fields.EN:
Tsuu and Jack move as a pair,
so actions are shared between
the two.
fields.JP:
つうとジャックは一心同体のため
常に一緒に行動する必要があります
そのため、２人はセットで行動を選択できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and Jack move as a pair,
so actions are shared between
the two.

fields.EN:
You can toggle who will take
action by pressing the Left
or Right Buttons.
fields.JP:
つうとジャックのどちらで行動するかは、
方向ボタンの左右で切り替えができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can toggle who will take
action by pressing the Left
or Right Buttons.

fields.EN:
You can either have Tsuu or
Jack act twice, or you can have
each of them take a single action.
fields.JP:
つうとジャックでそれぞれ行動したり、
つうが二回行動、ジャックが二回行動といった
パターンの組み合わせができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can either have Otsuu or
Jack act twice, or you can have
each of them take a single action.

fields.EN:
Nightmare Jack has 4 commands:
"Deep Breath," "Nightmare Zone,"
"Item," and "Escape."
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックには、
『しんこきゅう』『ナイトメアくうかん』
『アイテム』『逃げる』のコマンドがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Jack has 4 commands:
"Deep Breath," "Nightmare Zone,"
"Item," and "Escape."

fields.EN:
The command chosen may affect
his mind meter located above
Nightmare Jack's icon.
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックは選択したコマンドによって
画面上に表示されている
意識メーターに影響を与える効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The command chosen may affect
his mind meter located above
Nightmare Jack's icon.

fields.EN:
"Deep Breath" has the ability to
calm his mind meter.
fields.JP:
『しんこきゅう』は、
意識メーターを落ち着かせる効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Deep Breath" has the ability to
calm his mind meter.

fields.EN:
"Nightmare Zone" can null enemy
actions the next turn, but it will
agitate his mind meter.
fields.JP:
『ナイトメアくうかん』は、敵単体か敵全体を
次のターン行動不能にさせる効果がありますが
その代わりに意識メーターが乱れてしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Nightmare Zone" can null enemy
actions the next turn, but it will
agitate his mind meter.

fields.EN:
"Item" and "Escape" has no
effect on his mind meter.
fields.JP:
『アイテム』や『逃げる』は、
意識メーターに影響を与えず使用できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Item" and "Escape" has no
effect on his mind meter.

fields.EN:
If Nightmare Jack's Mind Meter becomes
too unstable, he will transform into the
berserk 'Ripper Jack' after the turn ends.
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックの意識メーターが
乱れすぎてしまうと、ターン終了後に
暴走状態の『ジャックリッパー』に変身します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If his mind meter peaks past a certain
point, at the end of his turn, there is a 
chance he will transform into Ripper Jack.

fields.EN:
Ripper Jack cannot be controlled,
and will attack both enemies and
allies.
fields.JP:
『ジャックリッパー』時は、
ナイトメア・ジャックの行動選択は不可能で、
敵味方関係なく攻撃を振るってしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ripper Jack cannot be controlled,
and will attack both enemies and
allies.

fields.EN:
Tsuu can calm Nightmare Jack
by using her command,
"Counseling."
fields.JP:
暴走したナイトメア・ジャックは、
つうの『カウンセリング』を使用することで
意識を正常に落ち着かせることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu can calm Nightmare Jack
by using her command,
"Counseling."

fields.EN:
If Ripper Jack activates three times in one
battle, Jack's mind will be swallowed by
darkness and it's Game Over, so be careful.
fields.JP:
ただ１度の戦闘で『ジャックリッパー』が３回発動
してしまうと、ジャックの意識が闇に呑まれ、
ゲームオーバーになるので注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Ripper Jack occurs 3 times
during a single battle, the game
will end, so be careful.

fields.EN:
Nightmare Jack can Purge or Life
Purge, but those will agitate
his mind meter.
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックのコマンド『じょうか』では、
意識メーターが乱れる代わりに、
『じょうか』と『いのちがけじょうか』ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Jack can Purge or Life
Purge, but those will agitate
his mind meter.

fields.EN:
Purge can clear one Blood Maiden's
Corruption, or lower the
Corruption of all Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
『じょうか』には、単体か全体の２種類あり、
単体では、一人の濁りを全て消し、
全体では、全員の濁りを少し消す効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Purge can clear one Blood Maiden's
Corruption, or lower the
Corruption of all Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Using Life Purge will allow you
to take a Blood Maiden out of
Blood Skelter mode.
fields.JP:
『いのちがけじょうか』では、
『ブラッドスケルターモード』になってしまった
血式少女の状態を元に戻す効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using Life Purge will allow you
to take a Blood Maiden out of
Blood Skelter mode.

fields.EN:
Press the Y Button when selecting
your command to use Auto-Battle.
fields.JP:
コマンド選択時にＹボタンを押すと、
オート戦闘を行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Y Button when selecting
your command to use Auto-Battle.

fields.EN:
Press the Left Stick to toggle
between the Auto-Battle
types available.
fields.JP:
Ｌスティックボタンを押すと、
オート戦闘のタイプを切替えられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Left Stick to toggle
between the Auto-Battle
types available.

fields.EN:
Press the R Button during battle
animations to skip them
and speed up the battle.
fields.JP:
また、戦闘演出中にＲボタンを押すと、
戦闘演出をスキップして高速戦闘ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Holding the R Button during
battle effects lets you skip the
effect to make the battles faster.

fields.EN:
These help to expedite battles,
but be careful using them when
facing powerful enemies.
fields.JP:
とても便利な機能ですが、
強敵との戦闘で使用する際には注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
These help to expedite battles,
but be careful using them when
facing powerful enemies.

fields.EN:
There are various effects in battle, such
as Poison, Paralysis, stat boosts, and more.
fields.JP:
戦闘では、毒、麻痺やステータスＵＰなど、
さまざまな状態効果が存在します
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are various effects that can
be used in battle, such as Poison,
Stun, stat boosts, and more.

fields.EN:
Each effect is displayed in the
Blood Maiden's stat window, so
keep an eye on what's in effect.
fields.JP:
効果は各血式少女のステータスウィンドウに
表示されるため、状態効果アイコンを
意識しながら戦闘を行いましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each effect is displayed in the
Blood Maiden's stat window, so
keep an eye on what's in effect.

fields.EN:
Press the - Button to view details on status
ailments. Check them whenever you need help.
fields.JP:
また、－ボタンを押すと
状態異常の詳細が確認できます
困ったときは確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you need to confirm what
effects are on you, press the
− Button to verify.

fields.EN:
Using a weapon or skill with the
"Bloodshot" effect has a chance of
triggering "Kagome-Kagome."
fields.JP:
武器やスキルに『血走り効果』がついていると、
一定確率でかごめかごめ効果が発動します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using a weapon or skill with the
"Bloodshot" effect has a chance of
triggering "Kagome-Kagome."

fields.EN:
Kagome-Kagome forces the enemy
to turn around making them weaker
against attacks.
fields.JP:
かごめかごめ効果は、
敵を後ろに振り向かせる効果で、
発動中は敵はとても弱くなります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kagome-Kagome forces the enemy
to turn around making them weaker
against attacks.

fields.EN:
Battles occurring near gimmicks
may cause them to attack even
during battle.
fields.JP:
独房エリア内のギミックの付近で戦闘が始まると、
戦闘中にかかわらず、ギミックが攻撃してきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Battles occurring near gimmicks
may cause them to attack even
during battle.

fields.EN:
Gimmicks aren't valid attack targets
and can't be disabled, so be careful.
fields.JP:
ギミックは、攻撃対象ではなく、
無力化することができないので注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beware as gimmicks in battle
can't be destroyed.

fields.EN:
Blood Maiden's can use "Embrace"
against those in Blood Skelter and
Ripper Jack.
fields.JP:
血式少女のコマンド『抱きとめる』は、
『ブラッドスケルター』『ジャックリッパー』化した
仲間を対象に使用するコマンドです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maiden's can use "Embrace"
against those in Blood Skelter and
Ripper Jack.

fields.EN:
When you use Embrace, if the target
goes berserk and attacks, the character
embracing them will take the attack.
fields.JP:
『抱きとめる』を使用すると、
対象が暴走して、攻撃した際、
抱きとめたキャラクターが攻撃を受け止めます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using Embrace will force those
targeted to attack the user of
Embrace.

fields.EN:
You can use Embrace to catch the attack and
completely protect an ally, or choose not to
and leave it to luck. The choice is yours.
fields.JP:
抱きとめて、仲間への攻撃を完全に阻止するか
抱き留めずに、運に任せて放置するか、
プレイヤーの判断に委ねられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Embrace to tactically control
who is attacked, or let luck take
its toll. The choice is yours.

fields.EN:
Aside from status ailments such as
Poison, Sleep, and Paralysis, there's
also an ailment called "Infection."
fields.JP:
戦闘では、毒、睡眠、麻痺といった状態異常
の他に、『感染』という状態異常があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aside from ailments, such as
Poison, Sleep, and Stun, one may
get inflicted with "Infection."

fields.EN:
Infection comes in three types: Poison,
Sleep, and Paralysis. Infection can
spread between adjacent characters.
fields.JP:
『感染』には、毒、睡眠、麻痺の３種類あり、
感染の状態異常は、隣同士のキャラクターに
移されたり、移したりする効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Infection carries Poison, Sleep,
or Stun, and can infect adjacent
allies in battle.

fields.EN: Cure the ailment before the Infection spreads.
fields.JP: 感染が広がる前に、状態異常を治しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leaving it alone may lead to a
party's demise, so be sure to heal
those with the "Infection" effect.

fields.EN:
Critical Notice is a system where
you are notified beforehand that
your attack will be a critical.
fields.JP:
クリティカル攻撃予告は、
ターン開始時に、そのターンの攻撃が
クリティカルになることが確定するシステムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Critical Notice is a system where
you are notified beforehand that
your attack will be a critical.

fields.EN:
There are 3 levels to the notice.
The flashier the effect, the
stronger the critical attack.
fields.JP:
クリティカル攻撃予告には３段階あり、
演出が豪華になるほど、
高いクリティカル攻撃が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 3 levels to the notice.
The flashier the effect, the
stronger the critical attack.

fields.EN:
The effect has a greater chance of
occurring when using combos, or
using weapons with "Strike."
fields.JP:
戦闘中に、コンボをつなげていったり
装備品に『殴打属性』などを付けることで、
発生しやすくなります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The effect has a greater chance of
occurring when using combos, or
using weapons with "Strike."

fields.EN:
Each dungeon is patrolled by
invincible guards called "Nightmares."
fields.JP:
各ダンジョンには、『ナイトメア』と呼ばれる
無敵の看守が徘徊しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are invincible creatures
called "Nightmares" in each
dungeon protecting the area.

fields.EN:
Nightmares bring a white mist with
them, so if the dungeon becomes
white, be careful!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは真っ白い闇をまとっているため、
ダンジョン探索中に周囲が真っ白い闇に
包まれたら警戒が必要です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmares bring a white mist with
them, so if the dungeon becomes
white, be careful!

fields.EN:
If you encounter a Nightmare,
"Chase" will begin.
fields.JP:
もし闇の中でナイトメアに遭遇してしまうと、
恐怖の『虐殺鬼ごっこ』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you encounter a Nightmare,
"Chase" will begin.

fields.EN:
Once Chase begins, the Nightmare
will chase the party until
everyone dies.
fields.JP:
虐殺鬼ごっこが発生すると、
ナイトメアは『プレイヤーが全滅』するまで
どこまでも追いかけてきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once Chase begins, the Nightmare
will chase the party until
everyone dies.

fields.EN:
If you can run far away from the
Nightmare, the chase will end,
and things will go back to normal.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアを引き離すことができれば
『逃亡成功』となり、通常の探索に戻ることが
できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can run far away from the
Nightmare, the chase will end,
and things will go back to normal.

fields.EN:
If you encounter Marchens during
a Chase, a "Booking Battle" occurs.
fields.JP:
また、虐殺鬼ごっこ中にメルヒェンに出会うと、
『ブッキングバトル』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you encounter Marchens during
a Chase, a special battle will
occur.

fields.EN:
In a Booking Battle, you can't move until
the Marchens are defeated, and the Nightmare
attacks too. Defeat the Marchens quickly.
fields.JP:
ブッキングバトルはメルヒェンを倒すまで移動できず、
ナイトメアからも攻撃を受けてしまうため、
速やかにメルヒェンを倒しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare will attack while
you're fighting the Marchens, so
defeat them as fast as you can.

fields.EN:
Note that the Blood Splatter that
occurs in battle may splatter the
blood onto the dungeon, too.
fields.JP:
戦闘中に発生する『血しぶき』は、
血式少女だけでなくダンジョンにも付着します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that the Blood Splatter that
occurs in battle may splatter the
blood onto the dungeon, too.

fields.EN:
The blood splatter will clear the
area, so it helps to cause blood
splatters whenever possible.
fields.JP:
血しぶきは真っ白い闇を照らす
道しるべとなるため、
普段から発生を狙っていくのも効果的です
fields.LOCALIZED:
The blood splatter will clear the
area, so it helps to cause blood
splatters whenever possible.

fields.EN:
If the Nightmare catches up to you
during a Chase, you may need to
face it in battle.
fields.JP:
鬼ごっこ中にナイトメアに追い詰められると、
戦って切り抜けるしかなくなる場合があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Nightmare catches up to you
during a Chase, you may need to
face it in battle.

fields.EN:
Press the A Button while standing
next to the Nightmare to enter
battle.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアに隣接してＡボタンを押すと、
戦闘に突入します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the A Button while standing
next to the Nightmare to enter
battle.

fields.EN:
You can knock down a Nightmare by
inflicting enough damage to it,
or by destroying its parts.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは、部位を破壊する
もしくは、ダメージを蓄積させることで
『ノックダウン』状態になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can knock down a Nightmare by
inflicting enough damage to it,
or by destroying its parts.

fields.EN:
When the Nightmare is knocked down
the battle ends, and you can get
past the Nightmare to escape.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアがノックダウンすると戦闘が終了し、
ナイトメアを乗り越えて逃げることができます
いざという時に活用していきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
