When the Nightmare is knocked down
the battle ends, and you can get
past the Nightmare to escape.

fields.EN:
Note that sometimes the "Move"
command may fail, so be careful.
fields.JP:
ただし、『移動する』コマンドが
失敗する可能性もあるので注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that sometimes the "Move"
command may fail, so be careful.

fields.EN:
Destroying "cores" in the dungeon
allows you to defeat Nightmares
in that dungeon.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内にある『核』を破壊すると、
ナイトメアの討伐が可能になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Destroying "cores" in the dungeon
allows you to defeat Nightmares
in that dungeon.

fields.EN:
If you encounter a Nightmare after
you destroy a core, you will enter
battle to defeat the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
核の破壊後にナイトメアと遭遇すると
ナイトメアを倒すための『討伐戦』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you encounter a Nightmare after
you destroy a core, you will enter
battle to defeat the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
You cannot escape from the Nightmare
during this battle, so use every means
at your disposal to seize victory.
fields.JP:
討伐戦では、ナイトメアから逃げることは
できないため、あらゆる手段を駆使して
勝利をつかみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You won't be able to escape from
this battle, so be sure you're
well-prepared.

fields.EN:
You can view important information
and adjust settings through the
menu.
fields.JP:
メニューでは、さまざまな情報を確認したり、
設定したりすることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view important information
and adjust settings through the
menu.

fields.EN:
"Item," "Skill," and "Equipment"
allow you to view details of each
and use them as needed.
fields.JP:
『アイテム』では各種アイテムの使用、
『スキル』ではスキルの使用や確認、
『装備』では装備の変更が行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Item," "Skill," and "Equipment"
allow you to view details of each
and use them as needed.

fields.EN:
"Skill Custom" lets you learn and set new
skills, as well as configure Blood Abilities.
fields.JP:
『スキルカスタム』では、
新たなスキルの習得やセットができるほか、
血式能力の設定もできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Customize Skills" lets you set
new Skills and Blood Abilities.

fields.EN:
Customizing skills is important
in strengthening a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
血式少女の強化を行うための
最重要項目のため、忘れずに利用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Customizing skills is important
in strengthening a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
"Formation" lets you set party
members and partners.
fields.JP:
『編成』では、パーティメンバーの設定や
戦闘のサポートメンバーの設定が行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Formation" lets you set party
members and partners.

fields.EN:
"Status" lets you view stats, and
"Area Info" lets you confirm Jail
Control and TriJail.
fields.JP:
『ステータス』では血式少女の能力の確認、
『エリア詳細』では、ジェイルマネージや
トライジェイルの確認ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Status" lets you view stats, and
"Area Info" lets you confirm Jail
Control and Jail Trial.

fields.EN:
"Library" lets you view work
orders, enemy details, and the
tutorial.
fields.JP:
『ライブラリ』では、受注した依頼や敵の情報、
チュートリアルなどを確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Library" lets you view work
orders, enemy details, and the
tutorial.

fields.EN:
"System" lets you save and load
data, change settings, and return
to the title screen.
fields.JP:
『システム』では、
データのセーブやロード、環境設定ができるほか、
タイトル画面に戻ることもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"System" lets you save and load
data, change settings, and return
to the title screen.

fields.EN:
There are 6 item categories: Items,
Equipment, Blood Crystals, Blood
Packs, Surprise Items, and Others.
fields.JP:
アイテムには、『道具』『装備』『血晶』
『ユ血液』『サプライズアイテム』『その他』の
６つのカテゴリーがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 6 item categories: Items,
Equipment, Blood Crystals, Blood
Packs, Surprise Items, and Others.

fields.EN:
"Items" lets you use items,
"Equipment" lets you access a
Blood Maiden's gear.
fields.JP:
『道具』は探索に役立つアイテム、
『装備』は血式少女の装備品です
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Items" lets you use items,
"Equipment" lets you access a
Blood Maiden's gear.

fields.EN:
"Surprise Items" lets you give
items to the Blood Maidens to
increase their affection.
fields.JP:
『サプライズアイテム』は、
血式少女に渡すことで友情度をアップできる
アイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Surprise Items" lets you give
items to the Blood Maidens to
increase their affection.

fields.EN:
"Blood Crystals" are needed to
change a Blood Maiden's job,
strengthen gear, and more.
fields.JP:
『血晶』は、血式少女の職業変更や
装備品の強化などに必要なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Blood Crystals" are needed to
change a Blood Maiden's job,
strengthen gear, and more.

fields.EN:
"Blood Packs" are used to learn
special Blood Pack Skills.
fields.JP:
『ユ血液』は、血式少女に『ユ血液スキル』を
習得させる特殊なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Blood Packs" are used to learn
special Blood Pack Skills.

fields.EN:
"Others" contains items that are
necessary in order to progress
through the game.
fields.JP:
『その他』は、物語を進めていく上で
重要なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Others" contains items that are
necessary in order to progress
through the game.

fields.EN:
If you have any unwanted items,
you can manage them in Tsuu's
room.
fields.JP:
不必要なアイテムは、
つうの部屋の格納庫で整理することもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you have any unwanted items,
you can manage them in Otsuu's
room.

fields.EN:
Under the Equipment menu there
are 4 types of gear: Weapons, Head
Gear, Body Armor, and Accessories.
fields.JP:
メニューの装備では、
『武器』『頭の防具』『体の防具』『装飾品』の
４種類を血式少女に装備させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Under the Equipment menu there
are 4 types of gear: Weapons, Head
Gear, Body Armor, and Accessories.

fields.EN:
Some equipment can only be used
by certain jobs.
fields.JP:
装備品には、血式少女の職業によって、
装備できるものとできないものがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some equipment can only be used
by certain jobs.

fields.EN:
Equipment that the current
job cannot equip cannot be selected.
fields.JP:
その職業では装備できない装備品は、
選択することができません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jobs that can't use any particular
equipment can't be selected.

fields.EN:
Obtain equipment from battles, as
treasures, at the Blood Farm, or
from Wandering Merchants.
fields.JP:
装備品は、宝箱や戦闘の報酬で手に入るほか、
ブラッドファームで収穫したり、
放浪商人から購入することもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Obtain equipment from battles, as
treasures, at the Blood Farm, or
from Wandering Merchants.

fields.EN:
You can set the skills to be used
by the Blood Maidens through
"Skill Set."
fields.JP:
スキルセットでは、血式少女が使用する
スキルをセットすることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can set the skills to be used
by the Blood Maidens through
"Skill Set."

fields.EN:
Be sure you set the skills you
learn through "Skill Creation."
fields.JP:
『スキルメイク』で新たなスキルを習得したら
必ずセットするようにしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure you set the skills you
learn through "Skill Creation."

fields.EN:
Toggle the job you want to set a
skill to by selecting a skill slot
and pressing the R or L Button.
fields.JP:
セットしたい『スキル枠』を選択した状態で
ＲボタンやＬボタンを押すと、
職業を切り替えることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toggle the job you want to set a
skill to by selecting a skill slot
and pressing the R or L Button.

fields.EN:
Customize your very own set of
skills by combining the skills you
learn from the jobs available.
fields.JP:
さまざまな職業で習得したスキルを
自由に組み合わせてカスタマイズしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Customize your very own set of
skills by combining the skills you
learn from the jobs available.

fields.EN:
You can learn new skills for the
Blood Maidens to use through the
"Skill Creation" menu.
fields.JP:
スキルメイクでは、血式少女に
『新たなスキル』を習得させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can learn new skills for the
Blood Maidens to use through the
"Skill Creation" menu.

fields.EN:
To learn skills, you will need a
set amount of "CP," which can be
gained through leveling up.
fields.JP:
スキルの習得には、
レベルアップで得られる『ＣＰ』を使用します
fields.LOCALIZED:
To learn skills, you will need a
set amount of "CP," which can be
gained through leveling up.

fields.EN:
You can only use skills that are
preset, so be sure to set them
prior to use.
fields.JP:
習得したスキルは『スキルセット』で
セットしないと使用できないため、
必ずセットするようにしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can only use skills that are
preset, so be sure to set them
prior to use.

fields.EN:
You can change the order of Blood
Abilities when checking Blood
Ability slots.
fields.JP:
血式能力スロットでは、
『血式能力』の並び替えができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can change the order of Blood
Abilities when checking Blood
Ability slots.

fields.EN:
Customize the order to your
liking, such as ordering them by
frequency of use.
fields.JP:
使う頻度の高い能力を並べるなど、
自分好みにカスタマイズしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Customize the order to your
liking, such as ordering them by
frequency of use.

fields.EN:
You can select "Party Formation"
or "Partner" through the
"Formation" menu.
fields.JP:
編成では、『パーティ編成』と
『コンビネーション』の設定ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can select "Party Formation"
or "Partner" through the
"Formation" menu.

fields.EN:
"Party Formation" lets you add or
remove party members and swap their positions.
fields.JP:
『パーティ編成』では、
パーティメンバーの追加や除外を行えるほか、
メンバー同士の配置入れ替えもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Party Formation" lets you change
and shift members within your
party.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens in the middle are
often targeted, so place the
weaker ones on the outside.
fields.JP:
中心にいる血式少女ほど、
敵からやや狙われやすい傾向にあるため、
弱い血式少女は外側に配置してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens in the middle are
often targeted, so place the
weaker ones on the outside.

fields.EN:
You can also press the Y Button
to toggle allies on the front and 
rear lines.
fields.JP:
また、Ｙボタンで
前衛、後衛を切り替えることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also press the Y Button
to toggle allies on the front and 
rear lines.

fields.EN:
Those in the front deal and
receive full physical damage to
and from enemies.
fields.JP:
前衛は物理攻撃が１００％の威力を発揮しますが、
敵からの物理ダメージも１００％受けます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those in the front deal and
receive full physical damage to
and from enemies.

fields.EN:
Those in the rear deal and receive
half the physical damage to and
from enemies.
fields.JP:
後衛は物理攻撃の威力が半減する反面、
敵からの物理ダメージを半分に抑えられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those in the rear deal and receive
half the physical damage to and
from enemies.

fields.EN:
"Partner" lets you assign Blood
Maidens to support members in
the party.
fields.JP:
『コンビネーション』では、
それぞれのパーティメンバーに
サポートの血式少女を設定できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Partner" lets you assign Blood
Maidens to support members in
the party.

fields.EN:
Assigned Blood Maidens offer
support through attacking enemies
or healing their partners.
fields.JP:
サポートメンバーに設定した血式少女は、
戦闘中に攻撃や回復の補助をしてくれます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Assigned Blood Maidens offer
support through attacking enemies
or healing their partners.

fields.EN:
Be sure to assign partners once
you have enough Blood Maidens in
your party.
fields.JP:
血式少女が増えてきたら、
コンビを組ませて戦闘を有利に進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure to assign partners once
you have enough Blood Maidens in
your party.

fields.EN:
Under "BONUS," you can view "NOVEL,"
"GALLERY," "MUSIC," "CHARACTER,"
and "HEROINE'S MEMORIES."
fields.JP:
BONUSでは、『NOVEL』『GALLERY』『MUSIC』
『CHARACTER』『HEROINE'S MEMORIES』の
鑑賞ができます

fields.EN:
You can read the prologue to the
novel version of "Mary Skelter:
Nightmares" under "Novel."
fields.JP:
『NOVEL』では、前作の前日譚
【神獄塔 メアリスケルター～獄中童話前日譚～】
を全話読むことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can read the prologue to the
novel version of "Mary Skelter:
Nightmares" under "Novel."

fields.EN:
You can watch movies and view CGs
in the "Gallery," and listen to
BGM through "Music."
fields.JP:
『GALLERY』では、ムービーやＣＧなどの閲覧、
『MUSIC』では、ＢＧＭの試聴ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can watch movies and view CGs
in the "Gallery," and listen to
BGM through "Music."

fields.EN:
You can view character
illustrations under "Characters."
fields.JP:
『CHARACTER』では、キャラクターのイラストを
鑑賞することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view character
illustrations under "Characters."

fields.EN:
You can view various heroine
events under "Memories."
fields.JP:
『HEROINE'S MEMORIES』では、
ヒロインの個別イベントを回想できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view various heroine
events under "Memories."

fields.EN:
Each gear is assigned a special
effect - Bloodshot, Slice,
and Strike.
fields.JP:
装備には『血走』、『鋭利』、『殴打』の
三つの付加効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each gear is assigned a special
effect - Bloodshot, Slice,
and Strike.

fields.EN:
Bloodshot causes the Kagome-Kagome
effect, Slice increases bleeding,
Strike increases the critical rate.
fields.JP:
『血走』はかごめかごめ効果を発生させます
『鋭利』は出血量が上がります
『殴打』はクリティカルの発生率が上がります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bloodshot causes the Kagome-Kagome
effect, Slice increases bleeding,
Strike increases the critical rate.

fields.EN:
The effects are graded as Silver,
Gold, and Platinum. The higher the
grade, the better the effect.
fields.JP:
付加効果には『シルバー』『ゴールド』『プラチナ』の
三つのグレードがあり、グレードが上がると
発生率や効果が高くなります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The effects are graded as Silver,
Gold, and Platinum. The higher the
grade, the better the effect.

fields.EN:
Stack the same added effect on multiple items
to increase its effect and activation rate.
Find a combination that suits your strategy.
fields.JP:
同じ付加効果は複数装備することで
効果や確率が上がります
自分の戦術にあった組み合わせを見つけてみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
These effects will stack, so find
the right set-up that will be
the best fit for your party.

fields.EN: So, what is it that you need?
fields.JP: それで、頼みたいことって何だい？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what is it that you need?

fields.EN:
Well, the shelves I had at
the store broke.
fields.JP: 実はさ、販売所の棚が壊れちゃったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, the shelves I had at
the store broke.

fields.JP: え？　それ大丈夫なのかい？

fields.EN:
Yeah, I'm fine, but it makes life
a pain without them.
fields.JP:
まぁ、大丈夫って言ったら大丈夫なんだけど、
やっぱりちょっと不便なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, I'm fine, but it makes life
a pain without them.

fields.EN:
So, you want us to find you some
shelves?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、依頼っていうのは僕たちに、
棚を探してきてくれってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you want us to find you some
shelves?

fields.EN:
That would be ideal, but I doubt
you'd find any good ones out
there.
fields.JP:
それでもいいけど、
壊れてない棚を見つけるのは大変でしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would be ideal, but I doubt
you'd find any good ones out
there.

fields.EN:
I'll make the shelves themselves, so I'd like
you and the others to bring me any usable wood
you find, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
棚自体はあたしが作るから、
おつうちゃん達には使えそうな木材を
持ってきてほしいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Instead, do you mind keeping an
eye out for wood that I can use
to make the shelves with?

fields.EN:
I see... Wood...
I wonder where I can find them.
fields.JP:
なるほど……木材か……
何処かにあったかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Wood...
I wonder where I can find them.

fields.EN:
Oh, and like I said, it only makes
life a bit of a pain, so keep it
low on your priority list.
fields.JP:
ああ、さっきも言ったけど、
ちょっと不便ってだけだから、
木材は見つかったらでいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and like I said, it only makes
life a bit of a pain, so keep it
low on your priority list.

fields.EN:
Got it.
If we stumble on some, we'll
be sure to bring them back.
fields.JP:
わかった
見つけたら持っていくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it.
If we stumble on some, we'll
be sure to bring them back.

fields.EN:
These look perfect to make
shelves with. I better bring them
back to Kaede.
fields.JP:
これなら棚を作るのにちょうど良さそうだな
戻ったら依頼所に持っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
These look perfect to make
shelves with. I better bring them
back to Kaede.

fields.EN: I found some wood for you.
fields.JP: 良さそうな木材を持ってきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I found some wood for you.

fields.EN:
Thanks! Now I can make the shelves!
I should get started right away. I can't wait!
fields.JP:
ありがとう！　これで棚が作れるわ！
早速作らなくっちゃね。腕が鳴るわよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks! I can make new shelves
with these! I'm gonna get started
pronto!

fields.EN:
You're going to make them now?
Do you mind if I watch?
fields.JP:
今から作るのかい？
だったら見学していいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to make them now?
Do you mind if I watch?

fields.EN:
Huh...
So that's how you make a shelf?
fields.JP: へぇ……棚ってこういう風に作るんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...
So that's how you make a shelf?

fields.EN:
All I did was hammer some nails
here and there, so it's a bit
rickety, but heck, it'll work...
fields.JP:
ただ釘で組み立ててるだけだから、
ガッタガタだけどね
まぁ、それでも無いよりかマシ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I did was hammer some nails
here and there, so it's a bit
rickety, but heck, it'll work...

fields.EN:
No problem! All I have to do is
put it back together again! We
have more wood too, so...
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫大丈夫
また組み立てなおせばいいだけだし、
木材はまだあるから――あ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem! All I have to do is
put it back together again! We
have more wood too, so...

fields.EN:
(Maybe the shelves broke because
of her...)
fields.JP:
（もしかして……棚が壊れたのって……
　カエデの力が強すぎたから？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe the shelves broke because
of her...)

fields.EN:
So, you wanted to see me?
What is it?
fields.JP:
それで？
僕たちに頼みたいことって何だい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you wanted to see me?
What is it?

fields.JP: おー、よくぞ聞いてくれました！

fields.EN:
See, I wanted to dismantle a rare
part I found, but I don't have the
proper tools to do it.
fields.JP:
いやさー、結構珍しい部品見つけたから
解体したいんだけど、
工具が足りないんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
See, I wanted to dismantle a rare
part I found, but I don't have the
proper tools to do it.

fields.EN:
Tools? You mean like a
screwdriver?
fields.JP: 工具っていうとドライバーとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tools? You mean like a
screwdriver?

fields.EN:
Bingo! That's exactly what I'm
missing. Oh, but I need one of
them tiny screwdrivers, you dig?
fields.JP:
そうそう、正にドライバーが足りないんだよ
つっても普通のじゃなくて、
極小ドライバーなんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bingo! That's exactly what I'm
missing. Oh, but I need one of
them tiny screwdrivers, you dig?

fields.EN:
So, my mission to you! Is!
Can you please bring me back
a mini-screwdriver?
fields.JP:
んで、君たちにお願いしたいのは
この極小ドライバーを探して持ってくること
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, my mission to you! Is!
Can you please bring me back
a mini-screwdriver?

fields.EN:
Sure thing, but I can't assure you
that we will find it...
fields.JP:
分かった
と言っても、見つかるかどうかは
分からないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure thing, but I can't assure you
that we will find it...

fields.EN:
Eh, if you can is fine. Not like
I need it right away anyway. Just
drop it off to me if you find one.
fields.JP:
まぁ、出来たらでいいよ
どうしても必要ってわけじゃないしねー
一応見つけたら、持ってきてほしいってだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eh, if you can is fine. Not like
I need it right away anyway. Just
drop it off to me if you find one.

fields.EN:
Will do. If I find one
I'll bring it to you.
fields.JP:
わかった
もし見つけたら持っていくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will do. If I find one
I'll bring it to you.

fields.EN:
Is this the mini-screwdriver
Takumi wanted? I better bring
it back to him.
fields.JP:
極小ドライバーってこれかな？
依頼所に持っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this the mini-screwdriver
Takumi wanted? I better bring
it back to him.

fields.EN:
Is this the mini-screwdriver you
were asking for?
fields.JP:
この前言ってた極小ドライバーって、
これのことかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this the mini-screwdriver you
were asking for?

fields.EN:
Ooh! That's the one!
I didn't expect ya to find one!
fields.JP:
お、お～！　これこれ！
マジで見つけて来たのか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! That's the one!
I didn't expect ya to find one!

fields.EN:
Didn't expect...?
Wait... You didn't think we'd
bring you back one?
fields.JP:
マジでって……
見つかると思ってなかったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't expect...?
Wait... You didn't think we'd
bring you back one?

fields.EN: To be honest, I didn't think you'd find one.
fields.JP: 正直に言うと見つかると思ってなかった

fields.EN:
C'mon, man, this stuff is
pretty darn rare. Also means
I super appreciate you found one.
fields.JP:
いやだってこれ結構レアなんだぜ？
だから、本当に感謝してる
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, man, this stuff is
pretty darn rare. Also means
I super appreciate you found one.

fields.EN:
It feels weird to hear you
thanking me...
fields.JP:
……なんか、
タクミに素直にお礼言われると調子が狂うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels weird to hear you
thanking me...

fields.EN:
Ouch... Well, I don't blame you
for saying that. Anyway, many
thanks for bringing one back.
fields.JP:
酷いなー。ま、自覚してるけどね
それだけ嬉しかったってことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ouch... Well, I don't blame you
for saying that. Anyway, many
thanks for bringing one back.

fields.EN:
Now then, I better get back to
business!
fields.JP: これでいろいろ作業が捗るからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I better get back to
business!

fields.EN:
Okay, well, good to hear...
As long as you're happy.
fields.JP:
そうか……なら、
こっちも素直にお礼を受け取っておくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, well, good to hear...
As long as you're happy.

fields.EN:
(I guess Takumi can be honest as
long as it has something to do
with what he likes.)
fields.JP:
（タクミも好きな物の前では、
　素直な反応になるんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess Takumi can be honest as
long as it has something to do
with what he likes.)

fields.EN:
A bag of beans... I assume it's
not very large, so I better keep
my eyes open for it.
fields.JP:
豆袋かぁ。小さい物だろうから、
見落とさないように気をつけておかないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
A bag of beans... I assume it's
not very large, so I better keep
my eyes open for it.

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised it got lost
after being chased by a Marchen.
I hope I can find it...
fields.JP:
大事な物でも、メルヒェンに追われたら
たしかにそれどころじゃなくて落とし
ちゃうよな。見つかるといいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised it got lost
after being chased by a Marchen.
I hope I can find it...

fields.EN:
This must be it...
Glad I found the bag of beans.
fields.JP:
ああ、これが例の豆袋かな。
見つかってよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
This must be it...
Glad I found the bag of beans.

fields.EN:
The beans must be pretty special
since it was kept in a special
bag...
fields.JP:
中身は豆、だよな？
袋に入れて大事に持っていたくらいだから、
なにか特別な豆だったのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The beans must be pretty special
since it was kept in a special
bag...

fields.EN:
It's nice they shared some beans,
but what should I do with them?
fields.JP:
豆袋を見つけたお礼にって、
少し豆を分けてもらったけど……。
うーん、どうしよう、これ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nice they shared some beans,
but what should I do with them?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Hm? Oh, this?
It's some beans I got after
returning the bag of beans.
fields.JP:
ああ、これ？
依頼のお礼にもらった豆だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Oh, this?
It's some beans I got after
returning the bag of beans.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Huh? You want them, Jack?
What are you going to do
with them?
fields.JP:
へ？　ジャック、この豆欲しいの？
どうするつもりだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You want them, Jack?
What are you going to do
with them?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Oh, you're going to eat them?
I never thought you'd want them,
but...
fields.JP:
ふぅん？　食べるんだ。
珍しいこと言うね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're going to eat them?
I never thought you'd want them,
but...

fields.EN:
Not like I need them anyway...
Let me toss them into your
mouth. Open wide...
fields.JP:
まぁ、いいや。
僕が持っていても仕方ないし、
欲しいならあげるよ。はい、あーん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not like I need them anyway...
Let me toss them into your
mouth. Open wide...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック
はぐっ、ぽりぽりぽり……ごっくん
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(Maybe he used to like beans? Jack and
beans... It kind of suits him, and kind
of doesn't. I can't really tell...)
fields.JP:
（もしかして昔は豆が好きだったのかな？
　ジャックと豆……。イメージが合うような
　合わないような。よくわからないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Jack liked beans from
before. Weird, Jack and beans
feels so natural together...)

fields.EN:
I know I'm going to ask
something unreasonable, but do
you mind listening to me?
fields.JP:
ダメ元で申し訳ないのだが……
君たちに頼みたいことがあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm going to ask
something unreasonable, but do
you mind listening to me?

fields.EN:
Sure.
What is it you want to ask?
fields.JP:
それは構わないけど……
頼みたいことっていうのはなんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure.
What is it you want to ask?

fields.EN:
Can you find me a blood sample?
There may be one left behind at
the old Liberated District.
fields.JP:
「血液サンプル」を探してきてほしい
元解放地区になら残っているかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you find me a blood sample?
There may be one left behind at
the old Liberated District.

fields.EN:
I highly doubt there's any left,
but if you happen across one,
please bring it back to me.
fields.JP:
だが、さっきも言った通りこれはダメ元だ
正直、今も残っている可能性は低いだろう
だから、できればで構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I highly doubt there's any left,
but if you happen across one,
please bring it back to me.

fields.EN:
Understood. We'll keep an eye
out for one when we're at the
old Liberated District.
fields.JP:
わかった
余裕があるときに、
元解放地区で探してみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. We'll keep an eye
out for one when we're at the
old Liberated District.

fields.EN:
I don't see any Marchens around
now, so I should check and see
if there's any blood samples left.
fields.JP:
今ならメルヒェンはいないみたいだし、
「血液サンプル」を探してみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see any Marchens around
now, so I should check and see
if there's any blood samples left.

fields.JP: 奥の方なら見つかるかな？

fields.EN:
I don't see any...
I guess they all went missing.
fields.JP:
なかなか見つからないな……
やっぱり残ってないのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see any...
I guess they all went missing.

fields.EN:
Hm...? Is this it? I think this
is what Itsuki was referring to.
I better bring it back to him.
fields.JP:
…………ん？　これじゃないか？
うん。たぶんそうだ
よし、持っていこう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...? Is this it? I think this
is what Itsuki was referring to.
I better bring it back to him.

fields.EN: Itsuki, I found a blood sample.
fields.JP: イツキ、「血液サンプル」見つけて来たよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Itsuki, I found a blood sample.

fields.EN:
This is it! Thank you!
This should help accelerate my
research!
fields.JP:
ああ、これだ！
ありがとう感謝する！
これで、研究が進むだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is it! Thank you!
This should help accelerate my
research!

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you were able to
find one remaining among
the ruins.
fields.JP:
しかし、あれだけの事があったのに
残っていたのは奇跡だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you were able to
find one remaining among
the ruins.

fields.EN:
I didn't expect to find one too,
but I guess luck was on our side.
fields.JP:
正直僕も残ってないと思ってたよ
日ごろの行いがよかったのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect to find one too,
but I guess luck was on our side.

fields.EN:
Sorry, Otsuu. You mind I ask
you something?
fields.JP:
すまん、おつう
ちょっと相談があるんだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, Otsuu. You mind I ask
you something?

fields.JP: 相談？　別にいいけど……なんだい？

fields.EN:
Well, you know how Hameln's
familiars are helping with the
rounds, right?
fields.JP:
ああ、この解放地区の見回りなんかを
ハーメルンの下僕のメルヒェン達に、
手伝ってもらってるんだけどさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you know how Hameln's
familiars are helping with the
rounds, right?

fields.EN:
But it's a bit of a pain to gather
them together, since they're
all over the place.
fields.JP:
いちいち声かけて回らないと
集まって来ないから、
頼み事するのめんどうなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's a bit of a pain to gather
them together, since they're
all over the place.

fields.EN:
So, I was thinking maybe there's
something I can use to gather
them. You got any clues?
fields.JP:
それで、あいつらを集めるための
道具かなんかあればいいと思うんだが、
なんか心当たりはないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I was thinking maybe there's
something I can use to gather
them. You got any clues?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Not really.
Any ideas, Hameln?
fields.JP:
うーん……僕はちょっと思いつかないな
ハーメルンはどう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Not really.
Any ideas, Hameln?

fields.EN:
Heh! They are my minions!
Of course they'd only listen
to me!
fields.JP:
ふふん！　あ奴らはこのワレの下僕だぞ？
ワレ以外に統率できるわけがなかろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh! They are my minions!
Of course they'd only listen
to me!

fields.EN:
Which means Hameln has no
clue, too.
fields.JP: ハーメルンにも心当たりはないみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means Hameln has no
clue, too.

fields.EN:
I see...
Well, it was worth the try.
fields.JP:
そうか……わかった
じゃあしょうがねぇな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Well, it was worth the try.

fields.EN:
Not that I can't communicate
with them... Well, thanks for
listening.
fields.JP:
めんどうだけど、
どうにもならないわけじゃないしな
この話は気にしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that I can't communicate
with them... Well, thanks for
listening.

fields.EN:
Come now, we'll see if there's
anything that can help. We may
find something out there.
fields.JP:
そういうわけにもいかないだろ
外で何か探してくるから待っててくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, we'll see if there's
anything that can help. We may
find something out there.

fields.EN:
You girls are busy though.
You sure about that?
fields.JP: でも忙しいだろ？　いいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You girls are busy though.
You sure about that?

fields.EN:
I can't guarantee we'll find
something, but we can at least
try.
fields.JP:
片手間で探すくらいならできるよ
見つかるかどうかは分からないけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't guarantee we'll find
something, but we can at least
try.

fields.JP: 探してくれるだけでも大助かりだ

fields.EN:
Maybe Mamoru can use this to
get Hameln's familiars together.
fields.JP:
これならマモルがハーメルンの
下僕を集めるのに使えるかもな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe Mamoru can use this to
get Hameln's familiars together.

fields.EN:
Mamoru, about that thing about
gathering the familiars...
Maybe this will help.
fields.JP:
マモル。この間のことだけど、
これなら集められるんじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, about that thing about
gathering the familiars...
Maybe this will help.

fields.EN:
A whistle? I guess this may work.
Let me try...
fields.JP:
これは……笛か。
確かに、これなら良さそうだな
ちょっと試してみるか
fields.LOCALIZED:
A whistle? I guess this may work.
Let me try...

fields.EN:
Whoa! They're all coming!
I won't need to go around trying
to corral them!
fields.JP:
おお！　集まってきた！
これでいちいち呼び回らなくてすむぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! They're all coming!
I won't need to go around trying
to corral them!

fields.JP: 上手くいったみたいでよかったよ

fields.EN:
Yeah, and it's all thanks to you!
You're the best!
fields.JP:
ああ、おまえらのおかげだ！
ありがとうな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and it's all thanks to you!
You're the best!

fields.EN:
I didn't expect my minions to
gather with just a whistle...
fields.JP:
ワレの下僕は笛で集まる様な、
単純な奴らだったのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect my minions to
gather with just a whistle...

fields.EN:
Glad to see ya!
I'm soooo in need of help!
fields.JP:
よく来てくれたわ～
もうホント私、今困ってるのよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad to see ya!
I'm soooo in need of help!

fields.EN:
Uh, you sound worse than usual...
What's the matter?
fields.JP:
なんかいつも以上に様子がおかしいけど、
どうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you sound worse than usual...
What's the matter?

fields.EN:
Um...
I found cockroaches in my room.
fields.JP: それが……私の部屋にゴキブリが出たのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um...
I found cockroaches in my room.

fields.JP:
そうよ！　
もうマジムリ！

fields.EN:
I'm never gonna be able to
sleep again with them around!
fields.JP:
あんなのがいる部屋じゃ、
私眠れないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm never gonna be able to
sleep again with them around!

fields.EN:
You're blowing this all out
of proportion...
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're blowing this all out
of proportion...

fields.EN:
No I'm not! Pretty please!
Bring me something that can
get rid of em roaches!
fields.JP:
大げさじゃないんだよ～！
お願いだから、なんかゴキブリを
退治できる物を持ってきてちょうだい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No I'm not! Pretty please!
Bring me something that can
get rid of em roaches!

fields.EN:
Huh... But, aren't Marchens
scarier than roaches?
fields.JP:
えぇ……
だいたいゴキブリより、
メルヒェンの方が怖いじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... But, aren't Marchens
scarier than roaches?

fields.EN:
The type of scare they each induce
is different! So, please!
Pretty please with sugar on it!
fields.JP:
それとこれとは恐怖の種類が違うのよ～
ね？　お願い！　ほ～んとに、お願い！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The type of scare they each induce
is different! So, please!
Pretty please with sugar on it!

fields.EN:
*sigh* Fine...
You're going to owe me one.
fields.JP:
はぁ……わかったよ
これは貸しだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Fine...
You're going to owe me one.

fields.EN:
A poison dumpling?
I guess this can get rid of the
roaches bothering Takumi...
fields.JP:
これは……ほうさん団子？
ゴキブリ殺せるみたいだし、これでいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
A poison dumpling?
I guess this can get rid of the
roaches bothering Takumi...

fields.EN:
Ooh! I can use it to get rid of
the roaches! Thanks, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
おお！　これで奴らを退治できるわー！
ありがとう！　おつうちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! I can use it to get rid of
the roaches! Thanks, Otsuu!

fields.EN:
No problem. Glad to hear...
Hm? Isn't that a cockroach?
fields.JP:
はいはい。それは良かったね……って、
そこにいるのゴキブリじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem. Glad to hear...
Hm? Isn't that a cockroach?

fields.EN:
Aha! We meet again!
Time for you to perish!
fields.JP:
此処であったが百年目！
成敗でござるー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aha! We meet again!
Time for you to perish!

fields.EN:
Heh...
The evil has been dispatched.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh...
The evil has been dispatched.

fields.EN:
You're not scared of
them at all...
fields.JP: タクミ、ゴキブリ平気じゃないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not scared of
them at all...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Hey, Jack.
What are you doing here?
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャック。こんなところにいたのか。
ボーっとしてどうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Jack.
What are you doing here?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
That? Oh, you were looking at
the Jail Tower?
fields.JP:
あれって……監獄塔を見てたのか？
ふーん
fields.LOCALIZED:
That? Oh, you were looking at
the Jail Tower?

fields.EN:
(Jack sometimes does strange
things. I shouldn't be surprised
though since he is a Nightmare.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックってときどき不思議な行動
　するよなぁ。まぁ、ナイトメアなんだから
　人間の基準で考えても仕方ないけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jack sometimes does strange
things. I shouldn't be surprised
though since he is a Nightmare.)

fields.EN:
That aside, we have a mission.
Let's get going, Jack.
fields.JP:
それより依頼を受けたんだ。
行こう、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside, we have a mission.
Let's get going, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan? Jack-san's been staring at
the tower the whole day.
Do you know why?
fields.JP:
ねぇ、おつうちゃん。
ジャックさん、今日はずっと監獄塔を見てるの。
どうしたんだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? Jack's been staring at
the tower the whole day.
Do you know why?

fields.EN:
(He was like that the last time,
too. I wonder why he's staring
at it...)
fields.JP:
（たしか、依頼を受ける前もあんな感じ
　だったっけ。本当にどうしたんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He was like that the last time,
too. I wonder why he's staring
at it...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack, you're looking at the tower
again, are you?
fields.JP: ジャック、また監獄塔を見てたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, you're looking at the tower
again, are you?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Are you that interested in it?
Like, you want to have it?
fields.JP:
そんなに監獄塔が気になるのか？
あれが欲しいとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you that interested in it?
Like, you want to have it?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Up? You want to climb the tower?
fields.JP: 上？　あの上に登りたいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Up? You want to climb the tower?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Well, that's going to be a
tough climb.
fields.JP: はは、それは大変そうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's going to be a
tough climb.

fields.EN:
(He wants to climb the Jail Tower... Is
that a Nightmare instinct, or Jack's own
wish...? Either way, it's a strange urge.)
fields.JP:
（監獄塔に登りたい、か。ナイトメアとしての
　本能か、ジャック自身の望みか……。
　どちらにしても不思議な欲求だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if wanting to climb the
tower is Jack's desire? A pretty
odd desire if you ask me.)

fields.EN: What is it you want, Hikari?
fields.JP: それで、ヒカリが頼みたいことって何だい？
fields.LOCALIZED: What is it you want, Hikari?

fields.EN:
Um, it's not absolutely necessary,
so only if you can, but I'd like
you to find some helmets for me.
fields.JP:
えーと、絶対に必要ってわけじゃないから、
できればでいいんだけど、
ヘルメットをいくつか探してきてほしいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, not that I really need it
right away, but do you mind
finding some helmets for me?

fields.EN:
Yup!
Oh, and large ones at that.
fields.JP:
うん！　
それも、ちょっと大きめの物が欲しくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup!
Oh, and large ones at that.

fields.EN:
Large helmets...
Okay, I'll keep my eye out for
them.
fields.JP:
大きめのヘルメットか……
分かった。探してみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Large helmets...
Okay, I'll keep my eye out for
them.

fields.EN:
Thanks!
Oh, but really, no need to go
out of your way for them.
fields.JP:
ありがとう！
でも、無理しなくていいからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks!
Oh, but really, no need to go
out of your way for them.

fields.EN:
Will do.
Well, I'll be going now.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ
じゃあ、行ってくる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will do.
Well, I'll be going now.

fields.EN:
I wonder if these helmets would
work for Hikari? I better take
them back with me.
fields.JP:
大きめのヘルメットってこれでいいのかな
ヒカリのところに持って行ってみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if these helmets would
work for Hikari? I better take
them back with me.

fields.EN:
I brought the helmets, but will
these do?
fields.JP:
ヘルメット持ってきたけど、
これでいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I brought the helmets, but will
these do?

fields.EN:
Let me see...
Yup, they should work just fine!
fields.JP:
えーっと……うん
これならたぶん大丈夫！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me see...
Yup, they should work just fine!

fields.EN:
That's good to hear.
So, what were you planning on
doing with them?
fields.JP:
そうか、それはよかった
それで？　このヘルメットは
なんに使うんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear.
So, what were you planning on
doing with them?

fields.EN:
I was gonna hand them out to
Hameln-chan's familiars.
fields.JP:
このヘルメットはね
ハーメルンちゃんのしもべさん達に
渡そうと思ってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was gonna hand them out to
Hameln's familiars.

fields.EN:
They go out to dangerous places
too, right?
fields.JP:
しもべさん達は危険なところにも
行ってもらってるでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They go out to dangerous places
too, right?

fields.EN:
So, I wanted to give them these
so that they can avoid getting
hurt from above.
fields.JP:
だから、少しでも怪我しないように、
せめてヘルメットを着けてあげたいって、
思ったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I wanted to give them these
so that they can avoid getting
hurt from above.

fields.EN:
I see. I'm sure they'd all be
happy you got them the helmets.
fields.JP:
なるほど
きっとしもべ達も喜んでくれるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. I'm sure they'd all be
happy you got them the helmets.

fields.EN:
(She's so kind...
She even extended her
kindness to the Marchens...)
fields.JP:
（メルヒェンまで心配するなんて、
　この子は本当に優しい子だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so kind...
She even extended her
kindness to the Marchens...)

fields.EN:
I was planning on making something
cool, but I don't have the
propellers I need, so...
fields.JP:
今ちょっと作ろうと思ってる物があるんだけど、
プロペラが足りないんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was planning on making something
cool, but I don't have the
propellers I need, so...

fields.EN:
So you want us to find some
for you, right?
fields.JP: それを僕たちが持ってくればいいんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you want us to find some
for you, right?

fields.EN:
Bingo!
You know me like a book!
fields.JP:
そうそうそのとーり！
いやぁ、話が早いねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bingo!
You know me like a book!

fields.EN:
Oh, but it's only cool and not
super important, so whenever
you come across some is fine.
fields.JP:
まぁでも、今作ってるのは
必需品ってわけじゃないから、
もし、見つかったらでいいよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but it's only cool and not
super important, so whenever
you come across some is fine.

fields.EN:
Okay, we'll keep an eye out
for some.
fields.JP: とりあえず、探すだけ探してみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, we'll keep an eye out
for some.

fields.EN:
I guess these propellers will do.
I wonder what Takumi is planning
to make with them.
fields.JP:
プロペラってこれだよな
タクミは一体何を作ろうとしてるんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess these propellers will do.
I wonder what Takumi is planning
to make with them.

fields.EN:
I'll just take them to him and
ask him then.
fields.JP:
とりあえず持って行って、
そのときに聞いてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll just take them to him and
ask him then.

fields.EN:
Here are some propellers.
Will these work?
fields.JP:
プロペラを持ってきたよ
これでいいかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here are some propellers.
Will these work?

fields.EN:
Ooh! Nice! Thanks!
Man, these are gonna spin
like crazy!
fields.JP:
おおー！　これこれ！　ありがとう！
いやぁ、実によく回りそうな、
いいプロペラだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! Nice! Thanks!
Man, these are gonna spin
like crazy!

fields.EN:
So, what in the world are you
planning on making?
fields.JP:
それで、いったい何を
作ろうとしてるんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what in the world are you
planning on making?

fields.EN:
Glad ya asked! I'm a making us
some electric fans!
fields.JP:
よくぞ聞いてくれたわね！
私は今、扇風機を作っているのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad ya asked! I'm a making us
some electric fans!

fields.EN:
Oh, I see. That's what you meant
by "cool." It can get hot and
muggy around here.
fields.JP:
あ、なるほど
ここは確かに蒸し暑いし、
ちょうどいいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see. That's what you meant
by "cool." It can get hot and
muggy around here.

fields.EN:
Right? I should have a number of
them ready soon enough, so I'll
bring ya one later.
fields.JP:
でしょでしょ
幾つか作れるから、
できたら持って行ってあげるね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? I should have a number of
them ready soon enough, so I'll
bring ya one later.

fields.EN:
They did help keep the temperature
in check back at Dawn, so I'd
love to get one. Thanks.
fields.JP:
黎明時代のときも部屋にあると、
大分過ごしやすかったからね
是非お願いするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They did help keep the temperature
in check back at Dawn, so I'd
love to get one. Thanks.

fields.EN:
Say, we have a lot of girls
with us now, right?
fields.JP: 最近さ、人がずいぶん増えたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, we have a lot of girls
with us now, right?

fields.EN:
Yes, and some of them are
Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
うん。
僕たちの仲間も増えたからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and some of them are
Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
So yeah, I'm getting a lot of
orders for hairpins now.
Lost all my inventory already.
fields.JP:
それで、髪留めを注文する
人が増えたんだけど、
在庫が無くなっちゃったのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So yeah, I'm getting a lot of
orders for hairpins now.
Lost all my inventory already.

fields.EN:
If you come across hairpins during
your expeditions, can you bring
them to me?
fields.JP:
だから、出来たらでいいんだけど、
髪留めになりそうなものがあったら、
拾ってきてくれない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you come across hairpins during
your expeditions, can you bring
them to me?

fields.EN:
Got it. I wouldn't mind getting
one too myself anyway.
fields.JP:
わかった、いいよ
僕もちょっと欲しいしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it. I wouldn't mind getting
one too myself anyway.

fields.JP:
よかった～
じゃあ、よろしくね

fields.EN:
That should be enough hairpins
for Kaede. I better head back.
fields.JP:
髪留めはこれだけあればいいかな
依頼所に持っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That should be enough hairpins
for Kaede. I better head back.

fields.EN:
Kaede, I brought some hairpins
back.
fields.JP: カエデ、髪留め持ってきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaede, I brought some hairpins
back.

fields.EN:
Really?! Thanks!
I think what you have
there will do.
fields.JP:
本当に！？　ありがとう！
これだけあれば、当分は大丈夫だと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?! Thanks!
I think what you have
there will do.

fields.EN:
These are all so cute! But, I'm
sure the guys are gonna be a
bit hesitant to use them.
fields.JP:
でも、見事に可愛いヘアピンばかりね
これを男の人がつけるのは、躊躇しそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
These are all so cute! But, I'm
sure the guys are gonna be a
bit hesitant to use them.

fields.EN:
Well, they're going to have to
get over it.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、その辺は
我慢してもらうしかないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, they're going to have to
get over it.

fields.EN:
Yeah, we're just lucky you were
able to come across them.
fields.JP:
ま、それもそうね
見つかっただけよしと思わなくちゃね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we're just lucky you were
able to come across them.

fields.EN:
Speaking of, your hair is pretty
long, so why don't you use
one of these hairpins?
fields.JP:
ところで、カエデも結構髪長いけど
こういう可愛いヘアピンは使わないのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of, your hair is pretty
long, so why don't you use
one of these hairpins?

fields.EN:
Oh, hell no! I don't look good
with them on!
fields.JP:
ないない！　
ガサツなあたしがこんなの着けても
似合わないって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, hell no! I don't look good
with them on!

fields.EN:
I don't think so.
I think they'd look cute on you.
fields.JP:
そうかな？
けっこう似合うと思うけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think so.
I think they'd look cute on you.

fields.EN:
Yes. Like, this red hairpin would
look great on you.
fields.JP:
うん
ほら、この赤っぽいのとか似合いそうだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Like, this red hairpin would
look great on you.

fields.EN:
Well, I guess I can try some of
them on... They are cute, too.
fields.JP:
そう言うなら、気が向いたらあたしも
たまには可愛いヘアピンを着けてみようかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess I can try some of
them on... They are cute, too.

fields.EN:
(Kaede may not show it,
but she really has a nice,
feminine side to her.)
fields.JP:
（なんだかんだ言っても、
　興味がある辺りカエデも女の子だよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaede may not show it,
but she really has a nice,
feminine side to her.)

fields.EN:
I have a personal request that
I wasn't hoping would bother
you much with.
fields.JP:
すまない。私的な事なので、
本来なら頼むべきじゃないのかもしれないが、
ちょっと困っていてな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a personal request that
I wasn't hoping would bother
you much with.

fields.EN:
No problem, but what is it
that you want?
fields.JP:
それはいいけど、
困ってるっていったいどうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem, but what is it
that you want?

fields.EN:
It seems as if my vision has taken
a nosedive recently, and my
glasses aren't helping much now.
fields.JP:
いや、実はどうにも視力が落ちたようでな
眼鏡の度が合わないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if my vision has taken
a nosedive recently, and my
glasses aren't helping much now.

fields.EN:
You're losing your vision...?
Are you all right?
fields.JP: 視力が落ちたって……大丈夫なのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're losing your vision...?
Are you all right?

fields.EN:
It's not as bad as it sounds, but
it is hampering my research
progress.
fields.JP:
日常生活を送る上では問題ない
ただ、研究の時に少し不便でな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not as bad as it sounds, but
it is hampering my research
progress.

fields.EN:
So, what I was hoping was for
you to find me a pair of lens
that I can use for my glasses.
fields.JP:
それで、君たちにお願いしたいのは
眼鏡か眼鏡のレンズを探してきて欲しいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what I was hoping was for
you to find me a pair of lens
that I can use for my glasses.

fields.EN:
Sure I can do that, but there's no
assurance that what I find
will correct your vision.
fields.JP:
それはいいけど……
持ってきたものが度が合うとは限らないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure I can do that, but there's no
assurance that what I find
will correct your vision.

fields.EN:
That shouldn't be a problem.
I can adjust it a bit to conform
better to my vision.
fields.JP:
そのあたりは大丈夫だ
ある程度ならこちらで調整できる
fields.LOCALIZED:
That shouldn't be a problem.
I can adjust it a bit to conform
better to my vision.

fields.EN:
Besides, it's not like I can't do
research as things are. Just look
for one if you have some spare time.
fields.JP:
それに、今のままでも
研究ができないわけじゃないからな
探すのも暇があったらで構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind you, my vision is merely an
inconvenience, so whenever you
come across one is fine.

fields.EN:
Understood. I can't guarantee I'd
find the perfect fit, but I'll try
my best.
fields.JP:
わかった
丁度いいのが見つかるかどうかは
分からないけど、探してくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. I can't guarantee I'd
find the perfect fit, but I'll try
my best.

fields.EN:
I wonder if these lens will help
correct Itsuki's vision?
fields.JP:
眼鏡のレンズってこれかな？
ちゃんと度が合うといいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if these lens will help
correct Itsuki's vision?

fields.EN:
I better take it back to him
and see.
fields.JP: とりあえず、依頼所に持っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better take it back to him
and see.

fields.JP: 頼まれていたもの持ってきたよ

fields.EN:
Yes, it just needs some minor
adjustments, but it should work
fine.
fields.JP:
ああ、これなら少し調整するだけで、
十分使えそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it just needs some minor
adjustments, but it should work
fine.

fields.EN:
That's good to hear. I was
wondering what to do if it
didn't help correct your vision.
fields.JP:
よかった
度が合わなかったらどうしようかと思った
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear. I was
wondering what to do if it
didn't help correct your vision.

fields.EN:
I can assure you that I will be
able to make great progress with
my research now. Thank you!
fields.JP:
これで、良く見えるようになり研究が捗る！
ありがとう、君たちのおかげだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can assure you that I will be
able to make great progress with
my research now. Thank you!

fields.EN:
Oh, but please don't research to
the extent that you drop your
vision.
fields.JP:
けど、せっかく僕たちが持ってきたんだ、
研究のし過ぎでさらに視力を落とすのは
やめてくれよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but please don't research to
the extent that you drop your
vision.

fields.EN:
Hm... I will try my best not to
do that. Now, if you will excuse
me...
fields.JP:
うっ……ぜ、善処しよう
では、僕はこれで失礼するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I will try my best not to
do that. Now, if you will excuse
me...

fields.EN:
I almost feel like he puts more
time into research than Gretel.
fields.JP:
やれやれ、あれは下手したら
グレーテル以上の研究好きだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I almost feel like he puts more
time into research than Gretel.

fields.EN:
He did say he'd try his best not
to, but I have a feeling he's just
going to worsen his vision again.
fields.JP:
善処するって言ってたけど、
また目を悪くしそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He did say he'd try his best not
to, but I have a feeling he's just
going to worsen his vision again.

fields.JP: 花を持ってきてほしい？

fields.EN:
Yeah, like this one. The problem
is, I don't think you'd find them
around here anymore.
fields.JP:
ああ。こういう感じの花だ
ただ、もうどこにも咲いてないかも
知れないから、探索のついででいいぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, like this one. The problem
is, I don't think you'd find them
around here anymore.

fields.EN:
I don't mind looking for them
while on our expeditions, but
I'm surprised you want flowers.
fields.JP:
探索のついででいいなら構わないけど
でも、花なんて意外だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't mind looking for them
while on our expeditions, but
I'm surprised you want flowers.

fields.EN:
I know it ain't like me to want
flowers...
fields.JP: ガラじゃないのは分かってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it ain't like me to want
flowers...

fields.EN:
Hm... Not sure what you want
them for, but I'll be sure to
bring some back if I find some.
fields.JP:
ふーん。まぁ、何に使うかは分からないけど
見つけたら取ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Not sure what you want
them for, but I'll be sure to
bring some back if I find some.

fields.EN:
These look just like the flower
Mamoru wanted.
fields.JP:
聞いてた特徴と一致する
たぶんこれがマモルが言っていた花だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
These look just like the flower
Mamoru wanted.

fields.EN:
Okay, I'll take some back
to him.
fields.JP: よし。いくつか摘んで行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, I'll take some back
to him.

fields.EN:
I found the flower you wanted,
so here you go...
fields.JP:
頼まれていた花を見つけたから、
いくつか摘んできたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found the flower you wanted,
so here you go...

fields.EN:
I'm surprised they're still
around... Good! Just hold on
a second!
fields.JP:
まだ残ってたんだな……
よし！　ちょっと待ってろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised they're still
around... Good! Just hold on
a second!

fields.EN:
Okay... I do this... and this...
Done!
fields.JP:
えっと……これをこうして……
よし、できた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... I do this... and this...
Done!

fields.EN:
That's fine, but what were you
doing back there?
fields.JP: それはいいけど……なにしてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine, but what were you
doing back there?

fields.JP: これを作ってたんだよ

fields.EN:
I made this fragrance pouch
using the flowers you got.
fields.JP:
おまえ達にとって来てもらった花で、
香り袋を作ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I made this fragrance pouch
using the flowers you got.

fields.EN:
Right? Hikari taught me how
to make it.
fields.JP: だろ？　昔ヒカリに教えてもらったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? Hikari taught me how
to make it.

fields.EN: Huh... But, why make it now?
fields.JP:
へぇー……
でも、なんでこれを今作ったの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh... But, why make it now?

fields.EN:
You know how this place is musty
and things? I figured it can help
make the place a little better.
fields.JP:
ほら、ここってかび臭いだろ？
だから、こういう物があると
少しはマシになると思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how this place is musty
and things? I figured it can help
make the place a little better.

fields.EN:
I see...
It does smell good and makes
you feel a little better.
fields.JP:
なるほど、確かに
これがあると気が休まるかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
It does smell good and makes
you feel a little better.

fields.EN:
It does, right? So, I made enough
for all you girls, so you mind
handing them out for me?
fields.JP:
だろ？
おまえらの分もあるから、
みんなに配ってくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It does, right? So, I made enough
for all you girls, so you mind
handing them out for me?

fields.EN:
You made it for all of us?
Um... Thanks...
fields.JP: 僕たちの分もあるのか……その、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You made it for all of us?
Um... Thanks...

fields.EN:
No need to thank me. You're the
one who went and picked the
flowers.
fields.JP:
お礼なんて要らねぇよ
だいたい、これはおまえらが持ってきた
花があったから作れたんだぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to thank me. You're the
one who went and picked the
flowers.

fields.EN:
If anything, I owe you girls
all the thanks in the world.
fields.JP:
お礼を言うならこっちの方だ
ありがとうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anything, I owe you girls
all the thanks in the world.

fields.EN:
You really know how to sweet
talk at the strangest of times...
fields.JP: まったく……調子が狂うな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really know how to sweet
talk at the strangest of times...

fields.EN:
Yup! If you find any, do you mind
bringing them to me?
fields.JP:
うん
見つかったらでいいんだけどね、
取ってきてほしいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! If you find any, do you mind
bringing them to me?

fields.EN:
Sure thing. I'll be sure to keep
an eye out for them.
fields.JP:
分かった
見つかったら持ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure thing. I'll be sure to keep
an eye out for them.

fields.EN:
These are... sugar beets!
Good! I'll take some back to
Hikari.
fields.JP:
これは……砂糖大根だ！
よし、持っていこう!
fields.LOCALIZED:
These are... sugar beets!
Good! I'll take some back to
Hikari.

fields.EN:
Hikari, I got those sugar beets
that you wanted.
fields.JP: ヒカリ、砂糖大根取ってきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikari, I got those sugar beets
that you wanted.

fields.JP: ありがとう、おつうくん！

fields.EN:
So, what are you planning on
cooking?
fields.JP:
ところでそれ、どうするんだい？
何かそれで料理を作るのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what are you planning on
cooking?

fields.EN:
Well, before I cook them,
I want to cultivate them.
fields.JP:
最終的にはそうするけど、
まずは育てて数を増やすつもりだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, before I cook them,
I want to cultivate them.

fields.EN:
Yup! Mamoru likes sugar beets,
and I wanted to have a crop for
us to enjoy, too!
fields.JP:
うん！　
この砂糖大根はマモルの好きな物だからね！
いつでも食べれるようにしたいし、
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Mamoru likes sugar beets,
and I wanted to have a crop for
us to enjoy, too!

fields.EN:
Then everyone can enjoy some
tasty sugar beets!
fields.JP: みんなにもご馳走してあげたいの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then everyone can enjoy some
tasty sugar beets!

fields.EN:
I see. So, you're doing this
for Mamoru, eh?
fields.JP:
なるほどね
マモルの好物だからか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So, you're doing this
for Mamoru, eh?

fields.EN:
Oh, um... I thought I said
this is for us to enjoy...
fields.JP:
あ、いや……その、みんなにも
食べてもらいたいんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... I thought I said
this is for us to enjoy...

fields.EN: I see you're telling the truth.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see you're telling the truth.

fields.EN:
You want all of us to enjoy the
sugar beets, but you want
Mamoru to have first dibs, right?
fields.JP:
みんなに食べてもらいたいのは
本当なんだけど、一番食べて欲しいのは
マモルなんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You want all of us to enjoy the
sugar beets, but you want
Mamoru to have first dibs, right?

fields.EN:
(I guess this just shows how
she feels about Mamoru...)
fields.JP:
（やれやれ、ヒカリとマモルは
　本当に仲がいいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess this just shows how
she feels about Mamoru...)

fields.EN:
You lost a frog plushie, was it?
It must have been special to you.
fields.JP:
君がなくしたっていうカエルのぬいぐるみ、
よっぽど大切なものだったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You lost a frog plushie, was it?
It must have been special to you.

fields.EN:
Yup... My mom gave it to me,
but I dropped while coming here.
fields.JP:
うん……。
ここに来る途中で落としてきちゃったんだ。
お母さんがくれたものだったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... My mom gave it to me,
but I dropped while coming here.

fields.EN: First my mom's gone... And now...
fields.JP: お母さん……もういないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: First my mom's gone... And now...

fields.EN:
(I see... So it was a keepsake
left behind by his mother.)
fields.JP: （そうか。母親の形見だったんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... So it was a keepsake
left behind by his mother.)

fields.JP:
わかった。
落ちていないか、気をつけてみるよ。
見つかったらちゃんと届けてあげるね

fields.EN:
Isn't this the frog plushie the
kid was looking for? It's great
I found it, but...
fields.JP:
……これ、あの子が探していた
カエルのぬいぐるみだよな？
見つかったのはいいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't this the frog plushie the
kid was looking for? It's great
I found it, but...

fields.EN:
(It's torn with only the head
remaining... What is he going to
say seeing it like this...?)
fields.JP:
（もうボロボロで首だけになっちゃってる。
　この状態で返すのも残酷な気がするな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's torn with only the head
remaining... What is he going to
say seeing it like this...?)

fields.EN:
(It can't be helped. I better take
it back to him. It is his precious
keepsake from his mother...)
fields.JP:
（でも仕方ない。とにかく報告するだけ
　報告しよう。どんな状態でも、
　あの子にとっては母親の形見だもんね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It can't be helped. I better take
it back to him. It is his precious
keepsake from his mother...)

fields.EN:
Here's your lost frog plushie.
Unfortunately, it was like this
when I found it...
fields.JP:
はい、カエルのぬいぐるみ。
見つけたときにはもうこの状態に
なっていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here's your lost frog plushie.
Unfortunately, it was like this
when I found it...

fields.EN:
Only the head...?
My mom's... My special plushie...
fields.JP:
あ……首だけになっちゃってる……。
お母さんがくれたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only the head...?
My mom's... My special plushie...

fields.EN:
(It must be shocking... I'm not
sure it was the right move to
bring just its head back...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりショックだろうな。
　一部だけでも戻ってよかったとはいえ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must be shocking... I'm not
sure it was the right move to
bring just its head back...)

fields.EN:
Oh, don't be scared. Jack may look
scary, but he's nice and gentle.
fields.JP:
ああ、怖がらないで。
このジャックは見た目は怖いけど、
本当は大人しくていい奴だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, don't be scared. Jack may look
scary, but he's nice and gentle.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(Hm? Why is Jack plucking
the leaf on his head?)
fields.JP: （ん？　ジャックが自分の葉っぱを取った……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Why is Jack plucking
the leaf on his head?)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Huh...? You're giving it to me?
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh...? You're giving it to me?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Um... Is he trying to cheer me up?
fields.JP: えっと……慰めてくれてるのかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... Is he trying to cheer me up?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Thanks...
I'm sorry I was scared...
fields.JP:
……ありがとう。
さっきは驚いちゃって、ごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks...
I'm sorry I was scared...

fields.EN:
Onii-san, I'm sorry too. Even though you
found my plushie for me, I got all
depressed...
fields.JP:
お兄さんも、ごめんなさい。
せっかくぬいぐるみを見つけてくれたのに、
落ち込んじゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I'm sorry I was like that...
You went and found my
plushie like I asked...

fields.EN:
That's fine. It's not much, but
be sure you take good care of it.
fields.JP:
いいんだよ。大事なものは、
もうなくさないようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine. It's not much, but
be sure you take good care of it.

fields.EN:
It looks like he's fine now,
and it's all because of you, Jack.
fields.JP:
元気になってくれたみたいでよかった。
ジャックのおかげだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like he's fine now,
and it's all because of you, Jack.

fields.EN:
You really are kind.
You're always the same Jack
no matter what.
fields.JP:
やっぱりジャックは優しいな。
どんな姿になっても、君は君ってことだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are kind.
You're always the same Jack
no matter what.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(Hm, but I didn't know his leaves
comes off... Wait a second...
It's grown back already... Wow...)
fields.JP:
（それはそうと、あの頭の葉っぱって
　普通に取れるんだな……
　っていうか、もう生えてるし。戻るの早っ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm, but I didn't know his leaves
comes off... Wait a second...
It's grown back already... Wow...)

fields.EN:
All the shovels I was using broke, so if
you find any, could you bring them to me...?
fields.JP:
私の使ってたシャベルが
全部壊れちゃったから、
見つけたら持ってきて欲しいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The shovel I was using broke,
so I was hoping you could find
one for me.

fields.EN:
I thought I told you a thousand
times... I'll take care of the
digging, so don't bother her.
fields.JP:
だから、何度も言ってるだろ？
わざわざおつう達に頼む必要はねぇよ
俺がでかいので掘るから、それでいいだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I told you a thousand
times... I'll take care of the
digging, so don't bother her.

fields.EN:
Um... So you want me to
do what again?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... So you want me to
do what again?

fields.EN:
Hey, Mamoru, can you be quiet for
a moment?! I wanna help you dig!
fields.JP:
もう！　マモルはちょっと静かにしてて！
私も一緒に掘りたいの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Mamoru, can you be quiet for
a moment?! I wanna help you dig!

fields.JP:
……分かったよ
しょうがねぇな

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry, Otsuu-kun. So, I was
hoping you could find a shovel for
me.
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんねおつうくん
ほんと、探索のついででいいから、
出来ればシャベルを見つけてきて欲しいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry, Otsuu. So, I was
hoping you could find a shovel for
me.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what exactly is going
on here, but... find a shovel?
Got it.
fields.JP:
なんだかよく分からないけど……
シャベルを見つけたら持ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what exactly is going
on here, but... find a shovel?
Got it.

fields.JP: ありがとう、おつうくん！

fields.EN:
This shovel would be perfect
for Hikari.
fields.JP:
このシャベルはヒカリに
ちょうどいいかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
This shovel would be perfect
for Hikari.

fields.EN: I better take it back to her.
fields.JP: 依頼所に持っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED: I better take it back to her.

fields.EN:
I found a right sized shovel,
so... here.
fields.JP:
良さそうなシャベルがあったから
持ってきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found a right sized shovel,
so... here.

fields.EN:
Thanks, Otsuu-kun!
I can get back to digging again!
fields.JP:
ありがとうおつうくん！
これで私も一緒に掘る事ができるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, Otsuu!
I can get back to digging again!

fields.EN:
You're very welcome. So, what
exactly are you digging for?
fields.JP:
どういたしまして
それで、そのシャベルで何をしてるんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're very welcome. So, what
exactly are you digging for?

fields.EN:
We were digging graves for
Hameln's familiars.
fields.JP:
俺達は、ハーメルンのしもべ達の
墓を掘ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were digging graves for
Hameln's familiars.

fields.EN:
I just wanted to help by digging
the graves for them...
fields.JP:
うん
それで、その時に私も一緒に
お墓を作ってあげたかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just wanted to help by digging
the graves for them...

fields.EN:
I didn't know you two were
doing that for my minions...
fields.JP:
まさか……ワレのしもべの為に、
裏でそんなことをしてくれていたとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you two were
doing that for my minions...

fields.EN:
As their master, I give you my
thanks. Thank you for caring
for them till the end.
fields.JP:
主として礼を言う
しもべ達を弔ってくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
As their master, I give you my
thanks. Thank you for caring
for them till the end.

fields.EN:
We're just doing what's expected.
To add, they are our friends
now, you know?
fields.JP:
べつに、当たり前のことをしてるだけだ
何だかんだあいつらもすっかり仲間だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're just doing what's expected.
To add, they are our friends
now, you know?

fields.EN:
Yup! We're doing it because
we want to, that's all!
fields.JP:
うん！　私たちがやりたいから
やってるんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! We're doing it because
we want to, that's all!

fields.EN:
I see...
Thank you for your kindness,
Hikari, Mamoru.
fields.JP:
そうか……
ヒカリたちは、本当に優しいのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Thank you for your kindness,
Hikari, Mamoru.

fields.EN:
Um, if you happen to come across
small-sized weights, do you
mind bringing one to me?
fields.JP:
本当にたまたま見つけたらでいいんだけど、
小さくて軽いダンベルがあったら、
持ってきてくれない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, if you happen to come across
small-sized weights, do you
mind bringing one to me?

fields.EN:
Sure, but... you said you want
small-sized weights?
fields.JP:
別にいいけど……
小さくて軽いのでいいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, but... you said you want
small-sized weights?

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm not gonna use them
myself.
fields.JP: あたしが使うわけじゃないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm not gonna use them
myself.

fields.EN:
Oh? Well, okay.
If I come across one, I'll be sure
to bring one back.
fields.JP:
そうなのか？
とりあえず分かった
もし見つかったら持ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Well, okay.
If I come across one, I'll be sure
to bring one back.

fields.JP: 悪いね、こんな事頼んじゃって

fields.EN:
Not a problem at all.
Well, I'll be going.
fields.JP:
別に構わないよ
じゃあ、行ってくる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not a problem at all.
Well, I'll be going.

fields.EN:
Wow... This weight is surprisingly
light-weight! I guess this should
work for Kaede.
fields.JP:
うわ、このダンベル凄く軽い！
カエデの依頼はこのダンベルを
持っていけばいいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow... This weight is surprisingly
light-weight! I guess this should
work for Kaede.

fields.EN:
Hm, but if Kaede isn't going to
use it, who is it for?
fields.JP:
しかし、カエデじゃないなら
誰が使うんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, but if Kaede isn't going to
use it, who is it for?

fields.EN:
I found a small weight, but are
you sure this is what you want?
It's pretty darn light, you know?
fields.JP:
とりあえず見つけたから持ってきたけど、
これでいいの？　かなり軽いよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found a small weight, but are
you sure this is what you want?
It's pretty darn light, you know?

fields.EN:
Ooh, you found one?! Thanks!
Actually, the weight is perfect.
fields.JP:
お、持ってきてくれたの？　ありがとう！
むしろ、これくらい軽いほうが
ちょうどいいと思うし、大丈夫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh, you found one?! Thanks!
Actually, the weight is perfect.

fields.EN:
As long as you're fine with it...
So, who is it for? It's not for
you, right?
fields.JP:
ならいいけど……
それで、結局これは誰が使うんだ？
カエデじゃないんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you're fine with it...
So, who is it for? It's not for
you, right?

fields.EN:
Well... How about you come with
me and see?
fields.JP:
そうだね……なんならついてくる？
今から渡しに行こうと思ってるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... How about you come with
me and see?

fields.JP: じゃあ、お言葉に甘えて

fields.EN:
All righty!
To the Laboratory we go!
fields.JP: じゃ、行きましょう――研究室に
fields.LOCALIZED:
All righty!
To the Laboratory we go!

fields.EN:
See? It's so light-weight that
even you can use it. You need to
get some training in, Itsuki.
fields.JP:
ほら、これだけ軽ければ持てるでしょ！
イツキも身体鍛えないとダメよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? It's so light-weight that
even you can use it. You need to
get some training in, Itsuki.

fields.EN:
(Ah, so that's why she was
looking for a weights that weren't
that heavy and big...)
fields.JP:
（なるほど。イツキが使うから
　あんなに軽いのを探してきてくれって、
　言っていたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ah, so that's why she was
looking for a weights that weren't
that heavy and big...)

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan and the girls went through
the trouble of finding it, so just
give it a try.
fields.JP:
わざわざおつうちゃん達が
持ってきてくれたんだから、
とりあえず持ち上げてみなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and the girls went through
the trouble of finding it, so just
give it a try.

fields.JP:
はぁ……分かったよ
しょうがない

fields.EN: You've got to be kidding me?!
fields.LOCALIZED: You've got to be kidding me?!

fields.EN:
I'm not... like you!
I'm... a thinker...
I don't do... manual labor...
fields.JP:
僕は……頭脳労働専門なんだ……！
君といっしょにしないでくれ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not... like you!
I'm... a thinker...
I don't do... manual labor...

fields.JP:
えぇ……
あんたが弱すぎるだけでしょこれは……

fields.EN:
An order that needs me to go into
the tower... I better get myself
ready for this...
fields.JP:
監獄塔の中での依頼か……。
なにがあるかわからないから、
気を引き締めてかからないとな
fields.LOCALIZED:
An order that needs me to go into
the tower... I better get myself
ready for this...

fields.JP: あぁあ……あぅ、ううううぅ……っ

fields.EN:
I can hear a Nightmare moaning
from afar. We better get out of
here while we still can.
fields.JP:
うわ……っ、遠くでナイトメアが鳴いてる。
ここは早めに引いた方がいいかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can hear a Nightmare moaning
from afar. We better get out of
here while we still can.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(He's looking in the direction the
moaning is coming from? I wonder
what's bothering him.)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアの鳴き声が聞こえてきた
　方角を見てる……？
　なにか気になることでもあるのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's looking in the direction the
moaning is coming from? I wonder
what's bothering him.)

fields.EN: Hey, Jack? We better get moving.
fields.JP: おーい、ジャック。早く行くぞー
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Jack? We better get moving.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(He's strangely fixed on that
Nightmare... I wonder...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり気になってるみたいだ。
　なんなんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's strangely fixed on that
Nightmare... I wonder...)

fields.EN:
Okay, that should do it with the
order... Whew...
fields.JP:
よし、依頼の報告も終了、っと。
あー疲れた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, that should do it with the
order... Whew...

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, Jack's
reaction back there is a bit
concerning.)
fields.JP:
（……そういえば、あのときの
　ジャックの反応が引っかかるな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, Jack's
reaction back there is a bit
concerning.)

fields.EN:
(It seemed like he was interested
in that Nightmare's wail...)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアの鳴き声に興味を
　持っているように見えた。
　まるで真剣に耳を傾けているみたいに）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It seemed like he was interested
in that Nightmare's wail...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe Jack could understand
what the Nightmare was wailing
about...)
fields.JP:
（僕にわからなかっただけで、
　あの鳴き声の意味がジャックには
　ちゃんとわかっていたのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Jack could understand
what the Nightmare was wailing
about...)

fields.EN:
(If so, I wonder what that
wailing was trying to say?)
fields.JP: （あの鳴き声はなんて言っていたんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If so, I wonder what that
wailing was trying to say?)

fields.EN:
We need to go to the tower,
so we better be very careful.
fields.JP:
監獄塔での依頼だし、
普段以上に気をつけないとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to go to the tower,
so we better be very careful.

fields.EN:
I have a bad feeling about this
order... I can only hope I'm
going to be proven wrong.
fields.JP:
……それに、なにか胸騒ぎが
するような気がする。
なにも起きないといいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a bad feeling about this
order... I can only hope I'm
going to be proven wrong.

fields.JP: こんなのどーってことないんだぞ！
ナイトメア・ジャック
よかった。それじゃあ、行こうか

（！！　あのメルヒェン二匹、
　まだ生きて……！）
アリス、ハーメルン！　危ない！！
ナイトメア・ジャック

う……っ！
ジャックの意識が……！

fields.EN:
(Jack went in between the Marchen
and Alice?!)
fields.JP: （ジャックがアリスを庇った……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jack went in between the Marchen
and Alice?!)

fields.EN:
Hmph! What insolence!
This is price you pay for
scaring me like that!
fields.JP:
ふん、死にぞこないめ！
ワレをちょっとびっくりさせた罪は重いぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! What insolence!
This is price you pay for
scaring me like that!

fields.EN:
Urrh...
Hameln... Are you all right?
fields.JP:
はぁ、はぁ……。
ハーメルン、そっちは大丈夫だった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh...
Hameln... Are you all right?

fields.EN:
Not to worry! I personally made
sure they won't get up again!
fields.JP:
うむ、今度こそトドメを刺して
やったから安心するがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to worry! I personally made
sure they won't get up again!

fields.EN:
That was a close call.
Thanks...
fields.JP: ありがとう。助かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was a close call.
Thanks...

fields.JP: ジャック、わたしを庇ってくれたの……？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Yes... Thank you for protecting
me, Jack.
fields.JP:
ええ、あなたのおかげよ。
ありがとう、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Thank you for protecting
me, Jack.

fields.JP:
（でも今のジャックの位置からだと、
　手前にいたハーメルンのほうが
　近かったはずだ）

fields.EN:
(I guess that's how precious
Alice is to him...)
fields.JP:
（それなのに奥にいたアリスを
　助けるなんて、本当にアリスのことが
　大事なんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess that's how precious
Alice is to him...)

fields.EN:
That was quite something back
there, Jack. That was great seeing
you cover for Alice.
fields.JP:
ジャック、さっきは活躍したね。
アリスを守ってかっこよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was quite something back
there, Jack. That was great seeing
you cover for Alice.

fields.EN:
Curious, but you went in to
protect Alice instead of Hameln,
right?
fields.JP:
……ねぇ、聞いていいか？
あのとき手前にいたハーメルンより、
奥の方にいたアリスを助けたよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Curious, but you went in to
protect Alice instead of Hameln,
right?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Does that mean Alice is someone
special to you? And, that's why
you went in to protect her?
fields.JP:
やっぱり、君にとってアリスは
特別な存在ということ？
だから守ろうとしたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean Alice is someone
special to you? And, that's why
you went in to protect her?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Well, there he goes...
I was hoping he'd answer my
questions...
fields.JP:
……行っちゃった。
もっといろいろ聞きたかったんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, there he goes...
I was hoping he'd answer my
questions...

fields.EN:
(In any case, Alice must really be
special to Jack...)
fields.JP:
（なんにせよ、ジャックにとってアリスが
　特別ってことは確かなんだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In any case, Alice must really be
special to Jack...)

fields.EN:
(We'll be caught if we
head back now.)
fields.JP: （戻ると追いつかれてしまう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We'll be caught if we
head back now.)

fields.EN:
(The Nightmare is catching up
on us! We need to run!)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアが迫ってきている！
　逃げなくては！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Nightmare is catching up
on us! We need to run!)

fields.JP: （おつうちゃんを追わなきゃ！）

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime's Poison Bomb
destroyed the obstruction!
fields.JP:
白雪姫のポイズンボムで
行く手を遮る壁を破壊した！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White's Poison Bomb
destroyed the obstruction!

fields.JP: パーティーが合流した！
